name: 通州大运河
summaryEn: Tongzhou marks the northern end of the Grand Canal, and this scenic area follows about 12 km of the North Canal from the confluence of five rivers south to Gantang Bridge, with parks along both banks. At its northern end stand the 'three temples and a pagoda': a Confucian temple, the Daoist Ziqing Palace and the Buddhist Yousheng Temple, grouped around the 56-metre, 13-storey Randeng Pagoda that once told boatmen they were nearing Tongzhou. Further south are Canal Park and the large Grand Canal Forest Park, and sightseeing boats run on the canal.
description: 燃灯塔，位于北京市通州区西海子公园内、古运河西岸，是一座佛塔。该塔附近有佑胜教寺。1982年，列入北京市文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 北京（通州）大运河文化旅游景区
accessEn: In Tongzhou District, about 22 km east of Tiananmen; metro Line 6 runs to Tongzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 衡水湖
summaryEn: A freshwater lake and wetland reserve on the south side of Hengshui, with about 75 sq km of water plus marsh, mudflats, meadow and woodland; it is described as the second-largest freshwater lake on the North China Plain after Baiyangdian. More than 330 bird species have been recorded, with swans and geese wintering and autumn migration peaking in mid to late November, so it is best known for birdwatching and for cycling round the shore. The developed visitor area is on the north shore, in a former garden-expo park that now holds the Hengshui Ecology Museum.
description: 衡水湖，又称千顷洼、千顷洼水库，位于中国河北省衡水市市区西南，所属湖区为海河区，一级流域为海河流域，二级流域为滦河水系。现为中国国家级自然保护区及湿地和鸟类省级自然保护区。衡水湖面积共75平方公里，是华北平原中仅次于白洋淀的第二大淡水湖，也是华北平原惟一保持沼泽、水域、滩涂、草甸和森林等完整湿地生态系统的自然保护区。
officialName: 衡水市衡水湖旅游景区
accessEn: The north-shore park, where the museum stands, is about 10 km south of central Hengshui, and the reserve stretches south-west towards Jizhou; the ecology museum is closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 唐山南湖·开滦
summaryEn: Two linked parks in the middle of Tangshan: Nanhu, a lake park of nine lakes and five islands laid out on ground that sank after a century of coal mining, and the Kailuan National Mining Park beside it. The mining park has the Kailuan Museum, the zero-kilometre marker of China's first standard-gauge railway, a railway museum with a full-size replica of the 'Dragon' locomotive and an old mine shaft toured in miner's gear; its nationally protected core is the 1878 mine shaft, the railway's starting point and the Dadao road-rail underpass. Nanhu is for walking and cycling round the water, with a light-and-water show in the evening.
description: 唐山南湖，全称唐山南湖城市中央生态公园，位于中国河北省唐山市路南区，是唐山著名景区，2016年世界园艺博览会举办地。唐山南湖分为多个子湖，在津山铁路北侧，从北至南依次为桃花潭、龙泉湾、青龙泽、将军淀和含烟渡；在津山铁路南侧，从北至南依次为天鹅湖、雁鸭湖和荷花淀。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 唐山市南湖·开滦旅游景区
accessEn: Nanhu is in the south of central Tangshan (Lunan District), about 4 km south-west of the city's centre point, and the Kailuan mining park lies about 4 km to the north-east. The Kailuan Museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 洪洞大槐树寻根祭祖园
summaryEn: The park commemorates the Hongtong locust tree, remembered by families across northern and eastern China as the point of departure of the Ming-era resettlements from Shanxi, of which Ming records list 18 between 1373 and 1417. It is a modern park built around that memory, with a yearly ancestor-worship ceremony (the 36th, in April 2026, drew descendants from 18 provinces and cities), stage shows such as the Daming Qianminshu and a genealogy advice centre. The ancestor-worship customs are on China's national intangible heritage list.
description: 洪洞大槐树，又称古大槐树，山西大槐树，位于中国山西省临汾市洪洞县城西北二公里的贾村西侧的大槐树公园内，是明朝的一处移民基地。
officialName: 临汾市洪洞大槐树寻根祭祖园旅游景区
accessEn: It is on the northern edge of Hongtong county town, about 2 km from the town centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 金石滩
summaryEn: Jinshitan is a coastal resort area in Jinzhou district, approved by the State Council as a national tourist resort in 1992. It is known for sea-eroded sedimentary rock formations several hundred million years old, now protected in a national coastal geological park, along with the Golden Coast beach and Jinshi Garden. Other attractions include the Discovery Kingdom theme park, a wax museum and a life-science museum.
description: 金石滩国家旅游度假区是中国大连市金州区功能区之一，属国家级风景名胜区、国家级旅游度假区、国家5A级旅游景区、国家级地质公园，曾被CNN评价为中国40个最美景点之一。金石滩的陆地面积62平方公里，海域面积58平方公里。
officialName: 大连市金石滩景区
accessEn: On the coast in Jinzhou district, about 37 km east-north-east of central Dalian (about 48 km by road), and linked to the city by Dalian Metro Line 3 to Jinshitan station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 沈阳植物园
summaryEn: A 246-hectare garden in the Qipanshan area on the north-eastern edge of Shenyang, founded in 1959 and the site of the 2006 China Shenyang International Horticultural Exposition, which is why it is also called the Shenyang Expo Garden. Wooded hills hold about 100 display gardens in the styles of Chinese and foreign regions, a rose garden and a science hall, and the 125-metre Lily Tower, shaped like an opening white lily, is the garden's landmark.
description: 沈阳植物园，又称“沈阳世博园”，位于中华人民共和国辽宁省沈阳市浑南区双园路301号棋盘山旅游开发区，是2006中国沈阳世界园艺博览会的举办地，中国5A级旅游景区。沈阳植物园始建于1959年2月。
officialName: 沈阳市沈阳植物园
accessEn: In the Qipanshan area of Hunnan district, about 22 km east-north-east of Shenyang railway station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 长春世界雕塑公园
summaryEn: A landscaped sculpture park on the southern side of Changchun, laid out around lakes and opened in 2003, with works by sculptors from many countries set among the grounds. Several museum buildings stand inside, including a sculpture museum and a collection of Makonde wood carvings from East Africa. It makes an easy half-day outdoors, and in recent winters the park has also put on an ice-and-snow event.
description: 长春世界雕塑公园座落于吉林省长春市南关区人民大街9518号，是一座集东西方雕塑艺术与自然山水为一体的雕塑主题公园，是中华人民共和国建设部公布的第一批20个国家重点公园之一。2017年，长春世界雕塑公园景区被评为国家5A级旅游景区。
officialName: 长春市世界雕塑公园景区
accessEn: About 7 km south of central Changchun in Nanguan district, reached by taxi or local transport.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 六鼎山
summaryEn: Liudingshan is a large cultural tourism area on the southern edge of Dunhua, laid out around a lake. Its centrepiece is the Zhengjue Buddhist temple, whose halls climb the hillside in 20 terraces to a culture and art museum at the top with views over the town, and there is also a park on the Qing founding ancestors with a museum and a shrine hall. The grounds hold the Liudingshan tombs, a Bohai-period (698–926) cemetery of more than 80 stone-chamber and earth-mound tombs that has been a national heritage unit since 1961.
description: 六鼎山位于吉林延边。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 延边州六鼎山文化旅游区
accessEn: About 7 km south of Dunhua railway station in a straight line, with a direct shuttle from the station and trains from Yanji taking about 45 minutes.

name: 中共一大会址
summaryEn: The pair of two-storey shikumen lane houses on Xingye Road where the Chinese Communist Party held its first national congress in July 1921, with the downstairs room where the delegates met arranged as it was at the time. A new memorial hall next door, opened in June 2021, holds the main exhibition on the party's founding, and the delegates' lodgings at the former Bowen Girls' School, about 200 m away and part of the same listed site, opened to visitors in March 2026 after restoration. The 5A scenic area also includes the memorial halls of the Second and Fourth Congresses in Jing'an and Hongkou districts.
description: 中国共产党第一次全国代表大会会址，简称中共一大会址，位于中华人民共和国上海市黄浦区淮海中路街道兴业路76、78号，是并排两幢的两层石库门里弄房屋，中国共产党第一次全国代表大会于1921年7月23日至7月30日在76号楼下客堂间举行。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 中国共产党一大•二大•四大纪念馆景区
accessEn: In Huangpu District next to Xintiandi, a few minutes' walk from the Metro stations Site of the First CPC National Congress·South Huangpi Road (Lines 1 and 14) and Site of the First CPC National Congress·Xintiandi (Lines 10 and 13); the former dormitory must be booked in advance through the memorial's WeChat mini-program. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 春秋淹城
summaryEn: The earthworks of Yancheng, a walled town of the late Spring and Autumn period, form the core of this tourist area in Wujin: three rings of ramparts and three moats set one inside another, an arrangement rare among early Chinese city sites. A museum at the entrance presents the site and its finds. Around the ruins are a Spring and Autumn-themed amusement park and a wildlife park, which make up the rest of the 5A area.
description: 淹城遗址位于江苏省常州市武进区湖塘镇淹城行政村。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 常州市春秋淹城旅游区
accessEn: In Wujin District about 8 km south of central Changzhou, around 25 minutes by taxi; the Yancheng bus hub is a few minutes' walk south of the entrance.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天目湖
summaryEn: Tianmu Lake is a reservoir in the hills south of Liyang, built in 1958–61 as the Shahe Reservoir and renamed in 1992 when it was opened for tourism. The 5A scenic area has two parts: the Shanshui Garden on the lake, with lakeside parks and islands, and the Nanshan Bamboo Sea, a bamboo-covered valley on the Anhui border with walking trails and a cable car into the hills. The lake is known locally for its fish-head soup.
description: 天目湖，即沙河水库，是中国江苏省溧阳市境内的一座水库，位于戴溪河流域，建于1961年。水库正常库容为4900万立方米，集雨面积为148.5平方千米，海拔为21米。
officialName: 常州市天目湖景区
accessEn: The Shanshui Garden is about 12 km by road south-west of Liyang station on the Nanjing–Hangzhou high-speed line; the Nanshan Bamboo Sea is about 25 km south of the station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 周恩来故里
summaryEn: Zhou Enlai, the first premier of the People's Republic of China, was born in 1898 in this pair of Qing courtyard houses on Fuma Lane and lived here until 1910; restored in 1978 and opened in 1979, its 32 rooms show his birth room, family rooms, an old well and displays on his childhood. The 5A scenic area also takes in the Zhou Enlai Memorial Hall about 1 km to the north-east, opened in 1992 among artificial lakes, where an 800 m axis links the main hall, an exhibition on his life, a bronze statue and a copy of his Xihuating residence in Beijing's Zhongnanhai. The hearse from his 1976 funeral has been on display there since 2016.
description: 周恩来故居位于江苏省淮安市淮安区淮城镇中心镇淮楼西侧，系清咸丰年间，周恩来祖父周攀龙与其二哥从浙江绍兴移居江苏淮安做师爷时，购买了东西相连的2个宅院，共32间房屋，面积1960平方米。东院大门向东，位于驸马巷7号，西院门向南，临局巷。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 淮安市周恩来故里景区
accessEn: In the old town of Huai'an District, about 15 km south-east of central Qingjiangpu, by city bus or tram line 1; the residence and memorial hall still required advance real-name booking in 2024, so reserve before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 连岛
summaryEn: Jiangsu's largest island, joined to the mainland at Lianyungang port by a long sea wall, with wooded hills, the sandy Dashawan beach and the quieter Sumawan bay linked by a seaside boardwalk. Near Sumawan a Han-dynasty inscription cut into the rock marks the old boundary between the Donghai and Langya commanderies and is a national heritage site. The island was rated a national 5A scenic area in 2024.
description: 连岛也称东西连岛、鹰游山，位于江苏省连云港市北面，海州湾畔。面积7.57平方公里，森林覆盖率达80%。岛西端通过西大堤与大陆相连。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 连云港市连岛景区
accessEn: About 30 km north-east of central Lianyungang, around 40 minutes by taxi; the road crosses the sea wall from Lianyun district.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 金鸡湖
summaryEn: The lake at the centre of Suzhou Industrial Park, the modern district east of the old city, turned from a shallow marshy lake into a ring of waterfront parks and promenades under a landscape plan of 2003. Around it stand the Suzhou Culture and Arts Centre, the International Expo Centre and towers such as the Gate of the Orient, while the late-Qing Ligongdi causeway is lined with restaurants and a rebuilt Ferris wheel on the east shore reopened in 2025 as the Suzhou Eye. A footpath runs right round the lake.
description: 金鸡湖是位于中华人民共和国江苏省苏州市苏州工业园区的一个淡水湖，是中国面积最大的内城湖泊之一。湖面面积10768亩，水深平均2.5至3米，为一浅小湖泊，有河道与周围水系相通，湖心有大小两座人工岛。湖北面建有金鸡湖大桥，南面规划有金鸡湖隧道。
officialName: 苏州市金鸡湖旅游区
accessEn: About 5 km east of Suzhou's old city; several metro lines, including Line 1, stop near the shore.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 沙家浜·虞山尚湖旅游区
summaryEn: A two-part 5A scenic area in Changshu, a county-level city north-east of Suzhou. Shajiabang, on the reed marshes beside Yangcheng Lake, is the setting of the revolutionary opera Shajiabang, one of the 'model operas' of the Cultural Revolution about local resistance to the Japanese occupation, and has a revolutionary history memorial hall, the Hongshi folk-culture village, the old Hengjing street and a reed-marsh wetland park. Yushan, a long wooded hill that reaches into Changshu's old town, is a national forest park with old temples and tombs, and Shanghu Lake lies at its south-western foot.
description: 沙家浜镇位于中国江苏省常熟市东南部，距常熟市区10公里。沙家浜镇面积80.4平方公里，人口80656人。2019年被评为中国文化百强镇。
officialName: 苏州市沙家浜－虞山尚湖旅游区
accessEn: Shajiabang is about 40 km north-east of central Suzhou and 10 km south-east of Changshu by road; Yushan and Shanghu Lake are on the western edge of Changshu, about 15 km further on.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 云龙湖
summaryEn: A lake on the south-western edge of central Xuzhou, enlarged from low-lying ground into a reservoir and now the heart of a 5A scenic area, framed by green hills on three sides with Yunlong Mountain to the east. Paths, causeways, old-style bridges and pavilions run round the water, with peach blossom and willows in spring, lotus in summer, red maples in autumn and plum blossom in winter, and the Han Stone Relief Art Museum stands on the eastern shore.
description: 云龙湖，位于徐州南部，史称“石狗湖”，原为一低洼之地。后为解决水患将其扩建成水库，因位于云龙山脚下而得名，是江苏省级风景名胜区。波光浩渺，三面青山，景区内风光如画，文物古迹众多，旅游资源丰富，其中包括考古发现的“汉画像石”。
officialName: 徐州市云龙湖景区
accessEn: About 4 km south-west of the city centre; city buses and taxis run to several entrances round the lake.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南湖
summaryEn: Jiaxing's best-known lake, about half a square kilometre on the south side of the old city, has a garden island reached by boat whose Yanyu (Misty Rain) Tower, last rebuilt in 1918, so pleased the Qianlong Emperor that he had a copy built at his summer resort in Chengde. In early August 1921 the First National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party, after leaving Shanghai, held its final session on a pleasure boat on this lake, and a replica of the boat built in 1959 is moored at the island as the commemorated site. The South Lake Revolutionary Memorial Hall, in a building opened on the south shore in 2011, presents the party's founding.
description: 南湖旧称鸳鸯湖，简称鸳湖，又称马场湖、滮湖，位于浙江省嘉兴市城南，水域面积约41.6万平方米，水深约2到5米，与南京玄武湖、杭州西湖并称江南三大名湖。湖中有一湖心小岛，岛上有一烟雨楼，是赏湖观景的绝佳去处。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 嘉兴市南湖旅游区
accessEn: On the south side of central Jiaxing, about 1 km south of Jiaxing railway station and 8 km from Jiaxing South high-speed station; boats to the island leave from the lakeshore piers.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 双龙风景区
summaryEn: A national scenic area on the southern slopes of Mount Jinhua, about 8 km north of the city, rated 5A in 2024. Its best-known sight is the Double Dragon Cave: visitors lie flat in a boat to pass under a low rock from the outer cave, with old inscriptions, into the inner cave, whose rock folds are said to look like two dragons; nearby Binghu Cave has a large underground waterfall. The area also includes other karst caves and the Huang Daxian Ancestral Temple, the home temple of the Taoist immortal Huang Daxian, whose cult has spread overseas.
description: 双龙风景名胜区位于中华人民共和国浙江省金华市婺城区北部，金华山南麓，距金华市区约8公里，面积约1200多平方米，海拔520米，是国家级风景名胜区，2024年评为国家5A级旅游景区。景区分为双龙洞景区、黄大仙景区、尖峰山景区、大盘天景区、家园里景区、赤松山景区等六大景区，其中双龙洞景区、黄大仙景区已开发成熟。
officialName: 金华市双龙风景旅游区
accessEn: On the southern slopes of Mount Jinhua, about 10 km north of Jinhua railway station, roughly 20–30 minutes by taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 仙都
summaryEn: A valley of rock peaks along the Lianxi stretch of the Haoxi River north-east of Jinyun town, named "capital of immortals" by the Tang emperor Xuanzong; its emblem is Dinghu Peak, a 170.8 m stone pillar shaped like a bamboo shoot, from which the Yellow Emperor is said to have ascended to heaven. Riverside paths link Dinghu Peak, Little Red Cliff, the Xiandu Taoist temple, Niweng Cave and Zhutan Hill, and the cliffs and caves along the way, most densely around Niweng Cave, carry 123 inscriptions from the Tang to modern times, including work by Li Yangbing, Zhao Bian and Shen Kuo. Ceremonies honouring the Yellow Emperor are held here at Qingming and the Double Ninth festival.
description: 仙都，与黄山、庐山并列为轩辕黄帝的“三大行宫”，是位于中国浙江省丽水市缙云县仙都街道的一处国家5A级旅游景区，分为鼎湖峰、大洋等等景区。通常所说的仙都风景区指位于缙云县城东向北七公里的鼎湖峰景区，面积76平方公里。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 丽水市缙云仙都景区
accessEn: About 7 km north-east of Jinyun town; Jinyun West station on the Jinhua–Wenzhou high-speed railway is the nearest rail stop.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 溪口－滕头
summaryEn: Xikou, a town on the Shan stream below the Siming hills, is the home town of Chiang Kai-shek, and its protected Chiang family buildings include Fenghao House, the family residence he enlarged in the late 1920s, the salt shop where he was born in 1887, the house where his son Chiang Ching-kuo lived from 1937 and his mother's tomb. Above the town, Xuedou Mountain has waterfalls, cliffs, Chiang's Miaogaotai villa and Xuedou Temple, a Chan monastery founded in the Jin and linked with the cult of the Maitreya Buddha, with a giant bronze Maitreya statue. The scenic area also takes in Tengtou, an ecological model village about 10 km east of Xikou with gardens, orchards and a collection of old carved stone windows.
description: 溪口－滕头位于浙江宁波。游览特色包括瀑布、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 宁波市溪口－滕头旅游景区
accessEn: Xikou is about an hour by road south-west of central Ningbo, and Xikou station on the Ningbo–Jinhua railway, opened at the end of 2023, is about 7 km south-west of the old town; Tengtou lies about 10 km east of Xikou, near Fenghua.

name: 古田会议会址
summaryEn: The Liao clan ancestral hall in Gutian town, built in 1848 and later used as a school, where the Fourth Red Army held its ninth party congress on 28–29 December 1929 and adopted a resolution drafted by Mao Zedong that set the principle of party control over the army. The restored hall shows the meeting room and the offices used by Mao, Zhu De and Chen Yi. The 5A tourist area around it also takes in the Gutian Congress Memorial Hall, a museum opened in 1974, and nearby houses that served as the army's headquarters and political department.
description: 古田会议会址位于福建省龙岩市上杭县古田镇，1929年12月，毛泽东主持的中国共产党红军第四军第九次代表大会在此召开，通过了具有历史意义的《古田会议决议》。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 龙岩市古田旅游区
accessEn: In Gutian town, roughly an hour by road north-west of Longyan city; Gutian Huizhi station on the Ganzhou–Ruijin–Longyan railway serves the town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 井冈山
summaryEn: The mountain base where Mao Zedong's forces settled from October 1927 and where Zhu De's troops joined them in April 1928, now a scenic area of eight zones around the town of Ciping, including Huangyangjie, Longtan and the main peak. The farmhouses used as headquarters, residences and a hospital were burned after the Red Army left in January 1929 and were rebuilt to their original form after 1949; they can be visited at Ciping, Dajing, Xiaojing and elsewhere, among forested ridges that are in flower with rhododendrons in April and May. The national heritage listing of 1961, made under the old Ninggang county, also includes sites outside the scenic area: Maoping, Longshi and Gucheng in Jinggangshan City, Sanwan, Longyuankou and the county town in Yongxin county, and the county town of Suichuan.
description: 井冈山，位于中华人民共和国江西省西南部，地处湖南省江西省边界的罗霄山脉中段，属于江西省井冈山市，市府设立在厦坪镇。东连江西泰和、遂川两县，南邻湖南炎陵县，西靠湖南茶陵县，北接江西永新县。井冈山最高峰达到海拔2,120米，为中国的一个旅游景点。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 吉安市井冈山市井冈山风景旅游区
accessEn: Ciping, the main town of the scenic area, is about 100 km south-west of Ji'an.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 篁岭
summaryEn: Huangling is a hillside village of Ming and Qing Huizhou-style houses; its residents were moved to a new village at the foot of the hill, and the old houses were restored for visitors, with cable cars linking the two. It is known for terraces of rapeseed flowers in March and April and for the autumn custom of drying chillies, pumpkins and flowers on large bamboo trays set out on roofs and window ledges. The UN World Tourism Organization named it one of its Best Tourism Villages in 2023, and it became a national 5A scenic area in 2024.
description: 篁岭村是位于中华人民共和国江西省婺源县东北部江湾镇的一个村落，建立于明朝，是清朝官员曹文埴、曹振镛的家乡，是婺源县的旅游热点，以春季油菜花梯田花海和秋季的“晒秋”著称，建有15平方公里的篁岭景区。篁岭村开发采取异地搬迁模式，将当地居民迁至山下新村，山上古村开发成为景区，保留修缮百余幢明清徽派古建筑，供游客参观，或改为酒店、餐饮店等，山上与山下通过2条索道联系，全村年接待游客达150万人次。
officialName: 上饶市篁岭景区
accessEn: About 26 km east-north-east of Wuyuan town and about 8 km south-east of Jiangwan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 微山湖
summaryEn: The 5A scenic area covers about 77 sq km of Weishan Lake and its shore in Weishan County; the lake is described as the largest freshwater lake in northern China. It takes in Weishan Island, a stretch of the Grand Canal and the Weishan Lake National Wetland Park, where egrets gather in a bird forest in the evenings. Lotus beds flower in summer, and fishermen on the island have traditionally kept cormorants for fishing.
description: 微山湖位于中国山东、江苏交界处，归山东省微山县管辖。微山四湖南北长120公里，东西最宽处达25公里，水域面积达1266平方公里，是中国北方最大的淡水湖泊。狭义上，微山湖是指1960年在湖腰建成了拦湖大坝南的下级湖，同昭阳湖、独山湖和南阳湖构成广义微山湖。
officialName: 济宁市微山湖旅游区
accessEn: In Weishan County at the southern end of Jining prefecture, about 100 km south-east of Jining city centre; Weishan Island is about 20 km south-south-east of the county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 青岛奥林匹克帆船中心
summaryEn: Built for the sailing events of the 2008 Olympics, this harbour and promenade of about 45 hectares on Fushan Bay is now a waterfront leisure area, with marinas, a long breakwater walk known as Lovers' Dam and the Olympic Sailing Museum, whose two-storey building holds material from the 2008 Games. Signs are in Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean, and sightseeing boats have sailed onto the bay from the harbour. The 5A scenic area is run together with Qingdao Underwater World, an aquarium on the old-town seafront.
description: 青岛奥林匹克帆船中心于位中华人民共和国山东省青岛市黄海近岸的市南区浮山湾畔，原本为北海船厂的厂区，现时已改建为用于国际或国内赛事之用的帆船比赛场地。该中心投资达人民币33亿元，总用地面积达45公顷，并分为水上及陆上两部分，前者如两个防波堤、突堤码头和奥运纪念墙码头。
officialName: 青岛市奥帆海洋文化旅游区
accessEn: On Fushan Bay in Shinan district, about 6 km east of the old town; the west entrance is next to May Fourth Square. The Olympic Sailing Museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 刘公岛
summaryEn: Liugong Island is a pine-covered island of 3.15 km² at the mouth of Weihai Bay, the base of China's Beiyang Fleet in the 1890s and the place where the fleet was defeated in 1895, later used by Britain as a naval base. Visitors see the restored Naval Office, a war exhibition hall, the iron pier, gun batteries and museums on the island's history and the British lease. Its war sites form a national heritage unit and the island is a 5A scenic area.
description: 刘公岛是一个位于山东省威海港附近的岛屿，地处华东地区山东半岛东端威海湾湾口，岛面积3.15平方公里，岛岸线长14.95公里。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 威海市刘公岛景区
accessEn: Reached by ferry from the passenger terminal on Haibin Bei Road in central Weihai, a crossing of about 4 km, with the island about 6 km east of the city centre; check the official site for current sailings.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 白云山
summaryEn: A high forested part of the Funiu range in southern Song County, on the watershed of the Yangtze, Yellow and Huai rivers, protected as a national forest park and nature reserve. Its summit, Yuhuang Peak (2,216 m), is a sunrise and sea-of-clouds viewpoint, and the area has the Jiulong Falls, about 100 m high, pools, a granite 'little Huangshan' ridge and primeval forest. It became a 5A scenic area in 2011.
description: 白云山位于河南省洛阳市嵩县南部，属于伏牛山山系，此山因云多而奇、美而幻而得名。主峰玉皇顶海拔2216米。洛阳白云山景区是国家级森林公园、国家级自然保护区、国家5A级旅游景区、曾被评为中国十佳休闲胜地，景区总面积约为168平方公里。
officialName: 洛阳市白云山景区
accessEn: In southern Song County, roughly 3 hours by road south of Luoyang; the visitor centre is by the Baiyun Mountain exit of the Zhengzhou–Luanchuan Expressway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙潭大峡谷
summaryEn: A 12 km U-shaped gorge cut by the Qing River into purple-red quartz sandstone in northern Xin'an County, the core of the Wangwushan–Daimeishan UNESCO Global Geopark. The trail runs through narrow slot sections, past a chain of deep pools and waterfalls and rippled rock surfaces. It became a 5A scenic area in 2013.
description: 洛阳龙潭大峡谷位于河南洛阳市新安县北部，是一条由紫红色石英砂岩经流水追踪下切形成的U型峡谷，全长12公里，谷内嶂谷、隘谷呈串珠状分布，是国家5A级旅游景区。2006年8月18日，大峡谷接受联合国教科文组织世界地质公园评审专家的验收，被评为“世界上最美的峡谷”，9月18日被正式命名为“世界地质公园”；同年11月入选“洛阳市新八大景”。
officialName: 洛阳市龙潭大峡谷景区
accessEn: In Shijing, northern Xin'an County, about 70 km north-west of Luoyang by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 老君山·鸡冠洞
summaryEn: One of the main peaks of the Funiu range, renamed in the Tang after the legend that Laozi retired here to cultivate the Way; Taoist temples have stood on it since the Northern Wei, and three cable-car lines and a long ridge walkway lead up towards the Golden Summit, a cluster of Taoist halls on the crest. The joint 5A area also includes Jiguan Cave a few kilometres west of Luanchuan town, a limestone cave 5.6 km long, of which about 1.8 km of stalactite halls is open, at an even 18 °C year-round.
description: 老君山，位于中国河南省栾川县城东3公里处，为八百里伏牛山主峰，原名景室山，唐代因为相传老子曾到此归隐修炼而易名为老君山，主峰玉皇顶海拔2200米，山上的老君庙始建于北魏。2012年1月9日被中华人民共和国国家旅游局授予国家5A级旅游景区称号。
officialName: 洛阳市老君山－鸡冠洞旅游区
accessEn: The Laojun visitor centre is on the south-eastern edge of Luanchuan county town, roughly 2½ hours by expressway from Luoyang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 太昊陵
summaryEn: A vast temple-and-tomb complex to Fuxi (Taihao), the legendary first of China's Three Sovereigns, honoured here since at least the Tang and laid out in its present form by the Ming and Qing along an axis of about 750 m through nine courtyards and a succession of gates. The main Tongtian Hall enshrines Fuxi holding the eight trigrams, the Xianren Hall behind it honours Nüwa, and at the north end rises the earthen burial mound, 13.5 m high, round above and square below. From the second day of the second lunar month to the third of the third, a huge temple fair brings pilgrims, ritual dances and Huaiyang's black clay 'nini gou' toys; the 5A area also includes part of the town's Dragon Lake.
description: 太昊陵庙位于中华人民共和国河南省周口市淮阳区淮宁街道，是太昊伏羲氏的陵庙，第四批全国重点文物保护单位。太昊陵庙有明确记载的历史沿革可追溯至唐宋时期，明、清两代经过多次重建和扩修，逐渐形成现有的建筑格局，现存古建筑即明清时期的遗存。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 周口市太昊伏羲陵文化旅游区
accessEn: On the north side of Huaiyang old town, about 25 km north-east of central Zhoukou, around 40 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 嵖岈山
summaryEn: A granite massif on the eastern edge of the Funiu Mountains, a national geopark whose main scenic area of about 50 km² is crowded with weathered rock pinnacles, caves and small lakes carved from granite about 140–120 million years old. It was a filming location for CCTV's Journey to the West television series, and the scenic area has added a dry 'sky rafting' run nearly 2 km long, a moving walkway up the slope and a cliff-side slide.
description: 嵖岈山位于河南省驻马店市遂平县境内，于伏牛山东缘余脉，因山势嵯峨、怪石林立而得名，又名石猴仙山、嵯峨山，玲珑山，素有“天下第一奇山”、“中原盆景”和“北方石林”之美称，总面积约148平方公里，主景区面积约50平方公里，1987年被河南省确定为首批省级风景名胜区。
officialName: 驻马店市嵖岈山旅游景区
accessEn: About 30 km north-west of Zhumadian, around 40 minutes by car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 三峡大瀑布
summaryEn: A waterfall 102 m high and 80 m wide in a limestone canyon in northern Yiling district, the main one of more than 30 falls along the valley stream. A path lets visitors walk through the curtain of falling water, so expect to get wet; a via ferrata route along the cliff and a cliff-side café have been added in recent summers. The scenic area, rated 5A in July 2022, also includes Golden Lion Cave and the cave spring known as Lovers' Spring.
description: 三峡大瀑布，又名白果树瀑布，位于湖北省宜昌市夷陵区黄花乡新坪村，高102米、宽80米，为国家4A级旅游景区。
officialName: 宜昌市三峡大瀑布景区
accessEn: In Huanghua town, about 30 km north of central Yichang, with local buses from Yiling coach station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 花明楼刘少奇故居
summaryEn: The birthplace of Liu Shaoqi (1898–1969), president of the People's Republic from 1959 until he was purged in the Cultural Revolution, at Huaminglou in south-eastern Ningxiang. The family farmhouse, a brick-and-timber courtyard house of 1871 with about 20 rooms, was restored to its 1961 appearance and reopened in 1980 after Liu's posthumous rehabilitation, and the scenic area around it adds a memorial hall, a bronze statue square and exhibition halls. Mao Zedong's birthplace at Shaoshan is about 20 km away, so the two are often visited together.
description: 刘少奇故居，坐落在湖南省长沙市宁乡市花明楼镇，是已故前中华人民共和国主席刘少奇的诞生地。现已辟为长沙市主要旅游景点，第一批国家一级博物馆，是国家5A级旅游景区的花明楼景区重要构成部分。它距离韶山毛泽东故居20公里，距离宁乡市城区35公里。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 长沙市花明楼景区
accessEn: Roughly an hour by road south-west of central Changsha; Shaoshan is about 20 km further on.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 韶山毛泽东同志故居
summaryEn: The farmhouse at Shaoshanchong where Mao Zedong was born in 1893 and grew up: an earth-walled, U-shaped house of the central Hunan type, shared with a neighbouring family across the central hall, confiscated by the Nationalist government in 1929 and restored to its original form in 1950, with the family's bedrooms, kitchen and farm tools on show. It is the heart of the Shaoshan 5A scenic area, which also takes in the Mao Zedong Memorial Museum (opened 1964) with his personal belongings, the Mao clan ancestral hall and the Nan'an old village school, a square with a large bronze statue (1993), and Dishui Cave, a secluded villa compound built for Mao in 1960–62 about 4 km away, where he stayed in 1966. Shaoshan is one of the main destinations of Chinese 'red tourism'.
description: 韶山冲毛泽东同志故居又称韶山冲毛主席旧居，位于中国湖南省湘潭市韶山市韶山乡韶山村韶山冲上屋场。1893年，毛泽东在此出生。1929年，国民政府将其没收，迄中华人民共和国建立后，1950年方按原貌修复。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 湘潭市韶山旅游区
accessEn: About 40 km west of Xiangtan or 1.5 hours by road from Changsha; the main entrance is the visitor transfer centre at 1 Shaorun Avenue, from where shuttle buses run to the sites. The memorial museum's life exhibition is closed on Mondays except public holidays, while the former residence opens daily, its interior by advance booking.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 炎帝陵
summaryEn: One of four places in China honoured as the tomb of the Yan Emperor (Shennong), the legendary ancestor credited with farming and herbal medicine, at Luyuanpo in Luyuan town, Yanling County, beside the Mi River. A temple was first built here in 967 under the Song; its halls burnt in 1954 and were razed in the Cultural Revolution, then rebuilt in 1986–88, and the complex now spreads over a sacrificial hall, the mausoleum hall, a memorial garden and a stele forest on the hill. The memorial rites held here are on China's national intangible heritage list.
description: 炎帝陵位于湖南省株洲市炎陵县鹿原镇鹿原陂，是全国四座炎帝陵之一，故又称湖南炎帝陵、株洲炎帝陵、炎陵炎帝陵。是第四批全国重点文物保护单位、国家5A级旅游景区。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 株洲市炎帝陵景区
accessEn: About 15 km south-west of Yanling county town by road; Yanling is roughly 3 hours' drive south-east of Zhuzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 万绿湖
summaryEn: Guangdong's largest man-made lake, a reservoir of about 370 km² formed by damming the Xinfeng River just north-west of Heyuan, scattered with more than 360 green islands and known for its very clear water. Boat tours run from the visitor area to developed zones such as Longfeng Island, Shuiyue Bay and Jinghuayuan, and the Wanlü Valley resort lies on the southern shore. It became a 5A scenic area in 2024.
description: 新丰江水库又称万绿湖，位于中华人民共和国广东省河源市东源县，是一个以发电、防洪为主，兼有灌溉、供水、养殖等功能的大型水利工程，具有多年调节性能。坝址位于河源市区西北6千米处的新丰江下游亚婆山峡谷，距广州市约170千米。
officialName: 河源市万绿湖风景区
accessEn: The visitor centre and pier are on Wanlühu Avenue in Xingang town, Dongyuan County, about 8 km north-west of central Heyuan; Guangzhou and Shenzhen are each about 2 hours away by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 惠州西湖
summaryEn: A chain of five shallow lakes on the west side of old Huizhou, linked by causeways and bridges, which Su Dongpo named West Lake during his exile here in 1094–1097. He helped pay for the Su Causeway and the Xixin Bridge, and Gushan islet holds the tomb of his companion Wang Chaoyun and a Dongpo memorial hall; other sights include the Sizhou Pagoda, first built in the Tang, and the old Fenghu Academy. The 5A scenic area also takes in Honghua Lake in the hills to the south-west, and the West Lake shore paths make an easy walk from the city centre.
description: 惠州西湖是位于中华人民共和国广东省惠州市境内的一个城市浅水湖泊，是中华人民共和国国家重点风景名胜区、国家5A级旅游景区。惠州西湖景区面积为3.2平方公里，水体面积为1.68平方公里，其景观由“五湖六桥十八景”组成。
officialName: 惠州市惠城区惠州西湖旅游景区
accessEn: In Huicheng District, beside the old town of central Huizhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 华侨城
summaryEn: Nanshan's Overseas Chinese Town groups Shenzhen's best-known theme parks: Splendid China Folk Village, founded in 1988, with small-scale models of Chinese landmarks and full-size replica villages of China's ethnic groups where staged shows are held; Window of the World, opened in 1994, with miniature copies of world landmarks; and Happy Valley, an amusement park with roller coasters opened in 1998. The district around them also has the OCT Contemporary Art Terminal and the OCT Harbour waterfront.
description: 华侨城位于广东深圳。游览特色包括主题游乐、山谷、游乐体验。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
officialName: 深圳市南山区华侨城旅游度假区
accessEn: In Nanshan district about 10 km west of central Shenzhen, by Metro Lines 1 and 2 to Window of the World or Overseas Chinese Town stations.

name: 百色起义纪念园
summaryEn: A memorial park on Yinglong, Panlong and Houlong hills on the east side of Baise, set up in 2008 around the sites of the Baise Uprising of 11 December 1929, in which Communist forces led by Deng Xiaoping, Zhang Yunyi and Wei Baqun founded the Seventh Red Army. Its main sights are the Baise Uprising Memorial Hall, with exhibitions on the uprising and the You River base area, the uprising monument and the Youjiang ethnic history museum. In the old town by the river, the Cantonese guild hall of 1720 that housed the Seventh Red Army's headquarters and the three-storey Qingfeng Building of 1911, its political department, are also part of the park.
description: 百色起义纪念园位于广西百色。游览特色包括纪念展览、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 百色市百色起义纪念园景区
accessEn: On the eastern edge of central Baise, a short taxi ride from the centre; the Seventh Red Army headquarters in the old town on Jiefang Street is about 1.5 km to the west.

name: 大小洞天
summaryEn: A coastal scenic area at the foot of Nanshan hill in Yazhou district, named Da Xiao Dongtian, or 'Great and Little Cave-Heavens' (a Daoist term for sacred grottoes), in the Song dynasty. The Xiaodongtian rock inscriptions, dating from the Song dynasty to modern times, are protected at provincial level, and the grounds also hold the Sanya Natural History Museum.
description: 大小洞天，是中华人民共和国海南省三亚市崖州区海滨的一个重要景点，位于三亚市以西40公里处的南山脚下，景区全面积达22.5平方公里。内有三亚自然博物馆等景点。
officialName: 三亚市南山大小洞天旅游区
accessEn: In Yazhou district, about 38 km west of central Sanya, at the foot of Nanshan hill; the Nanshan Cultural Tourism Zone is about 6 km to the east.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 安仁古镇
summaryEn: Anren is a market town on the western edge of the Chengdu Plain, listed among China's historic towns in 2005, with well-preserved streets of traditional western Sichuan architecture. Its main sights are the Liu Family Manor, a sprawling landlord estate built by the Liu Wencai family from the late Qing onwards and now a national heritage site, and the Jianchuan Museum Cluster, a large private group of museums on 20th-century Chinese history. Between them they easily fill a full day.
description: 安仁古镇位于四川成都。游览特色包括博物馆、古镇、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1 天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 成都市安仁古镇景区
accessEn: About 42 km west of central Chengdu, roughly an hour by road.

name: 天台山
summaryEn: A forested mountain area in western Qionglai, protected as a national scenic area and forest park and included in the Sichuan Giant Panda Sanctuaries World Heritage Site. Trails follow the Jinlong River past shoals, cascades and waterfalls towards Yuxiao Peak, the main summit at 1,812 m. On warm evenings between late spring and autumn the valleys are known for large displays of fireflies.
description: 天台山位于四川省邛崃市西部，距离成都市区120公里，是国家级风景名胜区，国家森林公园，国家5A级旅游景区，同时也是世界自然遗产四川大熊猫栖息地的组成部分之一。
officialName: 成都市天台山景区
accessEn: About two hours by road south-west of Chengdu, via Qionglai.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 邓小平故居
summaryEn: The late-Qing farmhouse in Paifang village where Deng Xiaoping was born in 1904 now stands in a large landscaped memorial park about 6 km north of central Guang'an. Visitors see the family's rooms, the neighbouring Hanlin and silkworm-house courtyards, a statue of Deng and an exhibition hall of relics from his life. His old primary-school buildings in the city belong to the same protected site.
description: 邓小平故居又名“邓家老院子”，位于四川省广安市广安区协兴镇牌坊村。是中国党和国家领导人邓小平的祖居。1997年邓小平故居命名为全国爱国主义教育基地。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 广安市邓小平故里旅游区
accessEn: About 6 km north of central Guang'an, a short taxi or local bus ride; Guang'an has trains and expressway links to Chongqing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 朱德故居
summaryEn: The birthplace and childhood home of Zhu De, commander-in-chief of the Red Army and later one of the ten marshals of the People's Republic, in Linlang village, Ma'an town, Yilong County. The scenic area takes in the site where he was born in 1886, the farmhouse where the family later lived, a memorial hall on his life opened in 1982, and the Ding family manor, a large landlord's estate in the same village built between about 1906 and 1925.
description: 朱德故居位于四川省南充市仪陇县城东的马鞍场郊，建于1820年，目前是四川全国重点保护文物单位之一。1886年12月1日，朱德诞生地在此，后来被地主强迫迁离。1980年7月7日列为四川省人民政府重新确定公布的第一批省级文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 南充市朱德故里景区
accessEn: About 1.5–2 hours by road north-east of Nanchong city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 碧峰峡
summaryEn: A wooded valley in the hills north of Ya'an that pairs a gorge walk with the Bifengxia base of the China Conservation and Research Center for the Giant Panda. Walkways lead through two V-shaped gorges past dozens of waterfalls, while the panda base has received several pandas born in zoos abroad. The scenic area also includes a wildlife park.
description: 碧峰峡旅游景区位于四川雅安市雨城区碧峰峡镇，2020年1月7日被文化和旅游部确定为国家5A级旅游景区。中国保护大熊猫研究中心雅安碧峰峡基地位于景区内。
officialName: 雅安市碧峰峡旅游景区
accessEn: About 15 km north of central Ya'an, roughly 30 minutes by taxi or bus; Ya'an is about 1–1.5 hours from Chengdu by train or expressway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 赤水丹霞
summaryEn: Chishui is one of the six components of the "China Danxia" World Heritage site (inscribed 2010), a landscape of red sandstone cliffs, forested gorges and waterfalls around Chishui city. The main stop is the Great Waterfall (Shizhangdong), about 76 m high and 80 m wide and described as the largest waterfall on danxia terrain in China; the area is also known for dense bamboo forest and for tree ferns, a plant group that survives from the Jurassic. Plan about a day for the main sights, with the bamboo forest and the Sidonggou falls nearby.
description: 赤水丹霞地貌是指位于中国贵州省赤水市和习水县境内，主要包括赤水国家级风景名胜区十丈洞景区、赤水桫椤国家级自然保护区和赤水竹海国家森林公园，总面积约1300平方千米，是中国面积最大的一处丹霞地貌区。赤水丹霞在地质发育上属丹霞地貌青年早期。
officialName: 遵义市赤水市赤水丹霞旅游区
accessEn: The Great Waterfall is about 40 km by road south of Chishui city, under an hour's drive.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 普达措国家公园
summaryEn: A protected area of lakes, wetlands, forest and alpine meadow east of Shangri-La, inaugurated in 2007 as the first reserve in mainland China to be named a national park, within the Three Parallel Rivers World Heritage area. Park buses carry visitors from the entrance to forest-ringed Shudu Lake, which is circled by boardwalks. Bita Lake and the Militang meadow were closed to visitors after a central environmental inspection in 2017, and a park notice for 2026 still keeps the main part of Bita Lake and its lakeside boardwalk closed for conservation.
description: 云南普达措国家公园是一座位于中国云南省迪庆藏族自治州香格里拉市境内的国家公园。该国家公园拥有湖泊湿地、森林草甸、河谷溪流、珍稀动植物等丰富的生态资源，原始生态环境保存完好。普达措国家公园是中国云南省林业厅确立的第一个国家公园。
officialName: 迪庆州普达措国家公园
accessEn: About 22 km east of Shangri-La town, roughly 30–50 minutes by taxi or by the park shuttle bus from the town's bus station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 昆明世博园
summaryEn: The grounds of the 1999 Kunming International Horticultural Exposition cover about 220 hectares of wooded slopes in the north-eastern suburbs, next to the Golden Temple. The site keeps its exhibition halls, including a large greenhouse, along with themed gardens for tea, bamboo, bonsai, medicinal herbs, trees and vegetables, and dozens of gardens laid out by Chinese provinces and by other countries.
description: 世界园艺博览园简称世博园，是1999年昆明世界园艺博览会的主会址，位于中华人民共和国云南省昆明市盘龙区青云街道，与金殿公园依山相伴，植被覆盖率约80%，其中有120公顷灌木丛茂密的缓坡，水面占10％～15％。
officialName: 昆明市昆明世博园景区
accessEn: About 8 km north-east of central Kunming, around half an hour by taxi; World Horti-Expo Park station, the terminus of Kunming Metro Line 5, is by the entrance.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 壶口瀑布
summaryEn: The largest waterfall on the Yellow River, where the river is squeezed from a bed several hundred metres wide into a narrow rock trough and plunges into it in a roar of brown water and spray; the 'teapot spout' (hukou) shape gives the falls their name. This card covers the west-bank viewing area in Yichuan County, Shaanxi; the opposite bank belongs to Jixian in Shanxi, and the falls and their 5A rating are shared between the two provinces. The falls are widest in the summer flood season, and the Qilangwo Bridge below them links the two banks.
description: 壶口瀑布是黄河中游流经晋陕大峡谷时形成的一个天然瀑布。东为吕梁山脉南端的火焰山，临山西省临汾市吉县；西为黄龙山，临陕西省延安市宜川县壶口乡，距吉县县城西南约25公里。瀑布宽达30米，深约50米，最大瀑面为3万平方米。
officialName: 黄河壶口瀑布旅游区(陕西省延安市·山西省临汾市)
accessEn: On the west bank about 50 km east of Yichuan town, roughly an hour by road; the viewing area closes temporarily during flood peaks and ice floods, so check before travelling.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 乾坤湾
summaryEn: A great looping meander of the Yellow River in the Shanxi–Shaanxi canyon at Yanchuan, promoted as the 'first bend of the Yellow River' and part of the Yellow River Meanders national geopark. Viewpoints on the Shaanxi rim look down on the river curling around a spur of loess hills, with Shanxi on the far bank; the scenic area was raised to the national 5A rating in 2024.
description: 乾坤湾位于陕西省延安市延川县乾坤湾镇，国家4A级旅游景区，是黄河蛇曲国家地质公园的一部分，有“黄河第一湾”之称。
officialName: 延安市延川黄河乾坤湾景区
accessEn: About an hour by road south-east of Yanchuan town, or roughly 2.5–3 hours by road east of Yan'an.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 延安革命纪念地
summaryEn: The compounds where the Chinese Communist Party Central Committee lived and worked while it was based in Yan'an from January 1937 to March 1947 are spread across the city: the cave dwellings, offices and assembly halls of Yangjialing, where the party's Seventh National Congress met in 1945, Zaoyuan (Date Garden), Wangjiaping, Fenghuang Hill and the former Northwest Bureau. The Yan'an Revolutionary Memorial Hall at Wangjiaping, founded in 1950 and reopened in a new building in 2009, displays documents, photographs and relics from those years. On Pagoda Hill (Baota Shan) above the city stands a nine-storey Ming-dynasty brick pagoda, about 44 m tall, which became a symbol of Yan'an and of the Communist revolution.
description: 延安革命遗址位于中国陕西省延安市，包括凤凰山革命旧址、杨家岭革命旧址、枣园革命旧址、王家坪革命旧址等。是与中共中央相关遗迹。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 延安市延安革命纪念地景区
accessEn: In and around central Yan'an: the Memorial Hall and Wangjiaping are in the city centre, Yangjialing is about 2.5 km north-west and Zaoyuan about 7 km north-west, all easy by city bus or taxi; since December 2025 Yan'an has been about 70 minutes from Xi'an North by high-speed train.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天山大峡谷
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area and national forest park covering about 1,038 km² of the Tian Shan's northern slopes in Ürümqi County, at an average altitude above 2,000 m. It holds the most complete old-growth Schrenk's spruce forest on the north side of the range, meadows where Kazakh herding families live, and the Zhaobishan reservoir and wetland.
description: 天山大峡谷位于新疆乌鲁木齐。游览特色包括峡谷、湿地、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 乌鲁木齐市天山大峡谷
accessEn: About 50 km south of central Ürümqi, roughly an hour by road.

name: 慕田峪长城
summaryEn: Mutianyu is one of the best-restored stretches of the Great Wall within easy reach of Beijing: a run of Ming-era ramparts and closely spaced watchtowers following a steep, forested ridgeline. It draws far smaller crowds than Badaling, and a chairlift or cable car does the hard climbing for you, so your energy goes into walking from tower to tower.
description: 慕田峪长城是中国万里长城的其中著名一段，位于首都北京市怀柔区的军都山中，是明长城北京段的重要组成部分，也是北京旅游的一个胜地，2002年被评为4A级景区，2011年被评为国家5A级旅游景区，现仍有一部分尚未开发，不对游客开放。
officialName: 八达岭—慕田峪长城旅游区
accessEn: Allow about 1.5–2 hours each way by car from central Beijing; a hired driver, tour bus or hotel transfer is easiest, as public buses involve a change in Huairou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 故宫
summaryEn: Home to 24 Ming and Qing emperors, the Forbidden City is the world's largest surviving ensemble of historic wooden palace buildings, a procession of gates, marble terraces and golden-roofed halls laid along Beijing's north–south axis. The great ceremonial halls are only the beginning: the quieter side courts, the Treasure Gallery and the Hall of Clocks reward anyone who strays off the central line.
description: 故宫，又称紫禁城，是中国明清两朝二十四位皇帝的皇宫。故宫始建于明成祖永乐四年，以南京故宫为蓝本营建，永乐十八年落成。位于北京中轴线中心的故宫，占地面积72万平方米，建筑面积约15万平方米，有大小宫殿七十多座，房屋九千余开间。
officialName: 故宫博物院
accessEn: Take Metro Line 1 to Tian'anmen East or West and walk north through Tian'anmen; you enter by the Meridian Gate on the south side and leave by the north gate.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天坛
summaryEn: The Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, three tiers of blue-tiled roof on a white marble base, is one of the most recognisable buildings in China. The cypress-shaded park around it, several times the size of the Forbidden City, is at its best in the early morning, when locals gather for tai chi, ballroom dancing, choir practice and games of cards and Chinese chess.
description: 天坛，位于北京市东城区，是明清两朝皇帝祭天、祈谷和祈雨的场所。天坛始建于明成祖永乐十八年，原名“天地坛”，明嘉靖九年在北京北郊另建祭祀地神的地坛，并改名为“天坛”。天坛占地约273万平方米，是故宫面积的四倍，是现存中国古代规模最大、伦理等级最高的祭祀建筑群。
officialName: 天坛公园
accessEn: Metro Line 5 to Tiantan Dongmen stops right at the park's east gate, about 15 minutes by taxi from Tian'anmen.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 颐和园
summaryEn: In Beijing's north-western suburbs, the Summer Palace arranges halls, temples and pavilions around Kunming Lake and Longevity Hill in one of the great set pieces of Chinese garden design. Walk the painted Long Corridor, climb to the Tower of Buddhist Incense for the view, then cross the water by boat to the Seventeen-Arch Bridge.
description: 颐和园是清朝的皇家行宫和大型皇家园林，位于中国北京市海淀区西北，占地297公顷，主要由万寿山万寿山(北京)和昆明湖组成。颐和园修建于清朝乾隆年间，重建于光绪年间，曾属于清朝北京西郊三山五园之一。颐和园素以人工建筑与自然山水巧妙结合的造园手法著称于世，是中国园林艺术顶峰时期的代表。
officialName: 颐和园
accessEn: Take Metro Line 4 to Beigongmen for the North Palace Gate, or allow 30–60 minutes by taxi from central Beijing depending on traffic.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 承德避暑山庄
summaryEn: For much of the 18th century the Qing court spent its summers in this walled park in the hills north-east of Beijing, where lakes, pavilions, wooded slopes and an open grassy plain recreate landscapes from across the empire. Beyond the walls, the Eight Outer Temples include a scaled-down copy of Lhasa's Potala Palace and a hall built around a giant wooden statue of the thousand-armed Guanyin.
description: 承德避暑山庄及其周围寺庙是被联合国教科文组织评定为世界遗产时使用的登录名称。其中的避暑山庄又称“热河行宫”，是中国清朝的夏宫及现存最大的皇家园林，位于中国河北省承德市双桥区。避暑山庄包括清代皇室的夏季行宫以及依照西藏、蒙古、新疆的藏传佛教寺庙形式修建的寺庙，位于承德市中心区以北。
officialName: 承德市承德避暑山庄及周围寺庙景区
accessEn: High-speed trains from Beijing reach Chengde in about an hour; the resort and the outer temples are short taxi rides from the city centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 平遥古城
summaryEn: Pingyao is one of the best-preserved walled towns in China: a grid of grey-brick courtyard houses, temples, shopfronts and old banking halls enclosed by a Ming-dynasty wall more than 6 km around. Stay overnight in a courtyard inn, walk the ramparts at sunset and explore the back lanes after the day-trippers have gone.
description: 平遥古城，位于中国山西省晋中市平遥县，是中国现存的保存最完整的古代城市，也是能呈现出中国传统历史古城原来格局和风貌的唯一范例，19世纪到20世纪初期，平遥曾是当时整个中国金融业的中心。平遥具有近2800年的悠久历史，始建于西周宣王时期，现存古城建于明朝洪武年间，占地225公顷，整座城池宛如乌龟向南爬行，因此有“龟城”之称。
officialName: 晋中市平遥古城景区
accessEn: Pingyao Gucheng station, on the high-speed line between Taiyuan and Xi'an, is a short taxi or electric-cart ride from the walls; Taiyuan is under an hour away.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 云冈石窟
summaryEn: On the western edge of Datong, more than 250 caves and over 50,000 statues are cut into a low sandstone ridge. The largest Buddhas stand well over 10 metres tall, and one now sits open to the sky where the front of its cave fell away, making Yungang one of the great early landmarks of Chinese Buddhist art.
description: 云冈石窟位于中国山西省大同市云冈区云冈镇云冈村武州山南麓，主要建于北魏兴安二年到太和十九年间，是中国第一处由皇室显贵主持开凿的大型石窟。整个窟群分东、中、西三部分。东部的石窟多以佛塔为主，又称塔洞；中部“昙曜五窟”是云冈开凿最早，气魄最大的窟群；西部窟群时代略晚，大多是北魏迁都洛阳后的作品。
officialName: 大同市云冈石窟景区
accessEn: The grottoes are about 30 minutes west of central Datong by taxi or city bus; Datong is about two hours from Beijing by high-speed train.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 长白山天池
summaryEn: Heaven Lake fills the crater of Changbai Mountain, a volcano straddling the border with North Korea, its deep blue water ringed by jagged rim peaks. On the north slope, park buses and minivans climb to a viewpoint on the rim; lower down, the Changbai Waterfall pours from the lake's outlet and hot springs steam beside the path, where vendors sell eggs boiled in them.
description: 天池，又名龙潭、长白山天池，在朝鲜半岛称白头山天池，是中华人民共和国和朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的界湖，位于中国吉林省南部，朝鲜两江道北部。天池是长白山的火山口湖，为中国最深的湖泊，水面高度及面积都要远远超过新疆的天山天池。
officialName: 延边朝鲜族自治州长白山景区
accessEn: Erdaobaihe, the town below the north slope, has a high-speed rail station and Changbaishan Airport nearby; park buses climb from the north gate to the rim.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 泰山
summaryEn: First among China's Five Great Mountains, Mount Tai has drawn pilgrims for some 3,000 years. A stone stairway of thousands of steps climbs past temples, memorial archways and cliffs carved with calligraphy to Jade Emperor Peak at the top; many hikers set out in the dark to arrive for sunrise, while cable cars cover the upper section.
description: 泰山，是中国五岳之首，古名岱山，又称岱宗、天孙，位于山东省中部，泰安市境内，矗立在鲁中群山间；主峰玉皇顶，海拔1532.7米。泰山是中国第一批国家级风景名胜区之一，1987年获联合国教科文组织公布为世界文化与自然双重遗产，且符合世界遗产10种评定标准中的7种，和澳洲的塔斯曼尼亚荒野并列为符合最多标准的世界遗产。
officialName: 泰安市泰山景区
accessEn: Tai'an is on the Beijing–Shanghai high-speed line, about two hours from Beijing; from the station, a taxi or bus brings you to the Red Gate at the foot of the main path.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 曲阜三孔
summaryEn: Qufu was the hometown of Confucius, and its three great sites, the Temple of Confucius, the Kong Family Mansion and the Cemetery of Confucius, form one of China's grandest historic ensembles. The temple's halls rival an imperial palace in scale, while the cemetery north of town is a peaceful forest of ancient trees, stone figures and tombs.
description: 曲阜孔庙，是祭祀中国春秋时期的著名思想家和教育家孔子的本庙，位于孔子故里、山东省济宁市曲阜市曲阜城内，又称“阙里至圣庙”，始建于鲁哀公十七年，历代增修扩建，经两千四百余年而祭祀不绝，是中国渊源最古、历史最长的一组建筑物，也是海内外数千座孔庙的先河与范本，和相邻的孔府、城北的孔林合称“三孔”。
officialName: 济宁市明故城三孔旅游区
accessEn: Qufu East station is on the Beijing–Shanghai high-speed line, about two hours from Beijing; a bus or taxi takes around 20 minutes to the old walled town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 少林寺
summaryEn: Founded in 495 at the foot of Mount Song, the Shaolin Temple is revered as a cradle of Chan (Zen) Buddhism and the home of Shaolin kung fu. Catch a martial-arts performance, walk among the hundreds of brick tomb pagodas of the Pagoda Forest, and hike or ride the cable car into the Shaoshi peaks behind.
description: 少林寺，是位于中华人民共和国河南省郑州市登封市少林街道嵩山五乳峰下的一座佛寺，由于其坐落于嵩山腹地少室山的茂密丛林之中，故名“少林寺”。少林寺始建于北魏太和十九年，距今1500余年，是汉传佛教的禅宗祖庭，现属曹洞宗。
officialName: 郑州市嵩山少林景区
accessEn: The temple is about 15 km north-west of Dengfeng; Zhengzhou, the nearest major high-speed rail hub, is around 1.5 hours away by bus or car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙门石窟
summaryEn: On both banks of the Yi River just south of Luoyang, limestone cliffs are honeycombed with more than 2,000 caves and niches holding around 100,000 Buddhist figures, carved over roughly four centuries from the Northern Wei to the Tang. The centrepiece is the 17-metre Vairocana Buddha at Fengxian Temple, whose calm face is among the finest in Chinese sculpture.
description: 龙门石窟位于中华人民共和国河南省洛阳市南郊12公里处的伊水两岸的龙门山和香山崖壁上，主要开凿于北魏至北宋的四百余年间，至今仍存有窟龛2100多个，造像10万余尊，碑刻题记3600余品，多在伊水西岸。数量之多位于中国各大石窟之首。
officialName: 洛阳市龙门石窟景区
accessEn: The grottoes are about 13 km south of central Luoyang, a short taxi ride from Luoyang Longmen high-speed station, which is around 1.5–2 hours from Xi'an by train.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 兵马俑
summaryEn: Found by farmers digging a well in 1974, the Terracotta Army is a buried host of clay warriors, horses and chariots placed to guard the tomb of Qin Shi Huang, the first emperor of a unified China. In Pit 1, ranks of infantry stand in battle formation under a vast hangar-like hall, each figure with its own face, hairstyle and armour.
description: 秦始皇兵马俑，又称秦始皇陵兵马俑、秦陵兵马俑，是秦始皇陵东侧大型陪葬坑中出土的陶质军队群像，位于中华人民共和国陕西省西安市临潼区。兵马俑坑于1974年由当地村民打井时发现，随后展开考古发掘，现已确认一号、二号、三号坑等遗迹。
officialName: 西安市秦始皇帝陵博物院景区
accessEn: The museum is about an hour east of central Xi'an by taxi, or by tourist bus from the square outside Xi'an Railway Station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大雁塔
summaryEn: Rising above Da Ci'en Temple in southern Xi'an, this square, tapering brick pagoda has been a landmark of the city since the 7th century. The squares around it come alive at dusk, with a large musical fountain on the north side and the lantern-lit, Tang-themed promenade of Datang Everbright City stretching away to the south.
description: 大雁塔是位于中华人民共和国陕西省西安市雁塔区大慈恩寺内的唐代佛塔。唐永徽三年，玄奘为保存从印度带回的佛经和佛像主持建塔，初建塔为五层；此后经武周重建和历代修缮，形成现存七层方形砖塔。大雁塔与玄奘主持的佛经翻译事业相联系，是唐代长安佛教传播和中外文化交流的实物遗存。
officialName: 西安市大雁塔－大唐芙蓉园景区
accessEn: Take the metro to Dayanta station, or a 20-minute taxi ride from the city wall's South Gate.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 西安城墙
summaryEn: Xi'an's Ming-dynasty wall is among the best-preserved city walls in China, a broad brick rampart about 14 km around with gate towers, corner towers and a moat. Rent a bike on top and ride the full loop in a couple of hours, with old courtyards on one side and the modern city on the other.
description: 西安城墙是环绕陕西省西安市明清城区的城墙，现存主体建于明洪武年间。明代城墙利用隋唐长安城皇城及其后城垣的部分基础扩建而成，此后历代修缮，构成由墙体、城门、瓮城、敌台、角楼和护城河组成的城市防御体系。城墙平面近长方形，周长约13.74公里，围合区域约12平方公里。
officialName: 西安市城墙•碑林历史文化景区
accessEn: Climb up at the South Gate (Yongningmen), the grandest entrance, beside Yongningmen station on Metro Line 2.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 华山
summaryEn: The western of China's Five Great Mountains, Mount Hua is a cluster of granite peaks joined by stairways hewn into the rock. Cable cars do most of the climbing; the real thrill is walking the ridges between the summits and, for the brave, clipping into a harness for the Plank Walk in the Sky on the South Peak.
description: 华山，又名太华山，是五岳中的西岳。位于中华人民共和国陕西省渭南市华阴市城南，西距西安市区120公里。秦、晋、豫黄河三角洲交汇处，南接秦岭，北瞰黄河，扼西北进出中原之门户。
officialName: 渭南市华山风景区
accessEn: Huashan North station is about 30–40 minutes from Xi'an North by high-speed train; shuttle buses run from there to the visitor centre and the cable car stations.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鸣沙山月牙泉
summaryEn: Just south of Dunhuang the desert begins abruptly at Mingsha Shan, the 'Echoing Sand Mountains'. Tucked into a hollow between the dunes is Crescent Lake, a small spring-fed pool with a rebuilt pavilion on its shore; around it you can ride camels along the ridges, slide down the sand or climb the crest for sunset.
description: 月牙泉，古称渥洼池、沙井，又名药泉，自汉朝起即为敦煌八景之一，清代后称为月牙泉。鸣沙山月牙泉风景区位于中国甘肃省酒泉市敦煌市西南5公里处。
officialName: 酒泉市鸣沙山月牙泉景区
accessEn: The entrance is about 5 km south of central Dunhuang, a short taxi, bus or bike ride.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 张掖七彩丹霞
summaryEn: About 40 km west of Zhangye, the Qicai (Seven-Colour) Danxia scenic area is a landscape of sandstone ridges banded in rust, ochre, cream and pink. Shuttle buses link boardwalks and viewing platforms, and in the low evening light the colours deepen dramatically.
description: 甘肃张掖国家地质公园又称张掖世界地质公园、张掖七彩丹霞景区、张掖七彩丹霞旅游景区，位于中国甘肃省张掖市，规划面积322平方千米，为国家5A级旅游景区。2012年4月，“甘肃张掖丹霞地质公园”国家地质公园资格被国土资源部批准。
officialName: 张掖市七彩丹霞景区
accessEn: The scenic area is around 45 minutes west of Zhangye by taxi or tourist bus; Zhangye itself is on the high-speed line between Lanzhou and Ürümqi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 嘉峪关
summaryEn: Built in 1372 at a narrow point of the Hexi Corridor, Jiayuguan was the westernmost major pass of the Ming Great Wall, the last gate of the empire for travellers heading out along the Silk Road. Its restored fortress of gate towers and walls within walls stands on a bare gravel plain below the snow-capped Qilian range.
description: 嘉峪关位于甘肃省嘉峪关市峪泉镇嘉峪关村，是明长城西端的第一重关，也是古代“丝绸之路”的交通要冲。
officialName: 嘉峪关市嘉峪关文物景区
accessEn: The fortress is about 15 minutes by taxi from central Jiayuguan, a city on the high-speed line between Lanzhou and Ürümqi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 青海湖
summaryEn: At about 3,200 metres, Qinghai Lake is China's largest lake, a salty, sky-blue expanse ringed by grassland where Tibetan herders graze yaks and sheep. In July the shores glow yellow with rapeseed and cyclists ride the loop road, while migratory birds nest here in spring and summer (Bird Island itself is closed to visitors).
description: 青海湖，又称库库诺尔，在两语内意思均为“蓝湖”、“青湖”。古称西海、鲜水、鲜海、卑禾羌海等。位于中国青海省内青藏高原的东北部，是中国“最大的湖泊”，也是中国“最大的咸水湖、内流湖”，早期面积4236.6平方公里，有时因人为及气候因素而极遽减小但也有扩大情况，环湖周长360多公里。
officialName: 青海湖风景区
accessEn: The nearest shore, at Erlangjian, is about two hours' drive west of Xining; most travellers hire a car and driver or join a tour that continues to Chaka Salt Lake.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 喀纳斯湖
summaryEn: High in the Altai Mountains near the borders with Kazakhstan, Russia and Mongolia, Kanas is a long glacial lake whose colour shifts from jade to milky blue with the light. Boardwalks follow the river through larch and birch forest past Moon Bay and Fairy Bay, and the nearby villages of Kanas and Hemu are home to Tuvan herders who live in log cabins.
description: 喀纳斯湖，又译哈纳斯湖，是中华人民共和国新疆维吾尔自治区阿勒泰地区布尔津县禾木哈纳斯蒙古族乡境内的著名淡水湖，位于阿尔泰山脉中，面积45.73平方公里，平均水深120米，最深处达到188.5米，蓄水量达53.8亿立方米。
officialName: 阿勒泰地区喀纳斯景区
accessEn: Kanas Airport, in Burqin county with flights from Ürümqi, is about 1.5 hours by road from the Jiadengyu park gate (Burqin town is about three hours away); park buses take you on to the lake and villages.
imageCredit: Wang Xiaozhe and Meng Jie Taken in Jul. 2005
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天山天池
summaryEn: Lying at about 1,900 metres in the Tian Shan, Tianchi is a long, clear lake framed by dark spruce forest and the glaciated peaks of the Bogda range. Take a boat, walk the lakeshore paths or climb to a viewpoint, and look out for Kazakh herders' yurts on the summer pastures.
description: 天池，是天山山脉东段博格达山主峰博格达峰北麓处的一个冰碛湖，位于中华人民共和国新疆维吾尔自治区昌吉回族自治州阜康市南30公里，首府乌鲁木齐东45公里处，为著名旅游胜地。天池形状狭长，南北长约3公里，东西最宽处1.5公里，总面积4.9平方公里，湖面海拔1928米，湖最深处105米。
officialName: 昌吉回族自治州天山天池风景名胜区
accessEn: The scenic area is about 1.5–2 hours' drive from Ürümqi; buses run from the city to the gate, where park shuttles climb to the lake.
imageCredit: Caitriana Nicholson from 北京 ~ Beijing, 中国 ~ China
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 布达拉宫
summaryEn: Climbing in tiers of white and red walls up Marpo Ri, the Red Hill above Lhasa, the Potala Palace was the winter residence of the Dalai Lamas from the 17th century and is one of the great buildings of Asia. Inside, a one-way route climbs through chapels, assembly halls and gilded burial stupas, lit by butter lamps and filled with murmuring pilgrims.
description: 布达拉宫坐落在中华人民共和国西藏自治区首府拉萨市区西北的玛布日山上，是一座规模宏大的宫殿式建筑群，最初是吐蕃王朝第三十三代藏王赞普松赞干布兴建。于17世纪重建后，成为历代达赖喇嘛的冬宫居所，为西藏政教合一的统治中心。
officialName: 拉萨市布达拉宫景区
accessEn: The palace stands in central Lhasa, walkable from the Barkhor and Jokhang area; Lhasa is reached by air from major Chinese cities or on the Qinghai–Tibet Railway from Xining.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 明十三陵
summaryEn: Thirteen Ming emperors were buried in this valley in Changping district, about 40 km north of central Beijing, each in his own tomb complex. Start on the Sacred Way, lined with stone animals and officials, then visit Changling, the largest tomb, whose great hall stands on columns of nanmu (a prized hardwood), and Dingling, where you can walk through the excavated underground palace.
description: 明十三陵，坐落于中华人民共和国北京市昌平区十三陵镇的天寿山下40平方公里的小盆地，距离北京市中心约50公里，是明朝皇帝的墓葬建筑群。自永乐七年五月起用，直到安葬崇祯帝后结束，历时230多年，共葬有13位皇帝，23位皇后、2位太子、30余名妃嫔、1位太监，是全球保存最完整的皇陵墓葬群之一。
officialName: 明十三陵景区
accessEn: Take the Changping Line to Ming Tombs station, then a taxi or local bus for the last few kilometres to the Sacred Way, Dingling and Changling; a taxi from central Beijing takes about an hour.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 恭王府
summaryEn: A few minutes' walk from the Shichahai lakes, Prince Gong's Mansion is one of the best-preserved Qing-dynasty mansions in Beijing, now run as a museum. Walk north through its courtyard houses, some with exhibitions on the mansion's history, into the garden of rockeries, ponds and pavilions, and look out for the grand opera house.
description: 恭王府位于中国北京市西城区什刹海街道前海西街17号，是清朝后期恭亲王奕䜣的府邸及花园，现在是全国重点文物保护单位。恭王府花园在20世纪90年代作为旅游景点对外开放，而恭王府主体建筑也在2008年北京奥运会举办时修缮完毕，并向公众开放。
officialName: 恭王府景区
accessEn: Take Metro Line 6 to Beihai North, leave by Exit B and follow the signposted route through the hutongs to the museum's Gate 1, a walk of a few minutes, or take a short taxi ride from Tian'anmen.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 奥林匹克公园
summaryEn: At the northern end of Beijing's central axis, the Olympic Green was laid out for the 2008 Summer Olympics and used again for the 2022 Winter Games. Walk the plaza between the round National Stadium, nicknamed the Bird's Nest for its woven-looking steel frame, and the square National Aquatics Centre, or Water Cube, a pairing often said to echo the old Chinese idea that the sky is round and the earth is square. Stay until dusk, when both buildings light up.
description: 奥林匹克公园是位于中华人民共和国北京市朝阳区的体育园区，为2008年北京夏季奥运会与夏季残奥会、以及2022年北京冬季奥运会和冬季残奥会的北京赛区的核心区域。公园南起北土城东路，北至清河，东至安立路和北辰东路，西至林萃路和北辰西路，跨越北四环和北五环，总占地面积11.59平方公里，包括先前已经建成的国家奥林匹克体育中心和一座森林公园。
officialName: 北京奥林匹克公园
accessEn: Take Metro Line 8 to Olympic Sports Center, just south of the two venues, or Line 8 or 15 to Olympic Park at the north end; a taxi from central Beijing takes about 30–40 minutes, depending on traffic.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 圆明园
summaryEn: A couple of kilometres east of the Summer Palace, the Old Summer Palace (Yuanmingyuan) was the Qing emperors' main residence, a garden complex of lakes, islands and halls covering about 3.5 square kilometres, until its destruction in 1860. Today it is a park of open water and ruins: head first for the carved stone fragments of the European-style palaces (Xiyang Lou), designed with Jesuit missionaries for the Qianlong Emperor, then walk or take a boat around the lakes.
description: 圆明园是清朝兴建的大型皇家园林，康熙帝赐此园予皇四子胤禛，并提匾“圆明”。供清帝盛夏避暑、听政，处理军政事务，位于现今中华人民共和国北京市海淀区。与长春园，绮春园合称为“圆明三园”，占地面积3.5平方公里，建筑面积达16万平方米，约合5,200亩一百五十余景，有“万园之园”之称。
officialName: 圆明园遗址公园景区
accessEn: Take Metro Line 4 to Yuanmingyuan Park station, where Exit B leads to the South Gate, or allow 30–60 minutes by taxi from central Beijing depending on traffic.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 九华山
summaryEn: Mount Jiuhua is one of the four sacred mountains of Chinese Buddhism and the holy site of Ksitigarbha (Dizang), the bodhisattva who vowed to save beings from hell. Some 99 temples survive, clustered around the monastery village of Jiuhua Street and scattered over granite peaks linked by stone paths, cable cars and a funicular. It is a working pilgrimage mountain, so the incense, chanting and mountain views come together in a way few scenic areas manage.
description: 九华山位于中国安徽省池州市青阳县境内，为中国四大佛教名山之一，是地藏菩萨的道场。九华山山势雄伟，自然风光和人文景观融为一体，有“东南第一山”之称。
officialName: 池州市九华山风景区
accessEn: Take a high-speed train to Chizhou (then a bus of about 30–60 minutes to the mountain) or to Jiuhuashan station on the Chizhou–Huangshan line (opened April 2024), about 6 km from the visitor centre at Kecun; Hefei South to Jiuhuashan is under two hours by train. The mountain is about 40 km south-east of Chizhou, Chizhou Jiuhuashan Airport is close by, and direct coaches also run from Hefei and Nanjing in about three hours.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 琅琊山
summaryEn: Mount Langya is a range of wooded hills on the south-western edge of Chuzhou, rising to 321 m, made famous by the Song writer Ouyang Xiu. He governed Chuzhou in the 1040s and wrote 'The Old Toper's Pavilion' about the Zuiweng Pavilion in its valley (the present pavilion is Qing). Up the valley is Langya Temple, founded in the 760s, whose Beamless Hall, a Ming brick-vaulted hall with no timber beams, is national heritage, as are more than 400 cliff and stele inscriptions, seven of them Tang, around the temple and the Zuiweng and Fengle pavilions.
description: 琅琊山，位于安徽省滁州市西南郊，以山水秀丽著称。主峰小丰山，海拔321米，是国家森林公园、国家重点风景名胜区、国家AAAAA级旅游区，安徽省五大风景区之一。主要景点有野芳园、古梅亭、醉翁亭、让泉、洗心亭、琅琊古道、深秀湖、琅琊寺、南天门、会峰阁、同乐园、丰乐亭等。
officialName: 滁州市琅琊山景区
accessEn: The hills lie on the south-western edge of Chuzhou, a short taxi or bus ride from the city centre. Chuzhou has rail links with Nanjing, which makes Langya an easy add-on to a Nanjing trip.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 采石矶
summaryEn: Caishi Rock is the cliff-bound foot of Cuiluo Hill where it juts into the Yangtze on the south-western edge of Ma'anshan, counted first of the river's three famous rocks and long a strategic crossing. The hill is dotted with memorials to the Tang poet Li Bai, among them the Qing-dynasty Taibai Tower, a national heritage site, a Li Bai memorial museum and his cenotaph. Other sights include Sanyuan Cave, an art museum devoted to the calligrapher Lin Sanzhi and viewpoints over the river.
description: 采石矶位于中国安徽省马鞍山市西部的长江东岸，三国时更名采石矶；原名牛渚矶，为牛渚矶凸出长江而成。该处江面狭窄，形势险要，自古为江防重地，南宋绍兴三十一年江淮参军虞允文大败金兵于此，史称采石之战。相传为唐朝诗人李白酒醉捉月溺死处。
officialName: 马鞍山市长江采石矶文化生态旅游区
accessEn: Caishi Rock is on the south-western edge of Ma'anshan, about 8 km from the city centre by road, a short taxi or bus ride. Ma'anshan is about 20 minutes by high-speed train from Nanjing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 三河古镇
summaryEn: Sanhe sits where three rivers meet near Chao Lake, with lanes, bridges and canalside streets across a 4.7 km² scenic area. Some buildings are genuinely old, such as the Liu Tongxing shop-residence and the Yang family refuge, while much of the rest is new work in traditional style. It is a relaxed half-day out of Hefei, and a good place to try local rice dumplings and rice wine.
description: 三河镇位于安徽省合肥市肥西县东南部，古称鹊渚、鹊尾、鹊岸、三汊，面积4.71平方公里，人口3.1万。下辖8个居委会。2007年入选中国历史文化名镇，2015年获评国家5A级旅游景区。
officialName: 合肥市三河古镇景区
accessEn: Long-distance buses from Hefei run to Sanhe bus station, and the town is about 35 km south of the city, roughly an hour by road. From the bus station it is about a 10-minute walk to the old town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 徽州古城
summaryEn: Shexian's old town, Huicheng, was the seat of Huizhou prefecture from the Song to the Qing and is the core of the Ancient Huizhou Culture Tourism Zone, together with Tangyue, Tangmo, Chengkan and the Qiankou Ming houses. Gate towers, a prefectural yamen, merchants' lanes and a river dam sit within an easy walk, making it a good place to understand how Huizhou's merchant wealth shaped the region before you visit its villages.
description: 景区内可游览许国石坊、东谯楼、徽州府衙。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 黄山市古徽州文化旅游区
accessEn: Huicheng is about 25 km north-east of Tunxi by road, with buses and taxis between the two. Shexian North, on the same high-speed line as Huangshan North, is a taxi ride of roughly 15 minutes from the old town; from Huangshan North station allow a longer bus or taxi transfer.

name: 龙川
summaryEn: Longchuan is a Hu-clan village on the Dengyuan River, 11 km east of Jixi county town, where the Ming general and official Hu Zongxian was born in 1512. Its Hu Clan Ancestral Hall, founded in the Song, rebuilt in the Ming with funds raised by Hu Zongxian and restored in 1898, is known for more than 600 carved wooden panels. It is quieter than Hongcun and Xidi, and shows another side of Huizhou culture.
description: 龙川胡氏宗祠享有“木雕艺术博物馆”和“民族艺术殿堂”的美誉，被建筑专家称为“规模之大、时间之长、完整之好、装饰之美、天下第一”，1988年1月13日被国务院评为全国重点文物保护单位。胡氏宗祠始建于宋代，明代嘉靖年间胡宗宪倡导捐资修建，清光绪24年(1898年)再次大修，总面积达1564平米，集徽派砖、木、石三雕和彩绘于一体，尤以600多件木雕部件最为精湛。
officialName: 宣城市龙川景区
accessEn: Take a high-speed train to Jixi North station, then a local bus or taxi into the county and out to the village, about 15–20 minutes by road according to Chinese travel guides. Longchuan is about 11 km east of Jixi county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 苏州园林
summaryEn: Suzhou's classical gardens were built by retired officials and wealthy scholars as private worlds, where a pond stands in for a lake and a single craggy rock for a mountain. The Humble Administrator's Garden is the largest; the compact Master of the Nets Garden is a lesson in proportion. Walk slowly: every moon gate and lattice window is placed to frame a view.
description: 拙政园，是中国江南一座园林，位于江苏省苏州市姑苏区平江街道东北街178号，始建于明朝正德年间，初为御史王献臣改佛寺以建。它是中国园林的杰出代表，中国四大名园之一，亦是江南私家花园典范。拙政园1961年被国务院列为首批全国重点文物保护单位，1991年被国家计委、旅游局、建设部列为国家级特殊游览参观点，1997年被联合国教科文组织与其它数座园林一同列为世界文化遗产。
officialName: 苏州市苏州园林（拙政园－留园－虎丘）
accessEn: Suzhou is about half an hour from Shanghai by high-speed train. From Suzhou station, the main gardens are a short metro or taxi ride into the canal-laced old town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南京钟山风景区
summaryEn: Purple Mountain rises just east of Nanjing's Ming city wall, its wooded slopes holding some of the city's most important monuments. A broad stairway climbs to the white-walled, blue-tiled mausoleum of Sun Yat-sen, while nearby the tomb of the first Ming emperor is approached along a Sacred Way guarded by stone elephants, camels and lions. In autumn, plane trees and maples turn the whole hillside gold and red.
description: 中山陵，是中华民国国父暨中国国民党总理孙中山的陵墓，位于中国大陆江苏省南京市玄武区孝陵卫街道紫金山南麓，东邻灵谷寺、西毗明孝陵。孙中山于1925年3月在北平市逝世后，国民政府和中国国民党遵照他的遗愿，在南京为其修建陵墓。
officialName: 南京市钟山风景名胜区－中山陵园风景区
accessEn: Metro Line 2 runs from central Nanjing to the foot of the mountain in about 20 minutes, and sightseeing shuttles link the main sites. Nanjing itself is roughly 1–1.5 hours from Shanghai by high-speed train.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 西湖
summaryEn: Ringed by soft green hills and crossed by willow-lined causeways, West Lake has been painted and written about for more than a thousand years. Walk the bike-free Su and Bai causeways, take a boat out to the little islands, then climb into the Longjing tea hills above the western shore. It's a city park on a grand scale, and it rewards an unhurried pace.
description: 西湖位于中华人民共和国浙江省杭州旧城西侧，是中国大陆首批国家重点风景名胜区和中国十大风景名胜之一。中国主要的观赏性淡水湖泊之一。西湖东靠杭州市区，其余三面环山，面积约6.39平方千米，南北长约3.2千米，东西宽约2.8千米，绕湖一周近15千米。
officialName: 杭州市杭州西湖风景区
accessEn: Hangzhou is about an hour from Shanghai by high-speed train. In the city, Metro Line 1 to Longxiangqiao station leaves you a short walk from the eastern shore.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 乌镇
summaryEn: Wuzhen is a canal town of arched stone bridges, black-tiled houses built right over the water and narrow stone lanes beside canals still plied by wooden boats. Its West Scenic Zone has been restored with real care, and once the day-trippers leave, the lanterns come on and the canals turn to mirrors. Stay a night to see it at its best.
description: 乌镇镇位于中华人民共和国浙江省桐乡市，是江南著名古镇之一。镇域面积71.19平方公里，建城区面积2.5平方千米，总人口6万，镇区常住人口1.2万。乌镇景区已被评为中国国家5A级景区，是全国20个黄金周预报景点之一，现由中青旅运营。
officialName: 嘉兴市乌镇古镇旅游区
accessEn: Take a high-speed train from Hangzhou to Tongxiang (about 20 minutes), then a bus or taxi for the last half hour to Wuzhen. Direct coaches also run from Shanghai and Hangzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黄山
summaryEn: Huangshan is a cluster of sheer granite peaks topped with pines that grow sideways out of bare rock. Cable cars lift you from the foothills to the summit area, where stone stairways link the viewpoints and mornings often bring a sea of cloud pooling between the peaks. Spend a night on the mountain to see both sunset and sunrise.
description: 黄山位于中国安徽省南部黄山市境内，南北长约40公里，东西宽约30公里，山脉面积1200平方公里，核心景区面积约160.6平方公里，主体由花岗岩构成，最高处莲花峰，海拔1864.8米。黄山原名黟山，因峰岩青黑，遥望苍黛而名。
officialName: 黄山市黄山风景区
accessEn: Huangshan North station has high-speed trains from Shanghai, Hangzhou and Hefei. From there, buses take about an hour to Tangkou, the gateway town, where shuttle buses continue to the cable-car stations.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 宏村
summaryEn: Hongcun is a Huizhou village of white walls, black tiles and stepped 'horse-head' gables, set around a half-moon pond and a willow-fringed lake. Merchants' mansions hide intricately carved wooden halls and quiet courtyards, and stone channels carry water past almost every door. Morning mist over South Lake is the picture everyone comes for.
description: 宏村村是中华人民共和国安徽省黄山市黟县宏村镇的行政村，位于安徽省南部的黄山脚下，是一座有着大量明清时期历史建筑的古村落。村中还构建了完善的水系和颇具特色的“牛”形布局，是徽州民居的典型代表。2000年，包括宏村在内的皖南古村落在第24届世界遗产委员会上被列为世界文化遗产。
officialName: 黄山市皖南古村落－西递宏村
accessEn: Hongcun is about an hour by bus or taxi from Huangshan North station or Tunxi. It pairs naturally with nearby Xidi and a climb up Huangshan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 福建土楼
summaryEn: The tulou of southwestern Fujian are giant round and square houses of rammed earth, some with hundreds of rooms stacked around an open courtyard. Many are still lived in, with families cooking, drying tea and selling snacks under the wooden galleries. At Tianluokeng, a square tulou ringed by round and oval ones makes the classic view from the hillside above.
description: 田螺坑土楼群位于福建省漳州市南靖县书洋镇田螺坑村，由一座方楼、三座圆楼、一座椭圆楼组成，坐落在半山坡上，从附近山岗上的观景台俯瞰，仿佛“四菜一汤”；由山岗下的观景台仰望，依地形而建高低错落壮观别致。1996年田螺坑土楼群被列为第四批福建省文物保护单位，2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位，2003年田螺坑村被公布为首批中国历史文化名村，2008年作为福建土楼的典型代表被列为世界文化遗产。
officialName: 福建土楼（永定•南靖）旅游景区
accessEn: The Tianluokeng area is roughly 2.5–3 hours by road from Xiamen. Most travellers join a tour or hire a driver, and an overnight stay makes the trip far more relaxed.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鼓浪屿
summaryEn: Just across a narrow strait from downtown Xiamen, Gulangyu is a hilly island of winding lanes, former consulates and mansions built by Chinese families who made their fortunes overseas. With no cars allowed, it's an island for wandering, from shady back alleys up to Sunlight Rock and its view across the water.
description: 鼓浪屿是位于中华人民共和国福建省厦门市思明区西南方的一个小岛，行政区划为鼓浪屿街道，面积不到2平方公里，人口约2万。有“海上花园”之美称。除环岛电动车外不允许机动车辆上岛。
officialName: 厦门市鼓浪屿风景名胜区
accessEn: Visitor ferries leave mainly from Xiamen's Dongdu terminal and take about 20 minutes. Daily visitor numbers are capped, so book your crossing ahead with your passport.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 武夷山
summaryEn: The Wuyi Mountains are a landscape of red sandstone cliffs and rounded peaks reflected in the clear, looping Nine Bend River. Drift downstream on a bamboo raft, climb Tianyou Peak for the view over the bends, then follow the tea trails where mineral-rich 'rock tea' grows in narrow terraces between the cliffs.
description: 武夷山位于中国福建省武夷山市，1999年12月1日被联合国教科文组织世界遗产委员会列入“世界自然遗产和文化遗产名录”，是继泰山、黄山、峨嵋山－乐山大佛之后，中国第四个列入世界双重遗产的单位，是全世界35个双重遗产地之一。
officialName: 南平市武夷山风景名胜区
accessEn: Wuyishan has an airport and high-speed rail links to Fuzhou, Xiamen and Shanghai. The scenic area is about 20 minutes by taxi south of town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 庐山
summaryEn: Mount Lu rises abruptly from the plains between the Yangtze River and Poyang Lake, its summit often wrapped in cloud. Up top, the resort town of Guling is full of stone villas built by missionaries and foreign families escaping the summer heat, and trails lead out to waterfalls, temples and cliff-edge viewpoints.
description: 庐山，又称匡山、匡庐，位于中国江西省九江市南郊，是联合国教科文组织评定的文化遗产和世界地质公园，同时还是中国国家5A级旅游景区和文明旅游风景区、世界名山大会的发起者。庐山形成于第四纪冰川时期，是一座地垒式断块山脉，是中国自古以来重要的游览目的地。
officialName: 九江市庐山市庐山风景名胜区
accessEn: Jiujiang has high-speed trains from Nanchang, Wuhan and beyond. From Jiujiang or Lushan station, scenic-area buses wind up to Guling on the summit plateau in about 1–1.5 hours, or a cable car near the South Gate makes the climb in about 10 minutes.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 武当山
summaryEn: The Wudang Mountains are one of China's most sacred Taoist ranges, with Ming-dynasty palaces and temples strung along forested ridges up to the bronze Golden Hall on the highest peak. Taoist priests still live and train here, and martial-arts schools at the foot of the mountain teach visitors the slow, flowing forms of Wudang tai chi.
description: 武当山，本名仙室山，一名太岳山，一名太和山，又名譧上山，位于湖北省西北部丹江口市境内，武当山旅游经济特区即依此山而定名。汉江南岸，西北-东南走向，长260余公里，为大巴山脉东段分支，起自湖北、陕西两省边界，止于襄阳市南，隔汉江和大洪山遥对。
officialName: 十堰市武当山风景区
accessEn: Wudangshan has its own high-speed rail station, roughly 2–3 hours from Wuhan. From the town at the foot of the mountain, park buses carry visitors up to the cable car and summit trails.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黄鹤楼
summaryEn: Yellow Crane Tower stands on Snake Hill above the Yangtze in central Wuhan, its five tiers of yellow-tiled eaves visible across the city. The present tower dates from 1985, but the view from the top, over the river, the first Yangtze bridge and the three historic towns that make up Wuhan, is the real reward.
description: 黄鹤楼位于中华人民共和国湖北省武汉市武昌蛇山上，与湖南岳阳楼、江西滕王阁合称江南三大名楼，是中国国家旅游胜地四十佳之一。黄鹤楼被称为“天下绝景”，这一称谓源自宋徽宗的一幅画“天下绝景黄鹤楼”。始建于三国时代吴黄武二年，自初代开始，距今已有1800年历史，历代屡修屡毁，上一代为三层式，毁于1884年，黄鹤楼原址靠近江边，被选用为武汉长江公铁两用大桥的引桥起点，现在的黄鹤楼是于1985年异址重建的。
officialName: 武汉市黄鹤楼公园
