accessEn: Wuhan is a major high-speed rail hub linked to Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou and Xi'an. The tower is in Wuchang, a short taxi or metro ride from any of the city's main stations.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 德天瀑布
summaryEn: Detian Waterfall tumbles in wide white tiers over limestone ledges on the Guichun River, framed by karst hills and rice fields. You can take a bamboo raft almost into the spray, while the Vietnamese half of the falls pours down just across the river.
description: 板约瀑布位于越南高平省重庆县谭水乡，世界地质公园高平山水地质公园之内，距重庆县城20公里，距河内400公里，被视为“越南最雄伟和最美的瀑布”。板约瀑布处于中国与越南边境处，与中国的德天瀑布相连，德天-板约瀑布是世界第四大、亚洲第一大跨国瀑布。
officialName: 崇左市德天跨国瀑布景区
accessEn: Detian is about three to four hours by road from Nanning. Buses run via Daxin County, but many visitors hire a car and stay overnight nearby.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 九寨沟
summaryEn: Jiuzhaigou is a Y-shaped system of forested valleys in northern Sichuan, threaded with lakes of startling turquoise, cobalt and green. Waterfalls spill over mossy travertine terraces, and boardwalks lead from one lake to the next. Autumn, when the forests turn red and gold, is the most spectacular season.
description: 九寨沟风景名胜区，简称九寨沟，位于中国四川省北部阿坝藏族羌族自治州九寨沟县。域跨东经103°46'~104°4'；北纬32°54'~33°19'。因沟中有树正、荷叶、则查洼、盘信、黑果、盘亚助、故洼、彭布、尖盘九个藏族村寨而得名。
officialName: 阿坝州九寨沟景区
accessEn: Trains from Chengdu East reach Huanglong Jiuzhai station in about 1.5–2.5 hours, then it's roughly 1.5–2 hours by bus or taxi to the valley. Flights to Jiuzhai Huanglong Airport are another option.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 乐山大佛
summaryEn: The Leshan Giant Buddha sits carved into a red sandstone cliff, gazing across the meeting of the Min, Dadu and Qingyi rivers. A steep, narrow staircase beside the statue leads from its head down to its feet, where you can look up at its vast face. A short river boat ride gives the full view from the water.
description: 乐山大佛，全名嘉州凌云寺大弥勒石像，别称凌云大佛，位于中华人民共和国四川省乐山市市中区的岷江、青衣江、大渡河三江交汇之处，是世界上高度最高的石佛像。乐山大佛开凿于唐代开元元年，完成于贞元十九年，先后历经3位负责人，历时约九十年。
officialName: 乐山市乐山大佛景区
accessEn: High-speed trains from Chengdu reach Leshan in about an hour; then it's around 20 minutes by bus or taxi to the scenic area.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 峨眉山
summaryEn: Mount Emei is one of China's four sacred Buddhist mountains, rising from the Sichuan plain to more than 3,000 metres. Old stone trails link monasteries through forest and bamboo, while buses and a cable car lift visitors to the Golden Summit, where a gilded, many-faced statue of Samantabhadra looks out over a sea of clouds.
description: 峨眉山，亦作峨嵋山，位于中华人民共和国四川省峨眉山市境内，景区面积154平方公里，最高峰万佛顶海拔3,099米，佛教圣地华藏寺所在地金顶成为了峨眉山旅游的最高点。地势陡峭，风景秀丽，有“峨眉天下秀”之美誉。
officialName: 乐山市峨眉山景区
accessEn: High-speed trains from Chengdu reach Emeishan station in about 1–1.5 hours. Buses then run to Baoguo Temple at the foot of the mountain and on to the upper slopes.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 稻城亚丁
summaryEn: Yading Nature Reserve protects three holy peaks in the Tibetan highlands of western Sichuan, ringed by alpine meadows, larch forests and glacial lakes. Trails climb from Chonggu Monastery to Pearl Lake and, much higher, to Milk Lake and Five-Colour Lake beneath the glaciers. It's remote and high, and that is exactly the appeal.
description: 稻城亚丁景区，常被称为稻城亚丁，其中亚丁为藏语，意为“向阳之地”，是位于中国四川省甘孜藏族自治州稻城县的自然风景区。主体部分是坐落理塘河上游贡嘎银沟两岸、三座完全隔开，呈“品”字形排列的雪峰，三座雪峰分号名为“仙乃日”、“央迈勇”和“夏诺多吉”。
officialName: 甘孜州稻城亚丁旅游景区
accessEn: Daocheng Yading Airport, one of the highest in the world, has flights from Chengdu. From the airport or Daocheng town, it's roughly 2–3 hours by road to Shangri-La Town (Riwa), the gateway to the reserve.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黄果树瀑布
summaryEn: Huangguoshu is one of China's biggest waterfalls, plunging into a deep pool in a lush karst gorge in western Guizhou. A path leads into the Water Curtain Cave behind the falls, where you watch the torrent from the inside. The wider park also takes in the broad cascades of Doupotang and the rock gardens and streams of Tianxingqiao.
description: 黄果树瀑布位于中国贵州省安顺市镇宁布依族苗族自治县，是珠江水系打邦河的支流白水河九级瀑布群中规模最大的一级瀑布。瀑布高度为77.8米，其中主瀑高67米；瀑布宽101米，其中主瀑顶宽83.3米。黄果树瀑布号称“亚洲第一大瀑布”。
officialName: 安顺市黄果树瀑布景区
accessEn: High-speed trains from Guiyang reach Anshun in about 30–40 minutes, then it's under an hour by bus or taxi to the falls. Tourist buses also run direct from Guiyang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 丽江古城
summaryEn: Lijiang's old town, Dayan, is a tangle of cobbled lanes where clear streams fed by Black Dragon Pool run past wooden Naxi houses, shops and courtyard guesthouses. The centre is busy and commercial, but early mornings and the backstreets reveal its charm, and the nearby villages of Shuhe and Baisha are quieter places to explore by bike.
description: 丽江古城，位于中华人民共和国云南省丽江市古城区，1997年12月4日被联合国教科文组织列为世界文化遗产，并于2007年获亚太区文物古迹保护奖。
officialName: 丽江市丽江古城景区
accessEn: Lijiang's airport is about 40 minutes from the old town by taxi, and trains arrive from Kunming and Dali. The railway station is a short taxi ride from the old town's edge.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 玉龙雪山
summaryEn: Jade Dragon Snow Mountain's jagged, snow-streaked ridge rises straight above the Lijiang plain, close enough for a day trip. A cable car carries visitors up to a glacier viewing platform at over 4,500 metres, while lower down, the turquoise terraced pools of Blue Moon Valley and the meadows of Spruce Meadow offer gentler walks.
description: 玉龙雪山是云南省丽江市玉龙纳西族自治县的一个南北向山脉，位于横断山脉的沙鲁里山南段，海拔5596m。雪山山腰云腾雾绕，远望像一条银白色的巨龙，因此得名。为纳西族的神山和聚居地之一；纳西族人称雪山为“欧鲁”，意为“银色的山岩”。
officialName: 丽江市玉龙雪山景区
accessEn: The scenic area is about 30–45 minutes' drive north of Lijiang Old Town. Buses and taxis go to the visitor centre, where park buses link the cable car stations.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 石林
summaryEn: The Stone Forest is a vast field of grey limestone pinnacles, many taller than a house, weathered into blades, towers and narrow corridors. Paths loop through the Major and Minor Stone Forests, squeezing between rock walls and climbing to pavilions that look out over the whole maze.
description: 石林风景名胜区，常称路南石林或云南石林，位于中国云南省石林彝族自治县，1982年11月8日经中华人民共和国国务院批准为首批国家重点风景名胜区，其时法定名称为“路南石林风景名胜区”。
officialName: 昆明市石林风景区
accessEn: The Stone Forest is about 1.5 hours by bus from Kunming, or about 20 minutes by high-speed train to Shilin West station followed by a bus of around half an hour.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大足石刻
summaryEn: The Dazu Rock Carvings are a World Heritage group of Buddhist, Daoist and Confucian sculpture spread across hills around Dazu, with Baodingshan as the main draw. Along a horseshoe-shaped cliff, huge reliefs of the reclining Buddha, the hell scenes and the thousand-armed Guanyin read like a stone picture book of faith and everyday life. Beishan, an older and quieter group just north of Dazu town, makes a good second stop.
description: 景区内可游览大佛湾、千手观音、父母恩重经变。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
officialName: 大足石刻景区
accessEn: High-speed trains reach Dazu South from Chongqing West in about 30 minutes and from Chengdu East in about an hour, but the station sits some 37 km from the carvings, so allow another hour or more by city bus (lines 204/206 to Dazu bus station, then 205 to Baodingshan) or taxi. By road, central Chongqing is roughly 1.5 hours away.

name: 武隆喀斯特
summaryEn: Wulong's limestone landscape is part of the South China Karst World Heritage Site and is visited at three main places. The Three Natural Bridges are huge limestone arches linked by deep sinkholes and a river canyon, Furong Cave is a long cave of formations, and Fairy Mountain is a cool highland of forest and meadow. Together they make the best nature trip from Chongqing.
description: 武隆喀斯特分布于重庆市武隆区境内，分为天生三桥、箐口天坑和芙蓉洞三大片，有天生桥、天坑地缝、溶洞等立体喀斯特景观。这几大片区分别作为国家级、直辖市级风景名胜区并整体作为“重庆武隆岩溶国家地质公园”加以保护。
officialName: 喀斯特旅游区
accessEn: Since June 2025 the Chongqing–Xiamen high-speed line puts Wulong South station about 35 minutes from Chongqing East; from there, buses and taxis go to Fairy Mountain (roughly 40–50 minutes) and Furong Cave (about 30 minutes). The older Wulong station in town is on the Chongqing–Huaihua line, with buses on to the sights, and driving from central Chongqing takes about 2 hours.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 白帝城·瞿塘峡
summaryEn: Baidicheng is a hilltop temple and fortress complex on the north bank of the Yangtze at the mouth of Qutang Gorge, the first and narrowest of the Three Gorges. Since the reservoir rose it has been an island joined to the bank by a bridge, with a direct view of Kuimen, the rock gateway of the gorge that is pictured on the 10-yuan note. You come for the halls to Liu Bei and Zhuge Liang, the old city walls and the boat ride into the gorge itself.
description: 白帝城位于重庆市奉节县瞿塘峡口的长江北岸，位于奉节城东8公里，是长江三峡重要旅游景点。2006年5月25日公布为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。白帝城一面靠山，三面环水背倚高峡，面对瞿塘峡口，气势十分雄伟壮观。
highlights: 南宋城墙与瞿塘关烽火台
officialName: 白帝城•瞿塘峡景区
accessEn: Fengjie is about 2 hours by high-speed train from Chongqing North, on the Zhengzhou–Chongqing line. Baidicheng is on the north bank about 8 km east of the county town, reached by taxi, scenic-area bus or hired car; check current timetables on 12306.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 金佛山
summaryEn: Mount Jinfo is a flat-topped limestone massif in the Dalou Mountains, ringed by cliffs up to 300 m high and rising to 2,251 m at Fengchuiling. It was added to the South China Karst World Heritage Site in 2014, in the second phase of the listing, and is known for karst gorges, caves and an exceptional range of plants, with more than 4,700 seed-plant species. Cable cars lift you onto the plateau from both the north and west slopes, so it works as a long day trip or an overnight from Chongqing.
description: 金佛山是世界自然遗产，位于重庆南部南川区境内，属大娄山山脉，由金佛、箐坝、柏枝三山组成。金佛山主峰风吹岭海拔2251米，每年积雪期长达4个月之久，也是大娄山脉最高峰。在夏秋晚晴的时候，落日斜晖把层层山崖映染得金壁辉煌，如一尊尊金身大佛闪射出万道霞光，异常壮观而美丽，“金佛山”也因此而得名。
officialName: 金佛山景区
accessEn: Nanchuan is about 2 hours by road from central Chongqing, and Nanchuan North station is on the Chongqing–Guizhou intercity railway, opened in June 2025 (check 12306 for current trains). The North Gate is reached by bus from Nanchuan town in roughly 40 minutes, and the West Gate by bus from Nanchuan East bus station; a direct bus from Chongqing's long-distance station also runs to the mountain.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 四面山
summaryEn: Simian Mountain is a forested upland in southern Jiangjin, on a spur of the Dalou Mountains, with a scenic area of about 213 sq km at 1,000–1,500 m. It is best known for more than a hundred waterfalls, led by Wangxiangtai (Wangxiang Cliff), about 150 m high and 40 m wide, whose cliff-framed outline is likened to a heart. Lakes and wooded walks fill the rest of the area, and the whole place stays several degrees cooler than the city in summer.
description: 四面山位于重庆江津区四面山镇，属于云贵高原大娄山北翼余脉，距离重庆主城130公里，离江津城区90公里。四面山景区幅员面积213.37平方千米，海拔高度1000~1500米，主要有望乡台、土地岩、龙潭湖、洪海、珍珠湖等核心景区，共128个景点。
officialName: 四面山景区
accessEn: The park is about 130 km by road from central Chongqing, roughly 1.5–2 hours by car depending on traffic. In the June–October peak season a direct tourist bus has run from Chongqing's Longtousi bus centre; otherwise take a long-distance bus to Jiangjin and change to the Simian Mountain bus. Check current times locally, as they vary by season.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 清源山
summaryEn: A granite hill range on the northern edge of Quanzhou, protected as a national scenic area and scattered with shrines, hundreds of cliff inscriptions and Song–Yuan stone statues. Its emblem is the Laozi statue at the foot of the hill, a seated sage carved from a single natural boulder and a component of the Quanzhou World Heritage site. Paths climb past cliff shrines to a Song Buddha in a stone chamber of 1364 and a rare group of three Tibetan-style Buddhas carved in 1292.
description: 清源山位于中国福建省泉州市北郊，是国家重点风景名胜区、国家5A级旅游景区。清源山别称有“泉山”、“齐云山”、“北山”及“三台山”。清源山景区由清源山、九日山、灵山圣墓三部分组成，面积约62平方公里，地处福建省东南部，晋江下游东北岸，位于东经118°30'-118°37'，北纬24°54'-25°0'之间，与发展中的泉州市区三面接壤，距厦门市106公里，福州市196公里。
officialName: 泉州市清源山风景名胜区
accessEn: The scenic area begins on the northern edge of Quanzhou's city centre, about 3–4 km north of Kaiyuan Temple by city bus or taxi. Quanzhou is about 30–40 minutes by high-speed train from Xiamen and about 40–50 minutes from Fuzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 三坊七巷
summaryEn: Fuzhou's best-preserved old quarter is a grid of three lanes and seven alleys either side of pedestrianised Nanhou Street, keeping the walled-ward street plan laid out when the city walls were built in the late Tang. Behind high walls stand Ming-to-Republican courtyard houses of scholar-official families, several open to visitors, among them the translator Yan Fu's home on Langguan Alley and a mansion with Fuzhou's only waterside opera stage. The smaller Zhuzifang block, just east across Bayiqi Road, shares the national heritage listing.
description: 三坊七巷位于福建福州鼓楼区，是中国现存面积最大的城中心历史文化街区，以南北走向的南后街为轴，西侧为衣锦坊、文儒坊、光禄坊等“三坊”，东侧为杨桥巷、郎官巷、塔巷、黄巷、安民巷、宫巷、吉庇巷等“七巷”。
officialName: 福州市三坊七巷景区
accessEn: In central Fuzhou, a short walk from Dongjiekou or Nanmendou metro stations. On the fastest trains it is about 40 minutes from Quanzhou and about an hour from Xiamen to Fuzhou's stations (repo 12306 timetable), then a short metro or taxi ride to the old quarter.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 湄洲妈祖祖庙
summaryEn: Meizhou Island, off the coast of Putian, is revered as the birthplace of Mazu, the sea goddess whose worship spread along the Chinese coast, to Taiwan and across South-East Asia. The ancestral temple on Woniu Hill, first built in 987, was almost entirely destroyed in the Cultural Revolution and has been rebuilt and greatly enlarged since the 1980s with donations from worshippers in China and abroad, especially from Taiwan. The whole island is a 5A scenic area devoted to Mazu culture, with a beach beyond the temple.
description: 湄洲天后宫，原名神女祠、林孝女祠，1983年后称湄洲妈祖祖庙，位于中国福建省莆田市秀屿区的湄洲岛卧牛山，主祀天上圣母。始建于北宋987年，历代受朝廷诰封或战事兵燹等，屡次改扩建而奠定祠祀基础。1929年为避国民政府反封建反迷信运动波及，改作“林孝女祠”。
officialName: 莆田市湄洲岛妈祖文化旅游区
accessEn: By ferry from Wenjia Pier on the Xiuyu District coast, reached by bus or taxi from Putian city in about an hour; the crossing is short. Putian is a short high-speed train ride from Fuzhou (about 25 minutes on the fastest trains) or Xiamen (about 40 minutes).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 厦门园林植物园
summaryEn: Founded in 1960 around the Wanshi reservoir, this 4.91 km² garden climbs the slopes of Wanshi Hill close to central Xiamen. It is laid out in about 16 themed sections, from a rainforest area to cactus, succulent, palm and bamboo gardens and a large bougainvillea collection. Old temples such as Wanshilian Temple stand among the trees.
description: 景区内可游览松柏园、棕榈岛、多肉植物区。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 厦门市厦门园林植物园景区
accessEn: On Huyuan Road in Siming District, about 15 minutes' walk from Zhongshan Park station on Xiamen Metro Line 1; several city buses stop at the Botanical Garden stop. A south gate with an escalator opens towards Zengcuo'an.

name: 太姥山
summaryEn: Mount Taimu is a granite mountain rising above the sea south of Fuding, long the sanctuary of the local goddess Taimu Niangniang and, from the Tang dynasty on, a centre of Buddhism. Its draw is a forest of weathered peaks and pinnacles, caves formed among fallen boulders such as Seven Stars Cave, and mist that often drifts between the rocks with the sea beyond. It is part of the Ningde UNESCO Global Geopark, designated in 2010.
description: 太姥山位于中国福建省福鼎市境内，北距温州市150公里，南至福州市250公里，背山面海，是闽越、百越地区古老神祇太姥娘娘的道场，素以“山海大观”著称。它北望雁荡山，西眺武夷山，三者成鼎足之势。
officialName: 宁德市太姥山旅游区
accessEn: Taimushan railway station on the Wenzhou–Fuzhou line is the nearest stop, in Taimushan town beside the mountain; Fuding station is over 20 km away, so choose a train that calls at Taimushan. Fuzhou trains take roughly 1 hour 10 minutes to 1 hour 50 minutes depending on the service; Wenzhou is about half an hour from Fuding on the same line.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 白水洋·鸳鸯溪
summaryEn: This scenic area of about 66 km² in Pingnan county has five parts, Baishuiyang, Yuanyang Stream, Liugong Rock, Taibao Tower and Yuanyang Lake, and is built around volcanic-rock gorges and the 'shallow-water square', a flat bedrock riverbed (the largest of three sections covers about 40,000 m²) across which the stream spreads in an even sheet that you can wade through. Downstream, Yuanyang (Mandarin Duck) Stream is named for the ducks that winter there. Summer brings water games, kayaking and rock climbing, and it is part of the Ningde UNESCO Global Geopark.
description: 白水洋旅游风景区，位于福建省宁德市屏南县境内，2005年8月被评为中国国家地质公园，2010年与福安市白云山、福鼎市太姥山联合列为宁德世界地质公园。白水洋国家地质公园由白水洋、宜洋、水竹洋、棋盘顶和双溪五大景区组成，占地面积77.34平方公里，因其奇特的景观而被誉为“天下绝景，宇宙之谜”。
officialName: 宁德市（白水洋•鸳鸯溪）旅游景区
accessEn: Pingnan station on the Quzhou–Ningde railway has a few trains a day, about an hour from Ningde, but it is some 40 km (roughly 45 minutes) by road from the scenic area; Pingnan town is about 30 km from it. By car from Ningde city it is about 2 hours, so most visitors hire a car or join a tour.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 泰宁大金湖
summaryEn: Taining's 5A scenic area covers the Taining UNESCO Global Geopark, about 490 km² of mainly Danxia red-sandstone landscape. Part of it is inscribed as one of the six components of China Danxia, a UNESCO World Heritage Site listed in 2010. Its centrepiece is Dajin Lake, a reservoir filled from 1980 whose winding arms run between red cliffs, rock towers and gorges and are toured by boat.
description: 泰宁世界地质公园位于武夷山脉中段东南侧，主体部分隶属福建省三明市泰宁县。在原大金湖国家地质公园的基础上，扩大景区范围，于2005年2月11日通过联合国教科文组织的评审，正式升格为泰宁世界地质公园，为第二批世界地质公园。
officialName: 三明市泰宁风景旅游区
accessEn: Taining town has a railway station on the Xiangtang–Putian line; trains from Fuzhou take roughly 1 hour 45 minutes to 2 hours, and from Sanming North about 35–40 minutes. The lake lies west and south-west of the town, roughly 15 km by road to the main boat landings around Meikou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 冠豸山
summaryEn: Guanzhai Mountain is a cluster of sheer cliffs and rock pillars rising straight out of the plain about 1.5 km east of Liancheng town. It was shortlisted as a national geopark in 2009 and has long been a local holiday spot, with a summit of 661 m. Its zones include the main summit, Wulao Peak, Shimen Lake and the Zhu'an and Qishi stockades.
description: 冠豸山，旧称东田石，又称莲花山。位于中国福建省龙岩市连城县城东1.5公里处。冠豸山于1986年被评为福建省十佳风景区，1994年被确定为国家重点风景名胜区，2000年被评为国家4A级旅游景区。
officialName: 龙岩市冠豸山景区
accessEn: The mountain is about 1.5 km east of Liancheng town, a short taxi ride from Guanzhaishan railway station or Liancheng Guanzhaishan Airport. From Longyan, trains to Guanzhaishan stations take 40–60 minutes, or about 1.5 hours by road (roughly 105 km); Longyan is the usual gateway city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 麦积山石窟
summaryEn: A steep, haystack-shaped crag of red sandstone near Tianshui is honeycombed with nearly 200 Buddhist caves carved from the fourth century onwards and strung together by walkways clinging to the cliff face. Where Mogao is famous for murals and Longmen for stone carving, Maijishan is known for painted clay sculpture, with thousands of figures. It is part of the Silk Roads World Heritage Site, and far quieter than the big names of the Hexi Corridor.
description: 麦积山石窟是位于中国甘肃省天水市麦积区麦积镇草滩村麦积山的佛教石窟。所谓中国“四大石窟”，即甘肃敦煌莫高窟、河南洛阳龙门石窟、山西大同云冈石窟，加上重庆大足石刻或麦积山石窟。前四个都以自身单独登录世界文化遗产，麦积山则于2014年以“丝路廊道”33个地点组团式登录世遗。
officialName: 天水市麦积山景区
accessEn: Tianshui South is about 1.5 hours by high-speed train from both Lanzhou and Xi'an (the fastest trains take roughly 1 h 15 min); the grottoes lie about 35 km south-east of central Tianshui, roughly an hour by taxi or bus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 炳灵寺石窟
summaryEn: Bingling is a Buddhist cave site cut into red sandstone cliffs above the Yellow River, where the Liujiaxia Reservoir fills a deep gorge. Most visitors arrive by boat, which is half the pleasure. Around 216 numbered caves and niches hold some 815 statues and about 1,000 m² of murals in both Chinese and Tibetan Buddhist styles, and the 27 m Tang Maitreya is the figure everyone comes to see. It is part of the Silk Roads World Heritage listing of 2014, and the wider scenic area includes the Bingling Stone Forest of red sandstone pinnacles.
description: 炳灵寺石窟，位于中国甘肃省临夏回族自治州永靖县王台镇塔坪村的积石山大寺沟西侧的崖壁。西晋初年开凿在黄河北岸大寺沟的峭壁之上，正式建立于西秦建弘元年，上下四层。最早称为唐述窟，是羌语“鬼窟”之意，唐代称龙兴寺，宋代称灵岩寺，明朝永乐年后称炳灵寺，“炳灵”为藏语“仙巴炳灵”的简化，是“万佛”、“十万弥勒佛洲”之意。
officialName: 临夏州炳灵寺世界文化遗产旅游区
accessEn: From Lanzhou, go by bus or car to Liujiaxia or Yongjing town (about 1.5 hours), then take a boat to the Bingling dock from the dock beside Liujiaxia Dam or from Xiangyang dock near Yongjing; the crossing takes roughly an hour or more depending on the dock and vessel. The scenic area also lists a drive-in route via the Taping visitor centre, but boats are the usual way.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 崆峒山
summaryEn: Kongtong Shan, a forested spur of the Liupan range about 11 km west of Pingliang, is one of the sacred mountains of Taoism, with temples and shrines scattered over its crags. Taoist and Buddhist buildings share the slopes, from the walled Huangcheng ('Imperial City') complex to the stone stairway of the Shangtianti ('Ladder to Heaven'). It is a good stop between Xi'an and the Hexi Corridor for anyone who likes mountain hiking with history.
description: 崆峒山，古称空同山，位于中国甘肃省平凉市以西11公里处，属六盘山支脉，南北走向，长约100公里，平均宽15公里，主峰翠屏峰海拔2123米，垂直高度683米。相传广成子在此修炼得道，黄帝前来向他问道，崆峒山因而被称为“天下道教第一山”。
officialName: 平凉市崆峒山风景名胜区
accessEn: The mountain is about 11 km west of central Pingliang, reached by taxi or local bus from the city; Pingliang has rail and coach links to Xi'an and Lanzhou, so check current times.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 开平碉楼
summaryEn: Kaiping's diaolou are fortified multi-storey tower houses, most built in the early 20th century with money sent home by emigrants in North America and elsewhere. They mix Chinese forms with Greek, Roman and Islamic-style ornament. Four village groups, Zili, Majianglong, Jinjiangli and Sanmenli, were inscribed by UNESCO in 2007 out of some 1,800 towers still standing, and the area is also a 5A scenic area.
description: 开平碉楼与村落以碉楼及相关村落闻名于世，位于广东省江门市开平市的乡村，现存碉楼有1833幢。开平碉楼与村落于2007年评定为世界文化遗产，包括三门里村落迎龙楼、马降龙村落群、自力村村落与方氏灯楼、锦江里村落4处遗产地。
officialName: 江门市开平市开平碉楼文化旅游区
accessEn: High-speed trains from Guangzhou South reach Kaiping South in roughly 1.5 hours; the station is at Sanbu, the city centre, and Zili and Li Garden are about 12 km west in Tangkou, a taxi ride of around half an hour. Direct coaches from Guangzhou to Kaiping take around 2 hours.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 丹霞山
summaryEn: Mount Danxia is the place that gave its name to the 'Danxia landform': flat-topped peaks, sheer red cliffs and narrow ravines carved from Cretaceous red sandstone and conglomerate. It forms part of the China Danxia World Heritage Site, listed in 2010, and is also a UNESCO Global Geopark and a 5A scenic area. Hiking trails, a river cruise and cliffside temples make it an easy outdoor trip from Guangzhou.
description: 丹霞山位于中国广东省北部的韶关市仁化县，是丹霞地貌的命名地。丹霞山以白垩纪红色陆相碎屑岩形成的峰林、赤壁、石墙等地貌景观闻名，是中国南方湿润区丹霞地貌发育的典型区域。“丹霞”一名取“色如渥丹，灿若明霞”之意，形容山体红色砂砾岩形成的赤壁景观。
officialName: 韶关市仁化县丹霞山景区
accessEn: Take a high-speed train from Guangzhou South to Shaoguan (about 1 hour), then a direct tourist bus from Shaoguan or Shaoguan East station to the park's outer gate. Renhua is roughly 45 km, about an hour, by road north-east of Shaoguan city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 白云山
summaryEn: Baiyun Mountain is a forested range of more than thirty peaks on the northern edge of central Guangzhou, a scenic area since ancient times and a popular place for walks, climbs and views over the city. Paths and roads lead to Moxing Ling, the highest peak, the Mingzhu Tower area, Nengren Temple, a stele forest and Yuntai Garden near the main south gate, and a cable car rises from the visitor centre to the summit plaza. It is the easiest way to swap city streets for woods and cooler air.
description: 白云山号称“羊城第一秀”，位于广州市区北部，因为主峰摩星岭常为白云所掩，所以得名。白云山是广州著名的风景区，与广州市内穿过的珠江并称“云山珠水”。由30多座山峰组成，呈长方形，南北长9.7公里，东西宽4.5公里，总面积约28平方公里，为东北—西南走向。
officialName: 广州市白云区白云山景区
accessEn: The main south gate is on Guangyuan Middle Road, about 6 km north of the old city centre, reached by bus or taxi; there are many other gates around the mountain, and the south and west gates also admit vehicles.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 长隆旅游度假区
summaryEn: Chimelong is a privately run, commercial resort in Panyu that grew from a safari park opened in 1997. It now combines the Chimelong Paradise amusement park, Chimelong Safari Park, a water park, a bird park and the indoor Chimelong International Circus, with several hotels on site. It is a crowd-pulling day out rather than a cultural sight, and suits families with children; seeing the main parks takes two days or more.
description: 广州长隆旅游度假区位于中国广东省广州市番禺区大石街道，经营者是广东长隆集团。目前拥有长隆欢乐世界、长隆野生动物世界、长隆水上乐园、长隆国际大马戏、长隆飞鸟乐园五个主题公园及长隆酒店、香江大酒店七个项目。
officialName: 广州市番禺区长隆旅游度假区
accessEn: From central Guangzhou take Metro Line 3 or Line 7 to Hanxi Changlong station, then walk or take a shuttle bus to the parks. A taxi from the city centre takes longer, depending on traffic.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 西樵山
summaryEn: Mount Xiqiao is an extinct volcano of 72 peaks rising from the Pearl River Delta plain in Nanhai District, covering 14 km² and topped by the 346 m Dacheng Peak. Waterfalls, springs, caves and wooded paths make it a favourite escape for Guangzhou and Foshan. A 61.9 m seated Guanyin on Daxian Peak and the man-made caverns of the Shiyanyan quarry are the best-known sights.
description: 西樵山，是一座具有四五千万年历史的死火山，位于中华人民共和国广东省佛山市南海区的西南部，距广州市68公里，是国家重点风景名胜区、国家森林公园和国家地质公园。西樵山总面积14平方公里，共有72峰，主峰346米。
officialName: 佛山市南海区西樵山景区
accessEn: The mountain is in Xiqiao town, south-west of central Foshan and about 68 km from Guangzhou. Taxi or ride-hailing is the easiest way; direct coaches run from Guangzhou and Foshan bus stations, but routes change, so check a map app.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 七星岩·鼎湖山
summaryEn: Zhaoqing's 5A Star Lake scenic area has two parts: the Seven Star Crags, seven limestone peaks rising from the lakes beside the city centre, and Dinghu Mountain, a forested range about 15–18 km to the north-east. The two are separate sites with their own entrances: the crags are a lakeside day out of paths, boats and caves, while Dinghu is a hill walk through forest to waterfalls and a temple. The cliffs carry 531 inscriptions from the Tang dynasty onwards, most of them in Stone Chamber Cave, and Dinghu became China's first nature reserve in 1956.
description: 七星岩位于中国广东省肇庆市端州区中南部，景区有“五湖、六岗、七岩、八洞”之称。湖分五湖：仙女湖、中心湖、波海湖、青莲湖和里湖；岩有七星：阆风岩、天柱岩、蟾蜍岩、石室岩、阿坡岩、仙掌岩、玉屏岩。传说七星岩的七座山峰是女娲补天时留下的七块灵石。
officialName: 肇庆市端州区星湖旅游景区
accessEn: Zhaoqing East station is under an hour from Guangzhou South by high-speed train and lies in Dinghu District, east of the lakes. The Seven Star Crags face Paifang Square on the north side of the city; Dinghu Mountain is north-east of the crags, about 15–18 km and 30 minutes by road, or by intercity train to Dinghushan station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 罗浮山
summaryEn: Mount Luofu is a sacred Daoist mountain in north-western Boluo County, revered as the seventh grotto-heaven and 34th blessed land of Daoism, with 432 peaks rising to 1,296 m at Feiyun Peak and hundreds of waterfalls, springs and caves. Its best-known temple, Chongxu Guan, grew from a hermitage of the Eastern Jin alchemist Ge Hong and keeps halls rebuilt in the Tongzhi reign (1862–1874), with his alchemy furnace and herb-washing pool beside it. Huanglong Temple and a Ge Hong museum are among the other sights.
description: 罗浮山又名东樵山，是中国十大道教名山之一。它位于中国广东省惠州市博罗县的西北部，横跨博罗县、龙门县、增城区三地，总面积260多平方公里，和位于广东省佛山市境内的西樵山是姐妹山。罗浮山的主峰是飞云顶，海拔1296米。
officialName: 惠州市博罗县罗浮山景区
accessEn: The mountain is roughly an hour by road north-west of central Huizhou. Luofushan station on the Guangzhou–Shantou high-speed line (opened 2023) is about 9 km from the scenic area, with taxis or ride-hailing for the last stretch, so a day trip from Guangzhou is feasible.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 孙中山故里
summaryEn: Cuiheng is the village where Sun Yat-sen was born and spent his childhood, and its centrepiece is the two-storey house he helped design in 1892, Western-style in front with a traditional Chinese interior. Beside it a memorial museum covers his life and family, while restored village houses and fields show the world he grew up in. It is an easy half-day trip from Zhongshan, Zhuhai or Macau.
description: 孙中山故居纪念馆，位于广东省中山市南朗街道翠亨村内，成立于1956年11月，为国家一级博物馆、国家5A级旅游景区孙中山故里旅游区的核心景区之一。
officialName: 中山市孙中山故里旅游区
accessEn: From central Zhongshan, bus 12 takes roughly 30–40 minutes to Cuiheng. By rail, Nanlang station on the Guangzhou–Zhuhai intercity line is about ten minutes north by bus (the museum also lists buses to the former-residence stop); Macau lies roughly 30 km to the south.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 花山岩画
summaryEn: On a limestone cliff above the Ming River, ancient painters left a wall of red figures: squatting humans, bronze drums, swords, boats and running animals. You reach the panel by boat through quiet karst scenery, which is half the appeal. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and has been a 5A scenic area since December 2024.
description: 花山岩画是分布于中华人民共和国广西壮族自治区崇左市左江及其支流明江流域的涂绘类岩画遗存，以宁明县驮龙镇耀达村明江东岸的临江峭壁岩画最为集中，为“左江花山岩画文化景观”的核心点位。该岩画由岭南古代壮族先民骆越人绘制于战国至东汉时期，距今约有1800年至2500年历史，是中国乃至东南亚地区规模较大的古代涂绘岩画群之一。
officialName: 崇左市花山岩画景区
accessEn: The fastest way is the high-speed train to Ningming East, a new station on the Nanning–Pingxiang line that opened in December 2025 (about 65 minutes from Nanning at best); a tourist bus line, number 88, is listed between the station and the Huashan visitor centre, but check it still runs. Coaches from Nanning to Ningming take about three hours. Carry your passport, as there are border checkpoints on the roads near the frontier.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 两江四湖·象山
summaryEn: Guilin's old moats and rivers have been joined into one waterside loop of lakeside parks, bridges and the twin Sun and Moon Pagodas, all within walking distance of the centre. At the south end, Elephant Trunk Hill, the city's emblem, drinks from the point where the Taohua River meets the Li. It is the easy, in-town counterpart to the Li River cruise (see Li River & Yangshuo): you see the karst from the city rather than out in the countryside, and it comes into its own after dark.
description: 景区内可游览象鼻山、水月洞、日月双塔。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 桂林市两江四湖•象山景区
accessEn: Everything is in central Guilin: the lakes are a short walk from Central Square, and Elephant Trunk Hill is about 1 km south-east on Binjiang Road, reached by city bus or a short taxi ride. Guilin is linked by high-speed rail and air to Guangzhou, Nanning, Changsha and other major cities.

name: 靖江王城·独秀峰
summaryEn: A walled Ming-dynasty princely seat in the middle of Guilin, begun in 1372, with stone ramparts, gates and the carved terraces of its halls still standing. Inside rises Solitary Beauty Peak, a lone karst spire with 306 steps to a view across the city. Unlike the Li River cruise (see Li River & Yangshuo), this is a half-day of history in the city centre, with the Qing-era provincial examination hall and the peak's cliff inscriptions as its extras.
description: 靖江王府，又称靖江王城，位于广西壮族自治区桂林市秀峰区独秀峰下，是明朝靖江王一系在桂林的府第，也是明代藩王府遗址。王府始建于洪武五年，洪武九年主体工程基本形成，外围筑有独立的王城，内部沿南北轴线设置承运门、承运殿、王宫门和王宫等主要建筑，并设宗庙、社稷坛、斋宫及其他府属设施。
officialName: 桂林市独秀峰•靖江王城景区
accessEn: The palace is in central Guilin, about 800 m north of Central Square, a 10–15 minute walk or a short bus or taxi ride. The princes' tombs and their museum lie about 10 km east of the city at the foot of Yao Mountain and need a separate taxi trip.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黄姚古镇
summaryEn: Founded in the Song dynasty and most prosperous under the Qing Qianlong emperor, Huangyao sits among karst hills in Zhaoping County and is named after its two main clans, the Huangs and the Yaos. More than 300 Ming and Qing houses of grey brick and dark tile line its flagstone lanes, with ancestral halls, temples, an old opera stage, wells and small covered bridges over the stream. It is a calmer, more lived-in old town than the better-known ones, and the buildings around Baozhu Temple are now a memorial museum: in 1945 the Communist Party's Guangxi provincial working committee moved its offices here.
description: 黄姚镇，是中华人民共和国广西壮族自治区贺州市昭平县下辖的一个行政建制镇。2023年中国文化百强镇。位于昭平县东北部，离贺州市区40公里，离桂林市区200公里。
officialName: 贺州市黄姚古镇景区
accessEn: The town is about 40 km west of Hezhou; buses leave from Hezhou and take roughly an hour. From Guilin, the high-speed train to Hezhou takes about an hour to an hour and a half, then take the bus or a taxi; by road it is around three to four hours.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 涠洲岛南湾鳄鱼山
summaryEn: Weizhou is a volcanic island of about 25 km² in the Beibu Gulf, described as China's largest and geologically youngest, and protected as a national geopark since 2004. The 5A area covers Nanwan (South Bay), a harbour sitting in an ancient crater, and Crocodile Hill on the west side, where a coastal walkway passes a volcanic crater, a sea arch and black lava shore. Beaches, fishing villages and two French-built churches fill out an easy island stay.
description: 涠洲岛是一座位于广西壮族自治区北海市南方北部湾海域的海岛，是中国最大、地质年龄最小的火山岛。该岛位于北部湾中部，北临广西北海市，东望雷州半岛，东南与斜阳岛毗邻，南与海南岛隔海相望，西面面向越南。涠洲岛目前由北海市海城区管辖，设涠洲镇。
officialName: 北海市涠洲岛南湾鳄鱼山景区
accessEn: Take a ferry from Beihai International Passenger Port; the crossing takes roughly 1.5 to 3 hours depending on the vessel (zh Wikipedia; guides quote 70 to 110 minutes on the fastest boats). Beihai is about 1 to 1.5 hours by high-speed train from Nanning. On the island people get about by motor tricycle, minibus, bicycle or e-scooter, and a ring road of about 14 km links the main sights.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 青秀山
summaryEn: Qingxiu Mountain is a hilly park of 18 low ridges beside the Yong River in south-eastern Nanning, rebuilt as a scenic area from 1986 on an old forest farm. Its themed gardens include a millennium cycad garden, a large orchid garden, a rainforest garden and the China–ASEAN Friendship Garden, linked by a covered Friendship Corridor in the style of Dong wind-and-rain bridges. Paths also lead to the Guanyin Chan Temple and the Ming-style Longxiang Pagoda on the summit.
description: 景区内可游览千年苏铁园、兰园、雨林大观。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 友谊长廊与中国-东盟友谊园
officialName: 南宁市青秀山风景名胜旅游区
accessEn: South-east of central Nanning; the west gate is a short walk from Qingxiushan station on metro Line 3, and city buses serve the other gates.

name: 梵净山
summaryEn: Fanjingshan rises to about 2,570 m at the heart of the Wuling Mountains and has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2018, with relict forests and species such as the Guizhou snub-nosed monkey and the Fanjingshan fir that live nowhere else. It is also a Buddhist mountain, traditionally linked with Maitreya, and the walk takes in Mushroom Rock and the Old and New Golden Summits, with temples and shrines on and below the rock pinnacles. A shuttle bus and cable car from the east gate shorten the climb, but it is still a full day out.
description: 梵净山位于中国贵州铜仁市的印江县、江口县、松桃县交界处，为武陵山脉主峰，其主峰为凤凰山海拔高2,572米。原始生态保存完好，1982年被联合国列为一级世界生态保护区。2018年7月2日，在巴林麦纳麦举行的世界遗产大会上被列入世界自然遗产名录。
officialName: 铜仁市江口县梵净山旅游区
accessEn: High-speed trains from Guiyang reach Tongren South station in about 1.5 hours; the east gate in Jiangkou county is then about an hour by road. A west gate on the Yinjiang side is the mountain's other entrance.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 青岩古镇
summaryEn: A walled stone town founded in 1378 as a Ming military post and later a market town, with walls, gates, lanes and houses built of blue-grey stone, hence its name 'stone city'. Temples, archways, a Catholic church and the former residence of Zhao Yijiong, Guizhou's first civil-service top scholar, stand along its main street, and part of its old paving is a listed section of the Tea Horse Road. It is Guiyang's easiest old-town day trip and a good place for snacks.
description: 景区内可游览定广门、赵状元府、万寿宫。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 贵阳市花溪区青岩古镇景区
accessEn: In Huaxi district, about 30 km south of central Guiyang; the drive takes around 40 minutes outside rush hour, and taxis and ride-hailing run from the city.

name: 织金洞
summaryEn: Zhijin Cave is one of China's largest show caves, with passages and halls on a scale few visitors expect: some chambers more than a hundred metres across and stalagmites that rise like pillars. Over 12 km of cave has been surveyed, and a walking route takes in the best halls and formations. It is a UNESCO Global Geopark and a 5A scenic area, and it combines easily with the old town of Zhijin and the canyon nearby.
description: 织金洞，中国贵州省织金县境内的一个溶洞，位于距县城东北23公里的民寨乡，距贵阳市区166公里，已探明长度为13.5公里，面积70万平方米。该洞原名打鸡洞，1980年被织金县旅游资源勘察队发现。
officialName: 毕节市织金洞景区
accessEn: Zhijin Cave is about 23 km north-east of Zhijin town and roughly two hours' drive (about 160 km) from Guiyang; coaches run from Guiyang to Zhijin, then a local bus or taxi covers the last stretch. From Bijie it is a shorter run by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 万峰林
summaryEn: Wanfenglin is a plain of cone-shaped karst peaks south of Xingyi; the UNESCO geopark profile counts more than 20,000 of them. Roads and footpaths wind between the peaks past farmland and Buyi villages, and the area holds one of Guizhou's larger clusters of homestays. It sits within the Xingyi UNESCO Global Geopark, designated in 2024, and was rated a 5A scenic area in December 2024.
description: 万峰林景区位于中国贵州省黔西南布依族苗族自治州兴义市万峰林街道，是中国国家5A级旅游景区，总面积两千多平方千米。该景区属于中国西南喀斯特地貌。明代大旅行家徐霞客曾称誉万峰林：“天下山峰何其多，唯有此处峰成林”。
officialName: 黔西南州万峰林景区
accessEn: Wanfenglin is about 12 km south of central Xingyi by road, a short bus or taxi ride. Xingyi has an airport and, since 28 November 2025, a high-speed rail link from Xingyi South station to Guiyang North that the operator quotes at about 1 hour 56 minutes.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 百里杜鹃
summaryEn: Baili Dujuan is a mountain forest of wild rhododendrons on the Bijie plateau, with more than 60 species recorded and a thousand-year-old azalea 'king' among the trees. The 5A scenic area covers about 126 sq km and has two main parts, Pudi and Jinpo, linked by shuttle buses in the flowering season. Yi, Miao, Bai and other peoples live around it, and the cool summers make it a retreat from the heat as well.
description: 百里杜鹃位于中华人民共和国贵州省毕节市大方县，为国家AAAAA级旅游景区。总面积697.17平方公里，总人口15.08万人。拥有全世界最大的的原始杜鹃林带，马缨杜鹃、露珠杜鹃、团花杜鹃等44个高山常绿杜鹃种，年平均气温11.8℃，夏季平均气温19℃，辖区海拔1200—1800米，紫外线强度低，森林覆盖率达80%。
officialName: 毕节市黔西县百里杜鹃景区
accessEn: The district is in Dafang county, Bijie, about 45 km from Dafang town by road. Most visitors come by car or charter from Bijie or Guiyang (around two hours from Guiyang by road), and shuttle buses link the Pudi and Jinpo areas in the flower season.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南山文化旅游区
summaryEn: Nanshan is a large, modern Buddhist-themed park on the coast west of Sanya, built around Nanshan Temple and the Guanyin of Nanshan, a 108 m statue including its base. Gardens, halls, further statues and a longevity theme fill the grounds. It is as much a landscaped day out as a pilgrimage site.
description: 南山寺是一个佛寺，位于中国海南省三亚市。其名称源于“福如东海，寿比南山”。三亚南山寺有一尊高108米的南山海上观音圣像，于2005年建成。
officialName: 三亚市南山文化旅游区
accessEn: The zone is in Yazhou district, on the coast about 40 km west of central Sanya by road. A taxi or ride-hailing car is the simplest way; city buses also serve the zone.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天涯海角
summaryEn: Tianya Haijiao is a beach west of Sanya strewn with large boulders, several of them carved with the characters that made the place famous. In Chinese poetry the name means the farthest reaches of the world, so couples often come here, and on clear days islets can be seen offshore. It is an easy seaside walk of a few hours, and late afternoon gives softer light.
description: 天涯海角是中华人民共和国海南省三亚市的一处海滨风景旅游区，相传一对情侣只要一起走到天涯海角就可一生一世拥有对方，位于三亚市区西面24千米处。
officialName: 三亚市天涯海角游览区
accessEn: The site is on the coast about 18 km west-north-west of central Sanya. The Sanya–Ledong tourist railway has a Tianya Haijiao station, about 18 minutes from Sanya station; a taxi takes roughly 40 minutes and a city bus about an hour and a half.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 分界洲岛
summaryEn: Boundary Island is a small uninhabited island in Riyue Bay, a short ferry ride from the mainland pier. Its beaches and clear shallows make it one of the easier places on Hainan to try snorkelling, diving or a sightseeing submarine, and families can add ray encounters and an ocean theatre. It is a resort-style attraction, busiest in holiday periods, and has been rated 5A since 2013.
description: 分界洲是中国海南省陵水黎族自治县东北部海域中的一座岛屿，是牛岭向南海延伸塌陷地段。面积3.8公顷，海拔最高点为99.5米，距最近海岸约1.6海里。分界洲岛是海南岛重要的南北分水岭，以分界洲岛为界，南部地区季风性气候特征突出，干湿季节分明；而北部则是海洋性气候明显，雨量充沛。
officialName: 陵水县分界洲岛旅游区
accessEn: Most visitors come by road: the island is about 1.5 hours' drive from both Sanya and Haikou, and a ferry of about 10 minutes runs from the mainland pier. By high-speed train, get off at Lingshui and continue by shuttle or taxi to the ticket office.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 山海关
summaryEn: Shanhai Pass is the fortified gateway at the eastern end of the Ming Great Wall, squeezed into the narrow plain between the Yan Mountains and the Bohai Sea. The scenic area takes in the walled old town with its gate towers and Bell and Drum Tower, Mengjiangnü Temple, and, some kilometres south, Laolongtou ('Old Dragon's Head'), where the wall runs out into the water. Much of what you see has been rebuilt since the 1980s, so expect a mix of original and restored work.
description: 山海关位于中华人民共和国河北省秦皇岛市山海关区与辽宁省葫芦岛市绥中县的边界附近，又名渝关、临闾关、榆关。山海关位于燕山和渤海之间，是明长城最东端的关隘，故而被称为“天下第一关”。此处早在战国时期就曾修筑有长城，明洪武十四年修筑现有关隘，自此山海关成为地理分界，该关口以东区域被称为“关外”。
officialName: 秦皇岛市山海关景区
accessEn: Shanhaiguan railway station, on the Beijing–Harbin line, is about 1.4 km from the old town; Qinhuangdao station is about 17 km south-west (around 23 km by road), so check 12306 for the train that suits you. Laolongtou is about 6 km south-east of the old town, reached by city bus or taxi; check the current bus number locally.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 金山岭长城
summaryEn: Jinshanling is a 10.5 km stretch of Ming-dynasty Great Wall on the Hebei–Beijing border, with five passes, 67 watchtowers and three beacon towers. The western end has been restored, while the stretch towards Simatai, which continues east into Beijing, is more weathered. Visitors walk the ridge path between towers, and it is a favourite place for sunrise views and photography.
description: 金山岭长城是中国河北省承德市滦平县与北京市密云区交界地带的燕山支脉——金山岭上横亘的一段长城。建于明代，西起古北口，东至望京楼，全长10.5公里，有关隘5处，敌楼67座，烽燧3座。此外，金山岭长城砖垛口东方台是中国中央电视台早间开台时播放的国歌视频中长城的拍摄地。
officialName: 承德市金山岭长城景区
accessEn: Jinshanling is in Luanping County, about 67 km south-west of central Chengde and about 113 km north-east of central Beijing, and is reached by road: day-tour vehicles from Beijing take roughly 2 to 3 hours each way depending on traffic, or you can hire a car from Chengde. There is no rail station at the wall.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 清东陵
summaryEn: The Eastern Qing Tombs are the burial ground of five Qing emperors (Shunzhi, Kangxi, Qianlong, Xianfeng and Tongzhi), 15 empresses and 136 imperial concubines, spread over about 80 square kilometres of hills around Changrui Mountain. Visitors walk stone-lined spirit ways past archways, bridges and carved guardian figures to the halls of several tombs, and can go down into the underground chambers of Qianlong's Yuling and of Empress Dowager Cixi's Ding Dongling. It is generally described as the largest and most complete surviving imperial tomb complex in China.
description: 清东陵坐落在中华人民共和国河北省遵化市境西北部马兰峪的昌瑞山一带，西距北京市区125公里，距离天津150公里，是清朝三大陵园中最大的一座。整座陵园共有5座帝陵，4座后陵，5座皇妃陵寝，8座皇子陵寝，4座奶妈坟，1座贞官墓和1座穆公墓，其中部分皇子陵寝分布于天津市境内。
officialName: 唐山市清东陵景区
accessEn: The tombs lie at Malanyu in the north-west of Zunhua county, about 125 km east-north-east of central Beijing; long-distance coaches run from Beijing to Zunhua (around two hours) and a taxi covers the last stretch. Day-trip tours from Beijing are the easiest option if you are short of time.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 清西陵
summaryEn: The Western Qing Tombs are one of the Qing dynasty's two imperial burial grounds, set among wooded hills in Yi County, with the tombs of four emperors (Yongzheng, Jiaqing, Daoguang and Guangxu, of which three are open to visitors) and of their empresses, concubines and princes. Tailing, the Yongzheng Emperor's tomb, is the earliest and largest, reached along a long stone spirit way of memorial archways, stone bridges and rows of stone statues. The underground burial chamber of Chongling, the Guangxu Emperor's tomb, was opened to visitors in 1980.
description: 清西陵位于河北省保定市易县西陵镇，是清朝的三大皇家陵园之一。该陵园筹建于雍正七年，至1924年瑾妃入葬正式修建完毕，陵区共葬有4位皇帝、9位皇后，以及多名妃嫔、亲王和公主。清西陵在清朝存续期间一直都有专门的机构主持祭祀和日常维护，也有专门的部队对陵寝及其周边进行护卫。
officialName: 保定市清西陵景区
accessEn: The tombs are in Yi County, about 13 km west of the county town and some 90 km by road from Baoding. From Beijing, take a high-speed train to Gaobeidian and continue by bus or taxi, or take a long-distance coach to Yi County and a taxi, and allow two to three hours.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 广府古城
summaryEn: Guangfu is a walled prefectural town on a peninsula in the Yongnian wetland, with a moat outside brick-faced walls about 4.5 km round. Inside, the streets follow a tidy grid of four main roads and eight smaller ones, lined with Ming and Qing courtyard houses and former official buildings. It is a quiet, walkable place to see a Chinese county town laid out as it was centuries ago, and to learn about tai chi at its source.
description: 广府城，又称永年城，是位于中国河北省邯郸市永年区的一座古城，也是明清广平府府治、永年县县治所在地。城址位于永年区东南60公里处的永年洼中，永年洼面积28平方公里，而古县城坐落于延伸至湖中的半岛上。
officialName: 邯郸市广府古城景区
accessEn: The town is about 24 km east-north-east of central Handan, reached by bus or taxi in roughly 40 minutes; Handan East high-speed station (on the Beijing–Guangzhou line, roughly two hours from Beijing West) is the usual rail arrival point. Ask locally for the current bus line from Handan to the old town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 娲皇宫
summaryEn: The Nüwa Palace is a temple complex on Fenghuang (Phoenix) Mountain in Shexian, dedicated to the goddess Nüwa. A four-storey pavilion clings to the cliff face, with older halls at the foot of the slope, most of it dating from the Ming and Qing periods, and Buddhist sutras are carved into the rock nearby. It is one of the most atmospheric temple sites in southern Hebei.
description: 娲皇宫又称娲皇圣母庙，位于中国河北省邯郸市涉县索堡镇凤凰山，1996年被列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。另外，“娲皇宫景区”也曾作为原“崇州风景名胜区”的组成部分，现该省级风景名胜区已以“娲皇宫风景名胜区”名称整体升格为国家级风景名胜区。
officialName: 邯郸市娲皇宫景区
accessEn: The site is in Shexian county, roughly 90–100 km west of central Handan; frequent buses run from the Handan bus terminal to Shexian town in about 1.5 hours, followed by a taxi of around 20 minutes. Driving from Handan via the G22 Qinglan Expressway takes around 1.5 hours.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 白洋淀
summaryEn: Baiyang Lake is the largest freshwater lake in North China, a patchwork of shallow lakes, channels, reed beds and lotus ponds scattered with island villages. The usual visit is by boat, since the main sights – the Culture Garden, the Lotus Garden and the villages – are reached across the water. You drift through the reeds and lotus to lake-island villages, where local restaurants cook fish and other lake produce.
description: 白洋淀位于中国河北省雄安新区安新县、雄县和容城县之间，是华北最大的淡水湖，属于华北平原北部海河流域。
officialName: 保定市白洋淀景区
accessEn: The lake lies in Xiong'an New Area, in the Anxin county area about 50 km east of central Baoding; trains from Beijing West reach Xiong'an station in under an hour, and a taxi or bus covers the rest – check the route to the wharf you want on a map app. Driving from Beijing takes roughly two hours.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 野三坡
summaryEn: Yesanpo is a mountain-and-river scenic area of about 520 km² in Laishui County, spread along the Juma River and built mostly on karst. Its best-known part is Baili Gorge, a set of narrow canyons with walkways and stairs, and the area also takes in river rafting, the Baicaopan forest reserve and a stretch of Great Wall at Longmen Gorge. It makes an easy hiking day trip from Beijing.
description: 景区内可游览百里峡、拒马河、龙门天关。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 保定市野三坡景区
accessEn: Yesanpo has a tourist rail line from Beijing West to Yesanpo and Bailixia stations, but its service has changed over the years, so check 12306 for current trains; the drive from Beijing takes roughly two hours. From Baoding it is a longer road journey, so most visitors come via Beijing.

name: 白石山
summaryEn: Baishi Mountain is a block of pale marble and dolomite in the northern Taihang range, in Laiyuan County, whose jagged peaks poke out of low cloud on overcast days. Walkways run along its cliffs, including two glass-floored skywalks opened in 2014 and 2015, and stretches of old Great Wall lie around the foothills. It forms part of the Fangshan UNESCO Global Geopark, which also takes in Shidu and Yesanpo.
description: 白石山是位于中华人民共和国河北省保定市涞源县境内的一座山，也是太行山最北端的一座山。其最高峰海拔2,096米，白石山上有长城。1995年白石山被评为国家风景名胜区。
officialName: 保定市白石山景区
accessEn: Laiyuan is about 200 km south-west of Beijing: roughly two and a half to three hours by road, or about four hours by long-distance bus from Beijing; check 12306 for trains to Laiyuan. The scenic area is about 15 km south of Laiyuan town, reached by taxi or local transport.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 镜泊湖
summaryEn: Jingpo Lake is a long, narrow lake in the Zhangguangcai and Laoye mountains, held back by lava that blocked the Mudan River; it covers about 90 sq km and is a UNESCO Global Geopark as well as a 5A scenic area. Most visitors come for Diaoshuilou Falls at the northern end and a boat trip or shore walk beside the water. The wider scenic district also reaches the volcanic-crater Underground Forest and the Bohai capital site, which can be added on the same trip.
description: 镜泊湖，清代《盛京通志》称毕尔腾湖，是中国最大的高山堰塞湖，位于中华人民共和国黑龙江省牡丹江市宁安市境内，系历经五次火山喷发，玄武岩浆流阻塞牡丹江河床而形成。
highlights: 渤海国上京龙泉府遗址
officialName: 牡丹江市镜泊湖景区
accessEn: The northern gate and Diaoshuilou Falls are about 90 km by road south-west of Mudanjiang and about 64 km from Ning'an; Mudanjiang is reached from Harbin by train, and tour coaches, taxis and chartered cars run to the lake in season. The Underground Forest is a separate excursion some 50 km north-west of the lake.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 太阳岛
summaryEn: Sun Island is a river island and wetland on the north bank of the Songhua, facing central Harbin. In summer its lakes, flower gardens, willow-lined banks and Russian-themed quarter make an easy, leafy day out; in winter the central park hosts the international snow-sculpture expo. The planned scenic area covers about 38 sq km, so it pays to choose a few areas rather than try to see everything.
description: 太阳岛是黑龙江省哈尔滨市松花江中的一个河岛，位于哈尔滨市新旧城区之间，总面积为88平方公里，其中规划面积为38平方公里，外围保护区面积为50平方公里，分为东区、中区和西区。太阳岛是国家级风景名胜区、国家湿地公园和国家水利风景区，为国家旅游局评定的中国国家5A级旅游景区和中国目前最大的城市沿江生态区。
highlights: 哈尔滨国际雪雕艺术博览会
officialName: 哈尔滨市太阳岛景区
accessEn: From Harbin Railway Station it is about 4.5 km, 15–25 minutes by taxi or a short ride by city bus across the Songhua River.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 扎龙生态旅游区
summaryEn: Zhalong is a vast freshwater reed marsh on the Wuyuer River plain, known as a breeding ground for red-crowned cranes and listed as a wetland of international importance (Ramsar) in 1992. The tourist area, about 4.7 sq km of the much larger reserve, has a viewing platform for scheduled flight displays by trained, captive-bred cranes, plus boat trips through the reeds and walking trails. The displays continue through the winter, and the area became a 5A scenic area in December 2024.
description: 黑龙江扎龙国家级自然保护区是中国第一个以丹顶鹤为主要保护对象的国家级自然保护区，位于黑龙江省齐齐哈尔市东南26公里处铁锋区扎龙镇，总面积21万公顷，主要保护对象为丹顶鹤等水禽及温带湿地生态系统，被誉为鹤的故乡。
officialName: 齐齐哈尔市扎龙生态旅游区
accessEn: High-speed trains from Harbin reach Qiqihar in roughly 1.5–2 hours; from there the reserve is about 26 km south-east of the centre, around 30–60 minutes by taxi, tourist bus or hired car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 北极村
summaryEn: Beiji Village sits on the south bank of the Heilongjiang River at about 53°N, in the far north of China and billed as the country's northernmost village (a neighbouring village is a little further north). Visitors come for the 'Divine Land's North Pole' stone beside the river, the northernmost post office and a riverside sandbar park. Around midsummer daylight runs for 17–20 hours and the sky never fully darkens; in deep winter the same lanes sit under snow at around –40 °C.
description: 北极村原名漠河村、“马托拉”，位于中国黑龙江省漠河市北极镇，是北极镇人民政府驻地，号称中国最北的城镇，不过其实仍然次于北红村。北极村位于53°28′45.61″N122°21′36.88″E，是中国唯一观测北极光的最佳地点。
officialName: 大兴安岭地区北极村旅游景区
accessEn: Harbin to Mohe takes about two hours by plane (to Mohe Gulian Airport) or roughly 16–20 hours on an overnight train; the village is then about 80 km (roughly an hour) from Mohe city by taxi, chartered car or the bus from Mohe station. Most visitors base themselves in Mohe city and make the trip out for the day.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 五大连池
summaryEn: Wudalianchi is a volcanic landscape at the foot of the Lesser Khingan range, with 14 cones, wide fields of black lava rock and a chain of five lakes formed when lava dammed a river. Its youngest volcanoes, Laoheishan and Huoshaoshan, last erupted in 1719–21 and you can walk up to the crater rim of Laoheishan. Cold mineral springs, lava caves and a geopark museum make it easy to fill one or two days.
description: 五大连池世界地质公园是位于中国黑龙江省五大连池市境内的一个地质公园，面积达1,060平方千米，内有14座火山，当中有12座在1200万~100万年前的地质时期形成，还有2座火山最后一次喷发于公元1719年~1721年的清朝康熙年间，是中国最新的火山。
highlights: 五大连池世界地质公园博物馆
officialName: 黑河市五大连池景区
accessEn: From Harbin it is roughly 320 km by road, around four to five hours by car, or take a direct coach to Wudalianchi city; by train, go to Bei'an and change to a bus (roughly one to one and a half hours) to the scenic area. A small airport, Wudalianchi Dedu, opened in 2017, but check which flights run now.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 殷墟
summaryEn: Yinxu is the ruined capital of the late Shang dynasty, spread across both banks of the Huan River on the north-western edge of Anyang. It is where the oracle-bone inscriptions, the earliest known Chinese writing, were excavated, and it was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2006. Visitors walk the palace and temple area, stand at the undisturbed tomb of Fu Hao, and see the royal cemetery with its large tombs and sacrificial pits. The new Yinxu Museum, opened in 2024, shows nearly 4,000 bronzes, jades, pottery pieces and oracle bones.
description: 殷墟是中国商朝后期王都遗址，位于河南安阳市，以殷都区西郊乡小屯村为中心，横跨洹河，东西长约6公里，南北宽约4公里，由殷墟王陵遗址与殷墟宫殿宗庙遗址、洹北商城遗址等共同组成。公元前14世纪，商汤的第九代孙盘庚即位后，把都城从奄迁到殷，直至帝辛纣灭亡的273年间，殷地一直是商朝后期的统治中心，因此商朝也称殷朝。
officialName: 安阳市殷墟景区
accessEn: Yinxu lies on the north-western side of Anyang, about 15–20 minutes by taxi from the city centre and roughly half an hour from Anyang East high-speed station. Anyang is on the Beijing–Guangzhou high-speed line, so it is an easy stop between Zhengzhou and Handan or Shijiazhuang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 清明上河园
summaryEn: Qingming Shanghe Park is a Song-style theme park on the west shore of Longting Lake, opened in 1998 and modelled on Zhang Zeduan's 12th-century scroll Along the River During the Qingming Festival and the Song building manual Yingzao Fashi. It is not an original site but a staged, costumed picture of life in the Northern Song capital, with craft workshops, food stalls and street performances. It suits families and anyone wanting a lively, photogenic introduction to Song Kaifeng before seeing the real relics.
description: 清明上河园是位于中华人民共和国河南省开封市龙亭区龙亭西路5号龙亭湖西岸的宋代文化主题公园，同时也是中国国家5A级旅游景区和中国非物质文化遗产展演基地，1998年10月28日正式对外开放。它是以画家张择端的写实画作《清明上河图》为蓝本，按照《营造法式》为建设标准，以宋朝市井文化、民俗风情、皇家园林和古代娱乐为题材，以游客参与体验为特点的文化主题公园。
officialName: 开封市清明上河园景区
accessEn: The park is on the west shore of Longting Lake in the north-west of Kaifeng's old city, about 15 minutes by taxi from the centre. Kaifeng is roughly 30 to 40 minutes from Zhengzhou by intercity train; check which Kaifeng station your ticket uses.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鸡公山
summaryEn: Mount Jigong is a forested ridge of the Dabie Mountains on the Henan–Hubei border, named for the rooster-shaped crag of Baoxiao Peak and long a summer retreat thanks to its cool climate. From 1898 to 1936 over 300 villas in various styles were built here, and the surviving early-20th-century buildings are protected as a national heritage site. Paths link the villa quarter with viewpoints and wooded valleys in what is also a national nature reserve.
description: 鸡公山属大别山支脉，地处河南省、湖北省两省交界处。主峰“鸡公头”又名“报晓峰”，海拔814米；因酷似引颈高啼的雄鸡，得名“鸡公山”。鸡公山位于河南省信阳市南38公里，是国家级重点风景名胜区、国家级自然保护区、4A级景区，是华中地区著名的游览、避暑胜地。
officialName: 信阳市鸡公山景区
accessEn: The mountain is about 38 km south of central Xinyang, roughly an hour by road. Xinyang has fast rail links to Zhengzhou and Wuhan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 云台山
summaryEn: Yuntai Mountain is a 190 km² scenic area of red-rock gorges, sheer cliffs, waterfalls and pools in the southern Taihang Mountains, within the Yuntai Mountain UNESCO Global Geopark (a geopark, not a World Heritage site). Its highest point, Zhuyu Peak, reaches about 1,308 m, and the area also takes in the Fenglin Gorge reservoir behind a 100 m stone arch dam, the 4 km Zifang Lake and a valley of wild Taihang macaques. The same 5A listing covers Shennong Mountain in Qinyang and the Qingtianhe gorges in Bo'ai, which make further day trips.
description: 云台山，古称“覆釜山”，位于河南省焦作市修武县境内。因山脉高峻，山间常年云雾缭绕，故名云台山，云台山属太行山系。云台山是一个集中国国家重点风景名胜区、国家5A级景区、国家地质公园、国家森林公园、国家水利风景区和国家猕猴自然保护区于一体的风景名胜区，景区面积达190平方公里。
officialName: 焦作市云台山－神农山－青天河风景区
accessEn: The scenic area is in northern Xiuwu County, about an hour by road north of central Jiaozuo. From Zhengzhou East, the Zhengzhou–Jiaozuo intercity train reaches Xiuwu West in roughly 25–40 minutes, where a tourist shuttle bus runs on to the area in about 40–50 minutes; a private car from Zhengzhou takes 1.5–2 hours.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 尧山－中原大佛
summaryEn: This 5A area joins two separate sights in western Lushan County. Mount Yao (formerly Shirenshan), at the eastern end of the Funiu Mountains, is a granite mountain area of about 268 km² rising to about 2,150 m, known for human-shaped rock pinnacles, waterfalls, forest and autumn colour, with a cable car and a cliff walkway up towards the summit. About 15 km to the east, Foquan Temple is home to the Spring Temple Buddha, a modern copper statue of Vairocana completed in 2008 that stands 128 m tall including its lotus throne (about 208 m with the pedestals built into its hill).
description: 尧山，曾用名石人山，位于河南省平顶山市鲁山县和南阳市南召县交界处，地处伏牛山东段。《水经注》中：“尧之末孙刘累，以龙食帝孔甲，孔甲又求之，不得。累惧而迁于鲁县，立尧祠于西山，谓之尧山。
officialName: 平顶山市尧山－中原大佛景区
accessEn: Both lie off national road G311 west of Lushan County town, the Buddha about 45 km out at Zhaocun and the Mount Yao gate about 60 km out in Yaoshan town; Lushan is about 40 km west of Pingdingshan. Reaching either without a car usually means a taxi or a chartered car from Lushan or Pingdingshan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 芒砀山
summaryEn: A cluster of low hills in northern Yongcheng, rising to 156.8 m, where the Western Han kings of Liang cut their tombs deep into the rock and where Liu Bang, the future founder of the Han dynasty, is said to have begun his revolt against the Qin by slaying a white serpent. Visitors can enter some of the vast rock-cut Liang tombs, including those of King Xiao of Liang and his queen, whose tomb is described as the largest rock-cut chamber tomb yet found in China, and see Chen Sheng's grave, the memorial to Liu Bang's uprising and the cliff where Confucius is said to have sheltered from rain. The foundations of a Han ritual hall lie on the main peak.
description: 景区内可游览汉梁王墓群、梁孝王与王后陵、陈胜墓。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 商丘市芒砀山汉文化旅游景区
accessEn: In Mangshan town about 30 km north of Yongcheng city, some 40 minutes by road; Yongcheng is about 1½–2 hours by road south-east of Shangqiu, which is a high-speed rail hub. Yongcheng North station on the Zhengzhou–Xuzhou high-speed line is only about 5 km from the scenic area.

name: 三峡大坝
summaryEn: The Three Gorges Dam is a concrete gravity dam across the Yangtze at Sandouping, and the world's largest hydroelectric station by installed capacity. Visitors are taken by shuttle round a one-way route of hilltop lookouts and platforms, ending at a park that faces the dam wall head-on. The ship lift, which began operating in 2016, raises whole vessels past the dam in one move.
description: 长江三峡水利枢纽工程，简称三峡工程或三峡大坝，是中华人民共和国长江上游段建设的大型水利工程项目。分布在重庆市到湖北省宜昌市的长江干流上，大坝位于长江三峡西陵峡内的宜昌市夷陵区三斗坪，并和其下游38千米的葛洲坝水电站形成梯级调度电站。
officialName: 宜昌市三峡大坝－屈原故里文化旅游区
accessEn: The dam is at Sandouping in Yiling district, about 30 km west-north-west of central Yichang in a straight line. From Yichang you reach the visitor transfer centre by tourist bus or taxi (ask your hotel for the current bus route), and many Yangtze cruises include a stop here; Yichang is linked to Wuhan by high-speed rail.
imageCredit: Source file: Le Grand Portage Derivative work: Rehman
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 恩施大峡谷
summaryEn: Enshi Grand Canyon, also called the Mufu Grand Canyon, is a karst canyon in the Qing River basin where cliffs, rock pillars, sinkholes, caves, natural bridges and underground rivers all occur. Visitors see it in two parts: the cliff-top walkways of Qixingzhai, and the Yunlong River Fissure, a narrow slot that is up to about 75 m deep. It suits a full day of walking among dramatic limestone scenery.
description: 恩施大峡谷，又名沐抚大峡谷，位于湖北西部恩施市境内的清江流域，毗邻重庆天坑地缝，全长约35公里，地形非常复杂，在这里几乎能找到喀斯特地貌的各种形态，包括绝壁、峰柱、天坑、地缝、溶洞、天生桥、暗河、竖井、石林、峰丛、悬谷等，构成罕见的立体性溶岩地貌。
officialName: 恩施州恩施大峡谷景区
accessEn: The canyon is about 60 km by road from Enshi city, with the main visitor centre and car parks in the Mufu area; local buses and tour minibuses run from Enshi. Enshi has an airport and a railway station, with fast trains from Yichang (under 2 hours) and from Wuhan (a few hours).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东湖
summaryEn: East Lake is a freshwater lake of about 33 sq km in Wuchang, one of China's largest urban lakes and several times the size of Hangzhou's West Lake. Its scenic area is split into zones such as Tingtao, Moshan and Luoyan, linked by a lakeside greenway of well over 100 km that you can walk or cycle. Moshan is the highlight, with the cherry-blossom garden, a plum garden and the Chu City theme area, and the Hubei Provincial Museum stands on the western shore.
description: 东湖，位于中国武汉市武昌区东部，故得此名。东湖水域面积达33平方公里，是杭州西湖的六倍，曾为中国最大的城中湖。东湖是以大型自然湖泊为核心，湖光山色为特色，近现代历史为依托，集旅游观光、休闲度假、科普教育为主要功能的旅游景区，现在是国家5A级旅游景区、全国文明风景旅游区示范点、首批国家重点风景名胜区。
officialName: 湖北省武汉市东湖景区
accessEn: East Lake is in eastern Wuchang, about 6 km east of the Yellow Crane Tower, and is reached by city bus, taxi or metro. Metro Line 8 to Liyuan station gives access to the greenway and the lakeside boats; for the cherry garden and Moshan, city buses 401, 402, 413 or 682 stop at Moshan station on Lumo Road, about ten minutes' walk from the garden. Wuhan is a major high-speed rail hub, so most visitors arrive by train and head across town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 古隆中
summaryEn: Longzhong is the wooded hillside west of Xiangyang that tradition names as the place where the Three Kingdoms strategist Zhuge Liang lived quietly before Liu Bei called on him. The grounds mix Ming and Qing halls with newer additions and run along a gentle path past a stone archway, shrines, a thatched cottage and a hexagonal well. It is a quiet, shaded half-day for anyone who knows Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
description: 襄阳“古隆中”是位于中华人民共和国湖北省襄阳市的一处明清古建筑遗产，于1996年11月20日被中华人民共和国国务院列入第四批全国重点文物保护单位。1956年11月15日，以“隆中诸葛亮故居”的名义被湖北省人民委员会列为第一批湖北省文物保护单位。
officialName: 襄阳市古隆中景区
accessEn: Longzhong is about 13 km west of central Xiangyang. From Xiangyang East (the high-speed station) allow roughly 35–40 minutes by taxi; city buses (reports name routes 6, 512 and 543, which change, so check a map app) run from the city to the visitor centre. Xiangyang is reached from Wuhan by high-speed train in roughly 1.5–2.5 hours depending on the service.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 明显陵
summaryEn: Xianling is the joint tomb of Zhu Youyuan, a Ming prince, and his wife, rebuilt on an imperial scale after their son became the Jiajing Emperor. It was inscribed as part of the Imperial Tombs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties World Heritage site in 2000, and its plan is unlike any other Ming tomb: a vase-shaped outer wall, a nine-bend ceremonial stream and a spirit way that curves like a dragon. The timber halls are gone, so you come for stonework, gateways, bridges, carved screens and a quiet wooded hill.
description: 明显陵，是明世宗朱厚熜的生父睿宗献皇帝朱祐杬及生母慈孝献皇后蒋氏的合葬陵寝，是中国明代帝陵中最大的单体陵墓。明显陵是明嘉靖时期“大礼议”的产物，由于其特殊的历史背景，在规划布局和建筑手法上与其他帝王陵寝相比，有其独特之处。
officialName: 荆门市明显陵文化旅游景区
accessEn: The tomb is on Chunde Hill about 5–7 km north-east of Zhongxiang town (sources differ), roughly 20 minutes by taxi, and bus 6 runs from town to the site. Zhongxiang has a conventional rail station and, since 26 December 2025, a high-speed station called Zhongxiang South in Chaihu town on the Shanghai–Chongqing–Chengdu line; it is not in the town centre, so check the transfer on a map app and 12306. Zhongxiang is about an hour from Jingmen by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 神农溪
summaryEn: Shennong Stream is a tributary about 60 km long that flows from the Shennongjia mountains through narrow gorges to meet the Yangtze opposite Badong town. Visitors take a tourist boat up the lower stream past cliffs with hanging coffins left by the ancient Ba people, and can switch to small wooden peapod boats pulled by trackers, a tradition now kept alive for tourism. It makes an easy half-day excursion from Badong.
description: 神农溪，湖北省巴东县境内的一条河流，全长60公里。发源于神农架主峰，流经湖北巴东县境内，于巫峡口东汇入长江。是一条常流性溪流，全长60公里，流向自北向南，年均流量20立方米／秒。
officialName: 恩施州神农溪纤夫文化旅游区
accessEn: Boats run on the stream opposite Badong county town, where Shennong Stream joins the Yangtze; most visitors cross from the Badong riverfront. The Zhengzhou–Chongqing high-speed line has a Badong station at Xiqiuwan, well outside the town, so allow a taxi or minibus transfer (reports vary from 15 minutes to the scenic area up to a longer drive to town). Check train times from Yichang East on 12306.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 腾龙洞
summaryEn: Tenglong Cave is a karst cave system near Lichuan with about 59.8 km of passages on several levels, billed as the longest single cave system in the world. Its mouth, some 74 m high, swallows the Qing River as a thundering waterfall, and visitors walk a section of the dry cave beyond. It is a cool, dramatic stop that pairs naturally with Enshi Grand Canyon.
description: 腾龙洞，位于中国湖北省恩施土家族苗族自治州利川市东部，世界最大单体溶洞。腾龙洞洞口高74米，宽64米，洞内最高处235米，洞穴总长度59.8公里，其中水洞伏流16.8公里，洞穴面积200多万平方米。清江干流从洞中流过。
officialName: 恩施州腾龙洞景区
accessEn: The cave is about 6 km north-east of Lichuan town centre, so take a taxi from Lichuan station or the town. Fast trains on the Yichang–Wanzhou line connect Enshi and Lichuan in roughly 40–45 minutes, so the cave is an easy day trip from Enshi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天门山
summaryEn: Tianmen Mountain is a karst massif rising to about 1,519 m just south of Zhangjiajie city, pierced by Tianmen Cave, a natural arch roughly 131 m high. Normally visitors go up by one of the world's longest passenger cable cars, which has been closed since 13 October 2026 for rebuilding; for now the only way up is the express cable car from the mountain gate to the arch, then escalators to the summit. Up top, cliff-side paths with glass-floored sections lead round the plateau, and a stairway of 999 steps climbs to the arch. It is the easiest big view in Zhangjiajie, and a good partner to the sandstone pillars of the forest park.
description: 天门山坐落在中国湖南省张家界市永定区，因天门洞而得名，被称为“湘西第一神山”、“武陵之魂”和“张家界之魂”。
officialName: 张家界市武陵源－天门山旅游区
accessEn: The old cable-car lower station is about a 20-minute walk from Zhangjiajie railway station, and about 10 minutes by taxi from Zhangjiajie West station or the airport. While the long cable car is shut, a shuttle bus runs between that station and the mountain gate where you enter. From Wulingyuan town, allow roughly 40 minutes by taxi or 1–1.5 hours by coach.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 岳阳楼
summaryEn: Yueyang Tower stands on the old west wall of Yueyang and looks over Dongting Lake towards Junshan Island. It is one of the Three Great Towers of Jiangnan, and its fame rests on Fan Zhongyan's essay on it, whose line about worrying before the world worries and rejoicing after it is known to most Chinese schoolchildren. The timber tower, 19.4 m tall under a helmet-shaped roof and held up by four full-height nanmu columns, largely dates from the 1880 rebuilding.
description: 岳阳楼是一座位于中国湖南省岳阳市古城西门之上的古城楼，下临洞庭，前望君山，北倚长江，主要因范仲淹《岳阳楼记》而闻名，有“洞庭天下水，岳阳天下楼”的盛誉。岳阳楼始建于公元220年前后，其前身相传为三国时期东吴大将鲁肃的“阅军楼”，西晋南北朝时称“巴陵城楼”，中唐始称“岳阳楼”。
officialName: 岳阳市岳阳楼－君山岛景区
accessEn: High-speed trains reach Yueyang East in about 30 minutes from Changsha South, and in 45 minutes from Wuhan. The tower is on the lakefront at the western edge of the centre, about half an hour by taxi from the station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南岳衡山
summaryEn: Mount Heng is the Southern Peak among China's Five Great Mountains, a granite range counted as 72 peaks that rises to about 1,300 metres at Zhurong Peak. Temples of both Taoism and Buddhism sit at the foot and on the slopes among old forest, with cliff inscriptions from the Southern and Northern dynasties to the Republican era scattered over some 375 spots. Nanyue old town at the base, with its palace-style Grand Temple, is as much a part of the trip as the summit.
description: 衡山，五岳之一，也称为“南岳”，南岳始封于唐虞，是古代中国帝王巡狩祭祀的地方，也是道教和汉传佛教的圣地之一。主景区全称“衡山风景名胜区”位于湖南省衡阳市南岳区境内，1979年被列为湖南省级自然保护区，1982年11月8日第一批公布为国家重点风景名胜区。
officialName: 衡阳市衡山旅游区
accessEn: Take a high-speed train to Hengshan West station on the Beijing–Guangzhou line (under an hour from Changsha South), then a bus or taxi to Nanyue town; from central Hengyang the town is about an hour away by road. Direct coaches from Changsha South coach station take about two hours.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 岳麓山·橘子洲
summaryEn: Yuelu Mountain is a wooded ridge about 300 metres high on the west bank of the Xiang River, facing central Changsha, and its paths link old temples, pavilions, the tombs of two 1911 revolutionaries and Yuelu Academy at its foot. Orange Isle, a sand island some 5 km long in the river, is a long riverside park with gardens at its southern tip. Together they form one 5A scenic area and make the best green day out in the city.
description: 岳麓山坐落在湖南省长沙市的湘江西岸，占地面积35.2平方公里，最高峰云麓峰，又名灵麓峰。海拔300.8米，是南岳七十二峰之一，南北朝时的《南岳记》就提到：“南岳周围八百里，回雁为首，岳麓为足”，亦是儒家岳麓书院的所在地、佛教的“湖湘第一道场”、道教第二十三福地以及辛亥革命与抗日战争英烈的埋骨地。
officialName: 长沙市岳麓山-橘子洲旅游区
accessEn: Both are in central Changsha on the west bank of the Xiang. Orange Isle has its own stop on Metro Line 2, and city buses run to the academy and the mountain, whose trails start behind Hunan University.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 桃花源
summaryEn: Taohuayuan lies on the Yuan River about 15 km south-west of Taoyuan county town and is the place long identified with Tao Yuanming's fable The Peach Blossom Spring. The 15.8 km² scenic area has temples and pavilions on wooded hills, a stream you can ride on a boat, and peach groves that cover the valleys in bloom. It makes an easy literary and scenic day out of Changde.
description: 桃花源位于中华人民共和国湖南省常德市桃源县，面临沅水，背依群山。桃花源主体景区15.8平方公里，包括桃花山、桃源山、秦人村和桃仙岭四片。此地被认为是陶渊明名作《桃花源记》的原型，桃花源古建筑群是国家重点文物保护单位，保护范围包括桃花山牌坊、渊明祠、方竹亭、桃花观、遇仙桥、集贤祠、佳致碑、问津亭、高举阁、水源亭、临仙馆、白云轩等十数处。
officialName: 常德市桃花源旅游区
accessEn: It is about 40 km south-west of central Changde by road, roughly 40 minutes by car or taxi, with its own expressway exit; Changde Taohuayuan Airport lies about 25 km to the north-east. From Taoyuan railway station the gate is about 14 km away, a taxi ride of roughly 30–40 minutes by traveller accounts; no reliable direct bus was found, so take a taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东江湖
summaryEn: Dongjiang Lake is a reservoir of about 160 km² among the hills of Zixing, held back by a 157 m double-curvature arch dam on the Lei River that was built in stages between 1958 and 1992. Its best-known sight is the Xiao Dongjiang gorge below the dam, where mist often lies on the water in the early morning and fishermen's boats drift through it. Boats also run out across the lake to islands such as Doushuai Island.
description: 东江水库，又名东江湖、小东江，位于中国湖南省资兴市东江街道，耒水上游，是以发电为主，兼有防洪、航运等功能的大型水电工程。东江湖亦是国家重点风景名胜区、国家5A级旅游景区。
officialName: 郴州市东江湖旅游区
accessEn: The scenic-area gate is near Zixing, about 30 km east of central Chenzhou, under an hour by road. From Chenzhou West high-speed station, take a bus or taxi to Zixing and on to the lake.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 矮寨·十八洞·德夯大峡谷
summaryEn: This 5A scenic area west of Jishou joins the Aizhai suspension bridge, the Dehang canyon and the village of Shibadong. The bridge opened in 2012 with a 1,176-metre main span carrying the G65 expressway more than 330 metres above the gorge; below it, Dehang has sheer cliffs, stone peaks, Miao villages and the 216-metre Liusha waterfall.
description: 矮寨·十八洞·德夯大峡谷景区是中华人民共和国湖南省湘西土家族苗族自治州吉首市的一个旅游景点，景区内有矮寨大桥、花垣县十八洞村、吉首市德夯大峡谷等景点。2021年6月11日被列为国家5A级旅游景区。2024年11月15日，十八洞村被联合国旅游组织执行委员会列入2024年“最佳旅游乡村”名单。
officialName: 湘西州吉首市矮寨·十八洞•德夯大峡谷景区
accessEn: Aizhai and Dehang lie about 20–25 km west of Jishou, roughly 40 minutes by road, and Shibadong is a further drive into Huayuan County, so a car or driver is the easiest way to link them. Jishou East station is on the Zhangjiajie–Jishou–Huaihua high-speed line.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 崀山
summaryEn: Langshan is a 108 km² area of red Danxia sandstone in Xinning County, with flat-topped mesas, free-standing pillars, sheer red cliffs and narrow slot canyons above the clear Fuyi River. It is one of the six areas inscribed together as the China Danxia World Heritage Site in 2010, and it is also a 5A scenic area. It suits walkers who like big views, and combines clifftop lookouts, a rock-walled lane and a river trip.
description: 崀山位于中国湖南省新宁县，相传舜帝南巡至崀山，惊奇此间美景，流连忘返，曰：“山之良也”，乃赐“崀”字，崀山因此而得名。2010年，崀山与广东丹霞山、福建泰宁、江西龙虎山、浙江江郎山、贵州赤水共6个丹霞地貌风景名胜区组成的“中国丹霞”获批世界自然遗产。
officialName: 邵阳市崀山景区
accessEn: Langshan lies south of Xinning county town; city buses 2 and 6 run from the town to the north-gate visitor centre, about 8 km, and cars can drive between the zones. Xinning is about 2–2.5 hours by coach from Shaoyang south coach station, with departures roughly every 40 minutes, according to the county government guide.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 成吉思汗陵
summaryEn: Three linked, ger-shaped halls with white walls, red windows and blue-tiled roofs stand on the Ejin Horo grassland south of Ordos. The Khan's actual burial place has never been found, so these halls, built in 1955–56, are a memorial and the main centre of his worship rather than a verified tomb. You see a living shrine with murals, a marble statue, relics and offerings.
description: 成吉思汗陵位于中国内蒙古自治区鄂尔多斯市伊金霍洛旗札萨克镇甘德尔敖包的伊金霍洛草原上，属窟野河上游。成吉思汗祭祀之所“八白室”清朝初年迁至伊金霍洛，抗日战争期间迁至甘肃，后于1949年迁至青海塔尔寺。
officialName: 鄂尔多斯市成吉思汗陵旅游区
accessEn: It is about 32 km by road south of Kangbashi, the new centre of Ordos, under an hour by taxi or hired car. From Baotou allow roughly two hours by car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 夫子庙—秦淮风光带
summaryEn: Fuzimiao, the Confucius Temple, stands on the north bank of the inner Qinhuai River at the heart of a lively district of restored lanes, snack stalls and teahouse-style restaurants. Next door, the Jiangnan Examination Hall now houses the China Imperial Examination Museum. It is the easiest place in Nanjing to combine history, street food and an evening stroll by the water.
description: 南京夫子庙，常简称夫子庙，是一座位于中华人民共和国江苏省南京市秦淮区秦淮河北岸贡院街的孔庙。“夫子”是孔子弟子对孔子的尊称。目前以夫子庙为中心、庙市街景合一的秦淮风光景区是集文化、旅游、购物、服务等功能于一体的文化活动中心。
officialName: 南京市夫子庙－秦淮风光带
accessEn: About 2 km south of Xinjiekou in central Nanjing; Fuzimiao station on Metro Lines 3 and 5 is a few minutes' walk north of the temple. Nanjing South railway station is roughly 20–30 minutes away by Metro Line 3.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 周庄古镇
summaryEn: A canal town of old houses, lanes and stone bridges in Kunshan, usually counted as the most famous of the Jiangnan water towns. Its Twin Bridges became widely known after a painting by Chen Yifei was presented to Deng Xiaoping in 1984, and two great houses, Shen Hall and Zhang Hall, are national monuments. It is heavily visited and commercialised, so go early or stay overnight.
description: 景区内可游览双桥、沈厅、张厅。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 苏州市周庄古镇景区
accessEn: About 30 km south-east of central Suzhou and 60 km west of central Shanghai, roughly an hour by road from either; buses run from both cities, and a taxi or ride-hailing car is the easiest way.

name: 瘦西湖
summaryEn: Slender West Lake is a long, narrow waterway at the north-west edge of Yangzhou's old city, strung with bridges, pavilions and garden islands. It grew from the moats of Tang and Song Yangzhou and was lined with gardens by Qing salt merchants and officials. Walk the banks or drift along by boat; it is the city's showpiece and a stop on the Grand Canal World Heritage listing.
description: 瘦西湖位于中国江苏省扬州市广陵区，扬州旧城北门外至蜀岗一带，现为“蜀冈-瘦西湖风景名胜区”核心区域。该湖最初由唐代扬州的城市护城河逐渐发展而成。目前总面积有约2000亩，水上面积约700亩，而游览区面积有100公顷。
officialName: 扬州市瘦西湖风景区
accessEn: Yangzhou East is the city's high-speed rail hub, under an hour from Nanjing by train, and the lake is a short taxi or bus ride from there or from the old city. Several gates serve the lake, and the north gate faces Daming Temple.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 同里古镇
summaryEn: A canal town more than a thousand years old on the edge of Wujiang, crossed by waterways and old stone bridges and named in 2003 among the first ten historic and cultural towns of China. Its best-known sight is the Retreat and Reflection Garden of 1885–1887, part of the Classical Gardens of Suzhou World Heritage Site. It feels calmer than Zhouzhuang and rewards slow wandering.
description: 同里镇位于江苏省苏州市吴江区，是一个有一千多年历史的江南古镇。中华人民共和国建设部和国家文物局于2003年10月8日公布了10个中国历史文化名镇，同里镇为其中之一。同里镇是2019年中国百强乡镇。
officialName: 苏州市同里古镇景区
accessEn: About 20 km south-east of central Suzhou in Wujiang district, by Suzhou Metro Line 4 to Tongli station and a short bus or taxi ride, or by bus from Suzhou (around half an hour) and from Shanghai (roughly two hours).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 茅山
