summaryEn: A low range on the Jurong–Jintan border, rising to 372.5 metres at Damao Peak and revered as the birthplace of the Shangqing school of Taoism. Taoists call it the 'eighth grotto-heaven and first blessed land'. The temple complex spreads over the hillside, and the open-air figure of Laozi is visible across the valley.
description: 茅山，古称勾曲山、积金山，位于江苏省句容市和常州市金坛区交界处，是中国道教名山之一，汉代三茅真君在此隐居，因称茅山。主峰名大茅峰，海拔372.5米。
officialName: 镇江市茅山景区
accessEn: About 20 km south-east of Jurong city and roughly an hour by road from Nanjing; Jurong is the usual base, with taxis or ride-hailing for the last stretch.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 灵山大佛
summaryEn: Lingshan is a modern Buddhist complex at Mashan on the north shore of Lake Tai, built from the 1990s and centred on an 88-metre bronze standing Buddha including its lotus base. An axis leads from the gate past a timed fountain show to the statue, which you can climb to for lake and hill views. Beside it, the ornate Lingshan Brahma Palace is a large hall complex with carved interiors and a domed hall, and the permanent venue of the World Buddhist Forum.
description: 灵山大佛，位于江苏省无锡市滨湖区，位于太湖之北滨。灵山大佛，高88米，用青铜700余吨，由南京晨光集团吴显林负责设计、雕塑。该地区为国家5A级旅游景区，带动了一系列“灵山产业”，如灵山食品厂、灵山蔬食馆、灵山香烛工艺制品公司等。
officialName: 无锡市灵山大佛景区
accessEn: Lingshan is at Mashan on Lake Tai, about 30 km south-west of central Wuxi; it takes roughly 45 minutes to an hour by taxi, or bus 88 from Wuxi railway station. Wuxi is about 30 minutes from Shanghai and 40–60 minutes from Nanjing by high-speed train.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鼋头渚
summaryEn: Yuantouzhu is a rocky headland on the north-western shore of Lake Tai, named for its resemblance to a turtle's head. Wooded hills, pavilions, rock inscriptions and old lakeside villas fill the park, and the water views are the reason to come. In spring it is one of the busiest places in Jiangsu, thanks to its cherry trees.
description: 鼋头渚，位于中国江苏省无锡市西南15公里的太湖之滨，为一突入湖中的岛渚，因形似鼋头故名。有太湖第一名胜、太湖佳绝处等誉称。
officialName: 无锡市鼋头渚旅游风景区
accessEn: The park is on the lakeshore about 15 km south-west of central Wuxi; city bus 1 runs from the centre to the Yuantouzhu stop at the Chongshan gate, and a taxi is quicker. Wuxi is about 30 minutes from Shanghai and 40–60 minutes from Nanjing by high-speed train.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 惠山古镇
summaryEn: Huishan Ancient Town is a cluster of ancestral halls and gardens along two old streets at the eastern foot of Mount Hui, in the west of Wuxi. It forms one scenic area with neighbouring Xihui Park, taking in Huishan Temple, the Second Spring under Heaven, Jichang Garden and the hilltop Longguang Pagoda. It is an easy, walkable stop on the edge of the city centre, and shops along the streets sell Huishan painted clay figurines.
description: 惠山镇祠堂，又称惠山古镇、“惠山老街”。位于江苏省无锡市梁溪区惠山东北麓，与天下第二泉、寄畅园、惠山寺等诸多无锡著名人文景区相接，是一处以大片古祠堂群组成的历史遗迹，其由唐代为纪念春申君所设的大王庙发展至民国，形成了118座供祭各家姓氏先祖的古祠堂。
officialName: 无锡市惠山古镇景区
accessEn: The town is at the western edge of central Wuxi, about 3 km from the centre, next to Huishan Ancient Town station on Metro Line 4. Wuxi is roughly 30–40 minutes from Shanghai and about an hour from Nanjing by high-speed train.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 金山·焦山·北固山
summaryEn: Zhenjiang's three classic Yangtze hills are managed as one scenic area but are separate parks several kilometres apart. Jinshan is covered by a temple and topped with a pagoda, Jiaoshan holds a temple and a museum of inscribed stones, and Beigushan carries a temple and an iron pagoda. Together they make a good day of temples and river views.
description: 景区内可游览金山寺·慈寿塔、定慧寺、焦山碑林。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 镇江市金山•焦山•北固山风景区
accessEn: Jinshan is about 2.5 km north-west of Zhenjiang railway station and Beigushan about 3 km north-east of it; Jiaoshan, on an island in the Yangtze, lies about 3 km further east. Zhenjiang is 20–40 minutes from Nanjing and roughly an hour from Shanghai by high-speed train.

name: 中华恐龙园
summaryEn: China Dinosaurs Park is a commercial theme park in Xinbei District, open since 2000, with rides, shows and parades built around its dinosaur theme. At its heart is a museum of Chinese dinosaur fossils, and the wider Dinosaur City resort around it adds a hot-spring complex and a shopping street. It suits families with children and is not a cultural sight in the usual sense.
description: 中华恐龙园，位于中华人民共和国江苏省常州市新北区，覆盖面积约600亩，2000年9月开园，是一家以恐龙为主题的游乐园，为国家5A级旅游景区。中华恐龙园内设有收藏展示中国系列恐龙化石的博物馆。
officialName: 常州市环球恐龙城休闲旅游区
accessEn: The park is in Xinbei District about 7 km north-east of central Changzhou, around 20 minutes by taxi. Changzhou is roughly 30–50 minutes from Shanghai or Nanjing by high-speed train.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 花果山
summaryEn: Mount Huaguo is a scenic area of 136 peaks above Lianyungang, crowned by Yunü Peak at about 625 metres, the highest point in Jiangsu. Paths, shuttle buses and a cable car lead to the Water Curtain Cave, the Sanyuan Temple and woods where macaques roam. It is a fun day for families and fans of the classic novel.
description: 花果山位于江苏省连云港市海州区，唐宋时称苍梧山，亦称青峰顶，为云台山脉的主峰。后以古典名著借用《西游记》中花果山之名。
officialName: 连云港市花果山景区
accessEn: High-speed trains link Nanjing and Lianyungang in about 2.5 to 3 hours. The visitor centre at the western foot is about 20–40 minutes by taxi from central Lianyungang, with shuttle buses and a cable car inside the area.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 三清山
summaryEn: Mount Sanqing in north-east Jiangxi is a World Natural Heritage site (2008) where dense clusters of granite pillars and peaks, such as the Giant Python and the Goddess of Spring, rise from forest and drifting cloud. It is also a Taoist mountain: the nationally listed group of ancient buildings around Sanqing Palace comprises more than 200 temples, pavilions, carvings, gates and bridges built from local granite, with the palace itself rebuilt in the Ming dynasty. Cable cars and cliff-hugging walkways reach the high ground, where Yujing Peak rises to about 1,820 m.
description: 三清山位于中国江西省上饶市玉山县与德兴市交界处，距玉山县城50公里，距上饶市78公里。三清山为怀玉山脉主峰，因玉京、玉虚、玉华“三峰峻拔、如三清列坐其巅”而得其名，三峰中以玉京峰为最高，海拔1816.9米，是江西第五高峰，也是信江的源头之一。
officialName: 上饶市玉山县三清山风景区
accessEn: Take a high-speed train to Yushan South station (or to Shangrao), then a bus or taxi of roughly an hour to the hotel villages at the south (Waishuangxi) or east (Jinsha) cable-car stations. Shangrao city is about 78 km away and Yushan town about 50 km; the direct bus from Yushan is the usual choice.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 滕王阁
summaryEn: The Pavilion of Prince Teng rises 57.5 metres above the east bank of the Gan River and is counted with Yueyang Tower and the Yellow Crane Tower as one of the three great towers of south China. Inside are murals of Jiangxi's historical figures and a bronze scale model, and the upper floors look over the river and the city. It is an easy, central stop that makes a good first or last hour in Nanchang.
description: 滕王阁，位于中国江西省南昌市西北部、赣江东岸，是中国江南三大名楼之一，另外两座分别为岳阳楼和黄鹤楼。是国家重点风景名胜区，以及国家5A级旅游景区。历史上滕王阁屡遭毁坏与重建，现存建筑于1989年在原址上重建，现代重建方案基于建筑师梁思成的草图，如今已成为南昌市的地标。
officialName: 南昌市东湖区滕王阁旅游区
accessEn: It stands on the east bank of the Gan River in Donghu district, in the north-west of Nanchang's old city. The most practical Metro Line 1 stop is Wanshougong, roughly 1 km away on foot, and many visitors take a short taxi or ride-hail from the city centre.
imageCredit: No machine-readable author provided. BetacommandBot assumed (based on copyright claims).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 武功山
summaryEn: Wugong Shan is a granite ridge in western Jiangxi whose upper slopes are covered by wide alpine meadows, rising to Baihe Peak (Jinding, the Golden Summit) at 1,918 m. Walkers come to cross the ridge and to watch the sunrise and sea of cloud from the top, with cable cars and shuttle buses available on the Pingxiang side for anyone who wants to skip part of the climb.
description: 武功山位于中华人民共和国江西省，属罗霄山脉北支，山体呈东北——西南走向，自江西吉安市安福县，宜春市袁州区，萍乡市芦溪县、莲花县，绵延120余千米，总面积近千平方千米。主峰白鹤峰海拔1918.3米，围绕金顶已设立“武功山国家地质公园”、“武功山国家森林公园”、“明月山国家森林公园”。
officialName: 萍乡市芦溪县萍乡武功山景区
accessEn: From Nanchang, high-speed trains reach Pingxiang North in about an hour and a half; from there a scenic-area bus (reported about 1 hr 20 min) or a taxi leads to the visitor centre, from where a shuttle bus runs to the foot of the mountain. The visitor centre is about 19 km from Luxi town and 30 km from Pingxiang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙虎山
summaryEn: Mount Longhu (Dragon and Tiger Mountain) is a low, bright-red Danxia landscape of cliffs, pillars and caves above the Luxi River, and one of the six components of the China Danxia World Heritage property. It is also a founding ground of Zhengyi Taoism, whose Celestial Masters have been based in the town of Shangqing for centuries. Drift down the river on a bamboo raft beneath the cliffs of Xianshuiyan, then walk through the old Taoist quarter.
description: 龙虎山位于江西省贵溪市境内，距鹰潭市区约20公里，境内有丹霞地貌峰林景观，其中主峰龙虎峰海拔247.4米，2001年被列为国家地质公园，2010年以“中国丹霞”的一部分被列为世界遗产。这里是著名的道教发源地之一，有许多道观依山而建，尤其是正一道，嗣汉天师府和大上清宫就在这里，被誉为道教四圣山之一。
officialName: 鹰潭市贵溪市龙虎山风景名胜区
accessEn: Take a high-speed train to Yingtan North on the Shanghai–Kunming line (about 45 minutes from Nanchang West), then a scenic-area bus or taxi of about 40 minutes to the main entrance. The scenic area lies roughly 17–20 km south-south-west of Yingtan city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 高句丽王城、王陵及贵族墓葬
summaryEn: Around the border town of Ji'an lie the remains of Koguryo (Goguryeo), a kingdom that ruled much of Manchuria and northern Korea. The UNESCO-listed sites here are the lowland city of Guonei, the hilltop fortress of Wandu and the Donggou tomb field, whose best-known monuments are the 6.39 m Gwanggaeto Stele and the stepped granite General's Tomb. Together they make an easy day among Yalu River hills, well off the main Jilin tourist routes.
description: 景区内可游览国内城、集安博物馆、丸都山城。图集建议预留一天游览。
officialName: 通化市高句丽文物古迹旅游景区
accessEn: Ji'an is a border town in Jilin's far south-east, at the end of the single-track Meihekou–Ji'an railway that runs through Tonghua; many visitors go by road from Tonghua instead. Check 12306 for current services and journey times.

name: 伪满皇宫博物院
summaryEn: The compound where Puyi, the last Qing emperor, lived as head of the Japanese-backed state of Manchukuo (1932–1945), now a museum. Its buildings mix Chinese, Japanese, Russian and European styles, and period rooms, furniture and photographs show how the court and the state were run. A separate hall covers the occupation of north-east China.
description: 伪满皇宫博物院，位于今中华人民共和国吉林省长春市宽城区新广街道光复北路5号，是在满洲国帝宫旧址上设立的宫廷遗址型博物馆。
officialName: 长春市伪满皇宫博物馆
accessEn: About 2 km north-east of central Changchun, reached by light rail on lines 3 and 4. Changchun is the province's main rail and air hub.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 查干湖
summaryEn: Chagan Lake is a broad shallow freshwater lake in north-west Qian Gorlos Mongol Autonomous County, the largest natural lake in Jilin. Its headline event is the winter fishing: from mid- or late December until about February, fishers cut holes through ice 70 cm to 1 m thick, draw a net more than a kilometre long beneath it and haul it out with horses turning a capstan. In the warmer months the area is promoted for spring outings, summer lotus and autumn birdwatching.
description: 查干湖，旧名“查干泡”，当地又称作“圣水湖”。位于中国吉林省松原市前郭尔罗斯蒙古族自治县西北部，霍林河末端。湖底海拔126米，最大湖水面307平方公里，水深4米，湖周长104.5公里，最大蓄水量4.15亿立方米，东西长38公里，南北宽14公里，是吉林省内最大的天然湖泊，也是东北平原上最大的淡水湖。
officialName: 松原市前郭查干湖景区
accessEn: Take a train to Songyuan, from Changchun or elsewhere in the north-east (check 12306), then a taxi or hired car: the lake is about 50 km by road from Songyuan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 净月潭
summaryEn: A large forest park around the crescent-shaped Jingyuetan reservoir on Changchun's south-eastern edge, close enough to reach by light rail from the city. It is the place locals go for lakeside and forest walks, cycling in the warm months and snow play and skiing in winter; the Vasaloppet China cross-country ski festival has been held here every year since 2003.
description: 净月潭国家森林公园位于中华人民共和国吉林省长春市南关区东南部，占地面积83.23平方公里。因形似弯月而得名，与台湾日月潭互为姊妹潭。该森林公园的核心为修建于满洲国时期的净月潭水库，后经人工造林和公园化建设，成为现在的森林公园。
officialName: 长春市净月潭景区
accessEn: About 16 km south-east of central Changchun; light-rail line 3 stops at the Jingyuetan scenic-area station by the main gate and at a ski-field station by the west gate, and several city bus routes also run to the park.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 本溪水洞
summaryEn: The Benxi Water Caves are a karst cave about 5.8 km long with an underground river, of which roughly 2.8 km is open to visitors. You walk through a dry cave, then board a boat that glides between stalactites and stalagmites lit in colour, in air that stays around 12°C all year. A geological museum and a fossil-tree garden make it an easy half-day from Benxi, and in winter rime often forms around the cave mouth.
description: 本溪水洞景区，位于中国辽宁省本溪市东郊，是目前发现的世界第一长的地下充水溶洞，形成至今已有数十万年的历史。2015年，本溪水洞风景名胜区被评为中华人民共和共国家5A级旅游景区。
officialName: 本溪市本溪水洞景区
accessEn: The caves are about 26 km east of central Benxi (about 36 km by road) in the Xiaoshi area; a local bus from Benxi's central passenger station to Xiaoshi takes around 30 minutes. From Shenyang, go to Benxi first by train or bus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 千山
summaryEn: Qianshan is a mountain scenic area of about 44 sq km, among the first national scenic areas named in 1982, where about 95 percent of the ground is forested and many pines are over a century old. Paved stone paths climb past temples, shrines and stelae to rocky viewpoints, and three cable-car routes shorten some of the climbs. It is one of few places where Buddhist monasteries and Daoist temples share one mountain, an easy day trip from Anshan or Shenyang.
description: 千山景区位于辽宁省鞍山市中心东南约25公里处，是千山山脉的精华部分。为中国政府在1982年公布的首批国家级风景名胜区之一，亦是中国国家5A级旅游景区。千山主峰仙人台海拔708.5米。
officialName: 鞍山市千山景区
accessEn: The main gate is in the hills about 16 km south-east of central Anshan; take a taxi or a city bus from the city. Reach Anshan from Shenyang by train or bus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 五女山
summaryEn: Wunü Mountain is a flat-topped massif with sheer cliffs above the Hun River, crowned by the stone ruins of a Koguryo (Goguryeo) hill fortress. The site is part of the UNESCO World Heritage listing for the Capital Cities and Tombs of the Ancient Koguryo Kingdom (2004), and a climb up the stone steps brings you to walls, gates and building foundations with views over Huanlong Lake. The 10.8 sq km scenic area also has a slot gorge, lookouts and a museum at the foot, and was rated 5A in 2024.
description: 五女山城又称纥升骨城、卒本城，是高句丽民族文明的发祥地，高句丽第一个都城。高句丽开国君主朱蒙自东夫余避祸南逃，于公元前37年在卒本川建国称王。前34年，筑纥升骨城，作为王都。
highlights: 山城遗址与一号建筑址
officialName: 本溪市五女山景区
accessEn: The fortress is about 8.5 km north-east of Huanren town and about 165 km by road from central Benxi, so most visitors go by road to Huanren and then take a taxi or local transport to the scenic area.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大连滨海路与老虎滩
summaryEn: Dalian's southern shore is strung along Binhai Road, a coastal drive and walk of about 35 km with sea views, cliffs and small bays. At its heart is Laohutan (Tiger Beach) Ocean Park, a commercial marine park on about 4 km of coastline. Together they make an easy family day out from the city; Jinshitan's beaches and sea-eroded rocks, further north-east, are a separate trip.
description: 大连老虎滩海洋公园位于中华人民共和国辽宁省大连市中山区滨海路沿线，是中华人民共和国国家5A级旅游景区。
officialName: 大连市老虎滩海洋公园—老虎滩极地馆
accessEn: Binhai Road and Laohutan are in Dalian's Zhongshan district, about 5.5 km south-east of Zhongshan Square; city buses and taxis reach them.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 镇北堡西部影城
summaryEn: Zhenbeibu is a film studio built in the ruins of two old frontier forts on the plain at the foot of the Helan Mountains. Films shot here include Red Sorghum, A Chinese Odyssey and New Dragon Gate Inn, and visitors wander through the Ming fort, the Qing fort and an 'Old Yinchuan' street laid out as sets. It is an easy, photogenic half-day from Yinchuan, especially for film fans.
description: 镇北堡西部影城位于宁夏银川市郊镇北堡，是中国西北地区一个影视基地。此处曾拍摄有《红高粱》、《大话西游》、《新龙门客栈》、电视剧《新龙门客栈》、《东邪西毒》、《双旗镇刀客》、《大旗英雄传》、《红河谷》、《黄河绝恋》等主要作品。
officialName: 银川市宁夏镇北堡西部影视城
accessEn: The studio is about 25 km north-west of central Yinchuan, around 40 minutes by taxi or car. A taxi or booked car is the most convenient way, and it combines easily with Helankou rock art.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 水洞沟
summaryEn: Shuidonggou is one of the first Palaeolithic sites excavated in China. Late Palaeolithic people left stone tools, hearths and ostrich-eggshell beads here, and the scenic area links the excavation localities and a site museum with a section of the Ming Great Wall, the walled Hongshanbao fort and the Cangbingdong tunnel fortifications. Few places in northern China put the Stone Age and the Ming frontier in one walk.
description: 水洞沟遗址位于中华人民共和国宁夏回族自治区灵武市，于1923年被发现及发掘，在中华人民共和国成立后再进行了多次发掘，截至2014年，该遗址发掘次数达到6次。水洞沟遗址是中国最早发掘的旧石器时代遗址之一，被誉为“东方史前考古的摇篮”。
officialName: 银川市水洞沟旅游区
accessEn: The scenic area is in Lingwu, about 30 km south-east of central Yinchuan, roughly 45 minutes by road; it is also close to Yinchuan Hedong Airport. Public transport is limited, so most visitors go by taxi, booked car or tour.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 青铜峡黄河大峡谷
summaryEn: Qingtongxia is the last gorge on the upper Yellow River, a long, narrow cleft between the foothills of the Helan range and Niushou Mountain. The scenic area ties together a water-conservancy museum, the dam begun in 1958, a river cruise through the gorge and the One Hundred and Eight Stupas, a triangle of brick stupas climbing the west-bank hillside. It makes an easy, varied half-day out of Yinchuan and shows why the river made Ningxia's plain so fertile.
description: 景区内可游览宁夏水利博览馆、青铜峡水利枢纽、十里长峡。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 吴忠市青铜峡黄河大峡谷旅游区
accessEn: From Yinchuan it is about 80 km by road to Qingtongxia, roughly 1–1.5 hours by car or taxi; buses run from Yinchuan to Qingtongxia town, and a taxi covers the last stretch to the scenic area. The stupas stand on the west bank a little upstream of the dam.

name: 塔尔寺
summaryEn: Kumbum is one of the six great monasteries of the Gelug school of Tibetan Buddhism, set on a hillside in Lusar town, Huangzhong District, built where the school's founder Tsongkhapa was born. Some 200,000 square metres of halls, colleges, residences and stupas climb the slopes, mixing Tibetan and Han styles, and the monastery is best known for its butter sculptures, murals and appliqué work. It is still a working monastery, so you share the lanes with monks and pilgrims.
description: 塔尔寺，又名塔儿寺，位于中国青海省西宁市湟中区鲁沙尔镇，是藏传佛教格鲁派六大寺院之一。该寺寺址为格鲁派创始人宗喀巴的诞生地。寺院建筑占地约20万平方米，建筑面积约45万平方米，共有各类房屋9300余间。
officialName: 西宁市塔尔寺景区
accessEn: The monastery is in Lusar town, about 26 km south-west of central Xining, 40 minutes to an hour by taxi or car. Local buses and tour minibuses also run from Xining; ask your hotel for the current pick-up point.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大明宫国家遗址公园
summaryEn: Just north of Xi'an Railway Station, this huge park marks out the Tang dynasty's main palace, whose timber halls vanished more than a thousand years ago. Enter through the Danfeng Gate, rebuilt as a protective hall over the excavated foundations of the five-passage main gate, then walk north past the bare earthen platforms of the Hanyuan, Xuanzheng and Zichen halls to the Taiye Pond, with a site museum and scale models to help you picture what stood here.
description: 大明宫又称东内，为唐长安城东北部的宫城。始建于唐太宗贞观八年，是唐长安城的三座主要宫殿群中规模最大的一座。自唐高宗起，唐朝的帝王们大都在这里居住和处理朝政，作为国家的统治中心，历时达二百余年。
officialName: 西安市大明宫旅游景区
accessEn: Take Metro Line 4 to Xi'anzhan (Xi'an Railway Station); the Danfeng Gate, the park's main entrance, faces the station's north building across the square. A taxi from the Bell Tower takes about 15 minutes.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 华清宫
summaryEn: At the northern foot of Mount Li in Lintong, about 30 km east of central Xi'an, Huaqing Palace is a landscaped complex of hot springs, lakes and pavilions where rulers built bathing palaces from the Zhou dynasty onwards. The Tang palace decayed after the An Lushan rebellion and most of what stands today is much later; the real survivors are the excavated bathing pools of the Tang emperors and their consorts, shown in a site museum. In the evening the dance drama The Song of Everlasting Sorrow is staged beside the lake, with floodlit Mount Li as its backdrop.
description: 华清池位于中华人民共和国陕西省西安临潼区骊山北麓，是唐代华清宫内的温泉浴池，以温泉和风景秀丽著称，更因唐玄宗和杨贵妃的爱情故事而著称于世。华清池是中国国家5A级旅游景区。景区内有唐代华清宫御汤遗址博物馆、西安事变旧址。
officialName: 西安市华清宫景区
accessEn: Take Metro Line 9 (change from Line 1 or 6 at Fangzhicheng) to Huaqingchi station, a few minutes' walk from the gate; tourist bus 306 from the east square of Xi'an Railway Station also stops here on its way to the Terracotta Army. A taxi from the Bell Tower takes about 45–60 minutes.
imageCredit: The original uploader was Yyk at Chinese Wikipedia.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 乾陵
summaryEn: On Liang Mountain in Qian County, about 85 km north-west of Xi'an, Qianling is the joint tomb of the Tang emperor Gaozong and his wife Wu Zetian, the only undisputed female sovereign in Chinese history. Its spirit way (the ceremonial approach to an imperial tomb) climbs between two southern hills, each topped by a tower, past stone pillars, winged horses, ostriches, five pairs of horses with grooms and ten pairs of officials, to Gaozong's inscribed stele, Wu Zetian's Wordless Stele and 61 headless statues of foreign envoys.
description: 乾陵是一座位于中华人民共和国陕西省咸阳市乾县梁山的唐朝帝陵，位于今陕西西安市西北方向85千米处，为唐高宗李治与武则天的合葬墓。乾陵建成于唐光宅元年，神龙二年加盖，采用依山为陵的建造方式。乾陵最著名的就是它气势磅礴的陵园规划，以及地表上大量的唐代石刻。
highlights: 永泰公主墓与乾陵博物馆
officialName: 咸阳市乾陵景区
accessEn: High-speed trains from Xi'an North reach Qianxian station in about 25–35 minutes; Qianling is then about 12 km away by taxi, roughly 20 minutes. A hired car from Xi'an takes about 1.5 hours each way.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 法门寺
summaryEn: Famen Temple, in Fufeng County about 120 km west of Xi'an, was favoured by Tang emperors as the home of a relic believed to be a finger bone of the Buddha. Start at the old temple, whose brick pagoda half collapsed in 1981: while clearing its base in 1987, archaeologists found a Tang crypt, and its gold and silver, glass and rare celadon are now shown in the museum beside it. Then walk up the long avenue of the modern cultural park to the 148-metre Namaste Dagoba, named for the gesture of palms pressed together, which now houses the relic.
description: 法门寺，又称为法云寺、阿育王寺，位于中国陕西省宝鸡市扶风县城北10公里处的法门镇，素有“关中塔庙始祖”之称，部分观点认为其始建于东汉末年桓灵年间。佛祖释迦牟尼涅槃后，遗体火化结成舍利，印度阿育王为弘扬佛法，将佛骨舍利分送世界各地，法门寺因舍利而置塔，因塔而建寺。
officialName: 宝鸡市法门文化景区
accessEn: A few direct coaches a day (recently only two) run from Xi'an's West (Chengxi) Coach Station, by Hanchenglu station on Metro Line 1, to the temple's south gate in about 2 hours; buses also run from Baoji. Many visitors instead join a day tour from Xi'an that pairs the temple with the Qianling Mausoleum, or hire a car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 太白山
summaryEn: Mount Taibai, where Mei, Taibai and Zhouzhi counties meet, is the highest peak of the Qinling Mountains, the range commonly taken as the line between northern and southern China, and rises to about 3,770 metres at Baxian Tai. From the visitor centre at Tangyu, park buses climb through forest to Hongshuping, where the Tianxia cable car lifts you to Tianyuan Difang at 3,511 metres. Short walks lead on from the top station, but the summit lies a long, high hike beyond.
description: 太白山，又称太一山，位于陕西省西南部眉县、太白县和周至县交界处。主峰拔仙台海拔3767.2米，也是秦岭主峰，是汉江和渭河的分水岭，也是青藏高原以东、陕西省的第一高峰。《水经注》载：“汉武帝时，已有太白山神祠，其神名谷春，是列仙传中人。
officialName: 宝鸡市太白山旅游景区
accessEn: High-speed trains from Xi'an North reach Baoji South in about an hour. From Baoji, take a bus to Mei County and then a local bus to the visitor centre at Tangyu, or allow about an hour by taxi or hired car; park buses run from the visitor centre to the cable car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黄帝陵
summaryEn: On Mount Qiao at Huangling, in the loess hills north of Xi'an, this is the traditional burial place of the Yellow Emperor (Huangdi), a legendary ruler revered as a common ancestor of the Chinese people. Start in Xuanyuan Temple at the foot of the hill, where a huge cypress inside the gate is said to have been planted by the Yellow Emperor himself, some 5,000 years ago according to local tradition. Then climb through the old cypress woods that cover the hill to the walled tomb mound on the summit.
description: 黄帝陵或称黄陵，曾称桥陵，位于陕西省黄陵县城北，是全国数座黄帝陵之一。号称“天下第一陵”。相传黄帝得道升天，故此陵墓为衣冠冢。
highlights: 桥山龙驭碑与黄帝陵冢
officialName: 延安市黄帝陵景区
accessEn: High-speed trains on the Xi'an–Yan'an line take about 50 minutes from Xi'an North to Huangling station. The mausoleum is about 9 km east of the station, roughly 15 minutes by taxi.
imageCredit: The original uploader was Cncs wikipedia at Chinese Wikipedia.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 崂山
summaryEn: Mount Lao rises directly from the Yellow Sea coast east of Qingdao, its highest peak, Jufeng, reaching 1,132.7 m. Granite ridges, waterfalls, forest paths and Taoist temples are spread across six scenic zones, so you can mix a coastal temple visit with a proper mountain walk. It is regarded as one of the cradles of Taoism and makes an easy day out from the city.
description: 崂山，古称劳山、牢山，是位于中华人民共和国山东省青岛市，黄海之滨的山，主峰巨峰海拔1132.7米，为山东省第三高峰。1982年被国务院设为中国名胜景区之一。其上道教宫观太清宫1983年获称道教全国重点宫观。
officialName: 青岛市崂山景区
accessEn: Scenic zones lie 25–35 km east of central Qingdao. Metro Line 11 serves Beijiushui (and, with a bus change, Yangkou), while Taiqing and Jufeng are reached via Line 4 to the Dahedong visitor centre and a scenic bus; a taxi takes roughly 40 minutes to an hour. Bus numbers change, so check a current route planner.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 蓬莱阁与蓬莱水城
summaryEn: Penglai Pavilion, first built in 1061 on Danya Hill above the sea, ranks among China's Four Great Towers and is tied to the legend of the Eight Immortals. Below it, the Ming Penglai Water City, begun in 1376 as a coastal defence base, keeps its sea gate, harbour and walls, with the Ancient Ships Museum and the Qi Jiguang Memorial Hall inside. Together they make an easy, scenic coastal day trip from Yantai.
description: 蓬莱阁坐落在山东省烟台市蓬莱区北濒海的丹崖山上，始建于北宋嘉佑六年，与黄鹤楼、岳阳楼、滕王阁并称为“中国四大名楼”。蓬莱阁景区由蓬莱阁、天后宫、龙五宫、吕祖殿、三清殿、弥陀寺六大单体及其附属建筑组成，面积1.89万平方米。
officialName: 烟台市蓬莱阁-三仙山-八仙过海旅游区
accessEn: High-speed trains from Yantai reach Penglai in about 30–45 minutes; check which Penglai station your ticket uses (Penglai City station opened in 2024), then take a taxi of roughly 15 minutes to the seafront. By road it is about 65 km west-north-west of central Yantai.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天下第一泉景区
summaryEn: The Best Spring Under Heaven Scenic Area strings together Baotu Spring Park, the Five Dragon Pool, the old-city moat with its Huancheng Park, and Daming Lake, with Baotu, Black Tiger and Five Dragon Pool as the three main spring groups. Baotu Spring, named 'First Spring under Heaven' by the Qianlong Emperor, is the best known of Jinan's 72 named springs, and a gentle walk or boat trip along the moat leads on to Daming Lake. It is the easiest way to see why Jinan is called the City of Springs.
description: 景区内可游览趵突泉、万竹园、黑虎泉。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 济南市天下第一泉景区
accessEn: The scenic area sits in the heart of central Jinan, with Baotu Spring about 0.6 km west of Quancheng Square and Daming Lake about 1.5 km north of it; the metro, city buses and taxis all reach the gates. Jinan's high-speed stations (Jinan West and Jinan East) are a short metro or taxi ride away.

name: 周村古商城
summaryEn: Zhoucun Ancient Commercial City is a preserved trading quarter built around Dajie (Main Street) and the old silk-market and silver-market streets, with Ming and Qing shopfronts, workshops and small museums. Zhoucun grew into an inland hub for silk and cloth and was opened as a commercial port in 1904. It is an easy, walkable half day, and the place to taste the thin, crisp shaobing the town is known for.
description: 周村古商业街，位于山东省淄博市周村区，是中华人民共和国山东省文物保护单位之一。2006年12月7日，授予山东省文物保护单位，是一座古建筑。
officialName: 淄博市周村古商城景区
accessEn: Zhoucun is in Zhoucun District, about 19 km west of central Zibo; city buses and taxis from Zibo take about half an hour. From Jinan, take a high-speed train to Zibo (under an hour) and continue by taxi or bus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 青州古城
summaryEn: Qingzhou's restored old town is a Ming and Qing-style quarter of lanes and shop streets in the centre of Qingzhou, on the site of several successive walled cities. It is the old-town core of Qingzhou's 5A scenic area, which also takes in Yunmen Mountain and the Qingzhou Museum. It makes a quieter, more local stop than Shandong's headline sights, and pairs well with the museum's Buddhist statues.
description: 青州古城是位于山东省潍坊市青州市范公亭西路与偶园街交叉口的古城遗址和旅游景区。2017年成为国家5A级旅游景区。青州古城旅游区面积约10平方公里。
officialName: 潍坊市青州古城景区
accessEn: Qingzhou is on the Jinan–Qingdao high-speed line, roughly 40 minutes to 1.5 hours from Jinan depending on the train; take a taxi or local bus from the station into town. The old town is in the centre of Qingzhou, about 60 km west of Weifang city centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 台儿庄古城
summaryEn: Taierzhuang is a Grand Canal port town of about 2 km² that was rebuilt in old canal-town style between 2009 and 2013. Most of what you see is therefore a recreation rather than original fabric, but it is a pleasant place to wander cobbled lanes, ride a boat along the canal and drop into small themed museums. It is at its best in the evening, when the waterways and rooflines are lit up.
description: 台儿庄古城，位于中国山东省枣庄市台儿庄区。原台儿庄古城在1938年台儿庄战役中严重毁损，后于2009年至2013年重建。台儿庄景区被列入国家5A级旅游景区。
officialName: 枣庄市台儿庄古城景区
accessEn: Take a high-speed train on the Beijing–Shanghai line to Zaozhuang station, then the BRT express bus B10 (named by Xinhua's 2025 visitor guide) to the old town's visitor centre, or a taxi or ride-hailing car. The old town is about 47 km from the station in a straight line and 60–70 km by road, so allow one to two hours.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 沂蒙山景区
summaryEn: Mount Meng (Mengshan) is a granite range in the Yimeng hills, topped by Guimeng Peak at 1,156 m, the second-highest summit in Shandong. Forested slopes, steep cliffs, waterfalls and rocks eroded into animal shapes make it the province's finest mountain scenery away from the coast, with misty cloud seas in the right weather. The area is rated 5A as the Yimengshan scenic area and is the Mengshan part of the Linyi Yimengshan UNESCO Global Geopark.
description: 沂蒙山泛指中华人民共和国山东省中南部的一片山系，大体处于潍坊的沂山，及其以南的临沂山区，由数座大山、绵延丘陵及河间平原组成。其中主要山脉有沂山、蒙山、孟良崮等，主要河流有沂河、沭河、祊河等。沂蒙山小调是当地的民间戏曲。
officialName: 沂蒙山旅游区
accessEn: The Guimeng area (pinned) is about 19 km east of Pingyi county town and 65 km north-west of Linyi, reached by taxi, ride-hailing or car; Linyi North is the high-speed rail station. The Yunmeng area is about 17 km south of Mengyin county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 陆家嘴
summaryEn: Lujiazui is the financial district on a bend of the Huangpu in Pudong, home to the Oriental Pearl Tower, Jin Mao Tower and the twisting Shanghai Tower. The 468-metre Oriental Pearl Tower, opened in 1995, has spheres strung on concrete columns, with an outdoor viewing corridor in the lower sphere and a glass-floored walkway at 259 metres in the upper sphere. From the riverfront here you look straight across the water at the Bund.
description: 东方明珠广播电视塔，是一座位于中华人民共和国上海市浦东陆家嘴的未来主义式广播电视塔，与外滩隔黄浦江相望。其原名为“上海广播电视塔”，上海市民也常简称其为“东方明珠”。该建筑由华东建筑设计研究院设计，1991年7月30日动工，1994年11月18日落成，1995年5月1日开放。
officialName: 东方明珠广播电视塔
accessEn: Metro Lines 2 and 14 stop at Lujiazui station, a short walk from the Oriental Pearl Tower. It is one stop by Line 2 from the East Nanjing Road station on the Bund side.
imageCredit: This Photo was taken by Supanut Arunoprayote. Feel free to use any of my images, but pleas
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上海科技馆
summaryEn: A large science museum on Century Avenue in Pudong, opened in 2001 around the theme of nature, people and technology. After a renovation that closed it from March 2023, it reopened in stages from February 2026, and its permanent exhibition areas, including a rainforest zone opened in April 2026, sit alongside giant-screen and dome cinemas. It suits families and anyone who likes hands-on science displays, and rain or heat is no problem.
description: 上海科技馆位于中国上海市浦东新区花木行政文化中心区的世纪大道2000号，是以科普教育为主的展览馆，以“自然·人·科技”为主题。
officialName: 上海科技馆
accessEn: Metro Line 2 stops at Shanghai Science and Technology Museum station beside the building, about 15 minutes from People's Square; Century Park is next door.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上海野生动物园
summaryEn: Opened in 1995 on the southern edge of Pudong, this is a large safari-style zoo of about 153 hectares with more than 200 species and over 10,000 animals. A drive-through area lets you watch zebras, rhinos, big cats and bears from a vehicle, while a walking area has giant pandas, elephants, giraffes and primates, and a boat ride visits golden snub-nosed monkeys. It is a commercial park with some fairground rides too, and best for families.
description: 上海野生动物园是由中国上海市人民政府和国家林业局合作建设的中国首座国家级野生动物园，位于上海市浦东新区宣桥镇南六公路178号，占地153公顷，距上海市中心约35公里。
officialName: 上海野生动物园
accessEn: The park lies about 35 km from the city centre; take Metro Line 16 to Wild Animal Park station, about 2 km from the main gate, then a short bus or taxi ride along Nanliu Highway. Allow well over an hour each way from central Shanghai.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 五台山
summaryEn: Mount Wutai in north-east Shanxi is one of China's four sacred Buddhist mountains, a high massif whose five flat-topped peaks, the 'five terraces', are identified with Manjushri, the bodhisattva of wisdom. Dozens of Han Chinese and Tibetan Buddhist monasteries cluster around the valley town of Taihuai: walk from Xiantong Temple to the great White Stupa of Tayuan Temple, then climb to yellow-roofed Pusading. With a second day, ride a tourist minibus up to the bare, grassy terraces themselves.
description: 五台山位于中国山西省东北部忻州市五台县东北隅，汉传佛教传统认为是文殊菩萨的道场，有“金五台”之称，位居中国四大佛教名山之首。是中华人民共和国国务院首批公布的国家级重点风景名胜区、国家森林公园，也是中华十大名山之首、国家首批4A级旅游区，现5A级景区。
officialName: 忻州市五台山风景名胜区
accessEn: Long-distance buses from Taiyuan East Bus Station reach Taihuai in about 3.5–4 hours, and there are also buses from Datong (about 4 hours) and from Xinzhou, near Xinzhou West high-speed station. Slow trains from Beijing and Taiyuan stop at Wutaishan station in Shahe, about 1.5 hours from Taihuai by bus or car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 雁门关
summaryEn: About 20 km north of Dai county town, Yanmen Pass guards a gap in the mountains on the Ming-dynasty Inner Great Wall, long a strategic route between the plains of northern Shanxi and the steppe frontier. Walk through the stone gates of the fort, look into the shrine to the general Li Mu, then follow the wall as it climbs the ridges to the watchtowers.
description: 雁门关又名西陉关，位于中华人民共和国山西省忻州市代县县城以北约20公里处的雁门山中，是长城上的重要关隘，与宁武关、偏关合称为“外三关”。现为全国重点文物保护单位、国家5A级旅游景区。与函谷关、仙霞关、剑门关并称中国四大古关口。
officialName: 忻州市雁门关景区
accessEn: High-speed trains on the Jining–Datong–Yuanping line stop at Yanmenguan station in Dai county, under an hour from Datong South and about an hour from Taiyuan South; the pass is about 30 km (40 minutes) away by taxi or by the station bus to the scenic area. By car, allow about 2 hours from Datong and 2–2.5 hours from Taiyuan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 晋祠
summaryEn: At the foot of Xuanweng Mountain, about 25 km south-west of central Taiyuan, Jinci is a spring-fed complex of shrines, pavilions, bridges and old trees added to over many centuries. Make for the Song-dynasty Hall of the Holy Mother, with wooden dragons coiled around its front pillars and about 40 life-size painted clay attendants inside, then walk over the cross-shaped Fish Pond Flying Bridge in front of it and find the reclining Zhou cypress beside the hall, said to be some 3,000 years old.
description: 晋祠，位于中华人民共和国山西省太原市晋源区晋祠镇，或称“晋国宗祠”，原名为晋王祠，初名唐叔虞祠，是为祭祀周朝晋国的开国诸侯唐叔虞及其母亲邑姜所建，是中国现存最早的皇家祭祀园林。祠内的周柏、难老泉、宋塑侍女像被誉为“晋祠三绝”，圣母殿、鱼沼飞梁、献殿则被誉为“晋祠三宝”。
officialName: 太原市晋祠天龙山景区
accessEn: Taiyuan South station is about 2.5–3 hours from Beijing by high-speed train. From central Taiyuan a taxi to Jinci takes around 40 minutes, and city buses from both railway stations stop at Jinci Park.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 乔家大院
summaryEn: In Qiaojiabao village in Qi county, about 30 km north-east of Pingyao, the Qiao family's mansion is a walled cluster of grey-brick courtyard houses begun in the 1750s and later home to the merchant-banker Qiao Zhiyong (1818–1907). Walk from courtyard to courtyard and through rooms laid out with period furniture and displays on merchant life, farming customs and local festivals.
description: 乔家大院位于山西省祁县乔家堡村，是清代著名晋商乔致庸的宅第。乔家大院于2001年被列入全国重点文物保护单位。
officialName: 晋中市乔家大院景区
accessEn: Qixian East station, about 30 minutes from Taiyuan South by high-speed train, is under 20 km from the compound by taxi. From Pingyao (about 30 km) or Taiyuan (about 54 km), a taxi or hired car takes an hour or less.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 壶口瀑布
summaryEn: On the Yellow River between Ji County in Shanxi and Yichuan County in Shaanxi, Hukou ('teapot spout') is where a river hundreds of metres wide is funnelled into a rock trough a few dozen metres across and pours into it in a churning brown cascade. On the Shanxi bank, paths and steps lead down to viewing points beside the falls and along the gorge below.
description: 壶口瀑布是黄河中游流经晋陕大峡谷时形成的一个天然瀑布。东为吕梁山脉南端的火焰山，临山西省临汾市吉县；西为黄龙山，临陕西省延安市宜川县壶口乡，距吉县县城西南约25公里。瀑布宽达30米，深约50米，最大瀑面为3万平方米。
officialName: 黄河壶口瀑布旅游区(陕西省延安市·山西省临汾市)
accessEn: High-speed trains from Taiyuan South reach Linfen West in about 1–1.5 hours. The falls are roughly 150 km west of Linfen: allow 2–3 hours each way by hired car or day tour, as buses run via Ji County and are slow.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 皇城相府
summaryEn: In Yangcheng County, about 25 km west of Jincheng, Huangcheng Xiangfu ('the chancellor's residence at Huangcheng') is the walled estate of the Chen family, a maze of courtyard houses, towers and gardens built mostly in the late Ming and early Qing dynasties. Enter through the outer town built for Chen Tingjing, then climb into the older hillside inner town and its tall defensive Hanshan Tower; the estate also houses a dictionary museum.
description: 皇城相府，又称午亭山村，是清朝康熙年间的文渊阁大学士陈廷敬所修的府邸，位于山西省晋城市阳城县北留镇皇城村，为中国国家AAAAA级景区。皇城相府共有16座院落，640间房屋，总面积3万6580平方米，分内城、外城两部分。
officialName: 晋城市皇城相府生态文化旅游区
accessEn: Take high-speed rail to Jincheng East (about 1.5–2 hours from Taiyuan South), then a taxi for the 45–60 minute drive to Huangcheng village in Beiliu town; Jincheng's Tourism Line 1 bus also serves the site.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 都江堰
summaryEn: Dujiangyan is the ancient water-management scheme that turned the Chengdu Plain into the 'Land of Abundance', and it still works after more than 2,200 years. Rather than damming the Min River, it splits the flow with a fish-mouth levee, spills floodwater and silt over a low weir and feeds the plain through a channel cut through solid rock. Walk from the Bottle-Neck Channel past the Flying Sand Weir to the Fish Mouth, then cross the swaying Anlan suspension bridge to the Two Kings Temple.
description: 都江堰是中国古代建设并使用至今的大型水利工程，位于四川省都江堰市城西，岷江上游340公里处。据《史记·河渠书》、《汉书·沟洫志》记载，都江堰是由战国时期秦国蜀郡郡守李冰及其子于约前256年至前251年主持始建，另有一说法是古蜀国开明王朝期间所建。
officialName: 成都市青城山－都江堰旅游景区
accessEn: Intercity trains from Xipu station, on Chengdu Metro Line 2, reach Lidui Park station in about 25–30 minutes, a short walk from the entrance; a few trains also run from Chengdu East. A taxi from central Chengdu takes about an hour.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黄龙
summaryEn: Huanglong is a narrow valley in the Minshan mountains where calcium-rich water has built thousands of terraced travertine pools, tinted turquoise, jade and gold. A boardwalk follows the 3.6-km travertine flow past cascades and pool fields up to the Five-Colour Pool at 3,576 m. It makes a natural pairing with Jiuzhaigou, a couple of hours away.
description: 黄龙风景名胜区，是位于四川省北部阿坝藏族羌族自治州松潘县境内的一个风景名胜区，在1992年与九寨沟共同登录成为世界自然遗产。
officialName: 阿坝州黄龙风景名胜区
accessEn: Trains from Chengdu East reach Huanglong Jiuzhai station at Chuanzhusi in about 1.5–2 hours; shuttle buses and taxis cover the last 26 km in 30–40 minutes. Jiuzhaigou is about 2–2.5 hours away by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 四姑娘山
summaryEn: Mount Siguniang is a cluster of four snow peaks in the Qionglai range, the highest of which, Yaomei Feng, reaches 6,250 m. Three valleys fan out from Rilong (now Siguniangshan Town): Shuangqiao, with a sightseeing-bus road to its far end; Changping, a long forested trekking valley; and Haizi, a tougher high-altitude hike to alpine lakes. The area is part of the UNESCO-listed Sichuan Giant Panda Sanctuaries.
description: 四姑娘山位于四川省阿坝藏族羌族自治州小金县四姑娘山镇境内，地处邛崃山脉中段，毗邻卧龙国家级自然保护区和米亚罗自然保护区，先后于1994年、1996年被国务院批准建立“四姑娘山国家重点风景名胜区”和“小金四姑娘山国家级自然保护区”，属世界自然遗产“四川大熊猫栖息地”的重要组成部分。
officialName: 阿坝州四姑娘山景区
accessEn: Rilong is about 4 hours by road from Chengdu via Dujiangyan, the Wolong panda reserve (the Shenshuping panda base makes a good stop) and the Balangshan tunnel. Buses from Chengdu's Chadianzi bus station towards Xiaojin stop in town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 海螺沟
summaryEn: Hailuogou is a glacier valley on the eastern flank of Mount Gongga, whose summit rises to more than 7,500 metres. Park buses wind up through fir forest to a cable car that rides over the ice to viewing decks facing an icefall more than 1,000 metres high, while the glacier's tongue reaches down below 3,000 metres among the trees. Stay in the small town of Moxi at the park gate, where hot-spring hotels make a perfect end to a cold day.
description: 海螺沟冰川位于中国四川省甘孜藏族自治州泸定县境内，磨西镇旁，距离成都西南380多公里，是国家5A级景区。海螺沟位于贡嘎山东坡，以低海拔现代冰川、大冰瀑布、森林、云雾、红石滩和高山温泉而著称。
officialName: 甘孜州海螺沟景区
accessEn: Moxi is about 3.5 hours' drive from Chengdu now that the Luding–Shimian expressway links the Ya'an–Kangding expressway to a Hailuogou exit; long-distance buses are slower. From the gate near Moxi, park buses climb about 30 km to the glacier area and the cable car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 剑门关
summaryEn: Jianmen Pass is a narrow cleft where sheer cliffs part to let the ancient road from Shaanxi through into Sichuan, guarded by a rebuilt gate tower. A visit means a full day of steep stone stairways and cliff-hugging plank paths, with a cable car to save the climb. The adventurous can tackle the Yuannao Path, a trail without handrails up a near-vertical cliff, climbed in a helmet and safety rope.
description: 剑门关是位于中国四川省剑阁县剑门关镇的一座古代关隘。与雁门关、函谷关、仙霞关并称中国四大古关口，有剑门天下险之称。
officialName: 广元市剑门蜀道剑门关旅游景区
accessEn: Jianmenguan station, on the Xi'an–Chengdu high-speed line, is about 1.5 hours from Chengdu East and 15 minutes from Guangyuan. Local bus 7 or a taxi covers the last stretch to the scenic area's north and south gates in around half an hour.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 古文化街与天后宫
summaryEn: Ancient Culture Street is a pedestrian lane of Ming-and-Qing-style shop-houses on the west bank of the Hai River, opened on New Year's Day 1986. Its centrepiece is Tianhou Palace, a temple to the sea goddess Mazu, which now houses the Tianjin Folk Museum. The shops sell antiques, folk crafts and Tianjin snacks, making it an easy first taste of old Tianjin.
description: 古文化街是中华人民共和国天津市南开区的一条由仿中国清代民间小式店铺组成的商业步行街。原为以天津天后宫为中心的“宫南大街”和“宫北大街”，是天津最早的文化、宗教和商贸聚集之地。目前，古文化街北起通北路，南至水阁大街，全长687米，宽5米。
officialName: 天津古文化街旅游区（津门故里）
accessEn: In Nankai District on the west bank of the Hai River, about 1.5 km west-north-west of Tianjin Railway Station; take a taxi or city bus, or walk along the river.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 盘山
summaryEn: Panshan is a mountain scenic area of about 106 square kilometres in northern Jizhou, long called the 'first mountain east of the capital'. Its five main peaks, odd-shaped boulders and pines drew emperors for centuries: the Qianlong Emperor climbed it 32 times and wrote about 1,700 poems on it, and the area once held 72 temples and 13 pagodas. Today there are five visitor zones with more than 300 sights, from temple sites and pagodas to stone inscriptions.
description: 盘山，位于天津市蓟州区境内，是有名的风景区，被誉为“京东第一山”。早在清朝，乾隆皇帝就曾发出“早知有盘山，何必下江南”的感叹。四库全书中有《钦定盘山志》。
officialName: 盘山风景名胜区
accessEn: From Jizhou, tourist bus 11 reaches the scenic area in about 40 minutes. From Tianjin, take the train to Jizhou North (roughly 2 hours) or a bus to Jizhou, or drive via the Jin–Ji Expressway; seasonal tourist coaches have run from Tianjin and Beijing, so check current services.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大昭寺与八廓街
summaryEn: The Jokhang is regarded as the most sacred temple in Tibet, founded in the mid-7th century under King Songtsen Gampo and enlarged many times since. Its main chapel houses the Jowo Shakyamuni, a statue of the Buddha said to have been brought by Princess Wencheng, and the gilded roofs look out over Barkhor Square at the heart of Lhasa's old town. Pilgrims circle it day and night on the inner Nangkor and the outer Barkhor kora, which makes the streets around it the best place in Lhasa to watch living faith.
description: 大昭寺是藏区卫藏地区的一座藏传佛教寺院，位于中华人民共和国西藏自治区拉萨市老城区八廓街，该寺院在藏传佛教中拥有至高无上的地位。大昭寺建成后经历代重新扩建，目前占地25100余平方米。2000年，大昭寺作为布达拉宫的扩展项目被列为世界文化遗产。
officialName: 拉萨市大昭寺景区
accessEn: The temple stands in the old town about 1.5 km east of the Potala Palace and is walkable from most central Lhasa hotels. Lhasa itself is reached by air from major Chinese cities or on the Qinghai–Tibet Railway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 扎什伦布寺
summaryEn: Tashilhunpo, on the southern slope of a hill on the west side of central Shigatse, was founded in 1447 by Gendun Drup, later recognised as the first Dalai Lama, and has been the traditional seat of the Panchen Lamas since the 17th century. One of the six great monasteries of the Gelug school, it is a working monastery whose halls include a chapel with a giant gilded bronze statue of Maitreya and the tomb stupas of successive Panchen Lamas. Pilgrims walk the circuit path around its walls, and a tall wall above the complex is used to display giant thangkas at festivals.
description: 扎什伦布寺，简称扎寺，位于中国西藏自治区日喀则市主城区日光山南麓。始建于1447年，此后规模扩大、地位提高，成为后藏地区最大的寺庙，历代班禅喇嘛驻锡之地，旧时的后藏政治兼宗教中心。与前藏的拉萨三大寺，多康的塔尔寺、拉卜楞寺，并为藏传佛教格鲁派六大寺。
officialName: 日喀则市扎什伦布寺景区
accessEn: In central Shigatse, which is two to three hours from Lhasa by train or about 260 km by road. Carry your passport for road checkpoints.
imageCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Mongol assumed (based on copyright claims).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 雅鲁藏布大峡谷
summaryEn: The Yarlung Tsangpo runs east across the plateau for about 1,700 km, then swings round the snow peak of Namcha Barwa (7,782 m) and cuts through the eastern Himalaya in a gorge generally ranked the deepest on land. The 5A visitor area at Pai, in Mainling, covers the upper entrance of the canyon: scenic-area transport and walkways lead to viewpoints and villages such as Suosong, with views of the mountain when the clouds clear and peach blossom in spring. Only these developed sections are open to visitors.
description: 雅鲁藏布大峡谷，是雅鲁藏布江的大峡谷，位于中国西藏东南部的米林县和墨脱县境内，长504.6公里，最深为6009米。因为印度洋季风带来丰沛的降雨，使此地成为了世界上降雨量最大的地方之一，年降雨量达4500-11060毫米。
officialName: 林芝市雅鲁藏布大峡谷景区
accessEn: Pai is about 130 km by road from Bayi (Nyingchi city), roughly three hours; Bayi is about three and a half hours by train from Lhasa on the Lhasa–Nyingchi railway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 巴松措
summaryEn: Basum Tso (Draksum Tso in Tibetan) is a crescent-shaped, glacier-dammed lake in a deep valley of the upper Ba River, ringed by snow peaks and forest. On Tashi island stands Tsozong Monastery, and the lakeside village of Jieba is a traditional Kongpo farming village, so one day takes in lake, temple and village.
description: 巴松措，也称错高湖，位于中国西藏自治区林芝市工布江达县东部的巴河上游高峡深谷中，是一座冰川堰塞湖。湖面海拔约3480米，东西长13.8公里，南北平均宽1.85公里，面积25.5平方公里，最大水深60米，形状如新月。
officialName: 林芝市巴松措景区
accessEn: About 120 km by road from Bayi (Nyingchi city) and roughly 350 km from Lhasa; the turn-off from the Sichuan–Tibet highway (G318) is near Bahe.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 赛里木湖
summaryEn: Sayram Lake, roughly 450 km² at about 2,070 m in the northern Tian Shan, is Xinjiang's largest and highest alpine lake, fed by rain, glacial meltwater and groundwater and ringed by steppe. A 79 km road circles the shore, and around the lake lie some 2,800 ancient tombs – stone cairns, stone-slab graves and earth mounds from the Bronze Age to the Sui and Tang – protected as a national heritage site. A large new visitor centre opened in January 2025.
description: 赛里木湖，古称“净海”，位于中国新疆维吾尔自治区博尔塔拉蒙古自治州博乐市境内的北天山山脉中，紧邻伊犁哈萨克自治州霍城县，是新疆海拔最高、面积最大的高山冷水湖，是大西洋暖湿气流最后到达地方，因此有“大西洋最后一滴眼泪”的说法。
officialName: 博尔塔拉蒙古自治州赛里木湖景区
accessEn: The lake lies beside the G30 expressway between Bole and Yining, about an hour by road from Bole and roughly 1.5–2 hours from Yining. Buses and tour minibuses run from both towns, and most visitors hire a car for the day or join a day tour.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 那拉提草原
summaryEn: Mountain grassland, spruce forest and river valleys at the eastern end of the Ili valley in the heart of the Tianshan, with a planned area of about 1,840 km² and an average altitude of about 1,800 m. Tourism here began in the 1980s, and the developed part links some 27 viewpoints by scenic roads, with home visits to herding families, hiking, photography and stargazing camps among the activities. The scenic area lies close to the Duku Highway, a popular mountain drive across the Tianshan.
description: 那拉提旅游风景区，蒙古语意为“最先见到太阳的地方”，又名巩乃斯草原，突厥语意为“白阳坡”，位于中华人民共和国新疆维吾尔自治区伊犁哈萨克自治州新源县那拉提镇东部那拉提山北坡，为发育在第三纪古洪积层上的中山地草原，地处天山腹地，伊犁河谷东端。
officialName: 伊犁哈萨克自治州那拉提旅游风景区
accessEn: The scenic area is by Nalati town in Xinyuan County, about an hour by road from Xinyuan town; Xinyuan is roughly 2–3 hours by bus or car from Yining. Xinyuan Nalati Airport, about 60 km from the scenic area, mainly serves visitors, so check current flights.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 博斯腾湖
summaryEn: Bosten is a freshwater lake of about 1,000 km² on the south side of the Tian Shan, fed mainly by the Kaidu River and drained by the Kongque (Peacock) River. Its reed beds, bird life and long sandy shores give it the look of a sea in the desert, and the 5A scenic area is split between the Dahekou and Lianhai World sections. A lake-circuit road of roughly 240 km strings the main shore stops together for self-drivers.
description: 博斯腾湖，中国古称敦薨之浦，湖名来自维吾尔语意为绿洲，又名巴喀刺赤海、巴格拉什库勒，位于中国新疆维吾尔自治区巴音郭楞蒙古自治州博湖县天山南坡焉耆盆地的东南部，塔里木盆地北缘，是中国最大的内陆淡水湖。湖面海拔1048米，面积1160平方千米，水深为8~15米，平均深度8.1米。
officialName: 巴音郭楞蒙古自治州博斯腾湖景区
accessEn: The Dahekou section is about 25 km by road south-east of Yanqi and roughly an hour's drive north-east of Korla, which has the airport and rail links. Buses and taxis run from Korla and Yanqi, but the shore stops are spread out, so a car or charter makes the loop much easier.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 巴音布鲁克
summaryEn: A high grassland basin in the central Tian Shan at about 2,000–2,500 m, home mainly to Mongol herders, where the Kaidu River meanders through marshes and oxbow lakes. Its Swan Lake wetlands form a national swan reserve and part of the Xinjiang Tianshan World Heritage Site, and the best-known view is the river's 'nine bends and eighteen turns' seen from a hillside viewpoint, loveliest around sunset.
description: 巴音布鲁克草原一般指巴音郭楞蒙古自治州巴音布鲁克景区。巴音布鲁克是中国新疆巴州和静县西部的一个地区，和静县在这里撤区设立2乡2镇，即额勒再特乌鲁乡、巴音郭愣乡、巩乃斯镇、巴音布鲁克镇。清代这里也叫裕勒都斯，为新疆南部主要的草场，巴音布鲁克草原是中国第二大的草原。
officialName: 巴音郭楞蒙古自治州巴音布鲁克景区
accessEn: Bayanbulak town, where the visitor centre is, lies in western Hejing County, a long drive of several hours north-west of Korla, and has a small airport. It is also reached on the Duku Highway (G217), the mountain road that links Nalati and Bayanbulak and runs on to Kuqa, in the season it is open.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 葡萄沟
summaryEn: Grape Valley is a green gorge in the Flaming Mountains some 10 km east of Turpan, about 8 km long and watered by snowmelt from the Tian Shan. Trellised vines shade the paths, airy drying houses hang with ripening raisins, and Uyghur villages sit among the orchards. It is the easiest place to see why Turpan is China's raisin country, and a cool, shady contrast to the baked desert around it.
description: 景区内可游览葡萄长廊、葡萄晾房、青蛙巷。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 吐鲁番市葡萄沟风景区
accessEn: The valley is about 10 km from central Turpan, a short taxi or hired-car ride; many visitors combine it with Jiaohe and the Flaming Mountains on a day with a driver. Turpan is about an hour from Ürümqi by high-speed train, though the station is outside the town.

name: 塔什库尔干石头城
summaryEn: Stone City is a ruined walled town on a hill at the edge of Tashkurgan, a small town high in the Pamir foothills on the Karakoram Highway. Below it spread the streams and meadows of the Alar Golden Grassland wetland, and beyond rise snow peaks, so the setting is better than the ruin itself. The area is also a window into the Tajik people of the Pamirs, with a folk village and a heritage park.
description: 石头城遗址位于中国新疆喀什地区塔什库尔干塔吉克自治县县城东北侧的山坡上，面积10万平方米，现存晋时期与唐时期的城址、寺院和清代官署。城址呈椭圆形，墙以石为基，上部用土坯砌成。
highlights: 彩云人家塔吉克民俗村
officialName: 喀什地区帕米尔旅游区
accessEn: The scenic area lies on the north-eastern edge of Tashkurgan town, about 290 km from Kashgar along the Karakoram Highway, roughly 4–5 hours by road; share-taxis, minibuses and day tours leave from Kashgar, and many travellers stop at Karakul Lake on the way.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 可可托海
summaryEn: Koktokay is a 5A scenic area in the Altai Mountains, centred on the Irtysh Grand Canyon, where the young Irtysh runs between pale granite walls and birch and larch woods, past waterfalls and the rock spire known as Divine Bell Mountain. The wider area adds Kekesuli, a reed-fringed lake that migrating birds use as a stopover and Yilemu Lake, and a separate mine park preserves the No. 3 Pit. In autumn the birch and poplar turn yellow and gold.
description: 景区内可游览白桦林与夫妻树、神钟山、喀拉卓勒瀑布。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 阿勒泰地区可可托海景区
accessEn: The scenic area is about an hour by road north-east of Fuyun county town, which has Fuyun Koktokay Airport with flights from Ürümqi. Self-driving or a hired car from Fuyun is the most flexible way; the canyon road is served by a park shuttle.

name: 中国科学院西双版纳热带植物园
summaryEn: Run by the Chinese Academy of Sciences, this vast research garden beside the town of Menglun holds more than 13,000 kinds of plants in themed collections, from palms, bamboos and orchids to towering banyans and aquatic plants. The landscaped West Park is easiest to tour by electric cart, while the East Park protects a patch of primary tropical rainforest threaded with shady walking trails. It is one of the best places in China to see what a real tropical forest looks like.
description: 中国科学院西双版纳热带植物园，位于云南省西双版纳傣族自治州勐腊县勐仑镇葫芦岛，从景洪市市区出发需乘车到达，为中华人民共和国国家5A级旅游景区，面积约1125公顷。
officialName: 西双版纳州中科院西双版纳热带植物园
accessEn: Menglun is about 70 km south-east of Jinghong, roughly 1–1.5 hours by road. Buses run from Jinghong's Banna bus station, or take a taxi or hired car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 和顺古镇
summaryEn: Just outside Tengchong, Heshun's grey-tiled courtyard houses climb a hillside above a stream, stone bridges and rice fields, linked by lanes paved with volcanic stone. Generations of its men traded in Burma and beyond, and their money built clan ancestral halls, memorial archways, mansions mixing Chinese and Western styles and the Heshun Library, founded in 1928 and often called China's largest village library. It is a gentle place to wander and to spend a night.
description: 景区内可游览和顺图书馆、双虹桥、洗衣亭。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
officialName: 腾冲市和顺古镇景区
accessEn: Heshun is about 4 km south-west of central Tengchong, around 15 minutes by taxi. Tengchong has no railway: fly from Kunming to Tengchong Tuofeng Airport in about an hour, or take the train to Baoshan (about 4 hours from Kunming, under 2 from Dali) and continue about 2 hours by road.

name: 千岛湖
summaryEn: Qiandao Lake, or Thousand Island Lake, is a vast reservoir in Chun'an county where hilltops rise from clear green water as forested islands. Cruises from Qiandaohu town visit a selection of islands, with lookouts, short walks and a sense of space that city-weary visitors enjoy. It works as a quiet overnight escape rather than a checklist of sights.
description: 千岛湖，又称新安江水库，为新安江水电站的水体部分，位于中华人民共和国浙江省杭州市西南部的淳安县和建德市境内，以发电为主，兼有防洪、灌溉、渔业、航运、旅游等功能。为多年调节大型水库。1959年在新安江建德马铜官峡筑坝兴建水电站而形成的人工湖，面积达567.40平方公里。
officialName: 杭州市千岛湖风景区
accessEn: Qiandaohu station, on the Hangzhou–Huangshan high-speed line, is about an hour by train from Hangzhou East; local buses and taxis cover the roughly 30 km to the piers at Qiandaohu town. Driving from Hangzhou takes around two to two and a half hours, depending on traffic.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 普陀山
summaryEn: One of the four sacred mountains of Chinese Buddhism, Putuo is a small island of about 12.5 km² where dozens of temples and nunneries sit among camphor groves, rocky headlands and sandy beaches. It is the holy site of Guanyin, and pilgrims, monks and day-trippers share the same lanes. Come for the combination of sea air, incense and temple architecture, which feels quite unlike the inland Buddhist mountains.
description: 普陀山，是中华人民共和国浙江省舟山群岛中的一个岛屿，也是中国四大佛教名山之一，是观音菩萨的道场，被誉为“海天佛国”、“南海圣境”。普陀山原名梅岑山，后改以观音菩萨在南印度海边的应化道场“补怛洛伽山”之名相称，又作“普陀落伽”，是中国四大佛教名山中唯一坐落于海上的佛教圣地。
officialName: 舟山市普陀山风景区
accessEn: Take a fast ferry of roughly 15–30 minutes from Banshengdong pier in Shenjiamen, or from the pier at Wugongzhi on Zhujiajian Island (near Zhoushan Putuoshan Airport). Shenjiamen and Zhujiajian are linked by bridges to the mainland, so long-distance buses run there from Ningbo, Hangzhou and Shanghai; confirm current schedules before travelling.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 横店影视城
summaryEn: Hengdian is a commercial film-studio complex in Dongyang, where full-size replica palaces and old streets are used for Chinese films and television dramas and opened to paying visitors. The 5A area includes Guangzhou and Hong Kong Streets, the Palace of the Qin King, the Song-dynasty city of Along the River During the Qingming Festival, a Ming and Qing palace complex modelled on the Forbidden City, and the Dream Valley theme park. It is more a day of staged spectacle than of heritage, with live shows, rides and sometimes a crew shooting a scene.
description: 横店影视城，又称横店影视基地，是中国目前面积最大的影视拍摄基地，也是中国首个国家级影视产业实验区，位于浙江省金华市东阳市横店镇，由横店集团的子公司浙江横店影视城有限公司所有。该影城规模巨大。
officialName: 金华市横店影视城景区
accessEn: Hengdian station on the Hangzhou–Wenzhou high-speed railway (opened 2024) is about 6 km from the centre of Hengdian town; the Jinhua–Yiwu–Dongyang rail transit line and buses or taxis run from the station to the town and the parks. Yiwu is one stop away on the high-speed line.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 西溪湿地
summaryEn: Xixi is a wetland of about 11.5 km² on the western edge of Hangzhou, threaded by six main watercourses with ponds, reed beds and old persimmon trees between them. It was China's first national wetland park, and it makes a quieter, greener counterpart to West Lake, with boats, boardwalks and water-village buildings in place of crowds of lakeside promenaders. Close to 90 bird species have been recorded here.
description: 西溪湿地位于中华人民共和国浙江省杭州市城西，距西湖5公里，是一块城中次生湿地，得名于西溪河，西溪曾与西湖和西泠合称“三西”。湿地占地总面积约11.5平方公里，是中国第一个集城市湿地、农耕湿地、文化湿地于一体的国家湿地公园，有“天堂绿肺”之称，现为国家5A级旅游景区。
officialName: 杭州市西溪湿地旅游区
accessEn: It is about 5 km west of West Lake. Xixi Wetland South station on Metro Line 3 is beside the Zhoujiacun entrance on the east side, and Xixi Wetland North station on Line 19 serves the north side.
imageCredit: shankar s. from Dubai, united arab emirates
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天一阁·月湖
summaryEn: Tianyi Ge, built in 1561–1566 by the official Fan Qin, is the oldest surviving private library in China: a two-storey book tower with a fire-pond in front and a rockery garden. The museum around it adds the Fan family residence, a forest of steles and a carved clan hall, and next door Moon Lake is a park of islands, bridges and restored historic houses in the heart of the city.
description: 天一阁是中国现存最古老的私家藏书楼，位于中国浙江省宁波市月湖西侧的天一街。天一阁于明代嘉靖四十年，由当时的兵部右侍郎范钦主持建造。它不但收藏了大量珍贵的图书典籍，并且对后世其他藏书楼的兴修也产生过重大影响。
officialName: 宁波市天一阁•月湖景区
accessEn: In central Ningbo on the west side of Moon Lake, a short walk from Gulou and Dongmenkou stations on Metro Line 1; check a map app for the best exit. Ningbo is roughly an hour from Hangzhou by high-speed train.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 西塘
summaryEn: Xitang is a canal town of Ming and Qing houses threaded by nine waterways and linked by old stone bridges. Its signature is a roofed walkway of nearly a kilometre beside the canal, backed by narrow alleys such as Shipi Lane. Compared with Wuzhen it is a little more lived-in and lively, and it is at its best in the evening, when lanterns reflect on the water.
description: 西塘，古称胥塘、斜塘，又名平川，位于浙江省嘉善县，在嘉善县城北10公里处，是一座已有千年历史文化的古镇。面积约1平方公里，春秋战国时期是吴越两国的相交之地，故有“吴根越角”和“越角人家”之称。西塘地势平坦，河流纵横，环境幽静，保存着完好的明清古建筑群，古镇中临河的街道都有廊棚，廊棚沿河而建，连为一体，绵延不断，总长近千米，类似北京颐和园的长廊。
officialName: 嘉兴市西塘古镇旅游景区
accessEn: Jiashan South high-speed station is the nearest main rail stop, roughly 20 km by road, with buses and taxis onward to the town. Central Shanghai is roughly 1.5 hours away by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南浔古镇
summaryEn: Nanxun is a canal town that grew rich on raw silk, and its late-Qing magnates left behind gardens and mansions that mix Chinese craft with Western details. Less crowded than better-known water towns, it rewards slow walking between a lotus-pond garden, a private library and riverside rows of old houses.
description: 南浔镇是浙江省湖州市南浔区辖镇，也是该区政府所在地，中国历史文化名镇之一。2023年中国文化百强镇。南浔镇自南宋淳祐季年(1252年)建镇至今已有758年历史，因地处江浙沪三地交界处附近，历史上也曾划归苏州管辖。
officialName: 湖州市南浔古镇景区
accessEn: Huzhou Nanxun station on the Shanghai–Suzhou–Huzhou high-speed railway (opened 26 December 2024) is about 6 km from the old town, roughly 15 minutes by taxi, and Shanghai Hongqiao is under an hour away by train, so Nanxun makes an easy day trip.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鲁迅故里·沈园
summaryEn: This historic quarter on Lu Xun Middle Road is where Lu Xun (Zhou Shuren), one of the founding figures of modern Chinese fiction, was born in 1881 and lived until 1898. It takes in his family homes, the Baicao Garden, the Sanwei Study and a memorial hall, and about 500 m east lies Shen Garden, linked to the Song poet Lu You's famous verses.
description: 鲁迅故里位于中华人民共和国浙江省绍兴市越城区鲁迅中路，是绍兴市一个历史文化街区，包括鲁迅祖居、鲁迅故居、三味书屋、绍兴鲁迅纪念馆以及土谷寺和绍兴古玩城。作家鲁迅于1881年在此出生并成长直至1898年离开。
officialName: 绍兴市鲁迅故里•沈园景区
accessEn: In the south of Shaoxing's old city, a short walk from Luxun Guli station on Shaoxing Metro Line 1. Shaoxing is under an hour from Hangzhou by high-speed rail.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天台山
summaryEn: The forested granite range north of Tiantai town gave its name to the Tiantai school of Buddhism, and its roughly 105 km² scenic area has two halves. At the foot, Guoqing Temple is the school's founding monastery, with a Sui-dynasty brick pagoda outside its gate. High above, Shiliang is a stream that plunges in three cascades under a natural stone beam, and Huading, the main peak, has a forest park, a mountain temple and tea gardens.
description: 天台山主要位于浙江省台州市天台县境内，甬江、曹娥江和灵江的分水岭；东北-西南走向，南连仙霞岭；主峰华顶山，海拔1,138米，在天台县城东北，为花岗岩组成。天台山脉的余脉没入东海，形成舟山群岛。
highlights: 中方广寺 · 下方广寺
officialName: 台州市天台山景区
accessEn: Tiantaishan station on the Hangzhou–Taizhou high-speed line, opened in 2022, is about 3.5 km from the county centre of Tiantai town; Guoqing Temple is about 10 km from it by taxi or local bus, and Shiliang is about 15 km north-east of the town by winding mountain road. Hangzhou is roughly 220 km away, about 45 minutes to an hour by train.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 雁荡山
summaryEn: The main area of North Yandang in Yueqing is a 5A scenic area and Global Geopark of about 450 km², where eruptions more than 100 million years ago were eroded into cliffs, pinnacles, caves and waterfalls. Its "three wonders" are Lingfeng's rock silhouettes by night, the rope-crossing performance between the cliffs at Lingyan, and the Dalongqiu waterfall. Many temples here are built into caves and cliff mouths.
description: 雁荡山，是中国浙江省温州市北部乐清市境内的一座山峰。海拔500至600米，主峰百岗尖西峰海拔1108米。形成于距今1.28亿至1.08亿年间的四次火山喷发，为世界地质公园、首批中国国家重点风景名胜区和国家5A级旅游景区。
officialName: 温州市雁荡山风景区
accessEn: Yandangshan station on the Ningbo–Taizhou–Wenzhou high-speed line is in Yandang town, about 5 km east of the Lingfeng entrance, with buses and taxis into the park. Central Wenzhou is about 60 km to the south-west.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 神仙居
summaryEn: Shenxianju is a 5A mountain scenic area in western Xianju County and the core of Xianju National Park. Sheer cliffs, rock pillars and peaks of volcanic rhyolite rise out of the valley and are often wrapped in cloud. Cable cars and escalators lift visitors to a cliff-hugging walkway, glass-floored viewing platforms and the Ruyi Bridge, a curving footbridge about 140 m above a valley.
description: 神仙居为中国一风景区名，在浙江台州市仙居县境内，当地号称拥有奇山、奇峰、奇岩、奇石、奇瀑等风景。区内主要景点有始建于宋代，重修于明代的古寺西庵寺等。
officialName: 台州市神仙居景区
accessEn: Xianju station on the Hangzhou–Wenzhou high-speed railway, opened in 2024, is about 8 km from Xianju town. The park lies roughly 25 km west of the town by road via Baita, so allow time for a taxi or bus transfer.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 台州府城
summaryEn: Linhai's old walled town was the seat of Taizhou prefecture from 591 until 1993 and is now a 5A scenic area of 3.12 km². The city wall follows the Ling River and climbs the ridge of Beigu Mountain, while the 1,080 m flagstone Ziyang Street is lined with old shops, small museums and craft workshops. East Lake and Jinshan Hill with its pagodas are close by, and about 28,000 people still live in the old town.
description: 台州府城，全称台州府城文化旅游区，是位于今中华人民共和国浙江省临海市的文化保护及风景旅游区。2022年入选国家5A级旅游景区。景区以以台州府城墙为核心，包括巾山塔群、恩泽医局旧址等全国重点文物保护单位，及紫阳街商业街区，东湖等景点。
officialName: 台州市台州府城文化旅游区
accessEn: In central Linhai, about 15 km by bus or taxi from Linhai station on the Hangzhou–Taizhou high-speed railway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 云和梯田
summaryEn: The Yunhe terraces climb from about 200 m to around 1,400 m above sea level around Chongtou, in layers that reach several hundred in places. A 3.9 km cableway rises over the fields, viewpoints look over sea-of-cloud mornings, and the old stone stockade village of Kenggen sits in the valley. The area became a 5A scenic area in February 2024.
description: 云和梯田位于中华人民共和国浙江省丽水市云和县崇头镇境内海拔高度高度200至1400米的山地丘陵地带，总面积约50平方公里，最多处达700余层，为华东地区最大的梯田群。
officialName: 丽水市云和梯田景区
accessEn: Take a train to Lishui station on the Jinhua–Wenzhou high-speed railway, then a bus or taxi via Yunhe town to the visitor centre at Chongtou, about 10 km from the county seat; allow an hour or a little more for the road, and check current bus links before travelling.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 江郎山·廿八都
summaryEn: Mount Jianglang is a trio of sheer red-rock pillars, Langfeng, Yafeng and Lingfeng, each more than 300 m tall, and one of the sites of the China Danxia World Heritage listing. Paths climb between them, including a narrow 'strip of sky' passage as little as 3.5 m wide. The same 5A area takes in Nianbadu, an old garrison town on the Xianxia road near the Fujian border, known for its Ming to Republican-era houses and its many surnames and dialects.
description: 江郎山位于中华人民共和国浙江省江山市南部石门镇，距江山市区25公里；为国家级风景名胜区，也是世界自然遗产地，素有“雄奇冠天下，秀丽甲东南”之誉。2010年8月2日，在巴西利亚举行的第34届世界遗产大会将“中国丹霞”正式列入《世界遗产名录》，联合申报该项目的江郎山名列其中。
officialName: 衢州市江郎山•廿八都旅游区
accessEn: Jiangshan station is the end of the Hangzhou–Quzhou high-speed line (opened December 2025) and also on the Shanghai–Kunming line, roughly 1.5 to 2 hours by train from Hangzhou; a bus or car covers the roughly 25 km to Mount Jianglang, and Nianbadu is about 30 km further south, close to an expressway exit.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 庐山西海
summaryEn: A large reservoir lake west of Mount Lushan, created between 1958 and 1972 by damming the Xiu River at Zhelin. Its 308 sq km of water spread mainly across Yongxiu and Wuning counties and are dotted with wooded islands, with boat trips and lakeside walks on offer. The scenic area has three sections, Zhelin, Jinkou and the Buddhist mountain of Yunju, and has been rated 5A since 2020.
description: 庐山西海位于江西九江。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 九江市永修县庐山西海景区
accessEn: The main pier at Sima, in Zhelin town on the south shore, is about 40 km west-north-west of Yongxiu town and about 70 km south-west of Jiujiang.

name: 汶川特别旅游区
summaryEn: Yingxiu, in Wenchuan County, lay at the epicentre of the magnitude-8.0 earthquake of 12 May 2008, and this 5A-rated zone brings together the places that commemorate it. The collapsed buildings of Xuankou Middle School have been left as they fell as a memorial, surrounded by the rebuilt town. The zone also takes in the rebuilt town of Shuimo nearby and the forested valleys of Sanjiang.
description: 汶川特别旅游区位于四川阿坝。游览特色包括林地风光、地震纪念。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 阿坝州汶川特别旅游区
accessEn: About 1.5 hours by road from Chengdu via the Dujiangyan–Wenchuan expressway.

name: 北川羌城
summaryEn: Beichuan, China's only Qiang autonomous county, was devastated by the 2008 Sichuan earthquake, and this area links the rebuilt county town at Yongchang with the memorial sites of the disaster. The new town has the Qiang Folk Museum, devoted to the culture of the Qiang people, while about 25 km to the north the ruins of the old county town are preserved as a memorial beside the 5·12 Wenchuan Earthquake Memorial museum.
description: 北川羌城位于四川绵阳。游览特色包括博物馆、历史遗址、地震纪念。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
officialName: 绵阳市羌城旅游区
accessEn: The new town is about 40 minutes by road west of Mianyang; the old-town ruins are roughly another 40 minutes' drive north.

name: 呼伦贝尔大草原
summaryEn: In the far north-east of Inner Mongolia, the Hulunbuir grasslands roll to the horizon each summer, threaded by looping rivers and dotted with herds of sheep, horses and cattle. Road-trip from Hailar west to the border town of Manzhouli, on the Russian frontier, or north to the wetlands around Ergun, stopping for horse rides, a night in a yurt and lamb roasted Mongolian-style.
description: 呼伦贝尔草原，蒙古高原草原-内蒙古草原-东北草原的一部分，位于中国内蒙古自治区呼伦贝尔市的天然草场，主要的区域覆盖陈巴尔虎旗、新巴尔虎左旗、新巴尔虎右旗以及鄂温克族自治旗。由呼伦湖及贝尔湖得名，是蒙古族的发源地之一。
officialName: 呼伦贝尔市呼伦贝尔大草原·莫尔格勒河景区
accessEn: Fly into Hailar from Beijing in about 2.5 hours, then hire a car with a driver; distances are long and public transport is thin.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 沙坡头
summaryEn: On the edge of Zhongwei, the dunes of the Tengger Desert slide right down to the banks of the Yellow River at Shapotou. It's a playground for all ages: zip-line across the river, ride a camel along the dune crests, sled down the sand or drift downstream on a traditional sheepskin raft.
description: 景区内可游览沙坡头滑沙、羊皮筏、草方格。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 中卫市沙坡头旅游景区
accessEn: Shapotou is about 20 km west of Zhongwei, half an hour by taxi or bus; Zhongwei is roughly an hour from Yinchuan by high-speed train.

name: 喀什古城
summaryEn: For some two thousand years Kashgar has been a great oasis at China's far western end of the Silk Road, where routes from Central Asia, India and China converged. Wander the restored Old City's lanes of carpenters, coppersmiths and naan bakers, visit the yellow-fronted Id Kah Mosque, and spend a Sunday at the bustling livestock market on the edge of town.
description: 景区内可游览艾提尕尔广场与清真寺、古城老街、阿帕克霍加麦扎。图集建议预留2 天游览。
highlights: 艾提尕尔广场与清真寺
officialName: 喀什地区喀什古城景区
accessEn: The Old City lies in the centre of Kashgar around the Id Kah Mosque, walkable from most hotels; Kashgar is about 1.5–2 hours by air from Ürümqi.

name: 天柱山
summaryEn: Mount Tianzhu is a granite mountain in Qianshan whose main summit, Tianzhu Peak (1,489 m), stands like a pillar above dozens of lesser peaks. Cable cars and stepped trails lead into a landscape of sheer cliffs, twisted pines, the boulder-cave passage of Shenmi Gu (Mysterious Valley) and the high mountain lake of Liandan Hu. It is a quieter, rockier alternative to better-known Anhui peaks.
description: 天柱山，又名皖山、皖公山、万岁山、万山、潜山，是位于安徽省安庆市潜山市的山脉，因主峰如柱倚天而得名。主要山体在潜山市市区西北约9公里，主峰天柱峰海拔1489.8m。天柱山古称霍山，是古南岳衡山的副岳，在汉武帝至隋文帝间为南岳祭礼的举办地。
officialName: 安庆市天柱山风景区
accessEn: The mountain is about 15 km north-west of Qianshan city, roughly 30 minutes by bus or taxi to the visitor centres at Chazhuang or Dalongwo. Qianshan high-speed railway station (opened December 2021) has a tourist shuttle, buses from Anqing to Qianshan run every few minutes, and Hefei has direct coaches to Qianshan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 凤凰古城
summaryEn: Fenghuang's old town lines both banks of the Tuo River, with wooden stilt houses hanging over the water, stepping stones across the shallows and covered bridges strung with lanterns. Miao and Tujia heritage shows up in the food, embroidery and silver jewellery. At night the riverfront lights up and the banks fill with music and boats.
description: 凤凰古城，或称凤凰县城，位于中国湖南省湘西土家族苗族自治州凤凰县沱江镇。凤凰古城所在的沱江镇古称镇竿。明清时，为五寨司城。
officialName: 湘西州凤凰古城旅游区
accessEn: Fenghuang has its own high-speed rail station, about an hour from Zhangjiajie, with links on to Huaihua. A short taxi ride covers the last stretch to the old town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 漓江与阳朔
summaryEn: Between Guilin and Yangshuo, the Li River winds through a landscape of limestone peaks, feathery bamboo and water buffalo cooling off in the shallows. Cruise downstream or ride a bamboo raft near Xingping, then base yourself in Yangshuo to cycle the Yulong River valley, climb a hill for sunset or take a cooking class.
description: 景区内可游览漓江游船、兴坪与二十元人民币背景、遇龙河。图集建议预留2–3 天游览。
highlights: 兴坪与二十元人民币背景
officialName: 桂林市漓江风景区
accessEn: Li River cruises sail from piers outside Guilin to Yangshuo in about four hours. Alternatively, take the high-speed train from Guilin to Yangshuo (about 30 minutes) and do a shorter raft trip from Xingping.

name: 小三峡·小小三峡
summaryEn: The Lesser Three Gorges are Longmen, Bawu and Dicui, along the lower Daning River at Wushan. The boat trip runs about 50 km through steep limestone walls, mist, waterfalls and forest, and takes about four hours. Visitors change to small boats at the Madu River for the narrower Mini Three Gorges, which many find prettier than the Yangtze gorges themselves.
description: 景区内可游览龙门峡、巴雾峡、滴翠峡。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 小三峡－小小三峡旅游区
accessEn: Boats leave from the Wushan county town, where the Daning River joins the Yangtze; Longmen Gorge begins at the edge of town. Wushan is on the Zhengzhou–Chongqing high-speed line, has a small airport and is a port of call for Yangtze cruises; check 12306 for times from Chongqing.

name: 龙缸
summaryEn: Longgang is a karst area of about 17 km² in Qingshui Tujia Township, built around a sheer-walled sinkhole shaped like a huge stone vat, about 335 m deep. The Cloud Bridge, a glass-floored walkway cantilevered from the cliff top, and the Cliffside Walkway give the viewpoints; Da'an Cave and the Shisun River canyon are close by. It is a long trip from the Yangtze, but one of Chongqing's most striking karst sights.
description: 景区内可游览龙缸、云端廊桥、绝壁栈道。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 龙缸景区
accessEn: The area is in Qingshui Tujia Township, about 68 km from downtown Yunyang and about 147 km from central Chongqing. Reach Yunyang by high-speed train from Chongqing in about 1.5 hours, then take a bus or taxi; there are also buses from Wanzhou South Bus Station. Check current times.

name: 程阳八寨
summaryEn: Eight Dong villages line the Linxi River north of Sanjiang, each with timber stilt houses, a drum tower, a stage and a covered 'wind and rain' bridge. The star is Yongji Bridge at the entrance, a long wooden span topped by pavilion roofs, and the quiet lanes beyond it give a real sense of everyday Dong life. The area became a 5A scenic area in 2024.
description: 景区内可游览程阳永济桥、马安寨、平寨鼓楼。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 柳州市程阳八寨景区
accessEn: From Guilin, take the high-speed train to Sanjiang South (about 35 minutes), then a bus or taxi into Sanjiang county town. Buses to Linxi and Chengyang leave about every half hour from the Hexi (west-bank) bus station and take around half an hour; they stop at the scenic-area entrance.
imageCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Asteiner assumed (based on copyright claims).

name: 荔波樟江景区
summaryEn: A national scenic area of roughly 270 sq km in southern Libo, made up of the Xiaoqikong and Daqikong areas, the Shuichun river gorge and the Zhangjiang river belt. Karst forest closes in around turquoise pools, lakes, waterfalls and rapids along the Zhangjiang, and the area is part of the Libo Karst cluster of the South China Karst World Heritage Site, inscribed in 2007. Most visitors spend their time in Xiaoqikong, a compact, walkable valley, with the canyon of Daqikong as a quieter extra.
description: 樟江，位于中国贵州省南部，是打狗河左岸支流。流域内有荔波樟江风景名胜区，总面积270平方公里，有58个主要景点，分为小七孔风景区、大七孔风景区、水春河风景区和樟江风光带景区。
highlights: 六十八级跌水与水上森林
officialName: 黔南布依族苗族自治州荔波县樟江景区
accessEn: High-speed trains from Guiyang North reach Libo station in about an hour to an hour and a quarter; from there the Xiaoqikong gate is about 10 km, roughly 20 minutes by shuttle bus or taxi. Libo town is about 30 km from the gates, and driving from Guiyang takes several hours.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 镇远古城
summaryEn: Zhenyuan sits on a tight S-bend of the Wuyang River, with the old prefectural city on the north bank and the old garrison city on the south, both laid out under the Ming. Stone-paved lanes, Ming and Qing houses, guildhalls, riverside docks and stretches of city wall make it one of the most atmospheric old towns in Guizhou, best explored on foot and from the water. The Qinglong Cave temple complex on the cliff above the river is a separate sight, but it is the town's best-known landmark and belongs in the same day.
description: 景区内可游览古城老街与码头、天后宫、镇远城墙。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 黔东南州镇远县镇远古城旅游景区
accessEn: The town is in Zhenyuan county, about 110 km by road north-east of Kaili (roughly an hour and a half); Zhenyuan station is served by slower conventional trains, about 1.5 hours from Kaili and 3.5–5 hours from Guiyang, so many visitors take a high-speed train to Kaili and continue by road. From Guiyang allow about three hours by road.

name: 龙宫
summaryEn: Longgong is a karst scenic area south of Anshun centred on the Dragon Palace, a cave with an underground river that visitors tour by boat. At the cave mouth the Longmen waterfall drops into the river, and around it are gorges, cliffs, peak forest and a stone forest.
