It is a 5A scenic area and sits close to the Huangguoshu area, so the two are often visited in one trip.
description: 景区内可游览龙门飞瀑、龙宫洞、漩塘。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 安顺市西秀区龙宫景区
accessEn: Longgong lies about 25–35 km south-west of Anshun by road (sources differ: 27 km on ticketing sites, 35 km on showcaves.com); take a taxi or a bus from the city. Anshun is a 30–40 minute high-speed train ride from Guiyang.

name: 蜈支洲岛
summaryEn: Wuzhizhou is a small island of about 1.5 square kilometres in Haitang Bay, with sandy beaches, rocky shores and tropical forest. It is well known for scuba diving and water sports, and the beaches and the coastal walkway also suit visitors who only want to swim or stroll. Boats run across from the mainland and electric buggies carry you round the hillside and the back of the island.
description: 蜈支洲岛，简称蜈支洲，古称“古崎洲”，位于海南省三亚市海棠区的海棠湾，距离市区约30公里。其西南侧邻近亚龙湾，东北侧邻近南湾猴岛。
officialName: 三亚市蜈支洲岛旅游区
accessEn: The island lies off Haitang Bay about 30 km north-east of central Sanya. Boats leave from the pier at Houhai village and the crossing takes about 15–20 minutes; city bus routes and taxis serve the pier.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 呀诺达雨林文化旅游区
summaryEn: Yanoda is a tropical rainforest zone in the hills of Sandao town, best known for stream trekking: visitors wade up forest streams in helmets and straw sandals, climb waterfalls and work through a course of nets and balance beams. A new adventure area with canyon descents and rafting opened in 2026. It suits active travellers and families.
description: 景区内可游览梦幻谷、莲恩瀑布、溯溪。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
officialName: 保亭县呀诺达雨林文化旅游区
accessEn: The zone is in Sandao town, on the west side of the G224 road, about 21 km south of Baocheng and roughly 35 km from central Sanya. A taxi from Sanya takes about 50 minutes, and buses from Sanya coach station towards Baoting or Wuzhishan stop at Sandao.

name: 槟榔谷黎苗文化旅游区
summaryEn: Binglanggu is a cultural park in Sandao town, set in a valley of areca palms, that presents Li and Miao traditions through demonstrations, music and an evening-style show. You can watch Li brocade weaving, hear nose-flute and bamboo-instrument music, see a staged Li wedding and join in the firewood dance. The park also keeps century-old boat-shaped Li houses.
description: 景区内可游览黎锦织造、船型屋、黎苗村寨。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
officialName: 保亭县海南槟榔谷黎苗文化旅游区
wikiEn: Baoting Li and Miao Autonomous County
accessEn: The park is in Sandao town, about 27 km south of Baocheng, the Baoting county seat, and about 5 km south of Yanoda. From Sanya, buses to Sandao take about 50 minutes, and a taxi is the other option.

name: 太行大峡谷
summaryEn: A national geopark on the eastern escarpment of the Taihang Mountains west of Linzhou, covering 89 km² and stretching about 50 km from north to south, with peaks up to 1,739 m and more than 1,000 m of relief. Its main areas are Peach Blossom Valley (Taohuagu) with its pools and waterfalls, the Taihang Tianlu cliff-top road, the Wangxiangyan cliffs and Xianxia Valley, and visitors can also try river rafting, a zip line and glass walkways. It is one of the two parts of the combined Red Flag Canal–Taihang Grand Canyon 5A scenic area.
description: 景区内可游览桃花谷、太行天路、王相岩。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
officialName: 安阳市红旗渠－太行大峡谷旅游景区
accessEn: The area is around Shibanyan town in the mountains west of Linzhou, roughly 40 minutes to an hour by road from the city. Linzhou is a short expressway drive from Anyang, so allow about 1.5–2 hours from Anyang; Anyang East high-speed station is about 40 minutes from Zhengzhou East by fast train. Public transport on to the canyon is limited, so a car or hired driver is easiest; self-drivers leave the expressway at Anyang, take the Anyang–Linzhou expressway and then the road through the Taihang tunnel.

name: 神农架生态旅游区
summaryEn: Shennongjia is a vast forested massif in north-western Hubei, listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2016 for its primary forests and rich wildlife. The main visitor area has two parts: Shennongding, with boardwalks through primeval forest, alpine meadow and rock forests below the 3,106 m summit, and Guanmenshan, an 8 km river gorge with natural-history museums. The wider district is also home to wild golden snub-nosed monkeys, which live in protected forest and are not guaranteed sightings.
description: 景区内可游览官门山、神农坛、神农顶。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
officialName: 神农架生态旅游区
accessEn: Muyu town is the base. From Wuhan, the usual route is a high-speed train to Xingshan station (about 2 to 2.5 hours), then a bus or taxi of around an hour or more to Muyu; Shennongjia station, on the eastern edge of the district, is much further from the main sights. Visitors from Yichang come by road along the Yichang–Shennongjia route, and Hongping airport has flights from Wuhan and some other cities.

name: 三峡人家
summaryEn: Three Gorges Tribe is a purpose-built scenic area of about 14 sq km at Dengying Gorge, part of Xiling Gorge between the Gezhouba and Three Gorges dams. It stages Yangtze boatman and Tujia village life with stilt houses, waterwheels and folk-song shows beside Longjin Stream, and the surrounding limestone gorge scenery is real and quite lovely. Treat it as a cultural-tourism park with a gorge setting rather than an old village.
description: 景区内可游览龙进溪、明月湾、灯影石。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 宜昌市三峡人家风景区
accessEn: It is at Shipai village in Sandouping town, on the Xiling Gorge stretch of the Yangtze, roughly an hour's travel from central Yichang. Reported ways in are a tourist bus (route 10-1 and tourist coaches run from Yiling Square and Yichang East) or a ferry from the Xiakou pier; check the current schedule before you set out.

name: 清江画廊
summaryEn: Qingjiang Gallery is a boat-trip scenic area on the Qingjiang River above the Geheyan Dam in Changyang county. The reservoir winds between steep wooded cliffs and small islands, with a calm, green-water feel quite different from the Yangtze. The long route reaches Wuluozhongli Mountain, which Chinese tradition names as the birthplace of the Ba people, ancestors of today's Tujia.
description: 景区内可游览倒影峡、隔河岩大坝、仙人寨。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
officialName: 宜昌市清江画廊景区
accessEn: The boats leave from the Geheyan Dam tourist pier (the Qingjiang Gallery visitor centre), roughly 40 km from Yichang East station. Take the intercity bus from Yichang East to Changyang (about 1.5 hours) and a local tourist bus or taxi on from there; a direct tourist coach from Yichang East has also run twice a day.

name: 三国赤壁古战场
summaryEn: This scenic area in Chibi stands on the south bank of the Yangtze around a cliff carved with the two characters for 'Red Cliff', and is the best-known memorial to the Battle of Red Cliffs of AD 208. The grounds hold a large statue of Zhou Yu, a shrine to Zhuge Liang on the Wind-Worship Platform, a hermitage, a stele gallery and a lot of newly built Han-style architecture. Historians disagree over where the battle took place, so it is best taken as a Three Kingdoms memorial rather than proven ground.
description: 景区内可游览赤壁摩崖石刻、周瑜塑像、拜风台。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 赤壁碑廊与赤壁大战陈列馆
officialName: 咸宁市三国赤壁古战场景区
accessEn: The area is in Chibi town, about 30–40 km by road from the centre of Chibi city. Fast trains from Wuhan reach Chibi North on the Beijing–Guangzhou line in roughly 35–40 minutes; from there take a taxi (reported at about 30–45 minutes) or a local bus.

name: 额济纳胡杨林
summaryEn: Ejin Poplar Forest is a belt of desert poplars (Populus euphratica) along the Ejin River beside Dalaihub, in the Gobi of western Inner Mongolia. The scenic area covers about 56 square kilometres of riverside forest, Gobi, grassland and lakes, arranged as a string of numbered 'bridges' along the river. The leaves turn gold in autumn, usually from late September into October, and the region fills with photographers for those weeks.
description: 景区内可游览二道桥、三道桥、四道桥。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
officialName: 阿拉善盟胡杨林旅游区
accessEn: The forest is about 2.5 km from the centre of Dalaihub, the Ejin Banner seat, with no public transport, so take a taxi or hired car. Ejin Banner airport has a few flights, for example from Xi'an and Hohhot; the train from Hohhot is slow (about 15 hours), and many visitors drive in from Jiayuguan (about 5–6 hours).

name: 响沙湾
summaryEn: Xiangshawan sits at the eastern tip of the Kubuqi Desert and is best known for its singing sand: slide down the big dune and the fine grains can hum or roar. It is a developed resort, not wilderness: cable cars, camels, dune buggies, pools, shows and hotel 'islands' fill the dunes. It suits families and anyone who wants a quick taste of desert and Mongolian culture rather than solitude.
description: 景区内可游览一粒沙度假村 · 索道、响沙湾港、仙沙岛。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 一粒沙度假村 · 索道
莲沙岛 · 沙漠莲花酒店
officialName: 鄂尔多斯市响沙湾旅游景区
accessEn: It is in Dalad Banner about 50 km south of Baotou, around an hour by car or taxi and about 3 km from the G65 expressway; long-distance buses from Baotou's Donghe station serve the area, but one stops several kilometres away, so plan a taxi for the last stretch. It is about halfway between Baotou and Ordos, and about 70 km from Ordos' Kangbashi district.

name: 阿斯哈图石林
summaryEn: Arshihaty is a stretch of granite columns and crags, 5 to 30 metres high, strung along a ridge at about 1,700 metres where the Greater Khingan Mountains give way to grassland. The rock is unusual for its strong horizontal jointing, which makes the stacks look like piles of giant slabs. It is the best-known area of the Hexigten Global Geopark, and the isolation is part of the appeal.
description: 景区内可游览月亮城堡、桃园结义、雄鹰敛翅。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 赤峰市阿斯哈图石林景区
accessEn: Fly or take the train to Chifeng, then drive or take a bus about 200 km to Jingpeng, the seat of Hexigten Banner. From Jingpeng it is roughly 105 km by road north to the park, so allow most of a day each way from Chifeng and hire a car and driver; shorter figures such as 77 km are straight-line.

name: 阿尔山—柴河
summaryEn: This 1,031 sq km scenic area spans Arxan in Hinggan League and Chaihe in Zalantun, Hulunbuir. The Arxan side is centred on the Arxan National Forest Park, where volcanic craters hold small lakes such as Tianchi (Heavenly Lake), rivers like the Yimin cut through larch forest and the Shitang Forest spreads over black lava. Chaihe lies further north-east on the Chaihe and Chuoer rivers.
description: 景区内可游览三潭峡、杜鹃湖、驼峰岭天池。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
officialName: 兴安盟阿尔山-柴河旅游景区
accessEn: Arxan has an airport and a railway station. From Arxan town the park is about 40 km, roughly an hour by road. Chaihe lies in Zalantun, Hulunbuir, a long drive to the north-east on a separate road, so treat it as its own trip.

name: 老牛湾黄河大峡谷
summaryEn: Laoniuwan is a gorge where the Yellow River leaves Inner Mongolia for Shanxi and the Ming-dynasty Great Wall comes down to meet the water. On the Qingshuihe bank, the stone-built village has cave dwellings and a Qing-dynasty opera stage dating from 1852, and a platform looks across to Wanghe Tower, a Ming watchtower on the Shanxi side. Boat trips run on the green river, and the area became Hohhot's first national 5A scenic area in December 2024.
description: 景区内可游览老牛湾村、神牛广场、长城黄河握手处。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 呼和浩特市老牛湾黄河大峡谷旅游区
accessEn: It is in the south-west of Qingshuihe County, about 177 km by road from Hohhot, roughly three hours by car, and about 33 km from Qingshuihe county seat. Public transport is thin, so most visitors hire a car and driver from Hohhot or Qingshuihe.

name: 龟峰
summaryEn: Guifeng, near Yiyang, is a forest of 36 red sandstone peaks, stone pillars, arches and caves, with boardwalks, steps and a glass-floored walkway through the rocks. It is the Guifeng section of the Longhushan component of China Danxia, which UNESCO inscribed in 2010, and it became a national 5A scenic area in 2017. It is smaller and quieter than most Danxia areas and easy to see in a morning.
description: 龟峰又名圭峰，位于江西省上饶市弋阳县圭峰镇。因山石相叠如龟，故名。共有36峰，八大景观。
officialName: 上饶市弋阳县龟峰景区
accessEn: Yiyang station on the Shanghai–Kunming high-speed line is about 12 km away: a taxi takes about 20 minutes, and a local bus also runs to the scenic area. Shangrao is about 55 km east-north-east and Mount Longhu about 40 km away.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 红海滩风景廊道
summaryEn: The Red Beach scenic corridor follows about 18 km of the Liaohe delta coast, where tidal flats are carpeted with seepweed (Suaeda salsa) set against reed marsh and wetland. A winding wooden boardwalk and boat rides on the river channel let you out among the red, and the surrounding reserve shelters many birds. It has been a 5A scenic area since 2020.
description: 景区内可游览九曲廊桥、河道游船、芦苇荡。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 双台河口国家级自然保护区
officialName: 盘锦市红海滩风景廊道景区
accessEn: The beach is in Dawa District on the Liaodong Bay coast, about 35 km from Panjin's urban area (a 40-minute to one-hour drive). High-speed trains from Shenyang reach Panjin North, in Panshan County, in roughly an hour; Panjin has two stations, so check which one your train uses, then take a taxi or tour.

name: 沙湖
summaryEn: Sand Lake is a freshwater lake fringed with reed beds and backed by sand dunes. The scenic area covers about 80 km², including some 45 km² of water and 22 km² of desert, so you can take a boat across the water and then ride a camel or slide on the dunes. Migratory birds gather on a bird island in the eastern wetlands, and the Ningxia Wetland Museum and an international sand-sculpture park add indoor stops.
description: 景区内可游览湖上游船、鸟岛、沙漠骆驼。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 石嘴山市沙湖旅游景区
accessEn: The lake is about 55 km north of Yinchuan, roughly an hour by road via the G6 Beijing–Lhasa expressway. Tourist coaches from Yinchuan's bus stations have run to the lake in season and take about 1.5 hours; check the current departure point with your hotel.

name: 祁连卓尔山与阿咪东索（牛心山）
summaryEn: Qilian town, in the middle Qilian Mountains, is ringed by two viewpoint mountains that face each other across the Babao River. Zhuoer Mountain, a ridge of red Danxia sandstone on the north bank, is the lookout; Amidongsuo, better known as Niuxin ('Ox Heart') Mountain, is the sacred snow-streaked peak it looks at to the south. Between them lie a long valley of meadow and shrub forest, wheat and rapeseed fields in early summer, and green pasture below slopes where snow lies all year.
description: 景区内可游览卓尔山观景台、天眼观景台、烽火台与民族团结塔。图集建议预留一天游览。
officialName: 海北州阿咪东索景区
accessEn: Qilian town is about 300 km from Xining by road: roughly 4–5 hours by car via Menyuan, or 5–6 hours by long-distance bus according to one listing. Zhuoer Mountain is on the northern edge of town, and the Amidongsuo scenic area lies about 9 km from town to the south, reached by local taxi or tour vehicle.

name: 黄河口生态旅游区
summaryEn: This 5A area is the visitor section of the Yellow River Delta National Nature Reserve, where the Yellow River reaches the Bohai Sea on some of the country's youngest land. Boardwalks cross natural willow woods, wetlands and reed beds, there are bird-watching points and a bird museum, and in autumn the red seepweed forms a crimson carpet. The reserve was set up in 1992, and Dongying's tourism bureau lists 368 bird species, including oriental storks and migrating cranes, geese and swans.
description: 景区内可游览鸟类博物馆、黄河故道天然柳林木栈道、红地毯。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
highlights: 黄河故道天然柳林木栈道
officialName: 东营市黄河口生态旅游区
wikiEn: Yellow River Delta National Nature Reserve
accessEn: In Kenli district, about 54 km north-east of Dongying city centre; go by taxi, ride-hailing or car, or check locally for a current bus.

name: 萤火虫水洞·地下大峡谷
summaryEn: This 5A area in Yishui County has two cave attractions about 8 km apart. The Underground Grand Canyon is a karst river cave more than 6 km long, where visitors walk, ride a small rail car and take boat or raft rides along the underground river among stalactites and coloured lights. The Firefly Water Cave takes visitors by boat across a dark underground lake where fireflies glow on the ceiling, and above ground there is a butterfly valley and cliff-waterfall rafting.
description: 景区内可游览地下大峡谷、管轨滑道车、地下暗河漂流。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 临沂市萤火虫水洞•地下大峡谷旅游区
accessEn: The Firefly Water Cave is in Yuandongtou town, about 18 km west-south-west of Yishui town, and the Underground Grand Canyon is about 8 km further east, both reached by road. Take a taxi, ride-hailing car or self-drive from Yishui town; day tours from Linyi are also sold on booking platforms.

name: 绵山
summaryEn: About 20 km south-east of Jiexiu, Mount Mian is a 75 sq km scenic area of gorges, cliffs and forest, with Buddhist and Taoist temples built into rock overhangs and caves. Ride the shuttle buses up to the cliff temples of Zhengguo and Yunfeng, the latter set in a huge natural cave, then walk the plank paths of Qixian Valley or the Sky Bridge along the cliff face.
description: 景区内可游览龙头寺、大罗宫、云峰寺。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 晋中市绵山风景区
accessEn: Jiexiu East station is under an hour from Taiyuan South and about 20 minutes from Pingyao by high-speed train; from Jiexiu the drive to the scenic area takes 30–40 minutes, and shuttle buses link the main areas inside.

name: 太行山大峡谷
summaryEn: In the far east of Huguan County, near the border with Henan, the Taihang Grand Canyon is a national geopark of deep gorges cut into the Taihang Mountains, visited through separate scenic areas. Baquan Gorge combines a boat ride on a reservoir between cliffs with cliff-side walkways, a cable car and a cliff lift, while Hongdou Gorge, named after its Chinese yews, and Qinglong Gorge are walking routes past pools and waterfalls.
description: 景区内可游览八泉峡、红豆峡、青龙峡。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 长治市太行山大峡谷八泉峡景区
accessEn: Take high-speed rail to Changzhi East (about 1–1.5 hours from Taiyuan South), then hire a car or take a taxi for the drive of about 1.5 hours to the visitor centre at Daxiagu town; buses via Huguan county town are slow.

name: 阆中古城
summaryEn: Langzhong's old town is a chessboard of grey-tiled courtyard houses, lantern-hung lanes and temples, wrapped on three sides by the Jialing River and ringed by hills, a site long held up as a model of feng shui planning. Highlights include the shrine and tomb of the Three Kingdoms general Zhang Fei, the tiered Huaguang Tower and a Qing-dynasty imperial examination hall, now a museum of the old civil-service exams. Stay overnight to see the lanes lit up after the day-trippers leave.
description: 阆中古城，是一个历史景点，位于中华人民共和国四川省南充市阆中市阆水中路，居嘉陵江中游。被称为中国四大古城，有超过2300年的历史。古城面积约2平方公里，有约5万人仍居住在古城中。
officialName: 南充市阆中古城旅游景区
accessEn: Langzhong station, on the Lanzhou–Chongqing line about 4 km south-west of the old town, is 1.5–2 hours by train from Chongqing North and about 2.5 hours from Chengdu East, though direct Chengdu trains are few. A taxi from the station to the old town takes around 10 minutes.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 喀拉峻草原
summaryEn: A great sweep of alpine meadow on the northern slopes of the Tianshan in Tekes County, ranging from about 1,300 m to nearly 4,000 m and used as summer pasture by herders. It forms part of the Kalajun–Kuerdening component of the Xinjiang Tianshan World Natural Heritage site. West Kalajun is known for wave-like rolling hills and marmot habitat; East Kalajun for flower meadows, a forested canyon and views of snow peaks.
description: 景区内可游览西喀拉峻、鲜花台、库尔代森林大峡谷。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
officialName: 伊犁哈萨克自治州喀拉峻景区
accessEn: The scenic area lies south-east of Tekes town, roughly half an hour to an hour by road depending on the section. Private cars cannot drive into the scenic areas; you move around by shuttle bus.

name: 天山托木尔
summaryEn: Tianshan Tomur is a 752 km² mountain scenic area in Wensu County, in the foothills of the Tomur Peak range (7,443.8 m, the highest summit of the Tian Shan), and in December 2024 it became Aksu Prefecture's first 5A area. Its three main parts are a red-rock canyon with salt-dome landforms, Ta Village with guesthouses, and the Kyrgyz township of Bozidun. Kyrgyz traditions such as the Manas epic and embroidery are part of local culture.
description: 景区内可游览托木尔大峡谷、塔村、博孜墩柯尔克孜民族乡。图集建议预留1 天游览。
highlights: 博孜墩柯尔克孜民族乡
officialName: 阿克苏地区天山托木尔景区
accessEn: The canyon visitor centre is about 70 km by road north-east of Aksu city, roughly an hour's drive by way of Wensu town. Ta Village is higher in the mountains, further on by road.

name: 江布拉克
summaryEn: A 48 km² mountain scenic area on the northern slopes of the Tianshan south of Qitai, known for the dry-farmed wheat fields that roll across the hills below forest and snow peaks. The green fields of early summer turn gold from August, and the area also has a gravity-hill curiosity and the Han-era Shichengzi site.
description: 景区内可游览天山麦海、天山怪坡、石城子遗址。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 昌吉回族自治州江布拉克景区
accessEn: The scenic area lies in the mountains about 45 km south of Qitai county town, roughly an hour by road; Qitai is about two to two and a half hours east of Ürümqi, with buses from Ürümqi to Qitai. A car or charter from Qitai is the easiest way in.

name: 世界魔鬼城
summaryEn: The World Ghost City, also called the Urho Wind City, is a field of yardangs on the north-western edge of the Junggar Basin, where strong winds have carved layered rock into shapes likened to castles, towers, sphinxes and animals. It became Karamay's first 5A scenic area in 2020. It sits beside the G217 road, so it makes an easy stop on the road between Karamay and Burqin or Kanas.
description: 景区内可游览狮身人面像、影视外景地、恐龙谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 克拉玛依市世界魔鬼城景区
accessEn: The site is in Urho district, roughly 90–105 km (about 1.5 hours) by road from central Karamay, beside the G217; go by car, hired car or tour bus.

name: 金湖杨国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park of desert poplars on the alluvial fan of the Yarkand River about 36–40 km south-west of Zepu, covering some 40,000 mu (about 27 km²) with water on three sides and the Kunlun range in the distance. Channels of the river wind through the forest between stretches of open gobi, and the leaves turn gold in autumn. A sightseeing vehicle carries visitors into the poplar zone.
description: 景区内可游览胡杨林区、圣树、叶尔羌河。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 喀什地区金湖杨景区
accessEn: The park is about 36–40 km by road south-west of Zepu county town, which is roughly 2.5–3 hours by road south-east of Kashgar; a hired car from Kashgar is the easiest option.

name: 普者黑
summaryEn: Puzhehei is a lake-dotted karst landscape in south-east Yunnan, where dozens of linked lakes and channels wind between hundreds of steep, rounded limestone hills. In summer the shallows turn into vast lotus fields, and visitors drift between Yi villages by boat, then climb Qinglong Shan for sunset over the water. It is a national 5A scenic area, hugely popular with Chinese holidaymakers and still little known abroad.
description: 普者黑湖位于中华人民共和国云南省东南部文山壮族苗族自治州丘北县境内，是一座高原溶蚀构造淡水湖。“普者黑”为彝语，意为鱼虾多的地方。普者黑湖泊群由多个大小相连的湖泊与河道组成，其中较大的湖泊有落水洞湖、普者黑湖和仙人湖。
officialName: 文山州普者黑旅游景区
accessEn: High-speed trains from Kunming South reach Puzhehei station in about 1–1.5 hours. The station sits just south of Qiubei town, about 20 km from the lakes, and a taxi to Puzhehei or Xianrendong village takes around half an hour.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 腾冲火山与热海
summaryEn: Dozens of dormant volcanoes ring Tengchong: in the volcano park north of town you can climb the stairway up Dakongshan to look into its crater, or float above the cones in a hot-air balloon. South-west of the city, Rehai ('Hot Sea') is a steaming valley of vents, spouting springs and mineral crusts around the Big Boiling Pot (Dagunguo), a pool about 6 m across that churns at around 96°C. End the day with a soak in a hot-spring pool.
description: 景区内可游览大空山与小空山、大滚锅、珍珠泉。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 保山市火山热海旅游区
accessEn: The volcano park is about 20 km north of Tengchong and Rehai about 10 km south-west, each under half an hour by taxi or hired car. Tengchong is about an hour's flight from Kunming, or about 2 hours by road from Baoshan station, which trains reach from Dali in under 2 hours and from Kunming in about 4.

name: 西柏坡
summaryEn: The village where the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party and the headquarters of the People's Liberation Army were based between 1947 and March 1949, and from which the Liaoshen, Huaihai and Pingjin campaigns of the civil war were directed. The site holds the residences and offices of leaders including Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai, Zhu De and Liu Shaoqi, the hall where the Second Plenary Session of the Seventh Central Committee met in March 1949, the military operations room, and a large memorial museum with exhibitions on the period. The original village was flooded by the Gangnan Reservoir in 1959, so the buildings are reconstructions on higher ground, rebuilt from 1970.
description: 西柏坡纪念馆，位于中华人民共和国河北省石家庄市平山县西柏坡镇，是介绍中共中央及中国人民解放军总部驻西柏坡期间历史的博物馆，为国家一级博物馆。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 石家庄市西柏坡景区
accessEn: In Xibaipo town, Pingshan County, beside the Gangnan Reservoir, about 24 km west-north-west of Pingshan town and about 60 km west-north-west of central Shijiazhuang; reached by road from Shijiazhuang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 汤旺河林海奇石
summaryEn: A forest and granite scenic area of about 190 sq km on the Tangwang River in the Lesser Khingan mountains, rated 5A in 2013. More than 100 granite peaks rise out of the woods in what is called a 'granite forest', among streams and old mixed forest. It is the core of a national forest park that is also a granite geopark.
description: 汤旺河兴安石林森林公园，又叫黑龙江小兴安岭石林国家森林公园、伊春花岗岩国家地质公园、黑龙江汤旺河国家公园等。位于中国黑龙江省伊春市汤旺县，属于小兴安岭山脉,海拔354-703米。以红松针叶、阔叶混交原始林为主,主要植物有云杉、落叶松和白桦等。
officialName: 伊春市林海奇石景区
accessEn: In Tangwang County, about 92 km north-north-east of central Yichun.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 西沙明珠湖
summaryEn: A scenic area at the western end of Chongming Island made up of Mingzhu Lake, described as the island's largest freshwater lake and ringed by water-conservation forest, and the Xisha National Wetland Park on the Yangtze shore. Boardwalks lead through flooded woodland, reed beds and tidal creeks where herons, gulls and cormorants feed, and a small fish-specimen hall shows species from the lake and the Yangtze estuary.
description: 明珠湖公园是中华人民共和国上海市崇明区的一个公园，是国家5A级旅游景区，面积6500亩，水域面积3000多亩，公园内有崇明岛上最大的淡水湖泊明珠湖，环湖还有4500亩的明珠湖水源涵养林。公园内还有鱼类标本馆，藏有30多种生活在明珠湖和长江口的鱼类标本。
officialName: 西沙明珠湖景区
accessEn: At the western tip of Chongming Island, about 2 hours by road from central Shanghai via the Yangtze River tunnel and bridge.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 吴中太湖旅游区
summaryEn: A 5A scenic area on the eastern shore of Lake Tai in Suzhou's Wuzhong district, made up of three separate parts: the Dongshan peninsula, Qionglong Mountain and the Wangshan valley. On Dongshan it takes in Luxiang, a lakeside village with a Ming stone-paved street, three memorial arches and the hall of the Ming grand secretary Wang Ao, as well as Sanshan Island and the Qi Garden, built on the shore in 1933 to mark the Kangxi Emperor's landing there in 1699. Qionglong, the highest hill around Suzhou, is where tradition says Sun Tzu wrote The Art of War, and Wangshan is a rural valley of farm-stay villages with Baohua Temple.
description: 吴中太湖旅游区，是位于苏州市吴中区西部的多个景区组成的旅游业聚集区，濒临太湖，总面积21.5平方公里，由东山景区、穹窿山景区与旺山景区等景区组成。2013年4月12日成为国家5A级旅游景区。东山景区：位于苏州市吴中区东山镇穹窿山景区：位于苏州市吴中区西部旺山景区：位于苏州市吴中区越溪街道旺山村。
officialName: 苏州市太湖旅游区
accessEn: Dongshan is about 45 km south-west of central Suzhou by road (around an hour); Wangshan lies about 15 km south and Qionglong about 25 km west of the city, in different directions, so a car or taxi is the easiest way to link them.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 无锡影视基地
summaryEn: A film and television base built by China Central Television on the shore of Lake Tai from 1987, whose 5A part is made up of Three Kingdoms City and Water Margin City, full-scale sets of palaces, naval camps and old streets built for the 1990s television series of Romance of the Three Kingdoms and Water Margin. The sets are still used by film crews, and the base stages more than 20 shows a day, including horseback battle stunts and special-effects demonstrations, as well as boat trips on the lake.
description: 无锡影视基地位于中华人民共和国江苏省无锡市滨湖区山水西路128号的一座大型影视基地，1987年4月20日由中国中央电视台建立，占地约100公顷，水面面积达200公顷，是中国国家5A级旅游景区之一。目前产权属于中视传媒无锡影视基地分公司。
officialName: 无锡市中央电视台无锡影视基地三国水浒城景区
accessEn: On the shore of Lake Tai about 12 km south-west of central Wuxi, by taxi or bus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中华麋鹿园
summaryEn: The visitor area of the Dafeng Milu National Nature Reserve on the Yellow Sea coast, where Père David's deer (milu), which had died out in China, were brought back in 1986 with 39 animals from British zoos; the reserve now holds the world's largest wild population of the species. Sightseeing buggies take visitors through woods, reed beds and grassland to see the deer herds, passing an arch made of thousands of shed antlers. The reserve is part of the Yellow Sea-Bohai Gulf migratory bird World Heritage Site and a Ramsar wetland.
description: 江苏大丰麋鹿国家级自然保护区，江苏省盐城市大丰区，面积3000公顷。1997年成为中国国家级自然保护区，主要保护对象为麋鹿及其生态环境。2002年被列入国际重要湿地名录。
officialName: 盐城市中华麋鹿园景区
accessEn: Near the Yellow Sea coast in south-eastern Dafeng, about 40 km south-east of central Dafeng and 75 km from Yancheng city; car or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 刘伯温故里
summaryEn: Wencheng County's 5A scenic area, named for the home region of Liu Ji (Liu Bowen), the strategist who helped found the Ming dynasty, combines two sites about 10 km apart. Baizhangji is a three-tier waterfall in a deep V-shaped ravine whose top fall drops 207 m in a single leap; in Nantian to the north-west, the Liu Ji Temple is a Ming timber hall complex of the Tianshun reign (1457–64) hung with commemorative plaques, and Liu Ji's tomb lies at the foot of Xiashan nearby.
description: 刘伯温故里位于浙江温州。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1 天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 温州市刘伯温故里景区
accessEn: The visitor centre is at Huangzhuang village in Baizhangji town, Wencheng County, roughly 65 km west of Wenzhou as the crow flies; buses run from Wenzhou to Wencheng, with local buses on to the scenic area.

name: 天堂寨
summaryEn: Tiantangzhai, at 1,729 m the second-highest peak of the Dabie Mountains, stands on the Anhui–Hubei border on the watershed between the Huai and Yangtze rivers. The Anhui side is a national forest park of about 120 km², with peaks such as Baima Peak, forest cover of over 95 percent and more than ten waterfalls along its stream valleys. A site linked to the Communist army's 1947 advance into the Dabie Mountains is also marked in the area.
description: 天堂寨国家森林公园位于中华人民共和国安徽省六安市金寨县，地处大别山主峰之一天堂寨东北侧。1992年，经林业部批准为国家森林公园。景区面积1.2万公顷，有1000米以上的高峰33座，1500米以上的高峰15座，最高峰天堂寨海拔1729.13米。
officialName: 六安市天堂寨旅游景区
accessEn: In Tiantangzhai town in the far south of Jinzhai County, roughly 2.5 hours by road from Lu'an.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大觉山
summaryEn: Mount Dajue is a forested mountain and canyon area of about 204 sq km on the western side of the Wuyi range in Zixi County, Fuzhou (Jiangxi). A cableway climbs the mountain, Dajue Temple sits inside a large granite cave, and a rafting run threads through the canyon. A cliff-side electric train about 11.8 km long was added in 2024, and a resort town at the foot of the mountain serves as the base.
description: 大觉山位于中国江西省抚州市资溪县境内，武夷山脉西麓，主峰海拔1396米。山上建有大觉寺。旅游业以漂流为主要特色。
officialName: 抚州市资溪县大觉山景区
accessEn: About 10 km east of Hecheng, the county town of Zixi in Fuzhou (Jiangxi).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 三百山
summaryEn: A forested mountain area in south-eastern Anyuan, on the Jiangxi–Guangdong border, where the Dongjiang (East River), a main water source for Hong Kong and Guangdong, rises. The range also divides the Yangtze and Pearl river basins, and its main peak, Dongyuan Peak, reaches 1,164.5 m. Walkways lead to the East River First Waterfall, a single drop of more than 120 m, and a glass bridge, a plank walkway and a cableway have been added for views over the forest.
description: 三百山位于江西省赣州市安远县东南部。是贡江与东江的分水岭。三百山是东江的发源地。
officialName: 赣州市三百山景区
accessEn: In the mountains of south-eastern Anyuan county, about 15 km south-south-east of Anyuan town (roughly 30 km by road) and about 105 km south-south-east of Ganzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 明月山
summaryEn: A 136 km² mountain on the border of Yichun's Yuanzhou district and An'fu county, named for its half-moon outline, with its main peak, Taiping, at 1,735.6 m. Sights include the Yungu waterfall, the Qingyun plank walkway, old stone pagodas on the slopes and a summit lake with small-train camps. It has been a national 5A scenic area since 2015, and the hot-spring town of Wentang lies at its foot.
description: 明月山位于中国江西省宜春市袁州区与吉安市安福县交界处，面积136平方公里，属武功山支脉，主要由太平山、玉京山、老山、仰山等十几座海拔千米以上的山峰组成，主峰太平山，海拔1735.6米，因整个山势呈半圆形，恰半圆明月，故称明月山。
officialName: 宜春市袁州区明月山旅游区
accessEn: At Tanxia in Wentang town, about 27 km south-south-west of Yichun.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 海陵岛大角湾
summaryEn: A curving, horn-shaped sandy bay at Zhapo on the south coast of Hailing Island, the island's earliest-developed and best-known beach, which with its surroundings was rated a 5A scenic area in 2015 as the Dajiao Bay Maritime Silk Road Tourist Area. Over the hill to the west lies the long beach of Shili Yintan, beside which the Maritime Silk Road Museum of Guangdong (opened 2009) displays the hull and cargo of the Southern Song shipwreck Nanhai I.
description: 海陵岛是位于中国广东省阳江市的一个海岛，由主岛及周围12个小岛屿组成，其中，主岛呈长条形，东西长24公里，南北宽8.5公里，面积108.89平方公里，是广东省第四大岛，常住人口约10万人。海陵岛是广东省著名的滨海旅游度假胜地，是中国首批国家级海洋公园，拥有大角湾、十里银滩、红树林国家湿地公园等景点，岛上的闸坡国家中心渔港是全国首批国家中心渔港之一。
officialName: 阳江市江城区海陵岛大角湾海上丝路旅游区
accessEn: On Hailing Island, linked to the mainland by a causeway and a bridge opened in 2020, about 50 km by road south-west of Yangjiang city, roughly an hour by car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 阿依河
summaryEn: The valley of the Ayi River, a tributary that rises in Guizhou and flows through Pengshui into the Wu River, home to protected animals such as François' langur. The scenic area follows the river south of Pengshui town, and rafting on it is the best-known summer activity.
description: 阿依河是发源于贵州省务川县分水镇，位于重庆市彭水苗族土家族自治县一条河流，是长溪河更名而来。主要经过长旗坝、舟子沱、三江口三个个地区，最终注入乌江。阿依河全长21公里，河段长近35公里。
officialName: 阿依河景区
accessEn: In Pengshui Miao and Tujia Autonomous County, about 15 km south of the county town; tourist buses run from Pengshui West station on the Chongqing–Xiamen high-speed railway, and the drive from central Chongqing takes about 3 hours.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 濯水古镇
summaryEn: An old trading town on the Apeng River that grew up from the late Tang and flourished in the Ming and Qing, with about a kilometre of flagstone lanes lined by Tujia stilt houses and Hui-style buildings. A 658 m covered 'wind-and-rain' bridge spans the river, and the 5A scenic area also takes in the nearby Puhua underground river, with three natural bridges and a large sinkhole.
description: 濯水古镇位于重庆。游览特色包括古镇。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 濯水景区
accessEn: In Zhuoshui town, about 25 km south of central Qianjiang in Qianjiang District and 18 km from Qianjiang Wulingshan Airport; tourist buses run from Qianjiang station on the Chongqing–Xiamen high-speed railway.

name: 金丝峡
summaryEn: A system of narrow, steep-walled limestone gorges on the southern side of the Qinling in Shangnan County, made up of the White Dragon, Black Dragon and Green Dragon gorges, Shiyan Stockade and the Danjiang source area, with a combined gorge length of 20.5 km. Streams run through dense forest between the cliffs, and the area is rich in plants and wildlife. It was rated a national 5A scenic area in 2015 and is also a national geopark, national forest park and national water park.
description: 金丝峡位于陕西省商洛市商南县新开岭腹地，是陕南唯一一家国家5A级旅游景区。景区内有白龙峡、黑龙峡、青龙峡、石燕寨和丹江源五大景区，峡谷总长度20.5公里，纵深10多公里。2015年10月，批准为国家5A级旅游景区，同时为中国国家地质公园、国家森林公园和国家水利风景区。
officialName: 商洛市金丝峡景区
accessEn: About 40 km south-east of Shangnan town by road; Shangnan is roughly 3 hours by expressway from Xi'an.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 崇圣寺三塔
summaryEn: The three brick pagodas stand northwest of Dali Old Town at the foot of the Cang Mountains. The central Qianxun Pagoda rises in sixteen tiers, flanked by two smaller towers.
description: 崇圣寺三塔，位于中国云南省大理白族自治州大理市大理古城西北的崇圣寺中，是三座南诏末期修建的砖质佛塔。其中以东侧的千寻塔为大塔，为密檐式佛塔；南北各有一座小塔，均为楼阁式佛塔，且距离千寻塔的距离相同。三塔在明清两代曾多次修缮，中华人民共和国成立后于1978年至1981年彻底大修，将三塔基本恢复原状，并从塔中出土了大量文物。
officialName: 大理州崇圣寺三塔文化旅游区
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0
imageCredit: The original uploader was TIY at Chinese Wikipedia .

name: 云丘山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in Xiangning County, rated 5A in 2020, with a total area of 210 sq km, a core visiting zone of 35 sq km and a highest point of 1,629 m. Visitors come for its ice caves, the old village of Tar'erpo and the cave-dwelling courtyards of Kangjiaping, and the area hosts an annual trail-running race and a yearly culture festival. It was named a national civilised-tourism demonstration unit in 2024.
description: 云丘山位于山西临汾。游览特色包括山地游览、洞穴、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
officialName: 临汾市云丘山景区
accessEn: It is in Guanwangmiao township, about 30 km south-east of Xiangning county town.

name: 满洲里中俄边境旅游区
summaryEn: Manzhouli is China's largest land port, and this 5A-rated zone takes in two of its best-known sights. The first is the monumental 'national gate' at the port, the fifth gate on the site, built in 2008 with models of the four earlier ones beside it. The second is Matryoshka Square in the town, a theme square built around giant nesting dolls, the largest of which houses a hotel and a performance hall.
description: 满洲里中俄边境旅游区位于内蒙古呼伦贝尔。游览特色包括边境口岸。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 呼伦贝尔市中俄边境旅游区
accessEn: The gate area is about 8 km west-north-west of central Manzhouli, which has an airport and a railway station and lies about 170 km west-north-west of Hailar.

name: 大安嫩江湾
summaryEn: A riverside park of about 3.5 sq km on a bend of the Nen River, on the north-eastern edge of Da'an, laid out around a lake and reed wetland with bridges, a quay and walking paths. Local government pages record the Liao-dynasty emperors holding their spring camps (chunabo) on this stretch of the river, fishing through the ice, and the sights include the Laokanzi wharf, the Liao Emperor's Fish-Viewing Platform and the Huayi Tongfeng courtyard. It is a national wetland park and forest park, was named a 5A scenic area in December 2024, and ran a winter snow programme in the 2024–25 season.
description: 大安嫩江湾位于吉林白城。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 白城市大安嫩江湾旅游区
accessEn: On the north-eastern edge of Da'an, a small city about 114 km east of Baicheng and 60 km north-west of Songyuan in straight lines; the provincial tourism bureau puts the park about 1 km from the built-up area.

name: 长影世纪城
summaryEn: A film-themed amusement park run by the Changchun Film Studio group, established in 2005 in the Jingyue district on the south-eastern edge of the city. Its grounds of about 33 hectares are laid out in four sections, with special-effects cinemas including dome and 4D theatres, film-dubbing and sound-effects experiences and film-themed live performances. It suits families and groups looking for a theme-park day, and the city tourism bureau lists it among the attractions that add ice-and-snow programmes in winter.
description: 长影世纪城位于吉林长春。游览特色包括主题游乐、演艺体验、影视拍摄。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
officialName: 长春市长影世纪城景区
accessEn: About 16 km south-east of central Changchun in the Jingyue district, a short way from Jingyuetan park and served by a light-rail stop of the same name.

name: 虎头旅游景区
summaryEn: A scenic area on the Ussuri River at Hutou, built around the remains of the Hutou fortress, one of a chain of fortifications that the Japanese Kwantung Army built along the north-eastern frontier in the 1930s and that Soviet forces attacked in August 1945. It has the fortress museum with relics and exhibits, wartime remains such as a military wharf, a large bronze tiger statue on the river bank, a Guandi temple and riverside wetland, looking across the river to the Russian city of Dalnerechensk. The fortress is part of a national heritage unit of the north-eastern fortifications.
description: 虎头旅游景区位于黑龙江鸡西。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑、城堡。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 鸡西市虎头旅游景区
accessEn: In Hutou town on the Ussuri, about 64 km by road east-north-east of Hulin, which has a railway station.

name: 濠河
summaryEn: The Haohe is Nantong's old city moat, dug by the 10th century and still ringing the historic centre in a gourd-shaped loop about 10 km long that widens from 10 m to more than 200 m. Its banks link Tianning Temple, the Song-era city-wall remains at Beijige, the Ming Wenfeng Pagoda, Nantong Museum and the old Sijie and Xinanying lanes, with parks and smaller museums in between. Boat trips run day and night, and an evening show of lights and live performance along the boat route was added in 2026.
description: 濠河是中国江苏省南通市区老城区的护城河，沿线风景优美。被称作是南通城的“翡翠项链”。现为国家5A级旅游风景名胜区。
officialName: 南通市濠河风景区
accessEn: In central Nantong; the main visitor centre and boat pier are on the north-west bank, and the riverside paths can be walked from anywhere in the old town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 洪泽湖湿地
summaryEn: A wetland scenic area in the shallows of north-western Hongze Lake, China's fourth-largest freshwater lake, forming part of the Sihong Hongze Lake Wetland National Nature Reserve. Boats thread through a maze of reed channels where waterbirds gather, and there is a wetland science museum, a dawn-redwood forest and a VR ride on the legend of Sizhou, the city the lake swallowed.
description: 洪泽湖湿地位于江苏宿迁。游览特色包括博物馆、湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 宿迁市洪泽湖湿地景区
accessEn: Near Linhuai town on the lake shore, about 25 km south-east of Sihong county town and roughly 1½ hours by road from central Suqian.

name: 溱湖
summaryEn: Qinhu was Jiangsu's first national wetland park and China's second, a lake and marshland in the Lixiahe lowlands where wetland covers most of the park and hundreds of wild plant and animal species have been recorded, Père David's deer among them. Boats link the visitor hall with a wetland science museum and a bird museum across the lake, and each Qingming festival around a thousand boats crowd the water for the Qintong Boat Festival, a national intangible heritage.
description: 姜堰市溱湖旅游景区，地处江苏中部，江淮之间的泰州市姜堰区溱潼镇。是中华人民共和国国家5A级旅游景区、中国国家湿地公园和中国国家水利风景区。800多年前的南宋时期岳飞岳家军与金兵在此战斗。
officialName: 泰州市溱湖旅游景区
accessEn: About 15 km north of Jiangyan and 20 km north-east of central Taizhou; boats leave from the visitor hall at the south gate.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 根宫佛国
summaryEn: A cultural park on the edge of Kaihua county town created by the root-carving artist Xu Guqing, where garden courtyards and buildings display thousands of root carvings and bonsai made from tree roots, a craft practised in Kaihua since the Tang dynasty. Its centrepiece is the 'Root Palace Buddhist Kingdom', with large Buddhist figures and a set of 500 arhats carved from roots, and the zone counts more than 20,000 root carvings across over 40 sights. It suits anyone interested in Chinese folk crafts.
description: 根宫佛国位于浙江衢州。游览特色包括园林景观、佛教文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 衢州市根宫佛国文化旅游区
accessEn: On the western edge of Kaihua county town, about 50 km west of Quzhou city by road.

name: 八里河
summaryEn: Bali River is a lakeside park in Balihe town, Yingshang County, built by local farmers from 1992 on a flood-prone marsh near where the Ying River meets the Huai, and opened in 1996 as a 'farmers' park'. Its sections include a bird garden, a 'World Scenery' area of concrete miniatures of foreign landmarks such as the Arc de Triomphe, Chinese-style gardens and pavilions, and flower islands, set in a 15.8 km² area that is mostly water. In 2013 it became northern Anhui's first 5A scenic area.
description: 八里河位于安徽阜阳。游览特色包括湖泊、园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 阜阳市八里河风景区
accessEn: In Balihe town, about 8 km south of Yingshang county town by road and roughly 70 km south-east of Fuyang.

name: 万佛湖
summaryEn: Wanfo Lake is the scenic name of Longhekou Reservoir, built by around 100,000 labourers mobilised from across Shucheng County from 1958 and largely finished in 1970 as a flood-control and irrigation source for the Pishihang irrigation district. The lake covers about 50 km² of a 135 km² scenic area, with wooded islands such as Zhouyu Island, the long earth dam, a reservoir memorial hall and the Longhe Pagoda. Boat trips between the islands and lakeside resorts make it a popular weekend escape from Hefei.
description: 万佛湖位于安徽六安。游览特色包括湖泊、纪念展览、水库。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 六安市万佛湖风景区
accessEn: About 35 km south-west of Shucheng county town by road, or roughly 1.5 hours' drive from Hefei.

name: 芜湖方特
summaryEn: A cluster of Fantawild theme parks in Jiujiang District on Wuhu's north-eastern side, run by the Huaqiang Fantawild group. The city government lists three parks: Fantawild Oriental Heritage (opened 2015), with more than 20 zones built around Chinese legends such as Nüwa mending the sky and the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl, plus a wooden roller coaster; Fantawild Dreamland (2010), with animation-themed attractions and fairground rides; and a water park. It suits families who want a full day of rides; Wuhu was also home to the chain's first large park, Fantawild Adventure, which opened in 2007 and closed in 2020.
description: 芜湖方特位于安徽芜湖。游览特色包括主题游乐。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 芜湖市方特旅游区
accessEn: About 10 km north-east of central Wuhu; Fantawild·Huizhou Road station on Wuhu Rail Transit Line 2 is beside the parks.

name: 瑞金共和国摇篮景区
summaryEn: Ruijin was the seat of the Chinese Soviet Republic's central government from late 1931 until the Long March began in 1934, and this scenic area gathers four sets of sites from that period. They are Yeping, where the first national congress of soviets met in 1931 and offices and residences survive in former village buildings; the Red Well area at Shazhouba, to which the government moved in 1933; the Great Hall of the Second National Congress; and a memorial park with a history museum and a martyrs' memorial hall. Xinhua counts 26 nationally protected sites within the area.
description: 瑞金共和国摇篮景区位于江西赣州。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、国家一级博物馆。图集建议预留1 天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 赣州市瑞金市共和国摇篮景区
accessEn: Yeping, the main zone, is about 5 km east-north-east of Ruijin, the other zones lie on the west side of the city, and Ruijin is roughly 135 km by road east of Ganzhou. The history museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays, while the site groups stay open all year.

name: 古窑民俗博览区
summaryEn: An open-air museum complex built around the Zhen Kiln, a Qing-dynasty porcelain kiln that can fire dozens of kinds of ware at high and low temperatures and was lit again in June 2014. The grounds also hold workshops where craftspeople demonstrate hand-made porcelain and kiln firing, a Qing temple to Tong Bin, the kiln master worshipped as the kiln god, and two groups of historic buildings moved here: the Ming Garden, seven Ming buildings from villages in Fuliang, and the Qing Garden of four Qing buildings. It suits visitors who want to see traditional porcelain-making and old kilns in one place.
description: 古窑民俗博览区位于江西景德镇。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
officialName: 景德镇市昌江区古窑民俗博览区
accessEn: On Guyao Road in Changjiang district, on the western side of Jingdezhen, about 3 km west-south-west of the Imperial Kiln Museum. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 江湾
summaryEn: Jiangwan is a lived-in Huizhou-style old town in the east of Wuyuan County, with ancestral halls, memorial archways, old houses, theatres and waterways. Its large Xiao-Jiang ancestral hall was rebuilt in 2003, and a folk-custom museum and local crafts such as She inkstone carving show the town's traditions. It has been a national 5A scenic area since 2013.
description: 江湾位于江西上饶。游览特色包括博物馆、祠堂文化、戏剧演艺。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 上饶市婺源县江湾景区
accessEn: About 23 km north-east of Wuyuan town, with Huangling about 8 km to the south-east.

name: 威海华夏城
summaryEn: Huaxia City is a large themed scenic area in Huancui District, built from 2003 over abandoned quarries on Longshan and rated 5A in 2017. Buildings in traditional Chinese style, a Jiaodong folk-customs museum, lakes and reservoirs and a nine-bend 'lovers' street' sit among restored woodland, and a live show has been staged in a former quarry pit. It suits families and a full day out.
description: 威海华夏城位于山东威海。游览特色包括博物馆、水库。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
officialName: 威海市威海华夏城景区
accessEn: In Huancui District about 10 km south of central Weihai, reached by road.

name: 龙口南山旅游景区
summaryEn: Nanshan is a large scenic area run by the Nanshan Group in the hills south of Longkou, best known for a seated tin-bronze Buddha of about 380 tonnes that stands above a long flight of 360 steps. Beneath the Buddha's lotus base are halls and a Buddhism museum, and the grounds also hold a jade Buddha hall, the rebuilt Nanshan Chan Temple and a history park laid out along the Chinese dynasties, with a seaside resort area on the Bohai coast belonging to the same complex. Most of the buildings are modern or rebuilt, and it suits a full day out from Longkou.
description: 龙口南山旅游景区位于山东烟台。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 烟台市南山景区
accessEn: In Dongjiang subdistrict, about 14 km by road south of the centre of Longkou, which is about 97 km by road from central Yantai.

name: 西峡恐龙遗迹园—老界岭
summaryEn: Two separate parts of the Funiu Mountain Global Geopark in Xixia County share this 5A listing. The Dinosaur Remains Park at Danshui shows a Cretaceous bed of fossil dinosaur eggs with more than 1,000 eggs exposed, together with an egg-fossil museum and a park of model dinosaurs. Laojieling, about 50 km to the north, is a forested ridge on the divide between the Yangtze and Yellow River basins that rises to over 2,200 m at Jijiaojian.
description: 西峡恐龙遗迹园—老界岭位于河南南阳。游览特色包括博物馆、地质景观。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
officialName: 南阳市西峡恐龙遗迹园-伏牛山-老界岭旅游区
accessEn: The dinosaur park is about 25 minutes by road east of Xixia town, and Laojieling roughly 1.5 hours further north by mountain road.

name: 八里沟
summaryEn: A canyon scenic area in the Taihang Mountains north-west of Huixian, rated 5A in 2019, where three tiers of red cliffs enclose deep valleys with a string of pools and waterfalls, among them the Tianhe (Heavenly River) Waterfall. Paths link sights such as a 'one-thread-of-sky' cleft and the Black Dragon Pool, and the area now also takes in the Tianjie Mountain and Jiulian Mountain sections on the heights above.
description: 八里沟位于河南新乡。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 新乡市八里沟景区
accessEn: In Shangbali town, about 50 km north-west of central Xinxiang by road.

name: 宝泉
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area under the red Taihang cliffs west of Huixian, rated 5A in December 2024. It has two linked parts: the Grand Canyon, a gentle valley of streams, pools and waterfalls suited to families, and Ya Tianxia on the cliffs above, which opened in April 2023. A cableway, a lift inside the cliff and the glass-floored Xiangyun platform give views over the lake, the cliff-top zone offers via ferrata, bungee jumping and a cliff roller coaster, and evening light shows are projected on the cliffs and waterfalls.
description: 宝泉位于河南新乡。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、湖泊。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 新乡市宝泉旅游区
accessEn: Near Bobi town, about 30 km west of Huixian and an hour by road from central Xinxiang.

name: 龟峰山
summaryEn: Guifeng Mountain is a mountain scenic area in Guishan town, Macheng, at the southern foot of the central Dabie Mountains near the Hubei–Henan–Anhui border. Its nine peaks rise to 1,320 m at Daofeng Peak, and about 95 percent of the area is forested. It is best known for a stand of old azaleas that local sources describe as covering about 100,000 mu and that blooms in spring, and it forms part of the Dabie Mountains geopark.
description: 龟峰山位于湖北黄冈。游览特色包括山地游览、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 黄冈市麻城龟峰山景区
accessEn: In Guishan town south of Macheng, reached by road, including a 5.6 km expressway spur off the Shanghai–Chengdu expressway that opened in 2021; Macheng has stations on the Beijing–Kowloon and Hefei–Wuhan lines.

name: 木兰文化生态旅游区
summaryEn: A national 5A area in northern Huangpi District made up of four parts tied to the legend of Mulan, which local tradition places here: Mulan Mountain, a long-standing religious site with an ancient building complex that is also part of a national geopark; Mulan Tianchi (Heavenly Lake), a forest canyon of waterfalls and pools; Mulan Grassland, a steppe-themed park; and Yunwu Mountain, known for its azaleas in spring. Mulan Mountain covers about 30 sq km. Sightseeing buses run within the scenic area.
description: 木兰文化生态旅游区位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、地质景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 武汉市木兰文化生态旅游区
accessEn: In Huangpi District, about 70 km north of central Wuhan by road.

name: 长鹿旅游休博园
summaryEn: A privately built leisure park of about 600 mu (40 hectares) in Lunjiao, Shunde, which grew out of the Changlu farm resort opened in the early 2000s and was rated a 5A scenic area in 2014. It is divided into ten themed areas, among them an amusement-ride park, a fairy-tale animal kingdom, a mine-tunnel aquarium, a snow world, a science hall, a Jurassic zone, a farm-restaurant area and a military-themed area, with a staged show at its Global Village theatre. Themed hotels and dozens of restaurants make it a full-day outing for families.
description: 长鹿旅游休博园位于广东佛山。游览特色包括水族展览、历史纪念、公园休闲。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 佛山市顺德区长鹿旅游休博园
accessEn: In Sanzhou, Lunjiao subdistrict, Shunde District, about 18 km south of central Foshan and roughly 30 km south of central Guangzhou by road.

name: 雁南飞茶田
summaryEn: A tea estate and resort in the hills of Changjiao village, Yanyang town, whose terraced tea gardens produce the local Yannanfei tea; it was rated a 5A scenic area in 2011. Paths and walkways run through the tea fields, and the estate hotel is built in the form of a Hakka weilongwu, an enclosed house with a rounded rear range. Visitors can try tea picking and tea making, eat Hakka food and watch Hakka song-and-dance performances.
description: 雁南飞茶田位于广东梅州。游览特色包括园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 梅州市梅县区雁南飞茶田景区
accessEn: In Yanyang town, Meixian District, about 35 km by road east of central Meizhou, roughly 45 minutes by car; Ye Jianying Memorial Park and Lingguang Temple are nearby.

name: 连州地下河
summaryEn: A three-level limestone cave in the hills north of Lianzhou, where two dry upper levels lead down to an underground river that visitors travel by boat. The chambers are full of stalactites, stalagmites, columns and flowstone, and the air stays at about 18 °C all year. The writer Qin Mu described it in a 1988 travel essay, and it is one of the best-known sights of north-west Guangdong.
description: 连州地下河位于广东清远。游览特色包括洞穴、钟乳石、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
officialName: 清远市连州市地下河旅游景区
accessEn: In Dongbei town, about 25 km north of Lianzhou city by road.

name: 观澜湖
summaryEn: Founded in 1992 in Guanlan, Mission Hills Golf Club was recognised by Guinness World Records in 2004 as the world's largest golf facility, with twelve 18-hole courses designed by players such as Jack Nicklaus, Nick Faldo, Ernie Els and Annika Sörenstam. The surrounding 5A leisure area also has a resort hotel, and is mainly of interest to golfers and resort guests.
description: 观澜湖位于广东深圳。游览特色包括高尔夫。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 深圳市龙华区观澜湖休闲旅游区
accessEn: In Guanlan, Longhua district, about 25 km north of central Shenzhen; Guanlanhu metro station is nearby.

name: 黑山谷
summaryEn: A 13 km gorge walk through dense forest in Heishan town near the Guizhou border, past waterfalls, pools, floating walkways and a great rift canyon, in a valley where François' langurs and dove trees are among the rare species recorded. The 5A listing also covers the Wansheng Stone Forest, or 'Dragon-Scale Stone Sea', a national geopark of karst pinnacles and caves whose rock surfaces are covered in scale-like ridges.
description: 黑山谷位于重庆。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、石林。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 万盛黑山谷-龙鳞石海风景区
accessEn: In Heishan town, about 20 km from Wansheng (Wansheng Economic Development Zone, Qijiang District) and roughly 2.5 hours by road from central Chongqing; the stone forest is in Shilin town nearer Wansheng.

name: 武陵山大裂谷
summaryEn: A karst landscape of gorges, cliffs, caves and streams in the mountains of south-eastern Fuling, rated 5A in 2024 and covering about 30 km² with a height range of some 1,380 m. Its headline sights are the narrow Qingtian slot canyon, the deep Wanzhang vertical shaft, a waterfall where an underground river pours out of Laojun Cave, and the 'Copper and Iron Walls' of steeply folded rock strata.
description: 武陵山大裂谷位于重庆。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 武陵山大裂谷景区
accessEn: In Wulingshan town in south-eastern Fuling District, about an hour by road from central Fuling, with a tourist bus from Fuling North railway station since July 2026.

name: 酉阳桃花源
summaryEn: A 50 km² scenic area on the edge of Youyang's county town that presents itself as the real-world model for Tao Yuanming's fable of the Peach Blossom Spring, with a secluded karst valley of streams, fields and peach trees, Taigu Cave and the large Fuxi Cave with its wide variety of dripstone formations. Other sections include a national forest park, Youzhou Ancient Town (a 1.3 km street of Tujia-style stilt buildings) and the 2,800-seat Taoyuan Grand Stage for the live show 'Dreamlike Peach Blossom Spring'. On the central square visitors can join Tujia hand-waving dances or listen to wood-leaf songs.
description: 酉阳桃花源位于重庆。游览特色包括古镇、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 桃花源旅游景区
accessEn: On the edge of Youyang county town in south-eastern Chongqing, about 4 hours by train or road from central Chongqing.

name: 光雾山
summaryEn: Guangwushan covers more than 400 km² of the Micang range on the Sichuan–Shaanxi border, with limestone peaks, deep valleys, caves and large tracts of beech forest rising to 2,507 m. It is best known for its autumn colour, when the forests turn red and gold, and the Micangshan National Forest Park, around Daba, is part of the same area. With the Nuoshui River it forms the Guangwushan–Nuoshuihe UNESCO Global Geopark.
description: 光雾山位于四川巴中。游览特色包括地质景观、森林公园。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
officialName: 巴中市光雾山旅游景区
accessEn: About 70 km (roughly 1.5 hours) by road north of Nanjiang county town, which has buses from Bazhong.

name: 冶力关
summaryEn: A mountain and forest scenic area around Yeliguan town in Lintan county, on the north-eastern edge of the Tibetan Plateau, rated a national 5A area in 2024. It takes in the Yeliguan National Forest Park along the Yemu River, with pasture and the narrow, cliff-walled Lianzhu Gorge upstream and forested ravines downstream, and Tianchi Yehai, a mountain lake 7 km north of the town, known locally as Changye Pool after the Ming general Chang Yuchun, whose temple stands on its shore.
description: 冶力关位于甘肃甘南。游览特色包括峡谷、森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 甘南州冶力关旅游区
accessEn: About 3 hours by road south of Lanzhou, or about 1.5 hours north-east of Lintan county town.

name: 官鹅沟
summaryEn: Guan'egou is a set of forested gorges on the edge of Tanchang county town, where Guanzhu Gully, Eman Gully and Leigu Mountain are linked into one U-shaped circuit of about 66 km². Paths follow the streams past waterfalls, the valleys turn red and gold in autumn, and since May 2025 a 2.5 km cable car has linked Guanzhu Gully with the upper areas towards Leigu Mountain. It became a national geopark in 2014 and a 5A scenic area in 2022.
description: 官鹅沟位于甘肃陇南。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、地质景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
officialName: 陇南市官鹅沟景区
accessEn: The visitor centre is just outside Tanchang county town, about 1.5 hours by the G75 expressway north-west of Wudu (Longnan city).

name: 互助土族故土园
summaryEn: A folk-culture complex around Weiyuan, the county town of Huzhu Tu Autonomous County, presenting Tu (Monguor) culture through traditional-style courtyard houses, an old oil mill, liquor workshops and a chieftain's mansion, with live song, dance and wedding performances. Its linked sites include the Rainbow Tribe village, the Western Tu folk village and Naton Manor. It was rated a national 5A scenic area in 2017 and suits travellers who want an introduction to Tu life; the Tianyoude liquor workshop is a short distance away.
description: 互助土族故土园位于青海海东。游览特色包括传统民居、历史宅院、酿造文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 海东市互助土族故土园旅游区
accessEn: In Weiyuan, Huzhu's county town, roughly 40 km north-east of Xining by road.

name: 六盘山红军长征纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial complex on the pass over the Liupan Mountains, the last high range the Red Army crossed on the Long March in October 1935, a crossing Mao Zedong marked in his poem 'Mount Liupan'. A memorial pavilion was put up on the summit in 1985 and a memorial hall with displays on the march opened in 2005, and a 2.5 km 'Red Army trail' built in 2013 has more than 200 sculptures in 18 scenes. Newer additions include an intangible-heritage hall and a themed post office, and the area was rated 5A at the end of 2024.
description: 六盘山红军长征纪念馆位于宁夏固原。游览特色包括纪念展览、楼阁建筑、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
officialName: 固原市六盘山红军长征旅游区
accessEn: On the G312 over the Liupan pass, a few kilometres east of Longde county town and roughly an hour by road south of Guyuan.

name: 白沙湖
summaryEn: A small freshwater lake ringed by pale sand dunes at the Bingtuan's 185th Regiment in the far north-west of Habahe County, about 2.5 km from the Kazakhstan border. Mixed woodland and dense reeds grow around the shore, lotus flowers open on the water in June, and the neighbouring Singing Sand Hill gives the dunes a rumbling sound. The 5A area also includes the regiment's 'Northwest First Company' site.
description: 白沙湖位于新疆阿勒泰。游览特色包括湖泊、林地风光、莲花观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 兵团十师185团白沙湖景区（阿勒泰地区）
accessEn: At the 185th Regiment about 108 km by road from Habahe county town. It lies in a border area, so a border-area permit (边境通行证) is needed as well as a passport; check the current rules before travelling.

name: 塔克拉玛干·三五九旅文化旅游区
summaryEn: A tourism area in Aral, the Bingtuan city of the 1st Division, centred on the 359th Brigade Reclamation Memorial Hall, which presents the history of the army units that came to Xinjiang around 1950 and turned to farming and land reclamation on the northern edge of the Taklamakan. It also includes the 'Gate of the Desert' area of the 11th Regiment, with desert sports and farm sightseeing, and was rated 5A in 2021.
description: 塔克拉玛干·三五九旅文化旅游区位于新疆阿拉尔。游览特色包括沙漠、纪念展览。图集建议预留半天游览。
officialName: 兵团阿拉尔市塔克拉玛干•三五九旅文化旅游区
accessEn: In Aral city, about 125 km by road south-east of Aksu, roughly an hour and a half's drive.

name: 八大处
summaryEn: Badachu, the 'Eight Great Sites', is a hillside park in the Western Hills linking eight Buddhist temples and nunneries founded between the Sui and Qing dynasties on three hills. The best known is Lingguang Temple, an active monastery where a Buddha tooth relic found in the ruins of an older pagoda is kept in a pagoda built in 1964. Old trees, including white-bark pines and ginkgos more than 600 years old, shade the paths between the temples.
description: 八大处，又称西山八大处，是指位于北京市西郊翠微山、卢师山、觉山三座山的八处汉传佛教寺院。现为八大处公园，地址为北京市石景山区八大处路3号。
accessEn: In Shijingshan District at the foot of the Western Hills, about 19 km west of Tiananmen and roughly 45 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 北京海洋馆
summaryEn: A large indoor aquarium opened in 1999 in the northern part of Beijing Zoo, run as a commercial attraction separate from the zoo. Its halls hold tanks of fish and other aquatic animals, and staged marine-animal shows are part of the programme, which makes it mainly a family outing.
description: 北京海洋馆，位于北京市海淀区北下关街道的北京动物园内，由北京信沃达海洋科技有限公司运营，其南面是长河、毗邻北京展览馆、天文馆和首都体育馆。其占地面积为12万平方米，建筑面积为4.2万平方米，是目前世界上最大的内陆水族馆。
accessEn: Inside the northern part of Beijing Zoo on Xizhimenwai Street, about 10 minutes' walk from Beijing Zoo (Dongwuyuan) metro station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 北京汽车博物馆
summaryEn: A museum of the motor car opened in 2011 on the South 4th Ring Road, with some 80 vehicles across 13 exhibition areas covering the history, technology and future of the car. Exhibits range from a replica of Benz's 1886 Patent-Motorwagen to Hongqi state cars and Beijing-built jeeps, alongside interactive displays.
description: 北京汽车博物馆位于北京市丰台区看丹街道南四环西路126号。
accessEn: On the South 4th Ring Road West in Fengtai District, about 12 km south-west of Tiananmen. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 北京天文馆
summaryEn: China's first large planetarium, opened in 1957 opposite Beijing Zoo, with a domed star theatre in the original building and a glass-walled second building added in 2004. The two buildings hold dome and 3D/4D theatres, astronomy exhibition halls and small observatories, making it a good indoor stop with children.
description: 北京天文馆，位于北京市西城区西直门外大街138号，是北京市天文学展览馆和科普基地。北京天文馆是隶属于北京市科学技术研究院的全额拨款事业单位。
accessEn: On Xizhimenwai Street opposite Beijing Zoo, a few minutes' walk from Beijing Zoo (Dongwuyuan) metro station. Closed on Tuesdays (except public holidays).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 石景山游乐园
summaryEn: Opened in 1986 as one of Beijing's first amusement parks, this district-owned park mixes Chinese garden scenery with a fairy-tale castle. It has six roller coasters, family rides and a converted Boeing 747 airliner, plus seasonal events such as a Spring Festival temple fair and summer water-splashing days, and it suits families with children.
description: 石景山游乐园是一个大型综合游乐园，位于北京市石景山区，是北京市第二大综合性游乐园。石景山游乐园建于1986年，占地26万多平方米。游乐园中有中国园林与西方城堡的融合风格。
accessEn: In Bajiao, Shijingshan District, about 17 km west of Tiananmen; Bajiao Amusement Park station on Metro Line 1 is closed for rebuilding (reopening planned for 2027), so use Babaoshan or Gucheng station nearby.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 北京世界公园
summaryEn: A theme park opened in 1993 in south-western Fengtai District, laid out by continent with more than 100 scale models of famous buildings and monuments, most of them at one-tenth size. A walk takes you past miniatures of the Eiffel Tower, the Egyptian pyramids, Angkor Wat and the Sydney Opera House, and it suits families with children.
description: 北京世界公园位于中华人民共和国北京市丰台区花乡大葆台，是一座以世界各地名胜古迹的微缩景观为特色的公园，被列为北京十大精品公园之一，也是中国国家4A级旅游景区之一。北京世界公园1992年4月5日奠基，经过一年多的施工，于1993年9月29日试营业开园，同年10月25日正式开放，共占地46.7公顷。
accessEn: In Fengtai District, about 17 km south-west of Tiananmen by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 北京动物园
summaryEn: Regarded as China's oldest public zoo, it grew out of the Qing government's agricultural experimental farm founded in 1906 and first opened to visitors in 1908. Besides the giant pandas and other animal houses, the wooded grounds keep buildings of the old farm, among them the brick gateway and Changguanlou, a Baroque-style two-storey villa built in 1908 as a stopping place for Empress Dowager Cixi on her boat trips to the Summer Palace.
description: 北京动物园位于北京市西城区展览路街道西直门外大街137号，原来名为农事实验场、天然博物院、万牲园、西郊公园，是中国开放最早、动物种类最多的动物园，从清光绪三十二年正式建园至今已有逾百年的历史。北京动物园曾经繁殖和饲养了众多珍贵的野生动物，例如大熊猫、朱鹮、金丝猴等。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Xizhimenwai Street in Xicheng District, about 6 km north-west of Tiananmen Square and a few minutes' walk from Beijing Zoo (Dongwuyuan) metro station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 首都博物馆
summaryEn: Beijing's municipal museum, founded in 1981 in the Confucius Temple and moved in 2006 to a large modern building on Chang'an Avenue designed by Cui Kai with Jean-Marie Duthilleul. Its galleries cover the history of Beijing alongside collections of porcelain, bronzes, jade, calligraphy, painting and Buddhist sculpture, much of it excavated in and around the city, and it hosts major touring exhibitions.
description: 首都博物馆，位于北京市西城区复兴门外大街16号，是北京市大型综合性博物馆，为北京市文物局直属单位。
accessEn: On Fuxingmenwai Street (the western extension of Chang'an Avenue), about 10 minutes' walk east of Muxidi metro station; its eastern branch, the Beijing Grand Canal Museum, is in Tongzhou. Closed on Tuesdays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中央广播电视塔
summaryEn: A 405-metre broadcasting and observation tower on Beijing's West Third Ring Road, completed in 1992 and opened to sightseers in 1994; it was the city's tallest structure until 2018. Lifts climb to an observation deck at 238 m and a revolving restaurant a little lower down, with views across Yuyuantan Park and the city.
description: 中央广播电视塔，俗称中央电视塔，简称中塔，坐落于中华人民共和国北京市海淀区西三环中路西侧，与玉渊潭公园隔三环路相望，在北京中信广场封顶前曾是北京市最高的建筑物，也是中国第四高塔和世界第九高塔。中央广播电视塔由原广播电影电视部设计院设计，塔高405米，底部占地面积12143平方米，建筑面积近6万平方米，由栈桥、退台、塔座、塔身、塔楼、天线桅杆6部分组成。
accessEn: On the West Third Ring Road about 8 km west of Tiananmen, across the road from Yuyuantan Park; Xidiaoyutai station on Metro Line 10 is about 10 minutes' walk away.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 朝阳公园
summaryEn: Regarded as the largest park inside Beijing's 4th Ring Road, Chaoyang Park was developed from 1984 on the east side of the city. Lakes, lawns and woods share the grounds with play areas, the former beach-volleyball venue of the 2008 Olympics and seasonal music festivals, and a long walking loop runs through the park.
description: 朝阳公园是位于中华人民共和国北京市朝阳区朝阳公园南路1号的一个公园，规划总面积为288.7公顷，为北京四环路以内最大的城市公园。
accessEn: In Chaoyang District near the East 4th Ring Road, about 8 km east of Tiananmen.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 国家植物园
summaryEn: Formed in 2022 by joining the Beijing Botanical Garden with the Chinese Academy of Sciences' garden, the China National Botanical Garden has a planned area of nearly 600 hectares at the foot of the Western Hills, between Fragrant Hills and Jade Spring Hill. The north garden has themed collections such as the peach, peony, lilac and rose gardens, a tropical conservatory, Cherry Valley (Yingtaogou) and a memorial hall to the novelist Cao Xueqin. It also takes in Wofo Temple (Shifang Pujue Temple), whose Hall of the Reclining Buddha holds a large bronze Buddha cast in 1321.
description: 国家植物园位于北京。游览特色包括纪念展览、植物园、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Haidian District, about 18 km north-west of Tiananmen; the Xijiao light-rail line stops at the garden. The conservatories, Wofo Temple and the Cao Xueqin memorial hall are closed on Mondays (except public holidays).

name: 中国紫檀博物馆
summaryEn: A private museum opened in 1999 by the entrepreneur Chen Lihua and devoted to zitan, a dense dark-red hardwood long used for fine Chinese furniture. Its five-storey building in Ming–Qing style shows a large collection of classical furniture and carving, and its zitan carving craft was listed as national intangible cultural heritage in 2011.
description: 中国紫檀博物馆是位于中华人民共和国北京市朝阳区高碑店地区的一座私人博物馆，占地25000平方米，展厅面积9569平方米，是中华人民共和国第一家专门收藏紫檀艺术品的博物馆，也是中华人民共和国首家冠以“中国”的私人博物馆，由陈丽华投资2亿元于1999年9月开办。
accessEn: On Jianguo Road at Gaobeidian, Chaoyang District, about 11 km east of Tiananmen.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 凤凰岭
summaryEn: A scenic area of about 9.7 km² of rocky hills in north-west Haidian, named after a huge 'Fenghuangling' inscription carved on a cliff and nicknamed the 'Little Huangshan of western Beijing'. Three hiking routes follow the valleys past cave shrines carved in the Liao and Jin periods, the Daoist Taoyuan Temple, a 53-step 'Heavenly Ladder' cut almost vertically into the rock, and Longquan Temple, an active Buddhist monastery at the foot of the hills.
description: 凤凰岭是位于北京市西郊，海淀区西北部的风景名胜区。凤凰岭古称千峰山，得名于摩崖刻字“凤凰岭”，有“京西小黄山”之称，传说八仙中的铁拐李曾在此修仙。景区内自然和人文景观众多，主要景点有龙泉寺、桃源观、飞来石和天梯等。
accessEn: In Sujiatuo, north-west Haidian District, about 35 km from Tiananmen and roughly an hour by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 北京欢乐谷
summaryEn: An amusement park opened in 2006 by the OCT group on the south-eastern side of the city, with dozens of rides, from big roller coasters and drop towers to gentle children's rides, spread over themed zones such as a Mayan jungle, an Aegean harbour and a Shangri-La area. Live shows and parades run through the day, and it suits families and thrill-seekers.
description: 北京欢乐谷，是位于北京市朝阳区东四环东四环小武基北路的一家大型文化主题公园，于2006年7月建成并开放，占地面积56万平方米。
accessEn: By the East 4th Ring Road in Chaoyang District, about 9 km south-east of Tiananmen; Happy Valley Scenic Area station on subway Line 7 is at the gate.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 红螺寺
summaryEn: A large Buddhist temple at the southern foot of Hongluo Mountain, by tradition founded in 338 and rebuilt many times, which became a leading centre of Pure Land Buddhism in northern China under the Qing masters Jixing and Yinguang. Its halls are laid out in several courtyards on the hillside, surrounded by an old pine forest, with Hongluo Lake to the south.
description: 红螺寺，位于北京市怀柔区城北4公里的红螺山南麓，是一座汉传佛教寺院，为中国北方的佛教圣地。
accessEn: About 4 km north of Huairou town, Huairou District, roughly 55 km north-north-east of central Beijing and about an hour by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黄花城水长城
summaryEn: A section of the Ming Great Wall at Xishuiyu in Jiuduhe town, where the wall runs down the hillsides into a reservoir so that parts of it lie under water, hence the name 'Lakeside' or 'Water' Great Wall. The walls guarded the Huanghuacheng garrison and its pass, built in the Yongle, Zhengde and Jiajing reigns; it is usually quieter than Mutianyu or Badaling, and a steep climb leads to watchtowers with views over the lake.
description: 黄花城长城是位于中华人民共和国北京市怀柔区九渡河镇黄花城村境内的明长城，长度为十几公里，共有敌台44座，城堡6座。元朝时此地有千户所，明朝时此地有参将驻守。黄花城长城的关口于永乐、正德和嘉靖年间修建。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Xishuiyu village in Jiuduhe town, Huairou District, about 60 km north of central Beijing, roughly 1.5 hours by road; Mutianyu is about 23 km to the east.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 戒台寺
summaryEn: A large Buddhist temple on the slopes of Ma'an Mountain in the Western Hills, known for its ordination altar, counted among the three great ordination platforms of Chinese Buddhism. The altar hall was first built under the Liao in 1069 and houses a three-tiered stone altar of the Ming; the courtyards are famous for old pines with names such as the 'Moving Pine', and Prince Gong lived here for about ten years after he was dismissed from office in 1884.
description: 戒台寺，又名戒坛寺，位于北京门头沟的马鞍山麓，与潭柘寺相距约为5公里山路。因在中国佛教历史上拥有规模宏大的戒台而著称于世。与杭州昭庆寺、泉州开元寺中的戒台并称中国三大戒台。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Yongding town, Mentougou District, about 27 km west of central Beijing, roughly 45 minutes by road; Tanzhe Temple is about 6 km further west.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 景山公园
summaryEn: The former imperial garden directly north of the Forbidden City, centred on an artificial hill piled up in the early Ming from earth dug out for the palace moat and canals. Five pavilions stand on its five peaks, and the central Wanchun Pavilion on the city's north–south axis gives the classic view over the palace roofs; the last Ming emperor, Chongzhen, hanged himself on the hill's eastern slope in 1644. Opened to the public in 1928, the park is part of the Beijing Central Axis World Heritage site inscribed in 2024.
description: 景山公园位于中华人民共和国北京市西城区的景山前街，西临北海，南与故宫神武门隔街相望，是元、明、清三代的御苑。公园坐落在明清北京城的中轴线上，公园中心的景山，曾是全城的制高点。在元、明、清三代，景山及其附属建筑不仅是一座供游赏的皇家园林，还具有习射、停灵、祭祖、官学、躬耕、戏曲、宗教等多重功能。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Jingshan Front Street, across the road from the north gate of the Forbidden City (Palace Museum), about 2 km north of Tiananmen Square.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 金海湖
summaryEn: A large reservoir in the hills of eastern Pinggu, formed by the Haizi dam built in 1959–1960 and enlarged until 1983, with hills on three sides. It hosted the rowing and canoeing events of the 1990 Asian Games, and today boats, speedboats and other water sports run from the shore, with a pagoda and viewpoints on the surrounding hills.
description: 金海湖位于北京。游览特色包括水库、古塔。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 15 km east of Pinggu town and some 85 km from central Beijing by road.

name: 居庸关
summaryEn: A Ming fortress pass in the Guangou valley north-west of Beijing, one of the 'three inner passes' that guarded the capital, where a walled garrison town with gated barbicans at both ends closes the valley and the Great Wall climbs steeply up the slopes on either side. Inside the pass stands the Cloud Platform, a white-marble base built in 1342–1345 for three Tibetan-style stupas, whose archway is carved with the Four Heavenly Kings and with Buddhist texts in six scripts: Sanskrit, Tibetan, Phags-pa, Uyghur, Tangut and Chinese.
description: 居庸关是明长城其中一座出名的关城，与附近的八达岭长城同为首都北京西北方的重要屏障，与倒马关和紫荆关合称“内三关”。居庸关也是太行八陉中军都陉的重要关隘，始建于秦代。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Nankou town, Changping District, about 50 km north-west of central Beijing beside the G6 Beijing–Tibet Expressway, roughly an hour by road; Badaling is about 10 km further up the valley.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙潭公园
summaryEn: A city park laid out around the eastern of the three Longtan lakes, dug in 1952 to drain marshy ground in south-east Beijing, and opened as Longtan Park in 1984. Its islands, bridges and pavilions are themed on the dragon, with spots such as a Dragon Gate and a Dragon Pavilion, and the grounds also hold a shrine to the late-Ming general Yuan Chonghuan. It is an everyday neighbourhood park rather than a historic site, handy for a stroll after the Temple of Heaven next door.
description: 龙潭公园，位于北京市东城区东南二环内，是一座以湖景为基础、以“龙”文化为主题的综合性城市公园。公园成立于1984年，总面积42.3公顷，其中水域面积19.47公顷，绿地面积12.99公顷；现属北京市一级公园。
accessEn: In south-eastern Dongcheng District just east of the Temple of Heaven, about 15 minutes' walk from Tiantan Dongmen station on Metro Line 5.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 明城墙遗址公园
summaryEn: The longest surviving stretch of Beijing's Ming-dynasty inner city wall, about 1.5 km of rampart running east from Chongwenmen, ends at the Southeast Corner Tower, completed in 1439 and described as the largest and oldest city-wall corner tower surviving in China. The double-roofed tower, pierced by 144 arrow windows, was badly damaged in 1900 and dismantled and rebuilt in 1981–83; you can climb up to it and onto a section of the wall top, while lawns and trees line the foot of the wall as an open park.
description: 北京明城墙遗址公园位于北京市东城区中部，是围绕明北京城城墙遗存而建立的公园。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Along the south side of Beijing railway station between Chongwenmen and the Second Ring Road; the corner tower is about 10 minutes' walk from Beijing Railway Station on Metro Line 2, and Chongwenmen station (Lines 2 and 5) is at the park's west end.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中国园林博物馆
summaryEn: China's first national museum devoted to gardens, opened in 2013 at the foot of Yingshan hill beside the Garden Expo Park, with galleries on the history, techniques and culture of Chinese garden-making. Indoor courts hold rebuilds of famous small gardens, among them Suzhou's Chang Yuan, Guangzhou's Yuyin Shanfang and Yangzhou's Pianshi Shanfang, and the outdoor gardens include a partial rebuild of Beijing's lost Banmu Yuan.
description: 中国园林博物馆，位于北京市丰台区射击场路15号，是中国首座以园林为主题的国家级博物馆。
accessEn: Next to the Beijing Garden Expo Park in Fengtai District, about 19 km west of Tiananmen. Closed on Mondays (except public holidays).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 紫竹院公园
summaryEn: Laid out from 1953 and named after the small Fuyin Zizhu Yuan temple inside it, Purple Bamboo Park covers about 47 hectares, a third of it water, with the Changhe River flowing through. Over ten thousand bamboo plants line its lakes, islands and bridges, making it a quiet place for a walk in north-west Beijing.
description: 紫竹院公园，位于中华人民共和国北京市海淀区紫竹院街道中关村南大街35号，是北京市的市属公园之一。
