accessEn: In Haidian District about 8 km north-west of Tiananmen, beside National Library station on metro Lines 4 and 9.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 十渡
summaryEn: A long valley where the Juma River has cut through the northern end of the Taihang Mountains, leaving limestone peaks and cliffs above the water; it is one of the largest karst landscapes in northern China and part of the Fangshan UNESCO Global Geopark. The name, 'Tenth Ferry', comes from the river crossings along the old road, and today the valley is a busy weekend resort with rafting, boating and other outdoor activities, while the river attracts wintering birds.
description: 房山十渡风景名胜区位于北京市房山区西南方，是中国北方唯一一处大规模喀斯特岩溶地貌。十渡风景区是中国国家AAA景区和中国国家地质公园。
accessEn: Around Shidu town in far south-western Fangshan District near the Hebei border, about 75 km south-west of central Beijing, roughly 2 hours by road; the Beijing–Yuanping railway also has a station at Shidu.
imageCredit: Peretz Partensky from San Francisco, USA
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 顺义奥林匹克水上公园
summaryEn: Built beside the Chaobai River for the rowing, canoeing and marathon swimming events of the 2008 Olympics, this venue is now a water-sports and leisure park. Visitors can try rowing and kayaking on the still-water course, go rafting on the slalom channel in summer, or use the waterside walking routes, camping lawn and children's play areas, and it suits active families.
description: 顺义奥林匹克水上公园位于中华人民共和国北京市顺义区马坡乡潮白河，占地面积约31850平方米，是2008年北京奥运中的赛艇、皮划艇赛事、游泳项目中的男女子马拉松游泳小项及随后的残疾奥运会中赛艇项目比赛场馆。
accessEn: In Mapo, Shunyi District, about 40 km north-east of Tiananmen and roughly an hour by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 陶然亭公园
summaryEn: A large lake park laid out in 1952 on old kiln land in the south of the city, named after the Taoran Pavilion, a hall built in 1695 by the kiln supervisor Jiang Zao inside the older Cibei Nunnery and a favourite gathering place of Qing scholars. Pavilions are scattered around three lakes and their islands, and the grounds also hold the graves of the lovers Gao Junyu and Shi Pingmei, whose story was retold in a book and a film.
description: 陶然亭公园，位于北京市西城区太平街19号，因园中的陶然亭而得名。
accessEn: In southern Xicheng District, north of Beijing South Railway Station and about 10 minutes' walk from Taoranting metro station. Cibei Nunnery, which holds the Taoran Pavilion, is usually closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 地坛
summaryEn: Built in 1530, the Temple of Earth is where Ming and Qing emperors made offerings to the earth at the summer solstice, the northern counterpart of the Temple of Heaven. Its centrepiece, the Square Water Altar, is a two-tier square platform ringed by a water channel, the square form standing for the earth, and the cypress-planted grounds around it became a public park in the 20th century, with a Spring Festival temple fair held here since the 1980s.
description: 地坛在中国北京安定门外，是明世宗以后明清两代皇帝每年夏至祭祀大地之神的地方，20世纪后逐渐开辟为公园。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Just north of the Second Ring Road at Andingmen, a few minutes' walk north of Yonghegong Lama Temple station on Metro Lines 2 and 5.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 丫髻山
summaryEn: A hill in Liujiadian town named after its two rocky summits, which resemble a girl's twin hair buns, and long a Taoist pilgrimage site whose temple fairs drew crowds from the capital and visits from Qing emperors. Its temple buildings were restored or rebuilt from the 2000s, and a stepped path climbs past steles and halls to the Bixia Yuanjun shrine and the Jade Emperor Pavilion on the two peaks.
description: 丫髻山，旧时正写作𩫾髻山，位于北京市平谷区刘家店镇北部，是一座道教名山。清朝曾在此建有𩫾髻山行宫。
accessEn: In Liujiadian town, Pinggu District, about 70 km north-east of central Beijing by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 雁栖湖
summaryEn: A reservoir in the hills north of Huairou town, built in 1959–1962, whose shores were developed into the conference area that hosted the 2014 APEC leaders' meeting and the first two Belt and Road Forums. A renovation removed the old lakeside amusement rides, and the lake is now an open waterfront park with boardwalks along the shore, stepped grass slopes and a large lawn on the east side used for events.
description: 北台上水库，又称雁栖湖，是位于北京市怀柔区北部北台上村的水库，拦截雁栖河，在1959-1962年建成。水库面积4.6平方公里，常年水面面积180万平方米，总库容3830万立方米。水深22-30米。
accessEn: In Yanqi town north of Huairou town, Huairou District, roughly 60 km north-north-east of central Beijing and about an hour by road. After a renovation the area reopened in autumn 2026 as an open lakeside park, with some parts still being finished.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 野鸭湖国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A national wetland park of reservoir shallows, rivers, reed beds and marsh on the south-western edge of Yanqing, the largest wetland in the Beijing area and part of a municipal nature reserve. Migrating and wintering water birds, among them cranes, storks and swans, make it a noted birdwatching site, named one of Beijing's ten best in 2015, and a wetland museum explains the ecosystem.
description: 野鸭湖国家湿地公园位于北京市延庆区西南部的延庆镇、康庄镇、张山营镇和延庆农场交界处，总面积283.4公顷，具有水库、河流、沼泽、季节性泛滥地等多种湿地类型，是北京地区湿地面积最大的湿地生态系统和北京唯一一家国家级湿地公园，具有重要的生态功能效益和保护价值，以及旅游、教育和科研价值。
accessEn: About 12 km south-west of Yanqing town and some 85 km north-west of central Beijing by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 银山塔林
summaryEn: A group of eighteen Buddhist pagodas in the hills of Yanshou town, the tomb pagodas of monks from temples that flourished below the dark cliffs of 'Iron Wall, Silver Mountain' from the Jin dynasty onwards. Five Jin brick pagodas with dense eaves stand together on the site of Fahua Temple, which Japanese troops destroyed in 1941, with a Yuan pagoda nearby and smaller Yuan and Ming stupas scattered on the slopes.
description: 银山塔林，位于中华人民共和国北京市昌平区延寿镇，是由6座密檐式佛塔、1座密檐式覆钵塔及11座覆钵式塔组成的佛塔群。该佛塔群建于金代至清代年间，是周边寺庙的僧人的墓塔。1941年，周边寺庙被日军全部拆毁，佛塔也受到严重损坏。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Yanshou town in northern Changping District, about 45 km north of central Beijing and 7 km beyond the Ming Tombs, roughly an hour by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 云居寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple at the foot of Shijing Shan ('Stone Sutra Mountain'), famous for the Buddhist scriptures that monks carved on thousands of stone slabs from the Sui dynasty to the Ming, begun by the monk Jingwan to protect the texts from destruction. The slabs were stored in nine caves on the mountain and in a vault below the temple; the halls were bombed in the 1940s and rebuilt from the 1980s, but several Tang and Liao pagodas survive, among them the Liao North Pagoda.
description: 房山云居寺，最初称西域寺，其全称为西域云居禅林，坐落于北京市房山区大石窝镇、白带山西南麓，距北京城区75公里。原有山麓的寺院建筑在中日战争期间已毁，仅存数座唐塔、辽塔，以及石经山上藏有石经的石经窟。1956年9月7日，河北省人民委员会将石经窟、云居寺北塔列入河北省第一批文物保护名单。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Near Shuitou village, Dashiwo town, in south-western Fangshan District, about 65 km south-west of central Beijing, roughly 1.5 hours by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 玉渊潭公园
summaryEn: The largest park inside Beijing's Third Ring Road, covering about 137 hectares, 61 of them water, between the ring road and the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse. The lake was created under the Qianlong Emperor in 1773 and revived as a public park from 1960, and its 25-hectare cherry garden is the focus of a cherry-blossom festival each spring.
description: 玉渊潭公园位于北京市海淀区，北靠白堆子、马神庙，南通军博、世纪坛，东临钓鱼台，西接西三环，占地100多公顷，是北京市三环以内最大的公园，国家AAAA级景区。园内以栽种的樱花最为著名，每年四月底五月初，公园均举办“樱花节”并引来大量游客前来参观。
accessEn: In Haidian District about 7 km west of Tiananmen, a short walk north of Military Museum metro station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中山公园
summaryEn: Just west of Tian'anmen, Zhongshan Park grew out of the Altar of Land and Grain (Shejitan), where Ming and Qing emperors made offerings to the gods of soil and harvest; its square marble altar is still spread with earth in five colours for the five directions. Opened to the public in 1914, the grounds were renamed in 1928 after Sun Yat-sen, whose coffin lay in the altar's hall in 1925, and also hold ancient cypresses, pavilions and a stone archway first raised for the German envoy Clemens von Ketteler, killed in 1900.
description: 北京中山公园位于北京市中心紫禁城南面，天安门西侧，于故宫一墙之隔。它原是明清两代的社稷坛，与太庙一起沿袭周代以来“左祖右社”的礼制建造。中山公园现占地23万平方米，是一座纪念性的古典坛庙园林。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Immediately south-west of the Forbidden City; take Metro Line 1 to Tian'anmen West and walk a few minutes east to the south gate on Chang'an Avenue.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 周恩来邓颖超纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial museum opened in 1998, the centenary of Zhou Enlai's birth, beside Tianjin Water Park, with exhibitions on the lives of Zhou Enlai and of Deng Yingchao, whose part in the women's movement has its own display. It also holds a full-size replica of Xihua Hall in Zhongnanhai, Beijing, with its fittings restored, and an Ilyushin Il-14 aircraft presented by the Soviet government for his use, now classed as a national second-grade cultural relic.
description: 周恩来邓颖超纪念馆坐落于中华人民共和国天津市南开区水上公园街道水上北路天津水上公园风景区内，占地6万平方米，建筑面积7千平方米。
accessEn: On the west side of Tianjin Water Park in Nankai District, about 6.3 km south-west of Tianjin Railway Station and by the Zhou-Deng Memorial station on Metro Line 3; closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 平津战役纪念馆
summaryEn: A national first-grade museum beside the Ziya River, opened in July 1997, on the Pingjin (Beiping–Tianjin) Campaign of 1948–49 in the Chinese civil war. Its galleries cover the campaign's decisions, its execution, civilian support and the people who fought, and the grounds hold a bayonet-shaped Victory Monument and a garden of retired military aircraft, a patrol boat and a missile.
description: 平津战役纪念馆，位于天津市红桥区平津道8号，是中华人民共和国为了纪念平津战役建立的纪念馆，为国家一级博物馆，由纪念广场、展厅、多维演示馆和军威园组成，占地面积4.7万平方米，建成面积12800平方米，馆名由聂荣臻题写。
accessEn: On Pingjin Road in Hongqiao District, about 6.4 km west-north-west of Tianjin Railway Station; closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大悲禅院
summaryEn: Tianjin's largest surviving Buddhist monastery, a working Chan temple founded in the mid-17th century, expanded in 1669 and extended with a large eastern compound in the 1940s. Its halls hold a Ming-dynasty bronze Shakyamuni, a hall of three Burmese jade Buddhas completed in 2000, and hundreds of older statues in stone, wood and bronze. A memorial hall to the monk Hongyi stands in the grounds.
description: 大悲禅院又名大悲院，是一座位于中国天津市河北区天纬路40号的佛教寺院，亦是天津市最大的佛教寺院，占地面积为4.2万平方米。大悲禅院始建于清朝顺治年间，几经修葺扩建，现包括大雄宝殿、天王殿、大悲殿、地藏殿等建筑。
accessEn: On Tianwei Road in Hebei District, about 2.6 km north-west of Tianjin Railway Station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 水上公园
summaryEn: Tianjin Water Park opened in 1951 on a marshy pool called Qinglongtan and is described as the largest comprehensive park in central Tianjin, laid out around lakes and islands linked by bridges. Its garden-within-a-garden sights include the Kobe Garden, a Japanese-style garden finished in 1989, and a Suzhou-style bonsai garden, and the park hosts large public events and festivals.
description: 天津水上公园，旧称青龙潭、南郊公园，位于中华人民共和国天津市南开区水上公园路，总面积164.57公顷，其中水域面积89.2公顷，是天津市中心城区内最大的综合性城市公园。天津水上公园所处地带，古时为天津老城厢八里台以南、绵延百里的卫南洼的一部分，地势低洼、水系密布。
accessEn: In Nankai District in the south-west of the city, about 6.8 km south-south-west of Tianjin Railway Station, with the Zhou Enlai and Deng Yingchao memorial on its west side.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天塔湖
summaryEn: The Tianjin Radio and Television Tower, completed in 1991, stands 415.2 metres tall in the middle of Tianta Lake in south-west Tianjin, with a parabolic shaft and a saucer-shaped pod near the top built to hold an observation hall and a revolving restaurant. The landscaped lake around it has a main plaza facing the east gate of Tianjin Water Park, and the tower is one of the 'Ten Views of Tianjin', 'Clouds Swirling Round the Tower'.
description: 天塔湖位于天津。游览特色包括湖泊、水上游乐、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At 1 Weijin South Road in Hexi District, about 5.6 km south-south-west of Tianjin Railway Station and next to Tianjin Water Park.

name: 狼牙山
summaryEn: A scenic mountain area in the Taihang range in the west of Yi County, known for the story of the 'Five Heroes of Mount Langya'. In the official account, five Eighth Route Army soldiers covering a withdrawal in September 1941 retreated to the summit ridge, Qipantuo, and went over a cliff rather than be captured. An exhibition hall about them stands near the entrance, and a memorial tower on Qipantuo marks the place.
description: 狼牙山旧名为郎山，位于河北省易县西部狼牙山镇附近，为河北当地的游览景点。狼牙山是因八路军五名勇士浴血抗击日寇舍身跳崖而出名的。
accessEn: In Langyashan town, about 36 km south-west of Yi County town; Baoding is the nearest large city, and a taxi or private car is the practical way.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 直隶总督署
summaryEn: The only complete provincial-level Qing government compound to survive in China, built in 1729 and used by successive viceroys of Zhili, the province around Beijing, until the end of the Qing. Five courtyards run along a central axis from the main gate through the ceremonial gate, main hall and second hall to the residential quarters. Seventy-four men held the post here over 99 terms, among them Zeng Guofan and Li Hongzhang, and the compound is now the Zhili Governor-General's Office Museum.
description: 直隶总督署，也称直隶总督部院，位于河北省保定市莲池区裕华路，明初为保定府衙，明永乐年间作为大宁都司署，清初作为参将署，清雍正八年(公元1730年)，直隶总督唐执玉方移直隶总督部院至明朝大宁都司故址。是直隶总督的办公场所，中国现存唯一完整的清代省级衙署。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the centre of Baoding's old city on Yuhua Road, within walking distance of the Ancient Lotus Pond and Daci Pavilion. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 永济桥
summaryEn: A long stone-arch bridge across the Juma River on the northern edge of Zhuozhou. The nine-arch main span was built in 1760 next to an earlier bridge begun in 1574, and long approach causeways with small culverts bring the whole structure to over 600 metres; its balustrades are carved with vases and lotus leaves. The bridge was repaired between 2008 and 2012 and now forms part of a riverside scenic area.
description: 涿州永济桥位于中国河北省保定市涿州市北关村，南北横跨拒马河，是一座九孔石桥，全长660米。始建于明万历二年，原名“巨马河桥”，现存桥梁建成于清乾隆二十五年，由乾隆皇帝题写桥名“永济桥”。2006年5月25日公布为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the northern edge of Zhuozhou, about 2–3 km north of the town centre, a short taxi ride away.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 丛台公园
summaryEn: A city park in the middle of Handan, first planned in 1939 to protect the Wuling Congtai, a terraced tower traditionally linked to King Wuling of Zhao in the Warring States period. The three-storey tower, about 26 m high, dates from the Qing dynasty and has been restored since; it stands beside a lake in grounds of roughly 25 hectares that also hold a plum garden and a shrine to seven sages, with a stele carved with a poem written by Guo Moruo in 1961 outside the main gate. It is a convenient stop for anyone interested in Handan's history as the Zhao state's capital.
description: 丛台公园位于中国河北省邯郸市中华大街中段西侧，是邯郸市以古赵历史遗址为主题开辟的一座大型历史文化公园，中国国家重点公园之一，AAAA级旅游景区。
accessEn: On the west side of Zhonghua Street in the centre of Handan, within the built-up area of the city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 晋冀鲁豫烈士陵园
summaryEn: A memorial cemetery and museum in southern Handan, inaugurated in October 1950 with the reburial of General Zuo Quan and other soldiers of the Jin-Ji-Lu-Yu border region, and described as the first martyrs' cemetery built after the founding of the People's Republic. Zuo Quan's tomb, with an inscription by Zhou Enlai, stands in the grounds, and the cemetery is noted for the many inscriptions by senior Communist leaders. The site now also operates as the Jin-Ji-Lu-Yu Revolutionary Memorial Museum, whose collection runs to more than 21,000 items.
description: 晋冀鲁豫烈士陵园位于河北省邯郸市，是中华人民共和国成立后修建的首个烈士陵园，也是老一辈无产阶级革命家题词和碑文最多的烈士陵园。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Lingyuan Road in southern Handan, about 1 km east of Handan railway station and about 2 km south of Congtai Park.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 华北军区烈士陵园
summaryEn: A memorial cemetery and park of about 21 ha in Shijiazhuang, opened in 1954 to commemorate people who died in the revolutionary wars in North China. Its graves include those of the Canadian doctor Norman Bethune and the Indian doctor Dwarkanath Kotnis, who both worked with the Communist-led armies, and its grounds hold a monument, bronze statues of named martyrs, a memorial hall on the North China revolutionary war and a memorial hall for the Bethune–India medical team. It is a state-designated patriotic-education and red-tourism site.
description: 华北军区烈士陵园位于中国河北省石家庄市桥西区中山西路343号，是中华人民共和国国务院首批全国重点烈士纪念建筑物保护单位，中共中央宣传部“全国爱国主义教育示范基地”，中共中央宣传部等七部委“全国百家红色旅游经典景区”，中华人民共和国教育部、中华人民共和国民政部等六部委“全国中小学爱国主义教育基地”，亦是国家级国防教育示范基地。
accessEn: On Zhongshan West Road in Qiaoxi District, in the city's urban area about 5 km west of central Shijiazhuang. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 荣国府
summaryEn: A full-size replica of the Rong family mansion from the novel Dream of the Red Chamber, built in Zhengding between 1984 and 1986 as the set for the 1987 television adaptation and kept open afterwards as an attraction. The courtyard houses, with 212 rooms in three axes of five courtyards each, are furnished in Ming and Qing style, and Ningrong Street beside them is a 200 m street of 51 shop-fronts built in Qing style. It is a film set rather than a historic building, and suits fans of the novel or the series.
description: 荣国府位于河北省正定县兴荣路，为仿古建筑。始建于1984年8月，1986年7月20日落成。是为了拍摄1987年中国电视剧制作中心电视剧《红楼梦》而兴建的，根据《红楼梦》书中描绘的“金门玉户神仙府，桂殿兰宫妃子家”和清代木结构建筑通行规范建造。
accessEn: In the old town of Zhengding, about 13 km north-north-east of central Shijiazhuang and about 500 m north-west of Longxing Temple, within walking distance of it.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大境门
summaryEn: A gate in the Great Wall on the northern edge of Zhangjiakou, built in 1644, through which the road to Mongolia once passed; the trade market that grew up outside it made Zhangjiakou a major caravan town. The gateway is about 12 m high and carries a 1927 inscription reading 'Magnificent Rivers and Mountains', with a stretch of wall running up the hills to the west. It is often counted with Shanhaiguan, Jiayuguan and Juyongguan as one of the Great Wall's four great passes.
description: 大境门位于中国河北省张家口市桥西区，是明长城的一个重要关口。大境门与山海关、嘉峪关、居庸关并称为长城四大关口，并是四大关口中唯一以“门”命名的关口。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the northern edge of Zhangjiakou, about 3 km north-north-east of the city centre, a short taxi or bus ride from the city centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 官厅水库国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A very large wetland park on the shores of Guanting Reservoir, a 1950s reservoir on the Yongding River that straddles the Hebei–Beijing border. The park covers about 13,500 hectares of river, floodplain, reservoir, fish-pond and rice-paddy wetland, with a boardwalk out into the wetland and a wetland museum. It is a quiet outdoor stop for open water views rather than a monument.
description: 官厅水库位于北京市与河北省交界处，大部分位于河北省张家口市怀来县境内，小部分位于北京市延庆区。官厅水库因大坝修建在官厅镇附近而得名，是1949年后中华人民共和国建设的第一座大型水库。
accessEn: In Huailai County, about 13 km south-east of Shacheng town on the reservoir's northern shore, and roughly 84 km south-east of Zhangjiakou city; a private car or taxi is the practical way.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鸡鸣山
summaryEn: An isolated peak of about 1,100 m on the east side of Xiahuayuan, nicknamed the 'flying peak' because it stands alone above the Yang River valley, within a scenic area of about 17.5 sq km. A stepped path climbs past rebuilt Buddhist and folk temples, including the 33 m Linji Light Pagoda and the Liao-founded Yongning Temple, to the summit, where a 20 m stone footbridge across a cliff is a provincial heritage site. Its temple fair in the fourth lunar month draws worshippers and visitors.
description: 张家口鸡鸣山，位于张家口市下花园区以东2公里处，京包铁路、110国道从其脚下经过，占地17.5平方公里，海拔1128.9米，是塞外著名的孤山，有飞来峰的美称。自古以来是文化名山，原有庙宇112间，最早的庙宇始建于公元前231年，后全部毁于文革期间。
accessEn: On the eastern edge of Xiahuayuan District, about 4 km south of Xiahuayuan North high-speed station and 26 km south-east of Xuanhua, with the old Beijing–Baotou railway and the G110 road passing at its foot.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 泥河湾遗址
summaryEn: A basin in the Sanggan River valley where more than 80 early-human sites have been found, among them some of the oldest known traces of people in East Asia, with stone tools more than 1.5 million years old. The national archaeological park is centred on the Xiaochangliang site and has a research centre, protective sheds over key excavations such as Majuangou, and a visitor centre. The setting is eroded lake-bed cliffs and farmland rather than a monument, so it suits visitors with a particular interest in human origins.
description: 泥河湾遗址又称泥河湾遗址群，位于中国河北省张家口市阳原县境内东部地区的桑干河流域，内有多处旧石器时代遗址。从1970年代开始，在阳原东西长82公里、南北宽27公里的广大区域内，陆续发现早期人类遗址共80多处。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Datianwa township, eastern Yangyuan County, about 14 km east of Dongcheng town and roughly 70 km south-south-west of Zhangjiakou city; a private car or taxi is the practical way.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 小五台金河景区
summaryEn: A forested river valley below the Xiaowutai peaks, whose East Terrace, at 2,882 m, is the highest point in Hebei. Part of the Jinhekou area belongs to the mountain's protected wildlife zone, home to species such as the black stork and the brown eared pheasant, and the valley holds the Jinhe Temple and Xuankong'an pagoda groups, nationally listed clusters of Yuan-to-Ming pagodas. It is a place for walking and nature-watching rather than sightseeing.
description: 小五台山，古称倒刺山。位于中国华北平原西北部，河北省张家口市境内，位于蔚县、涿鹿县交界处。是冀北山地的组成部分。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the Jinhekou valley, Changning township, about 36 km east-north-east of Yuxian old town, reached by road; Yuxian is about 105 km south-south-west of Zhangjiakou railway station. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 元中都遗址
summaryEn: The earthen remains of Yuan Zhongdu, the 'Middle Capital' that Emperor Wuzong began building on the grassland north of Zhangbei in 1307; work was halted in 1311 and the palace was burned in 1358 during the Red Turban uprising. Three nested walled enclosures can be traced on the ground as earthen walls and banks, with the foundations of the palace city's south gate, the I-shaped platform of the main hall and an excavated corner-tower platform. The Yuan Zhongdu Museum, in Zhangbei town about 15 km away, shows the finds and the story of the excavations.
description: 元中都遗址位于今中华人民共和国河北省张家口市张北县馒头营乡白城子村，元朝大德十一年建。元中都是继和林、上都、大都后元朝兴建的第四个都城。遗址原称“白城子”。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 18 km north-north-west of Zhangbei town on open grassland, and roughly 57 km north-north-west of Zhangjiakou city; a taxi or private car from Zhangbei is the practical way.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 蔚州博物馆
summaryEn: Yuxian's county museum, ranked a national second-grade museum, which moved in 2016 from Shijia Temple into a purpose-built building of about 13,000 sq m. Its main exhibition, 'Daiwei Changge' ('A Long Song of Dai and Yu'), follows the area from prehistory through the ancient state of Dai, the Sui–Tang and Liao–Yuan periods and the Ming–Qing fortified villages, and was named one of China's ten best museum exhibitions of 2016. A second exhibition is devoted to Yuxian paper-cutting, a nationally listed intangible heritage craft, and the collection of about 11,000 items includes a Western Han painted bronze goose-and-fish lamp.
description: 蔚州博物馆，即蔚县博物馆，位于中华人民共和国河北省张家口市蔚县蔚州镇通元路，是一个综合地志博物馆，也是国家二级博物馆。蔚州博物馆成立于1958年，早期选址于清代四合院，后迁入释迦寺，2016年从释迦寺迁至通元路新馆。
accessEn: On Tongyuan Road in the south-east of Yuxian town, about 4 km south-east of the walled old town; Yuxian is about 105 km south-south-west of Zhangjiakou railway station, reached by road. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 八路军太行纪念馆
summaryEn: A national first-class museum on the Eighth Route Army's war of resistance against Japan, opened in 1988 at the foot of Phoenix Hill in Wuxiang and enlarged in 2005. The main exhibition runs for 1,450 m and shows more than 1,000 items and over 600 photographs and charts; the grounds also hold a panorama hall on the Hundred Regiments Offensive, a stele park and a 19.37 m monument on the hilltop. It suits visitors interested in the wartime Taihang base area, and it adjoins the Eighth Route Army Cultural Park.
description: 八路军太行纪念馆，位于山西省长治市武乡县太行街363号，1988年9月3日落成并对外开放，为中华人民共和国国家一级博物馆。纪念馆主要展示八路军与华北各根据地在抗日战争时的数次战斗与根据地建设等内容。馆名由邓小平于1979年题写。
accessEn: It stands in Wuxiang town, next to the Eighth Route Army Cultural Park and about 2.5 km from the Wuxiang exit of the Taiyuan–Changzhi expressway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 华严寺
summaryEn: A large Buddhist temple in the west of Datong's old city, founded in 1038 as a royal temple of the Liao dynasty and divided into an upper and a lower temple under the Ming. The upper temple's main hall, rebuilt in 1140 under the Jin, is among the largest surviving ancient Buddhist halls in China, and the lower temple's Bhagavan Hall still holds 29 Liao-dynasty painted statues. Among them is a smiling bodhisattva with clasped hands, nicknamed the 'Oriental Venus'.
description: 华严寺位于中国山西省大同市清远门内的清远街南侧，下寺坡街459号，东临华严寺广场及华严街，因佛教华严宗而得名，寺内有辽代的薄伽教藏殿和金代的大雄宝殿以及诸多彩塑，具有极高的文物价值和艺术价值，1961年被列为第一批全国重点文物保护单位，是中国仅存的三大辽代寺院之一。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Just inside the west gate (Qingyuan Gate) of Datong's old walled city, on the south side of Qingyuan Street.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 善化寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple just inside the south gate of Datong's old city, popularly known as the South Temple, which keeps buildings from both the Liao and Jin dynasties. Its Daxiongbao Hall dates from the Liao and is one of the largest surviving halls of its type in China; it holds Jin-dynasty clay statues of the Five Tathagatas and the Twenty-four Devas. The gate building and the Sansheng Hall are of the Jin, and a glazed five-dragon screen wall moved here in 1980 from the former Xingguo Temple stands in front of the gate.
description: 善化寺，俗称南寺，是山西省大同市古城内的一所佛寺，位于永泰门内西侧，平城区南寺街6号，东侧靠近永泰街，西近楼房巷，北临教场街，内有一座辽代木构和三座金代木构建筑，具有极高的文物价值，1961年被列为第一批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Just inside the south gate of Datong's old walled city, in the centre of the city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 海会寺
summaryEn: Haihui Temple, at the foot of Dongfan Mountain, is known for its pair of brick pagodas: an early-10th-century pagoda that leans to the west and a Ming pagoda of 1565 with a glazed-tile balcony on its tenth level. Around them are the temple halls, springs and pools, among them the 'Haihui Longqiu' water view, and the site of Haihui Academy, where 68 of the 123 jinshi graduates recorded for Yangcheng studied in Ming and Qing times. The temple has been a national heritage site since 2006.
description: 海会寺位于中国山西省阳城县北留镇大桥村，依山傍水，2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It is in Daqiao village, Beiliu town, about 13 km east of Yangcheng and about 2 km from the Tianguan Wang Mansion.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 常家庄园
summaryEn: The fortified manor of the Chang family, Qing-dynasty merchants who traded tea to Russia, in Chewang village south-west of Yuci. A stone-paved street runs through it past restored courtyard houses, a family temple, the Shiyunxuan study with carved stone tablets, and a large landscaped garden known as Jingyuan. Carved stone and brick, such as the Fish Leaps the Dragon Gate relief at the west gate, reward a slow visit.
description: 常家庄园，位于山西省晋中市榆次区东阳镇车辋村，是一座规模宏大的清代北方民间建筑群。清代山西晋商常氏家族在自己的故乡车辋村进行了大规模的宅院建设。经过200余年的陆续修建，堡墙八道堡门的环围下，建起南北、东西两条大街，庄园共占地一百余亩。
accessEn: In Chewang village, Dongyang town, about 19 km south-west of central Yuci.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大寨
summaryEn: A village in the Taihang foothills that was promoted nationwide in the 1960s and 1970s as a national model for agricultural production, under the slogan "In agriculture, learn from Dazhai". The scenic area takes in the former Dazhai People's Commune buildings (a national heritage unit dated 1966), the Dazhai Exhibition Hall and a cultural exhibition hall, and a walking route up Hutou Mountain. It suits visitors interested in the history of China's rural collectivisation.
description: 大寨村位于山西省晋中市昔阳县大寨镇，地处太行山麓。大寨的名称是因为北宋时，宋军在此驻兵抗击辽兵，因此得名。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Dazhai town, about 5 km south of Xiyang.
imageCredit: The original uploader was Ran at English Wikipedia.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 镇国寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple in Haodong village, listed with Pingyao Ancient City and Shuanglin Temple as part of the 1997 World Heritage site. Its Ten Thousand Buddha Hall, dated by an inscription to 963 under the Northern Han, is one of the oldest surviving timber halls in China and is known for its large bracket sets, and it holds eleven painted clay figures of the same period. The walled complex has two courtyards, with the Tianwang Hall as its gate and a Qing-dynasty Sanfo Hall at the back.
description: 镇国寺是一座中国佛教寺庙，位于山西省平遥县城东北15千米的襄垣乡郝洞村，被联合国教科文组织与平遥古城一同列为世界文化遗产。该寺始建于五代北汉时期，原名京城寺，明朝嘉靖年间改名为镇国寺，延用至今。镇国寺总占地面积1万多平方米，建筑面积5000余平方米，现存山门及左右钟鼓二楼、万佛殿、东西配殿、三佛楼等建筑。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Haodong village, about 13 km north-east of Pingyao.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 柏山东岳庙
summaryEn: A large temple to the Lord of Mount Tai (Dongyue) on wooded Baishan hill east of Pu county town, with roots in the Tang and rebuilt in 1316–18 after the 1303 Pingyang earthquake. It covers about 20,000 sq m in several groups, among them the Dongyue palace, a Hell hall and the Huaqing pool; only the palace's main hall is Yuan, five bays wide and deep under a double-eave hip-gable roof, and the rest is Ming and Qing. The temple appears on a national rural-tourism route for Linfen promoted in 2024, alongside Xiaoxitian and the Guangsheng area.
description: 柏山东岳庙位于中国山西省临汾市蒲县城东的柏山，2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。柏山东岳庙始建年代不详，早在唐代即初具规模，元大德七年因平阳地震被毁，延祐三年至五年重修。庙坐北朝南，占地2万平方米，由东岳行宫、地狱、华清池、太蔚庙五部分组成。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It is on Baishan hill, about 3 km south-east of Pu county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 北武当山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in Fangshan county, in the Lüliang range, which is a national-level scenic area and one of northern China's Daoist holy mountains. The county government gives its area as 88 sq km, of which fewer than 20 sq km are open, with 72 peaks, 36 cliffs and 24 ravines; visitors climb a stepped path of about 1,455 steps past ancient pines and rock formations to the temples on the summit, and there are also 5.5 km of wooden walkways. A temple fair is held in the first days of the third lunar month.
description: 北武当山位于中国山西省吕梁市方山县境内，吕梁山脉中段，又名真武山，古称龙王山，景区规划面积80平方公里，由72峰、36崖、24涧组成，主峰香炉峰，海拔1985米。素有“三晋第一名山”之称，为山西道教圣地之一，1994年入国家级风景名胜区。
accessEn: It is in the mountains about 16 km south-east of Fangshan county town and, according to the county government, about 33 km from Lüliang railway station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 崇福寺
summaryEn: A large Buddhist monastery in the middle of Shuozhou, founded in the Tang dynasty and best known for its two Jin-dynasty halls, the Mituo Hall of 1143 and the Guanyin Hall. The Mituo Hall keeps its Jin glazed roof tiles and wall paintings, and the other halls line the central axis, from the entrance hall and the bell and drum towers through the Thousand Buddha Pavilion to the main hall. Visitor numbers rose after the 2024 video game Black Myth: Wukong brought attention to the monastery.
description: 朔州崇福寺，也称林衙寺、崇福禅寺，位于山西朔州城区东大街，净土宗寺庙。全国重点文物保护单位。该寺始建于唐朝唐高宗麟德二年，原名林衙寺，金天德年间称崇福禅寺。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the middle of Shuozhou city, on East Street.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中国煤炭博物馆
summaryEn: A national first-grade museum on the history of coal, opened in 1989 on the western side of Taiyuan. Its Coal Sea Exploration area has seven themed halls on how coal forms and how it has been mined and used, a four-dimensional cinema and a full-scale simulated mine where visitors wear miners' helmets and try out mining equipment. It suits families and anyone curious about Shanxi's coal industry.
description: 中国煤炭博物馆，1989年10月1日建成开馆，位于中华人民共和国山西省太原市万柏林区迎泽大街和晋祠路交汇处，为中国国家一级博物馆。煤炭博物馆分东西两院。东院是博物馆的主体，主要介绍中国煤炭分布以及煤炭自然形成机制等；西院曾长期作为太原理工大学千峰校区，供太原理工大学现代科技学院使用。
accessEn: In Wanbailin district at the western end of Yingze Avenue, about 2 km south-west of central Taiyuan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 蒙山大佛
summaryEn: A giant seated Buddha carved into a cliff on Mount Meng from 551 under the Northern Qi, which Taiyuan's heritage pages describe as the largest cliff Buddha of the Northern Dynasties period. The head was lost and the body was found buried in rubble in 1980; a new head 12 m high was added in the 2000s, and the whole figure now stands about 38 m high. The scenic area also has the ruins of Kaihua Temple, two small Song-dynasty brick pagodas known as the Lianli Pagodas and an iron Buddha of the late Sui or early Tang.
description: 蒙山大佛，也称晋阳西山大佛，是一尊位于山西省太原市晋源区罗城街道寺底村西北的蒙山中的摩崖大佛，现为太原市文物保护单位。蒙山大佛开凿于北齐天保年间，本是蒙山开化寺后的摩崖佛像。唐高祖李渊、唐高宗李治与皇后武则天、后唐武皇帝李克用、后汉高祖刘知远都曾来此礼佛。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Mount Meng, about 8 km north of Jinci and about 13 km south-west of central Taiyuan.
imageCredit: YOTTKP_cultural_trip.jpg: Dereklamnc1104 derivative work: 如沐西风
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 阎家大院
summaryEn: A large courtyard compound built from 1913 to 1937 in his home town of Hebian by Yan Xishan, who controlled Shanxi's government and army from 1911 until 1949. The museum's own website counts 27 courtyards and nearly 1,000 rooms, over 700 of them still standing, including the multi-storey Deyi Lou. It has been open as the Hebian Folk Museum since 1989, and the compound was listed as a provincial monument in 1986 and as a national one in 2013.
description: 阎锡山旧居又称阎家大院，位于山西省忻州市定襄县河边镇。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Hebian town, about 17 km north-east of Dingxiang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 娘子关
summaryEn: A Ming-dynasty fortified pass on the Shanxi–Hebei border, known as the ninth pass of the Great Wall, where the railway and road cross the Taihang Mountains; the present walls date from 1542. Visitors climb the walled pass and its gate towers, and the scenic area also takes in sections of Great Wall, a waterfall and an old village in the valley. In legend the Tang princess Pingyang garrisoned the pass with a force of women, which gave it the name 'Ladies' Pass'.
description: 娘子关为中国万里长城的一个关隘，位于太行山脉西侧河北省石家庄市井陉县西口，山西省阳泉市平定县东北的绵山山麓。娘子关原名“苇泽关”，因唐平阳公主曾率兵驻守于此，平阳公主的部队当时人称“娘子军”，故得今名。
accessEn: On the Hebei border about 30 km north-east of Pingding, with the Shijiazhuang–Taiyuan railway and a road running through the pass.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 万荣后土祠
summaryEn: This is the successor to the Han-dynasty shrine where emperors came to sacrifice to Houtu, goddess of the earth: Emperor Wu of Han made it the imperial site for the rite in the second century BC, and Tang and Song emperors also made offerings here. After Yellow River floods and shifts in its course the temple was moved more than once and settled on its present site in 1870; it covers about 25,000 square metres, with a Yuan-dynasty gate that doubles as a stage, an offering hall and main hall of the late Qing, and the Qiufeng Tower, a Ming-dynasty three-storey tower about 33 m high at the rear of the main axis. A ceremony honouring Houtu has been held here every year since 2003.
description: 汾阴后土祠俗称后土祠，因所在地今亦称万荣后土祠，位于今中国山西省运城市万荣县荣河镇庙前村，汾河南岸、黄河东岸，1996年被列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。汾阴后土祠为汉武帝所确立的皇帝祭地的本庙，汉、唐、宋多位皇帝曾在此亲祀后土。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It stands in Miaoqian village beside the Yellow River, about 35 km west of Wanrong.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 普救寺
summaryEn: Pujiu Temple is the setting of the love story in The Story of the Western Wing, in which the scholar Zhang Sheng and Cui Yingying meet, and its brick pagoda is nicknamed the Yingying Pagoda after the heroine. The temple is recorded from the Sui dynasty at the latest, was destroyed by fire in 1920 and left only the Ming-dynasty pagoda and three cave shrines, and its main buildings were restored from 1986. The Yongji culture and tourism bureau counts the pagoda among China's four famous ancient echo structures, with a toad-like croak heard from around its base.
description: 普救寺是指中国山西省永济市蒲州古城遗址附近的一座寺庙建筑。它因《西厢记》而名声鹊起。关于普救寺的最早文字记载是在隋代，但其具体建造年代已不可考，现在的普救寺主体建筑是1986年以后修复的。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It is in Puzhou town on the old Yellow River crossing, about 10 km west of Yongji and about 70 km by road west-south-west of central Yuncheng, close to the Stork Tower and the Tang-dynasty iron oxen.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鹳雀楼
summaryEn: The Stork Tower is a modern reconstruction of a tower on the Yellow River bank made famous by a short poem of the Tang poet Wang Zhihuan, and it is counted as one of China's Four Great Towers. The original was a Northern Zhou military watchtower that was destroyed in the wars of the early 13th century; the present 73.9 m tower, built in Tang style on a steel and concrete frame, was finished in 2002. Its six interior floors carry exhibits on the history and culture of Puzhou, and the surrounding scenic area covers about 2 sq km.
description: 鹳雀楼，又名鹳鹊楼，因时有鹳雀栖其上而得名。楼阁位于中国山西省运城市永济市蒲州镇，是中国著名的古代楼阁之一，与黄鹤楼、岳阳楼、滕王阁被并称为中国古代四大历史文化名楼，也是四大名楼中唯一一座位于黄河以北的楼阁。
accessEn: It stands on the Yellow River bank at the western edge of the old Puzhou city, about 16 km west of Yongji and about 75 km by road west-south-west of central Yuncheng.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 美岱召
summaryEn: Meidaizhao is a walled monastery in Tumed Right Banner that began as a fortified town built by the Tumed Mongol leader Altan Khan in the 16th century and later became a Gelug-school Tibetan Buddhist temple. Earth walls faced with stone, about 5 metres high, enclose halls of the Ming period, and the murals, about 1,650 square metres in all, include scenes from the Buddha's life and a group of Mongol donor figures. It suits visitors interested in Mongol history and Buddhist art.
description: 美岱召，原来汉名“灵觉寺”，清代赐名“寿灵寺”，位于中国内蒙古自治区包头市土默特右旗，是一座藏传佛教格鲁派寺院，1996年被列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。美岱召是呼和浩特地区的“八小召”之一。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Meidaizhao town, about 16 km east-north-east of Salaqi, the Tumed Right Banner seat, and about 73 km east of the centre of Baotou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 乌梁素海
summaryEn: Wuliangsuhai, or Ulansuhai Nur, is a shallow freshwater lake on the north bank of the Yellow River in Urad Front Banner, formed from an old river channel and fed mainly by drainage from the Hetao irrigation district. Reed beds cover much of it, and it is a stopover for more than 120 species of bird, among them whooper swans and spot-billed pelicans, as well as an important freshwater fishery. The ecotourism area is in Erdenburag sumu on the lake's south-western side.
description: 乌梁素海位于内蒙古巴彦淖尔。游览特色包括湖泊、灌溉工程。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The pin marks the tourist wharf on the south-western shore, about 7 km west-south-west of the lakeside town of Erdenburag and about 15 km north-east of Wulashan, the Urad Front Banner seat.

name: 将军衙署
summaryEn: The Suiyuan General's Yamen was the office of the Qing general who commanded the Manchu banner garrison of Suiyuan, the walled 'new city' built beside Guihua (old Hohhot) between 1735 and 1739. Founded in 1737, its three courtyard routes now hold a restored display of the general's office, a Republic-era section and galleries on the history of Suiyuan and Hohhot. About 700 m of the Qing city wall survives at the former city's north-east corner, a few hundred metres from the yamen.
description: 将军衙署位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、国家一级博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It is on Xinhua Street in Xincheng District, in the old Suiyuan quarter of Hohhot; the museum is closed on Mondays.

name: 昭君墓
summaryEn: A 33 m rammed-earth mound on the south bank of the Dahei River is the traditional tomb of Wang Zhaojun, the Han-dynasty woman who married a Xiongnu ruler; her actual burial place is not recorded. A processional path of about 400 m lined with stone figures leads from the Zhaojun Museum to the mound, which has pavilions on its upper terrace and summit. The museum's halls cover Han-Xiongnu marriage alliances and include one called the Chanyu's Great Tent, and the mound has been restored several times since the 1960s.
description: 昭君墓，又称青冢，位于内蒙古自治区呼和浩特市玉泉区南郊大黑河南岸，是王昭君的墓葬。蒙古语称“特木尔乌尔虎”，意为“铁垒”；相传秋季附近草木皆枯黄，唯昭君墓草色青翠，故又称“青冢”。除呼和浩特的昭君墓外，根据地方文献及民间传说，在内蒙古、山西、山东、河北等地另有十余处昭君墓。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It stands on the south bank of the Dahei River in Yuquan District, in Hohhot's southern suburbs; the museum is closed on Tuesdays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 呼伦湖
summaryEn: Hulun Lake, also called Dalai Lake, is the largest lake in Inner Mongolia and one of the largest freshwater lakes in China, covering about 2,300 sq km at the western end of the Hulunbuir grassland. Its shores are low and open, fringed with reed beds and wetland that form a protected nature reserve, and the lake is frozen from early November until early May. The lake is shared by Xin Barag Right Banner, Xin Barag Left Banner and Zhalainur District.
description: 呼伦湖位于内蒙古呼伦贝尔。游览特色包括湿地、草原、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The lake's north shore, nearest Zhalainur District, lies about 30 km south-south-east of Manzhouli, which has an airport and a railway station.

name: 玉佛苑
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple complex on the west slope of Jade Buddha Hill in Anshan, opened in 1996 and built around a hall about 33 m high that houses a statue carved from a single block of Xiuyan jade weighing 260.76 tonnes, with Shakyamuni on the front and Guanyin crossing the sea on the back. Its buildings include a Heavenly Kings hall, bell and drum towers and a jade-belt bridge, and the complex was enlarged and reopened in 2006. In 2015 the site was approved as a place of Buddhist worship and renamed Jade Buddha Temple, so it is a working temple as well as a sight.
description: 玉佛寺，原名玉佛苑，位于辽宁省鞍山市玉佛山风景区，占地面积约为10万平方米。玉佛苑所在的玉佛山，是一处集自然风光和人文胜迹于一体的城市公园，登临山顶可俯瞰钢都美景。
accessEn: On Jade Buddha Hill in Anshan's Tiedong district, about 3 km east-south-east of Anshan railway station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 关门山森林公园
summaryEn: Guanmenshan is a forested valley in Benxi Manchu Autonomous County, named for two facing peaks that look like a gate, and is known above all for its autumn maples. The park is divided into five zones, including Longmen Gorge and Mingcui Valley, and the provincial tourism page counts 108 sights. Remains of camps used by anti-Japanese guerrilla forces, including barracks and hidden storerooms, are scattered through the park.
description: 关门山位于本溪满族自治县境内，距本溪市区48公里，因双峰对峙，一阔一窄，一大一小，其状如门，故称关门山。关门山以秋天的枫叶出名。本溪关门山国家森林公园是国家4A级景区。
accessEn: In Benxi Manchu Autonomous County, about 37 km east-south-east of central Benxi in a straight line (about 51 km by road, under an hour).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大黑山
summaryEn: A 663-metre mountain and forest park in Jinzhou, with Buddhist and Taoist temples and rock canyons, and azaleas that bloom on the slopes in mid-April. Along the ridges runs Beisha Fortress, a ruined Goguryeo hill fort of about 5 km, whose west gate, Guanmenzhai, stands at the canyon entrance. The fortress is a national heritage site and one of the scenic area's main sights.
description: 大黑山是中国辽宁省大连市金州区的一座山峰。又名大赫山、大和尚山，海拔663米，是辽东半岛南部最高峰。位于金州城区以东5公里，距大连市区25公里。
accessEn: In Jinzhou District, about 23 km north-north-east of central Dalian in a straight line.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大连博物馆
summaryEn: Dalian's city museum stands beside Xinghai Square and opened in 2002. Its permanent exhibition, 'Modern Dalian', covers the city's history from 1840 to 1949 in seven sections, from naval defence and the 1894–95 war through Russian and Japanese rule to the establishment of people's government in 1949. Other halls hold changing exhibitions of art and antiquities borrowed from Chinese and foreign museums.
description: 大连博物馆位于中华人民共和国辽宁省大连市沙河口区星海湾街道会展路10号，是大连市属综合性博物馆。
accessEn: On Huizhan Road on the north-west side of Xinghai Square in Shahekou district, about 6 km south-west of Zhongshan Square (straight line); closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大连自然博物馆
summaryEn: The museum, on the Heishijiao shore, covers geology, palaeontology, zoology and botany in 12 halls, among them earth sciences, dinosaurs, marine life, north-eastern forest animals, wetlands, biodiversity and western Liaoning fossils. It holds about 200,000 specimens, and its grounds include a 270,000-square-metre area of sea. Its predecessor dates from 1907 and the present building opened in 1998.
description: 大连自然博物馆位于中华人民共和国辽宁省大连市沙河口区黑石礁西村街40号，是一座集地质、古生物、动物、植物标本收藏、研究、展示于一体的综合性自然科学博物馆，其前身始建于1907年。新馆为现代欧式建筑，建筑面积1.5万平方米，展览面积1万平方米，是国内唯一拥有27万平方米海域的博物馆。
accessEn: On the Heishijiao shore in Shahekou district, about 9 km south-west of Zhongshan Square (straight line); closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 旅顺日俄监狱旧址博物馆
summaryEn: Built by Russia from 1902 and enlarged by Japan from 1907, this former prison in Lüshun held mainly activists from Manchuria and Korea until 1945, and it opened as a museum in 1971. Inside a perimeter wall about 725 m long, visitors see the brick cell blocks, an interrogation room, an execution room and the former prison workshops. Two exhibition rooms cover the Korean independence activist An Jung-geun, who was held here in 1909–10 after killing the Japanese statesman Itō Hirobumi at Harbin station and was executed in March 1910.
description: 旅顺监狱旧址，位于辽宁省大连市旅顺口区市区北部，现为“旅顺日俄监狱旧址博物馆”，是俄罗斯帝国和大日本帝国统治旅顺时建立的一座监狱，1902年由俄罗斯帝国始建，1907年由大日本帝国扩建，1945年苏军进入旅大后解体。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the north of Lüshun, about 3 km north-east of the Lüshun Museum and roughly 40 minutes by road south-west of central Dalian; closed on Mondays and on Chinese New Year's Eve.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 抗美援朝纪念馆
summaryEn: This national first-grade museum on Yinghua Mountain in Dandong is devoted to the Korean War, which China calls the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea, and to the campaign in China to support it. The complex has an exhibition building with halls on the war, the home-front campaign, Sino-Korean ties and those who died, a panorama hall with a large painting of the 1950 Chongchon River battle, a 53 m memorial tower and an outdoor park of displayed weapons, with views toward Sinuiju across the river. It reopened in 2020 after a refit that began in 2014 and holds more than 20,000 relics, according to the provincial tourism page.
description: 抗美援朝纪念馆位于中华人民共和国辽宁省丹东市振兴区山上街7号，是一所专题纪念馆。纪念馆始建于1958年，其前身为1953年建立的辽东省地质博物馆筹备处。该馆陈列中国人民志愿军参与抗美援朝战争和相关运动的历史文物，此外还展有一些其他时期的历史文物，是国家一级博物馆。
accessEn: On Yinghua Mountain in Zhenxing district, about 2 km west-south-west of Dandong railway station; closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 凤凰山
summaryEn: Phoenix Mountain is a rocky mountain area south-east of Fengcheng, divided into West Mountain, East Mountain and Ancient City sections, with cliff-side boardwalks, a glass-floored walkway, a glass suspension bridge and several temples. The Ancient City section holds the Goguryeo-period Fenghuangshan Mountain City, also called Wugu City, begun in the early fifth century, where stretches of wall and the remains of its gates survive. Several routes run along cliff faces, so it suits confident walkers.
description: 凤凰山旅游景区，位于辽宁省凤城市凤山区，是国家4A级旅游景区，属于长白山的余脉。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 2.5 km south-south-east of Fengcheng railway station and about 43 km north-west of Dandong railway station in a straight line.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 抚顺雷锋纪念馆
summaryEn: Opened in 1965 near the former barracks of Lei Feng's army unit, this memorial park commemorates the soldier Lei Feng (1940–1962), who became the subject of a long-running national 'Learn from Lei Feng' campaign. The grounds of about 10 ha hold an exhibition hall on his life, a 13.4 m granite monument, his tomb, statues and a court of stone tablets, and the tomb and monument together are a national heritage unit. The displays present the official Chinese account of his life and of the campaign.
description: 抚顺市雷锋纪念馆建立于1965年8月15日，位于雷锋牺牲地—辽宁省抚顺市望花区雷锋路东段。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Leifeng Road in Fushun's Wanghua district, about 11 km west-south-west of central Fushun; the memorial hall is closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 笔架山
summaryEn: A small island of about 1 sq km in Liaodong Bay that a natural sand-and-gravel causeway about 1.6 km long links to the mainland; the tides expose it twice a day and cover it again. On the island is a group of old buildings, including Sanqing Pavilion, an all-stone pavilion built without timber or nails that houses Confucian, Daoist and Buddhist figures. The causeway can only be walked at low tide, so check tide times before going.
description: 笔架山位于中国辽宁省锦州市南35公里的辽东湾中，紧邻锦州港，是一座近海中的陆连岛。南北长1.5公里，东西宽0.8公里，总面积约1平方公里。岛上三峰，形如笔架，故名。
accessEn: On the Bohai coast in Taihe district, about 33 km south of central Jinzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 广济寺古建筑群（锦州市博物馆）
summaryEn: A walled group of old temple buildings in the middle of Jinzhou, centred on a 13-tier brick pagoda begun under the Liao dynasty in 1057 and a Buddhist temple rebuilt in the Qing dynasty, with a Mazu temple, a Guanyin pavilion and a shrine to soldiers killed in the 1894 Sino-Japanese War. Jinzhou Museum shares the site, with permanent displays on the city's history, western Liaoning fossils, local customs and Buddhist art, and exhibitions on Mazu worship and the 1894 land war in the old halls. The pagoda, about 71 m high after its 1996 restoration, stands in Guta Park in the middle of the city.
description: 广济寺古建筑群位于中华人民共和国辽宁省锦州市古塔区，包括广济寺、广济寺塔，天后宫和昭忠祠等建筑，于2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the Guta district in the middle of Jinzhou, about 3 km south-west of the Liaoshen Campaign Memorial Hall.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 医巫闾山
summaryEn: A mountain range some 45 km long on the western edge of Beizhen, revered since ancient times as the guardian mountain of the north and, under the Liao dynasty, an imperial hunting ground; its highest peak, Wanghai Peak, is about 870 m. The Beizhen scenic area has forest walks, an old stand of black pine and temples such as the Guanyin Pavilion. Other parts of the range, such as Daluhua and Qingyan Temple, are separate scenic areas with their own entries.
description: 医巫闾山，又称医巫山、无虑山、闾山等，中国辽宁省西部主要山脉之一，为阴山余脉，位于锦州北镇市和义县交界处，古称于微闾山或医无虑山，传说帝舜封天下分为十二个州，每州以一座山作为镇山，医巫闾山被封为幽州的镇山。
accessEn: About 6 km west of Beizhen town and about 74 km north-east of central Jinzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 广佑寺·辽阳白塔
summaryEn: The White Pagoda is an eight-sided brick pagoda with thirteen tiers of eaves, 70.4 m high, which the provincial heritage department calls the tallest ancient pagoda in Liaoning and which is usually dated to the middle or late Liao period. It stands in Baita Park beside the rebuilt Guangyou Temple, which tradition dates to the Eastern Han; the temple was burned down in 1900 and rebuilt in 2002–04 in Liao-influenced style around a large main hall and a gilded camphor-wood seated Buddha. The pagoda and temple were once one complex, and Baita District is named after the pagoda.
description: 辽阳白塔，位于中华人民共和国辽宁省辽阳市白塔区的白塔公园中，白塔区也因该塔得名。是一座密檐式砖塔，因其周身被涂白而被称为白塔。该塔建造具体建造年代有多种说法，一般认为始建于辽金时期。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Baita Park in central Liaoyang, about 800 m east-south-east of Liaoyang railway station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: “九·一八”历史博物馆
summaryEn: A museum in north-eastern Shenyang documenting the Mukden Incident of 18 September 1931, when Japanese forces attacked Shenyang, through photographs, objects and audio-visual displays. The present complex, opened on 18 September 1999, grew out of an earlier memorial from 1991 built around the Broken Calendar monument and an underground hall. In the grounds stands a bronze monument put up in 1999 by Japanese orphans left in China after the war, to thank their Chinese foster parents.
description: “九·一八”历史博物馆是位于中国辽宁省沈阳市大东区上园街道望花南街46号的一座介绍九一八事变的博物馆。该馆是在1991年开馆的原残历碑以及地下展厅的基础上，于1997年9月开始扩建，1999年9月18日正式落成并开馆。
accessEn: About 8 km north-east of Shenyang railway station, on Wanghua South Street. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 沈飞航空博览园
summaryEn: An aviation museum run by the Shenyang Aircraft Corporation (AVIC Shenyang), on Lingbei Street beside the company's factory, which tells the story of the firm and the fighter aircraft it has built. The main hall of about 4,600 square metres has eight exhibition sections with some 1,950 historical photographs and 1,200 objects, and fighters made by the company, including J-5, J-6 and J-8 types, are displayed outdoors on the square. It suits aviation enthusiasts.
description: 沈飞航空博览园，又名“沈阳市航空博物馆”，位于中华人民共和国辽宁省沈阳市皇姑区陵北街1号，沈阳飞机工业集团内部。
accessEn: In Huanggu district, about 8 km north-north-east of Shenyang railway station; the museum is inside the aircraft company's grounds, so check the visiting rules before going. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 沈阳铁路陈列馆
summaryEn: A railway museum on an 80,000-square-metre site in Sujiatun district, with some 800 pieces of railway equipment, including dozens of locomotives, and more than 1,500 historical photographs. Steam locomotives on show include a US-built engine of 1907, a German-built 'forest railway' locomotive of 1914 and a Japanese-built locomotive of 1934, and a green-carriage 'time train' recreates an old platform scene. A railway-themed square outside has sculptures and a small sightseeing train.
description: 沈阳铁路陈列馆坐落于中华人民共和国辽宁省沈阳市苏家屯区山丹街8号，沈阳铁路局苏家屯机务段北侧。该馆占地面积8万平方米，建筑面积1.9万平方米，是中国东北地区最大的铁路博物馆，通过包括数十台铁路机车车辆在内的800余件展品和1,500多张史料图片，展现了东北地区百余年来的铁路发展历程。
accessEn: In Sujiatun district, about 13 km south-south-west of Shenyang railway station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 吉林省自然博物馆
summaryEn: A natural-history museum run by Northeast Normal University on its Jingyue campus, holding tens of thousands of specimens, mostly from Jilin's own environments. Its permanent displays include rare animals, fossils, minerals, insects and a butterfly hall.
description: 吉林省自然博物馆暨东北师范大学自然博物馆位于中华人民共和国吉林省长春市南关区净月大街2556号，是东北师范大学所属的一座综合性自然历史博物馆。馆藏自然标本共88726件，其中有植物23353件，脊椎动物2899件，昆虫59000件，化石1309件，岩矿2201件。
accessEn: On Jingyue Avenue in the Jingyue district, about 11 km south-east of central Changchun. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 北山公园
summaryEn: A hillside city park in the west of Jilin, laid out in 1924 around a group of Qing-period temples, among them the Guandi Temple of 1701, the Yaowang (Medicine King) Temple of 1738 and the Jade Emperor Pavilion of 1776, with a granite arch bridge of 1935 spanning the valley between the two peaks. Its temple fairs were added to China's national intangible heritage list in 2011, and the rear hill has a martyrs' cemetery and a four-season cross-country ski centre. It is a popular place for local walks and views over the city.
description: 吉林市北山风景区，或称吉林市北山公园，是位于中国吉林省吉林市船营区的一处城市公园和风景区，始建于1924年，是国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: In Chuanying district on the western edge of the old city, about 4 km west-south-west of Jilin railway station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 松花湖
summaryEn: A reservoir of about 550 km², the largest lake in Jilin province, created by the Fengman dam on the Second Songhua River, begun in 1937, and a national-level scenic area since 1988. The scenic area near the dam offers boat and speedboat trips, walking and cycling in the surrounding forest, and the Wuhu Island leisure area with an amusement park and a water park. Freshwater fish from the lake is the local speciality.
description: 松花湖即丰满水库，位于吉林省吉林市境内的第二松花江上，是吉林省最大的湖泊。是1937年拦截松花江水，建设丰满水电站形成的人工湖。湖面面积550平方公里，最大蓄水量108亿立方米。
accessEn: The scenic-area entrance is at 1 Songbai Road beside the Fengman dam, about 17 km south-east of Jilin railway station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 吉林龙湾
summaryEn: A group of volcanic crater lakes (maar lakes) in the Longgang mountains of Huinan County, protected as a national forest park and nature reserve. The best-known stops are Sanjiaolong, a triangular lake formed by an eruption about 200,000 years ago, and Dalongwan, the largest lake in the park, with boat trips on the lakes and the Diaoshuihu waterfall nearby. Forest paths run around the lakes.
description: 吉林龙湾位于中华人民共和国吉林省南部龙岗山脉中段，是由8个称为“龙湾”的火山口湖组成，分布于辉南县和靖宇县两县境内。属于国家级自然保护区。吉林龙湾群形成于早更新世晚期至中更新世早期的火山喷发，是中国目前已发现的最大的玛珥湖群。
accessEn: In Jinchuan township in the hills of southern Huinan County, about 47 km south-east of Huinan town in a straight line.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 二道白河名镇
summaryEn: Erdaobaihe is the gateway town on the north side of Changbai Mountain and an important base for visitors going up from this side; its centre was approved as a 4A scenic area in January 2019. The town has a network of riverside walking and cycling paths, parks and plazas, and a sculpture park among stands of the tall local pines known as 'beauty pines', with hotels, restaurants and shops serving the mountain.
description: 二道白河名镇位于吉林延边。游览特色包括滨水景观、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 28 km north-north-west of the Changbai Mountain north gate in a straight line, with Changbaishan railway station about 3 km to the north-north-east.
imageCredit: Caitriana Nicholson from 北京 ~ Beijing, 中国 ~ China

name: 防川
summaryEn: Fangchuan is a small village on the lower Tumen River at the eastern tip of Hunchun, close to where the borders of China, Russia and North Korea meet. From the viewing tower, the Longhu Pavilion, visitors can see the river, the Russia–North Korea railway bridge, the Russian settlement of Khasan and, across the river to the south-west, the North Korean city of Rason. The scenic area also holds the Tuzi marker, a granite boundary stone set up in 1886 and now a nationally protected monument, as well as a folk-culture area of the village's ethnic Korean community and a lotus lake.
description: 防川村，又名“防川岛”、“防川风景名胜区”，位于吉林省延边朝鲜族自治州珲春市敬信镇，毗邻图们江的日本海入海口，是中国、俄罗斯、朝鲜三国交界的地方，2002年5月17日，防川被中国正式确立为中国国家重点风景名胜区，其规划面积为139平方公里，有着44.68公里长的边境线。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Fangchuan village, Jingxin township, about 54 km south-south-east of Hunchun town centre in a straight line; a tourist bus line runs to Fangchuan from Hunchun's coach station and high-speed railway station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 延边博物馆
summaryEn: Yanbian Museum is the main museum of Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture, a national second-class museum with about 15,000 items, in a new building opened in 2012 on a site of more than 20,000 m² on Changbai West Road. Its core displays cover finds from the prefecture, the folk customs of the ethnic Korean (Chaoxian) community and the history of the community's revolutionary struggle, and they include a copy of the mural and stele from the Bohai Princess Zhenxiao's tomb. The folk-customs exhibition received an excellence award in a national top-ten museum exhibitions selection in 2013.
description: 延边博物馆位于中华人民共和国吉林省延边朝鲜族自治州延吉市长白西路8627号，是一座国家二级综合博物馆，国家4A级旅游景区，实行延边博物馆、延边朝鲜族民俗博物馆和延边朝鲜族革命纪念馆三块牌子一套班子，兼具地方历史与朝鲜族民族特色。
accessEn: On Changbai West Road in the west of Yanji, about 7 km west-south-west of the city centre and 2 km south-south-east of Yanji West railway station. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大庆博物馆
summaryEn: Daqing's city museum, which grew out of an exhibition hall founded in 1964 and has stood in its present building in the Daqing High-tech Zone since 2008. It is best known for Quaternary-period fossils from north-east China, among them mammoth and woolly rhinoceros, shown in permanent exhibitions on the Quaternary environment and mammals of north-east China and on early human cultures around Daqing. It was ranked a national first-grade museum in 2017.
description: 大庆博物馆位于中华人民共和国黑龙江省大庆市萨尔图区大庆高新技术产业开发区文苑街2号，是大庆市属综合性博物馆，国家一级博物馆。隶属大庆市文化广电新闻出版局。
accessEn: On Wenyuan Street in the Daqing High-tech Zone, about 4 km east-south-east of Daqing's central Saertu district; closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙塔
summaryEn: A 336 m steel lattice tower for television and radio, opened in 2000, which is among the tallest lattice towers in the world. It has observation levels and a revolving restaurant, and its base has held science and wax-figure exhibits, according to a 2017 China Daily profile. It is also the Heilongjiang provincial radio and television tower.
description: 龙塔，又称“黑龙江省广播电视塔”，坐落于中华人民共和国黑龙江省哈尔滨市南岗区长江路178号，为一座全钢结构的广播电视塔。龙塔于2000年建成开放，塔高336米，时为亚洲第一、世界第二高的钢结构塔。建成之初，龙塔整合了电视广播、旅游观光、餐饮服务、广告传播、环境与气象检测、微波与无线电通讯等多项功能。
accessEn: In Nangang district, about 4 km east-south-east of Harbin Railway Station; it closed for renovation on 18 August 2025, so check whether it has reopened before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 哈尔滨极地公园
summaryEn: A polar-themed animal park in Songbei district beside Sun Island, which trades as Harbin Polarland and was formerly known as the Harbin Polar Museum. It combines exhibits of polar and Arctic animals such as penguins and polar bears with staged shows featuring beluga whales, sea lions and walruses, according to a 2017 China Daily listing. It suits families.
description: 哈尔滨极地馆位于中华人民共和国黑龙江省哈尔滨市松北区太阳大道277号，是世界首座极地演艺游乐园，中国哈尔滨国际冰雪节四大景区之一，国家4A级旅游景区，中国唯一一家以娱乐表演为主题的极地馆。
accessEn: In Songbei district beside Sun Island, about 4.5 km north-west of Harbin Railway Station, by bus or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东北虎林园
summaryEn: A tiger park and breeding centre on the north bank of the Songhua River, covering about 80 hectares and open to visitors since 1996. Siberian tigers are watched from a vehicle in the open-range zone and on foot from walkways and a viewing platform, alongside white tigers, white lions, leopards and other big cats. The operator describes it as a breeding base for Siberian tigers and a source of animals for the Northeast China Tiger and Leopard National Park.
description: 东北虎林园位于中华人民共和国黑龙江省哈尔滨市松北区松北街88号，是一个动物园。坐落于松花江北岸，与太阳岛毗邻，占地面积144万平方米，拥有各种不同年龄的纯种东北虎800余只，园内数量最多的动物为西伯利亚虎。
accessEn: In Songbei District on the north bank of the Songhua, about 16 km by road north-north-west of central Harbin; city buses 35, 122 and 145 stop about 100 m from the park.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 侵华日军第七三一部队罪证陈列馆
summaryEn: The site of Unit 731, an Imperial Japanese Army unit that developed biological weapons and carried out human experiments, whose base here dates from 1936 and whose buildings were mostly blown up in August 1945. The museum complex has a large exhibition building opened in 2015, with documents, photographs and objects, and the preserved former headquarters grounds a few hundred metres away. Since 2012 the site has been on China's national tentative list for World Heritage nominations.
description: 侵华日军第七三一部队罪证陈列馆简称七三一陈列馆或七三一部队旧址，位于中华人民共和国黑龙江省哈尔滨市平房区新疆大街47号，是遗址型博物馆，于侵华日军第七三一部队旧址上建成，建筑面积9997平方米。此旧址建于1933年，大日本帝国陆军第七三一部队于1936年开始在此建立细菌武器研究生产基地，将6.1平方公里的土地作为特别军事区域。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 17 km south of central Harbin in Pingfang district, reached by Metro Line 1 to Xinjiang Street station and a walk of 300–600 m; visits need real-name booking in advance and the museum is normally closed on Mondays except public holidays, so check current rules.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 瑷珲历史陈列馆
summaryEn: A museum on the site of New Aihui, a Qing-era walled town dating from the 1680s that served as the seat of the Heilongjiang General and is now a national heritage unit. Its displays include a reconstructed scene of the signing of the 1858 Treaty of Aigun, a panorama painting of the 1900 events at Blagoveshchensk (Hailanpao), archaeological finds and ethnic artefacts from the Heilongjiang basin, and local Qing-period weapons. The grounds hold a rebuilt Kuixing Pavilion and a heritage stele marking the old town.
description: 瑷珲历史陈列馆位于中华人民共和国黑龙江省黑河市爱辉区瑷珲镇，是依托瑷珲新城遗址而建成的一座历史博物馆。隶属中共黑河市委宣传部。馆中陈列有《瑷珲条约》签订的复原场景、海兰泡惨案半景画、瑷珲军民抗俄中使用的带有“吉林”字样的子弹、长矛，俄军使用的枪、刀以及屠杀海兰泡和江东六十四屯居民的照片等。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Aihui town, about 35 km south of central Heihe by road (around 40 minutes by car).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 七星山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park on the northern slope of the Wanda Mountains where Jixian, Lingdong district and Huanan County meet, named for seven rock crags; the highest, at 852.7 m, is billed as the first peak of the Sanjiang Plain. In the 1930s the area was one of the largest bases of the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army, with camps, an arsenal and a school; a memorial and carved stones mark the mid-slope, a red-tourism hall stands at the foot, and the park also has a film set for a television drama about the army.
description: 黑龙江七星山国家森林公园位于黑龙江省佳木斯市桦南县、双鸭山市岭东区和集贤县交界处的完达山脉北麓，是国家4A级旅游景区。七星山又名“七星砬子”，得名于虎头峰、利剑峰、骆驼峰、聚仙峰、仙女峰、宝印峰、狼牙峰七座石砬子，主峰海拔852.7米，有三江平原“第一峰”之称。
accessEn: On the boundary of Jixian County, Lingdong district and Huanan County, about 19 km west-south-west of Shuangyashan; reached by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 世纪公园
summaryEn: A park of about 140 hectares of lakes, lawns and woodland at the end of Century Avenue in Pudong, designed by the British consultancy LUC, opened in 2000 and described as the largest naturalistic park inside Shanghai's Inner Ring Road. It is laid out in seven areas, including a lakeside area, a bird-protection zone and an 'exotic' garden area, with small sights such as a flower clock and a music fountain, boating and bicycles for hire, and makes a quiet break next to the science museum.
description: 世纪公园，曾用名浦东中央公园，位于上海市浦东新区花木行政文化中心，是上海内环线中心区域内最大的富有自然特征的生态型城市公园。于2000年正式对外开放并更名世纪公园。
accessEn: At the end of Century Avenue in Pudong, beside Century Park and Shanghai Science and Technology Museum stations on Metro Line 2.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 长风公园
summaryEn: A large landscaped park in Putuo, opened in 1959 around the artificial Yinchu Lake and Tiebi Hill. Its northern half reopened in October 2026 after nearly two years of renovation, with several gates and stretches of boundary wall removed and the old 'Path of the Brave' adventure trail rebuilt on Black Pine Hill. Changfeng Ocean World, an aquarium opened in 1999 beneath the lake's west shore, shows rays, penguins and other marine life.
description: 上海长风公园位于上海市普陀区，正门位于大渡河路。面积达36.6万平方米，其中水域面积14.3万平方米。临近华东师范大学中山北路校区，是上海市大型的综合性山水公园。
accessEn: In Putuo District, by Changfeng Park station on Metro Line 15; the southern half of the park is due to close for renovation now that the northern half has reopened, so check which areas and gates are open before going.
imageCredit: Roddy Austin from Irvington, New York, U.S.A.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 陈云故里·练塘古镇
summaryEn: A memorial complex opened in 2000 in Liantang, the home town of the senior Chinese Communist Party leader Chen Yun (1905–1995), and renamed Chen Yun Memorial Hall in 2013. It brings together a bronze statue square, exhibition halls on his life, a hall of his personal relics, his restored former residence and a corridor of stelae carved with his handwriting, and the scenic area also takes in the canal-side streets of Liantang's old town.
description: 陈云纪念馆，位于中国上海市青浦区练塘镇老朱枫公路3516号，是中国共产党领导人陈云的纪念馆。
accessEn: In Liantang town, southern Qingpu District, about 2 km from Liantang station on the Shanghai–Suzhou–Huzhou high-speed railway from Shanghai Hongqiao, or about 10 km south of Zhujiajiao station on Metro Line 17 by bus or taxi. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中国航海博物馆
summaryEn: China's national maritime museum, opened in 2010 beside Dishui Lake in Lingang, in a building whose central roof is shaped like a white sail. Six halls cover navigation history, ships, ports, maritime safety, seafarers and naval history, and the central hall holds a full-size replica of a Ming-dynasty Fujian-type sailing ship modelled on those of Zheng He's fleets. It suits anyone interested in ships and China's seafaring past.
description: 中国航海博物馆位于中华人民共和国上海市浦东新区南汇新城申港大道197号滴水湖畔，是中国第一个国家级的航海博物馆，同时也是中国规模最大、等级最高的综合性航海博物馆，整个馆内收藏了2万余件与航海有关的物品。
accessEn: In Lingang, south-east Pudong, about 2 km from Dishui Lake station at the end of Metro Line 16, a short bus or taxi ride. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东平国家森林公园
summaryEn: A 3.55 km² planted forest on reclaimed land in northern Chongming, begun as a state forest farm in 1959 and opened to visitors in 1989. Paths run through dawn redwoods around Shuishan Lake to themed gardens of bamboo, maples, osmanthus, plum and cherry and a wisteria walk about a kilometre long, and there is an RV and camping area with barbecue grounds.
description: 东平国家森林公园位于中华人民共和国上海市崇明区崇明岛中北部。东西最宽处为1.7公里，南北最长处为2.8公里，总面积为3.55平方公里。东、西、北三面与东平镇东风农场为邻，南隔河与建设镇接壤，边界均呈直线形。
accessEn: In northern Chongming Island, about 12 km from the district seat at Nanmen and roughly 1.5–2 hours by road from central Shanghai.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 方塔园
summaryEn: A park laid out from 1978 by the architect Feng Jizhong around the Square Pagoda, a nine-storey brick-and-timber pagoda built under the Northern Song in the late 11th century and the only survivor of the Xingshengjiao Temple. Around it stand a carved brick screen wall of 1370 from the old prefectural City God Temple, the Tianfei Palace moved here from Henan Road in the late 1970s, a Ming hall, and Feng's bamboo-and-thatch pavilion He Lou Xuan, whose restoration won a UNESCO Asia-Pacific heritage award in 2024.
description: 方塔园位于上海。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、古塔、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Songjiang old town, about 75 minutes from People's Square on Metro Line 9 to Zuibaichi Park station, then a short taxi ride of about 2 km.

name: 共青森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park beside the Huangpu in north-east Yangpu, planted from the 1950s by volunteer youth on dredged-up riverbank land and opened as a park in 1986. The northern part has woods, lawns and a lake with an amusement area, barbecue grounds and horse riding, while the southern Wanzhu Garden shows dozens of bamboo species among Jiangnan-style buildings.
description: 上海共青国家森林公园简称共青森林公园，是上海市中心城区唯一的大型森林公园和国家森林公园，位于杨浦区东北部的军工路2000号，嫩江路以南部分又名万竹园。公园以模拟自然森林景观为特色，亦设有一些游乐设施。
accessEn: At 2000 Jungong Road, Yangpu District, about 1.5 km from Shiguang Road station on Metro Line 8.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 广富林文化遗址
summaryEn: A culture park opened in 2018 on the Guangfulin archaeological site, where excavations since 1999 have uncovered remains from the late Neolithic to the Eastern Zhou, including those of the Guangfulin culture, named in 2006. The site's archaeological museum (opened 2020), shaped like half-buried pots, and the partly water-set Guangfulin Cultural Museum present the finds, while the rest of the park is a newly built complex of temples, halls and lakeside buildings in traditional style.
description: 广富林遗址，位于中华人民共和国上海市松江区广富林村北侧，是一处距今4000至2500年的古遗址。该遗址于1958年被当地居民发现，此后曾被多次发掘，发掘面积达到24000平方米。该遗址由上至下分为三个文化层，其中第三层于2006年被确定为广富林文化。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Songjiang District, about 3.5 km west of Songjiang University Town station on Metro Line 9, a short taxi ride from the station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 顾村公园
summaryEn: A large park in Gucun, Baoshan, opened in 2009, with woods, lawns, lakes and themed gardens. It is best known for its cherry trees: the Shanghai Cherry Blossom Festival has been held here every spring since 2011.
description: 顾村公园是上海市的一所公园，位于宝山区顾村镇，规划总面积超过4.3平方公里，规划布局为“一轴、一带、三区、七园”，于2009年正式开园。一期用地1.8平方公里。2011年，首届上海樱花节在顾村公园开幕。
accessEn: In Baoshan District in the north of the city, at Gucun Park station (Lines 7 and 15).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 古猗园
summaryEn: One of Shanghai's five classical gardens, begun in the Ming dynasty's Jiajing era and renamed Guyi Yuan after a new owner bought and enlarged it in 1746, with bamboo planted throughout. Its sights include the Yiye Hall, a lotus pond with a Song-dynasty pagoda, a Tang sutra pillar brought here in the 1950s, and a pavilion built in 1933 with one corner left missing to mark the loss of north-east China in 1931. The garden is also linked with the origins of Nanxiang xiaolongbao soup dumplings.
description: 古猗园位于上海市嘉定区南翔镇，离市中心上海人民广场约21公里是一座典型的江南园林，也是上海市五大古典园林之一。亦是南翔小笼的发祥地。2014年，入选上海市文物保护单位。
accessEn: In Nanxiang, Jiading District, a short walk or taxi ride from Nanxiang station on Metro Line 11, about 40 minutes from central Shanghai.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上海欢乐谷
summaryEn: An amusement park of the Happy Valley chain, opened in 2009 in the Sheshan resort area and covering about 65 hectares, according to the city's visitor site. Its seven themed zones hold roller coasters, among them a 60-metre floorless drop coaster and a 1,200-metre wooden coaster, a 30-metre shoot-the-chute water ride and stage shows, and it suits families and thrill-ride fans.
description: 欢乐谷是上海市的一个大型主题公园，其口号为“动感、时尚、欢乐、梦幻”。2009年8月16日正式开放，在上海迪士尼乐园建成之前，曾是中国最大的游乐园。上海欢乐谷位于上海市西南部的松江上海佘山国家旅游度假区，占地达90万平方米，由上海华侨城主建。
accessEn: In the Sheshan resort area of Songjiang, under 2 km from Sheshan station on Metro Line 9, about an hour from People's Square.
imageCredit: Jeremy Thompson from United States of America
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 金茂大厦88层观光厅
summaryEn: The observation deck on the 88th floor of the 420-metre Jin Mao Tower, a pagoda-inspired Lujiazui skyscraper completed in 1999, about 340 metres above the street. Besides views of the Bund and the taller towers next door, it looks straight down into the Grand Hyatt hotel's atrium, which rises through the building's upper floors, and an open-air skywalk runs round the outside of the tower at this level.
description: 金茂大厦又称金茂大楼，位于中华人民共和国上海市浦东新区黄浦江畔的陆家嘴金融贸易区，楼高420.5米，是上海第三高的摩天大楼、中国大陆第10高楼。大厦于1994年开工，1999年建成，建成时为中国第一高楼，世界第三。
accessEn: In Lujiazui, Pudong, a short walk from Lujiazui station on Metro Lines 2 and 14; lifts to the deck leave from the basement.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 金泽古镇
summaryEn: A small canal town in western Qingpu near the Jiangsu and Zhejiang borders, once known for its many temples and bridges, of which 21 old bridges survive. The Puji and Wan'an bridges, both from the Southern Song dynasty, are regarded as the oldest stone arch bridges in Shanghai, and Yihao Temple beside the old streets was founded in 1260.
description: 金泽古镇位于上海。游览特色包括古镇、寺庙建筑、运河。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jinze town, western Qingpu District, about 6 km south-west of Xicen station on Metro Line 17 by taxi, or about 75 minutes by road from central Shanghai.

name: 龙华烈士陵园
summaryEn: A large memorial park beside Longhua Temple that takes in the former Songhu Garrison Command of the Nationalist government, where Communists and left-wing activists were imprisoned and executed between 1927 and 1937, among them 24 people shot on 7 February 1931, including five writers of the League of Left-Wing Writers. The listed memorial site in its north-east corner keeps the 1920 gatehouse, the men's and women's cell blocks and the execution ground, and a memorial hall opened in 1997 presents this history.
description: 龙华烈士陵园，位于中华人民共和国上海市徐汇区龙华西路180号，其东北角的龙华革命烈士纪念地是全国重点文物保护单位之一。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xuhui District next to Longhua Temple, about 400 m from Longhua station (Lines 11 and 12); the memorial hall is closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南翔古镇
summaryEn: An old market town known as the home of xiaolongbao soup dumplings, whose restored old streets centre on the Twin Pagodas, a pair of small Five Dynasties–Northern Song brick pagodas imitating timber buildings that face each other across a street. In front of them are two ancient wells excavated during the street renovation that began in 2008, and nearby is Liuyun Chan Temple, still widely called Yunxiang Temple, rebuilt in 1998–2004 on the site of the old Nanxiang Temple.
description: 南翔镇，位于上海市嘉定区东南部，距上海市中心18公里。全镇总面积33.31平方公里。户籍人口4.88万人。
accessEn: In Nanxiang, Jiading District, a short walk or taxi ride from Nanxiang station on Metro Line 11, about 40 minutes from central Shanghai.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 北外滩国客中心
summaryEn: The riverside grounds of the Shanghai Port International Cruise Terminal, now officially the North Bund International Passenger Center, built on the site of 19th-century wharves and brought into service between 2006 and 2009. Its lawns and riverside promenade are open to the public, look across the Huangpu to the Lujiazui skyline and are used for outdoor events and brand launches.
description: 上海港国际客运中心简称国客中心，是中华人民共和国上海市虹口区北外滩黄浦江边的一座邮轮码头，西起虹口港，东至高阳路。总建筑面积约40万平方米，共有13个项目。
accessEn: In Hongkou District, next to International Cruise Terminal station on Metro Line 12.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东方绿舟
summaryEn: A large outdoor activity camp and park in Qingpu run for Shanghai's school students since 2002, which also admits the public. Among its lakes and woods are a full-size replica of a US Nimitz-class aircraft carrier with exhibition halls, an avenue lined with statues of scientists and thinkers, an island of rare plants and a course of 18 swing and wave bridges. It suits families with children.
description: 上海市青少年校外活动营地——东方绿舟，位于上海市青浦区，隶属于上海市教育委员会和东方明珠，是上海唯一的集拓展培训、青少年社会实践、团队活动以及休闲旅游为一体的大型公园。
accessEn: In Qingpu District, opposite Oriental Land station on Metro Line 17.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 浦江郊野公园
summaryEn: One of Shanghai's first five pilot country parks, opened in 2017 on woods, farmland and waterways along the east bank of the Huangpu River in Pujiang, Minhang. It is split by roads into separate sections, among them the Miracle Garden with its large spring flower displays, forest areas, a farmland section named for its willows and egrets and a riverside promenade, and it suits families and anyone after a green day out near the city.
description: 浦江郊野公园是上海市首批五个试点建设的郊野公园之一，位于闵行区浦江镇，规划面积15.3平方公里，其中实际建设的一期面积约5.82平方公里。浦江郊野公园是上海各郊野公园中离中心城区最近的一个。
accessEn: In Pujiang town, Minhang District, about 700 m from Shendu Highway station (Line 8 and the Pujiang Line).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 七宝古镇
summaryEn: An old market town on the Puhuitang River in western Minhang, which had taken shape by the Northern Song and is usually said to be named after its Qibao Temple.
