Its old streets on both sides of the river are now a busy shopping and snack street, with small attractions such as the memorial hall of the painter Zhang Chongren, Hergé's friend and the model for Chang in The Adventures of Tintin, and a house devoted to Qibao's fighting crickets.
description: 七宝镇是位于中国上海市闵行区西北部的一个行政建制镇。
accessEn: In Qibao, Minhang District, about 550 m from Qibao station (Line 9).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上海汽车博览公园
summaryEn: A 76-hectare lakeside park in Anting's International Automobile City, completed in 2006 around the Shanghai Auto Museum, which opened in 2007 and is described by the city as China's first specialised car museum. Since a 2022 refit the museum's first three floors trace the history of the motor car with more than 100 vehicles from around 50 makers, and the top floor is a car-themed play area for children.
description: 上海汽车博览公园是中华人民共和国上海市嘉定区的一个公园，为国家4A级旅游景区，面积76.67公顷，园内有人工湖以及中华人民共和国首家以汽车为主题的行业博物馆上海汽车博物馆以及上海汽车会展中心。
accessEn: In Anting, Jiading District, a short taxi ride from Anting or Shanghai Automobile City station on Metro Line 11, about 75 minutes from central Shanghai. The museum is closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上海植物园
summaryEn: A large botanical garden in southern Xuhui, opened to the public in 1978 on the site of the former Longhua nursery, with themed sections for penjing (Chinese bonsai), peonies, magnolias, roses, osmanthus, conifers, maples and bamboo, plus an orchid house and a tropical glasshouse. The penjing garden is particularly well known, and the garden holds flower shows every spring and autumn.
description: 上海植物园位于上海。游览特色包括植物园、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In southern Xuhui District, about 10 km south of People's Square; the main gate is at 1111 Longwu Road, and Gate 4 on Luocheng Road is about 1 km on foot from Shilong Road station (Line 3).

name: 上海影视乐园
summaryEn: A film and television studio lot built by the Shanghai Film Studio in Chedun, with streets and buildings recreating old Shanghai, opened to visitors in 2000. Period dramas are regularly shot here, and since July 2024 visitors can also walk the replica of Huanghe Road built for the TV series Blossoms Shanghai.
description: 上海影视乐园又称上海影视摄制基地、车墩影视基地，位于上海市松江区车墩镇北松公路4915号，是上海电影电视暨上海电影制片厂兴建的影视拍摄基地。总面积43.3万平方米，规划建筑总面积12.989万平方米。
accessEn: In Chedun, Songjiang District, under 1 km from Chedun station on the Jinshan Railway suburban line from Shanghai South Railway Station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上海大观园
summaryEn: A large garden of traditional-style halls and courtyards on the west shore of Dianshan Lake, built from 1979 and opened in 1988 to recreate the Grand View Garden described in the Qing novel Dream of the Red Chamber. Its courtyards are named after the characters' residences in the novel, such as Baoyu's Yihong Court and Daiyu's Xiaoxiang Lodge, and the grounds add a large plum grove and a modern seven-storey pagoda. It is a modern re-creation rather than a historic garden and suits readers of the novel.
description: 上海大观园是根据中国清代名著《红楼梦》中大观园的描写设计而成的大型仿古园林建筑群，是国家4A级旅游景区，上海五星级公园，位于上海青浦区青商公路701号，淀山湖西侧，距离上海市区65公里，占地135亩，建筑面积约8000平方米。
accessEn: On the west shore of Dianshan Lake in Jinze town, Qingpu District, about 5 km west of Xicen station on Metro Line 17 by taxi, or about 75 minutes by road from central Shanghai.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上海玻璃博物馆
summaryEn: A museum about glass opened in 2011 on the site of a former glass-instrument factory in Baoshan, covering how glass is made, the history of the glass industry and its uses, alongside galleries of glass art and exhibitions of contemporary art. Glass-blowing demonstrations and hands-on workshops make it a good choice for families.
description: 上海玻璃博物馆位于上海市宝山区长江西路685号，由上海轻工玻璃有限公司资助建立，是一家以玻璃为主题的市级专业博物馆。
accessEn: On Changjiang West Road in Baoshan District, about 400 m from Changjiang West Road station (Line 18). Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上海海洋水族馆
summaryEn: An indoor aquarium beside the Oriental Pearl Tower, opened in 2002, with about 450 species laid out as a journey from the Yangtze through South America, Australia, Africa, South-East Asia and Antarctic waters. Highlights are the China Zone of Yangtze species such as the Chinese sturgeon and giant salamander, and a long underwater tunnel where sharks and rays swim overhead. It suits families and rainy days.
description: 上海海洋水族馆是上海的一座公共水生生物博物馆，位于浦东陆家嘴核心地区、东方明珠电视塔东面。该馆是上海重要的旅游景点之一。
accessEn: In Lujiazui, Pudong, a short walk from Lujiazui station on Metro Lines 2 and 14.
imageCredit: This illustration was made by Peter Potrowl. Please credit this with : © Peter Potrowl in
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上海城市规划展示馆
summaryEn: A six-storey exhibition hall on People's Square, opened in 2000 and described by the city as China's first venue dedicated to urban planning, that explains how Shanghai has grown and how it plans to develop. Its displays, renewed during a closure from late 2019 to 2022, use planning maps, scale models, films and interactive exhibits in themed galleries on the city's culture, innovation and ecology.
description: 上海城市规划展示馆是位于上海市中心的人民广场的一幢六层楼的建筑，用于展示上海市的城市规划。上海城市规划展示馆于2000年建成，2000年2月25日正式对外开放。所有展品中，最为重要的是以1:500比例制作的上海内环线100余平方公里范围内城市规划模型。
accessEn: On People's Square in Huangpu District, beside Exit 3 of People's Square station (Lines 1, 2 and 8). Closed on Wednesdays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上海动物园
summaryEn: One of Shanghai's two main zoos, laid out on a former golf course near Hongqiao Airport and opened as Xijiao Park in 1954 before taking its present name in 1980. Mature trees, wide lawns and the Swan Lake surround enclosures for Chinese species such as golden snub-nosed monkeys and South China tigers as well as animals from other continents, and it suits a relaxed family day.
description: 上海动物园位于上海市长宁区虹桥路2381号，紧邻上海虹桥国际机场，原名西郊公园，因地处当时上海市西郊区故名，至今仍有许多上海市民习称其为西郊公园。上海动物园属于国家级大型动物园，占地面积74.3万平方米，饲养展出动物的馆舍面积有47237平方米。
accessEn: On Hongqiao Road in Changning District, about 600 m from Shanghai Zoo station (Line 10).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上海宋庆龄故居
summaryEn: The 1920s garden villa at 1843 Middle Huaihai Road, built for a foreign shipowner, that was the Shanghai home from 1948 of Soong Ching-ling, Sun Yat-sen's widow and later Honorary President of the People's Republic. It became a memorial after her death in 1981 and keeps the rooms and furniture as they were in her lifetime, set in front and back gardens.
description: 上海宋庆龄故居位于上海市徐汇区淮海中路1843号，是中华人民共和国名誉主席宋庆龄于1948年以后在上海的住所。该住所最早由一名希腊船主于二十世纪二十年代修建，后来为朱博泉所购，抗日战争结束后被南京国民政府收归国有，并于1948年拨给宋庆龄居住。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Middle Huaihai Road in Xuhui District, about 450 m from Exit 1 of Jiao Tong University station (Lines 10 and 11). Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上海之巅观光厅
summaryEn: The visitor observatory of the 632-metre Shanghai Tower, China's tallest building, reached by high-speed lifts that climb to the 118th floor at 546 metres. It gives a 360-degree view down onto the Jin Mao Tower, the Oriental Pearl Tower and the Bund, and a separate show on the 125th and 126th floors presents the building's giant tuned mass damper.
description: 上海中心大厦，为中华人民共和国上海市已落成的综合物业发展计划，属于一座超高层地标式摩天大楼，其高度超过附近的上海环球金融中心，当前为世界第三高楼、中国第一高楼及拥有全球最高室内观景台。该建筑位于浦东新区陆家嘴金融贸易区，东泰路、银城南路、花园石桥路交界处，即陆家嘴金融中心区Z3-2地块。
accessEn: In Lujiazui, Pudong, a short walk from Lujiazui station on Metro Lines 2 and 14; the observatory entrance is on Lujiazui Ring Road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 徐家汇源
summaryEn: An open-street scenic area, rated 4A in 2012, that links the historic buildings and museums of Xujiahui, the district named after the descendants of the Ming scholar Xu Guangqi who settled here. Besides St Ignatius Cathedral and Xu's tomb in Guangqi Park, its sites include the Bibliotheca Zi-Ka-Wei library of the old Jesuit mission, the former Xujiahui Observatory, now the Shanghai Meteorological Museum, the T'ou-Sè-Wè Museum and the Pathé building where the national anthem, The March of the Volunteers, was first recorded. It also takes in the Shanghai Film Museum and the historic Jiao Tong University campus.
description: 徐家汇是位于中华人民共和国上海市徐汇区的地区和商业中心，亦是上海的四大副中心和十大商圈之一。其地区可以泛指北到广元路，东到宛平路、宛平南路，西到宜山北路，南到南丹路及斜土路的地段。地区内不但有大量经营奢侈品、中高档服饰、电脑电子设备等产品的商店，也有各种娱乐、餐饮行业商家。
accessEn: Around Xujiahui station (Lines 1, 9 and 11) in Xuhui District, with the sites spread through the surrounding streets.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 醉白池
summaryEn: One of Shanghai's five classical gardens, rebuilt in the mid-17th century by Gu Dashen, who named it 'Drunken Bai Pond' in homage to the Tang poet Bai Juyi. The pond, halls and corridors keep their Qing layout, and two of its stone carvings survived the Cultural Revolution because staff disguised them as propaganda boards; a larger public park was added around it in 1959.
description: 醉白池位于上海松江区人民南路64号，是上海五大古典园林之一。1959年为满足城镇居民休闲需要在原古建筑基础上扩建外园，统称醉白池公园。现已成为国家AAAA级旅游景区和上海市文物保护单位。
accessEn: In Songjiang old town, next to Zuibaichi Park station on Metro Line 9, about 70 minutes from People's Square.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 常州博物馆
summaryEn: Changzhou's main city museum, founded in 1958 and housed since 2007 in a large modern building beside the civic square in Xinbei District. Its history galleries run from Liangzhu-culture jades and early green-glazed stoneware to Song and Yuan lacquer and porcelain and Ming and Qing painting, and it also has a natural history museum for children. It is rated a national first-grade museum.
description: 常州博物馆，位于中华人民共和国江苏省常州市新北区龙城大道1288号，是常州市属综合性博物馆。
accessEn: In Xinbei District about 4 km north of the old city centre, roughly 10 minutes' walk from Shimin Guangchang station on Metro Line 1. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 环球动漫嬉戏谷
summaryEn: A theme park on the shore of Lake Tai at Xueyan in Wujin, opened in 2011 and built around video-game and animation themes, with roller coasters and other rides. Its original look drew on online games such as World of Warcraft. It is aimed at teenagers and families.
description: 环球动漫嬉戏谷是一个位于的中华人民共和国江苏常州南部的主题公园。
accessEn: At Xueyan on Lake Tai, about 35 km south of central Changzhou, roughly 50 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 吴承恩故居
summaryEn: Wu Cheng'en, the Ming writer credited with the novel Journey to the West, lived in this courtyard house in the Hexia quarter of Huai'an; it was restored in 1982 and is a city-level protected site. The compound of about 1 ha has his main hall with a bust reconstructed from his skull, a bedroom and a small garden, flanked by memorial halls to Wu and to the Monkey King, including an art gallery on the Monkey King family of actors. It lies at the edge of Hexia old town, whose lanes are worth a stroll.
description: 吴承恩故居，或吴承恩宅，位于江苏省淮安市淮安区淮城镇打铜巷12号，是吴承恩的故居，占地9876平方米，建筑面积1842平方米，美猴王纪念馆和吴承恩纪念馆建于东西两侧。
accessEn: In Hexia old town on the north-west side of the old city of Huai'an District, about 15 km south-east of central Qingjiangpu; city bus or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 洪泽湖大堤
summaryEn: The great dike along the east shore of Hongze Lake was begun as a 30-li embankment in AD 200 and extended under the Ming and Qing to hold back the lake, protect the plains to the east and feed water to the Grand Canal; between 1580 and 1751 its lake face was clad with a wall of dressed stone about 60 km long and 7–8 m high. Now some 67 km long and part of the Grand Canal World Heritage listing, it can be toured from the Ancient Dike scenic area in Hongze District, whose sightseeing cars run along the top. Stops include the Zhouqiao breach, where floodwater broke the dike in 1824 and the stone wall was rebuilt with iron cramps, and some of the more than 300 Ming and Qing inscriptions carved along the dike.
description: 洪泽湖大堤，古称高家堰，是位于中国江苏省淮安市的古代水利工程。高家堰始建于东汉建安五年，由广陵太守陈登主持建筑，初为30里。当时还没有洪泽湖，大堤是在淮河边的富陵湖、白水塘等诸湖荡的东北隅。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: The Zhouqiao section is about 10 km south of Hongze town, which is about 35 km south-west of central Huai'an; by car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 淮安府署
summaryEn: The seat of Huai'an Prefecture from 1370 until prefectures were abolished in 1913, on the old town's central axis north of the Governor-General of Grain Transport's office and the Zhenhuai Tower. Its great hall, seven bays and 26 by 18.5 m, was rebuilt after an 1861 fire with timber from a Hexia salt merchant's mansion, and it survived with the second hall through later use as a factory. Restored and opened in 2007 over some 12,000 m², it is described by the provincial tourism department as the only surviving Ming–Qing prefectural yamen along the Grand Canal.
description: 淮安府衙是中国保存下来的两座府衙之一，其大堂体量为全中国之最。2002年淮安府署被列为江苏省文物保护单位，2006年淮安府衙被列为全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Dongmen Street in the centre of the old town of Huai'an District, about 15 km south-east of central Qingjiangpu; city bus or taxi.
imageCredit: No machine-readable author provided. TIY assumed (based on copyright claims).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 明祖陵
summaryEn: The first imperial tomb of the Ming dynasty, built from 1386 to about 1413 by the Hongwu Emperor and his son the Yongle Emperor beside Hongze Lake for the founder's grandfather, great-grandfather and great-great-grandfather; only the grandfather is actually buried here. Swamped by the lake around 1680 together with the city of Sizhou, it re-emerged in the 1960s and is now ringed by a protective embankment. The main sight is the spirit way lined with Ming stone statues of qilin, lions and other figures and carved pillars, while the burial chamber lies under a pond at its end and the halls survive only as foundations.
description: 明祖陵是明朝开国皇帝朱元璋于1385年为其高祖父、曾祖父修建的衣冠冢，这里亦是其祖父朱初一的实际埋葬地。位于泗州城北杨家墩，即今江苏省淮安市盱眙县淮河镇境内，淮河以北的洪泽湖畔。清朝康熙年间被洪泽湖淹没，直到1966年洪泽湖的枯水季节方又露出水面。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Huaihe town north of the Huai River, about 12 km north-west of Xuyi town; by car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 清晏园
summaryEn: A garden in central Qingjiangpu that grew from a lodge set up in 1678 by the river-works chief Jin Fu on the site of a Ming revenue office, and from 1729 belonged to the office of the Director-General of the Southern Rivers, who ran the river and canal works of the region. Its one original building is the Hefang Academy of 1750, built for the Qianlong Emperor's southern tour and flanked by stele pavilions and a stele corridor on the history of river works; the other halls, pavilions, Guandi temple and rockeries are later rebuildings in traditional style. Rated 4A in 2023, it is a compact garden of ponds, lotus and old trees.
description: 清晏园是位于中华人民共和国江苏省淮安市清江浦区人民南路西侧、环城西路北侧的一座古典园林。曾用名淮园、瞻园、留园、城南公园，是中国漕运史上唯一存留至今的官署园林。
accessEn: On Renmin South Road in central Qingjiangpu, near the canal; city bus or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 桃花涧·将军崖岩画
summaryEn: A wooded valley on the southern slopes of Jinping Mountain, south-west of Haizhou, with a stream, pools and paths up to a summit viewpoint; its western part holds the General Cliff petroglyphs. Carved into a sloping rock face, they show human faces linked to plant-like lines, star symbols and animals, and archaeologists read them as a prehistoric farming ritual site of the Dongyi people. Micro-erosion dating suggests the carvings were made over a long span, between about 10,000 and 3,000 years ago.
description: 将军崖岩画位于中国江苏省连云港市海州区西南郊的锦屏镇锦屏山南麓，1988年被列为第三批全国重点文物保护单位。将军崖岩画刻于南北长22米，东西宽15米的倾斜岩壁上，可分为三组，第一组主要为人面、农作物，第二组主要为星象、鸟兽纹，第三组主要为人面夹杂符号图案。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Jinping town about 14 km south-west of central Lianyungang, around 30 minutes by taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 朝天宫
summaryEn: Rebuilt from 1384 as Nanjing's leading Taoist temple, where the Ming court's Taoist registry sat and officials rehearsed court ceremonies, the complex on Yeshan hill was wrecked in the Taiping war and rebuilt in 1865–69 as the Confucian temple and school of Jiangning prefecture. Its Qing gates, Dacheng Hall and the halls on the hill behind are described as the largest and best-preserved group of official-style historic buildings in the Jiangnan region, and in 1936 a vault was built in the grounds for Palace Museum treasures evacuated from Beijing. It now houses the Nanjing Municipal Museum, whose permanent exhibitions cover the city's history, highlights of its collection and Song and Ming dress excavated in Nanjing.
description: 朝天宫位于中国江苏省南京市秦淮区，原南京城水西门内冶山。是江南规模最大、保存最为完好的明清官式古建筑群，现为南京市博物馆所在。南京本地的文史专家和民众常以冶山道院与朝天宫互称。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Mochou Road in Qinhuai District about 1.5 km west of Xinjiekou, a few minutes' walk from Chaotiangong station on Metro Line 5. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 红山森林动物园
summaryEn: A zoo of about 68 hectares spread over three wooded hills in northern Nanjing, Xiao Hongshan, Da Hongshan and Fangniu Shan, which opened in 1998 when the old Xuanwu Lake Zoo moved here. It keeps more than 3,000 animals of over 260 species in hillside enclosures, among them giant pandas, golden snub-nosed monkeys, South China tigers, Asian elephants, giraffes and red-crowned cranes, and runs a rescue centre for injured native wildlife. It ended animal performances in 2011 and stopped visitors feeding the animals in 2014.
description: 南京红山森林动物园位于中华人民共和国江苏省南京市玄武区红山街道和燕路168号，是一座动物园，园区总面积68公顷。现任馆长是沈志军。
accessEn: On Heyan Road about 6 km north of Xinjiekou, next to Hongshan Zoo station on Metro Line 1.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 梅园新村纪念馆
summaryEn: The group of houses in the Meiyuan Xincun residential quarter where the Communist Party delegation led by Zhou Enlai lived and worked from May 1946 to March 1947, during its negotiations with the Nationalist government in Nanjing. The memorial, opened in 1977, takes in the delegation's former offices and residences, an exhibition hall on the Nanjing negotiations opened in 1990, a bronze statue of Zhou Enlai and a Zhou Enlai library opened in 1998.
description: 中国共产党代表团梅园新村纪念馆是纪念以周恩来为首的中国共产党代表团于1946年5月至1947年3月间在南京与国民政府进行和平谈判的专题性纪念馆，位于中华人民共和国江苏省南京市玄武区梅园新村街道长江路东端。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Hanfu Street at the east end of Changjiang Road in Xuanwu District, about 400 m east of the Presidential Palace and 10 minutes' walk from Daxinggong station (Metro Lines 2 and 3). Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
imageCredit: Px820 at Japanese Wikipedia / 権作 / http://px820.onmitsu.jp
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 侵华日军南京大屠杀遇难同胞纪念馆
summaryEn: The memorial museum to the victims of the mass killings carried out by Japanese troops after they captured Nanjing, then China's capital, on 13 December 1937. It stands at Jiangdongmen, where prisoners of war and civilians were killed and buried, and opened in 1985; enlarged in 1995 and 2005, it holds the main historical exhibition, an excavated burial pit with human remains, memorial squares and sculpture, and a peace park. The national listing also covers the other killing and burial sites around the city, most marked by memorial steles erected from 1985 onwards.
description: 侵华日军南京大屠杀遇难同胞纪念馆又称江东门纪念馆，是南京市人民政府为悼念侵华日军南京大屠杀遇难者而设立的遗址型专门史博物馆。馆址位于南京城西南江东门，是当年日军大屠杀的一处主要地点和遇难者丛葬地。纪念馆于1985年落成开放，经过1995年、2005年两次扩建，现占地约7.4万平方米、建筑面积2.5万平方米、展陈面积9800平方米，包括展览集会、遗址悼念、和平公园和馆藏交流等4个区域，其中展览陈列包括广场陈列、遗骨陈列和史料陈列三部分。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Shuiximen Street in Jianye District, about 4.5 km west of Xinjiekou and a short walk from Yunjinlu station on Metro Line 2; visits must be booked in advance with real-name registration. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 莫愁湖公园
summaryEn: A lake park in western Nanjing, west of the Qinhuai River and Hanzhongmen, laid out around Mochou Lake, which takes its name from Mochou, a virtuous young woman of local legend. Halls, pavilions and covered walkways stand among rockeries and trees on the shore, among them the two-storey Shengqi Pavilion, the Yujin Hall and a white marble statue of Mochou beside a lotus pool. By tradition the Ming founder Zhu Yuanzhang gave the lakeside garden to his general Xu Da, and in summer boats can be taken out among the lotus.
description: 莫愁湖古称横塘，因其依石头城，故又称石城湖，是位于中国江苏省南京市城区西南部的一个淡水湖。面积为0.295平方公里，外观呈三角形，是南京市内仅次于玄武湖的第二大城市湖泊。平均水深为1.5米，湖区地势平坦，为封闭性内陆湖泊，2020年曾进行过全湖清淤。
accessEn: On Shuiximen Street in Jianye District, about 3 km west of Xinjiekou; Mochouhu station (Metro Lines 2 and 7) is beside the park.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南京眼
summaryEn: A riverside park area of about 61 hectares on both banks of the Jiajiang, the arm of the Yangtze between Nanjing's Hexi new town and Jiangxinzhou island, taking its name from the Nanjing Eye, a cable-stayed footbridge across the channel. The bridge was completed in 2014 for the Nanjing Youth Olympic Games, described at the time as the first bridge over the Yangtze for pedestrians only, and links the riverside of the Youth Olympic quarter with the Youth Olympic Forest Park on the island. The area is themed on the river landscape and the 2014 Games, and is a place to stroll the riverfront and cross the Yangtze channel on foot.
description: 南京眼步行桥是中华人民共和国江苏省南京市建邺区的一座人行桥，跨过长江夹江连接河西新城与江心洲，为主跨270米的斜拉桥，全长827.5米，是南京河西新城与南京青奥会的配套工程，2014年青奥会前夕建成，也是长江上第一座步行专用桥。
accessEn: At the riverside end of the Hexi new town in Jianye District, about 9 km south-west of Xinjiekou, a taxi ride.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 牛首山
summaryEn: A twin-peaked hill south of Nanjing, a Buddhist centre since the Southern Dynasties and the birthplace of the Niutou school of Chan, redeveloped as a Buddhist cultural park that opened in 2015 to enshrine a relic venerated as part of the Buddha's skull, found in 2008 in the crypt beneath the old Bao'en Temple. The relic is kept in the Usnisa Palace, a vast domed building set into a pit left by iron mining on the west peak, with a hall holding a jade reclining Buddha and a thousand-Buddha hall inside, beside a new nine-storey Tang-style pagoda and the old Hongjue Temple pagoda. Paths also lead to stone ramparts linked to Yue Fei's victory over the Jin here in 1130 and to the tomb of the Ming admiral Zheng He on the southern slopes.
description: 牛首山是位于中国江苏省南京市江宁区的低山丘陵，属于宁镇丘陵西段南支，主峰海拔242.9米，因山顶南北双峰似牛角而得名，又名天阙山，民间又叫牛头山。自南朝起，牛首山一带佛教鼎盛，是佛教牛头禅发祥地，有宏觉寺和始建于唐朝的宏觉寺塔。
accessEn: In Jiangning District about 15 km south of central Nanjing, by taxi or by bus from the metro.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 玄武湖
summaryEn: A lake of about 10 km round just north of the old city, bounded on the west and south by the Ming city wall and looking east to Purple Mountain, which has been an imperial park and pleasure ground since the Six Dynasties. Five islands, Huanzhou, Yingzhou, Lingzhou, Liangzhou and Cuizhou, are linked by causeways and bridges and planted with willows, cherry trees and lotus; in the Ming dynasty the empire's household registers were archived on Liangzhou. It became a public park after Xuanwu Gate (then Fengrun Gate) was opened in the wall in 1909 for the Nanyang Industrial Exposition.
description: 玄武湖位于江苏省南京市玄武区，六朝前称桑泊，曾经是中国最大的皇家园林湖泊，当代仅存的江南皇家园林。与杭州西湖、嘉兴南湖并称“江南三大名湖”。玄武湖公园是江南最大的市内公园。
accessEn: The main entrance, Xuanwu Gate on the west shore, is beside Xuanwumen station on Metro Line 1; Nanjing railway station lies just north of the lake.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 阳山碑材
summaryEn: An ancient stone quarry in the hills near Tangshan where, from 1405, the Yongle Emperor had a vast memorial stele cut for his father's tomb, the Ming Xiaoling, using a huge labour force. The three parts, the tortoise base, the tablet and its crowning head, were never moved because they were far too heavy, and they still lie where they were carved, partly freed from the bedrock; a much smaller stele was set up at the tomb instead. The quarry is the centre of a 4A scenic area branded the Ming Culture Village.
description: 阳山碑材位于中国江苏省南京市江宁区，由3座从山体上开凿出的石材组成。这3座石材开凿于明朝永乐三年，原本做为明孝陵的碑材使用，在开凿时动用了上万名人力，由于工程量巨大，开凿期间也曾出现不小的伤亡。但由于最终开凿出的石材过于巨大而无法搬运，这三座石材也被弃置于原地。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 20 km east of central Nanjing near Tangshan, roughly 40 minutes by car; the Nanjing Man site and the Tangshan hot springs are nearby.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 阅江楼
summaryEn: A seven-storey tower in Ming style on Lion Hill in north-western Nanjing, completed in 2001 to realise a building that the Hongwu Emperor ordered in 1374 but never finished, and which was known for six centuries only through essays such as Song Lian's 'Record of Yuejiang Tower'. From the top there are views north over the Yangtze and south over the city, and inside are murals including scenes of Zheng He's voyages. Lion Hill, inside the Ming city wall near Yijiang Gate, also has old caves said to have hidden troops.
description: 阅江楼位于中国江苏南京古城西北角的狮子山上，临近长江，因明初文学家宋濂所撰《阅江楼记》而闻名。明洪武七年春，明太祖朱元璋决定在京师西北临江的狮子山建一楼阁，主要原因是因为朱元璋在狮子山上指挥数万伏兵，击败了劲敌陈友谅40万人马的强势进攻，为在其称帝前，建立明朝奠定了基础。
accessEn: On Lion Hill off Jianning Road in Gulou District, about 5 km north-west of the Drum Tower and about 800 m from Jinghaisi station on Metro Line 5.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 雨花台
summaryEn: A ridge of low hills just south of Zhonghua Gate, named after a legend that flowers rained from the sky when the monk Yunguang preached here in 503. From 1927 to 1949 it was an execution ground where many Communists and other prisoners were killed, and Japanese war criminals were executed here after the war; since 1950 it has been a memorial park with a martyrs' monument on the main hill, a large sculpture group and a memorial hall. The wider scenic area also holds the tomb of the Ming scholar Fang Xiaoru, the Gaozuo Temple, a museum of the coloured 'rain-flower' pebbles and a spring once ranked second south of the Yangtze.
description: 雨花台烈士陵园位于中华人民共和国江苏省南京市雨花台区，距离中华门约1公里，是雨花台风景区的主体部分。此处是一片丘陵地带，共有5个山岗，高约60米，长约1,000米，面积113公顷。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Just south of Zhonghua Gate in Yuhuatai District; the north gate is about 1 km from Zhonghuamen station on Metro Line 1, and Yuhuatai station on Line 10, opened in 2025, is at the southern side.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 狼山
summaryEn: Langshan is a low hill on the Yangtze shore south of Nantong, the highest of five small hills grouped as a scenic area and counted among China's eight lesser Buddhist mountains. Guangjiao Temple, founded in 669 by the monk Sengjia and dedicated to the bodhisattva Mahasthamaprapta (Dashizhi), spreads its halls from the foot to the summit, which is crowned by the Song-dynasty Zhiyun Pagoda. Old ginkgos, cliff inscriptions and the tomb of the Tang poet Luo Binwang line the climb, and a Catholic pilgrimage church stands on the hill's north side.
description: 狼山，位于江苏省南通市崇川区南郊，是江苏省省级风景名胜区，国家AAAA级旅游区，被称为“江海第一山”。与马鞍山、剑山、军山和黄泥山组成，合称狼五山。为中国佛教八小名山之一，山上有广教寺，同时狼山也是天主教在中国的十二大朝圣地之一。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 8 km south of central Nantong by bus or taxi; stepped paths climb from the temple gate at the foot to the summit.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 水绘园
summaryEn: Shuihui Garden in Rugao was begun by the Mao family in the late Ming and became the home of the scholar Mao Xiang (Mao Pijiang) and the courtesan Dong Xiaowan, whose romance made it famous. Built around water in an Anhui-influenced style, it centres on the Shuiming Lou, a two-storey boat-like pavilion by the Xibo Pond added in the Qianlong era. The wider scenic area also holds a garden of Rugao-style bonsai, including a cypress said to be 1,000 years old, and the Rugao Longevity Museum.
description: 水绘园位于中国江苏省南通市如皋市碧霞路299号，2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。始建于明万历年间，为冒氏所有，明末清初冒襄即居于此，后渐衰败。乾隆时汪之珩在此建水明楼，形成现有格局。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the north-east side of Rugao's old town, about 50 km north-west of Nantong, around an hour by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 方塔
summaryEn: Changshu's 'Square Pagoda' is the surviving pagoda of Chongjiao Xingfu Temple, begun in 1130 and rebuilt in 1272. It is square in plan, with nine storeys of brick and projecting wooden eaves that give it a gently curved outline, and has wooden stairs inside; its ground-floor gallery was destroyed by bombing during the war against Japan. It stands in Fangta Park, a garden laid out on the former temple site at the eastern end of the old town.
description: 方塔位于江苏苏州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、古塔、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the old town of Changshu, a county-level city about 40 km north of central Suzhou and roughly an hour away by road.

name: 黎里古镇
summaryEn: A well-preserved canal town in the south-east of Wujiang near the borders with Shanghai and Zhejiang, laid out as one canal with a street along each bank. Both banks are lined with two-storey Ming and Qing buildings whose shopfronts and halls run on without a break along the water. Among them is the house the poet Liu Yazi rented from 1922, once a Qing minister's mansion and now a memorial museum.
description: 黎里镇是中国江苏省苏州市吴江区所辖的9个镇之一，东接上海市，南邻嘉兴市。黎里镇是一座保存较好的典型江南古镇。镇为一河两街，两岸保存下来的大多是明清建筑的二层楼房，铺面店堂毗连相接。
accessEn: In Lili town, Wujiang district, about 45 km south-east of central Suzhou by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 狮子林
summaryEn: A garden founded in 1342 by disciples of the Chan monk Tianru as part of a Buddhist monastery, named after its Taihu rocks, which are said to look like lions. Its centre is a huge labyrinth of rockery, with paths, tunnels and caves that climb and twist so that visitors can see each other but take a long way round to meet; halls and a pavilion in the lake surround it. In 1917 it was bought by Bei Runsheng, a great-uncle of the architect I. M. Pei, and it is part of the Classical Gardens of Suzhou World Heritage Site.
description: 狮子林位于中国江苏省苏州市姑苏区平江街道园林路23号，毗邻太平天国忠王府和拙政园，占地1.1公顷，开放面积0.88公顷，是苏州四大名园之一。已被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位和世界文化遗产——苏州古典园林项目。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Yuanlin Road in the north-east of Suzhou's old city, a few minutes' walk from the Humble Administrator's Garden and the Suzhou Museum.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 甪直古镇
summaryEn: A canal town east of Suzhou whose old quarter keeps Ming- and Qing-style houses along its waterways and many old stone bridges, a few from the Song and Ming dynasties; in 2003 it was named one of China's first historic and cultural towns. Its centrepiece is Baosheng Temple, founded in 503, where the surviving clay arhats of an original set of eighteen are kept in a hall built for them around 1930; tradition credits them to the Tang sculptor Yang Huizhi, while the national listing dates them to the Northern Song. The temple grounds also hold the tomb of the Tang poet Lu Guimeng, who lived here in retirement.
description: 甪直古镇，古称“甫里”(依本地方言音读puli)，是苏州吴中区甪直镇的一个古镇区，是一个国家AAAA级旅游景点。甪直古镇的民居保留明清风格，禁止拆改，区内禁止设工厂、盖新式高楼，禁止汽车、摩托车通行。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 25 km east of central Suzhou in Wuzhong district, around 40 minutes by road; buses run from Suzhou and Kunshan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 网师园
summaryEn: A small residential garden first laid out in the Southern Song as an official's library retreat and rebuilt in the Qianlong era by Song Zongyuan, who renamed it after the fisherman, the 'master of the nets', as a symbol of the simple life. Halls, galleries, a rockery and a pavilion are fitted closely around a central pond, with the family residence to the east and a quiet inner courtyard to the west. That courtyard, Dianchun Yi, was the model for the Ming Xuan court built at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York; the garden is part of the Classical Gardens of Suzhou World Heritage Site.
description: 网师园位于江苏省苏州市姑苏区阔家头巷11号，始建于南宋时期，原本只是取名叫“渔隐”的小型私人花园，经过多次修建，清朝乾隆时期，改名为网师园。1982年，列为第二批全国重点文物保护单位。1997年，与其它三座苏州古典园林一同被列为世界文化遗产。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Kuojiatou Lane in the south-east of Suzhou's old city, about 1 km east of the Canglang Pavilion.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 木渎古镇
summaryEn: An old canal town at the foot of Lingyan Hill on Suzhou's western edge, named a national historic and cultural town in 2005, which the Qianlong Emperor visited six times and which fills half of the 18th-century scroll Prosperous Suzhou. Its main sights are restored private gardens and houses: the Yan Family Garden, rebuilt by Xiangshan craftsmen after 1902 and the birthplace of Yen Chia-kan, later president of the Republic of China on Taiwan, the Old Pine Garden and Hongyin Shanfang, a residence associated with Qianlong's visits.
description: 木渎古镇位于江苏苏州。游览特色包括古镇、运河。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 12 km west of central Suzhou in Wuzhong district, by bus or taxi.

name: 盘门
summaryEn: The only original gate left from Suzhou's city wall, a combined land and water gate at the south-west corner of the old city where the moat meets the Grand Canal; the present gate was built in 1351 under the Yuan, with a square barbican added in 1356, and it is a component of the Grand Canal World Heritage Site. The scenic area also takes in Wumen Bridge, a tall single-arch stone bridge over the moat rebuilt in 1872, and Ruiguang Pagoda, a seven-storey octagonal pagoda whose brick body dates from the early 11th century. Relics of the Five Dynasties and early Song were found inside the pagoda in 1978.
description: 盘门是位于苏州城南面城墙上偏西的一座水陆城门，门前临古老的京杭大运河，是苏州仅存的古城门遗迹和中国唯一保存完整的古水陆城门。春秋吴国阖闾元年，吴王阖闾命伍子胥所筑吴国都城——阖闾城。盘门即是当时的8座城门之一，因门上悬有木制蟠龙，以震慑南面的越国，最初称为蟠门。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the south-west corner of Suzhou's old city beside the outer moat, a short taxi or bus ride from the centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 千灯古镇
summaryEn: An old canal town south of Kunshan, threaded by a stone-slab street. Its landmark is the Qinfeng Pagoda, a slender seven-storey brick-and-timber pagoda whose founding is traditionally dated to 503, restored to its Song appearance in 1994 and closed to climbers since 2007. The town was the birthplace of the Ming–Qing scholar Gu Yanwu, whose five-courtyard family house, shrine and tomb form one site, and the home of Gu Jian, credited with founding Kunqu opera, who has a memorial hall here.
description: 千灯镇，属于中国江苏省苏州市昆山市，位于昆山市市区以南15公里处。千灯旧称千墩浦，1910年建乡，称茜墩乡，1950年设镇，1966年改为现名，2003年原石浦镇并入千灯镇。千灯镇是中国历史文化名镇，国家4A级旅游景区，东与上海市青浦区接壤，面积84平方公里，人口约13万人。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 15 km south of central Kunshan and 40 km east of Suzhou, by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 山塘街
summaryEn: A canal street in north-west Suzhou that follows the Shantang canal, dug in 825 under the poet and prefect Bai Juyi to link Changmen gate with Tiger Hill; street and canal run for 'seven li' (about 3.8 km), the source of its nickname. Its eastern section is lined with restored old houses, guild halls and small museums, with stone bridges over the canal. Burnt in 1860 and rebuilt, the street so pleased the Qianlong Emperor that he had a copy, Suzhou Street, built at the Summer Palace in Beijing.
description: 七里山塘又名七狸山塘，正式名称为山塘街，是江苏苏州姑苏区一条有将近1200年历史的步行街，西起虎丘山下席场弄，东到阊门外古运河上的渡僧桥，全长3829.6米。
accessEn: In the north-west of Suzhou just outside the old city; the busy restored section starts near Changmen gate, and the street leads on to Tiger Hill.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 沙溪古镇
summaryEn: An old market town on the Qipu River in the middle of Taicang, named a national historic and cultural town of China in 2005. Its long old street runs beside the river, lined with Qing-era houses with carved doors and windows and stone steps down to the water, and old stone arch bridges of the Ming and Qing cross the river.
description: 沙溪古镇位于江苏苏州。游览特色包括古镇、桥梁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shaxi town in central Taicang, about 13 km north of Taicang's city centre and about 50 km from Shanghai Hongqiao Airport by road.

name: 天池山·花山
summaryEn: Two wooded hills west of Suzhou, Tianchi Mountain and Huashan, which with the neighbouring Baixiangwan valley form one scenic area inside the Dongwu National Forest Park. On Tianchi Mountain stands Jijian Temple, founded in 1357, whose Yuan-dynasty stone hall and two flanking stone shrines are carved to imitate timber buildings and set against the cliff, with Yuan Buddha figures in their niches. The area suits a half-day hill walk combined with the temple.
description: 天池山·花山位于江苏苏州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the hills north-west of Mudu, about 15 km west of central Suzhou, best reached by taxi.

name: 天平山
summaryEn: A low hill on Suzhou's western outskirts, long linked with the Song statesman Fan Zhongyan, whose ancestors are buried here and who is honoured in a memorial hall. It is known for three things: its oddly shaped rocks, its springs and its red maples, which draw crowds in autumn.
description: 天平山，古称白云山，又名赐山，是位于苏州市西南部的一座小山，海拔201米。此山东南为金山，南面是灵岩山，西北则为天池山，北方是寒山岭和观音山。此地是范仲淹祖先的归葬之地，并建有范仲淹纪念馆。
accessEn: About 12 km west of central Suzhou, north of Mudu, by taxi or bus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 震泽古镇
summaryEn: A former silk town in the south-west of Wujiang on the Zhejiang border, a national historic and cultural town whose old quarter centres on Baota Street. Its landmark is the pagoda of Ciyun Temple on that street, a six-sided, five-storey brick-and-timber tower, mostly Ming in date, which alone survived when the temple was burnt in the wars of the 1850s; the temple has since been partly restored. Nearby is Shijian Hall, a merchant family's compound that combines a rice warehouse on the water, shops, living quarters and a small garden.
description: 震泽古镇位于江苏苏州。游览特色包括古镇、寺庙建筑、古塔。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About an hour by road south of central Suzhou, in Zhenze town in the far south-west of Wujiang district.

name: 中国宜兴陶瓷博物馆
summaryEn: One of China's earliest specialist ceramics museums, at the foot of Xianhe Hill in Dingshu, Yixing's pottery town, and since 2013 also designated the China Zisha Museum. Its displays run from Neolithic pottery, Han glazed wares and Jin celadon through Song and Yuan Jun-style pottery to Ming and Qing purple-clay (zisha) teapots and modern work, with a gallery for the master potter Gu Jingzhou and studios where visitors can try making pottery.
description: 中国宜兴陶瓷博物馆，又称中国紫砂博物馆，是位于江苏省宜兴市丁蜀镇仙鹤山麓的陶瓷专业博物馆。馆区依山而筑，气势宏伟。博物馆建筑面积20000多平方米，展馆3000多平方米。
accessEn: In Dingshu town about 11 km south of central Yixing, by taxi or bus. Closed on Monday mornings except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东林书院
summaryEn: A Confucian academy in central Wuxi founded in 1111, where the Song scholar Yang Shi taught, and revived in the early 1600s by Gu Xiancheng and Gao Panlong, whose circle of scholar-officials criticised court politics and became known as the Donglin faction. Destroyed in 1626 and rebuilt under the Qing, it keeps a stone memorial archway, the Lize and Yiyong lecture halls and the Daonan Shrine to Yang Shi, with Gu's well-known couplet about caring for 'the affairs of family, state and world'.
description: 东林书院位于江苏无锡。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、书院文化。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In central Wuxi on Jiefang East Road, a short walk east of the Chong'an Temple quarter.

name: 薛福成故居
summaryEn: The mansion that the late-Qing diplomat and reformer Xue Fucheng, envoy to Britain, France, Italy and Belgium, had built in Wuxi's old city between 1890 and 1894, known by its imperial name plaque as the Qinshidi, the 'Imperial Envoy's Residence'. Covering more than 2 hectares, it is one of the largest surviving late-19th-century official residences in Jiangsu, laid out on three parallel axes with a screen wall, reception halls, a two-storey 'turntable' building, a theatre stage, granaries, a library tower and a rear garden.
description: 薛福成故居建筑群，又名“钦使第”，为近代中国著名思想家、外交家、维新派代表人物薛福成及家眷的居所。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Xueqian Street in Wuxi's old city, about 1 km south-west of the centre, on foot or by taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 蠡园
summaryEn: A lakeside garden on the north shore of Lihu Lake, created between 1927 and 1936 by the Wang family of Qingqi village and joined in 1952 with the neighbouring Yuzhuang garden of 1930 to form a public park. Water covers much of its 8.2 hectares, with rockeries, a long waterside corridor, a lake pavilion and four pavilions planted for the four seasons, and its name recalls the legend that the Yue minister Fan Li went boating here with Xi Shi.
description: 蠡园是一座位于中国江苏省无锡市滨湖区的国家AAAA级风景区，因地处蠡湖北岸而得名。蠡湖则因春秋时越国大夫范蠡而得名，相传春秋时期，越国大夫范蠡帮助越王灭吴之后，曾携佳人西施于此泛舟。
accessEn: On Lihu Lake about 8 km south-west of central Wuxi, by taxi or bus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 清名桥古运河
summaryEn: A stretch of the old Grand Canal south of Wuxi's former city wall, lined with old waterside houses along Nanchang Street and Nanxiatang and crossed by the humpbacked Qingming Bridge, first built in the Ming dynasty and last rebuilt in 1869. Restored from 2007 and reopened in 2011, the district is part of the Grand Canal World Heritage Site; alongside its shops and creative businesses are museums in old industrial buildings, including the China Silk Industry Museum in the former Yongtai silk mill, and the remains of the brick kilns along Dayao Road.
description: 清名桥古运河街区，又称清名桥历史街区，位于中国江苏无锡市梁溪区，是大运河畔的江南水乡，被称为“江南水弄堂，运河绝版地”。街区由南长街、京杭大运河无锡段、南下塘、伯渎港、大窑路一带等具有丰富历史文化底蕴的区域组成。
accessEn: In Liangxi district about 2.5 km south-east of central Wuxi; the north end of Nanchang Street is a short walk from Nanchan Temple station on Metro Line 1 (Qingming Bridge station is not near the district).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 善卷洞
summaryEn: A karst cave in Luoyan Hill near Zhangzhu, the first of Yixing's 'three wonders' among its caves, with upper, middle and lower chambers full of stalactites and a water cave where boats follow an underground river. The scenic area is tied to the Butterfly Lovers legend of Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai, with a Tang inscription marking 'Zhu Yingtai's study', and nearby at the foot of Guoshan stands the Guoshan Stele, a cylindrical stone carved in seal script in 276 to record the sacrifices to heaven and earth held there for the Wu ruler Sun Hao.
description: 善卷洞，位于中国江苏省宜兴市张渚镇螺岩山，距宜兴市区20公里。相传虞舜要将天下禅让给自己的老师善卷，善卷拒绝，隐居于此洞内而得名。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Near Zhangzhu town about 20 km south-west of central Yixing, by road; a sightseeing cable car runs up the hill.
imageCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Whw assumed (based on copyright claims).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 无锡博物院
summaryEn: The city's main museum, opened in 2008 in a large steel-framed building beside Taihu Square, which merged the old Wuxi Museum with the city's revolutionary and science museums. Its collection of nearly 40,000 objects is strongest in Ming and Qing painting and calligraphy, and the displays also cover local history, Yixing purple-clay teapots, Huishan clay figurines and Wuxi's industry, with a bronze sword of King Liao of Wu among the highlights.
description: 无锡博物院为中国江苏省无锡市的市立博物馆，为国家一级博物馆、全国八大藏画馆之一。无锡博物院由原无锡博物馆、无锡革命陈列馆和无锡科普馆三馆合并而成，馆址位于梁溪区太湖广场南侧、钟书路北侧，建筑采用全钢架结构，地下二层、地上五层，建筑面积71000平方米，采用了“水光石色”的设计理念。
accessEn: On Zhongshu Road beside Taihu Square, about 3 km south of central Wuxi, near Taihu Square station on Metro Line 1. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 梅园
summaryEn: A hillside garden west of Wuxi begun in 1912 by the industrialist Rong Desheng, who planted some 3,000 plum trees around his family villa; it is one of the best-known places in the Jiangnan region to see plum blossom in late winter and early spring. Paths climb past pavilions, a nanmu-wood hall and the three-storey Nianqu Pagoda, built by the Rong brothers in 1930 in memory of their mother, to the 1930s Kaiyuan Temple; Rong Yiren gave the garden to the state in 1955 and it was later extended onto neighbouring Hengshan hill.
description: 荣氏梅园，简称梅园，位于中国江苏省无锡市滨湖区荣巷街道梁溪西路卞家湾13号，距市区7公里。原是清朝进士徐殿一的“小桃园”旧址。1912年，荣氏梅园被无锡企业家荣德生购得，以“为天下布芳馨”的宗旨，植梅3000株，堪比小香雪海，取名“梅园”。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Liangxi West Road about 7 km west of central Wuxi, by bus or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龟山汉墓
summaryEn: The joint tomb of Liu Zhu, sixth king of Chu in the Western Han dynasty, and his queen, cut side by side into the west face of Guishan hill on Xuzhou's north-western edge and identified in 1985 from the king's silver seal. Two narrow passages about 56 m long, with finely smoothed walls, lead to fifteen rock-hewn rooms including bedchambers, a kitchen, a well, a carriage room and a toilet, which visitors can walk through; a museum opened at the site in 1993.
description: 龟山汉楚王墓，位于中华人民共和国江苏省徐州市鼓楼区境内的龟山西麓，1981年2月于采石过程中被发现，1981年至1982年南京博物院对其进行两次发掘清理。1985年征集到墓中出土的墓主银印，遂确认该墓为西汉第六代楚王襄王刘注的夫妻合葬墓。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 7 km north-west of central Xuzhou in Gulou district; by taxi or city bus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 淮海战役烈士纪念塔
summaryEn: A memorial park on the southern side of central Xuzhou honouring soldiers of the People's Liberation Army killed in the Huaihai Campaign of November 1948 to January 1949, one of the decisive campaigns of the Chinese Civil War. Its centrepiece is a 38.15 m obelisk completed in 1965 and inscribed in Mao Zedong's calligraphy, and the grounds also hold the Huaihai Campaign Memorial Hall, whose exhibitions cover the campaign.
description: 淮海战役烈士纪念塔位于中国江苏省徐州市的凤凰山东，上面刻有毛泽东题字的“淮海战役烈士纪念塔”九个字，为纪念淮海战役中牺牲的中国人民解放军烈士而建。塔高38.15米。1959年决定开始兴建，1960年开工至1965年完工开放。
accessEn: About 3 km south of the city centre in Quanshan district, next to Pengzu Park; Huaita station on metro lines 2 and 3 is about 600 m away.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 徐州博物馆
summaryEn: Xuzhou's main history museum, a national first-class museum at the northern foot of Yunlong Mountain, best known for finds from the rock-cut tombs of the Western Han kings of Chu, among them a jade burial suit sewn with gold thread. Its grounds take in the excavated Han-dynasty quarry where stone was cut from the hillside, part of the national heritage unit of the Chu king tombs, and the surviving main hall of a palace built for the Qianlong Emperor's southern tour of 1757.
description: 徐州博物馆位于中国江苏省徐州市云龙区和平路101号，城区内云龙山与户部山之间。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Heping Road in central Xuzhou, about 400 m from Shida Yunlong Xiaoqu station on metro line 2 and an easy walk from Hubu Hill; visits are booked online in advance with real names. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 新四军纪念馆
summaryEn: A museum opened in 1986 on Jianjun East Road about the New Fourth Army, the Communist-led army that fought the Japanese in central China and had its headquarters re-established in Yancheng in 1941 after the Wannan Incident. Its galleries draw on a collection of more than 10,000 wartime relics, documents and artworks, and the memorial also looks after the former headquarters at Taishan Temple across town. It is listed among China's national memorial sites of the War of Resistance against Japan.
description: 新四军纪念馆，位于中华人民共和国江苏省盐城市亭湖区建军东路159号，是展现新四军抗战历史的综合性博物馆。1986年正式开馆。2001年6月11日，获列中共中央宣传部公布的第二批全国爱国主义教育示范基地名单。
accessEn: On Jianjun East Road in central Yancheng, about 3 km north-west of Yancheng railway station; city bus or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大明寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple on the Shugang hills, founded in the Daming era (457–464) that gave it its name, where the monk Jianzhen taught before his voyages to Japan, which he finally reached in 753 after five failed attempts. Its sights include the Jianzhen Memorial Hall, designed by Liang Sicheng after the main hall of Tōshōdai-ji and completed in 1973, Pingshan Hall, built in 1048 by the Song writer Ouyang Xiu, the nine-storey Qiling Pagoda, rebuilt in 1995, and a spring in the West Garden once ranked fifth in China for making tea.
description: 大明寺位于中国江苏省扬州市蜀冈风景区之中峰，曾是鉴真居住和讲学之所，古有“扬州第一名胜”之说。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the Shugang hills about 4 km north-west of Yangzhou's old city, near the northern end of Slender West Lake; bus or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东关街
summaryEn: A 1,122 m flagstone street that ran from the Great East Gate of Yangzhou's old city to Dongguan by the canal, once one of the city's busiest trading streets. It keeps long-established shops such as the Simei pickle shop and the Xie Fuchun cosmetics shop, and along it or just off it are Ge Garden, Yipu, Wang Xiaoyuan and the rebuilt Xiaolinglong Shanguan garden. It was named one of China's famous historic streets in 2010, and the restoration of its houses and gardens won a UNESCO Asia-Pacific Award of Excellence for heritage conservation in 2023.
description: 东关街是中国江苏省扬州市广陵区的一条东西向街道，全长1122米，宽约5米。此街在昔日西通扬州旧城大东门，东面直抵新城东关，曾是一条颇为繁盛的街道，至今保留不少商业老字号，例如著名的四美酱园、谢馥春香粉店、绿杨春等。
accessEn: In the north-east of Yangzhou's old city, running from Guoqing Road east to the old canal; easy to walk from Ge Garden.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 何园
summaryEn: A large late-Qing residence and garden, also called Jixiao Shanzhuang, built from 1862 to 1875 by He Zhidao, a former circuit intendant in Hubei, who added the older Pianshi Shanfang garden in 1883. A two-storey covered walkway links the halls of the house with the garden, and buildings with Western details stand among classical rockeries and ponds; the rockery of Pianshi Shanfang is attributed to the painter Shitao. In China it is often called 'the foremost garden of the late Qing'.
description: 何园，又名寄啸山庄，位于中华人民共和国江苏省扬州市徐凝门大街66号，被誉为“晚清第一园”。1988年列为第三批全国重点文物保护单位。同时还是国家AAAA级旅游景区以及国家重点公园。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Xuningmen Street in the south-east of Yangzhou's old city, a few minutes' walk from the Lu residence and Xiaopangu.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 运河三湾
summaryEn: In 1597 Yangzhou's prefect Guo Guangfu replaced a straight stretch of the canal, nearly 200 m long, with a 1.8 km course of three bends to raise the water level and slow the current; after 2014 factories and wharves were cleared from its banks, which reopened in 2017 as a wetland park. Its centrepiece is the China Grand Canal Museum, opened in June 2021 in a ship-shaped building designed by Zhang Jinqiu, with the Dayun Pagoda beside it. The galleries cover the whole canal, from a 25.7 m section of riverbed lifted from the Zhouqiao site on the Bian canal to a restored Qing passenger boat and a recreated canal-town street.
description: 扬州中国大运河博物馆，简称“运博”，位于中国江苏省扬州市运河三湾生态文化公园，是一座现代化综合性大运河主题博物馆。该博物馆的主要功能是文物保护、科研展陈、社会教育。博物馆由扬州建设，南京博物院运营，占地约200亩，总面积约8万平方米，展陈面积约1.8万平方米，内设11个专题展览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the old canal about 3 km south of Yangzhou's old city centre; several city bus routes stop at the museum. The museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 宋夹城
summaryEn: The Jiacheng was a walled enclosure the Southern Song built between Yangzhou's main city and the fortress on the Shugang hills; its earthen walls, about 2.6 km round and still 1–3 m above the surrounding ground, are ringed by water and now form a park with paths and the excavated north gate. It is one of the visible parts of the Yangzhou City Ruins, the overlapping Sui, Tang and Song cities protected as one national site, whose other display points include the West Gate ruins museum of the Song city on Siwangting Road and the Tang City Ruins Museum on the Shugang, built over the site of the Sui emperor's Jiangdu palace.
description: 宋夹城位于江苏扬州。游览特色包括城堡、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Just east of the northern part of Slender West Lake, about 3 km north of Yangzhou's old city centre; bus or taxi.

name: 文游台
summaryEn: A group of halls in the north of Gaoyou that began in 976 as a temple to the god of Mount Tai. Its name, 'Terrace of Literary Outings', recalls a gathering in 1084 when Su Dongpo, passing through, met the Gaoyou poet Qin Guan and the scholars Sun Jue and Wang Gong here to drink and talk about literature. The core of the site is a provincial heritage unit and one of the traditional Eight Views of Gaoyou.
description: 文游台，位于江苏省扬州市高邮市人民路507号，是中华人民共和国江苏省文物保护单位之一。1995年4月19日，授予江苏省文物保护单位，是一座古建筑及历史纪念建筑物。
accessEn: Near Wenyou Middle Road in the north of Gaoyou town, about 45 km north of Yangzhou (around an hour by road).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 扬州博物馆
summaryEn: Yangzhou's main museum shares a modern building beside Mingyue Lake with the China Block Printing Museum, so the pair is known locally as the 'Double Museum'; both opened here in 2005. The galleries trace the city's history from the Neolithic to the late Qing, with special emphasis on woodblock printing and shipbuilding. The best-known piece is a Yuan-dynasty blue-glazed vase with a white dragon, one of only three known.
description: 扬州博物馆，又称扬州双博馆，由扬州中国雕版印刷博物馆和扬州博物馆新馆组成，位于中国江苏省扬州市邗江区文昌西路。最重点为印刷史和造船史的演绎，以及元代蟠龙瓶。兼有隋炀帝下江南的介绍。
accessEn: On Wenchang West Road facing Mingyue Lake, about 6 km west of Yangzhou's old city centre; a short bus or taxi ride.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 盂城驿
summaryEn: The largest relay station on the Ming–Qing Grand Canal, founded in 1375 beside the canal at Gaoyou to keep post horses and boats and lodge officials; it burned in 1557, was rebuilt in 1568 and was repaired several times under the Qing. The restored complex includes the Huanghua Hall where officials were received, the Zhujie Hall with Ming beams and columns, and a three-storey drum tower, and it houses a museum of China's postal relay system. It is part of the Grand Canal World Heritage Site.
description: 盂城驿位于中国江苏省高邮市高邮街道馆驿巷，京杭大运河东侧，是明清时大运河沿线规模最大的驿站。驿站名中的盂城二字是高邮的别称，取自秦观的《送孙诚之尉北海》“吾乡如覆盂，地处扬楚脊。”一句。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Guanyi Lane by the Grand Canal at the south end of Gaoyou's old town, about 45 km north of Yangzhou (around an hour by road).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 宝华山隆昌寺
summaryEn: Mount Baohua, a forested hill just east of Nanjing, is a national forest park whose main sight is Longchang Temple, founded in 502 and regarded as the ancestral seat of the Vinaya (monastic discipline) school of Chinese Buddhism. Its protected buildings are a copper hall and two brick 'beamless' halls built in 1605, and the temple also keeps its ordination platform and ginkgo trees about 400 years old.
description: 隆昌寺位于江苏镇江句容宝华山，距离南京城东中山门23公里。始建于南朝梁天监元年，初名宝志公庵。曾名千华寺、千华社，明万历33年明神宗赐“护国圣化隆昌寺”额，遂名“隆昌寺”。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Baohua town, about 25 km east of Nanjing's Zhongshan Gate by road (around 40 minutes).
imageCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Px820~commonswiki assumed (based on copyright claims)
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 镇江博物馆
summaryEn: Zhenjiang's city museum has occupied the former British consulate since 1958: five colonial-style verandah buildings of 1889–90 on the slope above Xijindu, rebuilt after the first consulate was burned in riots in 1888. Its collection of nearly 30,000 objects is strongest in bronzes of the Wu state, Six Dynasties celadon, Tang gold and silver, Song silks and paintings of the local Jingjiang school.
description: 镇江英国领事馆旧址位于江苏省镇江市西津渡古街五十三坡上，面对大西路和伯先路。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Boxian Road at the foot of Xijindu Ancient Street, about 2 km north of Zhenjiang railway station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 超山
summaryEn: A low hill on the plain north-east of Hangzhou, famous for centuries for its plum trees and made popular by poets and artists in the late Qing and early Republican years. Around the Damingtang hall at its foot are the Song Plum Pavilion and the tomb and memorial hall of Wu Changshuo, first president of the Xiling Seal Society, and paths climb past the Miaoxi and Yuxi temples to a 'stone forest' of rocks on the summit.
description: 超山，又名超然山，位于中华人民共和国浙江省杭州市临平区塘栖镇南部，属天目山余脉。《唐栖志》等旧志称其超然于皋亭、黄鹤诸山之外故称超山，《中国名胜词典》称其因塘栖与临平间最高的一座山故名，《杭县志稿》称超山为塘栖的镇山。
accessEn: About 6 km south of Tangxi and roughly 30 km north-east of central Hangzhou, about 45 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中国丝绸博物馆
summaryEn: A national museum of silk and textiles south of West Lake at the foot of Yuhuang Hill, opened in 1992 and rebuilt and enlarged in 2015–16. Its galleries trace Chinese silk and dress from Neolithic finds to the 20th century, with a weaving workshop, displays on sericulture and silk crafts (on UNESCO's intangible heritage list since 2009) and a textile conservation gallery, and it has held a Chinese costume festival every year since 2018.
description: 中国丝绸博物馆位于中国浙江省杭州市上城区玉皇山路73-1号(近南山路)，是第一座全国性的丝绸专业博物馆，也是世界上最大的丝绸博物馆。
accessEn: On Yuhuangshan Road about 1 km south of Leifeng Pagoda, by bus or taxi from the lakeshore.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 京杭大运河杭州段
summaryEn: The southern end of the Beijing–Hangzhou Grand Canal, part of the Grand Canal World Heritage Site since 2014, runs through northern Hangzhou, and its landmark is Gongchen Bridge, a three-arch stone bridge 92 m long first built in 1631 and rebuilt in 1885. Around the bridge are the canal-side streets of the Qiaoxi historic quarter and the Grand Canal Museum on Canal Culture Square. Further south along the canal stands Fuyi Granary, built in 1880–84 to store tribute grain and now Hangzhou's only surviving canal granary.
description: 京杭大运河杭州段位于浙江杭州。游览特色包括博物馆、运河、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Gongshu District about 8 km north of West Lake, a short walk from Gongchenqiao East station on Metro Line 5; Fuyi Granary is about 3 km south along the canal.

name: 径山
summaryEn: Jingshan Temple, on the summit area of Mount Jing in north-western Yuhang, was founded in 745 and in the Southern Song ranked first among the 'Five Mountains', the leading Chan Buddhist monasteries. It is honoured in Japan as one of the ancestral temples of Zen and in China as one of the birthplaces of tea culture. The present buildings were rebuilt on the old site from 1994, and the scenic area also takes in the old Jingshan path and the bell tower with a Southern Song imperial stele and a Ming bell.
description: 径山寺，全称径山万寿禅寺，位于中华人民共和国浙江省杭州市余杭区径山镇径山山顶，属汉传佛教临济宗。径山寺始建于唐代，唐天宝四年牛头宗径山法钦禅师开山，大历三年唐代宗诏令兴建禅寺。北宋苏轼任杭州知府时，改径山寺传承为十方丛林制，至南宋径山寺位列五山十刹之首，明代废除丛林后径山寺逐渐衰弱。
accessEn: In Jingshan town about 50 km by road north-west of central Hangzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 雷峰塔
summaryEn: A pagoda on Sunset Hill on the south shore of West Lake, rebuilt in 2002 over the ruins of the brick tower that the Wuyue king Qian Chu completed in the 970s and that collapsed in 1924. The new steel-framed tower, reached by escalators and served by lifts, preserves the base of the original inside, and the pagoda is famous as the prison of the White Lady in the Legend of the White Snake.
description: 雷峰塔原名皇妃塔，文献及民间亦名黄妃塔、王妃塔、黄皮塔，原为五代吴越王钱俶所建供养舍利的佛塔，位于今中华人民共和国浙江省杭州市西湖区西湖南岸净慈寺前雷峰之上，与北岸宝石山上的保俶塔南北对峙、遥相呼应。
accessEn: On the south shore of West Lake opposite Jingci Temple, about 3 km by road from the lakeside centre at Hubin.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天目山
summaryEn: A forested mountain in western Lin'an, about 80 km west of Hangzhou, whose West Tianmu peak (1,506 m) and its slopes have been a national nature reserve since 1986 and a UNESCO biosphere reserve since 1996. It is known for giant Japanese cedars, one of them named 'Giant Tree King' by the Qianlong Emperor, old ginkgos, waterfalls and temples, among them Chanyuan Temple at the foot of the mountain.
description: 天目山在浙江省西北部，东北-西南走向，东起湖州，临太湖平原，西延浙皖交界处，遥望黄山。长200公里，宽约60公里。天目山由粗面岩和流纹岩等构成。
accessEn: Above Tianmushan town, about 30 km by road west of central Lin'an.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 塘栖古镇
summaryEn: A canal town on the Grand Canal north of Hangzhou, often spelt Tangqi, which grew into one of the richest market towns of the Jiangnan region in the Ming and Qing dynasties. Its landmark is Guangji Bridge, a seven-arch stone bridge over the canal rebuilt in 1489, and the old town keeps a Qianlong-era imperial stele, an ancient well and the riverside Shuibei street. The area is also known for its loquats and local pastries.
description: 塘栖镇是中华人民共和国浙江省杭州市临平区下辖的镇。全镇总面积79平方公里，总人口9.9051万人。地处杭嘉湖平原南端，为江南水乡名镇。
accessEn: About 20 km north of central Hangzhou, roughly 45 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 湘湖·跨湖桥
summaryEn: A lake in Xiaoshan south of the Qiantang River, first dammed as an irrigation reservoir in 1112 and later largely filled in by brickworks, which was dredged and landscaped in stages between 2006 and 2016 as a lakeside park and resort area. On its south shore the Kuahuqiao Site Museum, opened in 2009, presents a Neolithic village of about 8,000 to 7,000 years ago, including a pine dugout canoe that is the oldest yet found in China, kept in a hall over the excavation.
description: 湘湖是一个位于中华人民共和国浙江省杭州市萧山区西南部的潟湖，面积约为1平方千米。湘湖景区是国家4A级旅游景区。附近设有杭州地铁1号线湘湖站。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xiaoshan District about 15 km south of West Lake; Xianghu station, the southern end of Metro Line 1, is at the north end of the lake, about 3 km from the museum.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 严子陵钓台
summaryEn: A riverside hill on the Fuchun River south of Tonglu, honouring Yan Guang (Yan Ziling), a first-century scholar who refused office from his old schoolfellow Emperor Guangwu of Han and retired here to fish. Visitors arrive by boat to see a stone memorial archway, a garden of inscribed steles with poems and essays about the place, and the Shrine of Mr Yan, first founded by Fan Zhongyan in the Northern Song.
description: 严子陵钓台位于浙江杭州。游览特色包括滨水景观、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 15 km south of Tonglu town on the Fuchun River; there is no road to the terrace itself, so visitors board the scenic area's boats at its visitor hall.

name: 飞英塔
summaryEn: Huzhou's 'pagoda within a pagoda': a stone relic pagoda of 884–894 enclosed from the Northern Song in an outer brick-and-timber pagoda, rebuilt after a lightning fire in the Southern Song and restored in the 1980s. It stands in Feiying Park in the old city, one of five sights of the Gucheng scenic area with Lotus Villa, the garden of the Yuan painter Zhao Mengfu rebuilt in 1986, the China Huzhou Writing Brush Museum and the former home of the revolutionary Chen Qimei.
description: 飞英塔位于浙江省湖州市内塔下街。始建于中国唐朝中和四年并于乾宁元年完工，最初仅有一座舍利石塔。北宋开宝年间，舍利石塔外面加盖了一座砖木塔，是为今天的飞英塔，同时是中国境内现存唯一一座塔中塔。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Huzhou's old city, about 8 km (20 minutes by taxi) from Huzhou station; Lotus Villa and the brush museum are 1.7 km to the south.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 江南天池
summaryEn: The upper reservoir of the Tianhuangping pumped-storage power station, a lake held on a mountain top in southern Anji, with the power plant itself hidden in caverns deep inside the mountain. An 18 km hairpin road climbs to it through bamboo forest, and the lake gives wide views over the hills of southern Anji.
description: 江南天池位于浙江湖州。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km south of Anji town, roughly 40 minutes by mountain road via Tianhuangping.
imageCredit: JiangNanTianChi_1.jpg: Farm JiangNanTianChi_2.jpg: Farm derivative work: Doctoroftcm (talk

name: 新四军苏浙军区旧址
summaryEn: In 1944–45 the Communist-led New Fourth Army made the hill villages around Huaikan, in north-western Changxing, the base of its Jiangsu–Zhejiang Military Region, which was formally set up at Wentang village in February 1945 with Su Yu as commander. Fifteen former command and support sites are protected as a group, and a memorial hall on the site of the First Column headquarters presents the history of the base.
description: 新四军苏浙军区旧址位于浙江省湖州市长兴县槐坎乡温塘村，有“江南小延安”之称。1945年2月5日，苏浙军区成立大会在旧址前的大操场上召开。1961年，列入浙江省文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Wentang village in Meishan town (formerly Huaikan), about 28 km west of Changxing station, roughly 40 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 太湖溇港
summaryEn: The lougang are hundreds of small channels and larger waterways cut from the Spring and Autumn period onward through the southern shore of Taihu Lake, which with cross-dykes and polder fields drained the land and regulated the lake; the network is best preserved in Wuxing and was listed as a World Heritage Irrigation Structure in 2016. Visits centre on Yigao, an old village strung along its channel near the lake, with stone bridges, a Lougang culture exhibition hall, cafés and guesthouses.
description: 太湖溇港是太湖东南岸一组水利系统的统称，曾分布于浙江湖州、嘉兴及江苏苏州、无锡地区。太湖溇港始建于春秋时期，经后世历代扩建、维修，形成了由运河𬱖塘、200多溇港、南北横塘等数条横塘及万顷圩田组成的水利体系，形成对太湖的调蓄功能。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Zhili town on the Taihu shore, about 20 km north-east of central Huzhou, roughly 30 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 余村
summaryEn: A village in the bamboo hills of Tianhuangping town that closed its limestone quarries and cement works in the early 2000s and turned to forestry and rural tourism. In August 2005 Xi Jinping, then Communist Party secretary of Zhejiang, first set out here the idea that 'clear waters and green mountains are mountains of gold and silver'; the village meeting room where he spoke is preserved as a provincial heritage site, and UN Tourism has named Yucun one of its Best Tourism Villages.
description: 余村“两山”会址，简称两山会址，位于中国浙江省安吉县天荒坪镇余村村文化礼堂二楼。2005年8月15日，时任中共浙江省委书记的习近平在余村调研，充分肯定余村关停矿山、水泥厂的做法，并在余村村委会议室召开座谈会，首次提出绿水青山就是金山银山的理念，建筑为砖混结构建筑，长7.26米，宽5.96米，设有椭圆形会议桌、座椅等会议设备。
accessEn: In Tianhuangping town about 14 km south of Anji town, roughly 25 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 盐官观潮
summaryEn: Yanguan, the old county seat of Haining on the north bank of the Qiantang River, is the classic place to watch the river's tidal bore, which arrives here as a single long wave, with the largest tides around the 18th day of the eighth lunar month. A stone seawall of interlocking 'fish-scale' blocks, built in the Qing dynasty, runs along the riverside tide-watching park, overlooked by the seven-storey Zhan'ao Pagoda of 1612. In the old town behind are the Sea God Temple, built on imperial order in 1729, and the childhood home of the scholar Wang Guowei.
description: 盐官镇位于浙江省海宁市境内，钱塘江北岸，钱江潮观赏地。以钱塘江“一线潮”出名。为第五批中国历史文化名镇。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Yanguan town about 20 km south-west of central Haining and roughly an hour by road from central Hangzhou; Yanguan station on the Hangzhou–Haining intercity railway is about 7 km north of the old town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 卢宅
summaryEn: A large complex of Ming and Qing mansions and halls on the east side of Dongyang, built by the Lu clan, who settled here in the Southern Song and prospered after a family member passed the highest imperial examination in the early 15th century. The buildings, covering about 2.5 hectares, are grouped around the clan's main ancestral hall and three branch compounds, of which the Suyong Hall complex is the centrepiece, and are rich in the wood carving Dongyang is known for. The scenic area also takes in a street of intangible-heritage workshops and Luzhai Old Street, about 500 m of shops selling carving and old building parts.
description: 东阳卢宅位于中国浙江省东阳市城东，为卢氏民居建筑群，1988年被列为第三批全国重点文物保护单位。卢氏于南宋定居此处，明永乐年间卢睿中进士后家族逐渐兴旺，陆续兴建形成这一规模宏大的宅第。卢宅以卢氏大宗祠为中心，复荆堂、肃雍堂、树德堂三大宗支建筑群位于其周围，总占地25000余平方米。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the eastern side of Dongyang city, a short taxi ride from the centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 婺州古城·侍王府
summaryEn: Jinhua's old inner city, first walled around 903, now a restored historic district of lanes with snack stalls and shops, a stretch of rebuilt red-sandstone city wall and the rebuilt Confucian temple, with the Jinhua Museum on its eastern edge. At its heart is the Shiwang Palace, an old government compound that the Taiping general Li Shixian, the Shi Wang, made his headquarters in 1861–63; it is the most complete surviving Taiping building complex and keeps more than a hundred wall paintings. On the southern edge, the Bayong Tower, a riverside pavilion first built in 494 and rebuilt in the Qing, was celebrated in a poem by Li Qingzhao.
description: 婺州古城·侍王府位于浙江金华。游览特色包括博物馆、古城、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In central Jinhua on the north bank of the Wu River, about 3 km east of Jinhua railway station by taxi or bus.

name: 义乌国际商贸城
summaryEn: Described by the World Bank in 2005 as the world's largest wholesale market for small commodities, it is a chain of huge linked halls with more than 75,000 booths selling toys, jewellery, hardware, kitchenware, stationery, clothing accessories and much more, mainly to traders from around the world. It grew out of a street market legalised in 1982; its first district here opened in 2002, and District 2 houses a museum of the commodity trade's history. Even a quick look takes hours, and many visitors come simply to see the scale of global trade in everyday goods.
description: 义乌国际商贸城又称福田市场，是位于浙江义乌的一个小商品专业批发市场，市场发展商和管理者为浙江中国小商品城集团股份有限公司。公司成立于1993年，2002年5月在上海证券交易所挂牌交易，股票代码600415。
accessEn: On the north-eastern side of Yiwu city, about 5 km from the centre; International Trade City station on the Jinhua–Yiwu–Dongyang line is beside the market, with a change at Qintang for trains from Jinhua.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 诸葛八卦村
summaryEn: A village in western Lanxi, founded in the Yuan, whose residents, mostly surnamed Zhuge, claim descent from Zhuge Liang, the third-century chancellor of Shu Han. Its lanes are laid out like the eight trigrams around a central pond, with eight lanes radiating out and eight low hills ringing the village, and it keeps more than 200 buildings from the Yuan, Ming and Qing dynasties, including ancestral halls and houses built with wealth from the herbal-medicine trade. The protected site also covers the old houses of Changle village, about 2 km away.
description: 诸葛村位于中国浙江省兰溪市诸葛镇，毗邻建德市和龙游县，距长乐村约2千米，1996年两村的民居建筑群联合列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。诸葛村是国家4A级旅游景区。诸葛村始建于元代，原名高隆，居民多为诸葛姓，自称是诸葛亮孙子诸葛京的后裔，因诸葛姓的兴旺于明代中期改称诸葛村。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 16 km west of Lanxi city, roughly 30 minutes by road, and about an hour by road from Jinhua.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 河阳古民居
summaryEn: A village of the Zhu clan in Xinjian town, founded in the Five Dynasties period and replanned in the Yuan, whose lanes and water channels still follow that plan. It keeps more than 1,500 rooms in buildings from the Ming and Qing dynasties and the Republican era, among them some 30 complete old houses and more than ten ancestral halls, entered through the Yuan-period Bashi Gate honouring eight local imperial-examination graduates. Bashimen Street has been revived with craft shops, and the teahouse by the gate has been a stage for dujiao taichang, a local art in which one performer plays a whole band's music.
description: 河阳村乡土建筑位于浙江省丽水市缙云县新建镇河阳村，为朱氏血缘村落建筑群。河阳村三面环山，一面临水，东西长约730米，南北宽约500，面积约0.4平方公里，始建于五代，元代规划重建。其乡土建筑历史悠久、规模宏大、布局合理、风格独特，是研究血缘村落选址、规划、建设、管理以及乡土建筑、宗族礼制、风俗文化的重要实例，具有较高的历史、艺术与科学价值。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xinjian town about 10 km north-west of Jinyun town, whose Jinyun West station is on the Jinhua–Wenzhou high-speed railway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 保国寺
summaryEn: A hillside temple north-west of Ningbo whose main hall, built in 1013, is one of the few Northern Song timber buildings surviving south of the Yangtze. The hall predates the Song building manual Yingzao Fashi by 90 years yet matches it closely, with melon-ribbed pillars and three caisson ceilings, while the outer eaves were added in 1684. There are no monks now: the halls form an architecture museum explaining how the building was made.
description: 保国寺是中国浙江省宁波市的一座古代佛寺。寺院位于江北区洪塘街道鞍山村境内的灵山南麓，始建于东汉，初名灵山寺，唐广明五年更名为保国寺，北宋时重建，清康熙年间又进行大修。保国寺大殿为全寺现存历史最悠久的建筑，建于北宋大中祥符六年，是长江以南现存为数不多的北宋木构建筑之一，宋《营造法式》的重要实例，亦以“鸟不入，虫不蛀，蜘蛛不结网，灰尘不上梁”闻名。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 15 km north-west of central Ningbo on Lingshan hill near Hongtang, best reached by taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中国港口博物馆
summaryEn: A large museum of China's ports and maritime trade at Chunxiao on the Beilun coast, opened in 2014 in a building designed by Cheng Taining that is shaped to suggest a conch shell and a sail. Its galleries trace port history and sea-borne trade, with hands-on halls on port science and the ocean, and it is also the Ningbo base of the national underwater cultural heritage programme; it was rated a national first-grade museum in 2020.
description: 中国港口博物馆位于中国浙江省宁波市北仑区春晓街道洋沙山风景旅游区，占地78亩，建筑面积40987平方米，是中国大陆首家大型港口专题博物馆，同时也是国家水下文化遗产保护宁波基地所在地。博物馆建筑由中国工程院院士程泰宁设计，外形取材于海螺，并结合风帆的外形，将海洋文化和港口文化结合。
accessEn: At Chunxiao on the coast, about 17 km south of central Beilun and roughly an hour by road from central Ningbo. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 慈城古县城
summaryEn: The walled seat of the old Cixi County until 1954, Cicheng was spared later redevelopment and keeps lanes of Ming and Qing mansions, guildhalls, memorial arches and wells. Highlights include one of the best-preserved Confucian temples in eastern Zhejiang and family mansions such as Jiadi Shijia and Buzhengfang, and the town's restoration received a UNESCO Asia-Pacific heritage award (honourable mention) in 2009. It is a pleasant half-day of lanes, courtyards and small museums.
description: 慈城古建筑群位于浙江省宁波市江北区慈城镇，是慈城镇中具有代表性古建筑的统称。慈城镇是原慈溪县的县城，1954年由原余姚县、慈溪县、镇海县3县之北部产棉区合并新设慈溪县，县城新设在浒山，而慈城镇划归宁波。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 20 km north-west of central Ningbo; Cicheng station on Metro Line 4 is about 1 km south of the old town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 奉化博物馆
summaryEn: The district museum of Fenghua, opened in 2020 in a converted former power-plant building on Dacheng Road in the town centre. Its permanent galleries cover Fenghua's history, Chiang Kai-shek and Chiang Ching-kuo and their ties with Fenghua, and local gazetteers and old books, and the history gallery won a national exhibition award for 2021.
description: 奉化博物馆是中国浙江省宁波市奉化区的一座博物馆。博物馆位于大成路北侧的奉化城市文化中心内，为原奉化热电厂建筑改建而成，2020年6月12日开馆。博物馆总建筑面积10800平方米，其中展厅总面积6000平方米，蒋氏父子展厅为中国内地所独有。
accessEn: On Dacheng Road in central Fenghua, about 25 km south-west of central Ningbo; Fenghua is linked to Ningbo by metro Line 3.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 浙东抗日根据地旧址
summaryEn: A group of old houses at Hengkantou village near Liangnong, in the northern Siming Mountains, that served in 1942–1945 as the command centre of the Communist-led anti-Japanese base area in eastern Zhejiang. They held the regional Party committee, the administrative office, the headquarters and political department of the New Fourth Army's Eastern Zhejiang column, its bank and newspaper and a branch of the Lu Xun Academy, and are now open as exhibition sites. The Eastern Zhejiang Revolutionary Base Memorial Hall stands opposite, and the village receives many school study groups.
description: 浙东抗日根据地旧址是浙江省宁波市八处与中国共产党领导的浙东抗日根据地有关建筑的统称，分别是位于慈溪市观海卫镇的中共浙东区委成立旧址和位于余姚市梁弄镇的中共浙东区委旧址、浙东行政公署及教导大队旧址、浙东银行和新浙东报社旧址、新四军浙东游击纵队政治部旧址、浙东敌后各界临时代表会议旧址、鲁迅学院浙东分院旧址和新四军浙东游击纵队司令部旧址。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Hengkantou village near Liangnong town, about 20 km south-west of Yuyao and roughly 40 minutes by road; the old buildings are across the road from the memorial hall.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 海天一洲
summaryEn: A service and sightseeing platform built on piers in the sea beside the middle of the Hangzhou Bay Bridge, opened to visitors in 2010. A 145.6 m observation tower has a 360-degree gallery near the top, and the platform holds a bridge exhibition hall, cafés and a hotel. It is a stop for views of the bridge and the open bay on a drive between Ningbo and Shanghai.
description: “海天一洲”景区，即杭州湾跨海大桥海中平台，为位于杭州湾跨海大桥中部海面，南航道桥以南1.7公里，大桥东侧约150米的海面，以匝道与大桥相连，距大桥南岸约18公里。在杭州湾大桥建设期间，海中平台是用来进行工程测量、应急救援以及物资堆放的。
accessEn: Reached only by car, from a dedicated exit in the middle of the Hangzhou Bay Bridge about 18 km from its southern end in Cixi; central Ningbo is roughly 1.5 hours away by road. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 九龙湖
summaryEn: A reservoir lake in the hills of Jiulonghu town, northern Zhenhai, completed in 1988 and later switched from drinking-water supply to landscape and recreation use. The tourist area combines the lake shore with side valleys of small waterfalls, pools and named rocks, and the lakeside has become a provincial tourism resort with hotels and family attractions.
description: 九龙湖位于浙江宁波。游览特色包括瀑布、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside Jiulonghu town in northern Zhenhai district, about 20 km north of central Ningbo, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 宁波博物馆
summaryEn: The city's history museum, opened in 2008 and designed by Wang Shu, who in 2012 became the first Chinese citizen to win the Pritzker Prize. Its sloping walls are faced with Ming and Qing bricks and tiles collected in the region and with concrete cast in bamboo formwork, and the galleries cover Ningbo's history and folk customs. It is now part of the Ningbo Museum group, which also runs the Ningbobang Museum.
description: 宁波博物馆，又名鄞州博物馆，建筑界也常称为宁波历史博物馆，是中华人民共和国浙江省宁波市的一所综合性博物馆。宁波博物馆为宁波市与鄞州区合办，位于鄞州区首南中路1000号，2008年12月5日开馆。博物馆由中国大陆知名建筑师、普利兹克建筑奖首位中华人民共和国籍获奖者王澍设计，建筑形态以山、水、海洋为设计理念，以民间收集的明清砖瓦组成瓦爿墙和毛竹铸成混凝土墙作装饰，突出江南民居的特色。
accessEn: In Yinzhou south of the centre, about 10 minutes' walk from Yinzhou Government station on Metro Lines 3 and 5; closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 宁波科学探索中心
summaryEn: A large hands-on science museum in the Ningbo Cultural Plaza of the Eastern New Town, open since 2014. Galleries on the ocean, the environment and the universe fill the second floor, with safety-education halls and an 18 m dome cinema above. It suits families with children.
description: 宁波科学探索中心位于浙江宁波。游览特色包括博物馆、科学科普。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Eastern New Town, about 5 minutes' walk from Haiyan North Road station on Metro Lines 1 and 5.

name: 宁波野生动物园
summaryEn: A large zoo on hilly ground with lakes at the north-east edge of the Dongqian Lake resort area, opened in 2004 as Youngor Zoo and renamed Ningbo Wildlife Park in 2021. Animal enclosures are spread around the lakes and woods, making it a family day out.
description: 宁波野生动物园，原名宁波雅戈尔动物园，2021年11月19日改为现名），又称宁波动物园，位于中华人民共和国浙江省宁波市鄞州区东钱湖旅游度假区梅湖村，是中国水域面积最大的野生动物园，首创第一条水上动物观赏游线。
accessEn: About 20 km east of central Ningbo, roughly 4 km by taxi from Wuxiang station on Metro Line 1.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 宁波帮博物馆
summaryEn: A museum about the 'Ningbo bang', the network of Ningbo-born merchants prominent in shipping, banking and trade in Shanghai and later overseas, opened in 2009 in a building by the architect He Jingtang laid out along a water street. Its four galleries trace how the merchants left home, the businesses they built and their ties with their home region.
description: 宁波帮博物馆位于中华人民共和国浙江省宁波市镇海区庄市街道宁波市高教园区北区，中官西路与思源路路口，是一家专题博物馆，主要陈列宁波帮人物相关展品和商帮发展历程，兼作宁波帮人士会馆。博物馆于2009年10月22日开馆，2018年9月成为国家二级博物馆。
accessEn: In the university district of Zhuangshi in Zhenhai, about 1 km from Ningbo University and Sanguantang metro stations; closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 老外滩
