summaryEn: A riverside quarter on the north bank of the Yong River at Ningbo's Sanjiangkou, where the foreign settlement grew up after Ningbo was opened as a treaty port in 1844, two decades before Shanghai's Bund took shape. Some 54 listed historic buildings remain, among them the former British consulate, the Zhejiang customs house, the old post office and the Catholic church, in cobbled streets now lined with bars, restaurants and shops. It is busiest in the evening, when the waterfront is lit up.
description: 老外滩位于浙江宁波。游览特色包括滨水景观、历史建筑、教堂建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north bank of the Yong River in central Ningbo, about 1 km north of Tianyi Square; Waitan Bridge station on metro Lines 2 and 7 is a short walk to the north.

name: 前童古镇
summaryEn: An old clan town in the hills of south-west Ninghai, founded when the Tong family settled here in 1233; about eight in ten residents still bear the surname. Lanes of Ming and Qing houses are laced with small channels fed by the Baixi and Lianghuang streams, and the Tong ancestral hall dates from 1385. It makes an unhurried half-day of old courtyards, stone bridges and village life.
description: 前童镇，中华人民共和国浙江省宁海县下辖的一个镇，由原前童镇和竹林乡于1992年5月组建而成。2023年中国文化百强镇。2010年，土地面积66.81平方千米。
accessEn: About half an hour by road south-west of Ninghai town, whose railway station is on the coastal line south from Ningbo.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 象山影视城
summaryEn: A film and television studio complex in Xinqiao, Xiangshan County, begun in 2003 for the wuxia series The Return of the Condor Heroes and open to visitors since 2005. Its period backlots include a Song-style martial-arts town, a Spring and Autumn and Warring States town, a Tang city and a Republican-era street, among sets used for many historical dramas. It suits film and TV fans and families.
description: 象山影视城是位于浙江省宁波市象山县新桥镇的一处影视基地，位于大塘港生态旅游区境内，于2005年1月10日启用，最初为拍摄张纪中电视剧《神雕侠侣》依照宋代风格建设，此后亦拍摄了《赵氏孤儿》、《盖世英雄曹操》、《王的盛宴》等多部影视作品。
accessEn: In Xinqiao town in southern Xiangshan County, about 20 km south of the county town and roughly 1.5 hours by road from central Ningbo.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 招宝山
summaryEn: A hill guarding the mouth of the Yong River, fortified from the Ming to the 1940s against Japanese pirates and British, French and Japanese forces, and the core of the Zhenhaikou coastal defence monuments. Paths lead to the Ming Weiyuan fort on the summit (1560), the Moon fort of 1883, old steles and the round Anyuan battery of 1887, with the Aozhu Pagoda on the hill and a coastal defence museum, opened in 1997, at its foot. Further monuments of the same group, including Qing batteries and a lookout on Jinji Hill, lie across the river in Beilun.
description: 招宝山古称候涛山，又名鳌柱山，是中华人民共和国浙江省宁波市镇海区山峰和旅游景点。招宝山位于甬江口，属于天台山余脉。山名来源于地理位置“当海口，商舶所经，百珍交集”，“招财进宝”。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Zhenhai about 20 km north-east of central Ningbo; Zhaobaoshan station on Metro Line 2 is about 1.5 km away.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙游石窟
summaryEn: A group of 24 huge man-made caverns cut into the sandstone of Fenghuang Hill beside the Qu River, found in 1992 when farmers drained five village ponds and discovered that they were flooded caverns. Nobody knows who dug them, when or why: their walls, ceilings and pillars are covered in neat bands of chisel marks, there is no record of their making, and pottery found in the silt dates from the Han dynasty. Several caverns can be walked through, with tall chambers supported by stone pillars left in place.
description: 龙游石窟，又名小南海石室，是位于中华人民共和国浙江省衢州市龙游县的一处古迹群，为巨大人工石穴群。推测为春秋至汉朝间开凿，至今使用何技术建成依然成谜。龙游石窟是迄今所发现的世界上最大的古代地下人工建筑群。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xiaonanhai town about 4 km north of Longyou county town, beside the Qu River.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙游民居苑
summaryEn: An open-air museum of old architecture on Jiming Hill on the southern edge of Longyou town, where Ming and Qing buildings from around the county that could not be protected where they stood have been dismantled and rebuilt since 1991. Among them are the Gaogang Qifeng hall with its double-eaved gatehouse, a Ming stone pavilion, the Wu family hall with an unusual earthquake-resistant bracket frame, the Wang family house and the Lingshan flower hall, grouped around the Ming Jiming Pagoda, which stands on its original site.
description: 鸡鸣山民居苑又称龙游民居苑，位于浙江省衢州市龙游县龙游镇南郊鸡鸣山，占地6.6万平方米。从1991年起，鸡鸣山民居苑将龙游地区部分缺乏就地保护条件的明、清古建筑集中迁建。除位于原址的鸡鸣塔外，现有迁入古建筑“高岗起凤”、“翊秀亭”、“巫氏厅”、“汪氏民居”、“邵氏小厅”、“灵山花厅”等六座。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Jiming Hill on the southern outskirts of Longyou county town, about 35 km east of Quzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 衢州古城
summaryEn: The historic core of Quzhou, a 3.2 km² cultural tourism zone opened in 2016 around Shuiting Gate, where the Ming–Qing city wall stands beside the Qu River, and the 'three streets and seven alleys' of old lanes lined with restored buildings, craft workshops and food stalls. Six old gates survive along with stretches of the wall that earned the city the name 'Iron Quzhou' in past sieges, and a gate tower over Shuiting Gate and a bell tower on its Ming stone base have been rebuilt. Near the gate on Xiaying Street stands the Zhou Xuanling Wang Temple, a shrine to a filial son first built in the Southern Song and rebuilt in the Ming.
description: 衢州城墙位于中国浙江省衢州市柯城区，2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In central Quzhou on the east bank of the Qu River; the Temple of Southern Confucianism is about 1 km east of Shuiting Gate.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 新昌大佛寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple in the Shicheng hills on the edge of Xinchang town, founded in 345, whose great hall encloses a seated stone Maitreya carved into the cliff of Xianji Rock and completed in 516 after the work of three successive monks. Nearby, the Thousand Buddha Cliff (Qianfoyan) carries rows of small Buddha figures from the same Southern Dynasties period, and the grounds also hold a reclining Buddha hall, cliff inscriptions and a petrified forest.
description: 新昌大佛寺，位于浙江省绍兴市新昌县石城山，汉族地区佛教全国重点寺院之一。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the south-western edge of Xinchang town, about 10 km by road from Shengzhou Xinchang high-speed station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 柯岩
summaryEn: A scenic area of about 6.9 km² west of Shaoxing made up of three parts: the rocks of Ke hill, a stretch of Jian Lake and Luzhen, a water-town quarter. Its centrepiece is the Tiangong Great Buddha, a seated Maitreya 11.3 m high carved in the Song dynasty inside a great curved rock face, with Puzhao Temple behind it and inscriptions from the Ming and Qing dynasties on the Yungu rock, Qixing Rock and other cliffs.
description: 柯岩造像及摩崖题刻位于中华人民共和国浙江省绍兴市柯桥区柯桥街道柯山南麓、今柯岩风景区内，1997年8月柯岩造像列入浙江省文物保护单位，2013年3月又与柯岩摩崖题刻一同列入第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Keyan subdistrict, about 11 km west of Shaoxing's old city by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大禹陵
summaryEn: The traditional burial place of Yu the Great, the legendary tamer of floods and founder of the Xia dynasty, at the foot of Kuaiji Mountain south-east of Shaoxing. The site has three parts: the tomb, marked by a stele pavilion inscribed 'Da Yu Ling' beside Yu Pool; the Yu Temple, first built in the early Liang dynasty and laid out as a palace-style complex; and the sacrificial hall, rebuilt in 2007–08. The temple grounds also hold the Goulou stele with its puzzling tadpole-like script and the Bianshi, a conical stone with a hole through it.
description: 大禹陵，是夏朝开国国君大禹的纪念陵墓，位于浙江省绍兴市东南8公里禹陵乡禹陵村，大禹墓在会稽山下，坐东朝西。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 5 km south-east of Shaoxing's old city by road, at the foot of the Kuaiji Mountain scenic area.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 兰亭
summaryEn: The garden at the foot of Lanzhu hill where, in 353, the calligrapher Wang Xizhi and more than forty friends held a spring gathering, floating cups of wine down a winding stream and writing poems, for which he wrote the Preface to the Orchid Pavilion Poems, the most celebrated work of Chinese running script. The present site was rebuilt in 1548 and restored to its Ming and Qing layout from 1979, with the Goose Pond, the Lanting stele, the Liushang pavilion beside the winding stream, the Wang Xizhi memorial hall and a stele carved with inscriptions by both the Kangxi and Qianlong emperors. A calligraphy museum and stone copies of the Preface by later masters complete the visit.
description: 兰亭古迹是位于中华人民共和国浙江绍兴的一个文化古迹和旅游胜地，位于绍兴城区西南13公里的兰渚山麓，是东晋著名书法家、会稽内史王羲之的园林住所，是一座晋代园林。东晋永和九年三月初三，王羲之与谢安、王献之等40多位名士在此举办修禊集会，王羲之“微醉之中，振笔直遂”，写下了著名的“天下第一行书”《兰亭集序》。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 13 km south-west of Shaoxing's old city in Lanting subdistrict, Keqiao, by road; the Yinshan royal tomb and Wang Yangming's tomb are both within 3 km.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 方山
summaryEn: A flat-topped mountain of volcanic rhyolite in Daxi town, western Wenling, on the border with Yueqing, ringed by sheer cliffs but open on top, where lakes and ponds dot the summit plateau and wild azaleas flower in spring; the Taizhou government describes it as the largest Mesozoic rhyolite volcanic platform in Asia. The Wenling side is divided into the Fangshan, Nansongyan and Shifeng areas, and the mountain forms the eastern section of the Yandangshan Global Geopark, listed in 2005, and, with Changyu Dongtian, a national scenic area since 2006.
description: 方山位于浙江省温岭市大溪镇，由方山、南嵩岩、狮峰三大景区组成。2005年作为雁荡山世界地质公园的东园区，被列为世界地质公园。2006年与长屿硐天景区被列为国家级风景名胜区。
accessEn: In Daxi town in western Wenling, about 10 km south-west of Wenling station by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 江心屿
summaryEn: A long islet in the Ou River opposite central Wenzhou and long the city's emblem, with Jiangxin Temple, founded in 1137 when monks filled the channel between two islets, the East and West Pagodas, a shrine to the Song loyalist Wen Tianxiang, and buildings recalling the poets Xie Lingyun and Meng Haoran. At the foot of the East Pagoda stands the former British Consulate, a verandahed three-storey building of 1894 from the treaty-port era, which now houses a museum on Wenzhou's opening as a port. Gardens and lakes fill the rest of the island.
description: 江心屿，又称江心孤屿、孤屿，是中国浙江省温州市的一处岛屿，位于市区北面的瓯江之中。岛屿东西长，南北窄，总面积为70万平方米。江心屿为中国四大孤屿之一，也是温州城市的象征和标志，有东西双塔、江心寺、文信国公祠、浩然楼、谢公亭等诸多人文景观，因历史上谢灵运、孟浩然等文人墨客留下近千首相关诗词被称为“诗之岛”。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Reached by a short ferry ride across the Ou River from the pier on Wangjiang East Road in central Wenzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 泰顺廊桥文化园
summaryEn: A heritage park in Sixi town built around Xidong Bridge (1745) and Beijian Bridge (1803), two timber covered bridges with woven-beam arches that stand close together over the streams of Xiaqiao village. The park also takes in old buildings such as Zhang Shiyi's former residence and the Bao ancestral hall, and showcases Taishun's puppet theatre. The two bridges head the national listing of 15 Taishun covered bridges scattered across the county; three of them were swept away by floods in 2016 and rebuilt in 2017, reusing as much of their original timber as possible.
description: 泰顺廊桥是中国浙江省温州市泰顺县廊桥的总称，以木拱廊桥为核心。1989年，浙江省人民政府将泰顺县泗溪乡的泗溪木拱桥列入第三批浙江省文物保护单位。泗溪木拱桥即溪东桥、北涧桥。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Sixi town, Taishun County, about 2 hours by road south-west of Wenzhou; buses from Wenzhou to Taishun stop at Nanxi, where minibuses continue to Sixi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 乌岩岭
summaryEn: A national nature reserve of 18,861.5 ha in north-western Taishun, set up mainly to protect Cabot's tragopan, a pheasant found only in China, and one of the best-preserved subtropical evergreen broadleaf forests in eastern China. Only a small part is open to visitors: trails follow two streams past waterfalls and pools such as Baiyun Falls and Longjing Pool, and a paved path climbs to Baiyunjian (1,611 m), the highest peak in Wenzhou.
description: 浙江乌岩岭国家级自然保护区位于中国浙江省温州市泰顺县西北部，浙南沿海山地，与福建省福安市、温州文成县、丽水景宁少数民族自治县相邻。保护区面积18861.5公顷，主要保护对象为黄腹角雉及其生态环境。
accessEn: About 17 km north of Luoyang, Taishun's county town, from where local buses run to the reserve; buses link Wenzhou with Taishun.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 桃花岛
summaryEn: A hilly island of about 44 km² south of Zhoushan Island, known across the Chinese-speaking world as the Peach Blossom Island of Louis Cha (Jin Yong)'s martial-arts novels, and used as a filming location for television adaptations of them. The scenic area spreads over six sections, among them the Tawan golden sands, Anqi Peak with Shengyan Monastery near the summit, and Taohua Valley, with beaches, rock formations, the seven-storey Jilin Pagoda and a bronze statue of Jin Yong set up in 2001.
description: 桃花岛是中国大陆东部外海舟山群岛中的一个岛屿，行政区划属于中华人民共和国浙江省舟山市普陀区桃花镇。桃花岛是省级风景旅游区，2007年获浙江“美丽乡村”美称。有塔湾金沙、安期峰、桃花峪、大佛岩、悬鹁鸪岛、桃花港6大景区，拥有金沙日出、金龙吐珠、安期云雾等12大景观，有弹指峰、东海神珠、白雀寺、清音洞、安期炼丹洞、观音望海、仙人桥、千层岩等100多个景点。
accessEn: By ferry from Shenjiamen on Zhoushan Island or from Zhujiajian Island; island buses link the pier with the beaches and villages.
imageCredit: Clestur Statue created by 浙江省舟山市普陀区桃花岛旅游管委会
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 花亭湖
summaryEn: A large reservoir in the hills north of Taihu county town, formed by the Hualiangting Dam, which was begun in 1958 and largely completed in 1976; it is now a national scenic area. Boats run out to islands and coves such as Moon Bay, and Xifeng Cave, a cliff-side site with an old temple, has views over the water.
description: 花亭湖即花凉亭水库，位于中国安徽省安庆市太湖县，是以防洪、灌溉为主，结合发电、供水、养殖、航运、旅游等功能的大型水库。花亭湖是国家重点风景名胜区、国家4A级旅游景区、国家水利风景区、全国农业旅游示范点、全省农家乐旅游示范点。
accessEn: The dam is on the northern edge of Taihu county town, about 1.5 hours by road west of Anqing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 亳州古地道
summaryEn: A network of underground passages beneath the old city of Bozhou, the home town of Cao Cao, begun in the late Eastern Han but surviving mostly from the Song dynasty; the tunnels radiate from the old crossroads of Dayushou and are built partly of earth and timber but mostly of brick. A section open to visitors is presented as 'Cao Cao's Underground Troop Tunnel', with low brick passages running several metres below the streets.
description: 亳州古地道位于中国安徽省亳州市谯城区老城区地下，2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。亳州古地道始建于东汉末年，现存大部分为宋代所建。全长4000余米，以大隅首为中心向四周延伸，一般深2.5～4米，最深达7米以上，内部高度在1.8米左右。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Entrance on Renmin Road in the old city of Bozhou, about 1.5 km south of Huaxilou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 花戏楼
summaryEn: A guild hall and temple to the war god Guan Yu built in the Qing dynasty by medicine merchants from Shanxi and Shaanxi trading in Bozhou, on Xianning Street in the old northern quarter. Its popular name, 'flower opera tower', comes from the opera stage facing the main hall, covered in painted wood carvings of Three Kingdoms stories; the gateway is faced with intricate brick carving and flanked by a pair of tall iron flagpoles.
description: 花戏楼，位于安徽省亳州市谯城区咸宁街，原为山陕会馆、大关帝庙，现中华人民共和国全国重点文物保护单位。花戏楼最初为大关帝庙，亦为清朝乾隆年间，山西、陕西两省药商在亳州为了行李往来相互照应所建立的会馆。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Xianning Street in the old northern quarter of Bozhou, a few minutes' walk from Nanjing Lane.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 吴敬梓纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial museum to Wu Jingzi (1701–1754), the Quanjiao-born author of The Scholars, often seen as China's foremost satirical novel, on Zoumagang on the northern edge of Quanjiao town, facing the site of his family home across the Xiang River. Opened in 1986 in Ming and Qing style and enlarged since 2019, it holds Wu family heirlooms, scholars' writings on Wu and works of calligraphy and painting, and his cenotaph stands in the grounds. His rebuilt family home, opened in 2015, is across the river.
description: 吴敬梓纪念馆位于安徽滁州。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the northern edge of Quanjiao town, about 25 km south of Chuzhou by road.

name: 小岗村
summaryEn: The village in Xiaoxihe town, Fengyang, where on the night of 24 November 1978 eighteen farmers secretly signed a pledge to divide the collective fields into household plots, a step later held up as the start of China's rural reforms. The 1979 grain harvest equalled the village's total for 1966–1970; the site of the pledge is protected as national heritage, and the Da Baogan (household contract) Memorial Museum tells the story. In 2024 UN Tourism named Xiaogang one of its Best Tourism Villages.
description: 小岗村位于安徽滁州。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xiaoxihe town, about 30 km east of Fengyang town by road.

name: 包公园
summaryEn: A park along the Bao River in central Hefei dedicated to Bao Zheng (999–1062), the upright Song-dynasty official known to generations of opera and television audiences as Judge Bao. It contains the Bao Gong Shrine, a memorial temple with his statue, his four guards and the three bronze guillotines of the Judge Bao stories, his tomb complex rebuilt in 1987 to Song building rules, the Qingfeng Pavilion and the Fuzhuang garden.
description: 包公园，简称包园，位于中华人民共和国安徽省合肥市包河区芜湖路72号，是一座为纪念包拯而建的公园，国家4A级旅游景区，公园内主要景点包括包公祠、包公墓、清风阁、浮庄等。
accessEn: On Wuhu Road in central Hefei, next to Baogongyuan station on Metro Line 1.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 李鸿章故居
summaryEn: Part of the family mansion of Li Hongzhang (1823–1901), the late-Qing statesman who founded the Huai Army and the Beiyang Fleet and was for decades the face of the Qing court in foreign affairs, on the Huaihe Road pedestrian street in central Hefei. Restored and opened in 1999, the 2,000 m² compound in late-Qing Jianghuai style runs from the gate through front and middle halls to a two-storey rear building, with displays on his life and calligraphy and rooms furnished in Qing style.
description: 李鸿章故居是清末大臣李鸿章的故居，位于中国安徽省合肥市淮河路中段208号。李鸿章故居为其原家宅的一部分，具有典型的晚清江淮建筑风格。故居占地2000平方米，是合肥市内现存最大的名人故居。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Huaihe Road pedestrian street in central Hefei, walking distance from the city centre. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 三国新城遗址公园
summaryEn: The ruins of Hefei's Xincheng ('New City'), a fortress the Wei general Man Chong built in 233 west of old Hefei to hold off the state of Wu, which besieged it several times without taking it. Excavations in 2004–05 uncovered three gates, a drill platform, a weapon-casting kiln and a cart road, and the park shows these with partly rebuilt walls and gates, a restored moat and exhibition halls in Han style. It suits visitors interested in the Three Kingdoms period.
description: 合肥曹魏新城遗址，又称三国新城遗址、三国新城遗址公园，是三国时期曹魏政权在合肥旧城近郊修建的用于抵御孙吴军队的军事性城池的遗址，现存部分破裂的城墙的残基，位于合肥市庐阳区三十岗乡古城郢村，南北长约500米，东西宽约210米。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Sanshigang township about 16 km north-west of central Hefei, by taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 渡江战役纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial museum opened in 2012 on the north shore of Chao Lake about the People's Liberation Army's April 1949 crossing of the Yangtze, which ended with the capture of Nanjing. The complex runs from Liberation Square through the 44-metre-high main hall, built leaning forward at 49 degrees, past a group statue of the General Front Committee to Victory Square and a 99-metre victory tower. The rating also covers the neighbouring Anhui Celebrities Hall.
description: 渡江战役纪念馆，位于中华人民共和国安徽省合肥市包河区北京路与环湖北路交叉口附近，巢湖北岸。1949年4月，中国人民解放军发起渡江战役，并以解放军方获得胜利而结束。该建筑即以纪念该次战役而建。
accessEn: In Binhu New District about 18 km south of central Hefei, by Dujiang Jinianguan station on Metro Line 5. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 渡江战役总前委旧址
summaryEn: A group of late-Qing courtyard houses in Yaogang, Feidong County, where the Communist General Front Committee under Deng Xiaoping and Chen Yi directed the Yangtze River Crossing Campaign in April 1949 before moving to Nanjing at the end of the month. Five restored buildings, including the committee's headquarters, secretariat and staff office and the office of the East China Bureau, show the leaders' rooms and campaign material, and a memorial museum stands alongside.
description: 渡江战役总前委旧址位于安徽省肥东县撮镇镇瑶岗社区，南临淮南铁路和合马公路，北靠312国道，是渡江战役期间中国人民解放军渡江战役总前敌委员会所在地，1996年，渡江战役总前委旧址被中华人民共和国国务院列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Cuozhen town, Feidong County, about 17 km east of central Hefei by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 八公山
summaryEn: A range of some 40 low peaks between Huainan and Shou County, named after the 'Eight Gentlemen' of the Western Han prince Liu An, who compiled the Huainanzi here and, by legend, invented tofu; the Battle of Fei River of 383 was fought below them. The scenic area on the Huainan side, a national forest park and national geopark, has a geological museum on the area's ancient fossils, including the 'Huainan worm', the White Pagoda Temple, the Huainan King's Palace, an immortals' terrace and a stone forest.
description: 八公山，位于中华人民共和国安徽省淮南市的寿县与八公山区两县区交界处，距离寿县古城以北2公里，距离淮南市区约20公里。八公山为大别山的余脉，有山峰四十余座，总面积200多平方公里。1987年，安徽省人民政府批准八公山风景区为省级风景名胜区。
accessEn: On the western edge of Huainan, about 20 km from the city centre by road; Shou County old town lies 2 km south of the hills.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 寿县古城
summaryEn: Shou County's old town, the Shouchun of history and the last capital of the state of Chu, is still ringed by its city wall, rebuilt in the Southern Song with bricks stamped 'Jiankang' that can still be seen. All four gates, Binyang (east), Tongfei (south), Dinghu (west) and Jinghuai (north), keep their barbican enclosures, and the wall held back the Huai River floods of 1991 while the town sheltered refugees. Inside are the Confucius Temple, a Ming–Qing mosque and Bao'en Temple, and the low Bagong hills rise just north of the town.
description: 寿县古城墙，位于安徽省淮南市寿县，是中国如今仍保存完好的古代城墙之一、全国重点文物保护单位之一。寿县城墙有四门，东门称为宾阳，南称为通淝，西门称为定湖，北门称为靖淮。而四门的瓮城也依然保存。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Shouchun town, Shou County, about 25 km west of central Huainan by road; Shou County station on the Shangqiu–Hefei–Hangzhou high-speed railway is about 3 km north-east of the old town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 岩寺新四军军部旧址
summaryEn: The Jin family compound at 22 Yinshan Road in Yansi, used as headquarters by the Communist-led New Fourth Army in the spring of 1938, when guerrilla units from eight southern provinces gathered here to be reorganised before moving to the front against Japan; the commanders Ye Ting and Xiang Ying lived in two of its three houses. A memorial museum stands across the lane from the compound, and the site also takes in the Ming Hongqiao covered bridge, beside which the army's code office worked, and the Ming Wenfeng Pagoda and Fengshan platform, where troops drilled and were reviewed.
description: 岩寺新四军军部旧址位于中国安徽省黄山市徽州区岩寺镇，主要包括新四军军部旧址、新四军机要科旧址和新四军练兵、点验处，1998年4月以南方八省红军游击队集中地旧址之名列为安徽省文物保护单位，2013年被列为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Yansi town, Huizhou district, about 15 km north of Tunxi by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南屏村
summaryEn: A village of the Ye clan at the foot of a hill west of the Yi county town, founded in the Northern Song, that keeps more than 300 Ming and Qing buildings, eight of them ancestral halls. Seven of its buildings are national heritage, including the Ye clan's Xuzhi Hall, the Ming Kuiguang branch hall, the Cheng clan hall, the Yinan Villa and the Bingling Pavilion.
description: 南屏村位于中国安徽省黟县碧阳镇西部，是以叶姓为主、兼有程姓、李姓等姓氏的血缘聚落，2008年被列为中国历史文化名村，南屏村古建筑群于2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。南屏村始建于北宋，占地面积16.2万平方米，现存三百多幢明清建筑，仅祠堂就有八座。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Biyang town about 4 km west of the Yi county town, about 50 km north-west of Tunxi by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 太平湖
summaryEn: A reservoir lake formed in 1970 by damming the Qingyi River, winding between forested hills in Huangshan district over about 88 km²; it was Anhui's first national wetland park. Boat trips run on the lake, and the lakeside resort area has a water park with motorboats, kart boats and kayaks.
description: 太平湖，又称太平湖水库，原名陈村水库，位于安徽省黄山市黄山区、泾县、石台县，位于长江水系青弋江上，大坝位于泾县桃花潭镇东面，故称陈村水库。又因水库大部分位于原太平县境内，故称太平湖。该水库建于1970年，是以防洪、灌溉、发电、旅游为主要功能的大型水库，也是安徽省最大的水库。
accessEn: In Huangshan district about 30 km north of Huangshan's northern gate, near provincial road S103 and the G3 expressway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 李白墓
summaryEn: The Tang poet Li Bai, who died in Dangtu in 762, was reburied in 817 at the western foot of Qingshan (Green Hill), where his grave mound lies in a memorial garden with the Taibai Shrine. The shrine and some of the old inscriptions were destroyed in a Japanese air raid in 1938, and the tomb and shrine were restored from 1979. The tomb is the core of the Daqingshan Li Bai Culture Tourism Area, which also takes in the surrounding hills and rural-tourism villages such as Taohua.
description: 李白墓，是唐代诗人、“诗仙”李白的墓地，位于安徽省马鞍山市当涂县城东南的青山西麓。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the south-eastern edge of Dangtu county town, about 25 km south of central Ma'anshan by road and about 4 km south of Taibai station, the southern terminus of the Nanjing–Ma'anshan line (Nanjing Metro S2), opened in 2026.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 江村
summaryEn: Jiangcun is a village of the Jiang clan in Baidi town, Jingde County, founded in the Sui–Tang period and at its height in the Qing, and listed as a national historic and cultural village in 2005. Its surviving Ming and Qing buildings include the Jiang ancestral hall, a filial-piety shrine, the Father-and-Son Jinshi memorial archway, several family halls and an old street, as well as the former homes of the mathematician Jiang Zehan and of Jiang Dongxiu, the wife of the scholar Hu Shi.
description: 江村位于中国安徽省宣城市旌德县白地镇，是以江姓为主聚居的村落，人口2237人，拥有众多的古建筑，2005年被列为“中国历史文化名村”。江村古建筑群于2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。江村始建于隋唐时期，鼎盛于清，经过太平天国战乱后衰败。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Baidi town, about 20 km south-west of Jingde county town by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 太极洞
summaryEn: Taiji Cave is a limestone cave system in Shilong Mountain, 38 km north-east of Guangde near where Anhui, Jiangsu and Zhejiang meet; it is about 5.4 km long and was opened to visitors in 1986. The route passes through some 19 chambers of stalactites and flowstone on dry and water-filled levels, including a boat ride on the underground river, and Song- and Ming-era inscriptions survive in and around the cave. A cable car runs on the mountain outside.
description: 太极洞是石灰岩地下溶洞群，位于中华人民共和国安徽省宣城市广德市东北石龙山腹部，地处苏浙皖交界处，距离广德县城38公里，为国家重点风景名胜区，是太极洞国家地质公园的核心景区，也是华东地区最大的天然溶洞。
accessEn: About 38 km north-east of Guangde by road, near the Jiangsu and Zhejiang borders.
imageCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Whw assumed (based on copyright claims).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 瑞岩山
summaryEn: A hill at Haikou town east of Fuqing whose eastern foot holds a laughing, pot-bellied Maitreya Buddha about 9 m tall, carved into the rock between 1341 and 1368 and described as the largest Yuan-dynasty Maitreya in China. The pavilion that once sheltered it is long gone, leaving ten stone pillars and three steles, and a temple with a main hall and bell and drum towers stands on a hillside carved with some 170 inscriptions, among them some by the Ming general Qi Jiguang.
description: 瑞岩弥勒造像位于中国福建省福州市福清市海口镇瑞岩山东麓，是中国最大的元代弥勒造像，1996年被列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Haikou town about 10 km east of Fuqing city, roughly an hour by road from Fuzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上下杭
summaryEn: Two parallel streets near the Min River in Taijiang district, Shanghang and Xiahang, that grew from riverside landing places into Fuzhou's main trading quarter after the city was opened as a treaty port in the 1840s. Tea, timber, paper and dried-goods merchants built warehouses and family shrines here, and traders from across Fujian set up guild halls. Many of these buildings survive in the restored district, some reused as teahouses and shops.
description: 福州市上下杭历史文化街区，简称上下杭，又称双杭，是由福州市台江区的上杭路和下杭路及其附近街区，故又称“双杭”。北宋元祐年间之前，大庙山南麓沿岸有两个大沙痕供来往船只装卸货物，原名“上航”、“下航”。因“杭”与“航”通，故又称“上杭”、“下杭”。
accessEn: In Taijiang district about 3 km south of Dongjiekou, a short taxi ride from central Fuzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 长汀革命旧址
summaryEn: Six buildings in Changting's old town used by the Communist movement in 1929–33, when Changting was a key part of the Central Soviet Area. They include the Central Red Hospital in the former Gospel Hospital, founded by a British mission in 1904, the Fujian Provincial Soviet Government in the old Tingzhou prefectural examination hall, the Fourth Red Army headquarters at Xingeng Villa, where Mao Zedong and Zhu De stayed, and the provincial party committee in a former church.
description: 长汀革命旧址位于中国福建省龙岩市长汀县城区内。长汀县是第一次国共内战期间中央革命根据地的重要组成部分。1988年中央红色医院旧址等六处旧址被列为第三批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Within walking distance of one another in the old town of Changting county town, about 2 hours by road north-west of Longyan; the former provincial soviet government building, which houses the Changting County Museum, is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中国闽台缘博物馆
summaryEn: A large state museum opened in 2006 on the historical ties between Fujian and Taiwan, in a red-brick and white-stone building whose four long flights of steps climb to a roof terrace over the city. Its main galleries trace migration, family lineages, trade, culture and shared folk religion across the strait, and a further hall presents folk customs through the four seasons.
description: 中国闽台缘博物馆坐落于福建省泉州市丰泽区北清东路212号，是中华人民共和国唯一一座以反映中国大陆福建地区与台湾之间交往关系史为主题的国家一级博物馆。博物馆集收藏、展示、研究、交流和服务等功为一身。是研究大陆与台湾关系史特别是闽台关系史的重要机构。
accessEn: On Beiqing East Road at the foot of Mount Qingyuan, about 2.5 km north of Kaiyuan Temple and beside Quanzhou Museum. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 泉州博物馆
summaryEn: The city museum, opened in 2005 in a large building in southern Fujian style at the foot of Mount Qingyuan, north of West Lake Park. Its permanent galleries cover Quanzhou's history and notable people and the culture of the Minnan region, including Nanyin music, local opera and puppetry, drawn from a collection of more than 10,000 objects.
description: 泉州市博物馆位于中华人民共和国福建省泉州市丰泽区的清源山下、西湖公园北侧，是福建省泉州市一座以泉州历史文化为主题，融合陈列展览、文物收藏、学术研究、文化交流、旅游观光为一体的的综合性博物馆。
accessEn: On Beiqing East Road at the foot of Mount Qingyuan, about 2.5 km north of Kaiyuan Temple and beside the Fujian–Taiwan Kinship Museum. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鳌园
summaryEn: A walled memorial garden on the Jimei waterfront holding the tomb of Tan Kah Kee (1874–1961), the Singapore-based businessman and philanthropist who founded the Jimei schools and Xiamen University; he began building the tomb in 1955 and was buried here in 1961. A long gallery of carved stone panels leads to the Jimei Liberation Monument, and behind it the turtle-shaped tomb is ringed with stone reliefs showing scenes from his life.
description: 鳌园位于福建厦门。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、园林景观。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At the end of Jiageng Road in Jimei School Village, Jimei District, next to Kah Kee Park and about 30 minutes by road from central Xiamen.

name: 胡里山炮台
summaryEn: A coastal fort on the south-eastern tip of Xiamen Island, completed in 1896 in a mix of European and Chinese styles, with granite ramparts, underground passages, barracks, magazines, lookout posts and a moat. Its main exhibit is a late-19th-century 280 mm Krupp breech-loading coastal gun, about 13 m long, the survivor of the fort's original pair; appraisals by the National Cultural Heritage Administration and the Krupp archive identified it as the largest surviving 19th-century coastal gun. The fort looks out across the water towards Kinmen.
description: 胡里山炮台位于中国福建省厦门市。此清光绪二十年（1894年)炮台使用德国克虏伯兵工厂制造的280毫米海岸炮为世界现存十九世纪制造最大。胡里山炮台于1996年列入第四批全国重点文物保护单位，2000年被编入吉尼斯世界纪录，2009年被评为中国国家4A级旅游景区。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the southern shore of Xiamen Island, a short walk south of Xiamen University's main campus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东山风动石
summaryEn: On the seaside rocks by the east gate of Tongshan, the stone-walled town built in 1387 to guard the coast against pirates, the Wind-Moved Rock is a huge boulder resting on a tiny base that seems to rock in the wind. The scenic area also takes in the old town's walls and gate and the Dongshan Guandi Temple, founded in 1387 and rebuilt in 1680, from which many of Taiwan's Guandi temples trace their incense. The Ming calligrapher and loyalist Huang Daozhou was born in the town.
description: 东山关帝庙，是中国福建省东山县铜陵镇岵嵝山东麓的关帝庙，又常称为铜陵关帝庙、铜陵武庙，是台湾众多关帝庙分香分灵入台的祖庙。1996年被列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。东山关帝庙始建于明洪武二十年，扩建于正德三年，清康熙十九年重建。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Tongling town on Dongshan Island, about 2 hours by road south of Zhangzhou city or 2.5 hours from Xiamen.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 流坑古村
summaryEn: Liukeng is a large village of Ming and Qing houses and ancestral halls between a lake and the Niutian river in Le'an County, founded under the Southern Tang in the 10th century and home mostly to the Dong clan. It is nicknamed the First Village of the Ages, has been a national heritage unit since 2001, and was in the first group of national historic and cultural villages in 2003. Old camphor trees line the river downstream.
description: 流坑村位于江西省抚州市乐安县牛田镇东南部。村民大都姓董，自称是董仲舒的后裔，实际可考的开基祖是董合。南唐昇元年间建村，原属吉州永丰县，南宋时改由乐安县辖。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 19 km south-south-west of Aoxi, the Le'an county town in Fuzhou (Jiangxi).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东生围
summaryEn: A large square Hakka walled house built from 1842 in the Qing dynasty and extended three times over 25 years, listed as a national heritage unit in 2013. It faces west and is laid out as a rectangle within a rectangle, with 199 rooms, nine courtyards and 18 halls (locally called nine wells, eighteen halls), and with its outbuildings and outer gate it covers about 30,000 m².
description: 东生围位于中国江西省赣州市安远县镇岗乡老围村，2013年被列为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。东生围是最大的客家方型围屋，始建于清道光二十二年，经过3次扩建、历时25年。围屋和附属设施及外大门，共占地面积30391平方米。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Laowei village, Zhengang township, about 16 km south-south-west of Anyuan town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中央红军长征出发地
summaryEn: In October 1934 more than 86,000 Red Army troops gathered around Yudu and crossed the Yudu (Gong) River at night at several crossing points, the start of the Long March. The national heritage listing covers eight sites in and around the town: the east-gate ferry crossing used by the central leadership, other units' crossing points, and the headquarters and lodgings used before the departure, including those of the Central Military Commission, the First and Fifth Army Corps and the Gannan provincial Soviet government. A memorial park on the riverbank at the east-gate crossing has the Central Red Army Long March Departure Memorial Hall and a monument.
description: 中央红军长征集结出发地旧址位于中国江西省于都县贡江镇及城郊，包括毛泽东周恩来等和中央直属机关长征第一渡口、中央红军各所属部队长征渡口、中央革命军事委员会旧址、中央红军第一军团部旧址、中央红军第五军团部旧址、赣南省苏维埃政府旧址暨长征前夕毛泽东旧居、赣南省委旧址、赣南省三级干部大会旧址八处，2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: The memorial park is on the riverbank at the east gate of Yudu town, with the other sites in the town and its outskirts; Yudu is about 48 km east-north-east of Ganzhou. The memorial hall is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 梅关
summaryEn: A mountain pass on the Meiling ridge between Jiangxi and Guangdong, on the old trade road that the Tang chancellor Zhang Jiuling had cut through the Dayu range in 716, about 5 m wide and 8 km long with a paved surface. The Ming-dynasty gate tower is inscribed Southern Guangdong's Mighty Pass on its north face and First Pass of Lingnan on its south face, and the Jiangxi side of the pass and the old road were listed as a national heritage unit in 2006. Plum trees were planted along the route, which gave the pass its name, and the road can be walked.
description: 梅关位于江西赣州。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、楼阁建筑、历史关隘。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the Meiling ridge at the Guangdong border, about 8 km south-south-west of Dayu town, with the Guangdong city of Nanxiong about 25 km to the south.

name: 通天岩
summaryEn: A red-sandstone (Danxia) hill in Shuixi town, north-west of Ganzhou, whose caves and niches hold hundreds of Buddhist statues and well over a hundred inscriptions from the Song dynasty to the Republic, among them Wang Yangming's. Most of the carvings are Song, apart from a few standing Buddhas at Cuiwei Rock that date from the Tang. It is described as the southernmost grotto complex in mainland China and as the largest cave temple in the Jiangnan region.
description: 通天岩位于中国江西省赣州市章贡区水西镇，属丹霞地貌景区，有三个山坳和四条山脊、十多处窟洞，主要有忘归岩、同心岩、通天岩、翠微岩等。通天岩景区共有石龛279座、造像359尊，是中国南方石窟造像较为集中的地方。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Shuixi town on the north-western edge of Ganzhou, about 9 km north-north-west of the city centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 浮梁古县衙
summaryEn: The government compound of Fuliang, the county town that long administered the Jingdezhen porcelain area, built in the Daoguang reign (1821–50). The surviving buildings are the gate, a courtyard, the main hall, a second hall, the inner residence and the kitchen, which together make up a Qing magistrate's office and residence. Demonstrations of intangible-heritage crafts for visitors are held on the site.
description: 浮梁县衙位于中华人民共和国江西省景德镇市浮梁县浮梁镇，建于清道光年间，现存中门、衙院、正堂、二堂、内宅和厨房六个部分，占地面积1200多平米。浮梁古县衙是中国仅存的四处古县衙之一，1987年被列为江西省文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the old town of Fuliang, about 14 km north-north-east of Jingdezhen, with the Red Pagoda about 200 m to the south.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 观音桥
summaryEn: A single-span granite arch bridge over the Sanxia Stream at the southern foot of Mount Lushan, built in 1014 under the Northern Song and one of the oldest surviving stone arch bridges in China. It is made of 107 granite blocks joined by tongue-and-groove joints without mortar, and the date is carved on the arch. Poets from Su Shi and Huang Tingjian to Zhu Xi wrote about it, and it stands beside Qixian Temple.
description: 观音桥位于中国的江西省九江市庐山市境内的庐山南麓，建于北宋，是中国现存最早的石拱桥之一，1959年被列为江西省文物保护单位，1988年被列为全国重点文物保护单位。观音桥位于栖贤寺旁，最初称为栖贤桥，北宋黄庭坚曾作《栖贤桥铭》。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the southern slope of Mount Lushan, about 7 km north-north-west of Nankang and about 18 km south-south-east of Jiujiang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 石钟山
summaryEn: A small hill on the Yangtze where Poyang Lake flows into the river, named for the bell-like booming of waves in the caves under its cliffs, a sound the Song poet Su Shi investigated by boat and described in his essay on the mountain. The hill commands the river-lake junction and was fought over by Taiping and Xiang Army fleets in the 1850s; the buildings on it, completed by 1860 and centred on a shrine hall, include Buddhist halls and a guest villa, and the rock is carved with inscriptions by Su Shi, Huang Tingjian, Guo Moruo and others. The buildings and inscriptions are on the national list of protected sites, added in 2013.
description: 石钟山位于江西省九江市湖口县，地处鄱阳湖与长江的交汇处，有城南上石钟山和城北下石钟山，合称“双钟”。下石钟山以险要的陡壁临长江，山多缝隙空穴，水石相击，声如洪钟而得名。“秀山石壁向湖中，缝洞深藏水可通；涌入浪波相荡击，声音传出像鸣钟”，关于石钟山得名之缘由，历史上有过很长时间的争论。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the Yangtze shore at the north-western edge of Hukou town, where Poyang Lake meets the river, about 28 km east-north-east of Jiujiang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 秀峰
summaryEn: A scenic area at the southern foot of Mount Lushan, centred on Longtan pool and the site of Xiufeng Temple, which was founded under the Southern Tang. The rock faces and steles carry inscriptions from the Tang dynasty to the Republic, among them the Tang Zhongxing Stele by Yan Zhenqing, of which three of the four original stones survive, and a stele by Wang Yangming. Its waterfalls and peaks are linked with Li Bai's poem on viewing a waterfall on Mount Lushan.
description: 秀峰摩崖位于中国江西省九江市星子县秀峰风景区，2006年5月25日被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。秀峰位于庐山南麓，此地原有秀峰寺，始建于南唐，毁于太平天国时期，寺虽毁，但秀峰一名却沿用下来。此处有唐代至民国时期的石刻和碑铭，其中著名的有：“青玉峡”，刻于龙潭峭壁上，传说为宋米芾所书。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At the southern foot of Mount Lushan, about 6 km west-north-west of Nankang and about 21 km south of Jiujiang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 云居山真如寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist mountain in western Yongxiu, one of the three sections of the Lushan Xihai 5A scenic area, rising to about 970 m, with cool summers and wooded valleys that hold waterfalls, among them a 120 m drop at Five Dragon Pool. At its centre is Zhenru Chan Temple, founded in the early 9th century in the Tang dynasty and the ancestral temple of the Caodong school of Chan Buddhism, with halls rebuilt from 1953. A short walk east of the temple, the pagoda court holds memorial pagodas of Chan masters from the Tang to the Yuan dynasties, which form the nationally listed Zhenru Temple Pagoda Forest.
description: 真如寺，又称云居禅院、龙昌禅院、真如禅寺，位于江西省九江市永修县云居山上，汉族地区佛教全国重点寺院之一。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Yunju Mountain, about 26 km west-north-west of Yongxiu town and about 73 km south-south-west of Jiujiang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南昌八一起义纪念馆
summaryEn: On 1 August 1927 the Chinese Communist Party launched the Nanchang Uprising, with its general headquarters in this building, the former Jiangxi Grand Hotel, a five-storey brick-and-timber block of 1923 with 96 rooms around a courtyard. The memorial hall, founded in 1956 and open since 1959, displays the events of the uprising, and the second-floor offices and bedrooms of Zhou Enlai and Lin Boqu are part of the building. The 1961 national heritage listing, 'Headquarters of the August 1 Uprising', also covers four other sites in the city, among them the headquarters of He Long and Ye Ting and Zhu De's former residence.
description: 南昌八一起义纪念馆位于中国江西省南昌市西湖区广润门街道中山路380号，是以八一起义指挥部旧址为基础成立的纪念馆，成立于1956年，1959年10月1日正式开馆，先后被授予“国家一级博物馆”、“国家AAAA级旅游景区”等称号。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Zhongshan Road in Nanchang's Xihu district, in the old city and next to the Wanshou Palace quarter. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南昌新四军军部旧址
summaryEn: A two-storey French-style house built in 1915 for the warlord Zhang Xun served as the headquarters of the New Fourth Army from 6 January to 4 April 1938, and afterwards housed the CPC Southeast Bureau and the army's Jiangxi liaison office until March 1939. The house and two other buildings stand in a compound beside an exhibition building opened in 2011, which holds a permanent display, 'The Iron New Fourth Army', on the army's formation and wartime service.
description: 南昌新四军军部旧址位于中国江西省南昌市西湖区友竹路，2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。1937年10月，南方八省的红军和游击队整编为国民革命军陆军新编第四军，或称“国民革命军新编第四军”，简称新四军。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Xiangshan South Road in Nanchang's Xihu district, in the old city and a short walk from the former CPC Southeast Bureau site. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 绿地中心303观光厅
summaryEn: This is an observation hall high up in one of the twin Greenland Central Plaza towers, supertall skyscrapers of 303 m and 59 floors built between 2011 and 2015. The towers stand in the Honggutan business district on the west bank of the Gan River, and the hall appears on the provincial tourism department's city leisure routes.
description: 南昌绿地中央广场是两栋超高层摩天大楼，位于中国江西省南昌市，由绿地集团承建。建筑高度为303米，地上59层。
accessEn: In the Honggutan business district on the west bank of the Gan River, about 2 km west of the Pavilion of Prince Teng.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 洪崖丹井
summaryEn: Hongya Danjing is a wooded gorge at the entrance to the Meiling hills, with a waterfall and cliffs carved with old inscriptions, the clearest dated 1185. A legend tells of Hongya, a music master of the Yellow Emperor, who dug five wells here to make elixirs and devised the twelve-tone scale, and the place is one of the Ten Views of Yuzhang, the old name for Nanchang. It has been a provincial heritage site since 1985, and Nanchang's old names Hongzhou and Hongdu are traced to it.
description: 洪崖丹井是豫章十景中历史最老的景点。其位于梅岭入口，湾里区水厂附近。此处山岭岩壁峭立，飞泉迸溅，人称“洪崖瀑布”，传说洪崖先生得道于此，并在涧中凿井五口，汲水炼丹，丹成后飞升而去。
accessEn: At the foot of the Meiling hills in Wanli district, about 17 km west-north-west of central Nanchang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 绳金塔
summaryEn: Shengjin Pagoda is a seven-storey octagonal brick pagoda, 50.86 m high, outside the old Jinxian Gate of Nanchang; the first pagoda dates from 904–907 and the present one was rebuilt in 1713–14. A temple, the Qianfo or Taxia Temple, stands at its foot, a temple fair is held on the site each autumn, and the surrounding old street is known for evening food stalls.
description: 绳金塔座落在中国江西省南昌市西湖区绳金塔街东侧165号，原南昌古城进贤门外，为八角七层楼阁式砖塔，始建于唐，重建于清。
accessEn: In the Shengjinta area of Nanchang's Xihu district, just south of the old city, a short walk from Shengjinta metro station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 小平小道
summaryEn: Deng Xiaoping and his wife Zhuo Lin were sent to Xinjian county, Jiangxi, in October 1969, during the Cultural Revolution, and stayed until February 1973; he worked at the county tractor repair factory and walked each day between it and his residence, a route later called the Xiaoping Path. The site keeps the workshop where he worked, with his bench and tools, the path with a visitors' walkway, an exhibition hall opened in 2013 with six display sections, and the former residence, which stands in the grounds of what is now the Nanchang Army Academy.
description: 邓小平旧居与劳动车间位于中国江西省南昌市新建区望城镇省庄村，包括“小平楼”、“邓小平小道”、“小平车间”及“小平广场”4处，2000年被列为江西省文物保护单位，2013年被列为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Wangcheng town, Xinjian district, on the north-western edge of Nanchang, about 9 km west of the city centre. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 安源路矿工人运动纪念馆
summaryEn: A museum on the slope of Niuxingling in Anyuan, the old coal-mining quarter of Pingxiang, housed in a building opened in 1969 that replaced a first exhibition set up in the former workers' club in 1956. Its displays follow the labour movement at the Anyuan collieries and on the Zhuzhou–Pingxiang railway between 1921 and 1930, centred on the miners' and railway workers' strike of September 1922, with large sculpture groups in the halls. The museum also runs the original sites nearby, among them the club, the former colliery office and the mine portal, which have their own entries on this map.
description: 安源路矿工人运动纪念馆，位于中华人民共和国江西省萍乡市安源区安源镇胜利广场的牛形岭山腰上，是为纪念安源路矿工人大罢工而建立的革命博物馆，为江西省文化厅直属单位。
accessEn: On the hillside above Victory Square in Anyuan town, on the eastern side of Pingxiang. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 杨岐山
summaryEn: Yangqi Shan is a wooded karst mountain north of Pingxiang, regarded as the ancestral home of the Yangqi school of Chan (Zen) Buddhism. Putong Temple, founded in 713 and renamed in the 1040s when the monk Fanghui began the school there, has two small Tang pagodas in its grounds, one octagonal (2.35 m) and one shaped like a square pavilion, which are a national heritage unit. The scenic area also includes the Nielong Cave, a lit karst cave used as a summer retreat, and a small geology museum.
description: 杨岐山位于江西省萍乡市上栗县杨岐境内，离城区20余公里，海拔约1000米，风景秀丽，气候宜人，是一个融合自然风光与宗教人文景观于一体的国家级风景名胜区。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Putong Temple in Yangqi township, about 11 km east-south-east of Shangli town and about 24 km north of Pingxiang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鹅湖书院
summaryEn: Ehu Academy stands at the foot of Mount Ehu on the spot where, in 1175, the philosophers Zhu Xi, Lu Zuqian, Lu Jiuyuan and Lu Jiuling held the debate known as the Ehu Meeting. The academy took its present name in the Ming dynasty, and its layout dates largely from a Qing rebuilding of 1717 that added a gatehouse, stone archway, hall, ceremonial pool, arched bridge, stele pavilion and imperial-book tower, with rows of student cells beside them. It has been a national heritage site since 2006 and is also a national 4A scenic area.
description: 鹅湖书院位于中国江西省上饶市铅山县鹅湖镇境内，地处鹅湖山北麓，距河口镇约15千米，1957年被列为第一批江西省文物保护单位，2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。鹅湖山上有湖，多生荷花，故名“荷湖”。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At the foot of Mount Ehu in Ehu town, about 12 km east-south-east of Hekou town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 李坑
summaryEn: Likeng, in Qiukou town, is a Li-clan village where lanes follow a winding stream crossed by dozens of stone, timber and brick bridges, with Ming and Qing houses on both banks. Four Ming houses and dozens from the Qing survive, and the village's families produced nine jinshi in the Song dynasty; named views such as the Twin Bridges and the Jiao Spring are marked along the stream. Do not confuse it with Likeng (理坑) in Tuochuan township, a different village listed separately.
description: 李坑村位于中国江西省上饶市婺源县秋口镇，是江西省历史文化名村。李坑村民以李姓为主，据其家谱记载其始祖为唐代宗室，唐末避乱到歙县，到五世祖迁到这里，时称理源，后改称为理田。李氏一族史上颇重文教，在宋代有九名进士，明代有一名武进士，清代有三名进士，另外在元代还出了一位全国著名的风水师李景溪。
accessEn: In Qiukou town, about 11 km north-east of Wuyuan town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 闽浙赣省委机关旧址
summaryEn: In December 1932 the Chinese Soviet Republic's Gandongbei (north-east Jiangxi) province was renamed Min-Zhe-Gan, and its party committee and government were based in Fenglin village in Geyuan town until the offices left in November 1934. The nationally listed group covers the provincial party and government offices, the military district headquarters, the open ground known as the Red Square and the fifth branch of the Red Army school, part of a wider set of 34 sites in and around Geyuan. The Geyuan scenic area takes in Fenglin, with the low single-storey offices, an exhibition hall and the square, and Geyuan village about 3 km to the south-east, with the Red Army school site, Lenin Park, an old opera stage and a martyrs' memorial hall.
description: 闽浙赣革命根据地旧址位于中国江西省上饶市横峰县，该旧址群完整反映了1926年至1934年期间闽浙赣革命根据地的建设发展历程，其中闽浙赣省委机关旧址于1996年被列为全国重点文物保护单位，闽浙赣省旧址是由三十四处革命旧址组成的建筑群，涵盖了中共赣东北省委、闽浙赣省各级机关、军事机构、文化教育设施和医疗机构等重要革命遗址。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Geyuan town, about 24 km north-north-east of Hengfeng town and about 34 km west-north-west of Shangrao city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 仙女湖
summaryEn: Fairy Lake is the Jiangkou reservoir on the Yuan river, a large artificial lake of about 50 km² south-west of Xinyu, dotted with nearly a hundred wooded islands. It was renamed in 1994 after a legend, recorded in the Jin-dynasty Soushen ji, of feathered fairy maidens who came down to earth, and is now run as a national tourist resort built around that legend and the Qixi (Chinese Valentine's Day) festival. Visitors take boats among the islands, visit the three islands rebuilt in 2024 with staged shows, and can drive the 34 km lakeside road.
description: 仙女湖又名江口水库，位于中国江西省新余市西南，赣江流域下游一级支流袁河中段，是以发电、防洪、灌溉为主，兼有供水、养殖、旅游等功能的大型水库，是江西省4大水库之一。水域总面积约50平方千米，库容约8.9亿立方米，平均水深12米。
accessEn: At Hexia town on the lake shore, about 16 km south-west of Xinyu.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 魏集古镇
summaryEn: Weiji Ancient Town is a tourist zone in Weiji town, one of Huimin County's Yellow River towns, that links two groups of Ming-Qing-style buildings, Wei's Manor and the Weiji old village, along a new old-style street. Wei's Manor, a national heritage unit, is a fortified landowner's compound completed in 1893: a walled rectangle of about 84 by 46 m with round corner turrets and some 48 rooms in six courtyards. The old village is a modern imitation of Ming-Qing houses with more than 200 snack shops, workshops and small attractions, and folk performances in the evenings.
description: 魏集古镇位于山东滨州。游览特色包括古镇、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Weiji town, about 30 km south-east of Huimin County town and 22 km west-south-west of Binzhou city centre; the manor and the old village lie about 1 km apart, and the zone is reached by road.

name: 百脉泉公园
summaryEn: A public park in the centre of Mingshui, Zhangqiu, built around the Baimai group of artesian karst springs, one of Jinan's 'seventy-two famous springs'. The main spring rises in a rectangular pool about 25 m long in the courtyard of the Dragon Spring Temple, with small lakes fed by the springs around it and a poetry garden for the Song poet Li Qingzhao, who is associated with Zhangqiu. Mingshui Ancient Town, a new town built in old style, opened beside the park in 2023-24.
description: 百脉泉位于中国山东省济南市章丘市驻地的百脉泉公园龙泉寺内，七十二名泉之一，与趵突泉齐名并列。1986年章丘市委市政府以百脉泉为中心兴建百脉泉公园。在百脉泉西北角建有一座因纪念宋代著名女词人李清照的清照园。
accessEn: In Mingshui, the centre of Zhangqiu district, about 51 km by road east of central Jinan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 莱芜战役纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial museum on Huangshan hill in Laiwu, now a district of Jinan, opened in 1997 on the site of an earlier martyrs' cemetery. It covers the Laiwu Campaign of 20–23 February 1947 and the wartime resistance in central Shandong, with an exhibition hall, a panorama painting 17 m high showing the fighting north of the town, a martyrs' memorial tower and an open-air weapons display. It suits visitors interested in the history of the Chinese civil war.
description: 莱芜战役纪念馆位于中华人民共和国山东省济南市莱芜区英雄路北首的黄山上，前身为莱芜革命烈士陵园。是国家4A级旅游景区，用以纪念1947年发生于莱芜境内的莱芜战役。
accessEn: In central Laiwu, about 78 km south-east of central Jinan; closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 千佛山
summaryEn: A wooded hill on the southern edge of Jinan, counted with Baotu Spring and Daming Lake as one of the city's three famous sights. About 130 Buddha figures carved in the Sui dynasty remain on the Thousand Buddha Cliff, and Xingguochan Temple, a Tang foundation, stands on the slope, with paths and a chairlift leading up. From the ridge there are views north across the city towards the Yellow River.
description: 千佛山位于中国山东省济南市南郊，是济南的名胜，是泰山的北端余脉，海拔285米。
accessEn: On Jingshi Road in Lixia district, about 3 km south-south-east of Quancheng Square in central Jinan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 水泊梁山
summaryEn: Mount Liang is a low hill, about 198 m high, in Liangshan County that the classic Chinese novel Water Margin made the stronghold of 108 outlaw heroes. The scenic area is built around that story, with structures put up to match the novel's descriptions, and it is also a provincial forest park and geopark. It will mainly interest readers and fans of the novel.
description: 梁山泊，亦作梁山泺，是曾经存在于今山东梁山城东南隅一带的湖泊。
accessEn: Beside Liangshan county town, about 60 km north-west of Jining city centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 尼山孔庙及书院
summaryEn: A temple on Mount Ni, the hill traditionally held to be the birthplace of Confucius, with an academy beside it, set in the hills east of Qufu. It was first built in the 950s, rebuilt in 1417 in the Ming dynasty and repaired several times, reaching its present form in the Qing; repairs in 1925 were funded by Confucius's 77th-generation descendant Kong Decheng. It is a separate visit from the main Temple of Confucius, Kong Family Mansion and Cemetery in Qufu.
description: 尼山孔庙是为纪念孔子诞生而在尼山所建的祭祀庙宇，位于山东曲阜。五代后周显德年间始建，明永乐十五年重建，之后数次重修。现为全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Nishan town, about 23 km east-south-east of Qufu's old town (about 38 km by road).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 青山寺
summaryEn: A hillside temple group on the western slope of Qingshan, south of Jiaxiang, which began as a shrine to the ruler of the Western Zhou state of Jiao and later became a joint Buddhist and Daoist temple. The surviving buildings are mostly Qing and Republican-era, rising up the slope from a Mount Tai palace archway through the Huijigong Hall to a ten-thousand-Buddha pavilion, with 58 stelae dating from the Song onwards. The surrounding hill is run as a 4A scenic area with several more temples and springs.
description: 青山寺，位于山东省济宁市嘉祥县纸坊镇青山风景区，2006年被列为山东省文物保护单位，2013年被列为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。青山寺始建年代无考，古称焦王祠，据旧县志记载：“武王克商，封神农之后于焦，世称焦王。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Zhifang town, about 9 km south-south-west of Jiaxiang county town and about 27 km west-south-west of Jining city centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 琅琊台
summaryEn: A coastal hill in the south of the West Coast New Area where, according to the Records of the Grand Historian, Qin Shi Huang stayed for three months in 219 BC and had a terrace built. Excavations since 2019 have uncovered a T-shaped rammed-earth platform of about 45,000 m² on the 183 m summit, with a stair of hollow bricks decorated with dragon patterns, rooms below the platform and drainage pipes. It was listed as a national heritage unit in 2013 and named one of China's top ten archaeological discoveries of 2025.
description: 琅琊台，遗址位于山东省青岛市黄岛区琅琊镇台西头村后琅琊台山上，是中华人民共和国全国重点文物保护单位之一。1992年6月12日，公布为山东省文物保护单位，2013年5月公布为全国重点文物保护单位，是一座古遗址。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the coast near Langya town in the south of the West Coast New Area, about 59 km south-west of central Qingdao.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 青岛电视塔
summaryEn: A 232 m lattice broadcasting tower completed in the mid-1990s on Taiping Hill, inside Julin Park, with an observation deck. It suits a short stop for views over the city, combined with a walk in the park.
description: 青岛电视塔是位于青岛市太平山榉林公园内的一座电视塔，所处海拔116米，塔高232米，建于1994年。青岛电视塔内拥有旋转餐厅、商场等设施，塔高130米处为球形建筑，球形建筑之下为230平方米的观光平台。
accessEn: On Taiping Hill in Julin Park, about 3 km east-north-east of Zhanqiao Pier in central Qingdao; check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 白佛山
summaryEn: A 370 m hill on the western side of Dongping, the county seat, whose cliff grottoes are centred on a Shakyamuni statue about 6.7 m high, carved in 587 in the Sui dynasty and protected as a national unit. The hill also has the Sanjiao (Three Teachings) Temple, with Buddhist, Confucian and Daoist figures, two caves called Black Cloud and White Cloud, and a landscaped park and lotus-sculpture plaza within a scenic area of about 10 square kilometres. The county rebuilt the scenic area from 2023 with a hotel and seasonal events such as an autumn chrysanthemum show, and locals traditionally climb the hill for a temple fair on the second day of the second lunar month.
description: 白佛山，又称白虎山、危山、金螺山，位于山东东平境内。海拔370米。白佛山景区内有三教寺、石窟造像群，及隋唐宋元明历代石刻等。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 4 km west-north-west of the centre of Dongping, the county seat, and about 69 km west-south-west of central Tai'an.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东平湖
summaryEn: Shandong's second-largest freshwater lake, described as the surviving water of the 'eight hundred li' Liangshan marsh of the novel Water Margin and a key point on the eastern route of the South-to-North Water Transfer Project. The county government gives a total area of 627 square kilometres, of which the permanent old lake is about 209 square kilometres. Lakeside tourism around Laohu includes boat trips, reed wetlands and fish-based local food, a large double-hulled sightseeing boat added in autumn 2026, and the Great Song Never-Night City, a Song-style district with costumed night shows.
description: 东平湖位于山东省西南部东平县境内，是山东第二大淡水湖泊，也是黄河下游一处重要的滞洪水库。是黄河、大汶河、运河三大水系的交汇地。湖面总面积约627平方公里。
accessEn: On the lakeshore near Laohu town, about 15 km west of Dongping town and about 80 km west-south-west of central Tai'an.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 十笏园
summaryEn: A small private garden built in 1885 in the old Weicheng district, covering about 2,000 square metres and named 'Ten Tablets' after its modest size. Courtyards, halls, rockeries, a pond and trees are packed into the compound, which was bought by the wealthy Ding family and now houses a museum. It lies inside a restored cultural district, the 4A scenic area, and suits a short stop for a compact Qing-period garden.
description: 十笏园是中国北方园林，又名“丁家花园”，位于山东省潍坊市潍城区胡家牌坊街，建于清光绪十一年，面积2000平方米。因占地小，故得名十笏园，以喻其仅如十个板笏大小。后为潍县首富丁善宝花重金买下。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the old town of Weicheng district, about 5 km west of the modern city centre, in a district of old lanes.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大黑山岛
summaryEn: Daheishan is a volcanic island at the western end of the Changshan Islands in the Bohai Strait, about 70 minutes by ferry from Penglai. Its main sights are the quartzite cliffs, sea caves and coastal walkway of Longzhua Shan (Dragon Claw Mountain), a national geopark site, and a long sand beach at Tuowei. At Beizhuang village the national-listed Beizhuang site is a prehistoric settlement about 6,500 years old, and the Beizhuang Prehistoric Site Museum shows finds from its excavations.
description: 大黑山岛是中国渤海长山列岛中的一个火山岛，位于群岛的最西端，是长山列岛中面积比较大的一个岛，距离南长山岛约3海里航程。大黑山岛地貌独特，岛上地形以山地为主，有极少量的平地，岛上有三个主要的山头，分别为老黑山、老鹰窝和鞍桥山，其中老黑山是全岛最高点，海拔高度约140米左右。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: By ferry to Heishan harbour from Penglai port (about 70 minutes) or from Changdao port; the Beizhuang museum on the island is closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 昆嵛山
summaryEn: Mount Kunyu is a forested granite range at the eastern end of the Shandong peninsula, rising to 923 m at Taibo Peak and regarded as the birthplace of Quanzhen Daoism in the 12th century. The visitor area is run as Kunyu Mountain National Forest Park, with separate sub-areas that include Shimenli, Jiulongchi, Wuran Temple, Yanxia Cave and Yuegu Hall. It suits hiking and temple visits from Yantai between spring and autumn.
description: 昆嵛山地处胶东半岛东端，跨山东省的威海文登区和烟台市牟平区，总面积24万余亩。主峰泰礴顶，海拔923米，巍峨耸立，为胶东群山之首。昆嵛山与艾山、牙山、大泽山等横贯半岛的中部和北部，构成半岛南北水系的分水岭。
accessEn: In the hills south-east of Muping, about 22 km by road from Muping town and about 50 km by road from central Yantai; the scenic area is closed over winter and reopens around the start of March.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 烟台山
summaryEn: Yantai Hill is a small hill on the waterfront in the city centre, named after the beacon tower built on it in 1398 to warn of pirate raids, which gave the city its name. After Yantai was opened as a treaty port in 1861, consulates, customs offices, banks and churches were built on and around it, and the surviving group of 38 buildings, listed nationally in 2006, is described as the most complete former consular quarter in China. Some buildings now house small museums, such as the port-opening exhibition and the Bing Xin memorial hall, and the hill also has a lighthouse and a long evergreen walkway.
description: 烟台山是中国山东省烟台市芝罘区内的一座山，位于市中心北部黄海边，海拔42.5米，面积45公顷，三面环海。山上植被较好。目前是中国国家4A级旅游景区和山东省重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the waterfront in Zhifu district, about 1.7 km east of Yantai railway station; many of the historic buildings are not open inside, and can be seen from the street.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中国古车博物馆
summaryEn: This museum on the east bank of the Zi River stands on the Neolithic Houli site, where a pit of buried Spring and Autumn period chariots and horses was uncovered in 1990 during construction of the Jinan–Qingdao expressway. The pit hall lies under the expressway's bridge approach and shows the remains where they were found, while a separate gallery displays 19 reconstructed vehicles from the Shang dynasty to the Qing and nearly a hundred models. It suits visitors interested in early Chinese transport or the archaeology of the Qi state.
description: 中国古车博物馆位于中国山东省淄博市临淄区齐陵镇后李官庄后李文化遗址上。该馆于1991年筹建，1994年落成，占地13000平方米，建筑面积3600平方米，投资990万元。部分展厅位于地下，地上便是青银高速公路，地上的现代交通工具和地下的古代交通工具相映成趣，别有一番象征意义。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Houli village, Qiling subdistrict, Linzi District, about 29 km east of central Zibo and about 3 km north-east of the Qi Culture Museum.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 蒲松龄故居·聊斋城
summaryEn: Pu Songling (1640–1715), author of the ghost and fox tales 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio', was born and lived in Pujiazhuang, now part of Zichuan. The museum there keeps his rebuilt family home, the Liuquan spring where tradition has him gathering stories from passers-by, his family cemetery, and exhibition rooms of manuscripts, editions and portraits. It is part of Liaozhai City, a modern themed garden of pavilions, a rebuilt temple and displays based on his stories.
description: 蒲松龄故居位于山东省淄博市淄川区洪山镇蒲家庄，是清代小说家蒲松龄的故居。包括故居旧址、附近住宅、柳泉以及墓园，现辟为蒲松龄纪念馆，介绍蒲松龄的生平以及其著作的影响，是全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Pujiazhuang, Hongshan town, about 4 km east-south-east of Zichuan town centre and about 21 km south of central Zibo; the museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 沂源溶洞群
summaryEn: A cluster of Ordovician limestone caves on the southern slope of Lushan, in Nanlushan town north-west of Yiyuan, several of which are open to visitors. The best known, Jiutian Cave, runs for about 518 m through nine halls and is noted for its unusually varied crystal deposits, especially its 'stone flowers'. Nearby Qianren (Thousand-Men) Cave yielded Palaeolithic remains in 1965 and was used by the Eighth Route Army as an arsenal in 1938–39.
description: 沂源溶洞群是中国北方的著名溶洞群，位于山东省沂源县城西北13公里的土门镇，鲁山南侧。在近五平方公里境内，有大小洞穴四十余个，称“北国第一洞群”。千人洞：洞高30余米，地质上称为“山东一号洞”。
accessEn: In Nanlushan town, on Wangfeng Road, about 12 km north-west of Yiyuan town and about 61 km south of central Zibo.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 羑里城
summaryEn: The site north of Tangyin held by tradition to be Youli, where the last Shang king imprisoned Ji Chang, later King Wen of Zhou, who is said to have worked out the 64 hexagrams of the Book of Changes (Yijing) here. Excavation has found deposits from the Longshan culture to the Shang and Zhou, and the site keeps Ming buildings including the Yanyi archway, the ceremonial gate, the main gate and the second hall. It holds Yijing-themed festivals and ceremonies honouring King Wen.
description: 羑里城遗址位于中国河南省安阳市汤阴县城北4公里，面积约1公顷。该地于新石器时代即有人类活动，商代为监狱之一，周文王曾被商纣王拘于此，修订《易经》，现存包括龙山文化和商周时期文化遗址，基本保存完好。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Wenwang Road at the northern edge of Tangyin county town, about half an hour by road south of Anyang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 焦作影视城
summaryEn: A film studio and theme park built from 1995 by the Jiaozuo government and China Central Television, with about 2.5 km² of sets in the style of Spring and Autumn, Warring States, Qin, Han and Three Kingdoms architecture. Many historical dramas were shot here; visitors walk the sets, watch staged performances and try period games such as archery and pitch-pot.
description: 焦作影视城位于中华人民共和国河南省焦作市解放区普济路的一家影视基地，为国家4A级旅游景区，以影视拍摄服务为主，兼具观光旅游、文化娱乐、休闲度假等功能，位于焦作市区北缘，太行山脚下。影视城占地面积2.5平方公里，建筑面积40万平方米，试图重现华夏文明早期的建筑风格。
accessEn: On Puji Road at the northern edge of Jiaozuo city, at the foot of the Taihang hills; about 15 minutes by taxi from the centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 嘉应观
summaryEn: A temple complex founded in 1723 on the orders of the Yongzheng Emperor as the temple of the dragon kings of the Huai, Yellow and other rivers, close to the north bank of the Yellow River. About 50 Qing buildings survive in two courtyards, among them the imperial stele pavilion, the Great King Hall and the Pavilion of Yu the Great, and it once housed the Yellow River control headquarters of Fu Zuoyi and Soviet advisers. It is a good stop for anyone interested in the long history of taming the Yellow River.
description: 嘉应观位于中国河南省焦作市武陟县嘉应观乡杨庄村南，2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。嘉应观始建于清雍正元年，为雍正帝敕建的“淮黄诸河龙王庙”。现存建筑五十座，占地一百四十亩，分南北两院。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Jiayingguan township, Wuzhi County, about 50 minutes by road south-east of central Jiaozuo.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 济渎庙
summaryEn: The temple of the god of the Ji, one of the four great rivers of ancient China, founded in 582 at the river's eastern spring and the largest and most complete of the temples to the Four Rivers. Twenty-three buildings from the Song to the Qing stand on three axes, including a rear hall of 973 that is the oldest wooden building in Henan, a Ming wooden archway gate and the spring-fed pools of the Beihai Shrine with a Song stone balustrade. It is the core of the Jishui Source cultural tourism area, which also takes in Longquan Lake and a peony garden.
description: 济渎庙位于中国河南省济源市济渎大道1396号，为“四渎”之一济水的水神庙，同时也是济水东源所在，是四渎神庙中现存规模最大，保存最完整的一处。济渎庙始建于隋开皇二年，唐贞元十二年在济渎池后建北海祠，使其亦为祭祀北海神的场所，故全称济渎北海庙。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Jidu Street in the north of Jiyuan city, about 2 km from the centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 王屋山
summaryEn: A Taoist mountain north-west of Jiyuan, ranked first of the Ten Grotto-Heavens of Taoism and the setting of the fable of the Foolish Old Man who moved the mountains. A stepped pilgrim path and a cableway climb to Tiantan Peak (1,715 m), where the Yellow Emperor is said to have sacrificed to Heaven. Near the entrance stands Yangtai Palace, built in 724–727 for the Taoist master Sima Chengzhen, whose Ming Sanqing Hall and three-storey Yuhuang Pavilion have stone columns carved with Taoist figures and stories.
description: 王屋山，又称“天坛山”。位于河南省济源市西北40公里处，为中国国家级风景名胜区。山名之由来，有谓“山中有洞，深不可入，洞中如王者之宫，故名曰王屋也”。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 30–40 km north-west of Jiyuan city; buses run from the city to Wangwushan and Yangtai Palace.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 五龙口
summaryEn: The gorge where the Qin River breaks out of the Taihang Mountains north-east of Jiyuan, home to a national nature reserve for Taihang macaques and to some of China's oldest irrigation works. Water has been drawn off here since the Qin dynasty, and the Ming tunnel intakes of the Yongli and Guangji canals survive, topped by shrines with stone statues of the officials who built them. Monkeys roam the slopes, and the scenic area also has hot springs and a gallery for the landscape painter Jing Hao.
description: 五龙口古代水利设施位于中华人民共和国河南省济源市五龙口镇沁河出山口处，为河南省开创年代最久、保存最为完好的古代水利设施之一，也是中国水利史上第一个采用暗渠进行隔山取水的水利工程。五龙口兴修水利的历史最早可追溯至秦朝，曹魏、唐朝、元朝均在此修渠，至明朝时期建成5条水渠，故称“五龙口”。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At the mouth of the Qin River valley about 15 km north-east of Jiyuan city, roughly 30 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙亭
summaryEn: A Qing palace-style hall raised on a brick platform of 72 steps on the site of the Northern Song imperial palace in the north of Kaifeng's old city. The platform began as an artificial hill in the garden of the Ming princes of Zhou, and the hall, built in the 18th century and rebuilt to the old design in 1856, faces an avenue between Panjia and Yangjia lakes, in a park whose gates have been rebuilt since 1985. The park also marks the sites of the Song palace walls and of its Daqing Hall.
description: 龙亭是中国河南省开封市内的一处旅游胜地，位于市中心龙亭区。为清代重檐歇山顶宫殿式建筑，建在72级台阶的巨大青砖台基上，坐北朝南。龙亭前以一条大道为界，东西分别为潘家湖与杨家湖。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At the north end of Kaifeng's old city, reached along the rebuilt Song Imperial Way from Zhongshan Road; Tianbo Yang Mansion and the Hanyuan Stele Forest are next door.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 焦裕禄纪念园
summaryEn: A memorial park on the old Yellow River dyke at the northern edge of Lankao town for Jiao Yulu, the county's Communist Party secretary from 1962 until his death in 1964, who led local campaigns against drifting sand, waterlogging and salinised soil. It holds his white-marble tomb, where he was reburied in 1966 at his own request, a memorial hall opened in 1994 with exhibits on his life, a monument to revolutionary martyrs and a grove of paulownia trees. It is a national patriotic-education base and receives many Communist Party delegations.
description: 焦裕禄烈士墓，是一座位于河南省开封市兰考县的全国重点文物保护单位。焦裕禄生前曾任河南开封市兰考县的县委书记，死后被批准为革命烈士；他起初葬于郑州市烈士公墓，后来遂其遗愿迁葬到现址，其墓是焦裕禄烈士陵园的一部分。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the northern edge of Lankao town, about 45 km east of Kaifeng and served by Lankao and Lankao South railway stations; since August 2026 visits must be booked in advance with real-name registration through the park's mini-programme.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 开封城墙
summaryEn: Kaifeng's Qing-dynasty city wall, rebuilt in grey brick in 1842 after a Yellow River flood, still runs for 14.4 km around the old city and is among the longest surviving city walls in China. Its circuit goes back to the Tang city of Bianzhou, rebuilt in 781, and roughly matches the inner city of the Northern Song capital. Its gate towers are modern reconstructions, the best known being the Daliang Gate on the west side, rebuilt in 1998.
description: 开封城墙，位于中华人民共和国河南省开封市龙亭区，为清代开封府城的城墙。1996年被列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。全长14.4公里，仅次于南京城墙。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: The wall encircles Kaifeng's old city; the Daliang Gate on the west side, a short taxi ride from the centre, is the easiest place to see it.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 开封包公祠
summaryEn: A memorial temple to Bao Zheng (999–1062), the Northern Song official who became China's byword for incorruptible justice as 'Judge Bao' of opera and television. Rebuilt in 1984 on the west shore of Baogong Lake on the site of a temple first raised under the Jin and Yuan, it has gates, a screen wall, a stele pavilion and halls that tell his life with a bronze statue, wax figures, models, rubbings and inscriptions. It pairs naturally with the rebuilt Kaifeng Prefecture office across the lake.
description: 开封包公祠位于开封市鼓楼区向阳路1号，是为北宋清官包拯而建的纪念场所。它是规模最大、资料最全、影响最广的专门纪念包公的场所。
accessEn: On the west shore of Baogong Lake in the south-west of Kaifeng's old city, a short taxi ride from the centre. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 贾湖遗址
summaryEn: The Neolithic settlement of Jiahu, lived in from about 9,000 to 7,500 years ago, yielded bone flutes made from the wing bones of red-crowned cranes that can still be played, along with signs carved on tortoise shells, early rice and traces of fermented drink. The site museum, opened in 2023 beside Jiahu village, shows the flutes and other finds, and walkways in the archaeological park next to it lead through four timber shelters with displays of a soil profile, house foundations and the origins of farming.
description: 贾湖遗址位于河南漯河。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Jiahu village near Beiwudu town, about 22 km north of Wuyang town and roughly an hour by road west of central Luohe.

name: 南街村
summaryEn: A village on the southern edge of Linying town, widely described as China's last Maoist village, which collectivised its farming and industry in 1986; a statue of Mao Zedong flanked by portraits of Engels and Lenin stands on its main square, and images of Marx and Stalin appear around the village. Its village-run food factories, best known for instant noodles, have paid for housing and welfare, and the model has drawn both praise and scepticism in the Chinese press. It receives many domestic red-tourism visitors.
description: 南街村是位于中国河南省漯河市临颍县城南隅的一个行政村，全村总面积1.78平方公里，共有848户3180人，村民主要包括回汉两个民族。该村一度以改革开放时代还坚持实施毛泽东思想而闻名。
accessEn: On the south side of Linying town, about 30 km north of central Luohe by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 小商桥
summaryEn: A red-sandstone arch bridge over the Xiaoshang River, traditionally dated to 584 under the Sui and rebuilt in early Song style, with one main arch and a small open arch at each end. The arch stones carry reliefs of heavenly horses, lions and lotus flowers, and small carved strongmen at the corners seem to hold the arch up on their shoulders. The scenic area also has a memorial park to Yang Zaixing, a general under Yue Fei who was killed fighting the Jin near the river in 1140.
description: 小商桥位于中国河南省临颍县皇帝庙乡商桥村，是一座石拱桥，又俗称“隋拱桥”。2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。据《临颍县志》记载：“小商桥在县南二十五里颍水之上，隋开皇四年建，元大德间重修。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Shangqiao village, about 15 km north of central Luohe.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 许慎文化园
summaryEn: A culture park of about 10 hectares built around the tomb of Xu Shen, the Eastern Han scholar who compiled the Shuowen Jiezi, regarded as the first comprehensive dictionary of Chinese characters. A Han-style hall named for Xu Shen's honorific 'sage of characters', an 80 m avenue of characters carved with famous calligraphy, a dictionary museum, an exhibition hall on the Shuowen Jiezi and a stele forest of more than a thousand stones line the axis leading to the tomb. The earth mound stands on a low rise with steles put up by local magistrates in 1656, 1707 and 1876.
description: 许慎墓位于河南省漯河市召陵区姬石乡许庄村东土岗上。为东汉时期著名经学家、文字学家许慎之墓。东南3公里为汉召陵故城，西1公里为沙河。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xuzhuang village, Shaoling district, about 10 km east of central Luohe by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 关林
summaryEn: The traditional burial place of the head of Guan Yu, the Three Kingdoms general later worshipped as a god, which Cao Cao is said to have buried here with princely honours in 220. Behind the temple, rebuilt from 1592 with Ming and Qing halls along a long axis, rises the tomb mound; it is traditionally regarded as the only Guan Yu temple entitled to the rank of 'lin', a term otherwise used for the Confucius cemetery in Qufu. Guan Yu's cult and its temple fair are a listed national intangible heritage, and the complex is one of the 'Guan Yu Cultural Sites' put forward for World Heritage.
description: 关林，又称关林庙、关林景区，位于中华人民共和国河南省洛阳市洛龙区关林街道，相传为埋葬东汉末年刘备阵营将领关羽首级之地，始建于东汉末年，重修于明万历二十年，是一座“冢、庙、林”三祀合一的明清古建筑群。关林是AAAA级旅游景区、全国重点文物保护单位，国家级非物质文化遗产“关公信俗”保护单位，“关圣文化史迹”、“万里茶道”世界文化遗产申遗单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Guanlin, about 7 km south of the Old Town on the road to the Longmen Grottoes; city buses stop at the Guanlin Temple bus terminus by the gate.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 小浪底水利枢纽
summaryEn: The visitor area at the south end of the Xiaolangdi Dam, the 154 m dam built across the Yellow River in 1994–2001 at the exit of its last gorge, mainly to control silt and floods. The main sight is the water-and-sediment flushing, usually run in early summer, when the outlet tunnels release jets of muddy water; in 2026 a viewing season ran from mid-June to early July.
description: 小浪底水利枢纽工程位于中国河南省洛阳市孟津县小浪底村与济源市蓼坞村之间的黄河主干流上，三门峡水利枢纽下游130公里、洛阳市城区以北40公里处。工程地处黄河中游最后一段峡谷的出口，控制流域面积69.4万平方公里，占黄河流域面积的92.3%，主要功能为治沙防洪，辅助功能为发电，是治理黄河的关键水利工程，被世界银行誉为该行与发展中国家合作项目的典范。
accessEn: On the south bank in Xiaolangdi town, Mengjin, about 40 km north of central Luoyang by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 花洲书院
summaryEn: An academy founded in the 1040s by the statesman Fan Zhongyan while he was governor of Dengzhou, where he wrote his famous essay 'On Yueyang Tower'. The present buildings, in Qing style, form five courtyards with a semicircular pool and bridge and a shrine to Fan, beside the Baihuazhou garden of pools and rockeries and a stretch of Ming earthen city wall.
description: 花洲书院，位于中华人民共和国河南省南阳市邓州市花洲街道人民中路，紧邻古城墙，为中国4A级景区。始建于宋代庆历年间，北宋著名政治家、军事家、文学家、教育家、思想家范仲淹任邓州知州期间创建了书院内讲学堂——春风堂、藏书楼、斋舍，并在书院东侧创建百花洲，重修览秀亭，构筑春风阁，花洲书院因百花洲而得名，是《岳阳楼记》的诞生地，范仲淹曾有诗曰：“南阳有绝胜，城下百花洲”。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the old centre of Dengzhou, about an hour by road south-west of Nanyang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 内乡县衙
