summaryEn: Regarded as the best-preserved Qing county government office in China, it was rebuilt in 1894 on a site that had been the seat of Neixiang County since 1304, served as the county government until 1968 and became a museum in 1984. Gates and three main halls line the central axis, leading from the magistrate's courtroom back to his offices and living quarters, with the county jail in the south-west corner and rooms furnished to show how a county was run.
description: 内乡县衙，又称菊潭古治，位于中华人民共和国河南省南阳市内乡县，是中国境内保存最完好的清代县级官署衙门，现存建筑群为清光绪年间营建，经历明、清、民国一直到文革时期均为内乡县治所，它是中国古代郡县制县级衙门的历史标本，享有“龙头在北京，龙尾在内乡”、“北有故宫，南有县衙”、“一座内乡衙，半部官文化”、“中华大地绝无仅有的历史标本”的美誉。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the centre of Neixiang town, about an hour by expressway west of Nanyang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 社旗山陕会馆
summaryEn: A guild hall and temple to Guan Yu built over 136 years, from 1756 to 1892, by merchants from Shanxi and Shaanxi trading in the town of Shedian. Its glazed-tile screen wall, the Xuanjian opera tower, a stone archway and the great worship hall are covered in fine wood, brick and stone carving. The scenic area also takes in other sights of Shedian old town, among them a fire-god temple, an old escort agency and a Qing tax office.
description: 社旗山陕会馆，又名山陕同乡会馆，位于河南省南阳市社旗县赊店镇。清乾隆二十一年(1756年)至光绪十八年，旅居赊店镇的山西、陕西富商们出资建造此座会馆。历时136年，坐北向南，南北长195.2米，东西宽34.4--44.2米，占地面积10000多平方米，建筑面积6000多平方米，在全国现存80余座会馆类古建筑群中规模最为宏伟、保存最为完好、建筑装饰工艺最为精湛、商业文化内涵最为丰富。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Shedian old town in the centre of Sheqi county town, about an hour by road east of Nanyang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 卧龙岗武侯祠
summaryEn: The shrine to the Three Kingdoms strategist Zhuge Liang on Wolong Gang, the low ridge south-west of central Nanyang where he is said, in a disputed tradition, to have lived and farmed for about ten years before joining Liu Bei. Worship here goes back to the Jin dynasty and the present halls are Yuan to Qing, with a thatched pavilion on the site of his supposed cottage and some 400 steles, among them the 'Chu Shi Biao' memorials in the hand of Yue Fei. The Nanyang Han Stone Carving Museum stands at the foot of the same ridge.
description: 卧龙岗，古称卧龙冈，位于中国河南省南阳市卧龙区卧龙岗街道，因古代该地岗弯起伏、曲折回旋、势若卧龙而得名。岗上目前有建于元代至清代的武侯祠以及近现代中国第一座的汉画像石陈列馆南阳汉画馆。卧龙岗可能是诸葛亮早年尚未出山辅佐刘备时的躬耕处，但目前存在争议。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the south-western edge of central Nanyang, about 15 minutes by taxi from the city centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 香严寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple in the hills at Cangfang, founded in the Tang dynasty as the seat of the Chan master Nanyang Huizhong and long counted among the four great temples of the Central Plains. Only the upper temple survives, as the lower temple was submerged by the Danjiangkou Reservoir in 1978; its Ming and Qing halls, library and stone archway are known for their brick, wood and stone carving and for a large mural in the main hall.
description: 香严寺，又名“长寿寺”、“香严长寿寺”、“显通禅寺”，位于中国河南省南阳市淅川县仓房镇西北部的白崖山群中，东临龙山，西接虎山，北依后岭，南拱面山，整个地形若莲花状，香严寺恰居中间。香严寺始建于唐代宗时期，本是南阳慧忠的道场，后在此建长寿寺。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the Baiya hills a few kilometres north-west of Cangfang town, roughly 2 hours by road west of Nanyang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 风穴寺
summaryEn: A hillside temple north-east of Ruzhou that keeps about 140 bays of buildings dating from the Tang to the Qing, laid out like a garden among streams and cliffs. Its oldest structure is the nine-storey Qizu Pagoda of 738, built for the remains of the monk Zhen; other highlights are a bell tower holding an iron bell cast in 1125, a Jin-dynasty middle hall and two pagoda forests with more than 80 monks' stupas from the Yuan to the Qing.
description: 风穴寺，位于中国河南省汝州市市区东北9公里的少室山南麓的山峦中，拥有唐塔等历代古建筑和中国第三大塔林，是一处兼具文化与自然特色的古迹。1988年，风穴寺及塔林被中华人民共和国国务院公布为第三批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the hills about 9 km north-east of central Ruzhou by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 平顶山博物馆
summaryEn: Pingdingshan's main history museum, opened in 2012 in a building designed by Tsinghua University's architectural design institute, with walls modelled on bundles of bamboo slips. Its permanent displays cover the history and culture of the Pingdingshan area, and its collection includes bronzes from the noble cemetery of the Western Zhou state of Ying, excavated in the city.
description: 平顶山博物馆位于中华人民共和国河南省平顶山市新华区长安大道与怀仁路交叉口的平安广场西侧的博物馆，为中华人民共和国国家一级博物馆。其位于长安大道与怀仁路交叉口的平安广场西侧。
accessEn: On Chang'an Avenue by Baiguishan Reservoir in Pingdingshan's new district, about 12 km west of the old city centre; closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 三苏园
summaryEn: The burial ground of the Song dynasty writer Su Shi (Su Dongpo) and his brother Su Zhe, with a cenotaph for their father Su Xun added in the Yuan dynasty, at the foot of Xiao Emei hill. Beside the three mounds stand a shrine founded in 1350 with Yuan-period painted clay statues of the three Su, the Guangqing Temple, and a stele forest of Su Shi's poems carved around 2000 in modern calligraphy, with a lake laid out in 2002.
description: 三苏墓，也称三苏坟，俗称苏坟、苏家坟。位于河南省平顶山市郏县西北五十里的小峨眉山麓，是北宋时期知名“三苏”的苏洵、苏轼、苏辙三人的墓冢。2006年，列入第六批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 23 km north-west of Jia County town, roughly an hour by road from Pingdingshan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 叶县县衙
summaryEn: The county government compound of Ye, founded in 1396 under the Ming and often described as the only Ming county yamen surviving in China; it is now run as a museum. Only the five-bay main hall survives from the Ming, the other halls being Qing rebuilds, laid out along a central axis flanked by two side courtyards.
description: 叶县县衙位于中国河南省平顶山市叶县，是中国现存惟一一座明代官衙，2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。叶县县衙始建于明代洪武二十九年，明末战火之余仅剩大堂五间，现存其它建筑均为清代所建。总占地面积1.6万余平方千米，由中轴线及东、西两侧副线三部分建筑群组成的。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the centre of Ye County town (Kunyang), about 30 km south-east of Pingdingshan by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 虢国博物馆
summaryEn: A museum built over the cemetery of the Western Zhou state of Guo on Shangcunling in northern Sanmenxia, where hundreds of burials, chariot pits and sacrificial pits were excavated from 1956 onwards. Its galleries show bronzes and jades from the tombs of the Guo rulers Guo Ji and Guo Zhong, among them a jade-handled iron sword, and visitors can walk into the excavated pits where real chariots and horses were buried some 2,800 years ago.
description: 虢国墓地是中国迄今为止发现的唯一一处规模宏大、等级齐全、排列有序、保存完好的西周、春秋时期大型邦国公墓。虢国墓地是因为三门峡水库的兴建而于1956年开始发掘的，位于中华人民共和国河南省三门峡市北部的上村岭一带，东起会兴沟，西至上村沟，南到春秋路南10米处，北到黄河岸边的断崖处。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Hubin District, northern Sanmenxia, reachable by city bus or taxi from the centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 函谷关
summaryEn: The site of the ancient pass that guarded the narrow corridor between the Central Plain and the Wei valley, fortified by the state of Qin in the Warring States period and fought over for centuries afterwards. Legend says that Laozi wrote the Tao Te Ching here at the request of the pass keeper Yinxi before heading west, and since 1992 the site has been rebuilt with a new east gate tower and Taoist halls such as the Taichu Palace.
description: 函谷关位于河南三门峡。游览特色包括山谷、楼阁建筑、历史关隘。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Wangduo village, Hanguguan town, about 12 km from Lingbao city and about 30 km west-south-west of central Sanmenxia.

name: 中流砥柱
summaryEn: A riverside scenic area built around the Sanmenxia Dam, begun in 1957 and brought into use in 1960–61 as the first major dam on the Yellow River, and the Dizhu rock just downstream, the 'pillar in midstream' that has withstood the current for millennia and gave Chinese a proverb for steadfastness. Besides views of the dam and the gorge, the area has a museum, a park on the flood-control legend of Yu the Great, terraced fields, a riverside sightseeing train and a shopping street.
description: 中流砥柱位于河南三门峡。游览特色包括博物馆、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Gaomiao township, about 20 km north-east of central Sanmenxia by road. The Zhongliu Dizhu Museum in the area is closed on Mondays.

name: 商丘古城
summaryEn: The walled city of Guide prefecture, built in 1511 after floods destroyed the earlier town, whose brick inner wall (about 4.4 km round), broad moat-lake and outer earthen rampart give it the 'round outside, square inside' plan of a Chinese coin. Inside the four gates the old grid of lanes survives, much restored since the 2010s, with the prefectural Confucian temple, the Mu family courtyard house and the Zhuang Hui Tang residence of the late-Ming writer Hou Fangyu, while outside lie the Ebo (Fire God) Terrace and the rebuilt Yingtian Academy. Several older cities, including the Zhou-dynasty capital of the Song state, lie buried beneath and around it.
description: 商丘古城，又称归德府城，位于中国河南省商丘市睢阳区，是以明清时期归德府为核心的历史城区，现四面环水，与外郭，护城池形成外圆内方的布局。现存古城与其周边的宋国故城、汉唐睢阳城、宋代应天府城及元代归德旧城等遗址存在空间上的叠压或相邻关系，形成城摞城现象。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Suiyang district in the south of Shangqiu city, reached by taxi or city bus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 潞王陵
summaryEn: The tombs of Zhu Yiliu, Prince Jian of Lu and a younger brother of the Wanli Emperor, and of his secondary consort Zhao, laid out side by side on the southern slope of Fenghuang Mountain on the model of the emperor's own Dingling tomb near Beijing. A spirit way of stone officials and animals leads past stone archways and a three-arched bridge to gates, a sacrificial hall, a soul tower and walled burial mounds, all within bluestone walls. Many of the sculptures were damaged in the 1960s, while the consort's tomb, used as a prison from 1953 to 2005, came through largely intact.
description: 潞王陵位于河南新乡。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Fenquan District, about 15 km north of central Xinxiang by road.

name: 比干庙
summaryEn: A temple and tomb complex for Bi Gan, the Shang-dynasty prince who was executed for rebuking the last Shang king, Di Xin, and was later worshipped as a god of wealth. A temple was first founded here in 494, and the present screen wall, gates and sacrificial hall are Ming and Qing rebuilds on an axis that ends at the earthen burial mound, ringed by old cypresses. Among the steles is one whose four characters are traditionally attributed to Confucius, and a Bi Gan culture festival with temple fairs and lantern shows is held each spring.
description: 比干庙，为殷商宗室比干之庙，位于中国河南省卫辉市西北，1996年被列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。比干墓为周武王所封国神，北魏太和十八年建庙，唐太宗、宋仁宗、元仁宗都对比干庙进行了大规模的维修，现存建筑为明清时重建。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the north-western outskirts of Weihui, about 30 km north-east of central Xinxiang by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 灞陵桥
summaryEn: A park on the western side of Xuchang marking the place where, in Three Kingdoms legend, Guan Yu took his leave of Cao Cao and lifted the parting gift of a robe on the tip of his blade. The original three-arched stone bridge was lost to water works; a modern bridge stands in the park, which also keeps a tablet put up by the late-Ming general Zuo Liangyu. The park's nationally listed Guan Yu Temple, a courtyard complex of halls and a pavilion founded in 1689 and rich in Ming and Qing steles, is unusual in honouring Guan Yu and Cao Cao together in its main hall.
description: 灞陵桥位于河南许昌。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Xuji Avenue on the western side of Xuchang, about 4 km west of the old centre.

name: 春秋楼
summaryEn: A walled complex of Ming and Qing-style buildings in the centre of Xuchang's old city, built around the tower where, in Three Kingdoms lore, Guan Yu sat up at night reading the Spring and Autumn Annals while he was held by Cao Cao. The same scenic area takes in the nationally listed Confucian Temple, founded in the Tang and rebuilt several times since, with a screen wall, a semicircular pool and the Dacheng Hall, so that temples to Guan Yu and Confucius stand side by side. A live drama on Guan Yu's story is staged by day and a light show in the evening.
description: 春秋楼位于河南许昌。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the centre of Xuchang's old city, about 1 km from Xuchang railway station and a taxi ride from Xuchang East high-speed station.

name: 神垕古镇
summaryEn: A pottery town in the hills south-west of Yuzhou where Jun ware has been made since the Tang and Song, and which is still full of working kilns, studios and showrooms. Its winding old street keeps Ming and Qing houses, the Bolingweng Temple with its opera stage and other shrines, and the town was named a national historic and cultural town in 2005. The town's kiln-site museum is open, and many workshops let visitors watch the firing or try the potter's wheel.
description: 神垕古镇位于河南许昌。游览特色包括博物馆、古镇、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km south-west of Yuzhou city by road.

name: 禹州钧官窑址博物馆
summaryEn: A museum on the Juntai kiln site in Yuzhou, source of the 'official' Jun wares made for the imperial court, whose date (late Northern Song or early Ming) is still debated; the kilns were found in 1964 and excavated from 1974. The building, designed by the architect Qi Kang and opened in 2011, presents the excavated remains and a chronological exhibition on Yuzhou's history and Jun ware drawn from a collection of about 1,500 objects. The national listing also covers the kiln sites at Shenhou, where a separate kiln-site museum is open.
description: 禹州钧官窑址博物馆位于中华人民共和国河南省许昌市禹州市钧官窑路492号，是中国第一座以钧瓷为主题的博物馆。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the eastern edge of Yuzhou's old city, about 45 km west of Xuchang by road. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 康百万庄园
summaryEn: The fortified hillside estate of the Kang family of merchants and landowners, who lived here for some four centuries from the late Ming, at Kangdian beside the Luo River in Gongyi. Built against the loess slope and ringed by walls, it combines street-front houses with cave dwellings: 33 courtyards, 53 multi-storey buildings and 73 cave dwellings in all, with fine brick, wood and stone carving. The rooms keep the family's furniture and inscribed boards, among them the well-known 'Liuyu' plaque of family precepts.
description: 康百万庄园位于河南省巩义市康店镇，庄园始建于明末清初。康百万家族前后十二代人在这个庄园生活，纵跨了明、清、民国三个时期400余年，庄园也从最初的半山腰一直建到了山顶。该庄园是一处典型的十七到十八世纪黄土高原上封建堡垒式的建筑。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Kangdian town about 4 km north-west of Gongyi city, roughly 1.5 hours by road west of Zhengzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 青龙山·慈云寺
summaryEn: A forested range of about 51 km² south-east of Gongyi city, a forest park since 1998, with waterfalls, pools and lakes linked by lakeside trails, red leaves in autumn and frozen falls in winter. In its heart stands Ciyun Temple, by tradition founded in AD 64 and counted among China's earliest Buddhist temples; its halls have been rebuilt in recent years, but more than 100 carved stones survive, including 52 Ming and Qing steles and 43 monks' stupa inscriptions.
description: 慈云寺位于河南省巩义市东南方的青龙山，始建于东汉永平七年。据登封法王寺《重修大法王寺碑记》云，“嵩阴慈云、洛阳白马、嵩阳法王，乃中国作寺之始”。故慈云寺也被认为是佛教传入中国后最早的寺院之一。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Near Minquan village, Dayugou town, south-east of Gongyi city, about 1.5 hours by road west of Zhengzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 嵩阳书院
summaryEn: One of the four great academies of the Northern Song, founded as a Buddhist temple in 484, later a Taoist temple and from 1035 a Confucian academy where the philosophers Cheng Hao and Cheng Yi taught. Its Qing-period courtyards hold a hall to Confucius, a lecture hall, a shrine to the sage-kings Yao and Yu and the Duke of Zhou, and a library, and two ancient cypresses that legend says Han Emperor Wu ennobled as generals. By the gate stands the Tang stele of 744, about 9 m tall and the largest ancient stele in Henan; the academy is part of the Historic Monuments of Dengfeng World Heritage site.
description: 大唐嵩阳观纪圣德感应之颂碑、大唐碑位于中国河南省登封市嵩阳街道嵩阳书院大门外西侧，是河南现存最大的古碑，2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Songyang Road about 3 km north of central Dengfeng at the foot of Taishi Mountain, a short taxi ride from the centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 郑州商都古城
summaryEn: The visitor area on the remains of Zhengzhou's early Shang-dynasty capital, a national heritage site whose rammed-earth inner wall ran for about 7 km round what is now the heart of the city. The 0.21 km² area between Chengdong Road, Chengnan Road, Zijingshan Road and East Street combines the Shang capital national archaeological park, with paths along and over stretches of the ancient city wall, the Zhengzhou Shang Capital Site Museum with about 5,500 m² of galleries, and the museum of the city's archaeology institute showing its major excavated finds.
description: 郑州商城遗址位于中华人民共和国河南省郑州市，是商代都城的遗址，年代距今3500年左右。1950年发现，1955年发现了内城的城墙，1961年国务院列为中国全国重点文物保护单位。郑州商城平面为长方形，城墙周长6960米，有11个缺口，其中有的可能是城门，城内东北部有宫殿区，发现宫殿基址多处，中心有用石板砌筑的人工蓄水设施。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Guancheng District about 2 km east of Erqi Square, by Dongdajie (Line 2) and Zhengzhou Wenmiao (Line 3) metro stations; the site museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 郑州黄河文化公园
summaryEn: The former Zhengzhou Yellow River Scenic Area, a national scenic area and geopark on the hills along the south bank of the Yellow River about 20 km north-west of central Zhengzhou, with wide views where the river leaves the hills for the plain. Its five open sections include the colossal busts of the legendary emperors Yan and Huang, 106 m high including the hill they rise from and finished in 2007, the 'Mother Yellow River' statue, Yueshan Temple hill with its pavilions, and a memorial where Mao Zedong viewed the river in 1952.
description: 郑州黄河风景名胜区是位于河南省郑州市惠济区古荥镇的标志性旅游景点。它北临黄河，南靠岳山，东西南北宽约5公里。风景区起初是荒芜的邙山，时任中共中央主席毛泽东于1952年视察黄河，并指示要把黄河的事情办好，此后这里先后建设了小型储水站、邙山提灌站和黄河提水站，继而被辟为“郑州市黄河游览区”，进行大规模植树造林，绿化荒山4000余亩，兴建亭台楼阁、塑像碑林、游乐设施，经过将近20年的建设，该景区最终被列入中国国家级风景名胜区和中国国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: In Huiji district about 30 minutes by road north-west of central Zhengzhou; Huanghe Jingqu station on the Zhengzhou–Jiaozuo line is a few minutes' drive away.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中原福塔
summaryEn: Henan's radio and television tower in south-eastern Zhengzhou, 388 m to the tip of its mast and built in 2008–09 entirely of steel, on a base shaped like a ritual cauldron. Lifts run to the observation floors, and since 2020 an open-air walkway at 281 m, a tilting viewing platform and a glass slide have been added. The base holds a 175 m-long panorama painting of Henan's scenery.
description: 中原福塔，位于中华人民共和国河南省郑州市机场高速公路与航海东路交汇处，由河南广播电视台所有、运营和维护。目前该塔是世界第一高的全钢结构电视发射塔，中原福塔是一座集广播电视发射、旅游观光、名画展览、文化娱乐、餐饮休闲等多功能的城市基础设施。
accessEn: At 1206 Hanghai East Road in south-eastern Zhengzhou, next to Zhongyuan Futa station on Metro Line 5.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中岳庙
summaryEn: The temple of the god of Mount Song, the Central Sacred Peak, where emperors had sacrifices offered; it traces its origins to the Qin dynasty, and its present buildings are Qing reconstructions after a fire at the end of the Ming. The walled precinct of about 11 hectares has some 400 bays of gates and halls on a long axis, more than 300 old cypresses and more than 100 steles and cast pieces, including Song-dynasty iron guardian figures and Han-dynasty stone figures. It is still a Taoist temple and is one of the Historic Monuments of Dengfeng inscribed as a World Heritage site in 2010.
description: 中岳庙，道教宫观，位于河南省登封市嵩山太室山东麓，始建于秦代，已有2000多年历史。是道教全真道的圣地，也是历代皇帝祭祀中岳神的地方。总面积达11万平方米，居中原各祠宇之冠，亦是五岳中现存规模最大、保存相对比较完整的古建筑群。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Shaolin Avenue about 3 km east of central Dengfeng, which is roughly 70 km south-west of Zhengzhou; the Taishi Que gates stand 500 m in front of the temple.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 周口关帝庙
summaryEn: A temple to Guan Yu that also served as the guild hall of Shanxi and Shaanxi merchants trading at Zhoukou, where three rivers meet; it was begun in 1693 and finished in 1852 after repeated enlargements. Its three courtyards hold more than 140 bays of halls, galleries and an opera stage, with cast-iron flagpoles 22 m tall given by merchants in 1797 and a stone archway of 1765 densely carved with dragons, immortals and scenes from legend. It has been run as a museum since 1986 and is famed for its stone and wood carving.
description: 周口关帝庙位于中国河南省周口市川汇区人和街道富强街，1996年被列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。周口地处河南省东南部，历史悠久，风光秀丽，沙河、颖河、贾鲁河在市区交汇，三岸鼎立，古为漕运重地，素有“小武汉”之称。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Fuqiang Street on the north bank of the Shaying River in central Zhoukou (Chuanhui District), reached by taxi or city bus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东坡赤壁
summaryEn: Dongpo Chibi is a complex of pavilions and halls on a reddish-brown rock bluff in the north-west of Huangzhou, which once stood on the north bank of the Yangtze before silt left it several hundred metres from the river. The poet Su Shi (Su Dongpo), exiled to Huangzhou in the Northern Song, wrote his Red Cliff Rhapsody and other famous pieces here, and a prefect renamed the site Dongpo Chibi in the late Kangxi reign. Most of the buildings seen today date from a restoration in 1868, and 139 stone tablets carved from rubbings of Su's handwriting are set into the pavilions.
description: 东坡赤壁位于中华人民共和国湖北省黄冈市黄州区西北公园路，古为长江北岸的岩石山，石呈红褐色，故称赤壁、赤岸，俗称赤鼻矶、赤鼻山。因泥沙淤积，现在的赤壁与长江已有数百米之遥。北宋苏轼谪居黄州时在此留下了《赤壁赋》等千古名篇。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the north-west of Huangzhou district, the old city of Huanggang, about an hour east of Wuhan by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天堂寨
summaryEn: Tiantangzhai is a forested massif in the Dabie Mountains that straddles the Hubei–Anhui border and forms the watershed between the Yangtze and the Huai rivers; this entry is the Hubei side, reached from Jiuzihe town in Luotian county. It is a core part of the Dabie Mountains geopark and is popular in summer for its cooler air, with rafting and a wire-assisted flying ride among the activities near Jiuzihe. The Anhui side, in Jinzhai county, is a separate scenic area with its own rating.
description: 天堂寨位于湖北省黄冈市罗田县、英山县与安徽省六安市金寨县交界处，是大别山山区第二高峰，属大别山国家地质公园核心部，有时也视为主峰，天堂寨的范围海拔700-1729.13米，是江淮分水岭，有"吴楚东南第一关"之称。
accessEn: In Jiuzihe town in the north-east of Luotian county on the Hubei–Anhui border, reached by road from Luotian town; the mountain also has a separate Anhui-side entrance, reached from Jinzhai.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 五祖寺
summaryEn: A Chan (Zen) Buddhist temple on Dongshan hill, founded in 654, where the Fifth Patriarch Hongren taught. Tradition places here the verse contest between Shenxiu and Huineng that led to Huineng being named his successor. The national heritage listing covers its stone pagodas, old gate, halls and a run of cliff inscriptions, one of them attributed to Su Dongpo.
description: 五祖寺，又名东山寺、东山禅寺、东禅寺，位于湖北省黄冈市黄梅县五祖镇，为禅宗五祖弘忍弘法道场，现任住持为见忍法师。汉族地区佛教全国重点寺院之一。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Wuzu township, about 15 km north of Huangmei town by road; it is an active temple and pairs well with Sizu Temple, about 15 km to the west.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 遗爱湖
summaryEn: An urban lake in the middle of Huanggang's built-up area, made up of an east and a west lake joined by a narrow channel, with about 3.2 sq km of water. It serves as the city's lakeside leisure park and landscape, and the shore park includes a forest of stone stelae and Yunxiang Tower. A pleasant stroll to combine with Dongpo Red Cliff in the west of the city.
description: 遗爱湖是一座位于中国湖北省黄冈市中心建成区内的典型城市内湖。该湖泊地处长江经济带中游北岸，属于长江中下游沿江平原湖泊。其水域面积较小，周边完全被高度城镇化的密集建筑群落所环绕，在当地发挥着城市景观、休闲娱乐以及生态保护等多重综合功能。
accessEn: In the south-east of Huangzhou, the urban district of Huanggang, along Dongpo Avenue.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 铜绿山古铜矿遗址
summaryEn: An ancient copper-mining and smelting site that was worked from at least the Spring and Autumn period, and probably earlier, until the Han dynasty. It came to light in 1973 when modern miners broke into ancient shafts, galleries and furnaces, and part of it is preserved in a museum built over a surviving shaft in the 1980s, now joined by a new museum that opened in June 2023. Indoor galleries explain how the copper was found, mined and smelted, outdoor areas show the excavated workings, and in 2025 the site became a National Archaeological Site Park.
description: 铜绿山古铜矿遗址，又作铜录山古铜矿遗址，是位于中国湖北省黄石市金湖街道铜绿山矿社区的一座古铜矿遗址。1982年被列为第二批全国重点文物保护单位，1994年被列入中国世界文化遗产预备清单，2001年被评为中国20世纪100项考古大发现之一。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the edge of Daye city, about 4 km from the town centre and roughly 20 km south-west of central Huangshi. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 漳河风景区
summaryEn: A large reservoir on the Zhanghe river west of Jingmen, built between 1958 and 1966 mainly for irrigation and water supply, with islands and many inlets across about 100 square kilometres of water. The scenic area around it offers lake views from named viewpoints and islands, and the reservoir was designated a national water-conservancy scenic area in 2002. It suits a relaxed day by the water rather than a sightseeing circuit.
description: 漳河水库位于湖北省荆门市东宝区与当阳市交界处，是一座以农业灌溉、城镇供水为主，兼有防洪、发电、旅游、养殖、航运等综合功能的大型水库。
accessEn: About 25 km west of central Jingmen.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 武汉欢乐谷
summaryEn: Happy Valley Wuhan is an amusement park run by the OCT group, the fifth in its Happy Valley chain, in the eastern suburbs near East Lake; it opened in April 2012. Its rides include a wooden racing coaster and several launched and looping coasters, spread over themed zones. It is a day out for families and thrill-seekers rather than a sightseeing stop.
description: 武汉欢乐谷位于中华人民共和国湖北省武汉市洪山区欢乐大道，是一个大型主题游乐园，于2012年4月28日开始营业。其由欢乐江城、飓风湾、梦想大道、极速世界、渔光岛、卡通工厂、欢乐时光、羽落天堂等八大主题区域组成。
accessEn: In the eastern suburbs on the edge of the East Lake area, about 10 km east of Yellow Crane Tower; taxi or ride-hailing from central Wuchang is the simplest way.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 盘龙城遗址
summaryEn: The remains of a walled Shang-dynasty city of about 1500-1300 BCE on the north bank of the Yangtze, uncovered by a flood in 1954 and described by the Wuhan government as the highest-ranking and largest early Shang site known in the Yangtze valley. Excavations have found city walls, palace foundations, high-status tombs and a bronze-casting workshop outside the walls, and the site was named one of China's ten major archaeological discoveries of 2024. It is a national archaeological site park, and its museum, opened in 2019, shows bronzes, jades and pottery from the digs while the walls and foundations are laid out in the grounds.
description: 盘龙城遗址是湖北省武汉市境内的一处商代遗址，位于武汉市东北郊黄陂区境内的盘龙湖畔，南隔府河与汉口相望。遗址发现于1954年，经过考古发掘，先后发现城址、宫殿建筑、高等级墓葬、铸铜遗址等遗迹。经鉴定，遗址年代为公元前1600年至1300年，至21世纪初为长江流域已发现规模最大的夏商时期城邑遗址，为该时期中原文化在长江流域的中心，被媒体誉为“武汉城市之根”。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the northern edge of Wuhan in Huangpi district, roughly 15 km north of Hankou, reached by taxi or car, and closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 武汉植物园
summaryEn: A research botanical garden of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, founded in 1956, whose Moshan campus of about 59 hectares lies on the shore of East Lake. It has 17 specialty gardens, among them a kiwifruit collection and what the garden describes as East Asia's largest aquatic plant garden. It suits plant lovers and families after a half-day walk by the lake.
description: 中国科学院武汉植物园，简称武汉植物园、武汉园、武植等，位于中国湖北省武汉市，在武昌磨山和武汉东湖新技术开发区分别建有磨山园区和光谷园区，始建于1956年，为中国三大核心科学植物园之一，包含光谷、磨山、中-非联合研究中心-肯尼亚园区，新洲、江夏两个基地及多个野外观测台站。
accessEn: On Lumo Road in eastern Wuchang beside East Lake's Moshan zone, a short taxi ride from the lake's other entrances.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 武汉博物馆
summaryEn: The city's main local-history museum, in Hankou's Jianghan District; the present building opened in 2001 and the museum was named a first-grade national museum in 2008. Its permanent galleries cover Wuhan's ancient history, including models of the Shang-dynasty city of Panlongcheng, and its modern history from 1848 to 1949, alongside collections of bronzes, jades, ceramics and Ming and Qing paintings and calligraphy. Its prize piece is a Yuan-dynasty blue-and-white plum vase.
description: 武汉博物馆是以展示武汉地区历史文化为主的地志类综合性博物馆，位于中华人民共和国湖北省武汉市江汉区常青街道青年路373号，建筑面积17834平方米，展示面积6000平方米，库房面积4000平方米。2008年5月被评为首批国家一级博物馆。
accessEn: On Qingnian Road in Hankou's Jianghan District, a short taxi ride from Hankou railway station; closed on Tuesdays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 武汉体育中心
summaryEn: A sports complex in Zhuankou, in Wuhan's economic development zone, built in 2002 around a 54,000-seat stadium that staged matches at the 2007 FIFA Women's World Cup and has been home to Wuhan Three Towns football club. It also has an arena, a swimming hall and landscaped plazas that make up the park rated as a 4A scenic area. In 2020 it served as one of the city's temporary Fangcang hospitals for mild COVID-19 cases.
description: 武汉体育中心位于中华人民共和国湖北省武汉市蔡甸区沌口街道车城北路58号，是一个综合型体育中心，总占地1580亩。武汉体育中心包括56,201座的主体育场，两片标准训练场，以及东、西、南三个广场，并有1.3万座体育馆和3500座游泳馆及休闲广场、商务区、全​​民健身等配套设施。
accessEn: In Zhuankou on the south-west side of Wuhan, about 15 km from the city centre by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 辛亥革命博物院
summaryEn: The Xinhai Revolution Museum is made up of two sites a short walk apart on the south side of Snake Hill, both about the Wuchang Uprising of October 1911. The north district is the Red Building, a 1910 assembly hall where revolutionaries and soldiers declared the Hubei military government on 11 October 1911, with its council chamber and offices restored; Sun Yat-sen spoke there in April 1912. The south district, built for the 1911 centenary, has a historical exhibition on the revolution, and Shouyi Square, with a 1931 bronze of Sun Yat-sen, lies between the two.
description: 辛亥革命博物院位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位、国家一级博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the centre of old Wuchang at the north end of Yuemachang, a short walk from Yellow Crane Tower; the south district is closed on Mondays and the north district on Tuesdays, except public holidays.

name: 中国地质大学逸夫博物馆
summaryEn: A natural-science museum on the China University of Geosciences campus beside East Lake, holding about 40,000 geological specimens, several thousand of them rare. Six permanent halls cover the planet and Earth, the origin and evolution of life, minerals and rocks, gems and jade, mineral resources and a donated collection, with dinosaur skeletons among the fossils. The building was completed in 2003 and its design draws on geology, biomimicry and astronomy.
description: 中国地质大学逸夫博物馆是位于中国地质大学的自然科学类博物馆，也是中南五省最大的自然类博物馆。
accessEn: On Lumo Road just north of Guanggu Square in Hongshan district, south-east of central Wuhan, reachable by taxi or city bus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中山舰博物馆
summaryEn: Zhongshan Warship Museum, in the Yangtze-side town of Jinkou, is built around the restored Zhongshan, a gunboat built in Japan in 1913 and renamed in 1925 after Sun Yat-sen. The ship was sunk by Japanese forces in 1938, raised from the river in 1997 and restored, and the museum has shown it with relics from the wreck since 2011. The grounds also hold military vehicles and aircraft in the open air.
description: 中山舰博物馆，位于中国大陆湖北省武汉市江夏区金口街中山舰路特一号，是收藏和展示中山舰以及出水文物等的专题性纪念性博物馆。
accessEn: In the river town of Jinkou in Jiangxia District, about 25–30 km south-west of central Wuchang; reached by road. The museum is being upgraded and is listed by the city as temporarily closed to the public, so check its current opening before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 九宫山
summaryEn: A forested mountain resort in the Mufu range on the Hubei–Jiangxi border, with a main summit of about 1,650 m and summer temperatures that local authorities put at around 21°C. The scenic area is known for Yunzhong Lake, a high-altitude lake at about 1,230 m, waterfalls and a Song-dynasty Daoist heritage, and it has a ski slope in winter and a wind farm on the ridges. It is a summer escape for visitors from Wuhan, and the tomb of Li Zicheng lies at the western foot.
description: 九宫山是中国湖北省的一处山脉。在咸宁市境内，建立九宫山国家级自然保护区。咸宁市人民政府于2010年设立正县级事业单位——九宫山风景名胜区管理局管理此处风景旅游区。
accessEn: In Tongshan County near the Jiangxi border, about 180 km from Wuhan and two to three hours by expressway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 三游洞
summaryEn: A limestone cave in a cliff above the Yangtze at the mouth of Xiling Gorge, named for two literary meetings: the poets Bai Juyi, his brother Bai Xingjian and Yuan Zhen explored it in 819, and Su Xun and his sons Su Shi and Su Zhe followed in 1056. The cave is about 30 m deep, and more than 40 inscriptions and steles survive inside and outside it, among them a Ming-dynasty recut of Bai Juyi's preface. Paths lead up to a hilltop pavilion with a view along the river and down to Lu You Spring, a small pool where the Song poet Lu You drew water to make tea in 1169.
description: 三游洞摩崖，简称三游洞，位于中华人民共和国湖北省宜昌市西北7公里的长江边的山崖上，位于西陵峡峡口处。现为全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the Yangtze bank at Nanjinguan, about 7 km north-west of central Yichang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 宜昌博物馆
summaryEn: Yichang's main museum, a large modern building that opened in September 2019 in Wujiagang District next to the city's planning exhibition hall, and rated a first-grade national museum in December 2020. Its galleries, about ten in all, cover local history, natural history, folk customs and traditional architecture, drawn from a collection of some 58,000 items.
description: 宜昌博物馆位于中华人民共和国湖北省宜昌市伍家岗区柏临河路，是一座博物馆。馆长是肖承云。
accessEn: On Qiusuo Road in Wujiagang District, on the east side of central Yichang; closed on Mondays except public holidays, and entry is by advance booking.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 玉泉寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple on the eastern slope of Yuquan Hill, said to have been founded in the 6th century and given its present name in the Sui dynasty; it is counted as an ancestral seat of the Tiantai school and as one of the national key temples of Han Buddhism. Highlights are a cast-iron pagoda from the Song dynasty, a large Sui-period iron cauldron, a Tang-dynasty ginkgo tree over 1,300 years old and a stone carving of Guanyin attributed to the painter Wu Daozi. The temple was rebuilt between 2003 and 2008, and the surrounding forest park also has Three Kingdoms sites linked to Guan Yu.
description: 当阳玉泉寺，位于湖北省宜昌市当阳市境内的玉泉山，为全国重点文物保护单位、汉族地区佛教全国重点寺院、国家森林公园和国家4A级旅游景区。南北朝大通二年，梁武帝敕建覆船山寺。隋开皇十三年，智𫖮奉诏建寺，在此宣讲《法华玄义》。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 12 km south-west of Dangyang town by road, reached from the Dangyang West expressway exit.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 城头山遗址
summaryEn: Chengtoushan, on the Liyang plain north-west of Li County town, is a round Neolithic town about 325 m across inside a rammed-earth wall and moat that were first built in the Daxi culture more than 6,000 years ago and enlarged several times before the town was abandoned around 4,000 years ago. Excavations from 1991 uncovered house platforms, pottery kilns, cemeteries, an altar, very early fired bricks and rice paddies that are among the oldest known anywhere. Since 2016 the site has been a national archaeological site park, with the walls and moat laid out for visitors and a site museum for the finds.
description: 城头山遗址位于中国湖南省常德市澧县车溪乡南岳村，地理坐标为北纬29°41′，东经111°40′。它是中国南方史前大溪文化至石家河文化时期的遗址。在1996年，该遗址被中华人民共和国国务院批准为全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 12 km north-west of Li County town, in Chengtoushan town; Li County town is roughly 1.5 hours by road north of Changde.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 长沙生态动物园
summaryEn: Changsha's main zoo, opened in 2010 when the old city zoo in Martyrs' Park moved to this 100-hectare site at Muyun in the southern suburbs. It shows more than 300 species in walk-through areas and a drive-through zone, with sections for education, landscaped grounds and leisure, and suits families.
description: 长沙生态动物园位于中华人民共和国湖南省长沙市天心区芙蓉南路，该园2003年底开始筹建，2010年9月自烈士公园原长沙动物园完成整体迁入，2010年10月1日正式对外开放。
accessEn: On South Furong Road in Tianxin District, about 20 km south of central Changsha.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 长沙滨江文化园
summaryEn: A cultural complex on the Beichen Delta where the Liuyang River joins the Xiang, fully opened in 2015 on the site of a former chemical works, grouping the Changsha Museum, the city planning exhibition hall, the Changsha Library, a concert hall and a viewing tower. The Changsha Museum's two permanent galleries cover the city's ancient and modern history, with Shang and Zhou bronzes and Changsha-kiln ceramics as its strengths, and the riverside park makes an easy half-day stop.
description: 长沙滨江文化园位于长沙市湘江与浏阳河交汇处的北辰三角洲上，紧邻湘江大道北段，园内分布有长沙博物馆、长沙市规划展示馆、长沙图书馆、长沙音乐厅等文化场馆及景观塔等周边设施，合称“三馆一厅”。长沙滨江文化园景区为国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: On Xiangjiang Avenue in Kaifu District, north of the city centre, near Beichen Delta station on Metro Line 1; the Changsha Museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 长沙海底世界
summaryEn: An aquarium and marine theme park opened in 2000 in north-eastern Changsha, beside Window of the World, with a 76-metre walk-through tunnel and freshwater and marine galleries. A polar hall keeps belugas, dolphins, walruses, seals and penguins, the park has staged animal shows in a theatre of about 1,800 seats, and there are a water park with slides and a wave pool and a children's playground; it suits families with children.
description: 长沙海底世界是位于中华人民共和国湖南省长沙市的一座海洋主题公园，集观赏、游乐、科普、休闲于一体，是国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: In Kaifu District, about 8 km north-east of central Changsha, next to Window of the World.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 胡耀邦故居
summaryEn: Hu Yaobang (1915–1989), who headed the Communist Party as chairman and then general secretary from 1981 to 1987, was born in this Qing brick-and-timber farmhouse of 19 rooms beside the Minxi River in Cangfang village, Zhonghe town, and left it at the age of 15. Restored and opened in 1995, the house is the centre of a 4A scenic area that also has a memorial exhibition hall of 2006 on his life, an ancestral hall, the family graves and a square.
description: 胡耀邦故居指的是曾经在八十年代担任中国共产党中央委员会总书记胡耀邦的故居。故居坐落在中华人民共和国湖南省浏阳市中和镇苍坊村敏溪河畔，始建于清朝咸丰年间，占地面积450平方米，建筑面积300平方米，共计19间。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Zhonghe town, south-eastern Liuyang, about 6 km from Wenjiashi, which is some 45 km south-east of Liuyang city by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黑麋峰
summaryEn: The highest hill in Wangcheng at 590.5 m, on the district's north-eastern border, protected as a national forest park of about 41 km² with forest covering over 80 percent. Trails for walking and cycling pass a reservoir on the way to a Buddhist temple on the summit, and the mountain is linked by tradition to the Tang monk-calligrapher Huaisu and, through legends and rock carvings, to the Daoist immortal Lü Dongbin.
description: 黑麋峰坐落在湖南省长沙市望城区东北角，主峰海拔590.5米，面积4079公顷，是望城境内第一高峰。距长沙主城区不到20公里，自古被号称“洞天福地”。整个区域已辟为森林公园，森林公园面积4079公顷，植被丰富，森林覆盖率83%，植物种类有7个群系673种，列入国家重点保护动物34种。
accessEn: In north-eastern Wangcheng, roughly 30 km north of central Changsha.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 湖南省植物园
summaryEn: A 120-hectare botanical garden in Yuhua District, southern Changsha, founded in 1985 as the Hunan Forest Botanical Garden and renamed in 2021, which combines research and conservation with public gardens. Its ten or so specialist gardens include cherry, magnolia, azalea, camellia, osmanthus, bamboo and shade-plant collections, with rare trees such as Cathaya and the dove tree.
description: 湖南省植物园原名湖南省森林植物园，坐落在中华人民共和国湖南省长沙市南部雨花区境内，主体位于湘府路以南、时代阳光大道以北、万家丽路以西、圭塘河以东合围区域，面积120公顷，该园为一家集科研、物种保存、科普、生态旅游、开发利用的公益性园区。
accessEn: In Yuhua District, about 11 km south of central Changsha by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 靖港古镇
summaryEn: An old river port on the west bank of the Xiang where the Wei River once flowed in, a rice market and salt depot busy enough to be called 'Little Hankou' until the river was diverted in 1957; it was here that Zeng Guofan, beaten by the Taiping in 1854, threw himself into the river and was pulled out by his men. Its streets of Ming, Qing and Republican-era houses, shops and guild halls, over 1,000 traditional buildings in all, were restored and opened as a scenic area in 2008, the year it was named a national historic and cultural town.
description: 靖港古镇位于湖南长沙。游览特色包括古镇、商贸街区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jinggang town, Wangcheng District, about 30 km north-west of central Changsha; Tongguan lies across the river.

name: 雷锋纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial museum in Wangcheng District to Lei Feng (1940–1962), the People's Liberation Army soldier who became the subject of a nationwide campaign from 1963 that held him up as a model of selfless service. Opened in 1968 and enlarged several times, it displays his diaries, books, clothes and work tools, a group of clay figures and inscriptions by national leaders, in grounds of about 11 hectares.
description: 湖南雷锋纪念馆位于中华人民共和国湖南省长沙市望城区雷锋街道，是纪念雷锋的场馆，被评为国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: On Zhengxing Road in Lei Feng subdistrict, Wangcheng District, about 15 km west of central Changsha. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 密印寺
summaryEn: A Chan Buddhist monastery on Mount Wei (Weishan) in western Ningxiang, founded in the early 9th century by the monk Lingyou, whose teaching gave rise to the Weiyang (also romanised Guiyang) school of Chan, and named Miyin by imperial grant in 849. It has burned and been rebuilt many times, most recently after a fire in 1918, and its halls, including the Hall of Ten Thousand Buddhas, stand within the Weishan national scenic area of forested hills, also known for Weishan Maojian tea. A giant statue of the thousand-armed Guanyin stands on the hillside in the same scenic area.
description: 密印寺坐落在湖南省长沙市宁乡市沩山乡境内，地处沩山毗庐峰，始建于唐朝元和二年，为裴休任潭州刺史时所建。其开山祖师为高僧灵祐禅师，被誉为沩仰宗的祖庭。
accessEn: In Weishan township, far western Ningxiang, about 100 km west of central Changsha; roughly 2 hours by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 清水塘
summaryEn: From late 1921 to April 1923 this small southern-style house at 22 Qingshuitang was the secret office of the Communist Party's Xiang (Hunan) District Committee, with Mao Zedong as secretary, and the home of Mao and Yang Kaihui, whose rooms are furnished as they were. It was the only building linked to the Party's early history in Changsha to survive the great fire of 1938, and it now stands in the grounds of the Changsha Party History Museum beside the ponds that gave Qingshuitang its name, with a statue of Mao put up in 1969.
description: 清水塘位于湖南长沙。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Bayi Road in Kaifu District, central Changsha, about 1.5 km south of the Hunan Museum. The Changsha Party History Museum, in whose grounds it stands, is closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 天心阁
summaryEn: The three-storey Tianxin Pavilion stands on the only surviving stretch of Changsha's city wall, a brick rampart of Ming origin some 250 m long and 13 m high that escaped the demolition of the walls in 1923–24. A pavilion has stood here since at least the 18th century; the present one, rebuilt in reinforced concrete in 1983–84 after the 1938 fire, has two side pavilions joined by corridors, and the surrounding Tianxin Park has a 1946 memorial pagoda to the dead of the war against Japan.
description: 天心阁，原名天星阁，坐落在中国湖南省长沙市天心区城南，地处贺龙体育文化中心西北面，紧邻蔡锷南路和城南路，阁楼与城墙、天心公园及其他建筑融为一体，为长沙重要古建筑之一。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the old southern part of central Changsha, beside Chengnan Road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 长沙铜官窑遗址
summaryEn: The Changsha kilns, strung along the east bank of the Xiang River at Tongguan, made glazed stoneware from the Tang to the Five Dynasties and are seen as the birthplace of underglaze painted decoration, often with poems and proverbs, for markets as far away as Japan, Southeast Asia, West Asia and Africa. The national archaeological site park, opened in 2012, covers the kiln remains and potsherd heaps around Wazhaping, and its Changsha Tongguan Kiln Museum (opened 2018) shows more than 1,000 pieces beside a full-size replica of the Belitung or 'Black Stone', a 9th-century Arab ship wrecked with a cargo of Changsha ware. The Tongguan Kiln Guofeng Park theme resort lies just to the south.
description: 长沙铜官窑，又称长沙窑，唐五代时期南方民窑，出产青瓷，同时运用多种装饰技法，品类繁多。长沙窑窑址坐落在湖南省长沙市望城区丁字湾街道内，因为最初发现地在铜官镇瓦渣坪，又称铜官窑、望成窑、瓦渣坪窑，与后世官窑并无联系。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Tongguan, Wangcheng District, about 30 km north of central Changsha; under an hour by road. The museum is closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 长沙世界之窗
summaryEn: A 40-hectare theme park opened in 1997 in north-eastern Changsha that combines scaled-down copies of famous buildings from around the world, such as Neuschwanstein Castle and the Pharos of Alexandria, with amusement rides and seasonal festivals. It suits families and groups with children.
description: 世界之窗是坐落在湖南省长沙市的大型文化主题公园，是湖南省最大的旅游、影视、文化、娱乐基地。公园位于长沙城以北星沙镇，毗邻开福区，处开元路以南、三一大道以北、万家丽路以东、锦绣路以西，与金鹰影视文化城连成一片；占地40公顷。
accessEn: On Sanyi Avenue on the north-eastern edge of the city, about 9 km north-east of central Changsha, beside Changsha Underwater World.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 洋湖湿地公园
summaryEn: A national wetland park of about 480 hectares at the mouth of the Jin River on the west bank of the Xiang in southern Yuelu District, created on the old Yanghu flood polder from 2010 and opened in stages from 2011. Boardwalks and paths wind through ponds and reed beds with more than 700 plant species and some 130 bird species, with the Egret Pagoda as a landmark and outdoor sculptures from the park's international sculpture festivals.
description: 洋湖国家湿地公园坐落在中国湖南省长沙市岳麓区，是一座公立湿地公园。洋湖国家湿地公园占地面积0.53平方公里，2010年建立，2011年对外开放参观。
accessEn: In Yuelu District, about 10 km south-west of central Changsha; Yanghu Wetland station on Metro Line 3 serves the park.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 高椅岭
summaryEn: A Danxia landscape of red sandstone cliffs and ridges on the border of Suxian District and Zixing, north-east of Chenzhou, covering about 50.5 km². It lies close to Feitian Mountain, Dongjiang Lake and Banliang village, and guesthouses, cafés and campsites have grown up around its visitor centre.
description: 高椅岭，又名高椅岭风景区，坐落在中华人民共和国湖南省郴州市苏仙区和资兴市交界处，属丹霞地貌，总面积50.5平方公里，是国家AAAA级旅游景区。
accessEn: About 25 km north-east of central Chenzhou beside Provincial Road S215; roughly 40 minutes by car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东洲岛
summaryEn: An island about 2 km long in the Xiang River in central Hengyang, whose peach blossom ('Dongzhou peach waves') was one of the city's eight traditional views. Its main sight is Chuanshan Academy, founded in 1878 in honour of the philosopher Wang Fuzhi and moved to the island in 1885 by Peng Yulin, who appointed the scholar Wang Kaiyun as its head; the academy was restored in a renovation of the whole island, which reopened in 2018. Luohan Temple, old camphor trees and a sandy beach at the island's tip, exposed when the river is low, complete a gentle walk.
description: 东洲岛位于湖南省衡阳市湘江中，是旧衡阳八景之一的“东洲桃浪”。岳阳君山、长沙橘子洲、衡阳东洲岛并称“湘江流域三大洲”。
accessEn: In the Xiang River just south-east of central Hengyang, reached by bridge or ferry from the riverbank.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 回雁峰
summaryEn: A 97 m hill in Yanfeng District, traditionally counted as the first of Mount Heng's 72 peaks and the source of Hengyang's nickname 'Wild Goose City', from the old belief that geese flying south turned back here. The hilltop park has the rebuilt Yanfeng Temple, first founded in the Southern and Northern dynasties, the 35 m Huiyan Pavilion, and a small memorial hall at Wang Fuzhi's birthplace on its western slope.
description: 回雁峰，位于湖南省衡阳市雁峰区境内。回雁峰海拔96.8米，总面积6.32公顷，是南岳七十二峰之首，故称南岳第一峰。回雁峰为市级重点文物保护单位，国家“AAAA”级旅游区。
accessEn: In Yanfeng District in the south of central Hengyang, a short taxi ride from the city centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 芷江受降旧址
summaryEn: The site in Qiliqiao village outside Zhijiang town where, on 21 August 1945, a Japanese delegation led by Major General Takeo Imai received the Chinese terms for the surrender of Japan's forces in China, the first step towards the formal surrender ceremony in Nanjing that September. It keeps the 1938 buildings of the Chinese Army headquarters and He Yingqin's office, a memorial museum opened in 1995, and the stone surrender memorial arch first built in 1946–47, destroyed in 1966 and rebuilt from old photographs in 2010.
description: 抗日胜利芷江洽降旧址位于中国湖南省怀化市芷江侗族自治县芷江镇七里桥村，是1945年8月21日，中日双方芷江洽降的所在地。抗日胜利芷江洽降旧址境内包括芷江受降纪念坊、中国战区总受降旧址、中国人民抗日战争胜利受降纪念馆、萧毅肃陈列室等建筑。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 4 km east of Zhijiang county town beside Zhijiang airport, roughly 40 minutes by road west of Huaihua. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 曾国藩故居
summaryEn: The family seat of Zeng Guofan (1811–1872), the Qing statesman whose Xiang Army put down the Taiping Rebellion, at Heye in eastern Shuangfeng. Fuhou Hall, a mansion of over 9,000 m² behind a crescent pond, was enlarged for his family from 1865 and finished in 1875, and its four library buildings once held more than 300,000 volumes, one of the largest private libraries of modern China; his birthplace, the Baiyu Hall farmhouse, is also in Heye.
description: 曾国藩故居坐落在湖南省娄底市双峰县荷叶镇，是晚清名臣曾国藩的故居，包括白玉堂和富厚堂，曾国藩出生成长于白玉堂，富厚堂是曾为官后兴建的宅院。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Heye town in eastern Shuangfeng County, roughly 2 hours by road south-west of Changsha; the Cai Hesen and Cai Chang residence is about 4 km away.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙山
summaryEn: A forested range on Lianyuan's southern border, a national forest park since 2007 centred on Yueping Peak (1,513 m), with forest cover of over 90% and seven scenic sections, among them the Feishuiya waterfall valley. Known as a 'mountain of medicinal herbs', it has on its summit the Medicine King Hall honouring Sun Simiao, the Tang physician said to have gathered herbs and written here, first built in the Tang and brought to its present form in 1887.
description: 龙山国家森林公园又名湖南百里龙山国家森林公园，坐落在中国湖南省娄底市涟源市杨市镇，是一座国家森林公园，总面积131.21平方公里。
accessEn: In Yangshi town south of Lianyuan city, about 45 km by road from Loudi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 彭德怀故居
summaryEn: The family home of Peng Dehuai (1898–1974), the general who commanded the Chinese People's Volunteers in the Korean War and was defence minister from 1954 until he was purged after clashing with Mao Zedong over the Great Leap Forward at the 1959 Lushan Conference. The mud-brick, tile-roofed house of 17 rooms at Wushi, which Peng paid to rebuild in 1925, stands about 30 m from the site of the thatched cottage where he was born. Around it the Peng Dehuai Memorial Hall, a 4A scenic area of about 30 ha, adds a biographical exhibition and a Korean War hall, a bronze statue, the Dehuai Pavilion and his tomb.
description: 彭德怀故居位于中国湖南省湘潭县乌石镇乌石村彭家围子，现存建筑是彭德怀任湘军营长时出资续建，始建于1925年。原为三间茅草屋，在今故居东北30米处。清光绪二十四年彭德怀出生于此。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Wushi in Xiangtan County, about 40 km south-west of Xiangtan city; roughly an hour by road. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 昭山
summaryEn: A 185 m hill on the east bank of the Xiang River at the Xiangtan–Changsha border, whose misty views after rain were painted by Mi Fu as 'Mountain Market in Clearing Mist', one of the classic Eight Views of Xiaoxiang; legend says King Zhao of Zhou drowned in the pool below. Zhaoshan Temple, first built in the Tang, stands on the summit with wide views of the river, Guanyin Temple lies at the foot, and a Qing granite path about 13 km long crosses the front and back hills.
description: 昭山坐落在湖南省湘潭市和长沙市交界处的湘江岸边，海拔185米。山下为昭潭。相传周昭王南巡至此，殁入昭潭。
accessEn: At Yijiawan in Yuetang District, about 15 km north of central Xiangtan and 5 km from Zhaoshan station on the Changsha–Zhuzhou–Xiangtan intercity railway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 红石林
summaryEn: A national geopark in Guzhang County where columns of red carbonate rock, laid down on an ancient sea floor some 450 million years ago, form a stone forest with a core area of more than 20 km². The rock looks reddish-brown in sunshine and turns dark when wet, so the forest changes colour with the weather.
description: 红石林国家地质公园是中国湖南省湘西土家族苗族自治州古丈县红石林镇的国家地质公园。园内有罕见的红色碳酸盐岩石林，形成于奥陶纪，石林颜色会随季节和天气改变。
accessEn: In Hongshilin Town, Guzhang County, across the You River from Furong Town and a short drive away.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 老司城
summaryEn: The ruined capital of the Peng clan, the Tujia chieftains (tusi) who ruled the Yongshun area from the 10th century until the Qing ended their rule in the 1720s; the walled city by the Lingxi River was their seat from the Southern Song onwards. Excavated palace and office quarters, streets, city walls, chieftains' tombs and temple sites survive, and the city has been one of the three Tusi Sites on the World Heritage List since 2015; a museum nearby explains the finds.
description: 老司城遗址是一处位于中国湖南省西北湘西土家族苗族自治州永顺县灵溪镇灵犀河畔的土司遗址。老司城最早建立于南宋时期，为土家族永顺宣慰司彭氏的数百年的司治所在，其统治瓦解于自清雍正年间改土归流。明代后期土司的治所在迁移到了以北的颗砂地区，称作“新司城”，因而原址称被称作“老司城”。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Sicheng village, about 20 km east of Yongshun county town by road; the Laosicheng Museum, about 4 km from the core of the site, is closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 益阳奥林匹克公园
summaryEn: A sports park in Heshan District on the south side of Yiyang, built for the 2002 Hunan Provincial Games, with a 30,000-seat stadium, a 5,000-seat arena, a swimming hall, outdoor pools and public fitness grounds. It was the main venue of the 15th Hunan Provincial Games, which opened there in September 2026, and is otherwise a local leisure and sports space rather than a sightseeing attraction.
description: 益阳奥林匹克公园，简称益阳奥体公园，也被称为益阳奥体中心、益阳奥林匹克体育中心，位于中华人民共和国湖南省益阳市赫山区康复南路3号，现为国家4A级旅游景区。益阳奥林匹克公园是益阳市人民政府为承办2002年湖南省九运会专门修建的，2003年第五届城运会的部分比赛也在这里进行。
accessEn: In Heshan District on the south side of Yiyang city, a short taxi ride from the centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 柳子庙·柳宗元文化旅游区
summaryEn: A riverside quarter on the west bank of the Xiao River in Lingling, the old town of Yongzhou, built around the places where the Tang writer Liu Zongyuan lived for ten years in exile from 805. At its centre is Liuzi Temple, founded in 1056 and moved in 1144 to its present site where the Yu Stream meets the Xiao; the three-courtyard hall with its opera stage dates from an 1877 rebuilding and holds the 'Lizi Stele', a text by Han Yu written out by Su Shi. The old Liuzi Street, the Yu Stream and the pools and hills Liu described in his 'Eight Records of Yongzhou' make up the rest of the area.
description: 柳子庙位于中国湖南省永州市零陵区，潇水西岸，是为纪念唐代柳宗元而设的庙宇，2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。柳宗元于贞元五年被贬为永州司马，在此谪居十年。后世为纪念他，北宋至和三年在华严岩学宫东侧建柳子祠，南宋绍兴十四年改建于愚溪汇入潇水处的北侧，称“柳子厚祠堂”或“柳司马祠”，清光绪三年重建，并改称柳子庙。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Liuzi Street on the west bank of the Xiao River in Lingling's old town, a short taxi ride from central Lingling and about 40 minutes by road from Yongzhou railway station in Lengshuitan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 阳明山
summaryEn: A mountain forest park in north-eastern Shuangpai County, a national forest park since 1992, rising to about 1,625 m. Its upper slopes carry more than 100,000 mu (some 6,700 ha) of wild azaleas that flower in spring, among forest with rare conifers such as Chinese Douglas fir and southern yew. The developed areas take in the azalea slopes, Wanshou Temple, Wanhe Lake and the source of the Xiaohuang River, and the park also has sites linked to the Red Army's Sixth Army Group on the Long March.
description: 湖南阳明山国家森林公园位于中国湖南省永州市双牌县境内，设立于1992年，面积11733.33公顷。
accessEn: Reached by mountain road, roughly 1½ hours from Lingling or from Shuangpai county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 幕阜山
summaryEn: The main peak of the Mufu range, about 1,600 m high, on Hunan's border with Hubei and Jiangxi in northern Pingjiang, a national forest park since 2005 that stays cool even in midsummer. The mountain has cliffs, waterfalls and pools, over 1,000 ha of natural Huangshan pine, more than a hundred rock inscriptions and the sites of old Daoist retreats, for Daoists counted it the 25th of their 36 grotto-heavens; shuttle buses run within the scenic area.
description: 幕阜山，地处湖南、湖北、江西三省交界处，同名主峰位于湖南省岳阳市平江县南江镇，是罗霄山脉北端支脉。东北-西南走向，为褶皱断块山。临近古夏水，故又称“负夏”。
accessEn: In Nanjiang town in northern Pingjiang County, roughly 2 hours by road east of Yueyang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 屈子文化园
summaryEn: The memorial temple of Qu Yuan, the Warring States poet whose drowning in the Miluo River is remembered at the Dragon Boat Festival, stands at the foot of Yusi Hill by the river: its brick-and-timber halls around three courtyards were moved here in 1754 after floods, the triple gate carries 13 reliefs of his life, and a stele forest of 356 carved inscriptions was added in 1995. Since 2017 the temple has been the core of the Quzi Cultural Park, some 6 km² with a new Quzi Academy, Dragon Boat Festival folk-culture areas and riverside wetland, which also takes in the eleven grave mounds on Miluo Hill, about 6 km to the south-east, that tradition since the Tang has held to be Qu Yuan's tombs.
description: 屈子祠，又名屈原庙，三闾庙，为祭祀战国时楚国大夫屈原神位之祠庙，位于湖南省汨罗市汨罗江畔的玉笥山麓，始建于汉代，现存建筑系清乾隆重建，是中国大陆现存纪念屈原的唯一古建筑，有“中华第一祠”之称。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 10 km north of Miluo city by road, roughly an hour from Yueyang. The Qu Yuan Memorial Hall, which looks after the temple, is closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 张谷英村
summaryEn: A clan village of the Zhang family below Bijia Hill in south-eastern Yueyang County, where connected houses built from the Ming and extended through the Qing form three great blocks, Dangdamen, Wangjiaduan and Shangxinwu, with 1,732 rooms, 206 skylit courtyards and 62 lanes over more than 50,000 m². Each hall is built around its courtyards and opens into the next, so much of the village can be crossed under cover, and its drains, light wells and fire-water pools still work; descendants of the founder Zhang Guying still live here.
description: 张谷英村位于湖南省岳阳市以东的渭洞笔架山下，地处岳阳县、平江县、汨罗市三县市交汇处，距离长沙市、岳阳市分别约150公里和70公里，为中国保存最为完整的江南民居古建筑群落，至今已存在了500多年。2001年6月25日被公布为全国重点文物保护单位，2003年被评为中国历史文化名村。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Zhangguying town about 70 km south-east of Yueyang city, roughly 1.5 hours by road; Changsha is about 150 km away.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 渌江书院
summaryEn: A traditional academy in western Liling, founded in 1175 and moved to its present site in the Qing dynasty, with whose teaching the scholars Zhu Xi, Wang Yangming and Zuo Zongtang are all associated. Its halls and courtyards were restored and reopened to the public in 2016, and Liling's old stone Lujiang Bridge is a short walk away.
description: 渌江书院系位于中国湖南省醴陵市的一座书院，始建于宋光宗淳熙二年，后在清朝道光九年迁至今址，2013年5月3日，中华人民共和国国务院将书院与同属醴陵市的沩山醴陵窑、渌江桥、李立三故居列为全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In western Liling, a short taxi ride from the city centre; Liling is about 40 minutes by road from Changsha Huanghua airport.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 韩文公祠
summaryEn: A memorial temple to the Tang writer and statesman Han Yu, who served as prefect of Chaozhou after being demoted, set on the western slope of Bijia Hill on the east bank of the Han River, facing the old town. First founded in 999 and moved to this site in 1189, its present halls date mainly from the Ming and Qing, and steles inside include a Qing recutting of Su Shi's inscription for Han Yu's temple.
description: 韩文公祠位于中国广东省潮州市湘桥区韩江东岸笔架山中峰西麓中轴线上，现址始建于南宋淳熙十六年，之后元、明、清各代均有续修，现主体基本为明、清建筑。是中国大陆现存的保存最完整历史最久远的纪念唐代韩愈的专祠。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the east bank of the Han River opposite Chaozhou's old town, a short walk across Guangji Bridge.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 可园
summaryEn: A compact Lingnan-style garden in Guancheng, built in the 1850s by the retired Qing official Zhang Jingxiu and counted among the four celebrated gardens of Guangdong. Halls, verandas, pools and rockeries are packed into a small plot, overlooked by the four-storey Ke Tower, the garden's tallest building. The painters Ju Chao and Ju Lian lived here for some ten years, and their work is seen as a forerunner of the Lingnan school of painting.
description: 东莞可园坐落在广东省东莞市城西的博厦村。为广东四大名园当中保留得最好的一个，岭南园林的代表。现为全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Guancheng, the old centre of Dongguan, a short taxi ride from downtown. Closed on Tuesdays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南社村和塘尾村
summaryEn: Two walled Ming and Qing clan villages in eastern Dongguan, listed together as a national heritage site in 2006. Nanshe, in Chashan town, is a Xie clan village laid out along a chain of four ponds, with a late-Ming wall and 16 ancestral halls lining the water. Tangwei, about 3 km away in Shipai town, keeps more than 260 Ming and Qing houses with 21 ancestral halls, study halls and watchtowers built of red sandstone and grey brick.
description: 南社村位于中国广东省东莞市茶山镇，是以谢氏为主的血缘村落，村内建筑具有典型的广府特色。2002年南社村古建筑群被列为广东省文物保护单位，2005年被列为中国历史文化名村，2006年南社村和塘尾村古建筑群被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位，2011年被列为全国特色景观旅游名镇。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Chashan town, eastern Dongguan, about 30 minutes by road from the city centre; Tangwei is a short taxi ride to the north-east.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鸦片战争博物馆
summaryEn: The museum in Humen town stands where the imperial commissioner Lin Zexu publicly destroyed confiscated opium in 1839, the event that led to the First Opium War, and its grounds keep the two destruction pools, rebuilt in 1957. Its Sea Battle Museum branch, opened in 1999 near the Weiyuan forts on Nanshan hill, holds the main exhibition on the Opium Wars, and the museum also looks after the Shajiao forts to the south. The Humen forts were begun in 1717, wrecked in both Opium Wars and rebuilt each time.
description: 鸦片战争博物馆位于广东省东莞市的虎门镇。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Humen town, south-west Dongguan, about 40 minutes by road from the city centre; the Sea Battle Museum beside the Weiyuan forts, and the Shajiao forts, are 5–8 km away by taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南海影视城
summaryEn: A film and television base of China Media Group (CCTV) in Shishan, Nanhai, begun in 1996 with street sets of old Hong Kong and Macau built for dramas about the two cities. Its largest set, built in 1997–98 for a series on the Taiping Rebellion, recreates the Taiping court palaces of Nanjing behind a gate tower 300 m wide, beside a moated quarter of Jiangnan-style streets, mansions and teahouses. Visitors walk through the replica sets, which are still used for filming and broadcasts.
description: 中央广播电视总台南海影视城，是中央广播电视总台位于广东省佛山市南海区的直属影视摄制基地，始建于1996年，为国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: In Shishan town, Nanhai District, about 20 km north of central Foshan by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南风古灶
summaryEn: A Ming-dynasty dragon kiln in Shiwan, built on a slope in 1506–1521 and fired continuously for about 500 years, a record recognised by Guinness World Records. The sloping brick kiln is 37.8 m long with 34 rows of stoking holes, and it forms the centre of a ceramics quarter with the Gaozao kiln, the Guangdong Shiwan Ceramics Museum, a street of ceramic-figure shops and workshops where visitors can try making pottery.
description: 南风古灶是一个位于广东省佛山市禅城区石湾镇街道高庙路的窑，始建于1506年，明朝正德年间，至今已有超过500年的历史。对研究中国的陶瓷生产技术的发展具有重要的价值。南风古灶是全国重点文物保护单位、国家AAAA级旅游景区、佛山新八景之一，并载入吉尼斯世界纪录。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Shiwan, Chancheng District, about 4 km south-west of central Foshan; the Nanfeng Guzao bus stops are at the entrance.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 白水寨
summaryEn: Baishuizhai is a mountain scenic area in Paitan, northern Zengcheng, crossed by the Tropic of Cancer and best known for the Baishui Fairy Waterfall, which drops from a reservoir high on the slope. A long stone stairway climbs past several waterfall viewing platforms, with a boardwalk along the lower stream, to the reservoir and the hills above.
description: 白水寨，全称为白水寨风景名胜区，位于中国广东省广州市增城区派潭镇，占地面积为170平方千米，与石门国家森林公园及南昆山国家森林公园相邻，属省级风景名胜区及国家4A级旅游景区。风景名胜区内含有广东地区罕见的原始森林、浅滩湿地、峡谷天池等自然生态资源，属山岳型风景名胜区。
accessEn: Near Paitan town in northern Zengcheng District, about 70 km north-east of central Guangzhou; buses run from Licheng in Zengcheng to a terminus at the main entrance.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 宝墨园
summaryEn: Baomo Garden in Zini village, Shawan, began as a Qing shrine to the Song official Bao Zheng, was destroyed in the 1950s and has been rebuilt since 1995 into a large garden in Lingnan style. Its ponds, bridges and halls are decorated with carved brick, stone and wood, and it holds a long porcelain relief copying the scroll 'Along the River during the Qingming Festival' and the collection hall of the donor Zhao Tailai. The neighbouring Nanyue Yuan is a sister garden.
description: 宝墨园位于中国广州市番禺区沙湾镇紫坭村，是一个以岭南园林为特色的主题公园，内有宝墨堂、聚宝阁、观景楼、赵泰来藏品馆、紫洞舫、龙图馆、列入上海大世界基尼斯之最的瓷塑浮雕《清明上河图》、巨型砖雕《吐艳和鸣壁》等景点。
accessEn: In Zini village, Shawan, Panyu District, about 30 km south of central Guangzhou, best reached by taxi or bus from Shiqiao in Panyu.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 北京路
summaryEn: Beijing Road has been a main street of central Guangzhou for centuries: the city's double gate tower stood here from 1244, and in the Qing the street was known for bookshops, antiques and its flower market. Fully pedestrianised since 2002, it is lined with department stores, bookshops and long-established Cantonese restaurants. The scenic area also counts the Nanyue Palace site museum, and the City God Temple and Dafo Temple are close by.
description: 北京路是中华人民共和国广东省广州市越秀区一条集文化、娱乐、商业于一体的街道，是广州市有史以来最繁华的商业中心，日均人流量约35万人次。北京路北起广卫路，南到沿江中路，全长1,500多米。
accessEn: In Yuexiu District in the heart of old Guangzhou, a short walk from Gongyuanqian station (Metro Lines 1 and 2) and Beijing Lu station (Line 6).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 正佳广场
summaryEn: Opened in 2005 at the junction of Tianhe Road and Tiyu East Road, Grandview is one of the largest shopping centres in southern China and in 2011 became one of the few malls in the country rated as a 4A scenic area. Alongside its shops and restaurants it houses the Grandview Polar Ocean World aquarium, a natural-science museum and an indoor rainforest garden, so it suits families on a rainy day.
description: 正佳广场是中国广州市的大型购物中心，位于天河区天河路与体育东路交汇处。毗邻天环广场和天河城广场。正佳广场是华南地区规模最大的购物中心，也是全国少数坐落于商场内的国家AAAA级旅游景区。
accessEn: In the Tianhe shopping district, linked by an underground passage to Tiyu Zhongxin station on Metro Line 1 and close to Tiyu Xilu station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大湾区中央湿地公园
summaryEn: Created on reclaimed mudflats at the mouth of the Pearl River in Wanqingsha, this wetland was planted with mangroves from the 1990s and opened to visitors in 2008, and it is the largest coastal wetland in Guangzhou. It draws large numbers of migratory birds and its ponds fill with lotus in summer, explored on boardwalks and by boat. Long known as Nansha Wetland Park, it was renamed the Greater Bay Area Central Wetland Park in November 2025.
description: 大湾区中央湿地公园，前称南沙湿地公园，是位于中华人民共和国广东省广州市南沙区万顷沙镇十八涌至十九涌之间的一个湿地公园，为国家4A级旅游景区。公园原为珠江入海口的泥滩，后被围垦，1995年开始培育湿地，2008年对外开放，占地面积约9,600亩，是广州市面积最大的湿地。
accessEn: In Wanqingsha, southern Nansha District, about 60 km south of central Guangzhou; from Wanqingsha station on Metro Line 18 a local bus takes about 40 minutes.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 广东科学中心
summaryEn: Opened in 2008 at the western tip of Xiaoguwei Island, the Guangdong Science Center is a large hands-on science museum whose ship-shaped building was certified by Guinness World Records in 2018 as the largest science centre by indoor floor area. Its permanent galleries cover physics experiments, transport, materials, digital technology, flight and space, and green living, with a children's area, several special-format cinemas including an IMAX and a dome theatre, and an outdoor science park beside a lake.
description: 广东科学中心位于中华人民共和国广东省广州市番禺区小谷围岛西南角，广州大学城外环西路西侧，是集科普教育、科技成果展示、国际学术交流和科普旅游四大功能于一身的大型公益性科普教育基地，全国乃至亚洲规模最大的科普教育基地之一，是亚太科学中心协会、世界科学中心协会和国际博物馆协会的成员单位，以及粤港澳大湾区科技馆联盟、广东省科技馆研究会和广州科普联盟的发起成员。
accessEn: On the west side of Guangzhou Higher Education Mega Center in Panyu District, about 20 km south-east of central Guangzhou, a short bus or taxi ride from the Mega Center metro stations.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 广州起义烈士陵园
summaryEn: Laid out in 1954–57 as a memorial park for those killed in the Communist-led Guangzhou Uprising of December 1927, the garden holds the communal tomb of the uprising dead, pavilions commemorating Chinese–Korean and Chinese–Soviet solidarity, and the Tomb of the Four Martyrs of Honghuagang from the 1911 revolution. Within its grounds stands the former Guangdong Provincial Assembly building of the late Qing, where Guangdong declared independence from the Qing in November 1911 and Sun Yat-sen was sworn in as Extraordinary President in 1921. That building now houses the Guangdong Museum of Revolutionary History, also called the Guangzhou Museum of Modern History.
description: 广州起义烈士陵园位于中国广东省广州市越秀区大塘街道东平社区中山三路92号，是为纪念1927年12月11日中共领导的广州起义牺牲的烈士而修建起来的一座纪念性公园，面积达26万平方米。1954年始建，1957年广州起义30周年落成。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Zhongshan 3rd Road in Yuexiu District, central Guangzhou, beside Lieshi Lingyuan station on Metro Line 1. The museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 广州起义纪念馆
summaryEn: The former Guangdong provincial capital police headquarters on Qiyi Road was stormed on 11 December 1927 in the Communist-led Guangzhou Uprising, and the next day the Guangzhou Soviet, or Guangzhou Commune, was proclaimed here before being suppressed within three days. The city police handed the gatehouse and office blocks over to the heritage authorities between 1987 and 2005, and after restoration they reopened in 2007 as a memorial museum, part of the Guangdong Museum of Revolutionary History.
description: 广州起义纪念馆，即广州公社旧址，为原中华民国国民政府广东省会公安局，位于中华人民共和国广东省广州市越秀区起义路200号之一，是1927年12月时由中国共产党的张太雷领导发动的广州暴动而建立的苏维埃政府——广州公社所在。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At 200 Qiyi Road in Yuexiu District, central Guangzhou, about 10 minutes' walk from Gongyuanqian station on Metro Lines 1 and 2. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 广州市城市规划展览中心
summaryEn: Designed by the architect He Jingtang and set at the western foot of Baiyun Mountain in the new Baiyun district, this exhibition centre tells the story of Guangzhou's history and planning. Displays include a large scale model of the whole city, galleries on urban history, transport and future master plans, and short films in a 4D cinema, and the building also houses the city's local gazetteer library.
description: 广州市城市规划展览中心，位于中国广东省广州市白云区展览路1号，是由中国建筑师何镜堂设计的一座城市规划展览馆，建筑面积为84,500平方米。建筑地处白云山西侧的白云新城内，毗邻广州白云国际会议中心及广东画院。
accessEn: At 1 Zhanlan Road in Baiyun District, about 7 km north of the old city centre, near Baiyun Cultural Square metro station. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 广州动物园
summaryEn: Opened on its present site in 1958, Guangzhou Zoo is counted with those of Beijing and Shanghai among China's three major city zoos, with animals grouped into areas for insects, reptiles and amphibians, birds, primates, big cats and herbivores. Residents include giant pandas, golden snub-nosed monkeys, South China tigers and Père David's deer as well as giraffes, elephants, hippos and rhinos, and the grounds also hold an aquarium opened in 1998.
description: 广州动物园是广州的一个动物园，位于广州市越秀区先烈中路120号。于1958年建成开放。与北京、上海的动物园合称中国三大动物园。
accessEn: On Xianlie Middle Road in Yuexiu District, about 4 km north-east of the old city centre; the south gate is at Zoo station on Metro Line 5 and the north gate near Huanghuagang station on Line 6.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 海珠湿地
summaryEn: Haizhu Wetland is a semi-natural wetland of orchards, canals and lakes in south-eastern Haizhu District, long known locally as the 'ten-thousand-mu orchard' and now a national wetland park surrounded by the city. Paths and bridges wind through fruit groves and waterways, making it a green escape close to the Pazhou exhibition area.
description: 广东广州海珠国家湿地公园，属半自然果林复合湿地生态系统，俗称“万亩果园”，被誉为“广州绿心”，位于广州市海珠区东南部，北面琶洲会展，南望广州大学城，东临国际生物岛，西跨城市新中轴其中，总面积1100公顷，水域面积达380公顷，核心区域869公顷为国家湿地公园建设范围，荣获中国人居环境范例奖。
accessEn: The main gate is on Xinjiao Middle Road in Haizhu District, about 8 km south-east of the old city centre, reached by bus or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黄花岗七十二烈士墓
summaryEn: This memorial park holds the tomb of the revolutionaries killed in the failed Huanghuagang uprising of April 1911 against the Qing, organised by Sun Yat-sen's Tongmenghui, whose remains were gathered and buried here by Pan Dawei. The cemetery was laid out from 1918 with funds from overseas Chinese, with a tomb pavilion and the Jigong Fang monument topped by a figure of Liberty, which was smashed in 1966 and re-created in the early 1980s. Tombs of other revolutionaries and of the aviation pioneer Feng Ru stand among the trees.
description: 黄花岗公园位于广东省广州市越秀区黄花岗街道先烈中路，是为了纪念于1911年4月，孙中山领导的同盟会在黄花岗起义中英勇牺牲的七十二位烈士而修建。除了七十二烈士墓之外，墓园内还陆续地修建了王昌墓、邓仲元墓、冯如墓、潘达微墓、史坚如墓和杨仙逸墓。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Xianlie Middle Road in Yuexiu District, about 3 km north-east of the old city centre, near Huanghuagang station on Metro Line 6.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 莲花山
summaryEn: Lotus Hill is a low hill on the Shiziyang channel of the Pearl River that was quarried for stone from the Western Han to the mid-19th century, leaving sheer cliffs, stone pillars, caves and pools now protected as an ancient quarry site. Paths lead up to the Lotus Pagoda, a nine-storey brick tower of 1612 that once guided ships into the river, and to a large gilded bronze statue of Guanyin erected in 1994 facing the water.
description: 莲花山是中国广东省广州市番禺区石楼镇的山脉，面临珠江的狮子洋水道，海拔约108米。莲花山建有广州莲花山风景旅游区，2002年入选为“新世纪羊城八景”之一的“莲峰观海”。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Shilou, Panyu District, about 30 km south-east of central Guangzhou, reached by bus or taxi from Shiqiao in Panyu.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 帽峰山森林公园
summaryEn: Maofeng Mountain is a forested range in Taihe, northern Baiyun District, whose main peak is the highest in Guangzhou's old urban districts. A hiking route climbs past the old Maofeng Temple, said to date back to around the 10th century, a maple garden that turns red in November and Tianhu Lake to the summit, while Jiulongjian on the northern slope is a lake fed by mountain springs.
description: 帽峰山森林公园，位于广州市白云区太和镇，距广州市区28公里，总面积6671.07公顷，建于1997年。2001年广东省林业局批准为广东省级森林公园，2003年被评为白云十景之一的“帽峰烟雨”，2023年4月被评为国家3A级旅游景区。
accessEn: In Taihe town, Baiyun District, about 30 km north-east of central Guangzhou, roughly 45 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南海神庙
summaryEn: Founded in 594 under the Sui dynasty, this is the only one of China's four imperial temples to the gods of the seas to survive, and officials came here to sacrifice for safe voyages, making it a landmark of Guangzhou's maritime trade. Its five courtyards hold many inscribed steles, including one with a text by Han Yu of 820 and imperial steles of the Ming founder and the Kangxi emperor, though the main hall was rebuilt in 1989 after being destroyed in the Cultural Revolution. On a hillock beside it stands the Yuri Pavilion, a classic spot for watching the sunrise over the river.
description: 南海神庙又称波罗庙，位于中国广东省广州市黄埔区穗东街道庙头社区旭日街22号，是古代皇帝祭祀海神洪圣的场所，也是海上丝绸之路的始发地。始建于隋朝开皇年间，至今已有1400多年历史，是中国四海神庙中唯一完整保存下来的建筑遗迹。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Miaotou, Huangpu District, about 20 km east of central Guangzhou, beside Nanhaishenmiao station on Metro Line 13. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南沙天后宫
summaryEn: Rebuilt in 1996 with funds from the Hong Kong businessman Henry Fok on the site of a Ming-dynasty shrine, this large temple to Mazu, the sea goddess Tianhou, climbs the south-east slope of Dajiao Hill above the Pearl River estuary. A granite statue of the goddess faces the sea from the front square, and Qing-style halls rise in tiers to the eight-storey Nanling Pagoda at the top.
description: 南沙天后宫座落在中国广州市南沙区大角山东南山麓。总占地4000多平方米。
accessEn: At the foot of Dajiao Hill in Nansha District, about 50 km south of central Guangzhou, near Nansha Passenger Port station on Metro Line 4.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 广州农民运动讲习所旧址
summaryEn: The institute occupies the former Panyu Confucian school, founded in 1370 and given its present layout in 1747, whose Lingxing Gate, semicircular pond with arched bridge, Dacheng Hall and side corridors survive. From May to September 1926 it housed the sixth and largest session of the Peasant Movement Training Institute, a school of the first Kuomintang–Communist alliance for training rural organisers, directed by Mao Zedong. Since 1953 it has been a memorial museum on the institute and the peasant movement.
description: 农民运动讲习所，简称农讲所，1924年7月在广州创办时全称为中国国民党中央执行委员会农民运动讲习所，1927年初随广州国民革命政府迁至武昌时名为中国国民党中央农民运动讲习所，是第一次国共合作时期培养中国国民党中央农民部农民运动干部的学校。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At 42 Zhongshan 4th Road in Yuexiu District, central Guangzhou, beside Nongjiangsuo station on Metro Line 1. Closed on Mondays, and visits must be booked in advance.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 沙湾古镇
summaryEn: Shawan is a Pearl River Delta town founded in the Song dynasty, whose old lanes and ancestral halls form a historic quarter known as a birthplace of Guangdong music and of ginger milk curd, a local dessert. Its centrepiece is Liugeng Hall, the ancestral hall of the He clan, founded in 1335 and rebuilt on a grand scale from 1698, with five courtyards of fine Lingnan stone, wood and brick carving.
description: 沙湾古镇位于广东广州。游览特色包括古镇、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Shawan, Panyu District, about 30 km south of central Guangzhou; Baomo Garden lies about 4 km to the west.

name: 中共三大会址
summaryEn: The Chinese Communist Party held its Third National Congress here in Dongshan from 12 to 20 June 1923, in a rented two-storey house that was destroyed by Japanese bombing in 1938. Its exact position was confirmed by excavation in 2006, when the brick floor was found; the foundations are marked by a small square beside a history exhibition hall opened the same year. The memorial also takes in Chunyuan, a villa next door that housed the party's central offices at the time.
description: 中国共产党第三次全国代表大会会址位于中国广州市越秀区东山恤孤院路3号，1923年6月12日至20日，中国共产党在此召开第三次全国代表大会。1979年被列为广东省文物保护单位，2013年3月会址遗址及中共中央机关旧址——春园被列为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
