accessEn: On Xuguyuan Road in the Dongshankou area of Yuexiu District, about 10 minutes' walk from Dongshankou station on Metro Lines 1 and 6. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 华南国家植物园
summaryEn: Founded in 1929 as a botanical institute of Sun Yat-sen University and run by the Chinese Academy of Sciences since 1954, the garden was designated the South China National Botanical Garden in 2022. Its Guangzhou section, open to the public since 1959, has dozens of themed collections such as the magnolia, palm and ginger gardens, a cluster of display glasshouses by a lake, and the Longdong Qilin lakeside landscape, chosen as one of the city's 'Eight Sights' in 1986.
description: 华南国家植物园，是中国南方地区唯一的国家级植物园，目前世界上最大的南亚热带植物园，也是中国国内历史最久、保存物种最多、面积最大的植物园之一，由国家林业和草原局、住房和城乡建设部、中国科学院、广东省和广州市人民政府合作共建，依托中国科学院华南植物园设立，由广州园区和鼎湖山国家级自然保护区组成，有“中国南方绿宝石”之称号。
accessEn: In Tianhe District about 15 km north-east of central Guangzhou, next to Botanical Garden station on Metro Line 6.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中山纪念堂
summaryEn: Built in 1929–31 with funds raised from local and overseas Chinese in memory of Sun Yat-sen, this octagonal hall by the architect Lü Yanzhi stands at the foot of Yuexiu Hill on the old city's north–south axis. Its blue-tiled roof covers a 71-metre auditorium without internal pillars, still used for concerts and meetings, and the Japanese surrender in Guangdong was signed here in 1945. A bronze statue of Sun stands in front, and the gardens include a kapok tree about 300 years old.
description: 广州中山纪念堂是广东省广州市的标志性建筑之一，位于越秀区北京街道莲花井社区东风中路295号，北靠越秀山，正对广州市人民代表大会常务委员会办公楼，左邻广东省人民政府。纪念堂由著名建筑师吕彦直和结构师李铿、冯宝龄设计，民国十八年动工，民国二十年建成。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Dongfeng Middle Road in Yuexiu District, central Guangzhou, beside Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall station on Metro Line 2.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黄埔军校旧址
summaryEn: Sun Yat-sen founded the Army Officer Academy, known as the Whampoa Military Academy, here on Changzhou Island in 1924, in the buildings of a Qing army school, to train officers during the first Kuomintang–Communist alliance. The main school building, bombed in 1938 and rebuilt to its original form in 1996, holds exhibitions on the academy's history and recreated offices, classrooms and dormitories. The site also includes the house where Sun stayed on visits, the academy club hall of 1926 and a memorial to Sun on a nearby hill.
description: 黄埔军校旧址位于中国广州市黄埔区长洲岛内，是孙中山创办的新式军事政治学校“中国国民党陆军军官学校”的首个校址，包括校本部、孙总理纪念室、孙总理纪念碑、俱乐部、游泳池等建筑，总面积约5.7万平方米。1984年6月被辟为纪念馆，成为广州市的知名旅游景点。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Changzhou Island in the Pearl River, Huangpu District, about 20 km east of central Guangzhou, reached by ferry or by road. Closed on Mondays except public holidays, and visits must be booked in advance.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 余荫山房
summaryEn: Yuyin Shanfang is a private garden built in 1867–71 for the Qing scholar-official Wu Bin in Nancun, Panyu, and is counted among the four famous gardens of Guangdong. Within a small walled plot it fits a rectangular lotus pond, an octagonal waterside pavilion, an arched bridge and halls with carved wooden screens and coloured 'Manchu' windows. The adjoining Yu Garden, added by a descendant in 1922, has a boat-shaped hall and a glass-walled upper room looking over the garden.
description: 余荫山房，又名余荫园，位于中国广东省广州市番禺区南村镇罗边村北大街，为清代道光年间举人邬彬的私家花园，广东四大名园之一。1983年被列为广州市文物保护单位，1989年被列为广东省文物保护单位，2001年6月被公布为全国重点文物保护单位，2023年3月被评为国家4A级旅游景区。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Nancun town, Panyu District, about 20 km south-east of central Guangzhou; the nearest metro station is Banqiao.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 河源恐龙文博园
summaryEn: A riverside park below Guifeng Hill in Heyuan that groups the Heyuan Dinosaur Museum, the city museum and the Song-dynasty Guifeng Pagoda. The dinosaur museum holds more than 20,000 fossil dinosaur eggs, a collection recognised by Guinness World Records as the largest. On the hilltop, the 42.6 m six-sided brick pagoda, begun in 1132, is the only early Southern Song pagoda in Guangdong with an exactly dated inscription, and its seven outer storeys hide fourteen floors inside.
description: 河源恐龙文博园位于广东河源。游览特色包括博物馆、古塔、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Binjiang Avenue in Yuancheng District, central Heyuan, a short taxi ride from the city centre. The museums are closed on Mondays.

name: 启超故里·小鸟天堂
summaryEn: Birds' Paradise is a river islet in Tianma village covered by a banyan grove that has grown from a single tree over more than 380 years, home to colonies of egrets and night herons that fly out and return at dawn and dusk; boats circle the island, and Ba Jin's 1933 essay about it made it famous across China. About 2 km to the east in Chakeng village is the family home of the late-Qing reformer and writer Liang Qichao, a brick-and-timber house with his study and a covered walkway, with a memorial hall on his life beside it.
description: 小鸟天堂，另称启超故里·小鸟天堂文化旅游区位于中国广东江门市新会区环城天马村前的一座小岛，是新会市新八景之一，亦是新会的生态旅游景点，是中华人民共和国最大的天然赏鸟乐园。1618年始，河中一个泥墩，一棵榕树长期繁衍生息，形成枝叶覆盖15亩河道，树上栖息2万多鹭鸟，鸟树相依，人鸟相处，和谐奇特的一道天然美丽风景线，鸟多了，人们便把这泥墩叫作“雀墩”。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Both are on the southern edge of Huicheng in Xinhui district, about 15 km south of central Jiangmen by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 古兜温泉
summaryEn: A large hot-spring resort at the foot of Gudou Mountain in Yamen town, southern Xinhui, between the hills and the sea, with both saline and fresh spring pools, a water park, villas and hotels. It is a weekend leisure complex rather than a sightseeing destination.
description: 古兜温泉渡假村位于中华人民共和国广东省江门市新会区大广海湾经济区崖门镇古兜山的脚下，是中国国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: In Yamen town at the foot of Gudou Mountain, about an hour by road south of central Jiangmen.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 圭峰山
summaryEn: A forested range of hills on the north-western edge of Xinhui's Huicheng, protected as Guifeng Mountain National Forest Park, with a hill lake, waterfalls and views over the delta plain. Historic sites on its slopes include Yutai Temple and the Zhenshan Pagoda, and it is a favourite local spot for evening walks, Mid-Autumn moon-viewing and Double Ninth hill-climbing.
description: 圭峰山也称圭峰山国家森林公园，是位于中华人民共和国广东省江门市新会区西北部的一座山峰，因形似圭璧而得名圭峰。最高峰主峰云峰为海拔545米。圭峰山南接新会市区，东接江门市区，西接新会大泽镇，北面是江门杜阮镇，与叱石山相连。
accessEn: On the north-western edge of Huicheng, Xinhui, about 10 km south-west of central Jiangmen.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 川岛
summaryEn: The Chuandao resort covers Shangchuan and Xiachuan, the two main islands of the Chuanshan archipelago off Taishan, with granite hills and long sandy beaches such as Feisha Beach on Shangchuan's east coast and Wangfuzhou on Xiachuan. Shangchuan was an early Portuguese trading base in the 16th century, and a memorial chapel and tomb garden mark where the Jesuit missionary Francis Xavier died in 1552; the Taishan Maritime Silk Road Museum opened on the island in 2019.
description: 上川岛，又称上川洲、穿洲和上川山，是广东省江门市台山的一个岛屿，位于广海湾南侧、川山群岛东部，西与下川岛隔海相望，东北距大陆9.19公里，面积为137.3平方公里，是广东省第二大岛，也是川山群岛的最大岛屿，有“南海碧波出芙蓉”之称。
accessEn: Ferries from Shanzui port in Taishan take about 30 minutes to Sanzhou on Shangchuan and about 35 minutes to Duwan on Xiachuan; Shanzui is roughly an hour by road south of Taishan city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 放鸡岛
summaryEn: An island of about 1.9 km² off the Dianbai coast, Maoming's largest, with a sandy beach on its north side, cliffs on the east and a hilltop lighthouse. Long without permanent residents, it was leased to a private developer in 2004 and is now run as a resort island with hotels and villas, a Tianhou temple, snorkelling and diving. Its name, 'release-the-chicken island', comes from sailors who stopped here to pray for safe passage and set a chicken free on the hill.
description: 放鸡岛，又名湾舟岛，原名汾洲山，位于中国广东省茂名市电白区博贺镇南部海面，距陆岸7.8海里，岛呈橄榄形自东北至西北弧形走向，面积1.9平方公里，是茂名市最大的海岛，北面为细沙海滩，东岸和北岸多为悬崖峭壁。
accessEn: Reached by boat from Bohe town on the Maoming coast, about 8 nautical miles across the sea; the island is about 40 km south-east of central Maoming. The resort closed for upgrading in August 2024, so check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 灵光寺
summaryEn: A Chan Buddhist monastery on Yinna Mountain, founded in the Xiantong era of the Tang dynasty (860–874) by the monk Pan Liaoquan as Shengshou Temple and renamed Lingguang Temple in 1385. Two ancient cypresses before the gate, one living and one long dead, are known as the 'trees of life and death', and the bell tower keeps a bronze bell cast in 1485. The forested mountain around it makes a cool walk in summer.
description: 梅州灵光寺位于广东省梅州市梅县雁洋镇阴那村阴那山五指峰，原名圣寿寺，为省级文物保护单位、国家4A级景区，是广东四大名寺之一。寺大门前挺立两棵古柏，一生一死，名生死树。文化大革命期间，灵光寺遭到严重破坏，改革开放后，1978年7月18日公布为广东省文物保护单位。
accessEn: On the slopes of Yinna Mountain in Yinna village, Yanyang town, about 40 km by road east of Meizhou, roughly 50 minutes by car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 泰安楼
summaryEn: A square fortified house of the Lan family on Tai'an Road in Huliao, Dabu's county town, built in 1763. Its outer walls combine earth, stone and brick around ranges of rooms, and it was listed as a national heritage site in 2019; the area around it has been developed as a Hakka culture tourism park.
description: 泰安楼位于中国广东省梅州市大埔县湖寮镇泰安路，是一座蓝氏家族居住的方形土楼，建于清乾隆二十八年，坐东北向西南，长49米，宽52.6米，占地面积6684平方米，共有房间200间。墙体以土、石、砖砌就。2002年被列为广东省文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Tai'an Road in Huliao, Dabu's county town, about 1 hour 15 minutes by road east of Meizhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黄腾峡
summaryEn: A forested gorge in the hills just north of Qingyuan city, nicknamed 'little Jiuzhaigou', where a long, narrow mountain stream has been turned into a white-water rafting run. The course drops past steep canyon walls and waterfalls, and rafting is the main reason to come.
description: 黄腾峡是中国广东省清远市清城区的一座山峰，高度683米，被誉为“小九寨沟”。因黄腾峡有一条长而狭小的溪流，当地人打造了漂流项目发展旅游业。
accessEn: About 10 km north-east of central Qingyuan, on the east bank of the North River, a short drive or taxi ride from the city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 妈屿岛
summaryEn: A small island at the mouth of Shantou harbour, known in the treaty-port era as Double Island, where the American and British consulates and the port's first foreign-run customs house opened in 1860 before moving across the harbour during the 1860s. Visitors come for its two Mazu (Tianhou) temples, one founded in the Yuan dynasty, a Qing Dragon King temple and a small swimming beach beneath the Shantou Bay Bridge.
description: 妈屿，又名放鸡山，是位于广东省汕头市的海岛。位于汕头港出海口，面积0.97平方公里，海拔39米，海岸线长2.3公里。
accessEn: At the mouth of Shantou harbour, about 8 km east of the old city centre; a road off the Shantou Bay Bridge leads onto the island.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南澳岛
summaryEn: Shantou's largest island and the seat of Nan'ao County, crossed by the Tropic of Cancer and linked to the mainland by the Nan'ao Bridge since 2015. It draws visitors to sandy bays such as Qing'ao Bay at its east end and to coastal-defence history, including the Zongbing Fu at Shen'ao, headquarters of the Ming and Qing regional commanders, begun in 1576.
description: 南澳岛，古称“钱澳”，又称浅湾，是位于中国广东省汕头市的海岛，距离汕头市区30余公里，为汕头市最大岛屿，也是中国大陆唯一穿越北回归线的海岛，北濒柘林湾、南濒南海，面积112平方公里，海岸线长达94.3千米，全岛呈葫芦状，东西两部为山丘，中部为冲积平原。
accessEn: About an hour by road from central Shantou, over the Nan'ao Bridge from Chenghai.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 海丰红宫红场
summaryEn: Haifeng's former Confucian school, with its Lingxing gate, crescent pond and Dacheng Hall, where Peng Pai convened the county congress of workers, peasants and soldiers on 18–21 November 1927 that proclaimed the Haifeng Soviet government; the buildings were painted red and renamed the Red Palace. The open ground to the east, where a mass rally was held on 1 December 1927, became the Red Square. The scenic area also takes in the nearby former residence of Peng Pai (1896–1929), the Dequ study hall and the former Chishanyue farmers' association.
description: 海丰红宫、红场旧址位于中国广东省汕尾市海丰县海城镇人民南路，1961年被列为第一批全国重点文物保护单位。红宫原为海丰县学宫，坐西北朝东南，有棂星门、泮池、戟门、大成殿等建筑。1927年10月彭湃在海丰发动武装暴动，11月18日～21日在学宫内召开了海丰县工农兵代表大会，宣布海丰县苏维埃政府成，并将学宫改称为红宫。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Hongchang Road in the centre of Haifeng town, about 20 km north of central Shanwei by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 玄武山
summaryEn: A hill in the coastal town of Jieshi, Lufeng, crowned by Yuanshan Temple, dedicated to the Daoist god Xuantian Shangdi and founded in 1127. Enlarged into its present layout in 1577 and renamed in the Kangxi reign to avoid the emperor's personal name, the south-facing temple has a gate hall, middle and main halls and side halls, with plaques inscribed by Lin Zexu and Liu Yongfu.
description: 玄武山位于广东汕尾。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At 1 Xuanwu Avenue in Jieshi town, southern Lufeng, about 70 km east of central Shanwei by road.

name: 满堂围
summaryEn: Begun in 1833 by the Guan family, Mantang Wei in Aizi town is a fortified Hakka communal house made up of three linked enclosures, the upper, middle and lower wei. Listed as a national heritage site in 1996, it is open to visitors as the Mantang Hakka Enclosure scenic area.
description: 满堂围位于中国广东省韶关市始兴县隘子镇满堂村，是一座客家围屋，1996年11月被列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。满堂围始建于清道光十三年，为官姓家族所建，占地13000余平方米，由上围、中围、下围三个单元组成一个整体。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Aizi town in southern Shixing county, about an hour by road south of Shixing town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 梅关古道·珠玑巷
summaryEn: On the Meiling ridge at the Guangdong–Jiangxi border, Zhang Jiuling, later a Tang chancellor, cut a paved road through the pass in 716, opening the main overland route between the Yangtze valley and Guangzhou; the stone road and a gate tower, first built in the Song and inscribed in the Ming 'Nanyue Xiongguan' and 'First Pass of Lingnan', survive. About 15 km south, the old village street of Zhuji Lane was the staging post where many Cantonese clans of the Pearl River Delta place their ancestors before the migration south, and it is lined with rebuilt clan halls and an old stone pagoda.
description: 梅关古道古称大庾岭路，位于中国江西省大余县和广东省南雄市交界处的梅岭上，是唐朝名相张九龄于716年所开凿。现存梅关关楼和古驿道约8公里，2006年梅关关楼和江西境内的古驿道被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位，2013年梅关关楼和广东境内的古驿道被列为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Mei Pass is about 30 km north of Nanxiong city and Zhuji Lane about 10 km north-east of it, so a car is easiest.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 云门寺
summaryEn: Founded in 923 by the Chan master Wenyan, Yunmen Temple is the birthplace of the Yunmen school, one of the five houses of Chan (Zen) Buddhism. Most of its present halls were rebuilt under the monk Xuyun between 1943 and 1951 in traditional Qing style, and the temple keeps a Southern Han stele of the 10th century honouring its founder. Around it, the Yunmen Mountain eco-cultural tourism area adds a water park, go-karts and a Guoshan Yao village.
description: 云门山大觉禅寺，简称云门寺，位于广东省韶关市乳源县城北6公里，离韶关市区有50公里。占地12000平方米，建筑面积达7000多平方米。云门寺始建于南汉乾亨七年，由云门宗始祖六祖惠能九传弟子文偃禅师所建，是云门宗的发祥地。
accessEn: About 6 km north of Ruyuan town and roughly 50 km by road west of Shaoguan city.
imageCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Nat Krause assumed (based on copyright claims).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 青青世界
summaryEn: An eco-tourism farm park opened in 1995 at the foot of Dananshan hill, with a simulated rainforest of artificial mist and rain, a butterfly garden and a petting area with small animals. It now suits young families more than sightseers.
description: 青青世界是位于中国广东省深圳市南山区的一个以生态旅游、环保科普为主题的观光农场和旅游景区，于1995年开业，是深圳市知名的旅游景点之一，亦是国家4A级景区。
accessEn: On Qingqing Street by Moon Bay (Yueliang Bay) in Nanshan district, about 25 km west of central Shenzhen.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 仙湖植物园
summaryEn: A large botanical garden at the foot of Wutong Mountain beside Shenzhen Reservoir, founded in 1983, open since 1988 and now linked with the Chinese Academy of Sciences. Lakes and pavilions frame themed collections including a national cycad conservation centre, desert-plant and shade-plant areas and a fossil forest, and the grounds also hold Hongfa Temple, which draws huge crowds at Chinese New Year.
description: 仙湖植物园，全称深圳市中国科学院仙湖植物园，是位于中国广东省深圳市罗湖区莲塘街道仙湖路的集科学研究、物种保育、公众教育科普等为一体的大型植物园，国家AAAA级旅游景区。其地理位置东倚深圳梧桐山，西临深圳水库，面积668公顷。
accessEn: In Luohu district about 10 km north-east of central Shenzhen, a short ride from Xianhu Road metro station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东部华侨城
summaryEn: A resort and theme-park complex opened in 2007 by the OCT Group in the Sanzhoutian hills above Dameisha beach. Knight Valley is an adventure park with rides and a man-made waterfall, while Tea Stream Valley has tea terraces, wetland gardens, a Chinese-style tea town and a copy of the Swiss resort of Interlaken; a forest train links the areas, and the complex also has hotels, a golf course and Huaxing Temple.
description: 东部华侨城是位于中国广东省深圳市盐田区，由华侨城集团投资建造的一个自然与人造景观结合的旅游度假区和主题公园。总占地面积约9平方公里，2004年开始兴建，2007年7月底开幕。度假区的位于盐田区大鹏湾畔三洲田附近山区，面临深圳著名的海滩大梅沙和小梅沙，自然景致优美，在度假区兴建之前就已是一处景区。
accessEn: In Yantian district above Dameisha, about 25 km by road east of central Shenzhen.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 深圳野生动物园
summaryEn: Opened in 1993 beside Xili Lake, this safari-style zoo is described by Shenzhen's tourism bureau as the first in China to keep its animals uncaged. Sightseeing vehicles tour the large-mammal areas, and the walking zones include giant pandas and South China tigers.
description: 深圳野生动物园，在1993年落成，是深圳市的一个动物园，邻近深圳西丽湖畔东侧，面积约120万平方米，园内放养3百多个品种、约万头野生动物。包括一级保护动物：大熊猫、金丝猴、华南虎、东北虎、黑豹、火烈鸟、麦哲伦企鹅、长颈鹿、斑马、亚洲象、丹顶鹤、河马等。
accessEn: In Xili, Nanshan district, about 20 km north-west of central Shenzhen; Xili Lake metro station is nearby.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 国恩寺
summaryEn: Founded in 683 on Longshan hill in Liuzu town, Guo'en Temple is where Huineng, the Sixth Patriarch of Chan (Zen) Buddhism, died in 713; it is counted with Guangxiao and Nanhua temples as one of his three ancestral seats, and the Platform Sutra is said to have been compiled here. The present halls date from the Ming to the Republican era, and the surrounding Sixth Patriarch's Hometown resort area also takes in his former home, a lychee tree said to have been planted by him and the Longshan hot spring.
description: 国恩寺，又名龙山寺，位于广东省云浮市新兴县六祖镇，是一座禅宗寺庙。2019年10月7日公布为第八批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Liuzu town, about 12 km south of Xinxing town; shuttle buses run there from Xinxing South station on the Guangzhou–Zhanjiang high-speed railway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 湖光岩
summaryEn: A volcanic crater lake (maar) in Mazhang district, formed by steam explosions some 140,000 to 200,000 years ago and now the core of the Huguangyan area of the Leiqiong Global Geopark. Footpaths circle the steep, wooded crater above the clear lake, with viewpoints along the rim.
description: 湖光岩，位于中国广东省湛江市麻章区湖光镇境内，因湖四面环崖“负阴而抱阳”，古称“湖阳岩”，又因湖水清澈如镜，别称“镜湖”，是雷州半岛上一处保存极为完好的第四纪火山口湖，也是中国乃至东亚最具代表性的火山地质遗迹之一，现为中国雷琼世界地质公园湖光岩园区、广东湛江湖光岩国家地质公园的核心区域，面积4.7平方公里。
accessEn: In Huguang town, Mazhang district, about 30 minutes by road south-west of central Zhanjiang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 德庆学宫
summaryEn: Deqing's school-temple of Confucius, founded in 1011 and moved to this site in 1081; after a flood its main Dacheng Hall was rebuilt in 1297 and still stands. The hall is known for its unusual timber frame, which leaves out four interior columns and carries very long bracket arms, and the Lingxing Gate, semicircular pond, Dacheng Gate and side halls survive around it. Ceremonies for Confucius and children's first-writing rites are held here twice a year.
description: 德庆学宫位于中华人民共和国广东省肇庆市德庆县德城街道朝阳西路，始建于北宋大中祥符四年，占地8000多平方米。1962年公布为广东省文物保护单位；1996年列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。北宋大中祥符四年，康州奉诏置孔庙，将其建于子城东五里的紫极宫故址；庆历三年，知州事李仲求重修；元丰四年迁至现址。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Chaoyang West Road in Decheng, Deqing's county town, about 90 km (1 hour) west of Zhaoqing by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 悦城龙母祖庙
summaryEn: The principal temple of the Dragon Mother (Longmu), a river goddess worshipped all along the West River, standing where the Yuecheng River joins the West River in Yuecheng town. The present stone archway, gate, incense pavilion, main hall and side halls date mostly from the late Qing Guangxu reign and are finely worked in brick, wood and stone, and the compound also holds the Dragon Mother's tomb. Her birthday fair in the fifth lunar month is a national intangible heritage item.
description: 悦城龙母祖庙位于中国广东省肇庆市德庆县悦城镇悦城河与西江交汇处，是祀奉龙母蒲媪的庙宇。1989年公布为广东省文物保护单位；2001年列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。龙母庙始建年代不详，综合明清时期编纂的《广东通志》、《德庆州志》、《龙母庙志》等地方志记载，唐代龙母祖庙已经有一定规模，有诗人前来题咏。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Yuecheng town, Deqing County, on the West River about 50 km west of Zhaoqing by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东澳岛
summaryEn: A small, mostly forested island in the middle of the Wanshan archipelago, south-east of Zhuhai, with one main settlement, Dong'ao village. Its sights include the Dong'ao gun fort, built in 1729 to guard the sea approaches, the ruins of a customs station set up in 1898 and rock formations along the shore.
description: 东澳岛，位于中华人民共和国广东省珠海市香洲区东南部万山群岛中部。岛屿总面积4.663平方公里。岛上人口约400人，主要居住于东澳村。
accessEn: By ferry from Xiangzhou port in Zhuhai or, in about 70 minutes, from Shekou in Shenzhen; sailings are reduced or cancelled in rough weather.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 桂山岛
summaryEn: An island in the Pearl River estuary between Zhuhai and Lantau, seat of Guishan town in the Wanshan archipelago, renamed in 1954 after the warship Guishan, whose crew made a beach landing here in the Wanshan Islands campaign of 1950. Round-island routes lead to the Guishan warship memorial park, a square and poem wall dedicated to Wen Tianxiang, a Mazu temple, rock inscriptions and lighthouses, and the surrounding waters are a base for sea fishing.
description: 桂山岛，前称垃圾尾岛、曱甴尾，是中华人民共和国广东省珠海市管辖的万山群岛岛屿之一，是著名的旅游海岛，亦是珠海万山海洋开发试验区的政治、经济、文化中心。行政区划属于广东省珠海市香洲区桂山镇。桂山岛东距香洲、澳门约15海里，北距香港大屿山分流约3海里，并邻近港珠澳大桥和珠江口。
accessEn: By ferry from Xiangzhou port in Zhuhai (about 50 minutes, passing under the Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge), from Shekou in Shenzhen, or from Taipa in Macau, as the island's port has border facilities.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 外伶仃岛
summaryEn: A hilly island at the north-eastern edge of the Wanshan archipelago, only a short distance south of Hong Kong's outlying islands but administered by Zhuhai as the seat of Dangan town. Most residents live along the west coast around the town and Miaowan, and the clear waters around the island support coral communities.
description: 外伶仃岛是中国广东省万山群岛的岛屿之一，位于万山群岛中北部，香港的长洲仅在其北10公里之外，江门的大广海湾在其西100公里之外。岛屿一如万山群岛其他岛屿，由珠海市管辖，担杆镇镇政府亦驻于外伶仃岛。该岛面积4.32平方千米。
accessEn: By ferry from Xiangzhou port in Zhuhai or from Shekou in Shenzhen; the island has no immigration post, so it cannot be reached directly from Hong Kong.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 宫保府
summaryEn: The hillside compound of the Cen family above the Tuoniang River at Nalao, home of the Qing official Cen Yuying, Viceroy of Yunnan and Guizhou, and his son Cen Chunxuan. Its centrepiece, the Gongbao Mansion begun in 1876, is a three-courtyard brick-and-timber residence with painted beams and carved wood; around it stand the family's Nanyang Academy, the Rongludi house, a three-storey octagonal pavilion, an ancestral hall and a Ming-dynasty general's temple. The buildings blend Han official architecture with the building traditions of the Zhuang region of western Guangxi.
description: 宫保府位于广西百色。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、祠堂文化、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Nalao town about 43 km by road from Xilin's county town.

name: 北海银滩
summaryEn: Beihai's main beach, a strand of fine white quartz sand running about 24 km along the south shore of the peninsula from Qiaogang to Daguansha, with a very gentle slope into the sea. It was developed as a resort from 1990, became one of China's first national tourism resorts in 1992, and its large 'Tide' sculpture is the city's landmark.
description: 北海银滩，位于中国广西壮族自治区北海市，是中国著名的滨海旅游胜地，以“滩长平、沙细白、水温净、浪柔软”著称。景区巨型雕塑《潮》为北海市的地标性建筑。
accessEn: On the south coast of Beihai, about 9 km south of the city centre by bus or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 侨港小镇
summaryEn: A small seaside town at the southern tip of Beihai, founded in 1979 as an overseas-Chinese fishing commune to resettle more than 7,700 ethnic Chinese who had left Vietnam. Its residents keep their own Cantonese dialects, and the harbour, market and streets of this returnee community are visited as one of Beihai's distinctive neighbourhoods.
description: 侨港小镇位于广西北海。游览特色包括海岸风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At the western end of Silver Beach beside Beihai International Passenger Port, about 6 km south of central Beihai.

name: 涠洲岛圣堂
summaryEn: A Gothic-style Catholic church in Shengtang village in the middle of Weizhou Island, built by missionaries of the Paris Foreign Missions Society and completed around 1880. It is described as the largest Catholic church on the Guangxi coast, and together with the smaller Chengzai church elsewhere on the island it is part of the national heritage listing of Beihai's modern buildings.
description: 涠洲天主教堂，是一所位于中国广西北海市涠洲岛上的天主教教堂，因位于盛塘村，故而又名盛塘天主教堂。该教堂由法国巴黎外方传教会传教士修建，落成于1880年。该教堂为哥特式建筑，楼高21米，总建筑面积774平方米，连同附属建筑在内总面积达到2000余平方米，是广西沿海地区最大的天主教教堂，2001年被列为全国文物保护单位。
accessEn: In Shengtang village a few kilometres north-east of Nanwan on Weizhou Island, reached by island minibus, motor tricycle or bicycle after the ferry from Beihai.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 友谊关
summaryEn: Friendship Pass is the historic gateway on the China–Vietnam border south-west of Pingxiang, known as Zhennan Pass until 1953 and given its present name in 1965. The four-storey, 22 m gate tower holds exhibitions on the pass's history, Ming-dynasty walls climb the hills on either side, which carry old gun batteries such as the group on Jinji Shan, and a colonnaded French-style building of 1896, remodelled in 1914, once housed the border affairs office. The pass saw the 1885 Battle of Zhennan Pass in the Sino-French War.
description: 友谊关位于广西崇左。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、楼阁建筑、历史建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 15 km south-west of Pingxiang city, roughly 20–30 minutes by road. Carry your passport, as there are border checkpoints on the roads near the frontier.

name: 金田起义地址
summaryEn: The village of Jintian where Hong Xiuquan's God Worshippers declared their revolt on 11 January 1851, the start of the Taiping Rebellion. On Xiniu Ridge the ramparts of their rectangular camp, about 65 by 35 m, survive around the stone where the flag was raised, with the old drill ground and Xiniu Pool nearby, and outlying sites include the site of Wei Changhui's home and the Sanjie Temple front-line post. A modern museum beside the camp tells the story of the movement through themed halls and a 3D cinema.
description: 金田起义地址位于中国广西自治区桂平市金田乡金田村犀牛岭。其北端为长方形营盘。南北长65米，东西宽35.5米，高3.6米，底厚1.8米，顶厚1.8米。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Jintian village, about 28 km (40 minutes) by road north of Guiping city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 恭城古建筑群
summaryEn: A group of Ming and Qing buildings in Gongcheng town. The Confucian Temple, founded in 1410 and rebuilt in 1842, climbs the hillside in terraces from its Lingxing gate and Pan pond to the double-eaved Dacheng Hall, and the Guandi (Wu) Temple of 1603, rebuilt in 1862, stands beside it with its own opera stage. Nearby are the Zhou Wei Shrine to a Song-dynasty official born in Gongcheng and the Qing-era Hunan Guild Hall, promoted together with the temples as the 'three temples and two guild halls'.
description: 恭城古建筑群位于中国广西壮族自治区恭城瑶族自治县，由恭城文庙、恭城武庙、周渭祠、湖南会馆组成，2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。恭城文庙位于拱辰街，始建于明永乐八年，重修于清道光二十二年，中轴线上有棂星门、状元桥、泮池、大成门、大成殿、崇圣祠，两侧有礼门、碑亭、乡贤祠、名宦祠等建筑。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the centre of Gongcheng town, about 110 km south-east of Guilin, roughly 1.5–2 hours by road or a short high-speed train ride.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 岩滩
summaryEn: The reservoir area of the Yantan hydropower station on the Hongshui River, whose 110 m dam was built between 1985 and 1995, now developed for lakeside stays. Its landmark is Meinü (Beauty) Peak, a karst ridge said to resemble a sleeping woman, where a campsite opened in 2023 with space-capsule pods, forest cabins, RV pitches, tent lodges, a hotel, hiking paths and viewing platforms over the lake.
description: 岩滩水电站位于中国广西壮族自治区大化瑶族自治县境内的红水河中游干流上，上游距龙滩水电站166公里，下游距大化水电站83公里。它是红水河的第五级水电站，也是广西第一座装机容量超百万千瓦的大型水电站。现时已准备对其扩建。
accessEn: Around Yantan town in north-western Dahua county, about 1.5 hours by road from Dahua county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 白莲洞洞穴科学博物馆
summaryEn: A museum at Bailian Cave, a limestone cave about 1,870 m long south of Liuzhou where digs since 1956 have yielded stone tools, human teeth, animal fossils and traces of fire spanning roughly 37,000 to 7,000 years ago. The site museum and a newer exhibition hall display the finds, including river-snail shells that show how long people here have eaten snails.
description: 白莲洞遗址位于中国广西壮族自治区柳州市鱼峰区柳石路472号，2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位，已设立白莲洞古人类遗址博物馆、白莲洞洞穴科学博物馆。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At 472 Liushi Road about 12 km south of central Liuzhou, roughly 25 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 柳侯公园
summaryEn: A city-centre park laid out from 1906 around the shrine to Liu Zongyuan, the Tang poet and essayist who governed Liuzhou and died here in 819. The shrine, founded in 822 and rebuilt in 1987 to a Qing plan, keeps about fifty steles from the Song dynasty onwards, among them the Lizi Stele of 1217 with a poem by Han Yu in Su Shi's calligraphy. Behind it is a memorial tomb holding Liu's robes and cap, and the park is a popular gathering place for local musicians and dancers.
description: 柳侯公园位于中华人民共和国广西壮族自治区柳州市城中区文惠路60号，是国家4A级旅游景区、国家重点公园。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Wenhui Road in central Liuzhou, opposite the Liuzhou Museum.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 柳州博物馆
summaryEn: The city's main museum, founded in the late 1950s and housed since 2003 in a granite building in the style of a city gate on the east side of People's Square. Its permanent galleries cover fossils and prehistoric remains, Liuzhou's history, ethnic costume and silverwork, ancient bronzes, painted fans and calligraphy, carved inkstones and stone steles.
description: 柳州博物馆位于中华人民共和国广西壮族自治区柳州市城中区解放北路37号人民广场东侧，是一所大型综合性博物馆。
accessEn: On Jiefang North Road beside People's Square in central Liuzhou, across the road from Liuhou Park. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 广西民族博物馆
summaryEn: A museum of the cultures of Guangxi's 12 long-established ethnic groups beside the Yong River within the Qingxiu Mountain scenic area, completed in December 2008 and opened to the public in May 2009, in a main building whose shape is taken from a bronze drum. Its four permanent exhibitions cover bronze drums, the ethnic cultures of Guangxi, Zhuang culture and everyday objects of the past century, and an open-air park shows traditional houses of different groups.
description: 广西民族博物馆位于广西南宁。游览特色包括博物馆、国家一级博物馆。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Qinghuan Road in Qingxiu District, on the south-eastern side of Qingxiu Mountain about 10 km south-east of central Nanning; a taxi is the easiest way there. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 中山公园·中山纪念堂
summaryEn: Wuzhou's oldest park, laid out on a hill above the old town in 1924 when the city wall was pulled down, and renamed Zhongshan Park in October 1930 when its memorial hall to Sun Yat-sen was completed. Sun stayed in Wuzhou three times in 1921–22 while preparing the Northern Expedition, and the white hall, which combines a Chinese palace-style front with a domed tower and a 1,000-seat auditorium, displays photographs and objects on his life and his visits to the city. The park also has gardens, a bamboo grove on the back slope and a memorial hall to the revolutionary Wei Baqun.
description: 梧州中山纪念堂位于中华人民共和国梧州市万秀区上三里18号中山公园内，完建于1930年10月。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Wanxiu District, central Wuzhou, on the hill just north of the arcade-house quarter; a short walk from the old town or a few minutes by taxi. The memorial hall is closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 真武阁·容州古城
summaryEn: The three-storey timber Zhenwu Pavilion was built in 1573 on the Jinglüe Terrace by the Xiu River, a platform said to date from the Tang dynasty, when the poet-official Yuan Jie drilled troops here. Its lever-like bracketing joins nearly 3,000 timber pieces without nails, and four inner columns on the second floor hang about 2 cm clear of the floor. Around it the former People's Park was rebuilt in 2014–16 as Rongzhou Old Town, a 25-hectare scenic area with a reconstructed prefectural hall, a museum, Kaiyuan Temple, an old-style shopping street and boat landings on Xiujiang Lake.
description: 经略台真武阁位于广西壮族自治区玉林市容县，由真武阁与经略台上下两部分建筑构成。古经略台位于容县城东的人民公园内，绣江之滨。相传建于唐乾元至大历年间，为唐代诗人元结任容县经略使时所建，主要用来操练士兵，故取名为经略台，至今已有1200多年历史。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the east side of Rong County town beside the Xiu River, within walking distance of the centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 七仙岭温泉国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park beneath the seven jagged peaks of Qixianling, with a forest zone and a hot-spring zone. A rainforest walk passes trees that flower on their trunks, epiphyte 'sky gardens' and strangler figs on the way to a viewing platform over Baoting, and hot springs rise naturally in the park's streams. Around the Qixi festival, usually in August, Baoting holds the Qixian Hot Spring Water Festival, a water-splashing celebration with Li and Miao song and dance that has run since 2000.
description: 七仙岭温泉国家森林公园，位于海南岛保亭黎族苗族自治县七仙岭温泉旅游区1号，处于保城镇七仙岭一带，距保亭县城内8公里，总面积2200公顷。最高峰海拔约1126米，为盆地、三面环山，是一个热带雨林公园，公园包括森林区和温泉区。
accessEn: About 7 km north-north-west of Baocheng, the Baoting county seat, under the Qixianling peaks.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东坡书院
summaryEn: The site where the poet and official Su Dongpo (Su Shi), exiled to Hainan in the late 1090s, lived and taught in Danzhou; the academy that grew up around his Zaijiu Hall was rebuilt in the Ming and Qing dynasties, destroyed in the Cultural Revolution and restored in 1982. The Zaijiu Pavilion and Hall, side rooms and corridors now serve as an exhibition hall, and the grounds also have Dongpo Lake, a bridge, a statue, a memorial hall for the Guanglang Hermitage and Dongpo's well. Guides use augmented-reality devices, and a live 'Dongpo micro-theatre' show is staged on site.
description: 东坡书院位于中国海南省儋州市中和镇东郊，为苏轼故居遗址。明清时期改建。文化大革命时期被毁，文物荡然无存，1982年其重建。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Zhonghe town, about 34 km north-west of Nada, the Danzhou city seat; the old walled town of Zhonghe (Ancient City of Danzhou) is under 1 km to the west.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 海南省博物馆
summaryEn: The provincial museum, in the Hainan Cultural Park on Guoxing Avenue, has occupied its present building since 2008 and was rated a national first-class museum in 2012. Its permanent exhibitions cover the history of Hainan, the island's minority peoples, intangible cultural heritage and a selection of relics, alongside changing exhibitions. It stands beside the Hainan Library and the Hainan Centre for the Performing Arts.
description: 海南省博物馆位于中华人民共和国海南省海口市琼山区国兴大道68号，是一个博物馆。
accessEn: On Guoxing Avenue in eastern Haikou; closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 假日海滩
summaryEn: A long city beach on Haikou's north-western coast, facing the Qiongzhou Strait and running alongside Binhai Avenue, set up as a visitor beach in 1995. Behind the sand are landscaped paths and areas for dining and water sports, and the sea is used for swimming, sailing and windsurfing.
description: 假日海滩是位于中国海南省海口市滨海大道西沿线的一处海水浴场。海滩全长6000米，分为沙滩日浴区、海上运动区、海洋餐饮文化区和休闲度假区。
accessEn: In Xiuying district, along Binhai Avenue on Haikou's north-western seafront.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 海瑞墓
summaryEn: The tomb of Hai Rui (1514–87), the Ming official remembered for his incorruptibility, was completed in 1589 as a granite mound reached along a spirit way of stone archways and carved animals and officials. It was badly damaged during the Cultural Revolution and restored in 1982. The surrounding Hai Rui Cultural Park, expanded from the heritage site, adds an exhibition hall on his life and on integrity in office, an academy hall and a connecting gallery.
description: 海瑞墓，位于中华人民共和国海南省海口市龙华区海垦街道丘海大道39号，是明代被誉为“海青天”的官员海瑞的墓地。该墓建成于万历十七年，文革期间一度被毁，后得以重修。1996年，海瑞墓被列为全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Longhua district on the western side of Haikou, off Qiuhai Avenue; the exhibition hall is closed on Mondays except major holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南湾猴岛
summaryEn: A macaque reserve on the Nanwan peninsula beside Xincun harbour, established in 1965, where more than a thousand macaques live in the forest. A cable car over the water links Xincun harbour with the reserve, and paths lead to the monkeys. The tourist area has added a dome-screen theatre show, sea sports and horse riding.
description: 南湾猴岛又称南湾猴岛生态旅游景区、陵水南湾猴岛生态景区、南湾猴岛自然保护区，是中华人民共和国海南省陵水县南湾半岛上的一个景区，也是一个猕猴自然保护区和国家AAAA级景区。总面积为10.2平方公里，平均海拔150米。
accessEn: On the Nanwan peninsula, about 13 km south-south-west of Yelin, the Lingshui county seat; a cable car runs over the water from Xincun harbour.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 三亚亚特兰蒂斯
summaryEn: An ocean-themed resort complex on Haitang Bay that opened in April 2018, covering about 31 hectares with a 1,314-room hotel, restaurants and a shopping arcade. Day visitors use the Aquaventure water park, the Lost Chambers aquarium, a theatre show and the dolphin and sea-lion encounters. It suits families and groups planning a water-park day.
description: 三亚亚特兰蒂斯酒店是位于中国海南省三亚市的一个一站式娱乐度假酒店，位于东郊的海棠区海棠湾海棠北路。这是全球第三座亚特兰蒂斯酒店。三亚亚特兰蒂斯酒店于2018年4月28日正式营业，由复星集团投资110亿元建造，为三亚的先锋新地标。
accessEn: On Haitang North Road in Haitang district, about 27 km east-north-east of central Sanya.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鹿回头公园
summaryEn: A hill park on the peninsula just south of central Sanya, covered in evergreen tropical monsoon forest. On the summit a large stone sculpture shows the Li legend of a hunter and a deer that turns into a girl, the story behind Sanya's nickname 'Deer City'. Viewpoints look north over the city and east to Dadonghai bay.
description: 鹿回头公园是中国海南省三亚市的一个公园，是位于市中心区南面三亚河对岸伸入海中的一座小山，整个三亚的制高点，在这里可以俯瞰北面的三亚市中心区和东面的大东海海滩，并远眺南面一望无际的南海，总面积82.88公顷，最高海拔181米，属常绿热带季雨林生态类型。
accessEn: In Jiyang district, on Luling Road, on the hill south of the Sanya River in central Sanya.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 三亚国际免税城
summaryEn: A large duty-free shopping mall run by China Duty Free Group on Haitang Bay, which moved here in 2014 from a smaller shop in Dadonghai that opened in 2009. Its halls sell perfume, cosmetics, jewellery, watches, leather goods and fashion brands, and a third phase was topped out in January 2026.
description: 三亚国际免税城是中国大陆的一家免税店。
accessEn: On Haitang North Road in Haitang district, about 29 km east-north-east of central Sanya and about 2 km north-north-east of Atlantis Sanya.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 宋氏祖居
summaryEn: A courtyard house in Changsa town linked to the family of Charlie Soong (Song Jiashu), the father of Song Qingling and Song Meiling, who married Sun Yat-sen and Chiang Kai-shek. The original dwelling no longer stands, and the present courtyard house is a rebuild of the 1980s. An exhibition hall beside it displays photographs and objects connected with the Song family.
description: 宋氏祖居是已故中华民国总统孙中山夫人宋庆龄、中华民国总统蒋中正夫人宋美龄之父宋嘉树家族曾经居住过的一处住宅，位于中国海南省文昌市昌洒镇古路园村，距海口市约80公里，距文昌市区约30公里。原有住宅已不复存在，现今建筑物为中华人民共和国官方于1985年重修，1994年成为海南省文物保护单位，是文昌市的一处旅游景点，游客需支付人民币15元的门票方可入内参观。
accessEn: In Guluyuan village, Changsa town, about 23 km north-north-east of Wenchang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 816工程
summaryEn: An unfinished underground nuclear plant dug into a mountain beside the Wu River from 1966 as part of the Third Front programme, meant to produce plutonium for weapons and to survive a nuclear attack. Work was halted in 1984 with about 85 percent of the construction done; the tunnels run for more than 20 km and the largest chamber, built for the reactor, is 79.6 m high. Declassified in 2002, it opened to tourists in 2010.
description: 816地下核工厂，也称816工程、816退役核设施，全名“三线建设进洞的原子能反应堆及化学后处理工程”，是中国原来的一座地下核燃料工厂，位于中国西南部重庆市涪陵区白涛街道的深山中。816工程遗址含烈士陵园、干打垒房等，文物遗址年代为1966年-1984年，2009年12月15日被列为第二批重庆市文物保护单位。
accessEn: In Baitao subdistrict on the Wu River, about 40 minutes by road south-east of central Fuling in Fuling District, with a tourist bus from Fuling North railway station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 长寿湖
summaryEn: A large reservoir formed by the Shizitan dam on the Longxi River, completed in 1956 for hydropower, with about 65 km² of water dotted with more than 200 islands. The scenic area around it includes island and lakeshore viewpoints, the Donglin Temple, founded in the Song dynasty, and stepped waterfalls on the Longxi River below the dam.
description: 长寿湖风景名胜区位于中国重庆市长寿区、垫江县和涪陵区交界处，是以狮子滩水库为基础设立的风景名胜区，距重庆主城区约100公里，2012年被国家旅游局批准为国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: At Changshouhu town in Changshou District, about 100 km north-east of central Chongqing by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 重庆自然博物馆
summaryEn: Chongqing's natural history museum, open in its present building at the foot of Jinyun Mountain in Beibei since 2015, with a design based on the spreading roots of the huangge fig, the city tree. Its collection of more than 110,000 objects covers fossils, minerals, animals and plants, and the dinosaur galleries show Sichuan Basin skeletons such as Omeisaurus and Tuojiangosaurus. The museum grew out of the Western China Academy of Sciences, founded in 1930, and the wartime Western China Museum, and it still runs the academy's old campus in central Beibei as a second site.
description: 重庆自然博物馆位于中华人民共和国重庆市北碚区北温泉街道金华路398号，是重庆市属自然科学类博物馆。
accessEn: At 398 Jinhua Road at the foot of Jinyun Mountain in Beibei District, about 45 km north-west of central Chongqing. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 重庆三峡移民纪念馆
summaryEn: Wanzhou's main museum, designed by the architect Cui Kai and opened in 2018, which also serves as the Wanzhou District Museum. Its lower gallery traces Wanzhou's history from its earliest settlements some 7,000 years ago to its days as a Yangtze trading port, and the two levels above document the building of the Three Gorges Dam and the resettlement of about 1.3 million people from the reservoir area.
description: 重庆三峡移民纪念馆又称为重庆市万州区博物馆，位于中华人民共和国重庆市万州区南滨路1561号，是一座纪念馆。主要记录因修建长江三峡水利枢纽工程的沿线百万居民大移民历史。
accessEn: On Nanbin Road by the Yangtze in central Wanzhou, Wanzhou District, served by city buses; visits are booked in advance online. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 重庆动物园
summaryEn: Chongqing's main zoo, opened in 1955 on 45 hectares of hillside at Yangjiaping, about 8 km south-west of the city centre. It keeps one of the largest groups of giant pandas in any Chinese zoo and breeds pandas and South China tigers, alongside red pandas, white tigers and African elephants.
description: 重庆动物园位于中华人民共和国重庆市九龙坡区杨家坪街道，距市中心8公里，海拔240—305.8米。占地面积45公顷，是重庆市较大的综合性公园，是中国境内饲养大熊猫最多的三个动物园之一，是大熊猫繁殖基地，也是国家华南虎繁殖中心种群基地。
accessEn: At Yangjiaping in Jiulongpo District, next to Zoo station on Metro Line 2, about 8 km south-west of Jiefangbei.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大鹅岭
summaryEn: A hilltop scenic area on the narrow ridge of the Yuzhong peninsula, rated 4A in 2022 and centred on Eling Park, laid out in 1909 as the villa garden of the merchant Li Yaoting at the highest point of the peninsula. The Liangjiang Pavilion looks over both the Yangtze and the Jialing, and the park also has a Japanese-style garden presented by the twin city of Hiroshima. Since November 2025 a 460 m walkway built against the cliff has linked it with Fotuguan Park to the west.
description: 鹅岭公园位于重庆市渝中半岛狭长地带山岭上，为市区内最高峰，因地形如鹅头而得名。紧临佛图关公园。
accessEn: On Eling Main Street in western Yuzhong District, about 4 km west of Jiefangbei, near Eling station on Metro Line 1.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 杨闇公故里
summaryEn: The family houses in Shuangjiang of Yang Angong (1898–1927), an early Communist Party organiser in Sichuan who was executed in 1927, and of his younger brother Yang Shangkun, President of China from 1988 to 1993. Yang Angong's Qing courtyard house on the main street has exhibitions on his life and on the family, and Yang Shangkun's birthplace, the Changtanzi compound of 1862 at Jinlong village on the edge of town, holds an exhibition of photographs, objects and documents on his career. The scenic area also takes in the Tianba compound, a large Yang family courtyard house of 1878, and the brothers' cemeteries, Yang Angong's being in Tongnan town about 10 km away.
description: 杨闇公故里位于重庆。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、国家一级博物馆。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In and just outside Shuangjiang town, about 10 km north-west of central Tongnan in Tongnan District, roughly 2 hours by road from central Chongqing.

name: 歌乐山烈士陵园
summaryEn: A memorial park at the foot of Gele Mountain on ground that in the 1940s held a base of the Nationalist intelligence service (Juntong), where the wartime Sino-American Special Technical Cooperative Organization (SACO) was also set up, and its two prisons for political detainees: Baigongguan, a former villa, and Zhazidong, a former coal pit. Days before the People's Liberation Army took Chongqing at the end of November 1949, most of the prisoners, many of them underground Communist Party members, were executed, an event known in China as the '27 November massacre'. The site has the restored prisons, an exhibition hall, a cemetery and monuments; the Chinese official name of the heritage unit is the 'SACO concentration camp site'.
description: 重庆歌乐山烈士陵园，位于重庆市沙坪坝区歌乐山麓，主要安葬中华人民共和国成立前牺牲在重庆的烈士，由重庆歌乐山烈士陵园管理处管理。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Lieshimu in Shapingba District, about 15 km west of Jiefangbei and about 600 m from Lieshimu station on Metro Line 1; Baigongguan is about 1 km and Zhazidong about 2 km uphill from the main memorial.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 汉丰湖
summaryEn: A lake created in the heart of Kaizhou by a regulating dam that since 2017 has held the water at 170–175 m, so that the falling Three Gorges reservoir no longer leaves bare mudflats around the town. It covers about 15 km² with more than 30 bays and 41 islands; lakeside parks and wetlands, a covered bridge, the Juziyuan garden with the Wenfeng Pagoda and the newly built Kaizhou Old Town line its shores. Boat trips and water sports such as kayaking and paddleboarding run from the lakeside.
description: 汉丰湖是中国重庆市开州区丰乐镇的一个人工湖，位于三峡水库支流澎溪河上游。主要支流河流有桃溪河、东河和南河。
accessEn: The lake surrounds the centre of the Kaizhou district town in north-eastern Chongqing; the lakeside paths start in town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 湖广会馆
summaryEn: A complex of Qing-dynasty guild halls on the Yangtze at Dongshuimen, built by merchants and settlers from Hubei, Hunan and Guangdong who came with the early-Qing migration known as 'Huguang fills Sichuan'. Its Yuwang Temple, Qi'an Hall and Guangdong Hall, largely rebuilt in 1846, have courtyards, halls and opera stages, and together with newer buildings in the same style they house a museum of that migration.
description: 重庆湖广会馆，位于重庆市渝中区朝天门街道长滨路芭蕉园巷1号，东水门长江边。是禹王宫、齐安公所、广东公所等清初古建筑群及仿古新建筑群的统称。重庆湖广会馆是目前已知的位于中国城市中心区最大的古会馆建筑群，内设重庆湖广填四川移民博物馆。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the Yangtze riverfront at Dongshuimen in Yuzhong District, about 1 km east of Jiefangbei; Xiaoshizi metro station (Lines 1 and 6) is the closest.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 两江国际影视城
summaryEn: A film and television set built from 2012, first for the film Back to 1942, that recreates wartime Chongqing of the 1930s and 1940s, when the city was China's provisional capital. Its 'Republic of China Street' has more than 200 replica buildings, among them the Victory Monument, the Nationalist government building, banks, a theatre and the Xinhua Daily office, and it was enlarged between 2015 and 2017.
description: 重庆两江国际影视城是中华人民共和国重庆市两江新区龙兴镇的一个影视拍摄基地，又称民国街，内部建筑仿照中华民国大陆时期的房屋而建。
accessEn: In Longxing town, Yubei District (Liangjiang New Area), about an hour by road east of central Chongqing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 聂荣臻元帅陈列馆
summaryEn: A memorial museum to Nie Rongzhen, the Jiangjin-born marshal who directed China's nuclear-weapons and satellite programmes, opened in 1999 at the foot of Aiping Mountain on the edge of Jiangjin's urban area. Its main building centres on a 36 m tower shaped like a rocket carrying a satellite, and the exhibition follows his life in five sections, from work-study in France and the Jin-Cha-Ji base area of the war against Japan to the 'Two Bombs, One Satellite' programme. In front, a bronze statue stands above a square displaying a retired fighter aircraft, artillery and missiles.
description: 聂荣臻元帅陈列馆是位于重庆市江津区的一座以纪念中华人民共和国元帅聂荣臻为主题的陈列馆，建成于1999年，现为国家一级博物馆、国家AAAA级旅游景区、全国爱国主义教育示范基地、国家国防教育示范基地，为江津区的文化地标之一。
accessEn: At 386 Dingshan Avenue, behind the Jiangjin bus station at the foot of Aiping Mountain in Jiangjin's urban area, about 43 km from central Chongqing, roughly an hour by road. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 菩提山
summaryEn: A 598 m hill above Changshou's Puti Ancient Town, named after Bodhidharma according to the county annals, with the Buddhist Puti Temple on its summit. The temple, first built in the Northern Song dynasty and destroyed several times, was rebuilt in 2014 as a large timber complex of gate, bell and drum towers and halls, reached by a long stone stairway decorated with the character shou, 'longevity'.
description: 菩提山，又名长寿菩提山文化旅游景区，位于中国重庆市长寿区、垫江县和涪陵区交界处。距离重庆主城区73公里，2017年经重庆市旅游景区质量等级评定委员会组织评定，批准为国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: Directly above Puti Ancient Town on the edge of the urban area of Changshou District, about 80 km north-east of central Chongqing by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 红岩村
summaryEn: The hillside compound by the Jialing River where the Chinese Communist Party's Southern Bureau and the Eighth Route Army's Chongqing liaison office worked from 1939 until early 1947, during the wartime alliance with the Nationalist government. Zhou Enlai lived and worked here, and Mao Zedong stayed for 41 days during the 1945 Chongqing negotiations; the office building, which looks two-storeyed from outside but has three floors, keeps their offices, bedrooms and the secret radio room. A memorial hall completed beside it in 2000 covers the bureau's history, and the protected site also includes the Zengjiayan 50 residence and the former Xinhua Daily sales office in central Yuzhong.
description: 红岩村位于重庆。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、国家一级博物馆。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Hongyan Village in western Yuzhong District, about 8 km west of Jiefangbei, near Hongyancun station on Metro Lines 5 and 9.

name: 石宝寨
summaryEn: A sheer rock outcrop on the north bank of the Yangtze in Shibao Town, climbed by a red timber pavilion built against the cliff in the early 19th century and raised from nine to twelve storeys in 1956, with a Buddhist hall on the summit. Since the reservoir filled, the rock stands as an island protected by a large ring dyke, and many Yangtze cruise ships stop here.
description: 石宝寨位于重庆市忠县石宝镇长江北岸边，距忠县县城45千米。此处临江有高十多丈，陡壁孤峰拔起的巨石，属丹霞地貌。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Shibao Town, Zhong County, about 35 km north-east of the county town by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 双江古镇
summaryEn: A market town near the south bank of the Fu River, founded in the early Qing and named after the two streams that wind around it, which keeps more than 20 Qing-dynasty courtyard houses along flagstone lanes and small bridges. Among them are the Yuwang Palace, a Huguang guild hall with an opera stage, and the family houses of Yang Angong and Yang Shangkun, which are kept as memorial museums; it was named one of China's first historic and cultural towns in 2003.
description: 双江古镇位于重庆。游览特色包括博物馆、古镇。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shuangjiang town, about 10 km north-west of central Tongnan in Tongnan District, roughly 2 hours by road from central Chongqing.

name: 雪玉洞
summaryEn: A limestone show cave in Fengdu known for the unusually white, jade-like colour of its formations, which are still growing. It runs for 1,644 m on three levels, and its highlights include a stone 'flag' about 8 m long, a stone shield about 4 m high and dense clusters of coral-like growths and soda-straw stalactites.
description: 雪玉洞位于重庆丰都县，是长江三峡国家级风景名胜区的一个景点，也是中国国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: At Rizhaoba village in Baoluan town, Fengdu County, about 12 km from Fengdu Ghost City.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 潼南大佛寺
summaryEn: A temple at the foot of Dingming Hill on the Fu River just west of Tongnan town, built against a cliff carved from the Sui to the Republican era with about 126 niches and more than 900 Buddhist, Daoist and Confucian figures. Its centrepiece is a gilded seated Buddha 18.43 m high, begun in the Tang and finished in the Song, sheltered by the seven-eaved Great Buddha Pavilion; the temple also keeps Guanyin and Jade Emperor halls and an 1843 couplet by Zeng Guofan.
description: 潼南大佛寺位于重庆市潼南县县城西北1.5公里的定明山下，亦名南禅寺、定明院。今存有大佛阁、观音殿、玉皇殿、鉴亭四座木结构古建筑。文物遗址年代隋至民国。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 1.5 km north-west of central Tongnan on the Fu River, in Tongnan District, roughly 2 hours by road from central Chongqing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 万州大瀑布
summaryEn: A broad curtain waterfall on the Qinglong River in Ganning Town, 64.5 m high and about 150 m wide, which Wanzhou promotes as the largest waterfall in Asia. It is billed as one of the few falls that can be seen from every side, and paths lead behind the curtain of water.
description: 万州大瀑布，又称青龙瀑布、甘宁瀑布，位于重庆市万州区境内，瀑布宽151米，高64.5米，瀑布面积7417.5平方米，是重庆市万州区著名景观。
accessEn: In Ganning Town, about 35 km by road south-west of central Wanzhou, Wanzhou District.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 三峡平湖·西山钟楼
summaryEn: Wanzhou's riverside parks and promenades along the wide reservoir lake created by the Three Gorges Dam, with the old city wall, Cengong Cave, walks under huangge fig trees, a light show in Yinghuadu Park and evening boat trips on the lit-up river. Walks usually start at the Xishan Clock Tower in Xishan Park, a 50 m, 12-storey tower completed in 1932 that is counted with the customs-house clock towers of Shanghai and Wuhan among the three great clock towers of the Yangtze and still chimes the hour.
description: 西山钟楼位于重庆市万州区西山公园，文物遗址年代为1931年，2000年9月7日列为第一批重庆市文物保护单位。2019年10月7日公布为第八批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In central Wanzhou on the Yangtze, Wanzhou District; Xishan Park with the clock tower is on Wangpai Road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 巫峡·神女
summaryEn: The land side of Wu Gorge, about 15 km east of Wushan town. Its main sights are the Goddess Sky Road, a 12 km mountain road at around 1,200 m with five viewing platforms facing Goddess Peak and others of the Twelve Peaks across the river; Jingtan Peak; and Shennü Stream, a narrow side gorge on the south bank. Sightseeing buses, the Huangyan cableway, a 200 m cliff-side lift and boats link the viewpoints, and the slopes turn red with autumn leaves from November to January.
description: 巫峡位于中国重庆市和湖北省境内长江干流上的一段峡谷。与瞿塘峡、西陵峡并称为长江三峡。巫峡西起重庆市巫山县大宁河口，东至湖北省巴东县官渡口，全长约45公里，以幽深秀丽著称。
accessEn: In Wushan County, about 15 km east of the county town by road to the Liuping visitor centre, or by boat down the Yangtze to Shennü Stream.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 长江索道
summaryEn: An aerial tramway that has carried passengers across the Yangtze since 1987, spanning 1,166 m between Xinhua Road in Yuzhong and Shangxin Street at Longmenhao on the south bank. The cabins hold about 80 people and take a few minutes to cross, giving a high view of the river, its bridges and the Yuzhong skyline; the line itself has been a listed municipal heritage site since 2009.
description: 长江索道位于中华人民共和国重庆市渝中区新华路151号、南岸区上新街4号，文物遗址年代为1986年，2009年12月15日列为第二批重庆市文物保护单位。长江索道是重庆市第二条跨江索道。是国内第一条双承载双牵引单跨往复式大型客运索道，1986年3月15日，长江索道动工修建，建设期间，重庆市公用局下属公用事业基建工程处挪用长江索道建设资金42.17万元修建职工住宅，并计入长江索道工程成本。
accessEn: The north station is on Xinhua Road in Yuzhong District, about 600 m east of Jiefangbei near Xiaoshizi metro station; the south station is at Shangxin Street in Nan'an District.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 张飞庙
summaryEn: A temple to Zhang Fei, the Three Kingdoms general whose head, by tradition, was buried here; founded in the late Shu Han period, it stood for centuries on the south bank of the Yangtze opposite the old Yunyang town. Ahead of the Three Gorges reservoir it was dismantled and rebuilt, largely from its original materials, in a similar setting on the south bank facing the new county town, and reopened in July 2003. Its halls and pavilions honour Zhang Fei and the poet Du Fu, who stayed here for two years.
description: 张飞庙位于重庆。游览特色包括峡谷、寺庙建筑、水库。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Yunyang County on the south bank of the Yangtze opposite the county town, a short ride across the Yunyang Yangtze River Bridge.

name: 毕棚沟
summaryEn: A high valley in Li County, within the Miyaluo nature area, climbing from about 2,400 to 4,500 metres past forest, streams and waterfalls towards snow peaks. It is best known for its autumn colours, and sightseeing buses run up the valley from the visitor centre.
description: 毕棚沟位于四川阿坝。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About half an hour by road west of Li County town (Zagunao).

name: 达古冰川
summaryEn: A group of mountain glaciers in Heishui County, spread between about 3,800 and 5,100 metres within a protected scenic area of high peaks and forest. A cable car lifts visitors to viewpoints near the ice, which was only identified by scientists in 1992. Go in clear weather and allow for the altitude.
description: 达古冰川又称达古冰山、达古冰川风景名胜区、四川达古冰川国家地质公园、达古冰川国家地质公园、达古冰川·卡龙沟风景名胜区，是位于中华人民共和国四川省阿坝藏族羌族自治州黑水县芦花镇的一个山地冰川，总面积7733公顷，冰川厚度约30米，海拔3800米至5100米。
accessEn: About an hour by road north-west of Heishui county town (Luhua).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南龛石窟
summaryEn: On Nankan Mountain, on the southern edge of central Bazhong, more than 170 niches holding about 2,700 painted Buddhist figures were cut into the cliffs, most of them in the Tang dynasty. It is the largest and best preserved of the Bazhong Grottoes, a protected group that also includes the smaller North Niches, West Niches and Shuining Temple carvings around the city.
description: 南龛石窟位于四川巴中。游览特色包括石窟造像、寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the southern edge of central Bazhong, a short taxi ride from the centre.

name: 白鹿音乐小镇与领报修院
summaryEn: Bailu is a small mountain town in Pengzhou, marketed as a 'music town'. Its main historic sight is the Annunciation Seminary, regarded as one of the largest French-style church complexes in Sichuan, run by French missionaries from 1908 to 1949. Badly damaged in the 2008 earthquake, the seminary was restored in 2016 and is a national heritage site.
description: 领报修院，通常被称为白鹿上书院、上书院，位于中国四川省成都市彭州市白鹿镇书院村，是一处法式天主教教堂建筑，始建于1895年，原为神学院。2004年增补为第六批四川省文物保护单位。2006年5月25日列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the mountains of Pengzhou, about 1.5–2 hours by road north-west of Chengdu.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 宝光寺与桂湖
summaryEn: Two neighbouring sights in Xindu, north of Chengdu. Baoguang Temple, a working Buddhist monastery founded in the Tang dynasty, has a 13-tiered Tang pagoda with a visible lean and a Hall of Arhats with more than 500 sculpted figures. About a kilometre to the south, Gui Lake is a classical western Sichuan garden beside the old town wall, associated with the Ming scholar Yang Shen and known for osmanthus in autumn and lotus in summer.
description: 宝光寺位于中国四川省成都市新都区，是全国重点文物保护单位之一。宝光寺占地10万平方米，由400余根大石柱构成。内置有文物：唐代舍利宝塔、梁代玉佛和石雕舍利塔，还有蜀汉章武铜鼎、唐代显庆陶塔、元代金银粉写的《华严经》以及舍利子、优昙花和贝叶经等。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xindu district, about 18 km north of central Chengdu; under an hour by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黄龙溪古镇
summaryEn: A historic river town where the Luxi River joins the Jin River south of Chengdu, a stop on the river trade since the Han dynasty and one of China's listed historic towns. Cobbled lanes of mostly Qing-era timber houses lead to old wharves and temples such as Zhenjiang Temple and Gulong Temple, and the town is often used as a set for period films. Many houses are now souvenir shops, and it is very busy at weekends and holidays.
description: 黄龙溪镇位于中国四川省成都市双流区下辖的一个乡镇级行政单位。该镇位于双流区西南部边缘，地处双流区、彭山区、仁寿县的交界处，距成都市区约40公里，是中国历史文化名镇之一，鹿溪河在此汇入锦江。黄龙溪镇拥有2100多年的历史，汉代起便成为锦江上水路运输的重要一站。
accessEn: About 40 km south of central Chengdu, roughly an hour by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 街子古镇
summaryEn: An old market town on the Weijiang River at the foot of Fengqi Mountain, on the back side of Mount Qingcheng. Lanes of timber houses run beside clear streams, and a Qing-dynasty paper-burning pagoda stands at the head of the old street. Guangyan Temple lies in the forest on the mountain above.
description: 街子古镇位于四川成都。游览特色包括古镇、寺庙建筑、古塔。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 25 km north-west of Chongzhou, roughly 1.5 hours by road from Chengdu; it combines well with Qingcheng's back mountain.

name: 金沙遗址博物馆
summaryEn: The museum stands on the Jinsha site in western Chengdu, a centre of the ancient Shu culture discovered in 2001 and dated to roughly 1250–650 BC. A large hall covers part of the excavations, and the exhibition halls show gold, jade, bronze and stone finds, among them the Golden Sun Bird gold foil, now the emblem of China's cultural heritage, and kneeling stone figures. It continues the story told at Sanxingdui, whose culture Jinsha succeeded.
description: 金沙遗址博物馆，位于中国四川省成都市青羊区金沙街道金沙遗址社区金沙遗址路2号，坐落在金沙遗址，是展示和研究金沙遗址的博物馆。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In western Chengdu, about 30 minutes by metro or taxi from the city centre; the museum is closed for a full renovation until 30 April 2027.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 平乐古镇
summaryEn: A market town on the Baimo River at the foot of the Qionglai Mountains, a settlement since the Western Han and traditionally counted as a stop on the Southern Silk Road. Old banyan trees line the riverbanks, two-storey timber shophouses face stone-paved lanes, and the Leshan Bridge, a multi-arched Qing-dynasty stone bridge, crosses the river. It is one of China's listed historic towns.
description: 平乐古镇位于四川成都。游览特色包括古镇、滨水景观、桥梁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 18 km south-west of Qionglai; roughly 1.5–2 hours from Chengdu by road, or by train to Qionglai and then a taxi.

name: 望丛祠
summaryEn: A memorial temple in Pidu to Wangdi (Du Yu) and Congdi (Bieling), two legendary kings of ancient Shu, traditionally credited with teaching farming and taming floods. Their burial mounds stand within the grounds, and it is described as the only shrine in south-west China honouring two kings together at their tombs. The surviving halls date mainly from the Qing dynasty, and the site is protected at provincial level.
description: 望丛祠位于四川成都。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、农业体验、历史建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Pidu district, about 25 km north-west of central Chengdu; around 45 minutes by road or metro.

name: 新场古镇
summaryEn: A long-established foothill market town in western Dayi County, laid out on a grid of old streets and lanes. A large number of Qing and Republican-era buildings in the western Sichuan vernacular style survive. It is quieter than nearby Anren and the two can be combined in a day.
description: 新场古镇位于四川成都。游览特色包括古镇、特色街区。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In western Dayi County, about 1.5 hours by road from Chengdu and around half an hour from Anren.

name: 庞统祠墓
summaryEn: The shrine and tomb of Pang Tong (179–214), the adviser to Liu Bei who was killed by an arrow during the campaign for Sichuan, an episode retold in Romance of the Three Kingdoms. The shrine, restored in 1691, has a gate, main and side halls with statues of Pang Tong and Zhuge Liang, and the tomb beside it under old cypresses. It lies at Baima Pass, on the old road north from Chengdu.
description: 庞统祠墓，又名龙凤祠。在四川省德阳市罗江区白马关镇，祠墓为东汉建安十九年庞统中流矢卒后，蜀汉昭烈帝刘备所建。整个祠墓内松柏参天，奇石沟壑，景色十分怡人，是有名的蜀汉遗迹。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 30 minutes by road north of Deyang city, near Luojiang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 德格印经院
summaryEn: The Derge Parkhang is a working Tibetan printing house founded in 1729 by Tenpa Tsering, king of Derge, and attached to the Sakya-school Gonchen Monastery. It holds what is described as the world's largest collection of carved Tibetan woodblocks, from which scriptures, commentaries and works on history and medicine are still printed by hand, with printers working in pairs to ink the blocks and roll the paper.
description: 德格印经院，位于四川省甘孜藏族自治州德格县欧普龙山，为藏传佛教印经中心之一，1980年7月7日列为四川省重新确定公布的第一批省级文物保护单位。1996年11月20日公布为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。清雍正七年，德格土司却杰·登巴泽仁在其家庙贡钦寺内另建佛殿，刻版印经。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Dêgê town, roughly 4 hours by road west of Ganzi town through the Chola Mountain tunnel; carry your passport, as it is checked at police checkpoints on the roads into western Ganzi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 惠远寺
summaryEn: Huiyuan Temple was founded in 1728 on the orders of the Qing Yongzheng Emperor in the Gata valley north of Bamei, and the 7th Dalai Lama lived here for seven years before returning to Tibet; the 11th Dalai Lama was born in a nearby village in 1838. Red walls set with 108 white stupas enclose a large courtyard and a multi-storey main hall with three bronze Buddha statues.
description: 惠远寺，藏文名“嘎达向巴林”，是位于中华人民共和国四川省甘孜藏族自治州道孚县协德乡的一座藏传佛教格鲁派寺院。2004年增补为第六批四川省文物保护单位，2019年10月7日公布为第八批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 9 km north of Bamei, roughly an hour's drive from Tagong.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 泸定桥
summaryEn: Luding Bridge is an iron-chain suspension bridge spanning about 100 metres across the Dadu River in Luding town, built in 1705–1706 on the orders of the Kangxi Emperor as a key crossing on the road between Sichuan and Tibet. In May 1935, during the Long March, Red Army troops captured the bridge, an episode known in China as the 'Seizing of Luding Bridge'. Visitors can walk across its swaying plank deck, and a memorial hall nearby presents the history of the crossing.
description: 泸定桥，又称大渡桥，位于中国四川省西部甘孜州泸定县城的大渡河上，是一座由清朝康熙帝御批建造的悬索桥。始建于清康熙44年，建成于康熙45年。1956年8月16日公布为四川省第一批历史及革命文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Luding town, about 3 hours by road from Chengdu via the Ya'an–Kangding expressway, or about an hour from Kangding.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 木格措
summaryEn: Mugecuo is an alpine lake at about 3,780 metres in the mountains north-west of Kangding, nearly 3 km long and fringed by forest, grassland and snow peaks. The scenic area also takes in smaller alpine lakes and hot springs nearby, and is part of the Mount Gongga national scenic area. Its official name, 'Kangding Love Song', borrows the town's famous folk tune.
description: 木格措也称长海子、野人海，是一个位于中国四川省甘孜藏族自治州康定市雅拉乡境内的淡水湖，湖面海拔3777米，湖长2.9千米，平均宽0.7千米，面积1.9平方千米。湖水从东岸出流汇入大渡河支流雅拉沟。木格措附近有众多高山湖泊和温泉，原始森林、草原和雪山景观互相交融，已辟为木格措风景区，属于贡嘎山国家级风景名胜区的一部分。
accessEn: Roughly an hour by road north-west of Kangding town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 新路海
summaryEn: Xinluhai, Yilhun Lha Tso in Tibetan and officially Yulong Latso, is a glacial lake at about 4,020 metres at the foot of Chola Mountain, about 3 km long and dammed by glacial moraine; it is described as the largest lake of its kind in China. It lies just off the G317 highway about 10 km west of Manigange, an easy stop on the road between Ganzi and Dêgê.
description: 新路海，又称玉龙拉措、玉隆拉措、玉龙海，位于中国四川省甘孜藏族自治州德格县境内的雀儿山下，紧邻川藏公路北线，是构造形成的断陷湖泊。湖水水位4020米，湖长3.1千米，平均宽0.9千米，面积3.33平方千米，最大水深64.5米，平均水深30.8米，蓄水量1.02亿立方米，是中国最大的冰川碛塞湖。
accessEn: Beside the G317 about 10 km west of Manigange, roughly 2 hours by road west of Ganzi town; carry your passport, as it is checked at police checkpoints on the roads into western Ganzi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 皇泽寺
summaryEn: Huangze Temple, at the foot of Wulong Mountain on the west bank of the Jialing River, is described as the only temple in China dedicated to Wu Zetian, the Tang empress who by tradition was born in Guangyuan. Its cliff holds about 1,200 Buddhist sculptures in six caves and dozens of niches, begun in the sixth century and mostly carved in the Tang, while the halls display a stone figure traditionally said to show the empress herself. The temple now also serves as a museum.
description: 皇泽寺摩崖造像位于中国四川省广元市城西，嘉陵江西岸，乌龙山脚下。1956年8月16日公布为四川省第一批历史及革命文物保护单位。1961年3月4日列为第一批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the west bank of the Jialing in Guangyuan city, about 10 minutes by taxi from the centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 千佛崖
summaryEn: A cliff on the east bank of the Jialing River north of Guangyuan, honeycombed with Buddhist niches carved from the late Northern Wei to the Ming, most of them in the Tang. Some 848 niches with more than 7,000 figures survive along a face about 400 m long and over 40 m high, although more than half of the original carvings were destroyed when the Sichuan–Shaanxi highway was cut along its foot in 1935–1936. The main caves include the Great Buddha Cave and the Lotus Cave.
description: 广元千佛崖摩崖造像位于中国四川省广元市城北，1961年3月4日列为第一批全国重点文物保护单位。千佛崖造像开凿于北魏晚期，隋、唐、宋、元、明均有凿建，以唐代居多，清代后未再开凿新的造像。造像沿嘉陵江东岸分布，南北长388.8米。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 4 km north of central Guangyuan on the east bank of the Jialing, 10–15 minutes by taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 千佛岩
summaryEn: A sandstone cliff on the bank of the Qingyi River just outside Jiajiang town, carved with some 270 Buddhist niches; most date from the Tang dynasty, with later additions into the Qing. Alongside runs the Dongfeng Weir, a working irrigation canal that was among the first World Heritage Irrigation Structures named in 2014.
description: 夹江千佛岩石窟位于四川省夹江县城郊，文物遗址年代判定为唐。1956年8月16日公布为四川省第一批历史及革命文物保护单位。大小共271龛。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the edge of Jiajiang county town, about 40 minutes by road north-west of Leshan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙脑桥
summaryEn: A stone beam bridge built in the late 14th century, early in the Ming dynasty, that crosses the Jiuqu River on 12 piers; the middle eight are carved into large dragons, qilin, lions and elephants, heads facing upstream. It is the best known of Luxian's carved 'dragon bridges', a wider group of Ming and Qing bridges across the county that is also nationally listed, and it now stands within the Longqiao Culture Eco-park.
description: 龙脑桥位于中国四川省泸州市泸县福集镇北部的九曲河上，1991年4月16日公布为四川省第三批文物保护单位，1996年11月20日列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。龙脑桥建于明洪武十一年至三十一年，是一座石质梁桥。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: A few kilometres north of Luxian county town, about an hour by road from central Luzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 泸州大曲老窖池
summaryEn: The historic core of the Luzhou Laojiao distillery, one of the best-known makers of strong-aroma baijiu, where earthen fermentation pits dating from the Ming dynasty are still in use. The old cellar groups and workshops were listed as a national heritage site in 1996, and the visitor area around Guojiao Square lets you see the working pits and learn how the liquor is made.
description: 泸州大曲老窖池位于四川省泸州市江阳区、龙马潭区，文物遗址年代判定为明。1991年4月16日公布为四川省第三批文物保护单位。1996年11月20日列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In central Luzhou's Jiangyang district, a short taxi ride from most hotels in the city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 太平古镇
summaryEn: A hillside market town on the Chishui River, on the Guizhou border, where the Red Army crossed during the Long March in 1935: the second and fourth of the 'Four Crossings of the Chishui' were made at Taiping Ferry. Its lanes of old houses include the former quarters of the Red Army headquarters, hospital and bank, and a memorial hall up the town's stone steps sets out the history of the campaign.
description: 太平古镇位于四川泸州。游览特色包括古镇、纪念展览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About an hour by road east of Gulin county town, or roughly 3 hours from central Luzhou.

name: 尧坝古镇
summaryEn: A well-preserved market town on the old road from Luzhou to Chishui in Guizhou, said to have begun as a post station in the Northern Song and to have flourished in the Ming and Qing. Its old streets of Ming and Qing shops, houses and halls are protected together as a national heritage site, and the town has often been used as a film location.
description: 尧坝镇古建筑群位于四川省泸州市合江县，文物遗址年代判定为明至清。2007年6月1日公布为第七批四川省文物保护单位。2013年3月5日列为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About an hour by road south-east of central Luzhou, in Hejiang county.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黑龙滩
summaryEn: A large reservoir in the hills of Renshou County, completed in 1972 and fed by the Dongfeng Canal, which carries water from the Dujiangyan irrigation system. The lake and its hilly shoreline were made a provincial scenic area in 1986 and make an easy rural outing from Chengdu.
description: 黑龙滩水库位于中国四川省仁寿县黑龙滩镇，是以灌溉、供水为主，兼有防洪、养殖等功能的大型水库，1972年1月25日建成大坝。上游通过东风渠从都江堰引水，全灌区总计建成水渠1319条，总长3692.30千米，灌溉仁寿、井研、简阳三地的121万亩耕地。
accessEn: About 1–1.5 hours by road south of Chengdu, near Renshou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 三苏祠
summaryEn: The former family home of the Song-dynasty writers Su Xun and his sons Su Shi (Su Dongpo) and Su Zhe, turned into a memorial shrine in the early Yuan and now run as a museum. Red walls enclose ponds, bamboo and old trees, with halls holding statues of the Su family, an old well, an inkstone-washing pond and a collection of calligraphy and paintings. It was badly damaged in the 2013 Lushan earthquake and reopened after repairs in 2016.
description: 三苏祠是位于四川眉山东坡区市区西南纱縠行的园林以及博物馆，本为苏洵、苏轼、苏辙旧宅，元代初年为纪念三苏父子改为祠庙，近年改为三苏祠博物馆。1980年7月7日列为四川省重新确定公布的第一批省级文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In central Meishan, which is under an hour from Chengdu by train or road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 白水湖
summaryEn: A hill reservoir at Jushui in western Anzhou District, where 23 islands break up some 3,000 mu (about 2 km²) of water into inlets and channels. Several episodes of the sequel to the television series Journey to the West were filmed here in 1999. It is a national water-conservancy scenic area and 4A site, usually visited together with nearby Mount Luofu.
description: 白水湖位于四川绵阳。游览特色包括水库。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Near Jushui town in western Anzhou District, about an hour and a half by road west of Mianyang.

name: 报恩寺
summaryEn: Built between 1440 and 1446 by the local chieftain Wang Xi, this Buddhist monastery in Pingwu town is a remarkably well-preserved Ming complex whose timber frames are all of nanmu wood. Highlights are a nine-metre wooden statue of the thousand-armed Guanyin and a great octagonal revolving sutra cabinet that still turns, along with Ming murals and sculpture.
description: 平武报恩寺位于中国四川省绵阳市平武县城内，1955年曾进行了培修，1956年8月16日公布为四川省第一批历史及革命文物保护单位。1980年7月7日重新公布为四川省第一批文物保护单位。包括镇羌门及城墙、王玺公衙、昭忠祠。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Pingwu county town, roughly 2.5–3 hours by road north of Mianyang on the eastern route towards Jiuzhaigou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 七曲山大庙
summaryEn: A Taoist temple complex on Qiqu Mountain just north of Zitong, founded as a shrine to the local deity Zhang Yazi and rebuilt as a Wenchang Palace after he was honoured as Wenchang, god of literature, in the early Yuan dynasty. Its 23 halls and pavilions date mainly from the Yuan, Ming and Qing dynasties and climb the hillside in an informal layout, surrounded by more than 20,000 ancient cypresses.
description: 七曲山大庙位于四川省绵阳市梓潼县城北七曲山上，1980年7月7日列为四川省重新确定公布的第一批省级文物保护单位。1996年11月20日公布为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。大庙始建于晋，原为祀张亚子的亚子祠，元初张亚子被封为“文昌帝君”后改建为文昌宫，现存建筑主要建于元明清三代。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 10 minutes by road north of Zitong town, which is roughly an hour's drive north-east of Mianyang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 无量宝塔
summaryEn: Nanchong's White Pagoda, a brick pagoda modelled on timber construction, stands on Heming Mountain in Gaoping District, looking across the Jialing River to the city centre. Its date is disputed, with proposals ranging from the late Tang to the Southern Song, but it is regarded as the earliest of Sichuan's Song-era pagodas and a record of the shift from Tang to Song design. The hill around it is laid out as the Heming Mountain park, with walks and river views.
description: 无量宝塔位于四川南充。游览特色包括古塔、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the east bank of the Jialing in Nanchong's Gaoping District, about 15 minutes by taxi from the city centre.

name: 隆昌石牌坊
summaryEn: Longchang is known for its stone memorial arches (paifang): 17 survive, built between 1496 and the late 19th century to honour upright officials, chaste widows, filial sons and long-lived elders. Most are four-pillar, three-gate bluestone gateways carved in imitation of timber, about 11 metres high, and the main groups stand along the old roads at the town's South and North Gates.
description: 隆昌石牌坊位于中国四川省隆昌市，1991年4月16日公布为四川省第三批文物保护单位。2001年6月25日列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位，包括：南关石牌坊群，位于隆昌市区南关景区及云峰关附近北关石牌坊群，位于隆昌市区北关景区及建设村响石牌坊群，位于隆昌市响石镇斗拱式镇山坊，位于隆昌市石燕桥镇嵌瓷观赏坊，位于隆昌市渔箭镇隆昌石牌坊建于明弘治九年至清光绪三年，共十七座，其中德政坊五座、节孝坊四座、功德坊两座，贞洁坊、孝子坊、百寿坊、山门坊、镇山坊、嵌瓷观赏坊各一座。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Take the Chengdu–Chongqing high-speed line to Longchang North station, then a short taxi ride to the South Gate arches in town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 高峰山
summaryEn: A hilltop Taoist complex 25 km north of Pengxi, first built in the Tang dynasty and by the late Ming and early Qing regarded as the largest Taoist centre in central, eastern and northern Sichuan, where Confucian and Buddhist worship were also practised. Its surviving temples date mostly from the late Qing and early Republican era, and on the mid-slope a group of buildings is laid out as an eight-trigram (bagua) maze with four gates. A fire in May 2017 destroyed the Sanqing Hall and damaged neighbouring halls, but the maze was not affected.
description: 高峰山古建筑群，位于四川省蓬溪县，是第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Wenjing town, about 25 km north of Pengxi county town, roughly 40 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 广德寺
summaryEn: Guangde Temple is a working Buddhist monastery on Wolong Hill at the western edge of Suining, founded in the Tang dynasty and renamed several times by imperial order before receiving its present name in the Ming.
