Its protected buildings span the Song to Qing periods. Suining promotes itself as the legendary home of Guanyin, and the same scenic area includes Lingquan Temple on a hill across the Fu River.
description: 广德寺，原名石佛寺，位于四川省遂宁市城西三里许的卧龙山首处，1996年9月16日公布为四川省第四批省级文物保护单位，2006年5月25日列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。寺始建于唐朝年间，原名石佛寺。大历二年更名为“保唐寺”。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the western edge of Suining, a short taxi ride from the centre; Suining is about an hour by high-speed train from Chengdu.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 金华山陈子昂读书台
summaryEn: Jinhua Mountain rises above the Fu River north of Shehong, with a Taoist temple first built in the Southern Liang dynasty and the reading terrace of Chen Zi'ang, an early Tang poet who studied here as a young man. The present terrace buildings were moved to the rear of the hill in the Qing dynasty, and a memorial hall to the poet stands nearby. It makes a quiet visit of temple halls and river views.
description: 陈子昂读书台位于四川省射洪市城区以北23公里处的金华镇金华山上，是初唐诗人陈子昂青年时代读书之所。1980年7月7日列为四川省重新确定公布的第一批省级文物保护单位。2006年5月25日公布为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 23 km north of Shehong city, roughly 40 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 二郎山·喇叭河
summaryEn: A forested river valley on the eastern side of Mount Erlang in Tianquan county, with trails and a cable car into the higher forest; the Labahe nature reserve here is part of the Sichuan Giant Panda Sanctuaries World Heritage Site. Mount Erlang (3,437 m) is the divide between the Qingyi and Dadu rivers; the Sichuan–Tibet highway (G318) crosses it, today through a tunnel.
description: 二郎山·喇叭河位于四川雅安。游览特色包括自然保护区、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Labahe is roughly an hour by road west of Tianquan county town, which is about 40 minutes from Ya'an by expressway.

name: 上里古镇
summaryEn: A historic market town in the hills north of Ya'an, with lanes of old timber-framed houses beside its streams, now run as a tourist village. Its sights include carved stone memorial archways and the Han family mansion, built in 1824 and protected as a Sichuan provincial heritage site, and Wujia village within the town was among the first places named Chinese Traditional Villages in 2012.
description: 上里古镇位于四川雅安。游览特色包括古镇、传统村落、历史宅院。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 25 km north of central Ya'an, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 翠屏山与真武山
summaryEn: Two linked wooded hills on the west side of central Yibin, south of the Min River, laid out as a large city forest park. On Zhenwu Mountain stands a complex of Taoist temples begun in 1574 and much extended in the Qing, centred on the Ming-dynasty Xuanzu Hall, with Buddhist and Confucian halls alongside; Cuiping Mountain has the Nezha Temple, the Zhao Yiman Memorial Hall in the former Cuiping Academy, and the Qianfo Rock carvings.
description: 真武山古建筑群位于四川省宜宾市翠屏区，1991年4月16日公布为四川省第三批文物保护单位。1996年11月20日列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。真武山位于宜宾市中心，岷江南岸，曾称师来山、仙侣山，海拔369米。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In central Yibin, a short taxi or bus ride from the old town; city buses stop at the foot of Cuiping Mountain.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 李庄古镇
summaryEn: A riverside town on the south bank of the Yangtze east of Yibin, with stone-paved lanes, Qing-dynasty guild halls and temples, and the Zhang family ancestral hall with its windows carved with a hundred cranes. From 1940, during the war against Japan, it sheltered Tongji University, institutes of Academia Sinica and the Society for the Study of Chinese Architecture, whose former premises, where Liang Sicheng finished his history of Chinese architecture, are now a protected site. On the edge of town stands the Ming-dynasty Xuanluo Hall, which Liang counted among Lizhuang's 'four wonders'.
description: 李庄镇原为四川省南溪县的一个镇，1983年划归宜宾市翠屏区管辖，位于长江南岸，距岷江与金沙江交汇处19公里，是中国历史文化名镇之一。早在南梁大同六年，李庄便成为南广县治和六同郡治所在。李庄至今保留着较为完好的古镇格局和许多历史建筑，包括旋螺殿、中国营造学社旧址两处全国重点文物保护单位和东岳庙、张家祠、禹王宫三处四川省文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 20 km east of central Yibin, 30–40 minutes by bus or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 五粮液
summaryEn: Yibin is the home of Wuliangye, one of China's best-known baijiu spirits, and the company's tourism area presents the history and making of the liquor through its Liquor Culture Museum and distillery grounds. In the old town, the Changfasheng and Lichuanyong workshops keep fermentation pits and brick-and-timber buildings from the Ming and Qing dynasties, protected as a national heritage site.
description: 五粮液位于四川宜宾。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: The old cellars are in central Yibin, near the Daguan Tower; the main distillery and museum lie a few kilometres north-west along the Min River, a short taxi ride away.

name: 兴文石海
summaryEn: A karst landscape on the southern rim of the Sichuan Basin, where fields of limestone pinnacles (the 'stone sea'), large caves such as Tianquan Cave and giant collapsed sinkholes, or tiankeng, form the core of the Xingwen UNESCO Global Geopark, designated in 2005. It was one of the first places in China where tiankeng were studied, and the surrounding county is home to Miao communities and traces of the ancient Bo people.
description: 兴文世界地质公园位于中国四川省宜宾市兴文县，处于四川盆地与云贵高原过渡地带，总面积约156平方公里。地质公园内广布石灰岩，形成了特有喀斯特地貌。其地质遗迹主要有：二叠纪地质剖面、地表喀斯特地形、天坑、溶洞、洞穴堆积物、瀑布、溶蚀峡谷、古生物化石、风暴岩沉积等。
accessEn: Roughly 125 km by road south-east of Yibin, about two hours; the scenic area is about 25 km from Xingwen county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 吴玉章故居
summaryEn: The birthplace of Wu Yuzhang (1878–1966), who in 1911 helped lead Rong County's declaration of independence from Qing rule, later joined the Communist Party and became president of Renmin University of China. The rural site in Shuangshi keeps his family's old house and the grave he shares with his wife, beside which a rebuilt residence and an exhibition hall on his life opened in 1988.
description: 吴玉章故居位于四川省荣县双石镇蔡家堰村六组，文物遗址年代判定为1878年。1988年为纪念吴老诞辰110周年，国家拨专款在旧居之西重建吴玉章故居和陈列馆。同年12月30日，揭幕开展。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Shuangshi town, Rong County, about 40 minutes by road west of Zigong.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 富顺文庙
summaryEn: A Confucian temple in the centre of Fushun, founded in the Northern Song and rebuilt under later dynasties, laid out along a 160-metre axis from the semicircular pool and Lingxing Gate to the Dacheng Hall. The double-eaved main hall, 25 metres tall, was first built in 1291, and the scenic area also takes in the town's West Lake nearby.
description: 富顺文庙位于四川省自贡市富顺县富世镇，始建于北宋，历经元明清各代重修。1980年7月7日列为四川省重新确定公布的第一批省级文物保护单位。2001年6月25日公布为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Fushun county town, about 40 minutes by road south-east of Zigong.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 荣县大佛
summaryEn: A 36.7-metre seated Buddha carved from a sandstone hill on the edge of Rong County town in the Tang dynasty, usually ranked second in size among China's ancient stone Buddhas after Leshan. It sits within the Dafo Temple, rebuilt in the Qing, whose halls climb the hillside around it alongside Tang and Song cliff carvings and a garden of inscribed steles.
description: 荣县大佛位于四川省荣县老城区东南，1956年8月16日公布为四川省第一批历史及革命文物保护单位。1980年7月7日重新公布为四川省第一批文物保护单位。2006年5月25日列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the south-eastern edge of Rong County town, about an hour by road west of Zigong.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 陈毅故居
summaryEn: The rural family home in Laodong town where Chen Yi (1901–1972) was born and grew up. He became a Communist military commander, one of the ten marshals of the People's Republic, mayor of Shanghai from 1949 and foreign minister from 1958 until his death; the house is preserved as a memorial site and forms the core of a scenic area named after him.
description: 陈毅故居位于中国四川省资阳市乐至县劳动镇中。是中华人民共和国十大元帅之一陈毅诞生并居住的地方。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 15 km north-west of Lezhi county town, which is roughly 2 hours by road from Chengdu.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 贵州省地质博物馆
summaryEn: A natural-science museum in Guanshanhu district, opened in August 2021. Its four permanent exhibitions cover Guizhou's fossils, including ichthyosaurs, the Guizhou dragon and sea lilies, its karst landscapes, its mineral resources and the history of geological work in the province. It was rated a national first-class museum in 2024.
description: 贵州省地质博物馆又名贵州省地质资料馆，位于中华人民共和国贵州省贵阳市观山湖区，是贵州省自然资源厅所属的地质博物馆兼地质资料馆。贵州省地质资料馆于2008年成立，2020年更名为贵州省地质博物馆，于2021年8月14日正式开馆，2024年获评为国家一级博物馆。
accessEn: On Yuntan South Road in Guanshanhu district, west of the old city centre of Guiyang. Closed on Mondays except public holidays; visitors must book in advance.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黔灵山公园
summaryEn: A forested hill park with a lake and woodland paths in the north-west of Guiyang's urban area, built from 1957. Its best-known sights are Hongfu Temple, reached by a winding path, the Qilin Cave where Zhang Xueliang was held, and the troop of wild macaques that live in the park; the macaques can bite, and visitors are asked not to feed them. It is one of Guiyang's main sights and a popular place for a half-day walk.
description: 黔灵山公园位于贵州省贵阳市主城区的西北部，是贵阳市内主要风景点之一。占地426公顷，是国内少有的城区大型公园。公园依黔灵山而建。
accessEn: In Yunyan district in the north-west of Guiyang's urban area, served by city buses and a metro station named after the park.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 平塘天空之桥
summaryEn: A highway service area turned destination beside Pingtang Bridge, a three-pylon cable-stayed bridge 2,135 m long whose tallest pylon is 332 m high, opened on 30 December 2019 across the Caodu river gorge. The service area, open to visitors since October 2020, has viewing platforms for the bridge and gorge, a bridge museum, an astronomy area, a cliff-top hotel and a campsite.
description: 平塘大桥是中国贵州省黔南布依族苗族自治州一座高速公路斜拉桥，位于贵州省余庆至安龙高速公路平塘至罗甸段K32-K35公里处，跨越曹渡河峡谷，是贵州高速公路网“横六”余庆—安龙高速公路中平塘至罗甸高速段的控制性工程。
accessEn: Beside the Pingtang-Luodian expressway, about 25 km west of Pingtang town in a straight line, reached by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 二十四道拐
summaryEn: A winding mountain road built in 1936 on the old Guizhou–Yunnan highway, climbing about 250 m in 24 hairpin bends over four kilometres. It became a symbol of US support for China in the Second World War after American army engineers reworked it in 1943, is part of what is called the Stilwell Road, and is a national-level protected monument; English-language sources also call it the 24-zig or the 24-bend road. The scenic area around it also has a viewing platform and exhibition hall, built in 2016 and run separately from the road itself.
description: “二十四道拐”抗战公路位于今中华人民共和国贵州省晴隆县城西南1公里，最早由贵州省路政局修建并于1936年9月通车。1943年，援华美军司令部1880工兵营对该路进行改造变为“二十一道拐”，是史迪威公路或称旧中印公路的其中一段。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the south-western edge of Qinglong county town, which is reached by road from Anshun or Xingyi; private cars may not drive onto the old road itself, so visitors walk it or use the shuttle.
imageCredit: Unknown authorUnknown author or not provided
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 四渡赤水纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial museum opened in 2007 in Tucheng town, telling the story of the Red Army's four crossings of the Chishui River between January and March 1935 during the Long March. Several of the crossings were made in what is now Xishui County, and the Red Army fought a heavy battle at Tucheng on 28 January 1935 before the first crossing. The hall is the main venue of a group of smaller museums in the old town, covering topics such as the women soldiers of the Red Army, the Red Army hospital and shipping on the Chishui River.
description: 四渡赤水纪念馆是一座位于中华人民共和国贵州省遵义市习水县土城镇长征街的纪念馆。
accessEn: On Changzheng Street in Tucheng town, about 30 km west of Xishui county town by road; closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 土城古镇
summaryEn: A former trading port on the Chishui River, where the Red Army fought a heavy battle in January 1935 and made its first crossing of the river. Its old streets and ferry crossing hold a series of Long March sites, including former residences of Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai, Zhu De and Liu Bocheng, a Red Army salt store and several small museums, among them those of the women soldiers of the Red Army and of Chishui River shipping. The national heritage listing, the battle sites of the Four Crossings of the Chishui, also covers the Erlangtan and Maotai ferries and Loushan Pass; twelve of its sites are at Tucheng.
description: 土城古镇位于贵州遵义。游览特色包括博物馆、古镇、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Tucheng town, about 30 km west of Xishui county town by road.

name: 遵义会议会址
summaryEn: The former residence of a Guizhou army commander, a two-storey house of the early 1930s, where the Chinese Communist Party's Politburo held an enlarged meeting on 15–17 January 1935 during the Long March. The meeting reviewed the failure of the fifth encirclement campaign and is regarded in party history as the point at which Mao Zedong's leadership was established. It forms the core of the Zunyi Conference Memorial Museum, whose protected buildings also include the nearby house where Mao Zedong, Zhang Wentian and Wang Jiaxiang stayed and the former Red Army political department at the Yangliu Street Catholic church.
description: 遵义会议会址位于中国贵州省遵义市红花岗区老城街道子尹路96号。于1961年3月被中国国务院列入第一批全国重点文物保护单位，也是中国国家AAAA级景区——遵义会议纪念馆的最核心部分。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the old centre of Zunyi city (Honghuagang district), on Ziyin Road, and served by city bus routes.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 国殇墓园
summaryEn: Guoshang Cemetery was completed in 1945 for soldiers of the Chinese Expeditionary Force's 20th Army Group who were killed retaking Tengchong from Japanese forces in 1944. On the small hill of Xiaotuanpo, 3,346 small headstones fan out around a memorial tower in sectors for each division, below a memorial shrine whose walls carry 9,618 names and a monument to Allied servicemen. The adjoining Western Yunnan Anti-Japanese War Museum, in a new building opened in 2013, covers the wider war in western Yunnan.
description: 国殇墓园，位于中华人民共和国云南省保山市腾冲市西南一公里处的叠水河畔、来凤山北麓的小团坡，是为了纪念抗日战争时期中国远征军第二十集团军在1944年腾冲战役中阵亡将士而修建的墓园。“国殇”之名由时任云贵监察使李根源拟定，取自楚辞中的“国殇”篇名。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the south-western edge of central Tengchong, a short taxi ride from the town centre; Tengchong is about an hour's flight from Kunming.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 松山战役旧址
summaryEn: Songshan, a mountain above the Nu (Salween) River, was held and heavily fortified by Japanese forces from 1942, cutting the Burma Road, until the Chinese Expeditionary Force took it in September 1944 after months of fighting. The battlefield park preserves bunkers, trenches, shell craters and the tunnel dug to blow up the main Japanese strongpoint, plus a cemetery for Chinese soldiers of the 103rd Division. The listed site also takes in Japanese wartime sites in Longling town, such as the former headquarters and the Dongjiagou 'comfort station', some now exhibition halls.
description: 松山战役旧址位于云南省保山市龙陵县腊勐镇、龙山镇，包括松山战役遗址、龙陵日军侵华罪证遗址两部分。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Above the Nu River gorge, roughly 1.5 hours by road south-west of Baoshan or about an hour from Longling town; carry your passport for checkpoints in this border area.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 光禄古镇
summaryEn: This scenic area covers the old centre of Guanglu, a small town north-west of Yao'an county seat, and Longhua Temple at the town's western edge. First a hermitage housing a reclining Buddha and enlarged in the Yuan dynasty, the temple was destroyed and rebuilt several times; the present buildings date from 1907. Its five-bay main hall contains a large Buddhist shrine canopy, one of the bigger surviving examples.
description: 光禄古镇位于云南楚雄。游览特色包括古镇、寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 20 minutes by road north-west of Yao'an county town, which is roughly an hour by road from Chuxiong.

name: 黑井古镇
summaryEn: Heijing, on the Longchuan River, grew rich on its salt wells and was at its most prosperous in the Ming and Qing dynasties. The town keeps much of its Ming–Qing layout, with the Dalong Shrine, a Confucian temple, an old opera stage, the Wu family mansion, the Wuma Bridge across the river and a salt-mining museum. It is listed as a national historic and cultural town.
description: 黑井古镇位于云南楚雄。游览特色包括博物馆、古镇、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: The daily Kunming–Yuanmou West slow train, one each way, stops at Heijing station just south of the town; by road it is roughly 1.5 hours from Chuxiong or Lufeng.

name: 蝴蝶泉
summaryEn: A clear, square spring pool edged with marble at the foot of the Cangshan range, about 27 km north of Dali Old Town. It is famous for accounts of butterflies gathering over the water in spring, recorded by the Ming traveller Xu Xiake, although such swarms are now rarely seen. The spring is the centrepiece of a landscaped park and a common stop on trips around Erhai Lake.
description: 蝴蝶泉位于中国西南云南省点苍山下，距离大理古城约廿七公里，为洱海的著名旅游景点，是4A级旅游景区。蝴蝶泉是方形泉潭，面积约五十平方米，四周为大理石，水质非常清澈。徐霞客在游记中曾这样描述：“还有真蝶万千，连须钩足，自树巅倒悬而下及于泉面，缤纷络绎，五色焕然。
accessEn: About 27 km north of Dali Old Town, roughly 40 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大理白族自治州博物馆
summaryEn: The prefecture's main museum, opened in 1986 beside the Xi'er River in Xiaguan, in a building that blends Tang-style architecture with Bai house forms. Its displays focus on the history of the Nanzhao and Dali kingdoms and on Bai culture, with further galleries on bronze-age cultures, ceramics, Buddhist art, Dali marble, local historical figures and painting and calligraphy, drawn from a collection of about 16,800 items.
description: 大理白族自治州博物馆是中华人民共和国云南省大理白族自治州大理市的一家综合地志博物馆。馆舍位于下关街道洱河南路8号，北临西洱河，总占地面积3.02万平方米，建筑面积10,455平方米，展厅面积4,940平方米，建筑风格为仿唐建筑与白族民居相结合。
accessEn: In Xiaguan, Dali's modern city centre, about 30 minutes by taxi from Dali Old Town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鸡足山
summaryEn: A Buddhist holy mountain north-east of Erhai Lake, venerated as the place where the Buddha's disciple Mahakashyapa waits for the coming of the future Buddha, and a meeting point of Chinese, Tibetan and Theravada Buddhist traditions. Under the Ming dynasty it held hundreds of temples; many were destroyed during the Cultural Revolution and only some have been rebuilt, chief among them Zhusheng Temple in the heart of the mountain and Jinding Temple on the 3,248 m Tianzhu Peak, topped by the 42 m Lengyan Pagoda completed in 1934. The Ming traveller Xu Xiake climbed it twice and compiled the mountain's gazetteer.
description: 鸡足山位于云南省大理白族自治州，地跨宾川县、大理市和鹤庆县，为著名佛教圣地、摩诃迦叶道场，亦为佛教、道教、本地巫教等宗教；汉传佛教、藏传佛教、南传佛教等宗派的交汇地。该山原名青巅山、九曲山，因山峰形似鸡爪，汉地古人认为此处就是佛经中记载的“鸡足山”，为摩诃迦叶尊者持释迦牟尼佛衣钵安住等待弥勒菩萨下生成佛处，据说尊者就入住于华首门旁的山石中。
accessEn: Roughly 2 hours by road north-east of Dali's Xiaguan, via Binchuan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 石宝山石窟
summaryEn: Buddhist cave carvings on forested Shibao Mountain above the Shaxi valley, cut during the Nanzhao and Dali kingdoms. Seventeen grottoes in three groups, at Shizhong Temple, Shiziguan and Shadengqing, hold 233 figures: Buddhas, bodhisattvas, guardian kings and monks, but also, unusually, Nanzhao kings with their courtiers and families. The carving shows Tang and Song influence, similar to cave art in Sichuan, combined with a strongly local style.
description: 石钟山石窟，又称石宝山石窟，位于云南省大理白族自治州剑川县沙溪镇石钟山上，开凿于南诏中后期至大理国。因山上有大石如巨钟，因而得名石钟山。石窟分布于石钟寺、狮子关、沙登箐，共17窟，造像233躯。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 30 minutes by road from Shaxi, which is roughly 2 hours from Dali or Lijiang; public transport is sparse.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 水目山
summaryEn: A wooded mountain near Yunnanyi with the Shuimu Temple complex, one of the earliest Buddhist sites in Yunnan, a centre of Chan (Zen) Buddhism in the west of the province and a royal temple under the Nanzhao and Dali kingdoms. In the temple's front courtyard stands a 15-tier square brick pagoda about 18 m tall, first built in the Dali kingdom and restored in 1605, and about a kilometre to the north lies a forest of 72 monks' tomb stupas, said to be the largest such group in south-west China. Xu Xiake, the Ming travel writer, was among its visitors.
description: 水目山位于云南省大理白族自治州祥云县云南驿镇。山上有水目寺建筑群，是云南省开创较早的佛教圣地之一，是滇西佛教禅宗的传播中心，享有“云南禅宗第一寺”的美誉，有中国西南地区最大的佛教塔林。水目山为清华洞国家森林公园的一部分；由水目寺建筑群、水目寺塔、塔林及自然景观构成的水目山文化旅游区为中国国家4A级旅游景区；位于水目寺前院的水目寺塔为全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 20 km by road south of Xiangyun town near Yunnanyi, roughly an hour by road from Dali's Xiaguan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 洱源西湖
summaryEn: A small highland lake at the northern foot of the Cangshan range, about 2 km² at 1,968 m, whose water drains south into Erhai Lake. Six villages and seven islets are scattered across it, and the lake and its reed beds are protected as a national wetland park, home to birds such as the purple swamphen. The Ming traveller Xu Xiake rated its scenery above that of Hangzhou's West Lake.
description: 洱源西湖也称大理西湖，位于中国云南省大理州洱源县右所镇以西1公里处，地处洱源县东南部，大理苍山十九峰之一的云弄峰北麓，是一座高原平坝淡水湖，湖面海拔1968米，面积2.1平方公里，流域面积119平方公里，属澜沧江水系，地处洱海源头，湖水经南端流出注入洱海，洱海13%的地表水来自西湖。
accessEn: Beside the G214 road in Eryuan County, about an hour by road north of Dali Old Town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 勐巴娜西珍奇园
summaryEn: A garden park on the south-east side of central Mangshi, formerly the Mangshi Nationalities Cultural Palace, whose Dai name means 'a beautiful place'. It is planted with hundreds of century-old trees and displays petrified wood, rare stones and large root carvings, and peacocks roam the grounds.
description: 勐巴娜西珍奇园，是位于中国云南省德宏傣族景颇族自治州芒市的一个公园，位于芒市勇罕街南段，原称芒市民族文化宫。傣语“勐巴娜西”是指“美好的地方”。
accessEn: On Yonghan Street in central Mangshi, about 7 km from Dehong Mangshi airport.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南甸宣抚司署
summaryEn: The headquarters of the Gong family, hereditary chieftains (tusi) of Nandian who ruled the area for about five centuries, in Zhedao, the county town of Lianghe. Begun in 1851 and enlarged until 1935, it is laid out like a Han Chinese government office, with 47 buildings around four main and ten side courtyards, and is often called the 'Dai Forbidden City'. It houses the Western Yunnan Tusi Culture Museum, opened in 2015.
description: 南甸宣抚司署位于中国云南省德宏傣族景颇族自治州梁河县遮岛镇南甸社区南甸路103号，始建于清咸丰元年，历经三代土司的不断扩建，最后于民国二十四年形成现在的规模。历史上的南甸宣抚司在云南边地土司中影响深远，其辖地广阔，实力雄厚。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Lianghe county town, roughly an hour by road from Tengchong or 1.5 hours from Mangshi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 一寨两国
summaryEn: A Dai village south-west of Ruili where the China–Myanmar boundary runs through the settlement, so that the Chinese part is called Yinjing and the Myanmar part Mangxiu. Boundary marker No. 71 stands beside the village, villagers from both sides share a well, and a swing hangs across the line.
description: 一寨两国是云南省德宏傣族景颇族自治州瑞丽市的一个旅游景区，位于姐相乡银井村，中缅边界71号界碑旁，距离瑞丽市区11千米。国境线穿过中国和缅甸的村寨，中方一侧称银井，缅方一侧称芒秀。景区内有两国村民共用的水井，边界上设有一座秋千，荡起进入缅甸，落下回到中国。
accessEn: About 11 km south-west of Ruili city, around 20 minutes by taxi; carry your passport, as there are police checkpoints on roads in this border area.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 阿庐古洞
summaryEn: A group of karst caves in Luxi County, billed as the 'First Cave of Yunnan', made up of the Luyuan, Yuzhu and Biyu caves and the underground Yusun River, together more than 3 km long. The Ming geographer Xu Xiake explored the caves and described them in his travel diaries. The name comes from the Yi language, and the caves are part of the Luxi Alu national geopark.
description: 阿庐古洞位于中华人民共和国云南省红河哈尼族彝族自治州泸西县内，有云南第一洞之称。是一组典型岩溶地貌地下溶洞群，规模宏大，景观奇特，具有“洞中有洞、洞中有天、洞下有河、洞外有泉”之特点。为亚洲最具代表性之一的喀斯特地形。
accessEn: About 3 km north of Luxi county town, which lies more than 160 km by road south-east of Kunming.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 碧色寨
summaryEn: A station on the French-built Yunnan–Vietnam railway, opened in 1909, where goods were transferred to the narrow-gauge Gejiu–Bisezhai–Shiping line, turning a small village into a busy trading post nicknamed 'Little Paris of the East'. Passenger trains stopped in 1992, and the yellow-walled, red-tiled French station buildings, the Greek-run Gelusi hotel, merchants' warehouses and a branch customs house are now a railway heritage park. Feng Xiaogang filmed scenes of his 2017 film Youth here.
description: 碧色寨站是滇越铁路和个碧石铁路上的车站，位于云南省红河哈尼族彝族自治州蒙自市观澜街道碧色寨村。碧色寨站建于1909年，为中国最早的火车站之一，是滇越铁路上唯一的特等站，也是中国最早修建的民营铁路之一个碧石铁路的始发站。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 10 km north of central Mengzi, a short taxi ride.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 蒙自海关旧址
summaryEn: Mengzi was opened as a treaty port after the Sino-French War, and its customs house, set up in 1889, was the first in Yunnan. Around South Lake survive the customs office, the French consulate of 1888, a French prison, the 'French Garden' and the French-style building of the Gelusi trading house, a firm set up by a Greek merchant in 1906. In 1938 the arts and law faculties of the wartime National Southwest Associated University taught here for several months, recalled by a memorial hall.
description: 蒙自海关旧址，位于中华人民共和国云南省红河哈尼族彝族自治州蒙自市南湖一带，始建于1887年，包含海关税务司署、法国领事府、法国监狱、法国花园和哥胪士洋行五处建筑，总建筑面积2925平方米。2006年5月，被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Beside South Lake (Nanhu) in central Mengzi, within walking distance of the old town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 团山村
summaryEn: A village of courtyard mansions about 13 km west of Jianshui, settled by the Zhang clan from Jiangxi in the early Ming and rebuilt on a grand scale in the late Qing with fortunes made in the Gejiu tin mines. Twenty-one historic gates, temples and ancestral halls and 38 old houses survive, laid out around the Zhang ancestral hall. The listed buildings include the Zhang Family Garden, several mansions, the Dacheng Temple and three of the old village gates.
description: 团山村是中华人民共和国云南省红河哈尼族彝族自治州建水县西庄镇下辖的行政村，坐落在泸江河南岸，西面靠山，东临西庄坝子，距离建水县城约13公里，面积约58.47公顷。2012年，团山村被列入第一批中国传统村落名录。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 13 km west of Jianshui; the Jianshui tourist train stops at Tuanshan, or it is a short drive.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 异龙湖
summaryEn: A shallow plateau lake beginning just east of Shiping town, known for the lotus flowers that cover parts of its surface. Its area has shrunk considerably since the 1980s, and a wetland park now lines part of the shore. Laihe Pavilion on its north-western shore gives a view across the water.
description: 异龙湖位于中国云南省红河哈尼族彝族自治州石屏县县城以东两公里处，是云南省八大高原湖泊之一，属于断陷溶蚀湖泊。水面面积32平方公里，平均水深4米。流域面积约为411.52平方公里，主要入湖河流有城河、城北河和城南河，均位于湖泊西岸，湖泊的出口在湖盆东侧，由新街海河流出。
accessEn: The western shore is about 2 km east of Shiping town, which is roughly an hour by road west of Jianshui.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大观楼
summaryEn: A lakeside park in south-western Kunming whose focal point is Daguan Lou, a three-storey Qing-dynasty pavilion facing south over Dian Lake towards the Western Hills. The pavilion is known for the long couplet by the Qing scholar Sun Ran on its gateposts, reputed to be the longest in China, and the willow-lined park around it is a local favourite for tea, kite-flying and boating.
description: 大观楼是位于中华人民共和国云南省昆明市的一座楼阁，坐落于市区西南部，南邻滇池，围绕其建设有大观公园。1983年，核心景区大观楼被列为省级重点文物保护单位，2013年又被国务院公布为国家级重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 5 km south-west of central Kunming, around 20 minutes by taxi or city bus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 太和宫金殿
summaryEn: A Taoist temple complex on Mingfeng Hill whose centrepiece is a hall cast entirely of copper, 6.7 metres high, rebuilt here in 1671 by the general Wu Sangui with more than 250 tonnes of copper after the original of 1602–1604 had been moved to Jizu Mountain. It is regarded as the largest and best-preserved all-copper hall in China. Walled courtyards with other Taoist halls surround it, and the wooded park holds a camellia garden of more than 1,200 varieties with an annual camellia show.
description: 太和宫金殿又称昆明金殿，位于云南省昆明市东北郊鸣凤山麓，距离中心城区约7千米，是中华人民共和国境内现存规模最大、保存最完整的纯铜铸殿，为全国四大铜殿之一。1982年2月，该文物被国务院公布为第二批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 7 km north-east of central Kunming, beside the World Horti-Expo Garden, around half an hour by taxi or city bus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 官渡古镇
summaryEn: An old ferry settlement near the northern shore of Dian Lake, about 10 km south-east of central Kunming, whose temples, pavilions and lanes were restored and partly rebuilt in 2001–2003. Its finest monument is the stone Diamond Pagoda in front of Miaozhan Temple, completed in 1458: a 16-metre central tower and four smaller corner towers on a square base pierced by arched passages. Several other temples survive in the town, among them Fading Temple and the Tuzhu Temple.
description: 官渡古镇位于中国云南省昆明市东南郊，地处滇池北岸、宝象河下游，距市中心区约10公里，是一座全国特色景观旅游名镇，国家4A级旅游景区。官渡是滇文化的发祥地之一，古称“蜗洞”，原系滇池东岸一片突起的小丘，3500年前就有人类在此活动聚居。
accessEn: About 10 km south-east of central Kunming, around half an hour by taxi or city bus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 轿子雪山
summaryEn: A high massif on the border of Luquan County and Dongchuan District in northern Kunming, rising to more than 4,000 metres as the highest point of the eastern Yunnan–Guizhou Plateau. It has been a national nature reserve since 2011, and in winter it is the main place near Kunming to see snow, with a cableway serving the upper slopes.
description: 轿子山又称轿子雪山，位于中国云南省昆明市北部禄劝彝族苗族自治县和东川区交界处，距昆明市区151公里，最高点海拔4344米，属于拱王山系，因山峰形如花轿而得名。轿子山是昆明北部阻隔南下寒流的天然屏障，是形成昆明乃至滇中地区“四季如春”气候的条件之一。
accessEn: About 150 km north of Kunming, roughly 3 hours by road via Luquan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 九乡风景区
summaryEn: A karst area in Yiliang County where more than 20 caves have formed in layers along the Maitian River, a tributary of the Nanpan; where cave roofs have collapsed, the river runs through gorges and under natural bridges. Parts of the cave system opened to visitors in 1989, and the area became a national geopark in 2009. The visitor route links the shady Yincui gorge with caverns such as the White Elephant and Bat caves and the rock formations known as the Fairy Fields.
description: 九乡溶洞群位于中华人民共和国云南省昆明市宜良县九乡彝族回族乡境内，洞群沿南盘江支流麦田河两岸分布。溶洞发育在震旦系灯影组硅质石灰岩地层中，第四纪以来，地壳间歇性抬升，使九乡溶洞群形成多层结构，上部层次无地下水，化学沉积物发育，下部层次多有地下水，有的溶洞顶部坍塌后，形成峡谷和天生桥。
accessEn: About 90 km east of Kunming, roughly 1.5 hours by road, and about 30 km north of the Stone Forest, so the two are often combined.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 昆明植物园
summaryEn: A research garden in the northern suburbs of Kunming, founded in 1938 and run by the Kunming Institute of Botany of the Chinese Academy of Sciences. It holds about 5,000 species of vascular plants, with collections of camellias, magnolias, begonias, ferns, medicinal herbs and rare and endangered species.
description: 中国科学院昆明植物研究所简称“昆明植物研究所”，是中国科学院直属的植物学与植物化学领域综合性研究机构。所训为“原本山川，极命草木”。建有昆明植物园和丽江高山植物园两个科学植物园。
accessEn: About 11 km north of central Kunming, around half an hour by taxi or city bus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 云南民族村
summaryEn: An ethnographic theme park of about 89 hectares on the shore of Dian Lake, where replica villages show the houses, crafts and customs of Yunnan's ethnic groups, including the Bai, Dai, Yi, Wa, Naxi and Tibetans. Staff in ethnic dress explain local customs, and staged versions of festivals such as the Dai Water-Splashing and Yi Torch festivals are held for visitors.
description: 云南民族村位于云南昆明南部的滇池之畔，距市区8公里，占地面积约1300亩是展示云南各民族文化风情的窗口。现已建成开放的有白族、傣族、彝族、佤族、纳西族、藏族、拉祜族、基诺族、布朗族、德昂族、哈尼族、景颇族等12个村寨和一个“摩梭之家”。
accessEn: On Dianchi Road in Xishan district, about 8 km south-west of central Kunming, 20–30 minutes by taxi or city bus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 云南陆军讲武堂
summaryEn: The former campus of a military academy founded in Kunming in 1909, in the last years of the Qing dynasty, which trained more than 9,000 officers before it closed in 1935; its graduates included Zhu De and Ye Jianying as well as cadets from Korea and Vietnam. The surviving main building is a two-storey block built round a large courtyard, each side about 120 metres long. It houses the Yunnan Military Academy History Museum, opened in 2009, with exhibitions on the academy and on the Chinese Expeditionary Force of the Second World War.
description: 云南陆军讲武堂，又称昆明讲武堂，是中国近代一所军事院校，原是清朝为编练新式陆军、加强边防而设的一所军事学校。建立时与天津讲武堂和奉天讲武堂并称三大讲武堂，后与黄埔军校、保定陆军军官学校齐名。旧址位于云南省昆明市五华区翠湖西路22号，坐落于翠湖西侧，为全国重点文物保护单位，开办有云南陆军讲武堂历史博物馆。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the west side of Green Lake in central Kunming, a few minutes' walk from the park.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 云南野生动物园
summaryEn: A large zoo opened in 2004 on the forested slopes of Jindian (Golden Temple) National Forest Park in north-east Kunming. More than 200 species are kept in hillside enclosures, including big cats in a lion-and-tiger area, and sightseeing buses link the stops on the long circuit.
description: 云南野生动物园位于中华人民共和国云南省昆明市盘龙区金殿国家森林公园内。
accessEn: In Jindian Forest Park, Panlong district, about 30 minutes by taxi from central Kunming; city buses 235 and 241 terminate at the park.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黑龙潭
summaryEn: Black Dragon Pool lies in Jade Spring Park at the foot of Elephant Hill, just north of Lijiang Old Town, and its springs feed the streams that run through the old town. The park was laid out in 1737 and is known for the view of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain across the pool and its white marble bridge. Its Ming and Qing pavilions and halls, including the Moon-Embracing Pavilion (rebuilt in 1963 after a fire), are protected as a national monument.
description: 丽江黑龙潭公园也称玉泉公园，位于云南省丽江市古城区丽江古城北部，总占地面积625.3万平方米，海拔2419米，为世界文化遗产－丽江古城的一部分。黑龙潭泉群主要由象山东麓的九子海洼地及其周边山系的泉水补给，潭水经玉河向南流入丽江古城，是丽江古城水系的主要来源。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 20 minutes on foot north of Lijiang Old Town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 拉市海
summaryEn: Lashi Lake lies at about 2,440 metres in a basin on the south-eastern slopes of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, 8 km west of Lijiang, and is the core of a provincial wetland nature reserve set up in 1998. Some 20,000 to 30,000 migratory waterbirds winter here, among them black-necked cranes and bar-headed geese, and 57 bird species have been recorded in the wetland. A dam built since the 1980s keeps the once-seasonal lake at a steady level.
description: 拉市海是云南丽江拉市海高原湿地省级自然保护区的核心部分，位于中国云南省丽江市西面8公里处的拉市坝中部，玉龙雪山东南坡。“拉市”为古纳西语译名，“拉”为荒坝，“市”为新，意为新的荒坝。拉市海是著名的候鸟聚集地，每年冬天约有两万多只候鸟会在此处过冬。
accessEn: About 8 km west of Lijiang, 20–30 minutes by taxi.
imageCredit: The original uploader was KingPilaf at Chinese Wikipedia.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 束河古镇
summaryEn: Shuhe, about 4 km north-west of Dayan, is one of the earliest Naxi settlements around Lijiang and grew into a market town on the Tea Horse Road, known from the Ming dynasty for its leatherworkers. Part of the Old Town of Lijiang World Heritage Site, it has a market square, the Qinglong Bridge, the spring-fed Jiuding Dragon Pool and the Qing-dynasty Sansheng Palace, while the Ming murals of its Dajue Palace are protected as a national monument. Like Baisha, it is usually quieter than Dayan.
description: 束河古镇位于云南省丽江市古城区城北，是纳西族在丽江最早的聚居地之一，也是茶马古道上保存完好的重要集镇。自明代以来，许多从事皮革加工和其他手工业的人云集束河，繁华热闹，束河古镇逐步成为茶马古道上的重镇和纳西文化交流中心。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 4 km north-west of Lijiang Old Town, 15 minutes by taxi or an easy bike ride.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 沧源崖画
summaryEn: Red rock paintings at 17 sites on limestone cliffs at 1,200–2,000 metres in Cangyuan county, made with haematite pigment, apparently by finger, and dated by uranium-series tests to about 3,800–2,700 years ago. The Sigangli Rock Painting Valley scenic area combines the main painting site with a sinkhole, caves including Sigangli, the cave of the Wa creation legend, and Bange village, where a new visitor centre opened in 2026.
description: 沧源崖画是对云南省临沧市沧源佤族自治县境内17处新石器时代崖画的统称。2001年，中国国务院公布为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。1965年1月，沧源崖画被在沧源调查民族情况的汪宁生和李老五发现。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 20 km north-east of Cangyuan county town by road, roughly 30 minutes; carry your passport, as there are police checkpoints on roads in this border area.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 翁丁
summaryEn: A Wa village in Cangyuan county long described as the most completely preserved traditional Wa settlement, with thatched stilt houses (people lived above, livestock below) and ritual posts once used in sacrifices. Fire destroyed almost all of its 105 houses in February 2021; the old village was rebuilt on the same site and reopened at the end of 2022, while most villagers now live in a new village nearby.
description: 翁丁村是云南省临沧市沧源佤族自治县的一个行政村，隶属于勐角傣族彝族拉祜族乡，因佤族的聚落而闻名，附近建有翁丁水库。“翁丁”佤语意为“连接之水”，瓮为水，丁为接，因该地有几条小河相互连接而得名。翁丁村保留有原始的佤族建筑——干栏式茅草顶的“叉叉房”，沿袭着上面住人，下面关猪、关牛的生活习惯，还有曾经祭祀使用的人头桩和牛头桩，当地砍人头祭旱谷的习俗直到1956年才被全部禁止。
accessEn: About 30 km by road from Cangyuan county town, roughly 40 minutes; carry your passport, as there are police checkpoints on roads in this border area.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 墨江文庙
summaryEn: The former Confucian temple of Talang sub-prefecture, begun in 1821 in Lianzhu, now the county town of Mojiang. Surviving buildings include the Lingxing Gate, the Lingxiao and Kuixing pavilions, side halls, the Chongsheng Hall and a five-bay Dacheng Hall with a double-eaved hip-and-gable roof, while the pond and one gate have been rebuilt. It was listed as a national heritage site in 2019.
description: 墨江文庙，即普洱府他郎厅文庙，位于云南省普洱市墨江县联珠镇东正街37号。始建于清道光元年，现存棂星门、凌霄阁、魁星阁、两庑、大成殿、崇圣殿，以及重建的泮池、星宿门。大成殿坐东北向西南，五开间，为重檐歇山顶建筑。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the centre of Mojiang county town, about 2 hours by road north-east of Pu'er city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大海草山
summaryEn: Dahai Caoshan ('Dahai grass mountain') is an expanse of high, open grassland in the Wumeng Mountains, in Dahai township south of Huize, ranging from about 2,570 m to 4,017 m. Since 2022 it has also had a ski area at an average altitude of about 3,500 m, open from mid-November to April.
description: 大海草山位于云南省曲靖市会泽县县城40公里外的大海乡，是乌蒙山脉的一部分，海拔在2570米到4017米之间，是国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: About 40 km by road south of Huize town, roughly 1–1.5 hours; Huize is roughly 2.5 hours by expressway north of Qujing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 坝美
summaryEn: Bamei is a Zhuang village in the north of Guangnan county, hidden in a small basin ringed by karst hills with no road in. Visitors arrive by boat through dark limestone river caves about 1 km long, and the village's secluded fields and traditional way of life have earned it the name of a real-life 'Peach Blossom Land'.
description: 坝美是中华人民共和国云南省文山壮族苗族自治州广南县的一个村庄，居民为壮族。坝美位于一个群山环抱的坝子中，不通公路，与外界的交通必经两个约1公里长的幽暗的石灰岩水溶洞，到达法利村。村民保持传统的生活方式，被称为世外桃源。
accessEn: About 1–1.5 hours by road north of Guangnan county town to the cave entrances near Tangna and Fali villages, then by boat through the caves.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 望天树
summaryEn: A rainforest area near Bubeng, north of Mengla and within the Xishuangbanna nature reserve, named after the wangtianshu (Parashorea chinensis), a dipterocarp that grows 40 m tall or more and is under first-class national protection in China. Its best-known feature is a canopy walkway of cable and rope slung between the trunks about 36 m above the ground, and boat trips run on the Nanla River.
description: 望天树为龙脑香科娑罗双属下的一个种，有时也归类于柳安属。为中国国家Ⅰ级保护植物。望天树生长形态为大型乔木，高40-60米，胸径60-150厘米。
accessEn: Roughly 15–20 km north of Mengla town, about half an hour by road; carry your passport for checkpoints in this border area.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 通海秀山
summaryEn: A hill on the southern edge of Tonghai, laid out as Xiushan Park, where temples have stood since the Dali Kingdom and were enlarged and rebuilt under the Yuan, Ming and Qing. Paths climb past a string of buildings listed together as a national heritage site, among them Yongjin Temple, the Qingliang Terrace, the Jade Emperor Pavilion, Puguang Temple, Wanshou Palace and Tonghai's Confucian temple.
description: 秀山古建筑群位于中国云南省玉溪市通海县秀山镇南的秀山公园，大理国时即已在山上立庙祭祀，元、明、清屡经增修重建，始成如今格局。秀山古建筑群主要包括：涌金寺、清凉台、玉皇阁、普光寺、土主庙、万寿宫、白龙寺、通海文庙、青龙庵，2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the southern edge of Tonghai county town, about an hour by road south of Yuxi city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大山包
summaryEn: A national nature reserve protecting about 19,200 hectares of high plateau marshland and grassland at 2,200–3,300 metres, west of Zhaotong city. It is one of the largest and densest known wintering grounds of the black-necked crane, a bird of the high plateaus, and has been a Ramsar wetland since 2004. The scenic area follows a loop road past the reserve's lakes and the Tiaodunhe reservoir.
description: 大山包黑颈鹤国家级自然保护区位于中华人民共和国云南省昭通市昭阳区西北部大山包镇，是目前中华人民共和国已知密度最大的黑颈鹤栖息地之一及世界上已知的最大、最密集的黑颈鹤越冬栖息地之一。
accessEn: Around an hour by road west of Zhaotong city; the cranes are here in winter.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 昌珠寺
summaryEn: One of the earliest Buddhist temples in Tibet, founded in the 7th century under King Songtsen Gampo in the Yarlung valley and enlarged in the 14th century; its main assembly hall is laid out like that of the Jokhang in Lhasa. Legend says the king had a falcon defeat a dragon to drain the lake here, which gave the temple its name, and Princess Wencheng is said to have stayed. Its treasures include a thangka of Avalokiteshvara worked in pearls, made in the Phagmodrupa period.
description: 昌珠寺位于中华人民共和国西藏自治区山南市乃东区昌珠镇，是西藏最早的佛寺之一，松赞干布和文成公主曾在此居住。昌珠寺占地面积4667平方米，主体建筑措钦大殿，面阔进深均为三间，其布局与拉萨大昭寺相似。1961年被列为第一批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 10 minutes by road south of Tsetang; carry your passport for road checkpoints.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 瀛湖
summaryEn: The reservoir behind the Ankang Dam on the Han River, about 15 km south-west of central Ankang, with some 77 km² of water and nearly a hundred islands and peninsulas; it is an important source area for the central route of the South–North Water Diversion. Boat trips visit islands such as Jinluo and Yuxing, and the shores have temples, villages and lakeside guesthouses.
description: 瀛湖位于陕西安康。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 15 km south-west of central Ankang by road, with city buses from the centre; Ankang West station on the Xi'an–Ankang high-speed line, opened in September 2026, is under an hour from Xi'an.

name: 金台观
summaryEn: A Taoist temple complex founded in the late Yuan or early Ming dynasty on the loess terrace above central Baoji, known through the tradition that Zhang Sanfeng, legendary founder of the Wudang school and of taijiquan, practised here. Its buildings rise up the slope along a central axis, among them the two-storey Jade Emperor Pavilion, an octagonal pavilion and Sanfeng Cave, and the temple is the core of the Taiji Source Cultural Area.
description: 金台观修建于元末明初，因家喻户晓的武当派开山祖师张三丰修道于此而名闻天下。金台观作为宝鸡市的标志性建筑之一，是历史遗存最为完整的道教古建筑群。金台观位于宝鸡市区北部的陵源上，南距火车站0.5公里。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the hillside about 0.5 km north of Baoji railway station, within walking distance.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 九成宫
summaryEn: Remains of a Sui and Tang summer palace in Linyou town: Emperor Wen of Sui built the Renshou Palace here in 593–595, Tang Taizong rebuilt it as the Jiucheng (Nine Perfections) Palace in 631, and a flood destroyed it in 836. Excavations from the late 1980s traced a precinct about 1 km long, including a Sui hall that filled a gap in the record of Chinese palace architecture. The original Liquan Spring stele of 632, composed by Wei Zheng and written by Ouyang Xun and long admired as a model of standard-script calligraphy, is kept in the Linyou County Museum.
description: 隋仁寿宫唐九成宫遗址是中国隋唐时期兴建的“离宫”之一。隋文帝开皇十三年下令在岐州以北建仁寿宫，并任命杨素为总监，宇文恺为检校将作大匠，封德彝为土木监。由于工程繁复，致使民怨沸腾。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Linyou town, about 1.5–2 hours by road north-east of Baoji.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 武侯墓
summaryEn: The tomb of Zhuge Liang, chancellor of the Shu Han kingdom in the Three Kingdoms period, who asked to be buried below Mount Dingjun after he died on campaign in 234. A walled precinct of Ming and Qing halls, with an opera stage, Ming-dynasty statues of Zhuge Liang flanked by Guan Xing and Zhang Bao, and dozens of inscribed boards and steles, leads to the mound, which is ringed by a white marble balustrade carved with 35 scenes from his life. Ancient cypresses surround it, and a temple fair is held at the Qingming festival.
description: 武侯墓即诸葛亮墓，位于中国陕西省汉中勉县定军山脚，是全国重点文物保护单位。诸葛亮，死后谥为“忠武侯”，后世称为诸葛武侯，故得此名。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At the foot of Mount Dingjun just south of Mian County town, about 45 km west of Hanzhong and roughly an hour by road; the Wuhou Temple is about 3 km to the north-west.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 勉县武侯祠
summaryEn: The oldest of China's many temples to Zhuge Liang, founded in 263 on the order of the last Shu Han emperor, Liu Shan, near the strategist's burial place below Mount Dingjun. Its Ming and Qing buildings line a long axis from an old opera stage and bell and drum towers to the worship and main halls, where a statue of Zhuge Liang sits among steles carved with poems by writers such as Li Shangyin and Lu You. A centuries-old magnolia in a side courtyard draws visitors when it flowers in March.
description: 勉县武侯祠是位于中国陕西省汉中市勉县的一座武侯祠。建安二十二年至二十四年，蜀汉与曹魏在这里展开了著名的汉中之战，此次战争以黄忠阵斩夏侯渊、刘备夺取汉中并进位为王结束。诸葛亮在此次战役中发挥了重要的后勤协调作用。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the western edge of Mian County town, about 45 km west of Hanzhong and roughly an hour by road; a taxi from Mianxian railway station takes a few minutes.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 桥陵
summaryEn: The mausoleum of the Tang emperor Ruizong (Li Dan), whose burial chamber was cut into Feng Mountain north-west of Pucheng, with a walled precinct built around the hill. Its long spirit way is lined with sculpture regarded, with that of Qianling, as among the finest of any Tang tomb: carved pillars, a pair of winged xiezhi beasts, ostriches in relief, horses, officials and, at the south gate, a pair of lions.
description: 桥陵位于陕西渭南。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 15 km north-west of Pucheng county town, roughly 25 minutes by taxi.

name: 仓颉庙
summaryEn: A temple and tomb honouring Cangjie, the legendary inventor of Chinese writing, laid out with the temple in front and his walled tomb mound behind. Along the axis stand a screen wall, gate, offering hall, main hall and a Yuan-style rear hall, flanked by an opera stage and bell and drum towers among dozens of ancient cypresses, and a stele carved with 28 'bird-track' characters attributed to Cangjie stands inside. A ceremony for Cangjie is held here every year at the Guyu solar term in April.
description: 仓颉墓与庙位于中国陕西省渭南市白水县史官镇杨武村。2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。为中国传说时代人物仓颉的墓与庙。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Shiguan, about 25 km north-east of Baishui county town, roughly 40 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 司马迁祠
summaryEn: The shrine and tomb of Sima Qian, the Western Han historian who wrote the Records of the Grand Historian, on a ridge above the old Xiayang ferry on the west bank of the Yellow River at Zhichuan. A stone path climbs to an offering hall and a rear hall rebuilt in 1126 under the Northern Song, behind which stands his round brick tomb, crowned by an old cypress and fronted by a stele of 1776 by the Shaanxi governor Bi Yuan.
description: 司马迁墓和祠位于中国陕西省韩城市芝川镇，是西汉史学家司马迁的墓及后世为其所建的祠庙，1982年被列为第二批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Zhichuan, about 10 km south of Hancheng old town, roughly 15 minutes by taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 半坡博物馆
summaryEn: The excavated site of a Neolithic village of the Yangshao culture, lived in roughly 6,800 to 5,300 years ago, on the east bank of the Chan River in eastern Xi'an. Discovered in 1953 and excavated in five seasons from 1954 to 1957, it is covered by China's first museum built on a Neolithic site, opened in 1958, where a large hall shelters the foundations of round and square houses, storage pits, kilns and the village's defensive ditch, and galleries show painted pottery and stone tools.
description: 半坡遗址位于中华人民共和国陕西省西安市灞桥区半坡村，地处浐河下游右侧覆盖有黄土的二级阶地上，背依白鹿塬，与河床相距800米。半坡遗址是中国黄河流域新石器时代仰韶文化的村落遗址典型代表，至今已有六七千年的历史。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Baqiao District about 10 km east of the Bell Tower, a few minutes' walk from Banpo station on Metro Line 1.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 八路军西安办事处纪念馆
summaryEn: This row of brick courtyard houses at Qixianzhuang on Beixin Street served the Chinese Communist Party as a covert liaison post from 1936, first in a rented dental clinic, and from 1937 to 1946 as the Eighth Route Army's open office in Xi'an during the wartime united front with the Nationalists. Its staff sent young volunteers on to Yan'an and bought and shipped supplies to the Communist base area; Zhou Enlai, Zhu De and Deng Xiaoping were among those who worked or stayed here, as did the Canadian doctor Norman Bethune and the American journalist Agnes Smedley. A memorial hall since 1959, it shows the restored offices, radio and cipher rooms and living quarters across four courtyards.
description: 国民革命军第八路军西安办事处旧址位于中国陕西省西安市新城区北新街附近的七贤庄1号；曾是全国15个八路军、新四军办事处中成立最早、坚持时间最长、影响最大的办事机构；1959年改建为八路军西安办事处纪念馆，包括七贤庄一、三、四、七号院；1988年公布为全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Beixin Street in the north of the walled city, under 2 km north of the Bell Tower by taxi or on foot. From November to April it is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 广仁寺
summaryEn: The only Tibetan Buddhist temple in Shaanxi, built on the Kangxi Emperor's orders in 1703–1705 just inside the north-west corner of Xi'an's city wall to lodge lamas travelling to and from the Qing court. It is an active Gelug monastery, largely rebuilt and enlarged since the 1950s, whose halls line one axis behind a gate bearing a plaque in the Kangxi Emperor's calligraphy, with a Thousand-Armed Guanyin among its images.
description: 广仁寺位于中华人民共和国陕西省西安市莲湖区，靠近西安城墙西北角，是一座藏传佛教格鲁派寺院。寺院由康熙帝敕建于1703年至1705年，是清朝中央政府联系西北、西藏和蒙古地区宗教人士的重要场所，也是陕西省现存唯一仍作为宗教活动场所使用的藏传佛教寺院。
accessEn: Inside the north-west corner of the city wall about 2.5 km from the Bell Tower, an 8-minute walk from Yuxiangmen station on Metro Line 1.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 关中民俗艺术博物院
summaryEn: A privately funded museum at the foot of South Wutai Mountain, built by the collector Wang Yongchao, to which some 40 Ming and Qing courtyard houses from across the Guanzhong plain were moved and re-erected. Besides the houses it shows stone, wood and brick carving, folk crafts and customs, and more than 8,600 carved stone hitching posts set out in rows.
description: 关中民俗艺术博物院是坐落于中华人民共和国陕西省西安市长安区一座民间博物院。博物院占地493.88亩、规划建筑面积10.8万平方米，由王勇超个人出资建设完成。博物院将关中地区四十余院座明清古民居从异地集中迁建到博物院，同时将8600多根历代拴马桩迁移至此。
accessEn: At Wutai in Chang'an District about 26 km south of the Bell Tower, under an hour by road and close to the South Wutai Mountain gate.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大唐西市
summaryEn: A Tang-style shopping and cultural quarter built in the 2000s on the site of the West Market, the international market of Tang-dynasty Chang'an. Its Tang West Market Museum, opened in 2010, shows excavated remains of the market's crossroads, cart ruts, a stone bridge, shop foundations and drains where they were found, with galleries on Silk Road trade drawn from a collection of more than 20,000 objects.
description: 大唐西市博物馆位于中华人民共和国陕西省西安市莲湖区劳动南路118号，是由陕西佳鑫集团投资设立的民营博物馆，是西安“唐皇城复兴计划”大唐西市文化产业项目的组成部分。
accessEn: In Lianhu District about 4 km south-west of the Bell Tower, beside Datang Xishi station on Metro Line 6.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 茂陵
summaryEn: Maoling is the tomb of Emperor Wu of Han (157–87 BC), the largest of the Western Han imperial mausoleums, whose great flat-topped mound rises on the loess plateau between Xianyang and Xingping. The Maoling Museum lies about 1 km to its east in the grounds of the tomb of his general Huo Qubing, where galleries hold the Western Han stone sculptures from Huo's tomb, among them the 'Horse Trampling a Xiongnu', together with finds from the tombs around Maoling. A path climbs Huo Qubing's mound to a pavilion on its top.
description: 茂陵是汉武帝的陵墓，是规模最大的西汉帝陵，也是西汉五陵之一。所在地原属汉代槐里县茂乡，故称茂陵。陪葬霍去病墓及大型石刻群。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Near Nanwei town about 12 km west of central Xianyang, roughly an hour by road from Xi'an.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 昭陵
summaryEn: Zhaoling, on Jiuzong Mountain in Liquan County, is the mausoleum of Emperor Taizong of Tang (died 649) and the largest of the Tang imperial tombs; begun in 636, it was the first Tang imperial tomb cut into a mountain, and its many satellite tombs hold princes, princesses and ministers such as Wei Zheng and Li Jing. The Zhaoling Museum, set up at the satellite tomb of the general Li Ji, shows steles and epitaphs gathered from these tombs in its 'Zhaoling Forest of Steles' halls, together with Tang tomb murals and other finds. The Six Steeds reliefs that once stood at the mausoleum are now in Xi'an's Beilin Museum and in the United States.
description: 昭陵是唐太宗李世民的陵墓，位于咸阳市礼泉县九嵕山，是关中“唐十八陵”中规模最大的一座。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: The museum is in Yanxia town, Liquan County, about 70 km by road north-west of Xi'an (roughly 1.5 hours), and Yuanjia Village is about 2 km to the north.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 红碱淖
summaryEn: Regarded as China's largest desert freshwater lake, Hongjiannao now covers about 37 km² where the loess plateau meets the Mu Us Desert on the border with Inner Mongolia. It is a national nature reserve, described by the local government as the world's largest breeding ground of the relict gull, with 195 bird species recorded, and its shores mix sandy beaches, grassland and wetland. The scenic area offers kayaking and other boat trips, sand buggies, and camel and horse rides.
description: 红碱淖，中国陕西省北部毛乌素沙漠内一淡水内流湖，属神木市尔林兔镇管辖。红碱淖曾经生活着17种鱼类和80多种水鸟，是国家一级保护动物遗鸥的主要栖息地。红碱淖是中国境内“最大的沙漠淡水湖”，全球95%遗鸥集聚于红碱淖栖息繁衍，2011年红碱淖的成鸟数量大概有七千巢，一万五千只，由于湖水减少，2016年仅四千巢。
accessEn: About 70 km north-west of Shenmu city in Erlintu township, around 1 hour 15 minutes by road.
imageCredit: Caitriana Nicholson from 北京 ~ Beijing, 中国 ~ China
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 石峁遗址
summaryEn: The ruins of a stone-walled city built around 2300 BC and abandoned around 1800 BC, the largest known walled settlement of China's late Neolithic, with inner and outer stone walls enclosing more than 400 ha around a terraced palace platform called Huangchengtai. It is now a national archaeological site park and on China's tentative list for World Heritage. The Shimao Museum, opened in November 2023, shows 688 jades, stone carvings, pottery, bone objects and painted mural fragments from the site.
description: 石峁遗址是中国陕西省神木县境内的一处新石器时代遗址。遗址位于高家堡镇石峁村秃尾河北侧山峁，在长城南边十余公里，黄河西边二十余公里。秃尾河与铜川沟交汇处，地处陕北黄土高原北部边缘，兴建于公元前2300年前后，废弃于公元前1800年前后。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Near Gaojiabu town, about 55 km north-east of Yulin or 40 km south-west of Shenmu, roughly an hour by road from either.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 玉泽湖公园
summaryEn: A city park in Yumen's new town, begun in 2000 when the city government moved here from the old oil town, laid out around an inner lake, an outer lake and a newer extension. Paths link a cultural promenade, squares, a lake island, wetland and a children's play area, with landmarks such as the Yanyu Pavilion, a memorial archway, a zigzag bridge, an old-style water tower and a Ferris wheel.
description: 玉泽湖公园是中国甘肃省酒泉市玉门市的公园，名称取自楹联“玉泽水灵秀，湖荡碧波春”。玉泽湖公园始建于2000年，最初是作为玉门市政迁址配套实施的重点惠民工程而建立。自建成以来，玉泽湖公园经历了多次绿化和改造。
accessEn: On Tieren Avenue in the new town of Yumen, about 150 km north-west of Jiuquan by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 哈达铺会议旧址
summaryEn: Hadapu, a town on the old route between Sichuan and the north-west, is where Red Army columns on the Long March halted and reorganised in 1935, and where the Party leadership decided to head for the Communist base in northern Shaanxi. Its Red Army Street keeps buildings used at the time, including the Guandi Temple where a cadres' meeting was held and the old post office, and a Long March memorial hall tells the story. The town is a national historic town and one of China's red-tourism classic scenic areas.
description: 哈达铺会议旧址，位于中国甘肃省陇南市宕昌县哈达铺镇，2001年6月25日公布为第五批全国重点文物保护单位，类型为近现代重要史迹及代表性建筑。哈达铺会议旧址的历史年代为1935～1936年。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Hadapu town, about 35 km by road north-west of Tanchang county town; Hadapu has its own station on the Lanzhou–Chongqing railway and an exit on the G75 expressway. The memorial hall is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 皇甫谧文化园
summaryEn: A traditional-medicine themed scenic area at Zhang'aopo village, the home district of Huangfu Mi (c. 215–282), the scholar-physician who compiled the Canon of Acupuncture and Moxibustion, one of the earliest systematic works on acupuncture. Around his tomb and memorial hall are a culture park, a herb garden, mugwort fields and an acupuncture centre offering moxibustion sessions, plus a small petting zoo, and an acupuncture forum is held here.
description: 皇甫谧文化园位于甘肃平凉。游览特色包括纪念展览、动物观赏。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Zhang'aopo village in Dudian town, about 5 km north of Lingtai town, a short drive.

name: 玉泉观
summaryEn: A Taoist temple complex climbing the foot of Tianjing Mountain on the north side of Tianshui's old city, founded in the Tang dynasty and rebuilt by Quanzhen Taoists from the Yuan onwards. Its Ming and Qing halls rise in terraces up the slope, among them a Ming Jade Emperor Hall, and it keeps more than fifty inscribed steles, including a four-sided Yuan stele. A temple fair, known locally as chaoguan, is held on the ninth day of the first lunar month.
description: 玉泉观位于中国甘肃省天水市秦州区，2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位，2010年被列为国家4A级旅游景区。玉泉观始建于唐代，现存为明、清建筑，共有90余座建筑，玉皇殿为保存最完整的明代建筑之一。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Yuquan Road on the north edge of central Tianshui, about 1 km from the city's central square.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 雷台汉墓
summaryEn: A brick tomb of the late Eastern Han with front, middle and rear chambers, found in 1969 under Leitai, an earthen terrace topped by a Ming Taoist temple in northern Wuwei; it yielded more than 230 objects, among them a procession of bronze horses, chariots and figures and the Bronze Galloping Horse (Flying Horse of Gansu), later chosen as China's tourism emblem. The originals are in the Gansu Provincial Museum in Lanzhou; the site is now the Leitai Han Culture Museum, a 12.7-hectare park with the tomb, the temple and a large replica array of the bronze procession.
description: 雷台汉墓是一座位于甘肃省武威市雷台、建于东汉末年至魏晋初期的墓葬，2001年列入全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Beiguan Middle Road, under 2 km north of central Wuwei, by taxi or city bus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天梯山石窟
summaryEn: Among the earliest Buddhist cave temples in China, cut into cliffs above the Huangyang River in the Qilian foothills from the time of the Northern Liang ruler Juqu Mengxun in the early fifth century and reworked up to the Qing; 19 caves survive in three tiers. When a reservoir was built at the foot of the cliff in 1959–60, most sculptures and some murals were moved to the Gansu Provincial Museum, but the largest group, a monumental seated Buddha with attendants, stayed in place and has been shielded from the reservoir water by a cofferdam since 1992; a site exhibition hall tells the caves' story.
description: 天梯山石窟，起始名为凉州石窟，位于甘肃省武威市凉州城南约50公里的天梯山上，分布在西南峭崖绝壁间。石窟开凿于北凉沮渠蒙逊时北魏、北周、隋、唐、西夏、元诸代都曾在这里开窟或重建，至明、清时期已成为喇嘛寺院。
accessEn: About 55 km by road south of Wuwei city, roughly an hour.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 武威文庙
summaryEn: Built in 1437–1439 and enlarged up to the Republican era, this is one of the largest Confucian temples in north-west China, laid out in three courts side by side: the Wenchang Palace to the east, the temple proper with its semicircular pool, Lingxing Gate, Dacheng Hall and Zunjing Library in the middle, and the old Confucian school to the west, with more than 30 steles from the Tang to the Qing. The city's Western Xia Museum across the road displays the Western Xia Stele of 1094, the only known stele with matching texts in Tangut and Chinese, whose rediscovery in the early 19th century reopened the study of the Tangut script.
description: 武威文庙位于中国甘肃省武威市凉州区，始建于明正统二年至四年，成化、顺治、康熙、乾隆、道光及民国年间曾多次重修。1996年被列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。武威文庙坐北朝南，南北长198米，东西宽152米，总占地3万余平方米。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Chongwen Street in central Wuwei, within walking distance of the city centre. The Western Xia Museum, which holds the stele, is closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 焉支山
summaryEn: A forested outlier of the Qilian range south of Shandan, rising to 3,978 m, which the Han general Huo Qubing won from the Xiongnu and where Emperor Yang of Sui is said to have received envoys from 27 states in 609. The forest park has dense forest, gorges lined with rock formations and the Zhongshan Temple on the heights, and is a cool summer retreat above the Hexi Corridor.
description: 焉支山，又称胭脂山、燕支山、删丹山，位于河西走廊的南部，今日中国甘肃山丹县城东南50公里处。古时焉支山盛产红兰花，其汁可做胭脂，用以美容，得名胭脂山，一说源出单于妻“阏氏”音“焉支”。汉武帝时，冠军侯霍去病孤军深入河西走廊，率军攻略祁连山、焉支山，歼灭其主力三万余人，俘虏匈奴单桓王、酋涂王和单于阏氏等百余人。
accessEn: About 50 km south of Shandan town by road, roughly an hour's drive.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 原子城
summaryEn: Atomic City is the former site of Plant 221, China's first nuclear weapons research and production base, set up from 1958 on the Jinyintan grassland north-east of Qinghai Lake, where state accounts say the country's first atomic and hydrogen bombs were developed. The plant was dissolved in 1987 and the site handed to the local government in 1995; preserved parts include the detonation test ground, an assembly plant, the Shangxing station where, in the Qinghai Daily's account, the first atomic bomb was loaded on a train for Lop Nur, and an underground command centre. The Atomic City memorial museum, opened in 2009 and reopened in June 2021 after refurbishment, presents the history with photographs, documents and objects, and Jinyintan is also summer grazing land for local Tibetan and Mongol herders.
description: 原子城位于青海海北。游览特色包括草原、湖泊、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Xihai town in Haiyan County, about 100 km north-west of Xining by road. The memorial museum is closed on Mondays.

name: 察尔汗盐湖
summaryEn: Qarhan is a vast salt flat in the southern Qaidam Basin, much of it worked for potash and other salts; the Golmud government gives its area as 5,856 km². The visitor area is built around a central wharf (really an industrial brine-pumping station), the 32 km 'Wanzhang Salt Bridge' where the Golmud–Dunhuang road and the Qinghai–Tibet railway run over the salt crust, and fields of 'thousand-island' salt flowers.
description: 察尔汗盐湖是中国青海省海西蒙古族藏族自治州的一个盐湖，位于柴达木盆地南部，地跨格尔木市和都兰县，由达布逊湖以及南霍布逊湖、北霍布逊湖、涩聂等盐池汇聚而成，总面积5856平方公里，是中国最大的盐湖；格尔木河、柴达木河等多条内流河注入该湖。
accessEn: About 60 km from Golmud by road; the Golmud–Dunhuang road crosses the lake.
imageCredit: Topographic Center of the United States Defense Mapping Agency
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 米兰古城
summaryEn: The ruins of a Silk Road oasis town where the Lop desert meets the Altun Mountains, once part of the Shanshan (Loulan) kingdom, with a large rectangular fort built under Tibetan rule in the 8th–9th centuries, Buddhist temple and stupa ruins and traces of an ancient irrigation system. Aurel Stein excavated murals here in 1907, including winged figures in a Roman-influenced style signed by a painter named Tita, and Tibetan documents found in the fort are among the oldest known in that script.
description: 米兰遗址，位于中国新疆维吾尔族自治区，是一组不同年代的跨文化遗址群。其中有鄯善国伊循城遗址，汉代屯田，唐代古戍堡遗址等。曾于佛寺壁画中发现了3世纪带有古罗马风格的有翼天使图像。
accessEn: Near Milan town, about 80 km east of Ruoqiang town by road; Milan station on the Golmud–Korla railway is nearby.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 七个星佛寺遗址
summaryEn: The largest Buddhist site of the ancient kingdom of Karasahr (Yanqi), founded in the Jin period and abandoned only when Islam reached the area around the 15th century. The mud-brick remains of 93 buildings, including temple halls up to about 25 m across, stupas and monks' cells, spread over a ridge beside 11 cave shrines with traces of painting, making it the only site in Xinjiang that keeps stupas, halls, caves and living quarters together. Sculptures and murals removed by early-20th-century expeditions are now in museums in Berlin, London, Paris, Tokyo and elsewhere, and a site museum stands by the ruins.
description: 七个星佛寺遗址位于新疆巴音郭楞。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Qigexing town about 25 km south-west of Yanqi, and about 35 km by road from Korla.

name: 北庭故城遗址
summaryEn: The earthen ruins of Beiting (Beshbalik), seat of the Tang Beiting Protectorate and later the summer capital of the Uyghur kingdom of Qocho, which was the leading city on the northern side of the Tianshan for some 700 years until its destruction in the 15th century. Its nested outer and inner walls survive and have been part of the Silk Roads World Heritage listing since 2014; west of the city stands the excavated Uyghur Buddhist temple known as Xidasi, a two-tier mud-brick building with niches, statues and murals. A site museum explains the city's history.
description: 北庭故城遗址，又名后堡子古城、护堡子古城，当地俗称破城子，位于中华人民共和国新疆维吾尔自治区昌吉回族自治州吉木萨尔县城北12公里处，是唐代北庭大都护府治所遗址。历史上，北庭城是丝绸之路的交通枢纽，也是自唐代设立庭州起七百余年间，天山山脉北麓的政治文化中心。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 12 km north of Jimsar town, roughly 2 hours by road east of Ürümqi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 巴里坤湖
summaryEn: Barkol Lake, known in Han times as the Pulei Sea, is a salt lake at about 1,585 m in the western Barkol grassland, ringed by the Barkol and Moqin Ula mountains. Its northern part yields salt and its southern part mirabilite and brine shrimp, and in summer herders pitch felt tents and graze their flocks on the meadows along the shore.
description: 巴里坤湖，古称蒲类海，又称巴尔库勒淖尔，是位于新疆巴里坤县的咸水湖。巴里坤湖位于天山山脉东段巴里坤山与莫钦乌拉山之间的巴里坤地堑式断陷封闭型高位盆地中，东西宽约9千米，南北长13千米，总面积113平方千米。
accessEn: About 20 km west of Barkol county town by road; go by car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 红其拉甫国门
summaryEn: The national gate building at the Khunjerab Pass, where the Karakoram Highway (G314) reaches the border with Pakistan at about 4,700 m, on the only land crossing between the two countries. Rated in 2021 as a red-tourism scenic area, it centres on the gate, the boundary marker and a monument to the opening of the pass in the 1980s. The border port has been open all year round since late 2024, but the altitude makes even a short visit hard work.
description: 红其拉甫山口，位于中华人民共和国新疆维吾尔自治区喀什地区西南部，帕米尔高原塔什库尔干塔吉克自治县境内，同巴基斯坦吉尔吉特-巴尔蒂斯坦地区毗邻。山口的中方境内，水布浪沟有红其拉甫河。山口海拔极高，号称世界第一关，官方数据称海拔为5,000米左右，但切实海拔高度从4,800米到5,100米说法不一。
accessEn: About 130 km by road south of Tashkurgan town at the end of highway G314, usually visited as a day trip by hired car from Tashkurgan. It lies in a border area, so a border-area permit (边境通行证) is needed as well as a passport; check the current rules before travelling.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 火焰山
summaryEn: The Flaming Mountains are a long ridge of bare red sandstone across the Turpan basin, so deeply gullied that at certain times of day they look as if they are on fire; in the novel Journey to the West the Monkey King has to borrow a magic palm-leaf fan to put out their flames. The scenic area at their foot has underground galleries on the geology and the legend, a giant thermometer, and statues of Xuanzang and his companions. Since August 2025 the original and the newer neighbouring site have been run as one area, linked by shuttle carts, with donkey-cart and camel rides.
description: 火焰山是位于中华人民共和国新疆维吾尔自治区吐鲁番市的单面山，是博格达山山前东西走向的褶皱与逆冲断层带。火焰山山体以红色为主，北缓南陡，南侧冲沟遍布，形似火焰。出露有侏罗系、白垩系、古近系、新近系、第四系的地层。
accessEn: Beside the main road about 30 km east of central Turpan, by taxi or as part of a day tour of the eastern sites.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 高昌故城
summaryEn: Gaochang, also known as Qocho, was the leading city of the Turpan basin for some 1,400 years: capital of the Gaochang kingdom, a Tang county seat and then capital of the Uyghur Qocho kingdom, until war destroyed it in the 14th century. Within its eroded mud walls you can still trace the outer city, inner city and palace citadel, and the best-preserved buildings are the Great Buddhist Temple and the south-western temple. Boardwalks and shuttle carts link the ruins to a visitor centre opened in 2016, and the site is part of the Silk Road World Heritage listing.
description: 高昌故城是公元前1世纪到公元14世纪吐鲁番盆地的第一大中心城镇，也是新疆留存最大的故城遗址。城遗址位于新疆维吾尔自治区吐鲁番市高昌区三堡乡，即火焰山南麓木头沟河三角洲，西距吐鲁番市约40公里，总面积约220万平方米。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 35 km east of central Turpan by road; go by taxi or hired car, often combined with the Bezeklik caves.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 库木塔格沙漠
summaryEn: The dunes of the Kumtag Desert, whose Uyghur name means 'sand mountains', run right up to the southern edge of Shanshan town. Visitors play on the dunes by day, and the scenic area regularly runs evening bonfire parties, folk performances and star-gazing camps. It was designated a national key scenic area in 2002.
description: 库姆塔格沙漠位于中国新疆鄯善县老城南，与老城东环路南段相连，面积1880平方公里，全称为“鄯善县库姆塔格沙漠风景名胜区”，是世界上惟一与城市相连的沙漠。“库木塔格”在维吾尔语中的意思是“沙山”。2002年被列入第四批国家级重点风景名胜区名单。
accessEn: At the southern edge of Shanshan town, about 90 km east of Turpan by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 吐鲁番博物馆
summaryEn: Turpan Museum is one of China's national first-grade museums and holds finds from the oasis's ancient cities and cemeteries. Its galleries, closed since 2025 for an extension, covered Turpan's history along the Silk Road, documents excavated at Astana and other sites, ancient coins and naturally preserved mummies with their grave goods, and a separate hall showed fossils of the giant hornless rhinoceros Paraceratherium.
description: 吐鲁番博物馆，位于中华人民共和国新疆维吾尔自治区吐鲁番市高昌区木纳尔路，是吐鲁番市属综合性博物馆。是国家一级博物馆、国家AAAA级旅游景区、2021-2025年第一批全国科普教育基地。吐鲁番博物馆前身可追溯到1960年代建立的吐鲁番县展览馆文物小组，博物馆于1986年开始筹备，1991年正式对外开放，成立后先以南昌路旧馆为馆址，后迁入木纳尔路的新馆。
accessEn: On Munar Road in central Turpan. The museum closed on 25 August 2025 for an extension and a new exhibition layout, so check that it has reopened before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 吐峪沟
summaryEn: Tuyoq is an oasis village of mud-brick Uyghur houses in a gorge through the Flaming Mountains, with Buddhist cave temples cut into the valley walls above it. The caves, begun in the 5th century, are among the earliest in the Turpan basin: 157 caves, three temples and nine stupas survive, and after long conservation work several caves with murals opened to visitors in May 2025. The 4A scenic area takes in the restored village, with craft workshops and food stalls, the grottoes and walks or viewpoints over the canyon.
description: 吐峪沟石窟始凿于公元5世纪前后，沿用至公元14世纪，现存洞窟157座、地面寺院3座、佛塔9座，是古代高昌地区开凿时代最早、年代跨度涵盖整个高昌佛教史、营建规模最大且洞窟类型最为齐全的佛教石窟寺院遗址群。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About an hour by road east of Turpan, roughly 40 km west of Shanshan town; go by taxi or hired car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 红山公园
summaryEn: A hill park in central Ürümqi around Hong Shan, the 'Red Mountain' of Permian red sandstone that serves as the city's emblem, laid out in 1985 after decades of tree-planting. The Hongshan Pagoda on the summit is a regional heritage site, and the park also has old-style buildings including a viewing tower and a Buddhist temple, a statue of Lin Zexu and a lake with fairground rides; a temple fair is held around the Lunar New Year.
description: 乌鲁木齐市红山公园是位于中华人民共和国新疆维吾尔自治区乌鲁木齐市水磨沟区的一处集旅游观光、人文内涵为一体的综合公园，同时也是乌鲁木齐市的地标，是中华人民共和国国家AAAA级景区。因公园内二叠纪形成的红山而得名。
accessEn: Just north of the city centre in Shuimogou District, a short taxi ride from the main streets.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 水磨沟公园
summaryEn: The core park, about 4 km², of the Shuimogou scenic area in north-eastern Ürümqi, where the Shuimo River runs between hills replanted with trees since the late 1970s. It takes its name from the water mills that ground flour here from the Qing period until the 1950s, and has a replica water mill, pavilions, a riverside landscaped in 2005 and the Qingquan Temple, built from 1988.
description: 水磨沟风景区是位于中华人民共和国新疆维吾尔自治区乌鲁木齐市水磨沟区，由水塔山、虹桥山、清泉山、温泉山、雪莲山五座山以及以水磨河为主的水系构成的风景区。是乌鲁木齐市“新十景”之一，也是国家4A级景区。主要景点即有“一砲成功”爱国主义教育基地，也有萧曹亭、古水磨、接官亭等仿古景点；还有清泉寺、翰文岭、“水磨欢歌”、“香妃出浴”等文化景点，除此之外，还有青年林纪念碑、拥军碑、将军碑等植树造林的纪念碑，另外也有高尔夫球场、灯光滑雪场等娱乐设施和相关项目。
accessEn: In Shuimogou District about 5 km north-east of central Ürümqi, with city buses to the park gate.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 五大道
summaryEn: Wudadao, the Five Great Avenues, is a grid of quiet, tree-lined streets in Tianjin's former British concession, built up in the early 20th century with brick villas, mansions and apartment blocks in a medley of European styles. It is a place to slow down: cycle or take a horse-drawn carriage around the blocks, peer through garden gates and stop for coffee on Minyuan Square.
description: 景区内可游览民园广场、马场道、睦南道与睦南公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Intercity trains reach Tianjin from Beijing South in about 30 minutes; from Tianjin Station it's a short metro or taxi ride to the avenues in Heping District.

name: 悬空寺
summaryEn: In a gorge below Mount Heng, about 65 km south-east of Datong, the Hanging Temple clings to a cliff face, its halls and pavilions linked by narrow walkways and apparently held aloft by slender wooden poles. It is unusual inside too: Buddhist, Taoist and Confucian figures share the complex, with the Buddha, Laozi and Confucius seated side by side in one hall.
description: 悬空寺，位于中国山西省大同市浑源县，是一座儒释道三教合一的寺庙。该寺始建于北魏年间，现存建筑均为明清时期重建。整座寺庙建于翠峰山的半山腰上，依靠27根木梁支撑全部寺庙主要建筑，远看形如悬在半空，故名悬空寺。
accessEn: It's roughly 1.5 hours by car from Datong; most visitors hire a driver or join a day tour that also covers the Yungang Grottoes.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 巴丹吉林沙漠
summaryEn: The Badain Jaran holds some of the tallest stationary sand dunes on Earth, great ridges that rise hundreds of metres above the desert floor. Between them lie more than a hundred small lakes, some fresh and some briny, and most visitors go in by 4x4 with local drivers who tackle slopes that look impossibly steep.
description: 巴丹吉林沙漠位于阿拉善高原，处于其邻近的三个沙漠的区域交会处，是当今中国境内第三大沙漠和第二大流动沙漠。该地属于中国大陆西北部的温带沙漠地区，呈现沙漠地形和地景持续发生之地质学和地貌学特征。当地行政区划上属内蒙古自治区的额济纳旗和阿拉善右旗。
accessEn: Licensed 4x4 operators run day and overnight trips into the dunes from Alxa Right Banner, a small town with its own airport and road links to Zhangye in Gansu.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 沈阳故宫
summaryEn: Built from 1625 into the 1630s, Shenyang's imperial palace was the seat of the early Manchu rulers before they captured Beijing in 1644. Smaller and far calmer than the Forbidden City, it blends Han Chinese, Manchu and Tibetan design; look for the octagonal Dazheng Hall facing two rows of pavilions once used by the princes and the Eight Banners.
description: 沈阳故宫，位于中华人民共和国辽宁省沈阳市沈河区明清旧城中心，是后金、清朝入关前的沈阳皇宫，清朝入关迁都北京后改为盛京行宫，始建于1625年。乾隆帝时期又有较大规模的改建与增修，占地约6万平方米。1926年以后，其建筑群陆续辟作博物馆。
accessEn: The palace is in Shenyang's old centre, a few minutes' walk from the Zhongjie shopping street; Shenyang is under three hours from Beijing by high-speed train.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 青岛
summaryEn: Qingdao tumbles down green hills to the Yellow Sea, its old town a patchwork of red-tiled roofs and stone buildings from the years of German rule. Walk out along Zhanqiao Pier, wander among the villas of Badaguan, then taste Tsingtao at the brewery where it has been made since 1903.
description: 青岛市，简称青，旧称胶澳，别称胶、琴岛、岛城，是中华人民共和国山东省的副省级市、计划单列市和区域中心城市，山东省最大城市，中国沿海重要中心城市和滨海度假旅游城市、国际性港口城市、国家历史文化名城，山东半岛城市群和青岛都市圈中心城市，青岛经济发达，在北方城市中，经济总量仅次于京津2个直辖市。
highlights: 德国总督楼旧址博物馆
accessEn: The old town surrounds Qingdao Railway Station, a short walk from Zhanqiao Pier; buses and taxis run along the seafront to Badaguan and the beaches.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 茶卡盐湖
summaryEn: Chaka is a salt lake on the Qinghai plateau, where a thin film of brine over white salt crust throws back near-perfect reflections of clouds and people on calm days. A little train runs out across the salt, and visitors wade in barefoot or in rented boots for the classic 'Mirror of the Sky' photographs.
description: 茶卡盐湖，也称茶卡或达布逊淖尔，位于中国青海省海西蒙古族藏族自治州乌兰县茶卡镇境内，湖面海拔为3059米。该湖湖水富含钠盐，盐层较厚，贴近湖面，湖水已经趋于干涸。湖边有铁路支线连接青藏铁路，还有窄轨铁路曾用于运盐，现用于景区交通。
accessEn: Chaka is about four hours' drive west of Xining, usually paired with Qinghai Lake on a two-day loop; in summer a tourist train from Xining also runs to Chaka station, by the entrance.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 吐鲁番交河故城
summaryEn: Turpan sits in a desert basin that dips below sea level, one of the hottest places in China, yet grapes and melons flourish here thanks to centuries-old irrigation. Just west of town, the Jiaohe Ruins are the remains of a city carved downward into a narrow loess terrace between two rivers, its streets, temples and houses still easy to read from the walkways.
description: 交河故城，即雅尔湖故城，位于中华人民共和国新疆维吾尔自治区吐鲁番市高昌区以西约10公里处的亚尔孜沟内，是世界上规模最大、保存最完整的生土结构古代城市建筑群遗迹，总面积约47万平方米，始建于约公元前2世纪，采用“减地起凸法”等建筑工艺，现存居住区、衙署区、寺院区等功能分区遗址。
accessEn: Jiaohe is about 10 km west of central Turpan, a short taxi ride; Turpan is about an hour from Ürümqi by high-speed train.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 纳木错
summaryEn: Namtso is one of Tibet's great sacred lakes, a huge sheet of salty turquoise water at about 4,700 metres beneath the snowy Nyenchen Tanglha range. Most visitors head for the Tashi Dor peninsula on the south-eastern shore, where prayer flags stream over rocky outcrops riddled with hermits' caves.
description: 纳木错，蒙古语作腾格里淖尔，两名称均为“天湖”之意，是当前中国面积第三大、西藏面积第二大的咸水湖，地跨西藏中部的班戈县青龙乡南部与当雄县纳木湖乡西部。湖的形状近似长方形，东西长70多公里，南北宽30多公里，面积1920多平方公里。
accessEn: Namtso is about four hours' drive north of Lhasa over the Largen La pass, at more than 5,000 m; agencies run it as a long day trip or with an overnight stay.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 司马台长城·古北水镇
summaryEn: About 120 km north-east of central Beijing in Miyun district, the Simatai section of the Great Wall follows a steep ridge above Gubei Water Town, a resort of stone lanes, courtyard inns and waterways built at its foot. Wander the town, ride the cable car or climb to the wall's eastern towers, then stay into the evening for a night walk on a short, lit stretch.
description: 司马台长城是中国万里长城的其中一段，位于北京市密云区与河北省承德市滦平县之间。它是长城中最险要的一段，东起望京楼，西至后川口，全长5.4公里。长城本建于北齐，现存的建筑为明朝时期所建。
accessEn: Tourist buses run from the Dongzhimen transport hub to the water town in about 2 hours; by car or taxi allow about 2 hours from central Beijing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙庆峡
