summaryEn: In Yanqing district, about 85 km north-west of central Beijing, Longqing Gorge is a 7 km canyon flooded by a reservoir, its cliffs rising straight out of the water. Take the boat up the gorge past its named rock formations and ride the cable car up a peak for the view, or come in winter for the Ice Lantern Festival in the frozen valley.
description: 龙庆峡水库是位于北京市延庆区旧县镇的水库，又称古城水库，龙庆峡风景区位于该水库。1973-1981年建成。库容852万立方米，水面面积34万平方米。
accessEn: Take a high-speed train from Qinghe or Beijing North to Yanqing station (about 25–40 minutes), then bus Y43 or a taxi to the gorge; by car allow 1.5–2 hours from central Beijing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 北海公园
summaryEn: Immediately north-west of the Forbidden City, Beihai ('Northern Sea') is a former imperial garden whose lake covers more than half of its area. Cross to Jade Flower Island and climb through Yong'an Temple to the White Dagoba, a Tibetan-style stupa on the summit, then take a boat to the north shore for the Five Dragon Pavilions and the glazed-tile Nine-Dragon Wall.
description: 北海公园位于中华人民共和国北京市城区的中偏北部，故宫和景山的西北侧，始建于宋辽金时代，是世界上现存建园时间最早的皇家宫苑。北海的布局以琼华岛为主体，在岛的顶端建有标志性建筑永安寺白塔，与南岸的团城、北岸的宫苑群遥相呼应，相互借景，构成园林的南北中轴线。
accessEn: Take Metro Line 6 to Beihai North, a few minutes' walk from the park's north gate, or take a short taxi ride from Tian'anmen to the south gate.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 孔庙和国子监
summaryEn: On Guozijian Street, a short walk west of the Lama Temple, Beijing's Temple of Confucius, first built in 1302, stands beside the Guozijian, or Imperial Academy, the highest seat of learning under the Yuan, Ming and Qing dynasties. Wander the temple's courtyards of old cypresses and carved stone tablets (steles), then cross into the academy, with its Biyong Hall ringed by a round pool, and see the Qianlong Stone Classics, 189 steles carved with the Confucian classics.
description: 北京孔庙位于中华人民共和国北京市东城区安定门内国子监街，是仅次于山东曲阜孔庙的中国第二大孔庙，始建于元大德六年，是元明清三代中央政府官方祭祀孔子的场所，除了三代皇帝，袁世凯在自封为中华帝国皇帝之后也曾前往北京孔庙祭孔。
accessEn: Take Metro Line 2 or 5 to Yonghegong Lama Temple and walk west into Guozijian Street, or Line 2 to Andingmen; a taxi from Tian'anmen takes about 20 minutes, depending on traffic.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 香山公园
summaryEn: At the foot of the Western Hills in Haidian District, Fragrant Hills Park is a former imperial garden of pine and cypress forest, temples and pavilions climbing to Incense Burner Peak. Walk up past Xiangshan Temple, rebuilt and reopened in 2017 after being destroyed in 1860 and 1900, towards the summit; from mid-October to early November the smoke trees turn the slopes red and draw very large crowds.
description: 香山公园，原名静宜园，为中国古代的皇家园林，位于北京市海淀区买卖街40号。北京每年秋季观赏红叶期间，通常会有数十万游客到香山赏红叶。
accessEn: Take Metro Line 10 to Bagou and change to the Xijiao light-rail line, which ends at Fragrant Hills station by the park; a taxi from central Beijing takes about an hour, much longer on autumn weekends.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 潭柘寺
summaryEn: In the hills of Mentougou District, about 30 km west of central Beijing, Tanzhe Temple is an active Buddhist temple whose Ming- and Qing-era halls rise up the slope in terraced courtyards. Follow the central axis up through the Hall of Heavenly Kings and the Mahavira Hall to the Vairocana Pavilion, then explore the side courtyards and the pagoda forest of monks' tombs outside the gate.
description: 岫云禅寺，通称潭柘寺，位于中华人民共和国北京市门头沟区潭柘寺镇潭柘山山腰，在108国道上。它始建于西晋年间，当时叫嘉福寺，是北京市最早的一座寺庙，民间曾有“先有潭柘寺，后有北京城”之说。
accessEn: Take Metro Line 1, 6 or S1 to Pingguoyuan and change to bus 931, which ends at the temple; a taxi from central Beijing takes about an hour.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 周口店北京人遗址
summaryEn: In Fangshan District, about 50 km south-west of central Beijing, the limestone caves of Dragon Bone Hill yielded the fossils of Peking Man, an early human (Homo erectus) who lived here hundreds of thousands of years ago, and the site is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Start at the site museum, with skull casts, stone tools and the story of the excavations, then walk up the hill to Locality 1, the main fossil cave, and the Upper Cave, where much later modern humans lived.
description: 周口店遗址，又称周口店北京人遗址、周口店古人类遗址，位于中华人民共和国北京市西南房山区周口店地区，距北京城区大约50公里。由龙骨山上的一系列洞穴组成，在此发现北京猿人的大量化石，同时也有发现几乎完整的硕鬣狗化石。
highlights: 周口店北京人遗址博物馆
accessEn: Take the Fangshan line to Yancundong, change to the Yanfang line for Raolefu and take bus F80 to the Yuanren Yizhi stop by the site, or allow 1–1.5 hours by taxi from central Beijing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 卢沟桥
summaryEn: Spanning the Yongding River about 15 km south-west of central Beijing, Marco Polo Bridge (Lugou Bridge in Chinese) is a 266-metre granite bridge of eleven arches, first completed in 1192, its balustrades topped by hundreds of carved stone lions in different poses. Cross the bridge, then walk east into Wanping Fortress, a small walled town built in 1638–1640 that holds the Museum of the War of Chinese People's Resistance Against Japanese Aggression.
description: 卢沟桥，中华人民共和国成立前多称芦沟桥，金朝建成时名为广利桥，近代欧洲又称之马可波罗桥，位于中华人民共和国北京市丰台区的永定河上，东距宛平城170米，因横跨卢沟河而得名，是北京市现存古老的石造联拱桥，被誉为“中国古代四大名桥之一”。
highlights: 中国人民抗日战争纪念馆
accessEn: Take Metro Line 16 to its southern terminus, Wanpingcheng, beside Wanping Fortress, with the bridge just west of the fortress; a taxi from central Beijing takes about 30–45 minutes.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 安徽博物院
summaryEn: The Anhui Museum's main Shushan building opened in 2011 and holds about 220,000 objects, from Chu bronzes to Huizhou carving. It is a good primer on Anhui before you visit Huangshan and the old villages. Allow half a day, and use Metro Line 3 to reach it.
description: 安徽博物院又名安徽省博物馆，是中华人民共和国安徽省唯一一家集自然、历史、社教为一体的省级综合类博物馆，庐阳馆位于合肥市庐阳区安庆路268号，占地面积约70亩，蜀山馆位于合肥市蜀山区怀宁路268号，建筑面积4.1万平方米。
accessEn: The Shushan building is on Huaining Road in the south-west of Hefei, served by Provincial Museum station on Metro Line 3. The old Luyang building is a separate branch on Anqing Road, near Sanxiaokou station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 齐云山
summaryEn: Mount Qiyun is one of China's four sacred mountains of Taoism, a range of red sandstone (Danxia) cliffs and peaks rising to 585 m west of Huangshan city. Paths lead past caves, cliff-side temples and shrines, and the mountain holds 305 cliff inscriptions and 232 stone tablets from the Northern Song onwards. It is a calm contrast to the granite crowds of Huangshan.
description: 齐云山，古称白岳，位于中国安徽省休宁县齐云山镇，是中国四大道教名山之一，与黄山、九华山并称皖南三大名山，先后被列为国家重点风景名胜区、国家森林公园、国家地质公园、国家4A级景区。《太平寰宇记》载:“白岳山在(休宁)西四十里”，明嘉靖年间以“一石插天，直入云端，与碧云齐”而改名为齐云山。
accessEn: Qiyunshan town, in Xiuning county, is about 33 km west of Tunxi. Local buses and tourist coaches run from Tunxi in roughly an hour, but the last services back leave in the afternoon, so check, or take a taxi. The old walking route starts at Dengfeng Bridge on the Heng River.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 广州塔
summaryEn: Canton Tower's twisted steel lattice rises above the Pearl River, lit in shifting colours every evening, with a slow Ferris wheel of glass pods circling its very top. Ride up for the skyline, then take a night cruise past the illuminated bridges and towers of the waterfront. Save time and appetite for Guangzhou itself: dim sum, roast goose and the old streets of Xiguan.
description: 广州塔，昵称小蛮腰、扭纹柴或针筒，位于中国广州市海珠区赤岗街道艺洲路赤岗塔附近地面，海拔高程600米，距离珠江南岸125米，与海心沙岛及珠江新城隔江相望。广州塔是一座以观光旅游为主，具有广播电视发射、文化娱乐和城市窗口功能的电波塔，为2010年在广州举行的第十六届亚洲运动会提供转播服务。
accessEn: Metro Line 3 and the APM line stop at Canton Tower station, a short ride from Zhujiang New Town and central Guangzhou. Guangzhou is about an hour from Hong Kong by high-speed train.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙脊梯田
summaryEn: The Longji terraces climb steep hillsides north of Guilin in tight contour lines that shine silver when flooded in spring, turn green in summer and go gold before the autumn harvest. Zhuang and Yao villages of wooden houses sit among the fields, linked by stone paths you can hike between Ping'an, Dazhai and Tiantouzhai.
description: 景区内可游览平安壮寨、九龙五虎观景点、七星伴月观景点。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
accessEn: The terraces are about two hours by bus or car from Guilin. Shuttles run from the ticket gate up to Ping'an and Dazhai villages.

name: 三亚
summaryEn: Sanya sits at the southern tip of Hainan Island, where palm-fringed bays meet warm, clear water. Yalong Bay has the softest sand and calmest swimming, Dadonghai is lively and close to town, and Haitang Bay is lined with big resorts and a vast duty-free mall.
description: 景区内可游览亚龙湾、大东海、海棠湾。图集建议预留2–3 天游览。
accessEn: Sanya Phoenix International Airport has flights from across China and parts of Asia. Yalong Bay is about 40 minutes from the airport by taxi.

name: 洪崖洞
summaryEn: Hongyadong is an 11-storey complex of stilt-house-style buildings clinging to the cliff above the Jialing River, just before it joins the Yangtze, and it lights up gold every evening. It's the most photographed corner of Chongqing, a hilly megacity of bridges, monorails and fiery hotpot, where a street on one level can lead straight onto a rooftop on another.
description: 洪崖洞民俗风貌区，常简称为洪崖洞，是位于中华人民共和国重庆市渝中区的商业景区，由重庆小天鹅集团修建并运营，于2006年正式开放。其主体建筑仿照重庆传统吊脚楼的风格，依山而建，高11层，商业面积5.3万平方米，目前是国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: Hongyadong sits just below the Jiefangbei shopping district in central Chongqing. Xiaoshizi metro station (Lines 1 and 6) is a short walk away.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 成都大熊猫繁育研究基地
summaryEn: The Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding is a landscaped park of bamboo groves and spacious enclosures on the city's northern edge. Adult pandas lounge and eat, red pandas wander through the trees, and in season the nursery holds the year's cubs. Go early: pandas are most active in the cool of the morning, especially around feeding time.
description: 成都大熊猫繁育研究基地位于中华人民共和国四川省成都市成华区熊猫大道1375号，在斧头山侧的浅丘上。是一个集大熊猫科研繁殖、公众教育和教育旅游为一体的研究机构和旅游目的地，也是一个专门从事濒危野生动物研究、繁育、保护教育和教育旅游的非营利性机构。
accessEn: The base is about 30 minutes by taxi from central Chengdu. Metro Line 3 stops at Panda Avenue (Xiongmao Dadao), a short ride from the entrance.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 西江千户苗寨
summaryEn: Xijiang is the largest Miao village in China, two hillsides of dark wooden stilt houses rising above a river and terraced rice fields. Women in festival dress wear towering silver headdresses, and the village stages songs and dances for visitors. Climb to a hilltop viewpoint at dusk to watch thousands of lights come on across the valley.
description: 景区内可游览西江苗族博物馆、手工作坊、噶歌古道。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
accessEn: High-speed trains from Guiyang reach Kaili in under an hour. From Kaili it's about an hour by bus or taxi to Xijiang.

name: 元阳梯田
summaryEn: In the Ailao Mountains of southern Yunnan, the Hani people have sculpted entire mountainsides into rice terraces, some valleys holding thousands of paddies. In winter and early spring the fields are flooded, and at sunrise and sunset they turn into a mosaic of pink, gold and silver mirrors. Mushroom-roofed Hani villages sit among the fields.
description: 红河哈尼梯田是在云南省红河哈尼族彝族自治州，是哈尼族世代耕作的梯田。其历史可追溯至约1300年前，分布范围跨越元阳、红河、金平、绿春四县，总面积约100万亩，其中核心区域集中于元阳县。2013年3月5日，红河哈尼梯田被列入第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
accessEn: Yuanyang's old town of Xinjie is roughly 4–6 hours by road from Kunming, often broken with a stop in the old town of Jianshui. Local buses and drivers link Xinjie to the main viewpoints.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 香格里拉松赞林寺
summaryEn: Ganden Sumtseling, known in Chinese as Songzanlin, is the largest Tibetan Buddhist monastery in Yunnan, its whitewashed halls and gilded roofs climbing a hillside above a small sacred lake. Hundreds of monks live here, and the prayer halls glow with butter lamps and painted murals. Shangri-La's old town, Dukezong, and the lakes and meadows of Pudacuo National Park are close by.
description: 噶丹松赞林，汉名“归化寺”，位于中华人民共和国云南省迪庆藏族自治州香格里拉市建塘镇以北约5公里处，海拔3380米，于1683年建成，为云南省最大的藏传佛教寺庙，属格鲁派。号称“小布达拉宫”。原建筑物于1966年文化大革命时期被摧毁，1982年开始在废墟原址重建。
accessEn: Trains from Lijiang reach Shangri-La in under two hours, and the airport has flights from Kunming. The monastery is a short bus or taxi ride north of town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天坑地缝
summaryEn: Xiaozhai Tiankeng is a sheer-walled sinkhole in Xinglong Town, about 626 m long and 537 m wide, with a depth of 511 to 662 m depending on where you measure. A long staircase leads down into it, and an underground river runs beneath it. Tianjing Gorge, in the same area, is a narrow slot canyon said to be some 37 km long. The area is around 1,200 m above sea level, so it is cooler than the Yangtze valley in summer.
description: 天坑地缝景区位于重庆市奉节县兴隆镇小寨乡，包括小寨天坑与天井峡地缝。
accessEn: The area is in Xinglong Town in southern Fengjie County, about 1.5 hours by road from the county town; hire a car or join a tour from Fengjie, which is about 2 hours by high-speed train from Chongqing North. Check that the site and its transport are running before you go.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 丰都鬼城
summaryEn: Fengdu Ghost City is a hill of temples and shrines on Ming Mountain above the Yangtze, associated in Chinese folk religion and Taoism with the court of the dead. Halls, bridges and gates named after the stages of the afterlife are filled with statues of demons and judges, and some of the tests the dead face are re-enacted for visitors. It is best seen as a theme of living folk belief and popular art, not a haunted house, and is a regular stop for cruise ships.
description: 丰都鬼城，旧名酆都鬼城，位于重庆市下游丰都县的长江北岸，是长江游轮旅客的观光胜地。又称为“幽都”、“中国神曲之乡”，相传是酆都大帝与十殿阎君管理诸鬼之所。
accessEn: Ming Mountain is on the north bank of the Yangtze, across the river from the new Fengdu county town and about 170 km downstream of Chongqing. By road it is roughly two hours; trains from Chongqing North reach Fengdu station in about an hour, from where a taxi or bus takes you to the scenic area.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 重庆中国三峡博物馆
summaryEn: The Three Gorges Museum is Chongqing's main history museum, opened in 2005 on People's Square opposite the People's Auditorium, and a national first-grade museum. Four core galleries cover the Three Gorges, the early Ba-Yu region, the growth of Chongqing as a city and its wartime years, and much of the collection comes from excavations in the area later flooded by the Three Gorges reservoir. It is the best single place to make sense of the Yangtze region before you head upriver.
description: 重庆中国三峡博物馆位于中华人民共和国重庆市渝中区上清寺附近，与重庆市人民大礼堂隔人民广场相对而立，与重庆市人民政府驻地相邻。是国家文物局指定的国家一级博物馆。
accessEn: On People's Square in Shangqingsi, Yuzhong District, about 500 m from Zengjiayan station (Lines 2 and 10) and People's Auditorium (Dalitang) station (Line 10). From Jiefangbei it is a short metro or taxi ride.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 重庆人民大礼堂
summaryEn: The People's Auditorium is a large assembly hall built in 1951–54, with a round domed hall inspired by Beijing's Temple of Heaven, colonnaded wings, red columns and blue-green glazed tile roofs. The auditorium seats about 4,200 people and sits on a broad terrace above People's Square, which is the best place to see its symmetrical front. It is one of the city's best-known buildings and an easy stop beside the Three Gorges Museum.
description: 重庆市人民大礼堂位于重庆市渝中区上清寺至学田湾附近，是一座仿古民族建筑群，重庆市的标志性建筑之一。2013年3月5日列为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
accessEn: On Renmin Road in Shangqingsi, Yuzhong District, about 200 m from People's Auditorium (Dalitang) station on Metro Line 10, a short ride from Jiefangbei.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 磁器口古镇
summaryEn: Ciqikou, 'Porcelain Mouth', is a former river port on the Jialing River whose name recalls the Ming and Qing pottery trade, now a busy pedestrian quarter of 12 flagstone lanes lined with old-style shops, tea houses and snack stalls. Among its timber houses are Baolun Temple, a Wenchang Palace and several listed Qing-era homes, and by the old wharf stands the 'Little Chongqing' stone inscribed by Lin Sen. It is crowded at weekends but gives a taste of old river-port Chongqing.
description: 磁器口古镇，原名瓷器口镇、白崖镇、白岩场镇、龙隐镇，位于重庆市沙坪坝区，比邻嘉陵江。自明、清时期以来磁器口一直是重要的水陆码头，为嘉陵江下游物资集散地。磁器口是重庆主城区内少有的能领略老重庆风味的地方，被称为“小重庆”。
accessEn: In Shapingba District on the Jialing River, about 12 km west of Jiefangbei; take Metro Line 1 to Ciqikou station, or a taxi from the centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 白鹤梁水下博物馆
summaryEn: The museum is built around White Crane Ridge, a rock ledge in the Yangtze off Fuling that showed above water only in the driest seasons and bears some 170 inscriptions and carved fish recording low river levels since AD 764. When the Three Gorges reservoir submerged the ridge, it was enclosed in a shell of filtered water about 40 m down; you ride a 91 m escalator to a gallery and look at the carvings through 23 portholes. The museum opened in 2009 as the first of its kind in China.
description: 白鹤梁是中华人民共和国重庆市涪陵区城北长江中的一道天然石梁。在丰水期被水淹没，在枯水期露出水面。唐朝人在石梁上雕刻石鱼，后人在石梁上题刻文字，内容多涉及当年的石鱼出水高度。
accessEn: On Binjiang Avenue by the Yangtze in Fuling District, about 1.5 hours by road from central Chongqing; trains from Chongqing North to Fuling North take about 40 minutes to an hour (Ctrip listing), then a taxi into town. It makes a day trip from Chongqing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 钓鱼城
summaryEn: Diaoyu Fortress is a Southern Song mountain fortress on Diaoyu Hill, a peninsula where the Jialing, Qu and Fu rivers meet east of Hechuan, which resisted Mongol armies for 36 years from 1243. The Mongol Great Khan Möngke died during his siege of it in 1259; its stone walls and gates, naval wharf and other remains form one of the best-preserved Song battlefield sites in China, now a national archaeological park. It is a good place for a walk with long river views.
description: 钓鱼城遗址位于重庆市合川区城区东面5公里的嘉陵江南岸钓鱼山上，是南宋四川置制司抗蒙山城之一。1259年2月，南宋军队于此抗击蒙古军，击杀蒙古大汗蒙哥，史称钓鱼城之战。合川钓鱼城被称为“迄今中国保存最为完好”的古战场遗址。
accessEn: In Hechuan District, about 5 km east of central Hechuan across the Jialing River, by taxi or local bus. Trains from Chongqing North to Hechuan take roughly 25–40 minutes (Ctrip listing), or about an hour by road; check 12306.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 泉州古城：开元寺与清净寺
summaryEn: Quanzhou's old city holds the heart of the Song–Yuan port that medieval travellers called Zayton, and most of its sights belong to the Quanzhou World Heritage listing. Kaiyuan Temple on West Street, founded in 686, is the anchor: its twin five-storey granite pagodas, rebuilt in stone between 1228 and 1250 at about 48 m and 44 m, are described on zh.wikipedia as the tallest pair of stone pagodas in China. A walk south takes in Qingjing Mosque, the Confucian Temple, Tianhou Temple and the excavated Deji Gate, Buddhist, Islamic, Confucian and Mazu worship and an old port gate, all within one compact old quarter.
description: 开元寺位于中国福建省泉州市鲤城区西街，是始建于唐代的汉传佛教寺院，1982年被列为第二批全国重点文物保护单位，1982年被列为汉族地区佛教全国重点寺院。
highlights: 大雄宝殿与印度教石刻
accessEn: Kaiyuan Temple stands on West Street in the north-west of the old city; city buses stop at Kaiyuan Temple West Gate (开元寺西门), and the other sights run south from it for about 2 km. Quanzhou is about 30–40 minutes by high-speed train from Xiamen and about 40–50 minutes from Fuzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 洛阳桥与安平桥
summaryEn: Two granite beam bridges from the Song dynasty, both components of the Quanzhou World Heritage site, show the engineering that supported the port. Luoyang Bridge, finished in 1059, crosses a tidal river mouth by way of a mid-river islet and is lined with Song guardian figures, small pagodas and inscribed stelae. Anping Bridge, on the far side of Quanzhou and more than 2 km long, is regarded as the longest ancient stone bridge surviving in China.
description: 景区内可游览洛阳桥、蔡忠惠公祠、安平桥。图集建议预留一天游览。
accessEn: Luoyang Bridge is about 10 km north-east of central Quanzhou by city bus or taxi. Anping Bridge lies between Anhai and Shuitou, about 30 km south-west of the centre by road; local buses serve the Anhai end, but a taxi or ride-hailing car is easier. Quanzhou is about 30–40 minutes by high-speed train from Xiamen and about 40–50 minutes from Fuzhou.

name: 崇武古城
summaryEn: A coastal garrison town, built from 1387 to guard the coast against wokou pirates, and regarded as the most complete stone sea-wall town surviving in China. The granite walls, about 2.5 km round and 7 m high with some 1,300 crenellations, watchtowers and four gates, were restored in the 1980s. They enclose lived-in lanes of old stone houses, temples and ancestral halls, with the sea on the other side.
description: 崇武古城，又称崇武守御千户所城，位于中华人民共和国福建省泉州市惠安县崇武镇，全国重点文物保护单位，是中国现存最完整的花岗岩滨海石城。全城周长“周围七百八十三丈，计四里零六步”2567米，南北长500米，东西宽300米，基宽5米，墙高7米，有窝铺26座，城堞1304个，箭窗1300个，总面积约50万平方米。
accessEn: In Chongwu town at the eastern tip of the Hui'an coast, about 45 km east of central Quanzhou, roughly an hour by road; a taxi, ride-hailing car or the intercity buses from Quanzhou all work.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鼓山
summaryEn: A forested mountain on Fuzhou's eastern edge, rising to 919 m, whose slopes hold Yongquan Temple, founded in 783, and more than 300 inscriptions carved into the rock from the Song dynasty onwards, among them calligraphy by Cai Xiang and Zhu Xi. Two Northern Song pottery pagodas stand in front of the temple, and paths link it with viewpoints and scenic spots such as Heshui Rock. It is the easiest real mountain day from Fuzhou's centre.
description: 鼓山是中华人民共和国福建省福州市晋安区的一座山。其北面为鼓岭，南面是闽江，东面是大磨溪，西面为福州平原，整座山南北长6公里，东西宽4公里，一般高度在700-800米，最高峰为海拔919.1米的大顶峰。
accessEn: About 10 km east of central Fuzhou; a road climbs to Yongquan Temple, roughly 30 minutes by taxi from the city centre. Local buses and tourist shuttles also serve the mountain; check the current route before you set out.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 培田古村
summaryEn: Peitian is a Hakka village of the Wu clan in Xuanhe, Liancheng, founded in the late Yuan and early Ming. Its present buildings date from the Ming and Qing, many rebuilt in the late Qing, and its lanes are lined with large family mansions, ancestral halls, private academies, memorial arches and temples. It sits in a small basin with a stream curving round its eastern side, and was named a Chinese Historical and Cultural Village in 2005.
description: 培田村位于中国福建省连城县宣和乡，是一个客家古村落，居民多为吴姓。培田村于2005年被列为中国历史文化名村，培田村古建筑群于2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。连城培田古村于全国旅游景区质量等级评定委员会发布2012年第12号公告中被评为国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: Peitian is in Xuanhe township, south-west of Liancheng town, roughly 40 minutes by road. Liancheng town is the practical base; Longyan is the gateway city, about 1.5 to 2 hours' drive from Longyan to Liancheng.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 拉卜楞寺
summaryEn: Founded in 1709 beside the Daxia River, Labrang is one of the six great monasteries of the Gelug school of Tibetan Buddhism and still a working centre of monastic study, organised in six colleges. Gilded roofs, white-walled halls and monks in maroon robes fill the valley, while pilgrims circle the whole complex along a corridor of prayer wheels. It is one of the most atmospheric places in Gansu to watch Tibetan religious life at close quarters.
description: 景区内可游览大经堂、弥勒佛殿、释迦牟尼佛殿。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: Xiahe is about four hours by road from Lanzhou, with direct buses; from Hezuo it is roughly an hour. The monastery sits on the western edge of town, within walking distance of most guesthouses.
imageCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Mrfish33~commonswiki assumed (based on copyright clai

name: 敦煌雅丹国家地质公园
summaryEn: Far northwest of Dunhuang, the wind has carved the Gobi into a maze of long clay ridges and towers called yardangs, covering around 400 km² in northern and southern zones. Locals call it the Ghost Town for the way the formations loom like ruined buildings and the wind howls through them. The national geopark is part of the Dunhuang UNESCO Global Geopark, approved in 2015, and the late-afternoon light on the formations is hard to beat.
description: 敦煌雅丹国家地质公园，也被称为魔鬼城，位于中国甘肃敦煌玉门关西北，距离敦煌达180公里，雅丹地貌的总面积达400多平方公里。
accessEn: The park is roughly 160–180 km north-west of Dunhuang (sources differ), beyond Yumen Pass; the usual way is a hired car, taxi or day tour taking about 2.5–3 hours each way. Direct buses are reported but limited and change, so check the current timetable first.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黄河石林
summaryEn: Tall conglomerate pillars and spires, mostly 80–100 m high and packed into around 10 km² of gullies, rise where the Loess Plateau meets the edge of the Tengger Desert. The pillars are the main draw, with the Yinma Gorge and river viewpoints, and you can float the Yellow River on a traditional sheepskin raft. The cliffs have served as a backdrop for many Chinese films and TV dramas, and the national geopark was approved in 2004.
description: 黄河石林国家地质公园是位于中国甘肃省白银市景泰县境内的一处景区。公园面积约50平方千米，其中古石林群10平方公里。是国家AAAA级旅游景区，2004年1月批准为国家地质公园。
accessEn: By road it is roughly two hours from Lanzhou north-east to Jingtai county; a charter or self-drive is easiest, as public transport needs transfers and a local ride to the park.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 伏羲庙
summaryEn: The temple is dedicated to Fuxi, the legendary forefather of Chinese civilisation, and its courtyards run along one axis from an opera stage across the road through a memorial archway, gate and ceremonial gate to the double-eaved Xiantian Hall, which holds a painted statue of Fuxi, and the Taiji Hall behind it. Old cypresses shade the grounds, and the Fuxi City streets lie just outside. Tianshui's municipal museum shares the grounds.
description: 伏羲庙位于中国甘肃省天水市秦州区伏羲路，1963年被列为甘肃省文物保护单位，2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。伏羲庙始建于元至正七年，经明弘治、嘉靖年间大规模扩建形成现有格局，清嘉庆、光绪年间曾大修。
accessEn: In the old centre of Qinzhou District, central Tianshui, a short bus or taxi ride from most hotels. Tianshui South station is about 1.5 to 2 hours by high-speed train from Lanzhou and from Xi'an.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 阳关
summaryEn: Yangguan, the Sunny Gate, was the Han dynasty pass that guarded the southern Silk Road route west of Dunhuang, fortified around 120 BC; the fort itself had fallen into ruin by about AD 900. What remains is a beacon tower on a rise above an oasis, with the Yangguan Museum beside the site telling the story of the passes. Come for the view across the desert and for the poetry.
description: 阳关，位于中国西北的甘肃省境内，离古代中国最西端的行政中心敦煌市西南约60公里。阳关始建于汉武帝时期，公元前120年左右加固，用作边防前哨，为古代丝绸之路的重要关卡，是古代陆路交通的咽喉之地，把守着通往西域的南路。
accessEn: Yang Pass is about 60–70 km south-west of Dunhuang (sources vary), roughly an hour by taxi or charter car. It is promoted together with Yumen Pass as one tourism area, but the two lie in opposite directions from Dunhuang, so visit each from the city. Public transport is limited.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 锁阳城遗址
summaryEn: Suoyang City is the ruin of a walled Silk Road city in the Gobi south-east of Guazhou, seat of Guazhou prefecture under the Tang and abandoned in the 16th century. The rammed-earth walls of the inner city still stand 9–12.5 m high, and the archaeological park takes in the Ta'er Temple ruins, ancient irrigation canals and more than 2,000 tombs. It is part of the Silk Roads World Heritage listing (2014), and the sense of emptiness is the draw.
description: 锁阳城遗址，位于中国甘肃省酒泉市瓜州县锁阳城镇南坝村，河西走廊西端，现为全国重点文物保护单位。锁阳城遗址始建于汉代，兴于唐代，名字来源于当地盛产的锁阳草，1524年因嘉峪关闭关而废弃。锁阳城是中国保存最完好的汉唐古城之一，包含古城址、古河道、古寺院、古墓葬、古垦区等多种遗迹。
accessEn: About an hour by road south-east of Guazhou county town; there is little public transport, so most people use a taxi, charter car or a Dunhuang day tour that pairs it with the Yulin Caves.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 张掖大佛寺
summaryEn: The temple was founded in 1098 under the Western Xia, and its two-storey Great Buddha Hall shelters a painted clay reclining Buddha about 35 m long, often described as the largest indoor reclining Buddha in China, with his ten disciples standing behind him. The temple also houses a museum, and the scenic area takes in the earthen Mituo Qianfo stupa (about 33 m tall) and the Shanxi Guild Hall next door, built by Shanxi merchants in the early 18th century with a gateway stage and a timber memorial arch.
description: 张掖大佛寺位于中国甘肃省张掖市甘州区民主西街大佛寺巷，始建于西夏永安元年，原名迦叶如来寺，明永乐九年敕名宝觉寺，清康熙十七年敕改宏仁寺，因寺内有巨大的卧佛像故名大佛寺，又名睡佛寺，1996年被列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。
accessEn: The temple is in the old centre of Zhangye, about 800 m south of the Drum Tower, and easy to reach on foot or by city bus. Zhangye West is on the Lanzhou–Ürümqi high-speed line, with a city bus or taxi into the old town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 马蹄寺石窟群
summaryEn: Mati Temple, the 'Horse-Hoof Temple', is a cluster of Buddhist cave sanctuaries in the green Qilian foothills of Sunan Yugur Autonomous County, near Mati Tibetan Township. Its caves are spread out along the valleys, from the cliff-hugging tiers of the North Temple to the Thousand Buddha Caves and the more distant Jinta Temple, and the surrounding slopes are summer pasture. It is a rewarding day out from Zhangye, easily paired with the Danxia landscapes.
description: 马蹄寺石窟群，位于中华人民共和国甘肃省张掖市肃南裕固族自治县境内，是包括马蹄北寺、马蹄南寺、千佛洞、金塔寺、上观音洞、中观音洞、下观音洞等7处洞窟群在内的石窟群。该石窟群始建于五胡十六国时期，最晚持续至清朝年间。
accessEn: The grottoes are about 60–65 km south of Zhangye by road, roughly 1–1.5 hours; most visitors go by taxi, charter car or a Zhangye day tour, since public transport is sparse. Allow a full day if you travel there and back from Zhangye.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 扎尕那
summaryEn: Zhagana is a cluster of Tibetan villages inside a natural 'stone city' of limestone peaks north of Têwo (Diebu) county town; the name is Tibetan for 'stone box'. Wooden houses, barley-drying racks and terraced fields sit under cliffs and spruce forest, with footpaths and viewpoints above the villages. It is one of the most photogenic places in Gannan and a fine base for short hikes.
description: 扎尕那是中国甘肃省甘南藏族自治州迭部县益哇镇的一个村落。扎尕那是藏语音译，意思是石匣子。1925年夏天，探险家约瑟夫·洛克在迭部采集植物，他写道：“靠山边栖息着一座寺院叫拉桑寺，在它下面是迭部人的村庄，房子挨着房子，还有小麦和青稞的梯田，在所有这些的后面，就是巨大的石灰岩山，郁郁葱葱的云杉和冷杉布满峡谷和坡地。
accessEn: About 30 km north of Têwo county town by road, under an hour by taxi or shared car; there is no railway in Gannan, so reach Têwo by long-distance coach or car from Lanzhou or Hezuo and check current times. Carry your passport for checkpoints.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 陈家祠
summaryEn: Built in 1888–94 with funds from Chen clans across Guangdong's 72 counties, this combined ancestral hall and academy gave lodging to clan members sitting the imperial examinations in Guangzhou. Its symmetrical complex of halls and courtyards is famous for the density of its decoration, with carvings in wood, stone and brick, ceramic roof ridges, plaster mouldings and cast ironwork. It now houses the Guangdong Folk Art Museum, so it doubles as a compact introduction to Cantonese craft.
description: 陈家祠位于中华人民共和国广东省广州市荔湾区金花街道陈家祠社区中山七路恩龙里34号，始建于清朝光绪十四年，是当时广东省七十二县陈姓宗亲合资兴建的合族宗祠。陈家祠是集岭南历代建筑艺术之大成的典型代表，以装饰精巧、堂皇富丽而著称于世。
accessEn: On Zhongshan 7th Road in Liwan District, right beside Chen Clan Academy station on Metro Lines 1 and 8, so it is a few stops from most central Guangzhou hotels.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南越王博物院
summaryEn: The museum is built over the stone tomb of Zhao Mo, second king of Nanyue, who ruled from Guangzhou in the second century BC; it was found in 1983 when a hill was cut down for building work, and visitors can go down into the burial chambers. Its galleries show the finds, among them the king's jade burial suit sewn with silk thread and his gold seal, together with bronzes, jades and a large donated collection of ceramic pillows from the Tang dynasty onwards. A second exhibition area, the Nanyue Palace site on Zhongshan 4th Road, displays the excavated palace garden with its stone pool and winding stone watercourse, along with remains of later palaces and government offices.
description: 南越王博物院王墓展区位于中华人民共和国广东省广州市越秀区六榕街道解放北路867号，是在第二代南越王赵眜的陵寝原址上修建的博物馆，简称南博。博物馆占地面积为14000平方米，建筑面积约8500平方米，是一座遗址博物馆，为南越王博物院的展区之一。
accessEn: The tomb area is on Jiefang North Road beside Yuexiu Park station on Metro Line 2 (Exit E); the palace area is about 1.5 km south-east on Zhongshan 4th Road, near Gongyuanqian station on Lines 1 and 2.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 永庆坊
summaryEn: Yongqingfang is a block of old Xiguan lanes off Enning Road that was renovated by the district government and Vanke and opened in 2016 as a pedestrian quarter of shops, cafés and studios among old houses. The area was a centre of Cantonese opera in the 1920s and 1930s, and it includes the ancestral house of Bruce Lee's family and the Cantonese Opera Art Museum, a new garden complex in traditional style with a stage for regular performances.
description: 永庆坊为中国广东广州一个南北走向的内街创意园区，位于荔湾区恩洲社区一带，南起恩宁路，北至荔枝湾涌与粤剧艺术博物馆附近。创意园区前身为永庆大街、永庆一巷和永庆二巷。2012年，由荔湾区人民政府与万科合作开发。
accessEn: On Enning Road in Liwan District, in the old Xiguan quarter west of the centre, a short walk from Huangsha station on Metro Lines 1 and 6.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 越秀公园
summaryEn: Yuexiu Park covers Yuexiu Hill, the low hill that formed the northern end of the old walled city. Its landmark is Zhenhai Tower, a five-storey Ming-origin tower that houses the Guangzhou Museum's history gallery, while the Five Rams statue, the Sun Yat-sen memorial obelisk and a stretch of the Ming city wall lie along the paths. It is the easiest way to see old Guangzhou, its symbols and a green hill in one outing.
description: 越秀山，亦称粤秀山、越王山、观音山，是广东省广州市中心的一座历史悠久的山脉，海拔70米，是白云山的余脉。
accessEn: On Jiefang North Road in Yuexiu District, beside Yuexiu Park station on Metro Line 2; Line 5 Xiaobei station is another entrance.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 佛山祖庙
summaryEn: Foshan Ancestral Temple is a Daoist temple to the Northern Emperor (Beidi), the water god revered as Foshan's protector, founded in the Northern Song (1078–1085), rebuilt in 1372 and restored throughout in 1899. Its Ming and Qing buildings include the Wanfu Stage of 1658, regarded as the largest old opera stage in the Lingnan region, the Lingying archway and a main hall with bronze and cast-iron ritual objects, all richly decorated with carving and ceramic ridge figures. The complex is now a national first-grade museum that also takes in a Confucian temple and halls devoted to Wong Fei-hung and Ip Man.
description: 佛山祖庙位于中国广东省佛山市禅城区祖庙街道祖庙路21号，是一座供奉道教玄天大帝的神庙。整个佛山祖庙博物馆由祖庙古建筑群、孔庙、黄飞鸿纪念馆、叶问堂等组成，占地3.2万平方米，现为全国重点文物保护单位、国家一级博物馆、国家AAAA级旅游景区、广东省文明旅游区示范点、广东省中华文化传承基地、广东十个文明旅游景区示范点、广东省爱国主义教育基地、佛山市爱国主义教育基地。
accessEn: From Guangzhou take the Guangfo metro line to Zumiao station, a short walk from the temple on Zumiao Road in Chancheng, central Foshan. A taxi from central Guangzhou is the alternative.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 清晖园
summaryEn: Qinghui Garden is one of the four great classical gardens of Guangdong, created in Daliang by five generations of the Long family on the site of a Ming garden. It was given its name in 1806. Its 0.34-hectare plot holds a southern water garden around a square pond, a central area of pavilions, a boat hall and studies, and a northern residential quarter of bamboo courts. The open front and denser back suit the hot climate, and the buildings are rich in fretwork wood carving and brick carving.
description: 清晖园位于广东省佛山市顺德区大良街道清晖路23号，建于清嘉庆年间。为广东四大名园之一，岭南园林的代表。1989年被列入广东省文物保护单位名录，2013年3月被列入列入第七批全国重点文物保护单位，是国家AAAA级旅游景区。
accessEn: The garden is on Qinghui Road in Daliang, the centre of Shunde District, about 25 km south of central Foshan. Shunde station on the Guangzhou–Zhuhai intercity railway is a short taxi ride away; city buses also reach the garden.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 潮州古城与广济桥
summaryEn: Chaozhou's old town packs the Han River's Guangji Bridge, the archway-lined Paifang Street, lanes of Ming and Qing courtyard houses, a gilded-woodcarving ancestral hall and the Tang-founded Kaiyuan Temple into a few compact blocks. It is the best place in Guangdong to feel Teochew (Chaoshan) culture at walking pace, and the food alone justifies an overnight stay.
description: 广济桥，俗称湘子桥，是位于广东省潮州市湘桥区东门外韩江上的桥梁。与赵县赵州桥、惠安县洛阳桥及北京市卢沟桥并称“中国四大古桥”，集拱桥、梁桥及浮桥于一体，为中国第一座启闭式浮桥。广济桥为古代闽粤交通要道。
accessEn: Take a high-speed train to Chaoshan station: about 2 hours from Shenzhen and roughly 2½–3 hours from Guangzhou. From there a city bus or taxi takes roughly 40–45 minutes to the old town, where the main sights are within walking distance of one another.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 芦笛岩
summaryEn: A show cave on the north-western edge of Guilin where a lit path of about 500 m winds through chambers of stalactites, stalagmites and columns. It is a good wet-weather alternative to the Li River cruise (see Li River & Yangshuo), and its walls hold more than 70 ink inscriptions from visitors over the centuries. Most visitors treat it as a short, easy outing from the city.
description: 芦笛岩位于广西桂林市西北郊的芦笛公园内的光明山上，因为其洞口长有可以做芦笛的芦笛草得名。芦笛岩常与七星岩并称为芦笛七星岩，是桂林山水的一颗璀璨明珠。
accessEn: The cave is on the Taohua River about 5 km north-west of central Guilin, roughly 15 minutes by taxi or city bus. Tour groups often pair it with the lakes or Elephant Trunk Hill.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 灵渠
summaryEn: Dug on the First Emperor's orders between 219 and 214 BC, the Lingqu carried troops and supplies south by linking the Xiang River, which flows towards the Yangtze, with the Li River and the Pearl River system across a low watershed. Its working parts still stand in and beside Xing'an town: a ploughshare-shaped stone spur, angled overflow dams, a tree-lined Qin embankment and old lock gates along the 36.4 km of the North and South channels. It is a quiet, walkable place to see how a 2,200-year-old piece of engineering was meant to work, and in 2018 it was added to the ICID's list of World Heritage Irrigation Structures, an irrigation-engineering honour separate from UNESCO World Heritage.
description: 灵渠，又名湘桂运河、兴安运河，俗称为陡河，位于广西壮族自治区桂林市兴安县境内，是世界上最古老的运河之一，是目前所知世界上最古老的盘山渠道，也是中国古代著名的水利工程。它开凿于秦代，沟通长江水系的湘江和珠江水系的漓江，自古以来是岭南地区与中原地区之间的水路交通要道。
accessEn: Xing'an is about 60 km north-east of Guilin, an hour or so by road; the high-speed train from Guilin North to Xing'an North takes roughly 25–30 minutes, then the station is several kilometres from the canal, so continue by taxi or local bus. Check the current timetable on 12306 or a booking app.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 通灵大峡谷
summaryEn: A deep, forest-filled gorge in Huru town near the Vietnamese border, entered by a stairway that drops through old trees into a cave about 100 m high and on to Tongling Falls, a single 188.6 m drop into a pool fed by an underground river. More than 2,300 plant species, including tree ferns, grow in the gorge, and an underground-river tunnel leads on to the farmed Nianba Gorge. It makes a good second day after Detian Waterfall (see Detian Waterfall), a short drive away.
description: 景区内可游览下谷石阶、通灵大瀑布、地下河与念八峡。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Jingxi city is about 30 km away: buses to Huru town take around half an hour, and you get off at the Tongling junction, about 1.5 km from the gate, then walk 15–20 minutes or take a motorbike taxi. Nanning to Jingxi is roughly 3.5 to 4 hours by coach, and the canyon is about an hour's drive from Detian Waterfall. Return buses thin out in the afternoon, so check times with the driver or plan a taxi back.

name: 广西壮族自治区博物馆
summaryEn: Founded in 1934 and a national first-grade museum, the Guangxi Museum reopened on Minzu Square at the end of November 2022 after nearly four years of rebuilding, in a new building of about 33,000 m² with about 10,000 m² of galleries. Its largest gallery traces Guangxi's history from Palaeolithic hand axes about 800,000 years old to the Ming and Qing dynasties, and the collection includes bronze drums such as the Western Han drum with flying egrets from Luobowan. Other displays cover porcelain, Hepu and the Han-era maritime Silk Road, and the region's bronze-drum culture.
description: 广西壮族自治区博物馆，简称广西博物馆或桂博，是位于中华人民共和国广西壮族自治区南宁市民族广场东侧的综合性历史和艺术博物馆。博物馆现有总建筑面积约4.2万平方米，展陈面积约1万平方米。馆藏文物近十万件，涵盖青铜器、陶瓷器、书画、古籍、民族文物等门类。
accessEn: At 34 Minzu Avenue on the east side of Minzu Square, in central Nanning, close to Minzu Square metro station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 肇兴侗寨
summaryEn: Zhaoxing is one of China's largest Dong villages, in Zhaoxing town in the south of Liping County, and is a 4A-rated scenic area. Its houses are grouped into five clan districts named Ren, Yi, Li, Zhi and Xin, each with its own drum tower, wind-and-rain bridge and opera stage. Performers sing Dong Grand Song beneath the drum towers for visitors.
description: 景区内可游览五座鼓楼、花桥、戏台。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: High-speed trains from Guiyang North reach Congjiang station in about 1.5 hours; Zhaoxing is only about 5 km away, roughly 15 minutes by scenic-area shuttle bus or taxi.

name: 中国天眼
summaryEn: The world's largest single-dish radio telescope: a 500 m dish built into a natural karst bowl at Dawodang in Pingtang county, completed in September 2016. Visitors see it from the scenic area's viewing deck and can visit the Nan Rendong Memorial Hall (named for its chief scientist) and an astronomy experience hall, with an XR centre and a dome film theatre alongside. It is a working observatory, so only the visitor areas are open.
description: 景区内可游览观景台、南仁东纪念馆、天文体验馆。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 球幕飞行影院与元宇宙XR体验中心
accessEn: The site is in Kedu town, Pingtang county, about 84 km from the county seat and about 180 km (roughly 3 hours' drive) from Guiyang. The scenic area lists a coach from Guiyang's Jinyang bus station (3–4 hours) and a direct bus from near Guiyang North station that has been suspended and resumed in the past, so check current services.

name: 郎德上寨
summaryEn: Upper Langde (Langde Shangzhai) is a Miao village of more than 100 households in Langde town, Leishan, set against a hillside and facing a stream. Its two- and three-storey timber stilt houses stand around a bronze-drum plaza used for gatherings and dances, and a 40 m wind-and-rain bridge crosses the stream in front. It is much smaller and calmer than nearby Xijiang, and works well as a short, unhurried first look at a Miao village.
description: 上郎德村又称郎德上寨，位于中国贵州省雷山县郎德镇，是苗族聚居的村寨，1986年被国家文物局列为全国第一座露天苗族风情博物馆，1997年被文化部授予“中国民间艺术之乡”，2001年郎德上寨古建筑群被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位，2010年被列为第五批中国历史文化名村。
accessEn: In Langde town, about 30 km by road from central Kaili, roughly 30 minutes by car or taxi; Kaili is under an hour from Guiyang by high-speed train.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 双河洞
summaryEn: Shuanghedong is a cave system in the dolomite hills of Suiyang county, surveyed to about 440 km (439.7 km in the October 2025 survey), which makes it the longest cave in Asia and the third longest in the world. Only a small part is open: visitors can walk a lit route along an elevated path, past an underground river, waterfalls, lakes and rimstone pools, and activities include a cave via ferrata and cave concerts. Curled stone and gypsum flowers are among the features, and the remains of more than 40 giant pandas have been found in the cave. China added it to its World Heritage tentative list in 2025.
description: 双河洞位于中华人民共和国贵州省遵义市绥阳县温泉镇桂花村和铜鼓村境内，因洞外有两条河流在铜鼓村交汇，因而得名。截止2025年10月，双河洞已探明长度为439.7公里，深度约917米，是中国第一长洞，也是世界最长的白云岩洞穴，世界面积最大的天青石沉积洞穴。
accessEn: Shuanghedong is in Wenquan town, Suiyang county, about 1.5 hours' drive from Zunyi; Zunyi is the nearest large hub and is reached by train or road from Guiyang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 海龙屯
summaryEn: Hailongtun is the ruined mountain stronghold of the Yang family, hereditary tusi (chiefs) of Bozhou, begun in 1257 under the Southern Song and taken by Ming forces in 1600. Cliffs guard it on every side, and stone gates and about 5.6 km of walls survive on Longyan mountain, enclosing around 1.6 sq km. It is one of the three Tusi Sites inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2015, and a good half-day hike from Zunyi.
description: 海龙屯或海龙囤位于中国贵州省遵义市汇川区高坪街道白沙村龙岩山上的一个带有军事防御的土司城址，始建于南宋末年抗元时期，被视为当今中国保存程度最好的中世纪城堡遗址，在贵州历史上也占有重要的地位。自876年杨端据播州时始建，经历杨氏土司凡27世，直到1600年平播之役时被灭，此后海龙囤成为遗迹长期掩埋在历史中直到20世纪末被文物工作者再次发现。
highlights: 三十六步天梯与飞虎关
accessEn: The site is in Gaoping subdistrict, Huichuan district, about 20 km north-west of central Zunyi in a straight line, a drive of well under an hour by taxi or hired car. High-speed trains from Guiyang North reach Zunyi in about an hour.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 茅台酒镇
summaryEn: Maotai is the town on the Chishui River where Moutai baijiu is made; distilleries there date back to the early 19th century. The tourist district is the renovated riverside old town, where you can walk the streets, learn about baijiu at the exhibition halls, taste local spirits in shops and see the town lit up at night. It suits travellers who want to see a distilling town at work and the river valley around it.
description: 景区内可游览茅台古镇、中国酒文化城、赤水河夜景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Maotai is about 10–15 km from the centre of Renhuai city, which in turn is roughly 1.5 hours by road from Zunyi, with coaches to Renhuai and local minibuses on to the town. Zunyi Maotai Airport lies in Renhuai, about 16 km from the city centre.

name: 海口火山口公园
summaryEn: The Haikou section of the Leiqiong Global Geopark sits on a lava plateau south of the city, which has more than 40 Quaternary volcanoes, the youngest of which erupted in the Holocene. The visitor area centres on the Maanling group of four neighbouring cones, where the main cone, Fenglu Ling, can be climbed for views over Haikou and the Qiongzhou Strait. Along the way you see ropy and wood-grained lava surfaces, basalt columns and lava tubes.
description: 海口石山火山群国家地质公园，又称海口火山口公园、海口雷琼火山群世界地质公园、中国雷琼世界地质公园海口园区，是位于中华人民共和国海南省海口市石山镇的一个地质公园，是中华人民共和国唯一的热带火山地质公园，为国家4A级景区。
accessEn: The park is in Shishan town, Xiuying district, about 13 km south of Haikou. A taxi or ride-hailing car is the easiest way from the city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东寨港红树林
summaryEn: Dongzhai Harbor holds a national nature reserve of mangrove wetland on Haikou's north-east coast, with about 36 species of mangrove. The visitor area has a boardwalk of about 1,700 m in three sections out over the water, a 33.5 m tower for a view over the forest and electric boats that glide through the channels. At high tide the mangroves are submerged to their crowns, at low tide the roots stand exposed, and in winter the reserve fills with migratory birds.
description: 海南东寨港国家级自然保护区位于中国海南省海口市美兰区演丰镇东寨港西侧。是中国建立的第一个红树林湿地自然保护区，也是中国首批列入《国际重要湿地名录》的七个湿地保护区之一。总面积为3,337.6公顷，其中红树林面积1,771.1公顷，滩涂与浅海湿地1,558.7公顷，大陆陆域7.8公顷。
accessEn: Dongzhai Harbor is in Yanfeng town, Meilan district, roughly 30–40 km east-south-east of central Haikou, and most visitors go by taxi, ride-hailing car or self-drive. Public transport is slow and indirect, so it is easiest to arrange a car there and back.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中国（海南）南海博物馆
summaryEn: This large museum stands beside the fishing harbour at Tanmen, opened in April 2018, with about 70,000 square metres of floor space. Its exhibitions cover the maritime history of the South China Sea, navigation technology, marine life, the ancient Maritime Silk Road and the history of fishing in these waters, and they include finds from underwater archaeology such as cargo recovered from shipwrecks. The building, designed by He Jingtang, is shaped to resemble a boat floating on the sea.
description: 中国南海博物馆是位于中华人民共和国海南省琼海市潭门镇的一座博物馆，主要展示南海及海上丝路历史文化与自然资源等展览。南海博物馆占地面积150亩，建筑面积70,593平方米。2016年5月，海南省委、省政府响应中国国务院和国家发改委关于“海南国际旅游岛”建设文件，启动南海博物馆建设项目；2018年4月26日，正式开馆。
accessEn: Tanmen is about 14 km east-south-east of Jiaji, the Qionghai city seat, and about 9 km from the resort town of Bo'ao. A taxi or ride-hailing car is the usual way for the last stretch.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 苍岩山
summaryEn: Mount Cangyan is a wooded gorge in the Taihang foothills where the Fuqing Temple complex is built into the cliffs, its Bridge-Tower Hall carried on a stone arch spanning a narrow cleft high above the valley floor. The temple is a national heritage unit, and a stepped path climbs from it towards the summit. The scenery was used in the film Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon (2000), and the bridge hall is counted among China's best-known cliff-hanging temples.
description: 苍岩山，为太行山支脉，位于河北省井陉县城东南方向约30公里的苍岩山镇，距河北省省会石家庄市市区70公里，是国家4A级旅游景区。苍岩山自然风光优美，享有“五岳奇秀揽一山，太行群峰唯苍岩”的盛誉。苍岩山古建筑甚多，主要的有福庆寺、书院、万仙堂、公主祠、桥楼殿、玉皇顶等。
accessEn: The site is in Cangyanshan town, about 30 km from Jingxing County town and roughly 50–70 km from central Shijiazhuang depending on the route (sources differ). The simplest way is a private car or taxi, or a train or bus to Jingxing and a taxi from there; direct coaches from Shijiazhuang have also been reported, so check locally.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 正定隆兴寺与古城
summaryEn: Zhengding, a short ride north of Shijiazhuang, is an old prefectural city whose Buddhist temples and brick pagodas span the Tang to the Jin dynasties. Longxing Temple is the headline: a long north–south axis of halls founded in 586 and enlarged under the first Northern Song emperor, with the cross-shaped Mani Hall, a revolving sutra cabinet and the Great Compassion Pavilion, home to a huge bronze thousand-armed Guanyin. A string of pagodas, a Tang bell tower and a restored Ming city wall lie a short walk or taxi ride to the south.
description: 景区内可游览隆兴寺、凌霄塔、开元寺须弥塔。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Zhengding old town is about 11–13 km north-north-east of central Shijiazhuang; a taxi or ride-hailing car takes roughly half an hour, and city buses also run out to the town. Within the old town the sights are spread over a few kilometres, so a taxi or bike between clusters saves time.

name: 赵州桥
summaryEn: The Anji Bridge is a single-span stone arch over the Xiao River, built between 595 and 605 and credited to the craftsman Li Chun. Its shallow arch is pierced by two small arches in each shoulder, and it is generally described as the world's oldest open-spandrel stone segmental arch bridge. The parapets carry carved dragons and animal masks, and the park around it has an exhibition on ancient bridges.
description: 赵州桥，又名安济桥，位于中国河北省石家庄市赵县，是城南五里洨河上的一座石拱桥，是很久的桥，当地人称之为“大石桥”，以区别于附近的另一座“小石桥”。一般认为，该桥始建于隋代，设计者是隋代杰出的工匠李春。
accessEn: The bridge is about 3 km south of Zhao County town and about 42 km south-south-east of central Shijiazhuang. From Shijiazhuang take a long-distance bus to Zhao County and then a taxi, or hire a car for the drive, which takes roughly an hour; check the current bus times locally.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 北岳庙
summaryEn: Beiyue Temple is a walled compound in the old town of Quyang, built for worship of the spirit of the Northern Peak. Its main building, the Yuan-dynasty Dening Hall, is described as the largest surviving Yuan timber hall and has wall paintings of heavenly figures traditionally attributed to the Tang painter Wu Daozi. The grounds also hold a stele gallery of over a hundred inscribed stones and a small exhibition hall on the temple's history.
description: 北岳庙，位于中华人民共和国河北省保定市曲阳县城内西南隅，是一座道教宫观。
accessEn: The temple stands in the south-west corner of Quyang's old town, about 73 km west-south-west of Baoding. The easiest route is a high-speed train to Dingzhou East, then a road transfer of roughly an hour to Quyang, or a taxi or driver from Baoding or Shijiazhuang; check local bus times.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 响堂山石窟
summaryEn: The Xiangtangshan Caves are Buddhist cave temples carved into the limestone of Mount Gu and Mount Fu, mostly under the Northern Qi (550–577). The northern group is the main stop, with large caves built around central pillars, including the Big Buddha Cave, and sutras cut into the rock. The southern group is smaller and easier to walk, with a site museum alongside.
description: 响堂山石窟，又称响堂寺石窟，是一座位于河北省邯郸市峰峰矿区鼓山的石窟，始建于东魏，石窟的主体开凿于北齐时期，此后在隋、唐、宋、金、元和明代均有不同程度的修复或增刻。石窟分为北响堂石窟、南响堂石窟及水浴寺石窟。
accessEn: The northern caves are in Fengfeng Mining District, roughly 30 km south-west of central Handan; driving or a taxi is the most convenient way, and public bus connections are limited, so check locally. The southern group is about 15 km away, on the southern side of the hill.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中央大街与圣索菲亚教堂
summaryEn: Central Street is a cobbled pedestrian street about 1.45 km long, running from Xinyang Square to the Songhua riverbank, lined with Baroque, Renaissance, Art Nouveau and eclectic buildings, shops, cafés and ice-lolly stands. A short walk to the south-east stands St Sophia Cathedral, a red-brick former Russian Orthodox church with a green onion dome, now home to the Harbin Architecture Art Gallery. Together they are the best way to see Harbin's Russian-era past in a few hours.
description: 中央大街是黑龙江省哈尔滨市的主要商业街之一。南起于道里区新阳广场，北止于松花江边的防洪纪念塔广场，由方石砖铺成全长1450米，宽21.34米，亚洲最长的步行街。
accessEn: Both are in Daoli District in central Harbin: Metro Line 2 has a Central Street station (中央大街站) beside the street, and taxis from Harbin Railway Station take about ten minutes. The airport is about 45 minutes away by road; the cathedral is roughly 700 m south-east of the street's coordinates, a 10–15 minute walk.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 渤海国上京龙泉府遗址
summaryEn: Shangjing was the main capital of the Bohai kingdom, a Tang-era state in north-east Asia, laid out on the plan of the Tang capital Chang'an with outer, inner and palace cities. Today the palace-city site is a national archaeological park, with a one-twentieth scale model of the palace city and models of six individual halls, and a site museum nearby. Xinglong Temple, built in the Qing dynasty on old Bohai temple ground, keeps stone carvings from the Bohai period.
description: 渤海国上京龙泉府遗址是唐代渤海国首都龙泉府的城池遗址，俗称上京城，位于今黑龙江省宁安市渤海镇。755年，渤海国三世王大钦茂自中京城迁至上京，从此成为国都。上京为渤海国五京之首。
accessEn: The site is in Bohai town, about 43 km by road south-west of Ning'an on the road towards Jingpo Lake, and is easily combined with a lake day trip from Mudanjiang by car, tour or taxi. Ning'an is reached from Mudanjiang by train and road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 横道河子俄罗斯风情小镇
summaryEn: A railway town founded in 1897 when the Russian-built Chinese Eastern Railway came through, with over a hundred Russian-style buildings surviving and six of them national heritage buildings. The highlights are the fan-shaped locomotive roundhouse, now a railway museum, the wooden Russian Orthodox Church of the Presentation of the Virgin, the former locomotive-crew apartment block and the old street of stone and timber houses. UNESCO's 2018 Asia-Pacific heritage awards gave the town an honourable mention, and it is popular with photographers, especially in snow.
description: 景区内可游览俄式老街、圣母进堂教堂、机车库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The town is about 58 km by road west-north-west of Mudanjiang, with its own railway station on the Binsui line and a high-speed station, Hengdaohezi East, at the north-eastern edge of the town on the Harbin–Mudanjiang line; the high-speed trip from Harbin takes a little under two hours. Check the timetable on 12306.

name: 亚布力滑雪旅游度假区
summaryEn: Yabuli is a commercial ski resort in the Zhangguangcai range, laid out across three linked peaks of 1,374 m, 1,258 m and 1,000 m, and also a national winter-sports training base. Skiing is the main draw, with the largest and busiest area at Sun Mountain and a quieter beginner area at Xintiwei; summer brings a hot spring, a water park, a mountain-bike park and a 20 km wooden hiking trail. It was among the first 12 national ski tourism resorts named by the culture and sports ministries in January 2022.
description: 亚布力滑雪旅游度假区位于中国黑龙江省哈尔滨市尚志市南的滑雪旅游度假区，也是中国境内规模最大的滑雪旅游度假区及综合性滑雪训练中心。西距哈尔滨市193公里，东距牡丹江市106公里，位于长白山系余脉张广才岭西麓的大锅盔山脚下，其中心位置的地理坐标为N44.60，E128.50，占地面积66公顷。
accessEn: From Harbin it is roughly 190 km by road, about two to three hours by car or private transfer, but the faster way is by train: high-speed trains reach Yabuli West in about an hour, then it is roughly 25 km to the slopes by taxi or hotel pickup. In winter a seasonal service also runs to Yabuli South, about 500 m from the slopes; it is slower than the high-speed line, so check the timetable on 12306.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 白马寺
summaryEn: By tradition White Horse Temple is the first Buddhist temple in China, founded in 68 AD near the Han capital. The Ming and Qing halls on the main axis hold Yuan-dynasty dry-lacquer Buddhas and arhats brought from the Forbidden City in 1972, and the 13-storey Qiyun Pagoda of 1175 stands just east. Thai, Indian and Burmese-style halls added since 1992 make it a rare place to compare Buddhist traditions in one visit.
description: 白马寺位于河南省洛阳老城以东21公里处，北依邙山，南临洛河，创建于东汉永平十一年，是佛教传入中国后兴建的第一座寺院，白马寺建立之后，中国“僧院”便泛称为“寺”，白马寺也因此被认为是中国佛教的发源地，有中国佛教的“祖庭”和“释源”之称。
highlights: 泰国佛殿 缅甸佛殿 印度佛殿
accessEn: The temple is about 12–15 km east of central Luoyang; city bus No. 56 from Luoyang railway station takes about 40 minutes, or a taxi is quicker. It is on the opposite side of the city from Longmen Grottoes.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 开封铁塔
summaryEn: Kaifeng's Iron Pagoda is a 13-storey octagonal brick tower, about 56 m tall, finished in 1049 in the Northern Song. It is called 'iron' for the rusty brown colour of its glazed bricks, which are moulded with more than fifty patterns of Buddhas, bodhisattvas, flying figures, musicians, lions and flowers. It stands in Iron Pagoda Park in the north-east of the old city and is one of the best surviving pieces of Song brick architecture.
description: 景区内可游览铁塔、琉璃砖雕、铁塔公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Iron Pagoda Park is in the north-east of Kaifeng's old city, about 10 minutes by taxi from the centre; city buses also stop at the park. Kaifeng is about half an hour from Zhengzhou by intercity train.

name: 万仙山
summaryEn: Wanxian Mountain is a Taihang Mountains scenic area made up of the Guoliang and Nanping sections, best known for the Guoliang Tunnel, a road carved by hand through the cliff face above the valley. Clifftop Guoliang village has long drawn painters and film crews, and the sheer walls around it form a national rock-climbing park with hundreds of routes.
description: 景区内可游览郭亮村、郭亮洞、天梯。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: The area lies in Shayao township, roughly 70 km by road north-west of Huixian city, and Xinxiang is the gateway city, so allow two hours or more for the drive. Without a car, take a bus to Huixian and continue by local bus or taxi.

name: 观星台
summaryEn: This brick-and-stone observatory was built in 1276 to designs by the Yuan astronomers Guo Shoujing and Wang Xun. A squat 9.46 m tower and a 31 m stone scale running due north let astronomers read the noon shadow of a gnomon to measure the length of the year. It is part of the Historic Monuments of Dengfeng World Heritage site and is among the oldest observatories still standing in China.
description: 登封观星台，也称为告成天文台，最早是周公建造的观星台，位于中华人民共和国河南省登封，邻近告成，是世界遗产之一。这个观星台有悠久的历史，从西周开始到元朝的初期。元朝的天文学家郭守敬在1276年将它重建成一个巨大的天文台，是中国现存最早的古代天文台。
accessEn: The observatory is in Gaocheng town about 12 km south-east of Dengfeng, reached by the Dengfeng–Gaocheng bus or by road along the S237. Dengfeng is about an hour or a little more by road from Zhengzhou, depending on traffic.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大相国寺
summaryEn: Daxiangguo Temple is a working Buddhist monastery in the middle of Kaifeng, with roots in the 6th century, refounded in 706 and renamed Daxiangguo in 712. Under the Northern Song it was the capital's leading monastery and a major trading market; today its halls date mostly from the Qing. It keeps an octagonal Glazed Hall with a four-faced, thousand-armed Guanyin, and its Buddhist music is listed as national intangible heritage.
description: 大相国寺位于中华人民共和国河南省开封市鼓楼区，是中国汉传佛教十大名寺之一。
accessEn: The temple is in the centre of Kaifeng's old city, a short walk from the Zhouqiao site and the Shanshangan Guild Hall. Kaifeng is roughly 30 to 40 minutes from Zhengzhou by intercity train.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 隋唐洛阳城
summaryEn: This is the site of the Sui–Tang eastern capital, rebuilt by Emperor Yang of Sui from 605 and later the seat of Empress Wu Zetian. The palace heart is now a national archaeological site park: the Yingtian Gate is a Tang-style reconstruction raised over its excavated base, and the Mingtang (Hall of Light) and Tiantang (Heavenly Hall) are modern buildings on or beside the original foundations. A short ride south, the Dingding Gate museum shows the outer city's main south gate, whose ruins are part of the Silk Roads World Heritage listing.
description: 隋唐洛阳城遗址位于河南省洛阳市近郊，始建于隋炀帝时期，格局仿照隋大兴城修建，时称东都或东京。历经了隋朝、唐朝、五代和北宋，前后沿用500余年，为隋唐的东都，北宋的西都。2010年被列为中国第一批国家考古遗址公园。
accessEn: The palace area is in central Luoyang on Dingding Avenue, with a metro station named Yingtian Gate close by. Dingding Gate is a separate site about 6 km south, best reached by taxi or ride-hailing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 二里头夏都遗址博物馆
summaryEn: The museum, opened in 2019, stands beside the Erlitou site, a Bronze Age settlement that many Chinese archaeologists identify as a capital of the Xia dynasty. Its five permanent galleries show finds from more than six decades of digging, including turquoise-inlaid bronze plaques, early bronze vessels and long jade blades. The excavated site beside it is laid out as a national archaeological site park.
description: 二里头夏都遗址博物馆是一座主要展示二里头遗址考古成果的博物馆，位于中华人民共和国河南省洛阳市偃师区翟镇四角楼村，北距二里头遗址保护区约300米，南临古城快速路。该博物馆由洛阳市政府与中国社会科学院考古研究所共建、共管。
highlights: 乳钉纹青铜爵与绿松石铜牌饰
accessEn: The museum is in Zhaizhen town, Yanshi District, about 25 km east of central Luoyang by road, a taxi or ride-hailing trip of roughly 40 to 60 minutes depending on traffic. The excavated site, where the foundation of Palace No. 1 can be seen, lies about 300 m to the north.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中国文字博物馆
summaryEn: The National Museum of Chinese Writing opened in 2009 in Anyang, where the Shang oracle bones were found. It follows the story of Chinese characters from their earliest forms, set against other writing systems of the world and the scripts of China's minority peoples. A gallery on the discovery and study of the oracle bones, plus calligraphy and folk-character galleries, make it an easy companion to a visit to Yinxu.
description: 中国文字博物馆位于中华人民共和国河南省安阳市北关区人民大道东段656号，是一所以“文字”为主题，兼具与文字相关的文物保护、陈列展示和科学研究三大功能为一体的专业博物馆，同时也是全球第一座以文字为主要“藏品”的国家级博物馆。
accessEn: The museum is on Renmin Avenue East in Beiguan district, about 15 minutes by taxi from central Anyang and some 20 minutes from Anyang East high-speed station; several city bus lines also stop nearby. Anyang is a high-speed stop on the Beijing–Guangzhou line, between Zhengzhou and Handan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 曹操高陵
summaryEn: The Gaoling tomb at Xigaoxue village is identified by Chinese archaeologists as the burial place of Cao Cao (155–220), the statesman, general and poet of the late Eastern Han. It was excavated from 2008 and announced in 2009. The Cao Cao Gaoling Ruins Museum, opened in 2023, is built over the whole site and shows the brick tomb with its sloping entrance passage and chambers, the spirit road, ditches and building foundations in front of it, and some 400 finds.
description: 曹操高陵，又称安阳高陵、魏高陵、西高穴2号墓，是东汉末年魏王曹操之陵墓。曹操陵墓之所在位置近两千年来一直是个谜团，直至2009年12月27日经由河南省文物局宣布，在曹操高陵考古确认，其地址位于安阳市安阳县安丰乡西高穴村一带。
accessEn: The museum is at Xigaoxue village in Anfeng township, about 18 km north-west of central Anyang, roughly 30 minutes by taxi or ride-hailing. From Anyang East high-speed station it is a slightly longer ride across the city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 荆州古城
summaryEn: Jingzhou's old town is enclosed by a brick-faced rampart about 8.8 m high and roughly 11.8 km round, rebuilt in 1646 on older foundations and counted among the best-preserved city walls in southern China. Gate towers such as Binyang Tower on the east side mark the old gates, and you can walk on parts of the wall and around the moat. Inside, the old town holds the Jingzhou Museum, Taoist temples and shrines to the Three Kingdoms general Guan Yu, and the wall is on China's tentative World Heritage list.
description: 荆州城墙位于中国湖北省荆州市荆州区的荆州古城，1996年被列为全国重点文物保护单位。荆州古城墙与城北的楚纪南故城和城西的八岭山古墓群是荆州古城的三大组成部分。荆州城墙是中国现存的四座保存最为完整的古城墙之一，其余三座分别为山西平遥城墙、陕西西安城墙和辽宁兴城城墙，也是保存最为完好的南方城墙。
accessEn: The old town is in central Jingzhou District, about 3 km from Jingzhou railway station by taxi or city bus. High-speed trains run from Wuhan to Jingzhou in roughly 1.5–2 hours.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 荆州博物馆
summaryEn: The regional museum of Jingzhou, founded in 1958, holds more than 130,000 items, most of them excavated in and around the city, once the heartland of the Chu state. Its displays cover the prehistoric cultures of the Jianghan plain, bronzes, jades, bamboo-slip documents, ceramics and lacquerware, with the Mashan tomb textiles and the preserved body of a Western Han man from Fenghuangshan among the stars.
description: 荆州博物馆位于中华人民共和国湖北省荆州市荆州区荆中路166号，是一座综合性地志博物馆，2008年被国家文物局评为“国家一级博物馆”。
accessEn: The museum is in the middle of Jingzhou old town, a short bus or taxi ride from Jingzhou railway station. Jingzhou is about two hours from Wuhan by high-speed train.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 湖南省博物馆
summaryEn: Hunan's provincial museum holds more than 540,000 items, but it is best known for its permanent Mawangdui exhibition of finds from the Han tombs near Changsha. The star is the remarkably preserved body of the Marchioness Xin Zhui, along with the T-shaped silk funeral banner, a plain gauze robe, lacquerware and silk manuscripts. A second permanent exhibition, 'Hunanese', traces the province from prehistory with pieces such as the Shang bronze Min fanglei.
description: 湖南省博物馆位于中华人民共和国湖南省长沙市开福区清水塘街道东风路50号，占地4.9万平方米，是湖南省最大的历史文化博物馆，曾用名“湖南博物院”。其初建于1951年3月，1956年7月正式建馆，1974年7月长沙马王堆汉墓出土文物陈列馆建成开放。
accessEn: The museum is on Dongfeng Road in Kaifu District, central Changsha, beside Martyrs' Park. From Changsha South high-speed station it is a short metro or taxi ride into the city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 张家界大峡谷
summaryEn: Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon is a wooded gorge at Sanguansi in Cili County, a separate scenic area to the east of Wulingyuan and the National Forest Park. It is best known for the Yuntiandu glass-bottomed bridge, a 430-metre span about 300 metres above the valley floor, with a walking route and streams below. It makes a good add-on if you want canyon scenery and a head for heights rather than the sandstone pillars of the main park.
description: 张家界大峡谷玻璃桥是一座位于中国湖南省张家界市武陵源风景名胜区的跨张家界大峡谷的桥梁，为吸引游客，采用全透明的玻璃桥面。
accessEn: The canyon is at Sanguansi in Cili County, roughly an hour by road from Zhangjiajie city and 30 minutes or so east of Wulingyuan town. Direct coaches run from the Zhangjiajie West high-speed rail station to the canyon in about an hour.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黄龙洞
summaryEn: Huanglong Cave is a karst cave system in the Suoxiyu area of Wulingyuan, with two dry and two water-filled levels, 13 chambers, underground waterfalls and a lake. The guided route takes about two hours and includes a boat ride on an underground river. It is a good counterpoint, and a rainy-day option, beside the sandstone peaks above ground.
description: 黄龙洞位于中国湖南张家界武陵源风景名胜区，是国家首批4A级旅游景区。黄龙洞总面积达10万平方米，全长7.5公里，属喀斯特岩溶地貌，以“高阔的洞天、幽深的暗河、密集的石笋”而闻名。洞内分两层旱洞、两层水洞，游览线路兼顾徒步与暗河游船，有龙舞厅、响水河、花果山、天柱街、龙宫等景观，洞中20米高的钟乳石柱“定海神针”为其标志景点。
accessEn: The cave is a few kilometres east of Wulingyuan town, in Suoxiyu, roughly 45 minutes to an hour by road from Zhangjiajie city; buses and taxis serve it from Wulingyuan town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 芙蓉镇
summaryEn: Furong is a Tujia town in Yongshun County, built on cliffs above a waterfall that drops into the You River. Timber houses and a stone-paved old street run along the water, and the town lights up at night. It sits roughly halfway between Zhangjiajie and Fenghuang and is easy to add to either trip by high-speed rail.
description: 景区内可游览瀑布与酉水、青石板老街、溪州铜柱。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Furongzhen station on the Zhangjiajie–Jishou–Huaihua high-speed line is about 2.5 km from the old town, a short taxi ride or shuttle. It is under an hour by train from Zhangjiajie West, and Jishou East and Fenghuang are on the same line.

name: 洪江古商城
summaryEn: Hongjiang sits where the Wu River meets the Yuan River, and in Ming and Qing times it was the main transit point for goods from south-western Hunan and eastern Guizhou. More than 380 buildings from the Ming dynasty to the Republican era survive, among them temples, money shops, trading houses, foreign firms, workshops, shops and inns; 18 are nationally protected (listed in 2006). It is a good place to see how an inland trading port worked, with lanes of high-walled merchant houses rather than a single showpiece.
description: 洪江古建筑群位于中国湖南省怀化市洪江管理区，2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。洪江古镇原属黔阳县，地处巫水与沅江交汇处，是明清时期湘西南和黔东地区土特产的主要运输中转站，现仍保存有明清至民国时期的大量古建筑如寺庙、钱庄、商号、洋行、作坊、店铺、客栈等共380多栋，总面积约20余万平方米，其中“国保”建筑18栋。
accessEn: Hongjiang District is about 50 km south of Huaihua city. Coaches run from Huaihua south coach station roughly every 20 minutes and take about 70 minutes, stopping at the main gate, according to Bendibao; a car takes a little over an hour.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 紫鹊界梯田
summaryEn: Ziquejie has terraces covering tens of thousands of mu on the mountains of Shuiche and Fengjia towns in western Xinhua, settled since Qin–Han times and watered by natural seepage and spring flow. Paths and viewpoints look over terraces that climb from the valleys to the ridges, with wooden farmhouses scattered among them. They are a national scenic area, a World Heritage Irrigation Structure (listed by the International Commission on Irrigation and Drainage in 2014) and a Globally Important Agricultural Heritage System (FAO, 2018); neither is a UNESCO listing.
description: 紫鹊界梯田坐落在中国湖南省娄底市新化县西部水车镇和奉家镇，从开垦至今，已有两千余年历史，总面积达8万余亩，是中国国家级风景名胜区、国家4A级景区、湖南省文物保护单位。
accessEn: The terraces are in Shuiche town, about 50 km from Xinhua town and roughly 1.5 hours by road. The Ziquejie South interchange of the Hohhot–Beihai Expressway is nearby; Xinhua South station on the Shanghai–Kunming high-speed line is 18 km from the county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 元上都遗址
summaryEn: Shangdu, the Xanadu of Coleridge's poem, was Kublai Khan's summer capital, laid out in 1256 beside the Luan River on the grassland north of the Great Wall. Little is left standing: earthen city walls, gate sites and palace platforms rise out of the grass inside three nested enclosures, and the open setting is the point. It became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2012, and a site museum a few kilometres south explains what the ground no longer shows.
description: 元上都或称上都，即开平，位于今中华人民共和国内蒙古自治区锡林郭勒盟正蓝旗上都镇，坐落滦河河畔。元世祖忽必烈即位以前，于1256年三月，命刘秉忠建王府于此。1260年5月5日，忽必烈在开平即位。
highlights: 锡林郭勒盟文化遗产博物馆
铁幡竿渠 · 砧子山墓群
accessEn: The ruins lie in grassland about 20 km north-east of Shangdu town, the Zhenglan Banner seat, and about 30 km north-west of Duolun; there is no direct public transport, so most visitors come by car. It is roughly 5½ hours' drive from Beijing and 6½ from Hohhot, so allow a night nearby.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 内蒙古博物院
summaryEn: The Inner Mongolia Museum is the region's main museum, in a large new building in east Hohhot that opened on a trial basis on 20 June 2025. Its ten permanent exhibitions run from fossils and dinosaurs through the peoples of the northern steppe to the Great Wall, intangible heritage, ecology and spaceflight. Over a half day it is the easiest way to get a grounding in the whole region before heading out onto the grassland.
description: 内蒙古博物院，旧名内蒙古博物馆，位于中华人民共和国内蒙古自治区呼和浩特市赛罕区中专路街道新华东街76号，与内蒙古乌兰恰特大剧院毗邻。馆舍主体建筑面积5万余平方米，由陈列展厅区、文物库房区、观众服务区、业务科研区及多功能厅等各部分组成。
accessEn: The new building is at No. 76 Xinhua East Street in Saihan District, east Hohhot, about 800 m from Hohhot East station, which has the high-speed trains and metro Line 1; Hohhot East is roughly 2½ to 3 hours from Beijing by high-speed train.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大召与席力图召
summaryEn: Dazhao and Xilitu Zhao stand a street apart in the old Guihua quarter of Hohhot, and together they are the best look at the Tibetan Buddhism the Mongols took up in the 16th century. Dazhao, the older, is known as the Silver Buddha Temple after its silver Sakyamuni statue; Xilitu Zhao has a grand sutra hall that blends Han and Tibetan styles. Both are working temples, so you meet monks and worshippers as well as architecture.
description: 大召，称“伊克召”意为“大庙”，其中“召”为藏语“寺庙”之意。位于中华人民共和国内蒙古自治区呼和浩特市玉泉区大召前街，是一座藏传佛教格鲁派寺院。大召居于明清时期呼和浩特地区“七大召”之首。
highlights: 银佛 · 龙雕 · 壁画
accessEn: Both temples are in Yuquan District in the old town, facing each other across a road, a short taxi ride from Hohhot or Hohhot East station; city buses also stop nearby. The Five Pagoda Temple is about a kilometre away on foot.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 五当召
summaryEn: Badekar Monastery, better known as Wudangzhao, is the largest Tibetan Buddhist monastery in Inner Mongolia, a Gelug-school complex of flat-roofed white halls and lamas' lodgings climbing a mountain slope in Shiguai District. Six main halls, three reincarnate lamas' residences and a mausoleum for their remains stand among more than ninety earthen lodgings, in an architecture closer to Tibet than to the Chinese-style temples of Hohhot. It is an easy half-day trip from Baotou.
description: 景区内可游览苏古沁独宫、洞阔尔独宫、却依林独宫。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 活佛府 · 苏波尔盖陵
accessEn: The monastery is in Jihuluntu sumu, Shiguai District, about 54 km north-east of central Baotou by road; a taxi or hired car takes about 1 to 1½ hours. A bus from Baotou is reported to run a limited timetable, so check before relying on it. From Hohhot, take a high-speed train to Baotou, about an hour, then transfer.
imageCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Lukacs~commonswiki assumed (based on copyright claims

name: 黑城遗址
summaryEn: Khara-Khoto, or Heicheng ('Black City'), is a walled Silk Road city in the Gobi beside the dry Ejin River. Built under the Western Xia and expanded under the Yuan, when it was the seat of Yijinai Circuit, it was abandoned in the late 14th century. Its rammed-earth walls, about 450 by 380 m and up to 9 m high, still stand around the foundations of Buddhist, Taoist and Islamic buildings, with stupas on the north-west corner and drifting sand piled against the interior. It is a long way out, which is much of its appeal.
description: 黑城遗址，又名黑水城遗址，是西夏西北部军事重镇，十二监军司之一黑水镇燕监军司治所。黑水城是西夏在西部地区重要的农牧业基地和边防要塞，该城建于公元九世纪的时期。元朝有重修，是西夏、元时期河套平原和河西走廊通往岭北行省的驿站要道。
accessEn: The ruins are about 25 km south-east of Dalaihubu, the Ejin Banner seat, in a straight line, or roughly 35–40 km by road with no public transport: hire a taxi or car for the scenic-area gate, from where a shuttle bus runs to the site and a short walk follows. Dalaihubu is reached by air (Ejin Banner airport has services from Hohhot and Xi'an) or by a long drive from Jiayuguan, about 5–6 hours.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 寒山寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple at Fengqiao, about 5 km west of Suzhou's old city, facing the old Grand Canal. It is famous because of Zhang Ji's Tang poem 'A Night Mooring by Maple Bridge', in which the temple's midnight bell reaches a sleepless traveller on a boat; the poem is still taught in schools in China and Japan. Allow a short visit, and pair it with the Maple Bridge and the old canal next door.
description: 寒山寺是位于江苏省苏州市城西阊门外5公里的枫桥镇的一个佛寺，坐东朝西，门对古运河。
accessEn: About 5 km west of Suzhou's old city in Gusu District, a short taxi ride or city-bus journey; Maple Bridge and the old canal are next to the temple. Tiger Hill lies in the same direction, so the two are easily combined by taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 平江历史街区
summaryEn: A historic quarter in the north-east of Suzhou's old city, laid out along Pingjiang Road and the Pingjiang canal, which have run side by side for some 800 years. Lanes of whitewashed houses, humped stone bridges and side canals branch off the main street, which is lined with bookshops, teahouses and small venues for Suzhou storytelling and ballad singing. It is the best place in the city to feel everyday old Suzhou rather than tour-group Suzhou.
description: 平江历史街区位于中国江苏省苏州市姑苏区东北部，街区以平江路和平江河为中轴线，东到外城河，西到临顿路，南起干将路，北到白塔东路，面积约116.5公顷。平江历史街区具有深厚的历史文化底蕴,是苏州现存最典型、最完整的历史文化保护区，仍然保留着800年来路河并行的城市格局，以及为数众多的传统江南风格和体量的建筑，道路宽度，两侧原为安静的居住区，包括世界文化遗产1处—耦园，各级文物保护单位9处，控保建筑43处。
accessEn: In the north-east of Suzhou's old city between Ganjiang East Road and Baita East Road, a short walk from the Humble Administrator's Garden and the Suzhou Museum; Xiangmen station on Metro Line 1 is within walking distance. Suzhou railway station is a short taxi ride away.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南京博物院
summaryEn: One of China's oldest and largest museums, with more than 400,000 objects and especially fine Ming and Qing imperial porcelain. The main hall, built 1936–48 in the style of a Liao-dynasty temple, tells the history of Jiangsu from prehistory to the Qing; other halls, enlarged in an expansion finished in 2013, cover Chinese art, the Republic of China period and Jiangsu's intangible heritage.
description: 南京博物院，简称南博，是一座位于中华人民共和国南京市的历史艺术博物馆。南京博物院为中国国家一级博物馆，与北京故宫博物院及台北国立故宫博物院齐名。行政上，为隶属于江苏省文化和旅游厅的副厅级公益性文化事业单位。
accessEn: At 321 Zhongshan East Road, just inside Zhongshan Gate, about 10 minutes' walk from Minggugong station on Metro Line 2. From the city centre at Xinjiekou it is a short Metro ride.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南京总统府
summaryEn: A 9-hectare compound on Changjiang Road that was in turn a Ming prince's mansion, a Qing viceroy's office, the palace of the Taiping Heavenly King, the seat of the 1912 provisional presidency and the headquarters of the Republic of China government until 1949. Since 2003 it has been the China Modern History Museum. Axial halls, offices and a classical garden make it a walkable lesson in layered history.
description: 南京总统府位于今中国大陆江苏省南京市玄武区梅园新村街道长江路292号，是明朝汉王府、清朝两江总督署和太平天国天王府遗址，1912年为中华民国临时大总统府，孙中山在此宣誓就职中华民国临时大总统。1927年至1937年、1945年至1948年间为中华民国国民政府办公地，1948年5月至1949年4月为中华民国总统府，中华人民共和国成立后，直至1980年代为江苏省人民政府等单位机关办公地。
highlights: 孙中山临时大总统办公室
accessEn: At 292 Changjiang Road in Xuanwu District, about 10 minutes' walk from Daxinggong station (Metro Lines 2 and 3); Xinjiekou is a short Metro hop away.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 栖霞山·栖霞寺
summaryEn: A low wooded hill above the Yangtze north-east of Nanjing, with Qixia Temple at its western foot and the Thousand Buddha Cliff cut into the hillside behind. In late autumn the slopes turn red with maples, an old local saying putting Niushou in spring and Qixia in autumn. It is a quieter, more devotional counterpart to Nanjing's city sights.
description: 栖霞山，又名摄山，位于南京城东北22公里处的栖霞镇，因南朝时山中建有“栖霞精舍”而得名。栖霞山有三峰，主峰三茅峰，又名凤翔峰；东北有龙山；西北有虎山。山西侧称枫岭。
accessEn: About 22 km north-east of central Nanjing; Qixiashan station, the terminus of Metro Line 6 (opened in September 2026), is about 1 km from the temple gate. Allow around an hour from the city centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大报恩寺遗址公园
