summaryEn: The site of the Great Bao'en Temple, whose nine-storey pagoda faced with white porcelain and glazed tiles was known in Europe as the Porcelain Tower of Nanjing until it was destroyed in 1856. A heritage park opened here in December 2015, with a light modern tower of steel and art glass over the excavated pagoda base and glass walkways above the Song and Ming foundations.
description: 大报恩寺位于江苏省南京市秦淮区中华门外雨花路东侧秦淮河畔长干里，原址为南朝时期的长干寺。大报恩寺中著名的琉璃塔修建于明朝永乐至宣德年间。
highlights: 长干寺地宫与阿育王塔
accessEn: At 1 Yuhua Road just outside Zhonghua Gate in Qinhuai District, about 500 m on foot from Zhonghuamen station on Metro Line 1; from Xinjiekou it is a short Metro ride.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 个园
summaryEn: Ge Garden is a compact Qing-dynasty garden in Yangzhou's old city, named after its bamboo and famous for four rockeries that evoke spring, summer, autumn and winter. It is a well-preserved example of a salt merchant's town garden, and is part of the Grand Canal World Heritage Site.
description: 个园，位于江苏省扬州城内的东关街，园名源于“月映竹成千个字”的意象。除竹外，最富盛名者四季假山，以石垒成四季之景，徜徉间即遍历春夏秋冬。1988年列为第三批全国重点文物保护单位。
accessEn: The garden is on the north side of Dongguan Street in the north-east of Yangzhou's old city, a short taxi ride from the city centre or Slender West Lake; from Yangzhou East station allow roughly half an hour by taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 徐州汉文化景区
summaryEn: Xuzhou's Han Culture Scenic Area sits at the foot of Shizishan, where a Western Han king of Chu was buried in a tomb cut deep into the hillside. Nearby, the Han Terracotta Army Museum displays small painted pottery warriors from burial pits found in 1984, and two cavalry pits lie under water in their own gallery. Together they give a compact and quieter look at early Han burial culture than the famous Qin army in Xi'an.
description: 景区内可游览汉兵马俑博物馆、水下兵马俑陈列馆、狮子山楚王陵。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: The site is in Yunlong district about 4 km east of central Xuzhou, roughly 1 km from Huangshanlong station on metro line 1; a taxi from the city centre is quick. Xuzhoudong high-speed station is about 1 to 1.5 hours from Nanjing and around 2.5 hours from Beijing or Shanghai.

name: 海昏侯国遗址公园
summaryEn: The park protects the remains of the Western Han state of Haihun, including its walled capital, its cemeteries and the tomb garden of Liu He, its first marquis. You can see the main tomb and its chariot-and-horse pit under cover, the marked-out foundations of sacrificial halls, and a museum of the more than 10,000 sets of finds, from gold ingots to lacquer and bamboo slips.
description: 海昏侯墓位于江西省南昌市新建区大塘坪乡观西村墎墩山，是西汉第九位皇帝汉废帝刘贺的陵墓。海昏侯墓是中国全国重点文物保护单位紫金城城址与铁河古墓群的组成部分。陵墓平面呈梯形，总面积约4.6万平方米，含两座主墓、七座陪葬墓、一座陪葬坑、两座园门、门阙等。
accessEn: In Datangping township, Xinjian district, about 40 km north of central Nanchang (more by road); allow roughly an hour by taxi or ride-hail. Bus links change, so check the park's official account before you go.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 青云谱
summaryEn: Qingyunpu is an old Taoist temple among camphor trees on the south side of Nanchang, now a memorial to the painter Bada Shanren. Courtyards hold his paintings and life story, a corridor of stone slabs reproduces more than 120 of his works, and a newer hall shows original paintings. Beside it lies Meihu Lake, with a lakeshore park and newer arts venues.
description: 景区内可游览关帝殿、吕祖殿、许祖殿、碑廊、八大山人墓。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Qingyunpu Road beside Meihu Lake, south of central Nanchang, with the Bada Shanren metro stop under 1 km to the west.

name: 龙南客家围屋
summaryEn: Longnan has 376 Hakka walled houses, fortified family compounds built to defend a clan. The most impressive is Guanxi Xinwei, whose scenic area also takes in five more houses of the Guanxi group, and further south the lived-in Yanyi Wei and the Ming-era Wushi Wei show other forms. Together they are a good alternative to the Fujian tulou, with fewer visitors.
description: 景区内可游览关西新围、关西围屋群、燕翼围。图集建议预留一天游览。
accessEn: Longnan East station is on the Ganzhou–Shenzhen high-speed line, about 30–40 minutes from Ganzhou West and on the same line as Shenzhen North. Guanxi is about 15 km east-south-east of Longnan town, and Yangcun, with Yanyi Wei and Wushi Wei, about 33–34 km south-south-west, so a taxi or hired car works best.

name: 长影旧址博物馆
summaryEn: The original Changchun Film Studio complex, in buildings that date from the 1930s Manchukuo Film Association, now a museum in the restored studio buildings. You see film props, scripts and reconstructed sets, the studio stages and a film-processing workshop kept as an exhibit. Costumed performers stage short film-themed scenes around the buildings.
description: 长影集团即长春电影制片厂，简称长影，企业名为长影集团有限责任公司，是中华人民共和国的第一个电影制片厂，也是中国最大的电影制片厂之一。创立初期旧厂区位于吉林省长春市朝阳区红旗街道红旗街1118号，现已改造成长影旧址博物馆和文化旅游创意项目。
accessEn: On Hongqi Street in Chaoyang district, about 4 km south-west of central Changchun, with the Line 54 tram a short walk away.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 北大湖与松花湖滑雪场
summaryEn: Beidahu, in Yongji county, and the Songhua Lake resort, near the Fengman dam, are Jilin Province's two main downhill ski areas, both reachable from Jilin City. Beidahu staged skiing events at the 2007 Asian Winter Games; its highest peak, Nanlou, is about 1,405 m. The Songhua Lake resort is closer to the city and is promoted for a wide range of runs and mountain sightseeing in summer.
description: 北大湖滑雪场，也称北大壶滑雪场，建于1993年，位于中华人民共和国吉林省吉林市永吉县，距离吉林市区56公里，为国家4A级旅游景区。滑雪场是由加拿大伊克森山地规划设计公司所设计，当地海拔1404.8米，雪道平均坡度15度，并设高山雪道13条，总长度20000米，最大高差达870米，占地30公倾，2006年底为亚冬会新上四人吊椅、六人吊箱均为多普玛雅公司生产，最高时速均为5米/秒。
accessEn: Both are reached from Jilin City, which is linked to Changchun by regular trains; Beidahu is about 50–55 km south of Jilin station, and the Songhua Lake resort about 20 km. Check the resorts' own announcements for transfer services.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 清昭陵与福陵
summaryEn: Zhaoling, the tomb of Hong Taiji in Beiling Park, and Fuling, the tomb of Nurhaci in the eastern hills, were built before the Manchus took Beijing and are part of the UNESCO-listed Imperial Tombs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties. Each follows the same plan: a red gate, a sacred way of stone animals, a stele pavilion, a walled square city with a sacrificial hall and a burial mound behind. Zhaoling is the larger, set in a 330-hectare city park of lakes and pine woods, while Fuling is quieter, up a hillside among old pines.
description: 清昭陵，俗称北陵，是后金第二代大汗、清朝开国皇帝皇太极与孝端文皇后的合葬陵墓，位于辽宁省沈阳市皇姑区，占地面积318.74万平方米，是清入关前“关外三陵”中规模最大、气势最宏伟的一座。除了葬有太宗帝后外，陪葬的妃园寝还葬有宸妃、贵妃、淑妃等后妃，是清初关外陵寝中最具代表性的一座帝陵，是中国现存最完整的古代帝王陵墓建筑之一，现为全国重点文物保护单位。
accessEn: Zhaoling is in Huanggu district, about 7 km north-north-east of Shenyang railway station, and Shenyang Metro Line 2 stops at Beiling Gongyuan station by the park. Fuling lies about 10 km east of the old city, so take a taxi or a city bus from central Shenyang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 兴城古城
summaryEn: Xingcheng, once the Ming garrison city of Ningyuan, keeps a roughly square brick-faced wall of about 3 km with a gate on each side, one of the best-preserved Ming town walls in China. Inside, a drum tower stands at the crossing of the main streets, two carved stone memorial arches line Yanhui Street and a Confucian temple dates to 1428. You can walk the streets in a morning, climb the tower and, if you wish, walk on the wall.
description: 兴城城墙，位于中国辽宁省兴城市，即宁远卫城。兴城城墙始建于明代，现存最完整的明代卫城。兴城城墙原有内城与外城，现仅存内城。
accessEn: The old town is in the centre of Xingcheng, about 20 km south-west of Huludao city centre, and the town has railway stations on the Shenyang–Shanhaiguan line and the Qinhuangdao–Shenyang passenger line. Check a timetable for the service you want.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 九门口长城
summaryEn: At Jiumenkou the Ming Great Wall spans a seasonal river on a stone gateway-bridge about 110 m long and 10 m high, with nine arched water gates that once held heavy double wooden doors. The river bed is paved with square stone slabs, and watchtowers and wall climb the hills on either side. It is the only stretch of the wall built across a river, and quieter than the sections near Beijing.
description: 九门口位于中华人民共和国辽宁省绥中县和河北省秦皇岛市海港区交界处的河道上，1996年被列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。九门口所处的河道为季节性河流，枯水期流量少乃至断流，因此需修建城墙以防敌军在枯水期由此进入。
accessEn: The pass is on the Liaoning–Hebei border, about 15 km north of Shanhaiguan, with the Liaoning entrance in Suizhong County; take a taxi or tour from Shanhaiguan or Suizhong.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 奉国寺
summaryEn: Founded in 1020 in the old town of Yixian, Fengguo Temple has a main hall nine bays wide, raised on a stone platform, and is one of the largest surviving timber Buddhist halls in China. Inside sit seven Liao-dynasty Buddhas of the past, each over 8 m high with its base, with attendant bodhisattvas and painted beams and walls. It is quiet and unfussy, a rare chance to stand in a thousand-year-old hall.
description: 奉国寺位于辽宁省锦州市义县县城内东街北侧，始建于辽开泰九年，初名咸熙寺；金改奉国寺；因大殿内供有过去七佛，所以又名“大佛寺”或“七佛寺”。1961年被列为第一批全国重点文物保护单位，是中国仅存的三大辽代寺院之一。
accessEn: The temple is in the old town of Yixian, about 49 km north-north-east of central Jinzhou, roughly an hour by road; Jinzhou is the usual base for the trip.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 牛河梁遗址
summaryEn: Niuheliang is a ritual and burial complex of the Hongshan culture, scattered over ridges where Lingyuan meets Jianping, with a platform known as the Goddess Temple, an altar and clusters of stone-mound tombs. The national archaeological site park has a site museum with jades and painted pottery, and protective halls built over the excavated Goddess Temple and over the altar and cairns, so the remains can be seen where they were found. It is an important prehistoric site in China.
description: 牛河梁遗址是中国北方新石器时代红山文化晚期的重要遗址群，位于辽宁省朝阳市建平县富山街道、凌源市凌北街道、万元店镇交界处的努鲁儿虎山谷间，占地面积约50平方公里。
highlights: 积石冢与祭坛（第二地点）
accessEn: The site is in the hills on the Lingyuan–Jianping boundary, about 15 km north-east of central Lingyuan and about 19 km from Niuheliang high-speed railway station; from Chaoyang city a car or taxi is the practical choice, so allow extra time for the transfer.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 西夏陵
summaryEn: The Western Xia (Xixia) Imperial Tombs are the necropolis of the Tangut dynasty, strung along the foot of the Helan Mountains and inscribed by UNESCO in 2025 as the Xixia Imperial Tombs. The site holds nine imperial mausoleums, 271 subordinate tombs and a northern architectural complex. The weathered rammed-earth mounds, up to about 23 m high, are thought to be the cores of once-tiled, tower-like structures. Most visitors combine the museum with Mausoleum 3, attributed to the dynasty's first emperor, Li Yuanhao.
description: 西夏陵位于中华人民共和国宁夏回族自治区银川市西夏区，是对贺兰山东麓西夏帝王陵园遗址的统称，面积约为50平方公里。该陵园遗址是中国现存规模最大、地面遗迹保存最完整的帝王陵园之一，被誉为“东方金字塔”。西夏陵建于西夏存续期间，在西夏灭亡时遭到了蒙古军队的毁灭性破坏，以至于在中华人民共和国政府组织考古探察之前，这些陵墓的建造年代一直无法得到确认。
accessEn: The tombs are about 30 km west of central Yinchuan at the foot of the Helan Mountains, 30–45 minutes by taxi or private car. Tourist buses may run in season; ask your hotel or the visitor centre for current departures.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 贺兰山岩画
summaryEn: The Helankou gorge is the best-known site of the Helan Mountains petroglyphs, with thousands of images carved on boulders and cliff faces along the valley. They are generally dated to between about 10,000 and 3,000 years ago and show animals, herding and hunting scenes and, above all, stylised human faces, about two-thirds of the range's face images being found here. A few later Tangut (Western Xia) inscriptions are also found, and the Yinchuan World Rock Art Museum near the entrance explains the carvings.
description: 贺兰山岩画，是对分布在中华人民共和国宁夏回族自治区贺兰山中的一系列岩画的总称。这些岩画的分布范围北至石嘴山市，南至中卫市，题材以人面像和游牧生活为主，其中还有部分西夏文。这些岩画最早于1969年被发现，1996年时被列为全国重点文物保护单位。
accessEn: The gorge is in Helan County, about an hour by road north-west of central Yinchuan; there is no straightforward public transport, so most visitors take a taxi or booked car. It is near the Zhenbeibu film studio, so the two combine in one day.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 固原博物馆
summaryEn: A national first-grade museum in Guyuan, on the old Silk Road route to the Hexi Corridor. It is best known for finds from the Northern Wei, Northern Zhou, Sui and Tang tombs around the city. The two permanent galleries cover the history of Guyuan and the Silk Road in Guyuan, so it works as a good primer before Xumishan.
description: 固原博物馆位于中华人民共和国宁夏回族自治区固原市原州区西城路133号，是国家一级博物馆之一。
accessEn: The museum is on Xicheng Road in the west of central Guyuan, a short taxi ride from the centre. Guyuan is about 330 km from Yinchuan, roughly 3.5–4 hours by expressway; buses and trains also run, with trains slower.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 须弥山石窟
summaryEn: More than 130 Buddhist caves are carved into the red sandstone hills of Mount Xumi, strung over about 1.5 km on a Silk Road branch. The seated Maitreya of Cave 5, about 20 m high, is the star, while the Northern Zhou caves at Yuanguangsi and Xiangguosi hold the finest carving. A museum on the Silk Road and cave art sits at the entrance. It is quieter and more rugged than the great grottoes of Dunhuang or Longmen.
description: 须弥山石窟位于宁夏回族自治区固原市原州区西北的须弥山上，是一批开凿于北朝至唐代的石窟的总称，部分石窟被开凿于明清时期。该石窟周围曾建有佛教和道教寺庙，但后来全部损毁。此后，石窟群在海原大地震和文化大革命时期曾遭受大规模破坏，后来又因严重风化和遭到盗凿而损毁严重。
accessEn: The grottoes are about 55 km north-west of Guyuan, roughly an hour's drive; most visitors take a taxi or hired car. Older guides describe a bus to the town of Sanying with a local connection onward, and a direct coach from Guyuan bus station; these are infrequent and may have changed, so ask at the bus station before relying on them.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 同心清真大寺
summaryEn: Tongxin Great Mosque is regarded as the oldest and largest mosque in Ningxia. It is built in Chinese timber style with Islamic decoration, set on a seven-metre brick platform with brick-carved screens at the gate. It is still a working mosque for the local Hui community, and beside it is the Red Army Western Expedition Memorial Park with a memorial hall opened in 2006.
description: 景区内可游览影壁、邦克楼、礼拜大殿。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: The mosque is in the south of Tongxin county town. From Wuzhong or Yinchuan it is roughly two hours by road, by direct bus or car; from the county bus station, take a taxi or walk.

name: 青海省博物馆
summaryEn: Qinghai's provincial museum sits beside Xinning Square in central Xining and is the quickest way to understand the plateau's long human story. Its collections are strongest in painted pottery from the Neolithic and Bronze Age, and the main exhibition runs through to the dynasties that connected the region with the rest of China. It is a good rainy-day or acclimatisation stop on your first day in Xining.
description: 青海省博物馆位于中华人民共和国青海省西宁市城西区西关大街58号，是隶属青海省文化厅的综合性博物馆。
highlights: 青海非物质文化遗产精品展
accessEn: On West Gate Street (Xiguan Street) in central Xining, beside Xinning Square, a short walk or taxi ride from most city-centre hotels.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 喇家遗址
summaryEn: Lajia is a Bronze Age settlement of the Qijia culture on a terrace above the Yellow River, near the Gansu border. Excavations uncovered houses destroyed in a sudden disaster, with victims still inside, and a bowl of noodles that made headlines in 2005. A site museum and archaeological park let you see the finds and the excavated houses under protective sheds.
description: 喇家遗址位于中国青海省民和县官亭镇喇家村，是一处距今约4000年前的齐家文化聚落遗址。这一遗址因其高度文明水平和突然毁灭的历史事件而备受关注，因而被称为“东方庞贝”。喇家遗址被认为是由地震引起的连续灾害所形成，在遗址区8处房址中发现了32具非正常死亡人骨遗骸和惨烈灾难场景。
accessEn: Lajia is in Guanting town on the Yellow River, about 75 km by road from Minhe's county town and further again from Xining. Most visitors drive or hire a car from Xining or Haidong, which makes it a full day trip.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 丹噶尔古城
summaryEn: Dan'gar is the old town of Huangyuan, about an hour west of Xining on the road to Riyue Mountain and Qinghai Lake. Its compact lanes hold temples, restored trading houses and a hall devoted to the local vinegar, and it works well as a first stop on the way to the lake. It was a frontier market where Han, Tibetan, Hui and Mongol traders met.
description: 丹噶尔古城，位于中国青海省湟源县，建于明洪武年间，时隶西宁府西宁县。道光九年，清朝政府在此设丹噶尔厅。民国二年，丹噶尔厅改为湟源县。
accessEn: Dan'gar is in Chengguan town, Huangyuan County, about 50 km west of Xining and under an hour by road; buses and taxis run from Xining, and it is on the road to Riyue Mountain and Qinghai Lake.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 隆务寺
summaryEn: Rongwo (Longwu) Monastery in Tongren, called Rebgong in Tibetan, is a large Gelug monastery of the Amdo region and the heart of a valley of Tibetan and Tu (Monguor) villages. Around it lie Wutun, Nyentog and Gomar, where families have painted thangkas and modelled murals and statues for generations. It is quieter than Kumbum, and a day here combines a lived-in monastery, painters' studios and a mud-walled fort village.
description: 隆务寺，全称“隆务贡德钦却科尔林”，著名藏传佛教格鲁派寺庙，位于中国青海省黄南藏族自治州同仁市隆务镇，为安多藏区仅次于拉卜楞寺和塔尔寺的第三大寺，全国重点文物保护单位。隆务寺原为萨迦派寺院，始建于元朝大德五年，名为“智卡贡康”，明朝宣德元年，三木旦仁钦重建隆务寺，后其弟罗哲森格继任为法台，被宣德帝封为“弘修妙悟国师”，成为当地政教合一的领袖。
accessEn: Tongren is about 160 km south of Xining, roughly 2.5–3 hours by road; buses and shared cars run from Xining's bus stations, so ask your hotel for the current one. Wutun is a few kilometres north of town (sources say 6–10 km) and the Gomar fort about 8 km, both short taxi rides.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 日月山
summaryEn: Riyue (Sun Moon) Mountain is a high pass on the road west from Xining to Qinghai Lake, at 3,399 m. It marks the divide between the Huangshui valley, with its farms, and the Qinghai Lake basin, whose herding country opens out to the west. It is a good short stop on the road to the lake, with a statue of Princess Wencheng, two small temples and wide views.
description: 日月山，古称赤岭，位于中国青海省东部湟源县西南40公里的日月藏族乡，属祁连山脉，为湟源县、共和县的交界处，且是青海省内流水系与外流水系分水岭，以及农、牧区的天然分界线。此山口海拔3,399米，将青海湖内陆盆地与黄河支流湟水河流域分开。
accessEn: The pass is about 40 km south-west of Huangyuan county town on the Xining–Qinghai Lake road, roughly an hour and a half by car from Xining. Tour cars and charter drivers usually stop here on the way to Qinghai Lake.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 新寨嘉那嘛呢
summaryEn: On the edge of Gyêgu (Jiegu), Yushu's main town, this huge heap of carved mani stones covers about 20,000 square metres, roughly 270 m long, 80 m wide and three to four metres high. Every stone is carved with mantras, sutras or Buddhist figures, and pilgrims circle the pile with prayer wheels and add new stones. It is one of the easiest ways to see living Kham Tibetan devotion.
description: 新寨嘉那嘛呢，又作新寨嘉纳嘛呢，是位于中华人民共和国青海省玉树市的大型嘛呢石堆，最初由结古寺的第一世嘉那活佛于18世纪末建立，用于雕刻佛经内容，此后历经300年信众的堆砌垒加至今，单体石块数量达25亿余块，已有2万多平方米的规模，有“世界第一嘛呢石堆”“大嘛呢”“嘛呢石经城”之称。
accessEn: The pile is in Xinzhai on the north-east edge of Yushu city, a short taxi ride from the centre of Gyêgu (sources give 3 to 9 km). Yushu is reached by flight to Yushu Batang airport (18 km south of town) or by a very long road journey from Xining (about 820 km).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 陕西历史博物馆
summaryEn: About 1 km north-west of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the Shaanxi History Museum opened in 1991 in a Tang-style complex and holds more than 1.7 million objects. Its main exhibition traces the province's past from the earliest settlements through the Zhou, Qin, Han and Tang; then see the Hejiacun hoard of Tang gold and silver and, with a separate ticket, the gallery of Tang tomb murals.
description: 陕西历史博物馆，简称陕博或陕历博，是位于中华人民共和国陕西省西安市雁塔区的一座历史博物馆，1991年4月16日设立，1991年6月20日首次开放。该馆历史可追溯至1940年代成立的陕西省博物馆，新馆自1977年筹建，1986年奠基，1991年建成开放，由建筑师张锦秋设计，建筑群以中轴对称和中央殿堂、四隅崇楼的布局表现唐代宫殿建筑特征，是中国改革开放后建设的大型国家级博物馆之一。
accessEn: Take Metro Line 2 or 3 to Xiaozhai, or Line 3 or 4 to Dayanta; both stations are about 800 metres from the museum, and a taxi from the Bell Tower takes about 20 minutes.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 小雁塔
summaryEn: South of the city wall, this 13-storey brick pagoda was built in 707–709 in the grounds of Jianfu Temple, and since 2014 it has been part of the Silk Roads World Heritage listing. It now stands in a park shared with the Xi'an Museum: look round the museum's galleries, then walk through what remains of the temple to the foot of the pagoda.
description: 小雁塔，又称荐福寺塔，是位于中华人民共和国陕西省西安市碑林区西安博物院院内的唐代密檐式砖塔。塔始建于唐景龙年间，与荐福寺的佛经翻译活动有关，最初为十五层；明代地震损坏塔顶两层，现存十三层，高约43.3米。
accessEn: Take Metro Line 2 or 5 to Nanshaomen and walk about 10 minutes west to the museum's north gate on Youyi West Road; a taxi from the Bell Tower takes about 10–15 minutes.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 汉阳陵
summaryEn: North of the Wei River, beside the expressway to Xi'an Xianyang airport, lies the tomb of Emperor Jing of Han (r. 157–141 BC) and his Empress Wang, two large burial mounds ringed by smaller burial pits. Start in the underground hall built over ten excavated pits, where glass floors and walkways let you look down on rows of small clay figures, animals and grave goods, then see more finds in the archaeology museum.
description: 汉阳陵是西汉汉景帝刘启及其皇后王氏同茔异穴的合葬陵园，位于今陕西省咸阳市渭城区正阳镇张家湾、后沟村北的咸阳原上，是咸阳原西汉诸帝陵中最东的一座，地跨咸阳市渭城区、泾阳县和西安市高陵县三地。景帝驾崩于公元前141年，15年后王皇后薨，方合葬陵内。
highlights: 帝陵外藏坑遗址保护展示厅
南阙门遗址保护展示厅
accessEn: There is no metro station nearby and buses are infrequent, so most visitors come by taxi or ride-hailing car: about 45 minutes from the Bell Tower, or about 20 minutes from Xi'an Xianyang airport.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 楼观台
summaryEn: In Zhouzhi County at the foot of the Zhongnan range of the Qinling Mountains, about 70 km west of Xi'an, Louguantai is one of the oldest holy places of Taoism, the Chinese religion that reveres Laozi. Much of what you see is new: a temple complex of nine courtyards, opened in 2012, climbs the slope on the axis of the Shuojingtai ('Terrace for Expounding the Scripture'), whose own halls date from the Ming, Qing and later restorations. Beside it, the ruins of the Tang-era Zongsheng Palace keep old steles and ancient trees.
description: 楼观台，位于中国陕西省西安市周至县楼观镇，秦岭北麓终南山下，相传老子西游时，曾在此为尹喜讲述《道德经》，故又名“说经台”，成为中国道教最早的重要圣地、楼观道的发源地，被誉为“天下第一福地”、“仙都”、“道教祖庭”。
accessEn: Louguantai is about 70 km west of Xi'an, roughly 1–1.5 hours by taxi or hired car. A Huanshan (foothills) tourist bus from the Big Wild Goose Pagoda's North Square takes over two hours, and its timetable changes, so check before relying on it.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 宝鸡青铜器博物院
summaryEn: In Baoji, on the Wei River west of Xi'an, this museum shows bronzes from a region rich in Zhou dynasty sites, where tens of thousands of bronzes have been unearthed since the Han dynasty. Head first for the He zun, an early Western Zhou ritual wine vessel displayed in a hall of its own, then look for long inscriptions such as the 372 characters of the Lai pan, which list Zhou kings, and the large bo bells of the dukes of Qin from the Spring and Autumn period.
description: 宝鸡青铜器博物院，原名宝鸡青铜器博物馆，位于中华人民共和国陕西省宝鸡市渭滨区滨河大道东段石鼓山中华石鼓园内，是国家一级博物馆。该馆是中国最大的的青铜器专题博物馆。博物院建筑面积3.48万平方米，文物库房面积8000平方米，展厅面积1.5万平方米，宝鸡青铜器博物院馆藏文物约48.7万余件，种类包括青铜器、陶器、玉器、金器、石器、骨器等，其中尤以商周青铜器最具代表性。
accessEn: High-speed trains from Xi'an North reach Baoji South in about an hour. The museum, in the Chinese Stone Drum Park on Binhe Avenue, is about 4 km from the station, roughly 10–15 minutes by taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 统万城遗址
summaryEn: About 50 km north of Jingbian, on the north bank of the Wuding River at the southern edge of the Mu Us Desert, stand the walls of Tongwancheng, capital of the Xia state in the Sixteen Kingdoms period (304–439), when northern China was divided among short-lived kingdoms. Start at the site museum on the south bank, which covers the Xiongnu people and the city's history, then take the shuttle across to walk the ruins. The city later served as a regional seat under the Tang and was abandoned by the early Ming, after which drifting sand slowly buried it.
description: 统万城，又称白城子，位于中华人民共和国陕西省榆林市靖边县城北50公里红墩界镇的无定河北岸，最早是5世纪初大夏的都城，也是匈奴在中国境内留下的唯一一座都城遗址。在大夏国灭亡后，该城池先后成为夏州、朔方郡及夏州都督府的驻地，后被党项族所占据。
accessEn: EMU trains from Xi'an Railway Station reach Jingbian in about 5 hours via Yan'an and Suide. Public transport to the ruins is scarce, so hire a car or taxi in Jingbian for the drive of about 50 km (about an hour each way), or from Yulin (about 2 hours each way).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 灵岩寺
summaryEn: Lingyan Temple is a Buddhist monastery in a valley on the north-western edge of the Mount Tai range, counted among China's four famous temples. Its Thousand Buddha Hall holds 40 painted clay arhat figures, 32 of them of Song date and 8 Ming, and the 11th-century Pizhi Pagoda rises about 55 m behind it. The Stupa Forest of 167 memorial pagodas, some from the Tang, completes an easy half-day trip from Jinan or Tai'an.
description: 灵岩寺位于中国山东省济南市长清区万德镇，地处泰山西北，始建于东晋，于北魏孝明帝正兴元年开始重建，至唐代达到鼎盛，与浙江天台国清寺，湖北江陵玉泉寺，南京栖霞寺同称天下“四大名刹”。灵岩寺风景秀丽，明代文学家王世贞有“登泰山不至灵岩不成游”之说。
accessEn: Lingyan Temple is in Wande subdistrict, Changqing District, about 33 km south of central Jinan and 20 km north of Tai'an. Driving or a taxi from Jinan takes about an hour; public bus routes change, so check a current route planner for stops named 灵岩寺.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 临淄齐国故城
summaryEn: Linzi was the capital of the state of Qi for centuries, and its ruins in Qidu town cover about 15 sq km, with a large city and a smaller palace city at its south-western corner. Stretches of rammed-earth wall still stand, the remains of the 14 m-high Huangong platform mark the old palace area, and a drainage-outlet site shows the culverts that carried water out under the wall. The Qi Culture Museum and, a short drive away, the Ancient Chariot Museum with its underground burial pit bring the finds from the city and its tombs together.
description: 临淄齐国故城位于中国山东省淄博市临淄区，为齐国都城遗址。故城分大、小城两部分，小城在大城西南，其东北与大城西南连接。两城总面积15平方公里。
accessEn: Linzi District is about 27 km east of central Zibo by taxi, bus or car; the sites are spread over several km, so a taxi or car is the practical way to link them. From Jinan, take a high-speed train to Zibo (under an hour) and continue by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 青岛啤酒博物馆
summaryEn: The museum fills the original red-brick buildings of the Tsingtao brewery, founded here in 1903 by German and British merchants and now a national heritage unit. It opened in 2003 as China's first beer museum, and covers the brewery's history and the story of brewing, with a production area, fresh beer to taste and holographic and projection displays. It is an easy half-day add-on to Qingdao's German-era sights.
description: 青岛啤酒博物馆，位于中华人民共和国山东省青岛市市北区登州路，是在国家重点文物保护单位青岛啤酒厂早期建筑的基础上建设而成的中国第一家以啤酒为主题的的博物馆，同时是国家4A级旅游景区、国家一级博物馆、国家首批工农业旅游示范点。
accessEn: On Dengzhou Road in Shibei district, about 3 km north-east of central Qingdao and a short taxi or bus ride from the old town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 成山头
summaryEn: Chengshantou is the rocky cape at the eastern tip of the Shandong Peninsula, with the sea on three sides and eroded coastal cliffs. On the headland stand the Qin Shihuang Temple, described as China's only temple to the first Qin emperor, and Weihai's oldest lighthouse. It suits a half day of coastal walking and sightseeing.
description: 成山头，位于中国山东省威海市荣成市成山镇，为山东半岛最东端。因该地地处成山山脉的最东端，故而得名。成山头三面环海，一面接陆。
accessEn: From Weihai, the cape is about 53 km east-south-east by road, roughly an hour's drive or taxi ride; by train, take the Qingdao–Rongcheng line to Rongcheng, from where it is about 32 km north-east. Check current local bus services to the scenic area before relying on them.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 孟庙孟府
summaryEn: Zoucheng is the hometown of Mencius, the thinker honoured as the 'Second Sage' after Confucius. His temple, with a grand green-tiled main hall, and the neighbouring mansion of his descendants are known with his forest cemetery as the 'Three Meng' sites. They echo Qufu's great ensemble on a smaller and much calmer scale, and make an easy half-day add-on.
description: 孟庙，又称亚圣庙，位于中国山东省邹城市千泉街道南关，是祭祀儒家亚圣孟子的庙宇，与同在邹城的孟府、孟林合称“三孟”，1988年被列入第三批全国重点文物保护单位。
accessEn: Zoucheng is about 20 km south of Qufu; frequent buses and taxis link the two, and Qufu East on the Beijing–Shanghai high-speed line is the nearest fast-train stop. Zoucheng has its own station on the conventional Beijing–Shanghai line, though not every train stops there, and Jining is about 34 km to the west.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 豫园与城隍庙
summaryEn: Yu Garden is a Ming-dynasty private garden in the north-east of Shanghai's old walled city, divided by walls into a string of smaller gardens with rockeries, ponds, pavilions and halls. Next door the City God Temple, a working Taoist temple, and the busy Yuyuan bazaar make it an easy half-day of old Shanghai. The national listing also covers the nearby Chenxiang Pavilion, a working Buddhist nunnery.
description: 豫园是建于明朝时期的古典园林，座落于中华人民共和国上海市黄浦区，原上海老城厢东北部，北靠福佑路，东临安仁街，西南有城隍庙、豫园商城。豫园建于1559年，最初是四川布政使潘允端的私人园林，他建造此园林的目的是“愉悦老亲”，而“愉”和“豫”意思相通，故而得名豫园。
accessEn: Metro Lines 10 and 14 to Yuyuan Garden station, then a walk of about 400 m through the bazaar streets. The garden's entrance is on Anren Street, just past the Zigzag Bridge.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上海博物馆
summaryEn: Shanghai's museum of ancient Chinese art has been housed since 1996 in a building on People's Square whose shape recalls an ancient bronze ding vessel. Since Shanghai Museum East opened in Pudong in 2024, the permanent galleries of bronzes, ceramics, painting, calligraphy, jade and more are shown there. From July 2026 to November 2027 the People's Square building shows only one large exhibition, on the ancient civilisations of the Americas.
description: 上海博物馆位于位于上海市黄浦区人民大道201号，是上海最大的一所综合性古代艺术博物馆，现任馆长为褚晓波。馆内藏品数量达102余万件，涵盖三十多个门类，其中青铜器、陶瓷和书画是最为突出的。
highlights: 中国历代绘画馆与书法馆
中国古代玉器馆与玺印篆刻馆
中国古代陶瓷馆与陶瓷与中外交流专题馆
上海博物馆人民广场馆
accessEn: The People's Square building is by Exit 1 of People's Square station (Lines 1, 2 and 8), with the entrance at the south gate on Wusheng Road. Shanghai Museum East is in Pudong on Century Avenue, by Shanghai Science and Technology Museum station (Line 2, Exit 8), Xiangcheng Road (Line 4) or Pudian Road (Line 6).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 朱家角古镇
summaryEn: Zhujiajiao is a canal town in Qingpu District, west of central Shanghai, where stone bridges cross narrow waterways lined with old rice shops, tea houses and temples. It is the easiest water town to reach by metro, and wandering the back lanes or taking a canal boat gives a taste of Jiangnan life without leaving the city.
description: 景区内可游览放生桥、北大街、课植园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Metro Line 17 runs from Hongqiao Railway Station to Zhujiajiao station, roughly an hour from central Shanghai with a transfer or two; the old town is a walk or short ride from the station.

name: 佘山
summaryEn: Two low wooded hills, East and West Sheshan, rise from the Songjiang plain and form the core of a national forest park. West Sheshan is crowned by the Basilica of Our Lady of Sheshan, a Catholic pilgrimage church reached by a path lined with the Stations of the Cross. Beside it stands the old Sheshan Observatory, built by French Jesuits and since 2004 the Shanghai Astronomical Museum.
description: 佘山，位于中华人民共和国上海市松江区佘山镇，分东佘山和西佘山，海拔分别是72.4米和97.2米。佘山现划有佘山国家森林公园。
accessEn: Metro Line 9 runs to Sheshan station, about an hour from central Shanghai (change at Xujiahui or Century Avenue, as Line 9 does not stop at People's Square), then a short taxi or bus ride to the West Sheshan entrance.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上海犹太难民纪念馆
summaryEn: A museum built around the former Ohel Moshe Synagogue in Hongkou's Tilanqiao Historic Area, telling the story of the roughly 20,000 Jewish refugees from Nazi-ruled Europe who found shelter in Shanghai between 1938 and 1945. Documents, photographs, personal belongings and reconstructed scenes sit in the restored synagogue and in halls added in a 2020 expansion. It is a quiet, moving stop that shows a side of the city most visitors never hear about.
description: 景区内可游览摩西会堂、展厅、名单墙。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Metro Line 12 to Tilanqiao station and walk from Exit 1; it takes about 25 minutes by metro from People's Square, changing once. The museum is at Changyang Road 62.

name: 上海辰山植物园
summaryEn: Shanghai's second botanical garden and its largest, opened in 2010–2011 around Chenshan hill and covering 207 hectares. The central display area has more than 20 themed gardens, among them one in a former quarry pit, plus large exhibition glasshouses, while the wooded hill is kept for conserving native plants. In 2026 the State Council approved its upgrade to Shanghai Chenshan National Botanical Garden.
description: 景区内可游览矿坑花园、展览温室、月季园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Take Metro Line 9 to Dongjing station (the stop the garden lists; Sheshan station also works), about an hour from central Shanghai with a change, then a local bus or the garden's shuttle where running, or a taxi, for the last few kilometres.

name: 应县木塔
summaryEn: In the county town of Yingxian, south of Datong, the octagonal timber pagoda of Fogong Temple rises more than 65 metres, with five outer storeys hiding four mezzanine floors. Built in 1056 under the Khitan Liao dynasty, it is the oldest surviving all-wooden pagoda in China, and Guinness World Records lists it as the world's tallest wooden pagoda. Walk round it to study its 54 kinds of interlocking wooden bracket sets (dougong), then step into the ground floor to see the great seated Buddha.
description: 佛宫寺释迦塔，通称应县木塔，位于中华人民共和国山西省朔州市应县，是中国现存最古老的木塔和二十世纪前世界最高的木建筑。始建于辽清宁二年，并且在金代、元代、明代和清代被多次修葺。该塔曾经历过数次大地震，并于1926年在军阀混战中被二百多发炮弹击中，受到很大的创伤，但塔身并未倾倒。
accessEn: High-speed trains reach Yingxian West in about 20–30 minutes from Datong South or about 1.5 hours from Taiyuan South; take a taxi from the station into town. By car it is about 1–1.5 hours from Datong.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 王家大院
summaryEn: On a loess terrace above Jingsheng town in Lingshi county, the Wang family built a series of walled residential compounds between the late 17th and early 19th centuries, among the largest of Shanxi's merchant mansions. The open sections alone hold more than 100 courtyards and over 1,000 rooms: climb through the Gaojiaya and Red Gate Castle complexes and look closely at the carved stone, brick and wood, much of it based on folk themes.
description: 王家大院位于山西省晋中市灵石县城东12公里处的中国历史文化名镇静升镇，是中国最大的民居建筑之一，也是山西最大的一座保存完好的建筑群。该院是清代民居建筑的重要代表，在2006年入选全国重点文物保护单位。
accessEn: Lingshi East station, about an hour from Taiyuan South by high-speed train, is roughly 5 km from the compound, around 15 minutes by taxi; from Pingyao, about 35 km away, allow under an hour by taxi or hired car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 双林寺
summaryEn: About 6 km south-west of Pingyao's walls and part of the Pingyao World Heritage Site, Shuanglin Temple hides behind a high, fortress-like wall, and its ten halls around three courtyards hold some 2,000 painted clay figures made between the 12th and 19th centuries, many of them in the Ming dynasty. Look for the arhats (Buddhist saints) in the Arhat Hall and, in the Thousand Buddha Hall, the relaxed Guanyin and the twisting guardian Weituo, the temple's best-known figure.
description: 双林寺位于中华人民共和国山西省平遥县城西南6公里的桥头村，初名“中都寺”，是一座始建于北魏时期的佛寺。现存建筑主要为明清两代重修。双林寺内保存有大量彩塑作品，共有10座大殿、约2052尊彩塑像，包括佛、菩萨、罗汉、天王、力士等多种题材，被联合国教科文组织誉为“东方彩塑艺术长廊”。
accessEn: Shuanglin is about 6 km south-west of Pingyao's old town and close to Pingyao Gucheng high-speed station, under an hour from Taiyuan South; a taxi from either takes 10–20 minutes.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 广胜寺
summaryEn: In the Huoshan foothills about 17 km north-east of Hongtong town, Guangsheng Temple is in two parts: the Upper Temple on the hill, dominated by the 47-metre Flying Rainbow Pagoda, and the Lower Temple and Water God Temple beside the Huoquan spring below. Start with the pagoda, faced with yellow, green and blue glazed tiles, then walk down to the Lower Temple's Yuan-dynasty halls, rebuilt after an earthquake in 1303, and the murals of the Water God Temple.
description: 广胜寺位于山西省临汾市洪洞县县城东北17公里霍山上下，是一座著名佛教寺院。著名佛教大藏经赵城金藏就是出自广胜寺，1961年广胜寺被列入第一批全国重点文物保护单位。广胜寺由广胜上寺、广胜下寺及水神庙三组古建筑组成，雄踞山顶的称上寺；坐落山脚，面临霍泉的为下寺；下寺西侧为水神庙。
accessEn: High-speed trains from Taiyuan South reach Hongtong West in about 1–1.5 hours; from there the temple is about 25 km by taxi or hired car, roughly 30–40 minutes. From central Linfen allow about an hour by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 永乐宫
summaryEn: Just north of Ruicheng town in Shanxi's far south-west, Yongle Palace (gong, 'palace', is a title for major Taoist temples) is dedicated to the immortal Lü Dongbin and holds about 1,000 square metres of murals from the Yuan dynasty (1271–1368). Walk north from the gate to the Hall of the Three Pure Ones, where a procession of nearly 300 deities fills the walls, then on to the Chunyang and Chongyang halls, where the lives of Lü Dongbin and the Taoist master Wang Chongyang unfold in strip-cartoon-like scenes.
description: 永乐宫，原名大纯阳万寿宫，位于山西省运城市芮城县城北3公里的古魏镇龙泉村东侧，是一座大型道教宫观，全真教三大祖庭之一，创建于公元1247年至1358年间，为纪念八仙之一的吕洞宾所建，是现存最大的元代道教宫观。
accessEn: Take high-speed rail to Yuncheng North (about 1 hour from Xi'an North or 2–2.5 hours from Taiyuan South), then a taxi or hired car south over the Zhongtiao Mountains to Ruicheng, about 1–1.5 hours. Buses also run from Yuncheng to Ruicheng town, about 3 km south of the temple.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 解州关帝庙
summaryEn: In Xiezhou town, about 20 km south-west of central Yuncheng, this is one of the largest temples to Guan Yu, a general of the Three Kingdoms era (220–280) later worshipped as a god of loyalty and war. Begin in the Jieyi Garden, named after the oath of brotherhood Guan Yu swore with Liu Bei and Zhang Fei, then follow the main axis north through a series of gateways and the main Chongning Hall to the Chunqiu Tower, where an upstairs statue shows Guan Yu reading the Spring and Autumn Annals.
description: 解州关帝庙位于中国山西运城市盐湖区解州镇解州村西五一路145号，距离市区20公里，为中国最大的关帝庙，全国重点文物保护单位之一。解州关帝庙是中国和海内外三大关帝庙之一。
accessEn: Take high-speed rail to Yuncheng North (about 1 hour from Xi'an North or 2–2.5 hours from Taiyuan South), then take a taxi for the 30–40 minute drive to Xiezhou; city buses also run from central Yuncheng to Xiezhou town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 运城盐湖
summaryEn: Known in ancient times as the Hedong salt pond, Yuncheng Salt Lake covers about 130 square kilometres along the southern edge of Yuncheng city, below the Zhongtiao Mountains. Walk or cycle the north-shore greenway past brine ponds that in warm weather turn shades of red, pink, yellow and green, then visit the Chishen Temple, which honours the gods of the salt pond, the wind and the sun, and the Hedong salt museum nearby.
description: 运城盐湖位于中国山西省西南部运城市境内，地处中条山北麓，是山西省最大的湖泊，世界第三大硫酸钠型内陆湖泊，于新生代第四纪形成。
accessEn: Take high-speed rail to Yuncheng North (about 1 hour from Xi'an North or 2–2.5 hours from Taiyuan South); the lake's north shore is on the southern edge of the city, about 20 minutes by taxi from the station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 武侯祠与锦里
summaryEn: Chengdu's Wuhou Shrine honours Zhuge Liang, the celebrated strategist of the Three Kingdoms era, together with Liu Bei, the Shu Han emperor he served, whose tomb mound lies within the same walls. Halls of painted statues of ministers and generals, a Tang-dynasty stele and a curving red-walled lane shaded by bamboo make it China's best-known Three Kingdoms site. Next door, Jinli is a rebuilt Qing-style street of snack stalls, craft shops and teahouses.
description: 锦里，又名锦里一条街、锦里古街，是位于中国四川省成都市的一条古商业街，最早可追溯到秦汉时期。传说中锦里曾是西蜀历史上最古老、最具有商业气息的街道之一，早在秦汉、三国时期便闻名全国。锦里毗邻武侯祠，颇有古蜀国民风。
accessEn: Metro Line 10, which runs direct from Shuangliu Airport, stops at Wuhouci (Jinli) station, about three minutes' walk from the shrine. Gaoshengqiao station on Lines 3 and 5 is about ten minutes away on foot.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 杜甫草堂
summaryEn: This leafy park in western Chengdu honours Du Fu, the Tang-dynasty poet revered in China as the 'Poet-Sage', on the banks of the Huanhua Stream where he made his home. Paths wind through bamboo groves and plum trees to memorial halls, a gallery of great Chinese poets and a reconstructed thatched hut laid out as his study, bedroom and kitchen. It is one of the calmest places in the city to spend a morning.
description: 杜甫草堂，又名杜甫草堂博物馆，位于中华人民共和国四川省成都市青羊区草堂街道青华路38号，浣花溪公园旁，占地24公顷居住于。1961年3月4日公布为第一批全国重点文物保护单位，2006年12月被中国国家旅游局评为国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: Du Fu Thatched Cottage (Dufu Caotang) station on Metro Line 13, opened in December 2025, is a few minutes' walk from the north gate. Caotang Beilu station on Line 4 is about 15 minutes away on foot.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 三星堆博物馆
summaryEn: More than 3,000 years ago, a kingdom on the Chengdu Plain cast bronzes unlike anything else in ancient China: huge masks with protruding eyes, a life-size standing figure and a sacred tree nearly 4 metres tall. A vast new museum hall opened beside the excavation site in 2023, displaying more than 1,500 pieces, including gold masks and other treasures from six further sacrificial pits dug since 2020. In the restoration hall you can watch conservators piecing together the latest finds.
description: 三星堆遗址位于中国四川省广汉市城西三星堆镇的鸭子河畔，属青铜时代文化遗址。由于其古域内有起伏相连的三个黄土堆而得名，有“三星伴月”之美名。遗址年代为公元前2,800年至公元前1,100年，分为四期，第一期为宝墩文化，第二、三期为三星堆文化，第四期为十二桥文化。
accessEn: Trains from Chengdu East reach Guanghan North or Sanxingdui station in about 20–25 minutes, then it's a 10–15-minute taxi ride to the museum; taxis can be scarce at busy times. Direct tourist buses from central Chengdu take about 1.5 hours.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 洛带古镇
summaryEn: Luodai, on Chengdu's eastern fringe, is the heart of Sichuan's Hakka community, and many residents still speak the Hakka language. Its real treasures are a set of nationally protected Qing-era guild halls built by settlers from Guangdong, Jiangxi and Huguang (Hubei and Hunan), with carved opera stages and quiet courtyards. Expect a busy, commercial main street of snack stalls and souvenir shops; the halls and side lanes are the reward.
description: 景区内可游览广东会馆、湖广会馆、江西会馆。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Direct express buses run from Wuguiqiao bus station in eastern Chengdu, or take Metro Line 4 to Xihe and change to a local bus; allow about an hour each way. A taxi from the city centre takes around 40 minutes.
imageCredit: This image was produced by me, David Castor (user:dcastor). The pictures I submit to the W

name: 若尔盖草原与黄河九曲第一湾
summaryEn: The Zoige grassland spreads across Sichuan's northern edge at around 3,500 m, part of one of the world's largest high-altitude marshes. Near Tangke, the Yellow River coils across the plain and swings almost completely round to head back into Qinghai, and a hillside stairway beside Suokezang Monastery gives the classic view, best at sunset. Boardwalks at Flower Lake (Huahu) lead out into the wetland, bright with flowers in early summer.
description: 景区内可游览黄河九曲第一湾、索克藏寺、花湖。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
accessEn: Take the train from Chengdu to Huanglong Jiuzhai station (about 2 hours), then it's roughly 2.5 hours by road north across the grassland to Zoige town. Tangke and the First Bend are about 70 km (1–1.5 hours) further west.

name: 嘉阳小火车
summaryEn: The Jiayang railway is a 19.8 km, 762 mm narrow-gauge line in Qianwei County, south of Leshan, built in 1958–59 to haul coal out of the hills. Coal traffic has all but ended, yet small steam locomotives still pull open-windowed carriages over a zigzag, through tunnels and past terraced fields to the old mining town of Bajiaogou, making it one of the few steam passenger services left anywhere. In late February and March the valleys glow yellow with rapeseed.
description: 芭石铁路，是一条位于中华人民共和国四川省乐山市犍为县的窄轨铁路。该铁路是为了方便运送煤炭的矿山铁路，于1959年7月12日开通，并被附近居民用作代步。铁路起点处停止产煤后，居民仍然需要以小火车进出山岭，被称作嘉阳小火车。
accessEn: High-speed trains reach Qianwei station in about an hour from Chengdu East or 15 minutes from Leshan. Yuejin station, where the steam trains start, is then a taxi ride of roughly 20–25 km.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天津之眼
summaryEn: Tianjin Eye is a 120-metre Ferris wheel built into Yongle Bridge, right over the Hai River beside the Sanchakou confluence. Its 48 enclosed capsules take about half an hour for a full turn, giving a slow view over the river and the city. It is lit in the evening and makes a good sunset-to-night stop.
description: 天津之眼是位于中国天津市海河上的大型摩天轮，坐落于永乐桥中央，被誉为天津的城市地标之一。“天津之眼”由日本川口卫设计事务所，是世界上唯一一座建在桥梁上的摩天轮，兼具交通枢纽与观光功能。作为天津重要的旅游设施和文化地标，“天津之眼”不仅是城市形象的象征，也成为海河夜景的重要组成部分，吸引大量国内外游客前来参观。
accessEn: On Yongle Bridge over the Hai River, about 2.7 km north-west of Tianjin Railway Station; city buses stop at Yongle Bridge and nearby Jingang Bridge, or take a taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天津意式风情区
summaryEn: The former Italian concession, laid out from 1902: a district of historic Italian-style buildings, restored from 2002 and now given over to restaurants, shops and hotels. Its centre is Marco Polo Square, where a column topped by a peace figure stands among Italian-style villas. The square and its buildings are a national heritage unit.
description: 景区内可游览马可波罗广场、梁启超旧居与饮冰室、但丁广场。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Hebei District, about 1 km west-south-west of Tianjin Railway Station, on foot or by short taxi ride; Metro Line 2 has a station named for the district (Jianguodao–Yifengqu).

name: 国家海洋博物馆
summaryEn: China's national maritime museum, opened for trial operation on 1 May 2019, is run jointly by the Ministry of Natural Resources and the Tianjin government. Its exhibitions cover the geological history of the oceans, marine life, ships and maritime culture, and it keeps a preserved Type 037IG missile boat. The building was designed by Australian architect Philip Cox.
description: 国家海洋博物馆位于中华人民共和国天津市滨海新区中新天津生态城滨海旅游区荣盛路与海轩道交口。该馆由中华人民共和国自然资源部与天津市人民政府共建共管，隶属于天津市滨海新区人民政府，是公益二类文化事业单位，集收藏、展示、研究与教育于一体，是中国唯一的国家级综合性海洋博物馆。
highlights: 菲利普·考克斯设计的馆舍
accessEn: In the Binhai Tourism Zone of the Sino-Singapore Tianjin Eco-city, Binhai New Area, about 13 km north-east of Tanggu; it is far from central Tianjin, and a taxi or ride-hailing from Tanggu or the Eco-city is easiest.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 独乐寺
summaryEn: Dule Temple, in the old town of Jizhou, keeps two timber buildings from 984, the mountain gate and the Guanyin Pavilion, which are among the oldest surviving wooden buildings in China. Inside the pavilion a clay eleven-headed Guanyin about 16 metres tall rises through the full height of the building. It is a compact, rewarding stop for anyone curious about early Chinese architecture.
description: 独乐寺，又称大佛寺，位于中华人民共和国天津市蓟州区文昌街道武定街41号，现存三大辽代寺院之一。独乐寺始建时间说法不一，梁思成认为“至迟亦在唐初”。天宝十四年，安禄山起兵叛唐并在此誓师。
accessEn: Jizhou is about 100 km north of central Tianjin: trains from Tianjin Railway Station to Jizhou North take roughly 2 to 2.5 hours, and long-distance buses (nos. 187 and 188) run from the station area to Jizhou bus terminal. From either, local buses reach the temple on Wuding Street in the old town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黄崖关长城
summaryEn: Huangyaguan is a section of the Great Wall in the mountains of northern Jizhou, with a fortified pass, a five-arch water gate and square and round watchtowers climbing the ridge. The complex includes an Eight Trigrams street maze and a Great Wall museum, with a statue of General Qi Jiguang at Taipingzhai on the hillside. It lies in the same district as Mount Pan.
description: 黄崖关是长城在天津市蓟州区下营镇黄崖关村的一处关口，距蓟州城区北约30千米。黄崖关在明代是防御满族入侵的重要关口，当时名将戚继光驻守在这里，他主持重新修缮了长城。这一段长城包括了长城的众多要素，有水关、烽火台、方型圆型各种敌楼、还有寨堡、敌台等，建筑材料也不仅用砖，还掺杂石材。
accessEn: It lies in Xiaying town in the far north of Jizhou, close to the Hebei border. From Tianjin, a direct bus ran from Tongsha bus station near Tianjin Railway Station in about 2.5 hours (four a day in 2024); alternatively take a train to Jizhou North in about 2 hours, then a taxi of roughly an hour or Jizhou bus no. 3.
imageCredit: Ronnie Macdonald from Chelmsford, United Kingdom
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大沽口炮台
summaryEn: These coastal forts at the mouth of the Hai River were rebuilt and extended several times under the Qing and saw fighting in 1858, 1859, 1860 and again in 1900. The restored Wei fort on the south bank, opened to visitors in 1997, survives beside a memorial park. A museum in a rust-coloured steel building covers the forts, the wars fought here and the 1901 protocol.
description: 大沽口炮台是近代中国主要军事防御设施之一，也是三次大沽口战役主战场。该遗址目前位于中国天津市滨海新区东炮台路。目前，大沽口炮台被中华人民共和国国务院批准为全国重点文物保护单位，天津市文物保护单位和中华人民共和国全国爱国主义教育示范基地，目前为大沽口炮台博物馆和大沽口炮台遗址公园，为“津门十景”之一。
accessEn: The forts are in Dagu, about 60 km south-east of central Tianjin on the south bank of the river mouth. A taxi or ride-hailing from Tanggu is easiest.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 石家大院
summaryEn: The mansion of the Qing-dynasty merchant Shi Yuanshi, one of Tianjin's 'eight great families', was begun in 1875 and now houses the Yangliuqing Museum on the South Canal. Its courtyards are noted for brick, wood and stone carving and include a private theatre. Displays cover local folk art, with Yangliuqing New Year prints, brick carving, paper-cuts, kites and customs of weddings and merchants.
description: 石家大院，又称“尊美堂”，位于天津市杨柳青镇估衣街47号，始建于1875年，为当时“天津八大家”之一石万程的第四子石元士的宅院。目前，石家大院被中华人民共和国国务院批准为全国重点文物保护单位，被天津市人民政府批准为天津市文物保护单位和特殊保护等级历史风貌建筑。
accessEn: Yangliuqing lies in Xiqing District, west of central Tianjin. Take a taxi or ride-hailing, or a city bus to the town; the courtyard stands on the old canal town's waterfront.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 羊卓雍措
summaryEn: Yamdrok Yumtso, one of Tibet's three great sacred lakes, is a long, branching turquoise lake ringed by snow mountains and believed to be the dwelling of a protector goddess. Viewpoints on the road along its northern shore look out over the water and its islands, home to many water birds. Samding Monastery, headed by a female incarnate lama, stands on a peninsula near Nagarzê on the south-western side.
description: 景区内可游览岗巴拉山口、湖畔观景点、湖中岛屿。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About two to three hours by road south-west of Lhasa via Gonggar, climbing to the Kamba La pass before descending to the shore; the same road continues to Gyantse and Shigatse. Carry your passport for road checkpoints.

name: 西藏博物馆
summaryEn: The Tibet Museum is the region's main museum, first opened in 1999 and reopened on 8 July 2022 after being rebuilt and enlarged on the same site beside Norbulingka. It holds some 520,000 objects, and its permanent displays run from Neolithic tools to thangkas, bronzes and manuscripts. It is a good, calm half-day for when you want a break from monasteries and altitude.
description: 西藏博物馆位于拉萨市城关区，是西藏第一座具有现代化功能的博物馆，也是西藏唯一一座综合性国家一级博物馆。总占地53,959平方米，建筑面积达23,508平方米，包括三个部分：主馆区，民俗文化苑和办公区，展厅面积为10,451平方米，馆藏瓷器、玉器、佛像、唐卡、典籍特别是印章、封诰等历史文物52万余件其藏品包括西藏史前文化遗物，并入中国后被历代帝王晋封的历史展品，藏族文化艺术作品以及民俗文化藏品等，是开展爱国主义和民族团结教育的重要基地。
highlights: 雪域长歌——西藏历史与文化
离太阳最近的人——西藏民俗文化
accessEn: On Norbulingka Road next to Norbulingka, about 3 km west of the Potala Palace; a taxi from central Lhasa takes 10–15 minutes.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 罗布林卡
summaryEn: Norbulingka, the 'Jewel Park', was begun in 1755 by the 7th Dalai Lama and served as the summer residence of the Dalai Lamas from the 1780s until 1959. Inside its walled gardens stand several palaces and a lake pavilion, among them the Takten Migyur Phodrang completed in 1956. It is the gentlest sight in Lhasa: shaded lawns, flower beds and murals, and part of the Potala Palace World Heritage Site since 2001.
description: 景区内可游览格桑颇章、措吉颇章、金色颇章。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Norbulingka Road about 3 km west of the Potala Palace; a taxi from central Lhasa takes about 10–15 minutes.

name: 哲蚌寺
summaryEn: Drepung was founded in 1416 by Jamyang Chöje Tashi Palden, a disciple of Tsongkhapa, on the slopes of Mount Gephel west of Lhasa. A visitor in 1936–37 reported some 7,700 monks here, which made it the largest monastery in Tibet at the time. Visitors climb through its lanes and courtyards to the great assembly hall and chapels, with views back over the Lhasa valley.
description: 哲蚌寺，位于中国西藏自治区拉萨市城关区金珠西路街道北京西路276号。为藏传佛教格鲁派寺院，拉萨“三大寺”之一，全名吉祥米聚十方尊胜洲。哲蚌，藏语“米堆”之意。
accessEn: About 5 km west of central Lhasa, on the slope of Gephel mountain; a taxi from the city takes about 20–30 minutes.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 桑耶寺
summaryEn: Samye is traditionally counted as the first Buddhist monastery in Tibet, founded in the 8th century under King Trisong Detsen. Its plan is a three-dimensional mandala: a tall central hall, the Utse, stands inside a circular wall and is ringed by four coloured stupas and smaller shrines. Rebuilt since the late 1980s, it is a rare place where the earliest chapter of Tibetan Buddhism feels tangible.
description: 桑耶寺，或桑耶贡巴，又名“存想寺”、“无边寺”，位于中国西藏自治区山南市的扎囊县桑耶镇境内，雅鲁藏布江北岸的哈布山下。它始建于公元8世纪吐蕃王朝时期，是西藏第一座剃度僧人出家的寺院。寺内建筑按佛教的宇宙观进行布局，中心佛殿兼具藏族、汉族、印度三种风格，因此也被称作“三样寺”。
accessEn: About an hour by road from Tsetang, on the north bank of the Yarlung Tsangpo, and roughly 3 hours by road from Lhasa.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 雍布拉康
summaryEn: Yumbulagang is a small white tower topped with a golden roof, perched on a ridge above the green Yarlung valley. Tradition holds it was the palace of the legendary first king, Nyatri Tsenpo. It was later turned into a monastery, and the viewpoint over fields and mountains is the best reason to climb up.
description: 雍布拉康，位于西藏自治区山南市乃东区东南约5公里、昌珠镇境内的扎西次日山上。相传由雅隆部落的首领聂赤赞普于公元前127年建造，是西藏的第一座宫殿。
accessEn: About 9 km south of Tsetang, roughly 20 minutes by road. From Lhasa it is roughly 3–4 hours by road, so it is normally combined with other Shannan sights.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 白居寺
summaryEn: Palcho Monastery (Pelkor Chöde) was built from 1418 by the local ruler Rabten Kunzang Phag and is unusual for sheltering several Buddhist schools, Gelug, Sakya and Shalu, in one compound. Beside its assembly hall rises the Kumbum, a many-tiered stupa whose chapels are lined with 15th-century murals and statues in Gyantse's own style. Above the town stands Gyantse Dzong, the old fortress, whose steps and walls make a good second stop.
description: 白居寺，藏语称“班廓曲德”，位于中国西藏自治区日喀则市江孜县江孜镇，是一座藏传佛教萨迦派、夏鲁派、格鲁派共存的寺院。
accessEn: In the north-west of Gyantse town, about 90–100 km by road south-east of Shigatse, which takes around 1.5–2 hours. From Lhasa it is about 260 km, usually 4–5 hours by road via the Yamdrok Lake highway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 萨迦寺
summaryEn: Sakya Monastery, founded in 1073, is the seat of the Sakya school of Tibetan Buddhism, whose leaders held a leading role in Tibet in the 13th and 14th centuries. The South Monastery is a massive walled complex painted in the school's grey with red and white stripes; inside, a great assembly hall is lined with a huge library of scriptures. The quiet town around it is and rewarding for a half-day.
description: 萨迦寺，地点位于中国西藏自治区日喀则市萨迦县本波山下，是一座藏传佛教萨迦派寺院，也是萨迦派的主寺。
accessEn: In Sakya town, about 130–150 km by road south-west of Shigatse on a branch road off the G318, taking around 2.5–3 hours. It is often visited on the way between Shigatse and the Everest region.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 米堆冰川
summaryEn: Midui Glacier flows down from the mountains above Midui village in Bomê County, where two great icefalls merge with a strip of forest between them, at the meeting of the Nyenchen Tanglha and Boshula ranges. Its tongue ends at only about 2,400 m, almost at the village fields, which is unusually low and makes the glacier easy to reach from the Sichuan–Tibet road.
description: 米堆冰川位于西藏林芝市波密县城以东约100公里的玉普乡，川藏线318国道旁。冰川由两条世界级冰瀑布汇流而成，两条冰瀑之间还分布着一片郁郁葱葱的原始森林，冰川末端一直延伸到山脚下的米堆村。壮美的雪山冰川和如诗如画的田园风光和谐并存，构成了一幅特有的风景线。
accessEn: About 100 km east of Bomê town along the G318, then a short side road to Midui village; Bomê is a long day's drive east of Bayi (Nyingchi city) on the Sichuan–Tibet road.
imageCredit: Jan Reurink Camera location29° 28′ 11.7″ N, 96° 30′ 02.9″ E View this and other nearby ima
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 冈仁波齐—玛旁雍错
summaryEn: Mount Kailash (Kang Rinpoche, 6,638 m) and Lake Manasarovar (Mapham Yumtso in Tibetan) form a sacred landscape for Buddhists, Hindus, Jains and followers of Bön, and pilgrims come to walk around the mountain and bathe in the lake. The roughly 52–53 km kora around Kailash starts and ends at Darchen (4,670 m) and crosses the Drölma La at over 5,600 m, usually over three days. The freshwater lake, about 320 km² at some 4,600 m, lies south of the mountain, reached by road from Darchen.
description: 冈仁波齐峰，又称吉罗娑山，是冈底斯山脉的第二高峰，海拔6638米，位于中国西藏普兰县巴嘎镇境内，其南面是圣湖玛旁雍错和拉昂错，北麓是印度河上游狮泉河的发源地。冈仁波齐峰的高度有6638米、6650米、6656米、6714米等说法，这几种海拔基本都是20世纪初期各国探险家的测量数值，但至今未见中国主管部门正式发布对其的精确测定数据。
accessEn: Darchen, the base for the kora, is about 330 km from Shiquanhe (Ali), Ngari's main town, a long day's drive; the lake shore at Chiu Monastery lies to the south of Darchen. Most travellers fly to Ngari Gunsa airport at Shiquanhe or drive for several days from Lhasa. Carry your passport for road checkpoints.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 古格王国遗址
summaryEn: The ruined capital of the Guge kingdom, which ruled this part of western Tibet from the 10th century until it fell in the 1630s, is built up an earth hill above the Langqên Zangbo (Sutlej) valley. More than 300 rooms, over 300 caves, stupas, tunnels and the remains of palaces climb about 175 m from base to summit, and the White Temple, Red Temple and other halls keep murals and sculpture that the Dunhuang Academy restored in 2012–13. About 18–20 km east, in Zanda town, Tholing Monastery, founded around 997, is the oldest monastery in Ngari and still holds important murals; together they make western Tibet's best-known historical sites.
description: 古格王国遗址，位于西藏自治区阿里地区札达县象泉河南岸山上，距离札达县城约18公里，占地约1.8万平方千米。这里曾是吐蕃王室后裔所建立的古格王国的中心。17世纪中叶，这里被外来的拉达克入侵者毁坏，仅存遗址。
accessEn: Tsaparang is about 18 km west of Zanda (Tholing) town by road, and Tholing Monastery stands in the town itself. Zanda lies about 280 km from Shiquanhe and roughly 260 km from Darchen, so it is usually combined with a Kailash trip.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 阿巴和加麻扎
summaryEn: The Afaq Khoja Mausoleum is a 17th-century family shrine north-east of Kashgar, with a tomb hall faced in green and yellow glazed tiles under a large dome and four slender corner minarets. Around it stand prayer halls with carved wooden columns, a lecture hall, a gatehouse and a working graveyard, making it among the finest pieces of Islamic architecture in Xinjiang. It is also popularly known as the Tomb of the Fragrant Concubine.
description: 景区内可游览陵墓主殿、门楼、礼拜寺与讲经堂。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: The mausoleum is in Ayziret village, about 5 km north-east of central Kashgar, a short taxi ride from the Old City. Kashgar is about 1.5–2 hours by air from Ürümqi.

name: 新疆维吾尔自治区博物馆
summaryEn: Xinjiang's regional museum, founded in 1959, is a national first-grade museum with more than 24,000 catalogued objects, in a building opened in 2005 and extended in 2022. Its galleries trace Xinjiang's history from the pre-Qin period to the Qing and are strongest on the desert-preserved finds: ancient mummies, costumes and textiles, and excavated documents. It is the best single stop in Ürümqi for understanding the Silk Road oases.
description: 景区内可游览新疆历史文物展、五星出东方利中国护膊、新疆出土古尸陈列。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 五星出东方利中国护膊
accessEn: The museum is on Xibei Road in Saybag District, north-west of central Ürümqi, reached by city bus or a short taxi ride from the centre. Ürümqi has the region's main international airport.

name: 新疆国际大巴扎
summaryEn: Xinjiang's best-known bazaar complex opened in 2003 in the Erdaoqiao district and mixes Islamic, Uyghur and Chinese building styles. Inside are market halls of dried fruit, carpets, musical instruments and crafts, a Silk Road tower more than 70 m high, a mosque, a theatre with resident song-and-dance shows and a food street. It is more of a tourist market than an everyday one, but the food and the evening atmosphere make it an easy first stop in Ürümqi.
description: 景区内可游览丝绸之路塔、清真寺、大巴扎市场。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: The bazaar is in Erdaoqiao, Tianshan District, in the south of central Ürümqi, with city buses stopping outside and taxis easy from the centre.

name: 克孜尔千佛洞
summaryEn: Kizil is the largest Buddhist cave complex of the ancient Kucha kingdom and said to be the earliest major cave complex in China, cut into cliffs on the Muzat River's north bank from about the 3rd century until the 8th–9th centuries. It has hundreds of caves (236 numbered in English Wikipedia, nearly 400 by Chinese counts), around 80 of them with murals in the distinctive Kucha style, and has been part of the Silk Roads World Heritage listing since 2014. Visitors see a selection of the caves with a guide.
description: 克孜尔千佛洞，又称克孜尔石窟或赫色尔石窟，中国佛教石窟，1961年公布的第一批全国重点文物保护单位之一，位于新疆拜城县克孜尔镇东南7千米明屋塔格山的悬崖上，南面是渭干河河谷。现存编号石窟共有236窟，大部分塑像都已被毁，还有81窟存有精美壁画，为古代龟兹国的文化遗存。
accessEn: The caves are about 65 km in a straight line and 75 km by road west of Kuqa (Kucha), near Kizil township in Baicheng County; Kuqa has rail and air links and is the usual base, and day tours and hired cars run from there. Aksu city is much farther away.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 翠湖公园
summaryEn: Green Lake is a small park in central Kunming, its four ponds divided by willow-lined causeways and arched bridges and dotted with pavilions. Locals gather here from early morning to sing, dance and play music, and from about November to March thousands of black-headed gulls winter on the water, swooping over the bridges as visitors feed them. The streets around it, by the old campus of Yunnan University, are some of the most pleasant in the city to wander.
description: 翠湖是位于云南省昆明市中心城区的一个湖泊，围绕其建设有翠湖公园，被誉为镶嵌在昆明城的绿宝石。湖泊北邻圆通山，东接五华山，水体面积约15公顷，海拔1890米，因其八面水翠，四季竹翠，春夏柳翠，故称“翠湖”。
accessEn: Green Lake is in the heart of Kunming, a short walk from Huashan West Road station on Metro Line 5. Most central hotels are within walking distance or a short taxi ride.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 西山龙门
summaryEn: The Western Hills rise steeply along the western shore of Dianchi, Kunming's great lake, cloaked in pine forest and dotted with temples. The highlight is Dragon Gate, where the Taoist halls of Sanqing Ge give way to a chain of shrines, tunnels and stairways cut into a sheer cliff, along a ledge path so narrow that people pass in single file. Along the road up, the Buddhist temples of Huating and Taihua sit in quiet woods.
description: 昆明西山旧称碧鸡山，位于中国云南省省会昆明市西山区境内，是碧峣、华亭、太华、罗汉诸山的总称，距昆明市区15公里。北起碧鸡关，南至海口，沿滇池西岸连绵35公里。因山形似仰卧的大佛或美女，故又称“卧佛山”或“睡美人山”。
accessEn: Metro Line 3 runs to its western terminus, Xishan Park (Western Hills Park), about 15 km from central Kunming; scenic-area shuttle buses climb from the visitor centre there into the hills. The Dianchi cable car also crosses the lake to the Western Hills from Haigeng Park on the eastern shore.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 沙溪古镇
summaryEn: Shaxi is a quiet Bai farming town in a valley between Dali and Lijiang, and its old core, Sideng, is often called the last surviving caravan market on the Tea Horse Road. The cobbled square is framed by a Qing-dynasty opera stage, old caravan inns and the Ming-dynasty Xingjiao Temple, and a short stroll leads out through the east gate to the arched stone Yujin Bridge over the Heihui River. It is far calmer than Dali or Lijiang, especially once the day-trippers leave.
description: 景区内可游览寺登街、兴教寺、古戏台。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
accessEn: Shaxi has no railway: it is about two hours by car from either Dali or Lijiang, and direct buses from both take two to three hours. Vehicles stop at the edge of the old core, which you explore on foot.

name: 虎跳峡
summaryEn: Tiger Leaping Gorge is one of the deepest river canyons on Earth: the Jinsha, as the upper Yangtze is called here, churns through a slot some 15 km long, with the snow peaks of Jade Dragon and Haba rising around 3,800 m above the water on either side. The High Trail, a two-day walk past Naxi villages, waterfalls and family-run guesthouses, is one of China's great treks. Non-hikers can take stairways and cliffside walkways down to the roaring rapids at the Upper Gorge viewing area.
description: 虎跳峡是中国云南省丽江一处峡谷，位于玉龙与香格里拉之间的金沙江干流上。相传金沙江逢枯水期时，有猛虎下山，在此江中的礁石上稍一脚后腾空便越过，故称“虎跳峡”，江中的礁石则称作“虎跳石”。虎跳峡的两岸有雪山对峙，左岸为哈巴雪山，右岸为玉龙雪山，自谷底到山顶高差达3790米。
accessEn: Buses from Lijiang reach Qiaotou (Hutiaoxia town), at the western mouth of the gorge, in about two hours, and shared transfers drop hikers at the trailhead near Naxi Family Guesthouse. The Upper Gorge viewing area is a short drive further along the gorge road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 泸沽湖
summaryEn: Lugu Lake is a deep, clear alpine lake at about 2,700 m, ringed by forested mountains and dotted with small islands, with its western shore in Yunnan and its eastern shore in Sichuan. Stay in Luoshui village or on the slender Lige peninsula, then paddle out in a dugout 'pig-trough' canoe to Liwubi Island and its small temple, or ride the chairlift up Gemu Goddess Mountain for views over the whole lake. On the Sichuan side, a long bridge and boardwalks cross the reed beds of the Grass Sea.
description: 泸沽湖，亦称永宁海、左所海、勒得海、落水海子、谢纳米，是一个高原淡水湖，位于中华人民共和国云南省北部、四川省西南部，即四川省凉山彝族自治州盐源县与云南省丽江市宁蒗彝族自治县之间，横跨川、滇两省。湖泊东南面长满水草的大片湿地称为草海，广阔的水域称为亮海，湖面海拔2690米，面积48.45平方公里。
accessEn: Buses and shared cars from Lijiang take about four hours on winding mountain roads to Luoshui, on the Yunnan shore. Ninglang Lugu Lake Airport is about an hour's drive away, but its flights were suspended in the second half of 2025, so check schedules before relying on it.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 梅里雪山与雨崩
summaryEn: The Meili Snow Mountains form a wall of ice-hung peaks above the Mekong gorge near Deqin, crowned by Kawagarbo (6,740 m), the highest summit in Yunnan. Feilaisi, across the valley, faces the whole range at dawn, and a trail from Mingyong village climbs to viewpoints over a glacier tumbling towards the river. The classic trek leads to Yubeng, a Tibetan village in a high valley beneath the peaks, with day hikes on to a sacred waterfall and a glacier lake.
description: 梅里雪山属于横断山脉，位于云南迪庆藏族自治州德钦县和西藏的林芝市察隅县交界处，距离昆明849公里。梅里雪山属于怒山山脉中段，处于世界闻名的金沙江、澜沧江、怒江“三江并流”地区。梅里雪山北与西藏阿冬格尼山，南与碧罗雪山相连接，相传共有山峰13座，称为太子十三峰。
accessEn: Trains from Lijiang reach Shangri-La in under two hours; from there, buses and hired cars take about 4 hours over the mountains to Deqin and Feilaisi, about 10 km beyond the town. Direct buses from Shangri-La to Ninong, the trailhead for the walk in to Yubeng, take about 4.5 hours.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 白水台
summaryEn: Baishuitai, the 'White Water Terrace', is a hillside of creamy travertine terraces in Sanba township, south-east of Shangri-La, where mineral-rich spring water spills from one shallow pool to the next. Covering about 3 sq km at around 2,380 m on the northern foot of Haba Snow Mountain, it is one of the best-known formations of its kind in China. Boardwalks climb beside the terraces, and it makes a scenic detour on a slow route between Shangri-La and Tiger Leaping Gorge.
description: 白水台是中华人民共和国云南省的一处钙华景观，位于迪庆藏族自治州香格里拉市三坝纳西族乡。白水台的自然景观有“中国版棉花堡”之称，是香格里拉市的旅游景点之一。白水台是东巴教圣地之一，在1993年入选第四批云南省文物保护单位。
accessEn: Baishuitai is about 100 km south-east of Shangri-La, roughly 2–2.5 hours by hired car; buses to Sanba township are slower. From Lijiang, allow 3–4 hours by car via Tiger Leaping Gorge and Haba village.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 良渚古城遗址
summaryEn: The ruins preserve the capital of the Neolithic Liangzhu culture, a rice-farming society that flourished around 3300–2300 BC and was inscribed by UNESCO in 2019. A site park lays out the earthen city walls, the raised Mojiaoshan palace platform and the Fanshan elite cemetery, while the Liangzhu Museum, in a David Chipperfield building a few kilometres east, shows the jades, pottery and lacquer found here. Together they make a rewarding half-day from Hangzhou.
description: 良渚遗址位于中国浙江省杭州市余杭区良渚街道、瓶窑镇，部分位于湖州市德清县下渚湖街道，是以良渚古城遗址为中心的遗址群，总面积34平方公里，遗址年代为公元前3300年—公元前2300年，属于新石器时代文化遗址。
highlights: 南城墙与东水城门遗址
accessEn: Take Metro Line 2 to Liangzhu station, about an hour from central Hangzhou, then a local bus or taxi for the last few kilometres; the museum and site park are roughly 4 km apart. By taxi from the city centre it is about 40–60 minutes, depending on traffic.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 莫干山
summaryEn: Mount Mogan is a bamboo-covered hill resort in Deqing, roughly an hour's drive north-west of Hangzhou, where foreign missionaries and merchants built summer villas from the 1890s. Trails wind through bamboo to Sword Pond and its waterfall and to viewpoints over the plain, past dozens of protected villas, and many guesthouses in the hills and valley villages now cater to weekenders.
description: 莫干山，位于中国浙江省湖州市德清县，杭州市西北方40多千米处。属天目山余脉，耸立在低平的杭嘉湖平原之上，面积20平方千米。主峰塔山海拔720米。
accessEn: Deqing station has high-speed trains to Hangzhou and Shanghai; from there a taxi to the visitor transfer centre at the foot of the mountain takes about 30–40 minutes, and a bus is also reported. Driving from Hangzhou takes roughly an hour.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 楠溪江
summaryEn: The Nanxi River winds south through Yongjia County in 36 bends and 72 shoals, wide, shallow and clear enough to see the pebbles on the bed. Along its banks are volcanic cliffs, waterfalls and the old clan villages of the middle reaches, where much of the Song-era layout and many Ming and Qing buildings survive. It is a slow, rural alternative to the better-known Yandang Mountains.
description: 楠溪江古称瓯水，位于中国浙江省雁荡山与括苍山之间，温州市区以北，永嘉县境内，是瓯江支流。在永嘉县境内形成树形水系，流域面积2420平方千米，自北向南注入瓯江。干流长139.8千米，自然落差1032米，江面宽而浅，水质透明度极高，河床下多为卵石，属旅游水景资源。
accessEn: Nanxijiang station on the Hangzhou–Wenzhou high-speed railway, opened in September 2024, is in Fenglin in the middle reaches, within about 4 km of Cangpo village, Lishui Street and Lion Rock. Roads also run up the valley from Oubei, across the Ou River from central Wenzhou, so the valley is a day trip from Wenzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 北京园博园
summaryEn: The site of the 2013 China International Garden Expo on the west bank of the Yongding River, built over a former construction-waste landfill and kept as a public park. It holds 69 exhibition gardens in regional, modern and international styles, a sunken flower valley made from an old waste pit, and the 69.7-metre Yongding Tower, a new pagoda in Liao–Jin style with views over the river.
description: 北京园博园位于北京。游览特色包括古塔、山谷、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Fengtai District, about 18 km west of Tiananmen; Garden Expo Park station on subway Line 14 is close to its southern gates.

name: 武强年画博物馆
summaryEn: A museum in Wuqiang, long known for woodblock New Year pictures (nianhua), which describes itself as the first museum in China devoted to the craft and was approved in 1985. Its collection includes more than 10,000 historic woodblocks and printed pictures from the Ming and Qing dynasties onwards, and hands-on woodblock printing is offered to visitors. A good fit for anyone interested in folk art and festival customs.
description: 武强年画博物馆位于河北衡水。游览特色包括博物馆、民俗文化、节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Wuqiang county town, about 43 km north-east of Hengshui; closed on Mondays.

name: 北岳恒山
summaryEn: Mount Heng is the northern one of China's Five Great Mountains, rising to 2,016.1 m at Tianfengling just south of Hunyuan; it took over the title of Northern Peak from a mountain in Hebei in the early Qing. Its temples, halls and pavilions are built against cliffs and in caves, and the Beiyue Temple stands high on the main peak, the only one of the five mountains' main temples built there. A cable car and walking routes serve the temple area, and the Hanging Temple on neighbouring Cuiping Peak is a separate sight.
description: 北岳恒山位于山西大同。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、楼阁建筑、洞穴。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: About 5 km south-east of Hunyuan and about 67 km by road (around 1.5 hours) from Datong railway station; visitors leave cars at the Hengshan visitor centre and take a shuttle bus into the scenic area.

name: 冰峪沟
summaryEn: Bingyu Valley is a mountain gorge in the Xianrendong area of Zhuanghe, known for forested peaks of quartzite, deep side valleys and clear streams and pools, and promoted as the 'Guilin of southern Liaoning'. It adjoins Xianrendong National Forest Park, which the provincial tourism department describes as rich in wildlife and plants. It suits a day trip into the mountains.
description: 冰峪沟位于辽宁大连。游览特色包括峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the mountains of the Xianrendong area, about 35 km north of Zhuanghe town (about 45 km by road) and roughly 170 km north-east of central Dalian in a straight line. Check that it is open before going.

name: 东鸡冠山
summaryEn: Dongjiguan ('East Cockscomb') Mountain, on the north-eastern edge of Lüshun, was a main battlefield of the Russo-Japanese War of 1904–05, when Japanese forces took the Russian fort on its north side in December 1904. The scenic area keeps the East Cockscomb North Fort, Erlongshan Fort and the Wangtai Battery, which the provincial tourism department calls an open-air history museum. Visitors walk through the preserved fortifications.
description: 东鸡冠山位于辽宁大连。游览特色包括博物馆、战役遗址。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north-eastern edge of Lüshun, about 5 km north-east of the Lüshun Museum (straight line).

name: 庆华军工遗址
summaryEn: A small-arms museum inside the former Qinghua Tool Factory, a state arms plant in Bei'an, which describes itself as the only firearms-themed museum in China. It has four areas (a history exhibition, a transition hall, the preserved factory site and a light-weapons hall) and, as of 2022, 5,621 items including 539 firearms and 149 machine tools.
description: 庆华军工遗址位于黑龙江黑河。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Bei'an city, about 3 km south-east of the provincial committee buildings; closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 高淳老街
summaryEn: The old main street of Chunxi, Gaochun's district town, which grew up as a market street from the Song dynasty and is lined with Ming- and Qing-period shop-houses now selling local snacks, crafts and souvenirs. Along the way are the Guanwang Temple and an old well associated with the Qianlong Emperor.
description: 高淳老街位于江苏南京。游览特色包括寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In central Chunxi, Gaochun District, about 80 km south of central Nanjing and about 2.5 km from Gaochun station at the end of Metro Line S9.

name: Hello Kitty乐园
summaryEn: China's first Hello Kitty theme park, built on the eastern edge of Anji town by a Chinese company under licence from Sanrio and opened in 2015. Six themed zones of rides, shows and character buildings are aimed at families with young children rather than at sightseers.
description: Hello Kitty乐园位于浙江湖州。游览特色包括主题游乐。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 5 km east of Anji town centre; Anji station on the Hefei–Hangzhou high-speed railway is about 30 km away by road, roughly 40 minutes by taxi.

name: 梁祝文化公园
summaryEn: A park in Gaoqiao, on the western edge of Ningbo, devoted to the legend of Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai, the 'Butterfly Lovers', and built on the site of a temple and a Jin-dynasty tomb traditionally said to be Liang Shanbo's. Opened in 1999 and reopened in 2012 after expansion, it tells the story in scenes along garden paths, with pavilions, the Liang Shanbo temple, a rebuilt joint tomb of the lovers and a sculpture of the pair turned into butterflies. It has nothing to do with the Neolithic Liangzhu culture near Hangzhou.
description: 梁祝文化公园位于中华人民共和国浙江省宁波市海曙区高桥镇，是一处以梁祝传说为主要内容的主题公园，为中国大陆首座爱情主题公园。公园以原梁山伯墓和梁山伯庙为基础兴建，开园于1999年。2010年10月底，公园开始扩建，并于2012年11月重新开放。
accessEn: In Gaoqiao town, Haishu district, about 9 km west of central Ningbo; Liangzhu station on metro Line 1 is about 1.5 km away.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东湖
summaryEn: A small lake on the eastern edge of Shaoxing that fills an old quarry: from the Han dynasty onwards masons cut away half of a hill of grey stone, leaving sheer cliffs and deep pools, which the late-Qing local scholar Tao Junxuan enclosed with a long dyke and laid out as a garden. Small boats take visitors under stone bridges and into the cliff caves, such as Xiantao and Taogong caves, past pavilions along the shore, and the Tao She hall on the west side commemorates the 1911 revolutionary Tao Chengzhang.
description: 东湖位于浙江绍兴。游览特色包括湖泊、园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Gaobu, about 5 km east of Shaoxing's old city by road.

name: 佛子岭水库
summaryEn: Foziling Reservoir on the upper East Pi River was built between 1952 and 1954 as the first large water-conservancy and hydropower project of the People's Republic, and is officially called the 'first dam of New China'. Its 74.4 m reinforced-concrete multiple-arch dam, designed by the hydraulic engineer Wang Huzhen, was the first of its kind in China and is now a national heritage site. The scenic area around the lake includes hill outlines known as the 'Reclining Buddha' and 'Sleeping Beauty', a resort and rafting on the East Pi River.
description: 佛子岭水库，亦称佛子岭水电站，位于中国安徽省西部大别山区淠河上游，六安市霍山县境内。是集蓄洪、灌溉、航运、发电、养殖等为一体的大型水利工程，也是治淮工程与淠史杭灌区工程的重要组成部分。该工程于1952年1月开工建设，至1954年11月工程竣工，历时2年又10个月，是中华人民共和国成立后兴建的第一个大型水利水电项目，中国官方将它称为“新中国第一坝”，其规模在当时也是全亚洲最大的。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 15 km south of Huoshan county town by road.
imageCredit: The original uploader was Lastman at Chinese Wikipedia.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 徽杭古道
summaryEn: The Huizhou–Hangzhou Ancient Trail is a stone-paved mountain path, begun in the Tang, along which Huizhou merchants carried goods towards Hangzhou, and it is now a popular hiking route. The classic section runs about 16 km from Fuling town in Jixi to Qingliangfeng in Zhejiang's Lin'an district, through the Qingliangfeng nature reserve and past the Jiangnan Diyiguan pass, old tea pavilions and stone bridges. The national listing also covers a section of the old eastern Huizhou road in Langxi County.
description: 徽杭古道是指从安徽省绩溪县伏岭镇到浙江省杭州市临安区清凉峰镇浙基田的长约16公里的古道。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: The trailhead is at Jiangnan village in Fuling town, about 20 km east of Jixi county town by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 船政文化景区
summaryEn: The site of the Foochow Arsenal, the Qing navy yard and naval school founded at Mawei in 1866 with French engineers, which built steam transports and gunboats and trained many of the officers of the late-Qing Beiyang Fleet. Surviving workshops and the Chuanzheng Culture Museum tell its story, and one old machine shop now hosts an immersive staged show. A short walk away, the Mawei naval battle memorial hall, the Zhaozhong shrine and the martyrs' cemetery on Maxian Hill recall the Chinese sailors killed when a French squadron destroyed the Fujian fleet here on 23 August 1884.
description: 船政文化景区位于福建福州。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
