accessEn: In Mawei district about 17 km east of central Fuzhou, roughly 30–40 minutes by taxi. The museum and the naval battle memorial hall are closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 华安土楼
summaryEn: The Hua'an tulou tourist area centres on the Dadi cluster in Xiandu town: three large earthen houses, Eryi Lou, Nanyang Lou and Dongyang Lou, built by the Jiang family in the Qing dynasty and inscribed in 2008 as part of the Fujian Tulou World Heritage Site. Eryi Lou, built in 1770, has a four-storey outer ring around a single-storey inner ring, and each family's vertical section has its own staircase instead of shared open galleries. The cluster lies some 80 km north-east of the better-known Nanjing and Yongding tulou.
description: 华安土楼位于福建漳州。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、历史建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Dadi village, Xiandu town, about 20 km east of Hua'an county town and roughly 1.5 hours by road north of Zhangzhou city.

name: 汉仙岩
summaryEn: A red-sandstone Danxia hill and gorge area in the south of Huichang county, named after the legend that Han Zhongli, one of the Eight Immortals, attained immortality here. Stone carvings of the Eight Immortals stand at the entrance, and the trail climbs through narrow rock clefts past inscriptions cut over several centuries to a small cave linked with him, then drops to a slit-like gorge. Boats on Hanxian Lake give a view of the whole cliff face.
description: 汉仙岩位于江西赣州。游览特色包括峡谷、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yingfang village, Junmenling town, about 45 km south of Huichang town, with Yangjiao Water Fort about 1.4 km to the east-south-east.

name: 葛仙山
summaryEn: Mount Gexian is a 1,096 m peak of the Wuyi range in Yanshan County, a Taoist mountain where legend holds that the Taoist Ge Xuan became an immortal. Its slopes hold the Yuxu temple complex (the Gexian Ancestral Temple, rebuilt many times and last repaired in 1928) and the Buddhist Ciji Temple, first built in 1593, and a cable car opened in 2017 takes about ten minutes to reach the upper area. At the foot, Gexian Village is a resort of hotels, homestays and evening shows built since 2016.
description: 葛仙山位于江西上饶。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、佛教文化、缆车观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the mountain above Gexianshan town, about 27 km south of Hekou town.

name: 临沂动植物园
summaryEn: Linyi Zoological and Botanical Garden is a large municipal park in the south-east of Hedong district, combining a zoo, planted botanical areas and landscaped lakes. The animal enclosures are the main attraction, so it is mainly a family day out rather than a sightseeing stop.
description: 临沂动植物园位于山东临沂。游览特色包括植物园、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Economic and Technological Development Zone of Hedong district, about 21 km south-east of Linyi city centre, reached by road.

name: 马氏庄园
summaryEn: The well-preserved mansion compound of Ma Piyao, a late-Qing governor of Guangxi and Guangdong, built from the Guangxu reign into the early Republic in Xijiang village, its courtyards covering more than 20,000 m². In May and June 1947 Liu Bocheng and Deng Xiaoping made it the headquarters of the Shanxi–Hebei–Shandong–Henan Field Army and held the meetings here that launched the Southwest Shandong campaign; rooms in the west court display maps, lamps and other objects from that time.
description: 马氏庄园位于河南安阳。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、庄园、历史宅院。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xijiang village near Shuiye town, about 20 km west of Anyang, roughly 40 minutes by car.

name: 只有河南·戏剧幻城
summaryEn: An immersive theatre park opened in June 2021 in Zhongmu county, directed by Wang Chaoge: a walled 'fantasy city' of rammed loess, 328 m on each side, set among wheat fields. Inside, three main theatres and dozens of smaller courtyard stages run some 700 minutes of performances on Henan's history and culture, from historical figures of the Central Plains to the famine of 1942–43 and the building of the railways. Seeing the three main theatre shows and some of the shorter pieces takes most of a day.
description: 只有河南·戏剧幻城位于河南郑州。游览特色包括戏剧演艺。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Zhongmu county east of Zhengzhou, about 40 minutes by road from the city centre and close to the Fantawild parks and the film town.

name: 柴埠溪大峡谷
summaryEn: A band-shaped karst canyon of about 60 km² in the Wuling Mountains in Wufeng county, with rock pillars, sheer cliffs and forested peaks above a stream, often compared with Zhangjiajie, which lies in the same range. The scenic area is split into four zones, Tanzikou, Dawankou, Jiaokou and Duanshankou, plus a protected inner area, with more than 120 named sights and Tujia villages in the valley. It became a national forest park in 1995.
description: 柴埠溪大峡谷位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括峡谷、山谷、山地游览。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Wufeng Tujia Autonomous County, in the hills south-west of Yichang; the canyon mouth is about 5 km from Yuyangguan, the county's eastern gateway town, and is reached by road.

name: 宝峰湖
summaryEn: An artificial lake in a gorge at Suoxiyu in the Wulingyuan scenic area, formed when villagers dammed the valley for hydropower in the 1970s and named after Baofeng Mountain behind it. Ringed by forested sandstone peaks, it is seen by boat, and it was a filming location for the TV series Journey to the West.
description: 宝峰湖位于湖南张家界。游览特色包括峡谷、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Just south of Wulingyuan town, about 40 km north of Zhangjiajie city by road.

name: 民歌湖
summaryEn: A landscaped lake park beside the Nanning International Convention and Exhibition Centre in Qingxiu District, with lakeside promenades, bars and restaurants, evening lights and sightseeing boats. It makes an easy evening stroll from the convention centre.
description: 民歌湖位于广西南宁。游览特色包括湖泊、民歌。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At 23 Jinpu Road in Qingxiu District, about 600 m from Jinhu Square metro station.

name: 人民公园
summaryEn: A city park in central Nanning, also called White Dragon Park after its 7-hectare White Dragon Lake, which has a small island reached by two bridges. Stone steps climb Wangxian Hill, the highest point in downtown Nanning, to the Zhenning Fort, built in 1917 by the Guangxi warlord Lu Rongting on the site of an old temple and still holding its German Krupp gun. The park also has a shady botanical garden with an old banyan and a 25 m Monument to Revolutionary Martyrs.
description: 人民公园位于广西南宁。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊、植物园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At 1 East Renmin Road, about a ten-minute walk from Chaoyang Square in central Nanning.

name: 海南长影奇幻乐园
summaryEn: A film-themed amusement park developed by the Changying film group, which opened as Changying Global 100 Fantasy Park and has since been renamed. Landmarks include the Loulan Tower and a Zheng He treasure-ship building, set around Bayin Lake, and the park stages parades and light-and-water shows on the lake. It suits families with children.
description: 海南长影奇幻乐园位于海南海口。游览特色包括湖泊、主题游乐、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xiuying district, off Yehai Avenue in south-western Haikou; closed on Mondays and Tuesdays for maintenance.

name: 海口观澜湖
summaryEn: A large resort complex on a black lava plateau south of Haikou, developed since the late 2000s around ten 18-hole golf courses. Besides hotels it has a volcanic hot-spring valley with 168 hot and cold pools, a water park, the Feng Xiaogang Movie Commune (a film-set town recreating streets of twentieth-century China, with stage shows) and a duty-free mall, outlet shops and restaurants. It suits golfers, families and shoppers more than sightseers.
description: 海口观澜湖位于海南海口。游览特色包括水上游乐、山谷、高尔夫。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Longqiao town, Longhua district, about 20 km south-east of Haikou.

name: 南山植物园
summaryEn: A large botanical garden on the wooded crest of Nanshan above the south bank of the Yangtze, with themed gardens for roses, camellias, plum blossom and orchids and a garden of rare and endangered plants; its camellia collection is recognised as an International Camellia Garden of Excellence. Within the camellia garden stand villas that housed the French embassy, the Indian commissioner's office and part of the Soviet embassy when Chongqing was China's wartime capital. A giant golden eagle statue on the ridge is a local landmark.
description: 南山植物园位于重庆。游览特色包括植物园、园林景观、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Nanshan in Nan'an District, about 30 minutes by taxi from Jiefangbei in central Chongqing.
imageCredit: Col Ford and Natasha de Vere

name: 叠溪·松坪沟
summaryEn: In 1933 an earthquake destroyed the old town of Diexi on the upper Min River and dammed the river, creating a lake that now covers the site of the old town. Viewpoints look out over Diexi Lake, and the side valley of Songpinggou to the west holds a chain of further lakes among forest.
description: 叠溪·松坪沟位于四川阿坝。游览特色包括湖泊、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About an hour by road north of Mao County town, on the road to Songpan.

name: 若尔盖花湖
summaryEn: A shallow lake in the Zoige marshes beside the G213, seen from wooden boardwalks that were rebuilt outside the reserve's buffer zone to protect the wetland. In summer it is ringed by flowering meadows and is a good place to watch waterbirds; the wider Zoige wetland is a breeding ground for black-necked cranes.
description: 若尔盖花湖位于四川阿坝。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About an hour by road north of Zoige county town on the G213.

name: 月亮湾
summaryEn: A crescent-shaped meander of a grassland river just outside Hongyuan town, part of the upper Yellow River wetlands. In summer the green pasture and the looping, shining river make a classic view of the Aba grasslands, best seen from the slopes above.
description: 月亮湾位于四川阿坝。游览特色包括湿地、草原。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: A few kilometres west of Hongyuan county town by road.

name: 东郊记忆
summaryEn: A cultural and creative district in Chenghua, east Chengdu, converted from the Hongguang Electron Tube Factory, a state electronics plant founded in 1958. Its old workshops, chimneys and pipework now house live-music venues, galleries, studios, cafés and shops; it opened in 2011 as the Eastern Suburb Music Park and took its present name in 2012. It suits an afternoon or evening for anyone interested in industrial heritage or Chengdu's music scene.
description: 东郊记忆位于四川成都。游览特色包括工业遗产、文创街区。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Next to Dongjiao Jiyi station on Chengdu Metro Line 8.

name: 灌县古城
summaryEn: The historic core of Dujiangyan, a city known as Guan County until 1988, lying beside the ancient irrigation scheme. Much of it was rebuilt after the 2008 earthquake, but its lanes include West Street, the starting point of the old road into the mountains towards Songpan, a restored stretch of the old city wall, the Confucian temple and the City God Temple, a nationally protected group of halls climbing the slope of Yulei Mountain. It is easily combined with a visit to the Dujiangyan Irrigation System.
description: 灌县古城位于四川成都。游览特色包括古城、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Dujiangyan city, under an hour from Chengdu by train or road, next to the Dujiangyan scenic area.

name: 成都欢乐谷
summaryEn: An amusement park in Jinniu district, north-west Chengdu, opened in January 2009 as the third park in the Happy Valley chain. Its rides include several roller coasters, among them a Bolliger & Mabillard dive coaster added in 2017. It suits families and ride enthusiasts looking for a day off from sightseeing.
description: 成都欢乐谷位于四川成都。游览特色包括主题游乐、山谷、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside Xihua Avenue station on Chengdu Metro Line 6, in the north-west of the city.
imageCredit: Jeremy Thompson from Los Angeles, California

name: 虹口
summaryEn: A forested valley along the Baisha River in the mountains north of Dujiangyan, bordering the Longxi–Hongkou National Nature Reserve, a habitat of giant pandas and golden monkeys. In summer it is popular for white-water rafting and for cooling off beside the river, and side gorges such as Shenxigou lead further into the hills.
description: 虹口位于四川成都。游览特色包括峡谷、自然保护区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 18 km north of Dujiangyan city, roughly 1.5 hours by road from Chengdu.

name: 三道堰
summaryEn: A riverside town in northern Pidu, named after a legend that an early Shu ruler built three weirs of bamboo baskets here to divert water for the fields, and once a busy river port and trading post. Its waterfront has been rebuilt as Huili Street, a lane of restaurants, snack stalls, teahouses and shops recreating the look of the late Qing and early Republic, beside canals and small bridges. Small museums in the town cover birdcages, Sichuan cuisine, jade and Han pottery.
description: 三道堰位于四川成都。游览特色包括博物馆、运河。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 45 minutes by road north-west of central Chengdu.

name: 石象湖
summaryEn: A lake park in Pujiang county, south-west of Chengdu, combining about 800 mu (53 hectares) of water with a large area of secondary forest, planted lawns and extensive flower fields. It is best known for its tulip festival in spring and lily displays in autumn, with more than 20 viewpoints around the grounds. It makes a day trip for flower lovers in March–May or September–November.
description: 石象湖位于四川成都。游览特色包括湖泊、花卉观赏、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At exit 86 of the Chengdu–Ya'an expressway, about 12 km south-west of Pujiang county town and roughly 1.5 hours by road from Chengdu.

name: 绵竹年画村
summaryEn: Mianzhu woodblock New Year prints, printed from carved blocks and then coloured by hand, are one of China's four great New Year print traditions and have been national intangible cultural heritage since 2006. This village area in Xiaode, south of Mianzhu, is one of the city's three centres of print-making, where door gods and auspicious scenes are produced and displayed.
description: 绵竹年画村位于四川德阳。游览特色包括非遗文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 15 minutes by road south of Mianzhu city, which is roughly 1–1.5 hours by road north of Chengdu; the Mianzhu New Year Print Museum in the city makes a good companion visit.

name: 华蓥山
summaryEn: Huaying Mountain is a long ridge on the eastern side of the Sichuan Basin, dividing the central Sichuan hills from the parallel ridges further east, and the scenic area above Huaying city is promoted for its stone forest, caves and forest walks. Baoding peak (1,586 m) on the same range has been a Buddhist pilgrimage site since the Tang dynasty. In the late 1940s the mountains sheltered the eastern Sichuan Communist guerrillas whose uprising lies behind characters in the novel Red Crag.
description: 华蓥山位于四川广安。游览特色包括石林、林地风光、洞穴。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: The forest-park visitor centre is about 10 km south-east of Huaying city, around 30 minutes by road; Huaying is under an hour by road from Guang'an.

name: 明月峡
summaryEn: A narrow gorge of the Jialing River near Chaotian where six generations of routes squeeze through side by side: an ancient plank road, the Jinniu post road, a boat-haulers' towpath, the river itself, the Sichuan–Shaanxi highway and the Baoji–Chengdu railway. About 2 km of plank walkway has been rebuilt on the original beam holes cut into the cliff, among the best preserved in China, so visitors can walk the cliff face above the river. The gorge forms part of the Jianmen Shu Road heritage site.
description: 明月峡位于四川广元。游览特色包括峡谷、栈道。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 26 km north of Guangyuan near Chaotian town, around 40 minutes by road.

name: 唐家河
summaryEn: A forested mountain reserve of about 400 km² in the far west of Qingchuan County, established in 1978 and now part of the Giant Panda National Park, ranging from about 1,100 m to almost 3,900 m. Its forests shelter giant pandas, Sichuan takin and golden snub-nosed monkeys, and visitors explore by road and trail along the Tangjia River valley. Qingxi ancient town, just to the south, is the gateway.
description: 唐家河位于四川广元。游览特色包括古镇、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
accessEn: Through Qingxi town, about 3 hours by road west of Guangyuan.

name: 昭化古城
summaryEn: A small walled town where the Bailong River meets the Jialing, known in antiquity as Jiameng; after the Qin conquered Shu and Ba in 316 BC they set up a county here, and the town calls itself the first county seat in Sichuan. Inside the gates are flagstone lanes of old houses and the Longmen Academy, and nearby is the tomb of Fei Yi, one of the leading ministers of the Three Kingdoms state of Shu Han. The town lies on the old Jinniu Road and is an easy stop between Guangyuan and Jianmen Pass.
description: 昭化古城位于四川广元。游览特色包括古城、书院文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 40 minutes by road south-west of central Guangyuan.

name: 大佛禅院
summaryEn: An active Buddhist monastery in Emeishan city, about 5 km east of Baoguo Temple at the foot of Mount Emei, run as a Buddhist cultural tourism area. Its halls and courtyards can be visited on the way to or from the mountain without entering the Mount Emei scenic area.
description: 大佛禅院位于四川乐山。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、佛教文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Emeishan city, about 10 minutes by taxi from Emeishan railway station.

name: 东方佛都
summaryEn: A privately run theme park beside the Leshan Giant Buddha, filled with reproductions of Buddhist statues and carvings in stone and other materials. It holds around 3,000 statues, including a reclining Buddha about 170 m long. It is a modern park, run separately from the Giant Buddha site, for visitors who want more Buddhist imagery after the main sight.
description: 东方佛都位于四川乐山。游览特色包括主题游乐、佛教文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Lingyun Road next to the Leshan Giant Buddha scenic area, a short taxi or bus ride from central Leshan.

name: 李白纪念馆
summaryEn: A museum and Tang-style garden beside the Changming River in Jiangyou, dedicated to the Tang poet Li Bai, who grew up nearby. Halls and pavilions around a lotus pool present his life and work, and the main Taibai Hall holds a statue of the poet; Taibai Park adjoins the site.
description: 李白纪念馆位于四川绵阳。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In central Jiangyou, a short taxi ride from the railway station; Jiangyou is about 20 minutes from Mianyang by high-speed train.

name: 绵阳科技馆
summaryEn: Mianyang's science museum reflects the city's role as China's 'Science City', home to the national nuclear weapons research academy, and is themed on the 'Two Bombs, One Satellite' programme. Its three floors cover missiles, aviation and spaceflight, satellites, nuclear weapons and nuclear technology, and science in Mianyang, and there is a digital dome cinema.
description: 绵阳科技馆位于四川绵阳。游览特色包括博物馆、科学科普、书院文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the eastern section of the first ring road in Youxian district, a short taxi ride from central Mianyang.

name: 窦圌山
summaryEn: Mount Douchuan rises above the east bank of the Fu River north of Jiangyou, its bare rock summit peaks linked by suspended iron chains. Yunyan Temple, where Buddhist and Taoist worship have long been combined, spreads over the slopes; its Feitian Zang hall, described as the only surviving Song-dynasty building in south-west China, houses a revolving Taoist sutra cabinet built in 1181.
description: 窦圌山位于中华人民共和国四川盆地西北边缘江油市西南部，龙门山前地带，涪江东岸，是四川著名的风景区之一。西南沿公路距涪江峡口的江油老县城武都镇约4公里，向南沿公路距江油新县城中坝街道约24公里。山顶东岳峰海拔1140米，高差约540米(山麓海拔约600米)。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 25 km by road north of Jiangyou city (4 km from Wudu town); Jiangyou is on the Xi'an–Chengdu high-speed railway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 仙海
summaryEn: A reservoir lake about 15 km east of central Mianyang, formed by the Chenkang Reservoir of the Wudu irrigation scheme and run as a national water-conservancy scenic area and 4A resort. The lake covers about 7 km² within a 75 km² scenic zone, with a lakeside boardwalk, cycle paths, water-sports facilities and lakeside hotels, and its water is kept clean enough to meet China's Grade II standard. It is a weekend retreat for Mianyang residents and an easy half-day out from the city.
description: 仙海位于四川绵阳。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 15 km east of central Mianyang, around 30 minutes by taxi.

name: 药王谷
summaryEn: A forested mountain valley in Beichuan run as a 4A wellness area themed on traditional Chinese medicine. It covers about 15 km² at an average altitude of around 1,400 m, with more than 160 kinds of medicinal herbs grown on its slopes and about 1,800 century-old magnolia (xinyi) trees that flower white to purple each April. It suits a cool-weather walk or a spring blossom trip from Mianyang.
description: 药王谷位于四川绵阳。游览特色包括山谷、林地风光、赏花。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Guixi town in northern Beichuan, about 2 hours by road from Mianyang; a cable car serves the upper slopes.

name: 越王楼
summaryEn: The first Yuewang Tower was built on Gui Hill in 656 by Li Zhen, Prince of Yue and a son of Emperor Taizong, and was praised by poets including Du Fu before being destroyed and rebuilt several times. The present 99-metre tower, completed in 2010, is a modern reconstruction in Tang style and a landmark above the Fu River; the riverside parks of the Three Rivers Peninsula belong to the same scenic area.
description: 越王楼坐落于四川省绵阳市龟山上，是中国四大名楼之一。由唐太宗第八个儿子越王李贞任绵州刺史时所建。其时高百尺，是四大名楼中最高楼。
accessEn: In central Mianyang on the Fu River, a short walk or taxi ride from the city centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 迤沙拉
summaryEn: A Yi village in the dry, hot valley of the Jinsha River near the Yunnan border, listed as a Historical and Cultural Village of China in 2005. Its red-walled, grey-tiled houses with carved eaves show the influence of settlers from Jiangsu and Anhui on the local Lipo Yi, and the village keeps up its own ritual music and sheepskin-drum dance. It was once a staging post on old trade routes into Yunnan.
description: 迤沙拉位于四川攀枝花。游览特色包括山谷、古道、传统村落。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 1.5 hours by road south of Panzhihua city, in Pingdi town.

name: 安顺场
summaryEn: A ferry crossing on the Dadu River where, in May 1935, a small Red Army vanguard crossed by boat under fire during the Long March, opening the way for the advance on Luding Bridge. A memorial hall presents the crossing, and a riverside monument completed in 1983 marks the landing. In 1863 the Taiping general Shi Dakai's army was trapped and destroyed at the same place.
description: 安顺场位于四川雅安。游览特色包括纪念展览、滨水景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 10 km north-west of Shimian county town, roughly 20 minutes by road; Shimian lies on the Ya'an–Xichang expressway.

name: 邓池沟
summaryEn: The valley where the French missionary-naturalist Armand David was based in 1869, when he obtained a giant panda; the specimen he sent to the natural history museum in Paris was the first scientific specimen of the animal. The church he worked from, begun in 1839, survives, its Sichuan-style timber exterior enclosing a Gothic-style interior. It lies in Fengtongzhai township, whose nature reserve is part of the Sichuan Giant Panda Sanctuaries World Heritage Site.
description: 邓池沟位于四川雅安。游览特色包括博物馆、自然保护区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Fengtongzhai township, about an hour by road north-east of Baoxing county town.

name: 青华海
summaryEn: Qinghua Lake National Wetland Park spreads across the floor of the Baoshan basin on the east side of the city, taking in an East Lake and a West Lake, the Beimiao reservoir and the banks of the East River. The lakes are described as the last remnant of an ancient lake that once filled the basin, and the park makes an easy walk on the edge of the new town.
description: 青华海位于云南保山。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the eastern side of Baoshan city, a short taxi ride from the centre; Baoshan has trains from Kunming (about 4 hours) and Dali (under 2 hours).

name: 右甸河公园
summaryEn: A riverside park along the Youdian River through the centre of Changning county town, built as a river clean-up and wetland-restoration scheme and opened in 2017. It links a tea-themed park with a tea museum and teahouse, farmland and farming-experience plots, and restored wetlands around a lake, and is used for walking and cycling.
description: 右甸河公园位于云南保山。游览特色包括博物馆、湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Tianyuan, the Changning county town, about 1.5 hours by road south-east of Baoshan city.

name: 金山古镇
summaryEn: A Ming–Qing-style commercial and residential quarter in Lufeng city, built from 2017 as part of a shantytown-redevelopment scheme and opened in 2019. Its stream, bridges, opera stage, courtyard inns, shops and restaurants are all new. The genuine stone Xingxiu Bridge, completed in 1832 and a nationally protected monument, stands next to it.
description: 金山古镇位于云南楚雄。游览特色包括古镇。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Lufeng city (Jinshan town), about 1.5 hours by road west of Kunming.

name: 紫溪山
summaryEn: Zixi Mountain, west of Chuxiong city, was one of Yunnan's Buddhist holy mountains in the Ming and Qing dynasties and is now a forest park and summer retreat. Ziding Temple stands on the mountain, and a camellia species garden, forest roads and walking trails spread across its slopes.
description: 紫溪山位于云南楚雄。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 minutes by road west of Chuxiong city.

name: 诺邓古村
summaryEn: A Bai village built up a steep hillside above an old salt well near Yunlong, said to have kept its name since the Nanzhao period and long made prosperous by salt. More than a hundred courtyard houses climb the slope among Ming and Qing temples, including a Confucian temple, a martial temple and the three-storey Yuhuang Pavilion, first built in the Ming, whose ceiling is painted with the 28 lunar mansions. Brine still rises from the old well, and some villagers still make salt by traditional methods.
description: 诺邓古村位于云南大理。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、古村落、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: A few kilometres from Yunlong town, which is about 3 hours by road west of Dali.

name: 天龙八部影视城
summaryEn: A film set built in 2002 below the Cangshan mountains for a CCTV television adaptation of Jin Yong's martial-arts novel Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils, and used since for other productions. Its streets, palaces and gate towers recreate the Song-era Dali kingdom alongside the Liao and Western Xia courts, and since 2023 a martial-arts-themed street has staged performances for visitors.
description: 天龙八部影视城位于云南大理。游览特色包括影视拍摄、影视文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 1.5 km west of Dali Old Town near the Ximatan cableway, a 20-minute walk or short taxi ride.

name: 鹤庆新华村
summaryEn: A Bai village on the edge of the Heqing plain whose families have long made silverware by hand, a craft that the county gazetteer traces back more than 500 years and that is on China's national intangible cultural heritage list. Its lanes are lined with family workshops where smiths hammer and engrave bowls, jewellery and teapots. It is a busy commercial centre for the trade, so compare prices before buying.
description: 鹤庆新华村位于云南大理。游览特色包括非遗文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: A few kilometres north of Heqing town, which is about an hour by road south of Lijiang or 2 hours north of Dali.

name: 芒市傣族古镇
summaryEn: A Dai-style quarter built from 2019 on a hillside on the east side of central Mangshi and opened in 2020, with the Menghuan Palace, a hall styled on Dai Buddhist temple architecture, and lanes of restaurants, craft and costume shops and a hotel. It is busiest in the evening, when the night-market street fills with food stalls and street performers. It is a modern development rather than a historic town.
description: 芒市傣族古镇位于云南德宏。游览特色包括古镇、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the eastern side of central Mangshi, a short taxi ride from the centre and about 8 km from Dehong Mangshi airport.

name: 石卡雪山
summaryEn: A mountain rising to around 4,500 metres just south-west of Shangri-La town; its Tibetan name is said to refer to a place where red deer roam. A cableway of about 4.2 km climbs from a meadow at about 3,270 metres to viewing points above 4,000 metres that look out over the surrounding ranges on clear days.
description: 石卡雪山位于云南迪庆。游览特色包括高山景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 7 km south-west of Shangri-La town, a short taxi ride; the top station is above 4,000 m, so acclimatise in town first.

name: 老阴山
summaryEn: The forested mountain that rises steeply above the east side of Gejiu, the old tin-mining city, to a summit of about 2,160 m. The Baohua cable car, running since 1997, climbs some 400 m up the slope, and a glass walkway about 350 m long, opened in 2019, wraps around the mountainside high above the city and Jinhu Lake.
description: 老阴山位于云南红河。游览特色包括湖泊、玻璃栈道、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Directly above the east side of central Gejiu; ride the Baohua cable car up from the city or walk up the slope.

name: 观音峡
summaryEn: Guanyin Gorge, at Qihe south of Lijiang, is a scenic area described as the southern gateway to the Lijiang basin, where the old Tea Horse Road passed through the Yulong Pass. It combines the wooded gorge with Tea Horse Road and Naxi folk-culture attractions.
description: 观音峡位于云南丽江。游览特色包括峡谷、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 12 km south of Lijiang Old Town in Qihe town, around 25 minutes by road.

name: 葫芦小镇
summaryEn: A Wa-themed leisure quarter built on the edge of Cangyuan county town around Gourd Lake, with red-walled Wa-style buildings, totem carvings and large gourd sculptures recalling the Wa creation myth. Evening song-and-dance and craft workshops such as weaving and wood carving are put on for visitors. It is a modern development with no old buildings; for a traditional Wa village, go to Wengding.
description: 葫芦小镇位于云南临沧。游览特色包括湖泊、雕塑艺术、手工艺。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the edge of Cangyuan county town, a short taxi ride from the bus station; carry your passport, as there are police checkpoints on roads in this border area.

name: 勐相湿地公园
summaryEn: A wetland park on the edge of Gengma county town, laid out around a lake with reed beds, groves of trees and boardwalks. Its square hosts local festivals such as the Dai Water-Splashing Festival, and it makes a pleasant evening stroll if you are staying in Gengma.
description: 勐相湿地公园位于云南临沧。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the edge of Gengma county town, a short taxi ride from the centre; carry your passport, as there are police checkpoints on roads in this border area.

name: 老姆登与知子罗
summaryEn: Two neighbouring places high on the eastern slopes of the Nu River canyon in Pihe Nu Township. Laomudeng is a Nu village with a plain Christian church, while Zhiziluo, about 2 km away along a footpath, was the seat of Nujiang Prefecture from 1954 to 1974 and of Bijiang County until 1986, and its largely empty buildings from that era now draw visitors as a 'city of memory'.
description: 老姆登与知子罗位于云南怒江。游览特色包括峡谷、教堂建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Up a side road above the Nu River canyon road in Fugong County, roughly 2–3 hours' drive north of Liuku; carry your passport, as police checkpoints on the canyon road check ID.

name: 墨江北回归线标志园
summaryEn: A hillside park on the western edge of Mojiang county town, built where the Tropic of Cancer passes through, with marker towers, a sundial square and sculptures on the theme of the sun along a path up the hill. It combines astronomy displays and a planetarium with features on Mojiang's 'twins' theme, and is the main venue of the town's International Twins Festival in early May.
description: 墨江北回归线标志园位于云南普洱。游览特色包括雕塑艺术、节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the west side of Mojiang county town, about 15 minutes by taxi from Mojiang station on the China–Laos railway.

name: 那柯里
summaryEn: A small village in Ning'er county that grew up as a staging post on the Tea Horse Road, where mule caravans rested and traded. Its sights are the Rongfa caravan inn, a covered wind-and-rain bridge more than a century old, and a stretch of the old road paved with dressed stone and cobbles, part of which has been cleared for walking. It makes a pleasant stop for a stroll and a caravan-style meal.
description: 那柯里位于云南普洱。游览特色包括传统村落。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tongxin town, Ning'er county, about 30 minutes by road north of central Pu'er.

name: 多依河
summaryEn: The Duoyi River flows through Lubuge township in south-eastern Luoping near the Guizhou border, dropping over dozens of small waterfalls between banks lined with old trees and bamboo. Bouyei villages sit beside it, and its banks are a gathering place for the Bouyei Sanyuesan festival on the third day of the third lunar month.
description: 多依河位于云南曲靖。游览特色包括瀑布、古树、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 40 km south-east of Luoping town, roughly an hour by road, and often combined with the Lubuge Three Gorges.

name: 珠江源
summaryEn: The Pearl River is held to rise on Maxiong Mountain in Zhanyi, whose eastern slopes became a national forest park of about 12.5 square kilometres in 1993. More than 95 percent of the park is forested, and it holds around 2,000 plant species, including rarities such as the ghost plant Monotropa uniflora and the giant tree rhododendron.
description: 珠江源国家森林公园位于中华人民共和国云南省曲靖市沾益区的马雄山东麓，占地面积12.5平方公里，1993年被国家林业局批准为国家森林公园。公园森林覆盖率达95%以上，拥有植物约两千种，其中包括水晶兰、元江锥、大树杜鹃、银鹊树、野鸦椿、灯台树、香花鸡血藤等珍稀植物。
accessEn: In Zhanyi district, roughly an hour by road north-east of central Qujing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 西双版纳傣族园
summaryEn: A ticketed area at Ganlanba (Menghan), south-east of Jinghong, that takes in five lived-in Dai villages. Among them is Manchunman, whose Theravada Buddhist temple dates from the Qing dynasty and is protected as a national heritage site. Water-splashing performances are staged every day, so this is where to see the custom outside the April festival.
description: 西双版纳傣族园位于云南西双版纳。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 35 km south-east of Jinghong, 40 minutes to an hour by road.

name: 勐巴拉
summaryEn: A resort development beside the Mengbala golf club on the G214 just outside Menghai town, combining hotels, a hot-spring resort, holiday housing and leisure facilities set in tropical gardens. It is a place to stay and relax rather than a sight in itself.
description: 勐巴拉位于云南西双版纳。游览特色包括园林景观、高尔夫。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the G214 at the edge of Menghai town, about an hour by road west of Jinghong.

name: 勐泐大佛寺
summaryEn: A large Theravada Buddhist temple complex on the southern edge of Jinghong, built from 2005 on the site of Jingpiao Temple, a royal temple of the old Dai kingdom destroyed in war in the 19th century; when it was consecrated in 2007 it was billed as the largest Theravada temple in China. Its halls climb a hillside, and since 2020 they have been in the care of the local Buddhist association. It is a modern reconstruction rather than a historic monument.
description: 勐泐大佛寺位于云南西双版纳。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、佛教文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 5 km south of central Jinghong, 15 minutes by taxi; since 2020 the site has officially been called the Mengle Cultural Tourism Area.

name: 野象谷
summaryEn: A visitor area in the Mengyang section of the Xishuangbanna National Nature Reserve, about 36 km north of Jinghong, where wild Asian elephants sometimes come out of the rainforest to feed and drink. A 2.3 km elevated walkway and a cableway cross the forest canopy to observation points, but sightings are a matter of luck. Captive elephants appear at an elephant 'science park', where since 2023 tricks and rides have given way to displays of natural behaviour such as bathing and feeding; the site also has an elephant museum, a feeding area and a butterfly garden.
description: 野象谷位于云南西双版纳。游览特色包括自然保护区、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 36 km north of Jinghong at Mengyang, under an hour by road; Wild Elephant Valley station on the China–Laos railway is about 6 km away.

name: 西双版纳原始森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park created on about 25,000 mu (some 1,700 hectares) of tropical valley rainforest in the Caiyanghe area east of Jinghong, described as the closest primeval forest to the city. Paths lead through the forest, but the park is developed for tour groups, with a staged show in which hundreds of peacocks are released to fly over a lake, an Aini (Hani) village and song-and-dance performances.
description: 西双版纳原始森林公园位于云南西双版纳。游览特色包括森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 8 km east of central Jinghong, 20 minutes by taxi.

name: 西双版纳南药园
summaryEn: A 20-hectare garden of medicinal plants on Xuanwei Avenue in central Jinghong, set up in 1959 by what is now the Yunnan branch of the Institute of Medicinal Plant Development. It grows more than 1,500 species used in Chinese, Dai and other traditional medicine under tall tropical trees, and labelled paths make it a shady hour or two in town that pairs easily with the nearby Tropical Flower Garden.
description: 西双版纳南药园位于云南西双版纳。游览特色包括花卉观赏、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Xuanwei Avenue in Jinghong, a short taxi ride from the centre.

name: 西双版纳热带花卉园
summaryEn: A tropical garden run by the Yunnan Institute of Tropical Crops on Xuanwei Avenue in central Jinghong, with palms, fruit trees, crop plants and more than a thousand kinds of plants along shady paths. It is an easy few hours in town; the much larger Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden at Menglun suits serious plant lovers better.
description: 西双版纳热带花卉园位于云南西双版纳。游览特色包括植物园、园林景观、赏花。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Xuanwei Avenue in Jinghong, a short taxi or city-bus ride from the centre.

name: 黄连河
summaryEn: A river valley in the Wumeng Mountains just outside Daguan county town, which the county promotes as a 'home of waterfalls'. Waterfalls of different sizes line the Huanglian River, set among forest that includes rare dove trees.
description: 黄连河位于云南昭通。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 4 km from Daguan county town, which is roughly 1–1.5 hours by road north of Zhaotong city.

name: 潼关古城
summaryEn: Tongguan, the fortified pass first built in 196 AD where the Wei River flows into the Yellow River, guarded the eastern approach to the Guanzhong plain and its capitals. Its walled town was demolished for the Sanmenxia Dam reservoir around 1960, but remains of the Han and Ming walled towns, the Ming Lower South Gate and the old Shuipo Lane survive. Since 2011 a tourism development on the hill to the east has added squares, old-style shopping streets and a rebuilt Shanhe Yilan gate tower, which since 2018 has housed the Tongguan County Museum.
description: 潼关古城位于陕西渭南。游览特色包括古城、水库、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Beside the Gangkou exit of the G30 expressway north of Tongguan county town, about 25 minutes by road east of Huashan North station, from which buses run to Gangkou.

name: 南郭寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple in a fold of the hills about 2 km south of central Tianshui, already a sizeable monastery in the Tang dynasty and visited by the poet Du Fu in 759, who wrote verses about it. Its courtyards hold ancient cypresses estimated at more than 2,000 years old, celebrated as one of the Eight Views of Qinzhou, old pagoda trees at the west gate and a shrine to Du Fu set up in 1904. From the hillside there are views over the whole city.
description: 南郭寺位于甘肃天水。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、古塔。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the hillside about 2 km south of central Tianshui, a short taxi ride from the centre.

name: 岗什卡雪峰
summaryEn: Gangshika is the highest peak of the eastern Qilian Mountains, a glaciated mountain of 5,254.5 m in Menyuan County that climbers often treat as a first snow mountain, because the approach is gradual and it lies under 160 km from Xining. The scenic area, a managed development that opened in 2024–25, has a visitor service centre at the foot of the mountain, horse rides and walks in summer, snow and ice activities in winter, a guided climbing route from a base camp at about 4,350 m, and a 47 km backpacking route along the Lenglongling range added in 2025. It was named a national ski-mountaineering training base in 2016, and the film The Climbers was partly shot here.
description: 岗什卡雪峰位于青海海北。游览特色包括高山景观。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: Reached from Menyuan County, under 160 km from Xining by road; Menyuan also has a high-speed railway station.

name: 张裕龙谕酒庄
summaryEn: Changyu's Ningxia wine estate, opened in 2013 as Chateau Changyu Moser XV, a joint venture with the Austrian winemaker Lenz Moser, and rebranded Longyu in 2021. A European-style château with a moat stands among the estate's own vineyards, and its visitor centre has an exhibition on the history of Changyu, China's oldest wine company, founded in 1892.
description: 张裕龙谕酒庄位于宁夏银川。游览特色包括葡萄酒文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 15 km west of central Yinchuan on Liupanshan Road, around 30 minutes by road.

name: 坎儿井乐园
summaryEn: Turpan's karez are hand-dug underground channels that carry snowmelt from the Tian Shan across the gravel plain to the oases, and this park, opened in 1992 by the Xinjiang Karez Research Association, is a place to see one from the inside. A walkway more than 10 m below ground follows part of an old working karez past its tunnel and vertical shafts, and a museum explains with models and photographs how the system was dug and maintained. There is also a display of surface construction work, a vineyard watered by the karez and a raisin drying house.
description: 坎儿井乐园位于新疆吐鲁番。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Ya'er township about 6 km north-west of central Turpan, a short taxi ride. Check that it is open before going.

name: 珠峰大本营
summaryEn: On the Tibetan side a road runs up the Rongbuk valley, so you can stand before the full north face of Qomolangma (Everest) without trekking for days. Since 2019 tourists have been kept below the climbers' base camp, staying at the guesthouse by Rongbuk Monastery or in the seasonal tent camp nearby and watching the summit catch the last light at sunset.
description: 景区内可游览绒布寺、珠峰北坡观景台、修行洞与玛尼墙。图集建议预留2–3 天游览。
accessEn: Base camp is a long day's drive from Shigatse along the Friendship Highway and a winding mountain road, usually as part of an agency-run overland trip from Lhasa.

name: 景德镇
summaryEn: Jingdezhen has made porcelain for more than a thousand years, and clay still runs through daily life here. See the excavated imperial kiln site and the striking brick-vaulted Imperial Kiln Museum (closed on Mondays), watch artisans throw and paint in the old workshop quarters, then browse studios where young ceramicists from all over the world sell their work.
description: 景区内可游览御窑厂遗址、陶溪川、古窑民俗博览区。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
accessEn: Jingdezhen has train links to Nanchang and Huangshan and a small airport, making it an easy add-on to a Wuyuan or Huangshan trip. The main sights are a short taxi ride from each other.

name: 龚滩古镇
summaryEn: Gongtan sits where the Apeng River joins the Wu River, facing Guizhou across the water. It is known for its flagstone street and timber houses on stilts, propped on a steep rocky bank above the river. The town is quiet outside holidays, and a boat on the river takes in the cliffs of the Wu River gorge.
description: 景区内可游览石板街、吊脚楼、西秦会馆。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Gongtan is in western Youyang County, roughly 400 km by the older road route and about 4–5 hours by car from central Chongqing (operator blog says about 4 hours); from Youyang county town it is about 1.5 hours by road, and the county has a station on the Chongqing–Huaihua railway. Most visitors drive or take a long-distance bus.

name: 七星公园
summaryEn: Guilin's largest park, about 137 hectares on the east bank of the Li River, is named for its seven hills, thought to echo the Big Dipper. Trails lead past Flower Bridge and Camel Hill to Seven Star Cave, a large show cave, and to a stele forest of carved cliff inscriptions. Visit it for a quiet, local-feeling day among Guilin's karst hills in the city, in contrast to the scenic Li River cruise (see Li River & Yangshuo).
description: 景区内可游览花桥、七星岩、骆驼山。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The park is on the east bank of the Li River, about 2 km east of Central Square across Liberation Bridge, a short taxi or bus ride.

name: 银子岩
summaryEn: A show cave in Maling, Lipu, that runs through twelve hills on three levels, its calcite formations glittering like silver under coloured light. The highlights are the halls called Snow Mountain with Waterfall, the Music Stone Screen and the Jade Pool. It is a short add-on to a Li River and Yangshuo day (see Li River & Yangshuo), giving you the underground side of the karst.
description: 景区内可游览雪山飞瀑、音乐石屏、瑶池仙境。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: The cave is beside National Road 321 in Maling town, about 18 km from Yangshuo, roughly 30 minutes by road, and 85 km from Guilin. From Guilin, buses run from Guilin South Bus Station towards Lipu; ask the driver to drop you at the cave, then walk about 5 minutes.

name: 北海老城
summaryEn: Beihai's old commercial quarter lies near the northern shore, where Zhuhai Road, Shaji Street and Zhongshan Road form a historic block of shophouses with Western-style arched facades from the treaty-port years. Zhuhai Road is now a pedestrian street lined with shops and cafés, and former consulate buildings protected as national heritage stand nearby. It is an easy, atmospheric stop before or after the beach and the Weizhou ferry.
description: 景区内可游览珠海路骑楼、沙脊街、中山路。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In central Beihai on the north side of the peninsula; city buses and taxis stop nearby. Beihai is about 1 to 1.5 hours by high-speed train from Nanning.

name: 海口骑楼老街
summaryEn: The Qilou Old Street district is a stretch of arcaded shophouses (qilou) along Zhongshan, Bo'ai, Xinhua North, Deshengsha and Jiefang roads, mostly built between the mid-nineteenth and mid-twentieth centuries. Chinese plasterwork and murals sit alongside European and Asian columns and arches. Restored in recent years, the streets now hold shops, cafes, guesthouses and heritage exhibition halls, and in 2009 the old street was named one of China's Famous Historical and Cultural Streets.
description: 景区内可游览中山路骑楼、博爱路与新华北路、博爱南路小吃。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: The district lies in central Haikou's Longhua district around Zhongshan Road, near the riverfront. A taxi or ride-hailing car is the easiest way to reach it from elsewhere in the city.

name: 塞罕坝国家森林公园
summaryEn: A planted-forest park on the high Saihanba plateau in northern Weichang County, once part of the Qing dynasty's Mulan imperial hunting ground. Larch and spruce plantations, lakes, grassland and forest walks fill the park, and the open Bashang grassland of Yudaokou lies nearby. Autumn colour and summer grass are the draws; the best views need a car.
description: 河北省塞罕坝机械林场是河北省人民政府林业和草原局直属的大型国有林场、公益二类正处级事业单位，位于河北省承德市围场满族蒙古族自治县塞罕坝。1993年，在其基础上建成河北塞罕坝国家森林公园。2007年，设立河北塞罕坝国家级自然保护区。
accessEn: The park is in the north of Weichang County near the Inner Mongolia border, a long drive north of Weichang town, and is best reached by car from Chengde or Beijing, which takes several hours (one guide says about seven from Beijing). Trains on the Jingtong line stop at Siheyong station in Weichang County, but you still need a taxi or chartered car for the final stretch.
imageCredit: Original uploader was 用心阁 at zh.wikipedia
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 北戴河
summaryEn: Beidaihe is a seaside resort on the Bohai Sea, with a beach about 10 km long, wooded Lianfeng Hill behind it and old villas in the streets between. Pigeon Nest Park, a small headland at the north-eastern end, is the classic spot for sunrise over the sea and for birdwatching in spring and autumn. Most visitors spend a relaxed day walking the seafront.
description: 北戴河区是中国河北省秦皇岛市的一个市辖区，濒临渤海湾。面积为70.3平方公里，海岸线22.5公里。北戴河属暖温带、半湿润、季风型大陆性气候，受海洋的调节，又具有海洋性气候的特点。
accessEn: Beidaihe is about 15 km by road south-west of Qinhuangdao station, reached by local bus or taxi; high-speed trains from Beijing take roughly 1.5–2 hours to Qinhuangdao. From Beijing Tongzhou the fastest train to Beidaihe takes 76 minutes.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 雪乡
summaryEn: Officially Shuangfeng Forest Farm, this village in the Zhangguangcai Range is known for deep, sticky snow that builds into thick caps on the eaves and roofs of its houses through a long winter. Visitors come for the snowy lanes and lantern-lit evenings, a small ski slope for beginners and a film set from the story Tracks in the Snowy Forest. It sits inside Xuexiang National Forest Park, which also holds the separate Taipinggou primeval forest area. Be realistic: it is heavily commercialised and crowded at New Year, and the charm lies in the snow itself.
description: 景区内可游览雪韵大街、梦幻家园、影视基地。图集建议预留2 天游览。
accessEn: From Harbin it is roughly 270–280 km by road, about 5½ hours, by direct tourist coach in season, private car or chartered car; some travellers take the high-speed train to Yabuli and charter a car from there (about two hours, one traveller report). From Mudanjiang, reached by train from Harbin, it is roughly 170–180 km by long-distance bus or taxi, via the forestry town of Changting. Private cars cannot enter the scenic area: park at the gate and take the sightseeing shuttle, about ten minutes.

name: 乌素特水上雅丹
summaryEn: Wusute is a shallow saline lake in the Taijinar basin of the western Qaidam Basin, where eroded clay ridges (yardangs) stand out of the water among salt flats and desert. Wild ducks gather on the lake, most visibly in autumn, which is why it is also called Duck Lake. The tourist park, opened in 2018 at about 2,700 m, is a long drive from anywhere but rewards it with some of the strangest scenery on the western loop.
description: 景区内可游览水上雅丹、乌素特湖、台吉乃尔湖。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The site is about 215–225 km by road west of Da Qaidam town, roughly 2.5–3 hours on the G315 past the Taijinar lakes, and well over 250 km from either Golmud or Delingha. From Chaka it is a long chain of drives: about 2 hours to Delingha, 2.5 to Da Qaidam, then 2.5–3 more, so plan it as an out-and-back day from Da Qaidam.

name: 勒巴沟文成公主庙
summaryEn: This small Buddhist temple is built against a cliff in the Beinagou valley near Gyêgu (Jiegu), Yushu's main town, where Vairocana and eight attendant bodhisattvas are carved in relief on the rock above the hall. More rock carvings and Tibetan inscriptions lie elsewhere in the valley and in neighbouring Lebagou. It is one of the most atmospheric heritage sites in Qinghai's far south.
description: 景区内可游览大日如来摩崖造像、大日如来佛堂、文成公主纪念堂。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: The temple is in Batang township, roughly 20–25 km south-east of Gyêgu (Jiegu) by road, reached by taxi or charter car in 30–45 minutes. Yushu is reached by flight or by a very long road journey from Xining.

name: 青木川古镇
summaryEn: Qingmuchuan, in the far west of Ningqiang County near the point where Shaanxi, Gansu and Sichuan meet, grew up as a trading town for the mountain border region. Walk the curving Huilongchang old street, where more than 50 old shophouses and courtyard homes survive, among them Rongshengkui, a three-storey merchants' entertainment house, then climb to the Furen Middle School on the hillside to the south.
description: 景区内可游览回龙场老街、荣盛魁、魏氏宅院。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: High-speed trains from Xi'an North reach Ningqiang South in about 1.5–2 hours, but Qingmuchuan is well over 100 km further west by mountain road, roughly 3 hours by hired car; buses from Hanzhong and Ningqiang are infrequent, sometimes only one a day. Coming from Sichuan, Yaodu station on the Lanzhou–Chongqing railway, served by only a few trains a day, is about 8 km away.

name: 韩城古城·党家村
summaryEn: Hancheng, on the west bank of the Yellow River where it enters the Guanzhong plain, keeps an old town of courtyard houses and Ming temples around Jincheng Street. Start at the Confucian Temple, largely rebuilt in 1371, and the City God Temple of 1571 nearby. Then take a taxi about 9 km north-east to Dangjia Village, where more than 100 Ming and Qing courtyard houses, ancestral halls and the six-storey Wenxing Pagoda survive.
description: 景区内可游览韩城文庙、韩城城隍庙、党家村四合院。图集建议预留一天游览。
accessEn: Direct EMU trains from Xi'an Railway Station reach Hancheng in about 2–2.5 hours, and the old town is about 3 km south of Hancheng station. Dangjia Village is about 20 minutes from the old town by taxi.

name: 长岛南北长山
summaryEn: Nanchangshan and Beichangshan, two linked islands in the Bohai Strait, are the main sightseeing area of the Changdao archipelago. The north island has the tall sea cliffs of Jiuzhangya and the curving beach of Crescent Bay, while the south has the sea-eroded rocks of Wangfu Reef, the folk-culture park of Xianjingyuan and Changdao town with its small museum. It is a slow, salty escape from the mainland, best with a night on the island.
description: 景区内可游览望夫礁、仙境源、长岛县城与博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
accessEn: Take the high-speed train from Yantai to Penglai (about 40 minutes), then a taxi to Penglai passenger port and the ferry to Changdao port on Nanchangshan, a crossing of about 40–45 minutes. A causeway and a bridge link Nanchangshan to Beichangshan, where Jiuzhangya lies about 8 km north-north-west of the port.

name: 大同古城
summaryEn: Datong was a 5th-century capital of the Northern Wei and later the Western Capital of the Liao and Jin dynasties, and its walled old town keeps rare temple halls of the 11th and 12th centuries. Start at Huayan Temple, with its Liao sutra hall of 1038 full of clay bodhisattvas and its huge Jin main hall of 1140, then see the 45-metre glazed-tile Nine-Dragon Screen and Shanhua Temple in the south of the old city. Finish on the rebuilt ramparts, a 7.24 km circuit.
description: 景区内可游览薄伽教藏殿、大雄宝殿、善化寺。图集建议预留一天游览。
accessEn: Datong South station is about 2 hours by high-speed train from Beijing (Beijing North or Qinghe) or from Taiyuan South, and the old city is about 20 minutes north by taxi.

name: 碛口古镇·李家山村
summaryEn: On the east bank of the Yellow River in Lin County, Qikou prospered in the Ming and Qing as a river port where cargo from upstream was unloaded and sent on overland; its old streets of warehouses, shops and merchants' courtyards still line the river below the Black Dragon Temple on the highest point of town. Walk the lanes and climb to the temple, then go a short way south to Lijiashan, where merchant families lived in yaodong (cave dwellings dug into the loess hillside) that rise more than ten levels up the slope, the roofs of one row serving as courtyards for the next.
description: 景区内可游览黑龙庙戏台、头道街·二道街、李家山村。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Trains from Taiyuan South reach Lüliang station in Lishi in about 1.5 hours. Qikou is about 50 km west of Lishi by road, roughly an hour by taxi or hired car; local buses from Lishi are slower, so check departures on the day.

name: 小西天
summaryEn: On Phoenix Hill at the western edge of Xi County town, Xiaoxitian ('Little Western Heaven', also called Qianfo'an) is a small late-Ming Buddhist temple laid out in two courtyards up the slope. Climb to the Mahavira Hall in the upper courtyard, only about 170 square metres, where nearly 2,000 painted clay figures, from about 3 metres tall to a few centimetres high, crowd the walls and beams, many of them 'suspended' sculptures fixed high up on iron wires.
description: 景区内可游览韦陀殿、无量殿、大雄宝殿。图集建议预留一天游览。
accessEn: Linfen West is 1–1.5 hours from Taiyuan South by high-speed train. Xi County is about 120 km north-west of Linfen, around 1.5–2 hours by car or about 2 hours by bus from Linfen's bus station, then a short taxi ride to the foot of Phoenix Hill.

name: 桃坪羌寨
summaryEn: Taoping is a Qiang village of tightly packed stone houses above the Zagunao River, its homes linked by dim alleys, covered passages and rooftop walkways, with tall stone watchtowers rising over them. Qiang families still live in the old village, and guesthouses in the new village next door make it easy to stay the night. In 2024 UN Tourism named it one of its Best Tourism Villages.
description: 景区内可游览桃坪羌寨古寨、碉楼、水网。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: Taoping lies beside the Wenchuan–Maerkang expressway in Li County, about 140 km and roughly 2 hours by road from Chengdu. Buses from Chengdu towards Li County (Lixian) pass the village.

name: 甲居藏寨
summaryEn: Jiaju is a village of about 140 Gyalrong Tibetan families, its stone houses whitewashed and banded in red and black and scattered among fields and orchards on a mountainside about 8 km from Danba town. Stay in a family homestay to see the village at dawn and dusk, then visit Suopo, a few kilometres south-east of town, where dozens of tall stone watchtowers rise among the houses. In 2005 Chinese National Geography magazine named Danba's Tibetan villages among the most beautiful in China.
description: 景区内可游览甲居藏寨、中路藏寨、梭坡古碉群。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
accessEn: Buses from Chengdu take 6–7 hours, and many travellers arrive via Mount Siguniang or from Kangding (3–4 hours). Jiaju is about 8 km from Danba town, a short taxi ride up a winding mountain road.

name: 自贡
summaryEn: Zigong, in southern Sichuan, grew rich on salt and rewards a stop on three counts. The Zigong Dinosaur Museum at Dashanpu is built over a dense bed of Middle Jurassic fossils, with bones displayed in the excavation pit just as they were found; in the old salt quarters, the ornate 18th-century Xiqin Guild Hall houses the Salt History Museum and the timber derrick of the Shenhai Well still stands. Each Spring Festival season the city's lantern festival fills Chinese Lantern World with giant illuminated figures.
description: 景区内可游览自贡恐龙博物馆、盐业历史博物馆（西秦会馆）、燊海井。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
highlights: 盐业历史博物馆（西秦会馆）
accessEn: High-speed trains from Chengdu East reach Zigong in about an hour. The Dinosaur Museum is in Dashanpu, about 7 km north-east of the centre, a short taxi ride from the salt museum and the Shenhai Well.

name: 蜀南竹海
summaryEn: The Shunan Bamboo Sea blankets some 120 square kilometres of low ridges in southern Sichuan with hundreds of bamboo varieties, led by towering moso. Roads and footpaths run through green tunnels to lakes, waterfalls and cliff-face galleries such as Xianyu Cave, and a cableway from the West Gate floats you over the canopy. It is cool, hushed and loveliest early in the morning, when mist hangs among the stems.
description: 蜀南竹海是四川南部地区的旅游胜地，位于宜宾市长宁、江安两县，是极少数以竹类资源著称的旅游景点。蜀南竹海观光景区面积约120平方公里，其中林区约46平方公里，所处山区及丘陵位于北纬28.5度附近，海拔高度约在600到1000米之间，原生竹子种类约60种，后又陆续引种了300多种其它竹子，以楠竹面积最大。
accessEn: High-speed trains from Chengdu reach Yibin in about 1.5 hours, or Changning on the Chengdu–Guiyang line in about 2 hours; from either it is roughly an hour by bus or taxi to the West Gate.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 西昌与邛海
summaryEn: Xichang, capital of the Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture, sits at about 1,500 metres beside Qionghai, Sichuan's second-largest freshwater lake. Mild, sunny winters earn it the nicknames 'Little Spring City' and 'Moon City'; walking and cycling paths run through the lakeside wetlands, and forested Lushan above the western shore is dotted with old Buddhist and Taoist temples. It is also the main town of the Yi people, whose Torch Festival is the region's biggest celebration.
description: 景区内可游览邛海、泸山、光福寺地震碑林。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
accessEn: Trains on the rebuilt Chengdu–Kunming line reach Xichang West from Chengdu in about 3–3.5 hours, and there are flights to Xichang Qingshan Airport. The lakeshore is around 15 km from the station by taxi.

name: 蒙顶山
summaryEn: Mount Mengding rises to 1,456 metres on the rainy western rim of the Sichuan Basin, about 15 km from Ya'an, its slopes striped with tea terraces. Stone paths climb past temples and ancient ginkgos to the Imperial Tea Garden, a small walled plot near the summit, while a tea museum at the foot and teahouses along the way introduce local teas such as Mengding Ganlu, a delicate green tea.
description: 景区内可游览茶史博物馆、天盖寺、甘露井。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: Trains from Chengdu reach Mingshan station in about an hour, and Ya'an in 1–1.5 hours; the scenic area is about 15 km from Mingshan station by taxi.

name: 安岳石刻
summaryEn: Anyue county, midway between Chengdu and Chongqing, holds one of China's largest concentrations of Buddhist cliff carvings, scattered across farmland and low hills. The star is Wofoyuan, where a 23-metre Tang-dynasty Buddha reclines on his left side near caves lined with carved scripture; Song-era highlights include the graceful Purple Bamboo Guanyin at Pilu Cave and the bodhisattvas of Huayan Cave. Crowds are thin, and so is public transport.
description: 安岳石刻，又称安岳石窟，位于四川省资阳市安岳县，是安岳境内石窟造像的总称。安岳古为普州治所，地处成渝古道的中点，经济文化较为发达。境内以丘陵地貌为主，多有红岩出露，有利于摩崖造像。
accessEn: Anyue has no railway station yet (a Chengdu–Chongqing high-speed line with a stop here is due around 2027), so allow about 2.5 hours by road from Chengdu or Chongqing. The Reclining Buddha lies north of the county town and Pilu Cave about 50 km to the south-east, so hire a car and driver.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 澄江化石地与抚仙湖
summaryEn: In the hills near Chengjiang, south-east of Kunming, mudstones laid down in a shallow sea some 518 million years ago hold some of the earliest complex animals ever found, with soft parts such as guts and even nerves preserved. The fossil beds became a World Heritage Site in 2012, and a large museum built beside them displays the finds with models and interactive galleries. Just to the south, Fuxian Lake, one of the deepest freshwater lakes in China, is good for a lakeside stroll or a night by the water.
description: 景区内可游览澄江化石地自然博物馆、帽天山、抚仙湖。图集建议预留1 天游览。
highlights: 澄江化石地自然博物馆
accessEn: Chengjiang is about 1–1.5 hours by road south-east of Kunming, with frequent buses from Kunming's South Bus Station. The museum is a taxi ride east of town.

name: 罗平油菜花海
summaryEn: Each late winter the farmland around Luoping, in eastern Yunnan, turns gold as rapeseed comes into flower across a vast area. At Jinjifeng, hundreds of small conical karst hills rise from the yellow fields, while at Niujie the crops curl around sinkholes in concentric 'snail shell' terraces. North-east of town, the Jiulong Waterfalls tumble down a staircase of ten falls in a Bouyei farming valley.
description: 景区内可游览金鸡峰丛、牛街螺丝田、九龙瀑布群。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
accessEn: Luoping is about 240 km east of Kunming: direct buses from Kunming East Bus Station take around 3.5 hours, and conventional trains (there is no high-speed link) take about 3–4 hours. The viewpoints lie 10–25 km from town, so hire a car and driver or use taxis.

name: 建水古城
summaryEn: Jianshui is an old garrison town in southern Yunnan, entered through Chaoyang Tower, a massive Ming gate tower of 1389, and laced with lanes of courtyard houses and old stone wells. In town, the highlights are a Confucian Temple that ranks among China's largest and the Zhu Family Garden, a late-Qing merchant mansion of 214 rooms and 42 courtyards. A vintage tourist train runs west to the 17-arch Double Dragon Bridge and the mansion village of Tuanshan.
description: 景区内可游览朝阳楼、建水文庙、朱家花园。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
accessEn: Trains from Kunming and Kunming South reach Jianshui station in about 1¾–2 hours; the station is about 6 km north-east of the old town, a short taxi or bus ride. Yuanyang's rice terraces are roughly 2–2.5 hours' drive further south.

name: 元谋土林
summaryEn: North of Kunming, the Yuanmou Basin holds fields of eroded clay and sandstone pillars, fins and towers, the tallest around 40 metres, banded in ochre, red, grey and white. Wumao, the most developed site, has paths leading down into a maze of gullies, while Langbapu sees fewer visitors. The colours are richest in low sun, so come early or late.
description: 元谋土林是指位于中华人民共和国云南省楚雄彝族自治州元谋县的一系列典型第四纪土林地貌景观，以其造型奇特、色彩斑斓、地质结构复杂而著称，其中物茂土林景区是国家AAAA级旅游景区。
accessEn: D trains on the Chengdu–Kunming line reach Yuanmou West from Kunming in about 1.5 hours (5–6 hours from Chengdu). Wumao Earth Forest is about 30 km north-west of Yuanmou town, around 40 minutes by taxi or hired car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 巍山古城
summaryEn: Weishan is a low-key old town an hour south of Dali, laid out in the early Ming dynasty as a grid of lanes lined with wooden shopfronts, courtyard houses and snack stalls. Gongchen Tower, the massive north gate, and Xinggong Tower at the centre can both be climbed for views over the tiled roofs. Outside town, the forested slopes of Weibao Mountain are scattered with Taoist temples.
description: 本条目叙述的是巍山古城，南诏镇古建筑群、等觉寺请参阅条目南诏镇古建筑群及等觉寺。巍山古城又称蒙化城，位于中国云南省大理州巍山彝族回族自治县南诏镇境内。古城内大街小巷纵横交错，为棋盘式格局，民居的建筑体型、体量、色调大多保留了明清建筑风貌，土木结构。
wikiEn: Weishan Yi and Hui Autonomous County
accessEn: Frequent buses from Xiaguan, Dali's modern centre, take about an hour, and some trains on the Dali–Lincang railway stop at Weishan station. Weibao Mountain is about 10 km south-east of town by taxi or minibus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 怒江大峡谷与丙中洛
summaryEn: North of Liuku, the Nu River, the upper Salween, cuts a deep, narrow canyon between the Gaoligong and Biluo ranges, both topping 4,000 m, and a road follows it for nearly 300 km past Lisu and Nu villages perched on the slopes. At its northern end, around Bingzhongluo, the valley widens into farmland on broad river terraces, the river swings round a cliff in the horseshoe-shaped First Bend, and walkers can follow an old caravan path cut into the cliffs to the Nu village of Wuli.
description: 景区内可游览怒江第一湾、石门关、重丁教堂。图集建议预留3–4 天游览。
accessEn: From Dali, Liuku (Lushui) is about 4.5 hours by road, or take the train to Baoshan (about an hour) and the Baoshan–Lushui expressway on to Liuku. The canyon road then runs nearly 300 km north to Bingzhongluo, a 6–7-hour drive or a long day by bus.

name: 西双版纳与景洪
summaryEn: Jinghong, the capital of Xishuangbanna in Yunnan's tropical far south, straddles the Mekong (here called the Lancang) and has a distinctly Southeast Asian feel. Its Dai people, close kin of the Thai, Lao and Shan, follow Theravada Buddhism: visit the gilded halls and stupas of the main Buddhist temple and Manting Park, once the Dai kings' royal garden, then cross to the riverside Gaozhuang quarter, where the sprawling Starlight Night Market fills with grilled fish, tropical fruit and crafts after dark.
description: 景区内可游览曼听公园、曼春满佛寺、西双版纳傣族自治州民族博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
highlights: 西双版纳傣族自治州民族博物馆
accessEn: Bullet trains on the China–Laos Railway run from Kunming South to Xishuangbanna station, on the edge of Jinghong, in about 3–3.5 hours; flights from Kunming take about an hour. From the station it is a 10–15-minute taxi ride to the centre.

name: 景迈山古茶林
summaryEn: On a forested ridge in Lancang county, in Pu'er prefecture, old tea trees grow scattered beneath taller forest trees instead of in clipped rows. Nine traditional Blang and Dai villages of wooden stilt houses sit among five old tea forests, and in 2023 the landscape became the world's first tea-themed World Heritage Site. Walk the forest paths, drink the local Pu'er tea in a village tea house and stay the night to watch the mist lift off the hills.
description: 景区内可游览景迈大寨、糯岗、翁基。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
accessEn: Flights from Kunming to Lancang Jingmai Airport take just over an hour, and the villages are a 1–1.5-hour drive from there. From Jinghong in Xishuangbanna it is about 3 hours by car.

name: 百里山水画廊
summaryEn: A 371-square-kilometre scenic area covering the whole of Qianjiadian town in the hills of north-eastern Yanqing, matching the Qianjiadian area of the Yanqing Geopark and strung along a riverside road loop of about 56 km. Its main stops are a geopark of fossilised (silicified) tree trunks, the Wulong Gorge, the Dishuihu waterfall and the old Chaoyang Temple, Dragon King Temple and Guandi Temple, with village guesthouses along the way.
description: 北京延庆百里山水画廊景区，也叫做千家店百里山水画廊景区。位于北京市延庆县东北部千家店镇，与中国延庆世界地质公园千家店园区范围基本一致，总面积371平方公里，距县城40公里，距市区110公里。东与怀柔区毗邻，北与河北省赤城县接壤，西南、东南分别于香营、刘斌堡、珍珠泉三个乡相连。
accessEn: About 40 km north-east of Yanqing town and 110 km from central Beijing, best reached by car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 北宫国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park in the low hills of western Fengtai, established in 2002 and approved as a national forest park in 2005. Paths climb through planted woods, flower gardens and stream valleys, and in autumn its maples and other coloured trees make it one of Beijing's popular red-leaf spots.
description: 北宫国家森林公园是位于中华人民共和国北京市丰台区的国家森林公园，因帝王憩地而得名。该公园始建于2002年10月，2005年12月被国家林业局正式批准为国家级森林公园。该公园森林覆盖率达68.8%，林木绿化率达89.3%。
accessEn: In the western hills of Fengtai District, about 25 km west of central Beijing by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 北京野生动物园
summaryEn: A large forested safari park near Yufa in southern Daxing, opened in 2001, with a self-drive route through the big-animal and predator areas and walk-through zones for smaller species. Themed areas include red-panda and capybara exhibits, a gibbon area and a Madagascar forest, and the park keeps sizeable groups of chimpanzees, jaguars and African elephants.
description: 北京野生动物园位于中华人民共和国北京市大兴区榆垡镇的万亩森林之中。
accessEn: In Yufa town in southern Daxing District, near Beijing Daxing International Airport, about 45 km south of central Beijing and roughly an hour by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黑龙潭
summaryEn: A narrow gorge about 4 km long north of Lupiguan in Shicheng town, where a stream drops through a chain of named pools and several waterfalls. Paths, steps and bridges follow the water up the cliff-lined valley.
description: 黑龙潭位于北京。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shicheng town, Miyun District, about 100 km north-east of central Beijing by road. Scenic areas across Miyun were closed during the floods of late July 2025, and the municipal register of A-level scenic areas still listed this one as closed in October 2026, so check that it has reopened before planning.

name: 京东大峡谷
summaryEn: A narrow, steep-walled canyon near Yuzishan village in northern Pinggu, with a waterfall, a chain of pools and walkways fixed to the cliffs, ending at a small lake where boats can be hired. A second area climbs to the flat top of Jingtai Mountain for views, and a cliffside walkway includes a glass-floored stretch.
description: 京东大峡谷位于北京市平谷县城东北约12公里的鱼子山村。包括大峡谷与井台山两大游览区组成，总面积约为20平方千米。
accessEn: About 12 km north-east of Pinggu town and roughly 90 km from central Beijing by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0
imageCredit: The original uploader was 高晶 at Chinese Wikipedia .

name: 滨海航母主题公园
summaryEn: A military-themed park in the Sino-Singapore Tianjin Eco-city built around the Kiev, a Soviet-built aircraft carrier that left Russian service in 1993 and arrived in Tianjin in 2000. The carrier, moored on the coast, is the main sight and visitors can go aboard; a linked tour also takes in two other warships, including a retired Chinese destroyer. The park also puts on shows, including a sea-battle show and Russian-style song and dance, and fireworks on summer weekends.
description: 天津泰达航母主题公园，原名天津国际游乐港，曾称天津滨海航母主题公园，是位于天津市滨海新区汉北路269号的一座军事主题公园，由泰达控股旗下的天津滨海泰达航母旅游集团股份有限公司运营。园区以退役的苏联基辅号航空母舰为主要展品，并陈列中国人民解放军海军的退役驱逐舰、潜艇和护卫艇，设有舰艇展览、国防教育和主题演出等项目。
accessEn: On the coast of the Sino-Singapore Tianjin Eco-city, Binhai New Area, about 18 km north-north-east of the Binhai New Area government in Tanggu.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 金街
summaryEn: Jinjie, the 'Golden Street', is the pedestrian stretch of Heping Road in central Tianjin, about 1.2 kilometres between Fu'an Street and Chifeng Road. The road dates from 1902, when the French concession built its first section, with a Japanese-concession section following in 1908; it became the city's main shopping street in the 1920s, and many of its stores and bank buildings date from the early 20th century, including the Quanyechang department store.
description: 金街位于天津。游览特色包括特色街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Heping District, about 1.5 km south-west of Tianjin Railway Station.

name: 萨马兰奇纪念馆
summaryEn: A museum on the west shore of Tuanbo Lake dedicated to Juan Antonio Samaranch, who led the International Olympic Committee for 21 years, opened in 2013 with the authorisation of the Samaranch family and the IOC. It holds about 16,000 items from his books, souvenirs and personal belongings, including the passports that record his visits to China, and sits in grounds with an Olympic sculpture park. It was rated a national second-grade museum in 2024.
description: 萨马兰奇纪念馆，是国际奥委会设立的旨在纪念国际奥委会终身名誉主席胡安·安东尼奥·萨马兰奇的纪念馆，是国际奥林匹克博物馆联盟的正式成员。萨马兰奇纪念馆坐落在天津市静海区团泊新城健康产业园，距离天津中心城区10公里。
accessEn: In the Tianjin Health Industry Park on the west shore of Tuanbo Lake, Jinghai District, about 9.7 km east-north-east of the Jinghai district government; closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天津极地海洋公园
summaryEn: An aquarium and marine-animal park in a whale-shaped building in the Xiangluowan business district, on the south bank of the Hai River facing Tanggu's commercial centre. Its exhibits include polar animals, an undersea tunnel, a beluga area and a jellyfish hall, and the park puts on regular animal shows. It suits families with young children.
description: 天津极地海洋世界坐落于天津市滨海新区响螺湾商务区，是一个包括极地海洋馆、酒店式公寓、城市旅游大道、嘉年华板道街以及阳光海游城等五大板块的综合休闲旅游项目，整体投资约16亿元人民币，其中极地海洋馆2009年12月26日上午全国最大的极地海洋馆正式封顶，本项目已于2011年10月1日正式对外营业。
accessEn: In the Xiangluowan business district, Binhai New Area, about 3 km west-south-west of the Binhai New Area government in Tanggu.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天津热带植物观光园
summaryEn: A greenhouse botanical garden beside the Caozhuang flower market in Xiqing District, opened in 2003, with an indoor collection of tropical and subtropical plants that includes palms and dragon trees. It closed in November 2023 to be converted into an aerospace-biology science park, and no reopening has been announced.
description: 天津热带植物观光园位于天津。游览特色包括植物园、园林景观。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Zhongbei town, Xiqing District, beside the Caozhuang flower market just north of the Outer Ring Road's seventh bridge, about 7 km east of the Xiqing District government in Yangliuqing; check whether it has reopened before going.

name: 晋察冀边区革命纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial museum at Chengnanzhuang that first opened in 1974 in the former headquarters of the Jin-Cha-Ji Military Region and was enlarged and renamed in 2005. Its photographs and objects cover the Jin-Cha-Ji border region during the War of Resistance against Japan and the civil war, and the preserved headquarters are three rows of 21 adobe houses, including rooms used by Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai and Ren Bishi, an operations office, a telephone room and a meeting room. Chengnanzhuang is also where the Communist Party issued its 1948 May Day slogans.
description: 晋察冀边区政府及军区司令部旧址位于河北省保定市阜平县城南庄镇花山村，由晋察冀边区政府成立处及晋察冀边区政府家北驻地两部分组成，1996年11月，该旧址被中华人民共和国国务院核定为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Chengnanzhuang town, about 13 km south of Fuping county town. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 刘伶醉烧锅遗址
summaryEn: Liulingzui is a liquor distillery in Xushui whose old works preserve a distillery site of the Jin and Yuan dynasties: two rows of 16 fermentation pits that archaeologists say have been in continuous use ever since, and an underground 'wine sea' of Ming and Qing wooden and wicker storage vats. The site became a national heritage unit in 2006 and national industrial heritage in 2020, and suits anyone curious about how Chinese baijiu is made and aged.
description: 刘伶醉烧锅遗址，位于中国河北省保定市徐水区刘伶醉酒厂，公布时间为2001年2月7日公布为河北省文物保护单位，2006年5月25日公布为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xushui district town, about 22 km north-east of central Baoding and reached by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 满城汉墓
summaryEn: Two rock-cut tombs on Lingshan hill belonging to Liu Sheng, Prince Jing of Zhongshan, and his wife Dou Wan, dated to the end of the 2nd century BC and found by military engineers in 1968. Each tomb has a long entrance passage, side chambers, a central hall and a rear chamber, with drainage and anti-theft features cut into the rock. The finds included two gold-thread jade burial suits and the Changxin Palace lamp, which are now in the Hebei Museum, with replicas shown on site, and the tombs are counted among the major Chinese archaeological discoveries of the 20th century.
description: 满城汉墓位于河北保定。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、历史纪念。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Lingshan hill about 3 km west-south-west of Mancheng town, a short taxi ride from there, and about 17 km west-north-west of central Baoding.

name: 南大港湿地
summaryEn: A coastal marsh on the west shore of the Bohai Sea, about 90 percent covered by reed beds, with open water, meadow and salt-tolerant plants. Experts have recorded 268 bird species here, including red-crowned and white cranes, swans, spoonbills and oriental storks, and there are observation platforms for watching them. The best times are the spring and autumn migrations, and the wetland was added in 2024 to the UNESCO World Heritage listing for the Yellow Sea and Bohai Gulf migratory bird habitats.
description: 南大港湿地位于中华人民共和国河北省黄骅市东北部的一处滨海湿地，属于沧州渤海新区南大港管理区管辖范围内，为省级自然保护区。湿地面积1.6万公顷，位于渤海西岸。历史上曾是黄河和石碑河流经的地方，现属于地下深层淡水漏斗区，埋深170～250米，从西向东逐步加深。
accessEn: The visitor area (the south square) is about 15 km north-north-east of central Huanghua and about 56 km east-north-east of Cangzhou, in the Nandagang district near the Bohai coast.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 吴桥杂技大世界
summaryEn: A performance park opened in 1993 in Wuqiao, the county known as the home of Chinese acrobatics, covering about 36 hectares. Its main attraction is the Jianghu Culture City, a walled street recreating the market scenes of early 20th-century Wuqiao, where performers stage stunts, hard-qigong feats and magic; the park also has an acrobatics museum, theatres, a 'comic zoo' and a circus amusement area. It is a commercial attraction, so expect staged entertainment rather than a historic site.
description: 吴桥杂技大世界，位于中华人民共和国河北省沧州市吴桥县，是充分发挥吴桥“杂技之乡”优势，在吴桥建造的一个游乐场所，也为吴桥县业余杂技艺人提供了一个表演和谋生的场所。
accessEn: About 2 km north-north-west of Wuqiao county town, which has a station on the Beijing–Shanghai railway, and about 84 km south-south-west of Cangzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 蟠龙湖
summaryEn: A large lake in the hills of Kuancheng Manchu Autonomous County where the Great Wall runs down into the water, so that stretches of wall can be seen under the surface in clear conditions. Boats run along the cliff-lined shore to see this 'underwater Great Wall', and the lake also has kayaks and motorboats and is one of the national rowing team's training bases. It suits a half-day outing on the water, and local routes link it with the Xifengkou Great Wall.
description: 蟠龙湖又名八一水库，是中国河北省石家庄市元氏县境内的一座水库，位于子牙河系滏阳河上，建于1959年。水库正常库容为4920万立方米，集雨面积为139平方千米，海拔为114.4米。
accessEn: On the shore at Xindianzi village, about 21 km south-south-west of Kuancheng town, reached by road. Kuancheng was hit by severe floods in July 2026, so check that the lake is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 朝阳沟
summaryEn: A wooded valley scenic area in the Taihang Mountains of north-west Wu'an, themed on the Henan opera Chaoyanggou, a 1958 play about an urban student who settles in a mountain village, and on rural 'educated youth' culture. Its museum, open since 2003, has nine exhibition areas, including one on the opera's author Yang Lanchun and others set out as a production team, a village school and the homes of characters from the play. It suits visitors interested in the opera or in rural-themed heritage, with mountain scenery around the village.
description: 《朝阳沟》是由编剧杨兰春于1958年创作的一部著名豫剧作品，是现代豫剧的经典之作。该剧以中国大跃进时期知识青年上山下乡为背景，围绕女主角银环到未婚夫拴保的家乡朝阳沟参加农业生产而展开的一系列矛盾冲突，最后立志扎根农村的爱情故事。
accessEn: In the mountains of north-west Wu'an, about 44 km north-west of the centre of Wu'an and about 71 km west-north-west of central Handan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 八路军一二九师司令部旧址
summaryEn: Chi'an village in Henandian township was the headquarters of the Eighth Route Army's 129th Division under Liu Bocheng and Deng Xiaoping during the war against Japan, and it is now a memorial complex.
