The headquarters consists of three northern-style courtyards, including the former Liu and Deng residence, and the complex also has an exhibition hall on the division's history and General's Ridge, a hillside where the ashes of Liu Bocheng, Xu Xiangqian and other senior officers of the division are interred. It is a red-tourism site, and the courtyards, hall and ridge together take about half a day.
description: 八路军一二九师司令部旧址，又名刘邓大军司令部旧址、129师司令部旧址，位于河北省邯郸市涉县河南店镇赤岸村，由将军岭、129师司令部、和129师陈列馆组成，面积340亩。是中国重点文物保护单位、中国4A级旅游景区。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Chi'an village, Henandian township, about 4 km west-north-west of Shexian town and about 77 km west of central Handan; the exhibition hall is closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 京娘湖
summaryEn: A mountain reservoir in the Taihang foothills of north-west Wu'an, formally the Koushang Reservoir (built 1966–69) and better known by the name of the folk tale in which the future Song founder Zhao Kuangyin rescues a kidnapped girl, Zhao Jingniang, and escorts her home. The scenic area has boat trips on the lake and through the narrow Jingniang Gorge, a shrine to Jingniang and steep cliffs around the water. The reservoir was listed as a national water-conservancy scenic area in 2005 and suits a day out in the hills.
description: 京娘湖位于河北邯郸。游览特色包括峡谷、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the mountains of Huoshui township, about 31 km north-west of the centre of Wu'an and about 57 km west-north-west of central Handan.

name: 太行五指山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area south of Shexian town, named for five peaks that resemble the fingers of the Buddha's hand, the highest reaching 1,283 m. The attractions listed for it include a plaza, a cliffside plank walkway, a glass bridge, Wukong Valley, a ski slope and a statue of the monkey king Sun Wukong, which ties the peaks to the Journey to the West story of the monkey pinned beneath a mountain. It suits a half-day trip from Shexian for hiking and views.
description: 太行五指山又名五行山，位于太行山东麓河北省邯郸市涉县，因五座山峰形似如来佛五指而得名，是国家4A级旅游景区，主峰海拔1283米。主要景点包括五行广场、长空栈道、五指禅院、悟空谷、孙悟空像、空中草原、玻璃桥、朝鲜义勇军旧址等。
accessEn: About 7 km south of Shexian town and about 75 km west of central Handan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 赵苑公园
summaryEn: A large landscaped park in north-west Handan, opened in 2004 and built in the style of the Warring States Zhao kingdom, with lakes, lotus ponds and a series of themed garden zones. Inside are earthen remains that local archaeologists link to Zhao-period metalworking, including a platform about 9 m high known as the arrow-casting furnace, and a Han tomb, and one garden presents idioms that originated in Handan. It is a local green space that suits a short walk when in the city.
description: 赵苑公园位于河北省邯郸市的西北部，联防路与丛台路之间，国家AAAA级景区，是以仿战国古赵文化而修建的山水绿地建筑群公园，同时也是是河北、山东、山西、河南四省交界处规模最大的、古代文化与现代游乐融于一体的多功能、综合性公园。
accessEn: Between Lianfang Road and Congtai Road in north-west Handan, about 2 km west-north-west of Congtai Park.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 梦东方·未来世界
summaryEn: An indoor space-themed activity park in Yanjiao, the commuter town of Sanhe on Beijing's eastern edge, inside the Tianyang City development. Exhibits and activities aimed at families and school groups have included astronaut-training equipment, a space medical centre, a genetics centre and spacesuit photos. It is a commercial attraction that suits children and visitors staying in the Beijing area.
description: 梦东方·未来世界位于河北廊坊。游览特色包括航天科普、休闲公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yanjiao, about 5 km south-west of Yanjiao town centre and 36 km east of central Beijing; bus routes such as 893 link the nearby Tianyang City terminus with Beijing's Lucheng subway station. Check that it is open before going.

name: 秦皇岛港口近代建筑群
summaryEn: The old West Port of Qinhuangdao, where the harbour opened to trade in 1898 and the Kailuan mining company built its offices, power plant, staff housing, wharves and railway. Nine of its buildings and sites are on the national list, and the former Kailuan staff club is now the Qinhuangdao Port Museum. Parts of the old port have been opened as an industrial-tourism area, so it works as an industrial-heritage walk beside the working port.
description: 秦皇岛港口近代建筑群，位于河北省秦皇岛市海港区，包括多个全国重点文物保护单位、河北省文物保护单位等。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the old West Port in Haigang District, about 3 km south-east of Qinhuangdao station (about 4 km by road). The Port Museum inside is open on weekdays only.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 秦皇岛野生动物园
summaryEn: A large safari-style wildlife park on the Beidaihe coast, opened in 1995, where animals including tigers, lions and bears are kept in zoned areas set in coastal woodland. Visitors tour it in their own vehicle or by park bus, with some areas open on foot. A giant panda house with two pandas opened in January 2026, and the park suits families for about half a day.
description: 秦皇岛野生动物园，位于河北省秦皇岛市北戴河区滨海大道中段，为国家4A级景区，创建于1995年。园内有美洲虎、白虎、东北虎、丹顶鹤等奇禽异兽，。
accessEn: On Binhai Avenue in Beidaihe District, about 9 km south-west of Qinhuangdao station (about 14 km by road).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 祖山
summaryEn: Zushan, called the 'ancestor of the Yanshan', is a large mountain scenic area in the Yanshan range north of Qinhuangdao; its highest peak, Tiannü Peak, rises to 1,428 m. Visitors come for the rocky peaks, gorges and streams, and a cable car serves the higher parts.
description: 祖山位于中国河北省秦皇岛市青龙县境内，区域总面积达118平方公里，其最高峰天女峰，海拔1428米。祖山由渤海以北、燕山以东诸峰组成，所以也被称作是“燕山之祖”。
accessEn: The scenic area lies in Qinglong Manchu Autonomous County; its east gate, the entrance nearest the city, is about 22 km north-north-west of Qinhuangdao station (about 25 km by road).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东方巨龟苑
summaryEn: A family leisure park on the east bank of the Ye River in Pingshan County, built by a local entrepreneur whose business began with soft-shelled turtle farming. Its sights include a giant turtle-shaped landmark, a long gallery walkway, a landscaped garden themed on Chinese history, an aquarium and water-play areas, with the turtle-farming side of the business also on show. It suits families with children and school study groups rather than heritage travellers.
description: 东方巨龟苑是位于中华人民共和国河北省石家庄市平山县内的一处国家4A级旅游景区，以及中国北方最大的高科技甲鱼养殖基地。同时也是河北省国防教育基地和石家庄市爱国主义教育基地。内有甲鱼养殖基地、水族馆以及其他一些人造景观，是一处包括农业养殖参观，自然景观游览，水上项目，人造景观的综合性景区。
accessEn: On the east bank of the Ye River, about 6 km south-west of Pingshan town and 37 km west-north-west of central Shijiazhuang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 棋盘山
summaryEn: A forested mountain scenic area of about 20 km² in the Taihang foothills of western Zanhuang County, divided into four sub-areas (Apricot Valley, Qipanshan, Camel Peak and Eight Immortals Ridge) with more than 110 named sights, among them dozens of peaks, cliffs and caves. The highest point, Sixianggong Zhai, is 1,342.3 m, and the long apricot valley blossoms around the end of March, with wild peach and rhododendron following in spring and summer. Its summers are cool, with a hottest-month average of about 22 °C.
description: 棋盘山位于河北石家庄。游览特色包括山谷、山地游览、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Duanli valley west of Zanhuang town, about 23 km west of it; the city government gives 27 km from the county seat and 77 km from Shijiazhuang, so a car is the practical way.

name: 天桂山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area of steep peaks, caves and springs in the Taihang hills of Pingshan County, with a large Taoist temple complex, Qinglong Guan, that is said locally to have begun as a late-Ming imperial lodge. On one cliff is a carving of the Chinese character gui ('return'), 97.71 m high and 49.1 m wide, cut in 1997 to mark Hong Kong's return to Chinese rule. Other sights include a cave and exhibition hall linked to the White-Haired Girl story and a Taoist martial-arts square.
description: 天桂山，位于中国河北省石家庄市的西北90公里处的平山县境内，太行山的名峰之一，主峰海拔1270米，总面积约60平方公里。2001年11月，被国家旅游局评定为国家AAAA级旅游区。2002年5月被中华人民共和国国务院审定公布为国家重点风景名胜区，整个景区由青龙观中心景区和玄武峰、望海峰、银河洞、翠屏山等八个景区组成。
accessEn: In the Taihang hills of Pingshan County, about 40 km west of Pingshan town and 71 km west-north-west of central Shijiazhuang (local sources quote 80–90 km from Shijiazhuang).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 沕沕水
summaryEn: A karst valley scenic area of about 11.5 km² in western Pingshan County, where a spring breaks out high on the hillside and feeds waterfalls with drops of 93 m and 45 m; in winter the water is used for an ice-fall display. The area also holds a late Palaeolithic cave site, Shuilian Cave, and a small hydroelectric station built in 1947–48 to supply power to Xibaipo, then the seat of the Communist Party's central leadership. It suits visitors who want mountain scenery and some red-tourism history in one outing.
description: 沕沕水是滹沱河上游的一条支流，位于中国河北省石家庄市平山县西南45千米，距石家庄95公里，旅游面积11.5平方公里，海拔高度800—1100米。是国家4A级景区、河北省级森林公园。沕沕水流域是典型的喀斯特岩溶地区，有落差为93米、45米的多级瀑布，山势雄伟秀丽，奇形怪状，年平均气温为8℃-11℃，年平均降水量为600毫米，气候凉爽湿润。
accessEn: In the hills of western Pingshan County, about 40 km west of Pingshan town and 69 km west-north-west of central Shijiazhuang (the county government gives 45 km from Pingshan town and 95 km from Shijiazhuang).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 曹妃甸湿地
summaryEn: Part of a coastal wetland on the Bohai shore of Caofeidian District, made up of reed beds, marshes, fish ponds, shallow reservoirs and tidal flats; the provincial-level wetland and bird reserve covers about 110 square kilometres and lies on the East Asian–Australasian migratory route. Around Cao Fei Lake, visitors can take boat trips, fish, walk a reed-maze trail with a lookout tower and watch birds, with waterbirds most numerous in April and May. More than 300 bird species have been recorded.
description: 曹妃甸湿地，原名唐海湿地，位于中华人民共和国河北省唐山市曹妃甸区西南渤海沿岸地区，总面积110.64平方千米，是一个由草甸、水体、野生动植物、人工动植物等多种生态要素构成的湿地生态系统，属省级湿地和鸟类自然保护区。
accessEn: On the shore of Cao Fei Lake about 13 km south-west of Tanghai town and roughly 53 km south-south-east of central Tangshan, reached by road. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 李大钊纪念馆及故居
summaryEn: Li Dazhao, an early leader of the Chinese Communist Party, was born in 1889 in Dahetuo village, where the three-courtyard farmhouse he grew up in is a nationally protected site. The memorial hall in Laoting town, on a site of about 9 hectares, holds some 35,000 objects, with a white-marble statue of Li in its tribute hall. The memorial hall is a first-class national museum and one of the 100 national red-tourism classic scenic areas.
description: 李大钊故居位于河北省乐亭县大黑坨村，建于1881年。故居分为前中后三院，为冀东农村地区典型的穿堂院式建筑。中国共产党早期领导人李大钊诞生于此。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: The former residence is in Dahetuo village about 15 km east-south-east of Laoting town, and the memorial hall is on the west side of Laoting, itself about 65 km east-south-east of central Tangshan. The memorial hall is closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 青龙山
summaryEn: A forested mountain scenic area in the north-west of Luanzhou, a spur of the Yan Mountains, with Buddhist and Taoist temples and walking routes through pine and cypress woods. It is promoted for spring blossom and autumn colour.
description: 青龙山，是南京市江宁区的丘陵，因“石坚而青”“重峦叠嶂”，与黄龙山呈二龙竞走状而得名，又称青山。长15千米，宽2千米，主峰海拔277米。有南京市青龙山精神病院。
accessEn: In Wangdianzi town about 25 km west-north-west of Luanzhou city and some 33 km north-east of central Tangshan, reached by road. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 扁鹊庙
summaryEn: A large temple complex at the foot of Que Mountain in Shentou village, dedicated to the physician Bian Que; tradition dates it to the Warring States period, though the present buildings are Ming and Qing rebuilds. It is known for its ancient cypresses, more than 100 steles from the Song to the Qing, halls to Bian Que and the Three Pure Ones, a tomb mound and a Han-dynasty stone beast. It is a national education base for traditional Chinese medicine culture, and a Bian Que Culture Festival is held in Neiqiu, most recently in September 2026.
description: 扁鹊庙位于河北省邢台市内丘县南寨乡神头村，南北410米，东西200米，占地面积82000平方米。始建年代不详，元代、明代重建。2006年5月，该建筑被中华人民共和国国务院核定为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Shentou village, about 22 km west of Neiqiu town and about 34 km north-west of central Xingtai, or roughly 45 minutes' drive from Xingtai.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 崆山白云洞
summaryEn: A karst cave in the Taihang foothills of Lincheng, formed in the Cambrian period and found in 1988 by quarrymen, which opened to visitors in 1990. The route passes through five halls named the Human World, Heaven, Labyrinth, Underworld and Dragon Palace, where the temperature stays around 17 degrees Celsius all year. The Lincheng Xingyao Museum, a national second-grade museum on the white porcelain once made in this area, stands inside the scenic area.
description: 崆山白云洞是位于河北省邢台市临城县的一座天然喀斯特溶洞。崆山白云洞形成于距今5亿年前的寒武纪。2014年成为中国国家AAAA级景区。
accessEn: About 6 km west-north-west of Lincheng town and roughly 44 km north of central Xingtai, reached by road from Lincheng.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 岐山湖
summaryEn: A large reservoir on the Zhi River in Lincheng County, officially the Lincheng Reservoir and first called the Sanqi Reservoir, built in 1958–60 and later also called Qishan Lake. It is run as a lakeside scenic area in the Taihang foothills a few kilometres west of Kongshan Baiyun Cave, so the two can be visited together.
description: 岐山湖位于河北邢台。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xishu town, about 10 km west of Lincheng town and about 4 km west of Kongshan Baiyun Cave, reached by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 天河山
summaryEn: A scenic mountain area of about 30 square km on the Hebei–Shanxi border, with ravines, streams and waterfalls below a high meadow and a main peak of 1,780 m. Local tradition places the Cowherd and Weaver Girl legend here, and the mountain is marketed as the 'Love Mountain' and a centre of Qixi (Double Seventh) culture. It suits visitors after mountain scenery with a romantic theme.
description: 天河山PCMP，加拿大政治人物，2025年起以加拿大自由党党员身份担任加拿大国会下议院议员，代表安大略省约克区的万锦—康山选区，同年起在总理马克·卡尼内阁中出任联邦能源及自然资源部长。
accessEn: In Baian township of Xindu District, about 64 km west of central Xingtai, or roughly an hour's drive.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0
imageCredit: Europäische Kommission - Audiovisueller Dienst, Peter McCabe, CE - Service audiovisuel, EC - Audiovisual Service, FACTSTORY

name: 邢窑遗址
summaryEn: The site museum in Neiqiu county town protects 11 kiln furnaces uncovered in 2012 in a dig named one of China's ten major archaeological discoveries of that year, and visitors look down on them from an elevated walkway. Beside it stand the Xingyao Museum, which shows the white porcelain fired here from the late Northern Dynasties onwards, and a ceramics studio where visitors can try the craft. Xingyao ware, one of the cradles of Chinese white porcelain, was fired at about two dozen main kiln sites, mostly in Neiqiu and Lincheng, which are protected together as a national unit.
description: 邢窑遗址是位于河北省邢台市内丘县、临城县、邢台县及邢台市区境内的邢窑瓷窑遗址。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Neiqiu county town, about 25 km north of central Xingtai, or roughly half an hour's drive, and the Xingyao Site Museum is closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 云梦山
summaryEn: A mountain gorge area on the Hebei–Shanxi border in Xindu District, laid out in four tiers called the 'pot-heaven' levels, with a main peak of about 1,300 m and a clear stream running through it. Its best-known sights are the Qiying waterfall, which drops about 105 m, and a large cave known as the lecture cave of Guiguzi, the legendary Warring States sage the mountain is traditionally linked with. It suits a day among the hills north-west of Xingtai.
description: 云梦山位于河北邢台。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Shibanfang village in Jijiacun township, about 60 km west-north-west of central Xingtai, or roughly an hour's drive.

name: 云顶滑雪公园
summaryEn: The ski park of the Genting Secret Garden resort in Taizicheng village, Chongli, which hosted the Olympic freestyle skiing and snowboarding events of the 2022 Winter Games (apart from big air, held in Beijing) and the Paralympic snowboarding. Since the Games it has redesigned three of its six Olympic courses to suit recreational skiers, has around 45 trails in all and keeps staging international competitions, including FIS World Cup halfpipe events. A resort hotel and Taizicheng high-speed station are close by, so it works as a winter day trip from Beijing.
description: 密苑云顶乐园位于中华人民共和国河北省张家口市崇礼区四台嘴乡太子城村梧桐大道，是以滑雪为主题的度假中心。
accessEn: In Taizicheng village, Chongli District, about 4 km north-north-west of Taizicheng high-speed station, reached by a short shuttle; the station is about an hour by high-speed train from Beijing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 蔚州古城
summaryEn: The walled old town of Yuxian, first walled in 580 and rebuilt under the Ming in 1377, with a chessboard of streets and courtyard houses inside a wall circuit of 3.8 km. Landmarks include the Drum Tower, the tallest building in the old city, the Ming–Qing prefectural yamen in the south-west corner and the Yuhuang Pavilion on the north wall, while temples and halls within the walls, such as the Nan'an Temple pagoda, are nationally listed in their own right. Only part of the wall survives, mainly on the north and north-west sides, but the old town is still lived in, with street stalls selling local snacks and a tradition of Yuxian paper-cutting.
description: 蔚州城墙，位于中国河北省张家口市蔚县，为原蔚州城墙。始建于北周，今存城墙为明代所建，现存长度1600米。2013年，蔚州古城墙列入全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the centre of Yuxian town, about 105 km south-south-west of Zhangjiakou railway station, reached by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 宝灵山
summaryEn: A religious and forest-leisure scenic area at the foot of Longhu Mountain in Qinyuan County, built since 2002 by a local coal and coke group. It has more than 40 temple buildings in traditional style, including Lingtong Chan Temple, the Daoist Baotong Temple and Tianqi Temple; the Tianqi Temple customs and the Lingtong Temple fair are listed as provincial intangible heritage. It suits visitors interested in newly built Buddhist, Daoist and Confucian complexes and the temple fairs held here.
description: 宝灵山风景区，又称通洲宝灵山风景区，位于中华人民共和国山西省长治市沁源县聪子峪乡新店上村龙虎山麓灵通山森林公园内的一处综合旅游景区，隶属于山西通洲煤焦集团。该景区占地面积2.7平方公里，2024年被评为国家AAAA级旅游景区。
accessEn: It lies on the wooded slopes between Mianshang village in Guodao town and Xindianshang village in Congziyu township, about 30 km north-north-west of Qinyuan county town. It was closed to visitors in late May 2026, with staff citing a collapse inside the grounds, so check that it has reopened before planning.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 八路军总司令部旧址
summaryEn: Three former headquarters of the Eighth Route Army in the Taihang Mountains: Beicun in Lucheng District, used from October 1938 to July 1939, and Zhuanbi and Wangjiayu in Wuxiang, used between 1939 and 1942. Each is a set of farmhouse or temple courtyards kept as the commanders' offices and residences, with displays of photographs and relics. Zhuanbi, a temple group and farmhouse courtyard, is where the Hundred Regiments Offensive of 1940 was directed.
description: 八路军总司令部旧址，是中国第一批全国重点文物保护单位的革命遗址及革命纪念建筑物之一，由三处分别位于山西省长治市潞城区北村、武乡县砖壁村和王家峪村的建筑物构成，它们分别是四合院和古寺庙群。旧址在中国抗日战争时一度被用作国民革命军第八路军总司令部，中国共产党军事将领朱德、彭德怀和左权均曾入住其中，并在此发动各种抗日运动、以及指挥战役，建立根据地。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Zhuanbi is a mountain village in Panlong town about 35 km east of Wuxiang; Wangjiayu is in the same hills, and Beicun is in Lucheng District of Changzhi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黄崖洞
summaryEn: A gorge in the northern Taihang Mountains where the Eighth Route Army built an arms factory in the early 1940s, which Changzhi Daily calls its earliest and largest; the name comes from a natural cave in the cliff, about 30 m above the valley floor, that was used for storing weapons. More than a hundred remains survive, including workshops, barracks, trenches and a martyrs' cemetery with a memorial tower for the defenders of the November 1941 battle, and a narrow gorge passage of about 500 m. It combines a revolutionary site with steep red-sandstone cliff scenery.
description: 黄崖洞兵工厂旧址位于中国山西省黎城县黄崖洞镇下赤峪村，是抗日战争期间八路军最大的武器弹药生产基地，曾被朱德誉为八路军的“掌上明珠”。2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。黄崖洞是以黄龙洞为中心的一片山区，面积约10平方千米。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It lies in Huangyadong town, about 35 km north of Licheng.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大同火山群
summaryEn: A field of more than 30 volcanic cones on the loess plateau in Yunzhou District, formed in the Quaternary period; the best known are Heishan, Jinshan, Langwoshan, Gelaoshan and Haotianshan. The national geological park covers 129.9 square kilometres, and the scenic area has a visitor service centre, a car park and wooden boardwalks. It suits travellers who want open, quiet scenery rather than monuments.
description: 大同火山群为中国境内一处第四纪火山群。该火山群分布于山西省大同市、云州区、阳高县境内，已知火山30多座。已建成中国国家地质公园和山西省级风景名胜区。
accessEn: The Langwoshan visitor centre and car park are about 30 km east of central Datong in Yunzhou District, and a wooden boardwalk climbs Langwoshan from there.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 郭峪古城
summaryEn: A walled Ming-era market village a short walk from Huangcheng Xiangfu, enclosed by a wall about 1.4 km round and 12 m high on average, begun in 1635, with cave-like chambers built into it. Inside are about forty Ming and Qing courtyard houses, the seven-storey Yu Tower, 33 m high, and a Tangdi temple with a nine-bay main hall.
description: 郭峪村位于中国山西省阳城县北留镇，2008年被列为第四批中国历史文化名村。郭峪村古建筑群于2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。郭峪村与同为中国历史文化名村的皇城村仅一河之隔，而与上庄村仅一山之隔，直线距离约2千米。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Guoyu village, Beiliu town, about 1 km south-west of Huangcheng Xiangfu and about 14 km east-north-east of Yangcheng.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 柳氏民居
summaryEn: A hillside village of courtyard houses where the Liu clan, who trace their descent to the Tang writer Liu Zongyuan, have lived for centuries. Most of the surviving buildings are Qing, built on the clan's salt and pawnbroking wealth, and the best preserved, Sima Di, is a two-courtyard house with a two-storey main hall and two Ming stone memorial archways in its yard. The village is a national historic and cultural village.
description: 柳氏民居位于山西晋城。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、传统民居。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xiwenxing village, Tuwo township, about 14 km south of Qinshui, the county seat.

name: 珏山
summaryEn: A steep twin-peaked hill on the south bank of the Dan River, climbed by a long flight of stone steps through successive gates to temple halls near the summit, built from the Song dynasty onwards. The scenic area also runs a river sports centre on the Dan with speedboats, bamboo rafts and similar rides. Qinglian Temple, with Tang-dynasty clay figures, lies at the foot of the mountain and is usually visited with it.
description: 珏山，又名“角”山，位于山西省晋城市泽州县境内的丹河南岸。距晋城市市区13千米，古有“晋魏河山第一奇”之美称，珏山吐月为晋城四大名胜之一。
accessEn: On the south bank of the Dan River, about 15 km east of central Jincheng.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 王莽岭
summaryEn: Wangmangling is a cliff-edged part of the southern Taihang range on the Shanxi–Henan border, and the scenic area covers four zones, Wangmangling, Xiyagou, Kunshan and Liuxiu City, falling from about 1,700 m to about 300 m. Paths and viewing points overlook precipices, gorges and caves, and the area is known for sunrise and sea-of-cloud views and, in winter, rime on the trees.
description: 王莽岭，又名龟鸵山，位于中华人民共和国山西省晋城市陵川县与河南省辉县市之间，现为国家4A级旅游景区及国家级地质公园。相传西汉末年时期支持大司马王莽称帝的人曾宣称在此发现一龙脉神龛，发现有一座相貌如王莽的帝王像，另有四字“王莽登基”。
accessEn: The scenic area is in Gujiao township, about 30 km east of Lingchuan, and one of Jincheng's tourist bus routes runs to Wangmangling.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 湘峪古堡
summaryEn: A fortified village on a hillside above a stream, built for the Sun family, three brothers who held senior posts under the late Ming, and completed in 1634. The outer wall, about 760 m round and 5 to 25 m high, has tiers of vaulted soldiers' caves that earned it the name "honeycomb city", and inside are three gates, stone-paved lanes of Ming and Qing courtyard houses and a five-storey watchtower about 25 m high. It belongs to the group of castle villages in the Qin River valley for which Jincheng is known.
description: 湘峪村位于中国山西省沁水县郑村镇下辖的一个村。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xiangyu village, Zhengcun town, in the south-east of Qinshui County, about 6 km north of Huangcheng Xiangfu and about 18 km north-east of Yangcheng.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 炎帝陵
summaryEn: The Yandi Mausoleum at Zhuangli village is one of four places in China that hold a tomb of Yandi, the legendary Emperor Yan or Shennong, remembered as the teacher of farming and herbal medicine. A large temple compound stands around the tomb mound, beside the older Wugu Temple, and the site has a stele dated 1611 that is the earliest known marker of the tomb. Memorial ceremonies are held here, including a yearly folk-culture exchange event that brings visitors from Taiwan.
description: 炎帝传说本非信史，其确切的葬地难以考证，现在中国境内有多处炎帝陵，分别是炎陵炎帝陵、宝鸡炎帝陵、高平炎帝陵、商丘朱襄陵。自宋代起，炎陵县炎帝陵成为历代中央政府认定的炎帝陵，见诸《宋会要辑稿》、《明会要》和《钦定大清会典》，并由皇帝委派官员致祭。
accessEn: It is in Shennong town, about 13 km north-east of Gaoping, and one of Gaoping's tourist bus routes runs to the mausoleum.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 羊头山
summaryEn: Yangtou Mountain rises to about 1,300 m where Gaoping meets Changzhi, and local tradition places Yandi's first sowing of grain here; the scenic area marks the sites of his legendary town, spring, well and field plot, with a lake and a ceremonial square at the foot. Halfway up the southern flank are the Yangtoushan Grottoes, a national heritage site and the largest group of Buddhist carving in Jincheng, with dozens of small caves and niches cut into sandstone blocks from the Northern Wei to the Tang dynasty. Stone stupas and a Northern Wei carved stone with a sheep-shaped base stand on the ridge above.
description: 羊头山石窟，原名定国寺，位于中国山西省高平市神农镇李家庄羊头山，是一处以北魏时期佛教石窟造像为主体，历经北齐、隋、唐等时期续凿形成的石窟群。石窟分布于羊头山山腰至山顶一带，除洞窟外，还保存有摩崖佛龛、造像碑、造像塔及石塔等遗迹，是晋东南地区较重要的北朝佛教石刻遗存之一。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: The scenic area is in Shennong town, about 14 km north of Gaoping, and one of Gaoping's tourist bus routes serves it.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 麻田八路军总部纪念馆
summaryEn: From 1941 to 1945 the Eighth Route Army's front headquarters and the Communist Party's Northern Bureau were based at Matian, a village in the Taihang mountains near the Hebei border. The old compound has courtyard houses with their plain period furnishings kept as they were, including the former residences of Deng Xiaoping and Zuo Quan, and a memorial hall nearby holds more than 6,000 historical items. Zuoquan county was renamed in 1942 after General Zuo Quan, the army's deputy chief of staff, who was killed in action near Matian that year.
description: 八路军前方总部旧址，位于山西左权县麻田镇麻田村，为八路军阻击侵华日军的前方总部。该旧址现由三部分组成：总部大院、邓小平旧居、左权旧居，为四合院落。1941年7月至1945年8月，八路军129师、太行区党委、北方局党校、《新华日报》社等机关在此驻扎。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Matian town in the Qingzhang River valley, about 34 km south-south-east of Zuoquan, near the Hebei border.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 榆次老城
summaryEn: A large quarter built from around 2000 on the site of the old Yuci county town and laid out as old-style streets. Most of the original houses were cleared for it, and a few listed buildings were kept, among them the City God Temple, the Qingxu Pavilion and the Confucian temple. It has served as a location for dozens of television dramas, and suits a short stop for anyone passing through Yuci.
description: 榆次老城本是榆次县的县城，今多用来指2000年前后开始，在榆次县城城址上新开发的一处旅游景点。当时在任的地方官员，将原县城内除几处重点文物保护单位之外的民居、街巷等全部拆除，建起规模庞大的仿古街，现除旅游外，主要用于影视剧拍摄。
accessEn: In central Yuci, the main urban district of Jinzhong, about 2 km south of the centre of Jinzhong.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 张壁古堡
summaryEn: A walled fortress village with gullies on three sides and a convex-shaped wall about 374 m by 244 m, entered through a barbican at its north gate. Inside, a stone-paved main street runs past temples to Guandi, Zhenwu and Erlang, a Yuan-dynasty opera stage and dozens of Ming and Qing houses, with a network of Sui and Tang tunnels beneath. The village was laid out on astrological lines and stages seasonal events, including light shows on its south gate.
description: 张壁古堡，又称张壁村，位于中国山西省介休市龙凤镇张壁村，2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。张壁古堡始建年代不详，传说为隋朝刘武周所建。古堡三面临沟，一面依塬，地势险要。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Zhangbi village, Longfeng town, about 9 km south-east of Jiexiu.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 太岳行署旧址
summaryEn: The former seat of the Taiyue Administrative Office, a regional wartime government for the Taiyue mountains of southern Shanxi, in Xiaoli village, Liangma town; the listed buildings date from 1942–44. The State Council listed it as a national monument in 2019 in the category of modern historic sites and representative buildings, and the scenic area around it covers about 1.8 sq km across the villages of Ducun, Xiaoli and Sangqu. Anze keeps 18 sites from the Taiyue base area, of which this is one.
description: 小李村太岳行署旧址位于中国山西省临汾市安泽县杜村乡小李村，是一处全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It is in Xiaoli village, about 25 km east of Anze county town in the hills of eastern Linfen.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 霍州署
summaryEn: The surviving prefectural office of Huozhou, on East Street in the old centre of Huozhou city, now a museum. Most of the compound was destroyed at the end of the Yuan dynasty and only the main hall survived; the ceremonial gate and an admonition-stone pavilion were rebuilt in the Ming and Qing, and the gate tower is a modern reconstruction. The hall is three bays wide and eight rafters deep under a single-eave overhanging gable roof.
description: 霍州州署位于中国山西省霍州市城内东大街，其大堂于1996年被列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。霍州州署在元末大部分被毁，仅大堂幸存，明清重建了仪门、戒石亭等建筑，谯楼为现代复建。大堂面阔三间，进深八椽，单檐悬山顶，梁架为六椽栿对乳栿通檐用三柱。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It is on East Street in the centre of Huozhou city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 晋国博物馆
summaryEn: A site museum on the Qucun–Tianma site, where archaeologists found the early capital and royal cemetery of the Western Zhou state of Jin, in use between about 1000 and 800 BC. The excavations uncovered 19 tombs of Jin marquises and their consorts, with chariot-and-horse pits, sacrificial pits and many bronzes and jades. The museum opened in 2014 on the cemetery site, with galleries on Jin history, the excavation and the marquises' tombs.
description: 晋国博物馆位于山西临汾。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Beizhao village, Qucun town, about 14 km north-east of Quwo. Its permanent display was taken down in mid-2025 for a refit, with a new exhibition announced for 2026, so check that it is open before going.

name: 彭真故居纪念馆
summaryEn: The memorial hall at the birthplace of Peng Zhen (1902-1997), a Communist Party leader who held senior posts in the party and the state, in Dieshang village, now part of Houma. Government reports describe exhibition halls with more than 300 historical photographs and over a hundred objects on his life, and a bronze statue of him stands at the memorial. The house is a provincial-level monument (listed in 2004).
description: 彭真故居，位于山西省临汾市侯马市侯马乡垤上村，是中华人民共和国山西省文物保护单位之一。
accessEn: It is in Dieshang village on the south side of Houma, about 2.5 km south-west of central Houma.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 尧帝陵
summaryEn: The tomb of Yao, one of the legendary Five Emperors, stands in the hills east of Linfen on the north bank of the Lao River. The earth mound is the ancient core, with Ming and Qing buildings and a number of stone tablets, and repairs are recorded from the Tang dynasty onwards. Since 2007 the city has restored the site and added new ceremonial buildings, among them the Guozu (State Ancestor) Hall, huabiao pillars and a glazed screen wall.
description: 尧帝陵位于山西临汾。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It is near Yuebi and Taiping villages in Dayang town, about 25 km east of central Linfen.

name: 尧庙
summaryEn: A temple complex to the legendary emperor Yao on the southern edge of Linfen, moved to its present site on the east bank of the Fen River in 658 and restored after the earthquakes of 1303 and 1695. Its main hall, Guangyun Hall, was rebuilt in 1999 after an arson fire the year before, and the complex also has the three-storey Wufeng Tower, about 19 m high, and four ancient cypresses in the courtyard of the main hall. The scenic area also takes in Huamen, a plaza and park to the west.
description: 尧庙，位于山西省临汾市尧都区南郊尧庙镇尧庙村，是中华人民共和国山西省文物保护单位之一。
accessEn: It is in Yaomiao village on the south side of Linfen, about 4 km south-west of the city centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 杏花村汾酒文化景区
summaryEn: A liquor-heritage visitor area built around the Fenjiu distillery in Xinghuacun town, the home of Fenjiu, a light-aroma Chinese grain spirit. The sights include the Fenjiu Museum, a workshop rebuilt in Ming–Qing style, the aged-liquor cellars and the distillery gardens. It also includes the Old Workshop, a courtyard complex with six surviving late-Qing buildings and an old well, which is a national monument and where liquor is still made by traditional methods.
description: 杏花村汾酒作坊位于中国山西省汾阳市杏花村镇东堡村卢家街西端，是历史上汾酒的重要生产作坊，2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It is at Xinghuacun town, about 13 km north-east of Fenyang; the Fenyang government gives about an hour's drive from Taiyuan and half an hour from Pingyao.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 卦山天宁寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple complex on Gua Mountain, 3 km from Jiaocheng, which the county government dates to 627 and describes as a major Huayan temple of the Tang dynasty. The Stone Buddha Hall was founded in the early Tang, and the Ming and Qing periods added a Holy Mother temple, a shrine hall, a Wenchang palace and an academy. The hill is also known for its ancient cypresses, which grow out of the cliff faces.
description: 卦山天宁寺位于中国山西省交城县附近，始建于唐代贞观六年，寺庙依山势而起，别具一格，寺内明清时期建筑居多。卦山天宁寺相传为中国佛教华严宗发源地。赵朴初曾于1977年初游卦山天宁寺时写下了“黛色参天多古柏，崇楼峻阁备庄严”的赞美之句。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It is about 3 km north-west of Jiaocheng county town, which can be reached from Taiyuan along the Qingyin expressway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 晋绥边区革命纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial museum at Caijiaya village in Xing county, set in the compound that was the seat of the Jinsui Border Region government and military headquarters during the war against Japan and the civil war. Displays cover the border region's history, and the preserved buildings include the residences used by Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai, Ren Bishi and He Long, the hall of the 1948 Jinsui cadres' conference and the Six Willows Pavilion. Mao, Zhou and Ren stopped at Caijiaya in March 1948, and Mao addressed the conference there.
description: 晋绥边区政府及军区司令部旧址，后改为晋绥边区革命纪念馆，位于中国山西省兴县蔡家崖村，为抗日战争、第二次国共内战时期晋绥边区中共领导机关旧址。旧址原为晋绥牛友兰宅院，抗日战争时期捐给当地政府，其东西为两个独立院落，东院为四合院，正南为普通瓦房。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It is at Caijiaya village, about 8 km west of Xing county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 孝义三皇庙
summaryEn: A temple to the Three Sovereigns of Chinese legend, Fuxi, Shennong and the Yellow Emperor, who are honoured together in one hall in Jiajiazhuang village on the western edge of Xiaoyi. The Sanhuang Hall keeps its Yuan-dynasty structure and the other surviving buildings are Qing, including a side hall and an opera stage; the temple was repaired in 2005. It stands on the village's old merchants' road, which is about 1,200 m long and once had 13 large inns for carts and horses.
description: 孝义三皇庙是一座明、清古建筑，位于山西省吕梁市孝义市白壁关镇贾家庄村，是中华人民共和国山西省文物保护单位之一。2004年6月10日，三皇庙公布为第四批山西省文物保护单位，。2013年3月5日，孝义三皇庙公布为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It is in Jiajiazhuang village, about 3 km west of the centre of Xiaoyi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 玄中寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple in the Shibi valley that Chinese and Japanese Buddhists regard as the ancestral temple of the Pure Land school, founded in 472 in the Northern Wei period according to the Lüliang government. The monks Tanluan, Daochuo and Shandao taught here, and Japanese Pure Land delegations have come to pay their respects since the 1950s. The main halls are Ming and later, including the Hall of the Heavenly Kings rebuilt in 1605, and a Song-dynasty brick pagoda, the Qiurong Pagoda, stands on a hilltop to the south-east.
description: 玄中寺，位于山西省交城县西北的石壁山中，又称“石壁寺”、“永宁寺”，是中国佛教净土宗祖庭。现主持为悟证法师。2013年，玄中寺成为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It is in a mountain valley about 7 km west of Jiaocheng county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 义居寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple at Zaogeda village in Sanjiao town, on a hillside beside a river, which was formerly called the Fotang Temple and served as a branch of the Tiangong Temple; the county government gives its area as 56,000 sq m. The axis runs from a Ming gate and front hall to a Yuan-dynasty main hall and a Qing sutra library, with a cave shrine, the Wanfo Cave, at the rear. The county counts it with Qikou as one of its two 4A scenic areas.
description: 义居寺位于中国山西省临县三交镇枣疙瘩村，2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。义居寺始建于宋代，旧称佛堂寺，原为天宫寺下院。寺坐西朝东，中轴线上依次为山门、前殿、正殿、藏经楼、万佛洞，两侧为偏殿、厢房，其中石窟为唐代所凿，正殿为元代遗构，山门和前殿为明代建筑，藏经楼为清代建筑。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It is at Zaogeda village in Sanjiao town, about 25 km south of Linxian county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 宝源老醋坊
summaryEn: A vinegar workshop and museum rebuilt in 2006 by a local vinegar company in Qingxu, the county titled China's vinegar capital. Its halls reproduce the Ming and Qing way of making vinegar with period tools and costume, alongside exhibits on farming and vinegar culture, and visitors can taste vinegars of different ages. It suits visitors interested in Shanxi's food traditions.
description: 宝源老醋坊，位于山西省清徐县杨房村，由山西水塔老陈醋股份有限公司建立，是山西的一个老字号。
accessEn: In Qingxu County, about 11 km south of Qingxu town and about 45 km south of central Taiyuan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 高君宇故居纪念馆
summaryEn: The family home of Gao Junyu, an early Communist Party leader who founded the party and youth organisations in Shanxi, in Fenglingdi village, Loufan County. The residence is the middle courtyard of the old Gao family compound, a Qing-dynasty brick cave-dwelling house restored and opened in 1996, where he lived and studied until he was 16. A memorial hall beside it covers his career and the history of Loufan as a revolutionary base area.
description: 高君宇故居，位于山西省太原市娄烦县静游镇峰岭底村，为中国共产党早期领导人之一的高君宇的故居。1996年1月12日列为中华人民共和国第三批山西省文物保护单位。2019年10月16日，由中华人民共和国国务院公布为第八批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Fenglingdi village, Jingyou town, about 12 km north-east of Loufan and about 70 km north-west of Taiyuan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 芦芽山
summaryEn: The highest peak of the Guancen range in Ningwu County, rising above 2,700 m and named for its stacked peaks that resemble reed shoots. The scenic area protects larch and spruce forest and is a main refuge of the brown eared pheasant, a nationally protected bird, and it counts among the four national forest parks that state media list for Xinzhou. Other sights in the area include a cliff-side walkway, lakes, waterfalls and the Malun grassland, with the ice cave and the Fen River source as separate stops.
description: 芦芽山风景名胜区是一处位于中国山西省忻州市宁武县东寨镇的景区。芦芽山是管涔山的主峰，因其山峰层层堆叠如同芦芽而得名。
accessEn: The resort's visitor centre is about 25 km south-west of Ningwu, the county seat, and the summit lies about 17 km further south-west.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 藏山祠
summaryEn: A group of temple halls and pavilions set in a mountain gorge north of Yu County, built around the legend of the Zhao Orphan, in which a child of the Zhao family of the ancient Jin state is hidden in these hills; the legend is listed as national intangible cultural heritage. The scenic area includes the Cave of the Hidden Orphan, the Orphan-rearing Garden, the Lotus Temple and a Loyalty Pavilion that looks over the gorge, and the temple buildings are Ming and Qing in date. Spring peach blossom and autumn leaves are the main seasons for walking the paths.
description: 藏山祠，位于山西省阳泉市盂县长池镇藏山村东，是中华人民共和国全国重点文物保护单位之一。1996年1月12日，公布为山西省文物保护单位，2013年5月公布为全国重点文物保护单位，是一座古建筑及历史纪念建筑物。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 16 km north of Yu County town, in a gorge in the Taihang Mountains.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 万荣东岳庙·飞云楼
summaryEn: Dongyue Temple stands in the middle of Wanrong's county town, and its landmark is the Feiyun Tower at the front: a 23 m timber tower of three visible storeys under yellow, green and blue glazed-tile roofs, held up by four tall pillars that run its full height. The temple was rebuilt in 1291–1297 under the Yuan and repaired repeatedly in the Ming and Qing; behind the tower the main axis runs through the Wu gate, an offering hall, and halls for the Dongyue emperor and the king of hell. The tower is also a real-world reference for a location in the video game Black Myth: Wukong.
description: 万荣东岳庙位于中国山西省万荣县县城中心，解店镇西大街8号，万荣县宾馆北侧。1988年被列为第三批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It is in the middle of Wanrong's county town, which is about 45 km north of central Yuncheng.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 绛州署·绛州大堂
summaryEn: Xinjiang town was the seat of Jiangzhou prefecture, and its government offices stood on a high bluff in the west of the old town; only the main hall and a second hall survive. The main hall was rebuilt under the Yuan dynasty and is seven bays wide, more than the usual five for a prefectural office, with a hip-gable roof and fewer interior columns than normal. A Northern Song stele of 1101 set into its north wall lists seven rules for officials, and the town's bell, drum and music towers stand close by on the same rise as part of the Jiangzhou Shu scenic area.
description: 绛州大堂位于中国山西省运城市新绛县城内西部的高岗之上，七星坡顶端，绛州鼓楼及城隍庙以西，是一处全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It stands on a rise in the west of Xinjiang, the county seat, inside the Jiangzhou Shu scenic area, about 85 km by road north-north-east of central Yuncheng.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 闫景李家大院
summaryEn: Begun in the Daoguang reign (1821–1850) by the Li family, who moved from farming and study into trade, this courtyard compound in Yanjing village is often grouped with the Qiao and Wang family compounds as one of Shanxi's three great merchant houses. Eleven of its original twenty courtyards survive, with carved brick, stone and wood, tall Huizhou-style fire walls and a few courtyards with Gothic-style details linked to a family member who studied in England. Look for the screen wall carved with 365 different forms of the character for 'good' and for the family ancestral hall.
description: 李家大院，位于山西省运城市万荣县南部边缘毗邻临猗县的高村镇阎景村，是中华人民共和国全国重点文物保护单位之一。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It stands in Yanjing village on the southern edge of Wanrong County, about 17 km south-west of Wanrong and about 40 km north-west of central Yuncheng, close to the Linyi county border.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 舜帝陵庙
summaryEn: This is the tomb and temple of Emperor Shun, a legendary ruler of ancient China, on the Mingtiao ridge near Xiquma village in Beixiang town. The precinct has an outer city, a tomb garden with a brick-built mound about 3 m high and a temple compound with a stage, offering hall and main hall; the sleeping hall was rebuilt on its original site, and the national listing dates the temple buildings to the Yuan to Qing periods. Shundi Park and the Yanhu District Museum lie next to it and make up the wider scenic area.
description: 舜帝陵庙或称舜陵、鸣条舜陵、舜帝陵、运城舜帝陵，位于中国山西省运城市盐湖区北相镇西曲马村南鸣条岗，是舜帝的陵和庙。2006年5月，以舜帝陵庙之名列入第六批全国重点文物保护单位。由盐湖区文物局舜帝陵庙文管所直接负责管理。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It is in Beixiang town, about 16 km by road north-west of central Yuncheng.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 司马温公祠·司马光墓
summaryEn: This is the family burial ground of Sima Guang (1019–1086), the Northern Song chief minister and historian who compiled the Zizhi Tongjian, on the Mingtiao ridge north-west of Xiaxian, with a shrine complex built around it. It has a stele hall holding his broken spirit-way stele, an ancestral shrine whose present form dates from 1762, the Yuqing Chan Temple (founded in 1065 as the tombs' incense temple, with painted clay figures in its hall) and the Sushui Academy. A bronze statue of Sima Guang stands in the square outside.
description: 司马光墓位于中国山西省夏县城北15公里鸣条冈，是北宋政治家、史学家司马光的墓地，1988年被列为第三批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It is in Shuitou town, about 11 km north-west of Xiaxian and about 20 km north-east of central Yuncheng.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 五老峰
summaryEn: Wulao Peak is a mountain scenic area in the southern Zhongtiao Mountains, once known as Donghua Mountain and counted among the famous Taoist mountains of northern China. The forestry ministry approved a national forest park here in 1992 covering about 104 sq km. Visitors can climb through the woods or take the cable car, and the area has a glass-floored walkway on a cliff and a forest slide.
description: 五老峰国家森林公园于1992年由国家林业部批准建立，总面积10400公顷。五老峰国家森林公园位于山西省永济市东南方向20公里的中条山上，距运城市40公里，距太原市468公里，东临塔儿园，西靠雪花山，北依虞乡镇，南接芮城县，是中条山脉南端的一部分。
accessEn: The cable-car station and main entrance are in the Zhongtiao Mountains about 14 km east of Yongji and about 55 km by road south-west of central Yuncheng.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0
imageCredit: Earth Science and Remote Sensing Unit , Lyndon B. Johnson Space Center

name: 策克口岸国际文化旅游区
summaryEn: Ceke is a road and rail land port of entry (kou'an) in the Gobi of Ejin Banner, used mainly for coal imports. Its international cultural tourism area is promoted by the Ejin Banner authorities as a place to see the port's national gate and to learn about the banner's culture and history. It suits visitors curious about how a working land port looks.
description: 策克口岸是中华人民共和国内蒙古自治区的一个陆路边境口岸，位于阿拉善盟额济纳旗策克镇境内，并与蒙古国南戈壁省的西伯库伦口岸相接。该口岸在1992年以二类口岸形式对蒙开放，其后于2005年获升格为一类口岸，并在2009年实行常年通关。
accessEn: About 71 km north-north-east of Dalaihubu, the Ejin Banner seat (about 88 km by road).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 定远营古城
summaryEn: Dingyuanying, also called Wohu Cheng, is a walled Qing-dynasty garrison town in the old centre of Bayanhot, founded in 1730 and handed to the Alxa Mongol prince as his seat the following year. Its surviving buildings include the prince's mansion, Yanfu Temple (the princes' family temple, begun in 1731), traditional houses and remains of the wall and gates, and the site was renovated in 2017. It suits visitors interested in Qing frontier history and Mongol princely rule.
description: 定远营，又称卧虎城，是清代兴建的城池。位于内蒙古自治区阿拉善盟阿拉善左旗巴彦浩特镇，2006年5月25日，公布为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。据《宁夏纪要》记载，定远营“擅园林之胜，四周白墙皑然，故又有‘沙漠中的白宫’之称”。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Wangfu Subdistrict, the old centre of Bayanhot, the seat of Alxa League, which has good road links to Yinchuan in neighbouring Ningxia; the prince's mansion museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 福因寺
summaryEn: Fuyin Temple, known as Beisi (North Temple), is a Gelug-school Tibetan Buddhist monastery in a mountain valley of the Helan range, founded in 1804 and named by the Jiaqing Emperor in 1806. About fifteen temples and more than a hundred buildings make up the complex, with a white stupa some 10 metres tall beside the main hall. After Nansi it is the largest Tibetan Buddhist monastery in Alxa.
description: 福因寺，藏语称“格都布林”、“米潘木却林”，蒙古语称“准黑惕”，俗称北寺，位于内蒙古自治区阿拉善盟阿拉善左旗巴彦浩特镇，是一座藏传佛教格鲁派寺院。该寺是阿拉善盟仅次于南寺的又一座大庙。
accessEn: About 23 km north-east of Bayanhot, the Alxa League seat, in the Helan Mountains.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 广宗寺
summaryEn: Guangzong Temple, known as Nansi (South Temple), is a Gelug-school Tibetan Buddhist monastery in a pine-wooded valley on the western side of the Helan Mountains, built in the 1750s–1760s and named by the Qianlong Emperor in 1760. At its height it had nearly 2,900 rooms and more than 1,500 monks, earning the nickname 'little Ta'er Temple'. Visitors see the archway gate, the halls and stupas, and painted Buddha figures carved into the cliff face at the valley mouth.
description: 广宗寺位于内蒙古阿拉善。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 22 km south-south-east of Bayanhot, the Alxa League seat, and about 90 km by road from Yinchuan in neighbouring Ningxia.

name: 居延海
summaryEn: Juyan Lake is the end of the Heihe, or Ejin, River, which runs more than 800 km through Qinghai, Gansu and Inner Mongolia before filling two hollows in the Gobi to form an east and a west lake, together called Juyan Hai. The scenic area on the shore has reed beds, waterbirds and Gobi scenery, with horses, cattle and camels grazing nearby. It suits birdwatchers and photographers.
description: 居延海位于内蒙古阿拉善。游览特色包括湖泊、观鸟。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 42 km north-north-east of Dalaihubu, the Ejin Banner seat.

name: 三盛公水利风景区
summaryEn: Sanshenggong is a large barrage on the Yellow River, built between 1959 and 1961, that feeds the Hetao irrigation district. The scenic area covers the barrage and about 55 km of river channel, with sandbars and more than 30,000 mu of wetland, and it straddles Dengkou County in Bayannur, Hanggin Banner in Ordos and Alxa Left Banner. A lake park lies beside the east end of the barrage, on the Hanggin Banner bank.
description: 三盛公水利枢纽位于内蒙古巴彦淖尔市磴口县城东南2公里的黄河干流上。使河套平原成为亚洲最大的自流式灌溉区，兼有防洪、水利发电、工业用水及交通等功能。黄河三盛公水利风景区为国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: It is on the Yellow River about 3 km south-east of Bayan Gol, the Dengkou County seat, and about 56 km south-south-west of Linhe, the Bayannur city seat.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 赤峰博物馆
summaryEn: Chifeng's main history museum stands on the bank of the Xibo River in the city's new district; its present building opened in 2010, and it is now part of the Chifeng Museum Institute. Four permanent exhibitions cover the prehistoric Hongshan culture, Bronze Age finds from the Xiajiadian cultures, the Liao dynasty, and the Yuan to Qing periods. The collection holds more than 80,000 items, including 133 first-class national relics.
description: 赤峰市博物馆即赤峰博物馆，前身为成立于1958年的昭乌达盟博物馆筹备处，是位于中华人民共和国内蒙古自治区赤峰市的一家历史类博物馆，位于锡伯河畔、赤峰市新城区富河街与锦山路交汇处，为国家二级博物馆。1985年，赤峰市博物馆动工兴建，于1987年7月1日开馆。
accessEn: In Songshan District, the new part of Chifeng, beside the Xibo River; the museum is closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 达里湖
summaryEn: A saline lake without an outlet on the Hexigten Banner steppe, dammed by lava flows, with the Hunshandak sand dunes on its southern side and a group of extinct volcanoes to the north-west. Swans, geese, gulls and cranes use it in summer, and it forms part of the Hexigten Global Geopark. The lake freezes from about mid-November to early April.
description: 达里湖位于内蒙古赤峰。游览特色包括地质景观、湖泊、火山地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 72 km west of Jingpeng, the Hexigten Banner seat, on the northern shore of the lake.

name: 喀喇沁亲王府
summaryEn: The palace was the seat of the Harqin princes under the Qing dynasty, begun in 1679 and enlarged in 1783 to the standard of a prince's mansion. It covers about 40,000 square metres in three parallel axes and now houses the Harqin Banner Museum, whose collection is mostly Qing and Republican-period furniture, porcelain, Tibetan Buddhist objects and Mongol household items. Gungsangnorbu, the last prince and a reformer, was born here in 1872.
description: 喀喇沁亲王府及家庙位于中国内蒙古自治区赤峰市喀喇沁旗王爷府镇，是清代内蒙古卓索图盟喀喇沁右翼旗的王府、佛堂、文武庙和宗祠，2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位，现已辟为中国清代蒙古王府博物馆。喀喇沁亲王府始建于清康熙十八年，初按郡王府规格建造，乾隆四十八年按亲王府规格扩建。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Wangyefu town, about 19 km west-south-west of Jinshan, the Harqin Banner seat, and about 60 km south-west of Chifeng.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 察尔森水库
summaryEn: Chaersen Reservoir is a large reservoir on the Tao'er River, a tributary of the Nen, 1.7 km north of Chaersen town in Horqin Right Front Banner. Work began in 1973, stopped in 1980, restarted in 1987 and had its main works finished in 1990, for flood control and irrigation with some power generation, and the reservoir can hold about 1.25 billion cubic metres. It was named a national water-conservancy scenic area in 2005 and suits visitors who want open water an easy trip from Ulanhot.
description: 察尔森水库位于中国内蒙古自治区兴安盟科尔沁右翼前旗察尔森镇北1.7千米处，距乌兰浩特市32千米，是以防洪、灌溉为主，兼有发电功能的大型水库。始建于1973年，由吉林省投资。因兴安盟由吉林省复归内蒙古自治区，于1980年停建。
accessEn: Beside Chaersen town in Horqin Right Front Banner, about 28 km north-north-west of Ulanhot.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 成吉思汗庙
summaryEn: The Genghis Khan Temple stands on Hanshan hill in the north of Ulanhot and was built in the early 1940s, finishing in 1944, with donations from Mongol communities. The hall is shaped like the character shan (山) with a round dome over a square body, and houses a gilded bronze seated statue of Genghis Khan, 2.8 m high, with Yuan-period weapons and costume in the side halls and murals of his life on the walls. The temple was damaged in the Cultural Revolution, restored from 1983 and completed in its present form in 1987.
description: 成吉思汗庙是现存的唯一一座纪念成吉思汗的祠庙。座落于内蒙古自治区兴安盟乌兰浩特市罕山上。庙宇始建于1940年，于1944年竣工，坐北朝南，正面呈“山”字型。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Hanshan hill in the north of Ulanhot.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 乌兰夫故居
summaryEn: Ulanhu's former residence is a courtyard of about 20 rooms in Tabusai village, where Ulanhu, the founding chairman of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, was born and spent his youth. Most of the original buildings were burned in 1939 and the house was rebuilt in 1991; it now presents a farmyard with main rooms, side wings, a mill and a granary, together with exhibition rooms and a bust of Ulanhu in the yard. It is run together with the Ulanhu Memorial Hall in Hohhot.
description: 乌兰夫故居是中国共产党和中华人民共和国的蒙古族高级将领、官员乌兰夫青少年时代的故居，位于呼和浩特市西偏南60多公里的土默特左旗塔布赛乡塔布赛村。乌兰夫1906年在此出生，并在这里度过了童年和少年时光。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It is in Tabusai village, Tumed Left Banner, about 52 km south-west of Hohhot (about 66 km by road); closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 哈素海
summaryEn: Hasuhai is a shallow natural lake in Tumed Left Banner, with a water surface of roughly 30 sq km and a depth of about 2 m, ringed by reed beds that attract wild ducks, geese and other waterbirds. A road circles the lake, and the scenic area on its north shore adds lakeside pavilions and tourist facilities. It is a local spot for lakeside walks and birdwatching, listed by the region as the Chilechuan Grassland Cultural Tourism Area (Hasuhai).
description: 哈素海是一个位于中国内蒙古自治区土默特左旗的湖泊，面积约为27.7平方千米。
accessEn: It is on the north shore of Hasuhai in Tumed Left Banner, about 19 km south-west of Chasuqi, the banner seat, and about 68 km west-south-west of Hohhot.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 土城子考古遗址公园
summaryEn: Tuchengzi is regarded as the largest ancient city site on the north bank of the Yellow River's great bend, a walled city used from the Spring and Autumn period to the Yuan dynasty and identified with Shengle, the first capital of the Northern Wei. Its four walled sections, about 1.45 by 2.3 km in all, survive as earthen walls from 0.5 to 10 m high around farmland, which can be viewed from a lookout platform. The museum at the entrance shows the finds and has a reconstruction of the Eastern Han painted tomb found at Xindianzi, whose original chamber is not open to visitors.
description: 土城子考古遗址公园位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括博物馆、古城、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It is beside the G209 road in the Shengle economic zone, about 42 km south of Hohhot and about 10 km north-north-west of Chengguan, the Horinger county seat; the museum is closed on Mondays.

name: 乌兰夫纪念馆
summaryEn: The Ulanhu Memorial Hall stands in Ulanhu Park in Hohhot and opened in December 1992 as a museum on the life of Ulanhu, the first chairman of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region. The complex has a main exhibition hall, a memorial square, a statue platform, a flagpole, a stele pavilion and a memorial archway, with about 650 objects, photographs, documents and reconstructed scenes on display. His birthplace in Tabusai, about 43 km to the south-west, is run as part of the same museum.
description: 乌兰夫纪念馆，位于中华人民共和国内蒙古自治区呼和浩特市回民区新华西街乌兰夫公园内，为纪念中国共产党的蒙古族高级将领乌兰夫而建，于1992年12月23日落成开馆。纪念馆展现了“乌兰夫等老一辈无产阶级革命家，为争取民族解放、祖国统一，为中国革命和建设建立的不朽功勋。
accessEn: It is in Ulanhu Park on Xinhua West Street in Huimin District, beside Ulanhu Memorial Hall Metro station; closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 嘎仙洞
summaryEn: Gaxian Cave is a granite cave in the forests of the northern Greater Khingan range whose west wall carries a 201-character inscription cut in 443 on the orders of the Northern Wei emperor Tuoba Tao, recording a prayer at the Tuoba Xianbei ancestral home; archaeologists identified it in 1980. The Tuoba Xianbei History and Culture Park around it adds an altar, a museum and other buildings, together with an Oroqen village display. Scholars still debate whether the cave marks the Tuoba's true place of origin.
description: 嘎仙洞是大兴安岭北部的一个山洞，位于中国内蒙古自治区鄂伦春自治旗境内，是北魏太平真君四年太武帝拓跋焘认定的鲜卑拓跋部起源地。嘎仙洞位于一道花岗岩峭壁上，洞口西南向，离地25米。该洞南北长92米，东西宽27米。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 11 km north-west of Alihe, the seat of the Oroqen Autonomous Banner, in a wooded valley, with Jagdaqi airport about 51 km away by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大沙头
summaryEn: Dashatou is a desert sports and leisure resort in the Mu Us sandy land in Otog Front Banner. Its roughly 9,600 mu (about 6 sq km) include dunes up to 50 m high, and it runs desert sports, conferences and cultural events, among them a fireworks music festival and a desert car-and-motorbike challenge in July 2025. It is a commercial resort aimed at weekend visitors and event crowds.
description: 大沙头，是广州市一个已消失的江心小岛，位于越秀区白云路以东、二沙岛西北面，沙河涌、东濠涌两涌出口之间。大沙头原为珠江泥沙淤积形成的江心沙洲，因泥沙淤积和人工筑堤，已成为珠江北岸一部分，只余下“二沙头”。
accessEn: It is about 5 km south-west of Aolezhaoqi, the Otog Front Banner seat.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 萨拉乌苏遗址
summaryEn: Salawusu is a Palaeolithic site along a 39 km canyon of the Salawusu River in the Mu Us Sandy Land, where Émile Licent found fossils in 1922 and excavated with Pierre Teilhard de Chardin in 1923; a human tooth from the finds became the emblem of 'Hetao Man'. The fossils and stone tools belong to the Late Palaeolithic, and in June 2025 the site was listed among the national archaeological parks approved by the National Cultural Heritage Administration. Visitors see fossils and animal bones in the Salawusu Site Museum, enter a protective shelter over part of the site and walk the valley boardwalks, and the tourism area also takes in the Batuwan red-culture town, which presents local revolutionary history.
description: 萨拉乌苏遗址是位于中国北方内蒙古河套地区的一处旧石器时代晚期遗址，因在乌审旗的萨拉乌苏河沿岸而得名。现为全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Wudinghe town at the far southern end of Uxin Banner, about 100 km south-south-west of Galutu, the banner seat, and about 235 km south-south-west of Kangbashi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 准格尔召
summaryEn: Zhunge'er Zhao, formally Baotang Temple, is a Gelug-school Tibetan Buddhist monastery founded in 1623 and enlarged in the Kangxi and Qianlong reigns. The Ordos government describes it as the largest and best-preserved Gelug temple complex surviving in Ordos. The surrounding tourist area adds a lake with boating, a vegetarian dining hall and guest courtyards, and large religious gatherings are held here in the first, fourth and seventh lunar months.
description: 准格尔召，藏语名“葛丹石达力布大尔展林”，汉文名原为“秘宝寺”，后为“宝堂寺”，位于鄂尔多斯市准格尔旗西南部，是一座藏传佛教格鲁派寺院。该寺俗称沙日召、公额日格庙、贝子召，近代又称西召、准格尔召。是准格尔旗最大的召庙，也是鄂尔多斯最知名召庙之一。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It stands in Zhunge'er Zhao town, Jungar Banner, about 31 km east of Kangbashi, the Ordos city seat (about 35 km by road).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大青沟
summaryEn: Daqinggou is a national nature reserve in the middle of the Horqin sandy land, where two spring-fed valleys, Daqinggou and Xiaoqinggou, hold broadleaf forest and streams among the dunes. A boardwalk of more than 4 km follows the valley floor, and other sights include a small lake, a lotus lake and a museum of Horqin Mongol customs, geology and specimens. Approved in 1980 and made a reserve in 1988, it suits visitors who want shade, water and woodland in a sandy region.
description: 大青沟为中国国内一国家级自然保护区，位于内蒙古自治区通辽市科尔沁沙地中部。由大青沟与小青沟两条深谷组成。两条河流嵌在沙地当中，沟外环境恶劣，温差较大，常有风沙弥漫，但沟内气温适宜，植被茂密。
accessEn: In Horqin Left Rear Banner, about 20 km south-west of Ganqika, the banner seat, and about 90 km south of Tongliao; the area closes for the autumn and winter fire-prevention season (in 2025–26 from 27 October to about 25 April).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 哈民考古遗址公园
summaryEn: Hamin Archaeological Site Park protects a Neolithic village of semi-subterranean houses, dated to about 5,500 to 5,000 years ago, found in the Horqin sandy ground in 2010 after looters disturbed it. A protective hall keeps part of the excavated house floors in place, and the museum beside it, reopened in July 2024 after a refit with AR displays, shows 188 pottery, stone, jade, bone and shell pieces, while a reconstructed settlement shows how the villagers lived. It suits visitors interested in prehistoric China and can be seen in half a day from Tongliao.
description: 哈民考古遗址公园位于内蒙古通辽。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Horqin Left Middle Banner, about 41 km north of Tongliao, with Shebotu the nearest town.

name: 孟家段湿地
summaryEn: Mengjiaduan is a large irrigation reservoir on the right bank of the West Liao River in northern Naiman Banner, built in 1958, whose upper and lower basins together hold about 108 million cubic metres. It is a national wetland park, which passed the National Forestry and Grassland Administration's pilot-stage acceptance in 2020; several rare migratory birds roost there, and the visitor area includes a fishing village and an ecological education display. It suits birdwatchers and visitors who want a day beside open water away from the towns.
description: 孟家段水库，位于中华人民共和国内蒙古自治区奈曼旗北部，地处科尔沁沙地南缘，是西辽河右岸的一座大型旁侧水库。水库工程于1958年4月开工，1958年12月竣工。水库以灌溉为主，兼有防洪、养鱼、旅游等综合效益。
accessEn: In Naiman Banner, about 37 km south-west of Kailu and about 107 km west-south-west of Tongliao; the park closes in winter (in 2025–26 from 9 October to 1 May), while the fishing village, the ecological education area and the service area stay open.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 库伦三大寺
summaryEn: The Three Great Temples of Kulun are three Gelug-school Tibetan Buddhist temples side by side in Kulun town: Xingyuan Temple, begun in 1649, Xiangjiao Temple, built in 1670, and Fuyuan Temple, built in 1742. Under the Qing, Kulun was the only banner in Inner Mongolia ruled jointly by its lamas and the state, and Xingyuan, the largest of the three, was the seat of the head lama. About 59,000 square metres of historic buildings survive, and the group is a stop on a Tongliao heritage trail of Qing-period buildings that also takes in Naiman Prince's Mansion.
description: 库伦三大寺位于内蒙古通辽。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Kulun town, the seat of Hure Banner, about 106 km south-south-west of Tongliao.

name: 辉腾锡勒黄花沟草原
summaryEn: Huanghuagou is the main visitor area of the Huitengxile alpine meadow in Chahar Right Middle Banner, at an average height of about 2,100 m. The meadow covers about 600 square kilometres, with lakes among volcanic rock, and the visitor area has a 16 km route served by a small train, cable car, sightseeing buses and animal carts, plus boardwalks, glass walkways, a ger resort and a staged show based on an oboo offering and Naadam. It suits a summer day out from Jining or Hohhot.
description: 辉腾锡勒草原，蒙古高原草原-内蒙古草原-东北草原的一部分，位于中国内蒙古自治区乌兰察布市察哈尔右翼中旗的中南部。辉腾锡勒海拔1800余米，东西长100千米，属于高山草甸草原。距乌兰察布市政府所在地集宁区75公里，距自治区首府呼和浩特135公里。
accessEn: In Chahar Right Middle Banner, about 19 km south-south-west of Kebuer, the banner seat, and about 52 km west-north-west of Jining.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 岱海
summaryEn: Lake Dai (Daihai) is a saline inland lake in a fault basin in Liangcheng County, the third largest inland lake in Inner Mongolia. The resort area on its shore has a hot spring with a surface temperature of 38 degrees Celsius, boating and activity facilities, and hotel accommodation. It suits visitors who want a lakeside day or an overnight stay within reach of Jining and Hohhot.
description: 岱海位于内蒙古乌兰察布。游览特色包括温泉、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the north-west shore of the lake, close to Daihai, the Liangcheng county seat, and about 60 km south-west of Jining; check that it is open before going.

name: 贝子庙
summaryEn: Beizi Temple is a Gelug-school Tibetan Buddhist monastery in Chinese–Tibetan style, founded in 1743 below Erdun Aobao hill and given the name Chongshan Temple by the Qianlong emperor. Five of its original seven main halls survive, in four courtyards, and in the early 19th century the monastery housed about 1,500 lamas. Xilinhot was itself once called Beizimiao, after the temple.
description: 贝子庙，清廷赐名崇善寺，蒙古语俗名班智达葛根庙，位于内蒙古自治区锡林郭勒盟锡林浩特市额尔敦敖包山下，是一座汉藏式藏传佛教格鲁派寺院。锡林浩特的旧称“贝子庙”即得名于此。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Beizimiao Street in Baoligen subdistrict, in the north-west of Xilinhot.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 清凉山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area of about 30 sq km in the north-east of Xiuyan Manchu Autonomous County, with steep peaks, deep valleys, primary forest, streams, an underground lake and hot springs, according to the provincial tourism page. Its main peak, Maokuishan (also called Zuofoshan), reaches about 1,141 m, the highest point in Anshan prefecture. The page lists sightseeing, rock climbing and hill walking among the activities.
description: 清凉山位于辽宁鞍山。游览特色包括温泉、湖泊。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Qingliangshan town, about 44 km north-east of Xiuyan town.

name: 汤岗子温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring spa district about 12 km south of Anshan, used for bathing since the Russo-Japanese War of 1904-05 and developed as a spa by the South Manchuria Railway Company from 1920, and in that era counted as one of the 'three great hot springs of Manchuria'. The provincial tourism page describes a 64-hectare resort with a medical and rehabilitation zone, hotels, a swimming hall, a sports centre and garden sights such as a lotus lake and a ginkgo square. Today it works as a modern health and leisure resort.
description: 汤岗子温泉株式会社是设立于1920年3月的日本法人，位于满铁汤岗子附属地。该公司1944年时公称资本金为100万日元，实际拂入资本金25万日元，总资产68.56万日元。主要股东为南满洲铁道。
accessEn: In Tanggangzi, about 13 km south-south-west of central Anshan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 朝阳凤凰山
summaryEn: Phoenix Mountain is a wooded ridge on the eastern edge of Chaoyang that rises to about 660 m, was known as Dragon Mountain in earlier times, and carries a group of old temples and pagodas on its slopes. The provincial tourism department lists three pagodas and four temples (Yanshou, Tianqing, Yunjie and Huayan); the landmark among them is the Liao-period Yunjie Temple Pagoda, a square brick tower of thirteen eaves some 37 m high whose body and base are carved with Buddhas, bodhisattvas, arhats and flying apsaras. It makes a half-day outing from the city that combines a hill walk with the temples.
description: 朝阳凤凰山位于辽宁朝阳。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、古塔、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the eastern edge of Chaoyang, with the Yunjie Temple Pagoda about 6 km south-east of the North Tower in the city centre.

name: 白玉山
summaryEn: Baiyushan is a hill in the old town of Lüshun that looks down on the naval harbour and the town. On its summit stands Baiyushan Tower, which the Japanese military built in 1907–09 as a memorial to its dead of the Russo-Japanese War and which was renamed after 1945, together with a naval weapons museum. A path of 499 steps, two roads and a cable car lead up.
description: 白玉山是大连市旅顺口区城区内的一座山，位于市区中心地带，海拔130米。
accessEn: In the old town of Lüshun, about 36 km west-south-west of central Dalian in a straight line, with the hill rising above the harbour.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大连森林动物园
summaryEn: Dalian Forest Zoo covers 7.2 square kilometres of Baiyun Hill in the south of the city and opened in 1997, with a free-range area added in 2000. It keeps more than 200 species and over 2,000 animals, with a panda house, hippos, golden snub-nosed monkeys, Siberian tigers, flamingos and cranes among its exhibits. It suits families.
description: 大连森林动物园位于中华人民共和国辽宁省大连市西岗区迎春路60号白云山风景区，1997年开园。其前身是大连动物园。
accessEn: On Yingchun Road at Baiyun Hill in Xigang district, about 6 km south-south-west of Zhongshan Square (straight line).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大鹿岛
summaryEn: Dalu Island lies at the mouth of the Yalu, about 4 km long, with a fishing and tourism village and a bathing beach. The sea to the south is one of the sites of the 1894 naval battle of the Sino-Japanese War, and the island has a tomb and statue of the Chinese naval officer Deng Shichang, a British-style lighthouse, a sea-goddess temple, a stele to the Ming general Mao Wenlong and the ruins of a Danish church. Visitors come by boat and can combine the memorials with the beach.
description: 大鹿岛是中国辽宁省东港市孤山镇下辖的一个岛屿，地处黄海，位于鸭绿江入海口，面积约6平方公里。岛上曾有大角鹿栖息，所以得名大鹿岛。岛上有捕鱼业和旅游业。
accessEn: Reached by boat from the mainland coast of Donggang; the island lies about 4 nautical miles from the nearest land and about 20 km south-east of Gushan town in a straight line.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 赫图阿拉城
summaryEn: Hetu Ala was the first capital of Nurhaci, the Jurchen leader who began building the city in 1603 and proclaimed himself khan here in 1616, founding the Later Jin state, the forerunner of the Qing dynasty. The hill-and-river site keeps the line of its walls and several historic sites, among them the Khan's Great Yamen, the Khan's well, the Zhengbai Banner office, the former home of Nurhaci's father Taksi, a qipao museum and the Manchu Museum. The capital moved to Liaoyang in the early 1620s, and the old city was renamed Xingjing in 1634.
description: 赫图阿拉城，亦作赫图阿喇、黑秃阿喇、黑图阿拉等，“赫图阿拉”为满语“横岗”之意，是指女真族首领努尔哈赤在今辽宁省抚顺市新宾满族自治县永陵镇老城村境内建国称汗的第一个都城。1622年努尔哈赤迁都辽阳筑新城后，始称赫图阿拉为老城。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Yongling town, Xinbin County, about 6 km east of the Yongling tomb and about 80 km east-south-east of central Fushun in a straight line (about 104 km by road, roughly an hour and a quarter).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 阜新万人坑死难矿工纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial and museum on the site of the mass graves of miners who died in the Fuxin coalfield while it was run by Japanese-controlled companies, from the 1930s to 1945; official figures put the number buried in the city's graves at about 70,000. Halls built over excavated pits show remains in place, one for miners and one for labourers held at a nearby camp who took part in a 1942 uprising, and exhibitions cover the history of the mines; the site spans about 57 ha. The memorial opened in 1968, was repaired and reopened in 2015, and is a national heritage unit.
description: 阜新万人坑位于中华人民共和国辽宁省阜新市太平区，是中国抗日战争时期，日本控制阜新煤矿期间死难矿工的集体墓葬，有较大的万人坑四处，埋葬有死难矿工7万余人。阜新煤矿万人坑于1988年被列为辽宁省文物保护单位，2006年，阜新万人坑被中华人民共和国国务院公布为全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Sunjiawan, Taiping District, about 6 km south-east of central Fuxin; the museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 瑞应寺
summaryEn: A working Gelug-school Tibetan Buddhist monastery in Fosi town, Fuxin Mongol Autonomous County, founded in 1669 and named by the Kangxi emperor in 1703, and long the seat of the Chagan Diancheqi line of incarnate lamas. The provincial tourism page calls it the largest Tibetan Buddhist monastery of north-east China and the eastern Mongol lands; in the Qing period it had colleges for philosophy, medicine, tantra and astronomy and influenced Mongolian medicine and calendar-making. The halls were badly damaged and the monks dispersed during the Cultural Revolution; restoration began in 1984, and the temple is a provincial heritage unit, with smaller temples on the hilltops around the main halls.
description: 瑞应寺，蒙古族人称“葛根苏木”，汉族人俗称佛喇嘛寺。位于中国辽宁省阜新市阜新蒙古族自治县佛寺镇佛寺村，是一座藏传佛教格鲁派寺院，也是中国东北地区最大的藏传佛教寺院。
accessEn: In Fosi town, about 19 km west-south-west of central Fuxin.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 觉华岛
summaryEn: Juehua Island, renamed in 2009 from Juhua (Chrysanthemum) Island, is the largest island in Liaodong Bay, with about 13 km² of land, 27 km of coastline and a high point of 198 m. The tourism department lists the Dalonggong Temple (a Liao-period foundation, rebuilt in 2002), an octagonal well, the remains of a Ming-era camp, a bodhi culture park, an east-coast park and bathing beaches. In Ming times it was a grain depot for the Liaodong army, and Nurhaci's forces attacked it in 1626.
description: 觉华岛位于辽宁葫芦岛。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Reached by boat from the Xingcheng wharf, a crossing of about 30 minutes; the island lies about 12.5 km offshore, roughly 16 km south-south-east of Xingcheng old town.

name: 辽沈战役纪念馆
summaryEn: A museum and memorial park about the Liaoshen Campaign, the autumn 1948 campaign of the Chinese Civil War in which the People's Liberation Army took Jinzhou, Changchun and Shenyang from Nationalist forces. The main hall, opened in 1988, has an introductory hall and galleries on the course of the fighting, civilian support and the dead, plus a panorama hall depicting the assault on Jinzhou. The grounds also hold a memorial tower and an arcade engraved with the names of PLA soldiers who died in the north-east.
description: 辽沈战役纪念馆位于中华人民共和国辽宁省锦州市凌河区北京路5段1号，是一所纪念辽沈战役的专题纪念馆，该馆占地18.8万平方米，陈列有关辽沈战役战争和相关运动的历史文物藏品21428件，是国家4A级旅游景区、国家一级博物馆。
accessEn: In Linghe district, about 3 km north-east of Guta Park in central Jinzhou; closed on Mondays and from Chinese New Year's Eve to the third day of the new year.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 辽阳博物馆
summaryEn: Liaoyang Museum is a local-history museum in a Chinese-style building that opened in 2009, with two permanent exhibitions: one on ancient Liaoyang and one of highlights from the collection. Most of its 6,000-plus objects come from local excavations, with the emphasis on Han, Liao–Jin and Ming–Qing material, and it has been a national second-grade museum since 2024. It gives an overview of the history of the old Liaoyang area.
description: 辽阳博物馆位于中华人民共和国辽宁省辽阳市白塔区中心路2号，是一个综合性博物馆，该馆成立于1985年，前身为辽阳文物陈列所。辽阳博物馆总占地面积3万平方米，其中建筑面积6500平方米，馆藏文物逾6000件。
accessEn: On Zhongxin Road in Baita district, about 2 km south-east of Liaoyang railway station; closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中国工业博物馆
summaryEn: A museum in Tiexi, Shenyang's old heavy-industry district, built in and around the former casting workshop of the Shenyang Foundry, a hall of 1956 where giant ladles and furnaces still stand. Its halls cover the history of Chinese industry, machine tools, cars and the Tiexi district, with a collection of more than 20,000 items. It suits anyone interested in industrial heritage, and the old foundry was named a national industrial heritage site in 2018.
description: 中国工业博物馆（中国博物馆协会列为“沈阳工业博物馆”，也称中国工业博物馆）位于中华人民共和国辽宁省沈阳市铁西区，是中国首家综合工业博物馆，其前身是铸造博物馆，系从沈阳铸造厂翻砂车间旧址历经多次改扩建而成，现馆藏有两万多件珍贵文物，占地面积5.1万平方米，建筑面积4.3万平方米，年均接待观众50余万人次，每天上午10点和下午2点设两场公益讲解服务。
accessEn: In Tiexi district, about 4 km north-west of Shenyang railway station. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 张学良旧居
summaryEn: The former residence and offices of the Northeast warlord Zhang Zuolin and his son Zhang Xueliang, begun in 1914 in the old city of Shenyang. The compound has a traditional three-courtyard house, the three-storey Western-style 'Big Green Building' of 1922, a group of red-brick buildings in the west courtyard and the former home of Zhao Yidi. Several buildings are now open as a museum, the Zhang Xueliang Former Residence Exhibition Hall, and visitors walk through connected courtyards with carved beams and painted rafters.
description: 张学良旧居，通称张氏帅府，又称为大帅府、少帅府，位于中华人民共和国沈阳市沈河区朝阳街少帅府巷48号，是中华民国大陆时期奉系军阀张作霖及其子张学良的官邸，也是国家AAAA级旅游景区。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the old city of Shenyang, about 450 m south-south-east of Mukden Palace. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 沈阳抗美援朝烈士陵园
summaryEn: A memorial cemetery east of Beiling Park, built in 1951 for soldiers of the Chinese People's Volunteers who died in the Korean War. It holds the graves of 123 Volunteers, including named heroes such as Huang Jiguang and Qiu Shaoyun, a wall inscribed with the names of 197,653 Volunteers who died in the war, and a memorial hall displaying photographs and personal objects. Since 2014 the remains of Volunteers returned from South Korea have been reburied here, 981 of them by April 2025.
description: 沈阳抗美援朝烈士陵园，位于辽宁省沈阳市皇姑区北陵公园的东侧，为了纪念“在抗美援朝战争中牺牲的烈士”。
accessEn: In Huanggu district immediately east of Beiling Park, about 8 km north-east of Shenyang railway station. The memorial hall is closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 莫莫格湿地
summaryEn: The visitor area of the Momoge National Nature Reserve in Zhenlai County, where the Nen and Tao'er rivers meet on the Songnen Plain: a 1,440 sq km mosaic of river channels, reed marsh, sedge meadow and saline-alkali flats whose seablite meadows turn red in autumn. It has been a Ramsar wetland of international importance since 2013 and is a major stopover for the Siberian crane; in 2025 the first arrived on 12 March and the last left on 11 May, and more than 1,900 had been counted by late October. Red-crowned cranes and Oriental storks also breed in the reserve, which has been a 4A tourist area since 2005.
description: 莫莫格国家级自然保护区，又称莫莫格湿地，位于中国吉林省白城市镇赉县，地处松嫩平原西部嫩江与洮儿河的交汇地带。该保护区是中国内陆的典型盐碱湿地，以保护丹顶鹤等珍稀水禽为主。总面积144000公顷。
accessEn: In the east of Zhenlai County, about 31 km east-north-east of Zhenlai town and 68 km east-north-east of Baicheng in straight lines.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 红石国家森林公园
summaryEn: A large forest park of about 28,600 ha across Huadian and Jingyu county, set up in 2005 and opened in 2007 around a former logging area that is now protected natural forest. The Jilin tourism bureau lists forest walks, a red-leaf garden, a birch-covered ridge, rafting on the Bailu River and a camp associated with the Communist-led guerrillas under Yang Jingyu. It suits visitors who want woodland and autumn colour away from the city.
description: 红石国家森林公园位于中国吉林省吉林市桦甸市和靖宇县，是目前吉林省境内占地面积最大，森林覆盖率最广，野生动植物最全，水土蕴含量最为丰沛的多功能型的国家森林公园和国家4A级旅游景区，于2005年12月设立，占地面积为28,574.6公顷。
accessEn: Near the Hongshi forestry bureau, about 35 km east-south-east of Huadian and about 120 km south-south-east of Jilin railway station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 吉林市博物馆
