summaryEn: The city's main museum, with permanent exhibitions on the history of Jilin city, the 1976 meteorite shower and local intangible heritage, art galleries, and a collection of more than 25,000 objects. Its best-known exhibit is the 1,770 kg 'Jilin 1' stone from the 1976 shower, usually cited as the largest single stony meteorite ever recovered. It was rated a national first-class museum in 2024.
description: 吉林市博物馆是一座位于中华人民共和国吉林省吉林市丰满区的综合类博物馆，为国家一级博物馆。该博物馆成立于1962年12月25日，1990年与吉林市陨石博物馆合署办公。1998年，吉林市博物馆新馆落成并投入使用，2009年扩建分馆后占地面积达15,800平方米，建筑面积达26,150平方米。
accessEn: At 100 Jilin Street in Fengman district, about 3.5 km south-south-west of Jilin railway station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 朱雀山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forested mountain park on the south-eastern edge of Jilin, one of the four hills that local tradition places around the city, with Zhuque, the Vermilion Bird, standing for the south. Visitors come mainly to hike and for the autumn colours, and the park has staged evening light-show tours in the autumn holiday season. The Ashihada cliff inscriptions and the Shengxin winery estate are close by.
description: 朱雀山是吉林市四大名山之一，位于中国吉林省丰满区，距离市区10公里。
accessEn: Off Jifeng East Road in Fengman district, about 12 km south-east of Jilin railway station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 辽源矿工墓
summaryEn: A burial ground and site museum for coal miners who died at the Xi'an (now Liaoyuan) mines during Japan's occupation of north-east China in 1931–45. Many thousands of miners were buried on this hillside from about 1940 and a furnace for burning the dead was added in 1943; the pits were excavated in 1963, and halls built over parts of the burial ground now show the remains laid out in rows, alongside mining equipment. A monument stands in the wooded grounds, and the site is both a national heritage unit and a 4A scenic area.
description: 东北沦陷时期辽源矿工墓，简称“辽源矿工墓”，又名“方家坟”，位于吉林省辽源市西安区泰安大路5048号，是一处抗日战争时期的矿工万人坑。该矿工墓由投靠日本的煤矿运营方“方家柜”制造，大批从中国东北、华北等地被拐骗至此的矿工被欺压、毒打或矿难致死后掩埋于此。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Tai'an Avenue on the north-western side of Liaoyuan, about 4 km north-west of the city centre in a straight line; closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大泉源酒业宝泉涌酒坊
summaryEn: A working liquor distillery in Daquanyuan township whose Qing-dynasty Baoquanyong brewery is a national heritage unit. The visit takes in the old brewery's surviving features (a well, a steaming stove, fermentation pits and a group of large storage vessels known as 'liquor seas'), a company history museum, a stele garden and a traditional brewing workshop beside the modern production hall. It suits visitors interested in how Chinese grain liquor was made.
description: 大泉源酒业宝泉涌酒坊，位于中国吉林省通化市通化县大泉源乡大泉源村宝泉街大泉源酒业厂区内。2007年5月31日公布为第六批吉林省文物保护单位；2013年3月5日公布为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Daquanyuan township, about 33 km south-west of Tonghua city centre in a straight line; the company's history museum is closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鸡冠山
summaryEn: A mountain forest park of about 15 km² in the Changbai Mountains foothills in the south-west of Meihekou, named for a peak shaped like a rooster's comb. The main peak, Jiguanlazi, is 969 m high and the highest point in Meihekou, and the park is known locally for azaleas in spring, autumn colour, seas of cloud and winter rime. It has an artificial lake, a suspension bridge, forest chalets and hiking paths, and holds a mountain-climbing festival each May.
description: 鸡冠山位于吉林通化。游览特色包括森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jile township in the south-west of Meihekou, about 60 km from Meihekou's urban area according to the city government; check that it is open before going.

name: 罗通山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in the north-east of Liuhe County, built around Luotong Mountain Fortress, a large stone-walled hill fort of the Goguryeo period that was reused under the Jin dynasty and is a national heritage unit. A route through the fortress passes the west gate site, a barracks site, a drill ground with a commander's platform, an old well and a reservoir, while the surrounding area has karst caves, old elm trees and a Taoist temple, the Sanqing Palace. A red-history exhibition hall stands at the south gate.
description: 罗通山城位于柳河县城东北25公里的罗通山镇与圣水镇交界的罗通山顶部。山城构筑在罗通山中部海拔906米的主峰上。由相连的东西两城组成，周长约7.8千米。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the mountains about 35 km from Liuhe county town according to the Jilin culture and tourism bureau, or about 23 km east-north-east in a straight line.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 杨靖宇烈士陵园
summaryEn: A memorial park on a hillside beside the Hun River in Tonghua, laid out in the 1950s around the grave of Yang Jingyu, a commander of the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army, who is shown in a bronze statue at the centre of the grounds. The Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army Memorial Hall beside the cemetery uses photographs, objects, paintings and reconstructed scenes to tell the story of the guerrilla forces that fought the Japanese occupation in the north-east. It is on Jilin's red-tourism list and is designated a national patriotic-education demonstration base.
description: 杨靖宇烈士陵园，位于中国吉林省通化市东昌区，是一座为纪念在东北抗日中牺牲的东北抗日联军将领杨靖宇将军修建的陵园，修建于1957年，由杨靖宇烈士陵园和东北抗日联军纪念馆组成。1961年4月13日，杨靖宇烈士陵园被公布为省级文物保护单位，类型为近现代史迹及代表性建筑。
accessEn: On the east bank of the Hun River about 2 km east of central Tonghua, a short taxi ride from the town centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 哈尔滨北方森林动物园
summaryEn: A forest zoo in the hills of Acheng district that opened on 28 September 2004 to replace Harbin's old city zoo. The district government counts 23 exhibition halls and five large free-range zones, including ones for lions and tigers, large herbivores and wolves, with more than 240 species on show, among them Siberian tigers, white lions and red-crowned cranes. It has a small forest train and suits families.
description: 哈尔滨北方森林动物园是位于中华人民共和国黑龙江省哈尔滨市阿城区东南部鸽子洞地区的一座森林动物园。它紧临301国道，距哈尔滨市区43公里。园区规划面积为848公顷。
accessEn: In Acheng district, about 55 km south-east of central Harbin in a straight line, beside National Road 301.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 胜山要塞
summaryEn: Remains of a fortified zone built by the Japanese Kwantung Army over about seven years from the early 1930s to face the Soviet border, covering some 138 sq km. Surviving works include an underground command post, barracks and tunnels, an artillery position and depots; there is a site museum, and the area is also a national forest park.
description: 胜山要塞位于中华人民共和国黑龙江省黑河市孙吴县，是大日本帝国关东军在中国东北地区针对苏联而修筑的侵华日军东北要塞群的构成部分。2006年5月25日，孙吴胜山要塞作为侵华日军东北要塞之一公布为第六批全国重点文物保护单位，包括步兵警备中队本部、“亚雷”高地炮台、地下仓库、兵舍第二卫生室、地下指挥部、主阵地地下通道。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Yanjiang Manchu and Daur township, Sunwu County, on the Sunwu–Yanjiang road at the 38 km point from Sunwu town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大亮子河国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park in the hills of Tangyuan county, set up in 1992, with a trail through the woods to the site of the secret camp of the Sixth Army of the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army. Only the stone foundations of the original log buildings survive, and beside them stand full-size replica log cabins that form a memorial museum, with the army's headquarters, uniform workshop and cadre school re-created (Xinhua, October 2026).
description: 大亮子河国家森林公园，是位于中华人民共和国黑龙江省佳木斯市汤原县的一个国家森林公园，于1992年4月设立，占地面积为3.1万公顷，是国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: At the park gate in the hills north-north-west of Tangyuan town, about 51 km by road from Tangyuan and 99 km by road from Jiamusi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黑瞎子岛
summaryEn: The Chinese part of Heixiazi Island, a low wetland island where the Amur and Ussuri rivers meet opposite the Russian city of Khabarovsk. The main sight is the Dongji Pagoda, a nine-storey, 79 m Han–Tang-style tower on a circular plaza 171 m across, completed in 2016, with views north over the Amur and east towards Khabarovsk. Visitors also come for the wetland park, boundary marker 259 and the nearby 'first guard post of the east', the area being billed as China's eastern extremity.
description: 黑瞎子岛，俄称大乌苏里岛，是位于黑龙江和乌苏里江交汇处的一个岛系，由包括银龙岛、黑瞎子岛在内的93个岛屿和沙洲组成，全岛面积约335平方公里。清朝末年，俄罗斯通过瑷珲条约、中俄北京条约将原属于中国的外东北据为己有，黑龙江和乌苏里江的交汇处成为两国国界。
accessEn: On the island about 47 km by road east of Fuyuan town, which has an airport.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东宁要塞
summaryEn: The Dongning fortress group was built from 1934 by the Japanese Kwantung Army, with forced Chinese labour, along the frontier south-east of Mudanjiang, and saw heavy fighting in August 1945. The visit centres on the Xunshan underground fortress, with a museum at its foot whose five permanent exhibitions cover the fortress itself, the Japanese occupation, local anti-Japanese resistance, the 1945 fighting and later peace and friendship exchanges. A garden commemorating Anti-Japanese United Army fighters and an ordnance display are in the same grounds, and the site is part of the national protected unit 'Fortifications of the Japanese Invasion Troops'.
description: 侵华日军东北要塞，或称东方马其诺防线、侵华日军东北要塞群、关东军要塞、满蒙防线，是九一八事件后，日本关东军占领中国东北地区期间，在满洲国与苏联、蒙古人民共和国边境附近，针对苏联所修建的一系列军事要塞的总称。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Near Sanchakou town, about 24 km by road south-south-east of Dongning town; the museum stands at the foot of Xunshan, about 9 km south of Sanchakou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙沙公园
summaryEn: A large urban park of about 64 hectares in the centre of Qiqihar, with Laodong Lake and Wangjiang Tower, a lakeside pavilion first built in 1908. The former Heilongjiang Provincial Library building, put up in 1930 and now a nationally protected monument, stands in the grounds, along with other historic buildings such as a former Russian consulate. In winter the park hosts ice sculptures.
description: 龙沙公园位于中华人民共和国黑龙江省齐齐哈尔市龙沙区公园路32号，占地面积64公顷，其中水域面积20公顷。是中国东北地区最大的综合城市公园。著名的建筑望江楼就位于龙沙公园劳动湖畔假山上，始建于1908年，许多名人到过此处，刘少奇、周恩来、朱德、董必武、邓小平等先后光临齐齐哈尔市，到望江楼观光赏景。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the city centre of Qiqihar in Longsha district, about 1.5 km south-west of the city museum and about 4 km west of Qiqihar railway station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 明月岛
summaryEn: A wooded island in the Nen River just north-west of Qiqihar, laid out as a park from 1981 and named Mingyue ("Bright Moon") in 1984. It has a Buddhist temple first built in 1925, the Heilongjiang General's Mansion complex with a multimedia show on the history of old Bukui (Qiqihar), a 500 m poetry corridor and flower gardens, and a small tourist train that restarted in June 2024 after about 11 years. Visitors reach it by boat or, when the water is too low, by a floating bridge.
description: 明月岛为中华人民共和国黑龙江省齐齐哈尔市嫩江上的一座江心岛，形状似一弯明月。明月岛风景区始建于1981年，1984年更名为“明月岛风景区”。景区位于齐齐哈尔市西北部，距市区2公里。
accessEn: On the Nen River in Jianhua district, about 9 km north-north-west of central Qiqihar, with boats from the north quay.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 回龙湾国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park of about 6.4 sq km set up in 1993 on a bend of the Tangwang River in Meixi, enclosed by the river on three sides; local legend makes it the birthplace of a black dragon, which gives the name. Alongside the forest walks, the park hosts a large holiday and recuperation centre built for model workers, whose first phase was finished in 2015.
description: 伊春回龙湾国家森林公园，是位于中华人民共和国黑龙江省伊春市伊美区的一个国家森林公园，占地面积为638.8万平方米，于1993年设立，是中国国家4A级旅游景区。这里传说是黑龙的诞生地，并因此得名。
accessEn: In Meixi on the Heyi road at the 110 km point, roughly 32 km east-south-east of central Yichun. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 比斯特上海购物村
summaryEn: An outlet shopping village beside Shanghai Disney Resort, opened in 2016 as Shanghai Village, with about 200 boutiques selling discounted fashion and lifestyle brands. Its low-rise buildings in a 1920s Art Deco style curve around Xingyuan (Star Wish) Lake, where short boat rides run in fine weather, and cafés and restaurants line the lakeside. It suits shoppers and makes an easy add-on to a Disney visit.
description: 比斯特上海购物村是位于上海迪士尼度假区附近的一个购物场所、奥特莱斯、餐饮和娱乐场所，为比斯特购物村系列成员之一。
accessEn: Beside Shanghai Disney Resort in Pudong, a short taxi ride or walk from Disney Resort station on Metro Line 11, about 40 minutes by road from the city centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 碧海金沙
summaryEn: A seaside leisure area on Hangzhou Bay, one of Shanghai's few beaches, where a sea wall encloses a sheltered stretch of water behind an artificial beach of sand brought from Hainan. The city's visitor site lists about 60,000 square metres of swimming area, used mainly from June to September, with seafood and barbecue restaurants and water sports such as windsurfing and kayaking, and it suits a family day by the sea.
description: 碧海金沙水上乐园地处上海市奉贤区海鸥路39号，是一个拥有人造沙滩的水上乐园，为国家4A级旅游景区。碧海金沙水上乐园建立于2005年，目前由上海碧海金沙投资发展有限公司运营。碧海金沙水上乐园沿1300米的防汛墙建造，并向海中伸延600米，共围成约79万平方米的游乐区。
accessEn: In the Haiwan tourist zone on the Fengxian coast, about 1.5 hours by road south of central Shanghai.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 长兴岛郊野公园
summaryEn: One of Shanghai's first seven country parks, opened in 2016 on Changxing Island in the Yangtze estuary beside the Qingcaosha Reservoir; its first phase covers 5.58 km². It is a farmland landscape of orange groves, rose and flower fields, orchards and a lotus garden, with kayaking and paddleboarding on Huaxi Lake in summer and a former farm barracks converted into the 'Qianwei 1966' area.
description: 长兴岛郊野公园是位于中华人民共和国上海市崇明区长兴镇长兴岛上的一个公园，也是上海市首批七个郊野公园中面积最大的一个公园。2016年10月22日，长兴岛郊野公园正式免门票试开园。公园位于北临青草沙水库，东临沪陕高速，南侧、西侧分别是潘园公路和风凰公路，总体规划面积近30平方公里，一期工程总面积5.58平方公里。
accessEn: On Changxing Island, Chongming District, about an hour by road from central Shanghai through the Yangtze River tunnel.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东滩湿地公园
summaryEn: A wetland park opened in 2010 at the eastern tip of Chongming Island, beside the Chongming Dongtan bird reserve, which became part of a UNESCO World Heritage site for migratory-bird habitats in 2024. Its wetlands lie on a major migration route for waterbirds, and summer nature programmes cover insects, Chinese alligators and stargazing.
description: 崇明东滩位于崇明岛最东端，属上海市崇明区。崇明东滩湿地是候鸟的重要栖息地，设有上海崇明东滩鸟类国家级自然保护区。2008年1月19日，中英签署《中国可持续发展生态城市项目设计、实施和融资谅解备忘录》。
accessEn: At the eastern end of Chongming Island in Chenjia town, about 1.5 hours by road from central Shanghai via the Yangtze River tunnel and bridge.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 枫泾古镇
summaryEn: A canal town on Shanghai's south-western border with Zhejiang, founded in the Yuan dynasty, whose old streets of Ming- and Qing-style houses are crossed by dozens of bridges, the oldest being the Yuan-era Zhihe Bridge. Small museums remember local figures such as the painter Cheng Shifa and the cartoonist Ding Cong, and the town is the home of Jinshan peasant painting; the Legoland Shanghai resort, opened in 2025, is nearby.
description: 枫泾古镇位于上海。游览特色包括博物馆、古镇、运河。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Fengjing town, Jinshan District, about 70 km south-west of central Shanghai, roughly 1 hr 15 by road.

name: 嘉定州桥
summaryEn: The historic core of Jiading, a county town since 1217, where canals and old streets around the Zhouqiao bridge lead to the Southern Song Fahua Pagoda, the Ming garden Qiuxia Pu and Huilongtan Park. The scenic area also takes in the Jiading Confucian Temple, founded in 1219 and described by the city as one of China's well-preserved county-level Confucian temples, which reopened in September 2024 after restoration.
description: 上海嘉定州桥是位于中华人民共和国上海市嘉定区嘉定镇街道的一个国家4A级旅游景区，上海嘉定州桥境内有桥、河流、住宅、老街、嘉定孔庙、法华塔、汇龙潭、秋霞圃等景点。其中老街在嘉定县建县时就已存在。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Jiading District, about an hour from central Shanghai on Metro Line 11 to North Jiading or West Jiading station, then a short taxi ride.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 金山城市沙滩
summaryEn: A man-made beach on the north shore of Hangzhou Bay, opened in 2006 between two older seaside bathing grounds, with about 160,000 square metres of sand, a swimming area and a 1.5 km seaside promenade. Swimming is open from late June to early September; at other times visitors come for the sand, boat rides, horse riding, go-karts and beach sports, and it suits a family day by the sea.
description: 上海金山城市沙滩地处上海市金山区南部，濒临杭州湾，是一个拥有人造沙滩的水上乐园，为国家4A级旅游景区。金山城市沙滩拥有人工沙滩21200平方米。
accessEn: In Jinshan District, about 2.5 km from Jinshanwei station on the Jinshan Railway from Shanghai South Railway Station, or roughly 1 hr 15 by road from central Shanghai.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 金山嘴渔村
summaryEn: A working fishing village on the north shore of Hangzhou Bay, said to be the only village in Shanghai that still sends boats out to sea. Visitors walk Jinshanzui Old Street and eat seafood at the restaurants of its seafood street and food court, and it suits a relaxed seaside lunch combined with Jinshan City Beach.
description: 金山嘴渔村是中华人民共和国上海市金山区山阳镇杭州湾北岸的一个渔业生产村落，也是上海唯一保留出海捕渔的村庄，同时也是国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: In Shanyang town, Jinshan District, about 1.5 km from Jinshanwei station on the Jinshan Railway from Shanghai South Railway Station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 廊下郊野公园
summaryEn: A country park among farmland and villages in Langxia town, southern Jinshan, opened in 2015, where white-walled, black-tiled houses in local style line the lanes and events such as half marathons and cycling races are held through the year. It takes in Shantang Old Street, a village street whose bridge crosses into Zhejiang, and farmhouse restaurants and guesthouses in Zhonghua village, and suits a day out in the countryside.
description: 上海廊下郊野公园又称廊下郊野公园，是位于中华人民共和国上海市金山区廊下镇的一个公园，总规划范围约21.4平方公里，北至景邱路，西至六里塘，南至廊华路，东至山红河，境内有占地面积600余亩的廊下生态园，为国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: In Langxia town, Jinshan District, roughly 1 hr 15 by road from central Shanghai.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上海杜莎夫人蜡像馆
summaryEn: A branch of the Madame Tussauds wax museum chain on the tenth floor of the New World department store at the People's Square end of Nanjing Road, opened in 2006. Its figures of Chinese and international film and music stars, athletes, scientists and world leaders are arranged in themed zones, and it suits families and fans of Chinese pop culture.
description: 上海杜莎夫人蜡像馆是亚太地区第二家杜莎夫人蜡像馆，仅次于香港杜莎夫人蜡像馆。该馆于2006年5月1日开幕，现时展出61组蜡像作品。
accessEn: In Huangpu District at the People's Square end of Nanjing Road, a short walk from People's Square station (Lines 1, 2 and 8).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 闵行文化公园
summaryEn: A landscaped city park in Qibao, Minhang, opened in stages from 2013, with lawns, a lake and wetland, magnolia and camphor groves and an orchard. It also contains the Minhang Museum, opened in 2019, whose permanent galleries include one on the Maqiao culture of about 3,900 to 3,200 years ago, first identified at Maqiao in the same district, and the Powerlong Museum of art, opened in 2017.
description: 闵行文化公园，是上海市闵行区七宝镇一处城市公园，规划范围北至航南路、南至漕宝路、东至上海外环高速公路、西至新镇路，功能定位为“生态为主、文化为魂、与七宝生态商务区相呼应”，规划面积84.84公顷，其中绿化种植面积12万平方米。
accessEn: In Qibao, Minhang District, about 700 m from Hangzhong Road station (Line 10); the Minhang Museum in the park is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 月湖雕塑公园
summaryEn: A sculpture park in the Sheshan resort area, laid out around the artificial Moon Lake with shores themed on the four seasons. Sculptures by artists from China and abroad stand in the lawns and woods, and the park suits an unhurried walk combined with a visit to the Sheshan hills nearby.
description: 月湖雕塑公园是中华人民共和国上海市松江区的一个公园，也是国家4A级旅游景区，面积为1300亩，公园内有名为月湖的人工湖，面积为465亩，湖边分为春、夏、秋、冬四个岸区。公园内还有来自世界各国的70多件雕塑作品。
accessEn: In the Sheshan resort area of Songjiang, a short taxi ride from Sheshan station on Metro Line 9, about an hour from People's Square.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 前卫村
summaryEn: A farming village in Shuxin town on Chongming that began hosting farm-stay (nongjiale) tourism in 1999 and now forms the Haishang Huadao ('Flower Island') scenic area, with rose fields, lawns, a rose-themed garden and hotel, and children's play areas. Its Xiyuan Garden displays Ming and Qing carvings and old wooden beds on the theme of traditional Chinese weddings, and many of the village's former farmhouse inns have become boutique guesthouses.
description: 前卫村也叫前卫生态村，位于上海市崇明区竖新镇，占地3671亩，居民近300户，是全国特色景观旅游名村和国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: In central northern Chongming Island on Linfeng Road, about 1.5–2 hours by road from central Shanghai.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上海宝山国际民间艺术博览馆
summaryEn: A museum of folk art and folk customs from China and other countries, opened in October 2010 in a building whose design is based on a Chinese knot. It stands at the edge of Gucun Park and pairs easily with a walk there.
description: 上海宝山国际民间艺术博览馆是中华人民共和国上海市宝山区的一个以展示各国民间艺术、民俗文化的展览馆，同时也是国家AAAA级旅游景区，总建筑面积14600平方米。外观设计来自于中国结这一形象。博览馆于2010年10月16日建成开放。
accessEn: On Hutai Road at the south-east corner of Gucun Park in Baoshan District, about 2 km from Gucun Park station (Lines 7 and 15).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上海国际时尚中心
summaryEn: A fashion and shopping complex in the former Yufeng cotton mill on the Yangpu riverside, whose saw-tooth-roofed brick sheds were built by a Japanese textile company between 1922 and 1935 and ran as a state cotton mill until 2007. Converted between 2010 and 2012, it now holds catwalk venues, designer studios, fashion shops, restaurants and the Zotter Chocolate Theatre, with a riverside walk along the old dock.
description: 上海国际时尚中心位于上海。游览特色包括滨水景观、戏剧演艺。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At 2866 Yangshupu Road, Yangpu District, about 1.2 km from Aiguo Road or Fuxing Island stations on Metro Line 12.

name: 上海海昌海洋公园
summaryEn: A marine theme park beside Dishui Lake in Lingang, opened in 2018 by Haichang Ocean Park Holdings, with one half themed as a polar tundra under an artificial snowy mountain and the other as a tropical island with a volcano. It combines aquarium and animal exhibits, rides such as a launch roller coaster and a river-rapids ride, and staged shows with killer whales and other marine animals. It suits families with children and fills a full day.
description: 上海海昌海洋公园为中华人民共和国海昌海洋公园在上海浦东临港滴水湖湖畔建设的主题公园，占地29.7公顷，总规划面积约19万平方米，于2015年3月29日举行奠基仪式，并估计开幕后日承载能力达到6.4万人次，瞬间承载能力约4万余人，每年可以吸引逾600万名游客。
accessEn: In Lingang, south-east Pudong, about 1 km from Lingang Avenue station on Metro Line 16, roughly 1 hr 15 by road from central Shanghai.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上海海湾国家森林公园
summaryEn: A planted forest park of more than 1,000 hectares in Haiwan town, Fengxian, begun in 1999, whose lakes, woods and meadows hold more than 300 species of trees. It has an amusement area, a water-sports area and a dozen cultural exhibition areas, and its 135-hectare plum garden of nearly 42,000 trees is the main draw in the blossom season.
description: 上海海湾国家森林公园位于中华人民共和国上海市奉贤区海湾镇随塘河路1677号，在五四农场内，是国家4A级旅游景区。公园内有华东最大梅园。
accessEn: In Haiwan town, Fengxian District, about 1.5 hours by road from central Shanghai.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上海国际赛车场
summaryEn: The motor-racing circuit in Anting that has hosted the Formula One Chinese Grand Prix since 2004 (with a break from 2020 to 2023), its 5.45 km track laid out in the shape of the character 上, the first in Shanghai's name. The main grandstand has wing-like viewing platforms over the track and the team buildings stand like pavilions in a lake, a design modelled on Yu Garden; besides F1 the calendar includes Formula E, touring-car and GT races.
description: 上海上汽国际赛车场位于中国上海市嘉定区安亭镇，由时任上海市市长陈良宇主持建造，投资约20亿元，2002年10月动工，2004年6月竣工，总面积为5.3平方千米，可容纳20万人。同年9月26日举办首届F1中国大奖赛。
accessEn: In Anting, Jiading District, about 600 m from Shanghai Circuit station on Metro Line 11, roughly an hour from central Shanghai.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上海都市菜园
summaryEn: A vegetable-themed farm park in Haiwan town, built by the Bright Food group and described by the city as China's first vegetable theme park. Its venues show more than 200 kinds of fruit and vegetables and the history and techniques of farming, visitors can plant and pick their own, and a small tourist train, karting and a children's playground make it a family outing.
description: 上海都市菜园是中华人民共和国上海市奉贤区海湾镇的一个蔬菜主题公园，是国家4A级旅游景区，面积5000亩。
accessEn: In Haiwan town on the Fengxian coast, about 1.5 hours by road from central Shanghai.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 吴淞炮台湾湿地森林公园
summaryEn: A riverside park at Wusongkou, where the Huangpu River joins the Yangtze estuary, laid out from 2005 on mudflats that had been filled with steel-mill slag since the 1960s and named after the Qing navy's Wusong forts. Paths and boardwalks run through woods, ponds and tidal wetland, with a long riverside promenade facing the shipping lanes, a memorial square for the Wusong forts and the Yangtze Estuary Science Museum.
description: 吴淞炮台湾湿地森林公园位于上海市宝山区，是上海最大的原生湿地公园。吴淞炮台湾原称杨家嘴，由于清政府曾在吴淞口建有水师炮台，故改称为现名。公园区域位于吴淞口的西北角，原为长江滩涂湿地，自20世纪60年代起，由废钢渣回填形成了公园的陆域部分。
accessEn: In Baoshan District next to the Wusongkou International Cruise Terminal, about 3 km from Baoyang Road station (Line 3), a short taxi ride.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 召稼楼
summaryEn: A small water town in Pujiang in south-east Minhang, named after a tower built in the Southern Song to summon farmers to work newly reclaimed land, to which a bell was added in the Ming. Restored and reopened in 2010, its old street, stone bridges and courtyard halls such as Ligeng Hall held small museums, including memorial halls to the local figures Qin Yubo and Ye Zongxing and an exhibition on the educator Huang Yanpei. Since 2023 the whole area has been under redevelopment as a new residential and commercial district, in which the Liyuan garden is to be kept and the old-town core revived.
description: 召稼楼，原名召楼镇，位于中华人民共和国上海市闵行区浦江镇革新村沈杜公路2059号，面积为150亩，是国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: In Pujiang town, Minhang District, about 3 km from Sanlu Highway station on the Pujiang Line; the old town has been closed since February 2023 for a large-scale redevelopment that is planned to show its first results in 2027 and to be largely finished around 2030, so check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 新四军江南指挥部旧址
summaryEn: The Li family ancestral hall in Shuixi village, where the New Fourth Army set up its Jiangnan Command on 7 November 1939 under Chen Yi, with Su Yu as deputy, to direct its anti-Japanese operations around Maoshan and southern Jiangsu. The hall and a memorial museum beside it present the history of the command.
description: 溧阳新四军江南指挥部旧址位于江苏省常州市溧阳市竹箦镇水西村，原为村内李氏宗祠，1939年11月7日，统一领导茅山和苏南地区抗日活动的新四军江南指挥部在此成立，陈毅任指挥，粟裕任副指挥。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Shuixi village, Zhuze town, about 20 km north-west of Liyang station by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 红梅公园
summaryEn: A large city park east of Changzhou's old centre, opened in 1960 and named after the Hongmei (Red Plum) Pavilion, one of its two old buildings together with the Wenbi Pagoda. Its lake, gardens and plum trees make it a popular place in early spring, and it lies next to Tianning Temple.
description: 红梅公园位于中华人民共和国江苏省常州市天宁区，临近天宁寺，始建于1958年，1960年正式建成开放，得名于园内的著名古建筑红梅阁。
accessEn: In Tianning District about 2 km east of Nandajie, beside Tianning Temple; Hongmei Park station on Metro Line 2 is next to it.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中国漕运博物馆
summaryEn: China's first museum devoted to caoyun, the imperial system that shipped tax grain along the Grand Canal to the capital, opened in May 2011 on Caoyun Square in Huai'an's old town. It stands at the north end of the excavated site of the Office of the Governor-General of Grain Transport, which ran the system from here under the Ming and Qing; the foundations and column bases of its great hall are laid out as a park in front. Five galleries hold about 6,000 m² of displays on the canal, the grain fleets and the city's role in them.
description: 中国漕运博物馆是一座位于中华人民共和国江苏省淮安市淮安区的博物馆，也是中国首座漕运相关博物馆。
accessEn: On Caoyun Square in the centre of the old town of Huai'an District, between the Prefectural Yamen and the Zhenhuai Tower, about 15 km south-east of central Qingjiangpu; city bus or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 第一山
summaryEn: A wooded hill above the Huai River in the north of Xuyi town, named after the Song calligrapher Mi Fu, who climbed it in 1097 on his way to a post in Lianshui and wrote a poem calling it the "First Mountain"; a later copy of his three characters stands by the entrance. Its cliffs and steles carry well over a hundred inscriptions from the Song to the Republic, among them verses left by Southern Song envoys on their way to the Jin court and a Su Shi poem carved in the Northern Song and rediscovered in 1983. Below the hill, the restored lanes of the Diyishan historic quarter, such as Huangpai Street, are lined with restaurants and shops.
description: 第一山题刻，位于江苏省淮安市盱眙县，是中华人民共和国全国重点文物保护单位之一。1982年3月25日，公布为江苏省文物保护单位，2013年5月公布为全国重点文物保护单位，是一座石刻及其他。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the north of Xuyi town by the Huai River, about 80 km south-west of central Huai'an; bus to Xuyi, then walk or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黄花塘新四军军部旧址
summaryEn: Huanghuatang village in southern Xuyi County was the seat of the New Fourth Army's headquarters from early 1943 to early 1945, during the later years of the war against Japan. The memorial site comprises the former headquarters buildings and leaders' quarters, an exhibition hall of photographs and objects on the war in central China, and landscaped grounds. It was listed as a national heritage unit in 2019.
description: 盱眙新四军军部旧址，位于江苏省淮安市盱眙县黄花塘镇黄花塘村，1982年3月25日公布为江苏省文物保护单位，2019年10月7日公布为第八批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Huanghuatang village, about 35 km by road south-east of Xuyi town; by car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 铁山寺国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forested area of low hills, up to about 200 m, in the far south of Xuyi County on the Anhui border, around the 9 km² Tianquan Lake reservoir. Its secondary broadleaf woodland mixes northern and southern plants, as it lies where the warm-temperate and subtropical zones meet. Within the park are the rebuilt Tieshan Chan Temple, an observing station of the Purple Mountain Observatory with a public astronomy park, and walking routes with a suspension bridge and a long stone stairway.
description: 铁山寺森林公园是位于中国江苏省淮安市盱眙县南部的一座森林公园，毗邻安徽省来安县和明光市。铁山寺一带为低山丘陵地形，海拔最高点接近200米，中间9平方公里的天泉湖。山上森林覆盖率较高，以次生阔叶林为主，植物种类体现暖温带向亚热带过渡的特色。
accessEn: In Tianquanhu town about 45 km south of Xuyi town; by car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大伊山
summaryEn: A cluster of twelve low peaks, the highest 226.7 m, on the northern edge of Guanyun county town, with the centuries-old Stone Buddha Temple (Shifo Si), a large bronze seated Buddha completed in 2009 and old rock carvings such as a Yuan-dynasty sika deer. On the eastern foot lies the Dayishan stone-coffin cemetery, a Neolithic burial ground about 6,500 years old whose graves were lined with natural stone slabs, described as the earliest stone-coffin cemetery found in China.
description: 大伊山石棺墓位于中国江苏省连云港市灌云县伊山镇北郊任庄村大伊山东麓青风岭上，1996年被列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。大伊山石棺墓于1981年被发现，仅存西北角，总面积约3000平方米。1985～1986年考古发掘发现新石器时代墓葬62座，全部采用天然石板镶砌而成。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the northern edge of Guanyun county town, about 35 km south of central Lianyungang; local bus 101 runs from Guanyun to the Buddha.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 秦山岛
summaryEn: A narrow islet of about 0.19 km² in the sea off Ganyu, roughly a kilometre long with three low peaks along its ridge. At the lowest spring tides a shingle causeway about 4 km long, the 'Divine Road', emerges from the water, and the island has Xu Fu's Well, old stone inscriptions and the sea-sculpted General Rock, all tied to legends of the First Emperor's eastern tour and Xu Fu's voyage in search of immortality.
description: 秦山岛，位于江苏省连云港市赣榆区境内，在赣榆新城区东15.3公里海面上，面积0.1928平方公里，全岛狭长形，呈单面山形态，东西长1000米，宽200米，分为东、中、西三峰。岛上名胜很多，有千年古亭、李斯碑、徐福井、天妃宫、受珠台、秦东门、古炮台等20余处主要景点，其中秦东门高达10余米，蔚为壮观，素来享有“秦山古岛，黄海仙境”的称谓。
accessEn: About 8 km off the Ganyu coast and roughly 30 km north of central Lianyungang; boats leave from the scenic area's pier on the shore, but sailings depend on weather and tides, so check that they are running before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 西双湖
summaryEn: A reservoir on the south-western edge of Donghai county town, built in 1960 on the Yuejin River, whose shores are now laid out as the Xishuang Lake National Wetland Park. It is an open town park for a lakeside walk, easily combined with a visit to Donghai's crystal market.
description: 西双湖水库是中国江苏省连云港市东海县境内的一座水库，位于跃进河上，建于1960年。水库正常库容为1610万立方米，集雨面积为22平方千米，海拔为32米。
accessEn: On the south-western edge of Donghai county town, about 45 km west of central Lianyungang; a taxi from the crystal market takes about 10 minutes.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 金牛湖
summaryEn: Nanjing's largest artificial lake, a reservoir built in 1958 on the Babai River in the far north of Liuhe District, near the borders of Tianchang and Yizheng and overlooked by Jinniu Hill. It hosted water-sports events of the 2014 Nanjing Youth Olympic Games and has since staged dragon-boat and sailing races; visitors can take sightseeing boats or speedboats, paddle a kayak or try wakesurfing and a floating obstacle course. The surrounding countryside is one of the places that claim to be the home of the folk song Mo Li Hua (Jasmine Flower).
description: 金牛湖，又称金牛山水库，是中华人民共和国江苏省南京市六合区境内的一座人工湖，位于八百河上，始建于1958年。金牛湖的正常库容为5165万立方米，集雨面积为124平方千米，海拔为21.5米。金牛湖现已成为一处知名的风景区，其北部与天长市和仪征市接壤的地区是中国代表民歌《茉莉花》的发源地。
accessEn: Jinniuhu station, the northern terminus of Nanjing Metro Line S8, stands next to the scenic area, about 50 km north of central Nanjing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 珍珠泉
summaryEn: A hill-and-lake scenic area at the eastern foot of Laoshan in Pukou, facing the Yangtze, named after a spring whose bubbles rise in strings like pearls and praised in Ming and Qing times as the finest outing north of the river. It now mixes nature with built attractions: bamboo rafts and boats on Jingshan Lake, a wildlife park with tigers, lions, bears and monkeys, a mountain toboggan run, a cable car and a 3 km imitation of the Great Wall built along the ridge in 1995. Next to the scenic area stands Dingshan Temple, founded in 503 and rebuilt in Tang style, which tradition links with Bodhidharma.
description: 珍珠泉位于江苏南京。游览特色包括湖泊、动物观赏、缆车观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dingshan Subdistrict, Pukou, about 15 km north-west of Xinjiekou across the Yangtze, by taxi or bus.

name: 天生桥
summaryEn: A natural-looking stone bridge over the Yanzhi River, a canal that the Ming founder Zhu Yuanzhang had a large labour force cut through a ridge in Lishui in 1393–1395, to link the Qinhuai River with the Taihu waterways for grain transport. Instead of cutting through the whole hill, the workers left a band of rock in place and chiselled the channel beneath it, giving the 'heaven-made bridge' its name; a second such bridge further north collapsed in 1571. The bridge, high above the water in the steep-sided cutting, is the centre of a scenic area along the canal and one of the New Forty-Eight Views of Jinling.
description: 天生桥位于南京市东南方48公里处的溧水区胭脂河上。现被列为金陵新四十八景之一。今设有国家4A级景区——溧水天生桥景区。
accessEn: In Lishui District about 50 km south-east of central Nanjing, roughly an hour by road and a few kilometres from Lishui town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 游子山
summaryEn: A wooded range of low hills in eastern Gaochun, whose name ('the wanderer's mountain') comes from a tradition, recorded in a Song-dynasty gazetteer, that Confucius passed this way on his journey to the state of Chu. The scenic area combines forest walks with a hall honouring Confucius and a martyrs' cemetery, while the nearby old village of Qiqiao has been home to descendants of Confucius since the Southern Song.
description: 游子山，又称游山，是南京市高淳区的丘陵。据明清史料记载，楚昭王二十七年，“孔子适楚经此山”，因而得名。长2千米，宽1-1.5千米，主峰海拔187米。
accessEn: In Dongba, about 15 km east of Gaochun town by road; Gaochun is about 80 km south of central Nanjing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 啬园
summaryEn: Seyuan is a large wooded park in Nantong's southern suburbs, counted by the city as one of its biggest botanical gardens and the burial place of Zhang Jian (1853–1926), the scholar-industrialist who built the Dasheng cotton mills and Nantong Museum. The tomb was wrecked during the Cultural Revolution and rebuilt in 1983, with his bronze statue put back in 1985, when the grounds took the name Seyuan after his art name Se'an. Each spring the park holds a tulip festival; the 2026 edition planted 130,000 tulips of 23 varieties.
description: 啬园位于江苏南通。游览特色包括博物馆、植物园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 7 km south-east of central Nantong, near Langshan; city buses stop by the north gate.

name: 龙王庙行宫
summaryEn: A temple to the Dragon King beside the Grand Canal and Luoma Lake in Zaohe town, first built in the Kangxi reign and rebuilt in 1727 and 1813, where the Qianlong Emperor lodged on five of his six southern tours; it is popularly called the Qianlong Palace. Three courtyards on a central axis lead past a stage and the imperial stele pavilion to the double-eaved Dragon King Hall and the Hall of Yu the Great. The site, which includes the remains of the imperial wharf, is part of the Grand Canal World Heritage Site.
description: 龙王庙行宫位于中国江苏省宿迁市宿豫区皂河镇，毗邻京杭大运河和骆马湖，乾隆皇帝六下江南有五次住在这里，故俗称乾隆行宫，2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。2006年御码头遗址作为第六批全国重点文物保护单位合并的项目归入龙王庙行宫。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Zaohe town about 20 km north-west of central Suqian, roughly 30 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 湖滨公园
summaryEn: A public park on the southern shore of Luoma Lake, in Suqian's Hubin new district and the Luoma Lake tourist resort. By 2025 it had been upgraded together with neighbouring lakeside gardens into an open shoreline park more than 10 km long, and it is a place for a lakeside walk rather than a sight in its own right.
description: 湖滨公园位于中华人民共和国浙江省杭州市西湖区与上城区交界，西湖东岸，东临湖滨路。公园南北长约1公里，包括6个大小不等的园地，从南到北依次为一公园、二公园、三公园、四公园、五公园和六公园，其中一公园和六公园面积最大，湖滨公园是在以前的六公园基础上扩充建成的。
accessEn: On the southern shore of Luoma Lake, about 11 km north of central Suqian and around 25 minutes by taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 洋河酒厂文化旅游区
summaryEn: The home of Yanghe, one of China's largest baijiu makers, in Yanghe town south-east of Suqian, where a visitor route runs through the working distillery. Stops include the Meirenquan spring, a hand-made production area, the old brewing site, a group of Ming and Qing fermentation pits and the underground cellar dug between 1960 and 1975, now a national heritage site.
description: 洋河酒厂地下酒窖，位于江苏省宿迁市宿城区，是中华人民共和国江苏省文物保护单位之一。2011年12月30日，授予江苏省文物保护单位，2019年成为全国重点文物保护单位，是一座古建筑。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Yanghe town, about 25 km south-east of central Suqian by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 聚沙塔
summaryEn: A brick pagoda in the small town of Meili, north-east of Changshu, first built in the Southern Song dynasty between 1131 and 1162. It is octagonal, seven storeys tall and ringed with wooden eaves; a typhoon toppled its top in 1911 and left it leaning, and it was straightened in 1993 and restored to its Song form in 1997. Jusha Garden, a small park laid out around the pagoda at that time, makes up the listed scenic area.
description: 聚沙塔又名聚沙百福宝塔，位于江苏省苏州常熟市梅李镇东。始建于南宋绍兴年间(1131-1162)。八角七层木檐楼阁式砖塔，通高32.83米。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Meili town, about 13 km north-east of central Changshu by road; Changshu itself is roughly an hour by road north of Suzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上方山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A wooded hill on the shore of Shihu Lake on Suzhou's southern edge, protected as a national forest park and known for remains linked to the ancient states of Wu and Yue. Its twenty-odd sights include the Lengqie Pagoda on the summit, Zhiping Temple, stretches of old wall attributed to Wu and Yue, a beacon platform, the Shihu Thatched Hall and an imperial path laid for the Qianlong Emperor.
description: 苏州上方山国家森林公园是位于中华人民共和国江苏省苏州市南部石湖湖畔的国家森林公园，以吴越遗迹和江南水乡风光而著称。公园内有楞枷塔、拜郊台、越公井、乾隆御道、吴越古城墙、治平寺、茶磨屿、石湖草堂、烽火台等二十余处景点。
accessEn: By Shihu Lake on the southern edge of Suzhou, about 8 km south-west of the old-city centre, by taxi or bus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 苏州乐园森林世界
summaryEn: A forest-themed amusement park at the foot of Dayang Mountain in Suzhou's western New District, opened after the original Suzhou Amusement Land of 1997 closed in 2017. It is laid out in six themed zones with more than 20 rides, among them a flying theatre and a vertical-drop roller coaster, plus shows and parades, and the same operator runs a summer water park and a children's park, Candy World, next to it. It suits families with children rather than sightseers.
description: 苏州乐园是江苏省苏州市的一个大型主题公园，主要经营建设娱乐、餐饮及其它旅游配套设施，建成于1997年，同年2月开始营业。
accessEn: In Huqiu (New) District about 15 km west of Suzhou's old city, by taxi or bus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 御窑金砖博物馆
summaryEn: A museum in Suzhou's Xiangcheng district beside the old Lumu imperial kilns, which in the Ming and Qing dynasties fired the fine clay floor tiles known as 'gold bricks' for the Forbidden City and the Summer Palace. Designed by the architect Liu Jiakun and opened in 2016, it pairs a modern exhibition building with a park around the surviving kiln remains.
description: 苏州御窑金砖博物馆位于中华人民共和国江苏省苏州市相城区阳澄湖西路95号，是一家砖窑博物馆。
accessEn: In Xiangcheng district about 6 km north of Suzhou's old city, next to Yuyao station on Suzhou Metro Line 8.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 西山
summaryEn: The largest island in Lake Tai, a hilly landscape of orchards and villages joined to the mainland by the Taihu Bridge, with Piaomiao Peak as its high point. The scenic area takes in Linwu Cave, counted in Taoist tradition as the ninth of the ten great grotto-heavens, the rocky lakeside headland of Shigong Hill, Mingyue Bay and Baoshan Temple. The island grows loquats, bayberries, plums, oranges and peaches, so spring and early summer bring fruit-picking.
description: 西山全名为洞庭西山，古称包山，位于江苏省苏州市吴中区金庭镇的太湖之中。面积达79.8平方公里，是中国最大的湖岛，现有中国内湖第一长桥——太湖大桥与西山之相连。岛上的缥缈峰海拔336.6米。
accessEn: About 55 km south-west of central Suzhou by road across the Taihu Bridge (around 1 hour 15 minutes).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 口岸雕花楼
summaryEn: The Diaohualou ('carved building') is a merchant's mansion of the Qing and early Republican periods in the old town of Kou'an near the Yangtze, with two-storey main buildings and side wings around a square courtyard richly decorated with wood, brick and stone carving. It is the centrepiece of a small old-town scenic area and has been a Jiangsu provincial heritage site since 2002.
description: 口岸雕花楼，位于江苏省泰州市高港区，是中华人民共和国江苏省文物保护单位之一。2002年10月22日，授予江苏省文物保护单位，是一座古建筑。
accessEn: In Kou'an, Gaogang district, about 20 km south of central Taizhou by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 李中水上森林
summaryEn: The Lizhong Water Forest is a man-made wetland forest begun in the early 1980s, when villagers planted pond cypress and dawn redwood on raised plots in waste marshland north-west of Xinghua. The trees now stand with their roots in water, and herons and other water birds nest among them; in 2014 it became Xinghua's first scenic area rated 4A.
description: 兴化李中水上森林景区是位于江苏省兴化市李中镇的一个旅游景点，为国家4A级景区。2014年5月，全国旅游景区质量等级评定委员会正式批准兴化市李中水上森林景区为国家4A级旅游景区，这是兴化首个国家4A级景区。
accessEn: Near Lizhong in Qianduo town, about 15 km north-west of Xinghua city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 沙沟古镇
summaryEn: Shagou is an old water town in the far north-west of Xinghua, where five counties meet, long a market centre for the fish and rice of the Lixiahe plain and named a China Historic and Cultural Town in 2010. Its lanes keep a Ming stone-slab street at the old fish market, the Ming-dynasty Hong Bridge, Qing houses and a clan hall, and an old wharf.
description: 沙沟古镇位于江苏泰州。游览特色包括古镇、水乡。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 25 km north-west of Xinghua city.

name: 郑板桥·范仲淹纪念馆
summaryEn: This memorial museum in Xinghua's old town honours two men tied to the city: the painter and calligrapher Zheng Banqiao (Zheng Xie, 1693–1766), born in Xinghua and one of the Eight Eccentrics of Yangzhou, known for his ink orchids, bamboo and rocks, and the Song statesman Fan Zhongyan, who served as Xinghua's magistrate in the 1020s and led the building of sea dykes along this coast. It shares its grounds with the Xinghua Museum and the Li Garden, a small Qing garden with a boat-shaped hall, and Zheng's former home survives nearby in the Jindongmen quarter.
description: 郑板桥·范仲淹纪念馆位于江苏泰州。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Xinghua's old town, about 500 m west of the Jindongmen historic quarter; Xinghua is about 50 km north of central Taizhou.

name: 崇安寺
summaryEn: The historic core of central Wuxi, named after a temple said to have been founded on the calligrapher Wang Xizhi's donated house in the 4th century and lost in the early 20th century; today it is a pedestrian shopping and food quarter around Erquan Square, known for old Wuxi restaurants and xiaolongbao. It takes in Chengzhong Park, laid out in 1905 as one of China's first public parks, and the 1914 clock-tower building of the old county library. In its south corner is the former residence of the blind street musician Abing (Hua Yanjun), composer of the erhu piece 'The Moon Reflected on Erquan', who was born and died here; it is now a memorial hall showing his erhu, pipa and modest living rooms.
description: 崇安寺，原是位于中国江苏省无锡市市中心梁溪区的一个著名佛教庙宇，也是无锡最古老的寺院，以庙会集市著称，为“梁溪十大刹”之一。它和上海的城隍庙、南京的夫子庙、苏州的玄妙观齐名，各自代表了儒、道、佛三教，亦可见过去江南一带宗教之盛行。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the centre of Wuxi, beside Sanyang Plaza station on Metro Lines 1 and 2.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 荡口古镇
summaryEn: A canal town in Ehu, east of Wuxi near the Suzhou border, that grew up from the early Ming dynasty as the home of the Hua clan, with Ming and Qing houses along the Beicang River; restoration began in 2009 and it is now run as a scenic area. Its main monument is the Hua Family Old Charitable Estate, begun in the 1740s and the first such clan estate in Wuxi, which used rents from its land to support widows, orphans and a clan school; four halls survive, the main ones built of nanmu wood.
description: 荡口华氏建筑群，当地也称为荡口古镇，位于中华人民共和国江苏省无锡市鹅湖镇荡口，是江苏省文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Ehu town about 30 km east of central Wuxi, roughly 45 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 阖闾城遗址博物馆
summaryEn: A museum opened in 2014 beside the remains of Helü City, a walled settlement on the Wuxi–Changzhou border that archaeologists identified in 2008 as a capital of the Spring and Autumn state of Wu under King Helü in the late 6th century BC, although the location of his capital is still debated. Built into the face of a former quarry by Lake Tai, it shows finds from the site, with a 3D cinema and multimedia displays on the excavations and on King Helü; only parts of the earthen ramparts can still be traced in the countryside nearby.
description: 阖闾城遗址位于江苏省常州市武进区和无锡市滨湖区，被认为是中国历代所争议的春秋时期吴国都城——阖闾城。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the Lake Tai ring road at Lüjiang in Mashan, about 20 km west of central Wuxi, by taxi. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鸿山遗址博物馆
summaryEn: A site museum in Wuxi's Hongshan area built over a cemetery of tombs of Yue-state nobles, whose excavation was named one of China's top ten archaeological discoveries of 2004. Its galleries centre on the great Qiuchengdun tomb, shown in place, with the celadon, low-fired glazed ceramics and finely carved jades found in the graves, which shed light on the burial rites and music of the Wu and Yue states.
description: 鸿山墓群，又称鸿山越国贵族墓，现有鸿山遗址博物馆、中国吴文化博物馆，位于中华人民共和国江苏省无锡市新吴区鸿山镇东部。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Hongshan, Xinwu district, about 20 km south-east of central Wuxi; easiest by taxi. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鸿山泰伯景区
summaryEn: The burial place on Hongshan hill traditionally held to be that of Taibo, the legendary founder of the Wu state, laid out with Wu Culture Square in front and the tomb area behind. Its 20-odd sights include Ming and Qing structures such as the Yangzhi Pavilion and the Imperial Stele Pavilion, and since 2006 it has hosted the annual Taibo memorial ceremony and Wu Culture Festival on 10 April.
description: 泰伯墓，是一座位于江苏省无锡市无锡新区的墓葬，里面安葬了历史三让皇位的主角泰伯。每逢泰伯正月初九的生日，许多市民乃至全球各地的吴姓后裔皆到此地参拜。
accessEn: In Hongshan, Xinwu district, about 18 km east of central Wuxi; Taibo Temple in Meicun is about 5 km to the west.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 江苏学政衙署
summaryEn: The site of the provincial education commissioner's office, unusually based in Jiangyin rather than in a provincial capital: the commissioner for Suzhou and Songjiang moved here in 1614, and from 1725 until the examinations ended in 1906 the Jiangsu commissioner, responsible for eight prefectures and three departments, was based here. Only the five-bay ceremonial gate survives, together with inscribed steles including one in the Qianlong emperor's hand and a set of poem tablets, and the site is now a cultural park with statues of former commissioners and the old rear garden, renamed Zhongshan Park.
description: 江苏学政署又名江苏学使署、督学察院等，为明代南直隶下江提学御史和清代江苏学政驻节地，同时也是常州府所辖八县的科举院试场所，位于中国江苏省无锡江阴市澄江街道人民中路中山公园内，始建于明万历四十一年，至清光绪三十二年废除科举后裁撤，前后共历时292年和124任学政。
accessEn: In central Jiangyin on Renmin Middle Road, about 35 km north of Wuxi; Jiangyin has high-speed trains on the Shanghai–Nanjing riverside line, about an hour from Shanghai Hongqiao.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 江阴滨江要塞
summaryEn: Riverside parks on Huangshan hill and Ebizui (Goose Beak) Point just north of central Jiangyin, where the Yangtze narrows to little more than a kilometre and has been fortified since the late Ming. Gun batteries from the Ming–Qing, late-Qing and Republican periods survive on the hilltops, a stone at Ebizui marks the spot as the river's 'tail' and the sea's 'head', and the paths give close views of passing ships and the Jiangyin Yangtze River Bridge.
description: 江阴滨江要塞位于江苏无锡。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、滨水景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the Yangtze about 2–3 km north of central Jiangyin, by taxi or city bus.

name: 南禅寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple near the old Grand Canal just south of central Wuxi, first founded in the Southern Dynasties and restored in 1995, whose seven-storey octagonal Miaoguang Pagoda was named by the Song emperor Huizong in 1104 and rebuilt in the Ming dynasty. The pagoda has been counted among the Eight Views of Wuxi since the Ming, and the streets around the temple now form a pedestrian quarter of shops and restaurants.
description: 南禅寺位于江苏无锡。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、古塔、运河。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Liangxi district about 1 km south of central Wuxi, near Nanchan Temple station on Metro Line 1.

name: 团氿
summaryEn: A small round lake on the western edge of Yixing's city centre, one of the three 'jiu' lakes that give the city its waterside setting. The scenic area rings it with promenades and parks, among them the Yi Garden (Yiyuan), laid out in Jiangnan garden style with bridges and pavilions, the south-shore promenade, Jiubin Park and a wetland park.
description: 团氿，古称潭氿，是位于中国江苏省无锡市宜兴市的一个湖泊，面积约2.6平方千米。周边有团氿风景区。
accessEn: On the western side of central Yixing, a short walk or taxi ride from the centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 无锡动物园·太湖欢乐园
summaryEn: A combined zoo and amusement park on the slopes of Mount Hui in western Wuxi, opened in 2010 when the city zoo moved here from Xihui Park, where it had been since 1956. The zoo is divided into areas by region and animal group, with giant pandas, giraffes, rhinos, chimpanzees, red pandas and lemurs among its animals, and the amusement park section has fairground rides and staged children's shows. It suits families with children.
description: 无锡动物园位于无锡市滨湖区钱荣路99号，依惠山而建，占地面积52万平方米，于2010年9月正式开园。
accessEn: On Qianrong Road at the western edge of Wuxi, about 6 km from the city centre, by bus or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 户部山古建筑群
summaryEn: A low hill in the heart of Xuzhou named after the Ming Ministry of Revenue branch office that moved up here when the Yellow River flooded the city in 1624, after which wealthy families crowded its slopes with courtyard houses. Thirteen fairly complete compounds of the Ming to Republican eras survive, among them the Yu and Zhai family mansions, now the Xuzhou Folk Custom Museum, and houses linked to the scholar-officials Cui Tao and Li Pan, while Ximatai, a terrace linked by tradition to Xiang Yu, stands on the hill. The surrounding Huilongwo streets, with shops, teahouses and restaurants, were named a national tourism and leisure block in 2024.
description: 户部山古建筑群位于中国江苏省徐州市云龙区户部山周围，2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In central Xuzhou beside Hubushan station on metro line 2, a short walk from the Xuzhou Museum.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大纵湖
summaryEn: A shallow lake of about 28 km² on the border with Xinghua, long admired for its autumn views, whose northern, Yancheng shore is developed as a lakeside resort with a national wetland park. The scenic area has reed and water landscapes, a cherry-tree avenue about a kilometre long, a 25 m statue of Guanyin standing in the water and a water park. Next door, Dongjin Water Town is a newly built canal town of Song- and Republican-style buildings on nine islands linked by 24 bridges, with light and fountain shows.
description: 大纵湖是一个位于中国江苏省兴化市、江苏省盐城市的湖泊，面积约为28平方千米。
accessEn: In Dazonghu town, Yandu District, about 33 km south-west of central Yancheng; car or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 金沙湖
summaryEn: A lake and wetland resort on the southern edge of Funing town, developed from 2010 around about 10,000 mu of water with reed-fringed islands, and listed as a national water conservancy scenic area. Its freshwater sand beach and bathing area draws summer crowds, while egrets, kingfishers and other birds use the quieter islands.
description: 金沙湖位于江苏盐城。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Jinshahu Avenue just south of Funing county town, about 55 km north-west of Yancheng city; taxi or local bus.

name: 西溪天仙缘
summaryEn: Xixi, on the western edge of Dongtai, was a salt-making centre from the Han dynasty and is linked with the folk legend of Dong Yong and the Seventh Fairy, a national intangible heritage item. The scenic area combines the Dong Yong and Seventh Fairy culture park, a rebuilt old town of Xixi and the garden of Taishan Temple, where the Haichunxuan Pagoda, a multi-eaved brick pagoda listed as Tang-dynasty and a national heritage site since 2013, still stands. The area has also staged shows based on the fairy legend and on Fan Zhongyan, who served as a salt official at Xixi.
description: 西溪天仙缘位于江苏盐城。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、古塔、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the western side of Dongtai city, about 3 km from the centre; taxi or city bus, and Dongtai has high-speed rail links to Yancheng and Nantong.

name: 汉陵苑
summaryEn: A museum on the Shugang hills built around the tomb of Liu Xu, the first Prince of Guangling in the Western Han, and the tomb of his consort, both excavated at Tianshan in Gaoyou from 1979 and later moved here. They are large timber tombs of the rare huangchang ticou type, in which the coffin chamber is enclosed by walls of stacked timber, and the reassembled chambers are the centrepiece of the museum.
description: 汉陵苑位于江苏扬州。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Pingshantang East Road on the Shugang hills, about 4 km north of Yangzhou's old city centre and 1.5 km east of Daming Temple; bus or taxi.

name: 西津渡
summaryEn: A stepped lane climbing Yuntai Hill in western Zhenjiang to the old Xijin ferry crossing on the Yangtze, where poets such as Li Bai, Wang Anshi and Su Shi waited for boats. Its stone steps pass Qing-era houses and shops, Guanyin Cave and the Zhaoguan Stone Pagoda, a Tibetan-style stupa of the late Yuan or early Ming built over the street so that people walk beneath it, and the slope above holds buildings of the former British concession. The pagoda's restoration in 2000 won a UNESCO Asia-Pacific heritage conservation award in 2001.
description: 西津渡古街位于镇江市西部云台山上，西津渡原名为“蒜山渡”，于三国时代命名；后来唐代改称为“金陵渡”；宋代以后才改称为“西津渡”。西津渡古街全长不足500米，历经唐、宋、元、明、清至今仍保留着古朴典雅的风情。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In western central Zhenjiang next to the Zhenjiang Museum, about 2 km north of Zhenjiang railway station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中国醋文化博物馆
summaryEn: A museum opened in 2010 by the Hengshun Group, maker of the well-known Zhenjiang vinegar, beside its works in Dantu District. It traces the history of vinegar-making through a history hall, a reconstructed old vinegar workshop, a traditional sauce yard and a hall on modern production.
description: 中国醋文化博物馆是一座位于中国江苏省镇江市的醋文化博物馆。
accessEn: In Dantu District about 11 km south-east of Zhenjiang railway station, around 25 minutes by taxi; check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大慈岩
summaryEn: A rocky mountain in south-west Jiande nicknamed the 'little Jiuhua of western Zhejiang', whose cliffs, caves and trees are read together as the face of a giant natural standing Buddha. Its main temple hall, dedicated to Ksitigarbha, is built into a cave in the cliff with half of it overhanging the drop, which has earned it the name 'hanging temple of Jiangnan', and cliff walkways and incense corridors lead around the rock.
description: 大慈岩位于浙江杭州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、洞穴、栈道。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Daciyan town about 2 hours by road from Hangzhou; Jiande South station on the Hangzhou–Quzhou high-speed railway (opened December 2025) is about 13 km away, and Xinye village is 5 km to the east.

name: 大明山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in Qingliangfeng town on the far western edge of Lin'an, on the border with Anhui, whose cliffs and rock pinnacles are often compared to Huangshan. Besides a gorge with waterfalls, a lake and upland meadows, it now offers a cliff swing, mountain go-karts, a long slide and guided stream walks.
description: 大明山位于浙江省杭州市临安区，海拔800米。是一个以良好的生态环境为基础，以悬崖峰林、峡谷飞瀑、高山原野为景观特色，以观光游览、避暑度假、生态养生为主的山水观光型景点，共有230个景源，为国家AAAA级景区，是临安唯一的省级风景名胜区。
accessEn: About 80 km by road west of central Lin'an and 110 km from Hangzhou; the Hangzhou–Huangshan (Hanghui) expressway passes at the foot of the mountain.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 杭州东方文化园
summaryEn: A large culture park opened in 2000 on the southern slopes of Yangqi Hill in Yiqiao, Xiaoshan, laid out on the eight trigrams and built around the three teachings of Confucianism, Buddhism and Daoism. It has a Guanyin square, a rebuilt Yangqi Chan Temple, a Daoist area and a Confucian temple, linked by a painted corridor over 2.7 km long, plus a resort area and gardens.
description: 杭州东方文化园是位于中华人民共和国杭州市萧山区义桥镇杨岐山南麓的主题乐园，为国家4A级景区。也是中国十佳主题公园之一。
accessEn: In Yiqiao town about 15 km south of central Hangzhou and of Xiaoshan; city buses stop at the park.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 杭州乐园
summaryEn: An amusement park opened in 1999 by the Songcheng group in the Xianghu resort area of Xiaoshan, with a suspended roller coaster, a log flume, a bungee jump and dozens of other rides, plus parades and stage shows. It suits families and ride fans.
description: 杭州乐园是位于杭州市萧山区湘湖路92号的游乐主题公园，是集旅游、休闲、娱乐、度假、居住为一体的大型旅游度假区。由杭州宋城旅游发展股份有限公司投资、开发和经营。
accessEn: In the Xianghu resort area of Xiaoshan, south of the Qiantang River, about 1 km from Xianghu station at the southern end of Metro Line 1. The park closes every winter and reopens in March.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 杭州长乔极地海洋公园
summaryEn: A marine theme park opened in 2008 in the Xianghu area of Xiaoshan, with themed halls of polar and ocean animals including beluga whales, dolphins, penguins, polar bears, Arctic wolves, seals and sea lions. It suits families, and a separate Changqiao children's park lies next door.
description: 杭州长乔极地海洋公园又名萧山少儿公园，是位于杭州市萧山区闻堰街道的一个极地海洋公园，地处湘湖旅游度假区区块。2008年10月1日建成开放。
accessEn: In Wenyan, Xiaoshan, about 2 km from Xianghu station at the southern end of Metro Line 1.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 杭州野生动物世界
summaryEn: A large safari park opened in 2002 in Yinhu, Fuyang, with about 200 species, among them giant pandas, crested ibises, white tigers, white rhinos and golden snub-nosed monkeys. Animals are seen from walking trails and from vehicles in a drive-through section, and the park also stages animal shows; it suits families with children.
description: 杭州野生动物世界位于中华人民共和国浙江省杭州市富阳区银湖街道九龙大道1号，是集动物保护与繁殖、科普教育与研究，以及野生动物资源利用与开发为一体的观光游览、休闲娱乐的综合性生态公园。被中国国家旅游局评定为“4A级旅游景区”，为“国家教育部濒危野生动物保护与繁育重点实验室、科学研究基地”、“浙江省濒危野生动物救护中心”、“浙江省青少年科普教育基地”。
accessEn: In Yinhu, Fuyang, about 20 km south-west of central Hangzhou, near East Safari Park station on Metro Line 6.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙门古镇
summaryEn: A clan town at the foot of Longmen Mountain on the south side of the Fuchun River, where more than 90 percent of the 7,000 residents are surnamed Sun and claim descent from Sun Quan, ruler of the Three Kingdoms state of Wu. Its lanes and long market street are lined with more than 40 Ming and Qing halls of the Sun clan, centred on two ancestral temples, as well as houses, brick memorial archways, a pagoda and footbridges, and the townspeople still live in them.
description: 龙门古镇位于浙江杭州。游览特色包括古镇、寺庙建筑、古塔。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 12 km south of Fuyang station on the Hangzhou–Huangshan high-speed railway, roughly an hour by road from central Hangzhou.

name: 清河坊
summaryEn: Described as the only fairly intact old street quarter left in Hangzhou, Qinghefang lies at the foot of Wu Hill and is named after the mansion of the Southern Song general Zhang Jun, Prince of Qinghe. Its spine is Hefang Street, a pedestrian street of old-style shopfronts and stalls, with side lanes such as Dajing Lane leading to the Hu Qing Yu Tang pharmacy and Hu Xueyan's mansion.
description: 清河坊历史街区，杭州历史上最著名的街区，也是杭州目前唯一保存较完整的旧街区，是杭州悠久历史的一个缩影。清河坊的得名，与南宋的太师张俊有关，建炎三年，张俊在明州击退金兵，取得高桥大捷，晚年封为清河郡王，倍受宠遇。
accessEn: In central Hangzhou next to Wushan Square, about 1 km east of West Lake.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 青山湖
summaryEn: A reservoir lake of about 20 km² on the eastern edge of Lin'an, built in 1964 for flood control on the Nantiaoxi river and now part of a national forest park. On its northern arm grows a 'water forest' of pond cypresses and redwoods planted in the water in 1977, and a 42 km greenway for cycling and walking circles the lake.
description: 青山湖，原名青山水库，位于中华人民共和国浙江省杭州市临安区，青山湖街道与锦城街道之间，因位于青山西南而得名。水库位于东苕溪主源南苕溪中下游，水域面积20.2平方公里。该水库是以一个防洪为主，兼有发电、灌溉、供水、养殖等功能的大型水库，为东苕溪防洪骨干工程的组成部分。
accessEn: On the eastern edge of Lin'an town; the water forest is about 1 km from Qingshanhu station on Metro Line 16, which links Lin'an with Hangzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 宋城
summaryEn: A theme park opened in 1996 on the south-western edge of Hangzhou, built as a Song-dynasty town with streets in old style, about 20 small theatres and staged street performances. Its main draw is The Romance of the Song Dynasty, an hour-long stage spectacle running since 1997 that retells episodes of Hangzhou's history and legend such as the White Snake story, and the park suits families and fans of big shows rather than visitors looking for historic buildings.
description: 宋城是杭州市的一个主题公园，位于中华人民共和国浙江省杭州市西湖区之江路148号。是中国最大的宋朝文化主题公园之一。由杭州宋城旅游发展股份有限公司投资、开发和经营。
accessEn: On Zhijiang Road about 10 km south-west of West Lake, by bus or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 严州古城
summaryEn: The old prefectural town of Meicheng, where the Xin'an and Lan rivers meet to form the Fuchun, which for about 1,200 years was the seat of Muzhou and later Yanzhou prefecture. Most of its walls, rebuilt in 1361, were pulled down in 1938, but a riverside stretch of about 380 m survives with two southern gates, and the lanes behind keep old houses, memorial archways and the Yuquan Temple alongside gates rebuilt or reopened in 2013–14.
description: 严州城墙，位于中国浙江省建德市梅城镇。严州城墙大部分已拆除，仅在南部沿江段尚存部分。2010年，严州古城墙遗址公布为建德市文物保护单位。
accessEn: In Meicheng, Jiande, about 8 km from Jiande station on the Hangzhou–Huangshan high-speed railway and under 2 hours by road from Hangzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 浙江美术馆
summaryEn: The provincial art museum, opened in 2009 on Nanshan Road beside West Lake, in a building of 32,000 m² with 14 exhibition halls. It focuses on modern and contemporary art, especially artists from or active in Zhejiang, alongside changing national and international exhibitions and holdings of older, folk and decorative art.
description: 浙江美术馆位于中华人民共和国浙江省杭州市西湖区南山路138号，毗邻西湖，占地面积3.5万平米，建筑面积3.2万平米。总投资人民币4.2亿元，由浙江省文化厅负责实施。2005年5月开工，2009年8月免费开放。
accessEn: On Nanshan Road by the south-eastern shore of West Lake, about 1 km south-west of Wushan Square. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 浙西大峡谷
summaryEn: A long valley system in the Qingliangfeng Nature Reserve of western Lin'an, where a headwater of the Qiantang River runs fast through steep-sided gorges in the outlying ranges of the Huangshan mountains. The developed stretch, the 18 km Longjing Gorge, has waterfalls, river pools and the narrow Jianmen Pass; a higher stretch of the valley is the only source of Changhua bloodstone, a red-mottled stone prized for carving seals.
description: 浙西大峡谷位于浙江省杭州市临安区境内的清凉峰国家级自然保护区内，是国家4A级旅游景区。由临安浙西大峡谷旅游开发有限公司开发运营。
accessEn: In Longgang town about 70 km by road west of central Lin'an.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 水口茶文化景区
summaryEn: Guzhu Mountain in Shuikou township grew Zisun ('purple shoot') tea, sent to the Tang court as tribute from 770, when a tribute-tea workshop was set up here, and Lu Yu, author of the Classic of Tea, studied tea on these hills. Officials who supervised the tribute, among them Yuan Gao and Du Mu, left inscriptions on the cliffs that survive in three groups. The scenic area centres on the rebuilt Great Tang Tribute Tea Institute, a hillside complex of Tang-style halls with tea-ceremony demonstrations, and also takes in Shousheng Temple and the tea village of Guzhu.
description: 水口茶文化景区位于浙江湖州。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、茶文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Guzhu village, Shuikou township, about 19 km north-west of Changxing station, roughly 30 minutes by road.

name: 原乡小镇
summaryEn: A rural leisure park opened in 2018 at Zhao village in the Xisaishan hills west of Huzhou, built around a large indoor butterfly house where visitors watch butterflies breed, emerge and fly. Plum and peach orchards, tea gardens, a hillside boardwalk, a small farm and children's play areas fill the rest of the valley, and it suits families with young children.
description: 原乡小镇，又称蝴蝶原乡小镇、原乡蝴蝶小镇、湖州中国原乡小镇，是一处位于中华人民共和国浙江省湖州市吴兴区妙西镇肇村的旅游景区，由湖州原乡假日小镇实业有限公司运营。位于西塞山旅游度假区内，总投资30亿元，用地面积1480余亩，于2016年启动建设，建设期为五年。
accessEn: About 7 km from Huzhou station, roughly 20 minutes by road from central Huzhou. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南北湖
summaryEn: A lagoon of about 1.2 km² near Ganpu on the Hangzhou Bay coast, divided into a south and a north lake by an old causeway and enclosed by wooded hills on three sides, with the sea to the south. Paths and a waterside greenway follow the shore, and trails climb Yingkeding, the highest hill in Jiaxing, a traditional spot for watching the sun and moon rise together over the bay around the first day of the tenth lunar month.
description: 南北湖风景名胜区是中华人民共和国浙江省一个融山、海、湖为一体的风景区，位于海盐县，是第一批浙江省省级风景名胜区、浙江十大“最佳休闲度假胜地”之一、国家AAAA级旅游区。
accessEn: In Ganpu town about 20 km south-west of Haiyan town by road; the main car park and east gate are on the lake's eastern side.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 绮园
summaryEn: A private garden in the centre of Haiyan laid out in 1871 by the merchant Feng Zuanzhai, who reused the rocks of two ruined Ming gardens; the garden historian Chen Congzhou ranked it first among the gardens of Zhejiang. About a hectare of old trees, three rockeries and two ponds crossed by zigzag bridges is set off by just four small pavilions and halls. At the front, one storeyed hall of the family house of 1870 survives behind a carved brick gateway.
description: 绮园俗称冯家花园，为位于中国浙江省嘉兴市海盐县武原街道海滨东路44号的一座中式古典园林，东西分别邻新桥北路和绮园路，南临海滨东路及市河，北临文昌东路。该园采用以自然山水景色为主的造园手法，既吸取了苏州、扬州园林的长处，又具有浙江地方特色，现为浙江保存最好、规模最大的私家园林，园林学家陈从周认为绮园“水随山转、山因水活”，赞誉“此园浙中数第一”。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Haibin East Road in central Haiyan (Wuyuan), about 40 km south-east of Jiaxing by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 方岩
summaryEn: A national scenic area of red Danxia rock east of Yongkang, where flat-topped Fangyan rises sheer from the plain and the classic way up is a steep stepped path of cut stone and timber known as the Flying Bridge. On top is a temple to Hu Ze, a Northern Song official worshipped locally as Hu Gong, whose temple fairs feature folk performances; nearby are the Five Peaks, where the Southern Song thinker Chen Liang taught and the Wufeng Academy grew up. During the war against Japan the Zhejiang provincial government was based here.
description: 方岩风景名胜区位于中国浙江省永康市方岩镇，距永康城区约20公里，海拔384米。1985年被批准为浙江省首批重点风景名胜区，1997年被评为“浙江十佳美景乐园”，2003年被列为国家重点风景名胜区，2004年被评为“浙江十大最具吸引力的旅游景点景区”，现为中国国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: In Fangyan town, about 20 km east of Yongkang city by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 牛头山
summaryEn: A national forest park in the mountains of western Wuyi County around Niutou Mountain, which at about 1,560 m is billed as the highest peak in Jinhua prefecture. Its forested valleys and streams are visited for walking, sightseeing and as a cool retreat in summer.
description: 牛头山位于浙江金华。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光、高山景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the mountains of western Wuyi County, roughly 1–1.5 hours by road from Wuyi county town.

name: 百山祖
summaryEn: At 1,856.7 m, Baishanzu is the second-highest peak in Zhejiang and the core of a nature reserve of about 109 km² in Qingyuan county, within the area proposed for the Qianjiangyuan–Baishanzu National Park. Its old forests shelter the Baishanzu fir, a conifer found only on this mountain and listed as critically endangered. The cool climate makes the villages around the reserve a popular summer retreat.
description: 百山祖国家级自然保护区位于浙江省庆元县，面积约108.8平方千米。管理处设于庆元县百山祖乡车根村，距庆元县城38千米，距丽水市261公里。主峰海拔1856.7米，为浙江第二高峰，享有“百山之祖”及“三江之源”之美誉。
accessEn: In Baishanzu town, about 38 km by road north-east of Qingyuan town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 宝溪
summaryEn: A mountain township in western Longquan whose village of Xitou has made celadon for centuries and was named one of UN Tourism's Best Tourism Villages in 2024. Seven old wood-fired kilns are still in use, the largest a long dragon kiln climbing a hillside, and firings draw visitors to watch the kilns opened. Nearby, a cluster of 18 bamboo buildings designed by architects from nine countries includes an exhibition hall of excavated and contemporary celadon.
description: 宝溪位于浙江丽水。游览特色包括主题展览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 40 km west of Longquan city, roughly an hour by mountain road.

name: 龙泉山
summaryEn: A mountain resort area on Fengyang Mountain inside the Fengyangshan–Baishanzu National Nature Reserve, crowned by Huangmao Peak, at 1,929 m the highest point in Zhejiang. With an average annual temperature of about 12 °C it is busiest in summer, and its upland meadows, winter rime ice and seas of cloud are the main sights.
description: 龙泉山位于浙江丽水。游览特色包括自然保护区。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 50 km south-east of Longquan city by mountain road; Longquan City station is on the Quzhou–Ningde railway.

name: 石门洞
summaryEn: A scenic area at Gaoshi on the Ou River that Tang-dynasty Taoists counted among the 36 lesser grotto-heavens. Its cliffs at Qigu Hill and the Moon Cave carry about 80 inscriptions and 25 carved steles from the 5th century to the 20th, including works attributed to Xie Lingyun, Shen Kuo, Ruan Yuan and Guo Moruo. Local legend holds that the young Liu Ji (Liu Bowen), the Ming founder's strategist, studied here.
description: 石门洞摩崖题刻位于浙江省丽水市青田县高市乡石门洞风景区内月洞旗鼓山处。唐代时，石门洞被列为道教三十六小洞天之第十二洞天。摩崖分布于旗鼓山16处，月洞64处，碑刻25通，是浙江省内摩崖题刻密度最高的地区之一。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 30 km by road from either Qingtian town or Lishui, both on the Jinhua–Wenzhou high-speed railway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 松阴溪
summaryEn: The Songyin is a 119 km tributary of the Ou River that rises in the hills of Suichang and flows east across the Songyang basin, past Songyang town, to join the main stream at the Tongji Weir in Liandu. Its reach through Songyang is listed as a scenic area, based on the south bank at Songyang town.
description: 松阴溪，位于中华人民共和国浙江省南部的一条河流，是瓯江大溪段左岸支流。上游称成屏溪，发源于遂昌县垵口乡北园村以南山区，蜿蜒向北偏东流，于遂昌县城妙高街道东北黄庄村转东南流，流经松阳县赤寿乡、新兴镇、古市镇、叶村乡、松阳县城、象溪镇、裕溪乡等地，于丽水市莲都区碧湖镇堰头村东南过通济堰后汇入大溪。
accessEn: Along the southern edge of Songyang town, about 6 km from Songyang station on the Quzhou–Ningde railway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 住龙
summaryEn: A mountain town on the upper Wuxi River in north-west Longquan that lay at the heart of the Communist base area in south-west Zhejiang in the 1930s and is promoted as "Zhejiang's little Jinggangshan". Riverside Red Army Street in Zhuxi village is lined with restored timber houses now used as guesthouses, teahouses and shops, and the restored seat of the Southwest Zhejiang Special Committee stands in nearby Xijing village. Zhulong is also a national historic and cultural town, visited for its river scenery, camping and spring cherry blossom.
description: 住龙位于浙江丽水。游览特色包括滨水景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 40 minutes by road north-west of Longquan city, which has a station on the Quzhou–Ningde railway.

name: 达蓬山
summaryEn: A 422 m hill near the coast north of Ningbo, renamed after the legend that the Qin-dynasty court sorcerer Xu Fu set sail from here for the islands of the immortals. The Youngor Group has developed it as a resort, with a Xu Fu culture park and Foji Temple in the forest park on the hill, a children's amusement park and lodgings. It suits a family day out or a hillside walk from Ningbo.
description: 达蓬山是中国浙江省宁波市一座山峰，山峰主体位于慈溪市龙山镇境内，部分位于镇海区九龙湖镇北部，海拔422米。达蓬山原名香山，后由于相传徐福曾经从此东渡蓬莱因而得名达蓬。目前，达蓬山由宁波雅戈尔集团开发，建有徐福文化园、佛迹寺、达蓬山庄等旅游设施和商务、住宿等设施，为中国国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: About 25 km north of central Ningbo near Longshan town in Cixi, roughly 40 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 九峰山
summaryEn: A forested range of hills in Daqi, Beilun district, with 26 peaks, two lakes and valleys of streams, pools, rock formations and waterfalls, and walking routes popular with Ningbo hikers; the Ruiyan Temple valley lies on its eastern side. Its old plum garden of more than 6,000 trees blooms in late winter, and in 2025 the scenic area added an evening tour with light displays and performances.
description: 九峰山位于浙江宁波。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the southern edge of Daqi in Beilun district, about 5 km from central Beilun and roughly 45 minutes by road east of central Ningbo.

name: 松兰山
summaryEn: A stretch of rocky headlands and small sandy bays on the open coast east of Xiangshan town, including East Beach, South Beach and Baisha Bay. In summer it is a busy seaside resort with a bathing beach and a sunrise pavilion, and the Zhejiang Ocean Sports Centre on its shore was the sailing venue of the Hangzhou Asian Games. It suits a beach day or a coastal walk.
description: 松兰山为中国浙江省象山县境内的一处滨海旅游景区。景区位于丹东街道和爵溪街道境内海岸，距离象山县城9千米，规划面积31.22平方千米，为国家4A级旅游景区、浙江省级旅游度假区。景区内山峰为天台山余脉，形成多处岛礁、岬角。
accessEn: About 9 km east of Dancheng, the Xiangshan county town; Damuwan station, the terminus of Metro Line 12 from Ningbo (opened in September 2026), is a short taxi ride away along Songlan Avenue.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 五龙潭
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in Longguan township, in the Siming foothills of south-western Haishu district, developed from 2000 around a stream that drops through a chain of five pools and waterfalls, each named after a dragon. A path climbs past rock inscriptions, cliffs and the pools to Yinglin Lake higher up, and a small Guandi and Dragon King temple, rebuilt many times, stands by the entrance.
description: 五龙潭是浙江省宁波市境内的一处山地旅游区，位于海曙区龙观乡境内，开发建设于2000年，开发面积16.17平方公里，是距离宁波市中心最近的山水生态旅游区，目前为中国国家4A级旅游景区。景区得名于五井龙潭，分为龙潭飞瀑、青云梯、鸣凤水三个景区，特色为自然山水风光、龙文化和山乡风情。
accessEn: In Longguan township in the hills of south-western Haishu district, about 35 km from central Ningbo, roughly an hour by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 古田山
summaryEn: A national nature reserve of about 81 km² in the mountains of western Kaihua on the Jiangxi border, set up in 1975 and upgraded in 2001 to protect subtropical evergreen broadleaf forest. Its wildlife includes Elliot's pheasant and the black muntjac, and the highest point, Shi'ershan, reaches 1,258 m. Part of the reserve is open to visitors as a scenic area, and the whole reserve lies within the Qianjiangyuan national park area at the source of the Qiantang River.
description: 古田山国家级自然保护区位于中国浙江省开化县，属于白际山脉的一部分，与江西省婺源县、德兴市毗邻，总面积8,107公顷。主峰青尖海拔1,258米，为典型的江南古陆强烈上升的山地地貌，属中亚热带湿润季风区。
accessEn: In the far west of Kaihua county about 30 km west of the county town, best reached by car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 浮盖山
summaryEn: A forested mountain on the Zhejiang–Fujian border just south of Nianbadu, an outlier of the Xianxia range whose 1,146 m summit lies on the Fujian side. On the Jiangshan side a scenic area has been laid out with walking trails, and Jiangshan promotes it together with Mount Jianglang and Nianbadu old town.
description: 浮盖山位于浙江省江山市廿八都镇与福建省浦城县盘亭乡交界处。又名盖仙山，为仙霞岭余脉。顶峰海拔1146.4米，位于浦城县境内。
accessEn: About 5 km south of Nianbadu, which is roughly 50 km south of Jiangshan city near an exit of the G3 expressway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 仙霞关
summaryEn: A fortified pass on the ancient Xianxia road over the Xianxia range, for centuries an important overland route between the Qiantang and Min river basins of Zhejiang and Fujian. Four stone gateways and about 5 km of stone-paved road survive; tradition says the road was opened by Huang Chao's rebel army in the late Tang. The pass was defended against the Qing by Southern Ming forces, and Chinese troops held the area against a Japanese advance in 1942.
description: 仙霞关位于中国浙江省江山市保安乡南部，为穿越仙霞岭的仙霞古道上的重要关隘，为浙、闽、赣三地要冲，素有“东南锁钥，八闽咽喉”之称，是目前保存最完整的唐末黄巢起义遗址，现存四道关门和五公里麻石垒砌的古道。
accessEn: In Bao'an township about 45 km south of Jiangshan city by road, on the way to Nianbadu.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 安昌古镇
summaryEn: An old canal town in northern Keqiao, named in the late Tang and listed among China's historic and cultural towns in 2005, with cobbled lanes and black-awning boats on its waterways.
