It is known for cured foods, with sausages, soy-sauce duck and dried fish hung under the eaves before the Lunar New Year, when the town holds a folk festival, and for the Renchang soy sauce works, founded in 1892 and still using traditional methods.
description: 安昌街道位于中华人民共和国浙江省绍兴市柯桥区北部，在柯桥街道以北7公里，北临杭州萧山区瓜沥镇，东临齐贤街道、南临华舍街道、西临钱清街道。该镇面积24平方公里，辖12个行政村、6个居委会。常住人口36480人。
accessEn: About 7 km north of central Keqiao and 18 km north-west of Shaoxing's old city by road; Shaoxing North high-speed station is about 6 km away.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大香林·兜率天
summaryEn: A Buddhist-themed scenic area in Hutang, Keqiao, at the western end of the Kuaiji hills, known for more than 400 mu (about 27 hectares) of sweet osmanthus trees, among them one over 1,000 years old that is billed as the 'King of Chinese Osmanthus'. Higher up stand Longhua Temple and the Doushuaitian (Tushita) palace, a hall built around a giant seated Maitreya Buddha. The trees flower in autumn, when the area is at its busiest.
description: 兜率天，又译为兜卒天、都率天、睹史多天、兜率陀天、率陀天，意思是“具有欢喜”，意译知足天、妙足天、喜足天、喜乐天，佛经记载乃“欲界六天”之第四天。
accessEn: In Hutang subdistrict, about 11 km south-west of central Keqiao and 18 km west of Shaoxing's old city, by road. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 西施故里
summaryEn: A tourist area of about 1.44 km² on both banks of the Huan River at the foot of Zhuluo hill in Zhuji, built by the city from 2003 around the legendary home of Xi Shi, one of the Four Beauties of ancient China. Its core is the Xishi Temple, completed in 1990 using more than 12,000 carved beams, brackets, windows and other parts salvaged from old houses across Zhuji, and around it are a hall of famous women, a shrine to Fan Li, a folk museum and a shopping street built in old style.
description: 西施故里旅游区于2003年初由浙江省诸暨市人民政府开始规划兴建，陆续建设至今，已建成一个横跨浣江两岸、总面积为1.44平方公里的人文风景旅游区。旅游区位于诸暨市城南苎萝山下，浣纱江畔，按不同的功能划分为“一轴一心六区”。
accessEn: On the southern side of central Zhuji, about 6 km from Zhuji station on the Shanghai–Kunming high-speed line.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 长屿硐天
summaryEn: A hill near Xinhe in Wenling honeycombed with man-made caverns left by some 1,500 years of quarrying stone slabs, now a national mine park and, with nearby Fangshan, a national scenic area. Linked halls, pillars and pools such as the Shuangmen, Guanxi, Shuiyun and Lingxiao caves can be explored on foot, and one cavern holds a giant carved stone bowl. It forms part of the Yandangshan Global Geopark, listed in 2005.
description: 长屿洞天位于浙江省温岭市新河镇，因长屿山中石矿资源丰富，经过南北朝以来1500年人工开采石板，形成了石洞群，共有28个洞群，1314多个硐穴，总面积为3.3平方公里。其与温岭的方山组成的方山·长屿硐天风景名胜区是中国国家重点风景名胜区，也是国家AAAA级旅游区。
accessEn: A few km south of Xinhe town and about 12 km north-east of central Wenling by road; Wenling station is about 13 km away.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大陈岛
summaryEn: A group of 29 islands and islets about 52 km off Taizhou, with Upper and Lower Dachen the two inhabited main islands, wooded hills that form a provincial forest park, sea-worn rocks, beaches and fishing harbours. The islands were held by the Republic of China until February 1955, when, after the loss of nearby Yijiangshan, its troops and the whole civilian population were evacuated to Taiwan under US Navy escort; Chiang Ching-kuo's former residence and old command posts and tunnels survive from that period. On Upper Dachen the Wushatou area has a cliffside walkway about 2.5 km long with a short glass skywalk.
description: 大陈岛行政上隶属于中华人民共和国浙江省台州市椒江区大陈镇，位于椒江区东南22公里的东海海上。大陈岛由“上大陈岛”和“下大陈岛”组成，同属台州列岛。下大陈岛是大陈镇的驻在地。
accessEn: About an hour or more by passenger boat from Jiaojiang to the pier on Lower Dachen; electric sightseeing buses run on both main islands, with extra services in the May–October peak season.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 九峰公园
summaryEn: A wooded hillside park on the eastern edge of Huangyan, named after the nine peaks that enclose its valley, opened in 1959 on the site of a Song-era monastery and a Qing academy and now covering about 106 hectares. Its oldest monument is the Ruilong Ganying Pagoda, a seven-storey, octagonal brick-and-timber pagoda 35.2 m tall from the 10th century, and paths lead on past springs, pools, waterfalls and pavilions towards the peaks. Local people come to walk and to fill bottles with spring water.
description: 九峰公园是中华人民共和国浙江省台州市黄岩区的一座公园，现占地112万平方米，是国家4A级旅游景区。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the eastern edge of Huangyan, a short taxi ride from the centre; Taizhou West station is about 6 km to the north.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 蛇蟠岛
summaryEn: An island in Sanmen Bay, joined to the mainland on its Ninghai side by land reclamation in 2008, known as the 'Island of a Thousand Caves' for the roughly 1,300 caverns left by quarrying its red Shepan stone from the Song dynasty onwards. At Gaolou Rock two linked caverns together reach the size of two basketball courts, with clear pools about 10 m deep, and Huangnidong village keeps 55 houses built of the local stone. The island also has shrimp ponds and seafood restaurants.
description: 蛇蟠岛位于中国东海三门湾中，属浙江省台州市三门县管辖，原面积为17.4平方公里，在玉环岛连陆后成为台州市第一大岛，2008年通过填海造地连接宁海县一市镇后成为半岛。现在南部隔蛇蟠水道与三门六敖镇相望，北部隔青山港、力洋港与宁海越溪乡、力洋镇、长街镇相望。
accessEn: About 18 km east of Sanmen county town (Haiyou); since 2008 reclaimed land has joined the island to Yishi in neighbouring Ninghai county, so it can be reached by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 台州海洋世界
summaryEn: An aquarium beside Taizhou Civic Square in Jiaojiang, opened in 2005 in a five-storey building that is toured from the top floor downwards. Its galleries cover a tropical rainforest, coral-reef life and an underwater tunnel, alongside some amusement facilities, and it is aimed mainly at families with children.
description: 台州海洋世界位于浙江省台州市椒江区台州市民广场西北侧，占地约15.5亩，为中国最高的海洋馆，浙江省最大的海洋馆，国内首创的都市型水族馆，建筑面积8903平方米，共分五层，是全世界为数不多的从上往下参观的水族馆之一，内有海洋生物约10000余只，分为热带雨林馆、珊瑚礁生物馆、海底隧道馆、等海洋生物展示和游乐设施，以及人鲨共舞、美人鱼等表演项目，于2005年5月1日正式对外开放。
accessEn: On the north-west side of Taizhou Civic Square in Jiaojiang, the city centre of Taizhou, by city bus or taxi. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 漩门湾观光农业园
summaryEn: A large agri-tourism park of nearly 10,000 mu (about 670 hectares) on the western edge of Qinggang town, Yuhuan, beside the Xuanmen Bay wetland and looking across Yueqing Bay to the Yandang mountains. It is divided into orchards, including a garden of pomelo varieties, a farming-culture area, a water garden, fishing ponds, a bird garden and a fishing-village area. It suits families and anyone curious about local fruit such as the Yuhuan pomelo.
description: 玉环漩门湾观光农业园，位于中华人民共和国浙江省玉环市西北清港镇西郊，可远观乐清湾跨海大桥，与玉环漩门湾湿地公园为邻。
accessEn: In Qinggang town about 13 km north of central Yuhuan, and about 6 km from Yuhuan station, opened in August 2026 on the Hangzhou–Taizhou high-speed railway. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中雁荡山
summaryEn: A national scenic area in the hills south-west of Yueqing, described as the 'toe' of the Yandang range and centred on Yuzeng Peak, a pale rock dome named for its resemblance to an ancient steamer pot. Trails link the peak with three lakes, Baishi, Zhongqian and Longshan, and with the waterfalls of the Xiji gorge, amid farmland villages. It is a separate area from the main Yandang Mountains 5A scenic area about 35 km to the north-east.
description: 雁荡山，是中国浙江省温州市北部乐清市境内的一座山峰。海拔500至600米，主峰百岗尖西峰海拔1108米。形成于距今1.28亿至1.08亿年间的四次火山喷发，为世界地质公园、首批中国国家重点风景名胜区和国家5A级旅游景区。
accessEn: About 10 km south-west of central Yueqing; Yueqing high-speed rail station in Baishi subdistrict is about 4 km away, then taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南麂列岛
summaryEn: An archipelago of 52 islands in the East China Sea off Pingyang, protected since 1990 as one of China's first national marine nature reserves and part of UNESCO's World Network of Biosphere Reserves since 1998, known for the variety of its shellfish and seaweeds. The main island, Nanji, has the Dasha'ao beach, sea-eroded headlands at Sanpanwei and cliff inscriptions at Guoxing'ao, a cove named after Koxinga, who used the island as a base in the 17th century.
description: 南麂列岛，简称南麂，谐音作南几、南杞、南纪、南屺、南岐、南箕等，是中国浙江省温州市平阳县位于外海的岛屿群，位于鳌江口外30海里的东海上，距温州市区50海里，距离钓鱼岛约300公里。南麂列岛由52个面积在500平方米以上的岛屿组成，其中最大的岛屿为南麂岛，面积7.64平方公里，因形似麂而得名。
accessEn: Passenger ships from Aojiang port in Pingyang take about 1½–2 hours; sailings stop in strong winds and typhoons.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 仙叠岩·半屏山
summaryEn: Two coastal sights in the Dongtou islands off the mouth of the Ou River. Banping ('half-screen') Island has a sheer east-facing sea cliff about 1.2 km long and 120 m high, said in local legend to be one half of a mountain whose other half lies in Taiwan, and a sandy beach at Dashalong on its north-west side; Xiandieyan, south-east of the Dongtou district centre, is a headland of stacked, wave-worn rocks. The cliffs show different shapes when seen from boats circling the island.
description: 半屏山，又称东雁荡山，是位于浙江省温州市洞头区北岙街道东南约3公里的一处海岛。岛屿南北约4公里，岛宽约200至1350米不等，总面积约2.3平方公里。岛东岸多为临海绝壁，崖面陡直，如同刀削斧劈；山体呈半月形，因此得名“半屏”。
accessEn: Dongtou is about 68 km by road from central Wenzhou over the Lingkun Bridge and the Lingni causeway; Banping Island is joined to Dongtou Island by the Banping Bridge.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 花鸟岛
summaryEn: The northernmost island of the Zhoushan archipelago, a small island whose blue-and-white painted village houses have earned it the nickname 'Santorini of the East', with clear-water bays, a sandy beach at South Bay and seasonal 'blue tears' of glowing plankton along the shore. On its north-western headland stands Huaniao Lighthouse, designed by the Scottish engineer David Marr Henderson and completed in 1870 to guide ships between the Yangtze mouth and the Pacific: a 16.5 m white-and-black tower with a copper dome, radio masts, service buildings and a fog signal, still in service. Visitor numbers on the island are capped each day.
description: 花鸟山，或称花鸟岛，是舟山群岛最北的一座岛屿，位于北纬30度51分，东经122度40分。行政上设立花鸟乡和花鸟社区，属于浙江省舟山市嵊泗县。因多生菊花、水仙花，岛形呈飞鸟状而得名。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Daily boats run from Shenjiawan pier, taking about 75 minutes on the fast ferry introduced in 2025 and longer on ordinary boats, with other sailings from Daishan's Yanwoshan pier and via Sijiao from Sanjiang pier in Dinghai; book ahead because of the daily cap.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 白崖寨
summaryEn: A mountain-top stronghold on Baiya Shan in Zhifeng township, first built at the end of the Yuan dynasty and enlarged in the late Ming and late Qing. A stone wall about 4 km round, with five gate towers, encloses surviving buildings such as a Guandi temple and a Kuixing pavilion. In 1932 the Red Army's 27th Army was formed here, and in 2024 the fortress drew new visitors as a model for scenes in the video game Black Myth: Wukong.
description: 白崖寨位于中国安徽省宿松县趾凤乡白崖山上，是一座防御性军事寨堡，2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。白崖寨始建于元末，明末及清末都曾扩建。寨墙周长4千米，高丈余，建有五座门楼。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Zhifeng township in northern Susong county, about 35 km by mountain road north of Susong county town, roughly an hour's drive.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 独秀园
summaryEn: A memorial park in the northern outskirts of Anqing built around the tomb of Chen Duxiu, a leader of the New Culture Movement, founder of the magazine New Youth and a founder and early leader of the Chinese Communist Party, who died in 1942. His remains were brought here in 1947, and the grave was rebuilt in 1979 and again from 1998. The park adds a bronze statue, a stone gateway, inscriptions from New Youth and an exhibition hall on his life.
description: 陈独秀墓是中国共产党的创始人陈独秀的墓地，位于安徽省安庆市大观区十里乡。现为全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Shilipu township, about 8 km north-west of central Anqing, roughly 20 minutes by taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 山谷流泉
summaryEn: A stream gully at the southern foot of Mount Tianzhu, beside Sanzu Temple, whose boulders and rock walls carry several hundred inscriptions from the Tang dynasty to the Republican era, most of them along a stretch of under 300 metres. They include poems, travel notes and names left by visitors such as Wang Anshi, Su Shi and Huang Tingjian, in every main script style. The gully, also called Shiniu Gudong (Stone Ox Ancient Cave), was landscaped as a culture park in 2009–2010.
description: 天柱山山谷流泉摩崖石刻，又称山谷流泉摩崖石刻，位于中华人民共和国安徽省安庆市潜山市天柱山风景区内，是分布于山谷溪流、崖壁和岩石上的历代摩崖题刻群。2001年6月25日，国务院公布第五批全国重点文物保护单位时，将其列入“石窟寺及石刻”类，时代定为宋至清，地址为安徽省潜山县，编号为5-0452-4-010。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Yezhai in Tianzhushan town, about 8 km north-west of Qianshan city, next to Sanzu Temple.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 皖光苑
summaryEn: A landscaped museum park in Meicheng, the centre of Qianshan, home to the Qianshan Museum and to memorial exhibitions on the novelist Zhang Henshui and on Cheng Changgeng, one of the founders of Peking opera. Its centrepiece is the Taiping Pagoda, a seven-storey octagonal brick pagoda rebuilt after a fire in 1154 and set inside and out with niches of brick-carved Buddhas.
description: 皖光苑位于安徽安庆。游览特色包括博物馆、古塔、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Meicheng, central Qianshan, about 1.5 km south of Tianzhushan railway station.

name: 蚌埠市博物馆
summaryEn: Bengbu's city museum, a national first-grade museum, which moved in 2015 into a large new building on the west side of Citizens' Square whose design evokes Yu the Great cutting through the mountains to channel the Huai. Its galleries cover the region's prehistory, the history and culture of the Huai River and the city's modern growth. Star pieces include a Neolithic clay human head with facial markings from the Shuangdun site and a Yuan-dynasty blue-and-white jar from the tomb of Tang He.
description: 蚌埠市博物馆，位于中华人民共和国安徽省蚌埠市蚌山区东海大道市民广场西侧，始建于1974年11月，是蚌埠市规模最大、安徽省仅次于省博物院的综合性博物馆，国家一级博物馆、国家4A级旅游景区，获“安徽省最美博物馆”荣誉称号。
accessEn: On the west side of Citizens' Square in eastern Bengbu, near Longzi Lake; closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 垓下遗址
summaryEn: An earth-walled settlement on the south bank of the Tuo River, known locally as Bawang Cheng (the Hegemon-King's City); excavations since 2007 have dated its walls to about 4,600 years ago, in the Dawenkou culture, and the county presents it as the oldest walled town found in Anhui. Tradition places here the Battle of Gaixia, where Xiang Yu heard the 'songs of Chu on all four sides' and parted from his consort Yu, and the archaeological park has spots linked to these stories alongside an intangible-heritage centre.
description: 垓下遗址是位于安徽省固镇县城东二十四公里处，濠城镇北、沱河南岸的一处城池遗址，俗称霸王城。曾以垓下城址之名列为安徽省文物保护单位。2013年，以垓下遗址之名列为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Just north of Haocheng town on the S304, about 24 km east of Guzhen county town and roughly 1–1.5 hours by road from Bengbu.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙子湖
summaryEn: A long, shallow lake on the eastern side of Bengbu, ringed by low hills and now enclosed by the growing city. Landscaped parks with lawns, wetlands and a long footbridge line both shores, and the scenic area also takes in Cao Shan, with the Bengbu Revolutionary Martyrs' Cemetery and the early-Ming tomb of Tang He.
description: 龙子湖是位于中国安徽省蚌埠市区东部的浅水湖泊，国家4A级旅游景区、国家级生态示范区和安徽省省级风景名胜区。水面南北长约8km，东西宽0.45-1.4km，平均水深1.7m，面积约8.4km2。龙子湖湖岸曲折多变，水面纵深开阔。
accessEn: On the eastern side of central Bengbu, about 2 km east of Bengbu Museum; the western-shore parks are easily reached by city bus or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 张公山公园
summaryEn: A city park of about 110 hectares in western Bengbu, made up of Zhanggong Shan, a 71-metre hill, and the lake beside it. The seven-storey Wanghuai Pagoda, built on the summit in 1986 and a city landmark, looks out towards the Huai River, while lakeside galleries, a classical garden-within-a-garden and a pearl-mussel sculpture at the south entrance fill the rest of the grounds.
description: 张公山位于中国安徽省蚌埠市禹会区，海拔71.2米，属涂山余脉，是蚌埠市禹会区的一处丘陵，山顶地势平坦，建有有望淮塔，现为张公山公园的一部分。张公山东侧有张公湖，湖面南北两侧分别连接迎河与席家沟。
accessEn: On Zhanggongshan Road in Yuhui District, in the west of central Bengbu; reachable by city bus or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 古井贡酒酿造遗址
summaryEn: The historic core of the Gujing Gongjiu distillery in Gujing town, where a Song-dynasty well, a Ming well and a set of fermentation pits in use since at least 1515, the date on a boundary brick found among them, are protected with the excavated remains of a Ming–Qing brewery. Around them the company's liquor culture park centres on a museum built in 1995, whose prizes include a Qing palace wine jar and samples of all 368 liquors entered in China's last national liquor competition in 1989, opposite a garden with a corridor of inscribed steles. The local liquor was sent as tribute to the Ming court, and the brand traces its method to a recipe Cao Cao presented to the Han emperor in 196.
description: 古井贡酒酿造遗址是位于中华人民共和国安徽省亳州市谯城区古井镇的古代酿酒工业遗址。该遗址是中国白酒品牌古井贡酒的历史源头与工艺基础，遗址包括明代古井、宋代古井、明清酿酒遗址和明清窖池群四个单体，其中明清窖池群最早可追溯于明朝正德年间，距今已有500多年历史，是中国目前连续使用时间最长的古窖池群之一。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Gujing town, about 20 km by road north-west of central Bozhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大愿文化园
summaryEn: A Buddhist-themed park at Kecun, the northern foot of Mount Jiuhua, built around a 99-metre bronze statue of Ksitigarbha, the bodhisattva of the mountain; the height stands for Jiuhua's 99 peaks and the 99 years of Kim Gyo-gak, the monk revered as his incarnation. Halls, pavilions, bridges and towers in a modern blend of Tang and Huizhou styles surround the statue.
description: 大愿文化园是一座位于中国安徽省池州市青阳县九华山北麓的佛教文化园风景区。景区占地约1500余亩，建有地藏菩萨铜像及殿堂厅馆、亭桥廊榭、塔台楼阁等配套景点与设施。地藏菩萨铜像高99米，是世界最高的露天地藏菩萨铜像。
accessEn: At Kecun beside the Mount Jiuhua visitor centre, where eco-buses leave for Jiuhua Street; about 6 km from Jiuhuashan station on the Chizhou–Huangshan high-speed railway (opened 2024) and about 40 km by road south-east of Chizhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 牯牛降龙门景区
summaryEn: The Shitai-county side of Guniujiang, a 6,700-hectare forest that has been a national nature reserve since 1988, Anhui's first forest-ecosystem reserve of that rank; its main summit, Guniu Dagang (1,727.6 m), is the third-highest peak in southern Anhui. Two areas are open to visitors: Longmen, with trails past Longmen Pool, a four-tier waterfall and old trees to Yanjia, an old village with a wall of Red Army slogans, and Shuanglong Valley, richest in the reserve's wildlife. A 2025–2026 upgrade added a hillside escalator, a natural-history hall and a 1.9 km twin-track glass water slide.
description: 牯牛降位于安徽省祁门县与石台县之间，面积约30平方公里，是黄山山脉向西延伸的主体。最高峰海拨1728米，被誉为“亚热带边缘的绿色自然博物馆”和“珍稀物种的天然基因库”。距离祁门县城65公里。
accessEn: In Dayan township, about 22 km by road south of Shitai town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 九华天池
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in south-eastern Guichi, developed from 2007 around the Siling Reservoir, a lake high in the hills known as the 'heavenly pool'. A trail of about 4 km climbs through the boulder-filled Glacier Stone Valley, named after ancient glaciation, to Longchi Falls and the lake, where boats cross the water; rafting and a zip line across a gorge are also on offer. At the entrance, Nuoxian Town, a street of new Huizhou-style buildings opened in 2024, stages evening shows built on local Nuo masked opera, with street processions, molten-iron 'fireworks' and aerial acts.
description: 九华天池风景区，位于安徽省池州市贵池区东南端，是中华人民共和国国家4A级景区、国家生态旅游示范区、国家级水利风景区之一。景区以山水民俗为主题。因“天池”建造于高山之上而得名。
accessEn: In Daling village, Maya, about 10 km south-east of central Chizhou and within about 10 km of Chizhou's railway stations and Jiuhuashan Airport; Nuoxian Town's evening shows are not held on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 齐山·平天湖
summaryEn: A 40 km² scenic area on the eastern edge of Chizhou that joins Qishan, a hill whose rocks carry cliff inscriptions left by visitors from the Tang dynasty to the Republic, among them a line attributed to the Song general Yue Fei, with Pingtian Lake and the wetland park on its southern shore. The lake, named after a line in Li Bai's 'Songs of Qiupu', is listed as a nationally important wetland, and its shores are laid out with paths and viewing points such as the Lotus Terrace.
description: 平天湖国家湿地公园位于中国安徽省西南部的池州市境内，地处长江和九华山之间。总面积约29.01km²。平天湖是池州市第二大湖泊。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the eastern side of central Chizhou, a short taxi ride from the city centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 秋浦河
summaryEn: A stretch of the Qiupu River near Shitai, the 'river of poems' where Li Bai stayed on five occasions and wrote his seventeen 'Songs of Qiupu'. The scenic area combines a 4 km raft run through 14 rapids, Qiupu Fishing Village, a farm-stay with a Li Bai exhibition hall and hot-spring baths, and Baizhangya, a gorge fitted with rope bridges, wire walks and other outdoor-adventure courses.
description: 秋浦河，又名秋浦江、云溪河、贵池江，是中国安徽省境内的一条河流，系长江下游支流。发源于安徽省祁门县境内，流经池州市石台县和贵池区，在贵池城区池口内河码头流入长江。干流全长150公里，流域面积约2235平方公里。
accessEn: In Jitan township, about 6 km north-west of Shitai town by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 仙寓山·榉根关古徽道
summaryEn: A mountain area in Xianyu town on the western arm of the Huangshan range, rising to 1,376 m, whose centrepiece is the Jugen Pass Ancient Hui Road: a 7.5 km stone-paved trade route of Tang origin by which Huizhou merchants carried tea and scholars' supplies, lined with old rest pavilions, inscribed steles and a stone-slab bridge of 1802. At the pass stands a stone wall and gateway built by Zeng Guofan's Hunan Army during the Taiping war. The scenic area also takes in Dashan, a village known for its selenium-rich farmland and long-lived residents, a stream gorge and a long dry toboggan run.
description: 榉根关古徽道位于中国安徽省池州市石台县仙寓山。2013年3月5日，被列为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xianyu town, roughly an hour by road south-west of Shitai town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 杏花村
summaryEn: A landscaped park on the western edge of Chizhou on the site that local tradition links to the 'apricot blossom village' of 'Qingming', the poem Du Mu wrote while prefect of Chizhou in the Tang dynasty; a Qing gazetteer of the village was included in the imperial Siku Quanshu collection. Apricot groves, streams and small bridges surround pavilions and halls named after poets, a poetry-reciting terrace and a wine shop.
description: 杏花村位于安徽池州。游览特色包括楼阁建筑、赏花。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the western edge of central Chizhou, a short taxi ride from the city centre. Check that it is open before going.

name: 明皇陵
summaryEn: The tomb that Zhu Yuanzhang, founder of the Ming dynasty, built between 1366 and 1379 for his parents, about 7 km south of Fengyang town, in the county where he grew up in a poor family. Its spirit way is lined with 28 pairs of stone figures carved by 1369, among them qilin, lions, tigers, rams, horses with grooms, civil and military officials and eunuchs, and the Great Ming Imperial Tomb Stele near the mound is a key source on Zhu's family. The statues and stele were damaged in the Cultural Revolution and re-erected during restoration from 1982.
description: 明皇陵是明朝开国皇帝朱元璋从龙凤十二年到洪武十二年为其父、母修建的陵墓，位于凤阳县城南七公里处。其中，《大明皇陵之碑》是研究朱元璋家世的重要史料。文化大革命期间，陵内石碑、石人石马以及皇城均遭损毁。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 7 km south of Fengyang town by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 颍州西湖
summaryEn: Yingzhou West Lake was a celebrated lake of Song-dynasty Yingzhou, today's Fuyang, praised by Ouyang Xiu and by Su Shi, who compared it with Hangzhou's West Lake, until Yellow River floods silted it up. The present lake was recreated from the 1980s about 4 km south-west of the old site and is now a national wetland park; its first phase, the South Lake area, combines wetland scenery with a historical and cultural zone devoted to Ouyang Xiu and Su Shi.
description: 颍州西湖地处安徽省阜阳城西北一公里新泉河两岸，是古代颍河、清河、小汝河、白龙沟四水汇流处。是安徽省级风景名胜区、省级自然保护区、国家湿地公园、国家AAAA级旅游景区。其与杭州西湖､惠州西湖并称中国三大西湖。
accessEn: About 15 km west of central Fuyang by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 合肥滨湖国家森林公园
summaryEn: A 10.7 km² wetland forest park on the north shore of Chao Lake near the mouth of the Nanfei River, opened in two phases in 2012 and 2013 and made a national forest park in 2013. Paths lead through plantations of poplar, dawn redwood and privet and around 2.6 km² of ponds and wetland, making it a good place to walk or cycle on the edge of the Binhu New District.
description: 合肥滨湖湿地森林公园，位于中国安徽省合肥市包河区大张圩附近，靠近巢湖北岸南淝河入湖口。2013年底，滨湖湿地森林公园成为合肥市第4个国家级森林公园。滨湖湿地森林公园总面积10.72平方公里，其中水域湿地面积2.63平方公里。
accessEn: In Baohe District about 18 km south-east of central Hefei, by bus or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 合肥植物园
summaryEn: A 70-hectare botanical garden on the south-eastern shore of Dongpu Reservoir in Hefei's Shushan District, established in 1987 on the site of a former horticultural farm. It holds more than 2,000 plant species in nine themed gardens, among them plum, osmanthus, bamboo, magnolia, pomegranate, water and bonsai gardens.
description: 合肥植物园，位于中国安徽省合肥市蜀山区董铺水库东南畔，总面积0.7平方公里。合肥植物园内有植物2000余种。合肥植物园内有梅园、桂花园、竹园、木兰园、石榴园、园林植物示范区、水景园、秋景园、盆景园9个植物专类园，并有三叠泉、湖滨绿色走廊、艺梅馆等景点。
accessEn: About 8 km west of central Hefei, by bus or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 姥山岛
summaryEn: A wooded volcanic islet of 0.86 km² in the middle of Chao Lake, 3.5 km off Zhongmiao on the north shore. On its summit stands the Wenfeng Pagoda, a seven-storey, 51-metre octagonal pagoda of dressed stone begun in 1631 and finished in 1878 at Li Hongzhang's initiative, which holds 802 brick-carved Buddhas and 25 inscribed plaques. A shrine on the hillside and a sheltered harbour on the south shore add to a half-day trip with wide lake views.
description: 姥山岛位于中国安徽省中部的巢湖湖心，是湖中最大的岛，隶属于合肥市巢湖市中庙街道办事处，面积0.86平方千米，海拔115米。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Boats cross Chao Lake to the island; the nearest shore is Zhongmiao in Chaohu, about 40 km south-east of central Hefei by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 紫蓬山
summaryEn: A range of low wooded hills in Feixi County south-west of Hefei, protected as a national forest park and laced with walking trails. Its main sight is Xilu Temple, a large Buddhist temple on the mountain.
description: 紫蓬山旅游开发区是依托紫蓬山建立的一个旅游开发区，位于中华人民共和国安徽省合肥市肥西县境内。由肥西县人民政府下属的紫蓬山旅游开发区管委会管辖，并以紫蓬山管委会之名列为庐江县的一个类似乡级单位。
accessEn: About 30 km south-west of central Hefei, roughly 45 minutes by car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 焦岗湖
summaryEn: A lake of about 40 km² on the north side of the Huai River in Huainan's Maoji district, cut off from the river by embankments in the 1950s and now a national wetland park and water-conservancy scenic area. Visitors boat through reed beds and lotus ponds, fish, and watch birds such as common cranes, and lakeside restaurants serve local salted duck eggs and wine-lees fish.
description: 淮南焦岗湖国家湿地公园位于中华人民共和国安徽省淮南市凤台县毛集实验区，是淮河中部北岸一个湖泊湿地，为安徽省颍上县与凤台县交界处。1950年代中淮河大堤修建后，与淮河的自然连通被阻断，仅通过圆心闸人工调节与淮河连通，并逐步被围垦，沿湖修建圈堤，圈堤内面积约40平方公里现已为长年积水湖泊，多数区域已被建为人工养鱼场，圈堤外已开垦为耕地，湿地面积已基本无存。
accessEn: In Maoji Experimental Zone, about 40 km west of central Huainan by road and about 3 km from Fengtai South station on the Shangqiu–Hefei–Hangzhou high-speed railway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙湖公园
summaryEn: Huainan's oldest public park, laid out around a lake in Tianjia'an District from 1957 and opened in 1980. Rebuilt in 2008, it has quiet garden areas, a waterfront, boating on the lake, a small animal and plant garden, children's rides and a food area, and is a pleasant stop for an hour or two in the city.
description: 龙湖公园位于安徽淮南。游览特色包括湖泊、乘船游览、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tianjia'an District, central Huainan.

name: 翡翠谷
summaryEn: A wooded valley in Shancha village below the eastern side of Huangshan, whose stream runs through a chain of clear green pools and small waterfalls. Also called Lovers' Valley after a group of 36 young Shanghai hikers who were stranded here in 1986, it was a filming location for 'Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon' and hosts the Huangshan Qixi (Chinese Valentine's Day) festival each summer.
description: 翡翠谷位于安徽黄山。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the G205 in Shancha village, about 8 km by road north-east of Tangkou town at Huangshan's southern gate.

name: 古城岩
summaryEn: A wooded rise beside the Heng River on the eastern edge of Wan'an town, with a Ming pagoda of the early Jiajing era (1520s), where since 1999 old buildings from around Xiuning county that could not be preserved where they stood have been moved and rebuilt. It now holds four stone memorial archways, six Ming and Qing houses, two ancestral halls and two other buildings, among them the Gulin double-chastity archway of 1730 and the hall of the Huang clan.
description: 古城岩位于中国安徽省黄山市休宁县万安镇东侧，西靠横江，东面皖赣铁路、齐云大道，四周群峰环抱，中间低矮，为一处易地迁移、集中保护休宁县境内不易就地保护的古民居、古牌坊等古建筑的场所。在原有古城塔的基础上，自1999年11月开始，共迁移复建明、清时期徽州典型的古牌坊4座、古民居6座、古祠堂2座和其它古建筑2座，其中以古林牌坊和黄家祠堂最具代表性。
accessEn: Beside Qiyun Avenue on the eastern edge of Wan'an town, Xiuning, about 12 km west of Tunxi by road. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 花山谜窟
summaryEn: A group of 36 large man-made caverns cut into the hills on the south bank of the Jian (Xin'an) River on the eastern edge of Tunxi, unrecorded in any historical source until they were found by chance in 2000. Stalactites inside are more than 1,700 years old, so the caves were dug no later than the Jin dynasty, but who made them and why is still unknown; some are held up by rows of stone pillars like underground halls, while others wind back to green pools.
description: 花山谜窟位于中国安徽省黄山市屯溪区东部，渐江南岸，与渐江组成花山谜窟-渐江风景名胜区，是国家重点风景名胜区，以花山石窟群之名列为安徽省文物保护单位。花山谜窟共有36座石窟，是目前中国已经发现的规模最大、谜团最多、面积最大的古石窟遗址。
accessEn: On the eastern edge of Tunxi towards Shexian, about 9 km east of Tunxi Old Street by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 九龙瀑
summaryEn: A waterfall described as the largest at Huangshan, which drops 360 m in nine stages over a 600 m course from the cliffs of Xianglu Peak into a U-shaped valley on the eastern side of the mountain, forming nine cascades and nine pools. The last and largest fall is 120 m high and more than 20 m wide, and its Xixi stream valley is a place to paddle in summer.
description: 九龙瀑是安徽黄山最大的瀑布，位于黄山市黄山区汤口镇苦竹溪村，黄山东坡的罗汉峰与香炉峰之间纵深6公里的U形谷中，紧邻205国道，距黄山南大门3公里。瀑布全长600米，落差360米，自香炉峰的悬崖上分成九折，盘旋折叠，跌水共达九次，飞流而下，形成九段飞瀑和九层水潭，因此命名为九龙瀑。
accessEn: In Kuzhuxi village, Tangkou town, beside the G205 about 3 km from the southern gate of Huangshan scenic area.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 屏山村
summaryEn: A village of the Shu clan on the Jiyang stream north-east of the Yi county town, settled at the end of the Tang, that keeps more than 200 Ming and Qing houses. Its two linked clan halls, the Qing Shu Guangyu Hall in front and the Ming Shu Qingyu Hall behind, are entered through a rare seven-eaved gate tower said to have been permitted by the Chongzhen emperor to honour a loyal official of the clan.
description: 屏山舒氏祠堂位于中国安徽省黄山市黟县宏村镇屏山村，包括一前一后两座保存完整的明清舒姓总宗祠，前面是建于清代的舒光裕堂，后面是建于明代的舒庆余堂。屏山舒氏祠堂气势恢弘，采用罕见的五彩牌楼门坊，门楼四柱三间五分楼，加上两侧八字墙，共有七个楼檐，系崇祯帝为褒扬忠臣舒荣都而特许，大厅悬挂的对联“源溯庐江，舒国舒城寻旧派；秀钟徽岭，长龄长演尽同根”，述说舒氏家族在唐末战乱期间从庐江避难来此的历史。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Hongcun town about 4 km north-east of the Yi county town, on the way to Hongcun.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 雄村
summaryEn: A village of the Cao clan on the Jian River in southern Shexian, listed as a national historic and cultural village in 2014. Its main sight is the Zhushan Academy, founded beside the river in 1755, with an octagonal pavilion, a Wenchang pavilion and halls over about 2,000 m², and the village also keeps a group of five stone archways, several old houses and the Taohua embankment along the river.
description: 雄村位于安徽黄山。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、楼阁建筑、书院文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xiongcun, about 6 km south of Shexian county town by road.

name: 白马尖
summaryEn: Baimajian, at 1,777 m the highest summit of the Dabie Mountains, rises in the far south-west of Huoshan County inside the Dabie Mountains nature reserve. The 4A Dabie Main Peak scenic area, a unit of the Dabie Mountains (Lu'an) National Geopark, also takes in the Longjing gorge, the Siwangbao lookout and Biehu Lake.
description: 白马尖，大别山第一主峰，位于大别山自然保护区。距安徽省霍山县县城约90公里，海拔1777米，为大别山最高峰。又名皖山，安徽省的简称皖，即得名于此。
accessEn: In Taiyang township, about 90 km south-west of Huoshan county town by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 梅山水库
summaryEn: Meishan Reservoir on the upper Shi River is one of the large reservoirs built to control the Huai River, supplying flood control, power and water for 3.83 million mu of farmland in Anhui and Henan. The old town of Jinjiazhai, which gave Jinzhai County its name, lies beneath the lake, and the present county town sits beside the dam. A national water-conservancy scenic area since 2004, the lake can be toured by passenger boat from a pier that opened in 2026.
description: 梅山水库位于中国安徽省六安市金寨县史河上游，是以防洪、灌溉、发电为主要功能的大型水库，也是治理淮河的重要水利工程之一。梅山水库是淠史杭灌区的主要水源之一，灌溉下游的安徽、河南二省五县区383万亩农田。
accessEn: Beside Jinzhai county town (Meishan town), about an hour by road from Lu'an.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 万佛山
summaryEn: Wanfo Mountain is a forested range in south-western Shucheng County, a national forest park and geopark of about 50 km² whose main peak, Laofoding, reaches 1,539 m. Trails climb past dozens of named peaks and rock formations, and the Jiutan valley holds a string of pools and waterfalls. Lesser sights include a small temple near the summit, a cave linked by legend to the monk Kim Gyo-gak before he went to Jiuhua Shan, and the site of a Red Army hospital.
description: 万佛山位于安徽六安。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑、地质景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 85 km south-west of Shucheng county town by road, or roughly two hours' drive from Hefei.

name: 响洪甸水库
summaryEn: Xianghongdian Reservoir on the West Pi River was built between 1956 and 1958 behind an 87.5 m concrete gravity-arch dam for flood control, irrigation and power, and is a main source of the Pishihang irrigation district. The long, winding lake between steep wooded hills is navigable for more than 20 km and is promoted locally as western Anhui's 'Little Guilin'; the dam and the lake views are the main sights.
description: 响洪甸水库位于中国安徽省六安市金寨县，是以防洪、灌溉、发电为主要功能的大型水库，也是治理淮河的重要水利工程之一。水库由上库，下库两部分组成。上库于1956年4月开工，1958年7月竣工，库容26.32亿立方米。
accessEn: At Mabu town, about 50 km south-west of Lu'an by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鸡笼山
summaryEn: Jilong Mountain is a forested hill of about 240 m in western He County, an outlier of the Dabie range with some 20,000 mu of woodland. Known as 'Little Jiuhua north of the Yangtze' and as the 42nd of the Taoist blessed places, it has a Taoist Sanqing Hall, the Sanhe altar, a 'Southern Gate of Heaven', a limestone cave and the Buddhist Fenglin Chan Temple. The rated scenic area also takes in Banyue Lake.
description: 鸡笼山位于安徽马鞍山。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、洞穴、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xibu and Shanhou towns, roughly 20 km west of He County town by road.

name: 凌家滩遗址
summaryEn: Lingjiatan, on the north bank of the Yuxi River, was a large late-Neolithic settlement of about 3800–3300 BC with double moats, a ritual altar platform and a cemetery rich in jade. Now a national archaeological park, it has a site museum opened in May 2025 that shows about 1,100 objects, among them jade human figures, a jade eagle bearing an eight-pointed star, an engraved jade plaque and an 88 kg jade pig found on top of the so-called 'king's tomb', 07M23. Lingjiatan ranks with the Hongshan and Liangzhu cultures as one of the three great jade-working centres of prehistoric China.
description: 凌家滩文化为中国新石器文化之一，分布地点在长江中下游的巢湖地区，凌家滩遗址位于安徽省含山县铜闸镇凌家滩村，地处裕溪河中段北岸，总面积约160万平方米，遗址约5000多年前为一处大型新石器时代晚期聚落。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Tongzha town, about 35 km south of Hanshan county town by road and about 4 km from Hanshan South station on the Shangqiu–Hefei–Hangzhou high-speed railway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 宿州市博物馆
summaryEn: The city museum of Suzhou in northern Anhui, opened in 2010 in a Han-style building on a raised platform and rated a national first-grade museum in 2020. Its upper floors trace the area's history with more than 700 objects, from early settlements and the Qin–Han period to the Sui–Tang canal, the Ming and Qing and modern times, while a ground-floor folk-art hall covers local opera, the Yongqiao circus tradition, crafts, painting and Lingbi stones.
description: 宿州市博物馆位于中华人民共和国安徽省宿州市埇桥区博物馆路1号、银河一路南侧和人民路西侧，宿州市人民政府对面。目前是国家一级博物馆、国家AAAA级景区、安徽省“十一五”十大地标性建筑、第四届安徽省爱国主义教育基地、第五届安徽省爱国主义教育基地、中国博物馆学会理事单位、安徽省研学旅行实践基地、安徽省博物馆协会常务理事单位。
accessEn: On Bowuguan Road in Yongqiao District, opposite the city government, in the west of central Suzhou. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大通古镇
summaryEn: Datong, on the Yangtze south-west of Tongling, was one of Anhui's main river ports, and the sandbank of Heyuezhou across the narrow Que River was from the 1860s to the 1930s a salt market and steamer landing nicknamed 'Little Shanghai', with three streets and thirteen lanes. Heyuezhou's streets burned in 1938 and floods and the decline of river trade later emptied it, leaving abandoned lanes, while Lanxi Old Street on the Datong side keeps its flagstones and old shopfronts and is busy with visitors and snack stalls on holidays. Datong is a national historic and cultural town.
description: 大通古镇位于安徽铜陵。游览特色包括古镇、商贸街区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km south-west of central Tongling by road.

name: 天井湖
summaryEn: A lake park of over 1,200 mu in the centre of Tongling, named after the 'heavenly well' on a small island in the lake. The 4A scenic area combines the lake with a copper-culture garden, a Jiangnan-style garden, a lakeside square and the North Lake, and makes a pleasant walk in the city.
description: 天井湖，位于中国安徽省铜陵市长江西路北侧，面积1200余亩。湖中有一小岛，岛上有口“上通天，下通海”的井，名曰天井，湖因此井而得名。
accessEn: In central Tongling, north of Changjiang West Road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 新四军军部旧址
summaryEn: From July 1938 to January 1941 the Communist-led New Fourth Army had its headquarters at Yunling, 25 km west of Jing county town, with its offices spread across 13 hamlets in a valley. Visitors see the command post in two former landlord houses at Luoli village where Ye Ting and Xiang Ying lived, the assembly hall in the Chen ancestral hall, the arms-repair workshop in a Guandi temple with a carved opera stage, and the memorial museum opened in 1985.
description: 泾县新四军军部旧址位于中国安徽省宣城市泾县云岭镇，1961年被列为第一批全国重点文物保护单位。1937年10月，南方八省的红军和游击队整编为国民革命军陆军新编第四军，或称“国民革命军新编第四军”，简称新四军。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Yunling town, about 25 km west of Jing county town by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黄田
summaryEn: Huangtian, in Langqiao town south of Jing county town, is a village of the Zhu clan founded in the Song whose Qing-dynasty houses survive in unusual numbers: 57 sites with 110 buildings. The best known is the Yangchuanwu, or 'foreign ship house' (Duchengtang), alongside halls such as Sishentang and Juxingtang, lanes with open and covered water channels, and the Fengzi River running past the village.
description: 黄田村位于中国安徽省泾县榔桥镇，是以朱姓为主聚居的村落，黄田村古建筑群于2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。黄田村始建于宋，现存清代建筑56处共135栋，总建筑面积三万多平方米。村内主要建筑有洋船屋、思慎堂、聚星堂、旗峰公家庙、敬修堂、崇德堂、思永堂、东新桥等。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Langqiao town, about 35 km south of Jing county town by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 敬亭山
summaryEn: Jingting Mountain is a range of low wooded hills on Xuancheng's northern edge, rising to 324 m at Cuiyun Peak, and is known as the 'poetry mountain' of the south. Xie Tiao wrote of it in the fifth century, and Li Bai climbed it seven times and left some 45 poems about it; Bai Juyi, Du Mu, Su Shi and many others followed. Paths lead from the forest-park entrance past tea gardens to viewpoints over the city.
description: 敬亭山位于中国安徽省宣城市区北郊的水阳江畔，属黄山支脉，山势呈西南—东北走向，大小山峰60座，拥有一峰、净峰、翠云峰三大主峰，最高峰翠云峰海拔324.1米。敬亭山原名昭亭山，西晋时为避晋文帝司马昭名讳，改称敬亭山。
accessEn: On the northern edge of Xuancheng, a short taxi ride from the city centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 青龙湾
summaryEn: Qinglongwan is the resort area around Qinglong Lake, the reservoir of the Gangkouwan dam west of Ningguo, where about 34 km² of water and 38 islands lie among forested hills. Boat services run on the lake, and the wider area takes in the Tang-founded Baiyun Temple on a summit and the Banqiao reserve, which keeps a large stand of natural evergreen chinquapin forest. It suits boating, lakeside walks and a quiet overnight stay.
description: 青龙湾国家森林公园，位于中华人民共和国安徽省宣城市宁国市皖南山区东缘。其属山地湖泊型景区，高峰绝顶建有唐朝白云禅寺，宋朝时亦称之为“铁瓦寺”。此外，青龙湾的秀云岛上建有惠云禅寺，宋朝大惠宗杲即在此僧度。
accessEn: About 10 km from central Ningguo by road to Zhoutang pier.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 查济
summaryEn: Zhaji, 60 km west of Jing county town, has been home to the Zha clan since the Sui dynasty and stretches for about 1.5 km along three streams. More than 140 old structures survive, among them the Yuan-dynasty De Gong Hall, Ming and Qing ancestral halls such as the Baogong and Erjia halls, old village gates, pagodas and dozens of stone bridges. It is a national historic and cultural village and a popular base for art students who come to sketch.
description: 查济村是中国安徽省宣城市泾县桃花潭镇下辖的一个村，由查村和济阳村组成，位于县城以西60公里。查济村自隋朝起为查氏家族所居，村落民居沿三条溪水绵延三里，至今仍保存有四门、三塔，红楼桥、天申桥、麟趾桥等三十余座石桥和元代建筑德公厅屋及宝公祠、二甲祠、洪公祠、馏公祠等明清建筑200多处。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 60 km west of Jing county town by road, near Taohuatan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 毛泽东才溪乡调查旧址
summaryEn: Buildings in Xiacai village, Caixi town, linked with Mao Zedong's third visit to Caixi in 1933, when he carried out a social survey of the township and wrote it up as 'The Caixi Township Investigation'. The group is made up of the former Caixi district soviet office, the district trade union hall known as Lenin Hall, the Glory Pavilion and the Lenin Platform.
description: 毛泽东才溪乡调查旧址群，位于中国福建省龙岩市上杭县才溪镇下才村，包括才溪区苏维埃旧址、才溪区工会旧址、光荣亭、列宁台。1985年10月11日公布为第二批福建省文物保护单位。2013年3月5日公布为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xiacai village, Caixi town, about 30 km north of Shanghang county town by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 和平古镇
summaryEn: Heping, in the south-west of Shaowu, grew up in the Tang and Song and flourished in the Ming and Qing as a rare walled market town, and is now a national historic and cultural town. Gate towers survive at the east and north gates with stretches of wall, and a flagstone main street about 600 m long runs past nearly 200 Ming and Qing buildings, among them the Heping Academy, a scholar-official's mansion and the county assistant magistrate's office. The Ming Jukui Pagoda also stands in the village.
description: 和平古镇位于福建南平。游览特色包括古镇、书院文化、历史宅院。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 40 km south-west of Shaowu city, under an hour by road.

name: 洋口红色旅游小镇
summaryEn: Yangkou, on the Futun stream 12 km from Shunchang county town, was long a river port and market for north-western Fujian and in the 1930s was counted among the province's four best-known towns. In August 1933 the Red Army's East Army under Peng Dehuai held the town for 39 days and set up a soviet government, and the red-tourism town presents restored sites from that time, among them Peng Dehuai's office, the East Army political department and the soviet government office, together with a Red Army bridge and an exhibition hall on the town's revolutionary history.
description: 洋口红色旅游小镇位于福建南平。游览特色包括红色文化、商贸街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yangkou town, about 12 km from Shunchang county town by road.

name: 鲤鱼溪·九龙漈
summaryEn: This 4A area joins two places near Zhouning town that together form a 13.5 km² national scenic area within the Ningde UNESCO Global Geopark. Jiulongji is a staircase of nine waterfalls dropping some 300 m over about 1 km through a gorge in volcanic rock. In the old village of Puyuan, settled by the Zheng clan in the early 13th century, villagers have long protected the carp in the stream that runs through it, a custom now on Fujian's provincial intangible heritage list.
description: 九龙漈景区，全称九龙漈国家级风景名胜区，位于中华人民共和国福建省宁德市周宁县，得名于九条以龙为名的瀑布群。九龙漈景区位于平均海拔880多米的福建海拔第一高县，地处欧亚大陆板块与西太平洋大陆边缘活动带之间，拥有独特的火山岩地质地貌，优良的生态环境以及独具一格的人文景观。
accessEn: Jiulongji is about 13 km by road from Zhouning town and Puyuan village about 5 km. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 九鲤湖
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in Zhongshan town, Xianyou, named after the legend of nine immortals who rode carp up to heaven. It is known for its lake, caves, rocks and above all the upper five of the Nine Cascades waterfalls, and the Ming traveller Xu Xiake, who came in 1620, ranked it with the Wuyi Mountains and Yuhua Cave as one of Fujian's three wonders. The area is also known for its tradition of dream divination, and an old trail restored in 2023–24 links it with Jiulonggu Forest Park downstream.
description: 九鲤湖（兴化平话字：Giû-lî-ó，国际音标：[kiu˨˩li˥˥ɔu˩˧]）位于福建省莆田市仙游县钟山镇，距县城31公里。相传汉武帝时，安徽庐江何氏九仙在此并跨鲤升天，故得名。九鲤湖是国家级水利风景区，景区内林木葱茏，千岩竞秀，怪石嶙峋，瀑流泱泱，自古以来就以湖、洞、瀑、石四奇著称，尤以飞瀑为最。
accessEn: In Zhongshan town, about 31 km north-east of Xianyou county town, roughly an hour by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 九仙山
summaryEn: A mountain of about 1,650 m in northern Dehua, on the meeting point of Chishui, Shangyong and Daming townships, with a scenic area of about 35 km² known for rime ice on its trees in winter. A Song–Yuan stone Maitreya statue, protected by the province, and a weather station stand on the mountain.
description: 九仙山位于福建泉州。游览特色包括高山景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In northern Dehua county, about 45 km by road from Dehua town.

name: 清水岩
summaryEn: A mountain temple in Penglai town, Anxi, where the Northern Song monk Qingshui Zushi practised, and the mother temple of his cult, which spread with emigrants to Taiwan and South-East Asia. A pilgrims' stairway climbs to the main Penglai ancestral hall, and the grounds include a sacred spring, an ancient camphor tree, a square pond and a tree whose branches are said all to point north.
description: 安溪清水岩，是位于中国福建省安溪县蓬莱镇的佛教寺庙，也是中国国家4A级旅游景区与朝圣旅游地。安溪清水岩有蓬莱祖殿、朝圣台阶、清水山门、圣泉、窥天古樟、方鉴塘、枝枝朝北和清水法门等景点，因北宋时，高僧清水祖师即在此地修行，其中蓬莱祖殿主要是供奉清水祖师，也是风行台湾与南洋的清水祖师信仰发源地。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On a mountainside in Penglai town, about 15–20 km north-west of Anxi town by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 石牛山
summaryEn: A granite mountain in Shuikou town, north-eastern Dehua, named after a great rock on it that looks like a bull, and protected as a national forest park and national geopark. Its main peak rises to 1,782 m, and it is known for steep peaks, oddly shaped rocks and caves, the Daixian twin waterfalls with a total drop of 314 m, and the Shihu Temple, a folk-Taoist shrine.
description: 石牛山位于福建泉州。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑、地质景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Shuikou town, about 40 km north-east of Dehua town by road; a cable car runs up the mountain.

name: 安贞堡
summaryEn: A huge fortified earthen house in Huainan town, Yong'an, built in 1885–99 by the local gentleman Chi Zhanrui and his son to protect their family from bandits, which it did through three sieges. Behind outer walls of stone and rammed earth 9 m high and 4 m thick, pierced by nearly 200 firing holes, more than 360 rooms are arranged in three courtyards rising 4 m up the slope, and the halls keep a wealth of murals and wood carving. It is regarded as the largest surviving earthen fort in the Sanming area.
description: 安贞堡，又名池贯城，位于中华人民共和国福建省三明市永安市槐南镇，是一座由当地池氏家族修建的土堡。安贞堡修建于清光绪十一年，其目的是为了防御土匪骚扰。整座院落坐西朝东，前后高差4米，外墙为防御性建筑，其内有360余间民居。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Huainan town in eastern Yong'an, roughly an hour's drive from Yong'an city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 桃源洞·鳞隐石林
summaryEn: A Danxia landscape scenic area of about 29 km² north-east of Yong'an city, made up of Taoyuan Cave, Baizhang Rock and three other zones; its best-known sight is Yixiantian, a cleft 90 m high and 127 m long that narrows to 0.4 m and is climbed by 206 steps. Rebels of Deng Maoqi's Ming-dynasty uprising held a stockade here, and three gates and stretches of wall remain. The listing also covers the Linyin Stone Forest, a 1.2 km² field of rock pillars about 13 km north-west of the city.
description: 桃源洞是一个位于福建省永安市的景点，总面积为28.78平方公里，由桃源洞、百丈岩、修竹湾、葛里、栟榈潭五大景区组成。桃源洞是明朝邓茂七农民起义军屯兵之处，邓茂七之侄邓伯孙在此设寨固守，至今仍存三道寨门和围墙的遗迹。
accessEn: Taoyuan Cave is about 8 km north-east of Yong'an city by road; the Linyin Stone Forest is in Dahu town on the north-western side.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 万寿岩遗址
summaryEn: A small, isolated limestone hill at Yanqian, west of Sanming, whose caves hold the oldest known traces of people in Fujian: stone tools from Lingfeng Cave have been dated to about 185,000 years ago, and Chuanfan Cave preserves a stone-paved floor and drainage channel some 30,000–20,000 years old. Saved from quarrying in 2000, the site has had a museum since 2006, the only museum of a Palaeolithic site in Fujian, and opened as a national archaeological site park in 2019. The surrounding Wanshouyan culture-and-tourism town adds parkland, a children's play area themed on early cave life and a library branch in a converted steelworks building.
description: 万寿岩遗址位于中华人民共和国福建省三明市三元区岩前镇岩前村，是旧石器时代人类活动遗址，2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。万寿岩是一座孤立的石灰岩小山峰，山上有船帆洞、灵峰洞、龙津洞等溶洞，山南是一片临水的小盆地，适合古人类居住。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Yanqian town about 20 km west of central Sanming by road; a city bus route has served the site since 2020. The museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 玉华洞
summaryEn: A limestone cave often described as the largest in Fujian, at the foot of Tianjie Mountain south-east of Jiangle town, with about 6 km of passages through six chambers and three underground streams thick with stalactites and stalagmites. The traveller Xu Xiake explored it in 1628 and compared it favourably with Zhanggong Cave in Yixing, and 17 inscriptions from the Song to the Republican period survive at the entrances and inside.
description: 玉华洞位于中国福建省三明市将乐县城东南5千米的天阶山下，面积43平方公里，是福建省最大的溶洞。玉华洞主要是由沉积的石灰岩经地壳抬升和流水冲刷、溶蚀和切割而成，其洞内岩石光洁如玉、华光四射，因而得名。因其喀斯特岩溶地貌景观和保护完好的山峰植被，玉华洞风景区被列为第四批国家重点风景名胜区。
accessEn: About 5 km south-east of Jiangle town, a short taxi ride.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 厦门园林博览苑
summaryEn: The site of the 6th China International Garden and Flower Expo in 2007, built on Xinglin Bay in Jimei by cutting channels through the bay's central islands to form nine islands joined by 16 bridges. About half of its roughly 10 km² is water, and the islands are laid out as gardens in many different styles, now used for flower shows, recreation and outdoor learning.
description: 厦门园林博览苑，简称厦门园博苑，是由中华人民共和国建设部和厦门市人民政府共同主办的2007年第六届中国国际园林花卉博览会的举办地，位于中华人民共和国福建省厦门市集美区杏林街道杏林湾。
accessEn: On Xinglin Bay in Jimei District; Yuanbo Yuan station on Metro Line 1 is at the park, about 30 minutes from central Xiamen.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 三平寺
summaryEn: Sanping Temple, in the hills of Wenfeng town in eastern Pinghe, grew from the retreat where the Tang Chan monk Yizhong (781–872), revered as the Sanping Patriarch, preached from the 820s. Its present buildings are Qing, and it keeps an edict plaque from Emperor Xuanzong of Tang granting him the title Guangji Dashi, a stone image of the patriarch and a camphor-wood statue of him with movable limbs. Worship of the patriarch spread with emigrants to Taiwan and South-East Asia and is listed as national intangible cultural heritage.
description: 三平寺是一座位于中国福建省漳州市平和县文峰镇三平村的清代古寺，为闽南著名的千年古刹，有唐宣宗敕封的“广济大师”圣旨牌、三平祖师公真容石刻神像、四肢关节可以活动的樟木祖师公雕像、毛氏洞石幢和众多碑铭石刻等文物，2005年5月11日公布为第六批福建省文物保护单位。
accessEn: In Sanping village, Wenfeng town, about 20 km east of Pinghe county town (Xiaoxi) and roughly an hour by road south-west of Zhangzhou city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南武当山
summaryEn: A national scenic area of 13.5 sq km in Wudang town, near the Guangdong border, where 99 red-rock peaks rise from the valley beside National Road 105 to a main summit of 864 m. A stepped path climbs onto the elephant-shaped rock masses, and a suspended walkway, glass walkways, a glass bridge and a viewing platform run among the peaks. The name Wudang comes from a couplet that the Ming philosopher Wang Yangming wrote after climbing it.
description: 南武当山，又称小武当山，位于江西省赣州市龙南市武当镇境内，地处赣粤交界处，距离龙南市中心约40公里处。主峰海拔864米。
accessEn: In Wudang town beside National Road 105, about 33 km south-south-west of Longnan town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中共苏区中央局旧址
summaryEn: A former Gong clan ancestral hall, known locally as Xinwu ('new house'), in Chikan village beside Xiaobu town: a south-facing brick-and-timber building restored in 2008. On 15 January 1931 the Soviet-area Central Bureau of the Communist Party and a central revolutionary military commission were set up here, and Mao Zedong lived in the building. It is the centrepiece of the Xiaobu scenic area, which has a visitor centre and some 18 sites of the early 1930s, among them Zhu De's former residence, the First Front Army headquarters and hundreds of wall slogans.
description: 中共苏区中央局旧址位于中国江西省赣州市宁都县小布镇赤坎村，1987年被列为江西省文物保护单位。2013年被列为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。旧址原为“龚氏宗祠”，俗名“新屋”，座北朝南。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Chikan village beside Xiaobu town, about 38 km north-north-west of Ningdu town (roughly 60 km by road).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 寻乌调查旧址
summaryEn: A two-storey house of timber and earth with cobble-and-lime walls and a wooden arcade on its south front, built in 1917 as the home of an American missionary at the Matigang Catholic church in the county town. In May 1930 Mao Zedong and Zhu De brought the Fourth Red Army to Xunwu, and the army's front committee and Mao lodged here while he carried out a survey of the county's economy and society. It stands in an experience park in the same neighbourhood with a memorial hall on the survey, the county martyrs' memorial hall and a red-culture street opened in 2024.
description: 寻乌调查旧址位于中国江西省赣州市寻乌县长宁镇中山路136号，原为马蹄岗天主堂，1987年被列为江西省文物保护单位。2013年被列为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。马蹄岗天主堂始建于1917年，原为美国牧师雪莱·鲍斯费尔德住房，坐北朝南，土木结构两层楼房，墙体为鹅卵石三合土砌成，四面坡小青瓦顶，南面建有3米宽的木质骑楼，整栋楼房东西长25.1米，南北宽13.9米，建筑面积349平方米。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the south of Changning, the county town of Xunwu. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 阳明山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park of about 69 sq km on the Hunan–Guangdong–Jiangxi border, rising to 1,259.5 m beside the county town of Chongyi. It was once called Guanyin Mountain, then Yangling in memory of the Ming official Wang Yangming, who put down a rebellion here and set up Chongyi county, and it took its present name in 2017. Its sights include the Lanxi gorge and falls, a small lake called Xiaoyangming Lake, Yunyin Temple and a large bamboo forest.
description: 江西阳明山国家森林公园是位于中华人民共和国江西省赣州市崇义县的国家森林公园，位于湘、粤、赣三省交界处。古称观音山，后为了纪念王阳明在崇义县平叛立县，更名为阳岭，2017年1月，经国家林业局批准正式更名为江西阳明山国家森林公园。
accessEn: The entrance is about 3 km south of Chongyi town, on the edge of the county town, and Ganzhou is about 65 km to the east-north-east.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 白水仙
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area at Baishui village in Bizhou town, known for waterfalls, bamboo and rocks and listed as a provincial scenic area in 1995. The three-tier falls near the Baishuixian temple drop about 86 m, 50 m and 30 m, and the area also has the Seven Star Falls, a narrow cleft about 200 m deep called One-Line Sky, and rock features such as Eagle Beak Cliff. The name comes from the temple, built to honour three sisters recorded in a Qing gazetteer as having become immortals.
description: 白水仙，又叫纸白水仙，是水仙属的一个种，种加词的意思是“纸一样的”。它原产于地中海附近的欧洲和北非地区，是一种较为常见的观赏植物。
accessEn: At Baishui village, Bizhou town, about 21 km east of Quanjiang, Suichuan's county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 陂下古村
summaryEn: A village of the Hu clan on the Fushui River in Futian town, founded in the Tang dynasty, with 36 ancestral halls, 18 old wells, three memorial archways, an old academy and polygonal halls rarely seen elsewhere. It was also a base of the 1930s Communist regional government: the first Party congress of south-west Jiangxi met from 22 to 29 March 1930 in the Hu clan's general ancestral hall (Dunren Hall), a nationally listed brick-and-timber building, and the Gonglüe county government moved to the village in 1932. A company now runs the village for visitors, with festival events and a riverside eco-park nearby.
description: 陂下古村位于江西吉安。游览特色包括古村落、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Bixia village, about 2.5 km south-west of Futian town and about 41 km south-east of Ji'an.

name: 东固革命根据地
summaryEn: A She ethnic township in the hills of Qingyuan District that became a Communist-held base area after the Donggu uprising of November 1927 and was a main battleground of the first three Nationalist encirclement campaigns of 1930–31. On its main street stands the nationally listed site of the Donggu Civilian Bank, set up in 1928 and merged into the Chinese Soviet state bank in 1932, and the Donggu Revolutionary Base Museum, in a former forestry-station building, shows more than 200 documents and objects on the base and the second campaign of spring 1931. The Donggu martyrs' cemetery joined the national list of martyrs' memorial facilities in February 2025.
description: 东固平民银行旧址位于中国江西省吉安市青原区东固畲族乡街道中心，1987年被列为江西省文物保护单位，2013年被列为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。1928年春，黄启绶等人办起了东固平民借贷所。同年10月，中共东固区委、红二团决定以平民借贷所为基础创办东固平民银行，黄启绶任行长。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Donggu She ethnic township, about 59 km south-east of Ji'an, in the hills of Qingyuan District. The Donggu Revolutionary Base Museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 吉州窑
summaryEn: The site of a pottery town at Yonghe that made wares from the late Tang to the early Ming, best known for black-glazed tea bowls with leaf and paper-cut decoration. The national archaeological site park keeps 24 kiln mounds, and the Jizhou Kiln Museum shows white, green, qingbai and black-glazed wares, tea bowls, pillows, toys and figurines. A dragon kiln rebuilt in the 1980s is used for wood-firing events, and Yonghe is itself a listed historic town.
description: 吉州窑，是江西省吉安县永和镇的古窑，创于唐代，盛于宋代。共有舒、陈、郭、周、谢五窑，以舒瓮烧制的瓷器最著名，舒瓮的女儿舒娇工艺更好，所烧制的瓷器和哥窑比美。吉州窑瓷以白色和紫色为主，和定窑瓷相似。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Yonghe town, about 10 km south-south-east of Ji'an. The Jizhou Kiln Museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 马家洲集中营旧址
summaryEn: A camp run by the Nationalist provincial government in Taihe from 1940 to 1945, officially the Jiangxi Youth Training Institute, where almost 500 prisoners, among them senior Communist Party members, were held before the camp moved away in January 1945. The surviving site covers about 5,000 square metres, with the Wang clan ancestral hall, a row of three village houses that includes the main confinement room, 18 smaller houses and an old camphor tree. A memorial park, rated a national 4A scenic area as the Majiazhou Revolutionary History Memorial Park, has been built beside it.
description: 马家洲集中营旧址位于中国江西省吉安市泰和县马市镇仙桥村，1984年被列为泰和县文物保护单位，2019年被列为第八批全国重点文物保护单位。抗日战争爆发后，南昌在1939年3月被日本占领，江西省政府和国民党江西省党部迁至泰和县。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xianqiao village, Mashi town, about 15 km west-south-west of Chengjiang, the seat of Taihe county.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 渼陂古村
summaryEn: A village of more than a thousand years on the Fushui River in Wenpi town, promoted as a water-town "generals' village" and developed for visitors with a visitor centre, a trading street, a Wanshou Palace and water activities. Two national heritage sites stand here: the Liang clan's Yongmu Hall, which served as the Red Fourth Army's headquarters in 1930, and the site of the Beitou conference of 7 to 9 February 1930, at which Mao Zedong chaired a joint meeting of Party and army committees that adopted a land law. The listing also covers the home of Liang Xingchu and the Fourth Army's health-corps site at Mingde Hall.
description: 渼陂红四军总部旧址位于中国江西省吉安市青原区文陂乡渼陂村，原为梁氏宗祠永慕堂，2013年被列为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。一同列入保护的有渼陂梁兴初故居、渼陂红四军卫生队旧址。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Meibei village, Wenpi town, about 23 km south-east of Ji'an.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 八里湖
summaryEn: A lakeside leisure area in Jiujiang's Balihu New District, rated 4A in 2015, with Haiyun Beach, Balihu Park and Wenbo Park around the shore of Balihu Lake. The new district also has a poetry gallery, a museum and a city exhibition hall near the water. It suits an easy walk or picnic rather than sightseeing.
description: 八里湖是一个位于中国江西省八里湖新区的湖泊，面积约为6平方千米。
accessEn: Haiyun Beach, the main lakeside spot, is in Jiujiang's Balihu New District on the south-west side of the city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 博阳河
summaryEn: A river-valley leisure area on the Boyang River at Niejiao town, in wooded hills with farmland along the banks. The main activity is rafting, on a 3.5 km course through woods and fields that suits the warm months, and the valley has also hosted a local folk-culture festival. It was rated 4A in 2020.
description: 博阳河，是中国长江流域的一条河流，汇入鄱阳湖，属于鄱阳湖水系。河长105千米，流域面积1354平方千米，多年平均流量立方米每秒。
accessEn: In Niejiao town, about 13 km north-west of De'an town and about 41 km south-west of Jiujiang. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 陈门五杰故里
summaryEn: A village scenic area built around Fengzhutang, the Chen family's old house at Zhuduan, listed nationally as the former residence of Chen Baozhen and Chen Sanli. The family produced five well-known figures: the reforming official Chen Baozhen, the poet Chen Sanli, the painter Chen Hengke, the scholar Chen Yinke and the botanist Chen Fenghuai. The older block of the house dates from 1793 and has a central courtyard, the newer block from the Guangxu reign, with flagpole stones in front, and the village has a folk-experience area on Hakka farming customs.
description: 陈门五杰故里位于江西九江。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、名人故居。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Zhuduan village, about 14 km east-south-east of Xiushui town.

name: 李渡烧酒作坊遗址
summaryEn: This is a distillery site of the Yuan to Qing dynasties, found in 2002 when an old workshop of the Lidu liquor works was being rebuilt, and named one of China's top ten archaeological discoveries of that year. The excavation turned up 22 cellars, 13 of the Yuan and 9 of the Ming, six of which are still in use, together with wells, hearths and two distillation bases. Visitors can see the old cellars and demonstrations of traditional brewing, and the site is also on China's list of national industrial heritage.
description: 李渡烧酒作坊遗址位于中国江西省南昌市进贤县李渡镇江西李渡酒业有限公司内，又称李渡无形堂元代烧酒作坊遗址，是目前中国发现的时代最早、遗迹最全、遗物最多、延续时间最长的古代烧酒作坊遗址，对烧酒的起源有重要研究价值，2002年被评为全国十大考古新发现，2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Lidu Avenue in Lidu town, inside the grounds of the Lidu liquor company, about 19 km south-south-west of Minhe, the county town of Jinxian.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天香园
summaryEn: Tianxiang Garden is a 1,150 mu (about 77 hectares) former horticultural farm turned wetland park in Qingshanhu district, on the eastern side of Nanchang, where lakes and marsh draw large flocks of wild birds. Birdwatching is the main draw, and in spring the garden holds a peony festival.
description: 天香园，原名西湖园艺场，位于江西省南昌市城郊青山湖区境内，园区占地1150亩，园内湿地、湖泊、原始沼泽串通成片，野生候鸟群30余种，几十万余只。天香园原为江西境内一大型盆景基地和花卉基地，园内及周边自然环境优越，以吸引大批鸟禽栖居形成的“都市候鸟”奇观著称，后逐渐被发展为国内少有的都市内候鸟观测基地，每年吸引这大批的候鸟观测爱好者。
accessEn: On Qingshan Lake South Avenue in Qingshanhu district, on the eastern side of Nanchang, close to the Aixi Lake wetland.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 怀玉山
summaryEn: The Huaiyu hills in north-west Yushan County, next to Mount Sanqing, rise to Yungai Peak (1,538 m) and Yuya Peak (1,380 m) and have been a place of learning since the Southern Song, when Zhu Xi lectured here. In January 1935 the Red Army's 10th Army Corps was defeated in the Huaiyushan campaign in these hills, and Fang Zhimin, a leader of the Min-Zhe-Gan base area, was captured. The Qingpin Garden has a statue of Fang Zhimin and a stele carved with his essay 'Qingpin', and is a stop on a Fang Zhimin heritage route launched in 2025.
description: 怀玉山，广义指怀玉山脉，位于中国江西省东北部，东起玉山县、德兴市与浙江省开化县交界处，西延至鄱阳湖平原。长百余千米，是信江与乐安江的分水岭。主峰玉京峰位于玉山县北境，海拔1817米，玉京峰与玉华峰、玉虚峰合称三清山。
accessEn: In Huaiyu township in the north-west of Yushan County, about 35 km north-west of Yushan town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 灵岩洞
summaryEn: Lingyan Cave is a group of 36 limestone caves in the mountains of northern Wuyuan, whose walls carry more than 2,000 inscriptions left by visitors over the centuries, among them the words 'Wu Hui Zhu Xi' linked to the philosopher Zhu Xi. The inscriptions have been a provincially protected site since 2006, and the surrounding hills became a national forest park in 1993 and a provincial scenic area in 1995.
description: 灵岩洞位于江西上饶。游览特色包括洞穴、森林公园。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Dazhangshan township, about 34 km north-west of Wuyuan town.

name: 大茅山
summaryEn: Damaoshan is a mountain of the Huaiyu range in the south-east of Dexing, with a main peak of 1,392 m, and has been a national scenic area since 2012. The scenic area has three parts: the mountain itself, Wufengdong, known for rock formations, clear pools and streams and sites from the revolutionary period, and Shuangxi Lake, a reservoir south-west of the main peak. Bamboo groves and mountain streams line the valley, and the area suits a day trip from Dexing.
description: 大茅山位于中国江西省德兴市东南部花桥镇、龙头山乡、绕二镇三乡镇交界处，属怀玉山脉，主峰海拔1392米。大茅山风景名胜区于2001年12月被列为县级风景名胜区；2004年3月被列为省级风景名胜区；2012年10月被列为国家级风景名胜区。
accessEn: In the hills about 21 km east-south-east of Dexing city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上饶集中营
summaryEn: From March 1941 to mid-1942 the Nationalist government held captured New Fourth Army officers and other Communist-aligned prisoners at several sites around Shangrao, and the national listing covers prison sites at Maojialing, Zhoutian, Licun and Qifengyan. At Maojialing, in the south of the city, the original prison site stands beside a memorial cemetery, a monument and a memorial museum that opened in 1978 and has had a new building since 2005. In May 1942 a group of prisoners escaped from Maojialing, and the camp was moved to Fujian the following month.
description: 上饶集中营位于江西省上饶市城区南部，是国民政府在1941年3月至1942年6月间囚禁共产党领导的新四军及其他共产党员的集中营。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Maojialing on Lingyuan Road, in the southern part of Shangrao's urban area (Xinzhou District), beside the memorial museum, which is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 铜钹山
summaryEn: Tongbo Mountain is the highest part of Guangfeng, a forested ridge of the Wuyi range on the Fujian border whose main peak reaches 1,534.6 m; its northern slopes have been a national forest park since 2002. The visitor area is built around Jiuxian Lake, a large reservoir among the hills, with other areas such as Baihuayan in the surrounding hills. It suits a day of lake and forest scenery in the mountains south of Guangfeng.
description: 铜钹山位于江西省广丰县铜钹山镇与上饶县、福建省浦城县、武夷山市交界处，属武夷山脉，主峰铜钹山尖为全县最高峰，座落于广丰与浦城县交界处，海拔1534.6米，位于广丰县境内的其它较高山峰有双峰尖、上加尖、青草弯、悟道尖、湖洋岗、黄泥山、蒋尖、湖山尖、长排尖等。
accessEn: In Tongboshan town, about 25 km south-south-east of Guangfeng town, close to the Fujian border.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 汪口
summaryEn: Wangkou is an old trading village of the Yu clan, founded in the early 12th century and surrounded by water on three sides, which lay on the land route from Huizhou through Wuyuan to Raozhou; its shops and merchants flourished in the Ming and Qing dynasties. A county-protected group of more than twenty old houses, halls, bridges and wharves survives, and the Pingdu weir across the river is provincially protected. The Yu clan ancestral hall (Renben Hall, built in 1736) is one of the national-level Wuyuan ancestral halls, and the village is a China Historic and Cultural Village (third batch).
description: 汪口村位于中国江西省上饶市婺源县江湾镇，古称永川，是中国历史文化名村。汪口三面环水，宋大观三年由俞杲建村，是一个以俞姓为主聚族而居的徽州古村落。历史上文风鼎盛，中进士者有14人，出任七品以上官员73人。
accessEn: In Jiangwan town, about 17 km north-east of Wuyuan town and about 6 km west-south-west of Jiangwan old town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 铜鼓秋收起义纪念地
summaryEn: A group of sites in Yongning, the county town of Tonggu, centred on the Xiao ancestral hall, a two-block timber-and-earth building of the 1870s on Dingjiang East Road. In August 1927 a Liuyang peasant force took up quarters there, and on 10 September Mao Zedong, then secretary of the front committee, announced its reorganisation as the 3rd Regiment of the First Division of the Workers' and Peasants' Revolutionary Army and briefed officers on the plan for the Autumn Harvest Uprising. A memorial hall beside it, completed in 1977, covers the uprising.
description: 湘赣边界秋收起义前敌委员会旧址位于中国江西省宜春市铜鼓县永宁镇定江东路487号，原系“萧永翁祠”，俗称萧家祠，1983年被列为铜鼓县文物保护单位，1987年列为江西省文物保护单位，2013年被列为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Dingjiang East Road in Yongning town, the county town of Tonggu. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 阁皂山
summaryEn: A Daoist mountain south of Zhangshu, regarded as the ancestral mountain of the Lingbao school of Daoism and counted as the 36th of Daoism's blessed lands. Relics include the Chongzhen Palace, an immortals' bridge, a pool for releasing animals and an alchemy well, and the Song-dynasty Mingshui Bridge, built in 1111 across a gorge. That bridge is a single stone arch 7.3 m long, with a 34-character dedication carved on its sides, and is a national heritage unit.
description: 阁皂山位于江西宜春。游览特色包括峡谷、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Geshan town, about 19 km south-south-east of Zhangshu.

name: 三爪仑
summaryEn: A forested valley area in northern Jing'an county, run as a national forest park and best known for river rafting and a small forest train. The park is divided into the Kuang Zhong garden, Luojiaping, Baofeng and Panlong Lake zones, and the white cliffs of Baiya Mountain are among its sights. It was rated national 4A in 2007.
description: 三爪仑位于中华人民共和国江西省宜春市靖安县北部三爪仑乡，三爪仑国家森林公园是国家级示范森林公园，国家AAA级景区。由况钟园林景区、骆家坪景区、宝峰景区、盘龙湖景区组成。景区内旅游以漂流为特色。
accessEn: In Sanzhualun township, about 23 km north-north-west of Jing'an town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 杜受田故居
summaryEn: This is the former home of Du Shoutian, a Qing scholar-official who served as an imperial tutor, in Binbei, north of Binzhou city. The courtyard compound dates from the Wanli era of the Ming and once had hundreds of rooms in some 28 courtyards, but only the embroidery tower, a reception hall and parts of the main and side ranges survive, in the plain northern-Shandong style of the Ming and Qing. Plaques over the gate and hall record the family's official ranks, and the house is also a provincial integrity-education base.
description: 杜受田故居，位于山东省滨州市滨城区滨北街道。是中华人民共和国山东省省级文物保护单位之一。2013年，列入第四批山东省文物保护单位，该文物保护单位是一座古建筑。
accessEn: In Binbei, about 11 km north of Binzhou city centre; reached by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 千年枣林景区
summaryEn: This rural tourist area in Zhuji town, Leling, is built around old jujube (Chinese date) orchards, with more than a thousand trees that the local government says are over 1,000 years old, a garden of nearly 600 jujube varieties and a 'mother-and-child' tree of more than 700 years. Inside it stands the Jilu Border Region Memorial Park, opened in 2014, with a museum on the Jilu Border Region, a wartime anti-Japanese base area across northern Shandong and neighbouring parts of Hebei, plus a memorial plaza, a martyrs' stele forest and a tunnel exhibit. It suits a half-day in early autumn, when the fruit ripens.
description: 乐陵千年枣林景区是位于山东省乐陵市的国家4A级旅游景区，地处朱集镇内，境内有冀鲁边区革命纪念馆和冀鲁边拓展训练基地、百枣园等。是德州市的主要乡村旅游A级景区之一。
accessEn: In Zhuji town, about 5 km north-east of Leling city centre; the pin is at the memorial park. The memorial museum is closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天宁寺
summaryEn: Tianning Temple is a large modern Buddhist temple complex in the west of Kenli district, built beside the Tianning Lake wetland park; its main hall was consecrated in 2013 and the area was rated 4A in 2014. The temple has a main hall and a relic pagoda surrounded by side halls, and the city culture and tourism bureau lists a folk-culture street, a Buddhist academy and a riverside park among the wider area's facilities. It suits visitors interested in contemporary Chinese Buddhist architecture and a quiet wetland setting.
description: 天宁寺位于山东东营。游览特色包括湿地、寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shengtuo town in the west of Kenli district, about 27 km north-west of Dongying city centre, reached by road.

name: 宏济堂中医药文化旅游景区
summaryEn: A tourist area built by the Hongjitang pharmaceutical group in the Linuo Science Park, laid out in late Ming and early Qing style around a lake modelled on a smaller Daming Lake. It has the Shandong Hongjitang Museum of Chinese medicine, a 456 m relief wall on the history of Chinese medicine, workshops where gelatin and other products are made, and a garden of medicinal plants. It suits visitors curious about traditional medicine.
description: 济南市宏济堂中医药文化旅游景区，位于中国山东省济南市历城区经十东路30766号力诺科技园内的一座中医药文化主题养生旅游度假区，国家AAAA级旅游景区，由山东宏济堂制药集团股份有限公司投资建设。
accessEn: In the Linuo Science Park on East Jingshi Road, Licheng district, about 20 km east of central Jinan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 济南野生动物世界
summaryEn: A safari-style wildlife park in the hills of Zhangqiu District, with a walking area in the north and a drive-through area in the south. Its attractions include a sea lion hall, a kangaroo park, an elephant house and a crocodile pond, and in summer 2026 it ran a night zoo with a train ride and staged performances. It suits families with children.
description: 济南野生动物世界是位于中华人民共和国山东省济南市章丘区柳埠国家森林公园跑马岭的一个野生动物园。
accessEn: In Bucun subdistrict, Zhangqiu District, about 40 km east of central Jinan and about 7 km south of the junction of Jingshi East Road and Bucun Road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 莲花山
summaryEn: A representative scenic area of Laiwu's southern hills, named for its ring of peaks, which resemble a lotus. It has 36 summits and 72 valleys, with gorges, odd rock formations, caves, waterfalls and pools, and its main peak, Lianhuajian, is about 991 m, the highest in Jinan. It was rated a 4A scenic area in 2023.
description: 莲花山位于山东济南。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Gaozhuang subdistrict, about 19 km by road south of the centre of Laiwu district.

name: 宝相寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple in the north-west of Wenshang town, renamed Baoxiang by a Song emperor. Its centrepiece is the Taizi Lingzong Pagoda, a Song-dynasty brick pagoda that is itself a national protected monument; the crypt beneath it was opened in 1994 and yielded Buddhist relics, among them one venerated as a Buddha tooth.
description: 宝相寺位于山东济宁。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、古塔、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the north-west of Wenshang county town, about 36 km north-north-west of Jining city centre.

name: 峄山
summaryEn: A granite hill south of Zoucheng, known in ancient times as Dongshan, the "eastern mountain" that the Mencius says Confucius climbed. Its slopes have granite outcrops, caves and Ming and Qing rock inscriptions, along with rebuilt academy buildings and a cave academy traditionally linked with Confucius. It is also a provincial scenic area and a national forest park, and suits a half-day walk.
description: 峄山，古称东山，位于中华人民共和国山东省邹城市区南10公里处，海拔582米，约形成于25亿年前，属花岗岩构成的山岳型自然保护区，是国家4A级旅游景区，省级风景名胜区，国家级森林公园，省级地质公园。《孟子·尽心上》的“孔子登东山而小鲁，登泰山而小天下”中的“东山”说的便是此山。
accessEn: About 10 km south-south-east of Zoucheng city centre, which is itself about 40 km east of Jining.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南阳古镇
summaryEn: Nanyang is a small town on a long, narrow island in Nanyang Lake, one of the Four Lakes of southern Shandong, with the old Grand Canal running along it. After a lock was built there in 1331 it grew into a busy canal port and was nicknamed 'second Jining' in the Ming and Qing periods. It is promoted as part of the Weishan Lake tourism area.
description: 南阳古镇位于山东济宁。游览特色包括古镇、湖泊、运河。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On an island in Nanyang Lake in Weishan County, about 36 km south-south-east of Jining city centre.

name: 明鲁王陵
summaryEn: The tomb of Zhu Tan (1370–1390), tenth son of the Ming founder, the Hongwu Emperor, and the first Prince of Lu, at the southern foot of Jiulong Mountain. The underground chambers were excavated in 1970–71, yielding more than 2,000 objects, and have been open to visitors since 1988; a second excavated tomb, that of a consort, lies about 60 m to the west. Many of the finds are displayed in the Shandong Museum in Jinan.
description: 明鲁王墓，是明朝鲁藩王族位于中华人民共和国山东省的墓葬群，包括鲁荒王陵、鲁靖王墓、鲁钜野王墓。鲁荒王陵为明太祖朱元璋的第十子鲁荒王朱檀的陵墓。朱檀死于洪武二十二年十二月十五日，葬在山东邹城九龙山麓。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 8 km north of Zoucheng city centre, at the southern foot of Jiulong Mountain, and about 40 km east of Jining.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 羊山战斗纪念地
summaryEn: A hill and village site where, in July 1947, forces of the People's Liberation Army under Liu Bocheng and Deng Xiaoping fought the Nationalist 66th Division in the Southwest Shandong Campaign. A martyrs' cemetery and memorial tower were built on the eastern summit in 1950, and the Southwest Shandong Campaign Memorial Museum stands in the grounds. The surrounding tourist area adds military-themed attractions and a street built in old style.
description: 羊山战斗纪念地，位于山东省济宁市金乡县羊山镇羊山集村，是中华人民共和国山东省文物保护单位之一。1992年6月12日，授予山东省文物保护单位，是一座革命遗址及革命纪念建筑物。2019年10月，列入第八批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Yangshan town, about 14 km north-north-west of Jinxiang county town and about 40 km south-west of Jining; the memorial museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东昌湖
summaryEn: Dongchang Lake surrounds the square, walled old town of Liaocheng and began in 1070, in the Northern Song period, as the town moat. Today it covers over five square kilometres with a shoreline of about 16 km, a lakeside park along the west shore and the Grand Canal passing beside it. It suits an easy walk or boat trip, with the old town's main sights (Guangyue Tower, the guildhall, the iron pagoda) around it.
description: 东昌湖旧称护城河、环城湖，位于中华人民共和国山东省聊城市城区内的一个人工湖泊，系由原护城河的基础上扩建而成，由10个湖区和20个水面组成，总面积5平方公里，湖岸线长16公里，是中国北方最大的城内人工湖泊。
accessEn: In the middle of Liaocheng city, ringing the old town, with the lakeside park on its west shore.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 景阳冈·狮子楼旅游区
summaryEn: This 4A area pairs two Water Margin sites in Yanggu County. Jingyang Ridge, where the novel has the outlaw Wu Song kill a man-eating tiger, is a wooded sand ridge with a Wu Song temple, a mountain-god shrine, a stele garden and a lake, and it stands on a Neolithic Longshan-culture walled town known from excavation rather than visible remains.
