The Lion Tower district in Yanggu old town, about 18 km west, has a Song-style tavern building and a recreated shopping street from the story.
description: 景阳岗，位于山东省阳谷县张秋镇境内。传为《水浒传》中描述的武松打虎处，也是龙山文化城遗址所在地。总占地面积33.3公顷。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: The ridge is in Zhangqiu town, about 17 km east of Yanggu county town, where the Lion Tower stands in the old centre; Yanggu is about 40 km south-south-west of Liaocheng.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鱼山曹植风景区
summaryEn: This scenic area on Yushan hill beside the Yellow River holds the tomb of Cao Zhi, the poet-prince of the Three Kingdoms period; it was begun in 233 AD, opened by archaeologists in 1951 and has had its chamber sealed since. The visit takes in the burial mound and memorial buildings, a Sui-dynasty stele and several hilltop viewpoints. It was rated a 4A area in December 2024, and the tomb has been a national protected monument since 1996.
description: 曹植墓，是曹魏陈王曹植之墓，普遍上认为位于山东省东阿县西南10公里鱼山西麓，另有河南省通许县东12.5公里处七步村的曹植墓一说。东阿县的曹植墓1951年曾进行发掘，出土文物曾收藏于北京中国历史博物馆。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the west side of Yushan beside the Yellow River, about 18 km south-south-west of Dong'e county town and about 37 km south-east of Liaocheng, reached by road along Tongyu Road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 山东省政府和八路军115师司令部旧址
summaryEn: A manor of the Zhuang family, built in the Ming and Qing dynasties in Dadian town, which in the 1940s housed the Eighth Route Army's 115th Division headquarters and the Shandong provincial government set up under the Communist Party. The compound has the former provincial government and division headquarters buildings, exhibition halls on the Shandong anti-Japanese base area and the Zhuang family's gardens and former homes. It is a national patriotic-education demonstration base and was included in a national list of 100 red-tourism routes in 2021.
description: 山东省政府和八路军115师司令部旧址位于山东省临沂市莒南县大店镇，是当地明清时期晋绅——庄氏家族所修建的一处群团式地主庄园。1996年，八路军一一五师司令部旧址被公布为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。2006年12月7日，山东省政府旧址被公布为第三批山东省文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Dadian town, about 19 km north-north-west of Junan county town and about 50 km north-east of Linyi city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 九间棚
summaryEn: Jiujianpeng is a mountain village at about 640 m on Longding Mountain in Difang town, whose people once lived in a natural rock shelter and later built roads, brought in electricity and terraced the slopes. Visitors come for the terraced orchards and honeysuckle fields along a hill road of about 10 km (the 'Nine Bends, Eighteen Gardens'), the village exhibition hall and its story as a rural self-help model known as the 'Jiujianpeng spirit'.
description: 九间棚，位于山东省平邑县地方镇。是中华人民共和国山东省省级文物保护单位之一。2013年，列入第四批山东省文物保护单位，该文物保护单位是一座古建筑。
accessEn: In Difang town, about 26 km south-south-east of Pingyi town, reached by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 孟良崮
summaryEn: Menglianggu is a small mountain of about 1.5 sq km in Mengyin County where, in May 1947, People's Liberation Army forces surrounded a Nationalist army unit in the Menglianggu campaign of the Chinese Civil War. A memorial museum stands nearby and a monument on the hill, and a live-action show called 'Heroes of Menglianggu' is staged in the area. The museum became a national defence education demonstration base in 2015.
description: 孟良崮位于山东省蒙阴县东南垛庄镇全桥村的芦山，属蒙山山系，面积仅1.5平方公里，海拔500米，传说因北宋抗辽名将孟良曾屯兵于此而得名，并于1947年孟良崮战役后闻名中外。
accessEn: Near Duozhuang town in Mengyin County; the summit monument is about 5 km north-east of Duozhuang, 26 km east-south-east of Mengyin county town and about 60 km north-north-west of Linyi city. The memorial museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天上王城
summaryEn: Tianshang Wangcheng occupies the flat top of Jiwang Gu, a cliff-edged mesa of about 577 m with a ring of stone walls and old foundations from the Spring and Autumn period. Archaeologists found a large tomb on the summit in 2012, later named one of China's top ten archaeological discoveries of 2013, and the site now offers costumed historical performances, views over the surrounding mesas and stalls selling local snacks.
description: 天上王城位于山东临沂。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、登山观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Jiwang Gu in Quanzhuang town, about 30 km north-west of Yishui town, reached by road.

name: 天宇自然博物馆
summaryEn: Tianyu Natural Museum, opened in 2004, is a large natural-history museum in Pingyi town with 28 exhibition halls and more than 390,000 items, mainly fossils and mineral and gem specimens from different geological periods. The collection includes more than 1,100 dinosaur fossils and over 2,200 bird fossils. It is one of Pingyi's best-known attractions and suits families and anyone interested in palaeontology.
description: 天宇自然博物馆是位于中国山东省临沂市平邑县的博物馆，它是世界上最大的自然地质博物馆和最大的恐龙博物馆。
accessEn: In Pingyi town, within about half a kilometre of the town-centre point and about 81 km north-west of Linyi city centre, reached by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大珠山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area of about 65 km² in the south of the West Coast New Area, whose main peak, Dazhaiding, rises to 486 m. Shimen Temple stands on the summit among many cave shrines with Buddha figures, and the slopes are known for wild azaleas that flower in spring. With neighbouring Xiaozhu Mountain it forms the 'Shuangzhu Qianyun' view, one of the old eight sights of Jiaozhou.
description: 大珠山是位于青岛市黄岛区滨海街道的一座山峰，总面积65平方公里，主峰大砦顶海拔486米。大珠山主峰上建有石门寺，周边有大量石窟佛洞。位于大珠山上的大珠山风景区是青岛市首家国家4A级景区、同时也是国家农业旅游示范点。
accessEn: In the south of the West Coast New Area, about 41 km south-west of central Qingdao across Jiaozhou Bay.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 石老人观光园
summaryEn: A seaside park in eastern Qingdao named after the Old Stone Man, a sea stack once about 18 m high that local legend says is a fisherman turned to stone while calling for his daughter, carried off by the Dragon King's son. The stack's upper part collapsed in October 2022, so what remains is a reduced pillar. The park has sea views, green hills and bamboo, and suits a short stop on the eastern seafront.
description: 石老人是中华人民共和国山东省青岛市崂山区的一个海蚀柱，位于青岛市区东部。高度为18.3米，底座周长约67.4米，体积约895平方米。由于该海蚀柱形如老人坐在海中，所以得名“石老人”。
accessEn: On the hillside above the coast road in Laoshan district, about 18 km east-north-east of central Qingdao, with the sea stack itself about 1.5 km to the south-west on the shore.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 青岛葡萄酒博物馆
summaryEn: An underground museum devoted to wine on Yan'an 1st Road in Shibei district, opened in 2010 and described as the first wine-themed underground museum in mainland China. Texts, pictures, video, objects and sculptures trace the origins, development and production of wine, and there are interactive areas such as a wine bank, a world bar and cellars. It suits visitors with an interest in wine culture.
description: 青岛葡萄酒博物馆，位于中华人民共和国山东省青岛市市北区延安一路红酒坊，是一座以葡萄酒历史与文化展示为主题的主题特色博物馆，同时也是中国大陆首座以葡萄酒为主题的地下博物馆。
accessEn: On Yan'an 1st Road in Shibei district, about 3 km east-north-east of central Qingdao. Closed from Chinese New Year's Eve to the third day of the new year.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大青山
summaryEn: Daqing Mountain is a forested hill area of about 30 km² south-west of Wulian town, with gorges, caves, waterfalls and a pagoda, plus a hotel and play facilities on the upper slopes. A Taiji culture plaza hosts Taiji tournaments, including a tenth invitational event in 2026. It suits a day of hill walking and sightseeing.
description: 大青山位于山东日照。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、古塔。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Wulian County, about 7 km south-west of Wulian town according to the Rizhao tourism bureau, and about 41 km north-west of central Rizhao.

name: 浮来山
summaryEn: Fulai Mountain is a wooded hill about 300 m high west of Ju County town, with a temple complex around Dinglin Temple, traditionally the home of Liu Xie, author of the literary treatise The Literary Mind and the Carving of Dragons. A ginkgo beside the temple is given by local authorities as more than 4,000 years old, and the hill also has a hall shared by Buddhism, Confucianism and Daoism, a Daoist temple and a Liu Xie exhibition. It suits half a day of temples and walking.
description: 浮来山又名浮丘。位于山东省日照市莒县城西，距县城8公里，莒县、沂南、沂水三县交界处，336省道从此经过，海拔298.9米，处莒西平原尽头。浮来山有三峰，北为“佛来峰”，西为“浮来峰”，南为“飞来峰”，三峰鼎峙而又拱围相连，唯东面略微开敞。
accessEn: About 9 km west of Ju County town, reached by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 日照海滨国家森林公园
summaryEn: This is a coastal forest of black pine, metasequoia and locust trees planted on former salt flats from 1960, covering about 8 km² along some 7 km of sandy shoreline north of Rizhao. It was approved as a national forest park in 1992 and has a beach, cycling routes and seaside hotels, although open fires are banned throughout. It suits a day of cycling or a beach walk.
description: 日照海滨国家森林公园是一个中国国家森林公园，位于中国山东省日照市东港区。该公园是国家4A级旅游景区，面积约6平方千米，海岸线长7公里，有滨海沙滩。该公园前身是1960年2月建成的大沙洼林场。
accessEn: On the coast about 16 km north-north-east of central Rizhao, reached by the coastal road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 万平口海滨风景区
summaryEn: Wanpingkou is Rizhao's main seafront leisure area, built around a sandy beach of roughly 4 km, a lagoon, several plazas, a wedding park and an RV camp. It was rebuilt in 2016 and also has attractions such as a water-slide and children's activity parks. It suits a half day by the sea close to the city centre.
description: 万平口又称日照市万平口海滨风景区、万平口海滨旅游景区、万平口海滨风景区、万平口风景区，万平口景区，是位于中国山东省日照市东港区黄海沿岸的海滩，海岸线长5000米。2009年2月被评为国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: On the seafront about 3 km east-south-east of central Rizhao, reached by city bus or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 宁阳颜子庙
summaryEn: A memorial temple and family burial grove for Yan Hui (Yan Zi), Confucius's favourite disciple, who is venerated as the 'Restored Sage' (Fusheng). The temple at Sigao village keeps Yuan-dynasty building features, described as 'the second beams do not rest on the main beam', and the protected unit also covers the Yan Forest (Yanlin), the family burial ground. It is a different site from the Yan Temple in Qufu, and became a national protected unit in 2013.
description: 宁阳颜子庙，位于山东省泰安市宁阳县鹤山镇泗皋村，是中华人民共和国全国重点文物保护单位之一。1992年6月12日，授予山东省文物保护单位，分类为古建筑及历史纪念建筑。2013年3月5日，列入第七批全国重点文物保护单位，分类为古建筑。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Sigao village, Heshan town, about 4 km north-north-west of the town of Heshan and about 18 km north-west of Ningyang county seat.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 水上王城·巨淀湖
summaryEn: A lake and wetland scenic area in north-west Shouguang on the remains of the ancient Judian marsh, now about 12,000 mu (some 800 hectares) of shallow water fed by four rivers and described locally as Weifang's largest natural wetland. Visitors can boat on the lake, walk a wetland corridor to watch birds and use a water-themed play area. The lake is also promoted as a red-tourism site for local revolutionary history.
description: 巨淀湖，古称巨淀或巨淀泽，曾是历史上著名的淡水湖泊，历史悠久。其距城三十五华里，隶属双王城生态经济发展中心。其曾经位于山东寿光市西北部、广饶县东部，坐落于潍坊、东营两地级市交界处。
accessEn: In north-west Shouguang, about 22 km north-north-west of the city centre; check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 牟氏庄园
summaryEn: Mou's Manor is a clan estate of three groups of linked courtyard houses in the Jiaodong style, with more than 480 rooms on over 20,000 m², built by the Mou family from the Yongzheng reign of the early Qing dynasty to the 1930s. The estate's staff stage short costumed skits about the family's life for visitors. It inspired a novel and a television series about the family, and suits anyone interested in rural life in late imperial China.
description: 牟氏庄园，位于山东省栖霞市城北古镇都村，为胶东牟氏家族的庄园，始建于清雍正元年，至1935年基本建成。总建筑面积达2万余平米，为中国北方地区规模最大和保存最为完整的封建地主庄园。牟氏家族原籍湖北省公安县，明洪武三年一世牟敬祖任栖霞县主簿，居于当地古镇都村，并逐渐繁衍成族。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Zhuangyuan South Street at the northern edge of Qixia, about 1.5 km north of the town centre; Qixia is about 65 km by road from central Yantai.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 养马岛
summaryEn: Yangma Island is a low island of about 14 km² off the north coast of Muping, linked to the mainland by a bridge, with sandy and rocky shores and a long coastal park along its rocky edge. Tianma Square at the entrance is built around Qin-dynasty and horse-culture themes, since tradition says the First Emperor of Qin kept his horses here. It suits a seaside day out from Yantai.
description: 养马岛，是中国的一个岛屿，位于山东省烟台市牟平区北部的一个岛屿。行政上属该区的养马岛街道管辖。养马岛后海产海参最佳，养马岛孤悬海中，而富冠全县。
accessEn: On the north coast of Muping district, about 30 km by road east-south-east of central Yantai, joined to the mainland by a bridge.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 抱犊崮国家森林公园
summaryEn: Baodugu is a flat-topped crag about 584 m high and the centre of a national forest park in Shanting District. A stepped path climbs through woods to the summit, where an archway and a pavilion were built in 2000; in 1923 bandits who had seized a train (the Lincheng Outrage) took their hostages up here. It suits a day of hill walking from Zaozhuang.
description: 抱犊崮，归属枣庄市山亭区，位于山东省枣庄市山亭区西南25公里处，高584米，为鲁南群山最高峰。汉代叫“楼山”，魏晋称“仙台山”，直至唐宋时才称“抱犊崮”。，现建有抱犊崮国家森林公园。
accessEn: In Shanting District, about 20 km north-east of Zaozhuang's Shizhong district centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 冠世榴园
summaryEn: Guanshi Liuyuan is a large pomegranate orchard in the hills of Yicheng District, which local records trace back to the Western Han. Paths run among old trees, springs and viewing pavilions towards Qingtan Temple, a valley temple that the city gazetteer dates to the Tang, with blossom in May and fruit in autumn. It suits an easy day among the orchards, with markets and festivals at blossom and harvest time.
description: 冠世榴园，位于山东省枣庄市峄城区榴园镇。是中华人民共和国山东省省级文物保护单位之一。2013年，列入第四批山东省文物保护单位，该文物保护单位是一座其他类型文物保护单位。
accessEn: In Liuyuan town, Yicheng District, about 10 km south of Zaozhuang's Shizhong district centre; the pin is at Qingtan Temple.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 墨子科技文化城
summaryEn: This district in central Tengzhou is organised around the Longquan Pagoda, an octagonal nine-storey brick-and-stone pagoda about 43 m high that the national heritage list dates to the Ming dynasty. Around it are six museums (the Tengzhou Museum and the Han Stone Reliefs Museum, both national first-class museums, plus museums on the philosopher Mozi, the craftsman Lu Ban and ink-stones, and an art museum) and a folk-culture street with a food court. It suits a half-day of Han-dynasty carved stones and local history.
description: 墨子科技文化城位于山东枣庄。游览特色包括博物馆、古塔、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Longquan Culture Square in central Tengzhou, about 1 km east of the city centre; the museums are closed on Mondays.

name: 台儿庄大战纪念馆
summaryEn: This museum opened in 1993 to commemorate the Battle of Taierzhuang of March–April 1938, which Chinese accounts describe as the first major Chinese victory over Japanese forces in the war. Its displays include documents and relics, a film hall and a circular panorama hall that combines a painting with modelled terrain, lighting and sound to stage the street fighting. It stands about 1 km west of the old town, and the Li Zongren Museum in the old railway station is a short walk away.
description: 台儿庄大战纪念馆位于中华人民共和国山东省枣庄市台儿庄区古运路6号，为纪念1938年的台儿庄战役而建立。
accessEn: In Taierzhuang District beside the old canal, about 1 km west of Taierzhuang Ancient Town and about 37 km south-south-east of Zaozhuang's Shizhong district centre; closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 王渔洋故里
summaryEn: The hometown of Wang Yuyang (Wang Shizhen, 1634–1711), a Qing-dynasty poet who rose to be Minister of Justice, in the old town of Xincheng, Huantai. The scenic area centres on his family residence of restored Ming–Qing courtyards, and also takes in the Zhongqin Shrine, now a memorial hall with exhibition rooms and a garden of carved stones, and the 1619 brick memorial arch known as Sishi Gongbao. The residence and the arch are both national heritage units.
description: 王渔洋故居及墓葬，位于山东省淄博市桓台县新城镇，为清朝官员王渔洋的故居及墓葬建筑。2006年12月7日，王渔洋故居及墓葬被公布为第三批山东省文物保护单位，2019年10月7日，王渔洋故居被公布为第八批全国重点文物保护单位，而王渔洋墓葬仍为省级文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xincheng town, Huantai County, about 14 km west of Huantai town and about 18 km north-west of central Zibo; the Sishi Gongbao arch spans a street and can be seen without entering the museums.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 万泉湖
summaryEn: A spring-fed lake and wetland in southern Linzhou where the Qi and Xi rivers meet, named for the many springs that feed it. Paths, plank walkways over the water, bridges and pavilions link its sights, which include the old Shimen Temple and named rock formations.
description: 万泉湖位于河南安阳。游览特色包括湿地、寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the south of Linzhou municipality, best reached by car or taxi from the city (allow about 40 minutes).

name: 汤阴岳飞庙
summaryEn: A memorial temple in the home county of Yue Fei (1103–1142), the Song general who fought the Jurchen Jin and was put to death under a frame-up, rebuilt on this site in 1450 under the Ming and extended under the Qing. Behind the Jingzhong archway stand the gate, the imperial stele pavilion, the main hall and shrines including one showing his mother tattooing loyalty on his back and others to his sons, with walls set with inscribed stelae, among them copies of his own calligraphy. An eastern extension opened in 2014 adds museum displays on his life.
description: 汤阴岳飞庙位于中国河南省安阳市汤阴县城关镇，2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。汤阴岳飞庙重建于明景泰元年，现存建筑以明代为主，主要有精忠坊、山门、正殿、岳母刺字祠、孝娥祠、岳云祠、四子祠、三代祠等。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Tangyin county town, about half an hour by road south of Anyang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 桑园小镇·太极图
summaryEn: A rural resort village in the Taihang hills west of Hebi, opened in 2017, with guesthouses, a forest playground, a glass walkway, an eco-trail along the Qi River and summer water rides. Nearby the Qi River doubles back on itself between wooded hills in a bend promoted as a natural taiji, or yin-yang, symbol.
description: 桑园小镇·太极图位于河南鹤壁。游览特色包括玻璃栈道、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shangyu township, Qibin district, about 20 km west of Hebi's new district by road.

name: 浚县古城
summaryEn: The Ming walled town of Xun County, begun in 1370 on the Wei River section of the Grand Canal and now promoted as the Liyang City cultural tourism area. A surviving stretch of wall runs along the river by the Yunxi Bridge, and inside, streets radiate from the Wenzhi Pavilion to the county yamen, the Confucian Temple, a Hanlin mansion traditionally linked to the Duanmu family and round earthen granaries of the 1950s. Evening light shows, folk performances and clay-whistle crafts keep the streets busy, above all during the great temple fair in the first lunar month.
description: 浚县城墙位于中国河南省鹤壁市浚县，是明代砖彻城墙。现存卫河沿岸段城墙及姑山南侧城墙遗迹。2000年9月，河南省人民政府以浚县城墙之名列入第三批河南省文物保护单位，同时含浚县文庙、文治阁、云溪桥；2013年3月，中国国务院以浚县古城墙及文治阁之名列入第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Xun County is about 30 km south-east of Hebi's new district by road; Huaxun station on the Jinan–Zhengzhou high-speed line lies about 6 km south of the old town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 云梦山
summaryEn: A Taihang mountain valley west of Qi County, also called Qingyan Mountain, where tradition places the retreat of Guiguzi, the Warring States master of strategy said to have taught Sun Bin, Pang Juan, Su Qin and Zhang Yi. The valley's caves, waterfall and 'Five-li Ghost Valley' are promoted as China's first military academy, and its cliffs carry nationally listed inscriptions from the Song dynasty to the Republican era. Paths also climb to the Nantianmen gate, the Bagua City temple complex and a hilltop grassland.
description: 云梦山位于河南鹤壁。游览特色包括瀑布、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 15 km west of Qi County town by road, roughly 30 km south-west of Hebi's new district.

name: 陈家沟
summaryEn: The village in Wen County where Chen Wangting created taijiquan in the late Ming, recognised by China's national martial-arts authorities in 2007 as the birthplace of the art, which UNESCO inscribed as intangible heritage in 2020. The scenic area takes in the Taijiquan Ancestral Hall, the taijiquan museum, the East Gully where the art is said to have been created, the place where Yang Luchan learned it and the Chen Zhaopi memorial garden. Taijiquan enthusiasts from around the world come to train at its many martial-arts schools.
description: 陈家沟原名常阳村，是中国太极拳发源地，位于河南省焦作市温县赵堡镇。陈家沟人口近3万，南水北调渠穿村而过，位处黄河北岸。是国家4A级景区，中国第一批非物质文化遗产，国家级文化旅游特色小镇。
accessEn: In Zhaobao town, Wen County, near the north bank of the Yellow River, about 45 minutes by road south of central Jiaozuo.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中国翰园碑林
summaryEn: A garden of modern stone inscriptions just west of Dragon Pavilion Park, founded in 1985 by the retired Kaifeng official Li Gongtao and built up largely with his own family's money. Long covered corridors display calligraphy, paintings and seal carving cut in stone, arranged in sections for Song-dynasty texts, emperors and statesmen, ethnic-minority scripts and international friendship, set among classical garden buildings. It appeals mainly to visitors interested in Chinese calligraphy.
description: 中国翰园碑林位于河南省开封市龙亭公园西侧，是国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: Just west of Dragon Pavilion Park in the north-west of Kaifeng's old city, a short walk from the park and from Qingming Shanghe Park. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 开封府
summaryEn: A modern reconstruction of the government office of Kaifeng Prefecture, which ran the Northern Song capital and where Bao Zheng, the 'Judge Bao' of later legend, served as prefect. It was built following the Song building manual Yingzao Fashi as a large complex of halls and courtyards on the north shore of Baogong Lake. It suits visitors interested in Song government and the Judge Bao stories, and pairs with the Lord Bao Memorial Temple across the lake.
description: 开封府是中国历史上的一个首府名，治所位于今河南省开封市境内，管辖范围达今许昌市、郑州市、新乡市、周口市境。
accessEn: On the north shore of Baogong Lake in central Kaifeng, a short walk from Yanqing Temple and the Zhouqiao site.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 沙澧河风景区
summaryEn: A belt of riverside parks along both banks of the Sha and Li rivers through central Luohe, centred on their confluence and built from 2007 on top of the city's flood-control works. Paths link themed gardens, beaches and promenades with rubber dams, sluices and historic spots such as an iron ox cast to guard the river, an old ferry landing and a Guanyin pavilion, and the rivers have hosted dragon-boat races.
description: 沙澧河风景区位于河南省漯河市市区，沿沙河与澧河河道两岸，以两河交汇处附近为中心，呈带状分布，总计36公里，总面积669万平方米。该景区以城市防洪工程为依托，集生态保障、文化旅游为一体，先后被评为国家4A级旅游景区、国家水利风景区、河南省生态文明教育基地、河南省文明风景旅游区。
accessEn: In central Luohe, a short walk or taxi ride from the city centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中国国花园
summaryEn: A large peony garden, laid out from 2001 in the riverside Luopu Park on the south bank of the Luo River, over part of the Sui–Tang city site. It grows peonies of more than a thousand varieties in nine colour groups, and two climate-controlled halls opened in 2022 and 2024 hold rare and late-flowering kinds so that the show lasts into early May, followed by herbaceous peonies. It is at its best during the Luoyang Peony Festival in April.
description: 中国国花园位于中华人民共和国河南省洛阳市洛龙区龙门大道2号，洛河岸边的洛浦公园内，长2400米，宽524米，占地面积1548亩，是中国最大的牡丹观赏园及自然山水园林。中国国花园建于2001年9月在隋唐古城遗址上建立的，中国国花园内的牡丹涵盖9大色系1000多个品种。
accessEn: On Longmen Avenue on the south bank of the Luo River, a short taxi or bus ride south of central Luoyang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黛眉山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in the far north of Xin'an County, on the south bank of the Yellow River upstream of the Xiaolangdi Dam. It is one of the scenic areas of the Daimeishan part of the Wangwushan–Daimeishan geopark, which also takes in Longtan Grand Canyon and Qingyao Mountain nearby and was named a global geopark in 2006.
description: 王屋山-黛眉山地质公园，位于中国太行山南麓，跨越黄河两岸，分布于河南省济源市西北与洛阳市新安县北部，于北京时间2006年9月18日22时，以第二名的成绩成功申报为世界地质公园。该地质公园分别由王屋山、黛眉山和黄河谷地三个地貌单元组成。
accessEn: At Dongshandi village, Shijing town, in northern Xin'an County, roughly 110 km north-west of Luoyang by road. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 花果山
summaryEn: A forested mountain in south-western Yiyang County that shares its name with the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit, home of the Monkey King in Journey to the West, and plays on the story with a Water Curtain Cave square and Monkey King themes. Other scenic areas in China, among them Huaguo Mountain in Lianyungang, Jiangsu, also draw on the Monkey King story.
description: 花果山位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括林地风光、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Huaguoshan township, south-western Yiyang County, about 85 km south-west of Luoyang by road.

name: 千唐志斋
summaryEn: A collection of carved tomb epitaphs described as China's largest, gathered in the 1930s by Zhang Fang from tombs looted around Luoyang and set into the walls of 15 brick-vaulted rooms beside his house in Tiemen. The name means 'Studio of a Thousand Tang Epitaphs': most of the more than 1,400 stones date from the Tang dynasty, with smaller numbers from the Western Jin, Northern Wei, Sui and Song, and they are a major source for the study of Tang history.
description: 千唐志斋位于中国河南省洛阳市新安县铁门镇西部，是中国最大的墓志石刻收藏地，1963年被列为河南省文物保护单位，1996年以千唐志斋石刻之名被列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。千唐志斋博物馆是国家二级博物馆。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Tiemen town, Xin'an County, about 45 km west of central Luoyang. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 神灵寨
summaryEn: A forest park of about 53 km² in the mountains south-east of Luoning town, rising to 1,859 m. It is known for its great rock slabs, called the 'stone waterfalls', for natural stands of lacebark pine and a bamboo grove unusually far north, and for its gorge and the Yuhuang Hall of a former Taoist temple.
description: 神灵寨国家森林公园，位于中国河南洛阳西南90公里的洛宁县县城东南26公里处。面积5300公顷，拥有2000种植物，300种动物。有大型石瀑群，名为“中华大石瀑”。
accessEn: About 26 km south-east of Luoning county town, which is about 90 km south-west of Luoyang by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天池山
summaryEn: A forested mountain area in north-western Song County, made up of the Tianchi ('Heavenly Lake'), Feilaishi ('Flying Rock'), Yunü Stream and Erlang Gully sections. Feilaishi is known for its steep crags and Yunü Stream for its quiet wooded gorge.
description: 洛阳嵩县天池山国家森林公园位于中国河南省洛阳市嵩县西北部，与古都洛阳相距98公里。包括天池景区、飞来石景区、玉女溪景区、二郎沟景区等。其中飞来石景区以“雄险特奇”著称，玉女溪景区以“清幽空灵、奇幻旖旎”著称。
accessEn: In Deting, north-western Song County, about 100 km south-west of Luoyang by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 二程文化园
summaryEn: The cemetery of Cheng Hao (1032–1085) and Cheng Yi (1033–1107), the Northern Song brothers who founded the Neo-Confucian 'study of principle', and of their father Cheng Xiang, at the foot of Jing Hill on the west side of Yichuan town. Three earth mounds stand in a triangle behind a memorial shrine with statues of the three men, with Qing-dynasty stelae before the graves and Ming stone figures, rams and tigers along the spirit way. A culture park built around the old cemetery opened in 2017.
description: 二程墓，又称程园，位于中国河南省洛阳市伊川县县城西侧的荆山脚下，是北宋理学家程颢、程颐及其父程珦等人的墓地。墓园由山门、墓祠、神道和墓地等部分组成。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the west side of Yichuan county town, about 35 km south of Luoyang by road. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 万安山山顶公园
summaryEn: A park along the crest of Wan'an Mountain, the 937 m ridge on the south-eastern edge of the Luoyang basin, facing the Song Mountains. A ridge road links a string of viewpoints and rock outcrops, and the summit has small temples to the White Dragon King and the Patriarch as well as the Yuquan Temple; fields of coreopsis flower on the top in early summer.
description: 万安山位于河南省洛阳市伊川县和偃师市交界处，与嵩山遥遥相望。万安山的海拔达937.3米。万安山的山顶有白龙王庙、西祖师庙和玉泉寺等历史建筑。
accessEn: About 30 km south-east of central Luoyang by road, in Yibin District.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 宝天曼
summaryEn: The visitor area of the Baotianman National Nature Reserve in the Funiu Mountains, a UNESCO biosphere reserve since 2001 that protects an unusually complete forest on the transition between China's subtropical and warm-temperate zones. Trails lead through old-growth woodland, gorges, streams and waterfalls in a reserve with more than 3,000 plant species, and in spring the slopes are bright with flowering azaleas.
description: 河南宝天曼国家级自然保护区位于中国河南省南阳市内乡县和南召县交界地带，主要保护对象为“过渡带森林生态系统”和“珍稀野生动植物”，2001年被联合国教科文组织列入“人与生物圈保护计划”，属于“世界生物圈保护区”，总面积29518公顷，这里保存着较为完整的天然次生植被和原生植物群落，有“物种基因库”、“动植物王国”之称。
accessEn: At Getiaopa village near Xiaguan in northern Neixiang County, roughly 1–1.5 hours by road north of Neixiang town. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 丹江大观苑
summaryEn: A lakeside resort park built by a private company on peninsulas and islets on the north shore of the Danjiangkou Reservoir, the source of the middle route of the South–North Water Transfer Project. Besides lake views and boats it has modern buildings on Chu and Buddhist themes, including the Fanli Pavilion, the Chufeng Tower, a large Guanyin statue, a recreation of Xiangyan Temple's flooded lower temple and a memorial hall for the water-transfer project.
description: 丹江大观苑是一处位于河南省淅川县丹江口水库的旅游区。景区占地面积12平方公里，由情人岛、龟岛、鹿岛、鹤岛等六个伸入丹江口水库的小岛组成。景区主要展现了药文化、水文化、楚文化、佛文化和商文化五大文化特色。
accessEn: On the north shore of the Danjiangkou Reservoir in southern Xichuan County, roughly 2 hours by road west of Nanyang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 老君洞
summaryEn: A large forested mountain area at Erlangping in northern Xixia County, in the core of the Funiu Mountain Global Geopark, with more than a dozen peaks over 1,000 m, rivers and springs. Legend says Laozi lived here in retreat, and the cave that gives the area its name is promoted as a Taoist grotto-heaven.
description: 老君洞位于河南南阳。游览特色包括地质景观、林地风光、洞穴。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Near Erlangping in northern Xixia County, about an hour by road north of Xixia town.

name: 五朵山
summaryEn: A Taoist mountain on the border of Nanzhao and Zhenping counties whose five rocky summits rise to 1,665 m; tradition links it with Yin Xi, some 2,500 years ago, and the Tang Taoist Wu Yun. The scenic area combines the climb to the peaks and the Wanfu Palace temple with a lakeside resort area at Jiulong Lake and a gorge with water play.
description: 五朵山，亦名“五垛山”，位于河南省南召县与镇平县交界地带，两千五百多年前的尹喜和唐代道士吴筠，曾修道于此山的北顶，乃中原道教圣地，主峰圣垛海拔1665米。《山海经》中称其为“依帝山”，《水经注》称其为“岐棘山”，《太平寰宇记》则称志为“骑立山”，《一统志》载：“骑立山山势昂耸，如立骑，本名岐棘山，音讹耳。
accessEn: In south-western Nanzhao County, about 1.5 hours by road north-west of Nanyang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 二郎山
summaryEn: A forested hill on the south shore of Shimantan Reservoir, part of the Shimantan National Forest Park and named after the legend of the god Erlang carrying mountains to chase the suns. Visitors climb to a Jade Emperor hall, rebuilt in 2000 after the old one was destroyed by Japanese bombing in 1941, cross a 286 m glass suspension bridge and a footbridge over the water, and can take bamboo-raft or boat trips on the reservoir.
description: 二郎山位于河南平顶山。游览特色包括森林公园、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Yinji on the edge of Wugang city, south-east of Pingdingshan; buses from Wugang to Yinji stop at the gate.

name: 画眉谷
summaryEn: A wooded valley beside national road G311 near Mount Yao, named after the hwamei songbirds that nest there and opened to visitors in 2004. Paths follow a stream past a chain of pools and waterfalls, including a six-tier fall, to a cliff-side walkway, a glass bridge and viewpoints in the forest, with water-play attractions near the entrance.
description: 画眉谷景区位于河南省鲁山县尧山镇，因有众多画眉鸟在此栖息繁衍，故名。因为景区中岩石、山水、野生动物及森林等都与长江三峡景区类似，所以也被称为“袖珍三峡”。目前该景区是河南省的重点旅游区、中国国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: In Sidaohe village, Yaoshan town, beside national road G311 about 55 km west of Lushan County town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 九峰山
summaryEn: A range of low forested peaks in south-western Ruzhou, named for nine summits that legend links to the Jade Emperor's daughters; the highest, Dazhai, reaches 895 m. Designated a national forest park in 2011 and developed by a private company since the mid-2010s, it has gorges, colourful rock strata and walking trails.
description: 九峰山位于河南平顶山。游览特色包括峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the south of Jiliao town, in the hills south-west of Ruzhou city, reached by road.

name: 马街书会
summaryEn: The home of the Majie Storytelling Fair, at which folk storytellers and ballad singers from across China gather every year on the 13th day of the first lunar month, a custom said to date back to 1315 and listed as national intangible heritage in 2006. The scenic area has an exhibition hall of Chinese quyi (storytelling and ballad arts), a hall devoted to the storyteller Liu Lanfang, a Fire God temple and a sculpture square, but the fair day is by far the liveliest time to come.
description: 马街书会是每年农历正月十三，在河南省宝丰县城南五公里处举行的民俗活动。那时众多说书艺人聚集在一起说书，唱书，亮书，卖书，非常吸引人、热闹。其中涵盖了京韵大鼓，山东琴书等40多种曲艺曲种，和上千部传统和现代曲目。
accessEn: In Majie village, Yangzhuang town, about 5 km south of Baofeng County town, which is about 30 km west of Pingdingshan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 香山寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple on Daxiang Shan north-west of Pingdingshan, revered as the place where, in a legend recorded here in the Song dynasty, the bodhisattva Guanyin attained enlightenment. Its treasures are the nine-storey Guanyin Dashi Pagoda, about 33 m tall and rebuilt in 1068 by order of Emperor Shenzong, and a stele of 1100 carrying the biography of the Great Compassionate Bodhisattva in the calligraphy of Cai Jing, one of 15 Song-to-Qing steles kept in the temple. Most of the halls have been rebuilt since 2008.
description: 香山寺位于河南平顶山。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、古塔、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 5 km north of Pingdingshan's new district along Xiangshan Avenue.

name: 仓颉陵
summaryEn: A round earth mound 3 m high at Shiguan village, honoured as the grave of Cangjie, the legendary inventor of Chinese writing, with Ming-dynasty stone figures, lions, columns and a stone gateway in front and a Cangjie temple beside it. The ground beneath is the Shiguan site, a moated Neolithic village of the Yangshao and Longshan cultures, and a Cangjie culture museum stands nearby; the county holds a Cangjie culture week at the site each spring.
description: 仓颉陵位于河南濮阳。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Shiguan village, Liangcun township, about 17 km north-west of Nanle County town, which is about 45 km by road north of Puyang city.

name: 单拐革命旧址
summaryEn: Danguai, a village in Qingfeng County where the Communist Party's Hebei–Shandong–Henan sub-bureau and military region headquarters moved in September 1944; Deng Xiaoping, then acting head of the North China Bureau, worked here for three months in 1945. The leaders' former quarters and the Chen ancestral hall, used as the military region's first arsenal, are preserved among the village houses, and a memorial museum founded in 2004 and expanded in 2016 has exhibition halls on the wartime base and its arms production.
description: 冀鲁豫边区革命根据地旧址是河南省濮阳市境内的一处第六批全国重点文物保护单位，分为颜村铺革命旧址、单拐革命旧址两处。颜村铺革命旧址位于范县颜村铺乡颜村铺村、单拐革命旧址位于清丰县双庙乡单拐村。2006年5月25日，中国国务院公布第六批全国重点文物保护单位，两处旧址以冀鲁豫边区革命根据地旧址之名列入，两处旧址均与冀鲁豫边区相关。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Danguai village, Shuangmiao township, Qingfeng County, about 25 km east of Puyang city by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 戚城遗址
summaryEn: A heritage park in Puyang city on the site of Qi, a Spring and Autumn town of the state of Wey where, according to the Chunqiu and Zuozhuan, the feudal lords met seven times; some place the death of Confucius's disciple Zilu here in 480 BC. About 1.5 km of the town's rammed-earth wall still stands in the park, built up over the Longshan, Spring and Autumn and Han periods. The park, laid out from 1991, has displays of the site and its finds alongside memorial sights, and now also hosts intangible-heritage workshops and a traditional-style academy.
description: 戚城遗址位于河南省濮阳市华龙区戚城村，地处京开大道西侧，北临古城路。1961年，列入第一批河南省文物保护单位。1996年，列入第四批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Jingkai Avenue in Hualong district, within Puyang city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 庙底沟考古遗址公园
summaryEn: The site of a Neolithic village of the Yangshao culture's Miaodigou phase (about 4000–3500 BC), with a later Miaodigou II layer, excavated in 1956–57 ahead of the Sanmenxia Dam and again in 2002. An archaeological park covers part of the site, and the Miaodigou Museum beside it, designed by Tsinghua University and opened in October 2021, displays painted pottery and other finds from recent excavations.
description: 庙底沟遗址位于中国河南省三门峡市湖滨区原陕州老城南关附近，是一处新石器时代遗址，1963年被列为第一批河南省文物保护单位，2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Jingu East Road and Zhaogong Road in Hubin District, Sanmenxia, reachable by city bus or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 双龙湾
summaryEn: A river-valley scenic area near the source of the Luo River in western Lushi County, named after the peaks Dalongtou and Xiaolongtou, around which the river winds in an S-shaped loop. It combines riverside walks with caves, side valleys of peach blossom, rafting and evening illuminations.
description: 双龙湾是位于中华人民共和国河南省三门峡市卢氏县境内的一个4A级景区，占地面积为50平方公里，因大龙头和小龙头两座山峰而得名为双龙湾。
accessEn: At Xihuling village, Shuanglongwan town, about 20 km west of Lushi town by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天鹅湖国家城市湿地公园
summaryEn: A large wetland park on the Yellow River flats between the eastern and western halves of Sanmenxia, known for the large flocks of wild swans that winter on its lakes from October. Paths link islands, pavilions and lakes, and the park also has a peony garden that blooms in April and lotus ponds in summer.
description: 三门峡市天鹅湖城市湿地公园，是一个位于中华人民共和国河南省三门峡市境内的一个4A级景区公园。地点在河南省三门峡市陕州区310国道。
accessEn: In the economic development zone between the two halves of Sanmenxia, reachable by city bus or taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 仰韶村遗址
summaryEn: The village where the Swedish geologist Johan Gunnar Andersson found Neolithic painted pottery in 1921, giving its name to the Yangshao culture; the site was settled roughly 7,000 to 6,000 years ago and also has Longshan remains. The Yangshao Culture Museum, opened in 2011 and reopened in September 2024 after a refit, presents the finds and the story of the discovery, and a national archaeological site park around the excavation areas has been open since 2021.
description: 仰韶村遗址是中国的新石器时代文化遗址，位于河南省三门峡市渑池县仰韶乡仰韶村。仰韶文化因此而得名，1961年被国务院确定为全国重点文物保护单位。仰韶遗址于1921年由北洋民国政府聘请的矿业顾问瑞典人安特生所发现。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Yangshao village, about 6 km north of Mianchi town and 75 km east of Sanmenxia by road. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 豫西大峡谷
summaryEn: A narrow river gorge more than 30 km long in the mountains of northern Lushi County, with a chain of waterfalls and plunge pools, the best known being the Dacongtan Waterfall. Its main draw is a 6 km drift-rafting route that passes through three rock tunnels and over a series of waterfall drops.
description: 豫西大峡谷位于中华人民共和国河南省三门峡市卢氏县官道口镇境内的汉川峪河两岸，整体呈东西走向，长30余千米，宽30-50米，谷底最深处达200米，两侧山峰最高海拔达1372米，有99处瀑布和300余处潭池，最大的大淙潭瀑布落差约40米，豫西大峡谷风景区总面积58平方千米，2006年被评为国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: At Xinping village, Guandaokou town, under 10 km from the expressway exits and about 1.5 hours by road south of Sanmenxia.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 商丘博物馆
summaryEn: Shangqiu's city museum, which opened in a new building on Huashang Avenue in 2016 and holds about 19,000 objects, mostly from excavations in the region. Highlights include finds from the Western Han royal tombs of Liang at Mount Mangdang, among them a jade suit sewn with gold thread.
description: 商丘博物馆，中华人民共和国河南省商丘市的一座地方综合性博物馆，成立于1983年10月.。
accessEn: On Huashang Avenue in Suiyang district, about 10 minutes by taxi south-west of the old city; closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 王公庄
summaryEn: A village about 25 km north-east of Minquan county town known as China's first tiger-painting village, where more than 900 villagers work in painting, mostly tigers in the traditional Chinese style. Visitors walk a street of galleries, see the art exhibition hall and browse paintings for sale, and there is also a fruit-picking garden and a study-tour base.
description: 王公庄位于中国河南省商丘市民权县境内，庄内一千六百名居民，约半数都从事绘画工作，尤其擅长画虎，素有“中国画虎第一村”的美誉，是中国十大书画名村之一。村中擅长作画的人比比皆是，其中最具代表性的要数“四大虎王”、“四小虎王”和“小虎队”。
accessEn: About 25 km north-east of Minquan county town, roughly 30 minutes by road; Minquan is about an hour by road west of Shangqiu.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 五龙山
summaryEn: A leisure and amusement complex in Changcun town just north-east of Huixian, with a children's amusement park, a ski slope in winter and staged shows, among them one on the Battle of Muye, in which the Zhou overthrew the Shang. It suits families looking for rides and entertainment rather than scenery.
description: 五龙山位于河南新乡。游览特色包括主题游乐、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Changcun town, about 5 km north-east of Huixian and 20 km north-west of central Xinxiang by road.

name: 大苏山
summaryEn: A national forest park of low wooded hills south-west of Guangshan town, set up in 2015 and taking in Dasu Mountain, Longshou Mountain and the Wangmu Daoist temple area. The monk Huisi taught in the area in the 550s and 560s, and his disciple Zhiyi, later the leading figure of the Tiantai school of Buddhism, studied under him on Dasu Mountain from 560 to 567. Jingju Temple, which honours this tradition, stands in the park, and Su Shi wrote a poem on a visit to it.
description: 大苏山位于河南省信阳市光山县西南22公里。该地于2015年1月被中国林业局正式批准设立为“大苏山国家森林公园”。大苏山国家森林公园占地面积为2788.53公顷。
accessEn: About 22 km south-west of Guangshan town, roughly half an hour by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南湾湖
summaryEn: A large reservoir in wooded hills just south-west of Xinyang, made by damming the Shi River in 1952–1955, whose dam face carries Mao Zedong's call to harness the Huai River. Three of its islands have been developed for visitors as Tea, Bird and Monkey islands, and Xianyin Temple, first founded in the Southern Dynasties, stands below Xian Mountain at the eastern end. The hills upstream are a main growing area for Xinyang Maojian tea.
description: 南湾水库，又称南湾湖，位于中国河南省信阳市浉河区西南，距市区约5公里，系截流浉河所形成的以防洪、灌溉为主，兼顾发电、养殖、城市供水及旅游开发等功能的大型水库。水域面积约75平方公里，最大蓄水量16.3亿立方米。
accessEn: The scenic area begins about 5 km south-west of central Xinyang, a short taxi or bus ride.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鄂豫皖苏区首府革命博物馆
summaryEn: Xin County town, then called Xinji, became the seat of the Communist-led Hubei–Henan–Anhui (Eyuwan) soviet base area in 1931, and former offices of the base survive here, among them those of the Party's Eyuwan Bureau, the soviet government and the Fourth Front Army headquarters. The museum beside them, opened in 1990 and rated a national first-grade museum in 2017, covers the ten years of the base area with weapons, banners, documents, seals, currency and land certificates, plus a gallery on generals from the county.
description: 鄂豫皖苏区首府革命博物馆位于中华人民共和国河南省信阳市新县首府路文博新村004号，是展示新县作为鄂豫皖苏区首府的革命历史的博物馆。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xin County town, about an hour and a half by road south-east of Xinyang; the old offices are a short walk from the museum.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鄢陵国家花木博览园
summaryEn: A large landscaped garden in Yanling's new town, built in 2002 to show off the county's centuries-old nursery and flower trade, with themed areas for bamboo, wintersweet, bonsai, conifers and tropical plants. It also works as a showground and market for nursery stock and hosted early editions of the Central China Flower and Tree Fair, which is still held in Yanling every autumn. Come for plants and bonsai rather than historic sights.
description: 鄢陵国家花木博览园，又称中原花木博览园，位于许昌鄢陵县，始建于2002年3月，2002年9月竣工。为中国国家植物园和国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: Beside national road G311 in Yanling's new town, about 30 km east of central Xuchang by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黄帝故里
summaryEn: A memorial complex of about 7 hectares on the northern edge of old Xinzheng, honoured as the birthplace of the legendary Yellow Emperor, Huangdi, where a large ancestor-worship ceremony is held each year on the third day of the third lunar month. At its heart is the Qing-dynasty Xuanyuan Temple on a low mound, with a gate, a main hall holding a seated statue of Huangdi, side halls for his consorts Leizu and Momu and a brick bridge of 1570 in front, set between a worship plaza and a plaza of Chinese surnames. The national listing also covers two small stone halls, a Ming cliff inscription and a long stone stockade wall on Fenghou Ridge in the Juci hills, south-west of Xinzheng.
description: 黄帝故里位于河南郑州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Xuanyuan Road in Xinzheng, about 40 km south of Zhengzhou and a short taxi ride from the city centre.

name: 太清宫
summaryEn: The Taoist temple at the traditional birthplace of Laozi, recorded as a Laozi shrine since AD 165 and raised by the Tang emperors, who claimed Laozi as their ancestor, into the imperial Taiqing Palace in 743. Today's Taiji Hall dates from the Qing or the early Republic, but the grounds keep a Tang stele of Emperor Xuanzong's commentary on the Daodejing, a stele of about 8 m composed and written by Emperor Zhenzong of Song after his visit in 1014, an iron pillar and ancient cypresses. In front is a modern square with a 27 m granite statue of Laozi, and the related Mingdao Palace stands in Luyi town.
description: 太清宫，是位于河南省周口市鹿邑县太清宫镇的道教宫观，位于鹿邑县城以东约5公里，传统上被视为老子的诞生地。宫观还包含祭祀老子母亲的洞霄宫。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Taiqinggong town, about 5 km east of Luyi county town and some 90 km east of central Zhoukou, best reached by car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 弦歌台
summaryEn: A Confucian shrine on an island in a lake at the south-west corner of Huaiyang old town, built to recall how Confucius and his disciples were trapped without food between the states of Chen and Cai and he went on teaching and playing music. A Confucius temple was moved here in 721 onto an old Han crossbow-training terrace, and the present layout dates from the Ming and Qing, with a gate bearing a 1711 inscription and a seven-bay main hall of 1714 ringed by a gallery of 24 square stone columns, rare in Confucian temples. The academy buildings behind it are modern reconstructions.
description: 弦歌台，又称“厄台”、“绝粮祠”，位于中华人民共和国河南省周口市淮阳区淮宁街道，地处淮阳古城西南，是为纪念孔子周游列国期间的“陈蔡绝粮”历史故事而建的一座孔庙，为第八批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On an island in Xiange Lake at the south-western corner of Huaiyang old town, about 3 km from the Taihao Mausoleum.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 竹沟革命纪念馆
summaryEn: The former seat of the CPC Central Plains Bureau and the Henan provincial party committee in 1938–39 in Zhugou town, known at the time as 'Little Yan'an', where Liu Shaoqi and Li Xiannian worked. The memorial hall, founded in 1956 with a name plaque written by Zhou Enlai, keeps 66 rooms of the bureau and its offices, stretches of the village wall and the New Fourth Army drill ground, with an exhibition of more than 1,000 documents, photographs and objects.
description: 竹沟革命纪念馆，即中共中央中原局旧址，位于中国河南省驻马店市确山县西30公里的竹沟镇延安街。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Zhugou town, about 30 km west of Queshan county town, roughly 40 minutes by car. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大水井古建筑群
summaryEn: A group of buildings in the mountains of Lichuan, mostly Qing-dynasty and Republican-era, that the Li family built up from the former residence of the Huang tusi (local chiefs). The main parts are the Li ancestral hall (built 1846-49), the Li family manor and the 1940s courtyard house of Li Gaiwu, with an old flagstone road and a bridge among the protected elements. Together they have 24 courtyards and more than 200 rooms, and the complex has been a national protected site since 2001.
description: 大水井古建筑群位于中国湖北省恩施土家族苗族自治州利川市柏杨坝镇大水井村，始建于明代，完成于民国，于2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。大水井古建筑群原为黄氏土司的宅院，乾隆年间，当时的土司收留了从洞庭湖逃难而来的李廷龙，后其财产、宅院反被李氏所夺。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Baiyangba township, about 45 km by road from Lichuan city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 彭家寨
summaryEn: A Tujia village of Qing-dynasty timber stilt houses (diaojiaolou) on a hillside beside the Longtan River in Lianghekou village, jointed by mortise and tenon with almost no nails. About 30 households still live in the old houses, and the village is promoted as an open-air museum of Tujia life, with rapeseed flowers in spring and rice-planting and harvest activities later in the year. It was listed as a national protected site in 2013.
description: 彭家寨古建筑群位于中国湖北省恩施土家族苗族自治州宣恩县沙道沟镇两河口村，是全国重点文物保护单位。彭家寨地处武陵山区，是一个土家族村落，依山临水而建。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Lianghekou village, Shadaogou township, about 70 km by road from Xuan'en town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 屏山·容美土司遗址
summaryEn: A village inside a cliff-ringed canyon, the site of the Jue Fu, the main seat of the Rongmei tusi (hereditary chieftains of the Tian family), built from the late Ming dynasty and abandoned after the Qing ended the tusi system in 1735. What survives are stone platforms, an opera-stage ruin carved with the words 'Shan Gao Shui Chang', the Xiaokunlun study terrace and Wanquan Cave across about 50 hectares, and the more visited part today is the canyon, where boats and boardwalks follow a clear green river between the cliffs. A Red Army hospital was also set up in the village in 1930.
description: 容美土司遗址位于湖北省鹤峰县容美镇屏山村，是容美田氏土司治所的遗址，是全国重点文物保护单位。容美田氏土司自元至大三年被授予黄沙寨千户，至正二十六年被明太祖授予容美宣抚司宣抚使，至清雍正十三年改土归流，共传15代23土司425年。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Pingshan village, Rongmei town, about 7 km from Hefeng county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 梭布垭石林
summaryEn: A karst stone forest of about 21 square kilometres in the north-west of Enshi, formed in the Ordovician period around 460 million years ago, with limestone pinnacles, narrow slot canyons and visible fossils. The scenic area has four main sections, Qinglong Temple, Lianhuazhai, Mozigou and Jiulonghui, and lies at about 1,000 metres, so it is cool in summer. It sits where Enshi, Jianshi and Fengjie in Chongqing meet.
description: 梭布垭石林位于湖北恩施州太阳河乡境内，总面积21平方千米，是中国第二大石林。梭布是土家语三个的意思，梭布垭即三个垭。整个石林景区包括青龙寺、六步关、莲花寨等八大景区。
accessEn: About 50 km from Enshi city, roughly an hour's drive from the city's airport and railway station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 仙佛寺石窟
summaryEn: A cliff-carving site on the west bank of the Youshui River in Xiangfeng town, facing Hunan's Longshan County across the water. Four main niches hold 13 Buddhist figures, carved between the Tang dynasty and the Five Dynasties period, and a side niche to the south adds sixteen small niches, each holding a small Buddha. It is one of the few surviving cliff-carving groups of this age in the middle Yangtze region, and the temple halls that once stood in front were destroyed in the 1960s.
description: 仙佛寺石窟位于中国湖北省恩施土家族苗族自治州来凤县城东北约7千米的关口村，在酉水西岸摩崖造像，北临宣恩县界，东与湖南省龙山县隔水相望。仙佛寺石窟是长江中游地区唯一的唐代摩崖造像，是全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xiangfeng town, a few kilometres north-east of Laifeng county town, on the Youshui River beside the Hunan border.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 莲花山
summaryEn: A hill park on the south side of Ezhou beside Yanglan Lake, built up with more than 30 man-made sights in dragon and lotus motifs. They include a gate tower, a pagoda called Yuanming Tower, the Jielong dragon terrace and a prayer hall, so it reads as a municipal leisure park rather than a historic site.
description: 莲花山位于湖北鄂州。游览特色包括湖泊、古塔。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the south side of Ezhou beside Yanglan Lake, about 3 km from the old centre, which is about 60 km east of central Wuhan in a straight line; a major redevelopment began in October 2023, so check which areas are open.

name: 三角山
summaryEn: Sanjiaoshan is a mountain scenic area in Lüyang township, Xishui, on the southern slopes of the Dabie Mountains, and is also a national forest park. Activities reported by the Hubei Daily include rafting through the Longtan Gorge, a bungee platform, a camper-van campsite and a ski area. It suits visitors who want outdoor activities and a cooler summer day out from Wuhan or Huanggang.
description: 三角山风景区是中国湖北省黄冈市浠水县绿杨乡境内的一个风景区，位于大别山南麓。三角山是国家4A级旅游景区和黄冈市爱国主义教育基地。风景区方圆60平方公里，主峰海拔1055米，属大陆性季风气候。
accessEn: In Lüyang township in the hills of Xishui county, reached by road from the county seat, Qingquan town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 四祖寺
summaryEn: The temple of Daoxin, the Fourth Patriarch of Chan Buddhism, founded in 624 and rebuilt several times in the Ming and Qing. Its national listing covers three old pagodas (the brick Pilu Pagoda of 651, 11.34 m high, where Daoxin died; the hexagonal stone Zhongsheng Pagoda of 1099, 8 m high; and the small Song-dynasty Robe-and-Bowl Pagoda) and two old bridges, while the temple also keeps cliff inscriptions. It is an active temple in hill country, usually visited together with Wuzu Temple.
description: 四祖寺塔位于中华人民共和国湖北省黄冈市黄梅县大河镇四祖寺村，是全国重点文物保护单位。四祖寺是唐初禅宗四祖道信的道场，始建于唐武德七年，明正德、万历及清同治年间多次重建，现存毗卢塔、众生塔、衣钵塔、灵润桥、四祖殿、蕉云阁及多方摩崖石刻。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Dahe township, about 20 km north-west of Huangmei town by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 五脑山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park in the wooded hills just north-west of Macheng city, run by its own management office. It is known for a large camellia garden of about 5,000 mu with more than 560 varieties, and also has azalea and chrysanthemum gardens; within it stands Wunaoshan Temple, a Qing-dynasty temple under provincial protection since 1992. It is a green half-day outing from the city.
description: 五脑山国家森林公园是位于湖北省黄冈市麻城市的一处国家森林公园。所在区域以五脑山林场之名列为麻城市的一个类似乡级单位。行政上由五脑山国家森林公园管理处管辖。
accessEn: A few kilometres north-west of the centre of Macheng city, on the edge of the built-up area.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 绿林山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area at Lulin town in northern Jingshan, on the Dahong Mountain side, tied by local tradition to the Lulin peasant uprising of AD 17 against Wang Mang's Xin dynasty, which gave Chinese the phrase for outlaws of the green forest. Sights include Meiren Valley, a rafting run on Yuanyang Creek and the Lulin Ancient Stockade, presented as the rebels' training base. Where the original Lulin Mountain lay is disputed, since ancient and modern sources place it in different areas.
description: 绿林山，是一个中国地名。史书记载，新莽末年农民军领袖王匡、王凤占领此地，聚集当地农民以及一些逃犯，以此作为起义根据地，形成了农民起义军绿林军。
accessEn: At Lulin town in northern Jingshan, about 35 km north of Jingshan town. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 屈家岭遗址
summaryEn: The type site of the Qujialing culture, a Neolithic farming culture of the middle Yangtze, where a village some 5,000 years old yielded carbonised rice and painted pottery cups of eggshell thinness. The national archaeological site park, in trial operation since November 2019, has a site museum, open-air areas marking a dozen excavated spots and landscaped areas on the themes of rice and water. Excavations since 2015 uncovered a large ritual building and a prehistoric water-control system, and were named one of China's top ten archaeological discoveries of 2023.
description: 屈家岭遗址是新石器时代的村落遗址，在中国湖北省荆门市屈家岭管理区，为屈家岭文化的命名遗址。1988年成为第三批全国重点文物保护单位。该遗址入选2023年度全国十大考古新发现。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the Qujialing Management District, about 70 km east-south-east of central Jingmen in a straight line.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 洈水
summaryEn: Weishui is a large reservoir resort in the hills of south-west Songzi, built round an earth dam about 9 km long whose construction began in 1958, with a lake of roughly 37 km² dotted with hundreds of wooded islands. It also takes in a national forest park of about 53 km² and karst caves such as Yan Jiangjun Cave, 2.2 km long with a flooded section, with boat trips on the lake and a large car-camping base below the dam. A memorial to the 1928 Jiulinggang uprising stands nearby.
description: 洈水水库位于中国湖北省松滋市洈水镇，是以灌溉为主，兼有防洪、发电、养殖、航运、供水等功能的大型水库。设计灌溉面积52万亩，其中湖北省松滋市27万亩、公安县10万亩、湖南省澧县15万亩。在库区北侧已设立洈水国家森林公园。
accessEn: At Weishui town, about 35 km south-west of Songzi by road, close to the Hunan border.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙湾国家考古遗址公园
summaryEn: The park preserves the Longwan site, the remains of a Chu detached palace-and-garden complex of the Eastern Zhou period that archaeologists think may be the Zhanghua Terrace, centred on the Fangyingtai mound. Because earthen remains survive poorly in the damp south, the display hall shows a full-size model of the excavated terrace base above, with real remains such as a shell-paved road, drainage pipes and a side gate exposed below. The Longwan Site Museum, about 2 km from the park gate, shows excavated finds and models of the palace.
description: 龙湾遗址，是位于中华人民共和国湖北省潜江市龙湾镇瞄新村的一个东周时期遗址，是全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Longwan town, about 25 km south-west of Qianjiang city centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大九湖
summaryEn: A high mountain basin at about 1,730 m on the western edge of Shennongjia, covering roughly 20 km², with sub-alpine peat bog, wet meadow, streams and small lakes ringed by hills, a rare habitat in central China that is listed as a wetland of international importance. It is also a water source for the middle route of the South–North Water Transfer scheme, and the area keeps traces of Quaternary glaciation, karst sinkholes and the old Sichuan–Hubei salt road. All visitors switch to a park shuttle bus at the Pingqian transfer centre, and a small train and buses run within the scenic area.
description: 大九湖是一个位于中国湖北省神农架林区的湖泊，面积约为16.6平方千米。
accessEn: In Dajiuhu town at the western end of Shennongjia, a long mountain drive west of Muyu, with the shuttle starting from Pingqian old town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 观音洞
summaryEn: A small temple-and-cave site on a hill about 3 km south of Fangxian county town. The county describes its layout as one hall, two caves, three star gods and four views: an ancestral-master hall, side-by-side caves for Guanyin and Guandi (Guan Yu), figures of the star gods Fu, Lu and Shou, and a few viewpoints. Its Qing-dynasty buildings are listed as a provincial heritage site, and it makes a short stop before heading on to Yeren Cave.
description: 观音洞位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、洞穴、历史建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 3 km south of Fangxian county town by road; Fangxian itself is about 65 km south of Shiyan as the crow flies.

name: 太极峡
summaryEn: A red-sandstone gorge on the western side of Danjiangkou Reservoir, in Shigu town. It was known as Shuanglong ('Twin Dragons') Gorge before its rename, after the Qinglong and Huanglong ridges that face each other across it. Its Danxia-type landforms led to its listing as a Hubei provincial geopark in 2008.
description: 太极峡原名双龙峡，因东西走向的两座山对峙成峡而得名，太极峡位于湖北省丹江口市石鼓镇，景区总面积40平方公里，地处丹江口水库西部，淅川香严寺南部。2008年太极峡因具有丹霞地貌特征而被劈为湖北省地质公园，2010年11月被中国国家旅游局列为国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: In Shigu town on the western shore of Danjiangkou Reservoir, about 25 km north-west of the centre of Danjiangkou city, reached by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 五龙河
summaryEn: A forested gorge scenic area on the Wulong River, a tributary of the Tianhe that rises in the Qinling foothills on the Hubei–Shaanxi border, nicknamed 'little Jiuzhaigou' locally for its clear water, waterfalls and woods. Sights include the Wangyou Bridge, the Silver Curtain waterfall and a narrow slot called 'Line of Sky', and the Xiangu Gorge has a high glass-floored walkway.
description: 五龙河位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Anjia township, about 7 km east of Yunxi county town, with shuttle buses running into the valley from the visitor transfer centre.

name: 大洪山
summaryEn: A stand-alone mountain massif of about 305 km² that straddles Suizhou, Jingshan and Zhongxiang, with 127 km² and its highest peak, Baozhu Peak (1,055 m), in Suizhou. Visitors come for the rebuilt Ci'en Buddhist temple on the peak, Bailong Pool (a crater lake high in the hills), two karst caves, a very large ancient ginkgo said to have been planted by Emperor Guangwu of the Han, and a rafting stream. It has been a national scenic area since 1988, and the hills were the base of the Lülin rebels at the end of the Western Han.
description: 大洪山位于中国湖北省随州、京山、钟祥交界处，又名绿林山因西汉末年绿林军起源于该山区而得名。主峰天柱峰，海拔1600多米。山上有喀斯特溶洞，黑龙池、白龙池、黄龙池等4大天池，在大洪山区设有大洪山风景区。
accessEn: Reached by road from Suizhou; the visitor centre is on the Suizhou side of the mountain, roughly 45 km south-west of the city centre, so allow an hour or more.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 武汉园博园
summaryEn: A public park of about 214 hectares built on a former landfill for the 10th China International Garden Expo in 2015 and kept as a city park afterwards, with its northern part in Dongxihu District and its southern part in Qiaokou District. The Expo laid it out with themed gardens from Chinese cities, and a 2020-23 survey recorded 73 bird species there, up from 26 before the restoration. It suits a half-day stroll or a family outing, and holds a large lantern fair each Chinese New Year.
description: 武汉园博园是位于中国湖北省武汉市的一个公园，总面积为213.77公顷。武汉园博园分为南、北两大区域,北区位于东西湖区，南区位于硚口区。
accessEn: In north-west Wuhan between Dongxihu and Qiaokou districts, roughly 10 km from central Hankou by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 武汉农民运动讲习所旧址
summaryEn: A late-Qing courtyard school of four brick-and-timber halls, opened in 1904 as a primary school, which housed the Kuomintang's Central Peasant Movement Training Institute in 1927, with Deng Yanda as director and Mao Zedong as deputy director. About 800 students from 17 provinces trained here between March and June that year. The halls now hold restored offices, classrooms and dormitories, plus exhibitions on the institute and the peasant movement.
description: 中央农民运动讲习所旧址纪念馆位于中国湖北省武汉市武昌区中华路街道解放路红巷，是中国全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In central Wuchang, on Hong Lane off Jiefang Road, about 1.5 km north of the Yellow Crane Tower; it houses the Wuhan Revolution Museum, which is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南漳山寨群
summaryEn: Nanzhang County has more than a thousand old stone mountain strongholds, and six built by local communities as refuges in the Ming and Qing dynasties make up the national listing. Chunqiu Stronghold in Donggong town is the one developed as a tourist area: a wall about 1.15 km long encloses more than 150 stone-built rooms on a hill ringed on three sides by the Maoping River. It suits anyone interested in vernacular defensive architecture in a mountain setting.
description: 南漳山寨群位于中华人民共和国湖北省襄阳市南漳县，是明清时期当地居民修建的防卫性堡寨，建筑均为石结构，以卧牛山寨、春秋寨、樊家寨、青龙寨、尖峰岭寨和张家寨6处为典型代表，2013年被列为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Chunqiu Stronghold lies in Donggong town in the south of Nanzhang County, beside provincial road S250 and about 45 km south of Nanzhang town as the crow flies, reached by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 襄阳古城
summaryEn: The walled old city of Xiangyang on the south bank of the Han River, whose mostly Ming-dynasty walls, 7.3 km round, are a national monument and are ringed by a moat up to 250 m wide, the basis of the saying 'iron Xiangyang'. Inside are the Zhaoming Tower, the old city's central landmark, and North Street, lined with tea houses, craft shops and snack stalls, while on the river side the gate towers of the old Xiaobeimen and Guanting wharves still stand. A 2025 city plan covers renovation of the Zhaoming Tower and North Street area, so some buildings may be under works.
description: 襄阳城位于湖北省西北部的襄阳市、汉水中游南岸。三面环水，一面靠山，城高池深，易守难攻，被誉为“铁打的襄阳”和“华夏第一城池”，故为历代兵家所看重。2001年，襄阳城墙被中华人民共和国国务院公布为第五批全国重点文物保护单位之一。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the middle of Xiangyang's Xiangcheng district on the south bank of the Han River, a short bus or taxi ride from most parts of the city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 观音湖
summaryEn: A lake-and-hills leisure district in the north of Xiaochang County, organised around Guanyin Lake, a reservoir, with the nearby hill called Dawu Mountain, which has Buddhist heritage. It is administered as a resort district in its own right, and what it offers is lakeside scenery, countryside walks and spring blossom. It suits a relaxed day out from Xiaogan.
description: 观音湖生态文化旅游渡假区是中国湖北省孝感市孝昌县境内的一处类似乡级单位。
accessEn: In Xiaowu township, about 20 km north-east of Xiaochang county town by road. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 双峰山
summaryEn: A hill resort and national forest park in Xiaochang County, in the foothills of the Dabie Mountains, centred on its twin-summit main peak, Shuangru Peak, which at 888 m is billed as the highest peak in Xiaogan. Forest covers about 89 percent of the park, and the sights include an old hill stockade (Baiyun), Shuangfeng Academy, Huilong Temple, a spring and a car-camping site. Local tradition ties the area to the Dong Yong and Seventh Fairy legend, and it suits a day of easy walking from Xiaogan.
description: 双峰山国家森林公园是位于中国湖北省孝感市东北部、孝昌县境内的一处国家森林公园。所在区域以双峰山旅游渡假区之名列为孝昌县的类似乡级单位，由孝感市双峰山旅游渡假区管委会管理。双峰山系大别山余脉。
accessEn: In the north-east of Xiaogan prefecture, in Xiaochang County, reached by road from Xiaogan city or Xiaochang county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中原军区旧址
summaryEn: A group of historic buildings in the small town of Xuanhuadian where the Communist Party's Central Plains Bureau and the Central Plains Military Region were headquartered from January to June 1946. The protected buildings include the headquarters, an assembly hall, the commanders' residence and the site of talks that Zhou Enlai held with US and Nationalist representatives that year. The Central Plains Breakout, in which the force left the encircled area, began from this district on 26 June 1946, and a renovated memorial hall in the town covers it with multimedia displays.
description: 中原军区旧址，位于中华人民共和国湖北省孝感市大悟县宣化店镇，包括中原军区司令部旧址、周恩来与美蒋代表谈判旧址、中原军区大会场旧址、中原军区首长旧居等建筑，是全国重点文物保护单位。抗日战争胜利后，中共中央命令王树声率领的河南嵩岳军区部队南下，王震、王首道率领的八路军南下支队自粤北返，于1945年10月24日在桐柏山区的唐河县与新四军第五师会合。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xuanhuadian town in the north-east of Dawu County, about 40 km east-north-east of Dawu county town, reached by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 九畹溪景区
summaryEn: Jiuwanxi is a tributary of the Yangtze in Zigui whose mouth faces the Cow Liver and Horse Lung Gorge on the Three Gorges reservoir. Its lower reach has been developed as a rafting and gorge-scenery route, and the cliffs hold rock-coffin burials from the Zhou to Han periods. The name recalls a line in Qu Yuan's poem Li Sao about growing orchids, and local legend ties the poet to the stream.
description: 九畹溪，也称九湾溪，位于中国湖北省西部秭归县境内，是长江上游右岸支流。当地政府修建宜昌九畹溪风景区，为国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: In Jiuwanxi town on the south bank of the Yangtze, about 20 km upstream of the Three Gorges Dam, reached by road from Zigui or Yichang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 夹山寺
summaryEn: A Chan Buddhist monastery in Jiashan National Forest Park, founded in 870 by the monk Shanhui and known from the Song to the Qing as Lingquan Chan Monastery; the Song master Yuanwu Keqin is said to have taught here the koan commentaries collected as the Blue Cliff Record, and the temple is promoted as a cradle of 'tea and Chan' culture. Most of its halls were pulled down after 1949 and rebuilt from 1992 to an 18th-century description, leaving the Qing-repaired old main hall, now the Guanyin Hall, as the chief survivor. On the western slope a mausoleum stands over the grave of the monk Fengtianyu, whom a 1993 conference in Shimen identified as the peasant rebel leader Li Zicheng, a claim that remains disputed and is also made for a tomb at Tongshan in Hubei.
description: 夹山寺坐落在中国湖南省常德市石门县夹山国家森林公园内，是一座汉传佛教禅宗寺院。现存伽蓝除观音殿外都是1992年重新建造。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Jiashan National Forest Park about 10 km south-east of Shimen county town; Changde is one to two hours away by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 柳叶湖
summaryEn: Liuye Lake, a lake of about 17.6 km² on the north-eastern edge of Changde, is the centre of a tourist resort set up in 1993, rated 4A in 2010 and named a national-level tourist resort in 2020. Its shores have parks and waterfront paths, a Ferris wheel, a statue of the Tang poet Liu Yuxi and lakeside hotels, while Peach Blossom Island in the lake holds a water park and the Kale Planet theme park, which has its own card. The resort combines sightseeing, water recreation and lakeside dining a short trip from the city centre.
description: 柳叶湖是一个位于中国湖南省常德市的淡水湖，面积约为17.61平方千米，属于长江区。它的一级流域为长江流域，二级流域为长江干流水系。
accessEn: On the north-eastern side of Changde, about 7 km from the city centre by taxi or city bus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大围山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park of about 47 km² on the Hunan–Jiangxi border in north-eastern Liuyang, rising to 1,607.8 m at Qixing Ridge, the highest point in the Changsha area, and the source of the Liuyang River. Trails lead through forest past more than 100 waterfalls and landforms attributed to Quaternary glaciers, azaleas cover Wuzishi Peak (1,515 m) in summer, and the mountain also has old temples such as Yuquan Temple and sites of the 1930s Red Army base.
description: 大围山坐落在中国湖南与江西二省边界。它西濒浏阳，东临铜鼓，南接万载，北邻平江，岗峦围绕，盘距四县。清嘉庆《一统志》载:大围山“岗峦围绕,盘踞四县,因名大围。
accessEn: About 150 km east of central Changsha near Daweishan town, roughly 2.5 hours by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 隆平水稻文化园
summaryEn: A park in Furong District, eastern Changsha, centred on the Longping Rice Museum, which opened fully in 2019 with three main halls on the history of rice, rice science and Yuan Longping (1930–2021), the agronomist who developed the first hybrid rice varieties in the 1970s. Around the museum in Longping Central Park are a rice-culture square and rice terraces used for hands-on paddy-farming activities, in the district that houses China's national hybrid rice research centre.
description: 隆平水稻博物馆位于中华人民共和国湖南省长沙市芙蓉区人民东路668号隆平中央公园内，是一个以水稻为主题的博物馆。主要展出袁隆平院士以及培育的杂交水稻的历史。
accessEn: On Renmin East Road in Furong District, about 7 km east of central Changsha, beside Longping Rice Museum station on Metro Line 6; the museum is closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 千龙湖
summaryEn: A national wetland park around the former Getang Reservoir of 1956 in Jinggang town, Wangcheng, whose two lakes, Qianlong and Tuantou, lie among the farmland of the Dazhongyuan polder. A resort village opened in 2004 offers a hotel and conference centre, fishing, water sports and farm produce, and the lake hosts dragon-boat races, including a qualifier of Hunan's provincial dragon-boat league in 2026.
description: 千龙湖国家湿地公园坐落在湖南省长沙市望城区境内大众垸区，属于格塘镇管辖范围。千龙湖生态旅游度假村于2002年组建，2004年7月1日正式营业，经营面积12000亩。园区规划总面积9.2平方公里，包括生态保育区、科普休闲长廊、休闲娱乐区、管理服务区等相关配套建设；目前已建“千龙湖生态旅游度假村”，经营主体为长沙千龙湖生态旅游度假有限公司。
accessEn: In Jinggang town, Wangcheng District, about 35 km north-west of central Changsha by road and some 8 km west of Jinggang Ancient Town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 秋收起义文家市会师旧址
summaryEn: Wenjiashi, a market town on the Jiangxi border, is where the units of the Autumn Harvest Uprising led by Mao Zedong regrouped on 19 September 1927, after their attacks on the cities had failed. They met at the Liren School, which occupies the Wenhua Academy of 1841, whose gate, halls, Dacheng Hall for Confucius and study rooms have been restored, and a memorial museum built beside it in 1977 displays documents, photographs and objects from the uprising.
description: 秋收起义文家市会师旧址位于中华人民共和国湖南省长沙市浏阳市文家市镇镇西头，民国时期的里仁学校校址。旧址南北朝向，经历了修缮复原，占地面积5000多平方米。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Wenjiashi town on the Jiangxi border, about 45 km south-east of Liuyang city by road; Hu Yaobang's former residence is about 6 km away. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 铜官窑国风乐园
summaryEn: A large theme park and resort opened in 2018 beside the Tongguan kiln site, with streets in Tang-dynasty style, eight small museums including one on Changsha ware, performance venues, guesthouses and three hotels. Its programme runs from day into evening with a stunt show about the Belitung ('Black Stone') shipwreck, a flying-theatre ride and folk-art performances, and at its southern end is Tongguan Old Street, a historic street of pottery workshops.
description: 铜官窑国风乐园，又名铜官窑古镇，是位于中国湖南省长沙市的主题乐园，以海上丝绸之路、铜官窑、湖湘文化为主题，是国家4A级旅游景区、国家级旅游度假区。乐园毗邻1200余年历史的长沙铜官窑遗址，投资约100亿，占地3000亩，包含八个主题街区、八个博物馆、17处人文景点及三个星级酒店。
accessEn: In Tongguan, Wangcheng District, about 30 km north of central Changsha, next to the kiln site park.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 杨开慧故居和纪念馆
summaryEn: The birthplace of Yang Kaihui (1901–1930), Mao Zedong's second wife and mother of three of his sons, who was arrested and executed in 1930, in Kaihui town, northern Changsha County. The site groups her family's earth-brick house of 1795 with 36 rooms, her tomb in a memorial garden with a marble statue and a stele of Mao's poem in her memory, the Yangsi temple school where she studied, and a memorial hall opened in 2010 on her life and those of her father Yang Changji and her sons.
description: 杨开慧故居和纪念馆位于湖南省长沙县开慧镇，是中国国家4A级旅游景区、全国百家红色旅游经典景区、国家级烈士纪念设施保护单位和全国爱国主义教育示范基地。占地126亩，建筑面积9600平方米，由杨开慧故居、杨开慧烈士陵园、杨开慧生平业绩陈列馆、杨公庙四部分组成，1966年对外开放。
accessEn: In Kaihui town, northern Changsha County, about 60 km north-east of central Changsha, roughly an hour by road. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 周洛大峡谷
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area around Shizhu Peak (1,359.7 m) in Shegang town, northern Liuyang, at the source of the Laodao River, with a core of about 14 km² of streams, waterfalls, quartz-veined rock and wild osmanthus groves. Old houses such as the Chen family mansion and a water-mouth pagoda stand in the valley villages, which also have hotels and farm restaurants.
description: 周洛风景区地处湖南省浏阳市连云山脉西部石柱峰周边地区，为捞刀河发源地。主景区位于社港镇，包括自然和人文景观两大部分；核心景区以自然景观为主，面积约14平方公里。周洛最早开发于2001年5月1日，其时通过“周洛旅游文化村”名义以农家乐形式对外进行旅游度假接待服务；2004年11月23日，张家界旅游经济开发有限公司获得核心景区五十年的经营权。
accessEn: In Shegang town, northern Liuyang, about 30 km north of Liuyang city and some 70 km north-east of central Changsha.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 板梁古村
summaryEn: A Liu-clan farming village in Gaotingsi town, Yongxing County, first built in 1358, whose lanes of grey-brick houses, ancestral halls and gateways survive largely from the Ming and Qing; 29 old buildings make up the national heritage group, among them the Upper Village Ancestral Hall of 1443 and the early-Ming Lower Village hall. The Middle Village hall (1420) is also a site of the 1928 Xiangnan Uprising, where local peasant forces seized the militia's guns. The village is lived in, with small stalls and guesthouses for visitors.
description: 板梁村古建筑群位于中国湖南省郴州市永兴县高亭司镇板梁村，是一处建于明清时期的传统古村落建筑群，初建于元至正十八年，现存建筑群主体为29处古建筑，其中明代建筑包括建于明正统八年的上村宗祠和建于明初的下村宗祠。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Gaotingsi town, Yongxing County, about an hour by road north of Chenzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 回龙山
summaryEn: A mountain of about 1,413 m north of Dongjiang Lake in Zixing, rated 4A in December 2024 and visited for sunrise, sunset and sea-of-cloud views from the top and for wild azaleas in May. A hotel, cliff-side guesthouses and a campsite on the mountain let visitors stay overnight, and it is marketed together with the lake ('the lake by day, the mountain by night').
description: 回龙山位于湖南郴州。游览特色包括湖泊、高山景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the hills north of Dongjiang Lake, about 45 minutes by mountain road from Zixing city and some 1.5 hours from Chenzhou.

name: 莽山
summaryEn: A large mountain forest at the southern tip of Yizhang County on the Hunan–Guangdong border, protected as a national nature reserve and national forest park; its subtropical forest has species named after it, such as the Mangshan pit viper. The main visitor zone is Wuzhi Feng (Five-Finger Peak), where a cableway, a vertical lift and cliff-side walkways run to the summit viewpoints, so that older and less mobile visitors can get up too.
description: 莽山，位于中国湖南省郴州市宜章县最南端，地处湘粤交界地带，因蟒蛇出没、林海莽莽而得名。莽山是全球同纬度最大的原始森林，有“中国原始生态第一山”之称，建有国家森林公园、国家级自然保护区，是国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: About 70 km south of Yizhang county town by mountain road (roughly 1.5 hours), or 2–2.5 hours from Chenzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 蔡伦纪念园
summaryEn: A memorial park in central Leiyang, home town of Cai Lun, the Eastern Han court official credited with improving papermaking around AD 105. At its core is Cai Hou Temple, a brick-and-timber shrine rebuilt in the late Qing on the site said to be his old home, beside Caizi Pond. The park around it was laid out in 2001 and includes a cenotaph tomb and a workshop demonstrating traditional papermaking.
description: 蔡伦纪念园位于湖南衡阳。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In central Leiyang, about 60 km south of Hengyang, roughly an hour by road.

name: 中国印山
summaryEn: A limestone hillside in Miaoqian Town, Changning, known locally as Yanbeiling, on which thousands of designs of historic Chinese seals have been carved into the rocks since 2003. The project was started by the printmaker Wu Guowei, and the carvings reproduce seals from Shang bronze seals to the Qin imperial seal and Tang official seals, in both relief and intaglio; the scenic area, reopened after an upgrade in 2020, also takes in a cave and flower fields.
description: 中国印山位于湖南省常宁市庙前镇，2003年5月创建，有几百枚中国玺印图案摩岩于山石上。
accessEn: In Miaoqian Town in the south of Changning, roughly 1.5–2 hours by road south of Hengyang city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 王船山故居
summaryEn: Xiangxi Caotang is the thatched retreat where the Ming loyalist philosopher Wang Fuzhi (Wang Chuanshan, 1619–1692) spent his final years writing, in Qulan Town, Hengyang County. Built in 1675, the modest brick-and-timber house of about 176 m² is a typical rural home of southern Hunan, and the national listing also covers his tomb in the same area.
description: 王船山故居，又称湘西草堂，座落于湖南省衡阳市衡阳县曲兰镇湘西村菜塘弯，始建于康熙十四年，是王船山晚年隐居的住所。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Qulan Town, Hengyang County, about 50 km north-west of Hengyang city, roughly an hour by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 夏明翰故居
summaryEn: The ancestral home of Xia Minghan (1900–1928), an early Communist organiser executed in Hankou in 1928 and remembered for the poem he wrote before his death, in Lizi Village, Hongshi Town, Hengyang County. The Qing-era compound of 45 rooms, built around 1745, was restored and opened in 2005. It now holds an exhibition on his life, a calligraphy display and restored living rooms.
