description: 夏明翰故居位于中华人民共和国湖南省衡阳市衡阳县洪市镇礼梓村，始建于清乾隆年间，2005年修葺后正式对外开放。夏明翰故居是首批衡阳市爱国主义教育示范基地、衡阳市党员教育基地、全国爱国主义教育示范基地，衡阳市首个党性教育基地。
accessEn: In Hongshi Town, Hengyang County, about 50 km north-west of Hengyang city, roughly an hour by road; buses run from Hengyang and Xidu.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 衡阳奇石文化博物馆
summaryEn: A private museum of ornamental stones in Zhengxiang District, the first private museum approved by Hunan's cultural relics bureau, run by the collector Liu Xuanling. Its two main halls show large and small decorative stones respectively, and galleries on minerals, crystals, fossils and geology serve as a science education base for young people.
description: 衡阳市奇石文化博物馆位于中华人民共和国湖南省衡阳市蒸湘区，是湖南省文物局批准的省内首家私人博物馆，也是国家AAA级旅游景区。
accessEn: On Jiefang Avenue West in Zhengxiang District, western Hengyang, a taxi ride from the city centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南湖公园
summaryEn: A wetland park around a former reservoir on the south-western side of central Hengyang, opened in 2014 and the city's largest urban wetland park. Boardwalks, zig-zag bridges and pavilions ring the lake, with restaurants and tea rooms on the shore.
description: 衡阳南湖公园，位于中华人民共和国湖南省衡阳市蒸湘区，是衡阳市区湿地面积最大的公园。
accessEn: In Yanfeng District on the south-western side of central Hengyang, a short taxi ride from the centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 岐山
summaryEn: Qishan, formerly called Fenghuang Shan and counted among the 72 peaks of Mount Heng, is a hill in the west of Hengnan County rising to 741 m, protected as a provincial forest park since 1998. Its secondary broadleaf forest is rich in nanmu trees and has 26 ancient ginkgos, ten of them more than 300 years old. Renrui Temple, a provincial heritage site, stands on the mountain.
description: 岐山，位于湖南省衡阳市衡南县。
accessEn: In the far west of Hengnan County, about 50 km west of Hengyang city, roughly an hour by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 石鼓书院
summaryEn: Shigu Academy stands on Shigu Hill, where the Zheng and Lei rivers join the Xiang in the north of Hengyang city. Founded around 810 under the Tang and twice given imperial name boards in the Song, it is often counted among the four great academies of the Song, and the Neo-Confucian philosopher Zhu Xi wrote a record of it in 1187. The old buildings were destroyed by Japanese bombing in 1939, and today's complex is a Qing-style reconstruction that opened in 2007.
description: 石鼓书院位于中国湖南省衡阳市城北蒸水、湘江、耒水汇合处的石鼓山。书院始建于唐元和五年，为宋朝四大书院之首，迄今已有1200年的历史。它三面环水、四面凭虚、地理位置独特，风光秀丽绝美，山上绿树成荫，亭台楼阁，飞檐翘角，江面帆影涟涟，渔歌唱晚，自古有“石鼓江山锦绣华”之美誉。
accessEn: In Shigu District on the riverfront in the north of central Hengyang, a short taxi ride from the city centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 水口山铅锌矿冶遗址
summaryEn: Mining in the Shuikoushan area of Changning goes back more than a thousand years, and the Qing government set up a mining bureau here in 1896; the listed industrial site has 19 features above and below ground, including old shafts, smelting halls and workers' housing. In 1922 Mao Zedong visited the mine, and later that year the miners' club organised a major strike. Visitors can see a new labour-movement memorial hall, opened in 2021, and the older exhibition hall in a building put up in 1953 for Soviet experts.
description: 水口山铅锌矿冶遗址位于湖南省常宁市松柏镇和水口山街道，总分布范围达120公顷。遗址包括19处地面遗迹和地下遗迹，反映了水口山铅锌矿的发展历史。水口山铅锌矿冶遗址于2011年入选第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 40 km south of Hengyang city, roughly an hour by road. The memorial hall is closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 四明山
summaryEn: A forested mountain on the western edge of Qidong County, said to take its name from the four neighbouring counties it looks out over; it became a provincial forest park in 2004 and a national forest park in 2014. Besides woodland walks, the mountain has Siming Temple, said to date from the early Tang, and the late-Ming Tengyun Zushi Hall.
description: 四明山，因靠近双牌、祁阳、东安、邵阳四县，故名四明山，又名四望山，位于湖南省衡阳市祁东县县境边缘。
accessEn: On the western edge of Qidong County, roughly 2 hours by road west of Hengyang city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 安江农校杂交水稻纪念园
summaryEn: The former campus of the Anjiang Agricultural School in Anjiang town, where the rice scientist Yuan Longping taught and did research from 1953 and where his team developed China's three-line hybrid rice system. The memorial park keeps school buildings from 1939 to the 1980s, among them Yuan's former home, the assembly hall, a genetics laboratory, a glasshouse and the experimental rice fields, and the Hybrid Rice Birthplace Museum, opened in 2024, stands about 1 km away. Across the Yuan River lies the Gaomiao Neolithic site, where carbonised rice grains about 7,400 years old have been found.
description: 安江农业学校旧址在湖南省黔阳县安江镇溪边村胜觉寺，搬迁后原址改建为安江农校纪念园。
accessEn: In Anjiang town, Hongjiang, about 45 minutes by road south-east of Huaihua city; Anjiang East high-speed station is close by.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 二酉山
summaryEn: A hill at the meeting of the You River and the Youxi stream north-west of Yuanling town, tied by legend to the scholar Fu Sheng, who is said to have hidden banned books in a cave here during the Qin book burning; the place became a byword for learning in Chinese. Rated 4A in 2025 and promoted as China's Book Mountain, it has a stepped path up to the cave, a visitor centre with exhibition rooms and a floating footbridge across the river.
description: 二酉山，也称二酉，是大酉山和小酉山的合称，现位于中国湖南省怀化市沅陵县，此地亦是酉水、酉溪二水合流之处。相传上古时期黄帝曾于此处藏书。秦始皇焚书坑儒时，博士伏胜偷运禁书五车，藏于山半石洞，直至秦亡，才拿出来献给汉高祖刘邦，终于保住春秋诸子百家不致断绝。
accessEn: In Eryou township, about 15 km north-west of Yuanling town, around 25 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 高椅古村
summaryEn: A Dong village in Gaoyi township, Huitong County, ringed by hills on three sides and a river on the fourth, where 104 houses built between 1380 and 1881 survive. Most villagers are surnamed Yang and trace their descent from the 10th-century local leader Yang Zaisi; it became a China Historical and Cultural Village in 2007 and was rated 4A in 2025.
description: 高椅村位于中国湖南省怀化市会同县高椅乡，2007年被列为中国历史文化名村。高椅村三面环山，一面临水，全村共2205人，85%为杨姓，侗族，系南宋诰封“威远侯”杨再思的后裔。高椅村保存有明洪武十三年到清光绪七年间修建的民居104栋。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About an hour by road from Huitong county town or from Hongjiang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙兴讲寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple on the southern foot of Huxi Hill in Yuanling town, traditionally founded in 628 by order of the Tang emperor Taizong, whose halls preserve building styles from the Song to the Qing and are described as the oldest surviving group of timber buildings in Hunan. The Mahavira Hall of the late Yuan or early Ming, nearly 20 m high on 24 nanmu columns, carries a plaque by the Ming calligrapher Dong Qichang, and the philosopher Wang Yangming is recorded as lecturing here for a month on his way back from exile in Guizhou. From the Guanyin Pavilion at the back there are views over the Yuan River.
description: 龙兴寺，又称龙兴讲寺，坐落在中国湖南省怀化市沅陵县虎溪山的南麓，是一座保留有宋代至清代建筑风格的佛寺建筑，是湖南省境内现存最古老的木构建筑群。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Yuanling town, a short taxi ride from the centre; Yuanling is about 2 hours by road north of Huaihua. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黔阳古城
summaryEn: The old walled town of Qiancheng, former seat of Qianyang County, sits where the Wu River meets the Yuan, with water on three sides, and keeps about 0.8 km² of flagstone lanes lined mainly with Ming and Qing buildings. Survivals include the west Zhongzheng Gate with its gate tower, the bell and drum tower, the Wanshou Palace, the Baoshan Academy, the old county yamen and the Chifeng Pagoda. Furong Tower, a garden pavilion complex built in memory of the Tang poet Wang Changling, has a stele corridor of more than a hundred carved inscriptions in the hands of Yan Zhenqing, Huang Tingjian, Mi Fu and other calligraphers.
description: 黔阳古城位于湖南怀化。游览特色包括古城、古塔、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Qiancheng, the seat of Hongjiang City, about an hour by road south-west of Huaihua.

name: 通道转兵纪念地
summaryEn: Gongcheng Academy in Xianxi town was founded in 1105 as the Luomeng Academy and rebuilt by Dong craftsmen in 1792, and is one of the more complete academies surviving in a Dong area. On 12 December 1934 leaders of the Central Red Army on the Long March met here and decided to turn west into Guizhou rather than north into western Hunan, the episode known as the Tongdao Turn. The Tongdao Turn Memorial Hall stands beside the academy.
description: 通道转兵纪念地位于湖南怀化。游览特色包括纪念展览、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xianxi town, about 30 km north-west of Tongdao county town by road. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 万佛山
summaryEn: A Danxia landscape of red sandstone peaks, cliffs and forest in Wanfoshan town, Tongdao, whose main summit rises to 635 m; together with nearby Dong villages it became a national scenic area in 2009. Named sights include the Wanfo summit, Qiansui Peak and Xianrenju, and the summit looks out over hundreds of peaks rising from the forest.
description: 万佛山位于中国湖南省怀化市通道侗族自治县万佛山镇，海拔635米，相对高度90米。2009年底与侗寨一同以万佛山·侗寨风景名胜区的名义列为国家重点风景名胜区。属丹霞地貌景观。
accessEn: In Wanfoshan town, about 20 km north-east of Tongdao county town by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 芋头侗寨
summaryEn: A Dong village in Shuangjiang town founded in the Hongwu reign of the early Ming and rebuilt after a fire in the Shunzhi reign of the Qing, its seven clusters of houses strung along the Yutou stream. Its old buildings include four drum towers, among them the Lusheng Drum Tower, three covered bridges, a gate tower, two Sa altars, two old wells, 78 timber stilt houses and a stretch of old post road.
description: 芋头侗寨古建筑群位于中国湖南省通道侗族自治县双江镇芋头村，2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。芋头侗寨始建于明洪武年间，清顺治年间大火后重建，形成七个聚居点。主要的古建筑有四座鼓楼、三座风雨桥、一座门楼、两口古井、两座萨岁台、七十八座吊脚楼以及古驿道等。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 9 km south-west of Tongdao county town, around 15 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大熊山
summaryEn: A mountain forest park in northern Xinhua whose peaks include Jiulong Feng (1,622 m), the highest in central Hunan, and Daxiong Feng (1,602 m), with gorges, waterfalls, old forest and more than 40 summits over 1,000 m. Local tradition makes it the homeland of Chiyou, the legendary rival of the Yellow Emperor, and there are a Chiyou culture park and hall, the rebuilt Xiongshan Temple, a forest of old monks' stupas and Qing rock inscriptions.
description: 大熊山国有林场又称大熊山林场，位于湖南省娄底市新化县北部的大熊山，距新化县城62公里。此处国有林场与大熊山国家森林公园管理处为两块牌子、一套班子。所在区域列为新化县的一个类似乡级单位。
accessEn: About 62 km north of Xinhua county town by road, roughly 1.5 hours.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 蔡和森、蔡畅故居
summaryEn: Guangjia Hall, a late-Qing brick-and-timber farmhouse in Yangqiu village, Jingzi town, where the family of the early Communist leader Cai Hesen (1895–1931) settled in 1899 and where his sister Cai Chang, later first chair of the All-China Women's Federation, was born in 1900. The single-storey house of about 550 m², U-shaped around a main hall, side wings and a courtyard, carries a name board written by Deng Xiaoping in 1985; the family had to sell it in 1908.
description: 蔡和森、蔡畅故居名为光甲堂，位于湖南省双峰县井字镇杨球村，是蔡和森和蔡畅兄妹青少年时期的居所。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Jingzi town in eastern Shuangfeng, about 4 km from Zeng Guofan's Fuhou Hall and roughly 40 minutes by road from Shuangfeng town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 蔡锷故居
summaryEn: The farmhouse in Cai'e Township, Daxiang District, where Cai E, the general who led the 1915–16 National Protection War against Yuan Shikai's attempt to restore the monarchy, was born in 1882. The simple three-bay mud-brick house collapsed in 1950 and was rebuilt to its original form in 1991; a neighbouring house holds an exhibition on his life, and the surrounding Cai E hometown scenic area was rated 4A in 2021.
description: 蔡锷故居位于湖南邵阳大祥区蔡锷乡蔡锷村，清光绪八年十一月初九日蔡锷将军诞生在此，蔡锷当年在这里发蒙识字度过了童年生活。2006年，蔡锷故居被国务院公布为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。2021年，蔡锷故里景区晋升为4A级旅游景区。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Cai'e Township on the south-eastern edge of Shaoyang, about half an hour by road from the city centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 塘田战时讲学院旧址
summaryEn: A late-Qing country villa built in 1877 for the official Xi Baotian at Tangtianshi in Shaoyang County, where in June 1938 the historian Lü Zhenyu, sent by the Communist educator Xu Teli, opened the Tangtian Wartime Lecture Institute; the Nationalist authorities closed it in April 1939. The villa survives as four rows of timber-framed buildings between fire walls, with sixteen blocks and more than sixty rooms.
description: 塘田战时讲学院位于湖南省邵阳县塘田市对河村。院址原来是清朝末年“光禄大夫”、太子少保席宝田的别墅，于清光绪1877年兴建。1938年6月吕振羽受徐特立委派，在这里创办了塘田战时讲学院，1939年4月被国民党查封解散。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Duihe village by Tangtianshi Town, Shaoyang County, about an hour by road south-west of Shaoyang city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东山书院
summaryEn: A late-Qing academy at the foot of Dongtai Hill in Xiangxiang, founded in 1895 and finished in 1900, which in 1905 became a modern-style higher primary school; the young Mao Zedong was admitted in 1909, and the generals Chen Geng and Tan Zheng also studied here. Its buildings, largely as built, follow the Hunan academy plan, with a moat and stone bridge before the gate, three halls on the axis, five study wings on each side and a library, plus some Western touches; the classroom added in 1905, where Mao studied, survives. The academy is part of Dongshan School, still a working secondary school, and the historic area is open as a 4A scenic area.
description: 东山书院旧址位于中国湖南省湘乡市东台山麓。为东山学院的建筑遗迹，现为东山学校的一部分。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the eastern side of Xiangxiang city, about 40 km west of Xiangtan; under an hour by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 茅浒水乡
summaryEn: A leisure park on Dongshan Island, a sandbar in the Lian River below Dongtai Hill on the eastern edge of Xiangxiang, built around the theme of Zeng Guofan's Xiang Army, whose river navy, by local legend, trained here. Visitors cross the 128 m 'Xiang Army Bridge' hung with plaques of the army's leaders' writings, can take a river trip on a full-size replica of the gunboat Weijing, and see an old ferry boat linked to stories of the young Mao Zedong.
description: 茅浒水乡度假村是位于中国湘乡市东郊东山湖中的一个中国国家3A级旅游景区。主要旅游点包括自然山水景观旅游、生态农业旅游、毛泽东成长之路的东山红色旅游区、曾国藩水师寨的历史文化旅游等。它是湖南省农业旅游示范点、2008年和2009年湘潭市最佳景区，2008年被评为国家3A级景区。
accessEn: On the eastern edge of Xiangxiang city near the Dongshan hydropower station and Dongshan Academy; about an hour by road west of Xiangtan. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 水府庙水库
summaryEn: A large irrigation reservoir on the Lian River, built in 1958–63, whose main body lies in western Xiangxiang, with the dam at Xikou in Shuangfeng County; its winding arms and dozens of wooded islands form a national wetland park and the Shuifu scenic area. Boats leave from the scenic-area wharf for trips among the islands, where egrets gather, and it is a popular weekend outing for families driving from Xiangtan and Loudi.
description: 水府庙水库主体位于中国湖南省湘乡市，大坝位于双峰县境内，库尾回水到达娄底市娄星区。因大坝位于双峰县杏子铺镇溪口村，故又名溪口水库，属不完全年调节水库。以灌溉为主要功能。
accessEn: Reached along Shuifu Avenue from Qizi town in western Xiangxiang, close to the Shanghai–Kunming expressway; about an hour by road west of Xiangtan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 边城茶峒
summaryEn: A riverside town on the Qingshui River where Hunan, Guizhou and Chongqing meet; formerly called Chadong, it was renamed Biancheng in 2005 after Shen Congwen's novella Border Town (Biancheng), which is set here. Visitors walk the stone lanes, cross the river on the hand-pulled cable ferry, stand at the three-province boundary marker and visit Cuicui Island, with a 9 m marble statue of the novel's heroine by the artist Huang Yongyu.
description: 边城茶峒位于湖南湘西。游览特色包括岛屿、滨水景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the far west of Huayuan County on the Chongqing border, roughly 30–40 minutes by road from Huayuan county town.

name: 浦市古镇
summaryEn: A former river port on the Yuan River in Luxi County that thrived in the Ming and Qing dynasties, when it was nicknamed 'Little Nanjing'. Its listed old buildings include the Wanshou Palace guild hall, the ancestral halls and family compounds of the Li and Ji clans, a Li family academy, old merchant houses and shops, an escort agency and an embroidery tower, and the town is regarded as the birthplace of Chenhe high-pitched opera (Chenhe Gaoqiang).
description: 浦市镇古建筑群位于中国湖南省湘西土家族苗族自治州泸溪县浦市镇，是一处明清时期的古镇建筑群，2019年被列为第八批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About an hour by road east of Jishou, on the Yuan River in Luxi County.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 乾州古城
summaryEn: An old walled town on the Wanrong River in southern Jishou, the prefecture capital, with stone-paved lanes, old gates and a riverside street. Its listed monument is the Confucian Temple, founded in 1729, burnt during a Miao uprising in the 1790s and rebuilt from 1801; after losses in the Cultural Revolution only the double-eaved Dacheng Hall, the semicircular pool and its bridge survived, and the temple was restored in 2007, with two side halls now holding exhibitions on the war against Japan and on notable people of Xiangxi.
description: 乾州文庙位于中国湖南省湘西州吉首市乾州古城内，始建于清雍正七年，富有湘西少数民族地域特色。2013年列入第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the Qianzhou area of southern Jishou, a short taxi ride from the city centre and about 5 km from Jishou East high-speed station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 太平山
summaryEn: A forested mountain park about 4 km from Longshan county town, long a Buddhist site with temple halls on its slopes. Springs from the karst hills gather in a six-tiered waterfall more than 30 m high that falls into a pool ringed by peaks, and after rain the mountain is known for its sea of cloud.
description: 太平山位于湖南湘西。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 4 km from Longshan county town, a short drive.

name: 勾蓝瑶寨
summaryEn: A walled Yao village in Lanxi township, Jiangyong, founded in the Ming dynasty and spread over about 6 km², defended by stone walls, watch houses and gate towers. Within them stand some 30 listed structures, including ancestral halls, temples, an academy, shops, covered bridges, pavilions and an old paved road, among more than 300 Ming and Qing houses. The village keeps its own customs, notably the 'Xini' (mud-washing) festival.
description: 勾蓝瑶寨位于中国湖南省永州市江永县兰溪瑶族乡，是一处始建于明代的瑶族传统村寨，占地面积约6平方千米，包含石寨墙、守夜屋、门楼构建的防御体系，以及祠堂、庙、书院、商铺、民居、风雨桥、凉亭、古道等30处建筑。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 40 minutes by road south-west of Jiangyong county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 九嶷山舜帝陵
summaryEn: The temple-mausoleum of Shun, the legendary sage-king whom the Records of the Grand Historian say died on a tour of the south and was buried at Jiuyi, set below Shunyuan Peak in the Jiuyi Mountains. Moved here in 1371 and rebuilt several times, it was restored between 1985 and 1998 with a gate, sacrificial halls, a spirit way of stone figures and some thirty Qing stelae recording imperial sacrifices, and the ceremony to Shun held here is national intangible heritage. About 3 km south, at Yuguan Rock, the excavated foundations of the earlier Tang and Song temple form an archaeological park beside cliff carvings, among them a large 'Jiuyi Shan' inscription by the Southern Song writer Fang Xinru.
description: 九嶷山舜帝陵位于湖南省宁远县南30公里九嶷山，是中国古代传说人物舜的陵墓，是全国两座舜帝陵之一。2011年，舜帝祭典被列入第三批国家级非物质文化遗产。2019年，中国国务院公布第八批全国重点文物保护单位，九嶷山舜帝陵并入第六批全国重点文物保护单位——舜帝庙遗址。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 30 km south of Ningyuan county town by road, roughly 40 minutes; Ningyuan is about 1½ hours by road south-east of Lingling.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 浯溪碑林
summaryEn: Cliffs on the west bank of the Xiang River where the Wuxi stream flows in, about 2 km west of Qiyang, carved since the Tang dynasty with around 500 poems, records and pieces of calligraphy by figures including Yan Zhenqing, Huang Tingjian and Mi Fu. The best known is the 'Ode to the Restoration of the Great Tang', composed by Yuan Jie and written by Yan Zhenqing, prized as the 'three wonders' cliff for its text, calligraphy and stone. A digital museum of the carvings opened in the visitor centre in December 2024.
description: 浯溪摩崖石刻，位于湘江西岸与浯溪交汇处，距湖南省祁阳市城西约2公里。第三批全国重点文物保护单位，第一批古代名碑名刻文物，湖南省省级爱国主义教育基地。江边崖岸上刻有书画诗文词题486处。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the western edge of Qiyang city, about 2 km from the centre; Qiyang is about an hour by road north-east of Lengshuitan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大云山
summaryEn: A forested mountain of 911 m on the border of Yueyang County and Linxiang, a national forest park since 1996 and an old Daoist and Buddhist pilgrimage hill whose restored temples draw worshippers from Hunan, Hubei and Jiangxi, above all at the fairs on the third day of the third lunar month and the ninth day of the ninth. On a cliff beside Longxing Palace is the 'Three Battles, Three Victories' inscription of December 1942, four characters each over 2 m tall with a commentary signed by the Nationalist general Yang Sen, marking the defence of Changsha against three Japanese offensives.
description: 大云山三战三捷摩崖石刻位于湖南省岳阳县大云山隆兴宫西侧的石崖上，是一处纪念抗日战争的摩崖石刻，为中国官兵抵御外敌的历史见证。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In northern Yueyang County, roughly an hour by road east of Yueyang city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 任弼时故居
summaryEn: The birthplace of Ren Bishi (1904–1950), a senior Communist military and political leader who was political commissar of He Long's Second Front Army on the Long March, in Bishi town in southern Miluo. The timber farmhouse of 31 rooms, with a name board written by Deng Xiaoping in 1980, stands beside a memorial hall showing close to 200 objects and more than 400 photographs, and a square with a 7.1 m bronze statue.
description: 任弼时故居位于中华人民共和国湖南省岳阳市汨罗市弼时镇弼时村新屋里。1904年4月30日，任弼时出生于此。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Bishi town, under an hour by road north of Changsha or about 40 minutes south of Miluo city. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 平江起义纪念馆
summaryEn: The former Tianyue Academy, founded in 1720 and moved to this site in 1867, a complex of white gable walls and grey tiles now within the grounds of Pingjiang No. 1 Middle School, where Peng Dehuai, Teng Daiyuan and Huang Gonglüe launched the Pingjiang Uprising on 22 July 1928 and formed the Fifth Red Army. The academy has been a memorial since the 1980s; the present complex, opened in 2008 and refreshed in 2018, adds an exhibition hall on the uprising and on Peng's career to the restored rooms, with an equestrian bronze of Peng Dehuai (1990) on the square in front.
description: 平江起义旧址原为天岳书院，位于位于湖南省平江县城东1.5公里的平江县一中校园内，占地面积5948平方米，建筑面积3907平方米。1928年7月22日，彭德怀、滕代远、黄公略等在此领导和发动了的“平江起义”，成立中国工农红军第五军。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Shuyuan Road in Pingjiang county town, about 1.5 hours by road from Changsha or Yueyang. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 圣安寺
summaryEn: A large Buddhist temple on the northern spur of Lengjia Hill above South Lake, rebuilt from 1997 by monks from Nanyue on the site of a Tang-dynasty monastery whose abbot Wuxing was commemorated in inscriptions by the writer Liu Zongyuan. Five courtyards climb the slope past a five-arched gateway, the Hall of Heavenly Kings and the main hall to a Guanyin hall with a 5 m gilded camphor-wood thousand-armed Guanyin, and on the summit a nine-storey pagoda 53 m tall looks over South Lake, the city and Dongting Lake.
description: 圣安寺，又称圣安古寺，为湖南岳阳一座佛教寺院。
accessEn: About 3 km south of central Yueyang near South Lake, a short taxi ride.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 洋沙湖
summaryEn: A resort district built around the 4.3 km² Yangsha Lake on the southern edge of Xiangyin town, opened in 2017 and themed on the area's old fishing-village culture. After an upgrade it reopened in May 2026 with a fishing-village water town, a farmers' market, a waterside flower street, children's play areas and animal-contact attractions alongside its lakeside hotels and walks, and it is aimed at families from Changsha and nearby cities.
description: 洋沙湖是一个位于中国湖南省岳阳市湘阴县洋沙湖镇的淡水湖，面积约为4.29平方千米，属于长江区。它的一级流域为长江流域，二级流域为长江干流水系。
accessEn: On the southern edge of Xiangyin town, about an hour by road north of Changsha and some 60 km from Changsha Huanghua airport.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 左宗棠文化园
summaryEn: A memorial park of about 18 ha in Xiangyin, the home county of Zuo Zongtang (1812–1885), the Qing general and statesman who fought the Taiping and other rebellions and led the reconquest of Xinjiang, and whose name was borrowed for the dish General Tso's chicken. Its core is the Zuo Wenxiang Temple, built on imperial order by the Hunan governor Wu Dacheng after Zuo's death and completed in 1892, around which a 2012 extension added a memorial museum of eight galleries, an 11.1 m granite statue on a square, a gallery of poems and couplets on steles and a 'chronology avenue'.
description: 左宗棠文化园位于湖南岳阳。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xiangyin county town near the Xiang River, about an hour by road north of Changsha; the Confucius Temple and Yuezhou Kiln Site Museum are about 1.5 km away.

name: 李立三故居
summaryEn: The childhood home of Li Lisan (1899–1967), a Chinese Communist politician and Politburo member, on the eastern side of Liling, known as Yuyuan ('Taro Garden') from the name over its gate. It is a single-storey courtyard farmhouse in eastern-Hunan style with 32 rooms behind yellow walls, built in the 1880s and bought by his grandfather in 1891.
description: 李立三故居，别称“芋园”，地址位于中国湖南省株洲市醴陵市阳三石街道立三村，是李立三的出生地和青少年时期的居所。现为全国重点文物保护单位和爱国主义教育基地以及国家3A级旅游景区。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Lisan village on the eastern side of Liling city, a short taxi ride from the centre; Liling is on the Shanghai–Kunming high-speed railway. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东江纵队纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial museum in Dalingshan town on the East River Column, the Communist-led guerrilla force that fought the Japanese in the Dongguan, Huiyang, Bao'an and Hong Kong area during the Second World War. Around it are nine preserved sites of the force's Dalingshan base of 1940–1943, including its headquarters, a meeting room, a newspaper office, a clinic and a former academy.
description: 东江纵队纪念馆位于广东东莞。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Dalingshan town, about 15 km south of central Dongguan by road. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 松山湖
summaryEn: A large reservoir lake at the heart of Dongguan's Songshan Lake high-tech park, with lakeside parkland laid out from 2002. Roads, footpaths and cycle tracks follow the wooded shore, and it is mainly visited for cycling and lakeside walks.
description: 松山湖景区是中华人民共和国广东省东莞市东莞松山湖高新技术产业开发区内的一个国家4A级旅游景区，内有14平方公里的生态绿地、600平方米的人工绿地、300万株的树木和8平方公里的松山湖、130公里的主干道、42公里的滨湖路和10公里的人行道和自行车道。
accessEn: In the Songshan Lake district, about 30 minutes by road south-east of central Dongguan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 碧水湾温泉度假村
summaryEn: A hot-spring hotel resort on the banks of the Liuxi River in Conghua's hot-spring area, opened in 2002 by the civil aviation air traffic bureau for central and southern China. It combines hot-spring bathing pools with rooms, restaurants and meeting facilities, and suits a relaxing overnight stay.
description: 广州从化碧水湾温泉度假村位于广东省从化区温泉镇御泉大道353号。其座落于从化流溪河畔，占地240亩，建筑面积4万多平方米，是一家集住宿、餐饮、休闲娱乐、会议、商务为一体的温泉度假村。由民航中南空管局投资，于2002年9月28日开业，2005年被国家旅游局评为国家4A级景区。
accessEn: On Yuquan Avenue in Liangkou, Conghua District, about 80 km north-east of central Guangzhou, roughly 1.5 hours by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 九龙湖
summaryEn: Jiulong Lake is a resort area in the hills of Huadong, Huadu, set around a large lake and wooded hills, whose golf club hosted the golf events of the 2010 Asian Games. Since 2021 it has been redeveloped by China Travel Service with the resort brand Aranya into a holiday community with hotels, restaurants, lakeside walks and arts events. It suits a weekend break or a lakeside stroll rather than sightseeing.
description: 九龙湖位于广东广州。游览特色包括湖泊、林地风光、高尔夫。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Huadong town, Huadu District, about 40 km north of central Guangzhou, best reached by car.

name: 岭南印象园
summaryEn: When Lianxi village was cleared in 2003 to build the Higher Education Mega Center, several of its old buildings, including ancestral halls and oyster-shell walls, were kept and restored, and some houses were moved here from elsewhere on the island, alongside new buildings in traditional Lingnan style. Opened as a folk-culture village in 2008 and reopened in 2021 after renovation, it has themed halls on Cantonese opera and music, puppetry, wedding customs, crafts and martial arts along a canal-side main street.
description: 岭南印象园是中华人民共和国广东省广州市番禺区小谷围岛广州大学城南部一座以岭南乡土风情及民俗文化为特色的旅游景区，由原番禺练溪村的古村落改造而成，总占地面积16.5公顷，2012年被评为国家AAAA级旅游景区。
accessEn: On the southern side of Guangzhou Higher Education Mega Center (Xiaoguwei Island) in Panyu District, near Higher Education Mega Center South metro station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 霍山
summaryEn: A mountain of red Danxia rock cliffs and crags in Tianxin town, northern Longchuan County, counted among the seven famous mountains of Guangdong and protected as a provincial forest park. Poets from Su Dongpo to Qu Dajun wrote about it, and it became a 4A scenic area in 2021.
description: 霍山，位于中国广东省河源市龙川县田心镇。以丹崖、奇岩闻名，被认为“广东七大名山之一”，是为广东省森林公园、中华人民共和国国家3A级风景区。
accessEn: In Dongjiang village, Tianxin town, about 47 km from the Longchuan county seat by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 苏家围
summaryEn: A Hakka village in Yihe town, Dongyuan County, whose families trace their descent from the Song poet Su Dongpo, made up of 18 mansion-style houses, the oldest dating from the 15th century. It stands by the Dong River, and the scenic area also takes in the riverside scenery promoted as the Dongjiang Gallery.
description: 苏家围，位于中华人民共和国广东省河源市东源县义合镇，是一个聚居着已客家化的苏轼后裔的村落。该村由18座府第式民居组成，现存年代最久远的房屋建于公元15世纪。Template:河源旅游资源列表。
accessEn: In Yihe town, Dongyuan County, about 30 km north-east of Heyuan city by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 佗城
summaryEn: The old seat of Longchuan County, founded in 214 BC by Zhao Tuo, Longchuan's first magistrate under the Qin and later ruler of the Nanyue kingdom, and the county's centre until 1949. The town keeps a cluster of historic sites, among them the Longchuan Confucian school with its Dacheng Hall, the Zhengxiang Pagoda, the Yuewang Well and a temple to the King of Nanyue.
description: 佗城位于广东河源。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、古塔。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In southern Longchuan County, about 80 km north-east of Heyuan city by road; Tuocheng station on the Beijing–Kowloon railway and Longchuan West station on the high-speed lines serve the town.

name: 龙门铁泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in Longtian town, Longmen County, covering about 50 hectares with mountains on three sides, whose iron-rich water emerges at up to 78°C. It has spring-fed pools set in landscaped grounds and villa accommodation, some with private pools.
description: 龙门铁泉，又称龙门温泉，是中华人民共和国广东省惠州市龙门县的一个温泉，位于244省道的K233+212标记位，是中国最大的山水园林温泉，有“亚洲第一泉”的称呼。龙门铁泉拥有亚洲最大的温泉康乐中心，以及黄金蒸气浴、黄金汤泉。
accessEn: In Lidong village, Longtian town, a short drive north of the Longmen county seat, roughly 2 hours by road from Guangzhou or Huizhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南昆山
summaryEn: A forested mountain area on the Tropic of Cancer in south-western Longmen County, a provincial nature reserve since 1984 and a national forest park since 1993, whose highest peak, Tiantangding, reaches 1,228 m. Streams, waterfalls such as Chuanlong Falls, old trees and bamboo groves make it a summer retreat from the Pearl River Delta, and the small resort centre is full of guesthouses.
description: 南昆山国家森林公园位于广东省惠州市龙门县西南部，距离惠州市区129km，被人们称为“北回归线上的绿洲”。
accessEn: About 97 km by road from Guangzhou, in the Nankunshan area of Longmen County on the border with Zengcheng and Conghua.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 叶挺故居
summaryEn: The house in Zhoutian village, Qiuchang, where Ye Ting (1896–1946) was born, the general who was front-line commander of the 1927 Nanchang Uprising and commanded the Communist-led New Fourth Army from 1937 to 1941. The house, listed provincially in 1989 and nationally in 2006, is the core of the General Ye Ting Memorial Park, rated a 4A scenic area in 2013, whose memorial hall has an exhibition on his life.
description: 叶挺故居，位于中国广东省惠州市惠阳区秋长街道周田村，为一国家级文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Zhoutian village, Qiuchang subdistrict, Huiyang District, about 30 km south of central Huizhou and roughly an hour by road from Shenzhen.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大雁山
summaryEn: A wooded hill just north of Shaping, the centre of Heshan, named for its supposed likeness to a wild goose; it was opened as a scenic area in 1989, a park in 1991 and a forest park in 2006. Paths climb past viewing pavilions and the Jiyuan Pagoda to Guiren Peak, and the hill is visited in spring for its 'bird-flower' (Mucuna) vines.
description: 大雁山风景区座落于中国广东省江门市鹤山沙坪以北，粤港澳大湾区以西，侧有佛开高速公路大雁山出口仅3.1公里，因形似大雁而得名。于1989年成立风景区，1991年开辟成公园，2006年成为森林公园。大雁山高海拔310米，同佛山南海区西樵山，形成“姊妹山”。
accessEn: On the northern edge of Shaping, the centre of Heshan, about 3 km from the Dayanshan exit of the Fokai Expressway and some 30 km north-west of central Jiangmen.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 那琴半岛地质海洋公园
summaryEn: A coastal park on a granite peninsula at Beidou town, at the south-western tip of Taishan, where wind- and sea-worn granite boulders crowd the headlands and small bays above the South China Sea. A boardwalk of about 3 km runs round the shore, and the beaches suit families.
description: 那琴半岛地质海洋公园位于广东省江门市台山大广海湾经济区北陡镇，西部沿海高速公路北陡收费站以南26公里，距离高铁恩平站仅55公里。此公园是国家4A级景区，江门沿海唯一一处国家地质公园。
accessEn: In Beidou town about 26 km south of the Beidou exit of the Western Coastal Expressway, roughly 55 km by road from Enping railway station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中国第一滩
summaryEn: A 12 km sweep of sand about 300 m wide on the Dianbai coast, opened as Maoming's seaside resort in 1993 and named by local officials. It has bathing beaches, water sports, a resort zone and a central plaza, behind a long belt of coastal shelter forest, and it has hosted national and international beach volleyball events. The coast on either side forms the open-access Maoming Seaside Park.
description: 中国第一滩，又称茂名滨海公园，是位于广东省茂名市电白区的一个旅游景区，也是茂名市开发最早、人流量最大的旅游景区之一，始建于1993年，距茂名中心城区25公里，规划面积3.6平方公里，其中核心区面积1.2平方公里，主体为长达12公里，宽约300米的天然沙滩。
accessEn: On the Dianbai coast about 25 km south-east of central Maoming; city buses run from Maoming and Shuidong.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 冼太夫人故里
summaryEn: The home district of Lady Xian, the sixth-century chieftain of the Li people of Gaoliang who served the Liang, Chen and Sui courts and is honoured as the 'Saintly Mother of Lingnan'. At Shandou village are her tomb, a walled burial ground first built under the Sui and repaired under the Song, Ming and Qing, with half of a Sui stone tortoise stele base and a stele re-erected in 1819, next to her temple and the site of her family home. Newer additions include a giant statue and a memorial square, and the local cult of Lady Xian is a national intangible heritage item.
description: 隋谯国夫人冼氏墓位于广东省茂名市电白区电城镇山兜村，为南梁俚人领袖冼夫人之陵墓，始建于隋朝，在宋、明、清均有重修。其遗址面积约13530平方米，是广东考古发现的首个隋唐墓园建筑实例，墓周围的地形地貌尚存，较完整地保存了历史环境风貌。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Shandou village in Diancheng town, Dianbai, about 45 km east of Shuidong by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 张弼士故居
summaryEn: The family home that Zhang Bishi (Cheong Fatt Tze, c. 1840–1916) built in 1908 in his native village of Chelong; he left Dabu at 16, made his fortune in the Dutch East Indies and Malaya, served as the Qing vice-consul in Penang and founded the Changyu winery in Yantai. Known as Guanglu Di, it is a large Hakka enclosed house laid out with three halls and four side wings inside a rear enclosure, and it was listed as a national heritage site in 2019.
description: 光禄第位于中国广东省梅州市大埔县西河镇车龙村，是梅州清代企业家张弼士的故居，光禄第建于清光绪三十四年，建筑面积4180平方米，为典型的三堂四横一围客家围屋，共有18个厅、13个大井、99个房间。2013年成为中国国家3A级景区。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Chelong village, Xihe town, about 15 km north of Huliao, Dabu's county town, and roughly 1.5 hours by road from Meizhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0
imageCredit: Yun Huang Yong from Harbord, Australia

name: 神光山
summaryEn: A wooded hill park in Fuxing subdistrict on the edge of Xingning, a national forest park since 2005, named after the legend that the Song scholar Luo Mengjiao studied here by a divine light before passing the imperial examinations. Temples on and around the hill include the Zushi Hall, Mochi Temple and the shrine of the folk deities Shigu Dawang, and a modern tower, Qichang Lou, designed after a Hakka enclosed house, stands on the summit square.
description: 神光山国家森林公园位于广东省梅州市兴宁市福兴街道，靠近广梅汕铁路兴宁站和梅河高速兴宁西出口，距兴宁市区3km，总面积676.7公顷。2005年12月，经国家林业局批准，准予设立神光山国家级森林公园。
accessEn: About 3 km from central Xingning, close to Xingning railway station, and about an hour by road from Meizhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 叶剑英纪念园
summaryEn: A memorial park in Yanyang town built around the birthplace of Ye Jianying (1897–1986), one of the Ten Marshals of the People's Liberation Army, who was born here into a Hakka merchant family. His family house was listed as a national heritage site in 2001, and the neighbouring memorial hall presents his life and career with multimedia and interactive displays. The park also takes in a forest area and visitor facilities.
description: 叶剑英故居是已故中华人民共和国领导人叶剑英的早年的住所，坐落在广东省梅州市梅县区雁洋镇雁上村，2001年作为近现代重要史迹及代表性建筑列入第五批全国重点文物保护单位名单。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Yanyang town, Meixian District, about 35 km by road north-east of central Meizhou, roughly 45 minutes by car; Yannanfei Tea Field and Lingguang Temple are nearby.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 宝晶宫
summaryEn: A limestone show cave in the Yanziyan hills south-west of Yingde, found in 1981 by a provincial hydrogeology team searching for water. Lit walkways lead through several levels of chambers hung with stalactites, stalagmites, columns and curtains of flowstone. In 1996 archaeologists found chipped stone tools in an old river channel inside the cave, provisionally dated to the Palaeolithic.
description: 宝晶宫位于广东省英德市西南7.2公里的燕子岩山脉中，是典型的石灰岩溶洞，溶洞面积达16000多平方米，为南中国溶洞之最，誉为“岭南第一洞天”。宝晶宫是1981年8月，被广东省水文地质二队在寻找水力资源过程中发现的。
accessEn: About 7 km south-west of Yingde city centre by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 广东第一峰
summaryEn: The scenic area around Shikengkong, at 1,902 m the highest point in Guangdong, on the Nanling range where Yangshan meets Ruyuan County and Hunan. Covering about 138 km² in Chengjia Yao Township, it takes in old-growth forest, high gorges, waterfalls, karst and hot springs, and is a core area of the Yangshan National Geopark. Hikers climb to the summit for sunrise over the clouds, often camping overnight, and winter frost and ice draw visitors on the coldest days.
description: 广东第一峰位于广东清远。游览特色包括温泉、瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
accessEn: In Chengjia Yao Township in the far north of Yangshan County, about 3 hours by road from Qingyuan.

name: 前美古村·陈慈黉故居
summaryEn: An old village of overseas Chinese families in Longdu town, Chenghai, best known for the mansion compound the Chen family of overseas merchants built between 1910 and 1939. Chen Cihong's former residence has 506 rooms in four linked compounds that join the traditional Chaoshan courtyard plan with Western-style villas, decorated with wood and stone carving, plasterwork and imported tiles and glass.
description: 陈慈黉故居，位于广东省汕头市澄海区隆都镇前美村，始建于清宣统二年，是泰国华侨实业家、金融家陈慈黉及其家族兴建的大规模民居建筑群体，占地面积2.54万平方米，有“岭南第一侨宅”的美誉。现在是广东省文物保护单位。
accessEn: In Qianmei village, Longdu town, about 15 km by road north of central Chenghai.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 礐石风景名胜区
summaryEn: A cluster of granite hills on the south shore of Shantou harbour, facing the old city across the water, with weathered boulders, caves, cliff inscriptions and harbour views from peaks such as Tashan and Yanfeng. Treaty-port buildings survive among the trees, among them the former British consulate of 1862 and Queshi Church, which mixes Chinese and Western styles.
description: 𬒈石街道是中国广东省汕头市濠江区下辖的一个街道。
accessEn: In Haojiang district across the harbour from central Shantou, about 20 minutes by road over the Queshi Bridge.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 红海湾
summaryEn: A coastal scenic area on the Zhelang peninsula at the eastern end of Honghai Bay, south-east of Shanwei city, where sandy beaches alternate with rocky headlands and a lighthouse stands on the offshore Zhelang Rock. Its steady winds and swell have made it a venue for sailing, windsurfing and surfing since the 1990s, and the scenic area offers sailing, jet-ski and parasailing trips.
description: 红海湾位于广东汕尾。游览特色包括海滨、海岸风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhelang subdistrict of the Honghai Bay Economic Development Zone, about 25 km south-east of central Shanwei, with an expressway to the scenic area since 2023.

name: 新山村
summaryEn: A village in Fucheng town on the edge of Haifeng that was an early base of the peasant movement led by Peng Pai: its farmers' association was founded in 1923 in the village hall Yipingshe, and its peasant guards drilled on an open ground known as Laohuiding. The village has restored these sites and the former homes of local revolutionaries, and built a red-culture museum, square and street. It is one stop on a national rural-tourism route linking Haifeng's revolutionary sites.
description: 新山村位于广东汕尾。游览特色包括博物馆、田园观光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Fucheng town, about 5 km south-east of central Haifeng; the Red Palace in Haifeng town is a short drive away.

name: 海上田园
summaryEn: An eco-park opened in 2001 in the coastal wetlands at Shajing, beside the Pearl River estuary, with lakes, streams, woods and lawns, birdlife and seasonal flowers. It combines sightseeing with family entertainment and nature education.
description: 海上田园是一个位于中国广东省深圳市西部宝安区沙井街道的海上休闲度假及生态旅游景区，也是深圳是深圳最大的一座生态文化主题旅游景区，面积1.73平方公里，西临珠江出海口，2001年9月29日开始营业。
accessEn: In Shajing, Bao'an district, about 45 km north-west of central Shenzhen; Haishang Tianyuan East station on Metro Line 12 is nearby.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 凌霄岩
summaryEn: A large karst cave at Helang town in north-western Yangchun, part of a national geopark, whose chambers rise in three levels above an underground river. Visitors take a boat along about 400 m of the river past lit rock formations, then climb into the halls, where tall stalactite pillars and cliff inscriptions from the Ming and Qing dynasties can be seen.
description: 凌霄岩位于中国广东省阳春市河塱镇，是一个暗河溶洞。溶洞从暗河河面算起，有177米高，分四层，第一层为纵贯全洞的暗河组成，第二层为熔岩大厅，现正式命名为“凌霄大殿”，洞内柱林立；第三层和第四层皆为溶洞景观。
accessEn: In Helang town, about an hour by road north of Yangchun city and some 2 hours from Yangjiang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天露山
summaryEn: A mountain resort in Lidong town on the slopes of Tianlu Mountain, which at about 1,250 m is the highest peak in south-central Guangdong. It offers a 3.8 km rafting run down the Chanlong Gorge, a forest boardwalk through Wuyou Valley, a small mountain train and amusement rides, with a lake-view hotel, hot-spring cabins and hillside villas. It is mainly a weekend outdoor-activity destination for visitors from the Pearl River Delta.
description: 天露山脉位于广东省中西部，范围包括新兴县、阳春市、阳东区、恩平市、开平市等五个县、市、区的交界地带。主峰天露山海拔1254米，位于云浮市新兴县、江门开平市的交界。发源于天露山的河流主要有新兴江、潭江和漠阳江的部分左岸支流。
accessEn: In Lidong town, about 35 km by road south of Xinxing town on winding mountain roads; a shuttle bus runs from Xinxing South station on the Guangzhou–Zhanjiang high-speed railway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 三岭山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park of about 22,700 mu on the south-western edge of Zhanjiang, known locally as the city's lungs, with low wooded hills around the Chixi Reservoir. A greenway about 17 km long loops through the park, and grey herons and other waterbirds feed in the wetlands by the reservoir.
description: 三岭山国家森林公园位于广东省湛江市霞山区，东边为湛江大道，南靠新湖大道，北靠南岑路，西与湛江平岭农场接壤。公园经营范围面积为738.8公顷，森林资源丰富，绿化覆盖率98%，被人们称作湛江市的“市肺“。
accessEn: On the south-western edge of the city in Xiashan district, about 20 minutes by road from central Zhanjiang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 御温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort opened in 1999 on former paddy fields at Nanmen village, Doumen, in western Zhuhai, where hot water had long welled up from the ground. Built in a Tang-dynasty style, it has outdoor and indoor hot-spring pools, spa treatments, restaurants and a hotel.
description: 御温泉位于广东珠海。游览特色包括温泉、天然泉水。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Nanmen village in Doumen District, about an hour by road from central Zhuhai; city buses run from Xiangzhou and from Jing'an in Doumen.

name: 镇安公园·感驮岩
summaryEn: A town park at the foot of Houlong Hill on the north side of Napo, around Gantuo Cave, where excavations in 1997–2000 found burials and more than a thousand pottery, stone, bone, shell and iron objects from the late Neolithic to the Iron Age, including a ritual zhang blade, the first found in Guangxi. A spring still flows from the cave, whose walls bear inscriptions from different periods, and remains of the Qing-era Zhen'an chieftain's office lie by its southern mouth.
description: 感驮岩遗址是位于中国广西那坡县后龙山的新石器时代遗址，面积约1200平方米，保存较好的文化堆积约400平方米，2006年5月25日列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。感驮岩遗址发现于上世纪50年代末，1997年8月至2000年9月，广西文物工作队和广西壮族自治区博物馆对该遗址进行发掘，发现墓葬三座、灰坑一个、用火遗迹多处，完整的陶、石、骨、蚌、铁器千余件。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the north side of Napo town, a border county seat in the far south-west of Baise; carry your passport, as there are border checkpoints on the roads near the frontier.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 合浦汉墓群·汉代文化博物馆
summaryEn: Hepu was a Han-dynasty starting port of the Maritime Silk Road, and in this heritage park on the edge of Lianzhou the grassy mounds across the lawns are barrows over 476 tombs of the Han to Wei–Jin period, with a visitor centre and an archaeology display area completed in 2021. Across the road, the Hepu Han Dynasty Culture Museum, founded in 1978, holds more than 5,200 objects from the Hepu tombs, many of them brought from South-East Asia, South Asia, West Asia and the Mediterranean; its best-known piece is a green-glazed Persian jar of the late Eastern Han, and the tombs also yielded a Roman glass bowl. Next to the museum is the Hanlü Culture Park, a Han-themed park.
description: 合浦汉墓群位于中国广西壮族自治区北海市合浦县环城公社廉南、廉东、冲口、塘排、禁山大队。1981年8月25日公布为第二批广西壮族自治区文物保护单位；1996年11月20日公布为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the southern edge of Lianzhou, the Hepu county town, about 20 km north of Beihai city by road; Hepu has a railway station on the Nanning–Beihai line.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 印象·1876
summaryEn: Central Beihai's group of Western-style buildings from the treaty-port era that followed the 1876 Chefoo Convention, spread over about 1 km around Beijing Road, Jiefang Road and Zhongshan East Road, among them the British consulate of 1885, the customs building of 1883 and the Qing post office of 1897. Some hold small exhibitions on the treaty-port years, such as the display on foreign trading firms in the 1891 building of the German Sengbao firm on Jiefang Road. The national heritage listing covers these 15 city buildings and two 19th-century churches on Weizhou Island.
description: 印象·1876位于广西北海。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In central Beihai around Beijing Road and Jiefang Road, under 1 km from the Old Street on Zhuhai Road and a short taxi or bus ride from most hotels. Several of the buildings stand inside schools, the city hospital, hotels and government compounds, where access may be limited.

name: 星岛湖
summaryEn: A large reservoir in the hills of northern Hepu, built between 1959 and 1964 on the Hongchao River and named Xingdao ('star islands') Lake for the more than 1,000 islets scattered across its water. It served as an outdoor location for CCTV's 1990s television series of the Water Margin, and besides irrigation and water supply it is now used for tourism.
description: 星岛湖位于广西北海。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 15 km north-west of Lianzhou (Hepu county town), roughly 40 minutes by road, or about an hour from Beihai city.

name: 大连城
summaryEn: After 1885 the Guangxi military commander Su Yuanchun made this ring of hills just north of Pingxiang his frontier headquarters, linking the peaks with walls, blockhouses and eight hilltop gun batteries and closing the passes with four gates over nearly two decades of building. Inside are the Wusheng Palace, a three-hall temple to Guan Yu used by the garrison, the three-level Baiyu limestone cave that Su used as a retreat and command post, and four old wells. It is a component of the national heritage unit of the Liancheng fortress sites and Friendship Pass.
description: 大连城，位于中国广西壮族自治区凭祥市北郊，为一个省级文物保护单位，类型为古建筑及历史纪念建筑物，为第二批广西壮族自治区文物保护单位，公布时间为1981年8月25日。大连城的历史年代为清。
accessEn: About 1.5 km north of central Pingxiang, a short taxi ride. Carry your passport, as there are border checkpoints on the roads near the frontier.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 小连城
summaryEn: A hill fortress near Longzhou, also called the Jiangshan forts, built from 1886 by the Guangxi military commander Su Yuanchun as the command centre of the frontier defences facing French-ruled Vietnam. Fifteen gun batteries, once armed with German Krupp cannon, line the ridges and guard the routes inland from the Zhennan, Shuikou and Ping'er passes. It is a component of the national heritage unit of the Liancheng fortress sites and Friendship Pass.
description: 小连城，位于中国广西壮族自治区龙州县彬桥公社，为一个省级文物保护单位，类型为古建筑及历史纪念建筑物，为第二批广西壮族自治区文物保护单位，公布时间为1981年8月25日。小连城的历史年代为清。
accessEn: In Binqiao township about 5 km west of Longzhou county town, 10 minutes by road. Carry your passport, as there are border checkpoints on the roads near the frontier.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 左江斜塔
summaryEn: A five-storey octagonal brick pagoda, also called Guilong Pagoda, standing on a rocky islet in the Zuo River just outside central Chongzuo. Begun in 1621 with three storeys and raised to five in the Qing, it is about 17.6 m tall and was built leaning some 1.4 m towards the oncoming current, which the builders are said to have done on purpose. Inside, a brick stair climbs through the hollow core.
description: 左江斜塔，位于中国广西壮族自治区崇左市江州区左江河中石头岛，1994年7月8日公布为第四批广西壮族自治区文物保护单位，2019年10月7日公布为第八批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On an islet in the Zuo River about 3 km north-east of Taiping old town in central Chongzuo, around 10 minutes by taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 京岛
summaryEn: The 'three Jing islands' of Wanwei, Wutou and Shanxin, now joined to the mainland by land reclamation, are home to most of China's Gin (Jing) people, whose ancestors came from the Hai Phong area of Vietnam about 500 years ago and who speak the Gin language alongside Cantonese. Their village ha pavilions host the Ha song festival, a national intangible heritage item held on Wanwei and Wutou from the 10th day of the sixth lunar month, with singing to the single-string zither and dances. On Wanwei's south shore is Golden Beach, a 13 km strand of golden sand facing the Beibu Gulf.
description: 京岛位于广西防城港。游览特色包括楼阁建筑、非遗文化、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Wanwei is about 18 km south-east of Dongxing city by road. Carry your passport, as there are border checkpoints on the roads near the frontier.

name: 丰鱼岩
summaryEn: A show cave about 16 km south-west of Lipu town that runs for 5.3 km through nine hills, named after the fish that live in its underground river. Visitors walk a 2.2 km dry section of stalactites, stalagmites and large halls, then take a boat along part of the underground river.
description: 丰鱼岩位于广西桂林荔浦县城西南16公里的三河乡东里村，溶洞贯通九座大山，全长5.3公里。因岩内的地下河盛产油丰鱼而得名，是国家4A级景区。丰鱼岩分旱洞和暗河两部分，旱洞长2.2千米，地下河长2.3千米。
accessEn: In Longhuai township, about 16 km south-west of Lipu town, roughly an hour by road from Yangshuo.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 冠岩
summaryEn: A cave system with an underground river, about 12 km long, that emerges on the east bank of the Li River at Caoping and is named after the crown-like shape of the hill above. Visitors descend by lift and travel through the open section on foot, by small train and by boat, and can leave by boat towards the Li River. The explorer Xu Xiake described the cave in 1637, and it opened to tourists in 1995.
description: 冠岩位于中国广西壮族自治区桂林市雁山区草坪回族乡，漓江东岸。是一个巨型地下河、溶洞，全长12公里。是国家AAAA级旅游景区。
accessEn: At Caoping on the east bank of the Li River, about 30 km south-east of central Guilin, roughly 50 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 乐满地度假世界
summaryEn: A large resort on the southern edge of Xing'an town, opened in December 2000 and covering about 4 km², with a theme park of family rides, a 27-hole golf course and a resort hotel beside a lake. It was among the first sites in China rated 5A; the regional list now rates it 4A.
description: 乐满地度假世界位于中国广西桂林市兴安县，为首批国家5A级旅游景区，由马志玲投资建造，占地6,000多亩，整个项目计划投资达31亿元人民币。其主题乐园包括欢乐中国城、美国西部区、梦幻世界区、海盗村、南太平洋区、欧洲区，并有曼陀罗园，各有特色，并有多种游乐和休闲设施。
accessEn: On the southern edge of Xing'an town, about 63 km north-east of Guilin and roughly 45 minutes by expressway; Xing'an North high-speed station is about 10 km to the north. Check that the theme park is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 桂林旅苑
summaryEn: The main campus of Guilin Tourism University in Yanshan District, a college founded in 1985 to train staff for the tourism industry, whose landscaped grounds, crossed by the Xiangsi River, are run as a scenic area. Visitors can walk the riverside grounds among the teaching buildings.
description: 桂林旅游学院是一所位于中华人民共和国广西壮族自治区桂林市的全日制公办普通高等学校。肇始于1985年，2015年，升格为普通本科高等学校，2021年，该校成为广西壮族自治区人民政府及中华人民共和国文化和旅游部共建高校。
accessEn: On Liangfeng Road in Yanshan District, about 17 km south of central Guilin near the ring expressway, roughly 30 minutes by road. As a working university campus, check that visitors are admitted before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 猫儿山
summaryEn: At 2,141.5 m, Kitten Mountain is the highest peak in Guangxi and is often called the highest in South China; it rises on the border of Xing'an and Ziyuan counties. A national nature reserve of about 17,000 hectares, reaching into Longsheng County, protects its subtropical evergreen and mixed broadleaf forest and the headwaters of the Li River. In 1996 local herb gatherers found here the wreck of a US B-24 bomber that crashed on the mountain in 1944.
description: 猫儿山位于中国大陆广西壮族自治区桂林市兴安县和资源县交界处，是南岭中越城岭的重要山峰，海拔2141.5米，是广西最高峰。猫儿山有国家级的猫儿山自然保护区。因海拔是华南第一高峰，猫儿山有“华南第一峰”之称。
accessEn: The scenic area is reached through Huajiang township in Xing'an County, about 2 hours by road north of Guilin.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南溪山公园
summaryEn: A park around Nanxi Hill in southern Guilin, a twin-peaked limestone hill rising about 140 m above the Nanxi stream, which winds along its northern foot to the Li River. Three linked cave systems inside the hill, among them White Dragon Cave, can be walked for about 500 m, and nearly 200 inscriptions from the Tang onwards are carved around the caves. The White Dragon Spring at its foot once sent its water to the court as tribute.
description: 南溪山是一座山，位于中华人民共和国广西桂林的南溪山公园内，在中山南路、崇信路接合的八一桥东侧，将军桥头。此山因南溪萦绕而得名，因山有白龙洞，又名白龙山。早在唐朝南溪山就已开发，拥有近200件摩崖石刻，多分布在北麓白龙洞、元岩、泗洲岩、龙脊洞，南麓刘仙岩、穿云岩等处。
accessEn: Off Zhongshan South Road about 3 km south of Central Square, roughly 10 minutes by taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 世外桃源
summaryEn: A landscaped theme park beside the Guilin–Yangshuo road near Baisha, laid out to evoke Tao Yuanming's fable of the Peach Blossom Spring. Boats pass a large water wheel and slip through a narrow channel into a lake, where staged folk dances are performed on the shore among Zhuang-style buildings, a wind-and-rain bridge and totem poles. It was among the first national 4A scenic areas, named in 2001.
description: 世外桃源位于中华人民共和国广西壮族自治区桂林市阳朔县，由桂林通往阳朔的桂阳公路中段，是一个集山水田园和人文风情的国家4A级旅游景区、世界旅游组织推荐的旅游景区。
accessEn: On the Guilin–Yangshuo road near Baisha, about 15 km north of Yangshuo town and 39 km south of Guilin.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 西山公园
summaryEn: Guilin's second-largest park, made up of the West Hill peaks, Yin Hill with its caves, and West Lake. West Hill was a Buddhist centre in the Tang dynasty, and more than 200 Buddha figures in some 90 niches survive on Guanyin Peak and the neighbouring crags, one of them dated 679. Stone steps climb the peaks for views over the western side of the city.
description: 西山公园位于中华人民共和国广西壮族自治区桂林市秀峰区丽君路西段、西山路东段，是桂林市第二大综合性公园。
accessEn: On Xishan Road about 2 km west of Central Square, roughly 10 minutes by taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 尧山
summaryEn: At 909 m, Yao Mountain on the north-eastern edge of Guilin is the highest peak in the city area and, unlike the limestone towers around it, a soil-covered mountain. A chairlift and footpaths climb to the summit for wide views over the karst peaks, a toboggan run comes down part of the slope, and azaleas cover the mountainside in late spring. The Ming princes' tombs of the Jingjiang line lie at its south-western foot.
description: 尧山位于广西桂林。游览特色包括喀斯特地貌、登山观景、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 10 km north-east of central Guilin in Qixing District, roughly 25 minutes by taxi.

name: 长乐宫
summaryEn: A show cave on Leishan hill in Bandeng village whose entrance is so low that adults must crouch to get in, opening into tall halls divided by columns of stalactites. Two main sections hold more than 20 smaller chambers, and about 1.5 km of passages with 14 named viewpoints are open to visitors; it was rated a national 4A site in 2022.
description: 长乐宫，原为汉长安城的主要宫殿之一，位于汉长安城内的东南角，因位于未央宫的东侧而得别名“东宫”。该宫始建于汉高祖五年，汉高祖七年建成，吕后掌权之后成为太后的专属宫殿。更始三年，赤眉军攻入长安城并焚毁了长乐宫。
accessEn: In Bandeng village near Changle town, about 15 km east of Donglan county town by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 凤山国家地质公园·三门海
summaryEn: Fengshan's half of the Leye–Fengshan UNESCO Global Geopark, designated in 2010, a karst landscape of peak clusters, caves, sinkholes and natural bridges. Its best-known sight is Sanmenhai in Poxin village, seven collapsed sinkholes joined by an underground river, three of which visitors enter by boat through cave mouths open to the sky. The geopark museum is at Chuanlong Cave on the edge of Fengshan town.
description: 三门海是中华人民共和国广西壮族自治区凤山县的一个风景旅游区，三门海是凤山县国家地质公园的一部分。三门海由喀斯特地貌中的一片水域组成，因其有三个天窗可以进入，并且有海的颜色、海的深度、海的潮汐，所以名为“三门海”。
accessEn: The museum is on the northern edge of Fengshan county town; Sanmenhai is about 22 km south-west of the town by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 会仙山
summaryEn: A craggy hill in Bailongshan Park on the northern edge of Yizhou, a sightseeing spot since the Tang dynasty, climbed for views over the town. Its cliffs and caves carry inscriptions from the Song dynasty to the Republican era, protected nationally since 2013, together with carved figures in White Dragon Cave and a Ming inscription on the bird-shaped Qiyun rock at the summit.
description: 会仙山摩崖石刻位于中国广西壮族自治区宜州市城北会仙山，年代为宋－民国。1994年7月8日公布为第四批广西壮族自治区文物保护单位；2013年3月5日公布为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Bailongshan Park about 1 km north of central Yizhou, within walking distance of the town centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 盘阳河
summaryEn: The Panyang River valley around Jiazhuan town, rated 4A in 2009 as Bama's main river area: the river re-emerges from underground at Poyue village and flows past Zhuang and Yao villages known for their long-lived residents. Along its course are the large caves of Baimo and Bainiao, the latter entered by boat beneath a skylight, and bamboo rafts drift on the clear green water.
description: 盘阳河，位于中国广西壮族自治区西北部，是西江红水河段右岸支流，发源于天峨县纳直乡拉里村西北400米处，东南流经凤山县乔音水库、乔音乡和县城凤城镇，在凤山镇京里村东南3千米潜入地下，于巴马瑶族自治县甲篆乡坡月村露出地表成明流，东南流经甲篆乡驻地和县城巴马镇北郊后，注入大化瑶族自治县岩滩水库。
accessEn: Along the river around Jiazhuan town, about 20 km north-west of Bama county town by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 珍珠岩
summaryEn: A karst scenic area of about 5 km² at Dandong village in Liujia town, built around a stalactite cave lit with coloured lights and marketed since 2022 as the Luming Sengu resort. Outside are natural swimming pools in the river, plank walks and pavilions, and a forest campsite with tents, a forest pasture and family activities.
description: 珍珠岩，在台湾又称珍珠石，是一种类似流纹岩的酸性火山喷发熔岩，由于喷发后急速冷却，形成球粒状玻璃质岩石，有弧形或圆形裂纹，尤如珍珠的结构，所以被命名为珍珠岩。珍珠岩一般为浅灰色、淡绿色和褐色，二氧化硅含量达70%，水分含量为3-5%，当将珍珠岩加热到850–900℃时，由于玻璃质软化，其中水分蒸发，造成体积膨胀，可以达到原有体积的7–16倍，为膨胀珍珠岩。
accessEn: At Dandong village, Liujia town, about 11 km west of central Jinchengjiang by road. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 姑婆山
summaryEn: A forested mountain park about 26 km north of central Hezhou, near the Hunan and Guangdong borders, with 25 peaks over 1,000 m and a highest summit of 1,844 m, the tallest in eastern Guangxi; its many cliffs give waterfalls in almost every ravine. Paths lead past streams and falls in the lower valleys, and the surrounding resort area also takes in the Jade Stone Forest, Shibashui, hot springs and a riverside park.
description: 姑婆山系又名东山、临贺岭、姑婆岭、桂岭，坐落在中华人民共和国广西壮族自治区贺州市富川瑶族自治县，属萌渚岭余脉。
accessEn: About 26 km north of central Hezhou, roughly 30 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 临贺故城
summaryEn: The old town of Hejie, on both banks of the Lin River where it joins the He, was the seat of Linhe county and later of Hezhou for some 2,000 years, from the founding of Linhe County in 111 BC until the county offices moved to Babu in 1952. The west-bank city keeps about 1.1 km of earthen walls up to 6 m high, the 27 m Kuixing Tower of 1740 rising from the wall, flagstone streets, old wells and about twenty clan ancestral halls, mostly of the Ming and Qing. Across the river the Hedong quarter has arcaded shops and the Qing-dynasty Yuedong Guild Hall built by merchants from Guangdong.
description: 临贺故城位于中国广西壮族自治区贺州市八步区贺街镇，是中国古代县治延续时间最长的城址，2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Hejie town, about 15 km south-east of central Hezhou (Babu) by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 神仙湖·神剑石林
summaryEn: Two adjoining scenic spots in Fuli town in the farm country east of Fuchuan: Shenxian Lake, a lake with rural scenery beside the old village of Babailing, and the Shenjian Stone Forest, a small cluster of sword-like limestone pinnacles. Both lie in a farming district of vegetable fields, navel-orange orchards and the Hengtang Reservoir, and make an easy outing from Fuchuan town.
description: 神仙湖，又称神仙岭水库，位于中华人民共和国广东省深圳市龙岗区体育中心上游，是一座建成于1954年的小型水库，与龙口水库相邻，属于香港中文大学校园的一部分。湖畔北面为神仙岭山脉，沿湖修有三座亭子，其中一座名为“勤补轩”。
accessEn: In Fuli town, about 11 km north-east of Fuchuan county town by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 莫土司衙署
summaryEn: The administrative seat and residence of the Mo family, hereditary local chieftains (tusi) who governed Xincheng under the Ming and Qing, begun in 1582 and used until the chieftain system was abolished in 1906. Laid out on a north-facing axis at the foot of Cuiping Hill over more than 4 hectares, it has a gate, three halls, a rear garden and ancestral halls, surrounded by officials' mansions, a pavilion, a cave and a drill ground that now houses a chieftain-culture exhibition. It is described as the largest and most complete chieftain's office surviving in south-west China.
description: 莫土司衙署位于中华人民共和国广西壮族自治区来宾市忻城县城关镇，是莫姓土司明清两代的衙署和府第，是中国西南地区现存规模最大、最完整的土司衙署，对土司制度的研究有重要价值，1996年被列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Chengguan, the Xincheng county town, about 2 hours by road from Liuzhou or Laibin.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 丹洲古城
summaryEn: A walled old town on an island in the Rong River that served as the seat of Huaiyuan county (renamed Sanjiang in 1914) through the Ming, Qing and Republican periods. Its surviving sights include the Danzhou Academy, the Fujian-Guangdong guild hall, the east and north gate towers and stretches of the old wall, among about 33 hectares of pomelo orchards. Many villagers now run guesthouses and small restaurants.
description: 丹洲古城，位于中国广西壮族自治区三江侗族自治县丹洲镇丹洲村，为一个省级文物保护单位，类型为古建筑，为第六批广西壮族自治区文物保护单位，公布时间为2009年5月4日。丹洲古城的历史年代为明－民国。
accessEn: On an island beside National Road 209 where Sanjiang, Rong'an and Rongshui counties meet, about 16 km north of Rong'an county town and roughly an hour by road from Sanjiang county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 都乐岩
summaryEn: A karst landscape park about 12 km south of central Liuzhou made up of twelve limestone peaks, a clear stream and two man-made lakes. Lit paths link three show caves, Panlong, Tongtian and Shuiyun, about 680 m long in total, and a forest of inscribed steles includes calligraphy by the film actor Zhao Dan.
description: 都乐岩是位于广西柳州的喀斯特地貌景观，由一条清溪、四个人工湖、十二峰、四十六岩洞、两千一百亩绿地及碑林组成。洞内游程共768米，总面积6400平方米，洞与洞之间有游道连接。
accessEn: About 12 km south of central Liuzhou, roughly 25 minutes by road; suburban buses run to the park gate.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 老君洞
summaryEn: A karst cave on the south-western edge of Rongshui town, also called Zhenxian Cave, through which the Lingshou stream flows for about 300 m past stalactites and cliff inscriptions. More than 30 inscriptions and 17 Song-dynasty steles survive, among them a passage from the Book of Changes in the hand of Sima Guang, and the Ming traveller Xu Xiake stayed here for 13 days. Two Song stone bridges cross the stream at the mouth, and during the war against Japan the cave housed an arsenal.
description: 老君洞位于广西壮族自治区柳州市融水苗族自治县县城西南郊，又名真仙岩、灵城岩、灵岩，为喀斯特地貌景观。建筑始建于唐朝，根据《融水县志》记载，宋太宗赐“御书碑”120轴藏于老君洞内，并敕封老君洞为“真仙岩”。
accessEn: On the south-western edge of Rongshui county town, about 1.5 hours by road north of Liuzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 柳州工业博物馆
summaryEn: A city industrial museum opened in 2012 in the sawtooth-roofed workshops of the former No. 3 Cotton Mill, on a site of about 11 hectares. Its main hall shows more than 6,000 machines and products made or used in Liuzhou since 1902, with steam and diesel locomotives outside, and further halls cover the city's companies and its recovery from acid-rain pollution.
description: 柳州工业博物馆位于中华人民共和国广西壮族自治区柳州市鱼峰区柳东路220号，是一所工业主题博物馆。
accessEn: At 220 Liudong Road on the east bank of the Liu River, about 10 minutes by taxi from People's Square. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙潭公园
summaryEn: A large karst park in southern Liuzhou, with 24 limestone peaks around two spring-fed pools, Longtan and Leitan, that steam on winter mornings, and a lake crossed by a covered bridge. Near the pools are Ming-dynasty cliff inscriptions on Lei Hill, a stele pavilion recalling Liu Zongyuan's prayer for rain here, reconstructed Zhuang, Yao, Miao and Dong houses and a nine-tier drum tower. At the foot of Longtan Hill a display hall covers the Liyuzui shell-midden site, where human remains about 12,000 to 7,000 years old and Neolithic layers were excavated in 1980.
description: 龙潭公园位于中华人民共和国广西壮族自治区柳州市鱼峰区，是一个融喀斯特地貌、西南少数民族文化、植物科研、科普为一体的风景区，是国家4A级旅游景区，国家重点公园。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Longtan Road in southern Liuzhou, about 10 minutes by taxi from People's Square.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 雀儿山公园
summaryEn: A park on a peninsula-shaped hill in Liubei District, surrounded by lakes on three sides, whose summit, about 180 m above sea level, looks out over the northern industrial district. Lakeside paths, flower gardens and a children's amusement area make it a weekend spot for local families.
description: 雀儿山公园位于中华人民共和国广西壮族自治区柳州市柳北区雀儿山路5号的一所公园，园中山峰海拔180.40米，似雀，故名雀儿山。公园地形为半岛状，中间高，四周低，东、南、北被湖水包围。山顶远眺可见柳北工业区。
accessEn: On Que'ershan Road in Liubei District, about 15 minutes by taxi north of People's Square.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大明山
summaryEn: A mountain range in central Guangxi, about 68 km long and spanning Wuming, Shanglin, Mashan and Binyang, whose main peak, Longtou Shan, reaches 1,760 m, the highest in central-southern Guangxi, and which the Tropic of Cancer crosses. Most of it is a national nature reserve of about 17,000 hectares with almost complete forest cover, and the scenic area, entered from Liangjiang town on the Wuming side, lies at an average altitude of about 1,200 m.
description: 大明山是位于中国广西壮族自治区中部，武鸣县、上林县、马山县三县交界处的山脉。该山脉呈西北—东南走向，约长60千米，宽25千米，与其东部的大瑶山等山脉一同围成广西中部的盆地。主峰龙头山海拔为1760米，为广西中部最高峰。
accessEn: Entered from Liangjiang town in Wuming District, about 76 km north of central Nanning by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 九龙瀑布群
summaryEn: A national forest park in the state-owned Zhenlong forest farm in the hills of northern Hengzhou, where streams drop through a cluster of waterfalls in tall forest below Jiulong Mountain. Within about 2.5 km² there are more than ten falls, many around 30 m high, spaced 100–300 m apart along forest paths.
description: 九龙瀑布群位于广西南宁。游览特色包括瀑布、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Dawulin section of the Zhenlong forest farm, about 50 km north of Hengzhou city and roughly two hours by road east of Nanning.

name: 昆仑关
summaryEn: A mountain pass on the old road between Nanning and Liuzhou, first walled with stone in 816 and best known as the site of the Battle of Kunlun Pass in December 1939, when Chinese troops of the Fifth Army retook the pass from the Japanese army after about two weeks of fighting with heavy casualties on both sides. From the memorial archway 331 steps climb to a 14.74 m memorial tower and the cemetery of the fallen, beside a pavilion carrying an inscribed account of the battle. A museum on the site displays weapons, helmets, photographs and film about the battle.
description: 昆仑关战役旧址位于中国广西壮族自治区南宁市、宾阳县、柳州市，包括陆军第五军昆仑关战役阵亡将士墓园、桂南会战检讨会旧址、昆仑关战役白岩前线指挥部旧址，2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。此前，位于邕宁县九塘乡、宾阳县思陇乡交界处的遗址，以昆仑关战役遗址之名，于1994年公布为广西壮族自治区文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the boundary of Xingning District and Binyang County, about 60 km north-east of central Nanning and roughly an hour's drive via the Kunlun interchange on the Nanning–Liuzhou expressway. The museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大芦村
summaryEn: A village of Ming and Qing mansions in Fozi town, nine building groups put up by the Lao family between 1546 and 1826 among ponds and old trees. It is known for its 'three olds' of old houses, old trees and old couplets, with Qing-era name boards and couplets still hanging in the halls, and villagers stage caicha tea-picking opera and tiaolingtou dances in the slack farming season.
description: 大芦村古建筑群，位于中国广西壮族自治区灵山县佛子镇大芦村，原为第六批广西壮族自治区文物保护单位。2013年5月，中国国务院公布为第七批全国重点文物保护单位，类型为古建筑。大芦村古建筑群的历史年代为明－清。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Dalu village, Fozi town, about 7 km north-east of Lingshan county town by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 三娘湾
summaryEn: A curving bay of beaches, rocks, fishing villages and coastal woodland in Xiniujiao town, known as the home of the Chinese white dolphin (Indo-Pacific humpback dolphin), seen offshore in numbers since 2003. Boats take visitors out to look for the dolphins, and the bay also has a bathing beach, a dolphin science museum, seafood restaurants and shores where visitors dig for sandworms and gather shellfish at low tide.
description: 三娘湾是一个新兴的，有湾形海岸线的旅游景区，位于广西钦州市犀牛脚镇。
accessEn: In Xiniujiao town, about 45 km south-east of central Qinzhou by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 李济深故居
summaryEn: The fortified family house in Liaoshen village where Li Jishen (1885–1959) was born: a Kuomintang general who later chaired the Revolutionary Committee of the Kuomintang and was a vice-chairman of the Central People's Government of the People's Republic from 1949. The present house, built in 1925, is a brick-and-timber courtyard compound with 53 rooms and gun towers at its four corners, linked by a walkway along the roof. Upstairs, his bedroom, reception room and telegraph room keep their period furnishings, and an old ironwood grove stands behind the house.
description: 李济深故居位于中国广西壮族自治区梧州市龙圩区大坡镇料神村，是原中华人民共和国中央人民政府副主席李济深出生并成长的地方，1996年被列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。李济深故居坐北朝南，占地5362平方米，建筑面积2010平方米，由连为一体的三座砖木结构楼房组成，前两座为二层，后座为三层，共有53间房。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Liaoshen village, Dapo town, Longxu District, about 40 km south of central Wuzhou by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 六堡镇
summaryEn: A mountain town in Cangwu County that gives its name to Liubao tea, a dark (post-fermented) tea known for its betel-nut aroma, ranked among China's famous teas in the Qing dynasty; its making is a national intangible-heritage item. The scenic area covers the town's memorial arch, tea industrial park, tea gardens and tea street, and the old Hekou wharf with its great camphor tree, start of the 'tea-boat route' by which Liubao tea was shipped downriver and overseas. Visitors can walk the gardens, buy tea at source and, at times, watch or try tea-making.
description: 六堡镇位于广西梧州。游览特色包括园林景观、历史建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 70 km north of Wuzhou city by road, roughly 30 km beyond the Cangwu county seat.

name: 白云山
summaryEn: A forested hill park on the north-east edge of Wuzhou's old town, opened in 1981, covering about 355 ha over two summits and rising to 367 m, the highest point in urban Wuzhou. A 3.7 km road climbs from the Bingquan soy-milk house at the foot to the Yunfeng Pavilion on the top, with views over the city and the meeting of its rivers, passing Si'en Temple halfway up. On the eastern slope the Longquan valley has rocks, a waterfall and shaded paths.
description: 白云山位于广西梧州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、山谷、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Main gate on Baiyun Road in Wanxiu District, about 2 km north-east of the arcade quarter; city buses or a short taxi ride.

name: 骑楼城·龙母庙
summaryEn: Wuzhou's old riverside trading quarter: 22 streets, about 7 km in all, lined with some 560 arcaded shophouses (qilou), most built after the city wall was demolished in the 1920s, mixing Chinese carved brick and lattice windows with Western balconies, columns and arched windows, with iron rings on the pillars and upper-floor 'water doors' for mooring boats when the rivers flood. Among them stand the protected treaty-port buildings of the late Qing and Republican years, after Wuzhou was opened to foreign trade in 1897, including the old customs house, the Standard Oil office, the Xinxi Hotel, the post office, the Catholic church and the former British consulate on Zhushan hill. At the quarter's north end, on the east bank of the Gui River, the Dragon Mother Temple, founded in the early Northern Song and rebuilt in the Ming and Qing, honours the river goddess Longmu and draws pilgrims from Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macau on her festival days.
description: 骑楼城·龙母庙位于广西梧州。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、滨水景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Wanxiu District, Wuzhou's old town on the east bank of the Gui River where it meets the Xi; the arcaded streets are best explored on foot, and the temple is about 1 km north on Guilin Road.

name: 永安王城
summaryEn: Mengshan, then called Yong'an, was captured by the Taiping rebels in the autumn of 1851, and it was here that their leader Hong Xiuquan issued edicts, named his kings and set up the rebel state's first institutions. The protected sites in the town centre are the Wu Temple to Guan Yu, since rebuilt, a stretch of the old town wall and the spot where the edicts were issued, beside a magnolia tree more than 500 years old, with a corridor of edict steles. The scenic area wraps these into a riverside park, an old-banyan park and themed shopping streets along the Meijiang River.
description: 太平天国永安活动旧址位于中国广西壮族自治区梧州市蒙山县城武庙，年代为1851年。1981年8月25日，以“太平天国在永安活动旧址”的名称公布为第二批广西壮族自治区文物保护单位；2006年5月25日，以“太平天国永安活动旧址”的名称公布为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the centre of Mengshan town on Minzhu Street; Mengshan is a county town about 190 km (2–3 hours) by road north-west of Wuzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大容山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A 4,825-hectare national forest park on Darong Mountain north of Beiliu, whose 1,275 m summit is the highest point in Yulin prefecture. Trails and stream-trekking routes run through subtropical evergreen broadleaf forest to the Nine Waterfalls Valley and a mountain lake, Tianhu.
description: 大容山国家森林公园位于广西壮族自治区玉林市北流市。大容山，古代又名嵱，是容县，兴业，桂平交界处的一座山脉。该公园原为广西玉林市大容山林场管辖，于1996年7月经广西批准其为省级森林公园后，2003年12月，国家批准其为国家森林公园。
accessEn: About 25 km by road north of Beiliu, entered from Minle town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 六万大山森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park in the Liuwan Mountains, a range about 70 km long on the borders of Yulin, Bobai and Pubei whose main peak, Kuishanding, reaches 1,118 m. Facilities include a lookout platform on Lianhua Peak, a forest music square and a campsite.
description: 六万大山，是中国广西东南部的一座山脉，东北——西南走向，分布于浦北、博白和玉林，长约70公里，宽30－40公里。主峰葵扇顶，海拔1118米。
accessEn: In Chengjun town, Fumian District, about 30 km south-west of central Yulin.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 谢鲁山庄
summaryEn: A private garden estate laid out on a hillside at Xielu village from about 1920, often called one of China's four great private manors. Its pavilions, halls, ponds and paths spread over about 26 hectares, following the model of Suzhou and Hangzhou gardens while mixing Hakka and Western architectural details.
description: 谢鲁山庄位于中国广西壮族自治区玉林市陆川县乌石镇谢鲁村，年代为1920年。1994年7月8日公布为第四批广西壮族自治区文物保护单位；2013年3月5日公布为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Wushi town about 20 km south-west of Luchuan county town by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 海南解放公园
summaryEn: A memorial park on Lingao Cape, the headland on Hainan's north-west coast where troops of the People's Liberation Army's 40th Army landed in the early hours of 17 April 1950, in the crossing of the Qiongzhou Strait that brought Hainan Island under PRC control. The 86-mu park, opened in 2006 and renamed Hainan Liberation Park at the end of 2020, has a large sculpture group, a memorial to the dead of the 40th and 43rd Armies and a museum on the crossing. Inside the park stands the Lingao Cape lighthouse, a 22 m cast-iron tower built by the French in 1893 and listed nationally in 2013.
description: 海南解放公园位于海南临高。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、岛屿、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Lingao Cape in Lincheng town, about 11 km north-north-east of Lincheng, the Lingao county seat.

name: 陈独秀旧居
summaryEn: Shiqiangyuan, a walled Qing-dynasty courtyard house on Heshanping where Chen Duxiu, a founder and the first general secretary of the Chinese Communist Party, lived from 1939 until his death in 1942.
