The east-wing rooms he shared with his wife Pan Lanzhen, a bedroom, parlour and study, are shown as they were, beside an exhibition in seven parts that follows his life from the New Culture and May Fourth movements to his last years in Jiangjin. The museum took its present form in 2012, and the house is a Chongqing municipal heritage site.
description: 陈独秀旧居陈列馆位于中华人民共和国重庆市江津区几江街道五举村鹤山坪，距离江津城区15公里，该地是中共早期领导人陈独秀最后的寓居地和逝世地，也是保存最完好的陈独秀生前居住地。陈列馆占地面积20951平方米，核心展厅面积3300平方米，是重庆市文物保护单位和国家AAAA级旅游景区。
accessEn: On Heshanping in Wuju village, about 15 km from Jiangjin's urban area and roughly an hour and a half by road from central Chongqing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 重庆园博园
summaryEn: A landscaped park of about 220 ha around Longjing Lake in Chongqing's northern suburbs, opened in November 2011, with 127 show gardens in the styles of Chinese regions and cities and of several foreign partner cities, set among hills, arched bridges and wetland. Electric carts and boats link the gardens across the site.
description: 重庆园博园位于中华人民共和国重庆市两江新区鸳鸯街道龙景路1号龙景湖区域，是一个城市公园，公园占地3300亩，其中水体面积800亩，是重庆标志性的园林公共设施，总投资14.8亿元人民币。
accessEn: In Yuanyang subdistrict, Yubei District (Liangjiang New Area), about 15 km north of central Chongqing, near Yuanboyuan station on Metro Line 3.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 重庆建川博物馆
summaryEn: A cluster of themed museums opened in 2018 by the collector Fan Jianchuan in the wartime air-raid tunnels of the former Hanyang Arsenal, which moved here from Hanyang in Wuhan and became the Nationalist Ordnance Department's First Arsenal. Some 51 tunnels survive in the hillside by the Egongyan Bridge: three linked ones form the arsenal site museum with recreated wartime production, and others hold museums of weapons history, wartime relics, ration coupons, traditional Chinese medicine, wedding customs and Chongqing life.
description: 重庆建川博物馆位于中华人民共和国重庆市九龙坡区，是一个博物馆群落，馆长是樊建川。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Xiejiawan in Jiulongpo District, near Xiejiawan station on Line 2 and the Loop Line, about 20 minutes by taxi from Jiefangbei.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 重庆市规划展览馆
summaryEn: Chongqing's urban-planning museum moved in 2022 from Chaotianmen to a new building on the Nanbin Road riverfront at Danzishi, looking across the Yangtze to the Yuzhong peninsula. Its exhibitions trace how the mountain city has grown and how it is planned to develop.
description: 重庆市规划展览馆位于中华人民共和国重庆市渝中区朝东路1号，是一座规划展示馆。
accessEn: On Nanbin Road at Danzishi in Nan'an District, about 1 km south of Danzishi station on the Metro Loop Line. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 重庆科技馆
summaryEn: Chongqing's main science museum opened in 2009 in the Jiangbeizui business district beside the Grand Theatre, close to where the Jialing River joins the Yangtze. Its themed halls cover everyday science, transport, defence technology, disaster prevention with simulated hazards, basic science and space flight, and there is a children's science playground and giant-screen and 4D cinemas.
description: 重庆科技馆是位于中华人民共和国重庆市两江新区的一座大型科普教育活动场馆，于2009年9月9日建成开馆，是重庆市委、市政府确定的全市十大社会文化事业基础设施重点工程之一，现为国家AAAA级旅游景区。
accessEn: On the Jiangbeizui waterfront opposite Chaotianmen in Jiangbei District (Liangjiang New Area), about 500 m from Grand Theatre station on Metro Line 6. Closed on Mondays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring area along the Wubu River in eastern Ba'nan, where springs supply a string of bathing resorts and hotels and a warm, steamy cave, Redong, is used as a natural sauna. Around the springs, karst peaks have cliff walkways and small caves, and the area also has Baisha Temple with its ancient trees and the tomb of Yang Cangbai, secretary-general of Sun Yat-sen's government in Guangzhou.
description: 重庆市东温泉风景区包括重庆秀泉映月花园酒店、叁峰温泉、威特卡斯、航空温泉、天体温泉、热洞等一系列温泉及风景区。位于重庆市巴南区东泉镇境内五布河畔，这一地区距重庆市区约68公里，因位于重庆市区东面而得名。
accessEn: In Dongwenquan town, eastern Ba'nan District, about 68 km from central Chongqing, roughly 1.5 hours by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 芙蓉江
summaryEn: The lower gorge of the Furong River, the largest tributary of the Wu River, a national scenic area since 2002 that runs for 35 km from Haokou to Jiangkou through a V-shaped karst canyon with largely untouched forest on both sides. Part of the river is a buffer zone of the Wulong Karst World Heritage site, and Furong Cave opens on its bank near Jiangkou.
description: 芙蓉江又名盘古河，是乌江的最大支流，发源于贵州省绥阳县境内的大娄山，由西南向东北在重庆市武隆区江口镇汇入乌江，干流全长227千米，天然落差1075米，流域面积7744.5平方千米。芙蓉江流域是典型的喀斯特地貌，流域内人口密度小，原始生态保存较好。
accessEn: At Jiangkou in Wulong District, about 20 km by road east of Wulong town, next to Furong Cave; Wulong South station, on the Chongqing–Xiamen high-speed railway since 2025, serves Wulong town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 歌乐山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A wooded ridge on the western edge of central Chongqing, made a national forest park in 2004, whose highest point, 693 m, is at Yunding Temple. Six marked hiking trails climb through the forest, the rocks around Yunding Temple carry inscriptions by the calligrapher Ke Huang and his friends, and a cable car also runs up the hill.
description: 歌乐山国家森林公园是位于中华人民共和国重庆市沙坪坝区歌乐山的国家级城市公园。
accessEn: In Geleshan, Shapingba District, about 16 km west of central Chongqing; the Geleshan Martyrs' Cemetery is at the foot of the same hill.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鸿恩寺公园
summaryEn: An urban forest park opened in 2009 on Longji Ridge in Jiangbei, north of the Jialing River, planted with many varieties of osmanthus along themed walks. On the summit stands Hong'en Pavilion, a seven-storey tower in Ming–Qing style whose viewing deck looks over the Yuzhong peninsula, Liangjiang New Area and Shapingba.
description: 鸿恩寺森林公园是中华人民共和国重庆市两江新区的一座城市公园，坐落于龙脊山上，于2009年5月1日开放。公园占地1100亩。龙脊山顶建有七层仿古建筑鸿恩阁。
accessEn: In Dashiba, Jiangbei District, about 20 minutes by taxi from Jiefangbei.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 重庆黄山抗战旧址群
summaryEn: From 1938 to 1946, when Chongqing was China's wartime capital, Chiang Kai-shek and the Military Affairs Commission used a group of villas hidden in the pine woods of Huangshan, a hill in the Nanshan range, as residences and offices. The 15 listed sites include Yunxiu Lou, Chiang's three-storey residence, Songting, the aides' and guards' quarters, a small school and the air-raid shelter below the house, and the complex is now run as the Chongqing Anti-Japanese War Sites Museum.
description: 重庆黄山抗战旧址群位于中国重庆市南岸区南山公园路30号，是抗日战争期间中华民国重要政治人物及相关机构在陪都重庆留下的遗迹，包括云岫楼、松厅、孔园、草亭、莲青楼、云峰楼、松籁阁、黄山小学、周至柔旧居、侍从室、侍卫室、防空洞、望江亭、发电房、炮台山15处遗迹。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Huangshan in the Nanshan hills of Nan'an District, about 30–40 minutes by taxi from Jiefangbei.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 华岩寺
summaryEn: A large working Buddhist monastery beside Huayan Lake on the south-western edge of central Chongqing, whose older buildings are protected as a Chongqing municipal heritage site. The temple has been much extended since the early 2000s and houses the Chongqing Buddhist College, and the surrounding scenic area adds lakeside gardens, a cave, a large outdoor Buddha statue and the Huayan Buddhist Museum.
description: 华岩寺位于重庆。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Huayan village, Jiulongpo District, by Huayansi station on Metro Line 5, about 15 km south-west of central Chongqing. The Buddhist museum is closed on Mondays.

name: 缙云山
summaryEn: A forested ridge above the Jialing River on the north-western edge of Beibei, protected as a national nature reserve and long a centre of Buddhism in the Chongqing area. Its main temple, Jinyun Temple, was founded in 423 and rebuilt in 1683; in 1932 the monk Taixu set up the Sino-Tibetan Buddhist Institute here, and the temple, its Ming-dynasty gateway and stone carvings are protected as the national heritage site of that institute. Paths lead through the woods from the temple to viewpoints on the peaks.
description: 缙云山位于重庆市北碚区城北嘉陵江畔。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Above Beibei District, about 45 km north-west of central Chongqing; the temple is a short drive uphill from central Beibei.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 开州博物馆
summaryEn: The district museum of Kaizhou, opened in 2013 on the Civic Square beside Hanfeng Lake, with seven galleries and more than 10,000 objects on the history and culture of the old Kai County. It stands on the lakeside promenade, so it combines easily with a walk around Hanfeng Lake.
description: 开州博物馆位于中华人民共和国重庆市开州区滨湖中路市民广场，是一座博物馆。
accessEn: On Binhu Middle Road by Hanfeng Lake in the centre of the Kaizhou district town, north-eastern Chongqing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 夔州博物馆
summaryEn: The museum of Fengjie County, long known as Kuizhou, opened in 2017 on the eastern edge of the county town and holds more than 20,000 objects, from carvings the museum attributes to 'Fengjie Man' some 130,000 years ago to a large Chu-style bronze ding, an Eastern Han pottery horse and Song-dynasty porcelain. Its grounds take in the Yaokui Pagoda on its original site, the rebuilt Yidou and Kaiji city gates with a stretch of the old prefectural wall, and the Dacheng Hall of the former Confucian temple.
description: 夔州博物馆位于中华人民共和国重庆市奉节县夔门街道诗城东路83号，是一座博物馆。
accessEn: On Shicheng East Road in the Fengjie county town, Fengjie County, a short taxi ride west of White Emperor City.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 涞滩古镇
summaryEn: A walled old town on a hill above the Qu River, dating from the Song dynasty, with Ming- and Qing-era houses, flagstone lanes and a Qing barbican gate, and one of the first ten towns named a Chinese Historic Town in 2003. Beside it, Erfo Temple shelters Song-dynasty cliff carvings, among them a large seated Buddha and rare groups of figures from the Chan (Zen) school.
description: 涞滩摩岩造像位于重庆市合川区，文物遗址年代判定为宋。1956年8月16日公布为四川省第一批历史及革命文物保护单位。1980年7月7日重新公布为四川省第一批文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Laitan Town, Hechuan District, about 30 km north-east of central Hechuan by bus from the Hechuan bus terminal.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 刘伯承同志纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial museum to Marshal Liu Bocheng in Shengshan Park in central Kaizhou, opened in December 1992 for the centenary of his birth, with its name written by Deng Xiaoping. Six halls hold an exhibition on his life and military career drawn from a collection of more than 4,500 items, and it is one of China's officially listed 'red tourism' classic sites.
description: 刘伯承同志纪念馆位于中华人民共和国重庆市开州区汉丰街道盛山公园内，是一座纪念馆。
accessEn: In Shengshan Park, Hanfeng subdistrict, in the centre of the Kaizhou district town near Hanfeng Lake, north-eastern Chongqing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 刘伯承故居
summaryEn: The family home in Zhoudu village, south of the Kaizhou town, where Liu Bocheng, the one-eyed marshal of the People's Liberation Army, was born in 1892. The house is protected as a national heritage site and has displays on his early life, and the surrounding village is run as the 'Marshal Liu's Hometown, Red Zhoudu' scenic area.
description: 刘伯承旧居位于重庆市开州区赵家街道周都村，文物遗址年代判定为1892年。1991年4月16日公布为四川省第三批省级重点文物保护单位。2000年9月7日列为第一批重庆市文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Zhoudu village, Zhaojia subdistrict, about 20 minutes by road south of the centre of the Kaizhou district town in north-eastern Chongqing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南温泉
summaryEn: Developed as a park from 1927 around hot springs known since the Ming dynasty, Nanwenquan in Ba'nan combines spring baths, boat trips on the Huaxi River, a cliff waterfall and gardens. During the war years Lin Sen, Kong Xiangxi and Chiang Kai-shek built retreats beside the springs, and their villas, with the former research department of the Central Political Institute, form the Nanquan wartime sites, a national heritage group.
description: 重庆市南温泉风景区位于重庆市巴南区南泉街道境内，景区最早开发于1927年，距重庆市区约18公里，属于重庆市一级公园，是重庆市十佳旅游风景名胜区。景区以其内温泉而闻名，因位于重庆市区南面，被称为“南泉”。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Nanquan subdistrict, Ba'nan District, about 18 km south of central Chongqing, roughly 40 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南腰界红三军司令部旧址
summaryEn: In 1934 the Red Third Army, led by He Long and Guan Xiangying, made the small town of Nanyaojie, in the hills of southern Youyang, the centre of its Sichuan–Guizhou revolutionary base area, with headquarters in a Qing-dynasty courtyard house, the Yu family compound. The scenic area takes in the preserved headquarters, with the rooms He Long and Guan Xiangying used, and some 34 other relics of that period, among them the meeting ground where the Second and Sixth Red Army Groups joined forces, the Daba ancestral hall, the army's political department and Red Army graves.
description: 红三军司令部旧址位于四川省酉阳县南界公社，文物遗址年代判定为1934年。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Nanyaojie town in southern Youyang County, roughly 2 hours by road south of Youyang county town, which is about 4 hours by train or road from central Chongqing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 聂荣臻故居
summaryEn: The family home at Langjia village near Wutan where Nie Rongzhen, later a marshal of the People's Liberation Army who led China's nuclear-weapons and satellite programmes, was born in 1899. Known locally as Shiyuanzi, it is a Qing-dynasty timber compound of three halls; most of it burnt down in 1923 and it was rebuilt on the old plan in 1988. Rooms show furniture and objects from his childhood and schooling in Jiangjin, and the surrounding village is run as the Marshal Nie's Hometown scenic area.
description: 聂荣臻故居位于重庆市江津区吴滩镇郎家村。原名石院子屋基，是清代的三重堂建筑，面积900多平方米。聂荣臻元帅出生于此。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Langjia village near Wutan town in north-western Jiangjin District, about an hour and a half by road from central Chongqing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 北温泉
summaryEn: A riverside park at the foot of Jinyun Mountain, on the south bank of the Jialing River's Wentang Gorge, laid out around Wenquan Temple, founded in 423 and rebuilt in 1432. In 1927 Lu Zuofu turned the temple grounds into the Jialing River Hot Spring Park, adding swimming pools, baths and a restaurant, and the springs, which stay above 40°C all year, are still used for bathing. Several 1930s villas in the park belong to the national heritage group of Beibei's rural reconstruction sites.
description: 重庆市北温泉风景区位于重庆市北碚区嘉陵江小三峡温汤峡畔，缙云山麓。是中国开发利用最早、至今仍在使用的温泉之一。
accessEn: On the Jialing River about 5 km north-west of central Beibei District, which is about 45 km north-west of central Chongqing.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 菩提古镇
summaryEn: A new town built in traditional Ba-Yu style at the foot of Puti Mountain on the edge of Changshou's urban area, rated 4A in 2014, with canals, a main street and old-style buildings including a yamen, an opera stage, a City God temple, a Confucian temple and gate towers. Its theme is longevity, a play on the district's name, and it holds festivals such as a hotpot festival.
description: 长寿菩提古镇，又名长寿古镇或长寿古镇文化旅游区，位于中国重庆市长寿区、垫江县和涪陵区交界处，是以菩提寺为基础设立的风景名胜区，坐落于菩提山脚下。距重庆主城区约78公里，2014年4月被国家旅游局批准为国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: On the edge of the urban area of Changshou District, about 80 km north-east of central Chongqing by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0
imageCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Shichen assumed (based on copyright claims).

name: 双桂堂
summaryEn: A Chan Buddhist monastery founded in 1653 by the master Poshan Haiming and named after its two osmanthus trees, known as an ancestral seat of Chan in south-west China and listed among the country's key Buddhist temples since 1983. Seven buildings stand on its main axis, among them the Mahavira Hall on 72 stone columns, Poshan's stupa, the Hall of Great Compassion and the sutra library, which keeps a Buddhist canon presented by the Yongzheng Emperor; a hall of 500 arhats was added in 1998. The fields, lotus ponds and wetlands around the temple are being developed as the Shuanggui Tianyuan scenic area, which so far adds a vegetarian food centre and visitor centre.
description: 双桂堂，位于重庆市梁平区。1983年被国务院确定为汉族地区佛教全国重点寺庙，现任方丈为身振法师。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Jindai, about 12 km south-west of the Liangping district town, roughly 20 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 松溉古镇
summaryEn: A river port on the north bank of the Yangtze in southern Yongchuan, listed among China's historic and cultural towns, whose flagstone streets lead past riverside teahouses with storytellers, the old county yamen and the site of a wartime cotton-spinning mill. Nearby are the Ming-dynasty Chen Gong weir and the tomb of the Southern Song classicist Chen Shaonan, and the town became a 4A scenic area in 2024.
description: 松溉古镇位于重庆。游览特色包括古镇、滨水景观、历史建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Songgai town on the Yangtze, about 40 km south of central Yongchuan in Yongchuan District, roughly 1.5 hours by road from central Chongqing.

name: 太阳湖
summaryEn: A reservoir lake in the highlands of Huangshui, in the south-east of Huangshui National Forest Park next to the Dafengbao forest, used for angling and water sports and as the venue of an open-water swimming race and the Huangshui triathlon. Like the rest of the Huangshui area it stays cool in summer, when it fills with visitors escaping the heat of Chongqing.
description: 太阳湖位于重庆。游览特色包括森林公园、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Near Wanshengba in Huangshui town, Shizhu Tujia Autonomous County, about 1.5 hours by road from Shizhu county town.

name: 特园
summaryEn: The mansion of Xian Ying, a wartime supporter of the democratic movement, built in 1929–31 at Shangqingsi; the China Democratic League began here in 1941 as the League of Chinese Democratic Political Groups. Since 2008 its two three-storey villas have held a museum of China's non-Communist 'democratic parties', enlarged in 2011 and renamed the Museum of the History of China's Democratic Parties.
description: 特园位于重庆。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Jialingqiao East Village in Shangqingsi, Yuzhong District, near Niujiaotuo metro station (Lines 2 and 3). Closed on Mondays.

name: 万寿山
summaryEn: A craggy forested mountain at 1,200–1,500 m east of Shizhu county town, topped by the two rock pillars that, in local legend, gave the county its name ('stone pillars'). The scenic area, opened in 2019, is built around the old battlefield where Qin Liangyu, the Ming-dynasty woman general who commanded Shizhu's troops, built a stockade against attackers, and the nearby Wanshou Old Village shows Tujia stilt houses and customs.
description: 万寿山位于重庆。游览特色包括林地风光、民间传说、历史建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills east of Shizhu county town, in Sanhe town, Shizhu Tujia Autonomous County; Shizhu is on the Chongqing–Lichuan railway.

name: 巫山博物馆
summaryEn: The county museum of Wushan, which grew out of the county's cultural relics office, opened in December 2012 and holds more than 50,000 objects; it was rated a national second-grade museum in 2018. Its main exhibition follows the area from the Longgupo site, whose simple stone tools the museum dates to about two million years ago, through the Neolithic Daxi culture to the local Wu culture, and smaller galleries show highlights such as a Han gilt-bronze plaque with the Queen Mother of the West.
description: 巫山博物馆位于中华人民共和国重庆市巫山县高唐街道平湖西路369号，是一座博物馆。
accessEn: On Pinghu West Road in the Wushan county town, Wushan County.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 小南海
summaryEn: A mountain lake formed in 1856, when an earthquake brought down a hillside and dammed the Laojiao stream, leaving a natural rubble dam over 1 km long and a lake of about 2.9 km² with three small islands. It is one of the best-preserved historic earthquake sites in China and is now a national geopark; Chaoyang Temple island was the meeting place of an anti-Qing uprising society shortly before the 1911 revolution.
description: 小南海是位于中国重庆市黔江区小南海镇的一个地震堰塞湖，原名小瀛海，有时又称为小南海水库。距黔江县城32千米，距咸丰县城75千米。现在是国家地质公园，也是中国保存较为完整的一处古地震遗址。
accessEn: In Xiaonanhai town, about 32 km north of central Qianjiang in Qianjiang District; tourist buses run from Qianjiang station on the Chongqing–Xiamen high-speed railway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 西沱古镇
summaryEn: A Yangtze river port facing the Shibaozhai pavilion across the water, which grew rich on the salt and river trade from the Qing dynasty and was named one of China's first historic and cultural towns in 2003. Its main street, the Yunti Jie or 'ladder to the clouds', climbs the hillside from the river in long flights of stone steps between tiers of Tujia stilt houses, past old halls such as the Yuwang Palace and the Ziyun Palace.
description: 西沱镇原名西界沱，位于中国重庆市东部石柱土家族自治县，与万州区、忠县毗邻，濒临长江，是石柱县唯一的长江口岸。与石宝寨隔江相望。全镇幅员面积66平方公里。
accessEn: In Xituo town on the Yangtze, in the north of Shizhu Tujia Autonomous County, about 1.5 hours by road from Shizhu county town; Shibaozhai is across the river in Zhong County.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 中山古镇
summaryEn: A riverside market town on the Shunxi River in southern Jiangjin, on the northern approach to Simian Mountain, listed as a National Historic and Cultural Town. Its long, narrow old street grew from three market sections joined together and once held more than 300 workshops and shops; bamboo-craft and sauce shops, grocers, small restaurants and old tea houses still trade there. A fire in 2021 damaged over 200 m of the street, which was repaired and reopened in early 2023.
description: 中山古镇位于重庆。游览特色包括古镇、滨水景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhongshan town in southern Jiangjin District, on the road to Simian Mountain, roughly two and a half hours by road from central Chongqing.

name: 措尔机寺·壤巴拉
summaryEn: Zamtang is a leading centre of the Jonang school of Tibetan Buddhism, and Cuo'erji (Chöje) Monastery at Zhongrangtang, whose national listing dates its buildings from the Yuan to the Qing, is one of its historic monasteries. Nearby, the Rangbala heritage park gathers workshops where Jonang thangka painting and other local crafts are taught and shown.
description: 措尔机寺·壤巴拉位于四川阿坝。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Zhongrangtang, about half an hour by road east of Zamtang (Rangtang) county town.

name: 观音桥
summaryEn: Guanyinqiao, in north-western Jinchuan County, is a Tibetan Buddhist pilgrimage centre built around its Guanyin (Avalokiteshvara) temple. The rated scenic area also takes in the river valley and high meadows around the town. It is a living religious site: dress modestly and walk clockwise around the shrines.
description: 观音桥位于四川阿坝。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、山谷、佛教文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Roughly two hours by road from Jinchuan county town or from Barkam.

name: 柯盘天街·直波碉楼
summaryEn: Kepan Tianjie ('sky street') is a ridge-top Jiarong Tibetan village above the Suomo River at Songgang, with the ruins of the Songgang chieftains' residence, two stone towers and some three dozen traditional houses, now restored with guesthouses and shops. Close by stand the Zhibo watchtowers, two stone towers of the Qianlong period, octagonal outside and round inside, 29 and 24.7 metres high.
description: 直波碉楼位于中国四川省阿坝藏族羌族自治州马尔康市松岗镇直波村，1991年4月16日公布为四川省第三批文物保护单位，2001年6月25日列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。碉楼建于清乾隆年间，有南北两座，相距约50米，均为石质，其平面外呈八角形，内呈圆形。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 20 minutes by road west of central Barkam.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 卓克基土司官寨
summaryEn: The fortified residence of the Zhuokeji chieftains, rulers of one of the eighteen Jiarong Tibetan chiefdoms of western Sichuan until 1955, faces the old stone village of Xisuo across the Xisuo River. The present stone-and-timber building, of up to five storeys and rebuilt in 1938–1940 after a fire, blends Tibetan and Han Chinese styles and is open as a museum. Mao Zedong and other Red Army leaders stayed in the earlier building during the Long March in 1935, and exhibitions cover both Jiarong culture and that period.
description: 卓克基土司官寨位于中国四川省阿坝藏族羌族自治州马尔康市马尔康镇西索村，为清代至民国早期的卓克基土司衙门所在地。建筑坐东北朝西南，占地面积3400平方米，建筑面积1400平方米，石木结构，建筑风格兼具藏汉两族的特点。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 10 minutes by road east of central Barkam.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 王坪红军烈士陵园
summaryEn: This hillside cemetery at Wangping in Tongjiang county was begun by the Red Fourth Front Army in 1934 and, after scattered graves from across the county were moved here in 2012, holds about 25,000 Red Army dead. The scenic area also includes Red Cloud Cliff, where the slogan 'Chihua Quanchuan' ('Turn all Sichuan Red') is carved in giant characters, one of the best known of the Red Army stone inscriptions that survive around Bazhong.
description: 川陕革命根据地红军烈士陵园位于四川省巴中市通江县沙溪镇王坪村，是中国规模最大的红军烈士陵园，现葬有约2.5万红军将士。1934年7月，西北革命军事委员会决定兴建“红军烈士集墓”，当时葬有7,800余名红军烈士，其中团职以上40人。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Roughly an hour by road north-east of Tongjiang county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 西岭雪山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in the Qionglai range in Dayi County, crowned by Daxuetang, at 5,364 m the highest peak in Chengdu municipality. Visitors come for forest and high-mountain views in summer and for the ski area in winter. The snow peak is often identified with the western ridge whose snows Du Fu described framed in his window in Chengdu.
description: 西岭雪山位于四川省成都市大邑县境内，属邛崃山系，主峰海拔5364米，是成都市境内最高峰。其间有西岭雪山风景名胜区、花水湾温泉度假区，是一个旅游运动的场所。唐代诗人杜甫的“窗含西岭千秋雪，门泊东吴万里船”赞的可能就是此山。
accessEn: In western Dayi County, about 2.5–3 hours by road from Chengdu.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 元通古镇
summaryEn: An old river-port town on the Wenjing River in Chongzhou, once one of the busier wharves of the western Chengdu Plain. Grey-tiled houses from the late Qing and early Republican years line the river, alongside the Huang family ancestral hall, a Guangdong guild hall and a late-Qing Catholic church.
description: 元通古镇位于四川成都。游览特色包括古镇、祠堂文化、教堂建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About an hour by road west of central Chengdu.

name: 文峰山
summaryEn: An open hillside park in Qu County town themed on local history and Confucian scholarship. Its landmark is a modern octagonal nine-storey Wenfeng Pagoda, 68.7 m tall, on the site of a pagoda that fell and was rebuilt several times in the Qing dynasty, together with the 56.5 m Wenfeng Pavilion recalling a Song-era lookout and a garden of sculptures and relief walls on the county's imperial-exam graduates. It is a short visit if you are in Qu County for the Han-dynasty stone towers.
description: 文峰山，位于台湾嘉义县竹崎乡文峰村与番路乡大湖村，峰顶海拔1,256米，原为2003年版台湾小百岳之一，2006年已被除名。文峰山为牛稠溪与八掌溪的分水岭。
accessEn: In Qu County town, a short taxi ride from the centre; Qu County is about an hour from Dazhou by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 五峰山
summaryEn: Wufeng Mountain in eastern Dazhu county is a national forest park; its ridges, between 600 and 1,080 m, are covered by a bamboo forest of many species that stretches for tens of kilometres. Paths lead through the bamboo past streams, small lakes, karst caves and pavilions.
description: 五峰山位于四川达州。游览特色包括洞穴、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 15 km east of Dazhu county town, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 真佛山
summaryEn: Zhenfo Mountain, in Fushan town about 35 km from Dazhou city, is topped by a Qing-dynasty complex of temples, among them Dehua Temple and the Jade Emperor and Tianzi halls, where Confucian, Buddhist and Taoist worship share one hillside. The wider scenic area adds forested ridges, karst caves and Yanzhi Lake.
description: 真佛山庙群位于四川省达州市达川区福善乡，文物遗址年代判定为清。1991年4月16日公布为四川省第三批文物保护单位。2013年3月5日列为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 35 km from Dazhou city, roughly an hour by road via Fushan town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 孝泉古镇
summaryEn: An old market town on the Chengdu Plain known as the home of Jiang Shi, a model of filial devotion in the classic Twenty-Four Filial Exemplars, who is honoured at the Jiang Xiao Shrine. Its sights include old streets and the Yanzuo Temple, whose Longhu Sarira Pagoda is listed as a Yuan-dynasty structure.
description: 孝泉古镇位于四川德阳。游览特色包括古镇、寺庙建筑、古塔。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 30 minutes by road north-west of Deyang city.

name: 宝箴塞
summaryEn: Baozhen Fortress is a walled clan stronghold that the Duan family began building in 1910 on a ridge in rural Wusheng county, enclosing courtyards, halls and storerooms behind stone walls about 2 km long and on average 6.5 m high, with a continuous gallery of gun ports. The old Duan family compound stands just outside, and the fortress survived later decades because it was used as a grain store.
description: 宝箴塞，是位于四川省武胜县宝箴塞乡方家沟村的一个古寨，距离武胜县城沿口镇21公里，2002年12月27日公布为四川省第六批省级文物保护单位。2006年5月25日列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 21 km from Wusheng county town (Yankou), roughly 40 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东河口地震遗址公园
summaryEn: A memorial park where the Wenchuan earthquake of 12 May 2008 brought down whole mountainsides around the village of Donghekou in Qingchuan County, burying more than 780 people. The collapsed slopes, rubble fields and lakes dammed by landslides have been preserved across an area of about 50 km², and geologists study it for the variety of landslide forms it shows.
description: 东河口地震遗址位于四川省广元市青川县，文物遗址年代判定为2008年。2012年7月16日公布为第八批四川省文物保护单位。东河口地震遗址位于广元市青川县中西部红光乡东河口村。
accessEn: In western Qingchuan County near Guanzhuang town, roughly 2 hours by road from Guangyuan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黑竹沟
summaryEn: A national forest park in the Xiaoliangshan mountains of Ebian Yi Autonomous County, whose scenic area covers about 575 square kilometres at altitudes from roughly 1,500 to 4,288 metres. Its old-growth forest, gorges and streams are rich in wildlife and plants. Unconfirmed stories of people and animals going missing here in the 20th century led the media to call it the 'Bermuda Triangle of the East', and its original Yi name, Sihuo, is said to mean 'valley of death'.
description: 黑竹沟国家森林公园位于中华人民共和国四川省乐山市峨边彝族自治县境内，距离乐山市区144公里。黑竹沟在彝语中原名为“斯豁”，意为“死亡之谷”。黑竹沟地处小凉山区，其景区面积575平方公里，外围保护地263平方公里，山的海拔高度在1500米至4288米之间。
accessEn: In Ebian county, about 144 km from Leshan city by mountain road, so best treated as an overnight trip.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 罗城古镇
summaryEn: A market town in Qianwei county whose main street is wide in the middle and narrows at each end, giving it the outline of a boat; the street is traditionally dated to the late Ming dynasty. Broad eaves resting on rows of wooden columns form covered arcades along both sides, shading the shopfronts from sun and rain. Luocheng was named a Sichuan provincial historic town in 1992.
description: 罗城镇，是中华人民共和国四川省乐山市犍为县下辖的一个行政建制镇。2019年12月，撤销南阳乡和金石井镇，将其所属行政区域划归罗城镇管辖。
accessEn: About an hour by road south-east of Leshan city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 灵山寺
summaryEn: Lingshan ('Spirit Mountain') is a forested mountain scenic area about 17 km east of Mianning town, centred on Lingshan Temple, a Buddhist temple whose halls are built up the hillside. The temple is an active place of worship, and local tradition dates its founding to the Qianlong reign of the Qing dynasty.
description: 灵山寺位于四川凉山。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、山地游览、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 17 km east of Mianning town, which is roughly 1.5 hours by road or rail north of Xichang.

name: 螺髻山
summaryEn: Luoji Mountain is a range running south from Qionghai Lake near Xichang, with summits above 4,300 metres. Its upper slopes keep well-preserved landforms carved by Ice Age glaciers, while primeval forest with rhododendrons and rare trees covers the lower ground. A cable car from the Puge side lifts visitors into the high country.
description: 螺髻山是四川省西南部的一座高山。北起于西昌邛海之南，沿普格、德昌县交界南下，接宁南、会理两县交接的鲁南山，长50余公里。主要岭峰由北至南有：摆摆顶山4182米，螺髻山4358米(在北)，螺髻山3816米，大火山3959米。
accessEn: The Puge-side entrance near Luojishan town is about 1–1.5 hours by road south-east of Xichang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 屈氏庄园
summaryEn: A large rural estate built by the Qu family during the Jiaqing and Daoguang reigns of the Qing dynasty (roughly 1796–1850) and used into the Republican era. Its more than 80 rooms are arranged around 48 courtyards and guarded by four watchtowers, making it a nationally listed example of a fortified family compound in southern Sichuan.
description: 泸县屈氏庄园位于四川省泸州市泸县，文物遗址年代判定为清代、民国。2007年6月1日公布为第七批四川省文物保护单位。2013年3月5日列为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Fangdong town, about 30 minutes by road north-east of Luxian county town and around an hour from central Luzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 张坝桂圆林
summaryEn: A large grove of old longan trees in the Qiancao area of Jiangyang district, Luzhou, planted in the Qing dynasty and listed as a Sichuan provincial protected cultural relic in 2007. Now a 4A scenic area on the edge of the city, it hosts an annual longan festival and makes an easy stroll from the centre.
description: 张坝桂圆林位于四川泸州。游览特色包括历史建筑、节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jiangyang district, about 15 minutes by taxi from central Luzhou.

name: 瓦屋山
summaryEn: A flat-topped mountain in south-western Hongya County whose long, roof-like summit plateau gives it its name, 'Tiled House Mountain'. Its slopes are protected as a national forest park and rise to 2,830 m above sea level, making it a cool, forested escape from the Sichuan Basin in summer.
description: 瓦屋山也称蜀山、大瓦山，位于中国四川省洪雅县西南部瓦屋山镇境内，是一处向东西两侧略倾的屋脊状台地，因整体上都状若瓦屋，故名。建有瓦屋山国家森林公园，瓦屋山景区于2019年成为国家4A级旅游景区。瓦屋山景区中有一处禁区，称为“迷魂凼”，被誉为“陆上百慕大”，易进难出。
accessEn: About 1.5–2 hours by road from Hongya county town, or 3–4 hours from Chengdu.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 重龙山
summaryEn: A hill on the north-eastern edge of Zizhong's old town whose cliffs, known as the North Cliff, carry 172 niches with more than 1,700 Buddhist figures carved from 783 through the late Tang, the Five Dynasties and the Song. Guardian kings, Guanyin and Pure Land scenes are common, and the rock faces also bear centuries of inscriptions, including calligraphy credited to Huang Tingjian and Su Dongpo's characters for the Huanyu Pool, re-carved here in 1928 from his original at Qingshen. Since an upgrade finished in 2025 the carvings can be seen without railings and two pavilions on the hill hold exhibitions; the scenic area also takes in Yongqing Temple near the summit and the Confucian and Guandi temples on Zhuangyuan Street below.
description: 重龙山位于四川内江。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、书法文化、佛教文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the north-eastern edge of Zizhong county town, a short walk from the old centre and a short taxi ride from Zizhong North station on the Chengdu–Chongqing high-speed line.

name: 罗泉古镇
summaryEn: An old salt-making town strung along one long street in the gorge of the Zhuxi River, a tributary of the Tuo, where brine wells were worked for centuries. Its nationally listed Yanshen (Salt God) Temple, a Qing building, honours Guan Zhong as patron of the salt trade alongside Guan Yu and the god of fire, and in August 1911 the town hosted the secret Luoquan meeting that pushed Sichuan's Railway Protection Movement towards armed revolt.
description: 罗泉镇位于中国四川省内江市资中县，是中国历史文化名镇之一。罗泉镇毗邻仁寿、威远，地处沱江支流珠溪河的峡谷中。古镇仅有一条五里的长街，形似蛟龙，罗泉因此被称为“龙镇”。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About an hour by road west of Zizhong county town, near the borders of Renshou and Weiyuan counties.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 资中文庙和武庙
summaryEn: Zizhong's Confucian temple and its temple to Guan Yu (Wumiao), both mainly Qing buildings, stand about 100 metres apart on Zhuangyuan Street in the old county town, an unusual pairing. The Confucian temple is entered past a screen wall and the Zhuangyuan Bridge to the Dacheng Hall, which keeps a large Ming spirit tablet to Confucius dated 1530, while the Wumiao's green-and-yellow glazed roofs contrast with the Confucian temple's red-brown tiles.
description: 资中文庙位于四川省资中县，文物遗址年代判定为清。1980年7月7日列为四川省重新确定公布的第一批省级文物保护单位。2006年5月25日公布为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the old centre of Zizhong county town, a short taxi ride from Zizhong North station on the Chengdu–Chongqing high-speed line.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙凤古镇
summaryEn: A tourist town of about 148 ha beside the Fu River south of central Suining, rated 4A in 2012. Its streets of traditional-style buildings hold shops, workshops and small venues, including a storytelling hall, an archery range, an apothecary, a wine shop and a square dedicated to the Guanyin legend, presenting themes from Guanyin worship to old market-town life. It is best for an evening stroll and snacks.
description: 龙凤古镇，位于四川省遂宁市船山区以南，东临涪江，与大白塔村接壤，西临张德桥村，南临用石桥村，北边与天星坝村和张飞梁村接壤，隶属南强镇龙凤村境内，总占地面积约为148.22公顷。2012年1月顺利通过国检，成为遂宁首个国家4A级特色旅游古镇景区。
accessEn: About 10 km south of central Suining, around 20 minutes by taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 金凤山
summaryEn: A wooded hill park on the edge of Ya'an city whose slopes hold Jinfeng Temple, a Buddhist temple protected as a Sichuan provincial heritage site. It is an easy short outing from the city centre for a walk among the trees and a look at the temple halls.
description: 金凤山位于四川雅安。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、林地风光、佛教文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the edge of Ya'an city, about 15 minutes by taxi from the centre.

name: 龙门古镇
summaryEn: Longmen, in a valley north-east of Lushan county town, was the epicentre of the magnitude 6.6 earthquake of 20 April 2013, and the rebuilt township is now run as a scenic area, Longmen Ancient Town. Its historic centrepiece is the main hall of Qinglong Temple, a timber hall dated by its beam inscription to 1323, in the Yuan dynasty, and protected as a national heritage site.
description: 龙门古镇位于四川雅安。游览特色包括古镇、寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 14 km north-east of Lushan county town, around 20–30 minutes by road; Lushan is about an hour from Ya'an.

name: 汉姜古城
summaryEn: A rebuilt old quarter of Lushan county town, laid out after the 2013 Lushan earthquake and themed on Jiang Wei, the Three Kingdoms general who held the title Marquis of Pingxiang. Its centrepiece is Pingxiang Tower, a Yuan-dynasty building dedicated to him and protected as a national heritage site, and the quarter also has a memorial hall to the earthquake.
description: 汉姜古城位于四川雅安。游览特色包括古城、纪念展览、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the centre of Lushan county town, about an hour by road north of Ya'an.

name: 严道古城
summaryEn: The site of Yandao, a county seat founded by the Qin state in 312 BC and later a staging post on the Southern Silk Road, in Gucheng village on the western edge of Yingjing town. Stretches of the old city walls remain, and the national listing also covers the He Jun inscription, a Han-dynasty rock carving recording road-building. The village is known for its black sand pottery, still made in workshops where visitors can watch and try.
description: 严道古城遗址位于四川省荥经县，文物遗址年代判定为汉。1980年7月7日列为四川省重新确定公布的第一批省级文物保护单位。2006年5月25日公布为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the western edge of Yingjing county town, under an hour by expressway from Ya'an.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 周公山
summaryEn: A forested outlier of the Qionglai range just south of Ya'an city, rising to about 1,743 metres and encircled by the Zhougong and Qingyi rivers. Much of it is a provincial forest park, and hot springs at its foot are a popular local retreat.
description: 周公山位于中国四川省雅安市，为邛崃山脉支系，周公河、青衣江环绕，最高海拔1742.6米。建有四川省级森林公园周公山森林公园。
accessEn: On the southern edge of Ya'an, about 20 minutes by road from the city centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 横江古镇
summaryEn: An old river town at the southern tip of Yibin's Xuzhou District, on the Hengjiang River near the Yunnan border, long known as a gateway between Sichuan and Yunnan. Its old quarter, which took shape in the Ming, keeps some 30 Ming and Qing courtyard houses, among them the provincially protected Zhu family residence, and the Shicheng Mountain forest park lies just south of the town.
description: 横江古镇位于四川宜宾。游览特色包括古镇、森林公园。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Roughly 1–1.5 hours by road south-west of Yibin.

name: 流杯池公园
summaryEn: A small park on the north bank of the Min River in Yibin, built around the rock channel where the Song poet and calligrapher Huang Tingjian, exiled here from 1098 to 1100, is said to have floated wine cups during poetry gatherings. The cliffs around the 'flowing cup pool' are covered with inscriptions carved from the Song to the Republican era, protected as a national heritage site since 2019.
description: 宜宾流杯池及石刻题记位于四川省宜宾市翠屏区，文物遗址年代判定为宋至民国。1980年7月7日列为四川省重新确定公布的第一批省级文物保护单位，2019年10月7日公布为第八批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: North of the Min River in central Yibin, a short bus or taxi ride from the old town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙华古镇与八仙山
summaryEn: Longhua is an old town in Pingshan County with stone-paved lanes and the Liang Bridge over the clear Xiaolong stream, shaded by old huangjue fig trees. Above it rises Baxian Mountain, a scenic area with hiking paths, a tea garden and a large modern standing Buddha that overlooks the town.
description: 龙华古镇与八仙山位于四川宜宾。游览特色包括古镇、园林景观、历史街区。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Longhua town, western Pingshan County, about two hours by road west of Yibin.

name: 南溪古街
summaryEn: The riverside heart of Nanxi, a former county town on the Yangtze downstream of Yibin, where more than a kilometre of city wall survives with three gates, among them the Wenming Gate facing the river. The wall was rebuilt in stone in the Ming dynasty and repaired many times since, and the gate towers date from the Qing; the streets behind it are largely rebuilt in traditional style.
description: 南溪城墙，为原南溪县城城墙，位于中国四川省宜宾市南溪区。南溪城墙现存长度1000余米，尚存文明门、广福门和望瀛门三座城门。1985年12月，列入南溪县文物保护单位；2007年6月1日公布为第七批四川省文物保护单位；2013年3月5日列为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Nanxi District, about 40 minutes by road east of central Yibin.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 夕佳山民居
summaryEn: A large country manor in Jiang'an County, begun in 1612 under the Ming and extended and repaired over the following centuries. Its 123 rooms of timber-framed buildings are set around three successive courtyards with a garden alongside, a well-preserved example of a southern Sichuan gentry residence.
description: 夕佳山民居位于中国四川省江安县夕佳山镇坝上村，1991年4月16日公布为四川省第三批文物保护单位，1996年11月20日列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。这里也是国家4A级旅游景区。夕佳山民居始建于明万历四十年，后世屡有增建和修缮。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xijiashan town, Jiang'an County, about an hour by road east of Yibin.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 仙市古镇
summaryEn: A salt-trade town on the Fuxi River south-east of central Zigong, founded in the Sui dynasty and for centuries a wharf and staging post on the route that carried Zigong's salt downriver. Its lanes keep late-Qing and early Republican houses, temples and guild halls, and it is listed as one of China's historical and cultural towns.
description: 仙市古镇位于四川自贡。游览特色包括古镇、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 11 km south-east of central Zigong, 20–30 minutes by bus or taxi.

name: 赵化古镇
summaryEn: A riverside old town on the Tuo River in Fushun County, south-east of Zigong. It was the birthplace of Liu Guangdi, one of the 'Six Gentlemen' executed in 1898 after the failure of the Hundred Days' Reform.
description: 赵化古镇位于四川自贡。游览特色包括古镇、滨水景观、名人故居。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 20 km south-east of Fushun county town, roughly an hour by road from Zigong.

name: 虹山湖
summaryEn: A small reservoir on the north-east side of central Anshun, begun in 1958 and filled in 1959, now ringed by a landscaped park. A 2017 makeover added art installations, boardwalks, walking paths, pedestrian bridges and picnic areas, and it became a 4A scenic area that year. It suits an easy walk by the water close to the old town.
description: 虹山水库又名虹山湖，是中华人民共和国贵州省安顺市的一个人工水库，于1958年4月开始修建，1959年6月水库开始蓄水。2017年11月10日，虹山水库被列为国家4A级旅游景区。2020年7月7日12时，一辆载有多名高考生的巴士撞毁一段道路护栏冲进虹山水库，导致21人死亡、16人受伤。
accessEn: In central Anshun, about 1 km north-east of the Confucius Temple, reachable on foot or by a short taxi ride.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 云峰屯堡
summaryEn: Yunshantun and the neighbouring Benzhai are the core of Yunfeng Tunbao, a group of eight fortified villages in Xixiu district settled in the early Ming dynasty by soldiers posted to Guizhou. Yunshantun is enclosed by stone walls and has a main street of roughly 600 m with houses from the Ming, Qing and Republican periods, while Benzhai is a maze of lanes, loopholed walls and stone watchtowers. Both are on the national heritage list, Yunshantun is also a China Historic and Cultural Village, and the scenic area adds a culture exhibition centre and craft workshops.
description: 云峰屯堡位于贵州安顺。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、历史建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Qiyanqiao town, about 20 km east of central Anshun, reached by road.

name: 鸡鸣三省
summaryEn: Jiming Sansheng ('cockcrow in three provinces') is a border village where Guizhou, Yunnan and Sichuan meet, named for the saying that a cock's crow here is heard in all three. It is linked to a meeting of the Communist Party's leaders held in February 1935 during the Long March, and the scenic area pairs that history with views over a deep gorge. The Sichuan and Yunnan villages along the border use the same name and each presents its own claim to the meeting, so travellers should check which side they are heading for.
description: 鸡鸣三省，是一个地理区域词语，主要位于先中华人民共和国四川、云南、贵州三省交界处，中间流经赤水河上游支流倒流河形成的地区。三省地区分别为四川省叙永县水潦彝族乡岔河村、云南省昭通市镇雄县坡头镇德隆村、贵州省毕节市林口镇鸡鸣三省村。
accessEn: In Linkou town at the northern tip of Qixingguan District, about 45 km north of central Bijie in a straight line; reached by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 九洞天
summaryEn: Jiudongtian is a stretch of the upper Wu River system, known here as the Zongxi River, that runs through a chain of karst caves open to the sky through collapsed roofs, on the boundary of Dafang and Nayong counties. Boats run between several of the caves and under natural stone bridges. It was approved as a national scenic area in 2004 and is called a 'karst encyclopaedia' locally.
description: 九洞天位于中国贵州省毕节地区大方县猫场镇和纳雍县交界处，六冲河在这一段上游称总溪河，下游为瓜仲河伏流，长约7公里，这段河道共有九个天窗洞口，故得名“九洞天”，九洞成串珠状相连，洞内平均高度约80米，最高处约100米，水面最宽处约50米，最窄处约10米。
accessEn: In Maochang town in south-western Dafang, about 70 km and roughly an hour by road from central Bijie.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 慕俄格古城
summaryEn: Mu'ege is a Yi name meaning the place where a ruler lives, and it was the seat of the Yi rulers of the Shuixi region, now Dafang; the 'ancient city' here is a reconstruction begun in 2008 on the old site. Its centrepiece is a rebuilt Guizhou Xuanweifu, the Ming-era Guizhou pacification commissioner's office, completed in 2011, beside the Shexiang Museum and other buildings. Less than a kilometre away is the tomb of Shexiang (1358–1396), the Yi woman who acted as Guizhou's pacification commissioner in the early Ming; the tomb was restored in the 1980s and sits in a landscaped park with a bronze statue, a pond and a stele gallery.
description: 慕俄格古城位于贵州毕节。游览特色包括博物馆、古城、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the north-eastern edge of Dafang town, a county seat about 35 km east of central Bijie in a straight line; the county tourism page puts Bijie Feixiong Airport about 16 km away.

name: 桃源河
summaryEn: A river gorge resort of about 15.7 sq km in Liutun town, Xiuwen county, with lakes, caves, springs, waterfalls and canyon scenery along the Taoyuan River. The Guiyang government calls it one of Guizhou's best-known rafting spots, and it also offers water play, forest walks, a hot-spring hotel and study programmes for school groups. It suits an active day trip from Guiyang.
description: 桃源河位于贵州贵阳。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Liutun town, Xiuwen county, about 55 km from central Guiyang by road.

name: 息烽集中营旧址
summaryEn: The site of a prison that the Kuomintang's military intelligence bureau ran near Xifeng from 1938 to 1946; the memorial hall counts more than 1,200 prisoners, among them communists, patriots and democrats, and Yang Hucheng, a leader of the Xi'an Incident. Nine prison blocks with 52 rooms survive in the compound, now the Xifeng Concentration Camp Revolutionary History Memorial Hall, opened in 1997, with an exhibition on the camp and its prisoners. The Xuantian Cave, a second place of confinement, forms part of the protected site.
description: 息烽集中营旧址，是位于贵州省贵阳市息烽县的中国近代建筑遗址，是中国抗日战争时期中国国民党军统局设立的一所监狱“息烽集中营”旧址，中国国民党方面称为“国民政府军事委员会息烽行辕”，由息烽阳郎坝集中营本部和玄天洞囚禁处建筑遗址组成，在旧址基础上还设有息烽集中营革命历史纪念馆，1988年，被列为全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xifeng county, about 6 km south of the county town and roughly 65 km north of central Guiyang by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 梅花山
summaryEn: Meihuashan is a mountain scenic area of about 40 sq km on the edge of Liupanshui, rising to about 2,499 m, with a resort park laid out in the shape of a plum blossom, a ski area first built in 2015 and a mountain cable car of nearly 10 km. Viewpoints look over karst peaks, cloud seas and forest, and the city promotes it for flowers in spring, cool summers, autumn colour and winter skiing. It is a short ride from the city centre.
description: 梅花山位于贵州六盘水。游览特色包括滑雪、山地游览、林地风光。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: On the south-western edge of Liupanshui, a few kilometres from the city centre; city buses link the centre with the shuttle and the cable car.

name: 乌蒙大草原
summaryEn: Wumeng Grassland is a plateau of pasture and dwarf rhododendron at about 2,000 to 2,857 m in Panzhou, with a high lake called Tianchi, a natural-bridge canyon on the Qingshui river and a ski area. It is promoted for rhododendron bloom in spring, cool summers, 'Buddha's light' halos in autumn and winter snow, and was one of Guizhou's first provincial-level tourist resorts. Horse riding, camping and a coloured slide track at the ski area are among the activities.
description: 乌蒙大草原坐落在中华人民共和国贵州省六盘水市盘州市，是乌蒙山国家地质公园的一部分，是西南地区海拔最高、面积最大的高山草场之一，是贵州省省级风景名胜区。
accessEn: About four hours by road from Guiyang, or from Panzhou high-speed station (about 1 hour 10 minutes by train from Guiyang North) by tourist coach; visitor numbers are capped on peak days, so check the latest notice.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 下司古镇
summaryEn: Xiasi is an old river town on the Qingshui River in Kaili, once a post station on a Tea-Horse trade route, and it still has a waterfront of old landing stages. The streets are lined with whitewashed walls and grey-tiled houses, and visitors can try craft workshops such as batik, tie-dye, lacquered fans and sachet-making.
description: 下司古镇位于贵州黔东南。游览特色包括古镇、手工艺。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 20 km west of central Kaili, 20–30 minutes by road.

name: 云台山
summaryEn: Yuntai Mountain, about 13 km north of Shibing, is the best-known part of Shibing Karst, inscribed in 2014 as part of the South China Karst World Heritage property. The landscape is dolomite karst of peaks and gorges, often wrapped in cloud, with walking routes between a number of viewpoints. The mountain was a Buddhist site some 600 years ago, and old temple buildings and cliff inscriptions survive.
description: 云台山风景区位于贵州施秉北部，距离县城约13公里，面积约210平方公里。云台山地形为白云岩喀斯特地貌，主峰海拔1066米，是国家4A级景区。2014年6月23日与广西桂林、重庆金佛山、广西环江共同组成“中国南方喀斯特”扩展项目被列入《中国世界遗产名录》。
accessEn: About 13 km by road north of Shibing county town, which has a high-speed railway station; the drive from Guiyang takes about two and a half hours.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 福泉古城
summaryEn: The old walled town of Fuquan, whose Ming-dynasty city wall, begun in 1391 as an earth wall and rebuilt in stone about ten years later, ran for roughly 4.8 km with four gates. Where the wall crossed a river it was built as a stone arch bridge with an iron sluice, so the town could keep its water supply under siege. The scenic area, planned at 3.88 sq km, also lists the Confucian temple, the Xiongzhen gate tower, a wetland park and a Zhang Sanfeng-themed museum.
description: 福泉城墙位于中国贵州省黔南布依族苗族自治州福泉市，2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。福泉于明洪武二十四年始建土墙，十年后改为石墙，周长4800米，高7米，厚3米，设东西南北四门。正统年间苗民暴动，福泉被围，城内缺水，人马多渴死。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the centre of Fuquan, a county-level city about 80 km east of Guiyang, usually reached by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 好花红
summaryEn: A rural tourism area of about 5 sq km beside the Lianjiang river in Huishui, where Buyei people make up about 96% of residents. The prefecture presents it as a showcase for rural tourism combining Buyei culture, farming experiences and agricultural sightseeing, and the county's 2026 holiday report describes a flower garden, a sand-beach area and water-play attractions. Haohuahong is also the name of a Buyei mountain-song style popular around Huishui.
description: 好花红调，即惠水山歌调，流行于贵州中南的惠水、长顺、贵阳、龙里等布依族地区，其历史可追溯至清代。属于五声调式民歌，曲调简练，结构单一，见物生情，生动活泼，是二乐句和四乐句的单乐段结构。二乐段重复变化，感情挚朴，委婉动听。
accessEn: On the Lianjiang river in Haohuahong town, about 15 km south-west of Huishui county town in a straight line, reached by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 马岭河峡谷
summaryEn: A fissure gorge cut by the Maling River just north-east of Xingyi, more than 70 km long and up to a few hundred metres deep, with waterfalls pouring from its walls and lime-rich deposits hanging from the cliffs. The core section, the Tianxing Gallery, is the part most visitors see, and UNESCO notes more than 100 cascades after heavy rain. It is a national-level scenic area and part of the Xingyi UNESCO Global Geopark, designated in 2024.
description: 马岭河峡谷位于中华人民共和国贵州省黔西南州兴义市境内，位于兴义市区以东北6公里，南盘江支流马岭河上，谷长74.8千米，宽50～100米，谷深120～280米，谷底均低于地面200米，是一条在造山运动中的大裂谷地缝。
accessEn: About 10 km north-east of central Xingyi by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 三岔河
summaryEn: A reservoir lake in Zhexiang town, north of Zhenfeng, named for the three rivers that meet here and developed as a lakeside leisure area of roughly 2,100 mu. It has a camping ground and RV park, lakeside hotels, a bridge, cliff inscriptions of the character for tiger, a former manor house and the Buyei village of Nakong. It suits families and camping weekends.
description: 三岔河位于贵州黔西南。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhexiang town, 18 km north of Zhenfeng county town by road.

name: 苗王城
summaryEn: A Miao fortified village in Songtao Miao Autonomous County, said to date from the early Ming dynasty, when it was the seat of a local Miao chiefdom. Stone-walled lanes with eleven gateways, stilted timber houses and a stream run through a steep-sided valley, and local authorities put its history at more than 600 years.
description: 苗王城是苗族的王城，位于贵州省铜仁地区松桃苗族自治县正大乡新寨自然村。苗王城分为东城和西城，占地面积约4平方公里，原有城墙2000余米，有4个城门，城内11巷×11寨。当地苗民使用湘西苗语。
accessEn: In Zhengda town, about 45 km by road from Fenghuang ancient town, across the border in Hunan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 红果树
summaryEn: Hongguoshu is a scenic area in Dalucao township, Suiyang county, that combines caves, a waterfall about 35 m high, forest and limestone rock formations, and is nicknamed the "geological museum of Guizhou" locally. Visitors can walk to the caves and falls, cross a glass suspension bridge and eat cave-style hot pot in a cave restaurant. It is one of ten A-level scenic areas in Suiyang county.
description: 红果树，又叫斯脱兰威木，为蔷薇科红果树属下的一个植物种。生长于中国云南、广西、贵州、四川、江西、陕西、甘肃和越南。常见于海拔1000-3000米的山坡、山顶、路旁及灌木丛中。
accessEn: In Dalucao township, Suiyang county, about 60 km north-east of Zunyi, roughly an hour by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 娄山关
summaryEn: A steep gateway pass through the Daloushan range between Zunyi and Tongzi, long a strategic crossing between Guizhou and Sichuan. Red Army forces fought a battle here in late February 1935 on the way to retaking Zunyi, and Mao Zedong's poem 'Loushan Pass', written the same month, made the name widely known. The site has the pass gateway, battle remains on the surrounding peaks, a monument and a memorial exhibition hall.
description: 娄山关又名娄关、太平关，是大娄山脉的主峰，位于中国贵州省北部，海拔1576米，北距桐梓县城13公里，南距遵义市50公里，在遵义市汇川区和桐梓县交界处。为全国重点文物保护单位、国家AAAA级旅游景区。1935年2月，红军三军团十三团在娄山关关北红花园与黔军第六团发生的一场战斗，历史上称为娄山关战役。
accessEn: On the boundary of Huichuan district and Tongzi County beside National Road 210, about 50 km by road north of Zunyi and 15 km south of Tongzi county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 桃花源记
summaryEn: A scenic area in Shiping township, Zheng'an County, themed on Tao Yuanming's classical essay about a hidden peach-blossom valley. Visitors pass through a natural karst cave into an open valley of fields and streams, billed as 'one mountain, two worlds', with boat trips on the water.
description: 桃花源，出自陶渊明诗《桃花源诗并序》。诗的序《桃花源记》记述一个世俗渔人的奇妙经历。
accessEn: In Shiping township in the south of Zheng'an County, about 75 km by road from Zheng'an county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 石羊古镇
summaryEn: Shiyang, north-west of Dayao, is an old salt town, once the seat of the Baiyanjing salt administration, and has a salt-culture museum. Its Confucian temple, founded in 1368, moved to its present site in 1609 and rebuilt in 1879, keeps its Dacheng Gate, main hall and side halls, while most other buildings, including the Lingxing Gate, are modern reconstructions. The main hall holds a 2.3-metre bronze statue of Confucius cast in 1708, described as one of only two large bronze Confucius statues known to survive.
description: 石羊文庙，即白盐井直隶提举司文庙，位于云南省楚雄州大姚县石羊镇石羊社区象岭街，始建于明洪武元年。
accessEn: About an hour by road north-west of Dayao county town; Dayao is roughly 1.5 hours by road north of Chuxiong.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 毛家湾
summaryEn: Maojiawan, a village in Chenghai town at the foot of Fenghuang Mountain south-west of Chenghai Lake, is promoted locally as the ancestral home of Mao Zedong's forebears. The Shaoshan Mao clan genealogy traces the family to Mao Taihua, a Jiangxi man who served at the Lancang garrison in what is now Yongsheng before moving on to Hunan in the early Ming, and local tradition holds that some of his descendants stayed here, though sources differ on the dates. The village has a Mao clan ancestral hall.
description: 毛家湾位于北京西城区平安里东南、中南海西北、皇城根附近的两条小巷，南巷称前毛家湾，北巷称后毛家湾，曾是中国共产党领导人林彪住处的代名词。
accessEn: About an hour by road south of Yongsheng county town; Yongsheng is about 2–2.5 hours by road east of Lijiang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 独龙江
summaryEn: The remote valley of the Dulong River, a headwater of the Irrawaddy, in the far north-western corner of Yunnan, west of the Gaoligong range and bordering Tibet and Myanmar. It is the only area where the Derung (Dulong) people live together as a community, and almost all of the township's roughly 4,650 residents are Derung.
description: 独龙江位于云南怒江。游览特色包括山谷。图集建议预留2 天游览。
accessEn: About 3 hours by mountain road west of Gongshan town; this is a border area, so carry your passport for checkpoints and check with a licensed agency whether foreign visitors are currently admitted.

name: 景东文庙
summaryEn: The Confucian temple of Jingdong, founded in 1442 under the Ming and moved and rebuilt several times since. The east-facing complex keeps its screen wall, semicircular pond, bell and drum towers, Lingxing Gate, side halls and a five-bay Dacheng Hall with a single-eaved hip-and-gable roof, with the former school laid out beside the temple. It was listed as a national heritage site in 2013.
description: 景东文庙，即景东直隶厅文庙，位于云南省普洱市景东县锦屏镇玉屏路111号，始建于明正统七年，后多次迁建、重修。现存照壁、泮池、钟鼓楼、棂星门、大成门、大成殿、两庑。景东文庙坐西向东，布局为右庙左学。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the centre of Jingdong county town, in the far north of Pu'er prefecture and several hours by road north of Pu'er city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 磨黑古镇
summaryEn: An old salt-producing town in north-eastern Ning'er county, whose name comes from Dai words meaning 'salt well'. Local accounts trace salt working here to the Han dynasty, and production expanded under the Qing, making Mohei one of Yunnan's main salt districts and a busy stop on the Tea Horse Road. Caravan inns, shops, old houses, bridges and stretches of the old road survive in the town.
description: 磨黑古镇位于云南普洱。游览特色包括古镇。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 60 km north of central Pu'er, roughly an hour by road.

name: 盐井古盐田
summaryEn: On the steep banks of the Lancang (Mekong) at Yanjing, families still make salt the traditional way: brine is carried up from wells by the river, poured onto flat terraces built on timber posts and left to dry in the sun and wind. Salt has been made here since the Tibetan imperial period; the terraces on the east bank give a pale salt and those on the west bank at Jiada a reddish one. The terraces lie in the Naxi and Quzika townships of southern Markam County.
description: 芒康县盐井古盐田，位于中国西藏自治区昌都市芒康县，是自吐蕃时期开始生产的古盐田。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About two hours by road south of Markam county town on National Road 214; carry your passport for road checkpoints.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 孜珠寺
summaryEn: Zizhu Monastery, regarded as one of the oldest and most important monasteries of the Bön religion, is spread across the six limestone peaks of Zizhu mountain, one of Bön's four sacred mountains, at about 4,800 metres. Revived in the 14th century and rebuilt from 1982, it runs colleges of philosophy, debate and meditation, and pilgrims visit the meditation caves of past masters on the mountain. Every twelve years, in the Tibetan Year of the Rooster, it stages a multi-day masked dance known as 'Heaven and Hell'.
description: 孜珠寺位于西藏昌都。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、洞穴、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Up a mountain road about 17 km long from National Road 317, east of Dêngqên county town; carry your passport for road checkpoints.

name: 西藏自然科学博物馆
summaryEn: A large science museum in eastern Lhasa, opened on a trial basis in 2015 and formally in 2016, that combines a natural-history museum, a science centre and an exhibition hall in one 33,000 m² building. The natural-history halls cover the uplift of the plateau, Tibet's landscapes and wildlife and scientific expeditions, the science halls are hands-on, and a third section introduces Tibetan writing, religion, arts and customs. There is also a 4D cinema and a dome theatre.
description: 西藏自然科学博物馆位于中华人民共和国西藏自治区拉萨市城关区纳金街道藏大东路9号，是一座自然科学类的综合型博物馆，主馆。馆长是党卫东。
accessEn: On Zangda East Road opposite Tibet University's new campus, about 6 km east of the Potala Palace by taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 西藏牦牛博物馆
summaryEn: A museum devoted to the yak and its place in Tibetan life, opened in May 2014 in Lhasa's Liuwu New District as a Beijing-funded aid project. Its galleries look at the yak in nature, history and art, drawing on a collection of some 7,900 objects, and one wall is hung with rows of yak skulls. It also holds temporary exhibitions and summer activities for children.
description: 西藏牦牛博物馆位于西藏拉萨。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At 16 Chagu Avenue in Liuwu New District on the south bank of the Lhasa River, a short taxi ride from the centre.

name: 当惹雍错
summaryEn: Tangra Yumco, a holy lake for followers of the Bön religion, is a large salt lake in a basin on the north side of the Gangdise (Transhimalaya) range in Nyima County. Wenbu village at its northern end is the base for visiting the lake and the nearby Targo snow mountain, and the Bön monastery of Yuben stands on the eastern shore. Much of the shore can be driven, which makes it a goal for long overland trips.
description: 当惹雍错位于西藏那曲。游览特色包括湖泊、寺庙建筑、盐湖风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 120 km by road south of Nyima county town via Wenbu township; carry your passport for road checkpoints.

name: 波密红楼
summaryEn: Known locally as the Bomê Red Building, this two-storey Soviet-style building of stone and timber in the Bomê county government compound was built in 1953 as an office of the Kham–Tibet Highway administration and from 1955 housed the Zamu Central County Committee of the Communist Party. In January 1959 armed Tibetan forces besieged it for about ten days, and the 60 or so officials and soldiers inside held it until reinforcements arrived. It now holds an exhibition of photographs and stories of the soldiers and officials who worked in the area in the 1950s.
description: 扎木中心县委红楼又称为波密红楼，位于中国西藏自治区林芝市波密县人民政府机关大院内，是原中共扎木中心县委和昌都人民解放委员会波密第二办事处办公楼。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the county government compound in Zhamo, Bomê's county town on the G318; carry your passport for road checkpoints. Visits must be booked in advance.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 凤翔东湖
summaryEn: A lake garden on the south-east edge of Fengxiang town that grew from an old pond called Yinfeng Chi ('Phoenix Drinking Pool'). In 1062 the poet Su Shi, then an assistant judge of Fengxiang prefecture, had it dredged and enlarged, fed with spring water and planted with lotus and willows, and named it East Lake; pavilions, bridges and halls in classical garden style surround the water.
description: 凤翔东湖，位于陕西省宝鸡市凤翔区城东南，古称饮凤池，是陕西省历史悠久的风景区之一。
accessEn: On Donghu Road in Fengxiang town, about 45 minutes by road north-east of Baoji.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙头山
summaryEn: A mountain resort in the Micang range on the Sichuan border south of Hanzhong, on limestone riddled with caves and sinkholes, with viewpoints and sights such as Hanwang Terrace, Fairy Cave and the Longtou waterfall. A cableway climbs to the ridge, where there are cliff walkways and a glass skywalk, and there is a ski area in winter.
description: 龙头山位于陕西汉中。游览特色包括瀑布、洞穴、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Roughly an hour by road south of Hanzhong near Xiaonanhai; the lower cableway station is beside the Yinchuan–Kunming expressway.

name: 张骞墓
summaryEn: The tomb of Zhang Qian, the Han envoy whose journeys to Central Asia in the 2nd century BC opened the routes later called the Silk Road, and since 2014 part of the UNESCO World Heritage site 'Silk Roads: the Routes Network of Chang'an-Tianshan Corridor'. A Han-style memorial hall with exhibitions on his missions leads to the cypress-shaded mound, fronted by a stele put up by the Qing governor Bi Yuan in 1776 and a pair of stone beasts, smashed in 1967 and later pieced together. Scholars of the wartime Northwest Associated University excavated it in 1938 and confirmed it as his tomb.
description: 张骞墓是位于陕西省汉中市城固县博望乡的西汉名臣博望侯张骞的坟墓。根据历史记载，张骞逝世于公元前114年汉武帝时期。1938-1939年，国立西北联合大学对该墓的考古挖掘工作确认了此墓属于张骞。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Raojiaying village about 3 km west of Chenggu town, which is about 30 km east of Hanzhong.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天竺山
summaryEn: A national forest park of steep crags and pinnacles about 30 km south-east of Shanyang town, rising to 2,074 m; its best-known sights are the free-standing rock pillar called Tianzhu Moxiao, the knife-edge Daobeiliang ridge and seas of cloud after rain. The mountain has long been a centre of Daoism, and of the dozen or so temples built over the centuries the Shuangfeng Daoist temple and Yungai Temple survive in good condition.
description: 天竺山位于陕西商洛。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km south-east of Shanyang town by road, with the east gate at Sengdaoguan in Faguan town; Shanyang station on the Xi'an–Shiyan high-speed railway opened in June 2026.

name: 陈炉古镇
summaryEn: A hillside pottery town south-east of central Tongchuan, the one Yaozhou-ware kiln centre that kept making ceramics after the Song and Yuan dynasties, where by local tradition the kiln fires have never gone out. Houses and cave dwellings are stacked in tiers up the slopes, with walls built of old pottery jars and lanes paved with potsherds, and workshops let visitors try making pots.
description: 陈炉古镇位于陕西铜川。游览特色包括古镇、洞穴、陶瓷工艺。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km south-east of central Tongchuan (Yintai District) by road.

name: 药王山
summaryEn: A temple-covered hill just east of Yaozhou town where the Tang physician Sun Simiao, revered as the 'King of Medicine', is said to have lived in retreat, with Jin- and Yuan-era halls, Yuan murals and a memorial hall on his life and on Chinese medicine. Its stone carvings are regarded as China's largest collection of Buddhist statue steles from the Northern Dynasties, Sui and Tang, with more than 100 steles and about 45 cliff-carved figures, beside steles of Sun Simiao's prescriptions carved in 1572. A temple fair listed as national intangible heritage runs for about ten days around the second day of the second lunar month.
description: 药王山石刻位于中国陕西省铜川市耀州区城东，是中国保存北朝、隋、唐造像碑最多的地方，1961年被列为第一批全国重点文物保护单位。药王山，唐称磬玉山，宋改称五台山，明隆庆六年将唐代医学家孙思邈所著药书刻成五通碑刻置于山上，后遂改称药王山。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 1.5 km east of central Yaozhou District, Tongchuan; tourist buses run from Tongchuan's high-speed railway station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 玉华宫
summaryEn: A forested valley in the north of Tongchuan where Emperor Taizong of Tang completed the Yuhua summer palace in 647; it was turned into a monastery in 651, and the pilgrim-monk Xuanzang spent his last years here translating Buddhist scriptures. Little of the palace survives above ground, but the scenic area, also a national forest park, has the site of the Sucheng Court, a Xuanzang memorial hall, lakes and woodland walks, and a ski slope in winter.
description: 玉华宫位于今中国陕西省铜川市，是唐朝初期兴建的“离宫”之一。始建于唐高祖武德七年五月，原名“仁智宫”。建筑范围仅限于当时的凤凰谷。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: North of central Tongchuan, reached from the Yuhuagong exit of the Xi'an–Yan'an expressway; tourist buses also run from Tongchuan's high-speed railway station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 洽川
summaryEn: A national scenic area of reed beds, lotus ponds and warm springs on the Yellow River floodplain east of Heyang. Black storks, swans and dozens of other bird species use the wetland, and among its seven warm springs the Chunü ('Maiden') Spring is known for the sand that boils up from its bed beneath floating bathers. The area is linked to 'Guanju', a poem in the Book of Songs that is said to have been set here.
description: 洽川，位于黄河中游秦、晋交界之处，合阳县县城以东23千米的洽川镇黄河二级台地上，距西安180千米，总面积176平方千米。洽川是目前中国最大的黄河湿地湖泊型风景名胜区，是陕西省5个国家重点风景名胜区之一。
accessEn: About 23 km east of Heyang county town, roughly half an hour by road; the springs are at Shenli village.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 渭华起义旧址
summaryEn: Sites of the Weihua Uprising, an armed rising led by the Chinese Communist Party in Weinan and Hua counties in 1928 and put down by Nationalist forces that June. The main site is the former primary school at Gaotang, once a Taoist temple and academy, where the rebels' military committee and headquarters were based; a memorial hall opened there in 1988, with a martyrs' cemetery to its south. The listing also covers a Qing-era temple at Dongyang used by the party's East Shaanxi committee and a village shrine where Liu Zhidan's guerrillas were active.
description: 渭华起义旧址位于陕西省渭南市华州区，包括渭华起义指挥部旧址、中共陕东区特派委员会旧址、刘志丹坚持革命活动旧址，1957年被列为第二批陕西省文物保护单位，2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。渭华起义是中国共产党领导的以渭南、华县为中心的陕西东部地区的武装起义。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Gaotang town at the foot of the Qinling, about 15 km south-west of Huazhou, roughly 30 minutes by road; Huazhou is about an hour from Xi'an.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黑河国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park at the headwaters of the Heihe River on the northern slopes of the Qinling in Zhouzhi County, opened in 2000 and made a national forest park in 2006, covering 7,462 hectares with forest over more than 90 percent of it. Trails follow clear streams past pools, waterfalls and stretches of old pine, oak and birch forest in an area that forms a corridor for giant pandas, and holes cut for the ancient Tangluo plank road survive on the cliffs.
description: 黑河国家森林公园位于秦岭北麓的黑河源头，地处陕西省周至县厚畛子林场经营区内，北面是太白山，西接老县城，南临周至自然保护区，108国道从园内横穿，总面积7462公顷，园区森林覆盖率92%。黑河国家森林公园由周至县厚畛子林场于1997年立项投资建设，2000年建成投入运营。
accessEn: About 100 km south-west of central Xi'an via Zhouzhi on National Road 108, roughly 2–2.5 hours by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 昆明池·七夕公园
summaryEn: A large lakeside park opened in 2017 on part of the Kunming Pool, the artificial lake that Emperor Wu of Han had dug in his Shanglin hunting park to train a navy, now refilled as part of a water project in Fengdong New City. The park is named after the Qixi festival and its legend of the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl, and has lakeside promenades, wetland planting and children's play areas.
description: 昆明池·七夕公园位于陕西西安。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Fengdong New City about 17 km south-west of the Bell Tower, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 曲江海洋极地公园
summaryEn: An aquarium complex in the Qujiang district of southern Xi'an, made up of the Qujiang Ocean World aquarium, opened in 2005, and a polar hall added in 2013, on a site of about 4.7 hectares. The aquarium has an underwater tunnel and a tropical rainforest hall, and the polar hall keeps animals such as polar bears, Magellanic penguins, Arctic wolves and seals. It suits families with children.
description: 曲江海洋世界位于中华人民共和国陕西省西安市雁塔区曲江新区曲江二路1号，的国家AAAA级景区。
accessEn: In Qujiang about 1.5 km east of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, roughly 25 minutes by taxi from the Bell Tower.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 陕西自然博物馆
summaryEn: A natural history museum opened in January 2008 beside the Shaanxi TV Tower, with a crescent-shaped nature building and a glass-sphere science building. Its galleries cover geology, fossils and insects and recreate the habitats of Qinling wildlife such as the giant panda, golden snub-nosed monkey, takin and crested ibis, while a separate Kenneth Behring hall shows African and North American animal specimens donated in 2014. A dome cinema and an outdoor science area make it popular with families.
description: 陕西自然博物馆位于中华人民共和国陕西省西安市雁塔区长安南路88号，是一所公益性文化事业单位，于1999年被列为陕西省重点建设项目，于2008年1月5号开馆。陕西自然博物馆占地面积110亩，总建筑面积达1,6105平方米，展厅展示面积达8,115平方米。
accessEn: On South Chang'an Road about 7 km south of the Bell Tower, beside Huizhanzhongxin (Convention and Exhibition Centre) station on Metro Line 2. Closed on Mondays and Tuesdays, except during public holidays and the school summer and winter holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 朱雀国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park in the Lao valley of the Qinling Mountains in Huyi District, set up in 1992 and made a national forest park in 1999, covering about 26 km² from around 500 m to over 3,000 m. Trails pass waterfalls, one of them more than 100 m high, rock formations and pine woods, and the highest section climbs to rocky peaks near the main Qinling ridge.
description: 朱雀国家森林公园又称陕西朱雀国家森林公园或西安朱雀国家森林公园，是位于中华人民共和国陕西省西安市鄠邑区的一个中华人民共和国国家森林公园以及国家AAAA级景区。公园面积26.21平方公里，分为5大景区和105个景点。
accessEn: In the Lao valley about 60 km south-west of central Xi'an via Huyi, roughly 1.5–2 hours by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大佛寺石窟
summaryEn: A cave temple cut into the cliff on the south bank of the Jing River west of Binzhou, listed in 2014 as part of the Silk Roads: Chang'an–Tianshan Corridor World Heritage Site. Carving began in the late Northern dynasties, and its centrepiece, the Great Buddha Cave of 628, holds a huge seated Amitabha flanked by the bodhisattvas Avalokiteshvara and Mahasthamaprapta, counted as the largest Buddha figure in Shaanxi. Smaller caves of the Tang to Ming periods with hundreds of figures and inscriptions spread along the cliff on either side, and the Mingjing Terrace pavilion, rebuilt in the Ming, stands before the main cave.
description: 大佛寺石窟位于中国陕西省咸阳市彬州市西部的大佛寺内，1988年被列为第三批全国重点文物保护单位。2014年6月，联合国教科文组织认定“丝绸之路：长安－天山廊道的路网”为世界文化遗产，大佛寺石窟被列入该名录，成为咸阳市第一处世界文化遗产。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 10 km west of central Binzhou on the road to Changwu; Binzhou is about 2 hours by road from Xi'an.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 郑国渠
summaryEn: Where the Jing River leaves the Zhongshan hills north-west of Jingyang lie the headworks of the Zhengguo Canal, the irrigation canal begun by the state of Qin in 246 BC that turned the salty northern Guanzhong plain into farmland. As the river cut its bed deeper, later dynasties moved the intake upstream, so the site keeps remains of successive intakes from the Qin canal to the Jinghui Canal completed in 1932, with steles recording the works; the canal system was listed as a World Heritage Irrigation Structure in 2016. The scenic area around the headworks also takes in a stretch of the Jing River gorge.
description: 郑国渠是中国战国时期水利学家郑国，于秦王政元年为秦国所筑的河渠。河渠长三百里，位于今日陕西省泾阳县上然村泾出口一带。为纪念韩国工程师郑国而得名。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Wangqiao town about 25 km north-west of Jingyang town, roughly 1.5 hours by road from Xi'an.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 保安革命旧址
summaryEn: Zhidan's county town, then called Bao'an, was the seat of the Communist Party Central Committee from July 1936 to January 1937, between its stays at Wayaobao and Yan'an, and the American journalist Edgar Snow visited the leaders here in 1936 for his book Red Star Over China. The site keeps a row of five stone cave dwellings used by Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai's residence and the cave used for Politburo meetings, and the Anti-Japanese Red Army University site stands on a hillside south of town.
description: 保安革命旧址位于陕西省延安市志丹县城内，1992年被列为第三批陕西省文物保护单位，2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。1936年6月21日中共中央离开瓦窑堡，经安塞县，于7月3日进驻保安县。1937年1月10日，中共中央离开保安，前往延安。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Zhidan town, about 2 hours by road north-west of Yan'an.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 甘泉大峡谷
summaryEn: A group of narrow Danxia slot canyons in Ganquan County, also called the Yucha Canyon, made up of side gorges such as Huashugou, Longbagou and Yueyagu where curving red rock walls close in overhead. The sculpted walls have earned it the nickname 'China's Antelope Canyon', and its landforms were the subject of a 2019 CCTV documentary.
description: 甘泉大峡谷，又称雨岔大峡谷，位于陕西省延安市甘泉县，为国家4A级景区，由桦树沟峡谷、龙巴沟峡谷、牡丹沟峡谷、蝴蝶谷峡谷、月牙谷峡谷、爱心谷峡谷、一线天峡谷、花豹岔峡谷等构成，有“中国的羚羊谷”之称。2025年，甘泉大峡谷入列《中国国家地理》杂志第10期“选美中国”20周年纪念专版“中国最美丹霞挑战者榜”榜单。
accessEn: At Xiasiwan town in north-western Ganquan County, roughly 60 km south-west of Yan'an, about 1.5 hours by road; the canyons close temporarily after heavy rain, as they did several times in 2025 and 2026, so check before travelling.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南泥湾
summaryEn: A valley about 45 km south-east of Yan'an where the Eighth Route Army's 359th Brigade was sent in 1941 to clear land and farm, as the Communist base area sought self-sufficiency under an economic blockade; the campaign is the subject of the 1943 song 'Nanniwan'. The scenic area has the Great Production Movement exhibition hall, rice paddies on the valley floor and restored sites such as the Yan'an artillery school and the brigade's former headquarters at Jinpenwan, about 10 km to the east.
description: 南泥湾，位于陕西延安城东南45公里处，是延安市著名旅游景点之一。1941年皖南事变后，中国共产党的根据地陕甘宁边区政府失去来自重庆国民政府的财政支持，中国共产党选择走生产自救的道路。同年春，八路军第三五九旅开进南泥湾实行军垦屯田，用以开展工农商活动，以生产、贸易等方法解决财政问题。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 45 km south-east of Yan'an by road, under an hour.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 钟山石窟
summaryEn: A Northern Song Buddhist cave temple at the foot of Zhong Shan west of Zichang, begun in 1067. Its main hall, Cave 4, holds 16 free-standing statues 2–3 m tall among carved pillars, and its walls and pillars are covered with more than 10,000 small relief Buddhas; four smaller caves are badly weathered.
description: 钟山石窟位于中国陕西省子长县安定镇，1988年被列为第三批全国重点文物保护单位。钟山石窟始凿于北宋治平四年，后世多有凿修。现存五窟，坐北朝南，面积约500平方米。
