highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 15 km west of Zichang city by road; Zichang is about 95 km north of Yan'an, roughly 1.5 hours by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 白云山
summaryEn: A large Taoist temple complex on Baiyun Mountain above the west bank of the Yellow River just south of Jia County town, founded in 1605 and rebuilt and enlarged in 1724. Fifty-six old buildings survive, among them the Zhenwu Hall, the Five Dragons Palace, the Jade Emperor Tower and the Hall of the Three Pure Ones, with more than 1,900 Ming and Qing murals and over 120 inscribed steles. Its temple fair early in the fourth lunar month draws worshippers from neighbouring parts of Shaanxi, Shanxi and Inner Mongolia.
description: 白云山庙位于中国陕西省榆林市佳县城南，地处黄河西岸的白云山上，2001年被列为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。白云山庙始建于明万历三十三年，清雍正二年重修并扩建，现存古建筑五十六栋，建筑面积4470平方米。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 3 km south of Jia County town, which is roughly 1½ hours east of Yulin by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 二郎山
summaryEn: A temple-covered ridge on the west bank of the Kuye River facing central Shenmu, also called Bijia ('brush-rest') Mountain because the Ming emperor Wuzong is said to have likened its outline to one in 1518. More than a hundred halls, pavilions and shrines of Ming, Qing and later date line about 1 km of the crest around the temple of the god Erlang, and together they form a provincial heritage site. Crowds climb it for the temple fair on the evening of the seventh day of the lunar new year.
description: 二郎山位于神木县内，传说是二郎神下凡压住一条作恶的蛇，化身为二郎山。山上有二郎神的神位。是神木县的标志性的山，并且与骆驼山相望。
accessEn: On the west bank of the Kuye River in Shenmu city, a short taxi ride from the centre, with steps up to the temples.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黑龙潭
summaryEn: A hillside temple to the Black Dragon King above a group of spring-fed pools beside the Wuding River at Zhenchuan, founded in the Ming Zhengde period (1506–1521) and long visited by farmers praying for rain. Visitors pass a carved stone archway of 1931 and climb 48 steps to a courtyard with bell and drum towers and a main hall with painted murals, while nine springs run into small stone pools around the temple. The temple fair on the 13th day of the sixth lunar month draws tens of thousands of people.
description: 黑龙潭位于陕西榆林。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、壁画。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 60 km south-east of central Yulin at Zhenchuan, beside National Road 210, roughly an hour by road.

name: 会宁红军会师旧址
summaryEn: In October 1936 the Red Army's First and Fourth Front Armies met at Huining during the closing stage of the Long March, and the protected site in the centre of the town preserves the Huishi gate tower, the venue of the joint celebration meeting and the former headquarters of several Red Army commands. Also on the site are the Reunion Tower, a forest of steles with commanders' inscriptions and the Long March Victory Memorial Hall, which presents the march and the meeting.
description: 会宁红军会师旧址，是一处位于中国甘肃省会宁县的全国重点文物保护单位。列入保护的范围约4万平方米，旧址与纪念建筑包括会师楼、会师联欢会会址、会师纪念塔、将帅碑林、革命文物陈列馆、红军烈士纪念堂、红军总司令部旧址、总政治部旧址、红四方面军总指挥部旧址、红一军团指挥部旧址、红四方面军政治部旧址、朱德故居、张国焘故居、徐向前故居等建筑。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the centre of Huining town, about two hours by road east of Lanzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 榜罗镇会议旧址
summaryEn: On 27 September 1935 the Communist Party's Politburo Standing Committee, then on the Long March, met in the principal's office of the Bangluo central school and decided to make the Shaan-Gan base area in northern Shaanxi the destination of the march; the next day Mao Zedong spoke to the Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment's company-level and higher officers at a threshing ground beside the school. The protected site includes the meeting room, 17 former quarters of Party and Red Army leaders and a memorial hall with exhibitions on the meeting and on the Red Army's passage through Tongwei, and it is on the national list of red-tourism classic scenic areas.
description: 榜罗镇会议旧址，位于中国甘肃省定西市通渭县，为一个全国重点文物保护单位，类型为近现代重要史迹及代表性建筑。榜罗镇会议旧址的历史年代为1935年。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Bangluo town, about 60 km by road south-west of Tongwei county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 南屏山
summaryEn: Nanping Mountain rises south of Lintao to an average height of about 2,800 m, and its snow-capped summit is the setting of 'Snow on the Southern Hills', one of the old Eight Views of Taoyang. The eco-tourism area in Nanping town has peony and herbaceous-peony fields, with Lintao's purple-spotted peonies flowering here in late spring, as well as farm-stay guesthouses, farming activities and, in winter, snow paths and sledging.
description: 南屏山是杭州西湖南岸的山麓，位于玉皇山北面，九曜山东面。因位于杭州城市的南面，且石壁有如屏障，所以称为南屏山。因为旧时山上有许多寺庙，也称为佛国山。
accessEn: About 40 km south of Lintao county town by road, in Nanping town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 首阳山
summaryEn: Shouyang Mountain in Lianfeng town south of Weiyuan is one of several places claimed as the mountain where the brothers Bo Yi and Shu Qi, refusing to eat the grain of the Zhou, starved to death; its nine lotus-like peaks have had Buddhist, Daoist and Confucian cave temples and halls since the Han and Wei. Nearby, the Yiqi tomb has a stele in the hand of Zuo Zongtang and the Qingsheng Shrine, first built in the Tang and last restored in 1874, with modern statues of the brothers by He E.
description: 首阳山是多部中国古代典籍中提到的山名，其地理位置历来说法不一。上古人物伯夷、叔齐曾隐居于该山，他们在周武王克商后，二人“不食周粟”、采薇充饥，后羞愤绝食而饿死。此二人在历史上被多人推崇为贤人君子。
accessEn: In Lianfeng town, about 34 km by road south of Weiyuan county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 俄界会议旧址
summaryEn: A Tibetan village house in Gaoji village, Dala township, where the Politburo of the Communist Party of China held an enlarged meeting on 12 September 1935, the day after the Central Red Army's Long March column crossed into Gansu from Sichuan; 'Ejie' is a Chinese rendering of the Tibetan name Gaoji. The meeting adopted a decision on the errors of Zhang Guotao, confirmed the plan to continue north and renamed the northbound force the Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment; the village around the site is now a 4A scenic area with guesthouses run by its residents.
description: 俄界会议旧址，位于中国甘肃省迭部县达拉乡，原为一个省级文物保护单位，类型为近现代重要史迹及代表性建筑。后升级为甘肃全国重点文物保护单位。俄界会议旧址的历史年代为1935年。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the south of Têwo county near the Sichuan border, roughly 1.5 hours by road from Têwo county town; carry your passport for checkpoints.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 甘加秘境
summaryEn: A high grassland basin in the north of Xiahe county with pastures, rivers and gorges below the long Baishiya cliff, at whose foot stand Baishiya Monastery and the Baishiya Karst Cave, a Tibetan Buddhist pilgrimage cave where a Denisovan jawbone about 160,000 years old was found. The scenic area also includes Bajiaocheng, the 'eight-corner town', a walled town of the Tang to Ming periods laid out as a hollow cross, whose 2.2 km of walls still enclose a village.
description: 甘加秘境位于甘肃甘南。游览特色包括峡谷、洞穴、草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 35 km north of Xiahe (Labrang) town by road, under an hour; carry your passport for checkpoints. Check that it is open before going.

name: 腊子口
summaryEn: A narrow gorge in the Min Mountains of Têwo county where the Lazi River runs between sheer cliffs, for centuries the main way between northern Sichuan and southern Gansu. On 16–17 September 1935 Red Army troops under Yang Chengwu took the pass, held by Nationalist forces in blockhouses, by climbing the cliffs to attack from the flank, which opened the Long March route north; the site has a memorial monument, a memorial hall, reconstructed blockhouses and bullet marks on the rock.
description: 腊子口是中国甘肃省甘南藏族自治州迭部县岷山的一个山口，是连结四川省北部和甘肃南部之间的交通要道。历史上对于参加长征的中国工农红军来说具有重要的战略意义。长征期间，毛泽东率军越过若尔盖湿地到达甘肃，夺取腊子口成为了摆在红军面前的一个重要任务。
accessEn: About 90 km east of Têwo county town by road, roughly 1.5 hours; carry your passport for checkpoints.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 赤金峡
summaryEn: A scenic area built around the Chijin Gorge reservoir on the Shiyou River in Chijin town, between Yumen's old and new towns, run as a water-conservancy scenic area in the Gobi. The earth dam, built in 1968 and given a wave wall in 1978, holds a reservoir of up to about 11 km² that irrigates the surrounding oasis farmland, and the grounds hold a replica of the Han dynasty Yumen Pass, a Dragon King Pavilion and other newly built shrines, a Han beacon tower, a Qing stele and the remains of an old post station.
description: 赤金峡水库是中国甘肃省酒泉市玉门市境内的一座水库，位于石油河上，建于1968年。水库正常库容为1940万立方米，集雨面积为3440平方千米，海拔为1560米。1978年增建防浪墙。
accessEn: About 50 km by road from the new town of Yumen, roughly an hour. Check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 水墨丹霞
summaryEn: A badlands landscape of banded red and grey hills in Shuping town in the north-west of Lanzhou municipality, opened on a trial basis in 2020 after the brickworks that once dug its red clay were closed. In the core visiting area, roads and walkways link a series of viewing platforms over the eroded ridges and gullies.
description: 兰州水墨丹霞景区是中华人民共和国甘肃省兰州市一个丹霞地貌景区，面积400平方公里，一期核心游览面积20平方公里，共有丝路古途、丝路霞光、九色丹青、翠峰澜天等十个观景平台。2021年5月1日正式对外开放。
accessEn: In Shuping town, Yongdeng County, north-west of Lanzhou, about 40 km by road from Zhongchuan Airport and 45 km from central Lanzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 兴隆山
summaryEn: A forested mountain range in Yuzhong County south-east of Lanzhou, protected as a national nature reserve since 1988, whose seven peaks rise to 3,021 m. The scenic area is divided into an eastern and a western mountain, with wooded trails and temples, and its summer temperatures average around 18°C, well below the city's.
description: 兴隆山又称兴龙山，位于甘肃省兰州市东南45公里的榆中县境内，距榆中县城西南5公里。属祁连山山系东延部分，为黄土高原上的石质山地之一。西北-东南走向。
accessEn: About an hour by road south-east of central Lanzhou, some 6 km south-west of Yuzhong county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 八坊十三巷
summaryEn: The old Hui Muslim quarter of Linxia, the historic Hezhou, where eight mosque communities (fang) grew up around their mosques and thirteen lanes took shape from the early Qing; some 2,000 households still live here, more than 98 percent of them Hui. Renovated without moving its residents out, it is now a culture and leisure district of grey-brick courtyard houses, mosques, craft workshops and food stalls, where Hui brick carving, wood carving and painted decoration can be seen and listed buildings include the dragon screen wall of the North Mosque and the courtyard at 80 Daga Lane.
description: 八坊十三巷位于甘肃省临夏回族自治州首府临夏市主城区，是一片具有回族民族特色的历史文化街区，国家4A级景区，被称为民族建筑艺术“大观园”、“甘肃新地标”和临夏文化旅游新名片。街区内居民共2000多户，8200人，回族占98%以上。
accessEn: In central Linxia city, entered from Qianheyan Road; Linxia is about 2 hours by road south-west of Lanzhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 碧口古镇
summaryEn: Bikou is an old trading town on the Bailong River near the Sichuan border, long a landing where goods such as medicinal herbs were loaded for shipment downriver, and most of its merchants came from Sichuan, which gave it a Sichuan-flavoured dialect and a taste for Sichuan opera. Its old lanes and merchants' shopfronts recall that trade, tea gardens climb the hills around it and the Bikou Reservoir lies just upstream; it was named a provincial historic town in 2006.
description: 碧口古镇位于甘肃陇南。游览特色包括古镇、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the far south of Wen County on the Bailong River, roughly 1.5 hours by road south-east of Wen county town.

name: 西狭颂
summaryEn: In the Tianjing Mountain gorge west of Chengxian, the Xixia Ode was cut into the cliff in AD 171 to praise Li Xi, governor of Wudu, for building a plank road through the gorge; its 385 characters of clerical script under a seal-script heading, beside a carved panel of five auspicious omens, make it one of the 'Three Odes of Han' prized by calligraphers. A walkway leads through the steep, wooded gorge past traces of the old plank road, later inscriptions and pools such as Huanglong Pool.
description: 西狭颂摩崖石刻，位于中国甘肃省陇南市成县抛沙镇丰泉村天井山峡谷中，刻于东汉建宁四年，由仇靖撰文、书写，全称汉武都太守汉阳阿阳李翕西狭颂，又称汉武都太守李翕西狭颂、李翕颂、惠安西表摩崖。由题额、正文、“五瑞图”及题名组成。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 15 km by road west of Chengxian county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 龙泉寺
summaryEn: A wooded valley just north of Chongxin town, a provincial scenic area and geopark named after the temple at its heart, where the Guanzhu Spring feeds a waterfall and an ancient cypress coils along the cliff, a scene called the 'coiling dragon cypress'. The valley is a cool summer retreat with festival markets and fairs, and the Chongxin County Museum stands on the west side of the scenic area.
description: 龙泉寺位于甘肃平凉。游览特色包括博物馆、瀑布、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 1.5 km north of central Chongxin, within walking distance; the Temple of the Prince of Wukang is about 3 km away by road. The Chongxin County Museum on the west side of the scenic area is closed on Mondays.

name: 王母宫·大云寺
summaryEn: Jingchuan's Queen Mother of the West culture area joins two sites in the town. At the foot of Huizhong Hill, linked in legend with the Queen Mother of the West, the Wangmu Palace Grotto is a Northern Wei central-pillar cave about 11 m high with more than 200 carved figures in three tiers, among them a white elephant carrying a pagoda, behind a four-storey timber facade added in the late Qing. About a kilometre to the north, a museum stands on the site of Dayun Temple, where Buddhist relics in nested gold, silver, bronze and stone caskets were unearthed in 1964.
description: 王母宫石窟，位于中国甘肃省泾川县，为一个全国重点文物保护单位，类型为石窟寺及石刻。王母宫石窟的历史年代为北魏。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Jingchuan town: Wangmu Palace is at the foot of Huizhong Hill and Dayun Temple about 1 km to the north, both reachable on foot or by taxi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 环州故城
summaryEn: A scenic area of 518 mu (about 35 ha) at the north gate of Huan county town, opened in September 2021 and laid out in Song style around the Huanxian Pagoda and the remains of the walled Song-era town of Huanzhou, a frontier post against the Western Xia in the time of Fan Zhongyan. The pagoda is an octagonal brick tower of five storeys, 22 m high, with bracketed eaves, balconies with carved balustrades and an iron finial recording a repair of 1264; a brick found at the top in 2014 bears a date of 1043. The new terraces around it, rising in five zones from the pagoda, hold old-style buildings, water cascades and courtyards.
description: 环州故城位于甘肃庆阳。游览特色包括古塔、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Beiguan on the east bank of the Huan River in Huan county town, which is about 2 hours by road north of Xifeng (Qingyang city).

name: 北石窟寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist cave temple cut into a sandstone cliff about 20 m high and 120 m long on the east bank of the Pu River where it meets the Ru, south-west of Xifeng, begun in 509 under the Northern Wei and extended under later dynasties into the Qing. Nearly 300 caves and niches with about 2,100 stone figures survive, many worn by weathering, with traces of painted murals; the centrepiece, Cave 165, is 14 m high, 21.7 m wide and 15.7 m deep and holds seven standing Buddhas. The Beishikuyi scenic area beside the grottoes adds parking and visitor facilities, and 1.5 km to the south-west a 323 m stretch of old road cut into the red rock at Shidaopo still shows deep cart ruts.
description: 北石窟寺是中国甘肃东部的一座石窟寺，坐落在庆阳市西南约25公里的寺沟。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 25 km south-west of Xifeng (Qingyang city) by road, roughly 40 minutes.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 大像山
summaryEn: A hillside of temples and grottoes on Wenqi Mountain just west of Gangu town, named after the large Buddha carved into the cliff near its summit. Stepped paths about 1.5 km long lead past halls such as a Taihao Palace to Fuxi, a Wenchang Pavilion and a Guandi Hall up to the Big Buddha Hall, with wide views over the Wei River valley. Together with the Shuiliandong grottoes about 35 km to the west it forms one national heritage site.
description: 大像山石窟，位于中华人民共和国甘肃省天水市甘谷县，2001年6月25日公布为第五批全国重点文物保护单位，类型为石窟寺及石刻。
accessEn: About 2 km west of Gangu county town; Gangu is roughly 45 minutes by road west of Tianshui.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 水帘洞石窟
summaryEn: A group of cave temples in a narrow gorge north-east of Wushan town, named after a natural cave about 50 m high whose overhang turns into a curtain of water when it rains. Its best-known work is the giant Buddha carved in relief on the cliff at Lashao Temple, dating from the Northern Zhou, while the Thousand Buddha Cave and other shrines keep statues, murals and inscriptions added from the Later Qin to the Yuan. The area is now run as the Tianshui Cliff Grottoes Cultural Tourism Area.
description: 水帘洞石窟，位于中华人民共和国甘肃省天水市武山县，2001年6月25日公布为第五批全国重点文物保护单位，类型为石窟寺及石刻。
accessEn: About 25 km by road north of Wushan county town, which is roughly 1.5 hours by road west of Tianshui.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 凉州白塔寺
summaryEn: The site of a Yuan-period Buddhist monastery at Wunan, south-east of Wuwei, where in 1247 Sakya Pandita, head of the Sakya school of Tibetan Buddhism, met the Mongol prince Köden (Godan), a grandson of Genghis Khan who held Liangzhou as his appanage. Remains of the old stupas stand among a field of white stupas with gilded tops, and the Liangzhou Assembly Memorial Hall on the site displays finds and the history of the meeting.
description: 白塔寺遗址，位于中国甘肃省武威市凉州区武南镇，2001年6月25日公布为第五批全国重点文物保护单位，类型为古遗址。白塔寺遗址的历史年代为元代。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Baita village in Wunan town, about 20 km south-east of central Wuwei by taxi or car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 扁都口
summaryEn: Biandukou, called Dadoubagu in the Sui, is a pass of over 3,500 m on the old route across the Qilian Mountains between Minle and Qinghai, linked by Chinese sources with Huo Qubing's army, the monk Faxian and Emperor Yang of Sui. The scenic area on the northern approach, at about 2,800 m, is known for summer rapeseed fields and highland pasture, Buddhist rock carvings, and campsites, cabins and riding trails for self-drive visitors.
description: 扁都口，隋朝期间被称为大斗拔谷，为一位于祁连山中部的山口，高约3,500多米。现今227国道从此关口经过，为交通要道。位于中国甘肃省民乐县与青海省祁连县之间，此地为往来中原与西域的重要通道。
accessEn: About 28 km south of Minle town on National Road 227 towards Qinghai, around 40 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 文殊山石窟
summaryEn: A cave-temple complex in the Wenshu Mountains south-west of Jiuquan, spread over a front and a back hill, with over 130 caves recorded, including about 30 from the Wei and Jin to the Qing that keep more than 500 statues and some 1,200 m² of murals. The early central-pillar caves were cited by the archaeologist Su Bai as examples of the 'Liangzhou model' of early Hexi cave art, and the Wenshu Temple at the foot, a Gelug Tibetan Buddhist monastery, shares the valley with Chinese Buddhist and Taoist shrines.
description: 文殊山石窟，位于中国甘肃省肃南裕固族自治县，是一处早期佛教遗存，属凉州模式石窟的范围内。全境分为前山和后山两个区域，由文殊寺、百子楼、普化寺、千佛洞，万佛塔、五百罗汉堂、观音洞，等七部分组成。共有遗存石窟131座，根据形制、功能，可分为中心柱窟、禅窟、僧房窟、佛殿窟等类型。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 20 km south-west of Jiuquan and a similar distance from Jiayuguan, in an outlying part of Sunan county; 30–40 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 月牙湖
summaryEn: A town park on the western edge of Gaotai, built since 1992 around a natural reed-marsh lake that was long counted among the county's ten sights as 'the lake reflecting the crescent moon'. Its 37 ha hold four lakes, five islands, nine bridges and sixteen pavilions, an old-style courtyard, a folk-collection museum and a fishing park, making it a pleasant stop for a stroll.
description: 月牙湖位于甘肃张掖。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: On the western edge of Gaotai town, about 2 km from the centre.

name: 将台堡红军长征会师纪念园
summaryEn: The earthen fort where the Red Army's Second Front Army met the First Front Army on 22 October 1936, after the First and Fourth had met at Huining on 9 October; the meeting completed the union of the three main Red armies and is taken as the end of the Long March. A 1996 monument stands beside the fort, whose walls, about 70 by 68 m and some 10 m high, enclose a memorial hall to the meeting, an exhibition on the Long March route and a stele garden; the memorial park was enlarged in 2006 and 2016.
description: 将台堡革命旧址，位于中华人民共和国宁夏回族自治区固原市西吉县将台堡镇，又称西瓦亭，是古丝绸之路上的一处军事要塞。1936年10月22日，红二方面军与红一方面军在将台堡会师，长征胜利结束。1996年，为纪念红军长征胜利暨将台堡会师60周年，经中宣部批准，将台堡修建了中国工农红军长征将台堡会师纪念碑，碑名由江泽民题写。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Jiangtaibu town, about 20 km south-east of Xiji county town and roughly an hour by road from Guyuan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 董府
summaryEn: The fortified residence of Dong Fuxiang, the late-Qing general whose Gansu troops took part in the 1900 siege of the Beijing legations, built in 1902–1905 after he was dismissed and sent home. Rammed-earth walls 8.5 m high with corner platforms enclose a compound of linked courtyards with more than 100 brick-and-timber rooms and much carved brickwork. The moat and outer enclosure have gone, but the walled core has been restored and is open as a scenic area.
description: 董府，位于宁夏回族自治区吴忠市利通区西五公里处的黄河东岸，是清末甘军将领董福祥的住宅。该住宅自董福祥被免职回乡后的1902年开始修建，1905年正式建成，建成时包含主体院落、府墙、府廓、护府河等建筑，后来府廓和护府河先后被毁，现存部分的占地面积为11025平方米。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the east bank of the Yellow River west of Wuzhong city, roughly 20 minutes by road from the centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 哈巴湖
summaryEn: A national nature reserve on the south-western edge of the Mu Us Desert, where small lakes and wetlands lie among sand dunes, dry steppe and planted belts of willow, peashrub and other trees. The tourism area has a museum about the reserve and a self-drive campground with wooden cabins and tent pitches.
description: 哈巴湖位于中国宁夏回族自治区吴忠市盐池县中北部，距盐池县城37公里。已设立国家级自然保护区。哈巴湖总面积16万公顷，湿地总面积2.16万公顷。
accessEn: About 40 km by road from Yanchi county town, which is about 2 hours south-east of Yinchuan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 鸣翠湖国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A national wetland park, approved in 2006 and covering 6.67 km², around a 2.88 km² freshwater lake that survives from an old chain of lakes east of Yinchuan and was restored from farmland from 2000 onwards. Its name refers to green reeds and birdsong, and the reed beds and waterbirds are the main attraction, about 3 km from the Yellow River.
description: 鸣翠湖，旧名道祖湖，岛嘴湖，位于中国宁夏回族自治区银川市兴庆区的淡水湖，湖面面积288公顷，年平均水深1.6m。本为明朝时长湖的中段，明末清初长湖渐渐淤积，分为三个湖泊。其中中段湖泊本无名字，清朝雍正时有一道士在湖边建有祖庙，湖泊改称为道祖湖。
accessEn: About 12 km south-east of central Yinchuan in Zhangzheng town, around 25 minutes by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 阿克苏地区博物馆
summaryEn: The prefecture museum of Aksu, also called the Aksu Prefecture Museum and Heritage Institute, opened in its present colourful building in 2009 and holds about 2,000 objects on the history of the Aksu region and the Kucha kingdom. Digital galleries let visitors explore Kizil, Subashi, the Kizilgaha beacon and other sites in VR, and a gallery reproduces Kucha cave murals.
description: 阿克苏博物馆，又名阿克苏地区博物馆，位于中国新疆维吾尔自治区阿克苏地区阿克苏市西大街27号，2009年5月成为首批国家三级博物馆。
accessEn: On Xi Dajie in central Aksu city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 克孜尔尕哈烽燧
summaryEn: A Han-dynasty beacon tower of rammed earth laid in layers with reeds and branches, still about 16 m high, standing on gravel desert north-west of Kuqa. Weathering has split its top so that it looks like a double tower, and remains of buildings lie to its north. Part of the Silk Roads World Heritage site since 2014, it is laid out as a heritage park with a visitor centre.
description: 克孜尔尕哈烽燧，又称克孜尔尕哈烽火台、克孜尔尕哈土塔等，为汉代始建的烽燧，现存遗迹以唐代烽燧为主，是丝绸之路古道上现存时代最早、保存最好的烽燧遗址，位于中国新疆维吾尔自治区阿克苏地区库车市。克孜尔尕哈烽燧是世界遗产丝绸之路：长安—天山廊道的路网的组成部分，也是全国重点文物保护单位、国家级长城重点段。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 13 km north-west of Kuqa by road, on the way to the Kizilgaha Caves.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 草原石城
summaryEn: A 59 km² stretch of the Saur Mountain foothills south-east of Jeminay where weathering has shaped the granite into rounded boulders, stacks, basins, hollows and caves rising out of grassland, with more than 200 kinds of wild flowers in spring and early summer. Within it lies the Tongtiandong cave site, the first Palaeolithic cave site found in Xinjiang, where excavations since 2016 have traced human use back about 45,000 years and found carbonised wheat around 5,200 years old. Display boards at the cave explain the finds, and the area also has a spring in a rock cave and the old pastures of Ailin, a Kazakh prince of the late Qing and Republican era.
description: 草原石城位于新疆阿勒泰。游览特色包括草原、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 45 km south-east of Jeminay county town by road, on the northern foothills of the Saur Mountains near highway G219. It lies in a border area, so a border-area permit (边境通行证) is needed as well as a passport; check the current rules before travelling.

name: 三道海子
summaryEn: A high basin of three lakes, Bianhaizi, Zhonghaizi and Huahaizi, at about 2,700 m on the Altai watershed near the Mongolian border, where summer pastures hold a Bronze Age landscape of giant stone mounds, tombs and deer stones. The largest mound, about 15 m high and 76 m across, is laid out like a wheel, with four paved stone paths running out to an outer ring of sunken stone slabs, and around it lie further large and medium mounds, about a hundred smaller cairns, deer stones carved with animals and weapons, and rock art. Excavations by the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences in 2013–16 studied the site, which is also a summer camping and wildflower area.
description: 三海子古墓是一处位于中国新疆维吾尔自治区阿勒泰地区青河县查干郭愣乡阿尔泰山分水岭处的青铜时代考古遗址群。该遗址地处中蒙边境，海拔约2700米，由边海子、中海子、花海子三个谷地组成，总面积达596.16平方公里。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: More than 100 km by road from Qinghe county town, close to the Mongolian border, at about 2,700 m.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 乌伦古湖黄金海岸
summaryEn: A sandy beach resort on the north-eastern shore of Ulungur Lake, with clear water, a shallow stretch about 100 m wide and water of around 20–22°C in summer. Besides swimming and sunbathing there are jet skis, flyboarding, parasailing, cruises around the lake to watch birds and grilled cold-water fish from the lake, and a wetland science museum of eight halls belongs to the Ulungur Lake national wetland park. In winter the resort hosts an ice and snow festival with ice fishing, and an autumn cold-water swimming meet.
description: 乌伦古湖，又名布伦托海、大海子、福海，位于中国新疆阿勒泰地区福海县，常与吉力湖被视为同一湖泊的不同湖体。乌伦古湖湖泊面积858.5平方千米，水体体积88.9×108立方米。乌伦古湖的水源包括乌伦古河和额尔齐斯河，乌伦古湖是乌伦古河的尾闾湖，20世纪70到80年代修成引额济海工程，额尔齐斯河成为乌伦古湖的另一水源。
accessEn: On the north-eastern shore of Ulungur Lake in Fuhai County, about 420 km and roughly four to five hours by road from Ürümqi on the S21 expressway.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 巴仑台黄庙
summaryEn: A Gelug (Tibetan Buddhist) monastery founded in 1888 by the Torghut Mongol khans in a Tian Shan valley at Baluntai, given the name Yong'an Temple by the Guangxu emperor and long the chief religious centre of the Torghut and Khoshut Mongols. Its two-storey main hall, with apricot-yellow walls and upturned eaves, stands at the centre of a group of temple buildings and stupas beside the Baluntai river, and a large Maitreya festival is held on the 15th day of the first lunar month.
description: 巴仑台黄庙，清朝赐名“佑安寺”，藏语名暨宗教法名为“夏尔布达尔杰楞”，蒙古语名“夏勒苏木库来”，位于新疆维吾尔自治区巴音郭楞蒙古自治州和静县，是一座藏传佛教格鲁派寺院。2013年被定为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the Baluntai valley in the Tian Shan, about 50 km by road north of Hejing county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 天鹅河
summaryEn: A landscaped river corridor in Korla's newer districts, near Minsheng Bridge, with riverside walks, summer lotus beds and boat rides. It is mainly a place for an evening stroll rather than a sight in itself.
description: 天鹅河位于新疆巴音郭楞。游览特色包括滨水景观、乘船游览、莲花观赏。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: In the new district of Korla, near Minsheng Bridge, a short taxi ride from the centre.

name: 塔里木胡杨林公园
summaryEn: A forest park of about 100 km² on the middle Tarim River in Luntai County, set in natural desert-poplar (Populus euphratica) forest on the northern edge of the Taklamakan. A sightseeing train runs along a 17 km route with stops at lakes and viewpoints, and the trees turn gold from mid-October to early November.
description: 塔里木胡杨林国家森林公园位于中华人民共和国新疆维吾尔自治区巴音郭楞蒙古自治州轮台县塔里木河中游，占地4.5平方公里，于1997年开园。
accessEn: About 65 km by road south of Luntai county town, near Lunnan, roughly an hour's drive.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 玛纳斯国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A national wetland park formed by the Manas and Taxi rivers and the reservoirs and canals between them, piloted from 2011 and formally designated in 2016. Large numbers of migrating birds stop here in spring and autumn on the West Asia–East Africa flyway, and Yanfeitai is one of five visitor zones with boardwalks, viewing platforms, bird hides and a wildlife exhibition hall.
description: 玛纳斯国家湿地公园是位于中国新疆维吾尔自治区昌吉回族自治州玛纳斯县的国家湿地公园，2011年3月25日启动试点，2016年8月16日通过验收。规划面积9,000公顷。玛纳斯河、塔西河、与二者连接的7座水库以及部分引水灌渠共同组成了玛纳斯国家湿地公园内的湿地系统。
accessEn: About 17 km north of Manas town and 16 km north of Shihezi, roughly two hours by road west of Ürümqi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 巴里坤古城
summaryEn: Barkol was a Qing garrison town on the grassland north of the Tian Shan, one of the four great military cities of northern Xinjiang, with a Han city built in 1731 and a Manchu city in 1772. Its long rammed-earth walls survive, and the scenic area follows them to the gates, a granary, the Xiangu temple, an old academy, an exhibition hall and an old-town culture street. The Kazakh pastures of the Barkol basin surround the town.
description: 巴里坤故城遗址是中国新疆巴里坤的清代古城遗址，又称会宁城，与伊犁惠远城、迪化巩宁城、奇台孚远城并称为北疆四大军城。1992年被列为巴里坤县县级文物保护单位，1999年被列为新疆第四批自治区级文物保护单位，2019年10月16日被列为第八批国家重点文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Barkol county town, about 95 km from Hami as the crow flies, on the far side of the Tian Shan; go by bus or car.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 哈密回王墓
summaryEn: For more than two centuries Hami was ruled under the Qing by a line of nine local Uyghur princes, and their burial ground in the south of the city mixes Islamic, Chinese and Mongol architecture. The largest tomb, of the seventh prince, is a domed brick mausoleum faced with green and blue tiles, beside wooden pavilion-roofed tombs of later princes and the Aitika Mosque, described as Hami's largest, with a flat roof carried on about a hundred red pillars. Next door the princes' palace has been rebuilt, and the two together form the Hami King scenic area.
description: 哈密回王墓是哈密札萨克和硕亲王及王室成员的陵墓建筑群。位于中华人民共和国新疆维吾尔自治区哈密市，主要有七世回王博锡尔、八世回王卖哈莫特和九世回王沙木胡索特的陵墓，另外，哈密最大的清真寺艾提卡大清真寺也坐落在哈密王墓的陵园内。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Huancheng Road in the south of Hami city, a short taxi ride from the centre and opposite the Hami Museum.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 达玛沟佛寺遗址
summaryEn: A group of Buddhist temples of the Khotan kingdom found in 2000 in the scrub desert of Toplukdong, Damagou township, now shown in a heritage park. Temple No. 1, of the 6th–7th century, is a tiny shrine with a seated Buddha in Gandharan and Gupta style and wall paintings, protected by a site museum opened in 2007; the larger temples No. 2 and 3, probably of the 8th century, show features of the Tibetan period. The temples were abandoned when the Karakhanids conquered Khotan around the year 1000.
description: 达玛沟佛寺遗址位于中华人民共和国新疆维吾尔自治区和田地区策勒县，由托普鲁克墩1号佛寺、托普鲁克墩2号佛寺、托普鲁克墩3号佛寺组成。其中托普鲁克墩1号佛寺是已发现最小的中古时期佛寺，始建于6至7世纪，为于阗国佛教遗迹。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 30 km east of Qira (Cele) town and 4 km south of the G315 highway, roughly 1.5–2 hours by road east of Hotan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 约特干故城
summaryEn: A walled tourist town opened in 2022 at Bagqi, about 5 km from the buried site of Yotkan, which scholars regard as the probable capital of the ancient kingdom of Khotan. Its design is based on a 10th-century Dunhuang mural of the Khotan capital: red walls enclose white Uyghur-style aiwan houses, a Xuanzang square, food lanes, craft workshops, guesthouses and exhibition halls. The original Yotkan site lies under farmland with nothing to see above ground, and some of its finds are in the Hotan Museum.
description: 约特干遗址，位于中华人民共和国新疆维吾尔自治区和田地区和田县巴格其镇艾拉曼村境内的一处古代遗址，曾是古代于阗地区重要聚落，学界认为可能是于阗国国都所在。
accessEn: In Bagqi town, Hotan County, about 20 minutes by road west of Hotan city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 伊犁州博物馆
summaryEn: The prefecture's main museum, founded in 1993 and now housed in a large new building on Ruyi Street in western Yining. Its collection of about 6,500 objects is shown in permanent galleries on the Ili valley's history from the pre-Qin period, gold and silver work from the Boma tombs, and the region's nature and resources. It is a national second-grade museum and a useful introduction before touring the valley.
description: 伊犁哈萨克自治州博物馆，简称伊犁州博物馆，位于中华人民共和国新疆维吾尔自治区伊犁哈萨克自治州伊宁市，是兼具典藏、研究、展示、教育、交流、服务等功能的地方综合博物馆。伊犁州博物馆是国家二级博物馆、国家AAAA级旅游景区。
accessEn: In the western part of Yining city, a short taxi ride from the centre. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 库尔德宁
summaryEn: A broad valley on the northern side of the Tianshan in Gongliu County, unusual for running north to south and filled with primeval forest of Schrenk's spruce, part of the Xinjiang Tianshan World Natural Heritage site. Rivers, meadows and snow peaks frame the forest, and after spring rain low cloud often fills the valley. It also opens in winter for snow activities.
description: 库尔德宁位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括山谷、林地风光、高山景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the east of Gongliu County beyond Kurdening town, about 70 km and an hour and a half by road south-east of Gongliu town.

name: 锡伯古城与靖远寺
summaryEn: A modern tourist town in old style in Sunzhaqi Niru, a Xibe village outside Qapqal town, built around Jingyuan Temple, the Tibetan Buddhist (Gelug) temple of the Qing Xibe garrison, whose halls were rebuilt in the late 19th century on a Chinese plan with a Hall of the Heavenly Kings, a main hall and side halls. The town also holds the Xibe Museum, on the move of Xibe soldiers and families from Manchuria to guard Ili in 1764, and an archery museum, since the county is known for Xibe archery. A gate-opening ceremony is staged at the town gate.
description: 靖远寺，俗称喇嘛苏木，位于中华人民共和国新疆维吾尔自治区伊犁哈萨克自治州察布查尔锡伯自治县，是一座藏传佛教格鲁派寺院，也是当年锡伯营八旗的主寺，亦是清代伊犁九大名寺之一。靖远寺虽为藏传佛教寺院，但布局采用汉地佛教伽蓝七堂，原建筑包括四大天王殿、大雄宝殿、东西配殿、三世佛大殿等得以保留。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Sunzhaqi Niru about 6 km west of Qapqal town, roughly 30 minutes by road south-west of Yining.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 八奇洞
summaryEn: A large limestone cave in the hills near Tanzhe Temple, hollowed out by an underground river, with a visitor route of about 1.35 km through big chambers and narrow passages. Its name, 'Eight Wonders', refers to eight featured sights, above all a huge figure-of-eight fold in the rock; the cave also has a 410 m underground slide and films projected onto a cave wall, and it stays at about 16°C all year.
description: 八奇洞位于北京。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、洞穴。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Near Pingyuan village in Tanzhesi town, Mentougou District, a little over 1 km from Tanzhe Temple and roughly 32 km west of central Beijing, about 45 minutes by road.

name: 北京世园公园
summaryEn: The 503-hectare site of the 2019 International Horticultural Exposition at Yanqing, kept open and renamed Beijing Horticultural Expo Park in 2020. Its main buildings are the China Pavilion, the flower-shaped International Pavilion and the Plant Pavilion, a large greenhouse of tropical and rare plants, set among the gardens left by Chinese provinces and foreign countries.
description: 北京世园公园位于北京。游览特色包括园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the south-western edge of Yanqing town, about 80 km north-west of central Beijing by road.

name: 北京国际鲜花港
summaryEn: A large flower park in Yangzhen, Shunyi District, best known as the venue of the Beijing Tulip Festival each April and early May. During the festival the grounds are filled with mass plantings of tulips and other spring bulbs, many of them imported, with costumed parades and stage shows, and areas are set aside for camping.
description: 北京国际鲜花港位于北京。游览特色包括花卉观赏、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yangzhen, Shunyi District, about 45 km north-east of Tiananmen and roughly an hour by road.

name: 张裕爱斐堡酒庄
summaryEn: A wine estate of the Changyu wine company in Jugezhuang town, built around a European-style castle with vineyards, a large underground cellar, a European-style village of shops and restaurants and a museum of Changyu's history since its founding in 1892. Visitors can tour the cellar, taste wine, pick table grapes in season and stay at the estate.
description: 张裕爱斐堡酒庄位于北京。游览特色包括博物馆、葡萄酒文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jugezhuang town, Miyun District, about 70 km north-east of central Beijing by road.

name: 谷山村
summaryEn: A mountain village in Miaofengshan town turned into a farming-culture park, with displays of old farm tools and machinery, a small farm, children's play areas and hands-on craft workshops. Pear and apple orchards surround it, with white pear blossom in spring, and it suits families with children.
description: 谷山村位于北京。游览特色包括果园、农业体验、手工艺。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Miaofengshan town, Mentougou District, roughly 30 km west of central Beijing, about 45 minutes by road.

name: 韩美林艺术馆
summaryEn: A museum devoted to Han Meilin, the artist best known for designing the Fuwa mascots of the 2008 Beijing Olympics, opened in 2008 in Liyuan, Tongzhou. Its galleries show his paintings, calligraphy, sculpture, ceramics and folk-craft designs, and it suits anyone interested in contemporary Chinese art and design.
description: 韩美林艺术馆位于北京。游览特色包括博物馆、雕塑艺术、书法文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Liyuan, Tongzhou District, about 20 km east of Tiananmen.

name: 乐多港假日广场
summaryEn: A modern leisure complex on the south-west edge of Changping town, combining a shopping and dining centre (now Leduogang Wanda Plaza), a Marriott resort hotel with a large hot-spring complex, and Karle Planet, a space-themed amusement park opened in 2022 on the site of an earlier theme park. It suits families looking for rides, shopping and a hot-spring break rather than sightseeing.
description: 乐多港假日广场位于北京。游览特色包括主题游乐、航天科普、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the south-west edge of Changping town near the Xiguan roundabout, Changping District, about 40 km north-west of central Beijing, roughly an hour by road.

name: 南宫旅游景区
summaryEn: A resort area in Wangzuo town, south-western Fengtai, built around the geothermal water of Nangong village. It groups hot-spring bathing centres and a hot-spring water park with a plant and parrot park and children's play areas, and suits families and anyone after a hot-spring soak close to the city.
description: 南宫旅游景区位于北京。游览特色包括水上游乐、泉水、温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wangzuo town, Fengtai District, about 25 km south-west of central Beijing by road.

name: 青龙峡
summaryEn: A wooded gorge north of Huairou town, dammed to form the Dashuiyu Reservoir, with Ming Great Wall watchtowers on the ridges above. Boats run on the lake behind the dam and adventure activities have been offered on its banks, and in wet summers water spills over the dam as a broad waterfall.
description: 青龙峡位于北京。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、长城。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Dashuiyu village in Huaibei town, Huairou District, about 20 km north of Huairou town and roughly 65 km north-north-east of central Beijing, around 1.5 hours by road. The Beijing scenic-area register currently marks it as closed, without a published reason, so check its status before going.

name: 圣莲山
summaryEn: A steep limestone mountain in the upper Dashi River valley, part of the Fangshan UNESCO Global Geopark, with karst peaks, arches, caves and springs. Taoist and Buddhist temples are spread over the slopes, among them a Quanzhen Taoist Zhenwu Temple rebuilt in 2004, and a 57 m statue of a seated Laozi, a pagoda on the summit area and a large Buddha carved into the cliff stand out on the walk up.
description: 圣莲山位于北京。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、地质景观、古塔。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Shijiaying township in western Fangshan District, about 60 km west-south-west of central Beijing, roughly 1.5–2 hours by mountain road.

name: 石花洞
summaryEn: A large limestone show cave on the Dashi River, the core of the Shihuadong National Geopark and part of the Fangshan UNESCO Global Geopark. Eight levels have been explored, and the four upper levels, about 2.5 km of passages, are open to visitors, with stalagmites, columns, flowstone curtains and the delicate helictites and 'stone flowers' (anthodites) that give the cave its name. A Ming monk found it in 1446 and had a statue of the bodhisattva Ksitigarbha carved inside; it opened to the public in 1987.
description: 石花洞位于北京。游览特色包括地质景观、洞穴、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Nancheying village, Hebei town, Fangshan District, about 40 km south-west of central Beijing, roughly an hour by road.

name: 京东石林峡
summaryEn: A gorge in the hills of north-eastern Pinggu, named after the groups of rock pinnacles that rise from its slopes, with clear pools, huge boulders and a waterfall that drops in several tiers. The path follows the valley floor, which narrows to a few metres in places, beneath cliffs where cypresses grow straight out of the rock.
description: 京东石林峡位于北京。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、石林。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Huangsongyu township, Pinggu District, about 20 km north-east of Pinggu town by road.

name: 水关长城
summaryEn: A Ming-dynasty section on the eastern part of the Badaling wall, which climbs in a steep V up both sides of the Guangou valley where it was cut by the Beijing–Zhangjiakou railway. Its name, 'Water Pass', is said to come from an arrow tower on the valley floor that also served as a water gate, and the wall here is known for its steep gradients.
description: 水关长城位于北京。游览特色包括长城、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Badaling town, Yanqing District, about 60 km north-west of central Beijing by road and a few kilometres short of the main Badaling gate.

name: 世界花卉大观园
summaryEn: A flower park and botanical garden just north of the South 4th Ring Road, with tropical and ornamental plants in large greenhouses and a series of themed outdoor gardens and plazas, some laid out in foreign styles such as a formal garden modelled on Versailles. The greenhouses host seasonal flower shows, such as a winter orchid show, and it makes an easy half-day for plant lovers inside the city.
description: 世界花卉大观园位于北京。游览特色包括植物园、花卉观赏、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the South 4th Ring Road in Fengtai District, about 9 km south-west of Tiananmen.

name: 仙居谷
summaryEn: A wooded valley by the Andamu River in Taishitun town, entered past a small mountain lake, with streams, pools and waterfalls along two trails: a gentler one past three linked falls and a steeper, rougher route to caves, a rock gate and a cherry-blossom valley. Wild cherry, peach and azalea flower on the slopes in spring, and a small Taoist temple, the Sanqing Gong, stands among old cypresses.
description: 仙居谷位于北京。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Taishitun town, Miyun District, about 115 km north-east of central Beijing by road. Scenic areas across Miyun were closed during the floods of late July 2025, and the municipal register of A-level scenic areas still listed this one as closed in October 2026, so check that it has reopened before planning.

name: 小汤山现代农业科技示范园
summaryEn: A large modern-agriculture demonstration park in the Xiaotangshan area of Changping, showing greenhouse growing, seedling breeding and flower and fruit production, and run partly as a family day out. Visitors walk through glasshouses of flowers, orchids and fruit trees and pick strawberries, vegetables and fruit in season.
description: 小汤山现代农业科技示范园位于北京。游览特色包括田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xiaotangshan town, Changping District, about 27 km north of central Beijing, around 45 minutes by road.

name: 长芦海盐文化旅游区
summaryEn: A tourism area on the Hangu saltworks in the north of Binhai New Area, a working saltworks whose history is traced to the year 925. Visitors can walk on the heaps of harvested salt beside the salt pans, and children can try traditional salt-making. It was rated a national 4A scenic area in 2024.
description: 景区位于滨海新区汉沽盐场，游览围绕当地延续千年的制盐历史和仍在生产的盐田展开。
accessEn: At the Hangu saltworks off Hannan Road in the Hangu area of Binhai New Area, about 27 km north-north-east of the Binhai New Area government in Tanggu.

name: 光合谷
summaryEn: Guanghegu, 'Photosynthesis Valley', is a resort and agri-tourism park of about 4,500 mu (300 hectares) on the east side of Tuanbo new town, planned in four zones: youth culture, hot-spring hotels, a wetland park and facility agriculture. It has a reed-filled artificial wetland park, a children's zoo with some 30 kinds of animals such as alpacas and kangaroos, and about twenty greenhouses where visitors pick vegetables and fruit, so it suits families.
description: 光合谷位于天津。游览特色包括湿地、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tuanbo town, Jinghai District, about 18 km east-south-east of the Jinghai district government and about 2 km south-east of the Renai Tuanbo Lake park.

name: 观湖城堡温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in the Dongli Lake holiday area, across the street from Happy Valley, with indoor and outdoor hot-spring pools, spa treatments, dining and leisure facilities. It suits a restful stay or a visit combined with the theme park.
description: 观湖城堡温泉位于天津。游览特色包括温泉、湖泊、主题游乐。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Dongli Lake resort area, Dongli District, about 18 km north-east of the Dongli District government, close to Happy Valley.

name: 郭家沟
summaryEn: Guojiagou is a small hill village of about 50 households beside a reservoir in northern Jizhou, rebuilt from 2012 as a tourist village of blue-brick courtyards and farmstay guesthouses, and in 2022 became Tianjin's first village-type 4A scenic area. Besides the guesthouses it has added flower fields, a petting zoo, a forest light-and-shadow park and a dinosaur-themed valley, so it suits families wanting a short country break.
description: 郭家沟位于天津。游览特色包括水库、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills of Xiaying town, Jizhou District, about 17 km north-north-east of the Jizhou district government and about 7 km south-south-east of Huangyaguan Great Wall.

name: 精武门·中华武林园
summaryEn: A memorial park for the martial artist Huo Yuanjia, built on the site of his former home and grave in Jingwu town, where he was born; he was one of the founders of the Jingwu sports association in Shanghai. The east side has his mausoleum with a memorial hall, a martial-arts spirit way and his tomb, and the west side a square with his statue and a memorial hall showing his life, relics and films. The grounds are large and open.
description: 精武门·中华武林园位于天津。游览特色包括纪念展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jingwu town, Xiqing District, beside Tuanbo Avenue, about 16 km south-east of the Xiqing District government in Yangliuqing.

name: 蓟州溶洞
summaryEn: Jizhou Karst Cave is a cave about 1,500 metres long in the Yanshan hills of northern Jizhou, in ancient dolomite rock, and is billed as the only cave attraction in Tianjin. It formed along large tectonic cracks rather than by dissolving water, which left a forest of tall stone columns. A farmer found it in 1998 while chasing a badger and it opened to visitors in 2006; the grounds around it now also have a hotel and outdoor rides.
description: 蓟州溶洞位于中华人民共和国天津市蓟州区罗庄子镇洪水庄村北灵气山，属燕山山脉，中上元古界地层。洞内全长1500米，是天津市唯一的洞穴景观。
accessEn: In Luozhuangzi town, Jizhou District, just north of Hongshuizhuang village and about 9 km north-north-west of the Jizhou district government.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 梨木台
summaryEn: Limutai is a forest and gorge area in the northernmost hills of Tianjin, covering more than 1,000 hectares of quartzite crags, pools, streams and waterfalls. It is part of a national geopark and a national forest park, and lies in the same hills as the Huangyaguan section of the Great Wall. A pear-blossom festival is held there each spring, with peach, apricot and azalea flowering after it.
description: 梨木台位于天津。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、长城。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xiaying town, Jizhou District, about 17.5 km north-east of the Jizhou district government and about 11 km south-east of Huangyaguan Great Wall.

name: 米立方水上乐园
summaryEn: An indoor water park in Xiaozhan town built around a building shaped like a grain of Xiaozhan rice, with a wave pool, a drifting river that runs through a cave and past a waterfall, a slide complex, a children's area and a hot-spring spa, all kept warm throughout the year. It suits families and groups looking for water play in any season.
description: 米立方水上乐园位于天津。游览特色包括瀑布、水上游乐、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xiaozhan town, Jinnan District, about 6.2 km east-south-east of the Jinnan district government.

name: 南湖绿博园
summaryEn: A lakeside park in Wuqing with a lake about 5.2 kilometres round and 136 hectares of water, and a northern garden-exhibition area of 862 mu (about 57 hectares) in which provinces and other bodies built 48 gardens under six themes, from Jiangnan-style gardens to folk-custom and landscape designs. Other zones around the lake include a water-street shopping area, a family sports and recreation area and a wetland area.
description: 南湖绿博园位于天津。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Wuqing District on the ring road around Nanhu lake, about 8.5 km south-east of the Wuqing district government.

name: 仁爱团泊湖国际休闲博览园
summaryEn: Renai Tuanbo Lake Leisure Expo Park is a leisure and resort district on the eastern shore of Tuanbo Lake, in the lakeside new town of Tuanbo, planned from 2009 to combine eco-leisure, conference and exhibition space, hot-spring resorts and housing. Tuanbo Lake has about 50 square kilometres of open water, and its wetland is on China's list of wetland nature reserves and is a Tianjin bird reserve; hot-spring hotels line the shore.
description: 仁爱团泊湖国际休闲博览园位于天津。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊、自然保护区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tuanbo town, Jinghai District, about 16 km east-south-east of the Jinghai district government and about 2 km north-west of Guanghegu.

name: 水高庄园
summaryEn: An agricultural leisure park of about 1,500 mu (roughly 100 hectares) in Xinkou town, in the Dongdian modern-agriculture zone south-west of Yangliuqing. It has five zones, covering farming scenery, a Ziya River theme, fruit picking, a greenhouse display and a rural hot-spring area, with fishing, dining and accommodation. It suits families looking for a rural day out.
description: 水高庄园位于天津。游览特色包括农业体验、庄园、公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xinkou town, Xiqing District, about 9 km south-west of the Xiqing District government in Yangliuqing.

name: 天士力大健康城
summaryEn: The campus of the pharmaceutical group Tasly in Beichen District, open to visitors as an industrial-tourism site on about 53 hectares. Visitors can see a production workshop and exhibitions on traditional Chinese medicine culture, and the site also runs study programmes for young people.
description: 天津北辰的制药企业园区对游客开放，参观主题集中在医药生产与工业展示。
accessEn: On Puji River East Road in Beichen District, about 7 km east of the Beichen District government.

name: 天津方特欢乐世界
summaryEn: A theme park in the Sino-Singapore Tianjin Eco-city run by the Chinese chain Fantawild, opened in July 2014. Its attractions combine science-fiction and animation themes with 3D and 4D screen technology, and include areas based on the Boonie Bears cartoon. The park stages seasonal events such as a summer water-splash festival and fireworks, and it suits families with children.
description: 天津方特欢乐世界位于天津。游览特色包括主题游乐、节庆文化。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the Sino-Singapore Tianjin Eco-city, Binhai New Area, about 16 km north-north-east of the Binhai New Area government in Tanggu.

name: 天津欢乐谷
summaryEn: A theme park by Dongli Lake run by the tourism group OCT, with indoor and outdoor rides and daily parades and shows. It is laid out in themed zones that include Viking Harbour, Christmas Village and Flying Caribbean, and it holds seasonal events and opens in the evening at busy times.
description: 天津欢乐谷位于天津。游览特色包括湖泊、主题游乐。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: On the shore of Dongli Lake in Dongli District, about 18 km north-east of the Dongli District government.

name: 天津津翔野生动物园
summaryEn: A wildlife park in the Sino-Singapore Tianjin Eco-city, reopened in 2024 on the site of the former Yili Fairy-tale Park. A walking zone has twelve themed areas with more than a hundred species, among them giant pandas, giraffes and zebras. A separate drive-through zone is toured by sightseeing train or a safari-style vehicle along a 2.1 km route past lions, wolves and antelope.
description: 天津津翔野生动物园位于天津。游览特色包括动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Sino-Singapore Tianjin Eco-city, Binhai New Area, near the junction of Zhongsheng Avenue and Jinghu West Road, about 15 km north-north-east of the Binhai New Area government in Tanggu.

name: 天津港文化旅游区
summaryEn: A port-themed tourism zone of about 23 square kilometres in the Dongjiang area, linking Dongjiang Bay beach, the Tianjin International Cruise Home Port, a warehouse-style wine showroom and several container terminals. It was accepted as a national 4A scenic area in October 2023, when it introduced a sea route of about 40 minutes past the terminals, from which the port can be seen at work. Dongjiang Bay is a large man-made beach on the Bohai coast.
description: 天津港文化旅游区位于天津。游览特色包括海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Centred on Dongjiang Bay beach in the Dongjiang area of Binhai New Area, about 11 km east of the Binhai New Area government in Tanggu; check that the boat route is running before going.

name: 杨柳青庄园
summaryEn: A leisure and holiday park of about 800 mu (roughly 53 hectares) in the north of Yangliuqing town, with wooded grounds and lakes, a hotel and conference facilities, fishing and fruit picking. It was upgraded in April 2024 with a series of rides branded Jack Park, and it suits families and groups on a day out from the city.
description: 杨柳青庄园位于天津。游览特色包括林地风光、休闲度假、庄园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Jintong Road in Yangliuqing town, Xiqing District, about 3.4 km west-north-west of the Xiqing District government, which is also in Yangliuqing.

name: 保定宴饮食博物馆
summaryEn: A large food-hall and restaurant complex in Baoding's high-tech zone, opened in September 2023 and registered as a museum of Zhili (Qing-era provincial) cuisine, with a small collection of historic cookery books and tableware. The ground floor is a street of snack stalls selling local favourites such as donkey-meat sandwiches, and the upper floors have banquet halls modelled on the old provincial guild halls of Baoding, plus a dinner-theatre show. It suits visitors who want to try Baoding food in one place rather than see a historic site.
description: 保定宴饮食博物馆位于河北保定。游览特色包括博物馆、戏剧演艺。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Chaoyang North Street in Baoding's north-western high-tech zone, about 7 km north-north-west of the old city centre, or about 9 km by road.

name: 古镇大激店
summaryEn: An old village on the western side of Baoding that has been restored as a cultural-tourism area. It keeps an opera tower protected as a municipal heritage site since 1993, nine restored stone tablets and a stream crossed by six bridges. State-media reports of 2021 and 2022 describe it as re-themed as a music and culture town, with an artists' creative park, craft, food and creative-goods outlets, performances, a water-and-light show on the river and an annual music festival.
description: 古镇大激店位于河北保定。游览特色包括古镇、楼阁建筑、传统村落。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Dajidian town on the western side of Baoding, about 11 km west of the old city centre, reached by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 绿建科技工业旅游景区
summaryEn: An industrial-tourism area in Gaobeidian's economic zone, run by Aorun Shunda, a maker of energy-saving windows and green-building systems, and earlier listed as its doors-and-windows industrial-tourism area. The city tourism bureau describes a visiting route through a green-building technology innovation centre, a history hall, the China Door and Window Museum, an ultra-low-energy building test centre and the production base; the museum's halls were described in 2017 as covering carved stone windows, timber doors and windows, and modern types. State media also describe automated production lines and a climate-simulation test chamber on the company campus, so it suits visitors interested in building technology or industry.
description: 绿建科技工业旅游景区位于河北保定。游览特色包括博物馆、工业参观。图集建议预留约3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Gaobeidian's economic development zone, about 5 km east-south-east of the city centre and about 78 km south-south-west of central Beijing.

name: 七山滑雪场
summaryEn: A ski resort on the hillside south of Laiyuan town, with ski runs and lifts. The same site holds China's national ski-jumping training and research base, which was built for the national ski-jumping and Nordic combined teams. Skiing runs through the winter, and the county also presents the resort as a summer retreat.
description: 七山滑雪场位于河北保定。游览特色包括滑雪。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xilonghu village, Baishishan town, about 4 km south of Laiyuan town centre; a taxi from the town is the practical way.

name: 恋乡·太行水镇
summaryEn: A purpose-built tourist town in Angezhuang township, Yi County, laid out in Ming-and-Qing style with stone-paved lanes and grey-roofed, white-walled buildings beside a lake on the Yishui River. It has shops, snack stalls and guesthouses, a campsite and seasonal festivals, and it has operated since about 2017, so it is a modern development rather than a historic village. It suits families and short breaks from Beijing, Baoding or Xiong'an, and is easy to combine with nearby Yishui Lake.
description: 恋乡·太行水镇位于河北保定。游览特色包括湖泊、节庆文化、村落风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Angezhuang township, about 22 km west-south-west of Yi County town and a few kilometres from Yishui Lake; a taxi or private car is the practical way.

name: 潭瀑峡
summaryEn: Tanpu Gorge is a scenic area in the Taihang mountains of western Tang County, formerly known as Dashiyu, built around rocky valleys with a series of pools and waterfalls. The pools and falls are the main sights, so it suits a half-day outing for those who like walking among rock and water.
description: 潭瀑峡位于河北保定。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Daomaguan township in the mountains, about 51 km north-west of Tang County town and reached by road from Tang County or Baoding.

name: 阜平天生桥
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in western Fuping County, known for a single gully of nine waterfalls stepping down the valley, the highest of which, on Yaotai mountain, drops 112.5 metres. The area is also a national geopark, and its name means 'natural bridge'.
description: 阜平天生桥位于河北保定。游览特色包括瀑布、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tianshengqiao town in the Taihang mountains, about 28 km west of Fuping county town; reached by road from Fuping.

name: 虎山风景区
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area of more than 20 square kilometres in the Taihang foothills at Quyang's northern edge, named after a tiger-shaped rock near the summit. A stream valley with springs and waterfalls runs through it, and an old gold mine with its tunnel and miners' quarters is open as a sight. The main peak, Sanjianliang, rises to a little over 1,100 metres.
description: 虎山风景区位于河北保定。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、山地游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the far north of Quyang County, about 38 km north-north-west of Quyang town; a private car or taxi is the practical way. Check that it is open before going.

name: 雄安郊野公园
summaryEn: Xiong'an Suburban Park is a large planted-woodland park on the northern edge of the Xiong'an New Area, opened in 2021 and covering about 26,000 mu (roughly 17 square kilometres). It has fourteen themed gardens, one for each of Hebei's eleven prefecture-level cities plus Xiong'an, Dingzhou and Xinji, along with a forest animal park and family areas, and suits a relaxed day outdoors.
description: 雄安郊野公园位于河北保定。游览特色包括园林景观、林地风光、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 7 km north-east of Rongcheng county town and about 21 km west of Xiong'an railway station, reached by road.

name: 易水湖
summaryEn: A mountain reservoir south-west of Yi County, ringed by steep hills and usually seen from the water, with a waterside plank walkway along the cliffs of Laozi Peak. The lake takes its name from the Yi River, which features in the story of the assassin Jing Ke setting out for the state of Qin, and it pairs easily with nearby Taihang Water Town.
description: 易水湖位于河北保定。游览特色包括湖泊、水乡、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 25 km west-south-west of Yi County town; a taxi or private car is the practical way. Check that it is open before going.

name: 鱼谷洞
summaryEn: A karst cave and spring in the Yesanpo area of Laishui County, which the Baoding government describes as a geological attraction and summer retreat. A spring, the Yugu Spring, lies beside the cave. It is one of the visitor districts of Yesanpo, alongside Baili Gorge, Longmen Tianguan and Baicaopan.
description: 鱼谷洞位于河北保定。游览特色包括峡谷、洞穴。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Yesanpo area, about 11 km north-north-west of Yesanpo railway station; a taxi from the station is the practical way.

name: 云花溪谷
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in the Taihang range in Fuping County, built around a forested valley with streams and rock formations. It is one of several scenic areas in Fuping, alongside Tianshengqiao Waterfalls and the Jin-Cha-Ji memorial. It suits a nature-focused day out for visitors already in the Fuping area.
description: 云花溪谷位于河北保定。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、山地游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xiazhuang township in the Taihang mountains, about 18 km west-south-west of Fuping county town; a car or taxi is needed.

name: 河间府署
summaryEn: The seat of Hejian prefecture, first set up in 1108 under the Northern Song and rebuilt on its original site in 2010–13 after standing in ruins for decades. The compound has more than 60 buildings and about 300 rooms in three rows along an axis, with the main hall, offices, residence, prison office and temples, and seven exhibition sections covering local history, official culture, intangible heritage and clean-governance culture. It suits a short visit together with the nearby Guangming Theatre.
description: 河间府署位于河北沧州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、非遗文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Hejian city, about 67 km west-north-west of Cangzhou.

name: 东光铁佛寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple in a park on the southern edge of Dongguang town, built around a seated cast-iron Shakyamuni in the main hall that the county gives as over 8 m high and 48 tonnes, and that the city government describes as the largest seated iron Buddha in China. The temple began as Puzhao Temple in the early Northern Song and holds 33 Buddha images in all; its gate plaque was written by the calligrapher and Buddhist leader Zhao Puchu. The park also has a lake, a Taoist temple on a mound called Erlanggang, a Mount Tai shrine and memorial halls to the Yuan dramatist Ma Zhiyuan and the Peking-opera performer Xun Huisheng, both linked to Dongguang.
description: 东光铁佛寺位于河北沧州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、佛教文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the south-western side of Dongguang town, about 1.5 km from the town centre; Dongguang has a station on the Beijing–Shanghai railway.

name: 板城酒博园
summaryEn: A distillery-based tourist park run by the Bancheng liquor company in Xiabancheng, the seat of Chengde County. It combines liquor-culture displays, viewing of the brewing process and hands-on experiences, and its museum holds more than 2,000 exhibits, including a 1:4 enlarged replica of a Jin-dynasty still excavated in 1975. It has also been named a national study-tour base and is used for school groups.
description: 板城酒博园位于河北承德。游览特色包括博物馆、酿造文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xiabancheng town, the seat of Chengde County, about 31 km south-east of the Mountain Resort in Chengde, reached by road. Its liquor museum closes in winter and on public holidays.

name: 中国马镇
summaryEn: A modern resort town on the Bashang plateau in northern Fengning, themed on horse culture and built around staged performances. By day it stages a dancing-horse show and a live drama, 'Zhao Zilong, God of War', in a Shangdu-themed set that visitors can walk through, and evenings bring bonfire gatherings and fire shows. It suits families and groups on a grassland trip who want shows and activities rather than open landscape.
description: 中国马镇位于河北承德。游览特色包括草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Datan town on the Bashang plateau of northern Fengning County, about 1.6 km north of the town centre; Chengde's tourism bureau puts it about 180 km north of Beijing.

name: 鼎盛文化产业园
summaryEn: A modern cultural-tourism complex at the foot of Yuanbao Hill in Shuangluan District, built around an evening outdoor drama and an old-style shopping street. The show, 'Dingsheng Dynasty: the Kangxi Ceremony', uses the hillside as its backdrop, with hundreds of performers and several horses staging scenes of the Mulan hunt, court ritual and southern China, and local media report more than 2,700 performances and over 4.3 million visitors. Yuanbao Street below has craft stalls, snacks and costumed street performances, and the park suits families and groups who want an evening show.
description: 鼎盛文化产业园位于河北承德。游览特色包括特色街区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the western side of Chengde, in Shuangluan District, about 9 km west of the Mountain Resort; reached by road from central Chengde, with the show held in the evening.

name: 董存瑞烈士陵园
summaryEn: A memorial park in the town of Longhua for Dong Cunrui, a People's Liberation Army soldier who died in May 1948 detonating an explosive charge at a Nationalist bunker during the fighting at Longhua, and who was later widely publicised as a model soldier. Laid out from 1954 on about 9 ha, it has a memorial arch, a granite monument, a statue of Dong, his tomb, inscription corridors and a memorial hall rebuilt in 2008, with the site of his death about 200 m outside the park. It is a national patriotic education base and was listed among China's classic red-tourism scenic areas in 2004.
description: 董存瑞烈士陵园位于河北承德。游览特色包括纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the town of Longhua, about 1.3 km north-west of the county's centre point and about 46 km north-north-west of central Chengde, and reached by road from Chengde.

name: 大汗行宫
summaryEn: A modern themed complex on the Bashang grassland in northern Fengning that sets out to recreate a Mongol-Yuan court, with palace-style halls and yurt-style buildings laid out across the plain. Chengde officials describe it as an immersive recreation of Mongol-Yuan history, and visitors can ride horses and try traditional archery. It is a new-built attraction rather than a historic palace, and suits families and groups touring the grassland.
description: 大汗行宫位于河北承德。游览特色包括草原、马术活动。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 8 km north-west of Datan, the nearest town, on the Bashang plateau in northern Fengning County, reached by car and usually combined with China Horse Town; a 2023 notice listed it among Chengde sights closed for the cold season, so check dates before going.

name: 七彩森林
summaryEn: A forest holiday park on the Bashang plateau in northern Fengning, built on state forest-farm land around a lake, white-birch woods and wooden boardwalks. Visitors ride a sightseeing miniature train through the trees, walk boardwalks over wetland and visit an animal farm and pet park. County and city officials present it as a summer outing for families, and it is usually combined with nearby China Horse Town.
description: 七彩森林位于河北承德。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 10 km east-north-east of Datan, the nearest town, on the Bashang plateau in northern Fengning County, reached by car along the grassland's 'Number One Scenic Highway' route.

name: 磬锤峰国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park on the hills east of Chengde's centre, named for Qingchui Peak, a tall hammer-shaped rock pillar (also called Bangchui Mountain, 'club mountain') above the Wulie River. A cable car and footpaths climb the slope to viewing platforms over the city and the river, and local media describe the red rock walls as Danxia-type and a favourite for autumn colour. The peak is mentioned in the Shuijing zhu, a 6th-century geography, and the Mountain Resort's garden is described as borrowing it as a distant view.
description: 磬锤峰国家森林公园位于河北承德。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光、观景台。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 3 km east-north-east of the Mountain Resort in Chengde, on the east side of the Wulie River near Anyuan Temple; reached by road from the city centre, with a cable car and separate north and south gates.

name: 热河中药花海小镇
summaryEn: A herb-growing farm and ecological study park on terraced hillsides in Xiayingzi village, Jingoutun town, in the Yan Mountains of Luanping County. It grows over 120 kinds of medicinal plants, with skullcap on about 100 hectares, and has walking trails, a medicinal-plant exhibition hall, a study classroom and a hands-on herb centre; the herbs flower from early summer. Hebei named it a provincial biodiversity experience site in 2026, and it receives school study groups as well as day-trippers.
description: 热河中药花海小镇位于河北承德。游览特色包括花卉观赏、主题展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 18 km north-east of Luanping town and about 40 km west of Chengde's Mountain Resort, reached by road.

name: 山庄老酒文化产业园
summaryEn: A working distillery estate on the edge of Pingquan city that is open as a tourist site, centred on the China Royal Liquor Culture Plaza. Its buildings are modelled on ancient wine vessels (the office block on a four-ram bronze zun, the museum on a winged cup), and it has a liquor museum with more than 500 wine vessels, a technology museum, cellars over 300 years old and a production viewing area. The museum says the Kangxi Emperor gave the 'Shanzhuang Laojiu' name after a banquet at the Mountain Resort in 1703, and the park suits visitors curious about baijiu, the Chinese grain spirit.
description: 山庄老酒文化产业园位于河北承德。游览特色包括博物馆、酿造文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the south-east side of Pingquan city, about 64 km east of the Mountain Resort in Chengde, reached by road.

name: 双塔山
summaryEn: Two tall rock pillars rise side by side beside the Luan River on the western edge of Chengde city, in Shuangluan District. Local media describe a Danxia-type landscape of rock peaks and woods, with a cable car between the peaks, stone steps and footpaths, and a feeding platform for a troop of monkeys. It suits a short climb or ropeway outing from the city.
description: 双塔山位于河北承德。游览特色包括缆车观景。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shuangta Mountain town, Shuangluan District, about 12 km west-south-west of the Mountain Resort; the entrance is on Binhe Street and the site is reached by road from central Chengde.

name: 唐家湾
summaryEn: A resort area in Cangzi township, Chengde County, built around red Danxia sandstone peaks, Tianmen Lake and a hot spring. Local media count more than 20 Danxia peaks and ridges, with hiking routes through Qingliang Valley and Tianmen Mountain, a children's play area, a lodge and a fluoride spring, and the area was upgraded in 2026 with new lawns, photo spots and costumed actors. It suits families and short stays from Chengde and nearby cities.
description: 唐家湾位于河北承德。游览特色包括温泉、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Cangzi township, about 17 km east of the Mountain Resort in Chengde and about 24 km north of Chengde County seat, reached by road.

name: 兴隆溶洞
summaryEn: A show cave in the Yan Mountains of Xinglong County, in Taojiatai village in the foothills south of Wuling Mountain. Local state media report three chambers covering more than 4,000 square metres with eight side passages and some 59 kinds of formation, including stalactites, stalagmites, columns and a soda straw about 4.35 m long, and a summer temperature of around 10 degrees Celsius. It suits a cool short stop on a Xinglong County trip, alongside Wuling Mountain Nature Reserve further north.
description: 兴隆溶洞位于河北承德。游览特色包括洞穴、钟乳石。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Taojiatai village, Wulingshan town, about 3.4 km north-north-west of Wulingshan town and about 8 km north of Xinglong county town, reached by road.

name: 兴隆山
summaryEn: A hill-country scenic area in the Yan Mountains of Xinglong County, with steep rock peaks, dense forest, streams and cliff-side plank walkways, plus a vertical lift up one cliff face. Local media describe a gently graded path network that older visitors and children can manage, named rock features such as Wanfo Cliff, and sea-of-cloud views. It sits beside Shishangzhuang, a village known for its poets, and local media say its forest was protected from felling for about 250 years under a feng shui ban.
description: 兴隆山位于河北承德。游览特色包括林地风光、栈道。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dashuiquan town, about 31 km east-north-east of Xinglong county town, in the hills of eastern Xinglong County; reached by road, with the poetry village of Shishangzhuang next to it.

name: 御道口草原森林风景区
summaryEn: A large state-farm landscape on the Bashang plateau in northern Weichang County, once part of the Qing imperial Mulan hunting ground, where the Kangxi Emperor drilled troops at the mouth of the Ruyi River. It lies at roughly 1,230–1,820 m and combines open grassland, birch and planted forest and many lakes, among them Moon Lake, Sun Lake and Taoshan Lake, and it borders the Saihanba forest area. It suits a summer day of driving and walking through open country rather than a visit to a single sight.
description: 御道口草原森林风景区位于河北承德。游览特色包括草原、湖泊。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the far north-west of Weichang County, about 67 km north-west of Weichang town and about 164 km north-north-west of central Chengde, and about 20 km south-west of the Saihanba forest farm; it is reached by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 诗经文化园
summaryEn: A landscaped culture park in Jize county town named for the Book of Songs, the ancient poetry anthology whose surviving text is the version annotated by Mao Heng and Mao Chang, scholars that the Jize gazetteer counts as locals. The county government promotes it as a local leisure spot, and its media reported costume-style 'national style' shows and an intangible-heritage acrobatics programme there over the October 2026 holiday. It suits a short stop in Jize rather than a trip of its own.
description: 鸡泽县以《诗经》为主题建园，本地文化与毛亨、毛苌所传的《毛诗》相联系。
accessEn: On Maosui North Street in Jize county town, about 48 km north-east of central Handan.

name: 长寿村
summaryEn: A mountain village in Huoshui township, in the Taihang Mountains of western Wu'an, run as a scenic area for rest and health holidays, with guesthouses in converted village houses. It suits a quiet countryside weekend rather than a sightseeing checklist.
description: 武安西部太行山区的村落发展起休闲旅游，一些原有村屋改作山间民宿。
accessEn: In the mountains of Huoshui township, about 46 km north-west of Wu'an town and about 71 km north-west of central Handan, reached by mountain roads. Check that it is open before going.

name: 丛台酒苑
summaryEn: A visitor park at the Congtai liquor distillery in Feixiang's economic development zone, built around a museum in Warring States and Han style with some 13,800 m² of floor space. The museum was set up in 2015 and has six sections on the origins of Chinese baijiu, the long history of brewing around Handan and the growth of the Zhenyuanzeng distillery, the present company's predecessor. It is a corporate attraction that mainly suits visitors curious about baijiu.
description: 丛台酒苑位于河北邯郸。游览特色包括博物馆、酿造文化、休闲公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Feixiang economic development zone, about 7 km west-north-west of Feixiang district town and about 22 km east-south-east of central Handan; the museum is closed on Mondays.

name: 大名古城
summaryEn: The walled county town of Daming, rebuilt in 1401 on the north bank of the Wei River after floods destroyed the Song-era city to the north-east, with walls about 4.5 km round and four gates. The north gate has a tower, and inside the walls are four main streets, eight lesser streets and some seventy lanes, which the county has been developing for tourism. Daming is best known to Chinese readers from the novel Water Margin, where it features in nineteen chapters, and is also known for its straw weaving and traditional snacks.
description: 大名古城位于河北邯郸。游览特色包括古城、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Daming county town in the far south-east of Hebei, near the Shandong and Henan borders and about 69 km east-south-east of central Handan; the pin is at the north gate.

name: 东山文化博艺园
summaryEn: A landscaped park on the east side of Wu'an, laid out in 2003 on about 500 mu (roughly 33 ha) with pavilions, bridges and ponds, and divided into seven zones that include geology, plants and folk-culture areas. Its main draw is the Wu'an Museum, opened in 2019 inside converted park buildings, whose seven halls include ancient history, the local ironmaking industry, intangible heritage and the revolutionary period. It suits a relaxed half-day out that mixes a municipal museum with general park leisure.
description: 东山文化博艺园位于河北邯郸。游览特色包括博物馆、楼阁建筑、非遗文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 4 km east-north-east of the centre of Wu'an and about 24 km west-north-west of central Handan; the Wu'an Museum inside the park is closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 东太行
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area on the eastern side of the Taihang range in north-west Wu'an, with a planned area of about 26 square kilometres and a highest point of 1,428 m at North Peak. Its landscape of red cliffs and gorges is classed as Zhangshiyan landform, and the area has a via ferrata (cliff-climbing) route on the rock face. It suits a day out from Wu'an or Handan for views and walking.
description: 东太行位于河北邯郸。游览特色包括峡谷、山地游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the mountains of north-west Wu'an, about 38 km north-west of Wu'an town and about 64 km north-west of central Handan.

name: 粮画小镇
summaryEn: A rural tourist village on the west side of Guantao, developed since 2014 from a poor village into a showcase 'beautiful village' planned over 3.7 square kilometres and organised as four adjoining village communities. Its streets of grey-roofed, white-walled houses have cafés, grain-painting workshops, a small cinema and restaurants, and more than 20 hands-on craft workshops cover grain painting, gourds, black pottery and cloth painting. It also has over 20 themed guesthouses and a hot-spring bathing facility, and suits families and short rural breaks rather than history.
description: 粮画小镇位于河北邯郸。游览特色包括陶瓷工艺、手工艺。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shoushansi township, about 5 km west of Guantao county town and about 66 km east of central Handan.

name: 古武当山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in the Taihang range north-west of Wu'an, whose main summit, the Golden Peak, rises above 1,400 m. It has a cable car, plank walkways and a high footbridge, and since September 2023 it has also run night climbs to see the lit-up summit and the sunrise. A temple stele is said to record the mountain as Wudang Mountain from the Tang dynasty at the latest, which the scenic area cites to claim that its name is older than that of Hubei's better-known Wudang Mountain.
description: 古武当山位于太行山东麓河北邯郸武安市，是国家4A级旅游景区，主峰金顶海拔1437.7米。据庙里古碑记载，此山至少从唐朝开始就被称为“武当山”，早于湖北十堰的南武当和山西北武当山。2023年9月，景区开始推出夜爬。
accessEn: In the mountains north-west of Wu'an, about 36 km north-west of the centre of Wu'an and about 62 km north-west of central Handan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 邯郸园博园
