summaryEn: A large landscaped park on the western edge of Handan, laid out for the 2020 Hebei Garden Expo on land that had held foundries, steel-slag works and construction-waste dumps. It has gardens for 13 Hebei cities, lakes lit up in the evening, industrial tanks left by a stone-crushing plant converted into a climbing wall, a petting zoo with peacocks and alpacas, and a children's play area. It suits families and relaxed outings rather than historic sightseeing.
description: 邯郸园博园位于河北邯郸。游览特色包括动物观赏、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the western edge of Handan in Fuxing district, about 7 km west-north-west of the city centre.

name: 韩王九寨
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in the Taihang foothills south of She County town, in the Qingzhang River area, themed in part on the Han general Han Xin, with a 'Han King Valley', re-created 'Qin' and 'Han' stockade settings, hiking routes to summit viewpoints and mountain camping. In autumn colourful rice-paddy art is laid out across the valley below, and a new walking route to the summit, themed on Han Xin mustering troops, opened in spring 2026. It makes a half-day stop in a county that also has Nüwa Palace and the Eighth Route Army's 129th Division sites.
description: 韩王九寨位于河北邯郸。游览特色包括山谷、山地游览、登山观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 6 km south-south-east of She County town and about 72 km west of central Handan.

name: 七步沟
summaryEn: A mountain valley scenic area in the Taihang foothills of Huoshui township, north-west of Wu'an, near Qibugou village. Its attractions are scenic rather than historic: steep rock walls, a small mountain lake and waterfalls, and in spring 2026 state media reported a rose-planted section of the canyon with pools. It suits a half-day outing from Wu'an or Handan for walkers.
description: 七步沟位于河北邯郸。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the mountains of Huoshui township, about 40 km north-west of Wu'an town and about 65 km west-north-west of central Handan.

name: 天保寨
summaryEn: A hill-country scenic area around Huatuo village in Taoquan township, in the far west of Ci County, developed from 2017 by a county-owned coal company after its mine closed; villagers replanted the slopes with more than a million saplings. The county promotes it for autumn colour, and a 2022 provincial report listed seasonal projects there including a summer water-play area and a winter snow-and-ice carnival. Huatuo was the site of an Eighth Route Army arsenal in 1938–43 and has a museum on it.
description: 天保寨位于河北邯郸。游览特色包括村寨、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Taoquan township, about 38 km west of Ci County town and about 52 km west-south-west of central Handan.

name: 赵王印象城
summaryEn: A corporate culture-and-tourism park in Guangping, run by a food and liquor producer and themed on the Warring States state of Zhao. Its four zones include a culture hall whose main building is styled as the palace of King Wuling of Zhao, a working production area that visitors can view, and cultural activities on Zhao and liquor themes. State media reported horse-riding parades, a war-drum show and costumed role-play there during the 2026 Spring Festival and May Day holidays.
description: 赵王印象城位于河北邯郸。游览特色包括酿造文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Zhaowang Road at Houguzhai village, about 2 km north of Guangping county town and about 42 km east-south-east of Handan.

name: 董子学村
summaryEn: A cultural-tourism village at Dongxue village, Fangzhuang town, where local tradition says the Western Han Confucian scholar Dong Zhongshu taught behind a lowered curtain, giving the village its old name Xiawei. It was developed in recent years for study tours, with four themed parts: the Dongxue garden on Confucian learning, a ten-li 'long street' on local customs, farm fields for field-work lessons and the Siyuan River for nature study. It is a modern themed village built around that tradition rather than a historic site.
description: 董子学村位于河北衡水。游览特色包括园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Dongxue village, Fangzhuang town, about 14 km north-north-east of Gucheng county town and 39 km south-east of Hengshui.

name: 衡水老白干景区
summaryEn: A visitor area built around the working plant of Hengshui Laobaigan, a baijiu (Chinese grain spirit) maker whose traditional brewing method is a national intangible heritage item. The plant's earthen-jar fermentation workshop holds 47,666 jars under about 61,000 sq m of floor space and was certified by Guinness World Records in 2021 as the largest of its kind, and a museum in the complex explains jar fermentation and the history of liquor-making. It is a corporate attraction best suited to visitors interested in baijiu or industrial tourism.
description: 衡水老白干景区位于河北衡水。游览特色包括博物馆、非遗文化、酿造文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the northern edge of Hengshui, in the city's high-tech zone, about 10 km north-north-east of the city centre; the museum closes over the Spring Festival.

name: 台城红色旅游景区
summaryEn: A memorial museum in Taicheng village, Anping County, devoted to the Taicheng special branch of the Chinese Communist Party, which party history and state media present as the first rural branch, founded in August 1923 by Gong Zhongtao under Li Dazhao's guidance. Its displays also cover the first county party committee in Hebei, set up in Anping in August 1924, and Anping's wartime role as a command centre of the central Hebei base area. The exhibition was fully refreshed for the branch's centenary in 2023, and the site is used for school and party-study visits.
description: 台城红色旅游景区位于河北衡水。游览特色包括博物馆、红色文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Taicheng village, about 5 km south-west of Anping county town and 54 km north-north-west of Hengshui, beside the G338 national road.

name: 周窝音乐小镇
summaryEn: A village-based visitor area at Zhouwo in Wuqiang County, a place that began making Western wind and string instruments more than 30 years ago and has turned village homes into music-themed shops, workshops, cafés and guesthouses since 2012. There is a world musical-instruments museum with well over a thousand instruments, and villagers play saxophone and other instruments for visitors. It is a small, informal place that suits visitors interested in music or in how a Hebei village reinvented itself.
description: 周窝音乐小镇位于河北衡水。游览特色包括博物馆、音乐文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Zhouwo village, about 8 km south-west of Wuqiang county town and 35 km north-east of Hengshui.

name: 中信国安第一城
summaryEn: A large leisure complex developed by the CITIC Guoan group in Xianghe, built on the model of Ming and Qing Beijing with a walled-city layout and palace-and-garden-style buildings, covering about 3,320 mu (roughly 2.2 square kilometres). It has a lotus garden and an old temple, Da'an Temple, inside its grounds, hosts seasonal events such as a lotus festival and Spring Festival fairs, and since April 2025 has run an immersive Ming-themed park called Daming Fantasy with costumed performers around the site. It is a modern commercial development rather than historic buildings, and suits Beijing-area day-trippers.
description: 中信国安第一城位于河北廊坊。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、园林景观、莲花观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xianghe County, about 10 km west-south-west of Xianghe county town and 48 km east-south-east of central Beijing, reached by road from Beijing.

name: 中国红木城
summaryEn: A large market complex of traditional-style halls and courtyards in Dacheng County, which state media call north China's largest hub for making and trading redwood (hongmu, meaning rosewood and other hardwood) furniture. The county government gives its site as 730 mu (about 49 hectares) with more than a thousand traders selling classical-style furniture and carvings, and a large weekly redwood market is held there on Tuesdays. It grew out of the county's long-running redwood and antiques market, which moved to a new redwood-culture district in 2014, and is a shopping and trade venue rather than a historic site.
description: 大城县的红木家具市场由传统风格的展厅和院落组成，是当地硬木家具制作与交易的集中展示地。
accessEn: In the redwood-culture district about 4 km east of Dacheng county town, and about 137 km south of central Beijing; reached by road.

name: 香河金钥匙
summaryEn: A large furniture mall opened in 2003 in Xianghe's furniture-trading district, with about 180,000 square metres of floor space on four floors: general and brand-name furniture, European-style pieces and a redwood hall. State media list it among Xianghe's tourism brands and call Xianghe's furniture city north China's biggest furniture distribution hub, but it is a showroom complex rather than a sight in the usual sense. Visit only if you want to browse furniture.
description: 香河家具商贸区内的大型展馆，分层展示现代家具、欧式家具以及红木家具。
accessEn: About 2 km south-east of Xianghe county town and 56 km east-south-east of central Beijing, reached by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 燕南春酒文化博览园
summaryEn: A liquor-culture visitor park attached to the Yannanchun distillery in Yongqing's industrial area, built around a museum that traces Chinese liquor-making and local history under a Song–Liao theme, with several hundred objects. The grounds include a Song–Liao-style pedestrian street and a peony garden of nearly 10,000 plants that holds a festival each spring, and visitors can taste the distillery's baijiu (Chinese grain spirit). A corporate attraction suited to visitors with an interest in baijiu.
description: 燕南春酒文化博览园位于河北廊坊。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观、特色街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yongqing's industrial park, about 7 km north-east of Yongqing county town and 62 km south-south-east of central Beijing.

name: 碧螺塔海上酒吧公园
summaryEn: A seafront leisure park on the easternmost stretch of Beidaihe's beach, opened in 2013 and laid out like a small peninsula between Jinshanzui and Pigeon Nest Park. It is built around a conch-shaped tower and is aimed at evenings more than daytime sightseeing, with bars, a seaside stage and live shows, including electronic-music sets by resident DJs. It is a modern leisure development, not a historic site.
description: 碧螺塔海上酒吧公园位于河北秦皇岛。游览特色包括海滨、海岸风光、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Beidaihe's east beach, about 13 km south-west of Qinhuangdao station (about 17 km by road), a short way south-east of Pigeon Nest Park.

name: 冰塘峪长城风情大峡谷
summaryEn: A mountain canyon scenic area in the hills north-west of Qinhuangdao, named for the Great Wall remains on the ridges above the valley. It suits walkers and families on a day trip from the coast.
description: 冰塘峪长城风情大峡谷位于河北秦皇岛。游览特色包括峡谷、长城。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Liangjiawan village in Daxinzhai town, Funing District, about 28 km north-west of Qinhuangdao station, reached by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 昌黎县旅游滑沙活动中心
summaryEn: A sand-sliding centre on the Changli Golden Coast, where visitors slide down sand dunes close to the beach. It is a small leisure venue rather than a sightseeing stop, set on a coast known for its long beaches and dunes.
description: 昌黎县旅游滑沙活动中心位于河北秦皇岛。游览特色包括海滨。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the Golden Coast, about 14 km east-south-east of Changli town (about 19 km by road). Check that it is open before going.

name: 长寿山
summaryEn: A small rocky hill north of Shanhaiguan, laid out as a scenic area with footpaths up its slopes. It is mainly a local day-walk rather than a major sight.
description: 长寿山位于山海关以北，游人可以沿山坡步道登高，欣赏小山的岩石地貌。
accessEn: In the hills about 8 km north-north-west of Shanhaiguan station; the hill road is longer. Check that it is open before going.

name: 华夏庄园
summaryEn: A wine estate on the northern edge of Changli, one of China's wine-growing counties, with vineyards and a winery that visitors can see and where they can taste wine. It is a commercial tourist estate, so it suits a short stop rather than a full day.
description: 华夏庄园位于河北秦皇岛。游览特色包括葡萄酒文化、庄园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the northern edge of Changli town, about 4 km north-north-east of Changli railway station (about 5 km by road) and about 41 km west-south-west of Qinhuangdao station (about 46 km by road). Check that it is open before going.

name: 角山长城
summaryEn: A mountain section of the Ming Great Wall running up from Shanhaiguan to the flat summit of Jiaoshan, with the Hanmen Pass and Qixian Temple on the way. The lower wall was restored in the 1980s and part of it can be climbed for views of the town and the sea, while higher up it is left in its original, crumbling state. At the foot of the hill, the Shanhaiguan China Great Wall Museum holds more than 5,000 relics and has four permanent exhibition halls.
description: 角山长城位于河北秦皇岛。游览特色包括博物馆、长城、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 3.5 km north-west of Shanhai Pass (about 7 km by road from Shanhaiguan station). The Great Wall Museum at the foot of the hill is closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 集发农业梦想王国
summaryEn: A family-oriented farm and leisure park in Beidaihe that mixes agricultural exhibits with play areas. In summer it also stages evening light shows along the Dai River, including a lantern festival with lanterns made in Zigong and drone displays. It is a modern commercial attraction aimed at families with children.
description: 集发农业梦想王国位于河北秦皇岛。游览特色包括田园观光、节庆文化、公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Beidaihe District off Haibei Road, about 3 km south of Beidaihe railway station (about 5 km by road) and about 19 km south-west of Qinhuangdao station (about 21 km by road).

name: 乐岛海洋王国
summaryEn: An ocean-themed park on the coast south of Shanhaiguan, with staged shows by dolphins, sea lions and beluga whales, a large wave pool and water slides, and a beach for sand and water play. It is a day out for families rather than a historic stop.
description: 乐岛海洋王国位于河北秦皇岛。游览特色包括海滨。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: On the coast about 6 km south of Shanhai Pass, about 5 km south of Shanhaiguan station (about 9 km by road) and about 14 km east of Qinhuangdao station (about 16 km by road).

name: 联峰山公园
summaryEn: A wooded hill park behind the western end of Beidaihe's seafront, with two low peaks covered in pines and cypresses, rock formations, caves, pavilions and winding paths. Its temples include the Ming-dynasty Guanyin Temple, and a viewing pavilion near the summit looks over the resort and the sea. It makes a shaded walk of an hour or two away from the beach.
description: 联峰山公园位于河北秦皇岛。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、海滨。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the west of Beidaihe's seafront, about 16 km south-west of Qinhuangdao station (about 20 km by road); the park lies off Lianfeng Road.

name: 南戴河国际娱乐中心
summaryEn: A seaside leisure complex at Nandaihe, south-west of Beidaihe, with a funfair that includes a Ferris wheel and a dome-screen cinema. Its Chinese Lotus Garden, about 40 hectares with some 300 lotus varieties, holds a lotus festival in summer. It is a modern commercial attraction for families rather than a historic site.
description: 南戴河国际娱乐中心位于河北秦皇岛。游览特色包括海岸风光、园林景观、莲花观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the coast at Nandaihe, about 30 km south-west of Qinhuangdao station (about 33 km by road) and about 14 km south-west of Beidaihe railway station (about 17 km by road).

name: 秦皇求仙入海处
summaryEn: A 19-hectare park on the Bohai shore at Nanshan, opened in 2002, built in ancient style around a Ming stele of 1477 said to mark where the First Qin Emperor sent men to sea in search of the elixir of life. It combines a garden on the quest theme with a Warring States garden, both laid out with ancient-style buildings and sculptures.
description: 秦皇求仙入海处位于河北秦皇岛。游览特色包括园林景观、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the shore at Nanshan in Haigang District, about 3 km south-east of Qinhuangdao station (about 4 km by road), next to the old West Port. Check that it is open before going.

name: 新澳海底世界
summaryEn: An aquarium on Qinhuangdao's seafront, with marine animals to view and staged shows by dolphins and sea lions. It is a commercial attraction aimed at families.
description: 新澳海底世界位于河北秦皇岛。游览特色包括水族展览、海岸风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the seafront in Haigang District, about 4 km south-west of Qinhuangdao station (about 5 km by road).

name: 渔岛海洋度假区
summaryEn: A large commercial seaside resort on the Golden Coast in the Beidaihe New Area, centred on a water park, a Ferris wheel and a myth-themed show quarter with mechanical-beast attractions. Performances run through the day and into the night, and the resort also has hot-spring pools. It is a modern family resort rather than a historic site.
description: 渔岛海洋度假区位于河北秦皇岛。游览特色包括水上游乐、海岸风光、天然泉水。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: On the Golden Coast in Changli County, about 16 km south-east of Changli town (about 23 km by road) and about 45 km south-west of Qinhuangdao station (about 55 km by road).

name: 渔田七里海
summaryEn: A family holiday resort beside the Qilihai lagoon on the Golden Coast, built around a themed resort town. It offers family attractions by day and stages shows and drone displays in the evenings. It is a modern commercial resort aimed mainly at families.
description: 主题度假小镇邻近黄金海岸的七里海潟湖，适合家庭在海岸与小镇之间安排休闲行程。
accessEn: Beside the Qilihai lagoon in Changli County, about 15 km south of Changli town (about 21 km by road) and about 51 km south-west of Qinhuangdao station (about 57 km by road).

name: 左右山谷
summaryEn: A rural leisure and holiday park in the Yanshan foothills of Lulong County, laid out with orchards and farmland for countryside sightseeing and family holidays. It is one of the scenic areas Qinhuangdao has added in recent years, so it suits a relaxed half-day rather than a sightseeing stop.
description: 左右山谷位于河北秦皇岛。游览特色包括果园、山谷、休闲度假。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 19 km east of Lulong county town (about 25 km by road), near Liutianzhuang town, and roughly 46 km west of Qinhuangdao station.

name: 抱犊寨
summaryEn: A steep-sided mountain on the western edge of Luquan whose cliff-ringed summit, 580 m above sea level, holds about 660 mu (44 hectares) of level ground. The main sights are on the summit plateau, among them the South Heaven Gate, a Five Hundred Arhats hall, the Jinque Palace, caves and a ring wall known locally as the Great Wall, and local tradition ties the mountain to the Han general Han Xin. Visitors can climb a stepped path of about 3 km with roughly 3,000 steps, or take the cable car.
description: 抱犊寨位于河北石家庄。游览特色包括长城、洞穴、登山观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the western edge of Luquan District, about 22 km west-north-west of central Shijiazhuang, and reached by road.

name: 国御温泉度假小镇
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort hotel and leisure complex in Gaocheng District, fed by a spring that the district government says is drawn from a depth of 3,254 m. The district government described three hot-spring gardens with more than fifty pools, a children's water area, steam rooms, a traditional-medicine hall and a small street of shops and restaurants. It is a modern commercial resort rather than a heritage site, aimed at hot-spring stays.
description: 国御温泉度假小镇位于河北石家庄。游览特色包括温泉、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside National Road 307 in Gaocheng District, about 21 km east of central Shijiazhuang; the city's list of A-level scenic areas (updated January 2026) marks the resort as business suspended. Check that it is open before going.

name: 黑山大峡谷
summaryEn: A forested gorge scenic area of about 17 km² in the north-west of the Taihang range, close to the Shanxi border, with a main summit of 1,910 m and an average altitude of about 1,300 m. Its sixty or so listed sights include a waterfall zone, Fusheng Temple and old woodland with wild kiwi trees more than a century old. It is a cool place to walk in summer.
description: 黑山大峡谷位于河北石家庄。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Yingli township, Pingshan County, about 120 km and a 2.5-hour drive from Shijiazhuang according to the city government (about 99 km north-west).

name: 锦绣大明川
summaryEn: A leisure and camping resort built from late 2018 on a reclaimed river flat beside the Wuyuezhai exit of the Xifu Expressway at Zhaitou in Lingshou County, known for its 'tree bridge' riverside park. It has a large visitor centre, car parks and a dining area, about 150 camping and lodging units including RVs, tree houses, tents and star-gazing cabins, a children's park, a pet park and, in winter, a snow field with lantern displays. It is a modern purpose-built destination for family and group outings, not a historic or natural sight.
description: 锦绣大明川位于河北石家庄。游览特色包括滨水景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Shuiyu and Zhangjiazhuang villages in Zhaitou township, close to the expressway exit, about 44 km north-west of Lingshou town and 74 km north-west of central Shijiazhuang.

name: 君乐宝乳业工业旅游区
summaryEn: A dairy industrial-tourism area run by the Junlebao dairy company in Luquan District, with a dairy-processing zone and a ranch zone; the company began offering industrial tourism in 2012. At the ranch, visitors see a cattle-science hall, a milking hall, a grazing area, a feeding area and a visitor centre with a milk-culture display. It is a modern company attraction aimed at families and school groups, and its subject is dairy farming rather than local history.
description: 君乐宝乳业工业旅游区位于河北石家庄。游览特色包括工业参观、农业体验。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Luquan District, about 12 km south-south-east of Luquan town and about 16 km west-south-west of central Shijiazhuang; a taxi or private car is the practical way.

name: 漫山花溪谷
summaryEn: A mountain-valley leisure and holiday resort on the south side of the Wuyuezhai massif, developed from 2011 around two former mountain hamlets. The Lingshou county government describes a valley about 12.5 km long and 20 km² in area, rising from about 800 m to over 2,000 m, with a stream along its floor, a mountain flower garden, a lake in the gorge and an elevated 'glass rafting' course. It has lodging, dining and recreation facilities, and suits families wanting a cool summer weekend rather than a hard hike.
description: 漫山花溪谷位于河北石家庄。游览特色包括峡谷、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Manshan village, Nanying township, in the mountains of north-west Lingshou County, about 92 km north-west of central Shijiazhuang, so a car is the practical way.

name: 秋山
summaryEn: A forested hill-and-valley scenic area of about 8 km² in the Taihang foothills of Lingshou County, bounded by reservoirs on three sides, with more than 95 percent plant cover, small waterfalls, lakes and stone outcrops. The official description names a stretch of old wall called Tianlei Great Wall, the Qinghu and Cuihu lakes and an old battlefield site among its sights, and gives a summer temperature on the hill of about 20 °C. It suits a cool day out from Shijiazhuang for people who prefer quiet woodland to developed attractions.
description: 秋山位于河北石家庄。游览特色包括瀑布、长城、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the foothills about 32 km north-west of Lingshou town, between the Hengshanling and Yanchuan reservoirs; the city government puts it at more than 60 km from Shijiazhuang, so a car is the practical way.

name: 水泉溪自然风景区
summaryEn: A mountain-stream scenic area of about 47 km² in the Taihang hills of Lingshou County, with forest covering about 90 percent of the ground and more than 100 named spots, among them Qingshi Gorge, Wolong Rock, the Fairy and Rainbow waterfalls and a cave called the Immortals' Cave. The largest waterfall drops over 100 m, and the streams and shade make it a cool place in the warmer months. It suits walkers and families who want water and woodland rather than temples or towns.
description: 水泉溪自然风景区位于河北石家庄。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Mufota village, Nanying township, in the mountains of north-west Lingshou County, about 85 km north-west of central Shijiazhuang (the city government gives 100 km), so a car is the practical way.

name: 藤龙山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area of about 8 square kilometres in Wangpo township, in the north-west of Pingshan County, known for woodland hung with vines. The city government describes streams, pools and small waterfalls among the rocks, and the ridge also keeps the remains of blockhouses from the war against Japan. It suits a half-day walk in the hills.
description: 藤龙山位于河北石家庄。游览特色包括瀑布、山地游览、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wangpo township, in the north of Pingshan County, about 31 km north-north-west of Pingshan town and about 64 km north-west of central Shijiazhuang; a taxi or private car is the practical way.

name: 天山海世界
summaryEn: A commercial leisure complex in Shijiazhuang's Yuhua District, opened in 1999, that combines shopping and entertainment with a water park. A 2018 upgrade added water attractions such as a lazy river and slides, and since 2023 the winter water-play area has been a children's play park. It is a modern mall-and-leisure venue rather than a historic sight, and it suits families wanting an indoor day out in the city.
description: 天山海世界是一座位于石家庄市高新区天山大街116号的文化旅游综合体，成立于1999年，建筑面积约80,000平方米，是国家AAAA级旅游景区、石家庄市十大购物中心。
accessEn: On Tianshan Street in Yuhua District, about 8 km east of central Shijiazhuang and a short walk from Liucun station on Metro Line 1.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 驼梁
summaryEn: A high Taihang mountain area of 158 km² with a summit of 2,281 m, one of the five highest peaks in Hebei, and about 98% forest cover. More than 200 sights are listed, among them a gorge of small waterfalls (Baipu Gorge), stepped cascades and the sub-alpine Yunding meadow, which is in flower in summer. It is also a national forest park and nature reserve, and its summer average of about 19°C is why it is promoted as a cool retreat.
description: 驼梁位于河北石家庄。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the north-west of Pingshan County near the Shanxi border, about 98 km north-west of central Shijiazhuang. It closes for the autumn–winter forest-fire season (in 2025 from 15 October), so check that it is open before going.

name: 五岳寨
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area and national forest park in the north-west corner of Lingshou County, named for five peaks standing side by side; the main summit is close to 2,000 m, with deep gorges, larch and birch woods and an alpine meadow near the top. The best-known sight is the waterfall called the First Waterfall of Yan and Zhao, a drop of about 108 m billed as the largest mountain waterfall in northern China. Routes range from a short gorge-and-waterfall loop to a full-day circuit to the main peak, and the area is known for its cool summers.
description: 五岳寨位于河北石家庄。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the mountains of north-west Lingshou County, about 94 km north-west of central Shijiazhuang; the city government gives 110 km from Shijiazhuang, about two hours by car, leaving the Xifu Expressway at its Wuyuezhai exit.

name: 西苑温泉度假村
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort hotel in Wentang township, Pingshan County, with a four-star hotel of about 460 rooms and a bathing and water-play complex called Xiyuan Xiangshuiwan. It has indoor water slides and a children's play area, landscaped outdoor pools fed by cold, warm and hot waterfalls, herbal baths, and a cave-themed water zone. It suits families and groups who want a hot-spring stay rather than sightseeing.
description: 西苑温泉度假村位于河北石家庄。游览特色包括温泉、瀑布。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wentang township, about 19 km west of Pingshan town and 53 km west-north-west of central Shijiazhuang.

name: 嶂石岩
summaryEn: A national scenic area and geopark on the western edge of Zanhuang County, where the Taihang range breaks into three stacked tiers of red sandstone cliffs, each about 100–150 m high and running for tens of kilometres. The Zhangshiyan landform is named after this place, and Chinese sources rank it with the Danxia and Zhangjiajie landforms as China's three main sandstone landforms. The area has five zones, including Jiunü Peak, the Echo Wall (a huge amphitheatre-shaped cliff valley that returns clear echoes), the Dongling Bei ice-fall valley and a flower-valley zone, with cable car, rafting and camping facilities.
description: 嶂石岩位于河北石家庄。游览特色包括地质景观、砂岩地貌。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Zhangshiyan township, about 37 km south-west of Zanhuang town and about 76 km south-south-west of central Shijiazhuang; the city government gives 86 km and about an hour's drive from Shijiazhuang.

name: 紫云山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area of about 5 km² in the Taihang hills of Pingshan County, with a main peak of 1,128 m, more than twenty natural limestone caves hung with stalactites, stone-built farmhouses and red autumn foliage on the slopes. It has also been developed with red-tourism and ethnic-culture displays and is a pilot forest-wellness base. It suits a quiet half-day in the hills.
description: 紫云山位于河北石家庄。游览特色包括洞穴、山地游览、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the hills of Beiye township, Pingshan County, about 29 km west of Pingshan town and 59 km west-north-west of central Shijiazhuang.

name: 白羊峪长城
summaryEn: A stretch of Ming Great Wall about 4.5 km long along the ridges at Baiyangyu pass, with 21 towers, of which the Qian'an city government counts six as fairly complete. State media describe about 1.5 km of it as the 'marble Great Wall', with its base and tower foundations laid in marble and the wall standing up to 10 m high.
description: 白羊峪长城位于河北唐山。游览特色包括长城、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: By Baiyangyu village about 22 km north of Qian'an, reached by road.

name: 菩提岛
summaryEn: The wooded island of the three that make up Tangshan International Tourist Island, in the Bohai Sea off Laoting County; state media describe it as an island of old trees, in contrast to the sandy Yuetuo Island. It lies within the Bodhi Islands provincial nature reserve, a migratory-bird stopover for which the Ministry of Ecology and Environment reports 379 bird species a year. A visitor centre and a culture hall stand by its harbour plaza at the north-east end.
description: 菩提岛位于河北唐山。游览特色包括自然保护区、岛屿、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Off the Laoting coast about 33 km south-south-west of Laoting town, with the visitor centre and harbour plaza at the island's north-east end. Check how to reach the island and its opening dates before going.

name: 多玛乐园
summaryEn: A fishing-themed leisure park inside the Caofeidian wetland resort, where visitors catch fish, crabs and clams by traditional methods and by newer ones. Attractions include robot fishing, an underwater-camera fishing system and a water-borne 'space-time express' train, according to the park's publicity as reported by state media. It suits families with children.
description: 多玛乐园位于河北唐山。游览特色包括湿地、公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Caofeidian wetland resort about 15 km south-south-west of Tanghai town and roughly 56 km south-south-east of central Tangshan, reached by road.

name: 凤凰山
summaryEn: A limestone mountain about 400 m high in Xinji town, southern Qianxi, named for its resemblance to a phoenix with spread wings, with secondary forest and a Buddhist temple, Putuo Chan Temple, at its foot. The main event is a traditional temple fair on the 19th day of the second lunar month, with opera, folk dance and other folk arts, and the park also runs high-mountain rafting and a tree-house area.
description: 凤凰山位于河北唐山。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、民俗文化、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xinji town about 11 km south-east of Qianxi's urban area, reached by road.

name: 河头老街
summaryEn: A shopping, food and entertainment street built in old-street style on both banks of the Tangjin Canal, on the line of the 1881 coal canal that gave Hetou its name. It first opened in January 2023 and has run as a regular attraction since early 2024; evenings are the main draw, with street and stage performances, a floating market selling local snacks, lantern-lit bridges, costumed actors and the outdoor shows Tang Wang Dong Zheng and Da Tang Cao Fei. It was named a national tourism and leisure street in December 2023 and a national night-time culture and tourism cluster in January 2024.
description: 河头老街，原名运河唐人街，位于中国河北省唐山市丰南区唐津运河两岸，因坐落于运河的河头而得名。这里曾是清朝时期煤炭运输的重要节点，随着时代的发展，运河运输功能渐渐消失，河头老街被改造成了旅游商业街，2023年以来，先后被官方评为国家级旅游休闲街区、国家级夜间文化和旅游消费集聚区。
accessEn: On the Tangjin Canal in Xugezhuang town, Fengnan District, about 2 km south-south-west of Fengnan's urban centre and 12 km south-west of central Tangshan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 花乡果巷
summaryEn: A rural-tourism zone in Qianxi built around flower and fruit farming, with oil-peony and kiwi-fruit farms and organic grain fields, approved as a national 'rural complex' pilot (the only one in Hebei when state media reported on it in 2020). Pear-blossom, peony and harvest festivals have been held in season, and the surrounding villages run farmhouse restaurants.
description: 花乡果巷位于河北唐山。游览特色包括田园观光、农业体验、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the countryside about 19 km south-south-east of Qianxi's urban area, reached by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 景忠山
summaryEn: A temple mountain about 610 m high in Qianxi, where Buddhist, Taoist and Confucian shrines stand in three clusters at the foot, middle and summit, joined by a stairway of 1,872 steps through pines more than 200 years old. The Shunzhi and Kangxi emperors visited six times between them, and Kangxi wrote the inscription 'Famous Mountain Under Heaven' for it; large temple fairs are held on the 18th day of the fourth lunar month and the 15th of the tenth.
description: 景忠山位于河北唐山。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、登山观景、佛教文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Santunying town about 11 km west-north-west of Qianxi's urban area, reached by road.

name: 揽月湾
summaryEn: A seaside leisure area on the Bohai shore of Caofeidian New City, built around a sandy bay with about 12.8 km of shoreline and a 13.14 km coastal walking trail. Beach camping, seafood meals, kite events and open-air film shows are on offer.
description: 揽月湾位于河北唐山。游览特色包括海滨、海岸风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Caofeidian New City on the Bohai coast, about 17 km south-east of Tanghai town and 63 km south-east of central Tangshan, reached by road.

name: 龙井关长城漂流
summaryEn: A river-rafting scenic area at Longjingguan, a Ming Great Wall pass at the foot of Qi Mountain in Han'erzhuang, northern Qianxi. The county government describes a rafting course of about 9.8 km on the Sa River, taking around two hours, with a tunnel section about 1 km long adapted from Ming-era soldiers' caves and an armoury under the mountain. The pass and the wall on the hills above form the backdrop.
description: 龙井关长城漂流位于河北唐山。游览特色包括长城、水上活动、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: By Han'erzhuang about 27 km north-north-west of Qianxi's urban area, reached by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 滦州古城
summaryEn: A reconstruction of the old walled town of Luanzhou in Ming-Qing style, opened in 2012, with a rebuilt city gate, bell and drum towers, a reception pavilion and the old county yamen from the 'Yang Sanjie' opera story. Inside are commercial streets, folk-custom and temple-fair quarters and the Luanzhou Shadow Puppet Museum, in a region known for shadow puppetry and pingju opera. It is a new development rather than a surviving old town, so it suits a relaxed stroll and a meal.
description: 滦州古城位于河北唐山。游览特色包括博物馆、古城、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the east side of Luanzhou city, about 5 km east of its centre and about 50 km east-north-east of central Tangshan.

name: 青山关
summaryEn: A Great Wall pass in the mountains of north-eastern Qianxi, reckoned the best-preserved part of the county's Ming wall, with a surviving lift-type water gate, a 72-arch tower, the round 'Moon City' and a 'prison tower'. Below the wall stands a fort more than 400 years old, whose former offices, barracks, temples, teahouses and inns are now partly restored as restaurants and guesthouses. Climbing the wall is steep in places.
description: 青山关位于河北唐山。游览特色包括长城、寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: By Qingshankou village in Shangying about 36 km north-east of Qianxi's urban area, reached by road.

name: 唐山启新水泥工业博物馆
summaryEn: A museum without walls on the site of the Qixin Cement Works, founded in 1889 as China's first cement works, with 24 old buildings kept, among them silos, a freight platform and red-brick walls. Rotary kilns 4 and 5 date from the early 1910s and are described by state media as the oldest surviving in China, and kilns 6 and 7 ran from 1922 to 1998. The site is also the Qixin 1889 creative park, with cafés, craft shops, a 3D cinema and art exhibitions in the old halls.
description: 唐山启新水泥工业博物馆位于河北唐山。游览特色包括博物馆、工业参观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Lubei District, about 2 km east of central Tangshan. The museum is closed on Mondays.

name: 尚禾源
summaryEn: A leisure and rural-tourism area in Xingwangzhai town, west of Zunhua, centred on Lianxiang Town, a street of buildings built in old-street style that is hung with red lanterns for the New Year. Local government and state-media reports show seasonal events there, among them garden parties with stage shows, costumed performers and bonfire evenings, and visitors in Han-style dress. It suits families and groups wanting an easy half-day outing rather than historic buildings.
description: 尚禾源位于河北唐山。游览特色包括田园观光、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xingwangzhai town, about 7 km west-north-west of the centre of Zunhua, reached by road from the town.

name: 山叶口
summaryEn: A scenic area of about 14 square kilometres in the hills west of Qian'an, opened in 2011 and known for its stream-cut valley, a mountaintop lake and coloured conglomerate pebbles and boulders from very ancient rock. It is part of Qian'an National Geopark and has a geology gallery and exhibition hall. A few dozen farmhouse restaurants and guesthouses serve visitors in the village at its entrance.
description: 山叶口位于河北唐山。游览特色包括地质景观、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: By Shanyekou village in Dawuli town, about 14 km west of Qian'an and some 49 km north-east of central Tangshan, reached by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 唐山市科技馆
summaryEn: The municipal science and technology museum, in a large modern building in central Tangshan on the south side of Xinhua Road, just west of its crossing with Weiguo Road. Its science educators perform live experiment shows, such as the 'elephant toothpaste' demonstration staged at Hebei's 2024 Science Popularisation Day event, and the museum is one of Tangshan's designated parent-and-child activity bases, so it suits visitors travelling with young children.
description: 唐山市科技馆位于河北唐山。游览特色包括博物馆、科学科普。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In central Tangshan (Lunan District), about 2 km west-south-west of the city centre and about 154 km east-south-east of central Beijing. Check opening days before going.

name: 月坨岛
summaryEn: A crescent-shaped sandy island in the Bohai Sea off Laoting County, one of the three islands of Tangshan International Tourist Island (with Bodhi and Xiangyun islands), which state media call a national demonstration base for island development. State media describe it as having white sand and clear water, and nickname it the 'little Holland hanging in the Bohai'.
description: 月坨岛位于河北唐山。游览特色包括岛屿。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Reached by boat from the Three Islands tourist wharf, with the island lying about 35 km south of Laoting town. Check boat times and opening dates before going.

name: 德龙钢铁文化园
summaryEn: An industrial-tourism park inside the working Xingtai plant of Delong Steel, a private steelmaker, in Xindu District. Xingtai Daily reported in October 2026 that it is the first national AAAA scenic area in China built on a steelworks that is still producing, with sculptures made from scrap steel and a disused railway turned into an industrial-culture wall. It is a factory tour rather than a heritage site, so it suits visitors curious about modern heavy industry.
description: 德龙钢铁文化园位于河北邢台。游览特色包括雕塑艺术。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xindu District, about 10 km west of central Xingtai, or roughly 15 minutes' drive.

name: 九龙峡
summaryEn: A sandstone gorge area in the Taihang Mountains of Xindu District, named for its nine gorges and nine valleys and planned to cover about 64 square km, with 1,800-metre Wangmao Mountain as its main peak. Its sights include waterfalls and pools, a peach-blossom valley, red-leaf slopes in autumn, Guanyin Cave and a stretch of Ming Great Wall. It is a day trip for walkers who want canyon scenery west of Xingtai.
description: 九龙峡位于河北邢台。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、长城。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jiangshui town, about 59 km west-north-west of central Xingtai, or roughly an hour's drive.

name: 南和农业嘉年华
summaryEn: A modern-agriculture leisure park in the north of Nanhe District, built around large greenhouse halls. The Xingtai agriculture bureau lists a visitor-service area, a creative themed hall, a rose garden, a high-tech farming demonstration area and an agriculture-themed amusement park, and its greenhouses host flower displays. It is a commercial attraction that suits families looking for a short outing from Xingtai.
description: 南和农业嘉年华位于河北邢台。游览特色包括主题游乐、田园观光、园林景观。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the north of Nanhe District, about 19 km east of central Xingtai, or roughly 20 minutes' drive.

name: 泥坑酒文化旅游产业园
summaryEn: A liquor-culture tourism park in Ningjin built around Nikeng baijiu, a strong grain spirit that traces back to a distillery founded in 1916. Its mud-pit solid-state fermentation craft is a Hebei provincial intangible-heritage item, and the old brewing pits and workshops were listed as provincial industrial heritage in 2025. It was added to Hebei's 4A list in December 2025 and suits visitors interested in how baijiu is made rather than in historic sites.
description: 泥坑酒文化旅游产业园位于河北邢台。游览特色包括工业遗产、酿造文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the G308 road in the east of Ningjin, about 4 km east of the county town.

name: 前南峪
summaryEn: A wooded valley in the Taihang Mountains that was the headquarters of the Anti-Japanese Military and Political University (known as Kangda) from November 1940, the school the Chinese Communist Party ran to train military and political cadres. The village is described as holding the largest and best-preserved group of Kangda sites, including a monument, leaders' former residences, a stele forest and the medical station, together with a national second-grade exhibition hall on the school's history. The surrounding forest park, which the provincial tourism department puts at about 38 square km, gives the visit a woodland setting.
description: 前南峪位于河北邢台。游览特色包括山谷、名人故居、历史纪念。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jiangshui town, about 51 km west-north-west of central Xingtai, or roughly an hour's drive, and the exhibition hall is closed on Mondays except on public holidays.

name: 羊绒小镇
summaryEn: A purpose-built cashmere trading and tourism town in Qinghe, with a planned area of about 3.2 sq km, grown from the Qinghe Cashmere Products Market, which began operating in September 2008. It is a place to browse and buy cashmere knitwear along its shopping streets, and the county has been building an e-commerce park and upgrading a riverside park nearby. It suits visitors interested in a Chinese specialist-industry town rather than in historic sites.
description: 羊绒小镇位于河北邢台。游览特色包括滨水景观、特色街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the northern part of Qinghe, about 5 km north of the county centre, near the cashmere market.

name: 天台山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in the Taihang foothills north-west of Lincheng, in the same hills as Kongshan Baiyun Cave and Qishan Lake. The Hebei culture and tourism department lists more than thirty natural sights, among them a lotus-seed lake, a red-cliff waterfall, a cliff plank walk and a gorge, along with the Tang-founded Ciyun'an temple, where worship continues. Its layered red sandstone cliffs are of the Zhangshiyan landform type.
description: 天台山位于河北邢台。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 14 km north-west of Lincheng town and about 9 km north-north-west of Kongshan Baiyun Cave, reached by road from Lincheng.

name: 天梯山
summaryEn: A hill scenic area in Xindu District, the nearest of the district's mountain 4A sites to Xingtai, known for the red autumn foliage of wild smoke trees growing on its cliffs. It has a cave, viewing platforms and walking paths, and the foliage is at its best from late October. It suits a short autumn outing from the city.
description: 天梯山位于河北邢台。游览特色包括洞穴、观景台。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xindu District, about 24 km west of central Xingtai, or roughly 25 minutes' drive.

name: 邢台大峡谷
summaryEn: A cluster of 24 sandstone canyons in the Taihang Mountains at Luluo town, near the Shanxi border, eight of them more than a kilometre long; it is a national key scenic area and a national geopark. The main gorge, Huangchao Gorge, runs for about 4 km between cliffs well over 100 m high, narrowing to a metre or two in places, and waterfalls drop through the canyons. Five of the canyons have been opened for walking.
description: 邢台大峡谷位于河北邢台。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Luluo town of Xindu District, about 63 km west of central Xingtai, or roughly an hour's drive.

name: 紫金山
summaryEn: A high mountain area in Baian township, Xindu District, averaging more than 1,300 m above sea level, with Motianling as its highest peak at about 1,750 m. It is described as a cool summer retreat and as the site of the ruins of the Yuan-dynasty Zijinshan Academy, where the astronomer Guo Shoujing is said to have studied under the adviser Liu Bingzhong. It suits hikers and anyone interested in Guo Shoujing's early life.
description: 紫金山位于河北邢台。游览特色包括书院文化、历史遗址、高山景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 64 km west of central Xingtai, or roughly an hour and ten minutes' drive, reached from the Luluo exit of the Xingfen expressway.

name: 安家沟生态旅游区
summaryEn: A scenic valley on the northern edge of Zhangjiakou, a gully about 4.6 km long with a dozen side gullies, run as an ecological tourism area for day visitors from the city. Visitors walk beside a stream between rocky gully walls, with a suspension footbridge and rafting among the activities. It suits a short outing for families.
description: 安家沟生态旅游区位于河北张家口。游览特色包括山谷、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 3 km north-north-west of Dajingmen on the northern outskirts of Zhangjiakou, a short taxi ride from the city centre. Check that it is open before going.

name: 赤城温泉度假村
summaryEn: A hot-spring valley west of Chicheng town, where mineral springs rise on the south bank of the Tangquan River and now supply hotels and sanatoria. The springs were already recorded in the Shuijing Zhu of the Northern Wei, and the county describes them as a former imperial spring. It suits visitors who want to soak in a quiet mountain setting rather than see sights.
description: 赤城温泉度假村位于河北张家口。游览特色包括温泉、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In a valley about 7 km west of Chicheng town, which is about 180 km from Beijing by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 翠云山森林风景区
summaryEn: A forested mountain area at Chongli with peaks above 2,000 m, developed as a mountain resort around the Galaxy ski area. In summer a cable car and slides run on the ski slopes, with mountain biking, archery, hiking and an artificial lake with pedal boats and lakeside events. It suits a day trip or a night in one of the resort hotels at its base.
description: 翠云山森林风景区位于河北张家口。游览特色包括湖泊、林地风光、缆车观景。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: About 5 km north-north-east of Xiwanzi, Chongli's main town, and roughly 40 km east-north-east of Zhangjiakou city.

name: 大青山国际旅游度假区
summaryEn: A mountain tourist resort in Shangyi County beside the Grassland Sky Road, a scenic highway that passes through the Daqingshan forest hills. Its best-known feature is the Jingguang Glass Bridge, a transparent suspension footbridge about 640 m long that spans a valley between two peaks, so a visit is mostly about views over the hills and the road beyond.
description: 大青山国际旅游度假区位于河北张家口。游览特色包括草原、玻璃栈道、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills about 15 km south-south-east of Shangyi town, beside the Grassland Sky Road, reached by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 富龙四季小镇
summaryEn: A resort town on the edge of Chongli's main town, built around the Fulong ski area, with a shopping street of 19 European-style buildings, a large indoor children's play centre and hotels. In winter it is a ski base; in summer it runs a bicycle pump-track park, mountain-bike downhill trails and a set of activities for children. It is mainly a family and active-break destination rather than a sightseeing stop.
description: 富龙四季小镇位于河北张家口。游览特色包括特色街区。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: On the north-eastern side of Chongli's main town (Xiwanzi), about 3 km north-east of the town centre and roughly 40 km east-north-east of Zhangjiakou city.

name: 黄帝城遗址
summaryEn: The remains of a rammed-earth walled town at Sanbao village, Fanshan town, which local tradition calls Huangdi City after the legendary Yellow Emperor. Archaeologists who excavated in 2014 found it was probably not built before the Warring States period, and the national heritage authority has said its nature still needs study. The tourist area around it has a lake, a spring, and a hall and ceremonial altar linked to the Yellow Emperor tradition, so it suits visitors interested in Chinese origin legends.
description: 黄帝城遗址位于河北张家口。游览特色包括湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Fanshan town, about 3 km west of the town centre and 25 km south-east of Zhuolu county town, roughly 80 km south-south-east of Zhangjiakou city. Check that it is open before going.

name: 黄龙山庄
summaryEn: A wooded mountain resort and scenic area in the Yan Mountains north-west of Huailai town, with streams and springs, forest walks and a cool summer climate. The county holds a climbing festival here, and the fifth, in May 2024, drew more than 300 hikers. It suits walkers and day-trippers from the Beijing–Zhangjiakou corridor.
description: 黄龙山庄位于河北张家口。游览特色包括林地风光、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Yuhongsi village in Xinbao'an town, about 13 km north-north-west of Huailai's county seat at Shacheng and about 103 km north-west of central Beijing.

name: 库伦淖尔
summaryEn: A lake and holiday resort on the Bashang grassland just north of Guyuan town. The county government lists boat trips on the lake, a wetland flower field with boardwalks that blooms from June to October, horse riding, a Mongolian-style yurt camp with meals and evening bonfire parties, and staged outdoor shows. It suits a summer day or overnight trip for families and groups from Beijing and Zhangjiakou.
description: 库伦淖尔位于河北张家口。游览特色包括湿地、草原、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 4–5 km north-north-east of Guyuan town on the lake's southern shore, and roughly 120 km north-east of Zhangjiakou city; a taxi or private car from Guyuan is the practical way.

name: 滦河神韵
summaryEn: A wetland and grassland viewing area on Zhuanfo Hill beside the Shandian River in northern Guyuan County, where the river winds in loops across the open grassland, with boardwalks and pavilions up the hill. The Zhangjiakou tourism bureau says a Neolithic altar and a Liao–Jin–Yuan-era general's review platform also stand here. It is a summer scenery and photography stop, close to the wetland park's bird-watching garden.
description: 滦河神韵位于河北张家口。游览特色包括湿地、草原。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 14 km north-east of Guyuan town, in the Shandian River wetland park; a taxi or private car from Guyuan is the practical way.

name: 桑干河大峡谷·飞瀑峡
summaryEn: A gorge scenic area on the Sanggan River in the far south-west of Xuanhua District, whose main sight, the Feibu ('flying waterfall') Gorge, is a narrow stretch of canyon about 5 km long with many small waterfalls and spray. It lies close to the borders with Yangyuan and Zhuolu counties, in hill country well away from the city. The attraction is natural scenery rather than a historic site, and it suits a short outdoor visit from Zhangjiakou.
description: 桑干河大峡谷·飞瀑峡位于河北张家口。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In hill country about 42 km south-south-west of Xuanhua's old town, reached by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 沙城酒文化博览园
summaryEn: A visitor area at the Shacheng Laojiao baijiu distillery in Shacheng town, rated a national 4A scenic area in December 2025. It has a liquor-history hall, hands-on blending and labelling workshops, vintage tastings and a dress-up 'imperial wine' sealing ceremony, while the production areas stay closed to the public. According to the operator, visitors book online and tour in guided groups.
description: 沙城酒文化博览园位于河北张家口。游览特色包括酿造文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shacheng town, the seat of Huailai County on the Beijing–Zhangjiakou corridor, about 71 km south-east of Zhangjiakou city.

name: 太舞四季小镇
summaryEn: A ski resort town at Chongli built in the style of a European alpine village, 2 km from Taizicheng, where the Zhangjiakou events of the 2022 Winter Olympics were held. It has around 30 ski runs, and in summer its cable car to a viewpoint, hiking trails, mountain-bike descents and go-karts stay open. Hotels, restaurants, an ice rink and hot-spring pools make it a base for a family or active break rather than a sightseeing stop.
description: 太舞四季小镇位于河北张家口。游览特色包括滑雪、山地游览、缆车观景。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: About 2 km south of Taizicheng station on the Chongli branch of the Beijing–Zhangjiakou high-speed railway, roughly 16 km east-south-east of Chongli town and 48 km east of Zhangjiakou city.

name: 天保那苏图
summaryEn: A grassland holiday resort on the western edge of Zhangbei, laid out around a lake and a large flower meadow, with a Mongol-Yuan themed area and a hot-spring and water-play zone. The provincial tourism department lists a sightseeing mini-train that crosses the lake, a hillside path to a stone gate, and views of wind turbines across the grassland. It is mainly a summer outing for families and groups.
description: 天保那苏图位于河北张家口。游览特色包括草原、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 6 km west-north-west of Zhangbei town and roughly 44 km north-north-west of Zhangjiakou city; a taxi or private car from Zhangbei is the practical way.

name: 万龙滑雪场
summaryEn: One of the large ski resorts in Chongli, the Olympic ski district of Zhangjiakou, with more than 30 runs, some of them certified by the International Ski Federation (FIS), a long gentle beginners' run and night skiing. It is a purpose-built mountain resort, so visits are mainly in the winter snow season, and it suits advanced skiers as well as first-timers.
description: 万龙滑雪场位于中华人民共和国河北省张家口市崇礼区，是该区7大滑雪场之一，是中国首家以滑雪为特色的国家级4A景区，拥有超过32条雪道，占地面积30余平方公里。
accessEn: In Chongli District, about 7 km north-west of Taizicheng high-speed station, with a shuttle of about 15 minutes from the station; the train from Beijing Qinghe takes a little over an hour.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 小五台辉川景区
summaryEn: A mountain-valley scenic area on the southern side of the Xiaowutai range, at Huichuan village in Yuxian's Baishu township, on Hebei's list of 4A scenic areas. Tour operators sell it for a hiking route past a series of waterfalls and pools. It suits walkers with a day to spare, and is a separate visit from the Jinhekou valley on the north side of the same mountains.
description: 小五台辉川景区位于河北张家口。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Huichuan village, Baishu township, about 32 km east of Yuxian old town; Yuxian is about 105 km south-south-west of Zhangjiakou railway station. Check that it is open before going.

name: 中都原始草原度假村
summaryEn: A grassland holiday resort on the Bashang plateau north of Zhangbei, built around a camp of Mongolian-style yurts that includes a very large domed yurt used as a restaurant and venue. In past summer seasons it has put on staged Mongolian song-and-dance and horse shows, an evening bonfire party and a stage play about the Yuan capital. It suits families and groups on a short summer break from Beijing or Zhangjiakou.
description: 中都原始草原度假村位于河北张家口。游览特色包括草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 17 km north of Zhangbei town on the grassland, roughly 55 km north-north-west of Zhangjiakou city and about 10 km east of Yuan Zhongdu; a private car or taxi is the practical way. Check that it is open before going.

name: 丹泉小镇
summaryEn: A mountain-valley leisure resort developed since 2021 around Yuanquan village in Xijing town, Licheng County, beside the Taihang Number One scenic road. The village is named for a spring that wells out of a cave beneath a hill the locals call Wugen ('rootless') Mountain and feeds a long pond; beside it stand a Yuhuang temple rebuilt in 2018 and a memorial pavilion put up by an Eighth Route Army chemical works for nine workers who died on duty. The resort adds camping and RV pitches, glass-walled 'Linglong' cabins, hillside guesthouses and a cave hotel, with nature-study and local-history programmes, so it suits families wanting a quiet rural stay.
description: 丹泉小镇位于山西长治。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、山谷、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is in Yuanquan village, Xijing town, about 20 km north of Licheng county town and about 70 km by road from central Changzhi, roughly an hour's drive.

name: 八路军文化园
summaryEn: A themed park between Phoenix Hill and the Mamu River in Wuxiang, built to recreate the wartime life and campaigns of the Eighth Route Army through hands-on, high-technology displays. Its seven parts include a front plaza, a visitor centre, Victory Avenue, a live-action theatre and a village area. It is a staged, family-oriented introduction to the subject rather than an archive, beside the Taihang memorial museum.
description: 八路军文化园位于山西长治。游览特色包括博物馆、戏剧演艺。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: It lies in Wuxiang town, next to the Taihang Memorial Museum of the Eighth Route Army. The park was closed for upgrading in 2026, so check that it has reopened before going.

name: 欢乐太行谷
summaryEn: A large leisure complex in Huguan County, east of Changzhi, that combines an amusement park, a water park (Jingwei Water World), an aquarium, a children's area, a hot-spring hotel and a farm. Its evening programme of light shows and performances is built around a 'Taihang myth' theme. It is a commercial venue for families rather than a historic or natural site.
description: 欢乐太行谷位于山西长治。游览特色包括水族展览、主题游乐、水上游乐。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It stands about 11 km east of central Changzhi and about 9 km north of Huguan.

name: 鲁迅艺术学校下北漳旧址
summaryEn: A wartime site in Xiabeizhang village, where teachers and students of the Lu Xun Art School's front-line branch and other wartime cultural groups worked in 1940. The scenic area includes the former school, the Jindongnan branch of the Sino-Soviet Cultural Association, the former home of Li Bozhao and an exhibition on the Communist Party and wartime culture. It is one of the sites in the Wangjiayu revolutionary-relics cluster and has been listed as a provincial protected site since 2021.
description: 鲁迅艺术学校下北漳旧址，位于山西省长治市武乡县监漳镇下北漳村，是一处山西省文物保护单位。2021年8月4日，鲁迅艺术学校下北漳旧址公布为第六批山西省文物保护单位，年代为1940年，近现代重要史迹及代表性建筑类，编号6-348。
accessEn: It lies in Xiabeizhang village in Jianzhang town, on the Taihang No. 1 tourist road about 20 km south-east of Wuxiang county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 太行龙洞
summaryEn: A karst cave in Shiquan village in Panlong town, east of Wuxiang, with four levels and more than 2,000 m of passages, of which three levels are open. The route passes more than 70 named sights among stalactites, stalagmites, flowstone curtains and 'stone waterfall' formations. It suits a short visit combined with the Eighth Route Army headquarters site at Zhuanbi, which is in the same town.
description: 太行龙洞位于山西长治。游览特色包括瀑布、洞穴。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It lies in Shiquan village, Panlong town, about 40 km east of Wuxiang.

name: 太行水乡·赤壁悬流
summaryEn: A 12 km stretch of the Zhuozhang River gorge in the Taihang foothills of Pingshun County, named after 'Chibi Xuanliu' (red cliffs and hanging streams), one of the old 'eight sights' of the Taihang. Red rock walls rise from green water, a broad waterfall about 118 m wide and 22 m high crosses the river bed, and a 4.5 km boardwalk runs through the red cliffs. The Commentary on the Waterways Classic, written in the early sixth century, already praised the blue-green cliffs and red walls like dawn cloud here, and today the gorge suits a half-day walk.
description: 太行水乡·赤壁悬流位于山西长治。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、水乡。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km north-north-east of Pingshun county town and about 45 km north-east of central Changzhi. It closed over the winter of 2024–25, so check that it is open before a winter visit.

name: 天脊山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in the Taihang Mountains of eastern Pingshun County, near Yanglaoyan village in Dongsitou township, which borders Henan, with streams, pools and waterfalls running in its valleys through the year. A cliffside plank walkway looks down on a drop of more than 300 m, and its highest fall, the Tianji Longpu, is promoted as dropping 346 m. A geopark of the same name, the Pingshun Tianjishan Geopark, holds national geopark qualification.
description: 天脊山位于山西长治。游览特色包括瀑布、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It lies near Yanglaoyan village in Dongsitou township, about 18 km east of Pingshun.

name: 通天峡
summaryEn: A gorge scenic area of about 65 sq km in south-eastern Pingshun County, in Hongtiguan and Dongsitou townships, which is also a national geopark. The main gorge runs about 26 km, with Tongtian Lake and its small island of macaques, a cliff more than 170 m high known as Shiping ('Screen') Mountain, the three-step Sandie waterfall and, in winter, a long natural ice curtain. The ancient Hongti Pass and the Minghui Master Pagoda lie nearby.
description: 通天峡位于山西长治。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It lies near Tihou village in eastern Pingshun County, about 16 km east of Pingshun.

name: 洗耳河
summaryEn: A mountain and river-valley scenic area of about 30 sq km in the Taihang Mountains of northern Licheng County, rising to Wuzhi Mountain at about 1,500 m. Local accounts place two legendary hermits here, Xu You and Chaofu, the source of the idiom xi'er gongting ('to listen respectfully'), and the stream is known for its clear spring water. After an upgrade it reopened in August 2026 with a water-play street, rock climbing, a jungle-adventure course, go-karts and mountain guesthouses.
description: 洗耳河位于山西长治。游览特色包括山谷、泉水。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It lies at Xi'er River village in Xijing town, about 30 km north of Licheng.

name: 仙堂山
summaryEn: Xiantang Mountain is a scenic area in the hills north-east of Xiangyuan, centred on Xiantang Temple, a Buddhist temple traced to the Eastern Jin whose group of Ming and Qing buildings has been a provincial-level protected monument since 1996. Caves including the Nuwa Palace, Guanyin Cave and Black Dragon Cave lie among the peaks, and the slopes turn red with smoke-tree and maple foliage between mid-October and the end of November.
description: 仙堂山位于山西长治。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、洞穴、佛教文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is about 15 km north-east of Xiangyuan county town, which is about 40 km north of central Changzhi.

name: 漳泽湖国家城市湿地公园
summaryEn: A landscaped wetland park on the edge of Zhangze Reservoir, which Changzhi promotes as the 'Taihang Heavenly Pond', on the north-western side of the city. The reservoir, a large one on the south branch of the Zhuozhang River, was completed in 1960; the park has waterways, woodland, walking paths, boat rides and Chinese-garden pavilions, and is known for its summer lotus. It makes an easy outing from the city for a walk by the water.
description: 漳泽湖国家城市湿地公园位于山西长治。游览特色包括湿地、水库。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is on the north-western edge of Changzhi, about 6 km north-west of the city centre, a short drive from downtown.

name: 振兴小镇
summaryEn: A rural-tourism complex built around Zhenxing village in Shangdang District, mixing family attractions with local folk culture. It has an agricultural science-and-technology park with themed indoor gardens (a 'suspended rainforest', an insect world, a pet area), a VR 'metaverse' hall, a patriotic-education area with relief carvings of wartime episodes such as the Hundred Regiments Offensive, an adventure area with zip lines and climbing, and a night-time pedestrian street in modern 'national-trend' style. Holiday programmes include folk shows such as sedan-chair processions and dragon dances, and the place suits families and school groups.
description: 振兴小镇位于山西长治。游览特色包括田园观光、民俗文化、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the south of Shangdang District, about 19 km south of the district seat and about 35 km south of central Changzhi.

name: 车河有机社区
summaryEn: A rural community in the hills of Hongshileng township, set up in 2013 around the villages of Upper and Lower Chehe and run as a showcase for organic farming. It has organic fields, a produce exhibition hall, a new village-style housing area, a fishing area and a valley eco-tourism zone, with oil-peony fields that flower in late spring. An international organic-agriculture forum has been held here twelve times, and the place suits visitors who want a quiet countryside stay.
description: 车河有机社区位于山西大同。游览特色包括山谷、农业体验、主题展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 10 km south-east of Lingqiu, and about 2 km west of Jueshan Temple.

name: 大泉山
summaryEn: A loess-hill area south of Yanggao that was once bare, gullied slopes and is now about 69% forest, held up as a national model of soil and water conservation. In 1955 Mao Zedong gave an article on the village's conservation work a new title and added a note of his own, and the scenic area has exhibition halls on that note and on soil conservation. Forest trails, the Daquanshan reservoir and Xiaolongmen are the main natural sights, and there is a visitor centre.
description: 大泉山位于山西大同。游览特色包括水库、林地风光、主题展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 13 km south of Yanggao, at Daquanshan village in Dabaideng township.

name: 大同方特欢乐世界
summaryEn: A theme park on the eastern edge of Datong, one of the Fantawild chain, which opened in 2016. The Datong government's 2026 description counts more than 30 themed rides and attractions, and the park adds parades, evening shows with fireworks and seasonal events such as a summer water-splashing festival. It is aimed mainly at families with children.
description: 大同方特欢乐世界位于山西大同。游览特色包括主题游乐、节庆文化。图集建议预留一天游览。
accessEn: About 8 km east of central Datong.

name: 晋华宫国家矿山公园
summaryEn: A former coal mine west of Datong, now a national mining park of about 36 hectares and one of the first 28 in China. Visitors can go underground into part of the old workings, and the park also has the Datong Coal Museum and an area of surface mine remains. It stands across the river from the Yungang Grottoes, so it combines easily with a visit there.
description: 晋华宫国家矿山公园位于山西大同。游览特色包括石窟造像、博物馆。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 13 km west of central Datong, on the opposite side of the Shili River from the Yungang Grottoes.

name: 李二口长城
summaryEn: A stretch of Ming-dynasty Great Wall built of rammed earth in the 16th century, in the hills of Tianzhen County in the far north of Shanxi. Two sections of the wall meet here in a T-shape, and the stretch is on the national list of important Great Wall sections. Li'erkou village at its foot has been restored as a small tourist village.
description: 李二口长城位于山西大同。游览特色包括长城、历史建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 12 km north of Tianzhen county town and about 105 km by road from Datong.

name: 平型关大捷景区
summaryEn: The memorial site for the Battle of Pingxingguan of 25 September 1937, when the Eighth Route Army's 115th Division ambushed a Japanese column in the Qiaogou gully, an engagement that Chinese accounts treat as the first major Chinese victory after the full-scale war began. The site has a memorial museum with a main exhibition hall and a panorama gallery, a plaza with ten bronze statues of the commanders, and a memorial monument on a ridge about 1 km to the east; the Qiaogou gully, about 4 km long, lies nearby. The Pingxingguan pass itself, a Great Wall gate, is about 10 km away by road.
description: 平型关大捷景区位于山西大同。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 25 km south-west of Lingqiu county town and about 135 km by road from Datong.

name: 魏都水世界
summaryEn: A large leisure complex of about 600 mu (40 hectares) on the southern edge of Datong, developed from 2015 around a water park with slides, a wave pool and a lazy river. The Datong government lists hot-spring bathing, hotel rooms, restaurants, an outdoor amusement area, a year-round ice rink and fishing among its facilities. It suits families and anyone looking for a leisure day out from the city.
description: 魏都水世界位于山西大同。游览特色包括水上游乐、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 7 km south of central Datong.

name: 大阳古镇
summaryEn: The old town of Dayang, famous in the Ming and Qing for hand-made needles and a national historic and cultural town since 2008. It has many official and merchant houses, towers, bridges and temples, and the scenic area adds folk performances such as yangge dancing, iron-flower displays and paper-cutting, with an evening market and light shows.
description: 大阳古镇位于山西晋城。游览特色包括古镇、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Dayang town, about 20 km north of central Jincheng; the Tangdi temple of Dayang is in the same old town.

name: 釜山村
summaryEn: Fushan, in Sizhuang town, is a village restored for tourism around old Qing-dynasty courtyards, a Confucian temple and a reservoir with boats and a floating bridge. Newer additions include a park of old pear trees, a coin museum and a pedestrian shopping street built in the style of 1978, so it suits a relaxed half-day rather than a monument visit.
description: 釜山村位于山西晋城。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The village is in Sizhuang town, about 14 km north-west of Gaoping, and one of Gaoping's tourist bus routes serves it.

name: 良户古村
summaryEn: Lianghu is a Taihang village of Ming and Qing courtyard houses in the Dan River valley, a China Historic and Cultural Village since 2007, now run as a heritage site with a guesthouse in restored courtyards. The sights include the Shilang (vice-minister's) Mansion, home of the official Tian Fengji, with its screen wall and carved brick, stone and wood, and Yuxu Temple, a Taoist temple with Yuan-dynasty halls that is a national heritage site.
description: 良户古村位于山西晋城。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、古村落、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: It lies in Yuancun township, about 15 km west of Gaoping, and one of Gaoping's tourist bus routes serves the village.

name: 沁水历山
summaryEn: The Qinshui side of the Lishan range in the Zhongtiao Mountains, a national nature reserve and forest park of about 204 square kilometres with forest, cave systems, alpine meadow and canyon scenery. Its main peak, Shunwangping, rises to 2,358 m and is named for the sage-king Shun, whom Chinese tradition places farming on Mount Li.
description: 沁水历山位于山西晋城。游览特色包括峡谷、森林公园、自然保护区。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: The access point near Xiachuan village is about 30 km south-south-west of Qinshui, the county seat; the county government puts the scenic area 50 km from the county town. The Yuanqu side, in Yuncheng, has its own scenic area and entrances.

name: 蟒河
summaryEn: A forested gorge area on the Shanxi–Henan border, set up as a national nature reserve and forest park mainly to protect rhesus macaques and subtropical plants, and nicknamed the 'little Guilin of the north'. Streams run through the gorges as waterfalls, pools and rapids beside the walking paths, and the wild macaques, which are often seen along the paths, are the main draw.
description: 蟒河，又称莽河、漭河，是中华人民共和国山西省和河南省的一条河流，发源于山西省阳城县王屋山花野岭，流经济源市、孟州市、温县，至黄河沿岸折向东流，在武陟县董宋村入黄河，全长135.7公里，流域面积1328平方公里，常年流量1.5立方米每秒。
accessEn: The scenic area is in the south of Yangcheng County near the Henan border, about 20 km south of Yangcheng, and one of Yangcheng's tourist bus routes serves it.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 司徒小镇
summaryEn: A tourist town in the north-east of Jincheng, built in Ming and Qing street style, with restaurants, shops, craft workshops, amusement rides and stage shows. It is best known for the Situ iron-flower show, a folk fire display in which molten iron is struck against a wooden structure to throw sparks; a 2024 performance with 108 participants was recognised by Guinness World Records as the largest of its kind.
description: 司徒小镇位于山西晋城。游览特色包括手工艺、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jincheng's urban area, about 5 km north-east of central Jincheng.

name: 天官王府
summaryEn: Tianguan Wang Mansion is a cluster of old houses in Shangzhuang village associated with Wang Guoguang, a Ming minister of personnel (the 'tianguan' of the name), and opened to visitors in 2012. Dwellings from the Yuan, Ming, Qing and Republican periods stand together, with an old Ming plum tree, a courtyard estate in mixed Chinese and Western style and an exhibition on Wang Guoguang. Costumed role-play shows and lantern tours at night are staged for visitors.
description: 天官王府位于山西晋城。游览特色包括历史宅院。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: It is in Shangzhuang village, Runcheng town, about 13 km east of Yangcheng and about 2 km from Haihui Temple.

name: 析城山
summaryEn: Xicheng Mountain is a karst summit on the north-west side of the Wangwu range, where a ring of cliffs with four gaps like city gates encloses a bowl of subalpine meadow, a landscape that is rare in northern China; the main peak is about 1,888 m. The meadow, called Shengwangping, has sinkholes, a spring pool called Yaochi and sites linked to the Shang founder Tang's rain prayers and to ancient sky-watching, and it held its first flower festival in June and July 2026.
description: 析城山位于山西晋城。游览特色包括喀斯特地貌、登山观景、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is about 25 km south-west of Yangcheng, reached by mountain road.

name: 红崖峡谷
summaryEn: A forested canyon in the Taiyue range, named for the red rock of its steep cliffs, and one of the scenic areas of Taiyueshan National Forest Park. Forest covers over 97 percent of the area, and the canyon has a ski area in winter. It suits walkers looking for a mountain day out within reach of Jiexiu and Lingshi.
description: 红崖峡谷位于山西晋中。游览特色包括峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Taiyue range, about 15 km east of Lingshi and about 20 km south of Jiexiu.

name: 后沟古村
summaryEn: A loess-plateau farming village in Dongzhao township, near the border with Shouyang county, where the houses are cave dwellings cut into the hillsides in stone, earth and brick. The village has 18 small temples and an ancestral hall, and an underground drainage system that runs through its courtyards. It suits visitors interested in traditional farming life in rural Shanxi.
description: 后沟古村位于山西晋中。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、古村落。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Dongzhao township, about 16 km north-east of central Jinzhong, near the border with Shouyang county.

name: 九龙国际文化生态旅游区
summaryEn: A leisure and holiday resort of about 3,900 mu (some 2.6 sq km) in the hills of Yuci District, close to Taiyuan. It combines a mountain lodge, a ski resort, an RV campsite and an off-road vehicle club. The ski resort hosted the opening of Shanxi's first Ice and Snow Carnival in December 2024, so it suits skiers and families on a short trip from Taiyuan rather than visitors looking for heritage.
description: 九龙国际文化生态旅游区位于山西晋中。游览特色包括滑雪、休闲度假、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yuci District close to Taiyuan Wusu Airport, about 15 km south-east of central Taiyuan and about 12 km north of central Yuci.

name: 石膏山
summaryEn: A forested mountain scenic area in the Taiyue range, rising to 2,532 m, of which about 20 of its 75 sq km are open to visitors. More than 70 sights are linked by about 25 km of visitor roads, including temples in the hills and a red-leaf zone. The area opened to visitors in 2011 and suits a day of walking in the hills.
description: 石膏山位于山西晋中。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、山地游览、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the Taiyue range, about 18 km south-east of Lingshi and about 30 km south of Jiexiu.

name: 太行龙泉
summaryEn: A large national forest park and scenic area in the Taihang Mountains south of Zuoquan, with a waterfall, lakes, temples and an alpine meadow. It suits a summer day in the hills.
description: 太行龙泉位于山西晋中。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: The entrance plaza and car park are at the mouth of a gorge about 1.5 km south-east of Longze village in Liaoyang town, about 10 km south of Zuoquan town.

name: 乌金山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forested mountain park on the boundary between Taiyuan and Yuci, run as a leisure resort that combines religious sites, walking paths and an amusement park. Peach blossom on the slopes in late March and early April is a seasonal draw. It suits a half-day outing from Taiyuan or Yuci.
description: 乌金山国家森林公园位于山西晋中。游览特色包括森林公园、主题游乐、山地游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills of Wujinshan town, about 18 km north of central Yuci and 20 km east of central Taiyuan.

name: 潇河莲花湾
summaryEn: A riverside leisure area on the Xiaohe River in south-east Yuci, laid out around 2020 as the first part of the planned Xiaohe Arts Town. It has a central plaza used for fountain and light-show performances, a footbridge shaped like a lotus stem, a snack street, about 3 km of woodland, sports pitches and large seasonal flower displays such as autumn chrysanthemums. It suits families and evening outings from Jinzhong.
description: 潇河莲花湾位于山西晋中。游览特色包括滨水景观、林地风光、莲花观赏。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Guojiabu area of south-east Yuci, about 4 km south-east of central Jinzhong.

name: 小西沟文旅康养小镇
summaryEn: A purpose-built tourist town that opened in July 2021 on the site of a former quarry in the hills east of Taiyuan, after the quarry had been cleaned up and replanted. It holds shops and stalls selling Shanxi snacks, crafts and intangible-heritage products, together with guesthouses, a children's play area and a traditional Chinese medicine wellness theme. It suits families and short day trips from Taiyuan or Jinzhong.
description: 小镇建在太原以东山地的旧采石场上，采石区经过修复和复绿后对游客开放。
accessEn: In the hills of Wujinshan town in Yuci district, about 13 km east of central Taiyuan and about 16 km north of central Jinzhong.

name: 昭馀古城
summaryEn: The old centre of Qi County, a town on the Great Tea Road whose Ming and Qing courtyard houses have been renovated for visitors. Sights include the Qu Family Compound (a national heritage unit, now a museum of Jin merchant culture), the old Sanjinyuan draft bank and a museum of the tea-trade route. The streets host seasonal events, such as the lantern festival at Chinese New Year.
description: 昭馀古城位于山西晋中。游览特色包括博物馆、古城。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the middle of Qi County town, about 60 km south of central Taiyuan and 20 km north-east of Pingyao.

name: 汾河文化生态景区
summaryEn: A riverside park about 17 km long along the Fen River through Linfen, laid out around the idea of one river, five lakes, ten gardens and eighteen views. People's Daily describes it as combining themes of the Yao and Shun legends, river ecological restoration and everyday leisure, with museums and a library set among the planting. It is a city park rather than a historic site.
description: 汾河文化生态景区位于山西临汾。游览特色包括博物馆、滨水景观、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It runs along the Fen River on the west side of Linfen, and the pin is about 2 km west of central Linfen.

name: 古县牡丹文化园
summaryEn: A peony garden at Sanhe village in the hills of Gu county, built around an old peony plant that is acclaimed locally as the finest in China. Shanxi Daily gives the plant's age as more than 1,300 years and counted 621 blooms on that single plant in 2026. The grounds are laid out as a visitor park, so the spring flowering season is the time to go.
description: 古县牡丹文化园位于山西临汾。游览特色包括园林景观、休闲公园、赏花。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is at Sanhe, about 13 km south-east of Gu county town in the hills of Linfen.

name: 曲沃晋园
summaryEn: A landscaped park in Quwo county town, laid out as a classical-style garden on the culture of Jin, the ancient state of this region. It has a lake with timber boardwalks and Chinese-style pavilions, a large public plaza, a theatre and a conference hall, and it stages short historical plays built around Chinese idiom stories. It suits an easy hour or two for anyone visiting the Jin-period sites around Quwo.
description: 曲沃晋园位于山西临汾。游览特色包括湖泊、园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is in the east of Quwo county town, about 2 km from the centre and about 50 km south of central Linfen.

name: 龙澍峪
summaryEn: Longshuyu is a hill-country scenic area above Huangya village in Xiangling town, on the western edge of Xiangfen County.
