A county official describes its tourism as built around Zen Buddhist practice and mental well-being. A November 2024 Shanxi government release lists it, with the Dingcun museums, the Taosi site museum, Yaojing Winery and Lotus Town, among the attractions of a themed tourist route through Xiangfen.
description: 龙澍峪位于山西临汾。游览特色包括博物馆、葡萄酒文化、佛教文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is in the hills about 19 km north-west of Xiangfen county town.

name: 荷花小镇
summaryEn: A hot-spring leisure town beside the Fen River in Dengzhuang town, north of Xiangfen county town. Shanxi's culture and tourism department listed it in 2023 among the province's night-time culture and tourism consumption zones and named its hot springs among Shanxi's ten hot-spring wellness destinations, and it appears on a 2024 rural-tourism route through Linfen themed on ancestral roots.
description: 荷花小镇位于山西临汾。游览特色包括温泉、田园观光、寻根文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: It is beside the Fen River in Dengzhuang town, about 10 km north of Xiangfen county town.

name: 永和乾坤湾
summaryEn: Qiankun Bay is a stretch where the Yellow River winds in tight S-shaped meanders between Shanxi and Shaanxi, and this scenic area looks over it from the Shanxi bank in Yonghe County; a separate scenic area faces it across the river in Yanchuan, Shaanxi. Provincial authorities list the Yonghe bends among Shanxi's twenty notable geological relics, and the Yellow River No 1 tourist road runs through Yonghe County.
description: 永和乾坤湾位于山西临汾。游览特色包括地质景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is on the Shanxi bank of the Yellow River in Qiankunwan township, about 20 km west-south-west of Yonghe county town.

name: 七里峪景区
summaryEn: A mountain valley scenic area on the Huozhou side of Mount Huo, in Licao town east of Huozhou, with forested slopes and a ski area at its entrance. Provincial reports describe a forest-wellness town here and say it became a popular regional destination in summer 2026. Mount Huo is the central one of China's five traditional guardian mountains.
description: 七里峪景区位于山西临汾。游览特色包括山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is in Licao town, about 16 km east of Huozhou, in the hills below Mount Huo.

name: 人祖山
summaryEn: Renzu Mountain is a forested mountain area in Ji County, named for Fuxi and Nüwa, the legendary ancestors of humankind. Provincial media describe more than a hundred old temples and shrines on its slopes, of which the Renzu Temple, the Xuantian Shangdi Temple, the Kongshan Temple and the Beidou Qixing Temple are best known. The scenic area is developed as a mountain leisure destination, with walking trails and seasonal events such as a locust-blossom festival and an autumn-leaf festival.
description: 人祖山位于山西临汾。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It lies in the mountains about 17 km north of Ji County town.

name: 戎子酒庄
summaryEn: A winery estate in Xiangning County that makes red wines from vineyards on the Loess Plateau. Shanxi government media report a foreign media delegation being taken to the estate in 2025 to taste its wines, and the winery was listed in a 2025 notice of Shanxi time-honoured brands.
description: 戎子酒庄位于山西临汾。游览特色包括葡萄酒文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is about 6 km north-west of Xiangning county town.

name: 兴唐寺景区
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area on the Hongtong side of Mount Huo, named after Xingtangsi village. Mount Huo is the central one of China's five traditional guardian mountains, and the village was the site of the Zhongzhen Temple where the mountain god was honoured; it was demolished in 1970 with the neighbouring Xingtang Temple, and in 2012 only a side hall and a Ming stele survived. The area includes Yunshan Valley, named in 2023 as a national forest-wellness pilot site.
description: 兴唐寺景区位于山西临汾。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、山谷、山地游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is at Xingtangsi village in the hills about 25 km north-east of Hongtong county town.

name: 尧京酒庄
summaryEn: A wine estate in Shangxiliang village, Dadeng township, Xiangfen County, rated as a 4A scenic area. It combines vineyards, wine-making, a wine-culture display and countryside leisure, with a campsite. A November 2024 Shanxi government release lists it, with the Dingcun museums, the Taosi site museum, Lotus Town and Longshuyu, among the attractions of a themed tourist route through Xiangfen.
description: 尧京酒庄位于山西临汾。游览特色包括博物馆、葡萄酒文化、莲花观赏。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is in Dadeng township, about 13 km east of Xiangfen town and about 18 km south of central Linfen; the Taosi site museum is about 7 km to the west.

name: 寨圪塔康养景区
summaryEn: A health-and-wellness resort area in Zhaigeta township, in the hills east of Fushan county town. Shanxi media reported in 2023 that, helped by the building of southern Shanxi's wellness cluster, it had become a leisure destination for visitors from neighbouring provinces, and that it held food and farm-produce events over the autumn holiday. It is a modern resort development rather than a historic site.
description: 寨圪塔康养景区位于山西临汾。游览特色包括村寨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is in the hills of Zhaigeta township, about 20 km east of Fushan county town.

name: 白马仙洞
summaryEn: A cave on Jiufeng Hill at Donggou village in Wucheng town, south-east of Lishi, set among wooded hills. The Lüliang government says about 1,000 m of the cave is developed, with a drop of more than 260 m from the mouth to the lowest developed point, and its walls carry inscriptions dated 1121, 1337 and 1406 that mostly record rain prayers and exploration. Stalactites and other limestone formations line the passages, and the cave was a traditional place for rain-making rites.
description: 白马仙洞位于山西吕梁。游览特色包括林地风光、洞穴、钟乳石。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is at Donggou village in Wucheng town, about 19 km south-east of central Lüliang; the city government's page gives 27 km from the Lishi urban area and 8 km from the G307 road.

name: 大东沟景区
summaryEn: A forest leisure area in the Guandi Mountains in Xinyi town, in the hills north-east of Lishi, where the road climbs past Qiannian village into birch woods along a stream below Guji Mountain. It began operating in May 2023 and is laid out mainly for camping, with several camps, capsule-cabin lodging, forest-wellness activities and a restaurant, and in 2023 it was named a national forest-wellness pilot site. It suits a day trip or a camping night from Lüliang.
description: 大东沟景区位于山西吕梁。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The camps and the Linlu reception centre are on the S329 road about 35 km north-east of central Lüliang (Lishi). A tourist bus has run from the Xialouqiao terminus in Lishi by way of Qiannian to the scenic area, though it has been suspended in snowy weather.

name: 黑茶山四八烈士纪念地
summaryEn: A memorial museum at the foot of Mount Heicha in Xing county, built for the people killed when a flight from Chongqing to Yan'an crashed into the mountain in fog on 8 April 1946. Those killed included the Communist Party figures Wang Ruofei, Qin Bangxian (Bo Gu) and Deng Fa and the New Fourth Army commander Ye Ting. The halls hold portraits, biographies and stone memorial tablets, a pavilion marks the crash site on the summit, and a separate martyrs' cemetery for the Jinsui area lies at the south-west foot of the mountain.
description: 黑茶山四八烈士纪念地位于山西吕梁。游览特色包括博物馆、楼阁建筑、登山观景。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is at Zhuangshang village in Donghui township, about 30 km south-east of Xing county town in the Lüliang mountains; the museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 贾家庄文化生态旅游区
summaryEn: A tourist area built around Jiajiazhuang, a village north-east of Fenyang that was a national model for agriculture from the 1950s to the 1970s and has since turned to rural tourism. Its main street, Jia Street, opened in 2016: it is 533 m long with 240 shopfronts, including snack stalls, a bar street and an art corridor, built in old-street style on the old village site. The wider area adds folk-custom, farming-culture and Party-history themes.
description: 贾家庄文化生态旅游区位于山西吕梁。游览特色包括田园观光、农业体验、传统村落。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: It is at Jiajiazhuang, about 4 km north-east of the centre of Fenyang.

name: 金龙山风景区
summaryEn: A hillside complex of Buddhist and Daoist shrines at Xiatujing village, west of Xiaoyi, built around the site of an old Dragon King temple on the hilltop. Its listed sights include the Chongxiao Temple, a large Guanyin statue, the Wenchang Pavilion, a stepped approach called the Eighteen Steps of the Blue Cloud and the Jinlong Spring, and the site mixes Buddhist, Daoist and local filial-piety culture.
description: 金龙山风景区位于山西吕梁。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、楼阁建筑、佛教文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is at Xiatujing village in Gaoyang town, about 9 km west of the centre of Xiaoyi.

name: 胜溪湖森林公园
summaryEn: A large city park in Xiaoyi laid out around a lake, which Shanxi named a five-star urban park in 2013. Its design draws on Suzhou-style gardens, with lotus gardens, lakeside paths, pavilions and bridges, a gallery on filial-piety themes and a children's amusement area. It adjoins the Xiaohe wetland park to the west.
description: 胜溪湖森林公园位于山西吕梁。游览特色包括湿地、森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is in the south of Xiaoyi city, about 2 km from the centre.

name: 孝河国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A wetland park around a reservoir on the Xiao River on the western side of Xiaoyi, with a planned area of 5.47 sq km of which about 3.28 sq km is water. It has reed beds, lotus and water-lily ponds that flower in summer, and long wooden boardwalks, and it is a stopping place for migratory birds in spring. It adjoins Shengxi Lake Forest Park to the east.
description: 孝河国家湿地公园位于山西吕梁。游览特色包括湿地、森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is on the western side of Xiaoyi, about 4 km west of the city centre.

name: 金沙滩古战场
summaryEn: A themed park outside Huairen built around the folk story of the Yang family generals' legendary battle against the Liao at Jinshatan, the 'Golden Sand Beach'. It has reconstructions of a Song army camp gate and tents, a general's review platform with a group of stone figures of the Yang family, a hall for the family, a peony garden, and the Tianmen Array, a labyrinth with an underground section. Visitors can also try archery and period costume, and the park suits families and school groups interested in the story.
description: 金沙滩古战场位于山西朔州。游览特色包括海滨、园林景观、马术活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 8 km south-west of Huairen.

name: 东湖醋园
summaryEn: A visitor site at a Taiyuan vinegar maker, laid out as a working factory museum on how Shanxi aged vinegar is produced, with displays of both the traditional and the modern process. It has been named a national industrial-tourism demonstration base. It suits visitors interested in Shanxi's best-known condiment and in food heritage.
description: 东湖醋园位于山西太原。游览特色包括博物馆、工业参观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Madaopo Street in Xinghualing district, about 4 km east of central Taiyuan.

name: 汾河景区
summaryEn: A 43 km riverside park along the Fen River through Taiyuan, running from the low-water bridge at Shanlan in the north to about 2 km beyond Yingbin Bridge in the south and crossed by 24 bridges. North of Shengli Bridge about 17 km is natural wetland, while the 26 km to the south is a landscaped reservoir stretch; the park has two riverside cycle lanes, more than 40 cultural features and 165 recorded bird species. It suits a walk or a bike ride rather than a single visit point.
description: 汾河公园是在中华人民共和国山西省太原市万柏林区汾河两侧修建的公园。全长20.5千米。汾河公园因夹河而建，因此其中还建有人工复式河槽，并有堤坝将之分成清水渠和浑水渠两部分。
accessEn: The park follows the river through the west of Taiyuan, and the pin marks its central stretch, about 1 km west of central Taiyuan.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 六味斋云梦坞
summaryEn: The visitor area of the Liuweizhai food-factory park in Qingxu County, run by a Taiyuan food company founded in 1738 that is known for cooked meats. It combines factory viewing, a company history museum, hands-on food making, tasting, gardens and outdoor barbecue and camping areas, and it has been named a national industrial-tourism demonstration base. It suits families and study groups.
description: 六味斋云梦坞位于山西太原。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is on Xiangyun Street, just west of the G208 road, about 11 km south-east of Qingxu town and about 35 km south of central Taiyuan.

name: 青龙古镇
summaryEn: A group of Ming- and Qing-style buildings in Qinglong village, Yangqu County, presented as a tourist old town with temples, gardens, an ancestral hall and an underground passage, plus a food street and folk performances. It lies by the road that northern Shanxi towns use to reach Taiyuan. It suits a short stop on a day trip north of the city.
description: 青龙古镇位于山西太原。游览特色包括古镇、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Qinglong village, Houcun township, about 5 km south-west of Yangqu and about 19 km north-east of central Taiyuan.

name: 太原植物园
summaryEn: A botanical garden of about 2,730 mu (roughly 1.8 square kilometres) in Jinyuan district, opened in 2020 on land that had held coal depots and polluting factories. It has 25 themed plant gardens, a bonsai hall and three glasshouses under timber domes, the largest spanning 88 m, and part of a former coal-storage pit was turned into a lake. It suits a relaxed half day outdoors.
description: 太原植物园位于山西太原。游览特色包括湖泊、植物园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jinyuan district, about 16 km south-west of central Taiyuan.

name: 太原森林公园
summaryEn: A city forest park of 224 hectares on the northern edge of central Taiyuan, planned from 1990, with more than 100,000 trees around an artificial lake of 378 mu, an arboretum and a bird garden. The arboretum holds mostly native Shanxi species, and the bird garden keeps brown eared pheasants, peafowl, golden pheasants and ostriches. It suits a walk or picnic close to the city.
description: 太原森林公园位于山西太原。游览特色包括森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Datong Road in Jiancaoping district, about 5 km north of central Taiyuan.

name: 太原动物园
summaryEn: The city zoo of Taiyuan, in the north-east of the city, with about 2,000 animals in zones for birds, tropical and subtropical animals, primates and grassland herbivores. A new zone for medium-sized carnivores and small mammals opened on 1 October 2026, with North China leopards, white lions and red pandas. It suits families with children.
description: 太原动物园位于山西太原。游览特色包括草原、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xinghualing district, about 6 km north-east of central Taiyuan.

name: 紫林醋文化工业园
summaryEn: A vinegar-factory visitor site run by the Zilin vinegar company in Qingxu, the county titled China's vinegar capital, built around a vinegar museum. Taiyuan's authorities list it among the city's industrial-tourism sites and its old-brand museums. It suits visitors interested in Shanxi's vinegar industry.
description: 紫林醋文化工业园位于山西太原。游览特色包括博物馆、工业参观。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: On Taimao Road at Gaohua in Qingxu County, about 14 km south-east of Qingxu town and about 40 km south of central Taiyuan.

name: 代州古城
summaryEn: The walled town of Daixian, the seat of Dai County, whose walls were rebuilt in 1373 and are about 12 m high and 4.3 km round. Four gates once pierced the wall; the west gate tower, a corner tower and 1.2 km of the west wall have been rebuilt, and monuments such as the Bianjing Tower and the Ashoka pagoda stand in the streets inside. State media list Daizhou among the old towns of the Sino-Russian tea road, and Dai County is a national historic and cultural city.
description: 代州古城位于山西忻州。游览特色包括古城、古塔。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The rebuilt west wall and gate tower are on the western edge of Daixian, the seat of Dai County, which lies about 70 km north of Xinzhou city.

name: 憨山文化园
summaryEn: A hillside cultural tourism park of about 81 hectares in Shahe town, in the north of Fanshi County, on the northern approach to Mount Wutai. The Ministry of Culture and Tourism's rural-tourism route lists an art museum, a former county-government compound, a Hanshan temple and several plazas among its sights, and Shanxi's culture and tourism authorities list it among the province's clean-governance culture sites. It staged an evening 'night-tour carnival' over the 2025 Dragon Boat holiday.
description: 憨山文化园位于山西忻州。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shahe town, about 2 km north-north-west of the town centre and about 25 km north-east of Fanshi county town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 红门口地下长城
summaryEn: A network of narrow defensive tunnels dug in the 20th century around Shuiquan village in Pianguan County and known as the underground Great Wall. Visitors go in through a cave dwelling in an ordinary village courtyard and walk a restored section of more than a kilometre, much of it so low that visitors have to stoop. It lies on the Great Wall Number 1 tourist road, which links it with Great Wall sections and with Laoniuwan on the Yellow River.
description: 红门口地下长城位于山西忻州。游览特色包括长城、洞穴。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shuiquan village, about 25 km north-east of Pianguan, the county seat, along the Great Wall Number 1 tourist road.

name: 滹源景区
summaryEn: A riverside park on the Hutuo River at the southern edge of Fanshi county town, with paths along a broad stretch of water. The Hutuo rises in Fanshi County, which gives the park its name ('source of the Hutuo'), and local people use the banks for evening walks, when coloured lanterns light the water. It is a short urban stroll rather than a major sight.
description: 滹源景区位于山西忻州。游览特色包括滨水景观。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: In Fanshi county town, along the river on its southern side, about 95 km north-east of central Xinzhou.

name: 老牛湾
summaryEn: Laoniuwan is the village where the Yellow River enters Shanxi and the Great Wall meets the river, on the border with Inner Mongolia. An old fort stands above the village, and from it the view takes in a long reservoir lake created by the Wanjiazhai dam, below loess hills and Great Wall beacon towers. The Pianguan side is Shanxi's 4A scenic area; a separate scenic area of the same name lies across the river in Inner Mongolia.
description: 老牛湾位于山西忻州。游览特色包括长城、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km north of Pianguan, the county seat, in the village where the Great Wall Number 1 tourist road begins.

name: 宋家沟
summaryEn: A resettlement village built to rehouse residents of 14 poor mountain villages around Kelan, now run as a rural-tourism destination. Stone-paved lanes run between grey-tiled courtyard houses, some of them turned into guesthouses, and a greenhouse farm north of the village offers fruit and vegetable picking and craft and game activities for children. The Song-dynasty Great Wall, Heyeping meadow and Luya Mountain are among the sights nearby.
description: 宋家沟位于山西忻州。游览特色包括长城、田园观光、传统民居。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Songjiagou town, about 12 km south-east of Kelan, the county seat.

name: 汾河源头
summaryEn: The headwaters of the Fen River, the longest river in Shanxi and the second-longest tributary of the Yellow River, which rises in the Guancen Mountains of Ningwu County. The source area lies in a mountain valley at the foot of the Luya Mountain resort, and state media single out its clear, lively water. From here the river runs south through Taiyuan and on to the Yellow River.
description: 汾河源头位于山西忻州。游览特色包括山谷、河溪风光。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Luya Mountain resort, about 25 km south-west of Ningwu, the county seat, close to the resort's visitor centre.

name: 天涯山
summaryEn: A scenic area of granite peaks and a small lake east of Yuanping, built around the story of Jie Zitui, the Spring and Autumn official remembered for carrying his mother into the mountains. Sights include a drum-shaped boulder about 20 m across that sounds in the wind, a lotus-shaped peak above a lake with a 14.88 m white marble Guanyin, and a Ming-Qing shrine to Jie Zitui. A 13.88 m bronze statue of him stands in the filial-piety area, where the steps are carved with the twenty-four filial exemplars.
description: 天涯山位于山西忻州。游览特色包括湖泊、莲花观赏。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 8 km east of Yuanping, just across the Hutuo River.

name: 万年冰洞
summaryEn: A large natural ice cave in a forested gorge in the Luya Mountain area of Ningwu County. Xinzhou's tourism promotion names it alongside the forests of Luya Mountain as one of the area's main draws.
description: 万年冰洞位于山西忻州。游览特色包括峡谷、林地风光、洞穴。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Luya Mountain area, about 14 km west of Ningwu, the county seat.

name: 忻州古城
summaryEn: The restored old quarter of Xinzhou, once the walled town of Xiurong, where lanes and buildings were repaired and rebuilt in a programme that began in 2017. The same programme covered Xiurong Academy, a college founded in 1775 on a ridge at the south-west of the old town, with hillside pavilions dating from 1725 and 1819. State media describe the old town as a stop on the Sino-Russian tea road that keeps local intangible-heritage crafts alive.
description: 忻州古城位于山西忻州。游览特色包括古城、楼阁建筑、书院文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the old town in the middle of Xinzhou city, which lies about 60 km north of Taiyuan.

name: 云中河
summaryEn: A landscaped riverside area along the Yunzhong River, a tributary of the Hutuo, in the northern part of Xinzhou city. Lakes and planted banks line the water, and the provincial tourism department promotes the Yunzhong River hot springs on a 2026 summer wellness route. State media cite the area's calm, ecological setting alongside the Fen River source and the Yellow River gorge at Laoniuwan.
description: 云中河位于山西忻州。游览特色包括温泉、峡谷。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the northern part of Xinzhou city, about 7 km north-north-west of the city centre.

name: 禹王洞
summaryEn: A karst cave and national forest park in the hills south-east of Xinzhou, named for Yu the Great, the legendary tamer of floods. State media list it as one of the four national forest parks of Xinzhou and promote the cave as its main attraction, set among mountain forest.
description: 禹王洞位于山西忻州。游览特色包括洞穴、森林公园。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the hills near Xizhang, about 17 km south-east of Xinzhou city.

name: 翠枫山
summaryEn: A forested mountain scenic area south-west of Yangquan, with forest cover above 97 percent and more than 300 plant species recorded, including over 100 rare tree species. A walking route of about 5 km called the Green Wild Fairy Valley passes named gateways, an old tree and a valley, and the hillsides turn red and yellow with smoke trees and maples in autumn. A camping base opened in 2025 and a winter snow-play park in December 2025, so the area suits day walkers and families in both seasons.
description: 翠枫山位于山西阳泉。游览特色包括山谷、山地游览、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The temple courtyards at the mouth of the valley, near Houyu village in Pingtan town, are about 15 km south-west of central Yangquan; the walking route starts up the valley from there.

name: 大汖温泉度假村
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in a deep mountain valley in the far north of Yu County, with open-air pools in several themed zones and a reception building that has a lounge, cinema and spa rooms. The spring water comes from about 100 m underground at around 60 degrees Celsius and contains radon and sodium sulfate. Dachang ancient village, known for its stone houses, is a separate stop on the same rural-tourism route.
description: 大汖温泉度假村位于山西阳泉。游览特色包括温泉、古村落。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Liangjiazhai township, about 40 km north of Yu County town, in a deep valley of the Taihang Mountains.

name: 红岩岭
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in the Taihang Mountains in north-east Pingding County, beside the Hebei border, with a planned area of 40 km² and a core of 8 km² of peaks, pine forest and karst. Its best-known sight is Yuhuang Cave, a karst cave of five linked chambers called Dragon Palace, Crystal Palace, Jade Pool, Lingxiao Hall and Arhat Court, and a path leads up to a viewing platform on the ridge. It suits visitors who want a cave visit and a forest walk in the hills.
description: 红岩岭位于山西阳泉。游览特色包括洞穴、山地游览、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Chakou township in the north-east of Pingding County, about 35 km north-east of Pingding town and next to Hebei's Xiantaishan scenic area.

name: 华北奕丰生态园
summaryEn: A farm-based leisure park near Qianyuanji village in Niucun town, Yu County, developed from a coal company's transformation project. It has a large tree nursery, fruit-picking orchards, an agricultural science education camp, an animal exhibit of more than 40 species, fishing and a riding track, with a hotel and restaurants on site. It suits families and school groups looking for an easy rural day out.
description: 华北奕丰生态园位于山西阳泉。游览特色包括果园、农业体验、公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Qianyuanji village in Niucun town, about 6 km east of Yu County town.

name: 桃林沟
summaryEn: A peach-orchard park in the hills just north-west of central Yangquan, nicknamed the city's back garden, where old peach trees fill the valley. The peach blossom festival is held here each April, and the park also has a peach-blossom themed garden, a farm sightseeing and fruit-picking area, a 'water village' area and play areas for children. It suits families and day-trippers from the city.
description: 桃林沟位于山西阳泉。游览特色包括果园、山谷、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Pingtan town, about 4 km north-west of central Yangquan.

name: 小河古村
summaryEn: A hillside village on the eastern edge of Yangquan with Ming, Qing and Republican-era courtyard houses, about 178 courtyards in all, and the ancestral home of the modern writer Shi Pingmei. Among the buildings are the Shi family garden, a memorial exhibition to Shi Pingmei, a Guandi temple and a Guanyin nunnery, with carved stone, brick and wood decoration, and the village also keeps a small lake and old wells and millstones. It holds national status as a historic and cultural village and a traditional village, the first in Yangquan to do so.
description: 小河古村位于山西阳泉。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊、古村落。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yijing town on the eastern edge of the city, about 6 km east of central Yangquan.

name: 阳泉记忆·1947文化园
summaryEn: A cultural park built on the site of the former Yangquan Water Pump Factory and opened in 2021. The old E-shaped foundry halls now hold an exhibition on the city's recent past, with rebuilt shopfronts and streets of the 1970s to 1990s, a wall of local dialect, a city library and a display of the writer Liu Cixin's science fiction. There are also cafes, shops and a night market, and the park suits an easy evening in the city.
description: 文化园由原阳泉水泵厂厂址改造，厂区空间保留了当地工业发展留下的痕迹。
accessEn: On Nanzhuang Road in Yijing town, in the built-up centre of Yangquan.

name: 大禹渡
summaryEn: Dayudu is a ferry crossing on the Yellow River in the south of Ruicheng, facing Henan across the water and named for Yu the Great, the legendary flood-controller. The scenic area runs along the river bank and cliff, with a temple hall to Yu, an old cypress traditionally linked to him and Buddhist features. Beside it the Dayudu pumping scheme, built in the 1970s to lift river water for irrigation, still supplies irrigation water to most of Ruicheng's irrigated farmland.
description: 大禹渡位于山西运城。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、佛教文化、灌溉工程。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is on the Yellow River bank about 9 km south-east of Ruicheng, so it can be combined with a visit to Yongle Palace.

name: 堆云洞
summaryEn: A Taoist temple complex founded in the early Yuan dynasty, built in terraces of courtyards and cave rooms in a loess gully at Shangniu village in Shuitou town. In 1922 Jia Kangjie founded a secondary school at the temple, and in 1928 the Chinese Communist Party's Hedong Special Committee was formally set up here. It has been a provincial-level protected monument since 1985 and is used for patriotic education.
description: 堆云洞位于山西运城。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、洞穴。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 20 km north-north-west of Xiaxian, in a gully near Shangniu village in Shuitou town, and about 30 km north of central Yuncheng.

name: 凤凰谷
summaryEn: Fenghuang Valley is a forest park in the Zhongtiao hills just south of Yuncheng, in Yanhu District, made up of Fenghuang Mountain and five valleys, with walking trails and a viewing corridor on the ridge. Part of the park has been developed as a leisure resort, with amusement rides and, according to the city tourism bureau, a glass suspension bridge and a cableway.
description: 凤凰谷位于山西运城。游览特色包括森林公园、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The entrance is about 8 km south-east of central Yuncheng, just south of the ring expressway, and city buses run to it from the city.

name: 绛北大峡谷
summaryEn: A mountain gorge scenic area on Xiaobeishan in the Zhongtiao hills, in Moli township east of Jiang County, developed since 2012 around a river-rafting course of about 5 km through the canyon, which drops about 200 m. The park also has water-sports and adventure activities in summer and a snow-play area in winter.
description: 绛北大峡谷位于山西运城。游览特色包括峡谷、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 19 km east of Jiang County, in the hills of Moli township.

name: 稷山板枣公园
summaryEn: This park of old jujube orchards around Yao, Taoliang and Jijiazhuang villages, north-west of Jishan town, holds more than 17,000 ancient jujube trees, many around a thousand years old. Since 2022 the villages have also been developed as a farm-tourism area with a jujube museum, a staged show performed largely by local jujube farmers, a sightseeing train and a children's dinosaur park. Autumn is the picking season, and the park holds a harvest festival.
description: 稷山板枣公园位于山西运城。游览特色包括博物馆、果园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The park's villages lie about 4 km north-west of Jishan, the county seat, and about 65 km north of central Yuncheng.

name: 历山风景区
summaryEn: Lishan is a mountain scenic area in the south-east of Yuanqu County, made up of sections with separate entrances: Shunwangping, the meadow on the 2,358 m main summit, named for the legendary sage-king Shun, whom Chinese tradition places farming on Mount Li; Huangguman, the second-highest peak at 2,134 m; and Mihouyuan, where a large colony of wild macaques gathers. Shunwangping's subalpine meadow is nicknamed the 'grassland in the clouds', and a fourth section lies on the Xiaolangdi reservoir on the Yellow River. This is the Yuanqu side of Mount Li; the Qinshui side, in Jincheng, has its own scenic area.
description: 历山风景区位于山西运城。游览特色包括山地游览、农业体验、登山观景。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: The area lies about 30 km north-east of Yuanqu and about 100 km north-east of central Yuncheng, with its sections linked by mountain roads, and it is usually open only from April to October.

name: 圣天湖
summaryEn: A lake on the Yellow River shore in Ruicheng County, run as a leisure scenic area with lakeside paths and boating. The main seasonal draw is winter, when wild white swans gather from about November, with numbers rising through December before they leave in late February or early March; the beach they use is fenced off from visitors. It suits a relaxed half-day outing, especially for bird-watching.
description: 圣天湖位于山西运城。游览特色包括湖泊、海滨。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: It lies on the Yellow River shore about 20 km east of Ruicheng and about 35 km south of central Yuncheng.

name: 神潭大峡谷
summaryEn: Shentan Grand Canyon is a gorge scenic area in the Zhongtiao Mountains just south of Yongji. In spring 2026 it reopened as 'Shentan · Bull Demon King Carefree Valley', an immersive attraction themed on the novel Journey to the West, with evening performances and a food street.
description: 神潭大峡谷位于山西运城。游览特色包括峡谷、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is on the southern edge of Yongji, about 3 km south-west of the city centre, and about 55 km south-west of central Yuncheng.

name: 望仙大峡谷
summaryEn: Wangxian Grand Canyon is a gorge scenic area in Wangxian village, in the hills of south-eastern Yuanqu County, where a stream cuts through a narrow rock canyon. Its main sights are the chain of waterfalls and pools known as the Three Pools of Wangxian and, at the head of the gorge, the Houhe reservoir. It lies in the same township as the Lishan scenic area, so the two can be combined.
description: 望仙大峡谷位于山西运城。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 17 km east of Yuanqu, up a valley road in the hills of Lishan township.

name: 黄河大梯子崖
summaryEn: A zigzag stone stairway cut by hand into a sheer cliff on the Yellow River bank in Banpo village, Xiahua township, is the centrepiece of this scenic area; the provincial tourism department dates it to more than 1,500 years ago. The steps are between about 2 and 4 m wide, and the chisel marks are still clear on the cliff face. A path along the top leads on to a stream valley with small waterfalls, and the summit looks down on the Yellow River as it comes out through the Shimen ('Stone Gate') gorge.
description: 黄河大梯子崖位于山西运城。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、登山观景。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: The entrance is at the foot of the cliff on the Yellow River No. 1 tourist road, about 15 km north-west of Hejin and about 100 km by road north-west of central Yuncheng.

name: 黄河龙门
summaryEn: At Yumenkou the Yellow River leaves the long Shanxi–Shaanxi gorge and widens onto the plain, the spot behind the saying about carp leaping the Dragon Gate to become dragons. The village-run scenic area has a street built in Ming and Qing style, a boat route up the river gorge, a viewing platform on Longmen hill and a monument to the Yumenkou campaign of the Anti-Japanese War. Seven bridges of different types span the river here, from an iron-chain bridge first built in 1949 to modern cable-stayed spans.
description: 黄河龙门位于山西运城。游览特色包括峡谷、观景台。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is on the east bank of the Yellow River at Yumenkou, about 12 km north-west of Hejin, where the G108 road crosses into Shaanxi.

name: 古居延泽
summaryEn: Ancient Juyan Marsh is a scatter of small lakes among dunes and red-grass flats in Ejin Banner, in the old Juyan area. The Ejin Banner authorities promote it for its sunset views over the lakes, which they call 'Sunset on Nine Lakes', and for the Tang poet Wang Wei's lines about Juyan.
description: 额济纳旗古居延一带散布着小型湖泊，湖泽、沙丘与红草滩相间。
accessEn: About 44 km east of Dalaihubu, the Ejin Banner seat.

name: 东风航天城
summaryEn: Dongfeng Space City is the tourism name for the area around the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center in Ejin Banner, the launch site for China's crewed Shenzhou spacecraft. Ejin Banner and national ethnic-affairs materials describe it as a national study-tour demonstration base and one of the first ten science-tourism bases in China, and recall how the Ejin people moved their banner seat three times from 1958 to give up their best pastureland for the site. Access to the launch centre itself is controlled; the banner's publicity department has advertised launch-viewing trips from a designated viewing point at Bayan Bogd in Dongfeng town.
description: 东风航天城位于内蒙古阿拉善。游览特色包括航天科普。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The pin marks the Dongfeng Revolutionary Martyrs' Cemetery in the Dongfeng area, about 126 km south-south-west of Dalaihubu, the Ejin Banner seat; a launch-viewing trip advertised by the Ejin Banner publicity department in April 2024 was open only to holders of a PRC resident identity card, so foreign visitors should check the current rules before planning.

name: 腾格里达来月亮湖
summaryEn: Tengger Dalai Moon Lake is a lake of about three square kilometres in the heart of the Tengger Desert, with a dark-sand beach about a kilometre long on one shore. A lakeside resort runs activities including dune-bashing in six-wheeled vehicles, go-karts, sandboarding, paragliding, camel and horse riding and boating. It suits a desert-and-lake day trip or overnight stay from Bayanhot.
description: 腾格里达来月亮湖位于内蒙古阿拉善。游览特色包括沙漠、湖泊、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 64 km south-west of Bayanhot, the Alxa League seat, on a paved road that runs to the resort's reception; check that it is open before going.

name: 腾格里沙漠天鹅湖
summaryEn: Swan Lake is a narrow lake on the eastern edge of the Tengger Desert, ringed by dunes with oleaster trees along its shore. Migratory swans and other waterbirds stop here in spring and autumn, and the ger camp beside the lake offers meals, overnight stays and activities such as sandboarding, camel and horse riding and boating. It suits a short desert-and-lake trip from Bayanhot.
description: 腾格里沙漠天鹅湖位于内蒙古阿拉善。游览特色包括沙漠、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 41 km west-south-west of Bayanhot, the Alxa League seat.

name: 通湖草原
summaryEn: Tonghu is a sandy lake basin in the south of the Tengger Desert, with reeds, grass and scrub around its lakes and dunes on all sides. Visitors stay in ger groups and camp tents, ride camels or horses, and can take a camel trek north into the dunes to an artificial oasis. The scenic area looks across the sand to Shapotou in Ningxia.
description: 通湖草原位于内蒙古阿拉善。游览特色包括沙漠、草原、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 18 km west-north-west of Tengger Els, a town of Alxa Left Banner, and about 150 km south-south-west of Bayanhot.

name: 百灵那达慕园区
summaryEn: Bailing Naadam Park is a purpose-built festival ground on the edge of Bailingmiao, with an oval racecourse, a main grandstand for about 11,000 people, six stables holding 360 horses and a sales area for local goods. It hosts the Damao Banner's summer Naadam, whose programme includes the traditional wrestling, archery and horse racing; the 34th festival opened here on 19 July 2024 and the 35th on 31 July 2025. It suits visitors timing a trip to the festival, whose dates change each year.
description: 百灵那达慕园区位于内蒙古包头。游览特色包括节庆文化、马术活动。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the south-eastern edge of Bailingmiao, about 5 km east-south-east of the centre of the town, the Damao Banner seat.

name: 包钢工业旅游区
summaryEn: The tour area is run by the Baotou Iron and Steel (Baogang) group at its works in Kundulun District, one of the three large steel complexes begun in the 1950s. Its route takes in an exhibition on the story of building Baogang, a steam-locomotive display, a culture hall and plaza at Blast Furnace 1, which tapped its first iron on 26 September 1959 with Premier Zhou Enlai at the opening ceremony twenty days later, and, by arrangement, views of working production lines. It was named a National Industrial Tourism Demonstration Base in 2022 and suits visitors interested in heavy industry and the history of Baotou.
description: 包钢工业旅游区位于内蒙古包头。游览特色包括工业参观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Hexi industrial zone of Kundulun District, on the west side of Baotou; viewing of the working lines depends on the production schedule and is arranged in advance.

name: 敕勒川风景区
summaryEn: Chilechuan Scenic Area is a group of sights in Tumed Right Banner, covering about 16 square kilometres between the Daqing Mountains and the Yellow River. Its anchor is the Chilechuan Museum in Salaqi, a branch of the Inner Mongolia Museum with galleries on regional history, local revolutionary history and folk culture; the area also takes in Jiufeng Mountain, an orchard-picking and village-life area at Dayantan, a liquor-making culture park and a leather and fur market. It suits visitors who want a museum visit combined with outings from Baotou or Hohhot.
description: 敕勒川风景区位于内蒙古包头。游览特色包括博物馆、果园、民俗文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The museum is in Salaqi, the Tumed Right Banner seat, about 58 km east of the centre of Baotou; it is closed on Wednesdays.

name: 春坤山
summaryEn: Chunkunshan is a mountain area of about 30 square kilometres in Guyang County, the highest range in Baotou, with a main peak of 2,340 metres. Its upper slopes are gently rounded and carry extensive alpine meadow, while the steeper flanks have rock outcrops, birch stands and caves; named sights include Hongqi Peak, a herb garden and a cave gully. It suits hikers and day visitors from Baotou.
description: 春坤山位于内蒙古包头。游览特色包括园林景观、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the east of Guyang County, about 46 km east of Jinshan, the county seat, and about 75 km east-north-east of Baotou.

name: 花舞人间
summaryEn: Huawu Renjian is a commercial leisure park in the hills of the Xiguitu new district of Shiguai District, modelled on a park of the same name near Chengdu. It combines urban-farming plots and a children's creative farm with a castle-style play area, a lawn wedding venue, a winery and a French-style small town. It is a modern attraction built for families and day-trippers from Baotou rather than a historic site.
description: 花舞人间位于内蒙古包头。游览特色包括葡萄酒文化、农业体验、公园休闲。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Xiguitu new district, Shiguai District, on Kangzhuang Avenue, about 18 km east of the centre of Baotou; check that it is open before going.

name: 吉穆斯泰
summaryEn: Jimusitai, which Chinese sources render as Huaguoshan or 'Flower-and-Fruit Mountain', is a group of rocky hills with weathered stone formations in Damao Banner. Walking trails of about 4 km run through the 'stone forest' and past old elm trees to the Bayanbaogeda obo, a stone-cairn shrine, and horse riding, archery and horse shows are among the activities on offer. It suits visitors who want hill scenery and Mongolian culture on a trip from Bailingmiao.
description: 吉穆斯泰位于内蒙古包头。游览特色包括石林、林地风光、马术活动。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Damao Banner, about 22 km west of Bailingmiao by road, on the way towards Bayan Obo.

name: 梅力更
summaryEn: Meilegen is a mountain valley on the south side of the Wula Mountains in Jiuyuan District, with a Gelug-school lamasery at its mouth and a stream, cypress woods and waterfalls further up; one waterfall drops about 60 metres. The lamasery, Meilegen Zhao (Guangfa Temple), was a centre of the Mongolian-language Buddhist chanting tradition of the Urad Mongols, and the valley was historically a route through the Yin Mountains. It suits hikers and visitors interested in Mongolian Buddhist heritage who want a half-day outing from Baotou.
description: 梅力更位于内蒙古包头。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Meilegen, Agarutai sumu, Jiuyuan District, about 33 km west of the centre of Baotou and about 1 km north of the G110 road.

name: 南海湿地
summaryEn: Nanhai Wetland lies on the north bank of the Yellow River at the southern edge of Baotou's Donghe District, a lake and floodplain wetland that formed after the river shifted south. About 2,990 hectares in all, it takes in a provincial wetland nature reserve and Baotou Yellow River National Wetland Park, with Nanhai Lake and Erhaizi lake fringed by reeds and open woodland and grass. Lakeside paths, viewpoints and a sand beach make it an easy half-day outing from the city.
description: 南海湿地位于内蒙古包头。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊、自然保护区。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Erlibansi area on the south side of Donghe District, at the southern edge of Baotou's urban area.

name: 北方兵器城
summaryEn: Northern Weapon City is an open-air display of retired weapons set in a landscaped park with lakes in Baotou's Qingshan District, planned and set up by the Beizhong Group (Northern Heavy Industries), part of China North Industries Group. It shows more than 40 pieces, including artillery, armoured vehicles, aircraft, missiles and steam locomotives, among them the first anti-aircraft gun, missile and jet fighter developed in China. It is listed as a National Industrial Tourism Demonstration Base under the name Northern Heavy Industries Industrial Tourism Zone and suits visitors interested in military and industrial history.
description: 包头青山区的公园展示退役装备，露天展区与湖面、园林步道相连。
accessEn: In Qingshan District, on Bingong Road, in the north-east of Baotou's urban area.

name: 赛汗塔拉城中草原
summaryEn: Saihan Tala is a large area of native grassland in the middle of Baotou, protected by a city regulation since 2007 and covering about 10,680 mu (roughly 7 square kilometres) as of 2020. Cattle and sheep graze on it, and deer and more than 30 species of wild animals live in the park. It suits visitors who want to walk or sit on open grassland without leaving the city.
description: 赛汗塔拉城中草原位于内蒙古包头。游览特色包括草原、动物观赏。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It lies in Jiuyuan District, in the centre of Baotou.

name: 诗画草原
summaryEn: Shihua Grassland is a purpose-built tourist camp on open steppe in Damao Banner, made up of arcs of white ger-style buildings around landscaped plazas. In 2022 Baotou named it one of the first seven night-time culture and tourism consumption zones in the city, and in 2024 it was a branch venue of the banner's Naadam festival. It is a modern commercial development rather than a traditional encampment, suited to visitors who want an organised grassland outing near Bailingmiao.
description: 诗画草原位于内蒙古包头。游览特色包括草原、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dabuxilatu village, about 20 km east of Bailingmiao, the Damao Banner seat.

name: 丝路梦郡
summaryEn: Silu Mengjun is a purpose-built tourist complex on the grassland near Xilamuren town in Damao Banner, laid out as a compound of ger-style buildings around central plazas. In 2022 Baotou named it one of the first seven night-time culture and tourism consumption zones in the city, and in 2024 it was a branch venue of the banner's Naadam festival. It is a modern commercial development, suited to visitors who want an organised grassland outing with an evening programme.
description: 丝路梦郡位于内蒙古包头。游览特色包括草原、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Hudiansu village near Xilamuren town, about 72 km east-south-east of Bailingmiao, the Damao Banner seat.

name: 河套农耕文化博览园
summaryEn: The Hetao Agricultural Culture Expo Park is a farming-themed attraction in Wuyuan County, built by a local agricultural company within the Baliqiao farm-tourism complex. Its Hetao Farming Museum shows more than 6,000 farm tools from the Stone Age to the present day, and the grounds include a 476-metre model of the Yellow River, a solar-terms square and greenhouses. It is used for school study tours and suits families with children.
description: 河套农耕文化博览园位于内蒙古巴彦淖尔。游览特色包括博物馆、田园观光、农业体验。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Baliqiao complex, about 7 km south-west of Longxingchang, the Wuyuan county seat, and about 79 km east-north-east of Linhe, the Bayannur city seat.

name: 河套酒业工业旅游区
summaryEn: The Hetao Liquor Industrial Tourism Area is a factory-visit attraction at the Hetao liquor company's distillery in Shanba, the Hanggin Rear Banner seat. The Hetao brand grew out of a distillery founded there in 1952, is listed as a China Time-honoured Brand, and is best known for its baijiu. It suits visitors interested in how local spirits are made.
description: 河套酒业工业旅游区位于内蒙古巴彦淖尔。游览特色包括工业参观、酿造文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Heju Road in Shanba, about 23 km north-west of Linhe, the Bayannur city seat. Check that it is open before going.

name: 纳林湖
summaryEn: Nalin Lake is a reed-fringed lake and wetland on the Nalintaohai farm in Dengkou County, at the western edge of the Hetao plain. It is run as an ecotourism area, and Bayannur's official food-themed tourism route lists the fish meals served beside it. It suits a short lakeside stop rather than a full day.
description: 纳林湖位于内蒙古巴彦淖尔。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 40 km north-west of Bayan Gol, the Dengkou County seat, on the Nalintaohai farm. Check that it is open before going.

name: 乌兰布和沙海湖
summaryEn: The Ulan Buh Sand Sea Lake tourist area lies at the eastern end of the Ulan Buh Desert in Hanggin Rear Banner, where dunes meet a lake, with the Yin Mountains to the north and the Yellow River to the south. It offers sandboarding, rides by camel or dune buggy, desert camping and evening bonfires, and has hosted events such as a desert Naadam. It has been developed as a tourism area since 2015.
description: 乌兰布和沙海湖位于内蒙古巴彦淖尔。游览特色包括沙漠、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At the north end of the lake, within the Taiyangmiao Farm area at the east end of the Ulan Buh Desert, about 36 km west-south-west of Shanba, the Hanggin Rear Banner seat. Check that it is open before going.

name: 五原抗战纪念园
summaryEn: The Wuyuan Anti-Japanese War Memorial Park commemorates the Wuyuan campaign of early 1940, in which Chinese forces under Fu Zuoyi retook Wuyuan, Linhe and Shanba from Japanese forces after about two months of fighting. The park holds the Inner Mongolia Anti-Japanese War Memorial Hall and a street laid out for urban-fighting displays. It suits visitors interested in the war in northern China and in Bayannur's local history.
description: 五原抗战纪念园位于内蒙古巴彦淖尔。游览特色包括纪念展览、历史纪念。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 2 km north of the centre of Longxingchang, the Wuyuan County seat, which is about 85 km east-north-east of Linhe.

name: 敖汉温泉城
summaryEn: A hot-spring health resort at Reshuitang village in the hills of south-west Aohan Banner, about 695 m above sea level beside planted pine woods. The spring comes out at about 68°C and is rich in radon, and the wellness complex includes a Mongolian and Chinese medicine hospital. It suits a spa stay rather than sightseeing.
description: 敖汉温泉城位于内蒙古赤峰。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 40 km south of Xinhui, the Aohan Banner seat, in Sijiazi town.

name: 大光顶子
summaryEn: A wind-themed leisure resort on high grassland in Hexigten Banner, set among wind turbines. It combines an amusement park, a windmill-themed park, a ski area and flower fields, and hosts a music festival and a kite festival. It suits families and groups looking for rides and events rather than quiet scenery.
description: 大光顶子位于内蒙古赤峰。游览特色包括草原、主题游乐、花卉观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 71 km south-south-east of Jingpeng, the Hexigten Banner seat, on upland grassland among wind turbines.

name: 道须沟
summaryEn: Daoxugou is a forested valley scenic area inside the Heilihe National Nature Reserve in the far west of Ningcheng County, covering about 1,180 hectares. Its sights include a granite 'stone-sea' forest and glacial features such as ice potholes, boulders left by glaciers and stone rivers, together with lakes, a waterwheel park, a yurt-style park and walking trails through the woods. It suits walkers and photographers who are prepared for a long drive into the mountains.
description: 道须沟位于内蒙古赤峰。游览特色包括自然保护区、冰川。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Heilihe nature reserve in western Ningcheng, about 12 km west-north-west of Heilihe town and about 84 km west of Tianyi, the Ningcheng county seat.

name: 美林谷滑雪场
summaryEn: A ski resort in the mountains of Harqin Banner with eight runs, three for beginners and five for intermediate and advanced skiers, and a 194-room hotel. It was a venue for the alpine skiing and snowboard events of the 14th National Winter Games in 2024 and hosted the opening snowboard parallel giant slalom races of the 2024–25 FIS World Cup in late 2024, on a run certified by the International Ski Federation. It suits skiers and snowboarders, from beginners upwards.
description: 美林谷滑雪场位于内蒙古赤峰。游览特色包括滑雪。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Meilin town, about 46 km south-west of Jinshan, the Harqin Banner seat.

name: 玉龙沙湖
summaryEn: A lake among dunes at the western edge of the Horqin Sandy Land in Ongniud Banner, with grassland, wetland, rock outcrops and pine stands nearby. It is named after the Hongshan-culture jade dragon unearthed in the area in 1971 and known as China's first dragon. Activities include sightseeing around the lake and off-road driving on the dunes.
description: 玉龙沙湖位于内蒙古赤峰。游览特色包括湿地、草原、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 14 km north-north-east of Wudan, the Ongniud Banner seat.

name: 真寂之寺石窟（召庙）
summaryEn: The Zhenji Temple grottoes are three Liao-dynasty caves cut into a cliff face in a valley in the hills south of Lindong, with a Qing-dynasty lamasery, Shanfu Temple, built against them; locally the place is called Zhaomiao. The central cave, whose lintel is inscribed "Zhenji Zhi Si", holds a reclining Buddha with mourning disciples and over a hundred small Buddha figures on its walls, the south cave has a Buddha flanked by Manjushri on a lion and Samantabhadra on an elephant, and the north cave has two chambers with relief figures. The Zhaomiao scenic area around them covers about 60 square kilometres of rock outcrops and temple buildings in the Qiguoshan National Geopark.
description: 真寂之寺石窟（召庙）位于内蒙古赤峰。游览特色包括石窟造像、寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In a valley about 12 km south of Lindong, the Bairin Left Banner seat.

name: 紫蒙湖
summaryEn: A reservoir in the hills of Ningcheng County, known as Dahushi Reservoir until it was renamed Zimeng Lake in 2010, with a water surface of about 600 hectares. The south shore has boat rides and water activities, and the north shore has a children's play castle, a rainbow slide, a water-play park, barbecue and camping areas, evening light shows, an exhibition hall and a folk museum. It suits families after a day of water play.
description: 紫蒙湖位于内蒙古赤峰。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 60 km west-south-west of Tianyi, the Ningcheng county seat, where Heilihe and Youbeiping towns meet; the scenic area is closed from November to April, apart from a winter fishing festival on the lake.

name: 奥伦布坎
summaryEn: Aolunbukan is a forest tourism area of about 292 square kilometres in the Greater Khingan hills near Bailang town, Arxan, with primeval forest, volcanic lava terrain, wetland and streams. An upgrade in 2026 added ten staged scenes along its trails, rafting on its natural river and UTV routes through forest and lava field. It suits visitors adding half a day to an Arxan trip.
description: 奥伦布坎位于内蒙古兴安。游览特色包括湿地、林地风光、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Bailang town, about 27 km south-south-east of Arxan.

name: 阿尔山口岸
summaryEn: The scenic area is built around Arxan Port, a road port of entry in the forested Greater Khingan hills west of Arxan. The port became a class I port in 2012, was closed from the end of 2019 and reopened on 3 April 2023. It suits visitors to Arxan with half a day to spare.
description: 阿尔山口岸是中华人民共和国内蒙古自治区的一个陆路边境口岸，位于兴安盟阿尔山市天池镇境内，并与蒙古国东方省的松贝尔口岸相接。该口岸在1992年以二类口岸性质向外开放通关，并于2012年获升格为一类口岸。
accessEn: About 36 km west-north-west of Arxan town, at the port of entry.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 海神圣泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in the centre of Arxan, built over the town's mineral springs, with spa pools, a rehabilitation hospital and the China Hot Spring Museum, which opened in 2004. Arxan takes its name from the Mongolian for 'hot holy water', and the town's springs range from cold to very hot. It suits visitors who want to soak after hiking in the forest park.
description: 海神圣泉位于内蒙古兴安。游览特色包括博物馆、温泉、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Wenquan (Hot Spring) sub-district in the centre of Arxan.

name: 翰嘎利湖
summaryEn: Hangali Lake is a lake just north of Bayan Huxu in Horqin Right Middle Banner, with a leisure resort on its eastern shore. It is one of the stops on the banner's tourist circuit, with the maple forest and the Tushiyetu prince's palace. It suits visitors who want a short lakeside stop in the banner.
description: 翰嘎利湖位于内蒙古兴安。游览特色包括湖泊、林地风光、休闲度假。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 7 km north of Bayan Huxu, the Horqin Right Middle Banner seat.

name: 内蒙古民族解放纪念馆
summaryEn: The memorial hall in Ulanhot, the city where the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Government was founded in 1947, was built to mark the autonomous region's 60th anniversary and opened in August 2007. It also manages the May First Site, the Inner Mongolia Working Committee office and the Ulanhu office, which together are known as the 'one hall, three sites'. It suits visitors interested in modern Inner Mongolian history and can be combined with the other sites in the city.
description: 内蒙古民族解放纪念馆位于内蒙古兴安。游览特色包括纪念展览、民族文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At the east end of Kuangquan Street, south-west of the municipal government square in Ulanhot; the hall is closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 天骄天骏
summaryEn: Tianjiao Tianjun is an eco-tourism resort on the hill of Tianjun at the northern edge of Ulanhot, close to an expressway interchange. The hill, bared by stone quarrying, was replanted by the local government and opened as a scenic area. It has terraced planting, visitor buildings and a viewing platform, and suits residents and passing visitors who want a short outing from the city.
description: 天骄天骏位于内蒙古兴安。游览特色包括观景台。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At the northern edge of Ulanhot, about 7 km north of the city centre. Check that it is open before going.

name: 乌兰毛都草原
summaryEn: Ulan Maodu is a rolling hill grassland in the north-west of Horqin Right Front Banner, crossed by the winding Jiuqu River. Visitors eat Mongolian food in gers, and the grassland hosts riding, costume and music events, including the Hinggan League Naadam in August 2023, which drew more than 220,000 visitors. It suits visitors who want open grassland in Hinggan.
description: 乌兰毛都草原位于内蒙古兴安。游览特色包括草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Ulan Maodu sumu, about 113 km west-north-west of Horqin, the banner seat, and about 119 km west-north-west of Ulanhot.

name: 五角枫
summaryEn: The scenic area is a large stand of painted maples (wujiaofeng) scattered through open woodland on the Daichintala grassland in Horqin Right Middle Banner. The leaves turn red, purple and orange in early October, and the banner runs a maple tourism season with a camping ground, guesthouses and cultural events. It suits visitors in the first half of October, and is usually visited together with the Tushiyetu palace and Hangali Lake.
description: 五角枫位于内蒙古兴安。游览特色包括草原、湖泊、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the north of Horqin Right Middle Banner, about 20 km north of Bayan Huxu, the banner seat, near the Tushiyetu prince's palace.

name: 中影制作基地
summaryEn: Zhongying Film Production Base is a film-set complex of streets and buildings next to the Tushiyetu prince's palace in Horqin Right Middle Banner, open to visitors as a tourist site. The palace, the seat of the Qing prince of the banner, stands a few hundred metres away and is a separate attraction. Visitors travelling the banner's circuit of maple forest, palace and lake can fit the film base in as a short stop.
description: 中影制作基地位于内蒙古兴安。游览特色包括湖泊、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Horqin Right Middle Banner, about 18 km north of Bayan Huxu, the banner seat, beside the Tushiyetu prince's palace.

name: 奥威马文化生态旅游区
summaryEn: Aowei is a horse-culture park of about 1,542 mu (roughly 100 hectares), set up in 2014 at Qiganqi village in Shengle town, with a racecourse for up to 20,000 spectators, stables and a riding ground. Visitors can feed, groom and ride horses, take riding lessons and watch staged horse shows and parades, and the park also has a children's playground, a boating lake and a horse museum. It suits families and school groups wanting hands-on time with horses within a day trip of Hohhot.
description: 奥威马文化生态旅游区位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is at Qiganqi village in Shengle town, about 28 km north of Chengguan, the Horinger county seat, and about 25 km south-south-east of central Hohhot.

name: 大黑河军事文化乐园
summaryEn: Daheihe Military Culture Park is a themed leisure park on the Daheihe river in Saihan District, on the south-eastern side of Hohhot. It has a flower-field zone and serves as an events ground: its winter ice-and-snow festival has an ice castle, ice-sculpture lanterns and a food market, and the park was the main venue for the opening of Inner Mongolia's 2026 Spring Festival tourism programme and for parts of the Zhaojun Culture Festival. It suits local families and visitors in Hohhot during the festival seasons.
description: 大黑河军事文化乐园位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括历史纪念、雕塑艺术、节庆文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: It is in Jinhe town in Saihan District, on Kerqin South Road near Yongshun Street, about 10 km south-east of central Hohhot.

name: 大青山抗日游击根据地旧址旅游区
summaryEn: The Daqing Mountains around Deshenggou village in Wuchuan County were the core of the Daqingshan anti-Japanese guerrilla base, set up in 1938 by an Eighth Route Army force that marched north from Shanxi. The tourism area includes the old command-post site in Deshenggou village at about 2,000 m and an exhibition hall on the base's history, with farmstays in nearby villages. Chinese historical accounts record more than 500 engagements with Japanese and puppet forces in the area between 1938 and 1942.
description: 大青山抗日游击根据地旧址旅游区位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括主题展览、历史旧址。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is in Deshenggou township in the Daqing Mountains of Wuchuan County, about 47 km west-north-west of Hohhot and about 22 km west-south-west of Kekeyiligen, the county seat; the exhibition hall is closed on Mondays.

name: 大青山太伟运动休闲度假区
summaryEn: Daqingshan Taiwei Sports and Leisure Resort is a resort in the foothills of the Daqing Mountains in Baoheshao town, on the north-eastern edge of Hohhot. The city's culture and tourism bureau lists it as one of Hohhot's three ski areas, alongside Mazongshan and Northern Lights. It suits winter visitors who want to ski within a short drive of the city.
description: 大青山太伟运动休闲度假区位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括运动休闲、休闲度假。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is in Baoheshao town, Xincheng District, in the Daqing Mountains about 13 km north-north-east of central Hohhot.

name: 大青山野生动物园
summaryEn: Daqingshan Wildlife Park is a zoo of about 12,300 mu (roughly 8 square kilometres) on the northern edge of Hohhot, set against the Daqing Mountains and open since 2006. It holds around 100 species in themed animal areas. It suits families with children.
description: 大青山野生动物园位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is in Youyouban town, Huimin District, on the northern edge of Hohhot, about 12 km west-north-west of central Hohhot.

name: 大盛魁博物馆集群
summaryEn: The Dashengkui Museum Cluster is a group of small museums in courtyard buildings in the style of Qing-dynasty houses, in the old town of Hohhot. It is themed on Dashengkui, the Shanxi merchant house that traded with the Mongolian plateau and Russia until it collapsed in 1929. The district government describes seven themed halls with reconstructed street scenes of the Dashengkui shop, a money-shop and a tea house, and displays of camel-caravan account books and merchants' contracts; the Inner Mongolia Morin Khuur Art Museum is in the north section.
description: 大盛魁博物馆集群位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括博物馆、历史建筑、历史街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is in the old town in Yuquan District at the junction of Daxi Street and Desheng Street, about 500 m north-east of Dazhao Temple.

name: 草原之门
summaryEn: A cultural-tourism complex built from 2020 in the town of Wuchuan by Yangufang, an oat-food company. Its themed halls cover the tea road, grassland life, ethnic culture, dairy foods and oats, and it also has a Russian-style hall, a food street built in Northern Wei style, restaurants and an evening tourism zone. It is a modern commercial development rather than a historic site, and suits visitors passing through Wuchuan on the road north to the Xilamuren and Gegentala grasslands.
description: 草原之门位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括草原、民族文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is in Kekeyiligen, the Wuchuan County seat, about 40 km north-west of Hohhot (about 48 km by road); check that it is open before going.

name: 呼和浩特雕塑艺术馆
summaryEn: Opened on 14 October 2023, the Hohhot Sculpture Art Museum is a grass-roofed building of 25,000 sq m on a 7.35-hectare site in eastern Hohhot, with a main sculpture hall, thematic galleries, artists' studios, a cafe and a gift shop. It opened with the first Hohhot International Sculpture Exhibition, which showed 58 invited works and 100 selected entries, and also has a gallery of Inner Mongolia-themed works. The adjoining Hohhot International Sculpture Park in the Silk Road Park to the south has 46 pieces, and the city presents both as part of a cultural axis with the Inner Mongolia Museum and Art Museum.
description: 呼和浩特雕塑艺术馆位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括博物馆、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is beside Silk Road Avenue in Saihan District in eastern Hohhot; the nearest Metro Line 1 stop is Inner Mongolia Museum, and the museum is closed on Mondays.

name: 黄河麦野谷
summaryEn: Huanghe Maiyegu is an eco-leisure area at Dongyingzi village in the Hekou tourist resort area of Tuoketuo County, on the Yellow River plain. Picking activities were part of the county's Yellow River opening festival in March 2024, and in March 2023 the Inner Mongolia culture and tourism department named it among the first 19 intangible-heritage tourism experience bases in the region, which host craft and performance activities. It suits families on a day trip from Hohhot.
description: 黄河麦野谷位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括节庆文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: It is about 6 km south of Shuanghe, the Tuoketuo county seat, near the Yellow River at Hekou, about 82 km south-south-west of Hohhot; check that it is open before going.

name: 内蒙古自然博物馆
summaryEn: The Inner Mongolia Museum of Natural History is the autonomous region's first large general natural-history museum, in a modern building that opened to the public in 2018. Its five permanent halls cover the region's forests, grasslands, waters and deserts, wildlife, fossils, geology and minerals, and farming and herding, and include a dinosaur hall, with an outdoor mineral park beside the building. It suits families and anyone interested in the region's natural history.
description: 内蒙古自然博物馆位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括博物馆、沙漠、草原。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: It is on South 2nd Ring Road in Saihan District, in the southern part of Hohhot. The museum is closed on Mondays.

name: 内蒙古赛马场
summaryEn: The Inner Mongolia Racecourse, first built in 1956, is a 32-hectare equestrian ground in northern Hohhot with a grandstand 275 m long, an obstacle-riding arena, a stunt-show ground and a standard speed-racing track. It hosts the Inner Mongolia International Equestrian Festival and other horse events, and has a Horse Culture Art Gallery. The district government also lists trick-riding displays by the regional equestrian team, including mounted vaulting, archery and sabre cutting.
description: 内蒙古赛马场位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括节庆文化、马术活动、艺术展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is on Hulunbuir North Road in Xincheng District, on the northern side of Hohhot.

name: 老牛坡红色文化旅游区
summaryEn: Laoniupo is a red-tourism area at the foot of the Ming Great Wall in Beibao township, in the far south of Qingshuihe County where it meets Pianguan County and Pinglu District in Shanxi. It presents the area's wartime role as a route linking Yan'an with the Daqingshan guerrilla base, through a memorial plaza for local martyrs, a Great Wall exhibition hall and wartime sites in Beibao village. The Beibao section of the Ming Great Wall runs through the same village.
description: 老牛坡红色文化旅游区位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括长城、主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is in Laoniupo village, Beibao township, in the far south of Qingshuihe County, about 36 km south-south-east of Qingshuihe, the county seat.

name: 小草种子乐园
summaryEn: Little Grass Seed Park is a visitor and study attraction inside the Mengcao Seed Industry Centre, run by the grassland-restoration company Mengcao in Shenggaiying village, north-east of central Hohhot. The centre keeps a bank of native plant seeds and grows native grasses in field plots, and it hosts school study visits in which children collect seeds and learn how grass roots hold soil. It suits families and school groups interested in grassland plants and ecological restoration.
description: 小草种子乐园位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括草原。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shenggaiying village, Xincheng District, about 8 km north-north-east of central Hohhot.

name: 马鬃山度假区
summaryEn: Mazongshan Ski Resort is a ski area in the hills east of Hohhot, one of the three ski areas listed by the city's culture and tourism bureau. It has a lift serving its intermediate runs and offers night skiing in winter, and in warmer months it has dry-slope skiing and other leisure activities, with guesthouses on site. It has operated since 2022 and suits skiers and families who want snow near the city.
description: 马鬃山度假区位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括滑雪。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is in Shimengou village, Yulin town, Saihan District, about 30 km east of central Hohhot.

name: 蒙草·草博园
summaryEn: Mengcao Grass Expo Park is a plant-themed park run by the grassland-ecology company Mengcao in the Horinger New Area, showing native grassland plants. It has a native-plant hall, a youth plant-ecology education zone, a wildflower valley, a drought-resistant plant institute and a seed-processing centre. It suits families and school groups interested in grassland plants and ecological restoration.
description: 蒙草·草博园位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括草原、山谷。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is in the Shengle area of the Horinger New Area, beside the G209 road, about 13 km north of Chengguan, the Horinger county seat, and about 39 km south of central Hohhot.

name: 蒙亮民族风情园
summaryEn: A commercial ethnic-crafts centre on the western side of Hohhot. Visitors can watch handicrafts such as hand-painted shawls and leather paintings being made, and buy Mongolian costume and headwear, silver and horn crafts, knives and dairy products. It suits visitors who want to see Mongolian craft products and souvenirs in one place.
description: 蒙亮民族风情园位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括手工艺、民族文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is on West 2nd Ring Road at its junction with Genghis Khan West Street in Huimin District, on the western side of Hohhot.

name: 蒙牛工业旅游区
summaryEn: Mengniu Industrial Tourism Area is a dairy-industry visit at the Mengniu company's base in Horinger's dairy development zone, open to visitors since 2007 and named a national industrial tourism demonstration base in November 2022. The route passes exhibition corridors on the company's history, research and product quality, an indoor display of grassland with cows and alfalfa, and the automated production lines; the visit was relaunched with updated displays in July 2026. It suits families and school groups interested in how milk is produced; the plant is an operating factory.
description: 蒙牛工业旅游区位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括草原、工业参观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is at the Mengniu Phase 6 plant in the Horinger dairy development zone, about 11 km north of Chengguan, the Horinger county seat, and about 41 km south of central Hohhot; check the current visiting arrangements before going.

name: 莫尼山非遗小镇
summaryEn: Moni Mountain is a village-scale heritage tourism town on a hillside in the Daqing Mountains foothills north-west of Hohhot, where more than 80 intangible heritage items are shown and taught through master workshops, an art centre, a museum and practice bases. Its founder's family craft, Mongolian leather art, is a national intangible heritage item. It was named a national preferred project for combining heritage and tourism in 2022 and one of the region's first intangible-heritage tourism experience bases in 2023, and in June 2025 it hosted the region's main intangible-heritage event for Cultural and Natural Heritage Day.
description: 莫尼山非遗小镇位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括博物馆、非遗文化、艺术展览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is at Duanjiayao village in Youyouban town, Huimin District, in the Daqing Mountains foothills about 16 km west-north-west of central Hohhot.

name: 南山旅游景区
summaryEn: A landscaped hill park of about 5 sq km on the southern edge of Horinger, laid out from 2000 with themes drawn from the culture of Shengle, an early capital of the Northern Wei dynasty. Its gardens include a calligraphy park, a zodiac garden, a lake and an altar of giant stone coins among about a hundred pavilions, and a peony garden is planted for the spring flowering. It is mainly a local leisure park, suited to a half-day outing from Hohhot.
description: 南山旅游景区位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括湖泊、园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is on the southern edge of Horinger, the county seat, about 53 km south of Hohhot.

name: 塞外桃园
summaryEn: Saiwai Taoyuan is a farm-based leisure area in Xindianzi town, in the south-east of Horinger County, which the county government describes as a green organic-farming tourism area. Its facilities include crop-growing areas using farm technology, an orchard and flower area, restaurants, leisure activities and cave-dwelling guesthouses, with wellness and retirement-living projects. It suits families and groups looking for a farm outing or an overnight stay.
description: 塞外桃园位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括果园、洞穴、农业体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Jiaonixiwan village, Xindianzi town, about 21 km south-east of Chengguan, the Horinger county seat.

name: 神泉生态旅游景区
summaryEn: A leisure park of about 4 sq km astride the Yellow River at Haojiayao village, with a classical Chinese-style garden, lakes and birds on the east bank and a sand-dune amusement area on the Kubuqi Desert edge on the west bank. County media list activities such as sand-sliding, zip-lines, camel rides and a staged horse show. The surrounding village of Haojiayao is known for its vineyards and has a separate Yellow River viewing platform.
description: 神泉生态旅游景区位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括沙漠、葡萄酒文化、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is at Haojiayao village in Shuanghe town, about 10 km south of Shuanghe, the Togtoh county seat, and about 86 km south-south-west of Hohhot (about 99 km by road).

name: 南湖湿地公园
summaryEn: Nanhu (South Lake) Wetland Park is a landscape park in the south of Hohhot, laid out by the city government from 2005 and opened to the public in 2007, with wetland, fishing and grassland areas. Woodland, reed beds and ponds are crossed by paths, and the main gate is on the park's northern side.
description: 南湖湿地公园位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括湿地、草原、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is in Yuquan District in the south of Hohhot, near Zhaojun Road.

name: 乌素图杏花谷
summaryEn: Wusutu Apricot Valley is a village-edge garden park at East Wusutu, at the foot of the Daqing Mountains on the north-western edge of Hohhot. It was laid out around old apricot trees, with pavilions and winding paths, and has added fruit picking, animal-contact areas, children's play activities and camping and barbecue spots. It is known for its apricot blossom in spring and suits families on a short outing from the city.
description: 乌素图杏花谷位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括山谷、花卉观赏、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is at East Wusutu village in Youyouban town, Huimin District, about 17 km west of central Hohhot.

name: 伊利草原乳文化旅游景区
summaryEn: A visitor complex run by the Yili dairy group in Hohhot's dairy industrial park, built around the Yili Grassland Dairy Culture Museum, which covers the history of dairy-making among northern pastoral peoples and early dairy equipment. Visitors can walk the viewing routes through the group's milk-powder and liquid-milk plants and see feeding and milking at its model dairy farm, and a pet-interaction park opened on the site in September 2025. It is a corporate showcase, suited to families and to anyone curious about the dairy industry.
description: 伊利草原乳文化旅游景区位于内蒙古呼和浩特。游览特色包括博物馆、草原、国家一级博物馆。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is in the Chilechuan dairy industrial park on the western edge of Hohhot, about 25 km west-south-west of Hohhot; closed on Mondays.

name: 敖鲁古雅使鹿部落
summaryEn: This scenic area beside Genhe presents the culture of the Aoluguya Ewenki, the only group in China that herds reindeer, who moved out of the forest into a settled township in 2003. Visitors walk a boardwalk into a forest enclosure to feed and photograph reindeer, see the conical tents known as chuoluozi and birch-bark craft workshops, and visit a museum devoted to reindeer culture; in winter there are reindeer-sleigh rides. It suits travellers interested in Ewenki culture and the Greater Khingan forest.
description: 敖鲁古雅使鹿部落位于内蒙古呼伦贝尔。游览特色包括博物馆、林地风光、手工艺。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 4 km west of Genhe, in the Aoluguya Ewenki ethnic township; the two museums in the scenic area are closed on Mondays.

name: 巴尔虎蒙古部落
summaryEn: A folk-custom park and ger camp on the Hulunbuir grassland, named after the Barag Mongols, whom the Qing court settled in Hulunbuir in the 1730s. The daily staged shows include a horse show with lasso-catching, wrestling and riding stunts using a herd of more than 300 horses, and evenings bring a bonfire party; visitors can also stay overnight in gers. It suits families and groups on a day trip along the Hailar–Manzhouli road who want a staged introduction to Mongolian customs.
description: 巴尔虎蒙古部落位于内蒙古呼伦贝尔。游览特色包括草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside the Hailar–Manzhouli expressway at Chagang, Xin Barag Left Banner, about 130 km west-north-west of Hailar and about 45 km east-south-east of Manzhouli.

name: 布苏里北疆军事文化旅游区
summaryEn: A former military logistics reserve base in the Greater Khingan forest of the Oroqen Autonomous Banner, now presented as a military-themed visitor area. The Ministry of Culture and Tourism's rural tourism route page describes it as one of the largest military-experience sites in northern China. It is visited on the same Oroqen route as the Tuoba Xianbei park and Alihe National Forest Park.
description: 布苏里北疆军事文化旅游区位于内蒙古呼伦贝尔。游览特色包括森林公园、田园观光、历史纪念。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 21 km west of Alihe, the seat of the Oroqen Autonomous Banner, in forest beside the Busuli railway station. Check that it is open before going.

name: 中国达斡尔民族园
summaryEn: A newly built park beside Nirji, the seat of Morin Dawa Daur Autonomous Banner, themed on the history, culture and customs of the Daur people, one of China's recognised ethnic minorities. It has an intangible-heritage exhibition area, a stage for Daur song and dance, Daur-style family restaurants and a lakeside landing stage that doubles as a camping ground. Morin Dawa is known in China for the Daur hockey game, beikou, which visitors can try.
description: 中国达斡尔民族园位于内蒙古呼伦贝尔。游览特色包括湖泊、民族文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 10 km north of Nirji, the seat of Morin Dawa Daur Autonomous Banner, beside the Nirji reservoir.

name: 额尔古纳国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A river-wetland park in the Shangkuli area north-east of Ergun city, opened to visitors in 2018 and covering about 120 sq km, of which roughly 10 sq km is open to the public. A sightseeing road and footpaths link eight viewpoints among birch and willow woods, grassland and rivers, and the Bird Island–Handagai point has an elevated lookout over the whole wetland. Extras include a deer enclosure, animal feeding and rafting.
description: 额尔古纳国家湿地公园位于内蒙古呼伦贝尔。游览特色包括湿地、草原。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Shangkuli area, about 21 km north-east of Ergun city centre.

name: 额尔古纳湿地景区
summaryEn: A hilltop viewing area on the edge of Ergun city, overlooking the winding channels of the wetland along the Genhe River and the town's blue and pink roofs. It is popular with photographers and is one of several wetland sites around Ergun, alongside the larger national wetland park to the north-east.
description: 额尔古纳湿地景区位于内蒙古呼伦贝尔。游览特色包括湿地。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the western edge of Ergun city in Labdarin subdistrict, a short drive from the centre.

name: 额尔古纳白桦林
summaryEn: A single-species stand of native white birch north of Ergun city, laid out with an elevated timber walkway and four themed zones for sightseeing and photography. The tourism department's description groups them as a sky walkway, a fairy-tale forest, a romance area and a photography zone. It suits a short stop on a day out from Ergun.
description: 额尔古纳白桦林位于内蒙古呼伦贝尔。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 32 km north of Ergun city, on provincial road S201.

name: 根河源国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A national wetland park around the upper Genhe River in the Greater Khingan forest, where forest, marsh, river and lake habitats are interlaced across about 590 sq km, of which roughly 200 sq km is wetland. East Asian waterfowl breed here, and the river it protects feeds the Ergun River. Visitor facilities include forest walks, an RV and log-cabin camp, and in summer rafting and wild-berry picking.
description: 根河源国家湿地公园位于内蒙古呼伦贝尔。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The park's centre lies about 12 km north-east of Genhe, in the Greater Khingan forest. Check that it is open before going.

name: 呼和诺尔景区
summaryEn: A ger-camp resort on the shore of Hohnuur, a lake in the Chen Barag grassland, with about 4 sq km of steppe and 12 sq km of water inside the scenic area. A yurt-style visitor centre forms the core of a cluster of gers where visitors can eat, stay overnight and try horse riding, archery and Mongolian wrestling. It suits a short stop or an overnight stay on the Hailar–Manzhouli road.
description: 呼和诺尔景区位于内蒙古呼伦贝尔。游览特色包括草原、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside the Hailar–Manzhouli expressway on the shore of Hohnuur, about 18 km west-south-west of Bayankuren, the Chen Barag Banner seat, and about 40 km west of Hailar.

name: 红花尔基樟子松国家森林公园
