summaryEn: A forest park of about 67 sq km on the southern edge of the Hulunbuir sands, protecting a large continuous belt of Mongolian pine, an evergreen conifer suited to sandy soil. Rivers, lakes and marshy grassland lie among the pines, and the park borders the Ewenki and Barag steppes. It is a forest-and-grassland stop for travellers in the south of Hulunbuir.
description: 红花尔基樟子松国家森林公园位于内蒙古呼伦贝尔。游览特色包括森林公园、草原。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Near Honghuaerji town, about 100 km south-south-east of Bayan Tohoi, the Ewenki Autonomous Banner seat.

name: 扎兰屯金龙山
summaryEn: A ski and leisure resort in the hills north-west of Zalantun, with 18 pistes graded from beginner to advanced, a U-shaped snowboard halfpipe and an aerials course used by national ski teams for training. It was a venue for snow events at the 2024 National Winter Games and is listed among China's first national ski-tourism resorts. Winter extras include snowmobiles and snow tubing; in summer the hill is used for hiking and camping, and a hot-spring hotel provides accommodation.
description: 扎兰屯金龙山位于内蒙古呼伦贝尔。游览特色包括休闲度假。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 9 km west-north-west of central Zalantun, close to the G302 road, with the city's airport about 25 km away.

name: 莫尔道嘎国家森林公园
summaryEn: Moerdaoga was the first national forest park in the Inner Mongolia part of the Greater Khingan range, covering cold-temperate forest of larch and birch that turns orange and yellow in autumn. The town of Moerdaoga lies inside the park, which has about 14 sights linked by a tourist loop of more than 100 km, including a small forest sightseeing train and White Deer Island. The local government gives May to October as the best season.
description: 莫尔道嘎国家森林公园位于内蒙古呼伦贝尔。游览特色包括森林公园、岛屿、林地风光。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: Moerdaoga town, inside the park, is about 136 km by road north-north-east of Ergun, the nearest city.

name: 世界反法西斯战争海拉尔纪念园
summaryEn: The park occupies Beishan hill on the northern edge of Hailar, where the Japanese Kwantung Army built a large underground fortress between 1934 and 1937. Visitors can enter part of the concrete tunnels and rooms beneath the hill, which held command posts, quarters and stores, and an exhibition hall covers the fortress's construction, including the testimony of a labourer who escaped, and the Soviet attack on it in August 1945. The Hailar works were among the largest fortifications the Kwantung Army built in north-east China.
description: 世界反法西斯战争海拉尔纪念园位于内蒙古呼伦贝尔。游览特色包括城堡、主题展览、历史纪念。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Beishan hill in Kaoshan subdistrict on the northern edge of Hailar, a short drive from the city centre.

name: 额尔古纳乌兰山
summaryEn: A hill scenic area of 4.7 sq km on open grassland in Heishantou town, with viewing platforms on the hill. It has a tent camp and an RV camp, and activities such as a zip line, a swing and a grass-sledging slope. It suits a half-day stop on the northern Hulunbuir tourist route.
description: 额尔古纳乌兰山位于内蒙古呼伦贝尔。游览特色包括草原、观景台。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Heishantou town, about 70 km north-west of Ergun city. Check that it is open before going.

name: 扎赉诺尔猛犸公园
summaryEn: A landscaped park in the new town of Zhalainur District, centred on a large group of mammoth sculptures set among lakes and paths. It refers to the mammoth fossils and other Ice Age animal remains found in the local coalfield, which scientists named the Zhalainur fauna. The Zhalainur Museum on the same street displays the area's mammoth fossils, ancient human skulls and Palaeolithic stone tools, with further halls on coal mining and the Hulun Lake wetlands.
description: 扎赉诺尔猛犸公园位于内蒙古呼伦贝尔。游览特色包括博物馆、化石遗迹、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the new town of Zhalainur District on Xinzheng Street, about 19 km east-south-east of central Manzhouli; the Zhalainur Museum on the same street is closed on Mondays.

name: 布龙湖温泉度假区
summaryEn: Bulonghu is a hot-spring and lake resort on the grassland of Otog Banner, beside the Bulong reservoir where the Dusitu River makes a wide bend. The Ordos government's English site describes a grassland lake resort combining recreation, hot springs, conference reception, catering, accommodation and water entertainment. It is a leisure resort rather than a sightseeing destination.
description: 布龙湖温泉度假区位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括温泉、草原、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is about 45 km west-south-west of Wulan, the Otog Banner seat. Check that it is open before going.

name: 城川红色文化旅游区
summaryEn: Chengchuan in Otog Front Banner was part of a Communist-led base area in the 1940s, and the tourist area gathers its memorial sites: the Yan'an Nationalities Institute Chengchuan Memorial, a memorial to Yang Zao and Han Chun, whom the Ordos government calls international communist fighters, and the Wang Zhen Well memorial park. The well was dug in 1944 under the Eighth Route Army commander Wang Zhen during wartime land reclamation, and a branch of the institute was based in Chengchuan from 1945. The area also runs training and study programmes.
description: 城川曾是革命根据地，今天可在多个纪念点了解延安民族学院城川旧址等地的历史。
accessEn: It is in Chengchuan town, about 90 km south-east of Aolezhaoqi, the Otog Front Banner seat; the memorial hall is on Jinyuan Street and the Wang Zhen Well park lies about 15 km west of the town.

name: 东联动漫城
summaryEn: Donglian Animation City is a themed leisure and education complex in Hantai town, Dongsheng District, built around animated stories on moral education. Alongside animation entertainment it offers youth study tours, outdoor training and red-culture education programmes. It is a modern commercial attraction aimed at school groups and families, not a heritage site.
description: 鄂尔多斯罕台镇的主题园区将动画故事与互动游乐、教育体验结合起来。
accessEn: It lies along a long avenue in Hantai town, about 25 km west of central Dongsheng and about 26 km north-north-west of Kangbashi, the Ordos city seat. Check that it is open before going.

name: 恩格贝
summaryEn: Engebei is an ecological demonstration area of about 300,000 mu (about 200 sq km) at the eastern end of the Kubuqi Desert, reclaimed from drifting sand through years of planting and development. Its attractions include the Inner Mongolia Engebei Desert Museum, viewing of desert birds and animals and of sand-binding plants, and ecological farming. It suits visitors interested in desert control and day trips from Baotou.
description: 恩格贝位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括博物馆、沙漠。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is in Engebei town, Dalad Banner, about 45 km west-south-west of Shulinzhao, the banner seat, and about 45 km south-west of Baotou.

name: 甘霖乌素
summaryEn: Ganlinwusu is a lake-and-wetland tourist area in the Mu Us sandy land in southern Uxin Banner, where autumn brings large flocks of migrating birds to its lakes. Uxin Banner's tourism bureau presents it with the Wengongmanha National Desert Park for desert off-roading, grassland sightseeing and wetland leisure, and it has hosted open-water swimming events.
description: 甘霖乌素位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括湿地、沙漠、草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is in Ulan Tolgoi town, about 36 km east of Galutu, the Uxin Banner seat.

name: 九城宫
summaryEn: Jiuchenggong is a large resort of about 6 sq km in Hantai town, Dongsheng District, themed around Manhan culture, the blend of Mongolian and Han folk traditions of the Ordos area. In winter it runs a ski field and ice-and-snow activities, and in the warmer months it offers a glass bridge, glass rafting, a jungle adventure course, go-karts, horse riding and archery. Cave-dwelling courtyards provide lodging, and it suits families and groups on a day or overnight break from the city.
description: 九城宫位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括玻璃栈道、水上活动、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is in Hantai town, about 19 km west of central Dongsheng and about 20 km north of Kangbashi, the Ordos city seat.

name: 准格尔黄河大峡谷
summaryEn: In the south-east of Jungar Banner the Yellow River runs through a deep canyon along the Shanxi border, with villages, forts and river views strung along its bank. The Ordos government lists Cuijiazhai, a village registered as a traditional village in 2014 with a history of more than 170 years, the Wanjiazhai water-control project, the Taiji Bay river bend and more than 50 sights including old forts, village walls and a riverside plank path. Via ferrata routes and a glass viewing platform have been added, and Cuijiazhai stages a traditional wedding performance.
description: 准格尔黄河大峡谷位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括峡谷、滨水景观、传统村落。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: It is on the Yellow River in the south-east of Jungar Banner, about 33 km south-east of Xuejiawan, the banner seat, and a few kilometres south of Laoniuwan, which lies on the Hohhot side of the river.

name: 康巴什旅游区
summaryEn: Kangbashi is the new urban district where the Ordos city government sits, and its core is rated as a tourist area made up of squares, themed parks and a city lake. The Ordos government counts 28 sights, among them seven themed squares, five themed parks, three museums, an ancient site and seven cultural buildings. The Ordos Museum, Ordos Bronze Museum and Ordos Revolution History Museum stand together on Wenhua West Road and are registered museums open all year.
description: 康巴什旅游区位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is in the middle of Kangbashi District, where the Ordos city government sits, about 30 km south-west of Dongsheng; the three museums are closed on Mondays.

name: 康镇草原丝路文化景区
summaryEn: Kangzhen is a cultural-tourism town of about 3,500 mu in Kangbashi, built in the manner of buildings from regions along the grassland Silk Road. Its courtyards and streets imitate Mongolian, Beijing, Jin-merchant, Guanzhong and north-western styles, with food and folk displays. It is a modern theme town rather than a historic one, and stages festival events such as opera performances, fairs and winter ice-lantern shows.
description: 康镇草原丝路文化景区位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括草原、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is in Kangbashi, about 3 km north-west of the Ordos city government.

name: 马兰花草原
summaryEn: Malanhua is a grassland resort in Otog Front Banner with a large performance stage, a racecourse, a Mongolian tribe-style village, a hotel named for the 38th parallel and a ceremonial oboo square. The indoor stage seats 1,200 people for shows, and the resort is aimed at tour groups and families.
description: 马兰花草原位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is about 5 km north-north-east of Shanghaimiao town in the west of Otog Front Banner, about 74 km west-north-west of Aolezhaoqi, the banner seat. Check that it is open before going.

name: 鄂尔多斯羊绒工业旅游区
summaryEn: This industrial-tourism area in Dongsheng District is the Ordos cashmere brand's production base, about 2,800 mu in size, with east and west plants, an office zone, living quarters and a research centre that houses the national cashmere products engineering research centre. A marketing and display centre of 3,000 sq m shows the brand's full range of garments. It is a company-run site, so check whether tours are running before planning a visit.
description: 鄂尔多斯羊绒工业旅游区位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括工业参观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: It is in Dongsheng District, about 14 km west of central Dongsheng and about 22 km north of Kangbashi, the Ordos city seat.

name: 鄂尔多斯文化产业园
summaryEn: The Ordos Cultural Industry Park is a development of 11.9 sq km near Altan Xire, the Ejin Horo Banner seat, built around film and television production, cultural exhibition and cultural tourism. It stages live shows, and the Inner Mongolia Museum has an Ejin Horo branch here. It suits visitors interested in film and culture; it is a modern development, not a historic site.
description: 鄂尔多斯文化产业园位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括博物馆、影视文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is about 7 km south of the centre of Altan Xire, the Ejin Horo Banner seat, and about 12 km south-south-west of Kangbashi, the Ordos city seat.

name: 鄂尔多斯草原旅游区
summaryEn: This ger resort on the dry steppe of Hanggin Banner is arranged around two Mongolian golden tents and a camp of about 400 gers. It offers lodging and dining for up to 1,500 guests and Mongolian-culture activities, and suits groups and families on a grassland stay.
description: 鄂尔多斯草原旅游区位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is about 10 km west of Xini, the Hangjin Banner seat.

name: 鄂尔多斯赛车小镇
summaryEn: The town is built around the Ordos International Circuit, a track certified by the FIA at grade 2 that opened in 2010 and has hosted 79 national and regional events, including CTCC circuit-racing and CDGP drifting championship rounds and the long-running 'Warm City' (Nuancheng) race weekends. Other attractions are a kart track, a racing-themed hotel and the Taifaxiang Museum, a private collection of mineral crystals and ornamental stones. It suits motorsport fans and families looking for a short stop in Kangbashi.
description: 鄂尔多斯赛车小镇位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the east of Kangbashi, about 8 km east of the Ordos city government.

name: 鄂尔多斯野生动物园
summaryEn: Ordos Wildlife Park covers about 12 km² of hills in Dongsheng district and opened in July 2012. It has four display zones with 25 venues and outdoor areas for birds, kangaroos, bears, tigers and leopards, mountain animals and wolves, as well as a petting area and a separate marine hall. Giant pandas Qiqiao and Qixi are among the animals on show, and the park suits families.
description: 鄂尔多斯野生动物园位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括动物观赏。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Dongsheng district, about 8 km west of central Dongsheng and about 26 km north-north-east of Kangbashi.

name: 库布其七星湖
summaryEn: Qixinghu, 'Seven Star Lakes', is a lake-and-dune resort area in the heart of the Kubuqi Desert in Hanggin Banner, developed by the Elion Resources Group; its seven lakes are laid out like the Big Dipper. A desert hotel, a desert science museum and a desert botanical house stand beside the main lake. The area was designated Kubuqi National Desert Park in 2014, and suits visitors who want to stay in the desert.
description: 库布其七星湖位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括博物馆、沙漠、湖泊。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: It is in the Kubuqi Desert, about 101 km north-north-west of Xini, the Hanggin Banner seat, about 41 km west-north-west of Dugui Tala town and about 130 km west of Baotou.

name: 水镜湖
summaryEn: Shuijinghu is a lakeside leisure-farming resort in the north of Jungar Banner. It has an eco-agriculture garden, a copy of an old Beijing courtyard house, angling on the lake, a fountain with music and bonfire evenings, and a hotel that can host more than 200 guests. It is a modern commercial resort for weekend breaks rather than a historic site.
description: 水镜湖位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括湖泊、园林景观、传统民居。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is about 13 km west of Burtaohai, a township in northern Jungar Banner, and about 75 km south-east of Shulinzhao, the Dalad Banner seat.

name: 苏泊罕草原
summaryEn: Subohan is a grassland leisure resort in Subuerga town, Ejin Horo Banner, built around Mongolian herding life: guests stay in gers, ride horses, eat Mongolian meals and watch staged shows. The Ordos government describes the grassland as a historic gathering and review ground of the seven banners of the Ordos league and as the site of the largest Ming and Qing post station in Ordos. It suits families and groups on a short stay away from the city.
description: 苏泊罕草原位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括草原、休闲度假。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is about 12 km north-west of Subuerga town in Ejin Horo Banner and about 37 km west of Kangbashi, the Ordos city seat (about 44 km by road). Check that it is open before going.

name: 乌审走马
summaryEn: This resort in Suldesumu, Uxin Banner, was begun in 2006 on saline-alkali land that has since been restored as a wetland grassland within the Mu Us sandy land. It combines grassland sightseeing and folk-culture experiences with horse events: Uxin is the home of zouma, the walking-horse contest, which is on the national intangible cultural heritage list and judges horses on a smooth, even gait. The area hosts banner-level festivals such as the fourth Uxin tourism Naadam in August 2025.
description: 乌审走马位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括湿地、草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is in Suldesumu, about 16 km south-south-east of Galutu, the Uxin Banner seat.

name: 万家惠欢乐世界
summaryEn: Wanjiahui Happy World is a large indoor leisure complex in Dongsheng District, with about 330,000 sq m of floor space. It combines a water park of about 90,000 sq m, an indoor snow and ice park, a European-style amusement park, a themed hotel of 1,500 rooms and areas for food and shopping, so it can be visited in any season. It is a modern commercial development rather than a heritage site, and suits families with children.
description: 万家惠欢乐世界位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括主题游乐、水上游乐、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It stands in the west of Dongsheng District, about 5 km west-north-west of central Dongsheng and about 29 km north-north-east of Kangbashi, the Ordos city seat.

name: 蒙根花万通生态旅游区
summaryEn: A farm-based tourism area in Bainijing town, Dalad Banner, developed from the Wantong modern agriculture and livestock park. Its demonstration areas cover crop growing, greenhouse and soilless cultivation, livestock breeding and farm-technology training, and an exhibition hall serves school labour-education visits. It suits families and school groups interested in modern farming rather than historic or scenic sights.
description: 蒙根花万通生态旅游区位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括农业体验、主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Bainijing town, Dalad Banner, about 47 km east-south-east of Shulinzhao, the banner seat, and about 66 km south-east of Baotou. Check that it is open before going.

name: 颐和生态文化博览园
summaryEn: Yihe is a walled park in Ejin Horo Banner on the western edge of Kangbashi, begun in 2011 and built in Mongolian, Tibetan and Han styles, with 999 prayer wheels set in its circular outer wall. Its courtyards hold the Inner Mongolia Buddhist Culture Museum, a temple hall named Erdeni Zhao, the residence of the Ulan Living Buddha and a culture experience centre. The park runs tea-tasting, incense-making, handicraft and meditation activities and is popular with families.
description: 颐和生态文化博览园位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Ejin Horo Banner, about 5 km west of central Kangbashi; the Buddhist museum inside is closed on Mondays.

name: 银肯塔拉沙漠绿洲
summaryEn: Yinkentala is a desert-and-grassland tourist park in Dalad Banner, on the south side of the Yellow River. The Ordos government lists activities including sand sledding, desert off-roading, camel rides, a desert ropeway, horse displays and an oboo ceremony, with Mongolian-style meals. It is a commercial leisure park for day trips from Baotou or Ordos.
description: 银肯塔拉沙漠绿洲位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括沙漠、草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is in Dalad Banner, about 24 km south-south-west of Shulinzhao, the banner seat, and about 43 km south of Baotou.

name: 油松王
summaryEn: Yousongwang, the 'Pine King', is a Chinese pine standing in Narisong town in the south of Jungar Banner. The Ordos government gives its age as nearly a thousand years, dates its sprouting to the Xining era of the Northern Song (1068–1077) and calls it the oldest known Chinese pine in China. Temple fairs are held beside it on the 13th day of the fifth lunar month and the 15th of the seventh.
description: 油松王位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯。游览特色包括寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: It is in Narisong town in the south of Jungar Banner, about 71 km south-west of Xuejiawan, the banner seat, and about 77 km east-south-east of Kangbashi, the Ordos city seat.

name: 宝古图沙漠
summaryEn: Baogutu Desert is a stretch of dunes in Baiyintala sumu, Naiman Banner, run as a scenic area with camel rides, off-road vehicle runs over the dunes and sand sliding. It has a self-drive campsite with capsule-style rooms and regularly hosts desert off-road car races. It suits visitors who want a short desert outing in the south of Tongliao.
description: 宝古图沙漠位于内蒙古通辽。游览特色包括沙漠。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Baiyintala sumu, about 34 km north of Daqintala, the Naiman Banner seat, and about 141 km west-south-west of Tongliao.

name: 草甘沙漠
summaryEn: Caogan Desert is a village-run scenic area of dunes, grass and small lakes in Sandu sumu, Horqin Left Rear Banner, set up in 2014 and covering about 9 square kilometres. It has ger-style restaurants, log cabins, container and caravan lodgings and a caravan campsite, with dune vehicle rides, a virtual-reality hall, archery tag and beach football. It suits families and self-drive groups who want an overnight stay in the desert.
description: 草甘沙漠位于内蒙古通辽。游览特色包括沙漠、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Sandu sumu, about 10 km east-north-east of Sandu, the sumu seat, about 33 km south-south-east of Jirgalang and about 110 km south-east of Tongliao; the area closes for the winter (in 2026–27 from 10 October to about 20 March).

name: 蒙古王工业旅游景区
summaryEn: Mongol King Industrial Tourism Area is an industrial-tourism site named after the Mongol King baijiu brand, in the south of Tongliao. Tongliao's tourism bureau has backed its upgrade as one of the city's industrial-tourism sites since 2024, and the brand's baijiu won silver at the 2020 China tourism-commodities competition. It suits visitors interested in local liquor and company-run industrial tourism, and it can be fitted into a stay in the city.
description: 蒙古王工业旅游景区位于内蒙古通辽。游览特色包括工业参观、酿造文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Minhang Road in the south of Horqin District, Tongliao, close to Tongliao Airport. Check that it is open before going.

name: 奈曼王府
summaryEn: Naiman Prince's Mansion is a large Qing-period complex of grey-brick halls and courtyards in Daqintala, begun in 1863 as the residence of the Naiman Banner's Mongol prince. It is one of the better-preserved Qing official-style compounds in Inner Mongolia and now houses a museum with 46 exhibition halls, showing local history and restored period interiors of a banner prince's household. It suits visitors interested in Qing-era Mongol banner life and architecture.
description: 奈曼王府位于内蒙古通辽。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Daqintala, the Naiman Banner seat, about 157 km west-south-west of Tongliao.

name: 孝庄园
summaryEn: Xiaozhuang Garden is a reconstruction of the Darhan Prince's mansion, the family home of Empress Dowager Xiaozhuang, who grew up in Horqin and married into the Qing court. The mansion was rebuilt on its old site in 2008 and opened to visitors in 2012; a hall added in 2019 presents local intangible heritage such as horse-head fiddle playing and Mongolian embroidery. The buildings are modern, and the visit suits those interested in Qing-Mongol history and the Horqin village setting.
description: 孝庄园位于内蒙古通辽。游览特色包括园林景观、非遗文化、庄园。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Huatugula town, Horqin Left Middle Banner, about 44 km north-west of Tongliao.

name: 银沙湾
summaryEn: Yinshawan is a dune scenic area in Hure Banner, Tongliao, used for desert driving and off-road sport. It has hosted off-road car and motorcycle races over the dunes, among them a winter car challenge in January 2025 on a natural course of about 20 km. It suits visitors interested in dunes and motor sport.
description: 银沙湾位于内蒙古通辽。游览特色包括沙漠。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: It is about 19 km north-west of Kulun, the Hure Banner seat, and about 100 km south-south-west of Tongliao.

name: 珠日河草原
summaryEn: Zhurihe is a grassland scenic area on the Zhurihe ranch in the north-west of Horqin Left Middle Banner, built around a racecourse with a reviewing stand. It is the main venue of the 8.18 Jerim horse-racing festival, whose 24th edition was held there in August 2023, and a speed-horse race meeting was run there in June 2024. It suits visitors interested in Mongolian horse culture and open grassland.
description: 珠日河草原位于内蒙古通辽。游览特色包括草原、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the Zhurihe ranch in the north-west of Horqin Left Middle Banner, about 86 km north-west of Tongliao.

name: 察尔湖
summaryEn: Chaer Lake is the Friendship Reservoir on the Dongyang River, begun in 1958 and finished in 1973, in Xinghe County on the border with Hebei. The reservoir holds 116 million cubic metres, and the resort area of about 4,400 hectares around it has boating, horse riding, a caravan camp and farmland and wetland scenery, with skating and skiing in winter. It suits visitors who want a day beside open water within reach of Jining.
description: 察尔湖位于内蒙古乌兰察布。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊、滑雪。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Yamenhao in Chengguan town, about 12 km east of Xinghe, the county seat, and about 78 km east of Jining; check that it is open before going.

name: 岱海国际滑雪场
summaryEn: A ski resort on the north-facing slope of Wofo Mountain above Lake Dai, with 12 runs for beginner, intermediate and advanced skiers, a top station at 2,100 m, a vertical drop of 397 m, snowmaking, lifts and a snow-play area, and a resort with a hotel and hot-spring bathing. It hosted events including cross-country skiing and biathlon at the 14th National Winter Games in February 2024. It suits skiers and families from Jining and Hohhot.
description: 岱海国际滑雪场位于内蒙古乌兰察布。游览特色包括滑雪、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 10 km north-west of Liangcheng, the county seat, and about 61 km south-west of Jining.

name: 格根塔拉草原
summaryEn: Gegentala is a grassland tourist centre on the northern foothills of the Daqing Mountains in Siziwang Banner, the main landing site for China's Shenzhou spacecraft. The regional tourism Naadam has been held here in late July every year since 1989, and an oboo-offering festival takes place on the thirteenth day of the fifth lunar month. The centre promotes itself as one of the autonomous region's five main grassland tourist areas, and it suits visitors who want an easy grassland stop north of Hohhot.
description: 格根塔拉草原位于内蒙古乌兰察布。游览特色包括草原、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Chagan Bulige sumu, Siziwang Banner, about 30 km north-north-east of Wulanhua, the banner seat, and about 104 km north of Hohhot.

name: 红石崖
summaryEn: Hongshiya is a privately developed grassland resort in Hongzhao township, Zhuozi County, on the northern side of the Daqing Mountains. It combines alpine meadow ranchland of about 100,000 mu (about 6,700 hectares) with a hot-spring spa drawing on a geothermal well of more than 2,300 m, a water park, a glass footbridge 380 m long between two cliffs, a Buddhist temple and a museum of the anti-Japanese war in the Daqing Mountains. It suits families and day-trippers from Hohhot.
description: 红石崖位于内蒙古乌兰察布。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑、草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Hongzhao township, Zhuozi County, about 38 km north-north-east of Hohhot.

name: 红召九龙湾
summaryEn: Jiulongwan is a forested mountain valley in Hongzhao township, Zhuozi County, inside the Daqingshan nature reserve and covering about 100 square kilometres of birch woods, cliffs, streams and meadow. It is named for its nine winding ridges, which look like dragons from the air, and visitors can ride a cable car or an off-road vehicle through it or try a glass walkway, cliff swing and zip line. It suits a summer or autumn day trip from Hohhot.
description: 红召九龙湾位于内蒙古乌兰察布。游览特色包括自然保护区、玻璃栈道、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Hongzhao township, Zhuozi County, about 34 km north-east of Hohhot.

name: 集宁战役红色纪念园
summaryEn: The memorial park covers about 13 hectares on Quanshan North Street in Jining and is built around the Jining Campaign Memorial Hall, which opened in October 2010. The hall's displays follow the fighting around Jining in 1946, with more than 1,200 objects, photographs and artworks, a sound-and-light panorama and a 5D cinema. The grounds also hold Victory Square, a generals' garden, a monument to the people's heroes and the site of the campaign command post.
description: 集宁战役红色纪念园位于内蒙古乌兰察布。游览特色包括纪念展览、园林景观、战役遗址。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Quanshan North Street in Jining; the memorial hall is closed on Mondays, and also on Tuesdays from mid-October to mid-April.

name: 林胡古塞
summaryEn: Linhu Gusai is a mountain resort planned across about 21 square kilometres in Dayushu township, Zhuozi County, themed on the Linhu, a people of the northern frontier in the Warring States period, and on local revolutionary history. Four giant pandas arrived there in September 2019 with the support of the China Conservation and Research Centre for the Giant Panda and were on show at the Qingming holiday in 2024; the resort also has leisure and accommodation facilities and was named a regional-level tourist resort in 2021. It suits families and visitors looking for a resort stay east of Hohhot.
description: 林胡古塞位于内蒙古乌兰察布。游览特色包括历史纪念。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dayushu township, about 21 km west-south-west of Zhuozishan, the Zhuozi county seat, and about 50 km east of Hohhot.

name: 明星沟
summaryEn: Mingxinggou is a resort in a mountain valley in Dayushu township, in the south-west of Zhuozi County, planned across about 17 square kilometres in eight zones. Its guest rooms are cave-style dwellings (45 rooms sleeping about 90), and there is a restaurant seating 300 and a stream of more than 300 m running past the entrance. It suits visitors who want a quiet overnight stay in the hills, and it borders the Linhu Gusai resort.
description: 明星沟位于内蒙古乌兰察布。游览特色包括山谷、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dayushu township, about 23 km south-west of Zhuozishan, the Zhuozi county seat, and about 70 km west-south-west of Jining.

name: 日光草原·大河湾
summaryEn: A year-round resort in the hills north of Jining, built around the Riguang Volcano and Dahewan ski area and hot-spring wellness facilities. In winter the ski area offers runs for different levels and snow play, and in summer the grassland is used for cool-weather stays, with guesthouse villages nearby. It suits visitors from Jining and further afield who want a winter or summer break close to the city.
description: 日光草原·大河湾位于内蒙古乌兰察布。游览特色包括草原、火山地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills about 23 km north of Jining.

name: 苏木山
summaryEn: Sumushan is a forested range south of Xinghe where Inner Mongolia, Hebei and Shanxi meet, rising to Huangshiya at 2,334.7 m, the highest point in Ulanqab. The scenic area has a 12 km wooden boardwalk through pine woods, the Bingling ravine, rock formations, a cave where monks once meditated and the film set used for the television series Dasheng Kui. It suits walkers and visitors who want cool mountain air within day-trip distance of Xinghe.
description: 苏木山位于内蒙古乌兰察布。游览特色包括林地风光、洞穴、影视拍摄。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills about 35 km south-south-west of Xinghe, the county seat, and about 72 km south-east of Jining.

name: 当代中国书法艺术馆
summaryEn: A large art museum in Haibowan, built from 2010 in a city that the China Calligraphers Association named a calligraphy city in 2008. The square building has a glass dome carrying a design taken from the sun-god rock engraving of Zhuozi Mountain, about 38 exhibition halls and room to show more than 6,000 works at once. It suits visitors interested in calligraphy and Chinese painting.
description: 当代中国书法艺术馆位于内蒙古乌海。游览特色包括博物馆、书法文化、主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Xuefu Street in Haibowan district, close to the Wuhai city government. Closed on Mondays.

name: 金沙湾生态旅游区
summaryEn: Jinshawan is a desert recreation area north of Wuhai, set in a hollow between two facing sand hills, the eastern one rising to 156 m. Visitors slide down the dunes, ride camels and take dune-buggy rides, and the area lies close to Wuhai airport. It suits visitors who want a short desert outing from the city.
description: 金沙湾生态旅游区位于内蒙古乌海。游览特色包括沙漠。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 15 km north-north-east of the Wuhai city government in Haibowan, near Wuhai airport.

name: 蒙根花生态休闲区
summaryEn: Menggenhua is a leisure park beside Wuhai airport that combines an indoor hot-spring and water-park complex with an amusement park, greenhouses and a peony garden. It also has a hotel and villas for overnight stays and suits families looking for an indoor day out.
description: 蒙根花生态休闲区位于内蒙古乌海。游览特色包括主题游乐、园林景观、公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 16 km north of the Wuhai city government in Haibowan, just north of Wuhai airport. Check that it is open before going.

name: 阳光田宇国际酒庄
summaryEn: Sunshine Tianyu is a vineyard and winery visitor estate in Saihanwusu, Hainan District, south of Wuhai, that began receiving visitors in early 2015. It presents wine culture through sightseeing, farm experiences, resort and conference facilities, with Mongolian cultural elements built into the design, across about 750 mu of visitor area. It suits visitors with an interest in wine and farm stays.
description: 阳光田宇国际酒庄位于内蒙古乌海。游览特色包括葡萄酒文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Saihanwusu village in the south of Hainan District, about 29 km south of the Wuhai city government in Haibowan, beside the Haihui road; the Rongwu expressway passes through the estate. Check that it is open before going.

name: 乌海湖
summaryEn: Wuhai Lake is the reservoir of the Haibowan water control project on the Yellow River, completed in 2013, and its 118 square kilometres of water lie between the Ulan Buh Desert and the city. Visitors can take boat trips from the No. 1 pier, ride a small sightseeing train and try more than twenty water and desert activities, from speedboats and flyboards to desert buggies and camel rides, while reed beds on the south and west shores attract many water birds. It suits visitors who want a desert-edge lake right beside a city.
description: 乌海湖位于内蒙古乌海。游览特色包括沙漠、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the western edge of Wuhai's Haibowan district, about 1 km west-north-west of the Wuhai city government.

name: 布林泉
summaryEn: Bulin Spring is a grassland scenic area built around eight springs that flow all year at about 5 °C, with the remains of Bulin Temple, founded in 1672, about 1.5 km away; the temple site was conserved from 2010. The area also has an octagonal pavilion, a Genghis Khan statue, a ger camp, a boardwalk, an oboo and a bonfire square, and more than ten films, including Wolf Totem, have been shot here. It suits visitors who want a night in a ger camp on the grassland.
description: 布林泉位于内蒙古锡林郭勒。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、草原。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Ulagai Management Area, about 10 km north-north-west of Bayanhushuo, the seat of the management area.

name: 中国马都核心区
summaryEn: A sports and culture complex of about 15 square kilometres on the southern edge of Xilinhot, developed from 2013 around Xilingol's title as China's horse capital, which the China Horse Industry Association gave the league in 2010. It has indoor and outdoor racecourses with stands, an equestrian club and riding school, stables, a horse-culture museum and a theatre for horse shows, and it has hosted national equestrian competitions. It suits visitors interested in horses and racing rather than historic sites.
description: 中国马都核心区位于内蒙古锡林郭勒。游览特色包括博物馆、戏剧演艺。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the southern edge of Xilinhot, south of the second ring road and between the old and new G207 roads.

name: 多伦湖
summaryEn: Duolun Lake is a reservoir on the upper Luan River, created by the Xishanwan hydropower scheme completed in 1999, with a surface of about 20,000 mu among hills, sand and grassland. The resort area is made up of seven linked lakes with islands and peninsulas and has a hotel, a visitor centre, a fishing village, lakeside piers and a riding trail, and a road cycling race has been held around the lake each year since 2007. It suits visitors who want a lakeside stay or day out in the Duolun area.
description: 多伦湖位于内蒙古锡林郭勒。游览特色包括草原、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the eastern side of Duolun County, about 19 km east-south-east of Duolun Nor, the county seat.

name: 二连浩特国门景区
summaryEn: The scenic area is built around the National Gate, a monumental gateway at Erenhot's port of entry on the northern edge of the city. Visitors can see ger-building craft works, cultural products and study-tour programmes, and alpacas from Sunid Left Banner joined the attractions in 2024. It suits travellers who want to see the port of entry on the Trans-Mongolian railway route.
description: 二连浩特国门景区位于内蒙古锡林郭勒。游览特色包括边境口岸。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the northern edge of Erenhot, at the port of entry on the Jining–Erenhot railway.

name: 二连浩特国家地质公园
summaryEn: The geopark lies on the north-eastern edge of Erenhot, in the Iren Dabasu area, which is known for Cretaceous dinosaur fossils. Its dinosaur museum has large moving models of the animals. It suits families and anyone passing through Erenhot with a few hours to spare.
description: 二连浩特国家地质公园位于内蒙古锡林郭勒。游览特色包括博物馆、地质景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 10 km north-north-east of the Erenhot city government.

name: 御马苑
summaryEn: Yumayuan is a horse-culture and riding centre on the grassland of Taipusi Banner, with a collection of horses of more than twenty breeds, among them Akhal-Teke, Friesian, Dutch warmblood and English thoroughbred. It has stables, a racing track, a barrel-racing ground, indoor and outdoor training areas, a horse hospital and a museum of imperial horse culture, and visitors can watch and ride the horses and join study programmes. It suits families and groups on a grassland trip.
description: 御马苑位于内蒙古锡林郭勒。游览特色包括博物馆、草原。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 22 km south-south-west of Baochang, the Taipusi Banner seat, off the G207 near the Gongbaolage exit of the Xilinhot–Zhangjiakou expressway. Check that it is open before going.

name: 蒙古汗城
summaryEn: Mongol Khan City is a ger resort camp in the grassland of West Ujimqin Banner, with buildings modelled on the khan's city of Genghis Khan's enthronement and more than 150 gers for dining and overnight stays. It stages Mongolian song and dance, a small Naadam-style show and evening bonfire gatherings, and in 2023 it was named one of the region's first intangible-heritage tourism experience bases. It suits groups and families who want to stay in a ger on the grassland.
description: 蒙古汗城位于内蒙古锡林郭勒。游览特色包括草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the grassland about 15 km south-south-east of Balagaer Gol, the West Ujimqin Banner seat. Check that it is open before going.

name: 星空文化旅游营地
summaryEn: The camp occupies 1,300 mu of grassland in Zhengxiangbai Banner, just north of the National Astronomical Observatory's Mingantu observing station. It has a science area with an astronomy exhibition hall, a science square and a lecture hall, and a living area with folk-style lodging and dining, and it runs stargazing and study programmes on astronomy, spaceflight and weather. It suits families and school groups with an interest in astronomy.
description: 星空文化旅游营地位于内蒙古锡林郭勒。游览特色包括草原、主题展览、航天科普。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the grassland about 22 km east-south-east of Mingantu, the Zhengxiangbai Banner seat.

name: 乌拉盖九曲湾
summaryEn: Jiuquwan is a stretch of the Ulagai River in the far east of Xilingol where the river winds in tight loops through wetland and grassland. The scenic area covers about 3,500 hectares and has been developed since 2015, with a large visitor centre; visitors can ride in a traditional ox cart, watch Mongolian song and dance and take cross-country trips over the grassland. It suits visitors who want river and wetland scenery on the grassland of north-eastern Inner Mongolia.
description: 乌拉盖九曲湾位于内蒙古锡林郭勒。游览特色包括湿地、草原。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Ulagai Management Area, about 69 km east-north-east of Bayanhushuo, the seat of the management area.

name: 乌拉盖野狼谷
summaryEn: Wolf Valley is a themed grassland attraction on the Hesige Ula ranch in the Ulagai Management Area, and was one of the main filming locations for the film Wolf Totem. Visitors cross the grassland on a small tourist train, stay in colourfully painted lodging houses, join evening tours of the valley and see steppe wolves at close range. It suits families and groups who want a themed stop on a grassland trip rather than open landscape.
description: 乌拉盖野狼谷位于内蒙古锡林郭勒。游览特色包括草原、山谷。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Ulagai Management Area, about 61 km north-north-east of Bayanhushuo, the seat of the management area.

name: 乌兰五台
summaryEn: Wulan Wutai is a scenic area of Mongolian Buddhist culture in the grassland of West Ujimqin Banner; its name means Red Wutai in Mongolian. The banner government built a large oboo, a Genghis Khan square, a Wutai temple and sixteen pagodas here in 2006, and an oboo-worship day with Buddhist rites, wrestling and horse racing is held on the 13th day of the fifth lunar month. It suits visitors interested in Mongolian religious customs and grassland scenery.
description: 乌兰五台位于内蒙古锡林郭勒。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、草原、古塔。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jirengaole town, about 62 km south-west of Balagaer Gol, the West Ujimqin Banner seat.

name: 鞍钢博物馆（鞍山钢铁厂早期建筑）
summaryEn: The Ansteel Group Museum fills the former No. 2 sintering shop of the Anshan steelworks, a 1950s building designed with Soviet help and one of eight early buildings listed together as a national heritage unit that runs from the Japanese-run works of the 1920s and 1930s to the Soviet-assisted rebuilding of the 1950s. Eleven themed galleries and a steel-themed park cover the works' history, and the old shop keeps its sintering machine and overhead crane beside Anshan's No. 1 blast furnace of 1919, shut down in 2005. The other listed buildings include offices, workshops and former housing in and around the working plant and are mostly in other use.
description: 鞍钢博物馆（鞍山钢铁厂早期建筑）位于辽宁鞍山。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位、国家一级博物馆。图集建议预留约2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Huangang Road just west of the main gate of the Ansteel works in Tiexi District, about 1 km north of Anshan railway station; the museum is closed on Mondays.

name: 佳宁欢乐谷
summaryEn: A leisure-farm resort of 340 mu (about 23 ha) in Yujiagou village near Tanggangzi, combining fishing, fruit picking, a zoo, a children's play area, a water park, sand and grass sliding, horse riding and live-action team shooting games. The provincial tourism page also lists hot-spring bathing, a swimming pool, an aerial cableway and a rapids ride, with garden features such as a Great Wall, a waterfall cave and zodiac figures. It is a commercial attraction for family and group outings.
description: 佳宁欢乐谷位于辽宁鞍山。游览特色包括瀑布、长城、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yujiagou village, about 17 km south-south-west of central Anshan. Check that it is open before going.

name: 龙泉湖
summaryEn: A lake-and-hills leisure resort in Qianying, Xiuyan Manchu Autonomous County, begun in 2000 and covering nearly 10,000 mu, about 6.5 sq km. The provincial tourism page says a stream rises in a mountain-top lake, which it calls rare in north-east China, and that buildings step down the valley in the outline of a dragon. The resort has since added culture and arts activities, lodging, dining, shopping, and wellness and retirement services, so it is mainly a leisure destination.
description: 龙泉湖位于辽宁鞍山。游览特色包括湖泊、山谷、休闲度假。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Qianying, about 14 km south-south-west of Xiuyan town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 千山老院子
summaryEn: A leisure resort in the village of Hanjiayu, in the Qianshan hills, laid out around courtyard-style buildings and gardens in a traditional manner. The provincial tourism page lists guesthouses, a petting zoo, a children's adventure park without powered rides, a winter snow-and-ice area, restaurants and a summer tent camp with 30 tents. It suits families and short breaks rather than sightseeing, and lies next to the Qianshan scenic area rather than inside it.
description: 千山老院子位于辽宁鞍山。游览特色包括动物观赏、园林景观、休闲度假。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Hanjiayu village, about 4 km east-south-east of Qianshan's main gate and about 20 km east-south-east of central Anshan.

name: 山水庄园
summaryEn: A hot-spring leisure resort at Gushouyu, in the Yuanbao hills at the foot of Qianshan. The provincial tourism page describes a rural-style resort where visitors can travel, stay, dine, shop and be entertained, in a hilly setting it calls a natural bonsai landscape. It is a modern commercial resort aimed at short breaks from Anshan rather than a historic or scenic sight.
description: 山水庄园位于辽宁鞍山。游览特色包括休闲度假、庄园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills at Gushouyu village, about 20 km east-south-east of central Anshan. Check that it is open before going.

name: 石头记千山大观园
summaryEn: A themed garden based on Dream of the Red Chamber (also called The Story of the Stone, Shitouji in Chinese), built at the foot of Qianshan in Anshan's high-tech zone and opened in 2023. More than 20 groups of buildings follow the novel's descriptions, among them the Yihong Courtyard, Xiaoxiang Lodge and Longcui Convent, and the Xiaoxiang group holds an art museum for the actress Chen Xiaoxu, a native of Anshan who played Lin Daiyu in the 1987 television series. The garden is lit at night and stages performances based on the novel.
description: 石头记千山大观园位于辽宁鞍山。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At the foot of Qianshan in Anshan's high-tech zone, about 11 km east-south-east of central Anshan.

name: 天源农业
summaryEn: A commercial agri-tourism resort of 300 mu (20 ha) at Beigeng village in Gengzhuang town, built around a hot-spring water park with about 12,000 sq m indoors and 4,600 sq m outdoors. The provincial tourism page also lists a winter snow-and-ice play area, a tropical plant garden with some 300 species of rare plants, a fishing pond, a children's play area and a 45,000 sq m agricultural showcase growing more than 600 crop varieties. It is aimed at family days out and group events rather than sightseeing.
description: 天源农业位于辽宁鞍山。游览特色包括水上游乐、田园观光、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Gengzhuang town of Haicheng, about 26 km west-south-west of central Anshan.

name: 祥和度假庄园
summaryEn: A family leisure resort of about 22 ha in Qianshan District, south-west of Anshan, built around an indoor children's play park modelled on a candy town and a flower valley with more than a hundred species of flowers. The provincial tourism page also lists mini golf, an archery hall, a go-kart club, children's off-road karts and bumper boats, and two hotels, villas and log cabins for overnight stays. It is aimed at families with children and short breaks rather than sightseeing.
description: 祥和度假庄园位于辽宁鞍山。游览特色包括山谷、休闲度假、庄园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Daton town, Qianshan District, about 13 km south-west of central Anshan.

name: 御汤泉
summaryEn: An indoor water park and hot-spring resort in the Tanggangzi new town, under an all-glass roof, with more than a hundred Southeast Asian plant species growing inside. The provincial tourism page lists a wave pool and more than 20 rides and slides, including an 'Amazon' rafting river. It is a modern commercial attraction for families and groups, not a historic bathing place.
description: 御汤泉位于辽宁鞍山。游览特色包括水上游乐、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Tanggangzi new town, about 11 km south-south-west of central Anshan. Check that it is open before going.

name: 本溪大峡谷
summaryEn: Benxi Grand Canyon is a gorge in Nanfen District, inside a national geological park, that has been developed as a thrill-oriented adventure park. Its core attractions are a high-level glass suspension bridge and a forest slide, with newer rides such as a "flying wing", an aerial walk, a cliff swing and a water slide. It suits visitors who want activities rather than a quiet walk, and anyone uneasy about heights may prefer to skip the glass bridge.
description: 本溪大峡谷位于辽宁本溪。游览特色包括峡谷、地质景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Nanfen District, about 18 km south-south-west of central Benxi in a straight line (about 25 km by road, roughly half an hour).

name: 大冰沟森林公园
summaryEn: Dabinggou is a forested valley in Nanfen District, with tree cover of about 97 percent and groundwater that stays near 4°C all year. It is known for ice waterfalls in summer, which the provincial tourism page calls rare at such a low altitude in a temperate zone. The park also has a stand of Siebold's magnolia (tiannü mulan) and maples that turn red in autumn.
description: 大冰沟森林公园位于辽宁本溪。游览特色包括瀑布、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills of Nanfen District, about 25 km south-south-east of central Benxi in a straight line (about 36 km by road, under an hour).

name: 大石湖
summaryEn: Dashihu is a two-part mountain scenic area in Benxi Manchu Autonomous County, made up of the Dashi Lake section and the Laobiangou valley, and noted for its autumn maples. The lake section is divided into Wulong Lake, Bingling Gorge, Xiangshui Lake and Mulan Valley zones, while Laobiangou has a river valley, a boulder slope and Wanxiang Valley; the provincial page also describes it as a national geological park. Several sites of fighting by anti-Japanese guerrilla forces lie in Laobiangou.
description: 大石湖位于辽宁本溪。游览特色包括峡谷、地质景观、湖泊。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In the east of Benxi Manchu Autonomous County, about 64 km east-south-east of central Benxi in a straight line (about 89 km by road, roughly an hour and a quarter).

name: 大雅河漂流
summaryEn: Dayahe is a river and valley leisure area in Huanren Manchu Autonomous County, at the foot of Huaping Mountain, an area nicknamed the "little Guilin of the north". It has two parts: a 6.6 km rafting run on a river that alternately narrows and widens, and Longxi Valley, where about 85 percent of the ground is forested and maples grow among waterfalls and a dragon pool. Restaurants, accommodation and entertainment are on site.
description: 大雅河漂流位于辽宁本溪。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills west-south-west of Huanren town, about 28 km from it in a straight line (about 42 km by road, roughly half an hour).

name: 枫林谷森林公园
summaryEn: Fenglin Valley is a forest park in Huanren Manchu Autonomous County, known for the red maples of autumn; forest covers nearly 99 percent of the park and its highest peak, Bamianwei, reaches 1,305 m. The provincial tourism page gives a summer average temperature of about 20°C. The park also contains remains of an anti-Japanese guerrilla base, including a stone barracks and a hidden mountain camp at Wohu Peak.
description: 枫林谷森林公园位于辽宁本溪。游览特色包括森林公园、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills south-west of Huanren town, about 22 km from it in a straight line (about 36 km by road, roughly half an hour).

name: 汤池沟绿石谷
summaryEn: Green Stone Valley is a forested valley in Benxi Manchu Autonomous County, named for the moss-covered boulders that fill the valley and give the rocks a jade-green look. Waterfalls large and small run through it, and the provincial tourism page calls it a rare moss-viewing area, with tree cover of about 90 percent.
description: 汤池沟绿石谷位于辽宁本溪。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills of Benxi Manchu Autonomous County, about 45 km east-south-east of central Benxi in a straight line (about 69 km by road, roughly an hour).

name: 关山湖
summaryEn: Guanshan Lake is a reservoir in forested hills in Benxi Manchu Autonomous County, developed as a national water-conservancy scenic area and known for its autumn colour. The provincial tourism page lists about 40 sights in four zones, built around boat cruises on the lake, a summit climb, a spring-fed valley and a lakeshore circuit. Activities include kayaking, small lake rafts, a campfire barbecue ground and an RV camp.
description: 关山湖位于辽宁本溪。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Benxi Manchu Autonomous County, about 37 km east-south-east of central Benxi in a straight line (about 54 km by road, under an hour).

name: 青云山
summaryEn: Qingyunshan is a hill scenic area on the southern edge of Benxi city, in Mingshan District, where visitors climb up for views out over the city. Official tourism pages record events there in 2024 and 2025: a spring garden fair with a night lantern show, lantern-floating wishes, intangible-heritage displays and hanfu (traditional dress) activities; a Mid-Autumn moon-viewing fair; a hill-running race in May 2025; and a martial-arts event on its Sifangtai platform in October 2025. It suits a short outing from the city, and because the events run on a seasonal calendar, check what is on before planning around one.
description: 青云山位于辽宁本溪。游览特色包括园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the southern edge of Benxi, a few hundred metres from the Benxi South expressway exit and about 5.5 km south-east of Benxi railway station in a straight line.

name: 铁刹山
summaryEn: Tieshashan, also called Jiuding Tieshashan ("nine-peak" Tieshashan), is a Daoist mountain in Benxi Manchu Autonomous County that is regarded as the birthplace of the Longmen school of Daoism in north-east China. Five main peaks, which look like nine when seen from different sides, belong to the Changbai mountain range, and the best-known of its many caves is Babao Yunguang Cave. Old inscriptions are cut into the rock across the mountain, and the Sanqing Temple on the mountain was founded in 1744.
description: 铁刹山又名九顶铁刹山、铁刹山景区，是位于中华人民共和国辽宁省本溪市溪田铁路南甸子车站西南的一座山，太子河位于其北，八盘岭位于其南。铁刹山山上有元始顶、真武顶、灵宝顶、玉皇顶、玄武顶、太上顶和锦绣顶等山峰，最高峰海拔912.9米。
accessEn: In the hills of Benxi Manchu Autonomous County, about 47 km east of central Benxi in a straight line (about 71 km by road, roughly an hour).
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 望天洞
summaryEn: Wangtian Cave is a karst cave in Huanren Manchu Autonomous County that the provincial tourism page dates to about 200,000 years ago. Explored passages total nearly 10 km, of which about 2.1 km is open to visitors, and the cave has corridor-like, hall-like and maze-like sections. Its best-known feature is a maze of about 1.1 km of passages, alongside small rimstone terraces and thin, translucent "stone flags".
description: 望天洞位于辽宁本溪。游览特色包括洞穴、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the hills south-west of Huanren town, about 14 km from it in a straight line (about 22 km by road, roughly a quarter of an hour).

name: 小市一庄
summaryEn: Xiaoshi Yizhuang is a rural tourism village at Tongjiangyu in Xiaoshi town, about 1 km from the Benxi Water Caves, developed around folk-custom experiences, local food, countryside stays and cultural shows. It has been named a provincial night-time culture and tourism consumption zone, so evening events are part of the offer. It is a modern tourism development rather than a historic village, and suits visitors who want a meal stop or a base next to the water cave.
description: 小市一庄位于辽宁本溪。游览特色包括田园观光、洞穴、村落风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Tongjiangyu village in Xiaoshi town, about 1 km from the Benxi Water Caves (according to the provincial tourism page) and about 24 km east of central Benxi in a straight line.

name: 朝阳鸟化石国家地质公园
summaryEn: The geopark in Longcheng District centres on the Liaoning Chaoyang Palaeontological Fossil Museum, which reopened in April 2025 after an upgrade. Xinhua reported that the museum now shows 2,025 fossils, up from 435, in a main hall on the Jehol Biota and four themed halls covering dinosaurs, the origin of birds, flowering plants and mammals. The provincial tourism page also lists a geological corridor, a fossil excavation site on the original find location and a petrified-wood forest.
description: 朝阳鸟化石国家地质公园位于辽宁朝阳。游览特色包括博物馆、地质景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Longniao Street in Longcheng District, about 7 km west-north-west of central Chaoyang and about 2 km west of Chaoyang railway station.

name: 北票大玄山
summaryEn: Daxuan Mountain, the name the provincial culture department now gives to the Dahei Shan scenic area, is a forested mountain in the north-west of Beipiao with rocky peaks and, by the department's figure, forest cover above 93%. The official description lists a 2.2 km sightseeing cable car, a 4.5 km step-free path and a 5 km timber boardwalk on the upper slopes, and more than a hundred sights, among them one called 'May ice'. It suits walkers and families wanting a half day in the hills.
description: 北票大玄山位于辽宁朝阳。游览特色包括林地风光、缆车观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills about 33 km north-west of central Beipiao.

name: 凌河第一湾
summaryEn: The Daling River makes a sharp S-shaped bend between hills in Kazuo county, and this scenic area links viewpoints along the river through four townships. Downstream, high in a cliff above the river, lies Gezidong ('Pigeon Cave'), a limestone rock shelter used by Palaeolithic people some 70,000 to 80,000 years ago, excavated in 1973 and 1975 and listed as a national heritage unit in 2019.
description: 凌河第一湾位于辽宁朝阳。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、洞穴、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the Daling River about 18 km east-north-east of Kazuo county town; the cave sits high on a cliff and is a protected archaeological site, so check locally whether it can be approached.

name: 朝阳化石谷
summaryEn: Fossil Valley is a commercially run, fossil-themed attraction in Longcheng District on the north-west side of Chaoyang, covering about 1.7 hectares in three parts: an interactive 'legendary fossil' experience park, the Chaoyang Jurassic Palaeontological Fossil Museum (a privately owned museum, formerly the Jizantang museum) and a fossil-culture creative area. It suits families and school groups who want a hands-on introduction to the area's fossils. The separate Chaoyang Bird Fossil National Geopark lies about 2 km to the west-north-west.
description: 朝阳化石谷位于辽宁朝阳。游览特色包括博物馆、山谷、化石遗迹。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Longquan Street in Longcheng District, about 4 km west-north-west of central Chaoyang and about 1 km south of Chaoyang railway station.

name: 老虎沟生态旅游区
summaryEn: Laohugou ('Tiger Gully') is a wooded valley scenic area in Dawangzhangzi township, south-west of Lingyuan, a township nicknamed the 'seventy-li apricot valley' and rich in Jehol Biota fossils. A palaeontological fossil museum in Gongjiashaoguo village, where the scenic area lies, opened in December 2025. It is a small, recently developed area that suits a short outing from Lingyuan.
description: 老虎沟生态旅游区位于辽宁朝阳。游览特色包括博物馆、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Dawangzhangzi township, about 8 km south-west of central Lingyuan. The fossil museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 喀左龙凤山
summaryEn: Longfeng ('Dragon and Phoenix') Mountain is a hill scenic area east of Kazuo county town, with rock outcrops, old cypresses, an old temple, caves and springs. Named features on the official page include an entrance-gate area, a pool-and-stream system, a misty forest, a primitive-tribe theme area and Longquan Valley, and the area is promoted around dragon and blessing-prayer themes.
description: 喀左龙凤山位于辽宁朝阳。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills about 21 km east-south-east of Kazuo county town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 龙源旅游区
summaryEn: The Longyuan tourism area is a lakeside leisure district at the edge of Kazuo county town, built around Longyuan Lake. The provincial tourism department lists a city-planning exhibition hall, a health-and-leisure centre, the Tiancheng Taoist temple, an ethnic-folk museum, the Lizhou Pagoda, the Baiyin'aili ethnic village and a purple-clay pottery culture park among its sights, and describes it as shared between visitors and residents.
description: 龙源旅游区位于辽宁朝阳。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the southern edge of Kazuo county town, about 4 km south-south-east of the town centre.

name: 朝阳千佛洞
summaryEn: Qianfodong ('Thousand Buddha Caves') is a hill scenic area in Nanshuangmiao township, south of Chaoyang, with odd-shaped rock formations, a Buddhist site that the provincial culture department traces back a thousand years and the remains of what it calls a Sui–Tang 'general-review platform'. It is split into history-and-culture, ecological-leisure and adventure zones, with a zip line, a rainbow bridge across a gorge, a revolutionary-themed film and television base and more than thirty named sights.
description: 朝阳千佛洞位于辽宁朝阳。游览特色包括峡谷、历史纪念、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Nanshuangmiao township, about 35 km south-south-west of central Chaoyang. Check that it is open before going.

name: 浴龙谷温泉度假区
summaryEn: Yulonggu is a hot-spring and water-play resort with a Mongolian theme on the south-western side of Kazuo, with hot-spring pools, a large wave pool and a drifting river that runs partly underground. It also has some twenty amusement rides, meeting rooms and restaurants, and suits families and groups after a leisure day or an overnight stay rather than sightseeing.
description: 浴龙谷温泉度假区位于辽宁朝阳。游览特色包括温泉、天然泉水、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the south-western outskirts of Kazuo, about 10 km south-west of the county town centre.

name: 安波旅游景区
summaryEn: Anbo is a hot-spring area in the hills of northern Pulandian District, and the listed scenic area spreads across five of the district's subdistricts. It includes a hot-spring villa, a ski resort, a water park, hill scenic spots such as Laomaoshan and Jiguanshan, and a Manchu folk park. The Weibashan fortress and the Shipenggou dolmen, both national heritage sites, lie within the area and have their own entries.
description: 安波旅游景区位于辽宁大连。游览特色包括滑雪、城堡。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In the hills of northern Pulandian District, about 53 km north-north-east of Pulandian town and about 113 km north-north-east of central Dalian in a straight line.

name: 棒棰岛宾馆景区
summaryEn: This coastal scenic area on the eastern stretch of Dalian's Binhai Road takes its name from a small club-shaped islet about 600 m offshore. Its core is the Bangchuidao Guesthouse, which the provincial tourism department and the national environment ministry describe as one of the first four state guesthouses of the People's Republic, set in woodland beside a sand beach with a lotus lake and a tree-lined avenue. The beach, about 1.2 km long, is the main draw for visitors.
description: 棒棰岛宾馆景区位于辽宁大连。游览特色包括湖泊、海滨。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the eastern stretch of Binhai Road in Dalian's Zhongshan district, about 7 km east-south-east of Zhongshan Square (straight line).

name: 大连武术文化博物馆
summaryEn: A museum of Chinese martial arts, with exhibits on the history of the martial arts in China and in Dalian over the past century. The collection centres on cold weapons from the Ming dynasty to modern times, along with boxing manuals and other martial-arts papers. A sunken ring-shaped theatre hosts demonstrations and staged shows.
description: 大连武术文化博物馆位于辽宁大连。游览特色包括博物馆、历史建筑、戏剧演艺。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xigang District, about 5 km south-south-west of Zhongshan Square in central Dalian in a straight line; closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 圣亚海洋世界
summaryEn: This commercial aquarium park in Xinghai Park by Xinghai Bay has four venues: Ocean World with a 118 m underwater tunnel, Polar World with Antarctic penguins and a spotted-seal bay, Coral World, and a zone of sea, land and air animals. Dolphin, sea-lion and beluga shows are staged in the park. It suits families and school groups.
description: 圣亚海洋世界位于辽宁大连。游览特色包括水族展览。图集建议预留3–4 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xinghai Park in Shahekou district, about 8 km south-west of Zhongshan Square (straight line).

name: 关向应故居纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial museum at the birthplace of Guan Xiangying (1902–46), a Chinese Communist leader who served as a political commissar in the Red Army and the Eighth Route Army. The site has his restored family home, a Manchu-style courtyard and a main hall with about 2,000 sq m of galleries, including scenes of the Long March. The museum was first built in 1964, and its displays were renewed in 2022.
description: 关向应故居纪念馆位于辽宁大连。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Daguantun village, Xiangying subdistrict, Jinzhou District, about 48 km north-north-east of central Dalian in a straight line; closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 海王九岛
summaryEn: Haiwang Jiudao is a group of nine islands and dozens of reefs in the Yellow Sea off Wangjia town, Zhuanghe, including Dawangjia, Xiaowangjia and Shoulong Islands. The land area is 9.64 square kilometres and the sea area 380 square kilometres, and the islands are a national island forest park and a provincial-level tourism resort. The provincial tourism department recommends them as a summer retreat, with a mild semi-humid monsoon climate.
description: 海王九岛位于辽宁大连。游览特色包括森林公园、岛屿、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
accessEn: Off the coast of Wangjia town, about 30 km south-south-east of Zhuanghe city (straight line) and reached by boat from Zhuanghe port, about 20 km across the water; sailings depend on the weather, so check them before going.

name: 横山北普陀主题文化公园
summaryEn: This Buddhist-themed culture park of about 45 hectares in wooded hills was begun in 2003 and rated 4A in 2014. The provincial tourism department describes pavilions, halls, streams and ponds that combine traditional architecture, garden design and calligraphy, with spring flowers and autumn foliage. The park includes Hengshan Temple, a Buddhist temple.
description: 横山北普陀主题文化公园位于辽宁大连。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the hills at Dashidong village, Longwangtang subdistrict, about 30 km by road west-south-west of central Dalian.

name: 将军石旅游景区
summaryEn: A leisure resort at Bohai village on the Bohai coast of Wafangdian, centred on a hotel with villas, a hot-spring club and conference rooms. Activities include fishing, picking, a ski slope, a riding ground, a sailing base and a yacht marina. It suits families and groups looking for a weekend resort rather than sightseeing.
description: 将军石旅游景区位于辽宁大连。游览特色包括休闲度假。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: On the Bohai coast, about 42 km north-west of Wafangdian city centre and about 110 km north of central Dalian in a straight line. Check that it is open before going.

name: 旅顺潜艇博物馆
summaryEn: The museum stands on the seafront below Huangjin (Golden) Hill in Lüshun and shows a retired Type 033 submarine alongside more than 60 other retired naval, land and air equipment items. It also has two '6D' ride theatres that simulate a submarine cruise, and the site includes the Huangjin Hill bathing beach. The museum and its partner areas cover about 6 hectares.
description: 旅顺潜艇博物馆位于辽宁大连。游览特色包括博物馆、海滨。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the Huangjin Hill shore in Lüshun, about 3.6 km east-south-east of the Lüshun Museum (straight line).

name: 铭湖国际温泉滑雪度假区
summaryEn: A resort of more than 4,000 mu (about 270 hectares) in the hills of Paotai subdistrict, combining a hot-spring hotel, a ski area and a farm-style ranch. The hot-spring water comes from a well about 2,600 m deep, and the ski area has five slopes plus a tubing run. It suits winter family trips more than sightseeing.
description: 铭湖国际温泉滑雪度假区位于辽宁大连。游览特色包括滑雪、温泉。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Paotai subdistrict, in the hills of the northern Jinpu New Area, about 66 km north-north-east of central Dalian in a straight line. Check that it is open before going.

name: 平岛辽参小镇
summaryEn: A tourist island off the Yellow Sea coast of Pulandian District, themed on local sea-cucumber farming, for which the provincial tourism department lists 12 protection zones. Its landmark is a sea-cucumber sculpture carved from a single block of Xiuyan jade, and at low tide visitors can gather shellfish and fish along the beaches around the island. It suits families and anyone curious about the local seafood industry.
description: 平岛辽参小镇位于辽宁大连。游览特色包括海滨、岛屿、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On a small island in the east of Pulandian District, about 32 km east-south-east of Pulandian town and about 76 km north-east of central Dalian in a straight line. Check that it is open before going.

name: 七彩南山
summaryEn: Qicai Nanshan is a rural tourism park of about one square kilometre at Xiaonan village in Lüshun, opened in 2010. According to the provincial tourism department it has five parts: a 'space plants' garden, a butterfly garden, the Songshushan fort (a Russo-Japanese War site), a countryside play area and a folk village, plus a village history hall and children's play areas. It mainly suits families with children.
description: 七彩南山位于辽宁大连。游览特色包括田园观光、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Xiaonan village in Shuishiying subdistrict, Lüshun, about 4 km north-north-east of the Lüshun Museum (straight line).

name: 世外俭汤
summaryEn: A hot-spring scenic area of about 3.8 sq km in wooded hills at Jiantang, in Anbo subdistrict of Pulandian District. The provincial tourism department describes a spring that flows naturally at about 57°C, set among forest and countryside. It suits visitors who want hot-spring bathing in a rural setting.
description: 世外俭汤位于辽宁大连。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Jiantang in Anbo subdistrict, about 16 km north-east of the Anbo hot-spring resort and about 129 km north-north-east of central Dalian in a straight line. Check that it is open before going.

name: 天门山国家森林公园
summaryEn: Tianmenshan National Forest Park lies in the mountains of northern Zhuanghe and borders Gaizhou, Yingkou and Xiuyan. The provincial tourism department lists 36 peaks above 800 m, the highest being Douyunfeng at 926 m, with cliffs, caves and gorges. Its main activity is rafting on the Tianmen Gorge, a course of about 10 km with a 91 m drop that takes two to three hours.
description: 天门山国家森林公园位于辽宁大连。游览特色包括峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the mountains of northern Zhuanghe, which the provincial tourism department places 66 km north of Zhuanghe and 220 km from Dalian. Check that it is open before going.

name: 仙浴湾旅游度假区
summaryEn: A seaside resort on the west coast of Wafangdian, with about 11 km of shoreline of which 6.4 km is bathing beach, backed by woodland and a forest park. The resort has a visitor centre, a seaside temple, a pine maze, a hot-spring hotel and silica-sand bathing. It was named a national marine park in 2016 and a 4A tourist resort in 2017.
description: 仙浴湾旅游度假区位于辽宁大连。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园、海滨。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: On the west coast of Wafangdian, about 44 km west-north-west of Wafangdian city centre and about 87 km north of central Dalian in a straight line. Check that it is open before going.

name: 小水口森林公园
summaryEn: A wooded coastal park of about 1.2 sq km at the eastern tip of Xiaochangshan Island in the Changshan Islands. A boardwalk of about 550 m runs along the rocky shore, with a glass-floored section of over 30 m, and woodland covers more than 80 percent of the park. Local tourism officials describe it as the only 4A scenic area on the islands.
description: 小水口森林公园位于辽宁大连。游览特色包括森林公园、岛屿、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At the eastern tip of Xiaochangshan Island, Changhai County, about 102 km east-north-east of central Dalian in a straight line; the islands are reached by sea from the mainland, and a bridge links Xiaochangshan with Dachangshan Island.

name: 西郊国家森林公园
summaryEn: A large forest park of about 70 sq km on the north-western edge of Dalian, with some 85 percent tree cover. Its main areas are West Mountain Lake with a nine-island wetland, Tangli Lake, which has hosted trail-running and archery events, Hongqi Valley with a golf course, and Changqing Lake, known for cherries. It serves as one of Dalian's main green spaces.
description: 西郊国家森林公园位于辽宁大连。游览特色包括湿地、森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the north-western edge of Dalian in Ganjingzi District, roughly 12 km west of central Dalian in a straight line.

name: 英歌石植物园
summaryEn: This privately run botanical garden of about 100 hectares in the hills of Dalian's high-tech zone was begun in 2003 and opened in April 2014. The provincial tourism department says it has collected 3,021 plant species in 126 families, and it is known for successive flowerings from spring to autumn, including tulips, cherry and peach blossom, peonies, hydrangeas and chrysanthemums.
description: 英歌石植物园位于辽宁大连。游览特色包括植物园、园林景观、赏花。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Yinggeshi village, Longwangtang subdistrict, about 30 km by road west of central Dalian.

name: 紫云花汐薰衣草庄园
summaryEn: A flower and herb farm of about 1,100 mu (roughly 73 hectares) in the hills of Xiangying subdistrict, planted mainly with lavender, verbena, sage and roses, plus fruit orchards and plum trees. It is run as a romance-themed leisure park, with RV camping, lodging, picking and activities such as small-bore shooting. Its lavender and other blue-purple flower fields are the main draw.
description: 紫云花汐薰衣草庄园位于辽宁大连。游览特色包括果园、花卉观赏、庄园。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tumenzi village, Xiangying subdistrict, Jinzhou District, about 49 km north-north-east of central Dalian in a straight line. Check that it is open before going.

name: 大梨树生态农业观光旅游区
summaryEn: The Dalishu tourism area is a rural-tourism complex in and around Dalishu village, south-west of Fengcheng, which the provincial tourism department counts among the first national agricultural-tourism demonstration sites. It is laid out as four zones, for leisure-farming experiences, health and culture, ethnic-village sightseeing and visitor services, and it includes picking gardens and a film-set town. It is a modern leisure attraction for families and groups, not a historic village.
description: 大梨树生态农业观光旅游区位于辽宁丹东。游览特色包括田园观光、园林景观、农业体验。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: The provincial tourism page puts it 10 km south-west of Fengcheng and 5 km from the Fengcheng exit of the Dandong–Fuxin expressway.

name: 天华山森林公园
summaryEn: Tianhuashan is a provincial scenic area and forest park in the mountains of Guanshui town in northern Kuandian County, made a provincial forest park in January 2001. The provincial tourism page lists Bailongjian, Tianhuafeng, Yulongjian, Qinglongjian and Foguangding among its walking areas and picks out Bailongjian, Tongtian Gorge, Tiantai and Maogong Peak as its main sights. It is a gorge-and-peak landscape for walking, well away from the Dandong riverfront sights.
description: 天华山森林公园位于辽宁丹东。游览特色包括峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In the north-west of Guanshui town, about 43 km north-north-west of Kuandian town in a straight line.

name: 天桥沟
summaryEn: Tianqiaogou is a forest park in the mountains of northern Kuandian County, close to the boundaries with Huanren and Benxi counties, and is best known for its autumn maple colour. The provincial tourism page describes it as covering more than 4,000 ha and as one of China's well-known maple-viewing parks. Autumn is the season to go.
description: 天桥沟位于辽宁丹东。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Shuangshanzi town in the north of Kuandian County, about 39 km north-north-west of Kuandian town in a straight line; the provincial page gives 59 km from the county seat and 159 km from Dandong.

name: 鸭绿江风景名胜区
summaryEn: The Yalu River Scenic Area is a national-level scenic and historic area that follows the river from the Hun River mouth, at the Liaoning–Jilin boundary, down to the sea; the provincial tourism department lists six sections: Jiangkou, Daqiao (the bridges at Dandong), Hushan, Taipingwan, Shuifeng and Lüjiang. Most visitors meet it in Dandong, where the riverfront looks across to the North Korean city of Sinuiju and the Broken Bridge and the Hushan Great Wall, both national heritage units with entries of their own, are the best-known stops. The pin marks the central riverfront park by the bridges rather than a single gate.
description: 鸭绿江风景名胜区位于辽宁丹东。游览特色包括滨水景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Dandong's riverfront about 1 km east of Dandong railway station and 700 m north-north-east of the Broken Bridge; the other sections lie many kilometres up and down the river.

name: 獐岛
summaryEn: Zhangdao, also called Xiaoludao (Little Deer Island), is a small island village in the Yellow Sea off Beijingzi town in Donggang. According to the provincial tourism department it is one main island with six smaller mounds, which separate into six islets at high tide and join into one island at low tide. The village lives mainly from tourism, fishing and aquaculture and has more than 110 hotels and farm guesthouses, so it suits a seaside day trip or a short stay.
description: 獐岛位于辽宁东港近海，是黄海上的渔村海岛，可沿岸观海、了解海岛渔村生活。
accessEn: Reached by boat from the mainland coast of Donggang; the island lies about 11 km south-west of Beijingzi town and about 60 km south-west of Dandong in a straight line.

name: 和睦国家森林公园
summaryEn: Hemu is a long, narrow forest park in the Longgang foothills of Xinbin Manchu Autonomous County, about 7.5 km from end to end and covering some 20,300 mu (about 1,350 ha). The Fushun tourism bureau describes it as holding the country's oldest planted larch forest, and it has a visitor centre, a bagua-pattern maze, log cabins and a hotel used for retreats and conferences. It suits visitors looking for forest walks and a short stay.
description: 和睦国家森林公园位于辽宁抚顺。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills of Xinbin County, roughly 12 km west-north-west of Yongling town in a straight line.

name: 筐子沟景区
summaryEn: Kuangzigou is a forested river-valley scenic area in Qingyuan Manchu Autonomous County, with forest cover given as 95 percent by the local tourism bureaus. A stream runs through the valley past a string of waterfalls, four numbered 'pot' pools, a suspension bridge and birch woods, and the area is promoted for summer cool and autumn colour.
description: 筐子沟景区位于辽宁抚顺。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Qingyuan County, about 10 km west-north-west of Qingyuan town in a straight line; the official tourism page puts it 23 km from the Qingyuan exit of the Shenyang–Jilin expressway.

name: 南天门景区
summaryEn: Nantianmen is a mountain-and-water leisure resort in Qingyuan Manchu Autonomous County with a planned area of about 10 sq km. Its attractions include a high-level glass water slide, a children's park, a high-level swing, a rainbow slide, a jungle-crossing course, a glass suspension bridge, bamboo rafts and boats and plank walkways. It is a commercial leisure park that suits families and groups looking for a day of activities.
description: 南天门景区位于辽宁抚顺。游览特色包括休闲度假、公园休闲、栈道。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dasuhe township, Qingyuan County, about 13 km south of Qingyuan town in a straight line. Check that it is open before going.

name: 红河峡谷漂流
summaryEn: Red River Gorge is a 12.8 km river-rafting run through a forested, U-shaped valley in Qingyuan Manchu Autonomous County, known locally as the 'Little Three Gorges of the north-east' and promoted with the slogan 'the first rafting in the north'. The trip takes about two and a half hours, with calm and fast stretches, and the service areas at the start and finish have changing rooms, showers, a dining hall, a landing stage and parking. Rafting is a summer activity: the 2025 season was formally launched on 22 June.
description: 红河峡谷漂流位于辽宁抚顺。游览特色包括峡谷、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dasuhe township, Qingyuan County, about 14 km south of Qingyuan town in a straight line. Check that it is open before going.

name: 三块石国家森林公园
summaryEn: Sankuaishi is a mountain forest park in Fushun County, named for three huge boulders that stand together on a high summit; its main peak reaches 1,131 m. The Fushun tourism bureau gives its area as 108.7 sq km, with forest covering about 92 percent of it. It was a base area during the war against Japan and the civil war, and sites of the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army survive there, so it is promoted for red tourism as well as scenery.
description: 三块石国家森林公园位于辽宁抚顺。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光、登山观景。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Hou'an town, Fushun County, about 41 km south-east of central Fushun in a straight line (about 59 km by road, roughly an hour).

name: 参仙谷
summaryEn: Shenxian Valley ('Ginseng Immortal Valley') is a forest leisure resort of about 1,360 ha in the mountains of Xinbin Manchu Autonomous County, developed over several years from the mid-2010s. It has lakes, wooded valleys, wooden lodges on the water, a high-level glass rafting ride and other adventure activities, with snowmobiles and horse-drawn sleds in winter, and it is run as a commercial resort. The tourism bureaus repeat a local tradition that the area was once an imperial ginseng ground and hunting preserve of Nurhaci.
description: 参仙谷位于辽宁抚顺。游览特色包括山谷、林地风光、水上活动。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: Inland from Yongling town, Xinbin County: about 19 km east-south-east of the town in a straight line, reached from the Yongling exit of the expressway, and about 120 km by road from Fushun.

name: 天女山森林公园
summaryEn: Tiannüshan is a forested mountain park in Fushun County whose main peak rises to 780 m, covering about 1,380 mu (some 92 ha). It has more than twenty named sights, including the Tongtian path, Nantianmen ('South Heaven Gate'), the Fox Spirit Cave, Zhuanxin Lake and the Phoenix Terrace.
