The Fushun tourism bureau highlights the tiannü magnolia in summer, azaleas in spring and red maples in autumn.
description: 天女山森林公园位于辽宁抚顺。游览特色包括森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Fushun County, about 48 km south-east of central Fushun in a straight line.

name: 宝地斯帕温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort town in Dongliang town, south-west of Fuxin, whose spring water is drawn from a well about 1,888 m deep at 82 °C and described by the provincial tourism page as a sodium bicarbonate spring. The leisure area has a hotel, restaurants, a water park and indoor and outdoor soaking pools, and a separate wellness and retirement section offers medical, research and education services for longer stays. It is a modern commercial resort for relaxing breaks rather than a sightseeing stop.
description: 宝地斯帕温泉位于辽宁阜新。游览特色包括温泉、水上游乐、泉水。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dongliang town, about 13 km south-west of central Fuxin.

name: 德力格尔草原
summaryEn: A lakeshore leisure area of about 800 mu (53 ha) on Deligeer Lake in Zhangwu county, where the provincial tourism page says lake, island, wetland, grassland and sand lie side by side. The listed facilities are a visitor centre, a camping area, guesthouses, a racecourse, an island attraction called Bixin Island, a rainbow slide, a petting zoo, a youth activity base and peony and lotus gardens. It is a commercial site aimed at family and group outings.
description: 德力格尔草原位于辽宁阜新。游览特色包括湿地、草原、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the shore of Deligeer Lake, about 24 km north-north-east of Zhangwu county town.

name: 海棠山
summaryEn: A mountain of old pines and rock outcrops in Daban town, Fuxin Mongol Autonomous County, protected as a national nature reserve and forest park, with a main peak of 715.4 m. Its best-known sight is a set of Qing-dynasty Buddhist figures carved into the cliffs, which the provincial tourism page calls fine examples of Qing Buddhist sculpture. The mountain was historically an area where the Gelug school of Tibetan Buddhism spread, and Puan Temple, founded in 1683, stands in it.
description: 海棠山位于辽宁阜新。游览特色包括森林公园、自然保护区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Daban town, Fuxin Mongol Autonomous County, about 19 km east-south-east of central Fuxin.

name: 黄家沟
summaryEn: A four-season leisure resort in Sihe town, Xihe District, which the provincial tourism page describes as set among a hill, two rivers, nine lakes and about 1,000 mu (67 ha) of pine woods. A water park in summer and a ski field in winter are the main attractions, with hot-spring guesthouses and rural tourism among the resort's five sections, and flower viewing and fruit picking in spring and autumn. The resort area has been named a national key village for rural tourism.
description: 黄家沟位于辽宁阜新。游览特色包括水上游乐、田园观光、休闲度假。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Sihe town, about 6 km north-north-west of central Fuxin.

name: 乌兰木图山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area of about 30 sq km in Bajiazi town, Fuxin Mongol Autonomous County, whose main peak, at 831.4 m, is the highest in Fuxin prefecture. The provincial tourism page highlights rock formations, dense woodland, temples built into the cliffs and a large wild stand of Amur tree lilac, and notes that the mountain had a different name in the Liao period and was settled in Hongshan-culture times. It also mentions herbs, deposits of maifan stone and local folk customs among the area's resources.
description: 乌兰木图山位于辽宁阜新。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、山地游览、林地风光。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Bajiazi town, about 35 km north-north-west of central Fuxin.

name: 欢乐龙湾
summaryEn: Huanle Longwan is a water park on the Xingcheng seafront with wave pools, slides, a drifting river, a children's water zone and hot-spring bathing pools, plus restaurants and rest pavilions. It is a modern leisure development rather than a historic site, aimed mainly at families.
description: 欢乐龙湾位于辽宁葫芦岛。游览特色包括水上游乐、海岸风光、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the seafront about 10 km east-north-east of Xingcheng old town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 葫芦古镇
summaryEn: Hulu Ancient Town is a leisure and farm-tourism complex on the northern edge of Huludao, begun in 2001 and themed on gourd culture (hulu, as in the city's name) and the folk customs of north-east China (Guandong). It offers folk-custom performances, fruit picking, study-tour programmes, a folk museum, restaurants and lodging, and skiing and skating in winter, in newly built old-style buildings rather than historic ones. It suits families and groups rather than visitors looking for heritage sites.
description: 葫芦古镇位于辽宁葫芦岛。游览特色包括博物馆、古镇、滑雪。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the northern edge of Longgang District, about 6 km north-east of Huludao city centre. The folk museum inside is closed in November and March.

name: 灵山风景名胜区
summaryEn: Lingshan is a hilly forest area in Lianshan District with crags, odd-shaped rocks, caves and cliffs, and an old temple complex that is a provincial heritage site. Named features include the Nantianmen (South Heaven Gate), a group of twelve-zodiac rocks, an eagle-beak rock and a camel-shaped peak. The department describes it as one of Liaoning's ten best forest parks and a provincial ecotourism demonstration area.
description: 灵山风景名胜区位于辽宁葫芦岛。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills of Shanshenmiaozi township, Lianshan District; the provincial tourism department puts it 48 km from Huludao's urban area.

name: 龙潭大峡谷
summaryEn: Longtan Grand Canyon is a wooded gorge in the hills of western Jianchang County, close to the Hebei border, with cliffs, pools, waterfalls, caves and oddly shaped rocks; the tourism department also describes it as a national geopark. Facilities include a glass-floored suspension bridge, a dry slide, boat rides and a small forest train, so the scenery comes with adventure-park attractions.
description: 龙潭大峡谷位于辽宁葫芦岛。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Laodazhangzi township, about 48 km south-west of Jianchang town.

name: 龙湾海滨
summaryEn: Longwan Beach is a seafront resort strip on Liaodong Bay in Longgang District, with a sand beach more than 2 km long, a marble-paved central plaza flanked by European-style hotels, a coastal boardwalk, and shopping and amusement areas. The scenic area covers 6.9 km² and is split into a bathing beach, a commercial street zone, a boardwalk-and-green-space zone and a visitor-service zone.
description: 龙湾海滨位于辽宁葫芦岛。游览特色包括海滨、海岸风光、商贸街区。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the coast about 8 km south-west of Huludao city centre.

name: 兴城海滨
summaryEn: Xingcheng Seaside is a 14 km sandy seafront on Liaodong Bay, divided into the Xinghai, Gangkou and Bingjia bays, with a gently shelving beach and no offshore reefs. A boardwalk of about 1.7 km runs along the shore between the rocky Longhuitou headland and Bingjia Bay, linking wooden and rope bridges, pavilions and plazas. It is a summer holiday and sanatorium resort.
description: 兴城海滨位于辽宁葫芦岛。游览特色包括海滨、海岸风光、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the coast about 9 km east of Xingcheng old town.

name: 银泰水星海洋乐园
summaryEn: Yintai Shuixing (Water Planet) Ocean Park is a beachfront leisure development in the Dongdaihe New Area, rated a 4A scenic area in 2017, with 4.6 km of sandy coastline. The tourism department describes a seaside holiday zone with caravan and car camping, a culture plaza with creative markets and stage shows, and a sea-themed amusement area with a marina and a slide park. It is a modern resort rather than a historic site, aimed at summer beach holidays.
description: 银泰水星海洋乐园位于辽宁葫芦岛。游览特色包括海滨、海岸风光、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Binhai Avenue in the Dongdaihe New Area, about 8 km east of Dongdaihe railway station. Check that it is open before going.

name: 北普陀山
summaryEn: A hill park of about 26 sq km on the north-western edge of Jinzhou, made up of six peaks and nine sights, with a Buddhist temple that holds Spring Festival prayer events. The provincial tourism page calls it western Liaoning's foremost 'cave-heaven' and says the site has a history of more than 1,400 years; the hills are wooded, with peach blossom in spring and red leaves in autumn.
description: 北普陀山位于辽宁锦州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、林地风光、洞穴。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north-western edge of Jinzhou, about 10 km north-west of the city centre.

name: 大朝阳温泉山城
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort and hotel complex at the foot of Yiwulü Mountain about 6.5 km west of Beizhen town, developed by a Liaoning company and next to the Yiwulü nature reserve. It has spa pools, a three-star hotel, conference facilities and a museum of the history and folk culture of the Yiwulü area. It is a modern commercial resort, useful as a base for visiting the mountain.
description: 大朝阳温泉山城位于辽宁锦州。游览特色包括博物馆、温泉、自然保护区。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At the foot of Yiwulü Mountain about 7 km west of Beizhen town and about 73 km north-east of central Jinzhou.

name: 医巫闾山大芦花
summaryEn: A scenic area in Baojia township on the middle-southern part of the Yiwulü range, a national geopark known for steep rock pinnacles, with a main peak of about 630 m. The name means 'big reed flowers': according to the provincial tourism page, reeds cover the hillsides here and their plumes drift in autumn. It is one of several separate scenic areas on the range, alongside the main Beizhen section and Qingyan Temple.
description: 医巫闾山大芦花位于辽宁锦州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Baojia township, about 17 km south-west of Beizhen town and about 62 km north-east of central Jinzhou.

name: 东方华地城湿地温泉旅游度假区
summaryEn: A resort of about 28,000 mu (roughly 1,900 ha) on the wetlands at the mouth of the Daling River on the Bohai coast, including about 10,000 mu of reed beds. It offers boat trips among the reeds, a hot-spring spa fed by a well about 1,368 m deep, villa and cabin accommodation and a winter snow-and-ice attraction. The provincial page also lists farm-experience activities and a youth nature-education base, so it is a modern commercial resort rather than a historic site.
description: 东方华地城湿地温泉旅游度假区位于辽宁锦州。游览特色包括温泉、湿地。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the Bohai coast at the mouth of the Daling River in Linghai, about 43 km east-south-east of central Jinzhou.

name: 锦州东方欢乐王国水世界
summaryEn: A seaside water park on the Bohai coast next to the Bijia Mountain scenic area, with more than ten water rides, a wave pool, a seawater cascade pool, an infinity pool facing the Bijia causeway and a sand beach. In summer it also stages evening fireworks, music events on the beach and other shows. It is a modern commercial attraction that suits families in summer rather than a sight of historical interest.
description: 锦州东方欢乐王国水世界位于辽宁锦州。游览特色包括海滨、水上游乐、海岸风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the Bohai coast in Taihe district, about 31 km south of central Jinzhou and about 2 km north of Bijia Mountain.

name: 锦州世博园
summaryEn: The main site of the 2013 Jinzhou World Garden Expo, a landscaped park of about 7 sq km on the Bohai coast, of which 3.3 sq km is land and 3.7 sq km water. The provincial tourism page describes hills, woods, islands, flower beds, buildings and bridges arranged to give a seaside-garden feel. The park stages seasonal events, such as a lantern fair at Chinese New Year in 2025, and the grounds are large enough that a short visit covers only part of them.
description: 锦州世博园位于辽宁锦州。游览特色包括海岸风光、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the Bohai coast in Jinzhou's Binhai New Area, about 23 km south-south-east of central Jinzhou.

name: 辽西九华山
summaryEn: A privately developed theme park of about 3.5 sq km on a wooded hill at the edge of Linghai's town centre, built from 2013 and rated 4A in 2015, which became a social-media hit in 2023 as a 'compressed pack' of China's famous sights. Its attractions include the Buddhist Cihai Temple, a Tibetan-style 'Little Potala' building, terracotta-warrior figures and statues of historical figures, a lotus lake with a music fountain and water-screen show, a night market and amusement rides. It is a modern commercial park rather than a historic site, and suits families and visitors who like photogenic themed scenery.
description: 辽西九华山位于辽宁锦州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊、主题游乐。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the western edge of Linghai town centre, about 19 km east-north-east of central Jinzhou.

name: 青岩寺
summaryEn: A temple complex in three courtyards, upper, middle and lower, set on steep ground at the southern end of the Yiwulü range in Changxingdian town, within a scenic area of about 13 sq km that the provincial tourism page also describes as a national geopark. The page lists 'eight scenes and twelve wonders' and notes pear blossom in spring, waterfalls in summer, red leaves in autumn and rime ice in winter.
description: 青岩寺位于辽宁锦州。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At the southern end of the Yiwulü range in Changxingdian town, about 20 km south-west of Beizhen town and about 58 km north-east of central Jinzhou.

name: 岩井寺
summaryEn: A wooded hill park in Wendilou town north of Jinzhou, set between two peaks of about 436 m and 459 m and protected as a city-level nature reserve. Its sights include the Ancient Buddha Cave, the Twin Dragon Well, the Sansheng Hall and bell and drum towers, in woodland that the provincial tourism page calls primeval.
description: 岩井寺位于辽宁锦州。游览特色包括自然保护区、林地风光、洞穴。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Wendilou town in Linghai, about 14 km north of central Jinzhou.

name: 人参谷森林公园
summaryEn: Ginseng Valley (Renshengu) Forest Park is a hill park in Anping Township, in the north of Gongchangling District, Liaoyang, set among rocky peaks and cliff faces. A hiking trail about 2.6 km long, built in 2023 from local stone, rammed earth and timber, links two hills, and official reports list more than 30 named sights along it, among them Eight Hundred Arhats Peak, a plank path along the natural rock wall, a seated Guan Yu stone figure and a platform called Dianjiangtai (the 'general-mustering platform'). The summit area looks out over Gongchangling's urban district, and the park suits a half-day of walking.
description: 人参谷森林公园位于辽宁辽阳。游览特色包括森林公园、山谷、山地游览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the hills of Anping Township in northern Gongchangling District, about 25 km east-south-east of Liaoyang railway station in a straight line; the road to the park has been heavily congested at busy holiday times.

name: 辽阳雷锋纪念馆
summaryEn: The memorial hall in Gongchangling District covers the months from August 1959 to January 1960 that Lei Feng, a young soldier whose name is used in China's long-running 'learn from Lei Feng' campaigns, spent working here before he joined the army. Its central hall, exhibition hall and theatre show his life through diary entries, photographs and objects and present him as a worker; the provincial tourism page says more than twenty well-known diary entries were written here. It is a separate museum from the Lei Feng memorial in Fushun, and it was named a national patriotic-education demonstration base in 2014.
description: 辽阳雷锋纪念馆位于辽宁辽阳。游览特色包括纪念展览、主题展览、戏剧演艺。图集建议预留约1 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tanghe town, Gongchangling District, about 26 km south-east of Liaoyang railway station in a straight line; closed on Mondays.

name: 龙石风景旅游区
summaryEn: Longshi Scenic Area, in Hongwei district south-east of central Liaoyang, has two parts: the wooded Longding Mountain and the Shidonggou area. The provincial tourism page gives its forest cover as 90% and highlights a zoo inside the area, a draw for children. It is a local hill-walking and day-out destination rather than a major sight.
description: 龙石风景旅游区位于辽宁辽阳。游览特色包括动物观赏、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Hongwei district, about 12 km south-south-east of Liaoyang railway station in a straight line.

name: 太子河历史文化风光带
summaryEn: This 4A listing covers the Taizi River as it runs through Liaoyang, where the provincial tourism page describes a riverside garden belt about 9 km long between the Yanshui and Xiangping bridges, laid out by the city for residents. It also names sights along the river, including the Yanzhou fortress, Dongjing city and the Dongjing Mausoleums (which have entries of their own), Shenwo Lake and Tanghe Lake. By tradition the river is named after Prince Dan of Yan, who is said to have hidden along it.
description: 太子河历史文化风光带位于辽宁辽阳。游览特色包括湖泊、城堡。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: The urban stretch runs along the east side of Liaoyang's old city, with the pin about 4 km east-south-east of Liaoyang railway station.

name: 汤河国际温泉旅游度假区
summaryEn: Tanghe International Hot Spring Resort is a hot-spring resort area at Tanghe town in Gongchangling District, which the provincial tourism department describes as the province's first provincial-level hot-spring resort zone. It combines hot-spring bathing, a winter ice-and-snow programme, mountain scenery and rural tourism, and the page describes the water as weakly alkaline and radon-bearing. It suits a leisure break rather than sightseeing.
description: 汤河国际温泉旅游度假区位于辽宁辽阳。游览特色包括温泉、田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tanghe town, Gongchangling District, about 25 km south-east of Liaoyang railway station in a straight line.

name: 佟二堡皮草购物旅游区
summaryEn: Tong'erbao is a fur and leather market town in Dengta, listed as a shopping tourism area. The provincial tourism page says the area sells fur coats, leather clothing and bags at a range of prices, with the Haining Leather City, Hong Kong Times Square and Wangding malls among the larger complexes, and that most visitors are winter shoppers from the Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei region, Inner Mongolia and the three north-eastern provinces. It is a shopping destination rather than a sight.
description: 灯塔市佟二堡因皮草和皮革交易发展成商贸镇，游览以当地市场和购物街区为中心。
accessEn: In the west of Dengta, about 20 km north-north-west of Liaoyang railway station in a straight line.

name: 北旅田园大唐文化旅游区
summaryEn: Beilü Tianyuan, also called Heifengguan Ancient Town, is a leisure complex in Xinli town, Dawa District, themed on Tang-dynasty culture, with a town in Tang style that has market streets, a 'granary' zone and costumed street performances. The tourism department also lists a hot-spring resort, a 'minus five degrees' snow village, Tang-style guesthouses and rice-field viewing areas, and since 2025 the town has also had a Journey to the West theme, licensed from the 1986 CCTV series. It is a modern attraction, not a historic town.
description: 北旅田园大唐文化旅游区位于辽宁盘锦。游览特色包括古镇、田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xinli town, Dawa District, about 14 km south-east of Panjin railway station.

name: 广厦艺术街
summaryEn: Guangsha Art Street is a modern arts and leisure street at the centre of the Liaohe International Art Zone in Panjin's Xinglongtai District. The tourism department describes galleries and painters' studios, creative-product shops, cafes and restaurants, two chain hotels and a library and cultural centre, with more than 100 resident artists from China and abroad.
description: 街区位于盘锦辽河国际艺术区中心地带，沿街空间汇集艺术展示与城市休闲设施。
accessEn: In the built-up area of Panjin, Xinglongtai District, about 8 km south-south-east of Panjin railway station.

name: 金帛滩
summaryEn: Jinbo Beach is a 1.6 km sandy beach on the Liaodong Bay coast in Panjin's Liaobin coastal development zone, promoted as the northernmost beach in China. The tourism department lists it as a 4A area offering food, lodging, entertainment and photo spots as well as bathing, and it lies beside the Liaohe estuary wetlands.
description: 金帛滩位于辽宁盘锦。游览特色包括湿地、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Liaobin coastal development zone, about 20 km south-south-west of Tianzhuangtai town and 38 km south of Dawa town.

name: 辽河碑林
summaryEn: Liaohe Stele Forest Park is an oval island of land and water of about 167 ha in the middle of Panjin, laid out from 1985 around a collection of carved stone steles and antique-style halls. About 100 ha of it is land and 67 ha water, and the park faces the Liao River across an embankment. The steles are described as covering calligraphy from every dynasty.
description: 辽河碑林位于辽宁盘锦。游览特色包括森林公园、岛屿、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shuangtaizi District, in the north of Panjin's built-up area, about 3.5 km west-south-west of Panjin railway station.

name: 盘锦特产博物园
summaryEn: The Panjin Specialty Products Museum Park combines four museums devoted to local products (rice, river crab, barbecue and reed weaving), in buildings that mix Chinese and foreign, old and modern styles. Rice and river crab are the delta's best-known farm products, and the park is a commercial attraction in Panshan County.
description: 盘锦特产博物园位于辽宁盘锦。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Panshan County, about 8 km north-west of Panjin railway station. Check that it is open before going.

name: 盘锦苇海●鼎翔生态旅游度假区
summaryEn: This 72 km² wetland resort on the western edge of Panjin, where the Liao and Raoyang rivers meet, has three areas: the Taiping River scenic belt, a 'reed sea and crab flat' reached by boat through the reed beds, and a bird park with an observation gallery. Visitors can watch, angle for and handle crabs on the crab flat, and the tourism department says more than 200 bird species rest and breed there.
description: 盘锦苇海●鼎翔生态旅游度假区位于辽宁盘锦。游览特色包括湿地。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the western outskirts of Panjin in Xinglongtai District, about 20 km west-south-west of Panjin railway station.

name: 中尧七彩庄园
summaryEn: Zhongyao Colourful Manor is an agri-tourism park in Dawa District built around local farm produce, with a shopping street themed on Panjin's history, a modern-agriculture exhibition, an animal ranch park, fishing and herding experiences, a tomato theme park, defence-education and farm study programmes, and a water park. Since 2025 it has also had a '1955 State Farm' section of recreated period shops with costumed performers. It is a commercial leisure development for families and school groups.
description: 中尧七彩庄园位于辽宁盘锦。游览特色包括主题游乐、水上游乐、田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wangjia subdistrict of Dawa District, on the Liao River delta plain, about 6 km south of Dawa town.

name: 华晨宝马铁西工厂
summaryEn: A car factory in Tiexi district, run by BMW Brilliance and opened in 2012, which in February 2017 became the first car plant in China to receive a national 4A tourist rating. Visitors can watch cars being built, with robots working on the production line. It is a working factory, so it mainly suits people interested in car manufacturing.
description: 华晨宝马铁西工厂位于辽宁沈阳。游览特色包括工业参观。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the south-west of Shenyang, about 23 km south-west of Shenyang railway station, with Metro Line 3's Tiexi Automobile Factory station beside the plant since December 2024; it is a working car plant, so confirm the operator's current visiting arrangements before going.

name: 丰远热高乐园
summaryEn: A large resort of about five square kilometres in the Shenyang–Fushun (Shenfu) Reform and Innovation Demonstration Zone, between the two cities. It has five land theme parks, a water park, a shopping area by Dolphin Lake and a castle-themed hotel, with more than 300 rides and attractions, and it mainly suits families.
description: 丰远热高乐园位于辽宁沈阳。游览特色包括湖泊、主题游乐。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the Gaowan economic zone of the Shenyang–Fushun Demonstration Zone, between Shenyang and Fushun, about 30 km east-north-east of Shenyang railway station.

name: 辽宁省科学技术馆
summaryEn: The provincial science and technology museum, in the cluster of new cultural buildings in Hunnan district beside the Liaoning Provincial Museum. It has four permanent exhibition halls, a children's science playground and a science cinema with an IMAX giant screen. It is mainly for families and school groups.
description: 辽宁省科学技术馆位于辽宁沈阳。游览特色包括博物馆、科学科普、主题展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Hunnan district, about 14 km south-south-east of Shenyang railway station; Metro Line 2's Provincial Museum station, opened in 2023, is close by.

name: 老北市
summaryEn: A pedestrian quarter on the site of the Beishichang market, a trading and street-entertainment district founded in 1921, which was redeveloped in the style of its earlier buildings, with the work completed on 1 October 2020. It now has shops, eateries and evening performances around Huangsi Temple, a Tibetan Buddhist temple built in the 1630s, and it keeps traditions such as Beishi wrestling, a national intangible cultural heritage item. It suits an evening stroll and a meal.
description: 老北市位于辽宁沈阳。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、非遗文化、佛教文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Heping district, about 3 km east-north-east of Shenyang railway station.

name: 沈阳棋盘山
summaryEn: A hill-and-lake recreation area in north-eastern Shenyang, on a spur of the Changbai mountains and named for a boulder on Mount Qipan that is said to be a chessboard on which two of the Eight Immortals once played. The peaks of Qipan, Hui and Dayang stand around Lake Xiu and the Pu River, within the 190-square-kilometre Qipanshan tourism zone, which also holds the Shenyang Botanical Garden and the Forest Zoo, listed separately.
description: 沈阳棋盘山位于辽宁沈阳。游览特色包括湖泊、植物园、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Hunnan district on the north-eastern edge of Shenyang, about 29 km east-north-east of Shenyang railway station.

name: 稻梦空间
summaryEn: An agri-tourism park in the rice-growing countryside of Shenbei district, north of Shenyang, whose main feature is rice-field art: coloured rice varieties are planted to form large pictures that can be viewed from an observation platform. The scenic area covers about 100 hectares and also has farming-science displays and family leisure areas. It mostly suits families and photographers when the rice is growing.
description: 稻梦空间位于辽宁沈阳。游览特色包括田园观光、农业体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xinglongtai, Shenbei New District, about 32 km north-north-west of Shenyang railway station.

name: 皇家海洋乐园
summaryEn: An ocean-themed leisure park of about 60 hectares in the Shenyang–Fushun (Shenfu) Reform and Innovation Demonstration Zone, between the two cities, laid out as six themed worlds. They include a polar-themed aquarium area and an indoor beach water park with a wave pool, and the park mainly suits families with children.
description: 皇家海洋乐园位于辽宁沈阳。游览特色包括海滨、水族展览、水上游乐。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Gaowan economic zone of the Shenyang–Fushun Demonstration Zone, between Shenyang and Fushun, about 30 km east-north-east of Shenyang railway station.

name: 沈阳三农博览园
summaryEn: An agriculture-themed cultural park of about 33 hectares in Daliutun town, north of Xinmin, begun in 1997 and designated a national agri-tourism demonstration site. It has more than thirty exhibition halls on history, folk customs, opera and local figures as well as farming, with ornamental gardens and lakes, and it serves as a study base for Shenyang's school pupils, so it mainly suits families and school groups.
description: 沈阳三农博览园位于辽宁沈阳。游览特色包括田园观光、民俗文化、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 64 km north-west of Shenyang railway station in a straight line and about 16 km north-north-west of Xinmin, in Daliutun town. Open only from May to mid-October, and closed on Mondays.

name: 沈阳爱新觉罗皇家博物院
summaryEn: A Manchu-themed museum and liquor-making complex of about 80,000 square metres at Banlashan village in Faku county, north of Shenyang, run by the Aisin-Gioro Zujiafang liquor company. It presents the history, customs and traditional liquor-making of the Manchu people, with the original distillery in the northern part, and the operator says the distillery dates back to the Liao dynasty and supplied the Qing court.
description: 沈阳爱新觉罗皇家博物院位于辽宁沈阳。游览特色包括博物馆、酿造文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Banlashan village, Dagujiazi town, about 60 km north of Shenyang railway station and about 20 km south-south-west of Faku town.

name: 沈阳方特欢乐世界
summaryEn: A theme park in Shenbei New District, on about 50 hectares, run by the Chinese theme-park chain Fantawild and opened in 2011. It is known for science-fiction and interactive attractions, with more than a dozen themed zones and roller coasters among its rides, along with live performances and seasonal events. It mainly suits families with children.
description: 沈阳方特欢乐世界位于辽宁沈阳。游览特色包括主题游乐、演艺体验。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Shenbei New District, about 19 km north of Shenyang railway station.

name: 沈阳森林动物园
summaryEn: A zoo in the forested Qipanshan hills on the eastern edge of Shenyang, which moved here from the old city-centre zoo and opened in 1999 as the Shenyang Forest Wild Animal Zoo. Its animals include Amur tigers, elephants, rhinoceroses, ring-tailed lemurs and giant pandas, which have lived here since 2017. It is a half-day outing mainly for families.
description: 沈阳森林动物园位于辽宁沈阳。游览特色包括动物观赏、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Qipanshan scenic area, about 28 km east-north-east of Shenyang railway station.

name: 沈阳怪坡
summaryEn: A scenic area in Shenbei New District best known for the Strange Slope, a short stretch of road about 80 m long where cars left in neutral appear to roll uphill by themselves. The effect was noticed in 1990 and gives walkers the odd sense that going downhill is hard work and going uphill is easy. The wider scenic area also has a tiger park and a glass viewing bridge.
description: 沈北新区一段约八十米长的坡道以反常的坡向观感闻名，是景区的主要体验点。
accessEn: In Shenbei New District, about 36 km north-east of Shenyang railway station.

name: 沈阳科学宫
summaryEn: A science education centre in south-eastern Shenyang (Shenhe district) that opened in June 2000. It has a science exhibition hall, a safety-education experience hall and a special-effects cinema, and sends a mobile science bus to schools and villages. It is mainly of interest to families with school-age children.
description: 沈阳科学宫位于辽宁沈阳。游览特色包括主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Qingnian Street, about 5 km south-east of Shenyang railway station.

name: 城子山山城
summaryEn: A large stone-walled mountain fortress on Chengzishan in Liangquan town, which the provincial heritage department dates to the early Tang dynasty and describes as a major city of the late Goguryeo kingdom; the national list gives Tang to Liao–Jin. It covers about 167 ha and still has roughly 4.4 km of wall around the mountain section, three gate sites, a water gate, a reservoir, a command platform and a winding path of about 1.7 km. The site is also a provincial forest park and 4A scenic area, with more than 30 peaks, the highest 760 m, old pines and rock formations.
description: 城子山山城位于辽宁铁岭。游览特色包括城堡、水库、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Liangquan town, about 24 km south of Xifeng town.

name: 铁岭莲花湿地
summaryEn: An urban wetland park of about 1,040 ha around Lotus Lake in Tieling's Fanhe New District, made up of constructed wetlands, a lake with a bird island, a lotus-variety garden, a hill and a children's park. The Liao River Museum in the park presents the history, culture and ecology of the river, and the lotus bloom and birdlife are the main draw in summer.
description: 铁岭莲花湿地位于辽宁铁岭。游览特色包括博物馆、湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Fanhe New District, about 10 km west-south-west of the old town of Tieling; the Liao River Museum inside the park is closed on Mondays.

name: 铁煤蒸汽机车博物馆
summaryEn: A railway museum and tourist site on the Tiefa coal railway at Xiaoming town in Diaobingshan, where a depot keeps 21 steam locomotives of several types that the provincial tourism page describes as still able to run. An exhibition park traces the development of the steam locomotive with texts, photographs, objects and models. The page says more than 160 films and TV series have been shot here, so it suits railway enthusiasts and photographers.
description: 铁煤蒸汽机车博物馆位于辽宁铁岭。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1.5–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Xiaoming town in Diaobingshan, about 19 km north-west of Tieling's old town.

name: 白沙湾黄金海岸
summaryEn: Baishawan is a 14.7 km stretch of sandy Liaodong Bay coast in Guizhou town, Gaizhou, with a coastal road running along it and a reputation as a summer retreat. The provincial page says the scenic area combines the seashore with woodland, island views, orchards and vineyards, and names local relics including a sea-viewing tower and Han-dynasty tombs, as well as the local peaches. It suits summer beach trips rather than sightseeing.
description: 白沙湾黄金海岸位于辽宁营口。游览特色包括海滨、岛屿、葡萄酒文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Guizhou town (unrelated to Guizhou province), Gaizhou; the provincial page gives 46 km from Gaizhou's urban area and 4 km from the Zhenghongqi expressway exit.

name: 万福赤山
summaryEn: Chishan ('Red Mountain') is a mountain national forest park in Wanfu town, south-east of Gaizhou, lying between Buyun Mountain to the east and the Yushi Reservoir to the north. The provincial page describes it as a well-known Liaodong mountain since the Sui and Tang dynasties and as a resort combining leisure, sport, sightseeing and prayer. The Yingkou government describes it as known for odd peaks, caves, clear springs and old temples, with sights that include Longtan Temple, a glass-floored walkway and the White Dragon Pool.
description: 万福赤山位于辽宁营口。游览特色包括森林公园、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wanfu town, about 40 km south-east of Gaizhou according to the provincial tourism page.

name: 虹溪谷旅游度假区
summaryEn: Hongxigu is a hot-spring and leisure resort in Shuangtai town, Gaizhou, close to the Bayuquan district of Yingkou, with a planned area of about 12 sq km. The provincial page lists a hot-spring centre, a holiday hotel, banquet and performance venues, a hot-spring water park, a mountain ski area, a football training base and the Silabao hot-spring town. It is a modern commercial resort for spa and holiday stays rather than a sightseeing site.
description: 虹溪谷旅游度假区位于辽宁营口。游览特色包括水上游乐、休闲度假、泉水。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Shuangtai town, Gaizhou, next to Bayuquan; the provincial page gives about 5 km by road from central Bayuquan.

name: 月亮湖公园
summaryEn: Moon Lake Park is a 91-hectare park around a seawater lake where two rivers reach the sea, in the south of the Yingkou Economic and Technological Development Zone at Bayuquan. About 53 ha is land and 38 ha water, and the provincial page says it has an ocean-culture theme with spaces for recreation, dining, fitness and exhibitions. It suits a short stroll or an evening by the water rather than a full excursion.
description: 月亮湖公园位于辽宁营口。游览特色包括湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the south of Bayuquan's development zone, about 7 km north-north-west of Xiongyue town and about 49 km south-south-west of central Yingkou, both in a straight line; an upgrade project began construction in 2026, so check what is open before going.

name: 团山国家级海洋公园
summaryEn: Tuanshan is a stretch of Liaodong Bay shoreline on the western seafront of Yingkou's Beihai New Area in Gaizhou, developed as a coastal leisure and holiday area with sightseeing, entertainment and fitness facilities. Liaoning's tourism department includes its sea-eroded rock formations on its 2025 summer coastal route. According to the provincial page it was named one of Liaoning's ten best seaside and island destinations in 2015, rated a 4A scenic area in 2017 and listed among China's 'remarkable landforms'.
description: 团山国家级海洋公园位于辽宁营口。游览特色包括岛屿、海岸风光、休闲度假。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the Liaodong Bay coast west of Tuanshan subdistrict, about 13 km west of central Gaizhou and about 28 km south of central Yingkou, both in a straight line.

name: 望儿山
summaryEn: Wang'er Shan ('Mountain of Watching for the Son') is a small lone hill of about 82 m beside Xiongyue town, topped by a Tibetan-style brick pagoda of the late Ming or early Qing and named for a legend of a mother waiting for her son's return. The provincial page calls it the only sea-eroded red-rock (Danxia) landform in the north-east, and says an annual Mother's Day event, which it describes as China's first organised one, has been held here since 1995, with the 28th in 2023.
description: 望儿山位于辽宁营口。游览特色包括古塔。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 2 km east of Xiongyue town in Bayuquan district (the provincial page's figure), and about 54 km south of central Yingkou in a straight line.

name: 查干浩特旅游度假区
summaryEn: A lakeside leisure area in the north-west of Baicheng's Taobei district, close to the Inner Mongolia border, built around Tuanjie Lake (also called Hasar Lake), a reservoir dating from the 1970s. It has a Mongolian-themed camp of yurts with a Genghis Khan statue and a performance stage, a beach and waterfront plaza, and a small ice-and-snow park used in winter, and a snow-sculpture festival was held here in December 2023. The grounds also hold the remains of an airfield built by the Japanese Kwantung Army from 1936, a provincial-level heritage site with the remains of its hangars and some surviving brick buildings.
description: 查干浩特旅游度假区位于吉林白城。游览特色包括湖泊、水库、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 40 km north-west of Baicheng in a straight line, near the Jilin–Inner Mongolia border; the district government's profile gives about 45 km to both Baicheng and Ulanhot.

name: 向海
summaryEn: The visitor area of the Xianghai National Nature Reserve in Tongyu County, a wetland of reed marsh, lakes, sand dunes and old elm woodland on the Horqin grassland, added to the Ramsar list of wetlands of international importance in 1992. It is known as a home of the red-crowned crane, and local government pages record six crane species; the sights include a bird garden, Crane Island and the Lanhai Pavilion viewing tower over the elm forest. The provincial tourism bureau promotes it as a self-drive destination, with homestays near the reserve.
description: 向海位于中国吉林省西部通榆县境内，是一个以保护丹顶鹤等珍稀水禽和蒙古黄榆等稀有植物群落为主要目的的内陆湿地与水域生态系统类型的国家级自然保护区。包括向海乡全部，四井子乡的四家子、大房村，兴隆山乡的东风、粮丰、兴盛、长发村，乌兰花乡的双龙、水村以及同发畜牧场的利民、东兴分场的大部，地跨4个乡1个牧场12个村共有32个村屯。
accessEn: In Tongyu County, about 64 km west-north-west of Tongyu town and 75 km south-south-west of Baicheng in straight lines; the provincial tourism bureau gives about five hours by car from Changchun.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 长白山华美胜地
summaryEn: A holiday resort of about 25 km² in the forest of Manjiang town, Fusong county, run as Luneng Shengdi before it took the Huamei Shengdi name. It has hotels, a ski area of about 32 ha on gentle slopes, a camping and RV site with an evening bonfire square, a glass net bridge, go-karts, a deer-feeding park and a children's castle. It suits families and groups who want a forest base on the west side of Changbai Mountain rather than a historic site.
description: 长白山华美胜地位于吉林白山。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 6 km west-north-west of Manjiang town in a straight line and about 32 km by road from Changbai Mountain West railway station, where the high-speed line stops; a car is the easiest way to get around Fusong's scattered sights.

name: 四保临江战役纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial hall at the foot of Maoer Hill in Linjiang, built in 2005 by enlarging a 1992 martyrs' hall inside the cemetery that was laid out in 1947 for those killed in the Four Defences of Linjiang campaign of the Civil War. Eight exhibition halls with more than 1,000 objects cover the planning before the campaign, how it was fought and the civilian support for the army. The same grounds hold a memorial monument and 438 graves.
description: 四保临江战役纪念馆位于吉林白山。游览特色包括纪念展览、主题展览、战役遗址。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Maoershan Road just west of the centre of Linjiang, about 1 km west-north-west of the Chen Yun former residence; Linjiang is about 58 km by road from Baishan city. Closed on Mondays.

name: 露水河国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park on the Lushuihe, a 63 km tributary of the Second Songhua River that runs between wooded hills and cliffs in Fusong county. State media report that the river stays above freezing through the winter, so rafting trips in the cold months pass trees coated in rime. People's Daily describes the surrounding Lushuihe forest area as holding what is left of China's Korean pine mother-tree forest, about 12,000 hectares.
description: 露水河国家森林公园位于吉林白山。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Lushuihe forest area, about 16 km east-north-east of Lushuihe town in a straight line, reached by road from the town.

name: 讷殷古城
summaryEn: A fortress-style attraction in forest at the head of the Toudao Songhua River, presented as a Jurchen tribal fortress; it is a modern reconstruction that the Chinan district authorities began building in 2014, not an excavated site. Inside it stands the Lingying Palace, a Daoist temple completed in 2016 and dedicated to the Changbai Mountain deity. It is a short stop for visitors already in the Manjiang area.
description: 讷殷古城位于吉林白山。游览特色包括古城、寺庙建筑、城堡。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Chinan area, about 4 km north-west of Manjiang town in a straight line and about 30 km by road from Changbai Mountain West railway station. Check that it is open before going.

name: 千年崖城
summaryEn: A themed attraction on the Yalu bank in Changbai town, built in the style of Bohai-period architecture, with a market area and a village section in the style of the local ethnic Korean (Chaoxian) community. It has a glass corridor bridge and a cliffside walkway with views of the river and the North Korean bank, and costumed staff stage short period dramas. It suits a short stop alongside the Lingguang Pagoda.
description: 千年崖城位于吉林白山。游览特色包括古塔。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the Yalu bank at the north-eastern edge of Changbai town, about 2 km east-north-east of the Lingguang Pagoda in a straight line; Changbai is reached by the G331 border road, about 115 km east-south-east of Linjiang in a straight line.

name: 松花江生态旅游风景区
summaryEn: A scenic area on the upper Songhua River in Huayuankou township, Jingyu county, built around sightseeing boat trips on the river; a 500-passenger new-energy cruise boat, the Tianhe 1, was launched at its Songjiang pier in September 2024. Xinhua reported nearly 700,000 visitors in the first two years after boat services began. It suits visitors who want a river and forest outing on the western side of Changbai Mountain.
description: 松花江生态旅游风景区位于吉林白山。游览特色包括乘船游览、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At the Songjiang boat landing near Huayuankou town, about 23 km east-south-east of Jingyu county town in a straight line.

name: 望天鹅
summaryEn: A forested valley in the Changbai Mountain foothills of Changbai county, known as Shiwudaogou, with old trees, waterfalls, springs and rock walls and pillars beside the stream. Xinhua's photo feature on the valley highlights the winter ice-falls, where the stream freezes into half-ice, half-flowing curtains on the rock. It suits walkers and winter photographers who are happy to travel into the hills.
description: 望天鹅位于吉林白山。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: At the mouth of the Shiwudaogou valley, about 24 km west-north-west of Changbai town in a straight line, reached by road from Changbai; check current opening and road conditions before going.

name: 北湖国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A large urban wetland park on the northern edge of Changchun, with lakes, reed beds and boardwalks and more than 200 bird species recorded. The grounds also hold Wanshou Temple and the Youguo Pagoda, and lotus flowers are a summer feature.
description: 北湖国家湿地公园位于吉林长春。游览特色包括湿地、寺庙建筑、古塔。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 11 km north-north-east of central Changchun in the Changchun New Area, served by a light-rail stop named after the park.

name: 长春农业博览园
summaryEn: A leisure park in the Jingyue district south-east of Changchun, built around exhibition halls and greenhouses first used for agricultural expositions. It stages the Jilin (Changchun) Winter Agricultural Expo, whose 16th edition ran there in February 2026, and has indoor greenhouse gardens, a World Agricultural Scenery Garden and, in winter, ice sculptures and a light-and-projection show. It suits families after an indoor garden visit rather than a historic site.
description: 长春农业博览园位于吉林长春。游览特色包括田园观光、园林景观、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 12 km south-east of central Changchun in the Jingyue district, with a light-rail stop named after it.

name: 长春孔子文化园
summaryEn: A cultural park built around the Changchun Confucian Temple, founded in 1872, rebuilt from 2002 and enlarged in 2012, the year the park opened. The three-courtyard compound has a Dacheng Hall, bell and drum towers, a pool and archways, and today it also runs as the Changchun Confucian Temple Museum, with exhibitions, traditional ceremonies and lectures.
description: 长春孔子文化园位于吉林长春。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: On Yatai Street, about 2 km east of central Changchun. Closed on Mondays.

name: 长春动植物公园
summaryEn: A municipal zoo and botanical park in the south of central Changchun, built in 1938 and opened to the public in 1987, with animal exhibition areas, a bird house and a planted hill with trees from the Changbai Mountain area. It now features a Journey to the West-themed area, where performers in costume stage shows on themed stages, and lantern displays are added in winter.
description: 长春动植物公园位于吉林长春。游览特色包括动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Ziyou Road, about 2 km south of central Changchun, reached by taxi or local transport.

name: 关东文化园
summaryEn: A garden-style hot-spring resort on the north-western edge of Changchun, built from 2010 on the site of abandoned brick kilns, with lakes, planted gardens and buildings in the Guandong (north-east Chinese) style. It has hot-spring pools and themed lodging in courtyard-style buildings, and folk events such as traditional wedding re-enactments have been held in the grounds.
description: 关东文化园位于吉林长春。游览特色包括园林景观、天然泉水。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Guandong Road in Lüyuan district, about 11 km north-west of central Changchun.

name: 国信南山温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring hotel and spa resort set in wooded hills in Shuangyang district, south-east of Changchun. The city tourism bureau describes a bicarbonate-sodium spring coming out at around 60°C, with more than 70 pools, indoor halls, a children's hall, a traditional-medicine hall and villa lodgings across the site. It also operates a ski area in winter.
description: 国信南山温泉位于吉林长春。游览特色包括温泉、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Changqing Road in Shuangyang district, about 28 km south-east of central Changchun.

name: 吉林省酒文化博物馆
summaryEn: A privately run museum in the south of Changchun devoted to alcohol, showing about 6,000 bottled drinks from the 1960s to the present. They range from local Jilin brands such as Yushuqian, Taonanxiang and Taoerhe to national names such as Moutai and Wuliangye, so it suits a short stop.
description: 吉林省酒文化博物馆位于吉林长春。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: On Yatai Street in Nanguan district, about 7 km south of central Changchun and a short way from the World Sculpture Park.

name: 凯撒森林温泉度假区
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort with a hotel, set in woodland beside Jingyuetan forest park on the south-eastern edge of Changchun. Its pools have included lemon, lavender and herbal baths, and it has also been promoted with a water park and a children's forest play area.
description: 凯撒森林温泉度假区位于吉林长春。游览特色包括温泉、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 14 km south-east of central Changchun on Jingyue Avenue, next to Jingyuetan park. Check that it is open before going.

name: 莲花山冰雪旅游度假小镇
summaryEn: A ski resort in the hills east of Changchun, with day and evening skiing in winter; the city tourism bureau groups it with Miaoxiangshan as better suited to skiers beyond the beginner stage. The area also has a summer amusement park, Baturu Park, which closed for the 2026 season on 8 October and is expected to reopen in spring 2027.
description: 莲花山冰雪旅游度假小镇位于吉林长春。游览特色包括滑雪、主题游乐、莲花观赏。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: About 33 km east of central Changchun in the Lianhuashan area, reached by car or taxi.

name: 辽金时代文化园
summaryEn: A 300-hectare rural leisure park in Qiangang township, Nong'an county, themed on the Liao and Jin dynasties that once ruled this area. It combines Liao-Jin folk-culture tourism, farm and orchard experiences with fruit picking, youth study tours and national-defence education, and the city tourism bureau lists it as a national study-tour base. It is a modern attraction rather than a historic site, and suits families and school groups.
description: 辽金时代文化园位于吉林长春。游览特色包括果园、公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Qiangang township, about 24 km south-south-east of Nong'an town and 38 km north of central Changchun, reached by car or taxi.

name: 莲花岛影视城
summaryEn: A film-and-television leisure park on the southern outskirts of Changchun, with period-style street and building sets that visitors use for costume photography; the city tourism bureau suggests Republic-era-style shoots. It also holds seasonal events, among them an Ice and Snow Lantern Festival that ran from December 2025 to March 2026.
description: 莲花岛影视城位于吉林长春。游览特色包括莲花观赏、影视拍摄、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yongchun town, Chaoyang district, about 17 km south of central Changchun, reached by car or taxi.

name: 庙香山度假区
summaryEn: A ski resort in the hills of Jiutai district, east of Changchun, one of the ski areas the city tourism bureau promotes. The bureau describes its slopes as better suited to skiers who have moved past the beginner stage, with day and evening sessions in the winter season.
description: 庙香山度假区位于吉林长春。游览特色包括滑雪。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: About 46 km east of central Changchun in Bonihe town, Jiutai district, reached by car or taxi.

name: 清泉湖文旅度假区
summaryEn: A lakeside leisure resort in Kuancheng district, part of the Changchun New Area, centred on a lake of about half a square kilometre. It offers boat rides, a hot-air balloon, a sand-beach play area, fishing, camping, a fruit-picking garden, a small animal area with camels, ostriches, raccoons and yaks, and a children's play area. Accommodation includes farmhouse-style courtyards, wooden cabins and converted railway carriages.
description: 清泉湖文旅度假区位于吉林长春。游览特色包括湖泊、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 21 km north of central Changchun in Kuancheng district, reached by car or taxi.

name: 神鹿峰度假区
summaryEn: A mountain resort in Shuangyang district built around the area's sika-deer tradition, with rides and attractions that include a glass skywalk, a high-level swing, a zip line, a cave and a children's play area. On the hillside there is a deer enclosure where visitors can feed the animals and have their photograph taken with them. Shuangyang calls itself the hometown of sika deer, with deer farming going back more than 300 years.
description: 神鹿峰度假区位于吉林长春。游览特色包括洞穴、农业体验、栈道。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 74 km south-east of central Changchun in Shuangyang district, reached by car; an expressway interchange named after the resort is about 2 km away.

name: 天定山旅游度假小镇
summaryEn: A ski resort and holiday town in the hills east of Changchun, with runs aimed mainly at beginners. Guesthouses and small restaurants serving north-eastern dishes stand beside the slopes, and in winter the Changchun Ice and Snow New World park, with ice sculptures and long slides, operates a street away.
description: 天定山旅游度假小镇位于吉林长春。游览特色包括滑雪、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: About 22 km east of central Changchun in the Lianhuashan area, reached by car or taxi.

name: 天怡温泉度假山庄
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in wooded hills near Xinlicheng Reservoir, south of Changchun. The provincial tourism department describes spring water coming out at 58°C, with an indoor bathing hall and four outdoor areas, including a forest zone, an island and a winter bathing area, and farmhouse-style single-storey rooms for overnight stays.
description: 天怡温泉度假山庄位于吉林长春。游览特色包括温泉、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 34 km south of central Changchun in Xinhu town, Jingyue district, reached by car or taxi.

name: 御龙温泉度假村
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in Shuangyang district, south-east of Changchun, with about 50 pools set in planted subtropical-style gardens, plus a hotel with villas, restaurants and sports facilities. The pools include herbal, flower-scented and play pools, and the restaurants serve dishes made with deer products, reflecting Shuangyang's long tradition of sika-deer farming.
description: 御龙温泉度假村位于吉林长春。游览特色包括温泉、园林景观、农业体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Longshuang Road in Shuangyang district, about 45 km south-east of central Changchun.

name: 森林慢谷
summaryEn: A lakeside leisure area of about 1,000 ha in forested hills near Huadian, opened in phases from June 2023 around a reservoir, with cycling round the lake, water barbecues, fishing and camping. In winter it offers snow-play areas and ice fishing. It is a new resort aimed at short family breaks rather than sightseeing.
description: 森林慢谷位于吉林。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Badaohezi town, about 40 km north-north-west of Huadian and about 65 km south of Jilin railway station.

name: 拉法山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park around Lafa Mountain, a rocky peak of 886 m that rises from a flat plain north of Jiaohe, known for its nine-peaked outline and its many natural caves. The largest, the Eight-Treasure Cloud-Light Cave, is about 60 m long and has three openings facing east, west and south, and visitors climb by footpath to the summit. Sunrise and sea-of-cloud viewing has become popular since a viewing programme was introduced in 2023, and the park opened for winter visits for the first time in December 2024.
description: 拉法山国家森林公园位于吉林。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 13 km north-north-east of Jiaohe city and about 67 km east of Jilin railway station.

name: 圣德泉亲水度假花园
summaryEn: A hot-spring and leisure complex in farmland west of Jilin, in Soudengzhan town, offering hot-spring bathing, a garden of fossil tree trunks and dishes made with its own vegetables. It is a commercial resort suited to a half-day outing from the city.
description: 圣德泉亲水度假花园位于吉林。游览特色包括园林景观、化石遗迹、田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Linjiaqiao village, Soudengzhan town, about 26 km west of Jilin railway station.

name: 圣鑫葡萄酒庄园
summaryEn: A wine-themed leisure estate in the hills south-east of Jilin, built around the story of the Chuang Guandong settlers who moved to the north-east, with Huizhou-style buildings, a red-wine hot spring and campfire evenings. The estate's own wines can be tasted on site, and some of the old-style buildings are used as guesthouses. It is a commercial attraction best suited to a short outing, often combined with Zhuque Mountain.
description: 圣鑫葡萄酒庄园位于吉林。游览特色包括温泉、葡萄酒文化、庄园。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Near the junction of Tongda North and South roads in Mengjia village, about 16 km south-east of Jilin railway station; its wine museum opens only from May to early October, so check the season before going.

name: 神农庄园
summaryEn: An agri-tourism estate in rice-growing farmland north-west of Jilin, built around a hot-spring bathhouse and with farming-culture displays, gardens and a rice-field art viewing area. It suits families and travellers who want a rural day out with a soak.
description: 神农庄园位于吉林。游览特色包括田园观光、园林景观、农业体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dahuangdi village, Gudianzi town, about 25 km north-west of Jilin railway station.

name: 卓远温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort set in farmland at Yilaxi town in Yongji county, west of Jilin, offering herbal hot-spring baths, private spring guesthouses and farmhouse meals, according to Yongji county tourism material of 2025. It is a commercial leisure stop for a relaxed half day.
description: 卓远温泉位于吉林。游览特色包括温泉、田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Sanjiazi, Yilaxi town, about 47 km west of Jilin railway station.

name: 田雨旅游度假区
summaryEn: A countryside leisure resort in Dongliao County, built in recent years as a German-themed village, with a castle-style building, a landscaped stream, flower beds, lawns, windmill-style villas and a fruit-picking garden. People's Daily Online describes it as a mixed leisure complex with dining and lodging, outdoor activities, family events and wedding services. It is a modern attraction rather than a historic one, and suits families and couples looking for a day out from Liaoyuan.
description: 田雨旅游度假区位于吉林辽源。游览特色包括园林景观、休闲度假。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dongliao County near Liaohe Yuan town, about 22 km east of central Liaoyuan in a straight line (about 36 km by road).

name: 悦动辽源欢乐荟
summaryEn: A family amusement complex in Liaoyuan's Xi'an district, described by the provincial tourism bureau as an immersive children's leisure park of about 30,000 sq m with a fairy-tale theme that mixes technology and outdoor play. It is a modern commercial park rather than a historic or natural site, and suits parents with young children.
description: 悦动辽源欢乐荟位于吉林辽源。游览特色包括公园休闲、游乐体验。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Xi'an district of Liaoyuan, about 5 km north-north-east of the city centre in a straight line.

name: 四平战役纪念馆
summaryEn: A museum in Hero Square in central Siping about the four battles fought for the city between March 1946 and March 1948, when Communist-led and Nationalist forces fought over this railway junction during the Chinese Civil War. Founded in 1958, it covers the course of the fighting, the support given from the rear areas and the people killed, through photographs, documents and objects. It suits visitors interested in the history of the civil war in north-east China.
description: 四平战役纪念馆位于吉林四平。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览、国家一级博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Hero Square in central Siping, in Tiexi district; closed on Mondays.

name: 叶赫那拉城
summaryEn: A Manchu-style walled complex rebuilt in 1994–95 on a hill beside Zhuanshan Lake, in the homeland of the Yehe tribe, from whose Nara clan Empress Dowager Cixi's family descended. Inside are an old-style post station, a council hall, a princess's tower and exhibition halls on Yehe history, Cixi, Nurhaci and the Manchu poet Nalan Xingde, as well as a Manchu costume hall. It is a reconstruction, not the original town: the two original Yehe cities, destroyed by Nurhaci in 1619, survive only as earth walls elsewhere in the valley, mostly in farmland.
description: 叶赫那拉城位于吉林四平。游览特色包括湖泊、楼阁建筑、主题展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 26 km south-east of Siping in a straight line; an official Jilin tourism page (2019) gives about 30 km by road from Siping railway station, leaving the Changchun–Shenyang expressway at the Siping exit.

name: 一马树森林公园
summaryEn: A provincial forest park on the sandy edge of the Horqin grassland near Shuangliao, planted largely with pines that foresters first trialled on the sands some forty years ago. Local pages list a forest-bathing area, a small zoo and botanical garden, a play zone with zip lines and sand motorbikes, and farmhouse restaurants and picking gardens. It is described as the back garden of Shuangliao's residents, so it suits a short local visit rather than a long trip.
description: 一马树森林公园位于吉林四平。游览特色包括森林公园、草原、植物园。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 9 km east of Shuangliao city and roughly 72 km west-north-west of Siping, in straight lines.

name: 伊通满族博物馆
summaryEn: A county museum of Manchu history and folk culture in Yitong Manchu Autonomous County, recognised as the Yitong branch of the China Ethnic Museum. Its galleries cover the origins of the Manchus, production, daily life, culture, ritual and belief, and Yitong past and present, using photographs, models and audiovisual displays alongside a collection of about 5,000 items. It is a compact museum, best as a short stop for anyone interested in Manchu customs.
description: 伊通满族博物馆位于吉林四平。游览特色包括博物馆、民俗文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Renmin Road in Yitong county town, about 61 km south of central Changchun and 78 km east-north-east of Siping in straight lines.

name: 松原市规划展览馆
summaryEn: The Songyuan Planning Exhibition Hall is a municipal exhibition in Ningjiang district on the city's development and urban planning. Its displays include interactive holographic projections, relief murals with historical themes and figure scenes of local customs. It is a modern civic exhibition rather than a historic site, and the district promotes it as a family stop alongside nearby villages.
description: 松原市规划展览馆位于吉林松原。游览特色包括壁画、主题展览。图集建议预留约1 小时游览。
accessEn: On Binjiang East Road in Songyuan's Ningjiang district, about 3 km north-east of the city centre in a straight line.

name: 白鸡峰
summaryEn: A national forest park in the mountains south-east of Tonghua, centred on Baijifeng ('White Chicken Peak', 1,318 m), the highest peak in the city's surroundings. Its named rock features include the pale outcrops known as the 'chicken waists', and the paths pass the sites of several small temples dating from the late Ming and early Qing. It is also marketed as a forest-health resort.
description: 白鸡峰位于吉林通化。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the mountains about 23 km south-east of central Tonghua.

name: 中国山葡萄酒博物馆
summaryEn: A wine park in Kuaidamao, the seat of Tonghua County, run by the Tongtian wine company and centred on the China Mountain Wine Museum, which covers wines made from wild mountain grapes, a speciality of the Tonghua area. A passage from the exhibition halls leads down to an underground cellar. It suits visitors interested in how Tonghua's mountain-grape wines are made.
description: 中国山葡萄酒博物馆位于吉林通化。游览特色包括博物馆、葡萄酒文化、主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Kuaidamao, the Tonghua County town, about 15 km west-south-west of Tonghua city.

name: 城市客厅
summaryEn: A landscaped riverside promenade along the Huifa River through central Meihekou, laid out as an urban wetland park with plazas, flights of steps down to the water and landscape bridges. A lotus-growing demonstration area comes into flower from the end of June and draws visitors and photographers from nearby towns. It is a place for an easy walk by the river rather than a destination in itself.
description: 城市客厅位于吉林通化。游览特色包括湿地、滨水景观、莲花观赏。图集建议预留约1 小时游览。
accessEn: Along the Huifa River in central Meihekou, about 2 km east-north-east of the railway station.

name: 海龙湖
summaryEn: A man-made lake park on the south-eastern edge of Meihekou, opened to the public in 2018 and covering about 109 ha, of which roughly 47 ha is water. Paths run past lakeside plazas, a wetland with stepped weirs, three islands, a sand beach and a children's playground, and there is a shopping street of new buildings in Huizhou (Anhui) style. It suits families and locals out for a stroll, and camping areas are provided.
description: 海龙湖位于吉林通化。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊、海滨。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the south-eastern edge of Meihekou, about 4 km east-south-east of the town centre.

name: 佟佳江旅游度假区
summaryEn: A riverside leisure park on the south side of Tonghua, laid out as an urban park around a performance island with a theatre that seats 3,000. It has a children's play area, a boat pier, a 2.7 km forest boardwalk with three viewing platforms, a camping area and a small sightseeing train, and it is lit up in the evening. It suits families on a relaxed half-day out rather than visitors looking for a major sight.
description: 佟佳江旅游度假区位于吉林通化。游览特色包括岛屿、滨水景观、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Binjiang South Road beside the Hun River, about 4.5 km south-south-west of central Tonghua.

name: 五女峰
summaryEn: A mountain forest park north of Ji'an, named for a line of steep peaks said to resemble five women in green veils. It covers about 69 km² with 26 larger peaks, 17 of them above 1,000 m, and is known locally for its rock formations, forest and deep valleys. It is one of the ten 'sights of Tonghua' named on a Jilin provincial government website.
description: 五女峰位于吉林通化。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光、山岩地貌。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: North of Ji'an, about 20 km from the town and about 80 km from Tonghua according to Jilin's official description of the park.

name: 鸭绿江国门
summaryEn: A scenic area on the Yalu River at Ji'an, built around the border gate of the road crossing and the 1939 railway bridge, with the North Korean town of Manpo on the opposite bank. Visitors can see the gate, the bridge and the river from the Chinese side, and the railway bridge was one of the routes used by Chinese troops entering Korea in 1950. The provincial tourism bureau describes it as the only border-gate scenic area in China with both a rail and a road crossing.
description: 鸭绿江国门位于吉林通化。游览特色包括边境口岸。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the Yalu River in the Xiajiefang area on Ji'an's eastern edge, about 9 km east-north-east of the town centre.

name: 振国壹号庄园
summaryEn: A large estate on the shore of Yingebu Reservoir in the hills west of Tonghua, covering about 13 km² of forest, water and farmland and run by the Zhenguo pharmaceutical company. It combines holiday accommodation and dining with a forest-ginseng growing base, boat trips to the ginseng plots, a traditional-medicine clinic and bonfire evenings.
description: 振国壹号庄园位于吉林通化。游览特色包括水库、乘船游览、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The provincial listing puts it 26 km from Tonghua County town and 40 km from Tonghua city; in a straight line the reservoir is about 28 km west of Tonghua.

name: 知北村
summaryEn: A leisure village built in 2021–22 on the southern edge of Meihekou in the style of a 1970s north-eastern Chinese village, with 91 buildings holding shops, a tea house, restaurants, a guesthouse, a folk museum and an intangible-heritage hall. It is a new development rather than a historic village, and is mainly somewhere to eat, shop and take photographs, with a flower-field park next door. The first phase opened on 31 December 2021.
description: 知北村位于吉林通化。游览特色包括博物馆、村落风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the southern edge of Meihekou, about 4 km south-south-east of the town centre, opposite the city stadium.

name: 长白山百花谷朝鲜族古村落
summaryEn: Baihuagu is a village of traditional-style ethnic Korean (Chaoxian) houses built in the late 2010s on the road to Changbai Mountain, in Songjiang town, Antu county. It has a folk museum on ethnic Korean migration to China and everyday life, an exhibition hall on intangible cultural heritage, a hall where visitors can try making kimchi and pounding rice cake, a costume hall and guesthouses. Folk song-and-dance performances are staged for visitors.
description: 长白山百花谷朝鲜族古村落位于吉林延边。游览特色包括博物馆、古村落。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the road to Changbai Mountain's north slope, about 4 km south-west of Songjiang town centre and about 20 km north-east of Erdaobaihe in a straight line.

name: 长白山峡谷浮石林
summaryEn: A canyon about 5 km long and up to 40 m deep, cut into volcanic ground near the north side of Changbai Mountain, where weathering has left some 30 formations of pumice, a porous volcanic rock light enough to float. A boardwalk and path follow the canyon floor past underground streams and springs to the Bingshui (ice-water) spring, a 3.2 km walk of about an hour and a half, and an eight-storey tower looks out over the forest and the mountain's peaks. The canyon is also visited in winter, when it is covered in snow and walked on foot.
description: 长白山峡谷浮石林位于吉林延边。游览特色包括峡谷、石林。图集建议预留3–4 小时游览。
accessEn: In Erdaobaihe township, about 6 km from the Changbai Mountain north gate according to the Jilin tourism department.

name: 长白山历史文化园
summaryEn: A themed cultural park beside the road to Changbai Mountain in Sihe village, Songjiang town, laid out as 'four gardens and one zone' and presenting Confucian, Buddhist and Daoist themes. It has a Buddhist temple (Tai'an Temple), a Nine-Dragon Wall, a bronze gate on Chan and Daoist themes, an ecological garden with a wooden boardwalk and flower fields, and a hotel whose roof terrace faces Changbai Mountain. It is a modern park rather than a historic temple site.
description: 长白山历史文化园位于吉林延边。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、花卉观赏、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside the road to the north slope of Changbai Mountain, about 14 km east-north-east of Erdaobaihe in a straight line.

name: 大关东文化园
summaryEn: Daguandong Culture Park is a forest park in Dongqing village, Antu county, founded in 2013 and themed on Manchu customs and the 'Guandong' frontier culture of north-east China. Its walking route of under 5 km passes a Manchu courtyard house, displays of traditional kang beds, crafts and shamanic culture, a deer park and a forest boardwalk, and it includes a memorial hall for the Dasha River ambush, an action by the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army. Most visitors come with tour groups on Changbai Mountain itineraries.
description: 大关东文化园位于吉林延边。游览特色包括森林公园、纪念展览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dongqing village, Yongqing township, about 38 km north-north-east of Erdaobaihe, the gateway town to Changbai Mountain's north slope, in a straight line.

name: 大戏台河
summaryEn: Daxitaihe is a forest and river-valley scenic area run from the Huangsongpu forestry station of the Changbai Mountain forestry group, on the way to the north gate of Changbai Mountain. It was rated 4A in 2014 and has been managed with the Changbai Mountain tourism company since 2018. Antu county's tourism pages list a night-time forest light show among its 2025 night-tour routes and winter activities such as skiing, all-terrain vehicles and horse-drawn sleighs in 2024, and forestry families in Huangsongpu run guesthouses for visitors.
description: 大戏台河位于吉林延边。游览特色包括滑雪、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Huangsongpu forestry area of Erdaobaihe, on the way to the north gate of Changbai Mountain and about 30 minutes by car from Erdaobaihe according to the county tourism bureau. Check that it is open before going.

name: 寒葱岭
summaryEn: Hancongling is a forested ridge in Dunhua's forestry district where units of the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army under commanders including Yang Jingyu, Wei Zhengmin, Wang Detai and Chen Hanzhang fought and lived during the Anti-Japanese War. Xinhua describes the camp remains as among the best preserved and most militarily distinctive of the army's camps in Northeast China, and the state forest farm there runs a red-education base with study groups. The 4A listing calls it a red-tourism and sightseeing area, and Chinese state media also note its autumn leaves and a forest road popular with cyclists.
description: 寒葱岭位于吉林延边。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Hancongling forest farm, Jiangyuan town, about 42 km south-south-west of Dunhua in a straight line.

name: 好记文化旅游度假区
summaryEn: Haoji Cultural Tourism Resort is a 720,000 m² complex of antique-style buildings in Wangqing County, built around the Haoji soy sauce factory. Visitors can see traditional soy sauce brewing in wooden fermentation barrels, a method listed as provincial intangible cultural heritage, and a soy sauce culture exhibition hall; the complex also has a performance hall, restaurants and a study-trip programme, and period-costume photography studios operate in the grounds.
description: 好记文化旅游度假区位于吉林延边。游览特色包括非遗文化、主题展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the economic development zone on the east side of Wangqing town, about 50 km north-north-east of Yanji in a straight line.

name: 红石峰
summaryEn: Hongshifeng is a forested area at the Hongshi forestry station east of Erdaobaihe, with old forest and unusual rock outcrops. Since 2020 the Changbai Mountain tourism company has run it as an outdoor-activity area. Its activities include a clifftop café, rafting and a railway-track crossing challenge in summer, cliff-top walks and an off-piste snow park in winter, and autumn colour in October.
description: 红石峰位于吉林延边。游览特色包括林地风光、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km east-south-east of Erdaobaihe in a straight line, or about an hour and ten minutes by car according to the county tourism bureau.

name: 老白山
summaryEn: A forest tourism area developed by a state forestry company on former logging land in the Huangnihe district of Dunhua. Reports from 2021 and 2022 describe summer flower fields and walks, a winter 'snow village' with snow tubing and snowmobiles, and displays on the region's loggers' (mubang) culture, with guesthouses and restaurants run by forestry families.
description: 老白山位于吉林延边。游览特色包括花卉观赏、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At the Tuanbei forest farm of the Huangnihe forestry bureau, about 52 km north of Huangnihe town and 76 km north-north-west of Dunhua in a straight line; check what is open before going.

name: 良田百世
summaryEn: Liangtian Baishi is a leisure and holiday park on the bank of the Hailan River in Dongshengyong town, Longjing, planned as the main tourism area of the Yanji–Longjing–Tumen new district and receiving visitors since 2022. It offers camping lawns and rented tents, a flower-field train, a smart farm growing vegetables without soil, a riverside restaurant and a hotel opened in 2024. It suits families and groups looking for a day out or a night under canvas rather than historic sights.
description: 良田百世位于吉林延边。游览特色包括滨水景观、休闲度假。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dongshengyong town, about 14 km east-north-east of Longjing and about 10 km south-south-east of Yanji in a straight line.

name: 梦都美民俗旅游度假村
summaryEn: Mengdumei is a holiday resort in Chunxing village, Yilan town, on the north side of Yanji, whose main draw is its ski area. Alpine ski competitions were held there in the 2024–25 season, and the slopes were open day and night over the 2026 Spring Festival.
description: 梦都美民俗旅游度假村位于吉林延边。游览特色包括民俗文化、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Chunxing village, Yilan town, about 15 km north-north-east of central Yanji in a straight line.

name: 长白山魔界
summaryEn: Mojie ('Demon Realm') is a forest and wetland scenic area of about 88 ha near Erdaobaihe, on the north slope of Changbai Mountain. It is laid out with a wetland reserve, a wildlife-viewing area, streams and small waterfalls, forest walks, a photography zone and a rafting area. The name comes from the mist over the river and the fallen trees standing in the water, which photographers prize in winter when hoar frost coats the branches.
description: 长白山魔界位于吉林延边。游览特色包括瀑布、湿地。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: A short drive (about 5 minutes, according to the county tourism bureau) from Erdaobaihe, the gateway town to the north slope of Changbai Mountain.

name: 琵岩山
summaryEn: Piyanshan is a hill beside Longjing from which visitors look over the Hailan River valley and the prefecture's largest apple-pear orchard, which flowers in spring. The scenic area lies next to the orchard and to the Piyanshan hot-spring village, and the Jilin tourism department suggests mid-April to mid-May for the blossom.
description: 琵岩山位于吉林延边。游览特色包括果园、山谷、赏花。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 3 km and five minutes by car from the centre of Longjing, on the western edge of the town, according to the Jilin tourism department.

name: 琵岩山温泉古村落
summaryEn: Piyanshan Hot Spring Village is a hot-spring resort built in traditional Korean style, with white walls, dark roof tiles, timber galleries and stone-paved lanes, next to Piyan Mountain near Longjing. The resort says its water is drawn from about 2,500 m underground at around 51 °C and feeds 66 indoor and outdoor pools, and it also has a hotel, a restaurant serving Korean dishes and live shows in the afternoons. It is marketed as China's first hot-spring folk village.
description: 琵岩山温泉古村落位于吉林延边。游览特色包括温泉、古村落。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 3 km and five minutes by car from the centre of Longjing, next to the Piyanshan scenic area, with a walk or shuttle between the two, according to the Jilin tourism department.

name: 青龙渔业
summaryEn: Qinglong Fishery Park is a spring-fed cold-water fish farm turned leisure resort at Qinglong village, Toudao town, in Helong. Salmon-family fish, including the large taimen, swim in viewing pools of about 17,000 sq m filled with underground spring water at a constant 8 °C. The resort also has a camping area, a glass suspension bridge, a water park and a lure-fishing base, and serves spring-fish meals.
description: 青龙渔业位于吉林延边。游览特色包括水上游乐、休闲度假、泉水。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Qinglong village, about 23 km north of Helong and about 15 km west of Toudao town in a straight line.

name: 雪山飞湖
summaryEn: Xueshan Feihu, also called Snow Mountain Lake, is a reservoir on the upper Second Songhua River in Liangjiang town, surrounded by forest and cliffs, with many small peninsulas and rock formations the county names Banana Rock and Sun Rock. The county tourism pages say the lake was a filming location for the television drama Flying Fox of Snow Mountain, and the remains of an ancient Bohai-kingdom hillfort are among its best-known sights. It suits a quiet half day by the water in a forested setting.
description: 雪山飞湖位于吉林延边。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Liangjiang town, about 19 km north of Erdaobaihe in a straight line. Check that it is open before going.

name: 亚光湖国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A reservoir and wetland park in the hills of Dashitou town, Dunhua, about 6.2 km from north to south and 5.5 km from east to west and covering 2,291 ha of forest, lake, hills, wetland and grassland. A boardwalk about 10 km long runs through the wetland, and a 135 ha meadow is covered in irises in June. The park held its formal opening on 23 June 2025 and has viewing pavilions and a camping area; the lake is also visited for sunrise and sunset.
description: 亚光湖国家湿地公园位于吉林延边。游览特色包括湿地、草原、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the hills of Dashitou town, about 13 km south-south-east of the town and 33 km south-east of Dunhua in a straight line.

name: 延吉帽儿山恐龙文化旅游区
summaryEn: This tourist area of about 1.8 km² on the southern side of Yanji combines dinosaur-themed attractions, the woodland of Maoershan hill and a folk and commercial quarter. The Yanji Dinosaur Museum shows fossils and science displays in two zones, and the Dinosaur Kingdom beside it is a theme park with rides, a water park and holiday shows. The China Korean Folk Park has about 40 Korean-style buildings recreating household scenes, where visitors can try on traditional dress.
description: 延吉帽儿山恐龙文化旅游区位于吉林延边。游览特色包括博物馆、主题游乐。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: On the southern side of Yanji, about 5 km south-south-west of the city centre in a straight line.

name: 百泉谷
summaryEn: A forest tourism area at the Cuifeng forest farm of the Jiagedaqi forestry bureau, on the southern slopes of the Yilehuli Mountains. The bureau has developed it as a forest-health base with a self-drive campsite, forest 'star-room' cabins, a radon-spring bath, hot-spring log huts and a boardwalk trail, and offers riding, camping, fishing and forest-bathing activities. The prefecture's own description also mentions ancient rock paintings, a picking garden and old-growth forest.
description: 百泉谷位于黑龙江大兴安岭。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the Jiamo road about 23 km north of Jiagedaqi, in Songling district; check opening dates before a winter visit.

name: 呼玛县博物馆
summaryEn: The county museum of Huma, on the Heilongjiang River, which opened in April 2016. Its stone tools, rock paintings, potsherds and iron and copper cauldrons tell the history of the area; it joined the 4A list in October 2025.
description: 呼玛县博物馆位于黑龙江大兴安岭。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: On Zhengqi Road in Huma town, about 1 km east of the town centre; closed on Mondays.

name: 寒温带植物园
summaryEn: A botanical garden of forest and lakeside planting just south of Jiagedaqi, with Mongolian pine and white birch around a stream and a lake. The district's media describe it as a 4A attraction with spring flowers and autumn fruit.
description: 寒温带植物园位于黑龙江大兴安岭。游览特色包括湖泊、植物园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Airport Road about 6.5 km south-south-west of Jiagedaqi station. Check that it is open before going.

name: 龙江第一湾
summaryEn: A sharp bend of the Heilongjiang River in the Tuqiang forestry bureau's area, where the river turns back on itself below the Hongqiling hills and is seen from viewpoints at the top of a hill reached by stairs. There are two ways up: a newer, gentler path and an older, steeper one that gives a fuller view of the bend.
description: 黑龙江流经图强林区时回转形成明显的大弯，可登高观看江流绕行的形状。
accessEn: On the G331 river road in Mohe, about 76 km east of Beiji Village and 28 km east of Beihong village; Mohe city is about 85 km to the south-west.

name: 鹿鼎山
summaryEn: A steep hill beside Huma town on the Heilongjiang River, named after Jin Yong's novel 'The Deer and the Cauldron'. Faulting and volcanic activity have left fault scarps and sheer rock faces, and the summit looks over the meanders of the Huma River, the plain and the town; a winter martial-arts culture week is held here.
description: 鹿鼎山位于黑龙江大兴安岭。游览特色包括登山观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 9 km south-south-west of Huma town, reached by road.

name: 二十二驿站
summaryEn: A scenic area at the 22nd station of the old Mo'ergen-Mohe post road, which the Qing court opened in 1685 to carry military dispatches and reopened in 1888 as the 'gold road' to the Mohe mines.
