The site has post-station statues, log-cabin station houses, stables, a 'northernmost post office', an educated-youth culture park, a rafting stop and a car-camping ground, and the site of the old station is among the stops nearby. The road's national listing covers its stations in Huma, Tahe and Mohe counties and in Nenjiang.
description: 二十二驿站位于黑龙江大兴安岭。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、历史纪念、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the G331 road at Ershi'er Zhan forest farm in Tahe County, about 87 km north of Tahe town by the county government's figure (about 73 km in a straight line).

name: 阿木塔蒙古风情岛
summaryEn: A Mongolian-themed tourist area on the Amuta peninsula, a long spit running into one of the lakes of the Lianhuan Lake system in Dorbod Mongol Autonomous County. Its centre is a shrine to Hasar, a brother of Genghis Khan, which holds a flame brought to the site in his memory; yurts, an obo cairn group and horse-riding and archery grounds make up the rest, with Mongol and fish dishes on offer. It was built by the Daqing media group and rated 4A in 2015.
description: 阿木塔蒙古风情岛位于黑龙江大庆。游览特色包括湖泊、马术活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 15 km north-north-west of Hujitumo town in Dorbod County and some 80 km west of central Daqing; reached by road.

name: 北国温泉
summaryEn: A large hot-spring resort on the south-western edge of Lindian town, themed on cold-region hot-spring culture, with, by the county's count, 83 pools in indoor, water-play, forest and herbal-bath zones, a 'Guandong'-style old street and a hotel. Its water comes from the Lindian geothermal field, which the county promotes as one of the largest medium- and low-temperature geothermal fields in China.
description: 北国温泉位于黑龙江大庆。游览特色包括温泉、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the south-western edge of Lindian town, about 1.3 km from the town centre and some 65 km north-north-west of central Daqing; reached by road.

name: 大庆石油馆
summaryEn: A museum on Century Avenue at Dongfeng Road in Saertu, Daqing's central district, housed in the former Petroleum Pavilion of Expo 2010 Shanghai, which was moved to Daqing and opened there in September 2012. Its exhibitions cover the development of the Daqing oilfield and the growth of the city around it. Heilongjiang's provincial tourism department recommends it as the place in Daqing to learn about the past and present of oil and the culture and spirit the industry gave the city.
description: 大庆石油馆位于黑龙江大庆。游览特色包括博物馆、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Dongfeng Road (Century Avenue) in Saertu district, about 2 km west-south-west of central Daqing; closed on Wednesdays.

name: 大庆赛车小镇
summaryEn: A motorsport complex on the northern edge of Saertu district, with a 3.16 km circuit built to the FIA grade-3 standard and opened in 2024 (a grandstand for 3,000), plus an off-road course, drift area, drag strip, go-karting and motorcycle stunt track. It also has a used-car market, a large graffiti-art zone and a camping ground, and holds races and festivals through the year.
description: 大庆赛车小镇位于黑龙江大庆。游览特色包括节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the northern edge of Saertu district, about 8.5 km north of central Daqing; race and festival dates vary, so check the programme.

name: 飞泷四季温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort at the southern edge of Lindian, recognisable by its Russian-style domed buildings beside the expressway toll gate. Its indoor halls hold more than 20 pools, including spa, swimming and fish-therapy pools, and there are 22 open-air pools; a military-culture museum opened in the grounds in 2017.
description: 飞泷四季温泉位于黑龙江大庆。游览特色包括博物馆、温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 3.5 km south of Lindian town beside the expressway toll gate, and some 65 km north-north-west of central Daqing; reached by road.

name: 鹤鸣湖湿地温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort on the edge of Heming Lake wetland in Lindian County, with indoor and outdoor pools. The grounds include bamboo-raft and boat rides and bird-watching on the reed marsh, a wetland museum and, in winter, an ice-and-snow park with an ice-lake zoo and sliding runs.
description: 鹤鸣湖湿地温泉位于黑龙江大庆。游览特色包括博物馆、温泉、湿地。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Heminghu town, about 28 km west-north-west of Lindian town beside the Heminghu interchange of the Suiman expressway, and some 87 km north-north-west of central Daqing; reached by road.

name: 铁人王进喜纪念馆
summaryEn: A museum on the life of Wang Jinxi, the oil driller nicknamed 'Iron Man' who led a drilling team to Daqing in 1960, in a building whose plan and profile spell out the characters for 'worker'. The galleries on the second and third floors hold more than 200 photographs and 300 objects with scene reconstructions, and the grounds have a 6.5 m granite statue of him and a Soviet-built drilling rig of the type his team used. The present building opened in September 2006 and the museum is a national first-grade museum.
description: 铁人王进喜纪念馆位于黑龙江大庆。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览、国家一级博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Zhongyuan Road in Ranghulu district, about 17 km west of central Daqing; closed on Mondays.

name: 连环湖温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort on the shore of Lianhuan Lake, a large shallow lake system in Dorbod Mongol Autonomous County, open since 2010. It has indoor and outdoor pools in landscaped grounds, herbal baths and a Mongolian-medicine bath, with ice-and-snow activities in winter; the county tourism office says the water comes from about 1,800 m underground at around 48 °C.
description: 连环湖温泉位于黑龙江大庆。游览特色包括温泉、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the lake shore in Lianhuan Lake town, about 20 km west-south-west of the county seat of Dorbod and some 70 km west-north-west of central Daqing; reached by road.

name: 杜尔伯特伊利乳业工业园
summaryEn: A visitor route through a plant of the Yili dairy group in the Delige'er development zone beside Dorbod's county seat, on a site of about 20 hectares. The indoor route covers company exhibits, a product hall and an explanation of milk-powder production, with windows over the workshop floor, and the outdoor route passes the milk-reception square and the warehouse. It is a 4A industrial-tourism site and was the first stop on the county's 2024 rural-tourism route listed by the Ministry of Culture and Tourism.
description: 杜尔伯特伊利乳业工业园位于黑龙江大庆。游览特色包括工业参观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Delige'er development zone, about 5 km south-east of the county seat of Dorbod and some 55 km west-north-west of central Daqing; confirm that factory visits are currently offered before going.

name: 白渔泡湿地公园
summaryEn: A national wetland park of about 3.3 square kilometres in Juyuan town, Daowai District, mostly reed marsh and open water north-east of Harbin. It is home to more than 80 kinds of waterbirds and land birds and about 20 wild fish species, and visitors tour the reeds in sculling boats, fish, or visit an education hall on wetland ecology. A lotus pond of about 2,000 square metres flowers from late July for roughly a month.
description: 白渔泡湿地公园位于黑龙江哈尔滨。游览特色包括湿地、莲花观赏。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Juyuan town, Daowai District, about 34 km by road north-east of central Harbin, roughly half an hour by car.

name: 大顶子山温泉度假村
summaryEn: A modern hot-spring resort beside the Songhua River in Hulan district, built around a large indoor spa hall with an 800 sq m pool and many types of hot-spring bath. Water is drawn from a mineral spring about 1,620 m underground, and the outdoor baths look out over the river and the hill that gives the resort its name.
description: 大顶子山温泉度假村位于黑龙江哈尔滨。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Hulan district beside the Dadingzishan river dam, about 55 km east-north-east of central Harbin in a straight line, reached by road.

name: 二龙山风景区
summaryEn: A lake-and-hill scenic area around the Erlong reservoir in Binxian County, east of Harbin; the dam was built between 1958 and 1974, and the lake gives the area its name. Activities include skiing and grass-skiing, zip-lining and climbing, with dozens of hotels and holiday villages in the area. In winter the frozen lake hosts a snow-play zone and an ice-fishing festival, and a small art museum stands inside the area.
description: 二龙山风景区位于黑龙江哈尔滨。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊、滑雪。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Binxian County, about 65 km by road east of central Harbin, roughly an hour by car.

name: 飞鹤（哈尔滨）智能产业园
summaryEn: An industrial-tourism park built around a plant of Feihe, a Heilongjiang infant-formula and dairy company, in Shuangcheng district south of Harbin. It offers factory sightseeing and study visits. The provincial tourism department approved it as a 4A scenic area in October 2025.
description: 哈尔滨双城区的飞鹤乳品工厂开放工业观光，游客可了解乳品工业的生产流程。
accessEn: In Shuangcheng district, about 28 km south-south-west of central Harbin in a straight line, reached by road. Check that factory visits are currently offered before going.

name: 哈尔滨啤酒博物馆
summaryEn: A three-storey museum at the Budweiser Harbin brewery in Pingfang District, telling the story of Harbin Beer, which dates from 1900 and is billed as China's earliest beer brand. The ground floor covers the brewery's history, the second floor is an interactive experience area and the top floor is a 'beer college', with guides on each level. It opened in 2014 and appears in the official A-level list as the Centenary Harbin Beer Cultural Tourism Area.
description: 哈尔滨啤酒博物馆位于黑龙江哈尔滨。游览特色包括博物馆、酿造文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Pingfang District, about 24 km by road south-south-east of central Harbin, roughly 20 minutes by car.

name: 黑龙江省科技馆
summaryEn: A ship-shaped science museum on the north bank of the Songhua River, opened in August 2003, with about 13,000 square metres of permanent galleries, a domed-screen cinema and a 4D cinema. Exhibits cover mechanics, space, life and environment and information technology, and there is a children's floor. In 2025 the ground-floor galleries were refitted with new themed zones on ice and snow, aviation, deep space and the oceans.
description: 黑龙江省科技馆位于黑龙江哈尔滨。游览特色包括博物馆、科学科普。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Songbei District on the north bank of the Songhua, about 8 km by road west-north-west of central Harbin; the museum is closed on Mondays.

name: 铧子山地质森林公园
summaryEn: A forested mountain park in Tonghe County, named after its plough-blade-shaped peaks (huazi means ploughshare), with the Dahuazi, Erhuazi and Sanhuazi summits and a highest point of 680.7 m. A walking route of about 3 km passes some 38 sights, among them a rock field, a waterfall and a footbridge. A base of the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army also lay on the mountain, and its remains are a county-level protected site.
description: 铧子山地质森林公园位于黑龙江哈尔滨。游览特色包括瀑布、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 16 km north-west of Tonghe town in Tonghe County, and about 195 km by road north-east of central Harbin, around two and a half hours by car.

name: 鸡冠山景区
summaryEn: A forested hill area in Mulan County, north-east of Harbin, made up of a geopark, a forest park and the remains of a base of the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army. Its best-known geological feature is the 'Thousand-metre Gallery', a long cliff and rock landscape that from the air looks like a dragon winding through the hills. It was listed as a 4A scenic area in the province's 2023 list.
description: 鸡冠山景区位于黑龙江哈尔滨。游览特色包括地质景观、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Mulan County, on forest land run by the Xinglong Forestry Bureau, about 180 km by road north-east of central Harbin, roughly three hours by car. Check that it is open before going.

name: 金龙山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park in the hills south-east of Harbin, approved in 2007, whose main peak, Jinlong Mountain, reaches 826 m. The park is divided into six zones, including Lingyin Mountain with its temple and a wooden boardwalk of 'eighteen bends' up the slope, and it is known locally for autumn colour, with a red-leaf festival held each autumn. The official A-level list names it the Jinlongshan International Tourism Resort.
description: 金龙山国家森林公园位于黑龙江哈尔滨。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jinlongshan town, Acheng District, about 80 km by road south-east of central Harbin, roughly an hour and a quarter by car.

name: 枫叶小镇温泉度假村
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in Harbin's northern Songbei district with thermal bathing pools. It is a commercial leisure resort rather than a historic or natural site, suited to a relaxing half-day.
description: 枫叶小镇温泉度假村位于黑龙江哈尔滨。游览特色包括温泉、休闲度假。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Songbei district, about 15 km west-north-west of central Harbin in a straight line, reached by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 美丽岛温泉水乐园
summaryEn: A hot-spring and water-park resort at Liaodian in Acheng district. It is a commercial leisure complex rather than a historic or natural site.
description: 美丽岛温泉水乐园位于黑龙江哈尔滨。游览特色包括温泉、泉水。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Acheng district, about 25 km east-south-east of central Harbin in a straight line, reached by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 凤凰山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park of about 50,000 ha in the mountains of southern Wuchang, run by the Shanhetun Forestry Bureau and also designated a national geological park. It has two main visitor areas, the Grand Canyon and the Alpine Garden (also called the Sky Garden), with boardwalks and trails; the main peak is about 1,700 m. The high ground stays cool in summer, and the park also runs a separate winter ice-and-snow season.
description: 凤凰山国家森林公园位于黑龙江哈尔滨。游览特色包括峡谷、地质景观、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the forest area of the Shanhetun Forestry Bureau in the south-east of Wuchang, roughly 100 km south-east of Wuchang town and some 200 km south-south-east of Harbin in a straight line; the winter and summer seasons run separately, so check opening dates.

name: 森工平山
summaryEn: A forest recreation area in the hills of Acheng district, centred on a semi-wild deer park where more than a thousand sika and red deer roam and visitors can feed them, according to the district government. Nearly 10 km of forest boardwalk runs through the park, and the area also offers boating on the Xiquanyan reservoir in summer and skiing in winter, with hotels on site.
description: 森工平山位于黑龙江哈尔滨。游览特色包括滑雪、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Acheng district, about 75 km south-east of central Harbin in a straight line, reached by road.

name: 波塞冬旅游度假区
summaryEn: A Greek-myth-themed resort in the Harbin New Area north of the Songhua, opened in stages from 2017. It has an indoor beach water park, an aquarium called Undersea World with a glass tunnel, and a shark-themed hotel; the second phase, opened in 2019, also added a dolphin-show arena. The resort covers about 1,600 mu (around 107 hectares).
description: 波塞冬旅游度假区位于黑龙江哈尔滨。游览特色包括海滨、水族展览、水上游乐。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Hulan District, within the Harbin New Area, about 18 km by road north-north-east of central Harbin.

name: 普罗旺斯薰衣草庄园
summaryEn: A flower park of about 1,200 mu (around 80 hectares) on rolling hills in Xiangyang town, Xiangfang District, planted with lavender, salvia, verbena and some 70 kinds of ornamental flowers. It has a glamping area with tents and barbecue facilities, and is run as a lavender-themed park for families. The flowers peak in summer, so it suits a summer day out from the city.
description: 普罗旺斯薰衣草庄园位于黑龙江哈尔滨。游览特色包括花卉观赏、庄园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xiangyang town, Xiangfang District, about 31 km by road east of central Harbin, roughly half an hour by car; it is a seasonal flower park. Check that it is open before going.

name: 松峰山
summaryEn: A forested mountain south-east of Harbin, whose main peak, Chimney Peak, is 627 m, long used as a Daoist retreat. The Taiyi Daoism founder Xiao Baozhen set up a cave hermitage here in 1143, and the Haiyun Temple, rebuilt on the old temple site in the Qing dynasty, still has resident Daoists and holds temple fairs. Rock formations, carved stones and old Daoist tombs lie along the paths, and the scenic area was rated 4A in 2024.
description: 松峰山位于黑龙江哈尔滨。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、林地风光、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Songfengshan town, Acheng District, about 100 km by road south-east of central Harbin, roughly an hour and a quarter by car.

name: 融创乐园
summaryEn: A large theme park in Songbei district, part of the Sunac tourism and residential development. It has rides and live shows, including a parade and a mythology-themed show street, and is aimed at families.
description: 融创乐园位于黑龙江哈尔滨。游览特色包括主题游乐。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Songbei district, about 11 km west-north-west of central Harbin in a straight line, reached by road.

name: 伏尔加庄园
summaryEn: A Russian-themed estate of about 60 hectares on the Ashi River in Xiangfang District, built by a private company over more than twenty years. Its main sights are a full-size reconstruction of Harbin's St Nicholas Cathedral, rebuilt in 2007, the Petrov Art Palace, with Russian paintings, murals and sculpture, and copies of other lost Harbin buildings such as a sailing-ship-shaped restaurant from Sun Island. It is a themed attraction rather than a historic site, and suits visitors who want a Russian-style day out.
description: 伏尔加庄园位于黑龙江哈尔滨。游览特色包括壁画、岛屿、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Chenggaozi town, Xiangfang District, about 26 km by road east-south-east of central Harbin, roughly half an hour by car.

name: 香炉山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park in the southern hills of Binxian County, named after its main peak, which is shaped like an incense burner and rises to 790 m. Sights include the Ice Lake, Butterfly Valley and Lovers' Peak, and there are hotels and a ski area at the foot of the mountain. The park has received visitors since 1999.
description: 香炉山国家森林公园位于黑龙江哈尔滨。游览特色包括森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Pingfang town in the south of Binxian County, about 90 km by road east-south-east of central Harbin, roughly an hour and twenty minutes by car. Check that it is open before going.

name: 英杰风景区
summaryEn: A hot-spring and leisure resort in a wooded valley at Youlian village, Binxian County, with a hot-spring complex of 54 indoor and outdoor pools, an indoor water park and a winter snow-play and ski area. Other sights include a Mongolian-style park, a glass walkway and a wooden boardwalk up the 722 m Hutou Cliff. Several TV dramas, including later seasons of the series Country Love, were filmed in the village.
description: 英杰风景区位于黑龙江哈尔滨。游览特色包括玻璃栈道、水上游乐、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Youlian village, about 13 km south-west of Binzhou, the seat of Binxian County, and about 75 km by road east of central Harbin.

name: 宝泉岭现代农业生态园
summaryEn: A farm-tourism park of the Baoquanling branch of the Beidahuang agricultural group, built around solar greenhouses where visitors pick fruit such as cherries, strawberries and dragon fruit. In summer, flower fields and a lawn camping area open, and school groups come for farming-science visits. It suits families and study groups.
description: 宝泉岭现代农业生态园位于黑龙江鹤岗。游览特色包括田园观光、花卉观赏、农业体验。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Baoquanling state-farm area of Luobei county, about 19 km east-north-east of central Hegang.

name: 鹤岗森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park in the hills north of Hegang, run by the city forestry bureau and made up of the Xilinhe folk-culture park, the Shilihe ecological scenic area and the Tongzigou stand of old-growth Korean pine. The Xilinhe park combines woodland scenery with folk song and dance performances and about 7 km of raft drifting on the river.
description: 鹤岗森林公园位于黑龙江鹤岗。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills about 21 km north of central Hegang (Dongshan district).

name: 萝北名山景区
summaryEn: A riverside scenic area at Mingshan town on the Heilongjiang (Amur) River, centred on the wooded Mingshan Island and a riverside park along the shore. The island holds the Heilongjiang River Basin Museum, a second-grade national museum opened in 2009 with natural-history, history and ethnic-folk halls and more than 4,000 objects, including fossils and displays on the peoples who live along the river. The park looks across the river to the Russian bank.
description: 萝北名山景区位于黑龙江鹤岗。游览特色包括博物馆、岛屿、滨水景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Mingshan town on the Heilongjiang River, Luobei county, about 25 km east-north-east of Luobei county town and about 72 km east-north-east of Hegang. The Heilongjiang River Basin Museum on the island is closed on Mondays.

name: 清源湖
summaryEn: A reservoir-lake scenic area in the Heli River valley west of Hegang, laid out with ten zones in a Nordic style across a core area of 147 hectares inside a wider area of 1,600 hectares. The zones include fishing, flower viewing, lotus ponds, a wetland walk, a wedding-themed area, a children's water-play area and an agricultural sightseeing area. It is run by the city water bureau and also serves as a water-conservation education site.
description: 清源湖位于黑龙江鹤岗。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the western edge of Hegang, about 13 km west of the city centre, close to Songhe West Lake.

name: 松鹤西湖
summaryEn: A lake park of about 300 hectares, 60 of them water, in wooded foothills of the Lesser Khingan west of Hegang, enclosed by hills on three sides and centred on the lake and Feilai Peak. It has a sandy beach, non-powered play rides, a forest adventure course, fishing, children's play areas and a conference centre for about 200 people. It was upgraded to a 4A scenic area in the 2025 review.
description: 松鹤西湖位于黑龙江鹤岗。游览特色包括湖泊、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 13 km west of central Hegang.

name: 萝北太平沟景区
summaryEn: A scenic area in the Lesser Khingan foothills on the Heilongjiang River, known for the Longjiang Three Gorges (Longmen, Jinlong and Jinman gorges), which visitors see from boats, and the 5 km Xinglong Canyon, about 400 m deep, with forest walkways and a steel lookout tower. Huangjin Ancient Town, built around the late-Qing gold-mining history of Taipinggou, has a gold-panning experience, a performance square and period-style shops and tea houses.
description: 萝北太平沟景区位于黑龙江鹤岗。游览特色包括峡谷、古镇。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the north of Luobei county on the Heilongjiang River, about 63 km north-north-west of Luobei county town and about 91 km north-north-east of Hegang; at peak holidays the boat trips may need booking in advance.

name: 月牙湖北方民族园
summaryEn: A lakeside park of about 84 hectares on the Heilongjiang River plain, part of the 570-hectare Yueyahu (Crescent Lake) National Wetland Park. It has three zones: a history zone with reconstructions of the Jin-era walled town of Aolimi and the Tongren culture site, an ethnic-customs zone with houses, costume and displays for the Daur, Oroqen, Hezhe (Nanai) and other northern peoples, and a lakeside leisure zone. The wetland park also has an exhibition hall with bird specimens.
description: 月牙湖北方民族园位于黑龙江鹤岗。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Zhongren town, Suibin county, about 42 km north of Suibin county town and about 129 km east-north-east of Hegang.

name: 朝阳山东北抗联第三路军密营遗址
summaryEn: A wooded hill area where the Third Route Army of the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army (an armed force that fought the Japanese occupation) had its headquarters and where the CPC North Manchuria Provincial Committee was based; the Third Route Army was set up here on 30 May 1939. Visitors can see the Dahengshan headquarters ridge, where machine-gun positions survive, a bullet-scarred boulder known as the Merit Stone, a memorial cemetery and a museum, with a themed park and homestay accommodation added in recent years.
description: 朝阳山东北抗联第三路军密营遗址位于黑龙江黑河。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Chaoyangshan town in the north of Wudalianchi city, about 54 km north-north-east of the city's urban area.

name: 中俄民族风情园
summaryEn: A purpose-built cultural park of about 35 ha on the western outskirts of Heihe, laid out in eight themed zones. They cover Oroqen folk displays, an 'Eight Banners' maze, a film and television set, a folk-style town, flower fields, outdoor activities, a water park and a star-gazing campsite, so it suits families and groups looking for a leisure stop.
description: 中俄民族风情园位于黑龙江黑河。游览特色包括水上游乐、花卉观赏、民族文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 11 km west-north-west of central Heihe.

name: 中共黑龙江省工作委员会和省政府旧址
summaryEn: Two former administrative buildings in Bei'an where the Chinese Communist Party's Heilongjiang committee and the provincial government were based from November 1945 until the provincial seat moved to Qiqihar in May 1949. The committee building, a grey two-storey block of about 1944 built as a Manchukuo-era county office, has reconstructed offices of the committee's secretary and department heads; the government building, put up in 1937 as the Manchukuo provincial office, has nine reconstructed offices and the meeting room where Oroqen representatives negotiated their resettlement.
description: 中共黑龙江省工作委员会和省政府旧址位于黑龙江黑河。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、历史旧址。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Bei'an city, about 36 km south-east of Wudalianchi's urban area; the two buildings are about 1.7 km apart, and both are closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 山口湖
summaryEn: A reservoir of about 84 sq km on the upper Nemor River, completed in 1999 and ringed by forested hills with many small islands. Boat trips pass granite crags such as Bajie Rock and Turtle Island, and the lake sits inside a nature reserve that is an important stop for waterbirds. Frost on the trees and ice scenes also draw winter visitors.
description: 山口湖位于黑龙江黑河。游览特色包括湖泊、水库、自然保护区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 47 km east of Wudalianchi city.

name: 新生鄂伦春民俗景区
summaryEn: A folk-culture visitor area in Xinsheng, an Oroqen township; the Oroqen are a traditionally hunting people of the Khingan forests. It has the Lingshangren Museum on Oroqen life, a herbal-medicine museum, a re-created 'primitive tribe' camp and the Cierbin River, and visitors can try horse riding, shooting and archery, dried-meat tasting and birch-bark or roe-deer-skin crafts. The township also stages the Gulunmuta fire-god festival, a national intangible cultural heritage item.
description: 新生鄂伦春民俗景区位于黑龙江黑河。游览特色包括博物馆、民俗文化、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 78 km by road from central Heihe (around 85 minutes by car).

name: 敖其湾赫哲族旅游区
summaryEn: A Hezhe cultural area on the Songhua River bank at Aoqi, the Hezhe village in the suburbs of Jiamusi. Xinhua reports that visitors make fish-skin pictures, try on fish-skin clothing and eat river fish, and that Aoqi town drew more than 300,000 visitors between 2024 and mid-2025. The Hezhe festival Wuribong, held every four years, was staged in Jiamusi's suburbs in 2025, and a ski slope on the same riverbank is used in winter.
description: 敖其湾赫哲族旅游区位于黑龙江佳木斯。游览特色包括滨水景观、节庆文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Aoqi town beside the Songhua, about 23 km by road west-south-west of central Jiamusi; the Hezhe museum in the village is closed on Mondays.

name: 富锦国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A wetland on the south-west side of Fujin that has been restored over many years and is now a summer gathering place for waterbirds, with a lotus pond. It is a designated national wildlife-protection education base and suits birdwatchers and anyone crossing the Sanjiang Plain.
description: 富锦国家湿地公园位于黑龙江佳木斯。游览特色包括湿地、动物观赏、观鸟。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jinshan town, about 51 km by road south-south-west of Fujin city.

name: 富锦万亩水稻公园
summaryEn: A rice-farming park on the Sanjiang Plain beside the Harbin–Tongjiang expressway, known for giant rice-field pictures: in 2026 the designs covered 120,000 square metres, planted with black rice, ordinary green rice and ornamental varieties and viewed from an observation tower. Visitors can also try transplanting rice in a demonstration field, see rice being milled and visit a small exhibition on rice growing, and the park has added camping and caravan areas (Xinhua, September 2026). The pictures are at their clearest in summer.
description: 富锦万亩水稻公园位于黑龙江佳木斯。游览特色包括楼阁建筑、农业体验。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 13 km by road south-south-west of Fujin, beside the Harbin–Tongjiang expressway, and about 150 km by road from Jiamusi.

name: 黑瞎子岛探秘野熊园
summaryEn: A large wildlife park on Heixiazi Island where more than 110 black bears, together with roe deer, deer and wild boar, are kept in semi-wild enclosures across 130 hectares of wetland and woodland; China Daily (2024) calls it the country's largest black-bear zoo. Visitors tour it by vehicle on a winding route and watch the bears swim, dig and climb trees. The island's Chinese name means 'black bear island'.
description: 黑瞎子岛探秘野熊园位于黑龙江佳木斯。游览特色包括湿地、动物观赏。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Heixiazi Island, about 43 km by road east of Fuyuan town, which has an airport.

name: 桦南百年蒸汽小火车
summaryEn: A narrow-gauge forest railway of the Huanan forestry bureau, described locally as a century old, on which steam locomotives carry sightseeing trains to the Sengong Dayuan folk village. The village re-creates a 1960s–70s logging community, with an old co-op shop, a photo studio and a school, and there is a campsite beside the station and evening performances in summer. The 2026 season began on 1 May, and weekends and holidays are the busiest times.
description: 桦南百年蒸汽小火车位于黑龙江佳木斯。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At the forestry bureau yard on the north-eastern edge of Huanan town, about 83 km by road south-south-east of Jiamusi; the train runs seasonally, so check before going.

name: 街津口赫哲旅游度假区
summaryEn: A Hezhe settlement area on the Amur in Tongjiang, centred on Jiejinkou Hezhe Township. The Hezhe are one of China's smallest ethnic groups, traditionally river fishers, and their sung epic Yimakan is on UNESCO's list of intangible heritage in need of urgent safeguarding; Tongjiang promotes Hezhe-style villages, murals and crafts. The township lies below the wooded Jiejinshan, a national forest park.
description: 街津口赫哲旅游度假区位于黑龙江佳木斯。游览特色包括森林公园、壁画。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 48 km by road north-east of Tongjiang town, along the Amur.

name: 七星旅游名镇
summaryEn: A farm-based tourist complex at Qixing Farm, a large state-run rice farm of the Beidahuang Group in the Jiansanjiang district of the Sanjiang Plain. The draw is large-scale rice farming: Xinhua photographs from July 2026 show big rice-field pictures planted on the farm, and a 2025 Xinhua report describes drones carrying rice seedlings across its paddies.
description: 七星旅游名镇位于黑龙江佳木斯。游览特色包括农业体验。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Jiansanjiang farming area about 58 km by road east of Fujin; check that it is open before going.

name: 同江三江口
summaryEn: A riverside wetland park where the Songhua River joins the Amur (Heilongjiang), a confluence that Xinhua describes as a stretch where the dark water of the Amur and the yellow water of the Songhua run side by side before mixing. The park is also the northern starting point of the Tongsan highway, which runs more than 5,000 km south to Sanya on Hainan, and its wetland is home to more than 200 bird species according to Xinhua. It suits a short stop for the river view.
description: 同江三江口位于黑龙江佳木斯。游览特色包括湿地、滨水景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 9 km by road north-north-east of the centre of Tongjiang, which is about 230 km by road from Jiamusi.

name: 星火稻乡
summaryEn: A Korean-minority farming village on the Sanjiang Plain that became a visitor attraction in 2025, built around its rice paddies, with rice-field pictures, a Xinghuo Tower, a re-created village co-op shop and about ten other sights, and a snow park in winter. China Daily reports that the first collective farm of the People's Republic was founded in the village on 19 February 1951. Xinhua counted more than 1.1 million visitors by early 2026, and the village restaurants serve Korean-minority dishes.
description: 星火稻乡位于黑龙江佳木斯。游览特色包括楼阁建筑、农业体验。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xinghuo Korean Ethnic Township, Huachuan county, beside a main road and about 22 km by road east-north-east of Jiamusi.

name: 北大荒书法长廊
summaryEn: A calligraphy garden beside the General's Lake reservoir north of Mishan, laid out over about 16 hectares as a garden of corridors, platforms and stone tablets. According to the city government it holds more than 2,400 carved stone tablets bearing the writing of about 1,600 people, from revolutionary figures and writers to contemporary calligraphers. The reservoir, formerly the Youth Reservoir, was built from 1958 under General Wang Zhen during the opening up of the Great Northern Wilderness.
description: 北大荒书法长廊位于黑龙江鸡西。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 17 km by road north-north-west of Mishan, on the shore of the General's Lake.

name: 当壁镇兴凯湖旅游度假区
summaryEn: A state-farm lakeside resort district on the western end of Lake Khanka, beside the Mishan border port, with a sandy shore, a lakeside deer park, a Russian-style park, a picking garden and a water park. Its history sights are memorials to the opening up of the Great Northern Wilderness, including a hall holding General Wang Zhen's tools and photographs, and the Bailing River bridge, kept as a relic of the old border crossing. The resort has been developed since the 1980s and is aimed at summer holidaymakers.
description: 当壁镇兴凯湖旅游度假区位于黑龙江鸡西。游览特色包括湖泊、水上游乐、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Dangbi on the western end of Lake Khanka, about 42 km by road south-south-east of Mishan; the Beidahuang development memorial hall is open from early April to November.

name: 东方红湿地
summaryEn: A lake and wetland tourist area in the Dongfanghong forestry area of Hulin, run from the forestry bureau and rated 4A. The provincial review of October 2025 lists it under the name Dongfanghong Nanchahu Scenic Area.
description: 东方红湿地位于黑龙江鸡西。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Dongfanghong forestry area, about 60 km north-north-east of Hulin town.

name: 麒麟山景区
summaryEn: Rock peaks and a lake in Xingnong town, Jidong county, named for a ridge whose north and south peaks are said to look like the head and tail of a qilin, the mythical beast. A hill path leads to a viewing platform at about 555 m, and around the 26.8-hectare lake there are play features such as coloured slides, a water-curtain bridge, high-level rafting and a 'Dream Island' play area, plus a horse show in summer (county government, 2025–26). It is also a provincial geopark and suits families on a day trip from Jixi.
description: 麒麟山景区位于黑龙江鸡西。游览特色包括湖泊、岛屿、山地游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xingnong town, about 38 km by road north-north-west of Jixi; it opens seasonally (the 2026 season began on 1 May).

name: 铁西森林公园
summaryEn: A forest, lake and wetland area in the hills west of Mishan, covering about 80 square kilometres by the Jixi city government's figure. It has reservoirs, a lotus pond crossed by a zigzag boardwalk, an island with villas, a crane-breeding base and Korean and Mongol-style folk parks, and a seasonal water park. It suits a half-day nature stop in summer.
description: 铁西森林公园位于黑龙江鸡西。游览特色包括湿地、森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Tiexi forest farm north of Taiping township, about 40 km by road west of Mishan.

name: 兴凯湖新开流景区
summaryEn: A lakeside scenic area on the sand ridge between Big and Small Lake Khanka, with a viewing platform, a bird-watching platform, a boat landing and a long sandy beach. The area includes the Xinkailiu site, a Neolithic fishing settlement about 6,000 years old that was excavated in 1972 and yielded 32 graves, 10 fish pits and net-patterned pottery, as well as a carved bone eagle's head that has become a symbol of the culture. A fishing-ritual performance is staged on the frozen lake in winter.
description: 兴凯湖新开流景区位于黑龙江鸡西。游览特色包括湖泊、海滨、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the sand ridge on the north shore of Lake Khanka, about 51 km by road east-south-east of Mishan.

name: 柴河九寨
summaryEn: A valley scenic area at the Hongsheng forest farm of the Chaihe forestry bureau, in Weihushan National Forest Park, where two clear mountain streams, the Golden Stream and Silver Stream valleys, drop over a group of cascades known as the Nine-Tier Springs. Around them are stone peaks, old pines and primeval forest, and the area is promoted as the 'little Jiuzhaigou of the north', after the famous valley in Sichuan.
description: 柴河九寨位于黑龙江牡丹江。游览特色包括森林公园、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At the Hongsheng forest farm in the mountains of the Chaihe forestry area, about 86 km by road north-north-west of Mudanjiang.

name: 黑宝熊乐园
summaryEn: A bear park of about 10 hectares inside Sandaoguan National Forest Park, north-west of Mudanjiang, that keeps and breeds captive bears for visitors to view. Its official A-level name also includes 'Water World'.
description: 黑宝熊乐园位于黑龙江牡丹江。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Sandaoguan on the north-western edge of Mudanjiang, about 27 km by road from the city centre.

name: 横道河子东北虎林园
summaryEn: A tiger park that grew out of a feline breeding centre set up at Hengdaohezi in 1986 and renamed the Northeast Tiger Park about ten years later; it keeps captive-bred Siberian tigers. Visitors ride in armoured sightseeing vehicles through a series of protective gates into the tiger enclosures and watch through the windows as the animals walk, climb and play-fight. Keepers say the tigers are livelier in cold weather, so winter is a good time to go.
description: 林园由横道河子的大型猫科动物繁育基地发展而来，参观主题是东北虎的观察与保护。
accessEn: About 55 km by road west-north-west of Mudanjiang and roughly a 10-minute drive from Hengdaohezi Russian Town.

name: 罗勒密山景区
summaryEn: A forest tourism area at Hongqi forest farm, run by the Fangzheng forestry bureau and listed in the province's 2025 review as the Yuanyang Peak Scenic Area, with a walk up Yuanyang Peak past rock formations and a waterfall; the area reaches 1,357 m. The best-known sight is the Magpie Bridge, a glass-floored footbridge 214 m long between two summits about 290 m above the valley, and there are also a 527 m glass walkway, a forest slide, a glass-bottomed rafting course and a jungle rail car. The wider area of about 3,000 hectares includes a rafting zone on the Xiangshui River and a forest wellness centre.
description: 罗勒密山景区位于黑龙江牡丹江。游览特色包括瀑布、玻璃栈道、山谷。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: At the Hongqi forest farm in Linkou County, about 65 km west-north-west of Linkou town and roughly 280 km by road from central Harbin.

name: 牡丹集团宁安智慧科技馆
summaryEn: A science and technology museum run by the Peony Group in Bohai town, about 2 km from Xinglong Temple and the Shangjing site, with digital and interactive displays aimed mainly at families and school groups. It was added to the 4A list in 2024.
description: 牡丹集团宁安智慧科技馆位于黑龙江牡丹江。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Bohai town, about 41 km by road south-west of Ning'an and close to the Bohai Shangjing site.

name: 三道关国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park of about 8,000 hectares on the north-western edge of Mudanjiang, at roughly 300 to 740 m above sea level, with dense forest, rocky cliffs and streams. Two areas are open to visitors, Wuxi ('Mist Stream') Valley and Xiaohuangshan ('little Huangshan'), and the park is promoted as a summer escape from the city. The separately listed Heibao Bear Park lies inside the park.
description: 三道关国家森林公园位于黑龙江牡丹江。游览特色包括森林公园、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Sandaoguan on the north-western edge of Mudanjiang, about 27 km by road from the city centre.

name: 绥芬河爱情谷
summaryEn: A love-themed park opened in October 2020 on the northern edge of Suifenhe, in a valley between Tianchang and Jiudi mountains around the Tianchang Lake reservoir. It has a birch-wood boardwalk, a giant rotating ring sculpture, a 100 m footbridge made of 16 red heart-shaped frames and a long stepped path up to a viewpoint. The name plays on the park's position, 131° E and 44° N, and its 520 m altitude, which read as 'one life, one world' and 'I love you'.
description: 绥芬河爱情谷位于黑龙江牡丹江。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the northern edge of Suifenhe, about 5 km by road north of the town centre and under 10 minutes by car.

name: 太平沟原始林风景区
summaryEn: A stand of about 297 hectares of primeval Korean pine at the Taipinggou forest farm, part of Xuexiang National Forest Park, which the provincial tourism department describes as the best-preserved forest tourism resource in north-east China. It was named one of 'China's most beautiful forests' in 2019, and one thousand-year-old pine in it carries the title 'China's most beautiful red pine'. Visitors can follow a stream trail through the forest and try an adventure course through the treetops.
description: 太平沟原始林风景区位于黑龙江牡丹江。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Taipinggou forest farm of Xuexiang National Forest Park, about 19 km east-north-east of Snow Town and some 80 km west-south-west of Hailin; check the park's opening dates before going.

name: 火山口国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park on the eastern slope of the middle Zhangguangcai Range, north-west of Jingpo Lake, where ten volcanic craters of different sizes, with steep inner walls, are mostly filled with primeval forest; it is also called the Underground Forest. The park has a lava tunnel with lava stalactites and an open-air ice cave in which ice can be seen all year. It counts as one of the three parts of the Jingpo Lake scenic district, with the lake itself and the Bohai Shangjing site.
description: 火山口国家森林公园位于黑龙江牡丹江。游览特色包括森林公园、湖泊、火山地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the mountains about 50 km north-west of Jingpo Lake (the provincial tourism department's figure) and roughly 109 km by road from Ning'an.

name: 威虎山影视城
summaryEn: A film and television set built in 1998 near Hengdaohezi, with about 107 buildings laid out as the world of the novel Tracks in the Snowy Forest, including Forest Sea Town, the thatched village of Jiapigou and Weihu Hall; People's Daily's Heilongjiang channel (2021) counts more than 600 films and series shot here. In 2021 an exhibition on the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army and staged immersive shows were added. It is a themed set rather than a historic site.
description: 威虎山影视城位于黑龙江牡丹江。游览特色包括林地风光、影视拍摄、影视文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the G301 near Hengdaohezi, about 56 km by road west-north-west of Mudanjiang and a few minutes from the Siberian Tiger Park.

name: 亿龙水上风情园
summaryEn: A water park on the Hailang River in Xin'an Korean township, south-west of Hailin, with a children's water area, water slides, a wave pool and a cable ride across the river, plus fishing, barbecue and camping areas. It first opened in 1997 and is mainly a summer attraction for families.
description: 亿龙水上风情园位于黑龙江牡丹江。游览特色包括水上游乐、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xin'an Korean township, about 45 km by road south-west of Hailin town (the city's figure) and roughly 58 km by road from Mudanjiang; it runs a summer season, so check opening dates before going.

name: 中兴朝鲜民族文化风情园
summaryEn: Zhongxing, an ethnic Korean village in Hainan Korean township, has been turned into a folk-culture tourist area, with Korean-style buildings, a tall drum-shaped building with a view over the village, costume photography, Korean-style restaurants and homestays among the rice fields. A folk-custom park started in 2014 by a returning villager includes a small folk museum, and a group of small exhibition halls includes a New Year picture hall and a 3D experience hall. It suits visitors interested in Korean-Chinese village life and food.
description: 中兴朝鲜民族文化风情园位于黑龙江牡丹江。游览特色包括博物馆、主题展览、民族文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 15 km west-south-west of central Mudanjiang, along the Mudanjiang–Hailin sightseeing road; check that it is open before going.

name: 中国一重工业旅游区
summaryEn: China First Heavy Industries is a heavy-machinery maker in the industrial town of Fularji, one of the three Soviet-aided projects of China's first Five-Year Plan sited there in the 1950s. Visits take in production workshops and the company's exhibition hall on its history and equipment, and a neighbouring steelworks, Jianlong Beiman Special Steel, has an exhibition hall of its own on the same circuit. It suits visitors interested in heavy industry rather than a general sightseeing stop.
description: 中国一重工业旅游区位于黑龙江齐齐哈尔。游览特色包括工业参观、主题展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Fularji district, about 30 km west-south-west of central Qiqihar and about 2 km west of Fularji railway station. It is a working factory and visits have been organised for groups, so check before going.

name: 哈拉新村
summaryEn: A village of about 60 hectares on the grassland at the edge of Qiqihar, marketed as the first Daur village in China; the Daur are an ethnic minority of the Nen River valley. Its attractions include an intangible-heritage experience hall, Morgen Square, traditional houses, the Hala ancient-city site, a grassland with an obo shrine and horse riding, and a street of village guesthouses. Daur music and the lurige dance are shown here, and the village hosts the annual Kumul festival.
description: 哈拉新村位于黑龙江齐齐哈尔。游览特色包括草原、山谷、马术活动。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yaersai town, Meilisi Daur district, about 14 km north-north-west of central Qiqihar.

name: 鹤城欢乐世界
summaryEn: An amusement park inside Hecheng Park in the south of Qiqihar, with some 30 rides, among them a Ferris wheel, pirate ship, carousel and bumper cars, plus an indoor children's play area and a hotel. In winter the park switches to an outdoor ice-and-snow programme. It is aimed at families and local day trips.
description: 鹤城欢乐世界位于黑龙江齐齐哈尔。游览特色包括主题游乐、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Hecheng Park in Longsha district, about 4.5 km south of the centre of Qiqihar and about 2 km north-north-west of Qiqihar South railway station.

name: 江桥抗战纪念地
summaryEn: A memorial park and museum at Jiangqiao on the Nen River, where Heilongjiang provincial troops under Ma Zhanshan fought Japanese forces at the railway bridge in November 1931. The museum, opened in 2008, shows photographs and objects from the campaign, a display recreating the wooden railway bridge and a sand-table model, and the grounds beside the river have a statue of Ma Zhanshan. It also displays finds from the Ang'angxi culture.
description: 江桥抗战纪念地位于黑龙江齐齐哈尔。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jiangqiao Mongol town on the Nen River, Tailai county, about 66 km south-south-west of central Qiqihar. Closed on Mondays.

name: 龙沙动植物园
summaryEn: A zoo and botanical garden on the northern edge of Qiqihar, with more than 200 species and about 3,000 animals from five continents, along with plants of the 47th parallel. It has a tiger-viewing corridor behind strengthened glass, a primate rainforest house, a small train through themed animal zones, stage shows, and animal feeding and parades in season, and it suits families.
description: 龙沙动植物园位于黑龙江齐齐哈尔。游览特色包括植物园、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Nianbei Road in the north of Qiqihar (Jianhua district), about 5 km north-north-west of the city centre.

name: 龙腾生态温泉度假庄园
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in Fuyu county on the edge of the Longanqiao wetland, across the Wuyuer River from the Zhalong reserve. It offers hot-spring bathing, wooden, water-side and hot-spring villas, fruit picking and speciality farming, and has five lakes in its wetland park. It suits families and groups wanting a spa stay near Zhalong.
description: 龙腾生态温泉度假庄园位于黑龙江齐齐哈尔。游览特色包括温泉、湿地。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Longanqiao town, Fuyu county, about 44 km east-north-east of central Qiqihar. Check that it is open before going.

name: 碾子山旅游区
summaryEn: A district-wide tourism area in the low hills at the eastern foot of the Greater Khingan range, west of Qiqihar, rather than a single park. Its sights are spread over the district: a ski resort, a military-industry culture park showing arms production and a firing range, a 12 km stretch of the Yalu River for rafting, Shexian Cave where Palaeolithic stone tools were found, and a section of the Jin-dynasty frontier earthwork. Chongshan Park above the town, begun in 1982, has a liberation monument and viewpoint pavilions, and the district promotes flowers in spring, rafting in summer, fruit picking in autumn and skiing in winter.
description: 碾子山旅游区位于黑龙江齐齐哈尔。游览特色包括滑雪、历史纪念、水上活动。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Nianzishan district, about 83 km west-north-west of central Qiqihar, with the district's sights spread across the hills and the river valley.

name: 水师森林温泉度假区
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort set in a forest park near Shuishiying in Ang'angxi district, covering about 2.5 square kilometres. It combines natural hot springs, a water park, non-powered rides, rooms and restaurants with fruit picking and Mongolian-style barbecue. It suits families and groups wanting a day or overnight stay, and it ran a night-time light-and-shadow festival in autumn 2025.
description: 水师森林温泉度假区位于黑龙江齐齐哈尔。游览特色包括温泉、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shuishiying town, Ang'angxi district, about 10 km south-south-east of central Qiqihar.

name: 泰湖国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A national wetland park on the eastern edge of Tailai county town, developed from 2002, with a lake, reed beds and a lotus pond. Visitors can walk the lakeside boardwalk, take a boat or battery car, visit the lake island and the Guangming Temple, or use the water park. It is a leisure park next to the town rather than a remote nature site.
description: 泰湖国家湿地公园位于黑龙江齐齐哈尔。游览特色包括湿地、寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the east side of Tailai county town, about 113 km south-south-west of central Qiqihar.

name: 乌斯浑河国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park in the hills south-west of Boli town, Qitaihe, which held its opening events in mid-August 2026 as the county's first 4A scenic area after a four-year upgrade. The park has forest streams, old pines and a rafting run, and the local report also mentions the area's revolutionary history.
description: 乌斯浑河国家森林公园位于黑龙江七台河。游览特色包括森林公园、历史纪念、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Hongxing forestry area, about 20 km west-south-west of Boli, the county town.

name: 安邦河国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A river-and-marsh wetland park of about 290 ha in north-eastern Jixian County, one of China's first national wetland parks and used for nature education. A small county museum inside the park is open seasonally, from early May to early October.
description: 安邦河国家湿地公园位于黑龙江双鸭山。游览特色包括博物馆、湿地。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In north-eastern Jixian County, about 32 km north-north-east of the county seat and some 37 km north-north-east of Shuangyashan; reached by road.

name: 北大荒农机博览园
summaryEn: A 35-hectare agricultural science park at Youyi, in the Beidahuang farming region, built around an exposition centre of farm machinery. The grounds also have a forest botanical garden, a landscaped avenue and a Beidahuang culture square, and the park is aimed at school groups and visitors interested in modern farming.
description: 北大荒农机博览园位于黑龙江双鸭山。游览特色包括植物园、园林景观、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Yilou Street at the west edge of Youyi town, about 49 km east-north-east of Shuangyashan; reached by road.

name: 青山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forested mountain park of about 28,500 ha in Lingdong district, south of Shuangyashan, with 82% tree cover, rocky peaks and many streams. It has a visitor centre, two Buddhist temples (the Jiufeng Chan Temple and the Pudu Temple), a hill with stone Buddhas and the Xingyue ('Star-Moon') Lake with a bathing beach.
description: 青山国家森林公园位于黑龙江双鸭山。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Lingdong district, about 23 km south of the centre of Shuangyashan; check that it is open before going.

name: 圣洁摇篮山
summaryEn: A ski and outdoor-sports resort on the Lishu forest farm in Baoqing County, where the city government says snow lies for about 130 days a year. The ski area has 12 runs from beginner to advanced with a vertical drop of 365 m, and the county government describes the resort as the province's second national-level ski-tourism resort.
description: 圣洁摇篮山位于黑龙江双鸭山。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: At the Lishu forest farm in Baoqing County, about 15 km west of Baoqing town and some 78 km east-south-east of Shuangyashan; reached by road.

name: 四排赫哲风情园
summaryEn: A folk park beside the G331 road at Sipai Hezhe Ethnic Township on the Ussuri River, built on about 10 ha with seven main zones. A boat-shaped hall on the Hezhe 'Ussuri Boat Song' and a tent-shaped intangible-heritage centre show clothing, fishing tools and ritual objects, and the visitor centre holds a 44 m fish-skin picture, 'Hezhe Panorama', made from nearly 22,000 salmon skins. A Hezhe river-lantern festival is held in mid-July.
description: 四排赫哲风情园位于黑龙江双鸭山。游览特色包括节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Sipai Hezhe Ethnic Township on the G331, about 22 km by road north-north-east of Raohe; Raohe is some 220 km east of Shuangyashan.

name: 雁窝岛
summaryEn: A wetland tourist area at the Yanwo Island marsh in northern Baoqing County, beside the 853 state farm in the Beidahuang land-reclamation region. It has an ecology museum, a long zigzag covered walkway, a water park with a boat pier and an exhibition hall on the 'Beidahuang spirit', and a landscape stone carved with the name 'Yanwodao' in the calligraphy of Dong Biwu. The city government also mentions a Jurchen-era site more than 800 years old inside the area.
description: 雁窝岛位于黑龙江双鸭山。游览特色包括博物馆、湿地。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the Yanwo Island marsh at the 853 Farm in Baoqing County, about 70 km north-east of Baoqing town and some 200 km from Shuangyashan by the city government's figure.

name: 绥棱林业局生态文化旅游景区
summaryEn: The cultural park at the seat of the Suiling forestry bureau, in the south-western foothills of the Lesser Khingan range, built around a steam-powered forest railway. The 'Anti-Japanese United Army' steam train, refitted in 2026, runs past the Plant Kingdom garden, the Dingsheng Garden square, a log-style station and the Suiling Forest Region Museum, which traces the area's logging history. The park also has black-pottery and dough-figure workshops.
description: 绥棱林业局生态文化旅游景区位于黑龙江绥化。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At the forestry bureau's seat on the north-western edge of Suiling county town, about 2 km north-north-west of the centre.

name: 嘉荫恐龙国家地质公园
summaryEn: A geopark on Longgushan (Dragon Bone Hill) near the Heilongjiang river, where fossils of the duck-billed dinosaur found in 1902 were among the earliest dinosaur discoveries in China. It has the Jiayin Shenzhou Dinosaur Museum, whose centrepiece is a mother-and-baby hadrosaur skeleton, plus the original excavation site, a Dinosaur Tower, a garden of statues of 24 palaeontologists and dinosaur-themed attractions for children.
description: 嘉荫恐龙国家地质公园位于黑龙江伊春。游览特色包括博物馆、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Hongguang township, about 12 km west-south-west of Jiayin town, the county seat.

name: 锦绣山水公园
summaryEn: A landscaped city park in the urban area of Yichun, laid out with walking paths and planted trees. It is a place for a short walk rather than a major sight.
description: 锦绣山水公园位于黑龙江伊春。游览特色包括城市公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the urban area of Yichun, about 1 km east-south-east of the city centre.

name: 九峰山养心谷
summaryEn: A forest health resort and small animal park in a mountain-ringed valley in Jinlin district, Yichun. It combines forest walks, flower fields, farm picking and forest-food products, and visitors can feed and approach animals such as deer and squirrels. The valley is one of Yichun's provincial demonstration bases for traditional Chinese medicine health tourism.
description: 九峰山养心谷位于黑龙江伊春。游览特色包括山谷、花卉观赏、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jinlin district, about 67 km south-east of central Yichun.

name: 茅兰沟国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forested stream valley in Xiangyang township, Jiayin County, close to Maolangou village and listed as a national forest park. Visitors walk along the stream through dense woodland, crossing on stepping stones.
description: 茅兰沟国家森林公园位于黑龙江伊春。游览特色包括森林公园、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xiangyang township, about 53 km west-north-west of Jiayin town, the county seat.

name: 桃山桃源湖
summaryEn: A forest lake near Taoshan town in Tieli, with outdoor hot-spring pools, a hotel, a forest trail and winter activities on the snow and ice. The hot springs are promoted for soaking in the snow, so winter is its best-known season, and the resort is among China's first national forest wellness bases.
description: 桃山桃源湖位于黑龙江伊春。游览特色包括温泉、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Taoshan town, about 21 km south-east of Tieli city.

name: 透龙山
summaryEn: A small hill on the southern slope of the Lesser Khingan range, named for two caves facing each other beside a waterfall; its 'nine peaks and eighteen sights' include Mandarin Duck Tree, Immortal Maiden Cave and Crouching Tiger Peak. Timber lodges at the foot offer dining, entertainment and rooms, and the site stages a winter outdoor drama about the anti-Japanese united army and performances of Khingan logging songs. It joined the 4A list in 2024.
description: 透龙山位于黑龙江伊春。游览特色包括瀑布、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On provincial road S207 in Riyuexia town, about 33 km north-east of Tieli city.

name: 五营国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park at Wuying in the Lesser Khingan range, in the part of Yichun known as the 'home of the Korean pine', also promoted as the Wuying Red Pine Sea scenic area. Boardwalks run through old Korean pine forest, which is at its most colourful in autumn. The park was among the third batch of national AAAA-rated tourist areas in 2002.
description: 五营国家森林公园位于黑龙江伊春。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Wuying in Fenglin County, about 64 km north-north-east of central Yichun.

name: 西岭森林生态旅游度假区
summaryEn: A forest tourism and holiday area at the former Xiling forest farm in Wucui district, with homestay and hotel accommodation, a hot-spring hotel and forest-wellness programmes among woodland. On nearby Guokui Mountain a memorial marks the former site of the Communist Party's North Manchuria Provincial Committee. It is somewhere to stay for a few days rather than a sight to visit for an hour.
description: 西岭森林生态旅游度假区位于黑龙江伊春。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wucui district, about 36 km south-south-west of central Yichun.

name: 新青国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A 4,490-hectare wetland park of peat bog and marsh near Xinqing town in Fenglin County, set up in 2007 and accepted as a national wetland park in 2013. It is a breeding ground of the hooded crane (white-headed crane), with about 150 returning each spring from late March or early April, so spring is the time to go.
description: 新青国家湿地公园位于黑龙江伊春。游览特色包括湿地。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At the park entrance on the Yichun–Jiayin road (G222), about 5 km north-east of Xinqing town, the seat of Fenglin County, and about 80 km north-east of central Yichun.

name: 溪水国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park in the Xishui forest area of the Shangganling forestry bureau, in the Lesser Khingan mountains of Youhao district. It has a visitor centre, themed hiking routes through the forest and forest-wellness activities such as forest meditation, and is popular for autumn colour. It works as a short half-day trip from Yichun city.
description: 溪水国家森林公园位于黑龙江伊春。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Shangganling area of Youhao district, on the Yichun–Jiayin road about 24 km north-east of central Yichun.

name: 漕泾水窠
summaryEn: A water-village scenic area in Caojing town centred on Shuiku village, where 41 rivers and canals and more than 70 islands and peninsulas make up about 40 percent of the village's area. Visitors take boat trips, kayak or paddleboard, walk the reed marshes and woods of Caojing Country Park and eat river food in the village, and it suits a slow day in the countryside.
description: 漕泾水窠位于上海。游览特色包括运河、乘船游览、郊野公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Caojing town, Jinshan District, about 3 km from Jinshan Industrial Park station on the Jinshan Railway, or roughly 1 hr 15 by road from central Shanghai.

name: 高家庄生态园
summaryEn: An eco-farm leisure park in Gangxi town on Chongming Island, with a lake, gardens, pick-your-own orchards and farm-style accommodation. Boating, cycling and fishing are the usual activities, and it suits families looking for a rural day out.
description: 高家庄生态园位于上海。游览特色包括湖泊、岛屿、果园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Gangdong Road in Gangxi town, central Chongming Island, about 1.5 hours by road from central Shanghai.

name: 江南三民文化村
summaryEn: A folk-culture park in central Chongming built around the traditional customs of the Jiangnan region and Chongming's local crafts. Its halls include a Chinese Dragon Palace with a 36-metre dragon made from about 5,000 carved boards, museums of Chongming homespun cloth, carved boards and longevity customs, and a street of small halls showing old household objects.
description: 江南三民文化村位于上海。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Linfeng Road next to Qianwei village in central Chongming Island, about 1.5–2 hours by road from central Shanghai.

name: 联怡枇杷乐园
summaryEn: A farm park on the edge of Qingpu New City named after its large loquat orchard, where the fruit can be picked during a season of about three weeks in early summer. Greenhouses grow tropical fruit such as wax apples, dragon fruit and mangoes for picking, and a farm restaurant reached through the orchard, wooden cabins and an RV campsite make it a family weekend spot.
description: 联怡枇杷乐园位于上海。游览特色包括果园、农业体验。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Waiqingsong Highway on the southern edge of Qingpu New City, about 3.5 km south of Qingpu Xincheng station on Metro Line 17, a short taxi ride.

name: 花开海上生态园
summaryEn: A flower park of about 87 hectares spread over small islands west of Zhujing town, with four zones: a sea of flowers, a plum garden, a fragrance garden and an autumn garden. Plum blossom covers the islands in early spring, lilies, sunflowers, hydrangeas and lotus follow in summer and maples colour in autumn, and children can ride horses, take boats and use the play slides.
description: 花开海上生态园位于上海。游览特色包括花卉观赏、园林景观、莲花观赏。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Zhujing town, Jinshan District, about 3 km from Jinshan North railway station, or roughly 1 hr 15 by road from central Shanghai.

name: 上海鲜花港
summaryEn: A large flower park near the East China Sea coast in Pudong's Lingang area, best known for its spring tulip show of about 3.2 million bulbs in more than 500 varieties. The tulips usually bloom from late March to early May, with flowers on show through the rest of the year, and the park reopened in March 2024 after an upgrade that added new garden areas.
description: 上海鲜花港是中华人民共和国上海市浦东新区的一个花卉展示园，是国家4A级旅游景区，内有产业化生产区、花卉展示区、科普休闲区和技术培训区。鲜花港总面积为100万平方米。
accessEn: In Shuyuan town, south-east Pudong, about 2.5 km from Lingang Avenue station on Metro Line 16, a short bus or taxi ride.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 上海薰衣草公园
summaryEn: A flower park in the Shanghai International Resort area near Shanghai Disneyland, planted mainly with lavender, which holds a lavender festival when it flowers in late May and early June. It suits a short stroll and flower photographs and is easily combined with the resort.
description: 上海薰衣草公园位于上海。游览特色包括花卉观赏、节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Shanghai International Resort area of Pudong, a short walk or taxi ride from Disney Resort station on Metro Line 11; it held a lavender festival in 2025, but a booking site listed it as temporarily closed in October 2026, so check that it is open before going.

name: 上海蓝精灵乐园
summaryEn: A largely indoor Smurfs theme park inside Shimao's Dream City complex beside the InterContinental hotel built into a former quarry, described by China Daily as the first Smurfs park in China. Visitors walk among mushroom houses in the Smurf village, watch a character parade, ride a small berry-car roller coaster and a forest tram and play games against Gargamel, and it is aimed at families with young children.
description: 上海蓝精灵乐园位于上海。游览特色包括主题游乐、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Sheshan resort area of Songjiang, about 9 km south-west of Sheshan station on Metro Line 9 by taxi.

name: 闻道园
summaryEn: A landscaped garden in Luodian, northern Baoshan, opened in 2006, with woodland, ponds and Huizhou-style buildings. Its main interest is a large collection of ornamental stones, shown with old stone carvings in two museums, alongside calligraphy and painting studios and a tea area.
description: 闻道园是位于中国上海宝山区罗店镇潘泾路的一个园林。占地一千余亩，园内种植5.6万棵树木以及收藏1000多方石头。园林内还有徽派建筑。
accessEn: On Panjing Road in Luodian, Baoshan District, about 4 km from Meilan Lake station (Line 7) and best reached by taxi; the district listed it on a festival walking route in April 2026, but a booking site shows it as temporarily closed, so check that it is open before going.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 云堡未来市
summaryEn: An arts and leisure complex in Dongjing town, presented in 2025 as the arts quarter of the Sheshan National Tourist Resort. It combines an art museum, a music centre, a bookshop, a Songjiang experience centre of the Shanghai Astronomy Museum and a waterside market, with seasonal exhibitions and monthly events, and suits a relaxed afternoon or evening.
description: 云堡未来市位于上海。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Dongjing town, Songjiang District, under 2 km from Dongjing station on Metro Line 9.

name: 张马村
summaryEn: A rural tourism village at the southern tip of Zhujiajiao, on the upper reaches of the Huangpu River, where waterways and farmland are laid out with field paths and small visitor facilities. Its best-known sight is the Maota Pagoda, a five-storey brick-and-wood pagoda first built in the Tang dynasty that also served as a lighthouse for boats on the Mao River. It suits a quiet half-day in the countryside, combined with Zhujiajiao.
description: 张马村位于上海。游览特色包括古塔、田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhujiajiao town, Qingpu District, about 9 km south of Zhujiajiao station on Metro Line 17; local bus Zhujiajiao 3 runs from Zhujiajiao bus station.

name: 中华孝道园
summaryEn: A themed park of about 860 mu (some 57 hectares) on the shore of Lake Tai at Xueyan, backed by the Lu'e hills and devoted to the Confucian virtue of filial piety. It combines Lu'e Chan Temple, on the site of an older temple, with a Guanyin hall, a grotto hall, a pagoda, an ancestral hall and a museum of filial piety, and it has held ancestor-worship ceremonies at Qingming.
description: 中华孝道园位于江苏常州。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Xueyan on the Taihu shore, about 35 km south of central Changzhou (roughly 50 minutes by road), near World Joyland.

name: 花谷奇缘
summaryEn: A commercial flower park in the Maoshan resort area, laid out as ten themed gardens with a hillside of planted flower fields. Spring is the main flowering season, and it suits families and garden lovers.
description: 花谷奇缘位于江苏常州。游览特色包括花卉观赏、园林景观、赏花。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Maoshan resort area near Xuefu, about 25 km west of Jintan and roughly an hour by road from Changzhou.

name: 茅山森林世界
summaryEn: An outdoor activity park covering about 3,500 mu (some 230 hectares) of forest and bamboo on the Jintan side of Maoshan, with forest-themed attractions such as a 'magic black forest' and a rafting run through the woods. Tea-field tents and forest villas allow overnight stays, and it is aimed mainly at families.
description: 茅山森林世界位于江苏常州。游览特色包括林地风光、水上活动、休闲公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Maoshan resort area north of Xuefu, about 25 km west of Jintan and roughly an hour by road from Changzhou.

name: 古运河南大街
summaryEn: The historic centre of Changzhou along the old course of the Grand Canal, combining Nandajie, the city's main pedestrian shopping street, with canal-side Xiyingli, where Xiying Gate and about 220 metres of wall are all that survive of the city walls. The canal's Changzhou urban section is part of the Grand Canal World Heritage Site, and old lanes such as Qingguo Lane lie close by.
description: 古运河南大街位于江苏常州。游览特色包括运河、特色街区。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In central Changzhou, around Nandajie station on Metro Line 2.

name: 东方盐湖城·道天下
summaryEn: A modern leisure resort at the foot of Maoshan, the Taoist holy mountain, themed on Taoist culture and on the area's hills, water, tea, salt, herbs and hot springs. Its Dao Tianxia section has costumed characters who interact with visitors and folk performances, and the resort has hot-spring hotels.
description: 东方盐湖城·道天下位于江苏常州。游览特色包括温泉、休闲度假、盐湖风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Maoshan resort area near Xuefu, about 25 km west of Jintan and roughly an hour by road from Changzhou.

name: 青枫公园
summaryEn: A large public park in western Changzhou, opened in 2008 after four years of building and laid out with lakes, low man-made hills, woodland and a big central lawn. It is a favourite with local families for walks and spring kite-flying, and has hosted the city's chrysanthemum festival in autumn.
description: 青枫公园位于江苏常州。游览特色包括林地风光、城市公园、节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Zhonglou District about 5 km west of the old city centre; Qingfeng Park station, the western end of Metro Line 2, is at its edge.

name: 古淮河文化生态景区
summaryEn: A riverside park of about 1.6 km² along the Gu Huai He, the old channel of the Yellow River, which flowed through Huai'an until 1855, on the north side of Qingjiangpu; Ninglian Road divides it into two parts. The eastern part has foot and cycle paths through landscaped banks and a cluster of museums, among them the China Huaiyang Cuisine Culture Museum, a Journey to the West exhibition hall and the Guhuai Tower with a display of local wedding customs. The western part holds a museum of Chinese urbanisation, a library and a culture square.
description: 古淮河文化生态景区位于江苏淮安。游览特色包括博物馆、滨水景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Hepan Road on the north side of Qingjiangpu, about 4 km north of the canal district; city bus or taxi.

name: 白马湖生态旅游景区
summaryEn: Baima Lake is a shallow lake on the border of Huai'an and Yangzhou that also serves as a through-lake for the eastern route of the South–North Water Diversion. The eco-tourism area in the north-west of the lake's tourist resort has a plum garden, an eco-amusement park, a campervan campsite and the "Three Islands Adventure", a set of small themed islands in the lake. It mainly draws families for a day by the water.
description: 白马湖生态旅游景区位于江苏淮安。游览特色包括湖泊、主题游乐、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the north-west of the Baima Lake tourist resort, about 35 km south of central Qingjiangpu; by car.

name: 龙宫海洋世界
summaryEn: A theme-park complex in Huai'an's economic development zone built around Journey to the West, the Ming novel credited to Huai'an's Wu Cheng'en. Its main part is Xiyou Amusement Park, a Journey to the West theme park opened in July 2021 with themed areas, rides, parades and evening shows. Next to it, Dragon Palace Ocean World, named after the Dragon King's undersea palace in the novel and rated 4A as Dragon Palace Beluga World by 2018, is now centred on a summer water park.
description: 龙宫海洋世界位于江苏淮安。游览特色包括主题游乐、游乐体验。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Off Xiyou Avenue in the Huai'an Economic and Technological Development Zone, about 17 km east of central Qingjiangpu; city bus or taxi.

name: 淮安市博物馆
summaryEn: Huai'an's museum of local history, rated a national first-grade museum in 2024, holds about 31,000 objects. Its main exhibition traces the area from prehistory through the Warring States, the canal grain trade, the salt monopoly and river works to its famous natives; highlights include Warring States bronzes from the Gaozhuang tomb found in 1978 and a carved wooden drum carriage from a tomb at Yunhe village excavated in 2004. Further galleries are devoted to the film director Xie Tieli and to collections of calligraphy and painting.
description: 淮安市博物馆位于江苏淮安。游览特色包括博物馆、运河、国家一级博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Jiankang West Road in Qingjiangpu, central Huai'an; city bus or taxi.

name: 里运河文化长廊
summaryEn: The Liyunhe, the section of the Grand Canal between the Yangtze and the Huai, runs 32 km through Huai'an, and this scenic corridor centres on a 15.6 km stretch through Qingjiangpu. Along it are parts of the Grand Canal World Heritage site – the Qingjiang Great Lock, the Qingkou hydraulic hub and the Huai'an section of the Huai–Yang Canal – together with the rebuilt Qingjiangpu Tower, a city memory museum, a hall of famous Huai'an people, an opera museum and the "south by boat, north by horse" stele marking where travellers once changed from boat to road.
description: 里运河文化长廊位于江苏淮安。游览特色包括博物馆、运河。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Along the canal in central Qingjiangpu; walk, city bus or taxi.

name: 荷花荡
summaryEn: A wetland of about 22 km², most of it water, on the shore of Gaoyou Lake in south-eastern Jinhu County, planted with lotus fields that bloom in summer. More than 300 lotus varieties are grown, and the scenic area also has a lotus garden, a lotus culture hall, an exhibition on water plants and farming, a stele corridor of lotus poems and the Qingshan Temple. It is at its best in the summer flowering season.
description: 荷花荡位于江苏淮安。游览特色包括湿地、寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: By Gaoyou Lake about 25 km south-east of Jinhu town, which is about 80 km south of central Huai'an; by car.

name: 金湖水上森林
summaryEn: A plantation of metasequoia (dawn redwood) standing in water in Tugou town, Jinhu County, planted in the 1980s as northern Jiangsu's largest man-made forest farm and opened as a privately run scenic area in 2017. Rows of trees rise from the water, with egrets in the canopy and the trees' breathing roots poking above the surface, seen from bamboo rafts, a forest train, a glass walkway and paths. Added attractions such as a maze, go-karts and flower fields make it a family day out.
description: 金湖水上森林位于江苏淮安。游览特色包括玻璃栈道、林地风光、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tugou town in northern Jinhu County, about 60 km south of central Huai'an; by car.

name: 今世缘旅游景区
summaryEn: The baijiu maker Jiangsu King's Luck (Jinshiyuan), successor to the old Gaogou distillery, runs a factory tour at its base in Gaogou town that is listed as a national industrial-tourism demonstration site. One part shows the modern works – a culture square, an automated brewing hall seen from a viewing gallery, a store of large pottery jars and the bottling line – and the other, the Gaogou liquor heritage zone, has a liquor culture hall, displays of starter-making and distilling and a field of old fermentation pits still in use. It suits visitors curious about how Chinese grain spirit is made.
description: 今世缘旅游景区位于江苏淮安。游览特色包括陶瓷工艺、酿造文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Gaogou town in northern Lianshui County, about 50 km north of central Huai'an; by car.

name: 五岛湖
summaryEn: A lake park in the middle of Lianshui town, laid out in 1930 around a lake with five small islands, grouped with the neighbouring Nengren Temple and the Lianshui County Museum into one scenic area. The temple's Song-dynasty Miaotong Pagoda was destroyed in 1948; after excavation of its crypt in 1998 yielded gold and silver reliquaries and other finds, a 68.88 m concrete pagoda with a lift was built on the spot in 1999–2002, and the temple was rebuilt in 2004–07. One island has a pavilion and an ink-washing pond recalling the Song calligrapher Mi Fu, who once held office in Lianshui.
description: 五岛湖位于江苏淮安。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In central Lianshui, about 30 km north-east of central Huai'an; by road, or by train to Lianshui station.

name: 潮河湾
summaryEn: A rural leisure area on a reed-fringed stretch of water east of Guanyun county town, with an eco-restaurant, a fishing centre and a campervan and camping base. It is aimed at local families and day-trippers, with holiday events such as hot-air balloon gatherings, markets and boat trips.
description: 潮河湾位于江苏连云港。游览特色包括乘船游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km east of Guanyun county town and roughly 40 km south-east of central Lianyungang; a car or taxi is the practical way to reach it.

name: 东海水晶城·水晶博物馆
summaryEn: The crystal quarter of Donghai, a county that brands itself the 'World Crystal Capital' because of its large deposits of rock crystal and quartz. It is made up of the China Donghai Crystal City, a large market where crystal jewellery and carvings are sold, and the China Donghai Crystal Museum, which is devoted to crystal. It suits visitors interested in minerals or shopping rather than sightseeing.
description: 东海水晶城·水晶博物馆位于江苏连云港。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Donghai county town, about 45 km west of central Lianyungang; Donghai County station has high-speed trains from Lianyungang and Xuzhou, and the market is a short taxi ride from it.

name: 二郎神文化遗迹公园
summaryEn: A temple park on the northern outskirts of Guannan county town devoted to Erlang Shen, the river-taming god of Chinese myth whom Journey to the West places at the mouth of the Guan River, a name the town links with its own Guan River. Its Tang-style halls and pavilions, among them the Zhenjun Hall and the Cixiao Pavilion, tell Erlang's story with an emphasis on filial piety, and visitors can strike the temple bell.
description: 二郎神文化遗迹公园位于江苏连云港。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the northern outskirts of Guannan county town, about 60 km south of central Lianyungang; Guannan station has high-speed trains, and a taxi from there takes about 15 minutes.

name: 海上云台山
summaryEn: A forested mountain area in the coastal Yuntai hills above Sucheng, in Lianyun district, whose summit viewpoints look over Lianyungang port and Lian Island. Paths climb through wooded valleys past the Tao Yuanming culture garden and the Faqi Temple towards the summit area.
description: 海上云台山位于江苏连云港。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、岛屿、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Sucheng, Lianyun district, about 22 km east of central Lianyungang and around 40 minutes by taxi to the south gate.

name: 孔望山
summaryEn: A small hill on the southern edge of Haizhou, Lianyungang's old town, named after the story that Confucius climbed it to look out to sea. Its cliff carvings, made in the late Eastern Han, mix Taoist figures such as Laozi and the Yellow Emperor with some of the earliest Buddhist imagery in China, including a Nirvana scene and the tale of a prince who gave his body to a starving tigress.
description: 孔望山位于江苏连云港。游览特色包括石刻、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the southern suburbs of Haizhou district, about 20 minutes by taxi from central Lianyungang.

name: 连云港市博物馆
summaryEn: The city's main museum, a national first-grade museum that presents the history and culture of the Lianyungang area. It stands on Chaoyang East Road next to the Lianyungang Revolutionary Memorial Hall, so the two are easily seen together.
description: 连云港市博物馆位于江苏连云港。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览、国家一级博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Chaoyang East Road in Haizhou district, a short taxi ride from central Lianyungang.

name: 连云港市革命纪念馆
summaryEn: A museum of the Lianyungang area's modern revolutionary history, including the War of Resistance against Japan, told through photographs and objects. It stands beside the Lianyungang Museum on Chaoyang East Road, and the two can be visited together.
description: 连云港市革命纪念馆位于江苏连云港。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Chaoyang East Road in Haizhou district, next to the Lianyungang Museum and a short taxi ride from central Lianyungang.

name: 汤沟酒生态文化旅游区
summaryEn: A visitor area at the working distillery of Tanggou baijiu, a strong-aroma liquor made in Tanggou town, where the old workshops were merged into one state distillery in 1952. The visit is built around the distillery's fermentation pits and brewing halls, and its old cellar is a provincial heritage site.
description: 汤沟酒生态文化旅游区位于江苏连云港。游览特色包括酿造文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tanggou town, Guannan county, about 50 km south of central Lianyungang and roughly an hour by road.

name: 伊园
summaryEn: A leisure park east of Guanyun county town built around large flower fields and a fairy-tale-style small town, with children's play areas and themed restaurants. It is run together with Guanyun's Chaohe Bay and plum-garden scenic areas and fills public holidays with markets, shows and fireworks, so it suits local families more than sightseers.
description: 伊园位于江苏连云港。游览特色包括花卉观赏、园林景观、公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside National Road 204 just east of Guanyun county town, about 35 km south of central Lianyungang; a taxi from Guanyun takes about 10 minutes.

name: 渔湾
