summaryEn: A steep valley in the Yuntai Mountains east of Mount Huaguo, where a stream drops through a chain of waterfalls and pools, known as the Three Pools, between cliffs and woods that turn red and gold in late autumn. A via ferrata along the stream and a children's play area themed on Journey to the West have been added for families.
description: 渔湾位于江苏连云港。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Yuntai Mountains about 12 km east of central Lianyungang, around 25 minutes by taxi to the south-east gate.

name: 高淳国际慢城
summaryEn: A rural area of low hills, tea gardens and villages around Yaxi in eastern Gaochun, which became China's first member of the international Cittaslow ('slow city') network and hosts the network's China office. A scenic road winds between the villages and is popular for cycling and driving, with farm stays and seasonal family activities such as tea picking.
description: 高淳国际慢城位于江苏南京。游览特色包括园林景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Around Yaxi, about 30 km east of Gaochun town; allow 1.5–2 hours by road from central Nanjing, and a car or bicycle is the easiest way to get around.

name: 南京欢乐谷
summaryEn: A large theme park in Qixia District, opened in November 2020 as the eighth park of China's Happy Valley chain. It has more than 40 rides, among them several roller coasters such as a Bolliger & Mabillard wing coaster and an Intamin launched coaster, and stages seasonal themed festivals. It suits a full day out for families and ride enthusiasts.
description: 南京欢乐谷位于江苏南京。游览特色包括主题游乐、山谷、节庆文化。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the Nanjing Economic and Technological Development Zone east of Qixia Mountain, about 25 km north-east of central Nanjing, by taxi.

name: 金牛湖野生动物王国
summaryEn: A safari park on the west shore of Jinniu Lake, laid out over hillsides and former quarry pits and holding more than 300 species of animals. In the drive-through section visitors follow a 3.2 km route in their own cars, with woodland and water used as barriers instead of fences; the walking section has a science hall, jellyfish and amphibian houses and animal-feeding areas. The walking section also puts on staged shows, including a circus, sea-lion performances and an animal parade, and has fairground rides, so it suits families with children.
description: 金牛湖野生动物王国位于江苏南京。游览特色包括湖泊、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the west side of Jinniu Lake, about 50 km north of central Nanjing; a short taxi ride from Jinniuhu station at the end of Metro Line S8.

name: 梅钢工业文化旅游区
summaryEn: An industrial tourism area inside the Meishan steelworks on Nanjing's south-western edge, a plant begun in the late 1960s as the '9424' project to supply iron to Shanghai and now one of Baosteel's main production bases. Old workshops have been turned into a steel experience hall, where a model blast furnace and projections show molten iron being poured, a factory history exhibition and a former locomotive repair shed with a steam engine on show, and giant cooling towers are painted with sky and clouds. Rated 4A in 2023, it is aimed mainly at school study trips and families.
description: 梅钢工业文化旅游区位于江苏南京。游览特色包括工业参观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Meishan on the south-western edge of Yuhuatai District, about 20 km from central Nanjing by taxi; it lies inside a working steel plant, so check the current visiting arrangements before going.

name: 南京科技馆
summaryEn: Nanjing's main science museum, set beside Huashen Lake in Yuhuatai District, with hands-on halls on scientific principles, space and the Earth. After nearly a year of renovation it reopened in July 2025 with new space exhibits, including a full-size replica of a space-station core module with virtual-reality launch rides. It suits families with children.
description: 南京科技馆位于江苏南京。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Zijinghua Road in Yuhuatai District, about 1 km north of Huashenmiao station on Metro Line 1.

name: 平山森林公园
summaryEn: A wooded hill park of about 22 km² in Liuhe District, north of the Yangtze, which the district describes as its largest green conservation area, with forest cover of more than 85% and a highest point of 161 m. Woodland paths and lakeside boardwalks run through the park, which also has a cherry-blossom valley, Shuangdie Lake and tea gardens. The gardens grow the local Huaping Yuhua green tea, and a small exhibition hall in the park is devoted to its tea culture.
description: 平山森林公园位于江苏南京。游览特色包括森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Ma'an Subdistrict of Liuhe District, about 50 km north of central Nanjing, roughly an hour by car.

name: 汤山紫清湖
summaryEn: A large hot-spring resort in the Tangshan spa area east of Nanjing, developed over more than a decade, combining hotels, outdoor hot springs and a wildlife park. Dozens of pools, among them waterfall pools, mineral-salt and stone-slab baths and fish pools, are spread over a wooded hillside facing the lake. Its wildlife world has giant pandas, elephants, giraffes, zebras, primates and parrots and a drive-through section, and with a children's play centre and a water park the resort is aimed at families and short stays.
description: 汤山紫清湖位于江苏南京。游览特色包括温泉、瀑布、湖泊。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Tangshan, about 25 km east of central Nanjing, roughly 40 minutes by car.

name: 渡江胜利纪念馆
summaryEn: A museum on the Yangtze waterfront where the Qinhuai River enters it, about the April 1949 campaign in which the People's Liberation Army crossed the Yangtze and took Nanjing, then the Nationalist capital. Its galleries tell the story through photographs, documents, objects and reconstructed scenes, and the Jingdian, a small steam launch that ferried troops across the river, is displayed in the forecourt. The Yangtze Crossing Victory Monument of 1979 stands about 1.7 km to the north-east on Rehe Road Square.
description: 渡江胜利纪念馆位于江苏南京。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Dujiang Road by the Yangtze in Gulou District, about 6 km north-west of Xinjiekou by taxi. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 云幽谷
summaryEn: A leisure park in the hills of Tangquan, at the western edge of Pukou District, that combines countryside scenery with a farm-themed amusement park. It has fairground rides such as a Ferris wheel, a carousel and go-karts, as well as a glass footbridge. It suits families with children on a day out from Nanjing.
description: 云幽谷位于江苏南京。游览特色包括主题游乐、田园观光、公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Longjing, Tangquan Subdistrict, about 35 km by road west of central Nanjing, best reached by car.

name: 叠石桥国际家纺城
summaryEn: Diesiqiao in Sanxing town is a vast wholesale market district for bedding, curtains and other home textiles, built up over some forty years and described by provincial media as the world's largest home-textile cluster, with more than 2,500 firms. The tourist area pairs the market halls, where visitors can buy direct from traders, with an exhibition hall on the trade, and a local brand opened a bedding museum in the same town in 2025.
description: 叠石桥国际家纺城位于江苏南通。游览特色包括博物馆、主题展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Sanxing town, Haimen district, about 20 km east of central Nantong and 11 km north-west of Haimen's centre.

name: 海安博物馆
summaryEn: Hai'an Museum is spread over a modern main building and Han's Mansion (Han Gongguan), the 1906 family residence of Han Guojun, a late-Qing official who governed Jiangsu in 1913 and again in 1922–25 and in old age refused to serve the Japanese-backed regime. The mansion is a compound of late-Qing-style halls and courtyards, and the main building holds the museum's displays on local history and archaeology.
description: 海安博物馆位于江苏南通。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In central Hai'an, about 70 km north-west of Nantong by road.

name: 南通森林野生动物园
summaryEn: A large wildlife park on Nantong's northern outskirts covering about 2 km², which the city says holds nearly 20,000 animals of some 300 species. Two giant pandas from Chengdu have lived here since 2019, and visitors can tour the grounds on foot, by bike or by boat. It forms part of the Sendi resort, which adds a water park, an indoor snow and ocean park opened in 2026 and a hotel, and the zoo has offered night tours in summer.
description: 南通森林野生动物园位于江苏南通。游览特色包括动物观赏、水上游乐。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 10 km north of central Nantong, around 20 minutes by road; city bus 108 runs from Nantong railway station.

name: 红十四军纪念馆
summaryEn: This memorial hall in a park on the east side of Rugao covers the 14th Red Army, formed in 1930 from Communist guerrilla bands in the Nantong, Haimen, Rugao and Taixing countryside and formally founded at a rally south-west of Rugao that April. Its commander He Kun was killed within weeks, and Nationalist forces had broken up the base by 1931; the exhibits follow the army's short history.
description: 红十四军纪念馆位于江苏南通。游览特色包括纪念展览。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: On Fushou East Road on the eastern side of Rugao city, about 2.5 km south-east of Shuihui Garden.

name: 盆景大观
summaryEn: Rugao calls itself China's capital of flowers and bonsai, and its Rugao school, known for trees shaped with a 'cloud head, rain feet and beauty's waist', is counted among the country's seven main schools of penjing. This scenic area on the city's southern side shows the craft at scale, with displays built around the Jiangsu Bonsai Museum, and bonsai traders line nearby streets.
description: 盆景大观位于江苏南通。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the southern part of Rugao city, about 6 km south of Shuihui Garden by taxi or local bus.

name: 通海垦牧公司旧址
summaryEn: Zhang Jian founded the Tonghai Land Reclamation Company here in 1901 to turn coastal salt flats into cotton farms for his Dasheng mills; it is regarded as China's first agricultural joint-stock company. The company compound was rebuilt on its old site from 2021 in late-Qing and Republican style, with a main hall, a farm-affairs hall, wing rooms and a grain-drying yard, and exhibitions of photos, film and objects tell the company's story.
description: 通海垦牧公司旧址位于江苏南通。游览特色包括历史旧址、盐湖风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Haifu town, Qidong, about 20 km north of Qidong city and roughly 80 km east of Nantong by road.

name: 奇妙农场
summaryEn: A farm-themed leisure park of about 53 hectares on Nantong's northern edge, opened in October 2021 and rated 4A in December 2024. Its seven themed sections build farming into family entertainment, with sightseeing fields, hands-on farm work, nature lessons and folk-craft activities, and there is a hot-spring hotel, guesthouses and restaurants. It suits families with young children and sits next door to Nantong Forest Safari Park.
description: 奇妙农场位于江苏南通。游览特色包括田园观光、林地风光、农业体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 10 km north of central Nantong, beside the Forest Safari Park; city bus 108 from the railway station stops nearby.

name: 洲际绿博园
summaryEn: A botanical park in Nantong's Tongzhou district that the city says holds more than 8,000 plant species gathered from around the world. It was the first scenic area in Tongzhou to be rated 4A and is mainly visited for its seasonal flowers and autumn colour.
description: 南通通州区的植物园以丰富的植物收藏和不同主题的园艺展区为特色。
accessEn: In Tongzhou district about 10 km east of central Nantong, around 20 minutes by road.

name: 中国杨树博物馆
summaryEn: A museum in Siyang county devoted to the poplar. The county began planting poplars introduced from Italy in 1972 and, with large plantations, promotes itself as China's 'hometown of poplars'; the museum stands on the southern side of the county town.
description: 中国杨树博物馆位于江苏宿迁。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 5 km south of Siyang county town, roughly an hour by road east of central Suqian. Check that it is open before going.

name: 三台山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park on low wooded hills on the northern edge of Suqian city. Seasonal flower fields of verbena, cosmos and spider flowers, a mist-spraying boardwalk, a petting area for small animals and guesthouses make it a popular family outing.
description: 三台山国家森林公园位于江苏宿迁。游览特色包括森林公园、花卉观赏、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 9 km north of central Suqian, around 20 minutes by taxi.

name: 神农时代文化旅游区
summaryEn: A modern agricultural theme park near Yanghe town, named after Shennong, the legendary inventor of farming. Eight themed pavilions show vegetables, flowers, fruit trees and plant factories grown with modern farming technology, and there is a petting area with small animals and family activities such as cooking and crafts.
description: 神农时代文化旅游区位于江苏宿迁。游览特色包括主题游乐、楼阁建筑、农业体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside the Xu–Huai road near Yanghe town, about 27 km south-east of central Suqian; a taxi from Yanghe takes about 10 minutes.

name: 双沟酒文化旅游区
summaryEn: A visitor area at the Shuanggou distillery in Shuanggou town, home of Shuanggou Daqu, a strong-aroma baijiu. The route takes in the historic brewing core, a museum on the site of a Song and Yuan-dynasty distillery, the large modern production halls and packaging centre, and a re-created Ming-style hand-brewing scene where visitors can try mixing the fermented grain.
description: 双沟酒文化旅游区位于江苏宿迁。游览特色包括博物馆、酿造文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shuanggou town, about 27 km south-west of Sihong county town and roughly 1½ hours by road from central Suqian.

name: 项王故里
summaryEn: A park in southern Suqian on the traditional birthplace of Xiang Yu, the Chu warlord who fought Liu Bang for control of China after the fall of the Qin and died in 202 BC. A locust tree said to have been planted by Xiang Yu stands among halls and gardens such as the Xiang residence and the Six Arts Garden, which present his life and Western Chu culture. Daily performances include Chu dances, guqin music and re-enactments of the Battle of Julu and the Feast at Hongmen.
description: 项王故里位于江苏宿迁。游览特色包括名人故居、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On South Huanghe Road in Sucheng district, about 10 minutes by taxi from central Suqian.

name: 雪枫公园
summaryEn: A memorial park of about 21 hectares in Suqian city, opened in 2007 in memory of Peng Xuefeng, a New Fourth Army commander killed in 1944, and others who fought in the War of Resistance against Japan. At its centre the Peng Xuefeng Memorial Hall displays about 400 photographs and more than 100 objects such as mortars, machine guns and a sword, with an exhibition upstairs on clean government in the wartime base area.
description: 雪枫公园位于江苏宿迁。游览特色包括纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Sucheng district, a short taxi ride from central Suqian; the memorial hall is closed on Mondays.

name: 白马涧生态园
summaryEn: A park of about 1.5 km² in the wooded hills on Suzhou's western edge, west of Fengqiao in the High-tech District, which the city calls the district's 'green lung'; legend makes the valley a horse farm of the King of Wu. Its centre is Longchi (Dragon Pond), a valley lake with a long boardwalk along the water, a waterfall and a shallow stream for paddling, and hiking paths continue across the hills.
description: 白马涧生态园位于江苏苏州。游览特色包括瀑布、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 15 km west of central Suzhou; the Baimajian Shengtaiyuan stop on Suzhou High-tech Tram Line 1, on Huashan Road, is beside the park.

name: 中国刺绣艺术馆
summaryEn: A museum of embroidery in Zhenhu, a lakeside subdistrict west of Suzhou known for Su embroidery, where more than 8,000 local people work as embroiderers. Its galleries cover China's four famous regional embroidery styles, the work of master embroiderers, the history of the craft and Zhenhu's own embroidery, and it holds special exhibitions, has embroiderers demonstrating their work and lets visitors try stitching.
description: 中国刺绣艺术馆位于江苏苏州。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Zhenhu, about 27 km west of central Suzhou, by taxi or bus; the studios and shops of Embroidery Street (Xiupin Jie) are beside it.

name: 大阳山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park covering Yangshan, a wooded range of hills on the north-western edge of Suzhou whose main peak, Jianque Peak (338 m), is the second-highest around the city. The listed scenic area has two parts with separate entrances: a botanical garden at the foot of the hills, which stages seasonal flower shows, and Wenshu Temple, a Buddhist temple on the hillside.
description: 大阳山国家森林公园位于江苏苏州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园、植物园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 15 km north-west of central Suzhou in the High-tech District, by taxi or city bus.

name: 吴江运河文化旅游区
summaryEn: The old town of Pingwang in southern Wujiang, where the Ditang canal from Huzhou joins the Grand Canal at Yingdou Lake, rated a 4A scenic area in 2023. Its small core, about 0.2 km², keeps the linear layout of a canal-side market town, and a walkway lined with canal-history steles leads from the lakeshore into the old lanes. It is a quiet stop for travellers following the canal between Suzhou and Zhejiang.
description: 吴江运河文化旅游区位于江苏苏州。游览特色包括湖泊、运河。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Pingwang town, Wujiang district, about 40 km south of central Suzhou by road.

name: 光福景区
summaryEn: A group of sights around Guangfu, a town in the hills by Lake Tai west of Suzhou, managed as one scenic area with its visitor centre beside Situ Temple. The Xiangxuehai plum groves on the hillsides have long been ranked among China's classic places for plum blossom, admired by the Kangxi and Qianlong emperors and planted with more than 20 varieties; Situ Temple is known for four ancient cypresses nicknamed Pure, Rare, Ancient and Strange. The plum season in February and March is the main time to go.
description: 光福景区位于江苏苏州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Guangfu town, about 25 km west of central Suzhou by road.

name: 静思园
summaryEn: A large private garden in classical Suzhou style, built over ten years from 1993 by a local entrepreneur in the countryside of Wujiang. Its centrepiece is the Qingyun Peak, a tall Lingbi rock from Anhui pierced by many holes, set among ponds and pavilions. It is a modern creation rather than a historic garden.
description: 静思园位于江苏苏州。游览特色包括园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 20 km south of central Suzhou and 3 km west of Tongli, by taxi.

name: 锦溪古镇
summaryEn: A canal town among the lakes of south-west Kunshan, called Chenmu from 1512 until 1992 after the 'water tomb' of a Song imperial consort, Consort Chen, on an islet in Wubao Lake beside the town. Old stone bridges, among them a ten-arch bridge, and a covered bridge cross its waterways, and the town calls itself a 'home of folk museums' for its many small museums of private collections. It lies a few kilometres from Zhouzhuang and is easily combined with it.
description: 锦溪古镇位于江苏苏州。游览特色包括博物馆、古镇、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km south-east of central Suzhou in Kunshan, and about 8 km north-east of Zhouzhuang, by road.

name: 暨阳湖
summaryEn: A large lake park on the southern side of central Zhangjiagang, with lakeside paths, gardens and lawns around the water. A small amusement park, Happy World, occupies one corner of the grounds. It suits a stroll or a family outing for visitors staying in the city.
description: 暨阳湖位于江苏苏州。游览特色包括湖泊、主题游乐、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the southern side of central Zhangjiagang, about 60 km north of Suzhou, by city bus or taxi from the centre.

name: 苏州湾黄金湖岸
summaryEn: A waterfront leisure area of about 200 hectares on the shore of East Lake Tai in Suzhou Bay, the new lakeside district of Wujiang, made up of the East Lake Tai Ecological Park, the Suzhou Bay Plaza Park, a lakeside viewing platform, a restaurant quarter and a yacht club. Paths and cycle tracks follow the water past lawns and wetland planting, and the Suzhou Bay Cultural Centre with its grand theatre, designed by Christian de Portzamparc, stands on the same shore. It is a place for a walk, a bike ride or the sunset over the lake rather than a historic sight.
description: 苏州湾黄金湖岸位于江苏苏州。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the eastern shore of Lake Tai in Wujiang district, about 18 km south of central Suzhou by road.

name: 苏州太湖国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A national wetland park of about 230 hectares on the shore of Lake Tai at Zhenhu, in Suzhou's High-tech District, made by turning former fish ponds back into lakeside wetland. Boardwalks and bridges lead through reed beds, ponds and small islands, one of them home to sika deer, and boat trips run through the wetland; more than 170 species of wild birds have been recorded here.
description: 苏州太湖国家湿地公园位于江苏苏州。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Zhenhu, about 27 km west of central Suzhou, by taxi or bus; the China Embroidery Art Museum is about 1 km away.

name: 太仓现代农业园
summaryEn: A large modern farming park of about 8,000 mu (533 hectares) in northern Taicang, run as a showcase for agricultural technology and ecology. Its signature section is Rose Manor, a rose-themed garden that the city is developing into a leisure destination with study tours, accommodation and wedding venues. It suits families and garden lovers rather than visitors looking for historic sights.
description: 太仓现代农业园位于江苏苏州。游览特色包括田园观光、园林景观、农业体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Between Shaxi and Fuqiao towns in northern Taicang, about 12 km north-east of Taicang's city centre by road; Taicang is about 50 km east of central Suzhou.

name: 亭林园
summaryEn: Kunshan's main city park, laid out in 1906 as Ma'anshan Park around Yufeng Hill (Ma'anshan) in the north-west of the city and renamed in 1936 after the scholar Gu Yanwu, known as Master Tinglin. Near the east gate are three small museums: one on Kunqu opera, which takes its name from Kunshan, one on Gu Yanwu and one on Kunshan stone, a prized ornamental rock that comes from this hill. The park also grows the qionghua viburnum and twin-flowered lotus that, with Kun stone, are called Kunshan's three treasures.
description: 亭林园位于江苏苏州。游览特色包括博物馆、城市公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the north-west of central Kunshan, a city about 35 km east of Suzhou with frequent high-speed trains from Suzhou and Shanghai.

name: 香山
summaryEn: Zhangjiagang's highest hill, at 136.6 m, a wooded ridge in Jingang (formerly Nansha town) west of the city centre, laid out as a scenic area of about 4.4 km² with plum groves, the Peach Blossom Brook valley, a lake and Buddhist halls. On the summit stands the Plum Blossom Hall, whose name board is attributed to Su Dongpo; it was rebuilt in the late Ming by the elder brother of the travel writer Xu Xiake, who stayed here on three visits and wrote poems about the hall.
description: 香山位于江苏苏州。游览特色包括湖泊、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 16 km north-west of central Zhangjiagang by road; Zhangjiagang station has high-speed trains from Shanghai and Nanjing.

name: 永联村
summaryEn: Yonglian is a village in Nanfeng town whose rolling mill, set up by the village committee in 1984, grew into the Yonggang steel group. Its tourist area has two parts: Yonglian Town, with an exhibition hall on the village's history, and the Jiangnan Farming Culture Park, a farm-themed leisure park opened in 2010 with rides, play areas and a water park. It suits families and visitors curious about the industrialised villages of the Yangtze delta.
description: 永联村位于江苏苏州。游览特色包括水上游乐、田园观光、农业体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Nanfeng town, about 15 km east of central Zhangjiagang by road.

name: 稻河
summaryEn: Just outside Taizhou's old north gate, the Daohe quarter is the city's main surviving block of old houses, lining the Daohe and Caohe rivers with Hanxi Street on one bank and five parallel lanes on the other. It grew up from 1372, when the Ming court resettled migrants from Suzhou and other southern prefectures here, and prospered as a landing for grain and salt boats, leaving Ming and Qing houses, an old pawnshop and a Ming bridge.
description: 泰州老北门外，沿河留下成片传统民居，是了解当地水乡街巷与居民生活的地点。
accessEn: On the north side of Taizhou's old town, about 1 km north of the City God Temple.

name: 凤城河
summaryEn: The Fengcheng River is the old moat that rings Taizhou's historic centre, landscaped with waterside parks and walks and plied by sightseeing boats. Along it stand the Wanghai Tower, the Taoyuan garden and the Mei Lanfang Memorial, a garden museum on the site of the opera star's ancestral home that he visited in 1956, and a new leisure hub has been added on Changdao and Maple Leaf islands.
description: 凤城河位于江苏泰州。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Rings the old centre of Taizhou; the scenic area's listed address is at Wanghai Tower on the south-east side, which has a boat pier.

name: 古罗塘
summaryEn: Guluotang is a restored and partly rebuilt old-street quarter along North Street in the centre of Jiangyan. Its southern half gathers the historic sights, among them the Wang clan ancestral hall and a memorial hall to the Qing Go master Huang Longshi, while the northern half is given over to shops, cafés and an evening market.
description: 古罗塘位于江苏泰州。游览特色包括纪念展览、祠堂文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In central Jiangyan on Beidajie (North Street), about 22 km east of central Taizhou.

name: 新四军黄桥战役纪念馆
summaryEn: In October 1940 the Communist-led New Fourth Army under Chen Yi and Su Yu defeated the Nationalist 89th Army of Jiangsu governor Han Deqin around Huangqiao, a clash within the wartime alliance that secured the Communists a base in central Jiangsu. The memorial hall in the town tells the story of the campaign; the battle's former command post in the old town is the protected heritage site, and a martyrs' memorial tower stands nearby.
description: 新四军黄桥战役纪念馆位于江苏泰州。游览特色包括纪念展览、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Huangqiao town, about 20 km north-east of Taixing city and 40 km south-east of central Taizhou.

name: 溱潼古镇
summaryEn: Qintong is a Ming- and Qing-era water town at the meeting of the Jiangxing and Taidong rivers, listed as one of China's historic and cultural towns in 2005. Its lanes keep old houses such as the Ming-dynasty Lüshu Courtyard and the Zhu family house, a Qing pharmacy and fire-brigade hall, and an old camellia famed locally for its thousands of blooms. The town hosts the Qintong Boat Festival on nearby Qinhu Lake at Qingming.
description: 溱潼古镇位于江苏泰州。游览特色包括古镇、湖泊、水乡。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 4 km north of the Qinhu wetland park gate and 16 km north of Jiangyan.

name: 秋雪湖
summaryEn: A large eco-park of lakes, wetlands and farmland on the north-eastern edge of Taizhou's main urban area, combining modern farming with waterside walks and leisure attractions. A children's amusement park, Fairy-tale Forest, stands beside it, and the area suits a half-day family outing.
description: 秋雪湖位于江苏泰州。游览特色包括湿地、主题游乐、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the north-eastern outskirts of Taizhou, about 9 km from the old town by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 中华赏石园
summaryEn: A museum and garden of ornamental stones at the northern entrance of the China Wu Culture Expo Park in Hongshan, founded as the first stone garden of the View Stone Association of China. Eight themed galleries show more than a thousand pieces, from oddly shaped and patterned stones to mineral crystals and fossils, and the prize exhibit is a fossil of Daxiatitan, a giant long-necked dinosaur from the Lanzhou Basin in Gansu.
description: 中华赏石园位于江苏无锡。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观、化石遗迹。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Hongshan, Xinwu district, next to the Hongshan Site Museum about 20 km south-east of central Wuxi; easiest by taxi.

name: 龙背山森林公园
summaryEn: A wooded hill park of about 5.5 km² on the southern edge of Yixing's city centre. Its landmark is the Wenfeng Pagoda, from which there are views over the city's lakes towards Lake Tai, and the park also holds memorial halls to notable people from Yixing in history, science and the arts.
description: 龙背山森林公园位于江苏无锡。游览特色包括森林公园、湖泊、纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the south side of central Yixing off Renmin South Road, a short taxi ride from the centre.

name: 陶祖圣境
summaryEn: A scenic area in the bamboo-covered hills of Huxu, south-west of Yixing, developed around Muli Cave, a karst cave whose route includes a stretch by boat. It is named after Fan Li, honoured in local tradition as the ancestor of pottery, and adds bamboo walks, a pottery workshop and sights themed on the legend of Fan Li and Xi Shi.
description: 陶祖圣境位于江苏无锡。游览特色包括洞穴、喀斯特地貌、陶瓷工艺。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Huxu town about 25 km by road south-west of central Yixing, by car or taxi.

name: 无锡影都
summaryEn: A film-industry park on Lihu Avenue in southern Wuxi, built on the site of the Xuelang steel-rolling mill that closed in 2009, whose old factory sheds were converted into about 15 sound stages used by film and television crews. For visitors it adds a digital-cinema science museum, a waxworks museum and a film-themed street, and it mostly draws local families with children.
description: 无锡影都位于江苏无锡。游览特色包括博物馆、科学科普、工业遗产。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Binhu district about 11 km south of central Wuxi, by taxi or bus.

name: 阳山桃花源
summaryEn: The peach-growing country around Yangshan town in western Wuxi, known across China for its juicy honey peaches, with orchards that blossom in spring and are picked in summer. Around the town are the Peach Culture Square, pick-your-own orchards, farm-stays and guesthouses, a geology exhibition hall on the ancient volcano of Yangshan hill, the Anyang Academy and the Chaoyang Chan Temple.
description: 阳山桃花源位于江苏无锡。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、火山地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Huishan district about 17 km west of central Wuxi, by car or bus.

name: 宜兴竹海
summaryEn: A forest park of bamboo-covered hills in the far south of Yixing, where Jiangsu meets Zhejiang and Anhui, long known as a 'sea of bamboo'. Its visitor area of about 1,000 hectares is crossed by paths through the groves, and a cable car climbs into the hills along the Zhejiang border.
description: 宜兴竹海位于江苏无锡。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光、缆车观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Huxu town about 25 km south-west of central Yixing, by bus or taxi.

name: 宜兴云湖
summaryEn: A scenic area around Yunhu Lake, the former Hengshan Reservoir in the hills of Xizhu in south-western Yixing, combining lakeside walks and a wetland park with a tea-culture zone that includes the Yangxian Tea Culture Museum. On the lake shore stands Dajue Temple, a large Buddhist complex rebuilt here from 2004 and recognised as the ancestral temple of the Taiwan-based Fo Guang Shan order.
description: 宜兴云湖位于江苏无锡。游览特色包括博物馆、湿地、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xizhu town about 30 km by road south-west of central Yixing; best reached by car or taxi.

name: 艾山
summaryEn: A hill scenic area of about 15 km² in Tiefu, northern Pizhou, that mixes woodland scenery with restored historic sites. Black locust and Chinese tallow woods and red autumn maples cover the slopes, and peach orchards ring the hill.
description: 艾山位于江苏徐州。游览特色包括果园、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tiefu town about 20 km north of Pizhou city and some 90 km by road north-east of Xuzhou; a car is the practical way to get there.

name: 蟠桃山宝莲寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple complex on Pantao Hill in the Xuzhou Economic and Technological Development Zone, east of the city, centred on Baolian Temple, rebuilt from 2009 on the site of an older monastery that had fallen into ruin by the mid-20th century. Besides the main halls and a multi-storey pavilion it has a temple to the Queen Mother of the West, and a traditional temple fair on the third day of the third lunar month draws large local crowds.
description: 蟠桃山宝莲寺位于江苏徐州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、楼阁建筑、佛教文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 8 km north-east of central Xuzhou in the development zone, some 600 m from Pantao station on metro line 3; by metro or taxi.

name: 大洞山
summaryEn: At 361 m the highest hill in the Xuzhou area, rising on the southern edge of Jiawang district centre and managed as a wooded scenic area. Paths and a brightly painted 'rainbow' walkway climb slopes planted with large pomegranate orchards, where fruit can be picked in autumn, and Zhuyu Temple within the scenic area is known for its vegetarian noodles and buns.
description: 大洞山位于江苏徐州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、果园、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the southern edge of Jiawang town beside national road G310, about 40 km by road north-east of central Xuzhou.

name: 大沙河湿地公园
summaryEn: A wetland park along the Dasha River in Feng County, in the far north-west of Jiangsu, where long riverside sandbanks, reed beds and ponds are laid out with birdwatching platforms and waterside paths. Rated a national 4A scenic area at the start of 2024, it is aimed mainly at families, with nature classes, a children's camp and seasonal themes running from birdwatching in spring and lotus in summer to water-caltrop picking in autumn and reed scenery in winter.
description: 大沙河湿地公园位于江苏徐州。游览特色包括湿地、滨水景观、观鸟。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km south of Feng County town and some 60 km north-west of central Xuzhou; a car or taxi is the practical way to reach it.

name: 督公湖
summaryEn: A reservoir east of Jiawang's district centre, built in 1958 and now a lakeside scenic area with waterside paths. It is mostly a local day-trip spot, busiest when its peach trees blossom in spring.
description: 督公湖位于江苏徐州。游览特色包括水库、湖泊、赏花。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 9 km east of the Jiawang district centre and some 45 km by road from central Xuzhou; a car or taxi is needed. Check that it is open before going.

name: 凤鸣海
summaryEn: A park on the eastern side of Jiawang, the former coal-mining district north-east of Xuzhou, which the district promotes as one of its scenic areas alongside Pan'an Lake and Dadong Mountain. It includes a horse-riding club with Mongolian-style yurts, which has staged riding displays, camel rides and bonfire evenings on public holidays.
description: 凤鸣海位于江苏徐州。游览特色包括湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 4 km east of the Jiawang district government and some 35 km north-east of central Xuzhou by road; a taxi from Jiawang takes about 10 minutes.

name: 刘邦故里文化景区
summaryEn: A Han-dynasty theme park in Feng County, which the ancient histories give as the birthplace of Liu Bang, founder of the Han dynasty. Tall modern gate towers in Han style mark the entrance, and inside are a 42.6 m bronze statue of Liu Bang with an immersive hall on early Han history at its foot, a ceremonial altar and a mound honoured as the tomb of the emperor's ancestors. It suits families and visitors interested in early Han history, and holiday fairs have brought Han costume, pitch-pot, archery, drumming and dragon dances.
description: 刘邦故里文化景区位于江苏徐州。游览特色包括主题游乐、名人故居。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 12 km north-west of Feng County town and about 1.5 hours by road north-west of Xuzhou; a car is the practical way to get there.

name: 马陵山
summaryEn: A range of low red-sandstone hills south of Xinyi city, with Danxia-type cliffs and rock formations, caves, small lakes and pine woods, which local tradition identifies as the site of the Warring States Battle of Maling and where the Qianlong Emperor stayed on his southern tours. At its western foot lies the Huating site, a Neolithic cemetery of about 5,500 to 4,500 years ago whose finds, including fine jades, mix the northern Dawenkou culture with elements of the Liangzhu culture from the south; it is presented through a site museum and a reconstructed 'Huating tribe' area. Trails, a zip line and campsites make it a popular weekend escape.
description: 马陵山位于江苏徐州。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、砂岩地貌、洞穴。图集建议预留1 天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 20 km south of Xinyi city centre and roughly 1.5–2 hours by road east of Xuzhou.

name: 潘安湖湿地公园
summaryEn: A national wetland park in Jiawang district made from what was the largest and most damaged area of subsided ground over old coal mines around Xuzhou, flooded and landscaped since the late 2000s into lakes, reed beds and stands of pond cypress. Visitors take rowing boats across the water and birdwatchers come for species such as the reed parrotbill, while the 'Xuzhou Night' street opened on the shore in 2023 for evening food and shows, and neighbouring Mazhuang village is known for its embroidered sachets.
description: 潘安湖湿地公园位于江苏徐州。游览特色包括湿地、观鸟。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km north-east of central Xuzhou by road (around 40 minutes); a car or taxi is easiest.

name: 彭祖园
summaryEn: A large wooded city park on the southern side of central Xuzhou dedicated to Peng Zu, the legendary sage said to have lived some 800 years, whom tradition makes lord of the ancient state of Dapeng at Xuzhou. Paths wind over low hills and round ponds to a statue of Peng Zu, his memorial shrine and a pavilion, and the park's cherry trees draw crowds in spring.
description: 彭祖园位于江苏徐州。游览特色包括楼阁建筑、林地风光、城市公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Quanshan district about 3 km south of the city centre, a short walk from the Huaihai Campaign memorial park; by taxi or city bus.

name: 水月禅寺
summaryEn: A large Buddhist temple in Suining County, built in recent years on the site of the county's former Dizang Temple inside the Baitang River wetland park. Its halls follow a traditional monastery layout but in a deliberately modern architectural style, and paths through the surrounding wetland make it a quiet half-day outing.
description: 水月禅寺位于江苏徐州。游览特色包括湿地、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Baitang River wetland park on the edge of Suining town, roughly 80 km south-east of central Xuzhou (around 1.5 hours by road).

name: 徐州乐园
summaryEn: A theme-park complex west of Yunlong Lake made up of a water park and two themed ride parks, with a resort hotel and a shopping street attached. It is a family day out rather than a sightseeing stop.
description: 徐州乐园位于江苏徐州。游览特色包括湖泊、主题游乐、水上游乐。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: On Yudai Avenue about 8 km south-west of central Xuzhou, west of Yunlong Lake; by taxi or city bus. Check that it is open before going.

name: 徐州汉画像石艺术馆
summaryEn: A museum on the eastern shore of Yunlong Lake devoted to the carved stone panels that lined Eastern Han tombs, shrines and gate towers around Xuzhou. The reliefs show scenes of daily life, historical tales and the world of immortals and mythical beasts, and the museum is run as a branch of the Xuzhou Museum.
description: 徐州博物馆位于中国江苏省徐州市云龙区和平路101号，城区内云龙山与户部山之间。
accessEn: On the east side of Yunlong Lake, about 3 km south-west of central Xuzhou; easily combined with a walk round the lake. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 窑湾古镇
summaryEn: A canal town on the Grand Canal where it meets Luoma Lake, in the south-west of Xinyi, with some 1,300 years of history; it grew into a busy trading port in the Ming and Qing dynasties. Stone-paved lanes keep a large group of Ming and Qing buildings, among them merchant guild halls and old banking houses, and in the evenings the town stages shows including the molten-iron 'fire flower' display, with lantern-lit boat trips along the water.
description: 窑湾古镇位于江苏徐州。游览特色包括古镇、湖泊、运河。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km south-west of Xinyi city and roughly 1.5–2 hours by road east of Xuzhou; a car is the practical way to get there.

name: 安丰古镇
summaryEn: Anfeng grew rich as the leading salt-producing town of the old Huainan salt fields, drawing Huizhou salt merchants who built along a long street beside the Chuanchang canal, and it was named a China Historical and Cultural Town in 2007. The preserved stretch of the old street, about 500 m long, keeps houses such as the Huizhou-style Bao family mansion of 1850 and the Wu clan hall, while a salt office, an opera stage and a salt wharf have been rebuilt nearby. The town was also known for its teahouses, which doubled as venues for Yangzhou-style storytelling.
description: 安丰古镇位于江苏盐城。游览特色包括古镇、运河。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Anfeng town about 17 km south of central Dongtai, near the Anfeng exit of the G15 expressway; taxi from Dongtai.

name: 草房子乐园
summaryEn: A rural theme park of about 350 mu in Zhouhuo village, the home village of children's author Cao Wenxuan, winner of the 2016 Hans Christian Andersen Award, planned around the site of the original straw-roofed houses behind his novel Caofangzi (The Grass House). A re-creation of the novel's Youmadi primary school and play areas spread across the Lixiahe farmland, with stage shows, outdoor activities and school study programmes. It mainly suits families and readers of the book.
description: 草房子乐园位于江苏盐城。游览特色包括主题游乐、田园观光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Zhouhuo village, Zhongxing subdistrict, Yandu District, about 21 km west of central Yancheng; car or taxi.

name: 中华水浒园
summaryEn: A themed park in Baiju town built around the Shi Nai'an Memorial Hall, which presents Baiju as the home town of Shi Nai'an, the writer traditionally credited with the classic novel Water Margin (the claim is shared with neighbouring Xinghua). The memorial hall shows more than 100 editions of the novel and material on Shi's life, and the wider park around it is themed on the novel. It suits readers of the novel more than general sightseers.
description: 中华水浒园位于江苏盐城。游览特色包括纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Baiju town about 21 km south-west of central Dafeng and 35 km south of Yancheng city; taxi or car.

name: 梦幻迷宫
summaryEn: A hedge-maze park in the countryside of Caoyan town that Guinness World Records lists as the largest permanent hedge maze, measured at 35,596.74 m² in June 2018, with about 9.5 km of paths. The main maze is laid out in the shape of a milu deer, with smaller heart-shaped, circular and children's mazes, an observation tower and bridges for seeing the pattern. It mainly suits families and groups.
description: 梦幻迷宫位于江苏盐城。游览特色包括楼阁建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Sanyuan village, Caoyan town, about 14 km north of Dongtai and 27 km south-west of central Dafeng; car or taxi.

name: 大丰港海洋世界
summaryEn: An ocean-themed family attraction in the marine-industry park near Dafeng Port, with aquarium halls, marine science exhibits, a tropical plant house and a children's play area. It is a modern built attraction rather than a natural site, best for families with children.
description: 大丰港海洋世界位于江苏盐城。游览特色包括水族展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 23 km east of central Dafeng towards Dafeng Port, roughly 30 minutes by car or taxi.

name: 大洋湾
summaryEn: A large park on the northern edge of Yancheng where the old and new channels of the Yangwan river loop around islands and inlets, laid out with lawns, flower meadows and waterside paths. Visitors can ride painted boats or steer small self-drive boats along the water, and a staged show on the city's past, 'Yandu Wangshi', has been put on here.
description: 盐城市区北部的大洋湾由河道回绕形成，洲岛、汊口和滨水绿地构成了公园的游览格局。
accessEn: In Nanyang town, Tinghu District, about 9 km north of central Yancheng near the airport; city bus or taxi.

name: 荷兰花海
summaryEn: A large flower park in Xinfeng town, named in memory of the Dutch water engineer who planned the area's irrigation in 1919, where tulips are grown over thousands of mu and a tulip festival has been held every spring since 2013. Tulips flower from March to May, followed by summer flowers and an autumn lily season, around a small town of European-style buildings. The park is popular for wedding photography and also has a theatre complex, Only Love: Theatre Fantasy City, created by director Wang Chaoge.
description: 荷兰花海位于江苏盐城。游览特色包括花卉观赏、灌溉工程、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xinfeng town about 8 km north of central Dafeng, near the Dafeng North exit of the expressway; taxi from Dafeng.

name: 淮剧小镇
summaryEn: A waterside village quarter of about 350 mu on the edge of the Jiulongkou wetland, renovated and extended in old style as a showcase for Huai opera and Jianhu acrobatics, both national intangible heritage. Old lanes and new buildings in matching style hold opera performances, street acrobatics, an art space, a bookshop and stalls selling local snacks such as lotus-root starch balls and fish balls. It is easily combined with a visit to Jiulongkou.
description: 淮剧小镇位于江苏盐城。游览特色包括湿地、非遗文化、莲花观赏。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside the Jiulongkou scenic area, about 20 km south-west of Jianhu town and 50 km west of Yancheng city; car or taxi.

name: 九龙口
summaryEn: A lake and marsh area in the Lixiahe lowlands where nine natural rivers meet around a small island, giving the name 'Nine Dragons' Mouth'. The scenic area covers reed beds, lotus and water-chestnut ponds and waterways, rich in water birds, and includes Longzhu (Dragon Pearl) Island; the Huai Opera Town, rated separately, lies next door.
description: 九龙口位于江苏盐城。游览特色包括湖泊、岛屿、莲花观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jiulongkou town, Jianhu County, about 19 km south-west of Jianhu town and 50 km west of Yancheng city; car or taxi.

name: 龙冈桃花源
summaryEn: An orchard park in Longgang, an old market town west of Yancheng named after the 15-li sand ridge to its north said to resemble a lying dragon. Peach and pear orchards planted from 1959 on the sandy soil cover a core area of about 1,900 mu, best in March when the blossom is out, and the park adds riverside walks, a chestnut avenue, sand play areas, fruit picking and a wartime air-raid shelter.
description: 龙冈桃花源位于江苏盐城。游览特色包括果园、滨水景观、赏花。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Longgang town, Yandu District, about 11 km west of central Yancheng; city bus or taxi.

name: 马家荡
summaryEn: Majiadang is a broad expanse of reed marsh, fish ponds and waterways in south-western Funing, counted as the first of the 64 marshes of the Lixiahe lowlands, with villages built along the water. The scenic area, rated 4A in 2023, centres on Maliang Lake, with a newly built old-style 'Maliang Ancient Town' and a small amusement park, and takes in the waterside village of Mugou.
description: 马家荡位于江苏盐城。游览特色包括古镇、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Majiadang village, Yilin town, about 35 km south-west of Funing county town and 50 km west of Yancheng city; car or taxi.

name: 梅花湾
summaryEn: A landscaped park on the north-western edge of Dafeng themed on plum blossom, laid out around lakes off a branch of the Doulonggang River with groves of plum, cherry and crabapple among camphor, osmanthus and magnolia trees. It also has Chinese-style garden buildings, a plum culture hall, an angling centre and a water play area, and egrets and other birds nest in the trees; late winter and early spring, when the plums flower, is the time to go.
description: 梅花湾位于江苏盐城。游览特色包括园林景观、赏花。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Tonggang Avenue about 6 km from central Dafeng; taxi or city bus.

name: 上海知青纪念馆
summaryEn: A museum on Haifeng Farm, one of the state farms run by Shanghai inside Dafeng, recording the tens of thousands of young Shanghai people sent to reclaim the Yellow Sea mudflats in the 1960s and 1970s. It occupies the former Yuanhua farm headquarters, a brick hall from the early 1950s, and displays hoes, straw sandals, call-up notices, photographs and wax figures, with recreated thatched living quarters. It is part of a cluster of sent-down-youth exhibition halls on the same site.
description: 上海知青纪念馆位于江苏盐城。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the Haifeng Farm (Yuanhua section) about 13 km east-north-east of central Dafeng, roughly an hour by road from Yancheng; taxi or car.

name: 安徒生童话乐园
summaryEn: A modern theme park on the edge of Sheyang county town built around Hans Christian Andersen's stories, with four themed zones based on The Little Match Girl, Thumbelina, The Emperor's New Clothes and The Ugly Duckling, rides, themed halls, a castle and a water park. It forms one complex with the neighbouring Qianhe Lake park, a hotel and a shopping street, and is aimed at families with young children.
description: 安徒生童话乐园位于江苏盐城。游览特色包括湖泊、主题游乐。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: On Xingfu Avenue in Hede, the Sheyang county town, about 47 km north of Yancheng city; local taxi or bus from Sheyang station.

name: 条子泥
summaryEn: A vast tidal mudflat on the Yellow Sea coast, part of the Migratory Bird Sanctuaries along the Coast of Yellow Sea-Bohai Gulf of China World Heritage Site since 2019 and a key stopover on the East Asian–Australasian Flyway. The flats are cut by branching tidal creeks and turn red with seepweed in autumn, and at high tide tens of thousands of shorebirds crowd onto the '720' roost, 720 mu of former fish ponds turned into a fixed high-tide refuge in 2020; rarities include the spoon-billed sandpiper and Nordmann's greenshank. Only a small area of about 5 km² is open to visitors, with spring and autumn migration the best seasons.
description: 黄海岸边的大片潮间带泥滩，是迁徙候鸟停歇与觅食的地点，也是黄渤海候鸟栖息地的一部分。
accessEn: About 60 km east of Dongtai by road via Jianggang town, roughly 1 hour 15 minutes by car or taxi.

name: 息心寺
summaryEn: A large Buddhist temple near the Sheyang River, founded in the late Ming dynasty as a small shrine (Zhenlong Temple, later Xixin An), later destroyed and rebuilt from 1993. The new complex follows a traditional Chinese temple plan, with a Mahavira Hall, a Hall of Heavenly Kings, a Great Compassion pavilion, a ten-thousand-Buddha pagoda, a hall of 500 arhats, a jade Buddha hall and a Buddhist relics exhibition. It is an active temple with large crowds on festival days.
description: 息心寺位于江苏盐城。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、古塔。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside the Sheyang River sluice in Haitong town, about 8 km east-north-east of Sheyang county town (Hede); taxi.

name: 盐城市博物馆
summaryEn: Yancheng's city museum, founded in 1961, moved in 2021 into a new group of buildings in traditional style on Jianjun West Road in the old centre. Its galleries cover the area's history, coastal ecology, urban development and folk traditions through more than 2,000 objects, and the building also houses an intangible-heritage performance centre. The former New Fourth Army headquarters at Taishan Temple is next door.
description: 盐城市博物馆位于江苏盐城。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑、国家一级博物馆。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Jianjun West Road in central Yancheng, about 6 km west of Yancheng railway station; city bus or taxi.

name: 盐城丹顶鹤湿地
summaryEn: The visitor area of the Jiangsu Yancheng Wetland Rare Birds National Nature Reserve, set up in 1983, a UNESCO biosphere reserve since 1992 and part of the Yellow Sea-Bohai Gulf migratory bird World Heritage Site since 2019. Several hundred wild red-crowned cranes winter on the coastal marshes from late October to March, while the visitor zone has a red-crowned crane museum, a crane breeding and feeding centre with captive cranes of several species, a water-bird lake and viewing pavilions among the reeds.
description: 盐城丹顶鹤湿地位于江苏盐城。游览特色包括博物馆、湿地、自然保护区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Xinyanggang, Huangjian town, about 43 km (under an hour) north-east of Yancheng city by road; tourist buses run from the city.

name: 海盐历史文化风景区
summaryEn: Yancheng, literally 'salt city', tells the story of its salt trade in this zone beside the Chuanchang River, an old salt-transport canal. The China Sea Salt Museum, opened in 2008, uses relics, models, sculptures and wax figures to show how sea salt was boiled from brine and later sun-dried; next to it, Salt Town Water Street is an old-style canal street with a Salt Yamen, a salt god's temple, a salt merchants' guild hall and Huai opera on a theatre boat, linked to the large Yandu Park. Evening boat trips run on the Chuanchang River.
description: 海盐历史文化风景区位于江苏盐城。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑、运河。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Kaifang Avenue in southern central Yancheng, about 2 km south-west of Yancheng railway station; city bus or taxi. The museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 黄海森林公园
summaryEn: A large planted forest on reclaimed coastal land near the Yellow Sea, begun in 1965 as the Dongtai state forest farm and made a national forest park in 2015. The mainly broadleaf plantation woodland shelters a rich wildlife, with 628 plant and 342 bird species recorded, and the park lies a short drive from the Tiaozini mudflats, so the two are easily combined.
description: 黄海森林公园位于江苏盐城。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the coastal zone east of Dongtai, about 50 km (an hour) by road from Dongtai city; car or taxi.

name: 抗日战争最后一役文化园
summaryEn: In December 1945, more than four months after Japan announced its surrender, the New Fourth Army's Central China Field Army under Su Yu attacked Gaoyou, whose Japanese and collaborationist garrison had refused to surrender to it; the town fell on 26 December and the Japanese garrison surrendered in the auditorium of its headquarters. That building at 70 Xihe Lane is preserved as the site of the surrender, with a memorial hall and a victory square, and Chinese official histories call the action the last battle of the War of Resistance Against Japan. According to Chinese state media, 892 Japanese soldiers were taken prisoner.
description: 文化园围绕高邮战役组织展陈，呈现当地抗战末期的战事与历史记忆。
accessEn: Just inside the west entrance of People's Park in central Gaoyou, about 45 km north of Yangzhou (around an hour by road).

name: 捺山地质公园
summaryEn: Nashan, a 146 m hill in the countryside of Yizheng, is an extinct shield volcano whose interior was exposed by quarrying from the 1980s. The geopark, opened in 2016, shows basalt columns with five different forms of columnar jointing, along with volcanic bombs and scoria, and has a geology museum with immersive displays; tea is grown on the slopes.
description: 捺山地质公园位于江苏扬州。游览特色包括博物馆、地质景观、火山地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yuetang town, Yizheng, about 30 km west of central Yangzhou; easiest by car or taxi.

name: 凤凰岛
summaryEn: A wetland park on the islands among the rivers north-east of Yangzhou, laid out around water, islands, woodland and birds. Inside are a petting area with capybaras, alpacas, rabbits and call ducks and a walk-through bird park, so it mainly suits families and anyone wanting greenery outside the city.
description: 凤凰岛位于江苏扬州。游览特色包括湿地、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tai'an town, Guangling District, about 12 km north-east of central Yangzhou, at the north end of Fenghuangdao Road; taxi or city bus.

name: 茱萸湾
summaryEn: A peninsula park in Wantou, north-east of Yangzhou, that combines gardens, woodland and water with the city zoo. Its best-known animals are two giant pandas, and there are also tigers, giraffes, gibbons, meerkats and capybaras as well as an aquarium hall, so it is mainly a family outing.
description: 茱萸湾位于江苏扬州。游览特色包括动物观赏、水族展览、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wantou, about 7 km north-east of Yangzhou's old city centre; city bus or taxi.

name: 米芾书法公园
summaryEn: A park in the Changshan hills of Dantu District devoted to Mi Fu, the Song-dynasty calligrapher and painter who spent much of his life in Zhenjiang. It has a gallery of model calligraphy engraved in stone, a Mi Fu academy and a hall on Chinese characters, and is popular for school study trips.
description: 米芾书法公园位于江苏镇江。游览特色包括书院文化、书法文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Changshan area of Dantu District, about 10 km south-west of Zhenjiang railway station by road.

name: 南山
summaryEn: A belt of low wooded hills on the southern edge of Zhenjiang, rising to 185 metres at Jiuhua Shan and protected as a scenic area of about 15.6 square kilometres, known as the city's 'mountain forest'. It is divided into the Zhulin, Zhaoyin and Wenyuan sections, with old Buddhist temples, springs and walking trails close to the city.
description: 南山位于江苏镇江。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、林地风光、佛教文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 3 km south-east of Zhenjiang railway station by taxi or bus.

name: 梦想小镇
summaryEn: A start-up and internet-business district opened in 2015 in the core of Cangqian, Yuhang, laid out as a scenic area from the start. Its Internet Village, Angel Village and start-up market sit along Cangqian's old street, renovated as an Entrepreneurship Street in 2016, close to the old Cangqian granary and Zhang Taiyan's former residence.
description: 梦想小镇位于浙江杭州。游览特色包括名人故居。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Cangqian about 16 km west of West Lake and about 2 km from Hangzhou West railway station (opened 2022).

name: 富春桃源
summaryEn: A scenic area at Shanglian village in Xukou town, in the hills of south-western Fuyang. Its centrepiece is Jiuxiao Biyun Cave, a limestone cave promoted for the size of its single main hall, and beside it the Yanling reservoir, the largest in Fuyang, is toured by bamboo raft; a small amusement park and a rafting run are also part of the area.
description: 富春桃源位于浙江杭州。游览特色包括洞穴、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Xukou, about 40 km by road west of Fuyang town.

name: 皋亭山
summaryEn: A chain of wooded hills about 9 km long on the north-eastern edge of urban Hangzhou, rising to 361 m at Gaoting peak; the western end is Banshan National Forest Park and the eastern end the Gaoting Shan scenic area. The hills are known for peach blossom in spring and once held several Buddhist temples, and their legends are painted in a mural in the Wangchen Pavilion on Banshan.
description: 杭州城北诸山或称皋亭山、或称半山，在城市文化、历史地理概念上一般指同一山脉，即位于浙江省杭州市东北部，拱墅区、江干区和余杭区交界处的山脉，自西往东山峰依次为半山、老虎山、黄鹤山、元宝山、皋亭山、桐扣山、佛日山等。
accessEn: On the north-eastern edge of the city, about 16 km north-east of West Lake.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黄公望隐居地
summaryEn: A bamboo-filled side valley at Miaoshanwu near Fuyang, by local tradition where the Yuan painter Huang Gongwang lived in his last years and painted 'Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains' (around 1350), whose two surviving parts are now in the Zhejiang Provincial Museum and the National Palace Museum in Taipei. Paths lead past a memorial hall to his life and work, a boat landing, an archway at the site of his hut, a spring and the South Tower presented as his studio.
description: 黄公望隐居地位于浙江杭州。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Dongzhou on the Fuchun River, about 6 km north-east of Fuyang town and 35 km by road from West Lake.

name: 建德航空小镇
summaryEn: A general-aviation town built around Qiandaohu General Airport near Shouchang in south-west Jiande, with a 1,200 m runway, flight schools and aviation companies. Visitors come for skydiving from about 3,000 m, low-level helicopter sightseeing flights and tethered hot-air balloon rides, and the town also has aviation-themed hotels and a hot-spring centre.
description: 小镇围绕寿昌附近的千岛湖通用机场发展，航空设施与飞行主题体验构成主要看点。
accessEn: Near Shouchang, about 20 km by road from Jiande city (Xin'anjiang); Jiande South station on the Hangzhou–Quzhou high-speed railway (opened December 2025) is about 12 km away.

name: 江南古村落
summaryEn: Five neighbouring villages in Jiangnan town, Tonglu (Shen'ao, Huanxi, Dipu, Xufan and Qingyuan), developed together as one rural scenic area of old houses, ancestral halls and farmland. Shen'ao, a national historic and cultural village since 2007, keeps a complex of old houses and halls protected by the province, while Dipu, home to the Shentu and Jiang clans, has ancestral halls, a memorial arch and Huizhou-style houses from the Ming to the Republic, with flower fields on its northern edge.
description: 江南古村落位于浙江杭州。游览特色包括古村落、祠堂文化、村落风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jiangnan town about 16 km north-east of Tonglu town by road; Shen'ao and Dipu adjoin each other.

name: 灵栖洞
summaryEn: One of the first show caves developed in Zhejiang, in the hills of Hangtou town south-west of Jiande city, made up of three limestone caves and a small stone forest. Lingquan Cave is known for its underground water, which visitors can tour by rowing boat, Qingfeng Cave for its cool draughts and Aiyun Cave for its mists, and all are lit with coloured light shows. The site was a filming location for the 1986 television series Journey to the West.
description: 灵栖洞位于浙江杭州。游览特色包括石林、洞穴。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Hangtou town about 30 km by road south-west of Jiande city (Xin'anjiang).

name: 龙坞茶镇
summaryEn: A tea-growing district in the hills of Zhuantang, south-west Hangzhou, where tea gardens cover the slopes around the villages; Hangzhou media describe it as the largest producing area of West Lake Longjing tea. It was developed as one of Zhejiang's first 'characteristic towns', combining tea growing with tea houses, tea culture and rural leisure.
description: 龙坞茶镇位于浙江杭州。游览特色包括湖泊、茶文化、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhuantang, Xihu District, about 13 km south-west of West Lake.

name: 千岛湖石林
summaryEn: A karst landscape of about 20 km² in Shilin town, south of Qiandao Lake, where limestone pinnacles and ridges stand in maze-like clusters among the hills. It is made up of three areas, Lanyuping, Daimaoling and Xishanping, where visitors walk among the stone peaks, springs and gullies, and a glass walkway, a via ferrata and a canyon swing have been added.
description: 千岛湖石林位于浙江杭州。游览特色包括峡谷、石林、湖泊。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Shilin town about 25 km south of Qiandaohu town, reached by road.

name: 太湖源
summaryEn: A wooded gorge about 5 km long in Taihuyuan town, northern Lin'an, with cliffs, waterfalls and clear streams, promoted as one of the sources of the Lake Tai river system. It is a summer retreat from Hangzhou's heat, and the town's villages, among them Baisha, have more than 500 homestays and farm guesthouses.
description: 太湖源位于浙江杭州。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Taihuyuan town about 30 km by road north of central Lin'an.

name: 天子地
summaryEn: A forested mountain scenic area of about 6 km² at Luoshan village in Baijiang town, in the hills of western Tonglu towards Qiandao Lake, now run as the Tianzidi mountain park. A covered moving walkway carries visitors up the slope to a karst cave, an aerial playground, a raft slide down the Zilong gorge and a dinosaur park, with more amusement rides added in 2025, so it suits families with children.
description: 天子地位于浙江杭州。游览特色包括峡谷、洞穴、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Baijiang town, about 45 km by road west of Tonglu town.

name: 文渊狮城
summaryEn: A new town built in the mid-2010s at Jiangjia on Qiandao Lake as a recreation of Shicheng, the old seat of Sui'an county that was drowned when the Xin'an River reservoir filled in 1959. Its streets of new traditional-style buildings are lined with rebuilt memorial arches and hold a Shicheng museum, craft workshops, old-brand shops, bars and homestays. It is the centre of Jiangjia's 'Leshui' lakeside resort town, which the 4A listing names with it.
description: 文渊狮城位于浙江杭州。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jiangjia town on the western side of Qiandao Lake, about 40 km by road from Qiandaohu town.

name: 下姜村
summaryEn: A mountain village in Fengshuling town, Chun'an, with white-walled houses along a clear stream, once one of the poorest in the area. From the 2000s it was the rural contact point of five successive Zhejiang Party secretaries, Xi Jinping among them, and it is now presented as a model of rural revitalisation, with dozens of homestays, orchards and a covered bridge. It was a filming location for the 2020 film 'My People, My Homeland' and was named one of UN Tourism's Best Tourism Villages in 2024.
description: 下姜村位于浙江杭州。游览特色包括果园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Fengshuling town in the hills south-west of Qiandao Lake, about 40 km by road from Qiandaohu town.

name: 瑶琳仙境
summaryEn: A limestone show cave in Yaolin town, in the hills north-west of Tonglu, whose first hall opened to visitors in 1980; its winding halls are filled with stalactites, stalagmites and flowstone. The caves are now lit with coloured light installations and an artificial snowfall effect, and the Chuiyun Tongtian River cave lies in the same town.
description: 瑶琳仙境位于浙江杭州。游览特色包括洞穴、钟乳石、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yaolin town about 20 km by road north-west of Tonglu town.

name: 玉皇山南基金小镇
summaryEn: A finance district for private investment funds at the southern foot of Yuhuang Hill, between West Lake and the Qiantang River, which began promoting itself as a tourist area in 2015. For visitors its interest lies in the landscaped parks and old sites inside it, among them the Baguatian ('Eight Trigrams Field') heritage park, the Jiangyangfan ecological park and Baita Park, with the Southern Song Guan Kiln Museum, the Tianlong Temple carvings and the Zhakou White Pagoda close by.
description: 玉皇山南基金小镇位于浙江杭州。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 4 km south of West Lake on the southern slopes of Yuhuang Hill, by bus or taxi.

name: 中国扬子鳄村
summaryEn: A breeding and conservation centre for the Chinese alligator, a small endangered crocodilian found only in China, set among ponds, woods and bamboo in the countryside of western Changxing. Visitors see the alligators in breeding ponds and enclosures, with displays on the species and the work to return it to the wild.
description: 以中国特有的扬子鳄为主题的繁育保护地，游客可以在园区了解这一濒危爬行动物。
accessEn: About 20 km south-west of Changxing town, roughly 30 minutes by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 中国竹子博览园
summaryEn: A bamboo garden on the south-western edge of Anji town, in a county known as China's 'home of bamboo', planted with more than 300 kinds of bamboo gathered from across China and abroad. It contains the China Bamboo Museum, whose halls cover the plant's history, cultivation, crafts and place in art, and paths lead through the groves past bamboo-themed scenes.
description: 中国竹子博览园位于浙江湖州。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 5 km south-west of Anji town centre in the Lingfeng resort area, 15 minutes by taxi.

name: 荻港
summaryEn: A water village in Hefu town south-east of Huzhou, set among the fish ponds and mulberry dykes of the Taihu plain, with old houses and family halls along its canals, more than 30 old stone bridges, a temple and covered streets running beside the water. It was named a Chinese Historic and Cultural Village in 2014.
description: 荻港位于浙江湖州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、运河。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 7 km from Huzhou East station on the Shanghai–Suzhou–Huzhou high-speed railway and 14 km south-east of central Huzhou, by road.

name: 黄金湖岸
summaryEn: A stretch of the southern shore of Taihu Lake in Huzhou's Taihu tourist resort, running east from Moon Plaza and the ring-shaped 'Moon Hotel' that has become a city landmark. The shore faces a wide expanse of open water and is a favourite spot for sunset and evening walks, when the hotel is lit up.
description: 黄金湖岸位于浙江湖州。游览特色包括湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 10 km north of central Huzhou, 20 minutes by taxi or by city bus.

name: 金钉子远古世界
summaryEn: At Meishan in north-western Changxing a quarried limestone face, Section D, was chosen in 2001 as the global reference point, the 'golden spike', for the boundary between the Permian and Triassic periods about 250 million years ago, the time of the largest mass extinction in Earth's history; a second golden spike, for the base of the Changhsingian stage, was fixed in the same section in 2005. The scenic area in the geological reserve shows the exposed rock beds and has a geology museum with fossils and displays on the history of life.
description: 金钉子远古世界位于浙江湖州。游览特色包括地质景观、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 26 km west of Changxing station, roughly 40 minutes by road; the New Fourth Army memorial at Wentang is 2 km away.

name: 湖州丝绸小镇
summaryEn: A new silk-industry and leisure district in Huzhou's eastern new town, built around Xishanyang, a lake and wetland park that is the main attraction for visitors. Footpaths circle the water past modern buildings for silk fashion and trade, a nod to Huzhou's claim to be the origin of silk.
description: 湖州丝绸小镇位于浙江湖州。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 5 km from Huzhou East station on the Shanghai–Suzhou–Huzhou high-speed railway and 7 km east of central Huzhou.

name: 太湖图影湿地文化园
summaryEn: A wetland park on the south-western shore of Taihu Lake in Changxing's Tuying resort area, described as the last natural lakeside wetland on this stretch of shore, with fish ponds, winding channels, reed beds and more than 20 small islands. Boat trips run through the channels, and the reeds turn white with flower in early winter.
description: 太湖图影湿地文化园位于浙江湖州。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 13 km south-east of Changxing station on the Nanjing–Hangzhou high-speed railway, roughly 20 minutes by taxi. Check that it is open before going.

name: 奇幻嘉乐比
summaryEn: A family amusement park in the Lingfeng resort area south-west of Anji town, listed as Tianyuan Jialebi and now run as Qihuan ('Fantasy') Jialebi together with a resort hotel, orchards and white-tea gardens. Nearly 40 rides and a boating pier are joined by a pet-animal park, outdoor and farm-kitchen cooking, and tea picking and tea making, so it mainly suits families with young children.
description: 奇幻嘉乐比位于浙江湖州。游览特色包括主题游乐、果园、乘船游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 8 km south-west of Anji town centre, 20 minutes by taxi.

name: 仙山湖
summaryEn: A reservoir lake and national wetland park at the western tip of Changxing county, close to where Zhejiang, Jiangsu and Anhui meet. A causeway crosses the lake beside Xianshan, a small hill that local legend links to the Silla prince-monk later revered as the bodhisattva Dizang, and the reed beds and shallows draw large numbers of wintering water birds.
description: 仙山湖位于浙江湖州。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 9 km north of Anji station on the Hefei–Hangzhou high-speed railway, roughly 15 minutes by taxi.

name: 下渚湖湿地
summaryEn: A natural lake-and-marsh landscape of about 10 km² in eastern Deqing, a maze of some 600 low islets, reed beds, bamboo groves and fish ponds threaded by channels. It is toured mainly by boat; egrets and herons gather in summer and wild ducks in winter, and the shrine of Fangfeng, a legendary local chieftain, stands near the north-western shore.
description: 下渚湖湿地位于浙江湖州。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 4 km from Deqing station, which has high-speed trains to Hangzhou and Shanghai, roughly 10 minutes by taxi.

name: 庾村
summaryEn: The village at the eastern foot of Mount Mogan where Huang Fu, a Republican-era statesman who retired to the mountain in 1928, founded a library, a school and a silkworm-egg farm in the 1930s; he is buried here. Its main street keeps Republican-era buildings, among them the old library of 1932, and a square on the site of the old bus station, and is now lined with cafés, a gallery, small shops and guesthouses.
description: 庾村位于莫干山东麓，村落历史与民国时期隐居山中的人物、活动相联系。
accessEn: About 30–40 minutes by road west of Deqing station, on the main road up Mount Mogan.

name: 浙北大峡谷
summaryEn: A forested river gorge in the hills of south-western Anji, near Baofu, where a walking trail follows a clear mountain stream past boulders, pools and a string of waterfalls. Its shade and running water make it a summer escape from the heat of the plains.
description: 浙北大峡谷位于浙江湖州。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 40 km south-west of Anji town by road, roughly an hour's drive via Baofu.

name: 浙江自然博物院安吉馆
summaryEn: The second site of the provincial natural history museum, opened in December 2018 on a hillside north-west of Anji town in a group of eight buildings designed by David Chipperfield Architects. Six themed halls, among them geology, dinosaur, ocean and ecology halls, are joined by temporary exhibitions, a 4D cinema and a hands-on discovery centre, and the displays lean towards interactive learning for families.
description: 浙江自然博物院安吉馆位于浙江湖州。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 6 km north-west of Anji town centre, 15 minutes by taxi; Anji station on the Hefei–Hangzhou high-speed railway is about 20 km away by road.

name: 中南百草原
summaryEn: A hillside eco-park on the north-western edge of Anji town, laid out as a series of themed gardens (cherry, plum, Japanese maple, purple bamboo, white tea, roses, osmanthus and medicinal herbs) among streams and ponds. A small sightseeing train runs through its European Pasture section, where children can meet farm animals, and the park also has models of prehistoric animals and a campsite, so it suits family outings.
description: 中南百草原位于浙江湖州。游览特色包括草原、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 6 km north-west of Anji town centre, 15 minutes by taxi; the Anji branch of the Zhejiang Museum of Natural History is about 1 km away.

name: 平湖东湖
summaryEn: A lake on the edge of central Pinghu whose shores and islands form a 4A scenic area. Its landmark is the Li Shutong Memorial Hall, a white lotus-shaped building of 2004 set partly over the water in Shutong Park on Daying Island, with seven galleries on Li Shutong (1880–1942), the painter, musician and teacher of Pinghu descent who became the Buddhist monk Hongyi. Baoben Temple and its pagoda stand on the south shore.
description: 平湖东湖位于浙江嘉兴。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊、纪念展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In central Pinghu, about 30 km east of Jiaxing by road; Mo's Manor is under 1 km to the west.

name: 歌斐颂巧克力小镇
summaryEn: A chocolate factory and themed visitor park in Dayun town, opened in 2014 by the Gefeisong chocolate company. A glass-walled gallery about 150 m long lets visitors watch chocolate being made from mixing to packing, and the park adds a chocolate-making workshop, Swiss-style streets and buildings, a wedding venue and gardens, which makes it mainly a family outing.
description: 歌斐颂巧克力小镇位于浙江嘉兴。游览特色包括园林景观、休闲公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 5 km east of Jiashan South high-speed station in Dayun town.

name: 嘉善图博中心
summaryEn: A civic cultural complex in Jiashan town, opened in 2019, that pairs the five-storey county library with the four-storey Jiashan Museum in buildings whose kiln-like form recalls the county's brick and tile making. The museum presents local history from prehistoric times and holds temporary exhibitions, and the library has a large children's picture-book hall; it suits a rainy-day visit combined with Xitang or Dayun.
description: 嘉善图博中心位于浙江嘉兴。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Yangguang East Road in Jiashan town, about 4 km north of Jiashan South high-speed station; the museum is closed on Mondays.

name: 梅花洲
summaryEn: A rural water-village scenic area in Fengqiao town, south-east of Jiaxing, named for the way its streams split the land into five petal-shaped islands like a plum blossom. Old stone bridges link the islands, among them the paired Sanbu Liangpan Bridges, a provincial heritage site, and Xianghua Bridge in front of Shifo (Stone Buddha) Temple, and the area also has two ancient ginkgo trees, the Feng family's old house, orchards and play areas aimed at families.
description: 梅花洲位于浙江嘉兴。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、果园、桥梁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Fengqiao town about 13 km south-east of central Jiaxing and some 5 km from Jiaxing South high-speed station.

name: 湘家荡
summaryEn: A lake of about 2,000 mu (1.3 km²) on the north-eastern edge of Jiaxing, whose shoreline park forms the 4A scenic area. A greenway of about 13 km links the lake with the city, and around the shore are a sandy beach called Moon Bay, a wetland park, a forest park and a farm park, with seasonal festivals through the year.
description: 湘家荡位于浙江嘉兴。游览特色包括湿地、森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 7 km north-east of central Jiaxing by road.

name: 云澜湾温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort built in the 2010s in Dayun town, part of the Dayun provincial tourist resort area, using water drawn from more than 2,000 m underground. Its spa centre is designed in the shape of two half-open lotus flowers, and the resort adds a hotel, seasonal flower fields and, in summer, a children's water-play park; it suits a relaxed half-day or an overnight stay.
description: 云澜湾温泉位于浙江嘉兴。游览特色包括温泉、花卉观赏、莲花观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 5 km east of Jiashan South high-speed station, beside the Dayun exit of the Shanghai–Hangzhou expressway.

name: 中国木雕文化博览城
summaryEn: A vast trade complex in Dongyang, a city known for its woodcarving tradition, where some 3,000 manufacturers sell carved woodwork, rosewood (hongmu) furniture and bamboo crafts from about 8,000 shops. Alongside the market halls are the China Woodcarving Museum, a wood-art hall and a woodcarving theme park, and more than 70 master craftsmen have studios here. It suits shoppers and anyone curious about Dongyang woodcarving, a nationally listed intangible-heritage craft.
description: 中国木雕文化博览城位于浙江金华。游览特色包括博物馆、主题游乐。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Shimao Avenue on the western side of Dongyang, about 6 km from the city centre; Mudiaocheng station on the Jinhua–Yiwu–Dongyang light-rail line is at the market.

name: 花园村
summaryEn: A village about 16 km south of Dongyang city, founded in 1342, that has twice absorbed its neighbours since 2004 and now covers 12 km² with more than 65,000 residents, most of them migrant workers. Promoted nationally as a model of rural development, it was the first single village in Zhejiang to be rated a 4A scenic area and is also listed as a provincial folk-culture village. It suits travellers curious about rural development in eastern China.
description: 花园村位于浙江金华。游览特色包括园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 16 km south of Dongyang city, and just over 10 minutes by road from Hengdian station on the Hangzhou–Wenzhou high-speed railway, opened in 2024.

name: 锦林佛手文化园
summaryEn: A farm park in Chisong town, Jindong district, devoted to the fingered citron or Buddha's hand, a fragrant citrus grown on the southern slopes of Jinhua's northern hills for nearly a thousand years. It combines citron plantations with displays and science education on the fruit, sales of farm produce and rural sightseeing. It suits families looking for a rural outing near Jinhua.
description: 锦林佛手文化园位于浙江金华。游览特色包括农业体验。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Chisong town, Jindong district, about 1 km from the Jinhua East exit of the Hangzhou–Jinhua–Quzhou expressway and roughly 20 minutes by road from central Jinhua. Check that it is open before going.

name: 金华之光
summaryEn: A civic culture complex completed in 2019 on Yanweizhou, the point where Jinhua's rivers meet, in the new Duohu business district. Its four linked buildings house the Jinhua City Exhibition Hall and the Jinhua Science and Technology Museum, whose four galleries cover life and evolution, discovery, design and the earth and universe; a hall of local intangible heritage opened inside in 2024. It stands beside the China Wu Opera House and suits families and anyone curious about the city.
description: 金华之光位于浙江金华。游览特色包括博物馆、科学科普、非遗文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Yanweizhou in central Jinhua, where the rivers meet, about 3 km south-east of Jinhua railway station by taxi.

name: 六洞山
summaryEn: A provincial scenic area on a low hill of karst caves between Jinhua and Lanxi, opened to visitors in 1985 and named after its six caves. Its main sight is the Underground River, a 2.5 km cave route that begins with an 800 m boat ride along an underground stream, at a steady 18°C all year, and continues on foot past stalactites, stalagmites and flowstone. A few minutes away is Qixia Garden, a Qing house that was the ancestral home of Zhao Yidi (Edith Zhao), the lifelong companion of the general Zhang Xueliang, with an exhibition on the couple.
description: 六洞山位于浙江金华。游览特色包括洞穴、乘船游览、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 8 km east of Lanxi city and 14 km north-west of Jinhua railway station, roughly 25 minutes by road from either.

name: 明清民居博览城
summaryEn: A park of about 60 hectares run by Hengdian World Studios that combines old buildings with film sets. Its Taohuayuan section gathers more than 120 Ming, Qing and Republican-era houses moved here from Zhejiang, Anhui and Jiangxi, with carved timber, brick and stone, ancestral halls, a theatre and a copy of Tunxi Old Street. The Qinhuai River section recreates old Nanjing around a Confucius Temple and examination hall and includes a scaled-down copy of the Yuanmingyuan.
description: 明清民居博览城位于浙江金华。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、祠堂文化、传统民居。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the eastern edge of Hengdian town, a short taxi ride from the other Hengdian parks; Hengdian station on the Hangzhou–Wenzhou high-speed railway, opened in 2024, is about 6 km north of the town centre. Check that it is open before going.

name: 舞龙峡
summaryEn: A gorge on the upper Jiaxi stream at Louxiazhai village, Jianshan town, in north-eastern Pan'an, where the stream cuts down through a raised plateau in a series of pools, waterfalls and small lakes. The scenic area, rated 4A in 2017, is divided into five sections named after dragons, and also takes in the old houses of Louxiazhai and the Daxingguo remains on Chenglishan.
description: 舞龙峡位于浙江金华。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Louxiazhai village, Jianshan town, in the north-east of Pan'an County, roughly an hour by road from the county town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 仙华山
