summaryEn: A national scenic area in the north of Pujiang County whose summit, above 600 m, is a cluster of sheer volcanic rock pinnacles; the highest, Shaonü Peak, reaches 720.8 m. Legend says a daughter of the Yellow Emperor became an immortal here, and the early-Ming scholar Song Lian praised it as one of the most beautiful places on earth. With 24 named peaks, over a hundred viewpoints and dense forest, it is a popular summer retreat.
description: 仙华山位于浙江金华。游览特色包括林地风光、登山观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Xianhua village, about 8 km north of Pujiang county town, around 20 minutes by road; Pujiang station on the Hangzhou–Wenzhou high-speed railway, opened in 2024, is the nearest railway station.

name: 中国青瓷小镇·披云青瓷文化园
summaryEn: Shangyang town is where modern Longquan celadon began: the state-owned Longquan Porcelain Factory was set up here in 1954, gathering leading craftsmen to revive the ware. The old factory has been turned into an intangible-heritage cultural centre with an interactive museum, and around the town visitors can watch the whole making process or try making pieces of their own.
description: 中国青瓷小镇·披云青瓷文化园位于浙江丽水。游览特色包括博物馆、工业遗产。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shangyang town, about 30 km west-south-west of Longquan city.

name: 东西岩
summaryEn: A 2.5 km² area of Danxia-type sedimentary rock in Laozhu She Ethnic Town, named after two great rocks that face each other from east and west. Paths link gorges, caves and outcrops such as Breeze Gorge, Sword-Split Rock, General Rock and the Seven Goddesses. The area lies in a She ethnic district, and She songs, dances and wedding ceremonies have been staged here on holidays and at the Sanyuesan festival.
description: 东西岩位于浙江丽水。游览特色包括峡谷、洞穴、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km north-west of central Lishui, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 古堰画乡
summaryEn: A riverside scenic area on the Ou River about 25 km south-west of Lishui, taking in the old river port of Dagangtou, Yantou village by the 6th-century Tongji Weir, and the Baoding celadon kiln sites. Painters borrowing the plein-air approach of France's Barbizon school have worked here since the 1980s, giving rise to the "Lishui Barbizon" school, and the area keeps an old street, pavilions, river landings and groves of old camphor trees, with boats crossing between the banks.
description: 古堰画乡位于浙江丽水。游览特色包括滨水景观、楼阁建筑、商贸街区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 40 minutes by road south-west of central Lishui and Lishui station on the Jinhua–Wenzhou high-speed railway.

name: 巾子峰
summaryEn: A forested mountain area a few kilometres north-west of Qingyuan town, centred on Jinzi Peak and run as a state-owned scenic area. In cold spells in winter its upper slopes are coated with rime ice.
description: 巾子峰位于浙江丽水。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 8 km north-west of Qingyuan town by road; Qingyuan station on the Quzhou–Ningde railway is the nearest rail stop.

name: 南尖岩
summaryEn: A 6 km² mountain area in south-west Suichang county with craggy peaks, odd-shaped rocks, streams and mountain views. Its slopes hold about 133 hectares of terraced fields built up by generations of villagers, whose layered lines are the main sight.
description: 遂昌西南部的山地以峻峭山峰、奇岩和溪流为特色，游览视野随山路不断变化。
accessEn: About 50 km south-west of Suichang town by road; Suichang station on the Quzhou–Ningde railway is the nearest rail stop.

name: 千佛山
summaryEn: A privately run mountain park in Shilian town in western Suichang, named for rock formations said to resemble a thousand Buddhas. A path follows a wooded gorge with waterfalls, pools and streams up to a small Buddhist temple.
description: 千佛山位于浙江丽水。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km by road west of Suichang town.

name: 青田中国石雕文化旅游区
summaryEn: Qingtian's showcase for its soft, many-coloured local stone, carved for at least 1,500 years into seals, figures and landscapes and listed as national intangible heritage in 2006. Its centrepiece is the Qingtian Stone Carving Museum, whose oldest piece is a Songze-culture pendant of Qingtian stone, and the craft can be watched in nearby Shankou town, its traditional home, where more than 1,000 workshops carve and sell work.
description: 青田中国石雕文化旅游区位于浙江丽水。游览特色包括博物馆、非遗文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the south-east side of Qingtian town, which has a station on the Jinhua–Wenzhou high-speed railway; Shankou is about 5 km further south.

name: 箬寮原始林
summaryEn: A privately developed forest area in Anmin township in south-west Songyang, opened up for visitors from 2000, with forest cover put at about 95 percent. It rises to Ruoliaoxian, at 1,502 m the highest peak in Songyang county, and forms part of the Ruoliao–Andaihou provincial scenic area.
description: 箬寮原始林位于浙江丽水。游览特色包括林地风光、高山景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Reached via Likeng village in Anmin township, roughly an hour by road south-west of Songyang town.

name: 遂昌金矿国家矿山公园
summaryEn: A former polluted gold-mining district east of Suichang town that was cleaned up and opened to visitors as a national mine park in 2007. It has a gold museum, a protected area of old mine workings and an exhibition of mining technology, linked by a sightseeing tram, and suits visitors curious about industrial history.
description: 遂昌金矿国家矿山公园位于浙江丽水。游览特色包括博物馆、矿业遗产。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Roughly half an hour by road east of Suichang town; Suichang station on the Quzhou–Ningde railway is the nearest rail stop.

name: 畲乡之窗
summaryEn: A village scenic area at Dajun in Jingning, the only She autonomous county in China, set up to present the culture of the She people. It has a She exhibition hall, and has offered staged She wedding and welcome ceremonies, song-and-dance performances and rafting on the river.
description: 畲乡之窗位于浙江丽水。游览特色包括水上活动、主题展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 10 km west of Jingning town by road.

name: 云中大漈
summaryEn: A high mountain basin in north-west Jingning, more than 1,000 m above sea level, where villages and terraced fields are ringed by steep peaks. Its sights include Snow Daji, a waterfall of about 100 m, the old Shisi Temple with a huge Japanese cedar at its gate, and Huguan Bridge, a timber covered bridge of 1781. Cool summers have made Daji a busy homestay retreat in July and August.
description: 云中大漈位于浙江丽水。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 40 km by mountain road north-west of Jingning town.

name: 阿拉的海水上乐园
summaryEn: A large water park in the Damuwan new town on the coast south-east of Xiangshan's county town, with water slides and pools, which also stages summer events. It is a summer outing for families and groups.
description: 阿拉的海水上乐园位于浙江宁波。游览特色包括水上游乐、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Damuwan new town about 10 km south-east of Xiangshan's county town; Damuwan station, the terminus of Metro Line 12 from Ningbo (opened in September 2026), is a short taxi ride away. Check that it is open before going.

name: 中国渔村
summaryEn: A seaside resort area on Huangcheng beach, a few kilometres north of Shipu town on the southern Xiangshan coast, themed on the fishing-village culture of the area. Its sandy beach is used for swimming in summer, and it suits a half-day by the sea combined with Shipu's old town.
description: 中国渔村位于浙江宁波。游览特色包括海滨、海岸风光、历史街区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the coast about 4 km north of Shipu town in southern Xiangshan County, roughly 2 hours by road from central Ningbo. Check that it is open before going.

name: 丹山赤水
summaryEn: A stream-valley scenic area by Shilin village in Dalan town, high in the Siming Mountains of southern Yuyao, where a walking route follows the water past pools, small waterfalls and rock formations. Shilin is a mountain village some 600 years old known for its 'diaohong' persimmons, grown here for more than 400 years, which hang red on the trees in autumn.
description: 丹山赤水位于浙江宁波。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、山岩地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Shilin village in Dalan town, high in the Siming Mountains about 45 km by road south of Yuyao, roughly 1.5 hours from central Ningbo. Check that it is open before going.

name: 方特东方神画
summaryEn: A large theme park of the Fantawild chain in the Hangzhou Bay new area on the coast north of Cixi, whose rides and shows are themed on Chinese history and legend and make heavy use of screen and special-effects technology. It suits families and theme-park fans and takes most of a day.
description: 方特东方神画位于浙江宁波。游览特色包括主题游乐。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the Hangzhou Bay new area on the coast about 20 km north-west of central Cixi, roughly 1–1.5 hours by road from central Ningbo.

name: 海皮岛
summaryEn: A large water park in the Hangzhou Bay new area on the coast north of Cixi, with slides, pools and a wave pool in indoor and outdoor sections. It is mainly a summer outing for families and groups.
description: 海皮岛位于浙江宁波。游览特色包括水上游乐。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Hangzhou Bay new area about 18 km north of central Cixi, roughly an hour by road from central Ningbo. Check that it is open before going.

name: 黄贤森林公园
summaryEn: A coastal forest park around Huangxian village in Qiucun, south-eastern Fenghua, covering about 10,000 mu (some 670 hectares) of wooded hills above the shore of Xiangshan Bay, promoted as the 'Huangxian Great Wall on the Sea'. The village is linked by local tradition with the Northern Song poet Lin Bu and with Xia Huanggong, a scholar of the late Qin.
description: 黄贤森林公园位于浙江宁波。游览特色包括长城、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Huangxian village in Qiucun town, on the coast about 20 km south-east of central Fenghua and roughly an hour by road from central Ningbo. Check that it is open before going.

name: 绿野山居
summaryEn: A rural leisure resort in the hills of Wuxing village on the north-western edge of Cicheng, where visitors try farm work, walk in the countryside and eat farmhouse food, and whose cherry trees draw crowds when they flower in spring. An adjoining amusement area, Lvye Happy Valley, adds rides, and the old county town of Cicheng is close by.
description: 绿野山居位于浙江宁波。游览特色包括山谷、休闲度假、田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wuxing village, Cicheng town, Jiangbei district, about 23 km north-west of central Ningbo, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 东钱湖马山
summaryEn: A lakeside leisure area of about 100 hectares on the south-eastern shore of Dongqian Lake, centred on the Mashan wetland, where boardwalks run through reed beds and waterside trees that draw many birds. Around it are tent and camper-van campsites and the Erlingshan hot-spring resort, and the Southern Song Stone Sculpture Park lies within the area.
description: 东钱湖马山位于浙江宁波。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the south-eastern shore of Dongqian Lake in Yinzhou district, about 18 km south-east of central Ningbo, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 鸣鹤古镇
summaryEn: An old market town at the foot of Wulei Mountain in Guanhaiwei, south-eastern Cixi, with about 1,200 years of history, whose lanes, waterways and stone bridges are lined with large houses of merchants, many of whom grew rich in the herbal-medicine trade in the Ming and Qing. It is a provincial historic and cultural town, and Du Lake, Baiyang Lake, Wulei Temple and Jinxian Temple lie close by.
description: 鸣鹤镇是浙江省慈溪市的一个已撤销的镇，位于慈溪市中南部，在2001年与原观城镇、师桥镇合并，设立观海卫镇。鸣鹤地区有1200多年历史，故有古镇之称，其拥有五磊山、杜湖等名胜，是省级风景名胜区，同时因盛产杨梅和雷竹而被称为“杨梅之镇”、“雷竹之乡”。
accessEn: In Guanhaiwei town about 12 km east of central Cixi, roughly 50 minutes by road from central Ningbo.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 宁波海洋世界
summaryEn: A city aquarium beside Ningbo Children's Park in Yinzhou district, with walk-through viewing tunnels beneath its tanks and galleries and gardens styled on places such as ancient Egypt and Cambodia. It suits families with young children and makes an easy indoor stop in the city.
description: 宁波海洋世界位于浙江宁波。游览特色包括水族展览、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yinzhou district about 3 km south-east of Tianyi Square, about 500 m from Children's Park station on metro Lines 3 and 4.

name: 宁海森林温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in the wooded hills of north-western Ninghai County, built around the Nanxi spring, whose water reaches about 49°C and contains more than 20 dissolved minerals. The surrounding forest is a national forest park, and the resort suits a relaxing half-day or an overnight stay away from the city.
description: 宁海森林温泉位于浙江宁波。游览特色包括温泉、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Nanxi village in the hills of north-western Ninghai County, about 15 km from Ninghai town, roughly 30 minutes by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 石浦渔港古城
summaryEn: The old quarter of Shipu, a fishing port at the southern end of the Xiangshan peninsula, set at the foot of a hill facing the harbour, with stone-paved lanes lined with old shops, houses and a temple; Shipu is a nationally listed historic and cultural town. A second section reopened in 2025 with plazas, boutique hotels, restaurants, exhibitions and music bars, and the lanes look out over the working harbour and the sea.
description: 石浦渔港古城位于浙江宁波。游览特色包括古城、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shipu town at the southern end of Xiangshan County, about 30 km south of the county town and roughly 2 hours by road from central Ningbo.

name: 天宫庄园
summaryEn: A rural tourism park of about 1,600 mu (some 107 hectares) run by Wandi village in Xiaying, on the southern edge of Ningbo city, combining farm fields and orchards with hands-on farm activities, children's study programmes, leisure facilities and halls showing local intangible-heritage crafts and the village's development. It receives large numbers of school study groups and suits families wanting a countryside day out close to the city.
description: 天宫庄园位于浙江宁波。游览特色包括田园观光、果园、庄园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wandi village, Xiaying subdistrict, Yinzhou district, about 7 km south of Tianyi Square in central Ningbo; Hansong Road station on Metro Line 8 is about 1 km to the south.

name: 天下玉苑
summaryEn: A jade-themed culture park at the foot of Jiulong Hill in Dayin town, eastern Yuyao, laid out on a hillside around a lake with a Buddhist temple, terraces, gateways and gardens, and centred on a giant stack of jade boulders. It suits a short visit for those interested in Chinese jade.
description: 天下玉苑位于浙江宁波。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Dayin town in eastern Yuyao, about 20 km north-west of central Ningbo, roughly 40 minutes by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 伍山石窟
summaryEn: An old stone quarry in low coastal hills at Changjie, eastern Ninghai, where stone was cut from the Sui and Tang onward, most intensively under the Song and Yuan, leaving more than 800 man-made caverns in some 30 groups. Some caverns are linked by passages or open to the sky through shafts, others are flooded into clear green pools, and paths and stairs lead through them to a pavilion on the hilltop. Opened to visitors after 2004, it stays cool even in summer.
description: 伍山石窟位于浙江宁波。游览特色包括石窟造像、楼阁建筑、洞穴。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Changjie town on the coast of eastern Ninghai County, roughly 45 minutes by road east of Ninghai town.

name: 大陈古村
summaryEn: A village with a history of more than 600 years in Dachen township, Jiangshan, its houses, mostly from the Qing dynasty, built close against the surrounding hills. The village keeps the ancestral hall of the Wang clan, and in 2019 Dachen was named in the first national list of key villages for rural tourism.
description: 大陈古村位于浙江衢州。游览特色包括古村落、田园观光、祠堂文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Dachen township about 10 km north of Jiangshan city and roughly 30 km south-west of Quzhou by road.

name: 龙天红木小镇
summaryEn: A modern 'characteristic town' of about 3.5 km² in Huzhen, Longyou, built around the rosewood (hongmu) furniture industry, with traditional-style buildings, furniture workshops, a timber trading area and a rosewood cultural and creative park. Visitors come to see furniture being made and to shop, and the town has staged evening events such as bonfire parties and music festivals.
description: 龙天红木小镇位于浙江衢州。游览特色包括音乐文化、节庆文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Near Caolang village in Huzhen town, about 8 km east of Longyou county town by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 梅树底
summaryEn: A forested hill scenic area of about 8 km² in eastern Changshan, known for its old trees, wide bamboo forests and the Jiulong Waterfall, which drops down a sheer cliff. Walkers can climb Baijuhua Peak, the highest point in Changshan county, and the villages offer family inns serving local tea, wild greens and 'Guanyin tofu', a jelly made from leaves.
description: 梅树底位于浙江衢州。游览特色包括瀑布、林地风光、古树。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In eastern Changshan county, roughly 30 km north-west of Quzhou city by road.

name: 七彩长虹
summaryEn: A rural scenic area covering Changhong township in the forested north-west of Kaihua, on the Jiangxi border next to Wuyuan, with woodland over more than 85% of its land. Its two main sights are Taihuishan, a hillside village nicknamed the 'Potala Palace of Jiangnan', and Gaotiankeng, an old upland village at about 680 m whose dark skies have made it a stargazing spot with a dark-sky park, an astronomy museum and viewing platforms. It suits walkers, photographers and anyone wanting a quiet night under the stars.
description: 七彩长虹位于浙江衢州。游览特色包括博物馆、林地风光、观景台。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Changhong township about 35 km from Kaihua county town by mountain road.

name: 三衢石林
summaryEn: A karst landscape on Sanqu Mountain in Huibu town, Changshan, where limestone formed from a reef about 440 million years ago (late Ordovician) has weathered into clusters of rock pinnacles, mazes, arches and fissures. Paths lead past a sinkhole about 40 m deep, vine-hung gorges and caves, and the rock holds fossils of corals and other reef animals. It is one of the highlights of the Changshan Geopark, which was designated a UNESCO Global Geopark in April 2026.
description: 三衢石林位于浙江衢州。游览特色包括峡谷、石林、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Huibu town about 10 km north of Changshan county town, and about 40 km west of Quzhou city by road.

name: 桃源七里
summaryEn: A large mountain and rural scenic area of about 60 km² in Qili township, Kecheng, at an average altitude of 650 m and almost entirely forested. It takes in the Daguping range, with 15 peaks above 1,000 m, waterfalls such as Yanghua and Feilaishi, the Zhiling stone forest and old villages including Yangwu, Shangcun, Junliang and Zhiling. Being several degrees cooler than the city, it is popular in summer for walking and village homestays.
description: 桃源七里位于浙江衢州。游览特色包括瀑布、石林。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Qili township in the hills about 30 km north of Quzhou city by road.

name: 药王山
summaryEn: A forested mountain scenic area in southern Qujiang, part of the Ziweishan National Forest Park, promoted for its clean air and themed on traditional Chinese medicine, from which it takes its name ('Medicine King Mountain'). Its sights include the Mawei Waterfall, which drops 88 m, as well as a glass skywalk and a fibreglass slide.
description: 药王山位于浙江衢州。游览特色包括瀑布、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills of southern Qujiang district, roughly 30 km south of Quzhou city by road.

name: 穿岩十九峰
summaryEn: A scenic area of red sandstone cliffs in Jingling town, south-west Xinchang, named after a row of nineteen peaks that rise above the meeting of several mountain streams. Paths climb to the peaks and run through Qianzhang Gorge (Qianzhang Yougu), a narrow ravine walked on a mostly level path, and the area also hosts events such as a motorcycle and music festival.
description: 穿岩十九峰位于浙江绍兴。游览特色包括峡谷、砂岩地貌、音乐文化。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Jingling town, about half an hour by road south-west of Xinchang town; the Hangzhou–Shaoxing–Taizhou expressway tunnels beneath the peaks.

name: 达利丝绸世界
summaryEn: An industrial-tourism site at the works of Dali Silk, a silk textile and garment maker in Xinchang, which the company began developing around the theme of silk in 2007. Visitors see how silk is produced and learn about silk culture, and it suits travellers with an interest in textiles or a short stop in Xinchang.
description: 园区位于新昌丝绸纺织企业厂区，可围绕丝绸生产与服装工艺展开参观。
accessEn: On the western side of Xinchang, about 7 km from the town centre by road.

name: 覆卮山
summaryEn: A mountain of the Siming range where Shangyu, Shengzhou and Yuyao meet, rising to about 860 m as the highest point in Shangyu; its name, 'the upturned wine cup', comes from a line by the fifth-century poet Xie Lingyun, who wrote of drinking and composing poems on the mountain, then turning his cup over. On its slopes in Lingnan township more than 20,000 small terraced fields, farmed for centuries, spill down past the old village of Dongcheng, and a dozen 'stone rivers' of tumbled boulders, regarded as relics of Ice Age glaciation, streak the hillside. The terraces turn yellow with rapeseed flowers in spring, when the township holds a flower festival.
description: 覆卮山是中华人民共和国浙江省绍兴市上虞区、嵊州市、余姚市交界地带的一个山脉，为四明山支脉。覆卮山海拔861.3米，主峰海拨864米，为上虞区最高峰。覆卮山的名称来源自谢灵运的诗句“登此山饮酒赋诗，饮罢覆卮”。
accessEn: In Lingnan township in the far south of Shangyu, about an hour by road south of the district centre; the terraces lie around Dongcheng village.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 东方山水乐园
summaryEn: An amusement-park complex in Keqiao, listed together with the surrounding 'Kuwan Town' leisure development, made up of the indoor Mountain Kingdom, the outdoor Coldplay Kingdom (Kuwan Wangguo) with several roller coasters including an inverted coaster, and a water park. It suits families and thrill-ride fans looking for a day of rides rather than sightseeing.
description: 东方山水乐园位于浙江绍兴。游览特色包括水上游乐、游乐体验。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In western Keqiao, about 17 km west of Shaoxing's old city and 9 km south-west of Shaoxing North high-speed station, by road.

name: 乔波冰雪世界
summaryEn: An indoor ski centre beside the Keyan scenic area in Keqiao, founded by the former speed-skating world champion Ye Qiaobo, where a refrigerated hall with artificial snow allows skiing and snowboarding all year round. Its two broad, gentle trails suit beginners and children, and the complex also has an exhibition on skiing and the Winter Olympics, an ice rink and a hotel.
description: 乔波冰雪世界位于浙江绍兴。游览特色包括滑雪。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Keyan subdistrict, about 12 km west of Shaoxing's old city by road.

name: 五泄
summaryEn: A hill scenic area in Wuxie town, in the north-west of Zhuji, named after a chain of five waterfalls, counted from the first to the fifth, that step down a forested gorge. The area is listed as a national scenic area and a national forest park.
description: 五泄风景区位于浙江省诸暨市西北部山区五泄镇，与县城相距23公里，总面积9.45平方公里。以西施故里、五泄、斗岩、汤江岩四大景区所构成，为国家级风景名胜区、国家AAAA级旅游区、国家森林公园。
accessEn: In the hills of Wuxie town, about 23 km north-west of central Zhuji by road; Zhuji station on the Shanghai–Kunming high-speed line is the nearest railhead.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 后岸村
summaryEn: A village of farm-stay guesthouses in Jietou town, western Tiantai, beside the Shifeng stream below a long wall of cliffs known as the 'Ten-li Iron-Armoured Dragon'. Villagers quarried stone slabs here until the quarries were shut in 2008 because of the dust that had made many workers ill; the village then turned to rural tourism, with dozens of family guesthouses and restaurants and seasonal events such as peach-picking and lotus festivals. The Tang poet-recluse Hanshan is said to have lived for decades in the Hanyan cave in front of the village.
description: 后岸村位于浙江台州。游览特色包括田园观光、莲花观赏、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 35 km west of Tiantai town by road (provincial road S316 through Jietou).

name: 黄岩博物馆
summaryEn: The district museum of Huangyan, founded in 1984, with more than 8,000 objects ranging from Western Zhou proto-celadon and Tang and Song celadon to Buddhist relics of the Song dynasty. Its best-known holding is the silk clothing excavated from the Southern Song tomb of Zhao Boyun, hailed in China as 'the crown of Song dress'.
description: 黄岩博物馆位于浙江台州。游览特色包括博物馆、佛教文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In western Huangyan on Jindai Road, about 7 km south-west of Taizhou West station by taxi.

name: 灵湖
summaryEn: A lake park in Linhai's newer eastern district, about 5 km east of the walled old town, laid out around a broad lake with an island, willow-lined causeways and waterside paths. It is a city park used by residents for walking and cycling rather than a sight in its own right, and suits a relaxed stroll after visiting the old town.
description: 灵湖位于浙江台州。游览特色包括湖泊、岛屿、城市公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 5 km east of the Taizhou Fu old town in Linhai and about 8 km from Linhai high-speed station, by bus or taxi.

name: 柔川
summaryEn: A rural scenic area in Yutou township in the forested hills of western Huangyan (Rouchuan is the township's old name), following the Rouji stream, a tributary of the Yongning River, for about 20 km through the valleys. Along it are old bridges, temples and the Shatan old street, whose buildings include the township offices and clinic of the 1980s, together with campsites and pick-your-own orchards.
description: 柔川位于浙江台州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、果园、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yutou township about 30 km west of central Huangyan by road.

name: 神仙氧吧小镇
summaryEn: A tourism district of about 3.8 km² spanning 20 villages in Baita town, at the approach to Shenxianju, developed as one of Zhejiang's provincial 'characteristic towns' around the area's clean mountain air and its closeness to the 5A scenic area. Its villages, set among fields and streams, are lined with homestays and hotels. It works mainly as a base for visiting Shenxianju rather than as a sight in itself.
description: 仙居白塔镇多座村庄组成这片旅游区，游客可在前往神仙居的途中停留游览。
accessEn: In Baita town about 20 km south-west of Xianju town by road, on the way to the Shenxianju gate; Xianju station on the Hangzhou–Wenzhou high-speed railway, opened in 2024, is about 9 km away.

name: 天台山大瀑布（琼台仙谷）
summaryEn: A scenic area on the western slope of Tongbai Mountain, about 7 km north-west of Tiantai town, that joins the Tiantai Mountain Great Waterfall to Qiongtai Valley, a gorge of oddly shaped cliffs and rocks with plank walkways. According to the Taizhou government the waterfall drops 325 m in a long series of tiers and is up to 90 m wide; it can be viewed from a path of about 2.5 km along the top or from sightseeing lifts. The Taoist Tongbai Palace, regarded as the ancestral temple of the Southern school of Taoism, is close by.
description: 天台山大瀑布（琼台仙谷）位于浙江台州。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 7 km north-west of Tiantai town by road; Tiantaishan high-speed station is about 6 km to the south.

name: 漩门湾国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A national wetland park of 31.48 km² in northern Yuhuan, where Yuhuan island meets the Chumen peninsula, made up of tidal flats, open water, freshwater marsh, islets and wooded hills. A stopover on the East Asian–Australasian Flyway, it had recorded 320 bird species by September 2026, among them black-faced spoonbills, spoon-billed sandpipers and wintering Saunders's gulls, and it was named a provincial bird-watching site in 2023. Visitors can take boats on the lake, ride a small sightseeing train and visit the wetland science centre, and the Xuanmen Bay agricultural park lies next door.
description: 漩门湾国家湿地公园位于浙江台州。游览特色包括湿地、岛屿、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In northern Yuhuan about 9 km north of the city centre, and about 3 km from Yuhuan station, opened in August 2026 on the Hangzhou–Taizhou high-speed railway, whose Xuanmen Bay bridge crosses the park.

name: 永安溪绿道
summaryEn: A riverside route for cycling and walking along the Yong'an River, the 'mother river' of Xianju, which crosses the county's farmland basin from west to east. Along the river visitors can cycle the banks or take bamboo-raft trips, including a rafting stretch of about 5 km near the county town, with views of fields, woods and the hills framing the valley.
description: 永安溪绿道位于浙江台州。游览特色包括山谷、滨水景观、绿道骑行。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The route follows the river through Xianju; the stretch by the county town is about 3 km from Xianju South station on the Jinhua–Taizhou railway.

name: 印象南塘
summaryEn: A riverside leisure and shopping district in central Wenzhou along the Nantang River, combining Nantang Street, lined with restaurants and shops, with Bailuzhou Park, a culture village and waterside gardens. It is busiest in the evening, with a night market, a light show in Bailuzhou Park and lit-up river views, and suits a relaxed walk and dinner.
description: 印象南塘位于浙江温州。游览特色包括滨水景观、园林景观、购物街区。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In central Wenzhou, about 2 km south-east of Wuma Street; a short taxi or bus ride.

name: 三垟湿地
summaryEn: A large wetland park on the south-eastern edge of central Wenzhou, where a dense grid of rivers breaks the land into 161 small islets, traditionally farmed with orchards of Ougan, the local citrus. Paths and bridges link gardens, a banyan grove, a bird island, the Wufuyuan area and the Nan Huaijin Academy, and 142 bird species have been recorded here. It was rated 4A in December 2023 and is an easy half-day outing from the city.
description: 三垟湿地位于浙江温州。游览特色包括湿地、岛屿、果园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 7 km south-east of central Wenzhou; Sanyang Wetland station on Wenzhou rail line S1 is close to the northern entrance.

name: 南雁荡山
summaryEn: A national scenic area in western Pingyang with five sections of rocky peaks, caves, clear streams and waterfalls, long paired with the northern Yandang Mountains. The core Dongxidong section packs Confucian, Buddhist and Taoist temples among its cliffs and caves, and rows of Ming and Qing houses survive in the villages; the Shunxi section to the west holds the Chen family mansions.
description: 雁荡山，是中国浙江省温州市北部乐清市境内的一座山峰。海拔500至600米，主峰百岗尖西峰海拔1108米。形成于距今1.28亿至1.08亿年间的四次火山喷发，为世界地质公园、首批中国国家重点风景名胜区和国家5A级旅游景区。
accessEn: About 85 km south-west of Wenzhou via Shuitou town, which has buses from Wenzhou and Aojiang; minibuses towards Shunxi pass the scenic area.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 苏步青故里
summaryEn: A cultural tourism area in Tengjiao town, Pingyang, built around the hometown of the mathematician Su Buqing (1902–2003), a founder of differential geometry in China and later president of Fudan University. It takes in his late-Qing timber family house, a museum on his life, a hands-on mathematics hall and maths park, the old Tingzi street and a stele garden honouring Chinese chess champions, as Tengjiao is known for the game. It was rated 4A in December 2023.
description: 苏步青故里位于浙江温州。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tengjiao town, western Pingyang, about 50 km south-west of Wenzhou; about an hour by road via the G15 expressway's Xiaojiang exit.

name: 铁定溜溜
summaryEn: A rural theme park near Dajing in northern Yueqing, built around the growing of tiepi shihu (Dendrobium officinale), a medicinal orchid long associated with the Yandang area. It has three parts: a slide park with many indoor and outdoor slides, including a 1,620 m rail slide and a 61.8 m slide tower, a dendrobium culture park and a farming park. It suits families combining it with a visit to the Yandang Mountains.
description: 铁定溜溜位于浙江温州。游览特色包括主题游乐、楼阁建筑、农业体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xiashantou village, Dajing town, about 8 km north of Yandangshan station; by taxi or car. Check that it is open before going.

name: 铜铃山森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park in western Wencheng, with forest over about 98% of its area and rare wildlife such as Cabot's tragopan. Its best-known sight is Tongling Gorge, an S-shaped ravine of about 500 m where swirling water has drilled deep potholes into the rock; the park also has Xiaoyaochi, a pool at about 1,000 m near a sunrise viewpoint, and Tonglingzhai, a cliff-top stronghold of a late-Yuan rebel leader. A pavilion built in 1997 commemorates Red Army soldiers killed in an ambush here in 1936.
description: 铜铃山森林公园位于浙江温州。游览特色包括峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In western Wencheng County, roughly 2 hours by road west of Wenzhou; buses run from Wenzhou to Wencheng, then local buses to the park.

name: 碗窑古村
summaryEn: An old pottery village in a wooded valley above Yulong Lake in Qiaodun, founded in the early Ming, which preserves its old hand-worked bowl kilns and workshops. Old houses in early Qing style, with more than 300 rooms in all, climb the hillside, with an old temple, an opera stage, water-powered mills and a few stilt houses, and a three-tier waterfall drops into deep pools nearby. It was among the first villages named Chinese Traditional Villages in 2012.
description: 碗窑古村位于浙江温州。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Qiaodun town, about 20 km west of Lingxi, Cangnan's county town; by bus or taxi.

name: 文成森林氧吧小镇
summaryEn: A mountain resort area in western Wencheng, where Wencheng, Jingning and Taishun counties meet, made up of the Tianshengshan area in Xikeng She Ethnic Town and the Tonglingshan town area, with core areas above 1,000 m and forest covering about 96% of the land. Its facilities have included Swan Castle (Tian'ebao), an indoor ski hall, and Anfu Temple, a Buddhist temple of the Medicine Buddha, and the Tongling Mountain and Longqiyuan scenic areas lie within its bounds. It was rated 4A in 2018.
description: 文成森林氧吧小镇位于浙江温州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、林地风光、佛教文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In western Wencheng County, roughly 2 hours by road west of Wenzhou; driving is easiest, and check that the ski hall is open before going.

name: 温州乐园
summaryEn: Wenzhou's first theme park, open for about two decades in Chashan south of the city, with a European-style zone, a cartoon zone, an adventure valley and a dinosaur zone, plus rides such as a suspended roller coaster added in 2008. The Wenzhou Polar Ocean World aquarium next door opened in 2019, and a third phase opened in May 2025 with a circus arena staging acrobatics and horseback acts and a mermaid-themed family hotel. It suits families with children.
description: 温州乐园位于浙江温州。游览特色包括主题游乐、水族展览、山谷。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Xia'ao village, Chashan, about 12 km south of central Wenzhou; a taxi or city bus ride.

name: 玉苍山
summaryEn: A granite mountain north-west of Cangnan's county town, rising to 921.5 m and protected as a national forest park since 1991. It is known for its 'stone sea' of rounded boulders in odd shapes, its sunrises and seas of cloud, and a handful of small upland lakes, and Fayun Temple, founded in the 1260s and rebuilt in 1983, stands at about 770 m.
description: 玉苍山位于浙江温州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km by road north-west of Lingxi, Cangnan's county town (Cangnan station); a taxi or car is easiest.

name: 渔寮
summaryEn: A coastal scenic area near the southern end of Zhejiang's coast in Cangnan, centred on Yuliao beach, a broad sandy bay about 2 km long, with a smaller crescent beach at Wuchengao. Rock formations along the shore, such as the 'music stone' that rings when struck, and offshore islets frame the bay, which is used for sea bathing in summer.
description: 渔寮位于浙江温州。游览特色包括海滨、海岛、山岩地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Mazhan in southern Cangnan, about 50 km by road from Lingxi, the county town (Cangnan station); buses run via Lingxi.

name: 泽雅
summaryEn: A large mountain scenic area west of Wenzhou, nicknamed the 'West Yandang', with eight sections of waterfalls, pools and gorges such as the Qipujian (Seven Waterfalls) ravine and Jinkeng Gorge. Zeya was long a 'paper mountain' of bamboo-paper makers, and at Siliandui four water-powered trip-hammer mills, first built in the early Ming, stand along a 230 m channel on the Longxi stream as a protected relic of traditional papermaking. The first section opened to visitors in 1990 as the papermaking trade declined.
description: 泽雅位于浙江温州。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1 天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 35 km west of central Wenzhou by road via Zeya town; Siliandui is between Shiqiao and Lin'an villages.

name: 南洞艺谷
summaryEn: A village in a small valley ringed by hills in Xinjian, Ganlan town, in the north of Zhoushan Island, once poor and remote and since redeveloped for rural tourism with an arts theme. Visitors come for its rural scenery, homestays and an old green steam train kept as a photo spot, and it is a stop on a national boutique rural tourism route together with the Ma'ao Museum.
description: 南洞艺谷位于浙江舟山。游览特色包括博物馆、岛屿、田园观光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xinjian village, Ganlan town, about 10 km north of Dinghai by road.

name: 朱家尖南沙
summaryEn: Nansha is one of the five linked sandy beaches, about 6 km in all, that line the east coast of Zhujiajian Island, just south of Mount Putuo across a narrow strait. It is the venue of the Zhoushan International Sand Sculpture Festival, held on the beach each year since around 2000; outside festival time it is an open sandy beach, and the island's coast is also popular for surfing.
description: 朱家尖南沙位于浙江舟山。游览特色包括海滨、岛屿、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the east coast of Zhujiajian Island, linked by bridge to Zhoushan Island, about 15 km by road from Shenjiamen and close to Zhoushan Putuoshan Airport.

name: 东海五渔村
summaryEn: A string of five fishing villages in Wulong township on the east side of Sijiao, the main island of the Shengsi archipelago: Tian'ao, Huangsha, Bianjiao'ao, Huicheng and Shiwuzhi'ao. Bianjiao'ao's houses were painted in bright colours by teachers and students of the China Academy of Art, Huangsha has a village art museum and history hall, and fishermen's paintings, sea-view homestays and seafood are found throughout. It suits a slow day or two of island village life.
description: 东海五渔村位于浙江舟山。游览特色包括博物馆、岛屿、书院文化。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: On Sijiao Island, reached by boat from Shenjiawan pier (with coaches from Hangzhou) or from Sanjiang pier in Dinghai, then by road to Wulong township.

name: 沈家门渔港小镇
summaryEn: Shenjiamen, on the south-east shore of Zhoushan Island, grew up around one of China's largest fishing harbours, sheltered by Lujiazhi Island and long the centre of the Zhoushan fishery. The 4A area takes in the harbour waterfront and the Zhoushan International Seafood Trade Center, where visitors can learn about the fishing industry and buy fresh seafood, and the seafront is known for its open-air seafood restaurants in the evening.
description: 沈家门渔港小镇位于浙江舟山。游览特色包括岛屿、海岸风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shenjiamen, the main town of Putuo district, about 20 km east of Dinghai by road; ferries to Mount Putuo leave from Banshengdong pier in the same town.

name: 白马潭
summaryEn: A riverside scenic area in Shuihou town below the western side of Mount Tianzhu, run mainly for rafting. Bamboo-raft and inflatable-boat trips float down the river valley in summer, and a water-splashing rafting festival has been held there in July.
description: 白马潭位于安徽安庆。游览特色包括山谷、滨水景观、乘船游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shuihou town near the Dongjiawan bridge of the G35 expressway, about 30 km by road north-west of Qianshan city.

name: 大别山彩虹瀑布
summaryEn: A waterfall at Monkey Cliff in Huangwei village, northern Yuexi county, where a stream rising on Baima Peak, the highest summit of the Dabie Mountains, drops nearly 100 metres. Its spray throws up a rainbow on most sunny mornings, which earned the falls a place on China's first national list of weather and climate landscapes; a glass viewing platform faces the falls and boardwalks follow the stream.
description: 大别山彩虹瀑布位于安徽安庆。游览特色包括瀑布、登山观景、观景台。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Huangwei village near the Huangwei exit of the G35 expressway, about 45 km by road north of Yuexi county town.

name: 独秀山
summaryEn: A hill in Huangdun town, Huaining county, from which Chen Duxiu, a founder of the Chinese Communist Party, took his pen name. The scenic area is themed on him: a boardwalk circles the hill past four small pavilions with displays on the stages of his life, and outdoor activity grounds are used by school study groups. Family attractions such as a glass water slide, go-karts and lakeside camping have since been added by the Guanyin Cave reservoir at its foot.
description: 独秀山位于安徽安庆。游览特色包括湖泊、楼阁建筑、洞穴。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Huangdun town, Huaining county, about 35 km by road north-west of central Anqing.

name: 飞旗寨
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area around the peak of Feiqi Zhai in Lianyun township, west of Yuexi county town in the Dabie Mountains. It is best known for wild azaleas that bloom down its cliffs in spring, one of the sights of Yuexi's annual azalea festival in April and May.
description: 飞旗寨位于安徽安庆。游览特色包括山地游览、节庆文化、村寨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Lianyun township, about 10 km by road west of Yuexi county town.

name: 五千年文博园
summaryEn: A modern cultural theme park on the hills at Taihu county town, built to showcase Chinese history and folk art rather than an old site. Its set pieces include a 35-metre statue of Laozi, a 490-metre stone dragon carved with the 47,035 characters of the Kangxi Dictionary, a hillside relief of the Along the River During the Qingming Festival scroll and a hall of more than 27,000 root carvings.
description: 五千年文博园位于安徽安庆。游览特色包括主题游乐、民俗文化、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside the Taihu toll gate of the Shanghai–Chongqing (G50) expressway, about 1.5 hours by road west of Anqing; town buses run there from Taihu South high-speed railway station.

name: 孔城老街
summaryEn: An old market street in Kongcheng town that grew in the Ming and Qing dynasties as a river port between the Chaohu Lake region and the Yangtze. About 3 km long and paved with granite slabs, it winds in an S-shape past grey-brick shops and houses with upturned eaves, the old Tongxiang Academy and the Ni family mansion, built by a late-Qing prefect who retired here; the central sections were restored and partly rebuilt from 2009.
description: 孔城老街位于安徽安庆。游览特色包括湖泊、书院文化、历史宅院。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Kongcheng town, about 12 km east of Tongcheng city, roughly 20 minutes by road, and about 5 km east of Tongcheng East high-speed railway station.

name: 菱湖
summaryEn: Linghu (Water Chestnut Lake) and the gardens around it form a large public park in the centre of Anqing, with pavilions, bridges and lawns along the water. The Huangmei Pavilion in the park hosts performances of Huangmei opera, the regional opera closely tied to Anqing.
description: 菱湖位于安徽安庆。游览特色包括湖泊、园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In central Anqing, about 2 km north of the Zhenfeng Pagoda; a short taxi or bus ride from most of the city.

name: 妙道山
summaryEn: A national forest park high in the Dabie Mountains of western Yuexi county, at the end of the G318 'Cloud Road' drive that also serves Mingtang Mountain and Tianxia Gorge. It is known for its ancient purple willows, locally said to be a thousand years old, set in deep mountain forest.
description: 妙道山位于安徽安庆。游览特色包括峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the mountains about 50 km by road south-west of Yuexi county town, past Hetu town.

name: 明堂山
summaryEn: A three-peaked mountain of the Dabie range in Hetu town, western Yuexi, whose main summit reaches 1,563 m; legend says it is named after the ritual hall (mingtang) set up here when Emperor Wu of Han honoured nearby Mount Tianzhu. A cable car climbs to the summit area, where a glass walkway, glass bridge and glass viewing platforms ring the main peak, and a long slide runs back down. High-altitude azaleas flower in late April and May, and the Huluhe gorge below has a chain of four waterfalls.
description: 明堂山位于安徽安庆。游览特色包括玻璃栈道、登山观景、观景台。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the G318 in Hetu town, about 40 km by road west of Yuexi county town; visitors switch to scenic-area buses at the visitor centre.

name: 青云峡
summaryEn: A river valley in Huangwei town in the Dabie Mountains of northern Yuexi county, developed as a scenic area whose main attraction is summer rafting. It lies about 6 km south of the Dabie Mountains Rainbow Waterfall, so the two can be visited on the same trip.
description: 青云峡位于安徽安庆。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yunfeng village, Huangwei town, south of the Huangwei exit of the G35 expressway and roughly 40 km by road north of Yuexi county town.

name: 石莲洞
summaryEn: A national forest park in the hills on the western edge of Susong county town, named after Shilian (Stone Lotus) Cave. Paths across its four hill areas, Hexi Shan, Fuyu Shan, Yangjiao Jian and Luohan Jian, lead to caves, pools, pavilions and Buddhist temples, among them Lingyin Temple and Dongshan Temple.
description: 石莲洞位于安徽安庆。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the western edge of Susong county town, a short taxi ride from the centre.

name: 天龙关
summaryEn: A narrow, steep-sided gorge in Shuihou village on the western flank of Mount Tianzhu, named for its winding course, likened to a dragon flying up to heaven. It lies beside a pass that in the Ming and Qing was the main way from the Yangtze lowlands into the Dabie Mountains, known locally as the 'First Pass of the Southern Sky'.
description: 天龙关位于安徽安庆。游览特色包括峡谷。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shuihou town, about 30 km by road north-west of Qianshan city. Check that it is open before going.

name: 天峡
summaryEn: A gorge in Hetu town, western Yuexi, on the southern slope of the watershed between the Yangtze and Huai rivers, with nine waterfalls of more than 30 metres along its streams. From late March to May a kilometre-long belt of wild azaleas flowers along a ridge above 600 metres, drawing big spring crowds, and the scenic area has a glass walkway.
description: 天峡位于安徽安庆。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Off the G318 in Hetu town, near the Hetu expressway exit, about 45 km by road west of Yuexi county town.

name: 天仙峡
summaryEn: A mountain gorge in Tianzhu village, Shuihou town, close to the main Mount Tianzhu scenic area, opened in 2018 as a leisure area of streams, pools and highland village scenery. When it opened its attractions included a 1.6 km glass water slide, a flower valley and fountains.
description: 天仙峡位于安徽安庆。游览特色包括峡谷、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the Tianzhu Mountain ring road in Shuihou town, north-west of Qianshan city, about 40 minutes by road.

name: 天悦湾
summaryEn: A hot-spring and wellness resort in Yuexi county town, built around a hot-spring park with a cluster of hotels. It also has a sports and culture centre, a traditional Chinese medicine clinic and a branch of the Anhui Provincial Library, and is used by workers' unions in Anhui and Shanghai for rest-and-recuperation stays. It suits a soak after walking in the Dabie Mountains.
description: 岳西县城的温泉度假区围绕温泉公园布局，周边配有休闲和住宿设施。
accessEn: On the edge of Yuexi county town, a few minutes by taxi from the centre.

name: 天柱大峡谷
summaryEn: A steep valley on the south-eastern side of Mount Tianzhu, next to the main peak area, where a stream drops more than 200 metres through a chain of waterfalls; the highest, Tongtian Falls, falls about 100 metres. It was rated a national 4A scenic area in December 2024.
description: 天柱大峡谷位于安徽安庆。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Off the Tianzhu Mountain ring road, about 15 km by road north-west of Qianshan city.

name: 大龙山乌龙溪
summaryEn: A wooded stream valley on the south-eastern side of Dalong Mountain National Forest Park, in the hills just north of Anqing city. About 4 km of looped walking trails run through the forest past the old Yuanzhao Temple, and the scenic area has added a glass bridge and a coloured toboggan slide; the forest farm has held an orange-season festival in autumn.
description: 大龙山乌龙溪位于安徽安庆。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Yangqiao town in Yixiu District, about 12 km north of central Anqing, roughly 30 minutes by road.

name: 嬉子湖
summaryEn: A natural lake and wetland scenic area in Xizihu town, south-east Tongcheng, covering about 71 km², more than half of it water. Along with lakeside wetland walks it offers fishing, a resort hotel, a camping ground, boat and jet-ski rides, go-karts and other family amusements. In winter large flocks of migratory birds, including spoonbills and swan geese, gather on the shores.
description: 嬉子湖位于安徽安庆。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xizihu town, about 25 km south-east of Tongcheng city, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 禾泉农庄
summaryEn: A farm-based leisure park on the western outskirts of Bengbu, founded in 2001, that mixes seasonal flower fields and fruit picking with restaurants, a hotel and guesthouses, children's rides and a row of workshops where sesame oil, vinegar and dendrobium liquor are made in front of visitors. It also stages folk performances such as Huagudeng (flower-drum lantern) dance and seasonal events like music festivals and a farmers' market, and suits families looking for a day out rather than sightseeing.
description: 禾泉农庄位于安徽蚌埠。游览特色包括花卉观赏、农业体验、音乐文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Donghai Avenue in Yuhui District, about 13 km west of central Bengbu, roughly 30 minutes by road.

name: 亳州博物馆
summaryEn: The city museum of Bozhou, founded in 1959 and now a national second-grade museum, in a Han-style building among trees. Its permanent exhibition, 'Through Five Thousand Years', follows the city's history from early cultures on the Guo River and the Shang capital of Bo through the age of Laozi and Zhuangzi and the Han–Wei era of Cao Cao and Hua Tuo to the merchant town of later centuries. It stands beside Cao Cao Park, around which some of the excavated tombs of Cao Cao's clan lie.
description: 亳州市博物馆是位于中华人民共和国安徽省亳州市谯城区的一座博物馆，成立于1959年10月1日。博物馆占地面积2.5万平方米，建筑面积5,200平方米，室内陈列面积2,800平方米，主要展示亳州文化相关历史展览。
accessEn: On Shaohua Road beside Cao Cao Park in southern central Bozhou, about 2.5 km south of the old city. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 林拥城
summaryEn: A forest park on the south-western edge of Bozhou laid out around a reservoir, also known as Yaodu Linhai, the 'forest sea of the medicine capital', after the city's role as a centre of the herbal-medicine trade. Besides woodland walks it has a botanical garden, family attractions and a virtual-reality 'metaverse' hall.
description: 林拥城位于安徽亳州。游览特色包括森林公园、水库、植物园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Off Bowu Avenue on the south-western edge of Bozhou, about 13 km from the old city.

name: 蒙城博物馆
summaryEn: The county museum of Mengcheng, home county of the philosopher Zhuangzi, opened in 2014 and now a national third-grade museum. Its main gallery presents the Neolithic village excavated at Yuchisi, 20 km north-east of the town, including the large pottery zun jars for which the site is known, some incised with early symbols; other galleries cover ancient Mengcheng, the local tradition of couplet writing and local role models.
description: 蒙城博物馆位于安徽亳州。游览特色包括博物馆、陶瓷工艺。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At the junction of Zhuangzi Avenue and Renhe Road in the south of Mengcheng town.

name: 南京巷钱庄
summaryEn: A Qing-dynasty qianzhuang, a traditional private bank and money-changer, on Nanjing Lane in the old northern quarter of Bozhou, a few minutes' walk from Huaxilou. Its grey-brick courtyard buildings, a national heritage site since 2013, can be visited.
description: 南京巷钱庄位于安徽亳州。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、历史建筑。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Nanjing Lane in the old northern quarter of Bozhou, about 300 m south-east of Huaxilou.

name: 天静宫
summaryEn: A Taoist temple at Zhengdian village on the northern outskirts of Guoyang, on the spot that local tradition, recorded in Yuan- and Ming-dynasty steles, names as the birthplace of Laozi, the founder of Taoism. Long ruined, the temple site has been excavated and the temple rebuilt, and the cycle of Laozi legends told around it is listed as national intangible cultural heritage.
description: 天静宫位于安徽亳州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、名人故居、非遗文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Zhengdian village, about 6 km north of Guoyang town.

name: 大王洞
summaryEn: A 10 km² karst scenic area in Paifang town on the south bank of the Yangtze, Chizhou's first 4A site, built around the Dawang Cave, whose name was written by the calligrapher and Buddhist leader Zhao Puchu. Besides the cave it takes in a natural stone bridge, the Linyu Gorge, Dawang Lake and a cable car over the countryside.
description: 大王洞位于安徽池州。游览特色包括峡谷、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Paifang town, Guichi District, about 40 km by road from both Chizhou and Anqing and 13 km from the Yinjiahui exit of the G50 expressway.

name: 怪潭
summaryEn: A whitewater rafting run of about 4.5 km on a mountain river, taking around an hour and a half through three sets of rapids, six river bends and five clear pools between forested hills. The wider Guaitan scenic area at Diaoyutai in Hengdu town also has a valley of oddly shaped boulders, a wildlife specimen hall and forest walks, and in spring some 20 kinds of azalea flower along the banks.
description: 怪潭位于安徽池州。游览特色包括山谷、林地风光、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Diaoyutai in Hengdu town, about 15 km by road south-east of Shitai town.

name: 九华神龙谷
summaryEn: A wooded gorge about 3 km long on the southern side of Mount Jiuhua, cut by streams from Pusatou and Loutai hills and known locally as 'nine drops and eighteen bends'. A path follows the stream past a chain of waterfalls, deep pools and boulders with names such as Shenlong Falls and Bathing Immortal Pool.
description: 九华神龙谷位于安徽池州。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside the Jiuhua–Huangshan road in Lingyang town on the south side of Mount Jiuhua, roughly half an hour's drive from Jiuhua Street.

name: 九子岩
summaryEn: A rocky mountain area on the eastern side of the Jiuhua range that gave Mount Jiuhua its old name, Jiuzi ('Nine Sons') Mountain, and is regarded as the cradle of Buddhism there: among its relics is the spot where Kim Gyo-gak, later venerated as Ksitigarbha, first practised. Paths and a cable car lead up through pines, oddly shaped rocks, waterfalls and steep peaks.
description: 九子岩位于安徽池州。游览特色包括瀑布、缆车观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhubei town on the east side of the Jiuhua range, about 15 km by road south of Qingyang town.

name: 莲峰云海
summaryEn: A scenic area on Lianhua (Lotus) Peak (1,048 m) at the northern foot of the Jiuhua range, named for the seas of cloud often seen from the summit; the peak's shape also earns it the name Brush-Rest Mountain. Paths lead past rock caves, the stone-built Jingxin Temple of 1480 and the gate of a Taiping-era hill fort, and the scenic area has a hotel and a folk museum showing Qingyang farmers' paintings and farm tools.
description: 莲峰云海位于安徽池州。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Baihua village, Rongcheng town, a few kilometres south-west of Qingyang town and about 2 km from Jiuhuashan station on the Chizhou–Huangshan high-speed railway.

name: 蓬莱仙洞
summaryEn: A large limestone cave more than 3,000 m long near Ducun, the home village of the late-Tang poet Du Xunhe, formed on four levels: upper, middle and lower caves and an underground river. Its best-known formations are a white 'gauze curtain', fine 'heavenly threads', a wall like a landscape painting and a 'thousand-Buddha hill'; the cave reopened in March 2025 after a lighting upgrade that added projected light shows to several formations.
description: 蓬莱仙洞位于安徽池州。游览特色包括洞穴、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Ducun in Renli town, about 6 km east of Shitai town by road.

name: 秀山门博物馆
summaryEn: A private museum of traditional Chinese building crafts, opened in 2006 in the gate tower and walls of Xiushan Gate, the west gate of old Chizhou, which took its present name in 1235 in memory of Xiao Tong, the Liang-dynasty Crown Prince Zhaoming. Its halls are fitted out with carved wooden doors and windows, brackets, stone drums and lions, brick carvings and inscribed boards gathered from old buildings, alongside porcelain, paintings and embroidery.
description: 秀山门博物馆位于安徽池州。游览特色包括博物馆、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the old town on the western side of central Chizhou.

name: 鱼龙洞
summaryEn: A limestone cave in Qidu town named for the way it winds under the hill like a coiled dragon; its mouth, about 8 m wide and 5 m high and shaped like a crocodile's open jaws, is hung with stalactites above a clear pool that never dries. Inside, the air stays at an even temperature all year, and since a 2025 upgrade visitors ride track-guided dragon boats along the underground water past projected light shows.
description: 鱼龙洞位于安徽池州。游览特色包括洞穴、钟乳石、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Qidu town in eastern Shitai county, roughly an hour by road from Shitai town.

name: 醉山野
summaryEn: A scenic area in Yuanxi village just outside Shitai town with two parts. Huangya Grand Canyon is a wooded gorge of small dams, green pools and stepped falls fitted with a zip line over 300 m long, a glass bridge and a 'shouting fountain'; Ciyun Cave, opened in 2018, is a karst cave of stalagmites, stalactites, columns and flowstone curtains.
description: 醉山野位于安徽池州。游览特色包括峡谷、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yuanxi village, Renli town, about 5 km from Shitai town and close to the Shitai exit of the G3W expressway.

name: 池杉湖
summaryEn: A national wetland park in south-eastern Lai'an County on the border with Nanjing's Luhe District, named for the pond cypresses (Taxodium) that grow in its lake and form a flooded forest. The trees and open water are a gathering place for water birds, and the park was rated 4A in 2023.
description: 池杉湖位于安徽滁州。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km south-east of Lai'an town by road.

name: 皇甫山
summaryEn: A range of forested hills in Nanqiao District, west of Chuzhou, protected as a national forest park, with a provincial nature reserve named after it in the same hills. Rated 4A in 2023, it is a place for woodland walks rather than sights.
description: 皇甫山位于安徽滁州。游览特色包括森林公园、自然保护区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 35 km west of central Chuzhou by road.

name: 韭山洞
summaryEn: A large limestone cave in the Jiushan hills of Yinjian town in southern Fengyang County, inside the Jiushan National Forest Park and rated 4A in 2020. Old accounts say it could shelter several thousand people, and in the Southern Song the general Wang Weizhong built stone walls around it as a stronghold against the Jin, whose stockade site is a protected relic.
description: 韭山洞位于安徽滁州。游览特色包括洞穴、森林公园。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yinjian town, about 35 km south of Fengyang town by road.

name: 狼巷迷谷
summaryEn: A karst scenic area in Fengyang County where narrow, winding passages cut through limestone form a natural maze, some so tight that visitors have to turn sideways or stoop to get through. Boardwalks link the maze with a cave and a Buddhist temple in the same hills, and it has been rated 4A since 2007.
description: 狼巷迷谷位于安徽滁州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、喀斯特地貌、洞穴。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yinjian town, about 30 km south of Fengyang town by road and a few kilometres east of Jiushan Cave. Check that it is open before going.

name: 龙岗古镇
summaryEn: Longgang, now part of Tongcheng town in northern Tianchang, is an old market town where the Eighth Branch of the Communist-led Anti-Japanese Military and Political University (Kangda) ran its school from the autumn of 1941 to the spring of 1944. The former school buildings in the town are protected as provincial heritage, and a memorial hall presents the school's history.
description: 龙岗古镇位于安徽滁州。游览特色包括古镇、纪念展览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tongcheng town, northern Tianchang, roughly 30 km north of Tianchang city by road.

name: 迪沟
summaryEn: A rural scenic area in Digou town, Yingshang County, made up of an ecological park that keeps peacocks, water birds, swans, parrots and monkeys among collections of rare plants, the Buddhist Zhuyin Temple and a culture square. It is mainly a day out for local families.
description: 迪沟位于安徽阜阳。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、佛教文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Digou town, about 25 km north-east of Yingshang county town by road.

name: 枫柏岗
summaryEn: A rural lotus and wetland park near the seat of Dicheng town in southern Funan County, close to the Huai River. Its centrepiece is a lotus garden of about 400 mu (27 ha) crossed by boardwalks, pavilions and arched bridges, best when the lotuses flower in summer, with farm-style restaurants nearby.
description: 枫柏岗位于安徽阜阳。游览特色包括湿地、园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Dicheng town, about 15 km south of Funan county town by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 阜阳生态乐园
summaryEn: A large leisure park on the north-western edge of Fuyang that mixes farm-style sightseeing with family entertainment. Its sections include a culture garden on Ouyang Xiu and Su Shi, two Song writers linked with old Yingzhou (Fuyang), a tropical plant house, a pick-your-own orchard, a dinosaur park, a zoo and a children's amusement area with a Ferris wheel.
description: 阜阳生态乐园位于安徽阜阳。游览特色包括动物观赏、果园、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the north-western edge of Fuyang near Beijing West Road and the West Third Ring Road, a taxi ride from the city centre.

name: 金种子文化产业园
summaryEn: The visitor park of the Jinzhongzi (Golden Seed) baijiu company in southern Fuyang, whose distillery grew from the Fuyang County liquor works founded in 1949. It presents the company's brewing heritage, including fermentation pits the company dates to the Ming dynasty, alongside landscaped grounds, and suits visitors curious about Chinese liquor.
description: 金种子文化产业园位于安徽阜阳。游览特色包括历史建筑、酿造文化、休闲公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yingzhou District near Lianhua Road, a taxi ride from central Fuyang. Check that it is open before going.

name: 魔幻之都
summaryEn: A tourism complex on the west bank of the Liu'an River in western Linquan, themed on the 'Investiture of the Gods' legends of the Shang–Zhou period. It groups a Nezha-themed water park, a large zoo, a 'Fengshen' fantasy valley, a craft street, a theatre and a hotel. The zoo stages animal shows, such as sea lion and bird performances, and offers animal feeding.
description: 魔幻之都位于安徽阜阳。游览特色包括动物观赏、水上游乐、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the western side of Linquan county town, about 60 km west of Fuyang by road.

name: 明清苑
summaryEn: A compound of Ming- and Qing-style courtyard buildings, including houses, a temple and an opera stage, beside the riverside park in Yingshang county town, a short walk from Guanzhong Old Street. Although it lies about 9 km north of the Bali River park, it is promoted as one of that scenic area's five sections, and local tourism material calls it the largest group of buildings in this style in northern Anhui.
description: 明清苑位于安徽阜阳。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、滨水景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jiangxinzhou Riverside Park in Yingshang county town, about 1.5 km from Guanzhong Old Street.

name: 太和嘉年华游乐园
summaryEn: An amusement park beside the Shaying River at Taihe, about 500 m west of the river's third bridge, whose rides include the 'Eye of Taihe' Ferris wheel, a roller coaster, a log flume and a water-play area. It is aimed at local families.
description: 太和嘉年华游乐园位于安徽阜阳。游览特色包括主题游乐、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the south bank of the Shaying River by Taihe county town, about 40 km north-west of Fuyang by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 尤家花园·五里湖湿地公园
summaryEn: A private garden begun in the late Qing beside Wuli Lake on the western edge of Yingshang town, together with the wetland park around the lake. The garden, ringed by water, is laid out in the Suzhou manner with rockeries, small bridges, pavilions, shaped pines and potted landscapes, and is nicknamed the 'Yu Garden of northern Anhui'; the wetland park adds lakeside paths for walking.
description: 尤家花园·五里湖湿地公园位于安徽阜阳。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Wuli Lake on the western edge of Yingshang county town, about 15 minutes by road from the centre.

name: 安徽省美术馆
summaryEn: Anhui's provincial art museum, opened in May 2022 on the north shore of Chao Lake in Hefei's Binhu New District, beside the Yangtze River Crossing Campaign Memorial Museum. The five-storey white steel-framed building of 50,000 m² has galleries of up to 2,000 m², a spiral staircase and a 70-metre suspension walkway, and shows changing exhibitions.
description: 安徽省美术馆位于安徽合肥。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Chengdu Road about 18 km south of central Hefei, less than 1 km south-west of Dujiang Jinianguan station on Metro Line 5.

name: 半汤郁金香高地
summaryEn: A hillside flower park in the Chaohu Economic Development Zone near the Bantang hot springs, east of Chaohu city. Its slopes are planted with tulip fields, which are at their best in April, so it is mainly worth a visit in spring.
description: 半汤郁金香高地位于安徽合肥。游览特色包括温泉、花卉观赏。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Near Bantang, east of Chaohu city, about 75 km east of central Hefei by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 包公故里文化园
summaryEn: A culture park opened in 2023 in Baogong town, Feidong County, where Bao Zheng, the Song official remembered as Judge Bao, was born and grew up. Laid out in Song style, it presents his life through three staged drama shows, a mystery game, a holographic theatre and craft activities. It includes the Huayuan Well, by tradition the well of the Bao family garden.
description: 包公故里文化园位于安徽合肥。游览特色包括园林景观、戏剧演艺。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Baogong town, Feidong County, about 40 km east of central Hefei by road.

name: 长临古街
summaryEn: The old street of Changlinhe, a town near the north shore of Chao Lake in Feidong County, lined with traditional houses and shops. Its Qing buildings include the provincially listed Wu family residence, a three-courtyard house in central-Anhui style, and the Liujiafan old houses and the Zhenhu Pagoda of 1892 stand a few kilometres to the south by the lake.
description: 长临古街位于安徽合肥。游览特色包括湖泊、古塔。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Changlinhe town, Feidong County, about 30 km south-east of central Hefei by road.

name: 大圩
summaryEn: A farming town on the south-eastern outskirts of Hefei developed for farm tourism, where city residents come to pick seasonal fruit and vegetables and to fish. It makes an easy half-day outing from the city, best in the fruit-picking seasons.
description: 大圩位于安徽合肥。游览特色包括农业体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 13 km south-east of central Hefei by road.

name: 金孔雀温泉度假村
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort with accommodation in Tangchi, a spa town in western Lujiang County and one of the two hot-spring areas around Chao Lake. It suits a relaxing overnight stay.
description: 金孔雀温泉度假村位于安徽合肥。游览特色包括温泉、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tangchi town, Lujiang County, about 70 km south-west of central Hefei by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 官亭林海
summaryEn: A large planted forest park on the Yangtze–Huai watershed at Guanting town in Feixi County, centred on Fengxiang Lake. A landmark on its eastern side marks the divide, where rain runs south-east to the Yangtze or north-west to the Huai, and a viewing platform in the middle of the forest looks over groves of red maple, cherry, plum, magnolia and crabapple, a rose garden and more than ten lotus ponds around the lake.
description: 官亭林海位于安徽合肥。游览特色包括森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Guanting town, Feixi County, about 40 km west of central Hefei by road.

name: 合柴1972
summaryEn: A creative and leisure quarter opened in 2019 in the former Hefei Diesel Engine Factory, which started work in 1972 and whose site was later used as a prison until 2018. Watchtowers, domed workshops, a chimney and red-brick buildings have been kept and now house the Hefei Home Appliance Story Museum, a contemporary art museum, cafés and shops.
description: 合柴1972位于安徽合肥。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Jinzhai South Road in Baohe District, about 8 km south-west of central Hefei.

name: 合肥融创乐园
summaryEn: A large theme park in Hefei's Binhu New District, built as Wanda's Hefei park and now run by Sunac, with themed zones, rides and live shows. Rides include Soaring with Dragon, an Intamin launched roller coaster opened in 2016 that reaches 125 km/h, and the park suits families and thrill-ride fans, with a shopping mall next door.
description: 合肥融创乐园位于安徽合肥。游览特色包括主题游乐、购物街区。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: On Luzhou Avenue in Binhu New District, about 18 km south of central Hefei, by taxi.

name: 合肥野生动物园
summaryEn: Hefei's main zoo, a wildlife park on Wangjiang West Road at the foot of Dashu Mountain on the western edge of the city. It suits families and can be combined with a walk up neighbouring Dashu Mountain forest park.
description: 合肥野生动物园位于安徽合肥。游览特色包括森林公园、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 12 km west of central Hefei, by bus or taxi.

name: 徽园
summaryEn: A theme park of gardens opened in September 2001 in Hefei's economic development zone, with about 45 sights; pavilions and gardens represent each of Anhui's cities, such as the Hefei and Lu'an gardens. It gives a quick overview of the province's regional architecture without leaving the city.
description: 徽园位于安徽合肥。游览特色包括主题游乐、园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Fanhua Avenue about 10 km south-west of central Hefei, by bus or taxi.

name: 三十岗
summaryEn: A rural township of orchards and farmland on Hefei's north-western edge, developed for farm tourism with seasonal activities such as blossom viewing and fruit picking. The Three Kingdoms Xincheng Site Park lies within the township.
description: 三十岗位于安徽合肥。游览特色包括果园、田园观光、赏花。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km north-west of central Hefei by road.

name: 祥源花世界
summaryEn: A modern flower-themed resort park built around Tanchong Lake at Shangpai town in Feixi County, south-west of Hefei. Themed gardens and seasonal flower fields are combined with children's play areas, boating and camping, and in early May it has hosted the Hefei Rose Season. It suits a family outing.
description: 祥源花世界位于安徽合肥。游览特色包括湖泊、花卉观赏、乘船游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside Jinzhai South Road at Shangpai town, about 25 km south-west of central Hefei by road.

name: 小井庄
summaryEn: A small village in Shannan town, Feixi County, whose 32-household production team secretly divided its farmland among households on 5 September 1978, during a severe drought, an early case of the household contract system that spread through China's rural reforms. A memorial stone at the village entrance marks it as a birthplace of household contracting, a title more often given to Xiaogang village, which followed three months later.
description: 小井庄位于安徽合肥。游览特色包括名人故居、田园观光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shannan town, Feixi County, about 50 km south-west of central Hefei by road.

name: 冶父山
summaryEn: A wooded hill north-east of Lujiang town, protected as a national forest park and named, by legend, after the swordsmith Ou Yezi, who is said to have forged swords here. Its two Buddhist temples frame the walk: Shiji Temple at the foot of the mountain and Fuhu Temple on the summit.
description: 冶父山位于安徽合肥。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 9 km north-east of Lujiang town, which is about 65 km south of central Hefei by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 紫微洞
summaryEn: A limestone cave in the hills on the northern edge of Chaohu city, also called Shuangjing ('Twin Wells') Cave after its two shaft-like openings, about 3 km long with a main passage of some 1.5 km along an underground river. The scenic area also contains Wangqiao Cave, whose walls carry more than 620 carved Buddhist figures, almost all of them now headless.
description: 紫微洞位于安徽合肥。游览特色包括洞穴、佛教文化、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 4 km north of Chaohu city centre, which is about 60 km south-east of central Hefei.

name: 南湖
summaryEn: Nanhu (South Lake) is a lake and wetland park in Huaibei's Lieshan district, created on land that subsided above coal workings and part of the chain of reclaimed lakes that now runs through the city. Paths and 45 decorative bridges link 22 viewpoints around the water, which draws water birds. A monument to the first borehole of the Huaibei coalfield stands in the lake as a reminder of the city's mining past.
description: 南湖位于安徽淮北。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the southern side of Huaibei city, about 6 km from the centre by road.

name: 四季榴园
summaryEn: Sijiliuyuan is a rural scenic area in the hills of Lieshan district, built around more than 1,000 mu of pomegranate orchards surviving from the Ming and Qing, in an area where pomegranates have been grown since at least the Song and Yuan. It links the old orchards, the China Pomegranate Museum with more than 500 exhibits, and the Longji Tianlu scenic mountain road, with a ski slope opened in the winter of 2024–25, camping and children's play areas. Autumn, when the fruit is picked and a pomegranate festival is held, is the best time to come.
description: 四季榴园位于安徽淮北。游览特色包括博物馆、果园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Lieshan town on the south-eastern side of Huaibei, roughly half an hour by road from the city centre.

name: 濉溪古城
summaryEn: Suixi Ancient Town is a leisure district in Suixi county town, home of the Kouzi liquor brand, that joins Qianlong Lake park to an old-style shopping quarter. The lake area of about 2,550 mu has four boat piers and the Huili Pavilion lookout, and the 283 m South Street links it to a canal-side street lined with liquor workshops, silversmiths and long-established shops. It suits an evening stroll and local food.
description: 濉溪古城位于安徽淮北。游览特色包括古镇、古城、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Suixi county town, about 8 km south of central Huaibei by road.

name: 相山公园
summaryEn: Xiangshan Park covers the southern slopes of Xiangshan, a hill on the northern edge of central Huaibei that was one of the eight views of old Suzhou prefecture. Among its 18 sights are Xiantong Temple, founded under the Jin dynasty (265–420) and with Qing buildings and 22 steles from the Song to the Qing, along with springs, caves, Yinma Pool and the Zouming Terrace. During the Huaihai Campaign of 1948 the Communist commander Su Yu held a meeting of senior officers at the temple.
description: 相山公园位于安徽淮北。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the northern edge of central Huaibei, a short taxi ride from the city centre.

name: 安徽楚文化博物馆
summaryEn: Shou County's museum, founded in 1958, reopened in 2022 in a new 15,000 m² building as the Anhui Chu Culture Museum, inside the Shouchun City National Archaeological Site Park on the site of the capital the state of Chu moved to in 241 BC. Displays include Chu bronzes, a pile of 158 Chu gold coins, a bronze sword of a king of Yue and a recreated chariot-pit excavation. Visitors enter along a 40-metre glass walkway over a layer of Warring States roof-tile rubble found during building work.
description: 安徽楚文化博物馆位于安徽淮南。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位、国家一级博物馆。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 2 km south-east of Shou County old town, about 25 km west of central Huainan by road; closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 焦岗湖影视城
summaryEn: A large outdoor film set beside Jiaogang Lake, built as a backlot of walled mansions, farm courtyards, an old railway station and locomotive, trenches, an old hospital, a people's commune hall and dormitories for 'sent-down' youth. Parts of the CCTV drama Six Sisters were filmed here, and on holidays the base stages short live shows in its streets during the day and fire performances in the evening.
description: 焦岗湖影视城位于安徽淮南。游览特色包括湖泊、影视拍摄、影视文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Maoji Experimental Zone near Jiaogang Lake, about 40 km west of central Huainan by road and about 2 km from Fengtai South station on the Shangqiu–Hefei–Hangzhou high-speed railway.

name: 上窑国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park of about 30 wooded hills and 10.4 km² in Huainan's Datong District, near Shangyao town, one of the centres of the Tang-dynasty Shouzhou kilns. Paths lead to the Buddhist Dongshan Temple, a Ksitigarbha hall, a release pond and the exhibition hall of a New Fourth Army memorial forest.
description: 上窑国家森林公园位于安徽淮南。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km north-east of central Huainan by road.

name: 打鼓岭
summaryEn: A deep wooded gorge on the Dagu stream in Meixi township, in the mountains of Yi county, where a path climbs through bamboo forest past clear pools such as the Fairy Pool, a 'water-curtain cave' behind a falling spring and the three-tiered Sandie waterfall. Steep boardwalks lead on to a pavilion on the ridge at about 1,200 m, where visitors beat a drum that echoes round the valley.
description: 打鼓岭位于安徽黄山。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Miaolin village, Meixi township, about an hour by winding mountain road from the Yi county town.

name: 东黄山度假区
summaryEn: A resort area on the Huangshan Tea Farm at Tanjiaqiao, a state farm that has been run by Shanghai since 1965 and to which large numbers of young people from Shanghai were sent to work in the 1960s and 1970s. Since 2003 Shanghai's Bright Food group has turned the farm into a tourist area with hotels and tea gardens, and its 'educated youth town' recreates Shanghai lanes and shikumen-style houses, with themes drawn from the farm's sent-down past, Shanghai culture and tea.
description: 东黄山度假区位于安徽黄山。游览特色包括园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside the G205 in Tanjiaqiao town, the town of Huangshan's new eastern gate, close to the Tanjiaqiao exit of the G3 expressway.

name: 芙蓉谷
summaryEn: A forested gorge on the northern side of Huangshan, where a stream runs through bamboo groves past a chain of green pools and waterfalls. Alongside the natural scenery the valley has been fitted out with family attractions, including a 500 m glass water slide, a 2,170 m mountain coaster, a 400 m zip line and a 'sky mirror' viewing platform looking towards the Huangshan peaks.
description: 芙蓉谷位于安徽黄山。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Fucun village, Gengcheng town, Huangshan district, near the northern foot of Huangshan.

name: 牯牛降观音堂
summaryEn: The Qimen entrance to Guniujiang, a forested range on the border of Qimen and Shitai counties that continues the Huangshan mountains westwards, rising to 1,727.6 m and protected as a nature reserve since 1982, now a national nature reserve of about 67 km². Of the five scenic areas usually listed for the range, Guanyintang is the only one in Qimen; the other four are reached from Shitai county in Chizhou.
description: 牯牛降观音堂位于安徽黄山。游览特色包括自然保护区、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Off provincial road S221 in Likou town, northern Qimen, about an hour by road north-west of the Qimen county town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 历溪
summaryEn: An old village in Likou town in northern Qimen, founded in the Southern Tang among tea hills on the Shunxi stream, which rises on the Guniujiang mountains. A bamboo grove, an old bridge and a grove of old trees with an ancient camphor mark the village entrance; the Heyi Hall and the village's other Ming and Qing buildings are protected at provincial level, and a gorge, the Lixi Grand Canyon, lies nearby.
description: 历溪位于安徽黄山。游览特色包括峡谷、古树、传统村落。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Lixi village, Likou town, about an hour by road north-west of the Qimen county town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 黎阳in巷
summaryEn: A leisure quarter on the old Liyang street across the Heng River from Tunxi Old Street, redeveloped between 2007 and 2013 around the original street plan and about ten restored Huizhou houses, with new buildings around them. It is filled with bookshops, guesthouses, bars and craft workshops, and in 2022 it was named one of China's first national tourist and leisure quarters.
description: 黎阳in巷又称黎阳老街、黎阳水巷，是一处旅游休闲街区，位于中国安徽省黄山市屯溪区三江口的黎阳镇一侧，与屯溪老街隔横江相望，通过镇海桥联通。黎阳老街本是千年古镇，在屯溪市中心的对岸，拥有石家大院、李氏医寓、贾家大院等百年老宅，为黄山市文物保护单位。
accessEn: In Liyang on the west bank of the Heng River in central Tunxi, across Zhenhai Bridge from Tunxi Old Street.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 祥源祁红产业文化博览园
summaryEn: A tea park devoted to Keemun (Qimen) black tea on the eastern edge of the Qimen county town, built by the Xiangyuan group in new Huizhou-style buildings. It combines a Keemun tea museum of seven halls, a demonstration factory whose production lines can be watched from walkways, a centre where visitors can try hand-making the tea, and a garden of tea varieties; the park is a stop on the county's 'red and black' tea route launched in 2024.
description: 祥源祁红产业文化博览园位于安徽黄山。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Guniujiang Avenue a few kilometres east of the centre of the Qimen county town, about 70 km west of Tunxi by road.

name: 谢裕大茶文化博物馆
