summaryEn: The museum of Xieyuda, a producer of Huangshan Maofeng green tea that takes its name from the Shanghai tea house of the 19th-century Huizhou merchant Xie Zheng'an, set in the company's tea expo park at Qiankou. Its displays trace the history of Huangshan Maofeng and of Huizhou's tea merchants, and the surrounding park has tea gardens of nearly 2,000 mu (about 130 hectares) and a rainbow slide.
description: 谢裕大茶文化博物馆位于安徽黄山。游览特色包括博物馆、茶文化、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On East Xieyuda Road at Qiankou, Huizhou district, about 20 km north of Tunxi by road.

name: 新安江山水画廊
summaryEn: A stretch of the Xin'an River of roughly 50 km through southern Shexian, between steep green hills dotted with Huizhou villages and old wharves, usually seen on boat trips from Shendu. Stops along the way include thousand-year-old camphor trees and the river villages of Jiusha and Miantan, and the banks are bright with rapeseed and azaleas in spring and with coloured leaves in autumn.
description: 新安江山水画廊位于安徽黄山。游览特色包括乘船游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Boats leave from Shendu town on the Xin'an River, about 30 km south-east of Shexian county town by road.

name: 新安江滨水旅游区
summaryEn: A stretch of the Xin'an River on the eastern side of Tunxi whose banks, once lined with wharves, have been landscaped as riverside parks for walking. Boat trips run on the river, including evening cruises to see the waterfront and the lit-up bridges.
description: 新安江滨水旅游区位于安徽黄山。游览特色包括滨水景观、乘船游览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the Xin'an River in eastern Tunxi, about 6 km downstream from Tunxi Old Street.

name: 梦幻海洋大世界
summaryEn: Anhui Dream Ocean World is a commercial indoor aquarium of about 10,000 m² in the Zhedong trade centre in central Lu'an, opened by private investors as a marine-life exhibition and science-education venue. It suits families with children looking for a couple of hours indoors.
description: 梦幻海洋大世界位于安徽六安。游览特色包括水族展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In central Lu'an near the junction of Jiefang Road and Dabieshan Road, a short taxi ride from the city centre.

name: 大别山风情谷
summaryEn: Fengqing Valley is a forested valley scenic area in Hongshan village, next to the Dabieshan Grottoes, with a narrow rock cleft, waterfalls dropping into a lake, a stream with sandy banks, bamboo groves and a stand of nanmu trees. Local curiosities include coffins wedged in cliff crevices, old cave dwellings and the ruins of Taiping stockade, and an opera stage puts on Lu opera and local folk songs. It makes a summer outing for walkers from Lu'an.
description: 大别山风情谷位于安徽六安。游览特色包括石窟造像、瀑布、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhangdian town, about 37 km south of Lu'an by road.

name: 大别山石窟
summaryEn: The Dabieshan Grottoes are natural rock shelters and caves, not carved shrines, in a wooded scenic area with a 15 km² core in Hongshan village, part of the Dabie Mountains (Lu'an) National Geopark. The best known, Changyan Cave, was shaped by water, weathering and rockfall; other curiosities are coffins set in cliff niches, old cave dwellings and the ruins of earthen hill forts. The Tianfo Chan Temple, a late-Yuan foundation once called Jiulong Tang whose ruins remain on the summit of Hongshanzhai, has been rebuilt with a gate hall, a Heavenly Kings hall and a main hall.
description: 大别山石窟位于安徽六安。游览特色包括石窟造像、寺庙建筑、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhangdian town, about 37 km south of Lu'an by road.

name: 大湾村
summaryEn: Dawan is a tea-growing mountain village in Huashi township whose 2.5 km² scenic area combines tea gardens, farm guesthouses and a group of twelve ancient sandalwood trees with sites of the revolutionary period. Preserved buildings include the former office of the Communist Party's Anhui Provincial Work Committee and the former local soviet government and clinic. A folk museum displays Dabie farming tools, household goods and costume, and the village runs a rafting route.
description: 大湾村位于安徽六安。游览特色包括博物馆、茶文化、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Huashi township, roughly 1.5 hours by road south of Jinzhai county town.

name: 东石笋
summaryEn: Dongshisun is a hill scenic area south of Maotanchang town whose slopes are built of stacked slabs of metamorphic rock, rising to just over 760 m. Its namesake is a free-standing rock pillar about 38 m tall, left where two faults meet and the surrounding rock collapsed. Paths lead past waterfalls, quartz-strewn slopes, pavilions and a small temple.
description: 东石笋位于安徽六安。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 9 km south of Maotanchang town, roughly an hour by road south of Lu'an.

name: 独山革命旧址群
summaryEn: Dushan is a market town in the Dabie foothills where a Communist-led uprising broke out in 1929, in the years when the Hubei–Henan–Anhui Soviet base was being formed. Along its old street, now branded 'Soviet City', a group of buildings including the uprising's headquarters is preserved and presented as a museum complex. Together with separate sites in Jinzhai County farther west, it forms part of the national heritage listing for the former Hubei–Henan–Anhui revolutionary base area.
description: 独山革命旧址群位于安徽六安。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 40 km south-west of central Lu'an by road.

name: 横排头
summaryEn: Hengpaitou, on the Pi River at Subu town, is the head of the Pi River main canal of the Pishihang irrigation district, a large scheme serving farmland in Anhui and Henan. The scenic area takes in the canal head on the river and the tree-lined canal that runs about 20 km north to Lu'an, with water views and pleasure boats. Subu, an old market town known for its food, lies next to it.
description: 横排头位于安徽六安。游览特色包括运河、灌溉工程、田园观光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 20 km south of central Lu'an by road, at Subu town.

name: 霍山大峡谷
summaryEn: The Huoshan Grand Canyon is a rafting and adventure area on the Kongque River, where an 8 km run drops 160 m in total, with a largest single drop of 19 m, over smooth patterned rock beds between bamboo-covered slopes. Other attractions are the Baiyunxia waterfalls, the Feiyun glass suspension bridge, 188 m long and 108 m above the valley, and a slide through bamboo forest. Rafting runs in the summer season only.
description: 霍山大峡谷位于安徽六安。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km west of Huoshan county town by road, in Luoerling town, beside the Liuwan Qingxia park.

name: 金寨红军广场
summaryEn: Red Army Square in Jinzhai county town is a memorial park on the county's revolutionary history, laid out around a monument tower to revolutionary martyrs. It brings together the Jinzhai County Revolution Museum, a Red Army martyrs' cemetery, a Red Army memorial hall and a monument to General Hong Xuezhi. Jinzhai is known in China as a 'county of generals' for the many army generals born here.
description: 金寨红军广场位于安徽六安。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Jinzhai county town (Meishan town), about an hour by road from Lu'an. The revolution museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 九公寨
summaryEn: Jiugongzhai is a wooded hill in Shibanchong township, counted among the eight traditional sights of Lu'an and long associated with Buddhism. Legend says Emperor Wu of Liang built a temple here with materials supplied by nine elders from the villages below, which gave the hill its name ('Stockade of the Nine Elders'). Paths climb past Buddhist statue plazas, Gaofeng Temple, boulders such as Chessboard Rock and a waterfall.
description: 九公寨位于安徽六安。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 30 km south-west of central Lu'an by road, in Shibanchong township some 6 km west of Hengpaitou.

name: 临淮岗
summaryEn: Linhuaigang is a flood-control scheme on the Huai River, described by the Lu'an government as the largest water-control project on the river, with a main dam, auxiliary dams, a diversion channel, a ship lock and sluices stretching some 78 km across the river plain north of Huoqiu. The scenic area built around it includes the main dam and a 49-bay sluice, an exhibition hall and a monument square on Huai River control, as well as wetlands and an old course of the river.
description: 临淮岗位于安徽六安。游览特色包括主题展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 20 km north of Huoqiu county town by road.

name: 六万情峡
summaryEn: Liuwan Qingxia is a commercial leisure complex built around a wooded gorge in Luoerling town, rated 4A in 2025 and themed partly on the area's anti-Japanese war history. It combines a film-set town in Republican-era style, a children's activity zone, a gorge walk and a viewpoint at Longtou Rock with rides such as a glass water slide, a dry slide through bamboo, zip lines and boat trips, plus a staged show, 'Legend of the Dabie Mountains'. It suits families and groups looking for activities rather than quiet scenery.
description: 六万情峡位于安徽六安。游览特色包括峡谷、乘船游览、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 16 km from Huoshan county town by road, in Luoerling town.

name: 龙津溪地
summaryEn: Longjin Xidi is a gorge scenic area about 8.5 km long in the hills of Quanjun township, developed by a private tourism company across the river from Xijiuhua Shan in Henan. A trail follows the valley past three pools, six waterfalls and named rocks and peaks, and a small sightseeing train runs through bamboo forest. A hotel and an outdoor-activity base stand near the entrance.
description: 龙津溪地位于安徽六安。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 18 km from Jinzhai county town by road, in Quanjun township.

name: 南岳山
summaryEn: Nanyue Shan is a 405 m hill rising 2.5 km south of Huoshan county town, steep on its southern face and gently sloping to the north. Over the centuries it has been known by several names, among them Tianzhu Shan, Huo Shan, Hengshan and 'Little Nanyue' (Little Southern Peak), and together with Foziling Reservoir it forms a provincial scenic area.
description: 南岳山位于安徽六安。游览特色包括水库。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 2.5 km south of Huoshan county town, a short taxi ride from the centre.

name: 铜锣寨
summaryEn: Tongluozhai is a steep, isolated peak of 1,096 m in the heart of the Dabie Mountains, within a 92 km² scenic area of pine-clad crags and oddly shaped rocks. Below it the Tongluo gorge runs for about 7 km past sheer cliffs, deep pools and waterfalls, with traces of an old plank road and of temples and houses. Its name ('Bronze Gong Stockade') comes from a legend that Emperor Wu of Han dreamed of the moon turning into a gong and falling onto the mountain.
description: 铜锣寨位于安徽六安。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Shangtushi town, about 68 km south-west of Huoshan county town by road.

name: 皖西大裂谷
summaryEn: The Wanxi Grand Rift is a deep V-shaped cleft through a wooded hill in Taipingqiao village, part of the Dabie Mountains (Lu'an) National Geopark. Visitors scramble up the gorge floor between mossy cliff walls, using hands and feet to squeeze through three points so narrow that only one person can pass sideways. A rock shelter in the gorge is linked by local tradition with the late-Ming rebel leader Zhang Xianzhong, who is said to have camped his troops here.
description: 皖西大裂谷位于安徽六安。游览特色包括峡谷、地质景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Zhangdian town, about 35 km south of central Lu'an by road.

name: 皖西博物馆
summaryEn: The Wanxi Museum is Lu'an's city museum, founded in 1980, whose present Hui-style building opened in 2011 and partly reopened in August 2025 after a refit. The main exhibition, renamed 'Into Lu'an', traces the region's history through bronzes, ceramics, burial customs and the revolutionary period, with a section on Gao Yao, the legendary judge associated with Lu'an. Smaller galleries are devoted to Lu opera and local folk customs.
description: 皖西博物馆位于安徽六安。游览特色包括博物馆、民俗文化、历史纪念。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the southern part of central Lu'an, a short taxi ride from the city centre. Closed on Mondays.

name: 燕子河大峡谷
summaryEn: Yanzihe Grand Canyon is a forested gorge about 5.8 km long in Yanzihe town, adjoining the Tiantangzhai area and part of the Dabie Mountains geopark. A walking route follows the stream past pools, cliffs and waterfalls, with a suspension bridge and a sinkhole-like basin promoted as 'Tiankeng Fairyland'. A glass water slide nearly 2.1 km long, with a drop of 133 m, runs down the valley.
description: 燕子河大峡谷位于安徽六安。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yanzihe town, roughly 1.5 hours by road south of Jinzhai county town and close to Tiantangzhai.

name: 悠然蓝溪
summaryEn: Youran Lanxi is a large resort complex in Sanshipu town built by the Xingmao property group, laid out round a lake with new Chinese-style buildings, gardens, a big fountain square and stone-inscription galleries. Its themed zones are loosely based on the 'five rites' associated with Gao Yao, the legendary judge linked with Lu'an. It has hotels, a children's play area and shopping and bar streets.
description: 悠然蓝溪位于安徽六安。游览特色包括湖泊、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 15 km east of central Lu'an by road, in Sanshipu town.

name: 悠然南山
summaryEn: Youran Nanshan is a sports and leisure resort in Zhongdian town built by a property developer, with Mediterranean-style buildings, hotels and inns. Its facilities include an 18-hole golf course in the hills and indoor halls for basketball, tennis, swimming, table tennis and badminton. It suits visitors wanting a sporty stay rather than sightseeing.
description: 悠然南山位于安徽六安。游览特色包括运动休闲、高尔夫、休闲度假。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 9 km south-south-east of central Lu'an by road, in Zhongdian town.

name: 褒禅山
summaryEn: Baochan Mountain, a wooded hill north-east of Hanshan county town, was once called Hua Shan and took its present name from the Tang monk Huibao, who built a hermitage at its foot and was buried here. In 1054 the statesman and writer Wang Anshi explored one of its caves and wrote the celebrated essay 'A Record of a Trip to Baochan Mountain', which made the hill widely known.
description: 褒禅山位于安徽马鞍山。游览特色包括林地风光、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 8 km north-east of Hanshan county town by road.

name: 大青山野生动物世界
summaryEn: Daqingshan Wildlife World is a commercial zoo and theme park of more than 2,000 mu in Taibai town, rated 4A in 2023, keeping over 3,000 animals of more than 200 species. Besides the animal exhibits it has a circus arena with staged shows, an outdoor-sports area, jungle adventure trails, an ice-and-snow hall and children's rides. It suits families with children.
description: 大青山野生动物世界位于安徽马鞍山。游览特色包括主题游乐、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Taibai town near Dangtu county town, about 25 km south of central Ma'anshan by road and about 2 km south of Taibai station, the southern terminus of the Nanjing–Ma'anshan line (Nanjing Metro S2), opened in 2026.

name: 德化堂古床博物馆
summaryEn: The Dehuatang museum in Ma'anshan's Yushan district is a private museum of traditional Chinese beds, displaying carved wooden beds, most of them from the Qing dynasty and the Republican era, with other old furniture in period room settings. It suits visitors interested in Chinese furniture and woodcarving and makes a short city stop.
description: 德化堂古床博物馆位于安徽马鞍山。游览特色包括博物馆、历史建筑。
accessEn: In Yushan district, central Ma'anshan, beside the Dehuatang hotel.

name: 濮塘
summaryEn: Putang is an area of about 20 km² of wooded hills on Ma'anshan's eastern edge, now run as the Putang National Holiday Park, with 49 peaks, 53 small valleys and eight reservoirs. Its forests and bamboo groves hold tea gardens and old trees, among them a ginkgo more than 800 years old and an evergreen holly whose crown spreads over 200 m².
description: 濮塘位于安徽马鞍山。游览特色包括水库、园林景观、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 15 km east of central Ma'anshan by road, in Putang town.

name: 太湖山
summaryEn: Taihu Mountain in southern Hanshan County is a wooded upland made up of the Taihushan National Forest Park, about 1,800 ha with 95% forest cover, and a deer park. A Buddhist centre since the Northern Song, it keeps a temple complex of long standing and is nicknamed 'Little Jiuhua north of the Yangtze'.
description: 太湖山位于安徽马鞍山。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 25 km south of Hanshan county town by road, in Tongzha town.

name: 香泉
summaryEn: Xiangquan is a small hot-spring town in He County whose warm spring has been used for bathing for centuries; legend says the Liang-dynasty crown prince Xiao Tong was cured of a skin complaint here. On the old street a public open-air spring pool is still used by local people, while a resort nearby has more than 50 landscaped pools, and Xiangquan Lake hosts dragon-boat races. Mutton noodles are the town's best-known dish.
description: 香泉位于安徽马鞍山。游览特色包括湖泊、天然泉水。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km north of He County town by road.

name: 蔡洼淮海战役旧址
summaryEn: The village of Caiwa in Xiao county, headquarters of the East China Field Army during the Huaihai campaign of 1948–49, one of the decisive battles of the Chinese Civil War. The preserved buildings where the campaign's General Front Committee met are shown together with a memorial hall, and the only photograph of all five committee members together, Deng Xiaoping, Liu Bocheng, Chen Yi, Su Yu and Tan Zhenlin, was taken here.
description: 蔡洼淮海战役旧址位于安徽宿州。游览特色包括纪念展览、历史旧址、战役遗址。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Dingli town, about 15 km south-west of Xiao county town and roughly 45 km by road south-west of Xuzhou; central Huaibei is closer, about half an hour by road to the south-west. The memorial hall is closed on Mondays.

name: 砀山梨树王
summaryEn: Old pear orchards around Liangli village in Dangshan, the county that calls itself China's pear capital and the home of the Dangshan Su pear, centred on an ancient tree known as the 'Pear Tree King'. The orchards are busiest during the pear-blossom festival in late March and early April, when opera is staged among the trees, and at the pear-picking festival in early September. Farm-stays, a pear-wine workshop and an exhibition hall on northern Anhui farming life have been added nearby.
description: 砀山梨树王位于安徽宿州。游览特色包括果园、主题展览、古树。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Liangli town, about 15 km east of Dangshan town; Dangshan South station is on the Zhengzhou–Xuzhou high-speed railway.

name: 皇藏峪
summaryEn: A wooded valley in the low limestone hills of Xiao county, named 'the valley where the emperor hid' after the tradition that Liu Bang, founder of the Han dynasty, sheltered here before his rise. Old trees, springs and caves such as Huangcang Cave and Sanxian Cave are linked by paths, with the Ruiyun Temple in the valley, and the area is known locally for its mushroom-stewed chicken.
description: 皇藏峪位于安徽宿州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Guanqiao town, Xiao county, about 25 km south-east of Xiao county town and roughly 40 km by road south-west of Xuzhou.

name: 灵璧现代农业博览园
summaryEn: A showcase farm park at the core of the Lingbi Sanhe provincial modern-agriculture demonstration zone, built around four large glasshouses: an agricultural science hall, an 'urban forest' hall, a desert-plant hall and a hall of city gardens and vegetable plots. It suits families and school groups interested in plants and farming.
description: 灵璧现代农业博览园位于安徽宿州。游览特色包括沙漠、田园观光、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 6 km north of Lingbi town, roughly an hour by road east of Suzhou city.

name: 灵璧奇石文化园
summaryEn: A landscaped park on the south-western side of Lingbi town, by the old Bian river, devoted to Lingbi stone, the ringing, intricately shaped limestone counted among China's four famous ornamental stones and used since antiquity for chime stones. Huizhou-style halls and pavilions in a classical-garden layout are set among display stones, and the main building, Bianyang Tower, houses the Lingbi Museum. A large stone market and 'stone town' next door sell rocks to collectors.
description: 灵璧奇石文化园位于安徽宿州。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the south-western side of Lingbi town, roughly an hour by road east of Suzhou city.

name: 新汴河
summaryEn: A landscaped riverside park along the New Bian River, a canal dug in the late 1960s for flood relief and irrigation, roughly parallel to the long-silted Bian canal of the Sui and Tang, where it passes the north of Suzhou city. At its head stand the Bian River Museum and the 'Yuanhang' (Setting Sail) sculpture; the north bank has 13 plazas on battles fought in the region, from the Dazexiang uprising and Gaixia to the Huaihai campaign, and the south bank 12 plazas on local customs and notable people.
description: 新汴河是淮河中游左岸的一条大型人工河道，开挖于20世纪60年代末，截流沱河、濉河上段来水直排入洪泽湖，具有防洪、排涝、灌溉、供水、航运等综合效益。因河线基本平行于隋炀帝开通的济渠，故命名新汴河。新汴河干流西起安徽省宿州市西北戚岭子，截取沱河上游部分来水，向东流至朱仙庄镇小吴家，左纳濉河引河，汇入濉河张家闸以上来水，继续东南流经灵璧县中部地区后进入泗县，在泗县境内先后跨过唐河和石梁河，之后进入江苏省泗洪县，最后在泗洪县的瑶沟乡东南注入洪泽湖溧河洼。
accessEn: Along both banks of the river on the northern side of Suzhou city, a short taxi ride from the centre.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 凤凰山
summaryEn: A group of low hills in Shun'an town, south-east of Tongling, known for Fengdan medicinal peony and named in 2000 'China's home of the medicinal peony'. Its peony garden holds more than 200 ornamental tree-peony varieties and more than 100 herbaceous peonies, including the four classic named cultivars; other sights are the Dishui Cliff and the 'Lovesick Tree'. The ancient copper-mine site at Jinniudong is nearby.
description: 凤凰山位于安徽铜陵。游览特色包括园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shun'an town, about 25 km south-east of central Tongling by road.

name: 浮山
summaryEn: An extinct volcano of the early Cretaceous on the shore of Baidang Lake in northern Zongyang, which seems to float on the water and is called 'the foremost literary mountain' for the poets who came here, from Meng Jiao and Bai Juyi in the Tang to Fan Zhongyan, Wang Anshi and Wang Yangming. Its caves and rock walls carry hundreds of inscriptions from the Tang to the Republic, protected as national heritage, among temples, pagodas and pavilions, and the scholar Fang Yizhi is buried on the mountain. It is a national geopark and national forest park.
description: 浮山位于安徽铜陵。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊、火山地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Fushan town, about 30 km north of Zongyang town by road.

name: 犁桥水镇
summaryEn: A village in Xilian town, north-east of Tongling, redeveloped into a 'water town' resort around its old street, where Ming and Qing buildings have been restored as small museums, a crafts street and boutique inns. The scenic area also includes the Manyuan garden and the old Liqiao street, and is lit up for night visits. It is a newly developed resort around an old village and suits an evening stroll or an overnight stay.
description: 犁桥水镇位于安徽铜陵。游览特色包括博物馆、水乡。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xilian town, about 20 km north-east of central Tongling by road.

name: 汉武文化生态园
summaryEn: A public hillside park on Qishan in Zongyang county town, themed on Emperor Wu of the Han, who by local tradition shot a flood dragon in the Yangtze at Zongyang on a southern tour and wrote the 'Song of Shengtang and Zongyang'; Zongyang became a county in 106 BC. The Hanwu Pavilion stands in the park.
description: 汉武文化生态园位于安徽铜陵。游览特色包括楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: In the west of Zongyang town, a short walk or taxi ride from the centre.

name: 铜陵市博物馆
summaryEn: The city museum of Tongling, long known as China's 'ancient copper capital', is devoted to bronze and copper culture. Since 2020 it has also run a digital copper museum, with a hall of digital displays and a children's interactive area showing models and images of Chinese bronzes held in other museums at home and abroad. It stands beside the West Lake Wetland Park.
description: 铜陵市博物馆位于安徽铜陵。游览特色包括博物馆、湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Xihu new district, about 6 km north-east of central Tongling by taxi or bus.

name: 西湖湿地
summaryEn: An urban wetland park laid out around West Lake in the Xihu new district on Tongling's north-eastern side, with lakes, planted woodland and paths for walking. The city museum stands on its eastern shore, so the two make an easy pair.
description: 西湖湿地位于安徽铜陵。游览特色包括博物馆、湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 6 km north-east of central Tongling by taxi or bus.

name: 梧桐花谷
summaryEn: A countryside flower park in Zhongming town on Tongling's eastern border with Nanling and Fanchang, covering 15.4 km² of hills and farmland. It has a peony garden, a large field of Fengdan medicinal peony, a green-plum orchard, tulip beds, Wutong Lake with Rose Island and the Big and Little Jinshan hills, and is best in spring.
description: 梧桐花谷位于安徽铜陵。游览特色包括湖泊、岛屿、果园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhongming town, about 20 km east of central Tongling by road.

name: 永泉旅游度假区
summaryEn: A farm-stay resort in the Yeshan forest park in Zhongming town, eastern Tongling, built in Huizhou garden style, with guest houses and villas, a food street of local snacks in Jiangnan-style buildings and a collection of Huizhou carvings. Its Siji Lanshan area adds an orchid garden and karst stone-forest scenery, and the resort suits a weekend stay rather than sightseeing.
description: 永泉旅游度假区位于安徽铜陵。游览特色包括森林公园、园林景观、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Zhongming town, about 20 km east of central Tongling by road.

name: 大浦乡村世界
summaryEn: An agricultural tourism park at Dapu in Xuzhen town, northern Nanling County, that mixes flower fields and farm displays with family amusements. Attractions include an indoor wave pool, a glass bridge between islands, water slides, a rose maze and a small train, as well as a tropical plant house and a medicinal-plant garden used for study tours; rape and rose fields flower in spring and fireworks are put on during holidays. It suits families on a day out from Wuhu rather than sightseers.
description: 大浦乡村世界位于安徽芜湖。游览特色包括玻璃栈道、田园观光、花卉观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km south of central Wuhu by road.

name: 鸠兹古镇
summaryEn: A newly built old-style town in Jiujiang District, developed by the Xinhualian group around the theme of the Huizhou merchants and put up by craftsmen in hand-worked Huizhou style. The Biandan River splits it in two: the west side holds buildings presenting merchant guild halls (Chaozhou, Huizhou and Hunan), the houses of notable families, an academy and a money shop, while the east side is given over to hotels, snack stalls, inns and bars. It is a modern resort town rather than a historic one and suits an evening stroll.
description: 鸠兹古镇位于安徽芜湖。游览特色包括古镇、书院文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jiujiang District on Wuhu's north-eastern side, roughly 10 km from the centre; tourist bus route 2 runs there from the east square of Wuhu railway station.

name: 鸠兹风景区
summaryEn: Wuhu's central lakeside district, made up of Jiuzi Square, Mirror Lake Park and the Zhongshan Road pedestrian street; Jiuzi is the city's ancient name. Mirror Lake (Jinghu), formed by the Large and Small Mirror lakes, was Wuhu's first open public park, and the pedestrian street is busiest in the evening when it is lit up. It makes an easy stroll combined with Zheshan and the riverfront.
description: 鸠兹风景区位于安徽芜湖。游览特色包括湖泊、滨水景观、特色街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the city centre, beside Jiuzi Square station on the Wuhu monorail.

name: 马仁奇峰
summaryEn: A forested range of limestone peaks rising to 316 m in Suncun town, where Fanchang meets Nanling and Tongling, protected as a national forest park and national geopark. Besides cliffs and rock formations, it has built attractions such as the 'Flying Dragon' glass bridge, a glass walkway on a cliff face and a cable car, and more recent additions include themed trails through a nanmu forest and, in winter, an artificial-snow park with snow slides. It suits a day of walking and rides.
description: 马仁奇峰位于安徽芜湖。游览特色包括地质景观、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Suncun town, about 20 km south of Fanchang town by road.

name: 红色山水涧
summaryEn: A rural scenic area in Hongmiao town, north-western Wuwei, built around the former headquarters of the Communist-led New Fourth Army's 7th Division, which fought in the Wanjiang region along the Yangtze during the war against Japan. It takes in the headquarters site at Sanshuijian, the 7th Division Memorial Hall and the Wanjiang Revolutionary Martyrs' Cemetery in Haiyun village, set among hills, flower fields and blueberry farms that also draw weekend visitors.
description: 红色山水涧位于安徽芜湖。游览特色包括纪念展览、花卉观赏、历史纪念。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Hongmiao town, about 20 km north-west of central Wuwei by road. Closed on Mondays.

name: 陶辛水韵
summaryEn: A water-country landscape around Taoxin town in Wanzhi District, between the Qingyi and Qing'an rivers, where an old grid of waterways is lined with large lotus fields. Both a 4A scenic area and a national water-conservancy scenic area, it holds a lotus festival each June (the sixth was in 2023), and its routes link Xianghu Island and Lianhuawan, the old village of Housha and fruit-picking farms. It is best in summer, when the lotus is in flower.
description: 陶辛水韵位于安徽芜湖。游览特色包括岛屿、莲花观赏、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 8 km from Wanzhi town and 30 km south-east of central Wuhu by road.

name: 王稼祥纪念园
summaryEn: A memorial garden built in 1986 on Shizi Hill in central Wuhu, in the grounds of the former St James Middle School, an Anglican mission school where the Communist leader Wang Jiaxiang (1906–1974) studied in 1924–25. It has a bronze statue, a memorial stele and an exhibition on his life told through documents, photographs and objects. The school's early 20th-century red-brick buildings, among them the 1910 St James Hall with its clock tower, are protected as national heritage but stand in a working school.
description: 王稼祥纪念园位于安徽芜湖。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Shizi Hill off Zhongshan North Road in central Wuhu, about 600 m west of Zhongshan North Road station on Line 1. Closed on Sundays and Mondays; it also closed for repairs in July 2026, so check that it has reopened.

name: 雨耕山
summaryEn: A small hill beside the Catholic cathedral in central Wuhu whose mission buildings were turned in 2013 into a cultural and creative park with a wine theme. Its core is the former St Aloysius (Neisi) technical school, built by Spanish Jesuits in 1934–35: a large block stepping down the hill, five storeys on the lower side and two at the top, with strong vertical lines and Huizhou-style stepped gables. Beside it on the summit is the former British consul's residence of 1887–89, which the Catholic mission bought for offices in 1934.
description: 雨耕山位于安徽芜湖。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、登山观景、草原。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Jihe South Road in central Wuhu, next to the cathedral; restoration of the school building was finishing in mid-2026 and the surrounding streets were being upgraded.

name: 枕水官巷
summaryEn: Guanxiang is an old village in Liulang town, Wanzhi District, ringed by ponds planted with lotus and water lilies; the Tao family genealogy records 13 imperial officials from the village after the Song, whose private lanes gave it the name 'Officials' Lanes'. Rated 4A in 2020, the scenic area centres on the village and its water street and also takes in the Yiranxiang oil-pressing culture park, where traditional wooden presses are shown, a mushroom garden and farm stays. It suits a relaxed half day in the Wuhu countryside, with local 'eight water vegetables' dishes.
description: 枕水官巷位于安徽芜湖。游览特色包括莲花观赏、传统村落。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Liulang town, about 20 km south-east of central Wuhu by road.

name: 赭山公园
summaryEn: A wooded hill park in the middle of Wuhu covering the two summits of Zheshan, named for its reddish-brown rock; the higher peak is 84.8 m and has long been the place to look out over the city and the Yangtze. Paths lead to garden spots such as Cuiming Garden and Shutian Pavilion, the Zhongshan Hall and the tombs of the educator Liu Xiping and of General Dai Anlan, and there is a small zoo with children's rides. Guangji Temple on the south-western slope belongs to the same 4A scenic area.
description: 赭山公园位于安徽芜湖。游览特色包括动物观赏、园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In central Wuhu, beside Zheshan Park station on the Wuhu monorail.

name: 中国宣纸文化园
summaryEn: Jing County is the home of Xuan paper, the absorbent paper prized for Chinese calligraphy and painting, whose hand-making craft is on the UNESCO intangible heritage list. This 4-hectare park at Wuxi includes the China Xuan Paper Museum, a traditional workshop where the old hand process is demonstrated, a room where old-style books are printed on the paper, and craft areas where visitors can try making paper, ink, brushes and inkstones.
description: 中国宣纸文化园位于安徽宣城。游览特色包括博物馆、非遗文化、书法文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Wuxi, about 16 km south of Jing county town on National Road 205 towards Huangshan; Jingxian high-speed station is about 21 km away.

name: 扬子鳄景区
summaryEn: The visitor area of the Anhui Chinese Alligator National Nature Reserve's breeding base on the southern edge of Xuancheng, opened to tourists in 1987 as 'China Alligator Lake' and renamed in 2016. Visitors see captive Chinese alligators, a critically endangered species found in the wild only along the lower Yangtze, in outdoor pools and a winter alligator house, and an education hall explains the breeding and release programme that helped Anhui's wild population pass 1,600 in a 2024 survey.
description: 扬子鳄景区位于安徽宣城。游览特色包括湖泊、自然保护区。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Xiangshan Road on the southern edge of Xuancheng, a short taxi ride from the city centre.

name: 恩龙世界木屋村
summaryEn: A resort and leisure park opened in 2001 on a 150-hectare site in the Qinglongwan forest area, built around clusters of timber holiday villas. Its grounds include a large ginkgo grove, orchards, a water park and a folk-culture park with model houses of several ethnic minorities. It is aimed at families and groups wanting a countryside stay rather than at heritage.
description: 恩龙世界木屋村位于安徽宣城。游览特色包括水上游乐、果园、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 8 km from central Ningguo on the Ninggang road. The official Ningguo A-level list of January 2026 marks the park as temporarily closed, so check whether it has reopened before going.

name: 官塘湖
summaryEn: A privately developed eco-tourism and leisure area on the shore of Guantang Lake in the north of Xuancheng's economic development zone, formerly called the Guantang Lake Eco-Sightseeing Garden. The city government describes lakeside gardens and farm-style sightseeing, an intangible-heritage museum, water-based amusements, restaurants and lodging. It suits a relaxed half day rather than sightseeing.
description: 官塘湖位于安徽宣城。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 16 km north of central Xuancheng by road, roughly 5 km from the Xuancheng North expressway exit. Check that it is open before going.

name: 观天下
summaryEn: This scenic area in Yaocun township, Langxi County, joins Shifo (Stone Buddha) Mountain, a 353 m hill long known as a Buddhist mountain, with Tianzi Lake, a 3.5 km² reservoir on its eastern side. Temples are built on the rocks of the summit among oddly shaped boulders, including a 32-tonne rocking stone, a cable car crosses the area and the lake is used for boating. A temple fair is held on the mountain each year on the 30th day of the seventh lunar month.
description: 观天下位于安徽宣城。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yaocun township in southern Langxi County, roughly 30 km south of Langxi county town by road.

name: 龙泉洞
summaryEn: A limestone show cave in the Shuidong area, south-east of Xuancheng, more than 2 km long, with halls such as the Milky Way Hall and White Dragon Palace and an underground river. Old inscriptions left on the walls by Southern Song and late Ming visitors survive inside, the air stays around 18°C all year, and the rebuilt Longquan Temple faces the cave exit.
description: 龙泉洞位于安徽宣城。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、洞穴、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 30 km south-east of central Xuancheng near Shuidong town, by road.

name: 箐箐庄园
summaryEn: A farm park of about 100 hectares in Xinhang town, run by a local company that grows kiwifruit and raises free-range chickens. Visitors come for seasonal fruit picking in the orchards, lotus ponds and plum trees, and farm meals. It lies about ten minutes by road from Taiji Cave and is often combined with it.
description: 箐箐庄园位于安徽宣城。游览特色包括果园、洞穴、农业体验。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xinhang town in north-eastern Guangde, about 10 minutes by road from Taiji Cave.

name: 水东古镇
summaryEn: Shuidong is a market town 29 km south-east of Xuancheng that grew rich in the Ming and Qing on river trade along the Shuiyang River and on its candied jujubes, and was named a national historic and cultural town in 2008. Its old streets keep Ming-era bluestone paving, the Dafudi mansion, the eighteen-step 'Shiba Ta' well, Ningdong Temple and a Catholic church, and several films and TV series have been shot there.
description: 水东古镇位于安徽宣城。游览特色包括古镇、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 29 km south-east of central Xuancheng by road.

name: 水墨汀溪
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in Tingxi, south-east Jing County, made up of the Danankeng, Majialing and Taoling sections across a planned 40 km² with about 80 percent forest cover. Visitors come for forested gorges, streams and pools, tea gardens and terraced fields, an old arched stone bridge and the winding Taoling mountain road, and for cool air in summer.
description: 水墨汀溪位于安徽宣城。游览特色包括峡谷、山地游览、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Based at Danankeng village in Tingxi town, roughly 30 km south-east of Jing county town by road.

name: 桃花潭
summaryEn: Taohuatan is a deep pool on the river 40 km west of Jing county town, famous from Li Bai's poem 'To Wang Lun', written when his friend saw him off here. On the east bank the Ming-built Tage Pavilion marks the old ferry where Wang Lun is said to have sung farewell, with old lanes behind it; across the water are the Huaixian Pavilion, Wang Lun's tomb and other sites, and downstream stands the octagonal Wenchang Pavilion of the Qianlong era.
description: 桃花潭位于安徽宣城。游览特色包括楼阁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 40 km west of Jing county town by road; the Taohuatan expressway exit is about 8 km north.

name: 皖南事变烈士陵园
summaryEn: A memorial cemetery opened in 1991 at the southern foot of Shuixi Hill, on the western edge of Jing county town, for the New Fourth Army soldiers killed in the Wannan (South Anhui) Incident of January 1941. The army's headquarters column of about 9,000, leaving Yunling, was surrounded and attacked by Nationalist government forces at Maolin in Jing County. The 15-hectare site centres on a monument inscribed by Deng Xiaoping, with an exhibition hall on the incident and a tomb of unknown soldiers.
description: 陵园位于泾县城西水西山南麓，以皖南事变中的新四军烈士为纪念对象。
accessEn: About 1.5 km west of Jing county town centre at the foot of Shuixi Hill, close to the Shuixi Twin Pagodas.

name: 夏霖九天银瀑
summaryEn: A forested valley of about 11 km² at Xialin village in Zhongxi town, where the Huangshan and Tianmu ranges meet, known for its many waterfalls. Trails follow the Wolong and Feilong gorges past pools and falls such as Dalong Pool and the three-tiered Guanyin Falls, which drop more than 30 m, and a 1.5 km rafting run descends Wolong Gorge in the warm season.
description: 夏霖九天银瀑位于安徽宣城。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km south-east of central Ningguo by road.

name: 宣酒文化园
summaryEn: The visitor park of the Xuanjiu baijiu distillery in Xuancheng's economic development zone, presenting the local liquor and how it is made. The company traces its craft to Ji Sou, a Tang-dynasty brewer of Xuancheng whose death Li Bai mourned in a short poem, while the modern distillery grew from four private workshops merged in 1951. It suits visitors interested in Chinese liquor and factory visits.
description: 宣酒文化园位于安徽宣城。游览特色包括酿造文化、休闲公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the development zone about 7 km west of central Xuancheng, a short taxi ride away. Closed on Saturdays and Sundays.

name: 鄣山大峡谷
summaryEn: A gorge scenic area of about 15 km² at the southern entrance to the Qingliangfeng national nature reserve, 22 km south-east of Jixi county town where the Tianmu and Huangshan ranges meet. Trails follow the Zhang River past pools and waterfalls below Baizhangyan, a sheer rock face about 460 m high, and a crag said to resemble Mao Zedong's profile, which gives the canyon the nickname 'Great Man Valley'. A stretch of the old Huizhou–Hangzhou trail also passes through.
description: 鄣山大峡谷位于安徽宣城。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、自然保护区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Fuling town, about 22 km south-east of Jixi county town by road.

name: 朱旺村
summaryEn: Zhuwang is a traditional village in Caijiaqiao town, Jingde County, with a history of about 1,300 years and 47 well-preserved Ming and Qing buildings. It is known for the 'nine wells and thirteen bridges' along its stream and for the old Fushan Academy, and it has been opened as a scenic area while villagers still live and trade there.
description: 朱旺村位于安徽宣城。游览特色包括书院文化、传统村落。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Caijiaqiao town, about 15 km north-west of Jingde county town by road.

name: 68海里
summaryEn: A coastal scenic area at Dong'ao village on Pingtan Island, named for the 68 nautical miles (about 126 km) of sea that separate Pingtan, the closest point of mainland China to Taiwan Island, from Hsinchu on the other side of the strait. It takes in Houyan Island and two neighbouring islets, known for rugged rocks and huge boulders, with a sandy beach beside them.
description: 68海里位于福建福州。游览特色包括海滨、岛屿、海岛。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the south-east coast of Pingtan Island, about 8 km from the main town and some 12 km from Pingtan railway station, which has trains from Fuzhou; by road Pingtan is roughly 2 hours from central Fuzhou.

name: 百漈沟
summaryEn: A gorge just over 1 km long in Wutong town, western Yongtai, named for the scores of waterfalls large and small that pour into it, with walkways cut along the cliffs through a sinkhole-like canyon. The Dazhang River flows past its mouth, and rides such as a coloured slide, a zip line and a glass bridge have been added.
description: 百漈沟位于福建福州。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the road from Yongtai to Songkou in Wutong town, about 30 km west of Yongtai town (leave the expressway at Wutong); allow roughly 1.5–2 hours by road from Fuzhou.

name: 福州国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park of about 860 hectares in the hills on Fuzhou's northern edge, founded in 1960 as the city arboretum, also run as Fuzhou Botanical Garden and the first national forest park in Fujian. Paths wind through tree collections, glasshouses and themed gardens and along the Bayi Reservoir, beside which stands a huge old banyan known locally as the 'king of banyans'.
description: 福州国家森林公园位于福建福州。游览特色包括森林公园、水库、植物园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xindian, about 10 km north of central Fuzhou, around 30 minutes by taxi.

name: 贵安新天地
summaryEn: A large resort and residential development built from 2011 by a property group in the Gui'an hot-spring area of Lianjiang county and rated 4A in 2014. It combines hot-spring hotels with the Gui'an Water World water park and an amusement park, and suits families wanting a resort break near Fuzhou.
description: 贵安新天地位于福建福州。游览特色包括主题游乐、水上游乐、游乐体验。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Pandu town, Lianjiang county, about 25 km north of central Fuzhou, roughly 40 minutes by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 罗源湾海洋世界
summaryEn: A marine park in the Luoyuan Bay waterfront new town, built by a property group as part of a large resort and residential development and opened in 2015. Besides its aquarium halls and staged shows, an animal park with land animals and a camping and picnic area were added in 2026; it suits families.
description: 罗源湾海洋世界位于福建福州。游览特色包括水族展览、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the Luoyuan Bay waterfront east of Luoyuan town, about an hour by road north of Fuzhou.

name: 闽江河口国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A 282-hectare wetland park of tidal flats and restored fish ponds at the mouth of the Min River in north-east Changle, part of an estuary wetland that joined China's World Heritage tentative list in 2022 and became a Ramsar site in 2023. Boardwalks, bird hides and a wetland museum serve birdwatchers: tundra swans and swan geese winter here from October to February, and the rare Chinese crested tern visits in the warmer months.
description: 闽江河口国家湿地公园位于福建福州。游览特色包括博物馆、湿地。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In north-east Changle about 13 km from Changle town, roughly an hour by road from central Fuzhou.

name: 闽越水镇
summaryEn: A modern themed water town on the Min River at Zhuqi in Minhou, whose first phase opened in 2021 and which was rated 4A in 2024. Canals are lined with shops and restaurants built in old-street style, with an opera stage, pavilions and immersive staged shows.
description: 闽越水镇位于福建福州。游览特色包括水乡、运河。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhuqi, Minhou county, about 20 km west of central Fuzhou, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 欧乐堡海洋世界
summaryEn: A marine theme park in Geling town with aquarium halls of sea and polar animals, several theatres for staged marine-animal shows, and a water park next door. It is aimed at families on a day out from Fuzhou.
description: 欧乐堡海洋世界位于福建福州。游览特色包括主题游乐、水族展览、水上游乐。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Geling town, Yongtai county, about an hour by road from central Fuzhou.

name: 青云山
summaryEn: A national key scenic area of deep gorges cut into volcanic rock in Linglu township, south of Yongtai town, made up of sections such as the Yuntian stone corridor, Baima Gorge, Shuilian Palace and Qinglong Waterfall, each with trails past cascades, pools and cliffs. The separately run Yunding scenic area occupies the plateau at the top of the same mountain.
description: 青云山位于福建福州。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Linglu township about 13 km from Yongtai town, served by the Qingyunshan–Yunding tourist bus from Yongtai; allow about 1.5 hours by road from Fuzhou.

name: 石竹山
summaryEn: A Taoist holy mountain west of Fuqing known for its long-standing custom of dream-seeking, in which pilgrims sleep overnight in a cave shrine hoping for a dream that answers their prayers. Temple halls, towers and a pagoda climb the wooded slopes, and a lake with small islands lies at the foot of the mountain.
description: 石竹山位于福建福州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊、古塔。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 10 km west of Fuqing city, roughly an hour by road from Fuzhou.

name: 坛南湾、海坛古城
summaryEn: A combined scenic area in south-east Pingtan made up of Tannan Bay, a sweep of fine white sand with more than 25 km of sandy shore running south to Jiangjun Hill, and Haitan Ancient City, a commercial complex of shops and restaurants built in the style of an old walled town. The bay is known for 'blue tears', glowing plankton that can light up the surf on some nights, and part of it is a protected area for Chinese horseshoe crabs.
description: 坛南湾、海坛古城位于福建福州。游览特色包括古城。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: A few kilometres south-east of Pingtan's main town and some 9 km from Pingtan railway station, which has trains from Fuzhou; by road Pingtan is roughly 2 hours from central Fuzhou. Check that Haitan Ancient City is open before going.

name: 溪山温泉度假村
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in the Gui'an hot-spring area of Lianjiang county, with a hotel, thermal pools and leisure facilities. Together with neighbouring Gui'an Xintiandi it is one of two 4A-rated resorts in the area and suits a relaxing overnight stay near Fuzhou.
description: 溪山温泉度假村位于福建福州。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Pandu town, Lianjiang county, about 20 km north of central Fuzhou, roughly 40 minutes by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 永泰云顶
summaryEn: A mountain-top scenic area on the summit plateau of Qingyun Mountain in Linglu township, most of it above 1,100 m, opened in 2010. Meadows ring a small lake in an old volcanic crater, and there are terraced fields, a canyon trail past a chain of waterfalls and a walkway hung on the cliffs.
description: 永泰云顶位于福建福州。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、湖泊。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 15 km south of Yongtai town, served by the Qingyunshan–Yunding tourist bus from Yongtai; allow about 1.5 hours by road from Fuzhou.

name: 梁野山
summaryEn: A forested mountain near Wuping county town, protected as a national nature reserve, with gorges, cliffs, deep pools and a chain of waterfalls. Fairy Lake lies between the upper and lower falls near Yuncha village, and the reserve's broadleaf forest shelters a wide range of birds, animals and plants.
description: 梁野山位于福建龙岩。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Chengxiang town, about 10 km north-east of Wuping county town by road.

name: 龙硿洞
summaryEn: A limestone show cave in Longkang village, Yanshi town, with passages on three levels, large chambers full of stalactites and other formations, and an underground river. A trail of about 2 km leads through the cave, and at its end visitors can take a wooden boat along the river to the exit.
description: 龙硿洞位于福建龙岩。游览特色包括洞穴、钟乳石、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Longkang village, Yanshi town, about 50 km north-east of central Longyan by road.

name: 梅花山华南虎园
summaryEn: A breeding and rewilding centre for the South China tiger, a critically endangered subspecies found only in China, on the southern slopes of the Meihuashan National Nature Reserve near Gutian. The Meihuashan South China Tiger Breeding Research Institute has run the programme since 1998, and visitors can watch the tigers in large grassy, wooded enclosures.
description: 梅花山华南虎园位于福建龙岩。游览特色包括自然保护区、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Near Mafang village in Gutian town (formerly Buyun township), about 15 km by road north-east of the Gutian Congress Site.

name: 千鹭湖
summaryEn: A wetland of hill ponds, small lakes and marshes among wooded valleys in Chengxiang town, just outside Wuping county town, forming part of the Zhongshan River National Wetland Park. Its name, 'lake of a thousand egrets', refers to the many egrets that live here and to the scattering of small lakes.
description: 千鹭湖位于福建龙岩。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Chengxiang town, about 5 km south of Wuping county town by road.

name: 狮岩
summaryEn: A limestone cave whose mouth looks like the open jaws of a lion, joined to Junqing Temple, the founding temple of Dingguang Buddha, the deified monk Zheng Ziyan from Tong'an whom Hakka communities honour as their protector. A statue of Dingguang sits inside the cave among stalactites, and the temple, founded in the early Song and granted its name by the court in 1011, is still an active place of worship. The Dingguang cult spread from here across the Hakka areas of Fujian, Guangdong and Jiangxi and to Taiwan and South-East Asia.
description: 狮岩位于福建龙岩。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、洞穴。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Lingyan village, Yanqian town, about 35 km south of Wuping county town by road.

name: 天子温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in Dongxi village just outside Yongding town, with a large number of open-air thermal pools set in gardens styled after South-East Asia and a children's water play area. It is an easy stop for visitors staying in Yongding town on the way to or from the tulou.
description: 天子温泉位于福建龙岩。游览特色包括温泉、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dongxi village, Chengjiao town, about 5 km north-east of Yongding town by road.

name: 汀江国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A river wetland park on the Ting River at Sanzhou, in a part of Changting that was once among the worst-eroded red-soil areas of southern China, its bare hills nicknamed the 'Flaming Mountain'. Decades of soil-conservation work have reforested the slopes, and the park now has ponds and lotus beds where 424 vascular plant species and 180 wild vertebrate species have been recorded. The neighbouring village of Sanzhou is a listed historic village.
description: 汀江国家湿地公园位于福建龙岩。游览特色包括湿地、林地风光、莲花观赏。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Near Sanzhou town, about 35 km south-east of Changting county town by road.

name: 中国包酒文化博览园
summaryEn: A visitor park opened in 2015 by a Pucheng drinks maker and also called 'Impression Xiaomi', in the Ronghuashan industrial zone north of Pucheng, built around baojiu, a traditional local rice wine. One of Fujian's first 'tourist factories', it combines a look at production with Hui-style buildings and Suzhou-style gardens, tastings, dining and shopping, and has a guesthouse on site.
description: 中国包酒文化博览园位于福建南平。游览特色包括园林景观、休闲公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Ronghuashan Avenue in the Ronghuashan industrial zone, about 10 km north of Pucheng county town by road.

name: 大安源
summaryEn: Da'anyuan lies in Da'an village, Yangzhuang township, in the north of Wuyishan city on the north-western edge of the Wuyishan national nature reserve. The scenic area takes in forested valleys with clear streams and waterfalls, including a canyon below Huanggang Mountain and a stretch of an old tea road.
description: 大安源位于福建南平。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、自然保护区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Da'an village, Yangzhuang township, roughly 40 minutes by road north-west of Wuyishan city.

name: 建州古城
summaryEn: Jian'ou was the seat of old Jianzhou, whose first character supplied the 'Jian' in Fujian's name. The scenic area centres on the Tiejinglan–Zizhi Street historic block, restored with nearly 50,000 salvaged old bricks, tiles and paving stones and reopened in 2023, including the Wanshou Palace with its restored opera stage. Workshops along the lanes show local crafts such as rubbings and Song-style whisked tea, among dozens of old-name shops.
description: 建州古城位于福建南平。游览特色包括古城。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Jian'ou city; the streets are best explored on foot from Tiejinglan.

name: 金坑红色旅游景区
summaryEn: Jinkeng is a township in the hills of western Shaowu, close to the Jiangxi border, that lay within the Communist Min–Gan (Fujian–Jiangxi) soviet area of 1933–35. The red-tourism area presents the former offices of the Min–Gan provincial Party committee and the East Army headquarters, the site of a battle at Huangtu Pass, Red Army slogans and a bullet-scarred wall, alongside the village's Qing-dynasty buildings, among them the Wenchang Palace, used as a temporary headquarters by the Red Army's Third Army Corps, and a Rulinlang mansion.
description: 金坑红色旅游景区位于福建南平。游览特色包括历史建筑、红色文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jinkeng township, roughly an hour by road west of Shaowu city.

name: 梅口埠
summaryEn: Meikou is a village on the Songxi River in Zhengdun town whose old landing, dated by the county to the Song dynasty, was a river port on the trade routes that carried tea north. The scenic area takes in the old wharf and ferry crossing, lanes of old houses including the Wu and Lu family compounds, a river-transport exhibition hall and a grove of old camphor trees, and stages folk performances and festivals.
description: 梅口埠位于福建南平。游览特色包括主题展览、节庆文化、商贸街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Meikou village, Zhengdun town, in the south-west of Songxi county, reached by road from Songxi county town.

name: 白茶小镇·石圳湾
summaryEn: Shizhen is a village almost encircled by water just west of Zhenghe town, which served as the county's river landing and goods depot in the Ming and Qing dynasties. Its old houses keep the look of a traditional northern Fujian village, with white tea planted around them, and the scenic area adds the old wharf, the Xingxi Academy and white-tea gardens that present Zhenghe's tea culture. The county itself takes its name from the Zhenghe reign era of the Song emperor Huizong, said to have been granted for its tea.
description: 白茶小镇·石圳湾位于福建南平。游览特色包括茶文化、园林景观、书院文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shizhen village, Shitun town, about 5 km west of Zhenghe county town, a short taxi ride.

name: 天成奇峡
summaryEn: A privately run scenic area in the Jiangshi nature reserve, Xiaojiafang town, in the far south-west of Shaowu, counted as part of the Taining UNESCO Global Geopark. Its Danxia cliffs, forest and streams are kept close to their natural state, and visitors explore them on foot and by bamboo raft.
description: 天成奇峡位于福建南平。游览特色包括地质景观、自然保护区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Jiangshi nature reserve, Xiaojiafang town, roughly 1–1.5 hours by road south-west of Shaowu city.

name: 武夷花花世界
summaryEn: A rural leisure park of about 40 hectares in Kaoting village on the edge of Jianyang, which began in 2011 as a family farm. It now combines fruit and vegetable picking, a theme park, a petting area, a campground and guesthouses. Its Yanzhan tourist factory, with seven Song-style buildings and three traditional dragon kilns, shows how Jian-ware tea bowls are made.
description: 武夷花花世界位于福建南平。游览特色包括主题游乐、公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Wolongwan Road, Kaoting village, about 5 km west of central Jianyang, a short taxi ride.

name: 中华武夷茶博园
summaryEn: This 7.8-hectare park in the Sangu resort area beside the Wuyi Mountains scenic area is devoted to Wuyi tea. A landscaped garden recalls famous writers on Wuyi tea, and the tea museum covers the history, legends and processing of Wuyi rock tea, with tea-art demonstrations. The park also holds the seating area for an open-air evening show staged against the landscape.
description: 中华武夷茶博园位于福建南平。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At 96 Dawangfeng South Road in the Wuyishan resort area, within walking distance of the resort hotels.

name: 香江茗苑
summaryEn: A tea company's visitor estate in Wuyishan's eco-enterprise park, rated a 4A scenic area in 2016 and listed by the province as a 'tourist factory' and a study-tour base. Set in a Jiangnan-style garden, it runs tea-making and tea-art sessions in which visitors try processing Wuyi rock tea by hand and taste the results.
description: 香江茗苑位于福建南平。游览特色包括园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At 1 Xianyun Road in the Wuyishan eco-enterprise park; take a taxi from Wuyishan city or the resort area.

name: 溪源峡谷
summaryEn: Xiyuan Canyon is the core scenic area of the Mangdangshan national nature reserve, in Shangyang village on the western side of Nanping's Yanping district. A path follows the stream up a forested gorge, the 'canyon gallery', past the Zhongyan waterfall to Longde Temple and the Xiyuan Hermitage.
description: 溪源峡谷位于福建南平。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shangyang village, Sihe subdistrict, roughly 20–30 minutes by taxi west of central Nanping (Yanping).

name: 云灵山
summaryEn: A privately run mountain scenic area beside National Road 316 in Longdou village, Shuibei town, north-west of Shaowu city. Its forested valleys are known for a 5.2 km canyon rafting run that starts from the 1,370 m Yunling Mountain and drops 216 m.
description: 云灵山位于福建南平。游览特色包括峡谷、山地游览、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Longdou village, Shuibei town, beside National Road 316, about 15 km from Shaowu city by road.

name: 自遊小镇汽车主题乐园
summaryEn: A privately run, car-themed leisure park near the Wuyishan resort area, rated a 4A scenic area in 2015 and aimed at self-drive visitors. It combines car-culture attractions with a campground for camper vans and tents and hotel accommodation.
description: 自遊小镇汽车主题乐园位于福建南平。游览特色包括公园休闲。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Xianfanjie Road near the Wuyishan resort area, south of Wuyishan city; take a taxi.

name: 福安白云山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area of about 67 km² north-west of Fu'an and part of the Ningde UNESCO Global Geopark, known for its volcanic-rock mountain scenery. Its valleys hold granite canyons, deeply incised meandering streams and clusters of potholes worn into the stream beds, and the Jiulong Cave section is one of the main sights.
description: 福安白云山位于福建宁德。游览特色包括峡谷、地质景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 25 km by road north-west of Fu'an city. Check that it is open before going.

name: 翠屏湖
summaryEn: The reservoir of the Gutian River hydropower scheme, formed when the dam's sluices closed in June 1959, drowning the old county town of Gutian, which had been the county seat for more than a thousand years, and displacing more than 36,000 people. Its long arms wind between wooded hills and islands, and boat trips run on the lake.
description: 翠屏湖位于福建宁德。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the north-eastern side of Gutian town, a few kilometres by road.

name: 牛郎岗
summaryEn: A seaside scenic area on the Fuding coast south-east of Mount Taimu, with a flat, clean sandy beach backed by green hills and sea-worn rocks given names such as Mandarin Duck Reef, the Weaving Maid's Cave and a narrow sea cleft. It was rated 4A in 2024.
description: 牛郎岗位于福建宁德。游览特色包括海滨、海岸风光、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: A short drive from Taimushan town, about 40 km by road south of Fuding city.

name: 鸳鸯草场
summaryEn: An upland grassland on the hills of Dongyuan township, Zherong, promoted as 'the Hulunbuir of the south' for its rolling open meadows, and rated 4A in 2022. Trails link viewpoints such as the sky walkway and the Turtle Stone platform, and since 2024 a cross-country race has been run across the meadows each August.
description: 鸳鸯草场位于福建宁德。游览特色包括草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dongyuan township about 15 km by road south-east of Zherong town; a bus stop for the scenic area is at Yuanyangtou village.

name: 九龙谷
summaryEn: A national forest park of about 1,090 hectares in Xinan village, Changtai town, with forest cover of over 95 percent. It adjoins Jiuli Lake: of the nine cascades that Xu Xiake described in 1620, the lower four lie here, among them the General, Flying Phoenix and Chessboard falls, and a restored stretch of the old Xiake trail links the two scenic areas.
description: 九龙谷位于福建莆田。游览特色包括森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xinan village, Changtai town, roughly 45 minutes by road north-west of Putian city.

name: 莆田工艺美术城
summaryEn: A trade and exhibition complex for Putian's craft industries, above all woodcarving and classical hardwood furniture, which with oil painting and gold and silver jewellery are among the city's traditional mainstays. It was the venue of the 2025 Cross-Strait (Putian) Crafts Fair, and its showrooms suit visitors interested in carving and furniture.
description: 莆田工艺美术城位于福建莆田。游览特色包括手工艺。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Licheng District, Putian; take a taxi from the city centre.

name: 瑞云山
summaryEn: A forest park in Dayang township, in the hills of northern Hanjiang District, whose peaks rise to over 1,000 m and are known for oddly shaped rocks, among them formations named the Heavenly Dog and the Sleeping Lion of the East. The scenic area includes the Fengwei waterfall and Yongxing Cave Temple, a provincial heritage site, and its forest shelters rare protected plants such as the Chinese yew.
description: 瑞云山位于福建莆田。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dayang township in the north of Hanjiang District, roughly 1–1.5 hours by road north of Putian city. Check that it is open before going.

name: 绶溪公园
summaryEn: Shouxi Park follows the Shouxi, as the Yanshou stream, the largest tributary of the Mulan River, is called where it flows through central Putian. Developed since 2011 as the city's green heart, it is laid out around lychee groves, waterways, old bridges and village houses, in eight themed zones that include 'Fishing Boats on the Shouxi', one of Putian's traditional twenty-four views.
description: 绶溪公园位于福建莆田。游览特色包括河溪风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: East of Licheng Avenue in central Putian, a short taxi or bus ride from the centre.

name: 仙水洋
summaryEn: At about 870 m in Fengshan village, Xiyuan township, a mountain stream spreads ankle-deep for more than 600 m over a single, almost flat bed of brown rock. In summer it is a popular place to wade and splash, and the scenic area, rated 4A in 2026, has added a lakeside boardwalk, water games, artificial snow in winter and evening fire-and-light shows. Seven traditional villages lie around it, and the Jiuzuo Temple and Wuchen Pagoda are about 2 km away.
description: 仙水洋位于福建莆田。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊、传统村落。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Fengshan village, Xiyuan township, roughly 1–1.5 hours by mountain road north-west of Xianyou county town.

name: 宝盖山
summaryEn: A granite hill about 209 m high on the eastern edge of Shishi, the highest in the city, crowned by Wanshou Pagoda, popularly the Gusao (Sisters-in-Law) Pagoda: a hollow five-storey octagonal stone pagoda about 22 m high, built in the Shaoxing era (1131–1162) as a landmark for ships, with stairs inside its walls. A niche on its top storey holds a relief of two women said to be the sisters-in-law of the legend, and the pagoda is one of the components of the Quanzhou World Heritage site. Huxiu Temple, founded in the Tang, stands at the eastern foot of the hill.
description: 宝盖山位于福建泉州。游览特色包括古塔。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the eastern edge of Shishi, about 30 km south-east of central Quanzhou by road.

name: 北溪文苑
summaryEn: A rural eco-tourism area in Beixi village, Hushan town, set in a wooded valley with streams and waterfalls. It makes an easy half-day outing from Yongchun town.
description: 北溪文苑位于福建泉州。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Beixi village, Hushan town, about 12 km (20 minutes) by road from Yongchun town; a local bus line runs from Yongchun bus station.

name: 牛姆林
summaryEn: A forested mountain eco-tourism area in Xiayang town in the far west of Yongchun, described by the county as one of the best-preserved native forests in Fujian, with several waterfalls along its paths. It has been a 4A scenic area since 2003 and makes a full-day trip from Yongchun town.
description: 牛姆林位于福建泉州。游览特色包括瀑布、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Xita village, Xiayang town, western Yongchun, about 70 km by road west of Yongchun town; a county bus runs from Yongchun bus station.

name: 泉州欧乐堡海洋王国
summaryEn: A seaside theme-park complex at Zhangban on the northern shore of Quanzhou Bay, made up of three parks: a water park, an ocean park with marine-life exhibits and staged shows, and a fairy-tale park with rides. Rated 4A in 2023 and also a provincial tourist resort, it suits families with children.
description: 泉州欧乐堡海洋王国位于福建泉州。游览特色包括主题游乐、水上游乐、海岸风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Zhangban town on the northern shore of Quanzhou Bay, about 25 km north-east of central Quanzhou by road.

name: 五店市
summaryEn: A restored historic quarter in central Jinjiang, said to be named after five shops opened here by the Cai clan in the Tang dynasty, with more than 130 Ming, Qing and early modern buildings: red-brick houses, Western-influenced 'fanzai' houses, ancestral halls and temples. Next to a modern shopping centre, it now holds museums and exhibition halls, studios, cafés and teahouses among the old houses.
description: 五店市位于福建泉州。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Jinjiang (Qingyang), about 15 km south of central Quanzhou by road.

name: 梧林传统村落
summaryEn: A 600-year-old home village of emigrants to the Philippines and South-East Asia in Xintang, Jinjiang, with 132 historic buildings: red-brick southern Fujian mansions next to Gothic and Roman-style villas and hybrid 'fanzai' houses that returning emigrants built mainly in the 1930s. Restored from 2018 and opened as a scenic area, it has cafés and restaurants in the old houses and folk performances during festivals.
description: 梧林传统村落位于福建泉州。游览特色包括历史建筑、节庆文化、历史宅院。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xintang subdistrict, about 15 minutes' drive from central Jinjiang and 25 km south of central Quanzhou by road.

name: 溪禾山铁观音文化园
summaryEn: A tea-themed leisure park on the edge of Anxi town built around Tieguanyin, the oolong tea for which Anxi is famous, and rated 4A in 2022. It combines tea gardens and a tea exhibition hall with flower fields, a lake, glass tea houses and children's play areas, and suits families and tea lovers.
description: 溪禾山铁观音文化园位于福建泉州。游览特色包括湖泊、花卉观赏、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Cannei town on the eastern edge of Anxi town, about 60 km north-west of Quanzhou by road.

name: 英良石材自然历史博物馆
summaryEn: A museum founded by a local stone merchant near Shuitou, the stone-trading town of Nan'an, in a modern building conceived like a book of stone pages. Its collection of more than 100,000 items runs from meteorites, minerals and gem crystals to fossils, the best known being 'Baby Yingliang', an oviraptorosaur embryo curled inside its egg, and a laboratory lets visitors watch fossils being prepared.
description: 英良石材自然历史博物馆位于福建泉州。游览特色包括博物馆、化石遗迹。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: Near Shuitou in southern Nan'an, about 40 km south-west of central Quanzhou by road and 5 km south-west of Anping Bridge.

name: 源和1916创意产业园
summaryEn: A creative park in former factory buildings on Xinmen Street at the western edge of Quanzhou's old city, centred on the Yuanhe Tang candied-fruit works founded in 1916 and later joined by neighbouring flour, television and jute mills. Old workshops, a barley store and a red-brick chimney more than 20 m tall have been kept and now house design and craft studios, shops and cafés, with exhibitions on the site's industrial past.
description: 源和1916创意产业园位于福建泉州。游览特色包括工业遗产。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Xinmen Street on the western edge of Quanzhou's old city, under 1 km south-west of Kaiyuan Temple.

name: 云龙谷
summaryEn: A gorge scenic area in Foling village, Guobao township, on the southern slopes of the Daiyun Mountains near Jiuxian Mountain, named after its long winding valley and a small temple, Yunlong Palace. Rated 4A in 2023, it is built around a frog mascot, with walking trails and boardwalks through the wooded valley, gorge rafting, a children's playground, a petting area and a campsite, and suits families.
description: 云龙谷位于福建泉州。游览特色包括峡谷、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Foling village, Guobao township, some 15 km north of Dehua town.

name: 中央苏区反“围剿”纪念园
summaryEn: A memorial park in the north of Jianning town on the county's role in the Red Army's campaigns against the Nationalist government's encirclement offensives of 1930–34; Red Army units took Jianning on 31 May 1931 in the last battle of the second campaign. It contains the former headquarters of the leading organs of the First Front Red Army, used in 1931–33, and the former residence of Zhou Enlai as head of its General Political Department, together with an exhibition hall on the campaigns and a bronze sculpture group nearly 100 m long.
description: 中央苏区反“围剿”纪念园位于福建三明。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、名人故居、历史纪念。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the Xikou area on the north side of Jianning town, walkable or a short taxi ride from the centre. The memorial hall is closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 大仙峰·茶美人
summaryEn: A tea-themed scenic area around Daxian Peak in Pingshan township, Datian, whose terraced tea gardens have been named among China's 30 most beautiful and whose cherry trees blossom in late winter. Datian grows about 70 percent of China's 'Oriental Beauty' (meiren) tea, and monks at the Chongsheng Rock temple on Daxian Peak, founded in 1164, are recorded as growing tea around it. The mountain is also a provincial nature reserve.
description: 大仙峰·茶美人位于福建三明。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、园林景观、赏花。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Pingshan township about 10–15 km by road south of Datian town; reach it by car or taxi.

name: 滴水岩
summaryEn: A karst cave about 2.5 km from Mingxi town where the Red Army ran a field hospital from 1931 to 1934, treating more than 250 of its own wounded and some 540 wounded prisoners; the cave had water and gave cover from air attack. A memorial stone marks the 'Former Site of the Red Army Field Hospital', and the area has been developed as a red-tourism scenic area, rated 4A in 2022.
description: 滴水岩位于福建三明。游览特色包括洞穴、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: About 2.5 km north of Mingxi town, a short taxi ride.

name: 格氏栲国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park at Louyuan in Xinkou town, south-west of Sanming, protecting a natural forest of Castanopsis kawakamii (gexikao), a tall evergreen of the beech family listed as near-threatened. The surrounding nature reserve holds about 700 hectares of it, and paths lead through the old trees of a park that is also run as a forest-wellness base.
description: 格氏栲国家森林公园位于福建三明。游览特色包括森林公园、自然保护区。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 20 km south-west of central Sanming by road via Xinkou town.

name: 桂峰村
summaryEn: A hillside village in Yangzhong town, north-eastern Youxi, where 39 Ming and Qing buildings with yellow walls and dark tiles are stacked up three slopes around a valley; it is a national historic and cultural village, described as one of the best-preserved old villages in Fujian. It once stood on the road between Youxi and Fuzhou, and old houses such as the Stone Lion House and Louping Hall survive along with stone paths, ancient trees and inscribed tablets. Today it has homestays and tea houses and holds festivals such as an autumn crop-drying festival.
description: 桂峰村位于福建三明。游览特色包括山谷、古树、传统村落。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yangzhong town, roughly an hour by road north-east of Youxi town.

name: 古溪星河
summaryEn: A leisure resort in the hills of Tangchuan township, eastern Youxi, at about 870 m above sea level, developed since 2016 in what had been an empty mountain valley. It has hotels and homestays, including a hotel in the shape of an earthen tulou, farm fields, children's play areas and a park devoted to the local goddess Ma Xian, and holds seasonal events such as a rape-flower festival and a summer firefly season.
description: 古溪星河位于福建三明。游览特色包括山谷、休闲度假、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tangchuan township near the borders with Minqing and Yongtai, about 1.5 hours by road from Fuzhou.

name: 闽江源·金铙山
summaryEn: The eco-tourism area of Jinnao Mountain in south-eastern Jianning, inside the Minjiang Source national nature reserve; the range's main peak, Baishiding, reaches 1,858 m, and its spur Yanfeng Mountain is taken as the true source of the Min River. The forests hold ancient ginkgo and Japanese cedar, village cattle graze on the upland meadows in summer, and a cable car climbs towards the summit area.
description: 闽江源·金铙山位于福建三明。游览特色包括自然保护区、登山观景、缆车观景。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 25 km by road south-east of Jianning town, best reached by car.

name: 九阜山
summaryEn: A forested mountain area in Xicheng town, south-west of Youxi town, lying within the Jiufushan provincial nature reserve. An eco-tourism zone with a gate, visitor centre and other facilities was built in the reserve's experimental zone from 2013 and rated 4A in 2019. It is also a provincial forest-wellness base whose streams and shady forest draw visitors in summer.
description: 九阜山位于福建三明。游览特色包括自然保护区、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xicheng town, a short drive south-west of Youxi town.

name: 九龙潭
summaryEn: A Danxia gorge north of Taining town where visitors drift on bamboo rafts between red cliffs and deep green pools. In the evening the 'Dream of Jiulongtan' night tour lights the gorge with projections, installations and a light show. It lies on the road to Shangqing, in the core of the Taining heritage and geopark landscape along with the Shangqing Stream and Zhuangyuan Rock.
description: 九龙潭位于福建三明。游览特色包括峡谷、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 15 km by road north of Taining town, on the road towards Shangqing.

name: 明清园
summaryEn: A museum park on the Jinxi River just east of Taining town, made up of dozens of old Ming- and Qing-style buildings collected from elsewhere; the first phase has nine buildings on different themes and a large collection of carved woodwork. Since 2022 one hall, the Baifu Guan, has displayed more than 100 Ming and Qing objects decorated with the character fu (good fortune), such as chests, plaques and steelyards.
description: 明清园位于福建三明。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 3 km east of central Taining on the Jinxi River, at the start of the road to Shangqing.

name: 瑞云山
summaryEn: A small hill scenic area of about 3 km² in Chenda town on the northern edge of Sanming city, combining forest with temple buildings and old rock inscriptions. Its sights include Tianma Rock and Ruiyun Cave, and groves of the rare Sichuan cycad and of ubame oak.
description: 瑞云山位于福建三明。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、林地风光、洞穴。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Chenda town about 8 km north of central Sanming, a short drive or taxi ride.

name: 三钢工业旅游区
summaryEn: Industrial tours inside the works of Fujian Sansteel, the steel producer in the Liexi area of Sanming. The route links the 1958 Industrial Memory Park and Memory Hall, on the city's industrial past, a safety-education hall and three viewing areas in the working plant, where visitors follow steelmaking from molten iron through to the rolling mills. In 2026 it was named among Fujian's first priority projects for industrial tourism.
description: 三钢工业旅游区位于福建三明。游览特色包括工业参观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Liexi area of central Sanming; visits start inside the working steelworks, so check visiting arrangements before going.

name: 沙县小吃文化城
summaryEn: A food-themed quarter built from the late 2000s at the foot of Taojin Mountain on the north-west side of Shaxian town, laid out in the style of the mansions of the area's wealthy Ming and Qing families. It is the showcase for Shaxian snacks, the cheap eateries serving wontons (bianrou) and other local dishes that Shaxian people run in thousands of towns across China, and is lined with restaurants and shops.
description: 沙县小吃文化城位于福建三明。游览特色包括历史宅院。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north-west side of Shaxian town, about 2 km from the old centre.

name: 石壁客家祖地
summaryEn: Shibi in Ninghua county is revered as the cradle of the Hakka people, the place where Hakka forebears settled before spreading south and overseas. The scenic area centres on the Shibi Hakka Ancestral Hall, said to be the largest of its kind and treated as the common ancestral temple of some 120 Hakka surnames; a World Hakka ancestor-worship ceremony has been held here each autumn since 1995.
description: 石壁客家祖地位于福建三明。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、祠堂文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shibi town about 17 km west of Ninghua town by road.

name: 水尾红军小镇
summaryEn: A mountain village in Kefang township on the Fujian–Jiangxi border which was a rear base of the Red Army and seat of the Jianning county Soviet government in the early 1930s. Restored former sites include the headquarters of the Fujian–Jiangxi guerrilla column, a Red Army hospital, an arsenal, a Soviet-area bank and the Soviet government office, and the village now caters mainly for study groups, with homestays in a converted school.
description: 闽赣边界的水尾村曾是红军后方基地，当地村落保存了与这段历史相关的记忆。
accessEn: In Kefang township about 70 km by road west of Jianning town, close to the Jiangxi border; a car is needed.

name: 天鹅洞
summaryEn: A group of limestone caves east of Ninghua town, the core of a 143 km² national geopark of karst landscapes. Tian'e (Swan) Cave is dense with stalactites, stalagmites and flowstone, and visitors take a boat along the Shenfeng underground river, where pillars of rock rise from the water. The caves stay at about 18 °C all year.
description: 天鹅洞位于福建三明。游览特色包括洞穴、地质景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 20 km east of Ninghua town by road.

name: 天芳悦潭
summaryEn: A hot-spring and forest-wellness resort at Gaolai near Songkou in eastern Qingliu, in what the county describes as Fujian's densest belt of hot springs. Its pools are fed by natural springs, and visitors can cook eggs in the hot water; the resort is also a provincial water-conservancy scenic area and a holiday base for workers' rest-and-recuperation trips.
description: 天芳悦潭位于福建三明。游览特色包括温泉、林地风光、泉水。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Songkou, about 15 km east of Qingliu town by road.

name: 侠天下
summaryEn: A martial-arts (wuxia) themed adventure area in Tangchuan township, eastern Youxi, which opened in 2015 as the county's first A-rated attraction. A plank walkway winds along the cliffs, and the main thrills are a two-level glass suspension bridge and a lift up the cliff built in the shape of a sword.
description: 侠天下位于福建三明。游览特色包括栈道。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tangchuan township in the far east of Youxi county, near the borders with Minqing and Yongtai, about 1.5 hours by road from Fuzhou.

name: 朱子文化园
summaryEn: A park at the birthplace of the Neo-Confucian philosopher Zhu Xi, born here in 1130, on Gongshan hill on the south side of Youxi town. At its heart is the Nanxi Academy, founded in 1241 on the site of the house lent to his father where he was born, with the square half-mu pond named after one of his best-known poems; new Song-style buildings around it hold a Zhu Xi museum and further academy halls, and a second phase is being added.
description: 朱子文化园位于福建三明。游览特色包括博物馆、名人故居、书院文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the south side of Youxi town, a short walk or taxi ride from the centre.

name: 北辰山
