summaryEn: A hill park of about 12 km² in Wuxian town, Tong'an, best known for the Twelve Dragon Pools, a chain of waterfalls and clear pools of different sizes running down a valley from near the top of the hill. It also has cultural spots such as the Hundred Dragon Garden.
description: 北辰山位于福建厦门。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wuxian town, Tong'an District, about 12 km north-east of Tong'an town and roughly an hour by road from central Xiamen.

name: 厦门方特梦幻王国
summaryEn: A theme park in Tong'an District opened in 2013 by the Huaqiang Fantawild group, covering about 40 hectares. Most of its main attractions are large indoor rides and shows using 4D film and other special effects, many on themes from Chinese stories and culture, and it suits a full day out with children.
description: 厦门方特梦幻王国位于福建厦门。游览特色包括主题游乐。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: On South Shixun Road in Hongtang town, Tong'an District, about 40 minutes by road north of central Xiamen.

name: 惠和石文化园
summaryEn: A park in Huli District devoted to stone carving, with a stone-culture gallery, a stone carving museum, a treasure gallery and a hall of 'stone shadow carving', a southern Fujian craft listed as intangible heritage, plus space for workshops and folk performances. It runs study trips and family activities around stone carving and suits anyone curious about southern Fujian's stone-carving tradition.
description: 惠和石文化园位于福建厦门。游览特色包括博物馆、非遗文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Zhonglun on Lüling Road, Huli District, next to Caitang metro station and about 20 minutes by taxi from the old town; its stone carving museum is closed on Mondays.

name: 老院子民俗文化风情园
summaryEn: A commercial culture park opened in 2015 near Xiamen North Railway Station, with a folk-culture area built in southern Fujian style. Its centrepiece is 'Minnan Legend', a live-action show on southern Fujian history and folk life in which a 3,000-seat moving grandstand carries the audience between outdoor sets, with motorboat stunts, high diving and water effects ending with a statue of the sea goddess Mazu rising from the water.
description: 老院子民俗文化风情园位于福建厦门。游览特色包括民俗文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Houxi town, Jimei District, about 400 m south of Xiamen North Railway Station.

name: 日月谷温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort at the foot of Tianzhu Mountain in Haicang, with indoor and outdoor thermal pools in gardens styled after South-East Asia, leisure facilities and a hotel. The resort describes its water as a mild, neutral silicate spring.
description: 日月谷温泉位于福建厦门。游览特色包括温泉、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At 1888 Fulian Road, Haicang District, about 40 minutes by road from central Xiamen.

name: 天竺山森林公园
summaryEn: Forested hills in Dongfu, Haicang, on Xiamen's western mainland edge, with lakes and valleys, a bamboo garden of more than 200 kinds of bamboo and around 60 cultural spots, including small Buddhist and Taoist temples such as Longmen Temple and Zhenji Temple. Tianzhu Lake, at its eastern end, mirrors the temples and ridges around it.
description: 天竺山森林公园位于福建厦门。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dongfu, Haicang District, about 36 km from central Xiamen and next to Tianzhushan station at the western end of Metro Line 2.

name: 厦门诚毅自然探索馆
summaryEn: An indoor family museum in Jimei, opened as the Chengyi Discovery Center with exhibits on space, aviation and navigation, which reopened on 3 July 2026 after a refit as a natural-history centre. Its four new halls, covering 7,260 m², use fossils, dioramas and hands-on displays to tell the story of life on Earth, with material from the National Museum of Natural History, the Hezheng Paleozoological Museum in Gansu and the Yingliang Stone Natural History Museum.
description: 厦门诚毅自然探索馆位于福建厦门。游览特色包括博物馆、动物观赏。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At 339 Xinglinwan Road in Jimei District, about 30 minutes by road from central Xiamen.

name: 灵玲国际马戏城
summaryEn: A circus-themed resort in Xinglin, Jimei, with a large circus theatre seating about 10,000, an 'animal kingdom' zoo area, a hotel and play areas for children. The theatre stages a resident circus show with acrobats from many countries alongside performing-animal acts.
description: 灵玲国际马戏城位于福建厦门。游览特色包括动物观赏、戏剧演艺。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Xingjin Road in Xinglin, Jimei District, about 30 minutes by road from central Xiamen.

name: 白塘湾
summaryEn: Baitang Bay, on the coast of Longjiao She Ethnic Township facing Xiamen across the water, has a 3.2-km crescent of sandy beach and the ancient volcanic crater at Niutou Shan, whose rows of basalt columns are nicknamed the 'terracotta warriors of the sea'. The resort area adds a visitor centre, an infinity pool by the sea, a volcano science hall, a container hotel, camping and caravan sites and flower fields.
description: 白塘湾位于福建漳州。游览特色包括海滨、火山地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Baitang village in Longjiao, southern Longhai, roughly an hour by road south of Xiamen; the Ming garrison town of Zhenhai Wei is nearby.

name: 高峰谷
summaryEn: Gaofeng Valley is a mountain tea-garden resort near Guanfeng village in Xiazhai town, western Pinghe, run by a Zhangzhou state-owned group around some 1,000 mu (about 67 hectares) of tea gardens. Visitors come for walks through the tea gardens and wooded valley, tea-culture activities and on-site lodging.
description: 高峰谷位于福建漳州。游览特色包括山谷、园林景观、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Guanfeng village in Xiazhai town, about 20 km by road north-west of Pinghe county town (Xiaoxi).

name: 官畲
summaryEn: Guanshe is a She ethnic village in the hills of Xinxu town, Hua'an County, promoted as 'Colourful Guanshe' for its brightly painted houses. It opened as a scenic area in 2019 and puts on She cultural events for visitors, such as displays of She wedding customs at holiday times.
description: 华安新圩镇的畲族村落以山地聚落、色彩鲜明的村居和畲族文化为特色。
accessEn: In Xinxu town, about 10 km south-east of Hua'an county town by mountain road.

name: 金汤湾
summaryEn: Jintang Bay is a seaside hot-spring resort at Chendai town on the coast of Yunxiao County, built around a natural seawater hot spring with a high mineral content. Its seawater hot-spring park is the main draw for visitors.
description: 金汤湾位于福建漳州。游览特色包括温泉、海岸风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Chendai town, about 20 km south-east of Yunxiao county town by road; Yunxiao station on the Xiamen–Shenzhen railway is the nearest railhead.

name: 鹭凯生态庄园
summaryEn: Lukai Eco-Manor is a farm resort at Zhouzai village in the Shuangdi Overseas Chinese Farm, a state farm founded in 1960 to resettle Chinese returnees from Indonesia, Myanmar, Vietnam, Malaysia and other South-East Asian countries. It combines leisure farming with study visits for school groups and suits families looking for a countryside day out near Zhangzhou.
description: 鹭凯生态庄园位于福建漳州。游览特色包括农业体验、庄园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Shuangdi Overseas Chinese Farm in Longhai District, about 30 minutes by road south of central Zhangzhou.

name: 马銮湾
summaryEn: Malan Bay is a broad sandy bay in Kangmei town on the east coast of Dongshan Island, run as a public beach resort area. It makes an easy add-on to the Wind-Moved Rock and old town at Tongling, a few kilometres to the north.
description: 马銮湾位于福建漳州。游览特色包括海滨、岛屿、历史街区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Dongshan Island, about 6 km by road south of Tongling town; Dongshan is about 2 hours by road from Zhangzhou city.

name: 十里蓝山
summaryEn: Shili Lanshan is a hillside leisure park in the Mayangxi Eco-Tourism Zone of Changtai, on the boundary with Xiamen, with flower fields, walking trails and a campsite that looks out over the lights of Xiamen after dark. It suits an easy half-day outing from Xiamen or Zhangzhou.
description: 十里蓝山位于福建漳州。游览特色包括花卉观赏、公园休闲。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Mayangxi area of Changtai District, about 40 minutes by road north-west of Xiamen.

name: 东南花都
summaryEn: This flower park at Xiban village in Zhangpu's Guanxun town is the showground of Zhangzhou's annual flower expo, held here since 1999 and long known as the Cross-Strait Flower Expo; in 2025 it took place as the Southeast Modern Agriculture Expo and Flower Expo. The roads leading to it run through a long corridor of nurseries in one of the area's main flower-growing districts, and the park itself displays flowers, potted plants and nursery trees.
description: 东南花都位于福建漳州。游览特色包括花卉观赏。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Xiban village, about 22 km south of central Zhangzhou, roughly 30 minutes by road.

name: 天福“唐山过台湾”石雕园
summaryEn: Opened in 2003 beside the Tianfu service area on the coastal expressway, this sculpture park was paid for by Li Ruihe, the Taiwan-born founder of the Tianfu tea group, whose ancestors sailed to Taiwan from Zhangpu. About a hundred groups of stone carvings tell the story of the migrants who crossed the strait from southern Fujian to Taiwan ('Tangshan' was their old name for the mainland they left) and of their descendants who later returned to invest, and a second section shows Fujian and Taiwan folk customs.
description: 天福“唐山过台湾”石雕园位于福建漳州。游览特色包括雕塑艺术。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At the Tianfu service area on the Shenyang–Haikou Expressway in Zhangpu County, about 12 km south-east of Zhangpu county town.

name: 天福茶博物院
summaryEn: Built by the Tianfu tea group as a non-profit cultural project, this museum complex at the company's tea estate covers about 130 mu (8.7 ha). Its galleries trace some 3,000 years of Chinese tea culture and tea customs in other countries, alongside a hall on the company's history and a hall of calligraphy and painting.
description: 天福茶博物院位于福建漳州。游览特色包括博物馆、茶文化、书法文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside National Road 324, about 15 km south-west of Zhangpu county town by road.

name: 天柱山欢乐大世界
summaryEn: This theme park and resort inside the Tianzhu Mountain National Forest Park in Changtai was developed from 2011 and opened in 2017–18. Its centrepiece is an ocean park with a large aquarium tank, alongside an animal park with some 200 species, and staged dolphin and sea-lion shows are put on in its theatre.
description: 天柱山欢乐大世界位于福建漳州。游览特色包括森林公园、主题游乐。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Changtai District, about 30 km north-east of central Zhangzhou and roughly an hour by road from Xiamen.

name: 云洞岩
summaryEn: Yundongyan ('Cloud Cave Rock') is a hill of small caves and boulders on the eastern edge of Zhangzhou city whose rocks carry more than 200 inscriptions from the Five Dynasties to the Qing, among them the characters 'Xishan Diyi' ('first among streams and hills') attributed to the Song philosopher Zhu Xi, who lectured here. It is a provincial-level scenic area with paths climbing past the carved rock faces.
description: 云洞岩位于福建漳州。游览特色包括洞穴。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Longwen District, about 10 km east of Zhangzhou's old town by taxi.

name: 漳州滨海火山国家地质公园
summaryEn: This national geopark protects the volcanic coast of southern Zhangzhou, shaped by eruptions millions of years ago; this scenic area covers its Zhangpu section between Qianting and Fotan. Columnar-jointed basalt, old craters, clusters of gas vents and lava formations line the shore and the offshore islets, notably Linjin Islet. The geopark's ancient crater at Niutou Shan, across the boundary in Longhai, is visited from Baitang Bay.
description: 漳州滨海火山国家地质公园位于福建漳州。游览特色包括地质景观、火山地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the coast of Qianting town, Zhangpu County, roughly 1–1.5 hours by road south of Xiamen.

name: 曹山景区
summaryEn: Mount Cao is where the Tang monk Benji taught, and he is counted as the second patriarch of the Caodong school of Chan Buddhism, which spread to Japan as Soto Zen. A cultural-creative street in the scenic area shows Yihuang opera, summer-cloth weaving and other local crafts. The provincial culture department lists it among Fuzhou's wellness destinations.
description: 曹山景区位于江西抚州。游览特色包括山地游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 12 km west of Fenggang, the Yihuang county town in Fuzhou (Jiangxi).

name: 中国莲花景区
summaryEn: Yaoxi village in Yiqian town is one of the main lotus-growing areas of Guangchang, a county known as China's home of the white lotus. Its lotus fields were certified by Guinness World Records in July 2016 as the world's largest lotus pond. The flowers are at their best in midsummer.
description: 中国莲花景区位于江西抚州。游览特色包括莲花观赏。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Yaoxi village in Yiqian town, about 34 km south of Guangchang, the county town in Fuzhou (Jiangxi).

name: 大觉溪旅游区
summaryEn: Dajue Stream Tourist Zone is a 7.3 km countryside corridor along a stream in Zixi County, built by the county in 2018. It strings together grape-picking gardens, a bread plaza, guesthouses, a food village, a paragliding base, a pet park, a farming-culture park and seasonal flower fields. It suits visitors who want a gentle rural stop alongside Mount Dajue.
description: 大觉溪旅游区位于江西抚州。游览特色包括花卉观赏、园林景观、农业体验。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: A corridor about 6 km east of Hecheng, the Zixi county town in Fuzhou (Jiangxi), on the way to Mount Dajue.

name: 佛岭国际公园
summaryEn: Foling International Park is a landscaped park on wooded hills beside a reservoir south of Xiaogang, the district town of Dongxiang. It was laid out around Buddhist, traditional and local-culture themes within a natural setting, and was listed as a 4A scenic area in 2018. The district promotes it as a leisure and wellness destination.
description: 佛岭国际公园位于江西抚州。游览特色包括水库、林地风光、佛教文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 4 km south of Xiaogang, the Dongxiang district town, and about 39 km north-east of Fuzhou (Jiangxi).

name: 旴源首镇
summaryEn: Ganzhu Old Street is the historic street of Ganzhu, a small town in Guangchang county, and the centre of the Xuyuan Shouzhen scenic area. Eleven old buildings in the Ganzhu district have been restored as part of the Long March National Cultural Park, and seven red-history exhibition halls, among them the former headquarters of the Red Army's 9th Army Corps and an ancestral hall, are linked by a sketching base and walking trails. At holiday periods the street stages themed street performances and folk-music shows.
description: 旴源首镇位于江西抚州。游览特色包括祠堂文化、特色街区、主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Ganzhu town, about 12 km north-north-east of Guangchang town in Fuzhou (Jiangxi).

name: 金竹飞瀑
summaryEn: Jinzhu Waterfalls is a forested valley of waterfalls in Jinzhu She ethnic township in the southern mountains of Le'an County, and was named one of Jiangxi's hundred scenic spots. Summers are cool, heavy snow can linger in winter, and the township keeps She customs. Preserved revolution-era sites in the area include former residences of Red Army leaders.
description: 金竹飞瀑位于江西抚州。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、名人故居。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jinzhu She ethnic township, about 45 km south-south-east of Aoxi, the Le'an county town in Fuzhou (Jiangxi).

name: 九瀑峡
summaryEn: Jiupu Gorge, meaning Nine Waterfalls Gorge, is a forested mountain valley of streams and waterfalls in Zhaoxie town in the south of Le'an County, listed as a 4A scenic area in 2020. River rafting is one of the summer activities offered in the valley. A larger resort project around the gorge was under construction in 2023.
description: 九瀑峡位于江西抚州。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhaoxie town, about 34 km south-south-east of Aoxi, the Le'an county town in Fuzhou (Jiangxi); a direct tourist bus from Fuzhou railway station began serving it in July 2024.

name: 黎川古城
summaryEn: Lichuan Old Town is the historic centre of Lichuan, a river town in the south-east of Fuzhou (Jiangxi), with a network of narrow lanes of old houses and shops beside the water. Its Old Street and Xianshi Street are protected as historic districts, and the streets host performances at festivals such as the Lunar New Year. It is a 4A scenic area.
description: 黎川古城位于江西抚州。游览特色包括古城、节庆文化、历史街区。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the south bank of the river in the old part of Lichuan, the county town in Fuzhou (Jiangxi).

name: 灵谷峰
summaryEn: Lingu Peak is a wooded hill of a little over 300 m on the eastern outskirts of Fuzhou (Jiangxi), laid out with footpaths and listed as a 4A scenic area in 2018. A local legend ties it to the poet Xie Lingyun, who governed Linchuan, and a Taoist hermitage he founded here. At the Lunar New Year, residents climb it to pray for blessings.
description: 灵谷峰位于江西抚州。游览特色包括林地风光、民间传说。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Donglin New Area, about 13 km east of Fuzhou (Jiangxi).

name: 麻姑山
summaryEn: Magu Mountain is a wooded mountain area west of Nancheng that Taoist tradition counts as the 28th of the 36 lesser cave-heavens, linked with the immortal Magu. In 771 the Tang calligrapher Yan Zhenqing, then prefect of Fuzhou, visited and wrote the Record of the Immortal Altar of Magu Mountain, one of the best-known works of his regular script. The mountain is a 4A scenic area that Fuzhou promotes for wellness stays.
description: 麻姑山位于江西抚州。游览特色包括林地风光、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 7 km south-west of Jianchang, the Nancheng county town in Fuzhou (Jiangxi).

name: 洽湾船形古镇
summaryEn: Qiawan is a river village on the Canglang River in Nanfeng County whose core is Makou Street, the old river-port street, with more than twenty well-preserved Ming and Qing buildings, among them ancestral halls and old houses, and about a dozen small temples. The best-known building is the Hu clan ancestral hall, built between 1608 and 1623, with three halls, two courtyards and 256 pillars. The village is on China's list of traditional villages and is promoted as a boat-shaped ancient town.
description: 洽湾船形古镇位于江西抚州。游览特色包括古镇、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Qiawan town, about 7 km north-east of Qincheng, the Nanfeng county town in Fuzhou (Jiangxi).

name: 三翁花园
summaryEn: Sanweng Garden is a riverside park in the urban area of Fuzhou (Jiangxi), laid out on both banks of the Fenggang River as seven themed gardens: an amusement park, azalea, Yuming, aquatic-flower, cherry, perennial-flower and rose gardens. It is a place for seasonal blossom and an easy walk, and local day-trip routes pair it with the city's memorials to Wang Anshi and Tang Xianzu. It was listed as a 4A scenic area in 2018.
description: 三翁花园位于江西抚州。游览特色包括主题游乐、滨水景观、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the southern part of the urban area of Fuzhou (Jiangxi), on the Fenggang River beside Sanweng Avenue. Check that it is open before going.

name: 同胜九曲东黎景区
summaryEn: Tongsheng Jiuqu Dongli is a privately funded leisure and holiday area on the shore of Liaoyuan Reservoir in Rifeng town, Lichuan County. It joins lake and hill scenery to buildings in traditional style, and is planned around leisure, culture and entertainment, sport and wellness. It is a 4A scenic area.
description: 同胜九曲东黎景区位于江西抚州。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Liaoyuan Reservoir in Rifeng town, about 6 km south of Lichuan, the county town in Fuzhou (Jiangxi). Check that it is open before going.

name: 文昌里
summaryEn: Wenchang Li is a Ming–Qing-style historic district on the east bank of the Fu River in Fuzhou's old town, a provincially protected quarter with 11 listed buildings and 9 historic buildings among its lanes, shops and food stalls. It is a popular evening destination, with street events and a live-action show, Xun Meng Mudan Ting, based on The Peony Pavilion by Tang Xianzu, the playwright from Fuzhou.
description: 文昌里位于江西抚州。游览特色包括楼阁建筑、历史建筑、历史街区。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Dagong East Road in the old town of Fuzhou (Jiangxi), beside the Fu River; Yulong Wanshou Palace stands inside the district.

name: 仙盖山农业观光园
summaryEn: Xian'gai Mountain Agricultural Park is a hillside leisure park south of Fuzhou (Jiangxi) that combines farming, sightseeing, traditional Chinese medicine and wellness-retirement facilities across more than 200 projects. Visitors come for walks among the farm gardens, a grass-sledding slope and cultural activities. It suits families and groups after a relaxed countryside outing.
description: 仙盖山农业观光园位于江西抚州。游览特色包括田园观光、园林景观、农业体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the countryside about 15 km south of Fuzhou (Jiangxi).

name: 野狼谷
summaryEn: Yelang Valley, meaning Wild Wolf Valley, is a commercial outdoor-themed park in Caoping village, built around a wolf theme and offering wolf-culture experiences. It also has a guesthouse and a motorhome campsite. It is part of the Zhenxiang Countryside belt.
description: 野狼谷位于江西抚州。游览特色包括山谷。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Caoping village, Wushi town, about 11 km south-west of Hecheng, the Zixi county town in Fuzhou (Jiangxi).

name: 资溪御龙湾国际旅游度假区
summaryEn: Yulongwan International Resort is a leisure resort in Yongsheng village, Matoushan town, in the north of Zixi County, rated a 4A scenic area in 2018. Its facilities were listed at that time as a beach area, a leisure corridor, camping tents, a children's playground and a walking trail. Zixi's tourism officials promote it, with Mount Dajue, as a place for fresh air and rest.
description: 资溪御龙湾国际旅游度假区位于江西抚州。游览特色包括海滨、休闲度假。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yongsheng village, Matoushan town, about 15 km north-north-east of Hecheng, the Zixi county town in Fuzhou (Jiangxi).

name: 曾巩文化园
summaryEn: Zeng Gong Cultural Park on the southern edge of Nanfeng is built around the memory of Zeng Gong, the Northern Song prose writer counted among the Eight Great Prose Masters of the Tang and Song. It holds the Zeng Gong Memorial Museum, opened in 2019 with six galleries, together with the Zeng Wending ancestral hall, a reading rock, an ink pond and cliff inscriptions. Come for the museum and the garden setting.
description: 曾巩文化园位于江西抚州。游览特色包括博物馆、祠堂文化、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Huancheng South Road on the southern edge of Nanfeng, the county town in Fuzhou (Jiangxi). The Zeng Gong Memorial Museum is closed on Mondays.

name: 真相乡村旅游景区
summaryEn: Zhenxiang Countryside is a belt of villages in Wushi town in the south of Zixi County, promoted as one valley and four households: Yelang Valley plus the villages of Changxing, Chenfang, Caoping and Xinyue. Xinyue is a She village that stages folk performances, Chenfang has a restored opera stage and clan hall, and Caoping has rebuilt commune-era buildings with an exhibition on the sent-down youth of that period. The area is a 4A scenic area.
description: 真相乡村旅游景区位于江西抚州。游览特色包括山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wushi town, about 13 km south-west of Hecheng, the Zixi county town in Fuzhou (Jiangxi).

name: 竹桥古村
summaryEn: Zhuqiao is a Jiangxi village founded in the late Yuan or early Ming that keeps the layout of Ming and Qing Gan-style houses, ancestral halls and memorial archways. It is one of Jinxi's national historic and cultural villages, and foreign guests were taken there during the 2024 Tang Xianzu international theatre month. It is a 4A scenic area.
description: 竹桥古村位于江西抚州。游览特色包括古村落、祠堂文化、村落风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shuangtang town, about 8 km north of Xiugu, the Jinxi county town in Fuzhou (Jiangxi).

name: 安基山
summaryEn: Anjishan is a provincial forest park in Chenglong town, west-south-west of Longnan, with dense woodland and a stretch of river. Visitors walk forest paths and take boat trips on the water.
description: 安基山位于江西赣州。游览特色包括森林公园、乘船游览、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Chenglong town, about 2 km west-north-west of the town centre and about 16 km west-south-west of Longnan.

name: 八卦脑
summaryEn: A high-mountain scenic area in Gaotian town, in the north-east of Shicheng county, promoted by the county as a high-altitude azalea viewing spot. Rice terraces above 1,000 m, planted with the local tribute rice, lie in the same town.
description: 八卦脑位于江西赣州。游览特色包括梯田、山地游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Gaotian town, about 26 km north-north-east of Qinjiang, the county town of Shicheng.

name: 中国(全南)攀岩小镇
summaryEn: A sports-tourism complex in Chengxiang town, on the north-western side of Quannan, built around rock climbing, with a 15 m competition wall, four zones and eleven activity areas, plus a national training base for young climbers. Quannan is the home county of the speed-climbing world champion Zhong Qixin, and the town hosts national climbing events.
description: 小镇位于全南县城西北，围绕攀岩运动设置了比赛岩壁和体育旅游体验空间。
accessEn: In Chengxiang town, about 7 km north-west of the centre of Quannan town.

name: 中国赣南脐橙产业园
summaryEn: A 5,400-mu (about 360-hectare) agricultural park in Anxi town, developed by the drinks company Nongfu Spring around a 5,000-mu navel orange demonstration orchard. It also has a 6,000 m² orange-culture exhibition hall and a glasshouse seedling nursery, and in 2018 it became Xinfeng county's first national 4A scenic area. It suits visitors interested in how Gannan navel oranges are grown and processed.
description: 中国赣南脐橙产业园位于江西赣州。游览特色包括田园观光、果园、主题展览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Anxi town, about 24 km south-east of Xinfeng town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 翠微峰
summaryEn: A cluster of red-sandstone Danxia peaks and cliffs on the north-western edge of Ningdu town, with a path to the summit at Lingxiao Pavilion and a glass walkway on the mountainside. At the end of the Ming dynasty a group of scholars known as the Nine Masters of Yitang lived on the peak and ran a school there. The area closed in November 2022 for a large-scale upgrade and reopened on 1 October 2025.
description: 翠微峰位于江西赣州。游览特色包括玻璃栈道、楼阁建筑、砂岩地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the north-western edge of Ningdu town, about 4.5 km from the centre.

name: 赣江源
summaryEn: A forested mountain area in Ganjiangyuan town, in the far south of Shicheng county, named for the headwaters of the Gan River that Shicheng counts as the river's source. The surrounding hills are protected as the Jiangxi Ganjiangyuan National Nature Reserve, and the scenic area was rated 4A in February 2026.
description: 赣江源位于江西赣州。游览特色包括自然保护区、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the mountains of Ganjiangyuan town, about 34 km south of Qinjiang, the county town of Shicheng.

name: 谷山
summaryEn: A wooded hill park on the south-western edge of Xinfeng town, laid out as a forest park and topped by the Xinfeng Pavilion (Xinfeng Ge). It was rated a national 4A scenic area in June 2020.
description: 谷山位于江西赣州。游览特色包括森林公园、楼阁建筑、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the south-western edge of Xinfeng town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 客家文化城
summaryEn: A Hakka-culture complex in the south of Meilin, the seat of Ganxian district, laid out as a group of Hakka-style buildings for ceremonies, exhibitions, trade and leisure, and home to the Jiangxi Hakka Museum. Its long cherry-blossom walkway is the main draw in spring, and the Gannan Hakka Culture Tourism Festival opened here in March 2026.
description: 客家文化城位于江西赣州。游览特色包括博物馆、节庆文化、赏花。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the south of Meilin, the seat of Ganxian district, about 9 km east of central Ganzhou. The museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 红兴谷
summaryEn: A study and training campus of about 900 mu (60 hectares) on the north-western outskirts of Xingguo town, built by the Jiangxi expressway group and opened in 2023. It is designed to house about 5,000 students at once and receive up to 20,000 visitors a day, and runs study courses built around the county's revolutionary history. It forms part of Xingguo's red-tourism offer alongside the Generals' Park and other sites.
description: 红兴谷位于江西赣州。游览特色包括历史纪念。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the north-western outskirts of Xingguo town, about 3 km from the centre.

name: 会昌戏剧小镇
summaryEn: A theatre quarter of about 128 mu (roughly 8.5 hectares) in Huichang town, developed with the director Stan Lai, whose father came from Huichang, and opened in January 2024. Old buildings were converted into theatres, including an ancestral hall made into a garden theatre, a former printing works and street houses, and they stand around a 300-year-old tree beside the Huichang Museum, which has a gallery on Lai's work. Seasons of plays and street performances by Chinese and foreign companies are staged here, so what is on depends on the dates.
description: 会昌戏剧小镇位于江西赣州。游览特色包括博物馆、祠堂文化、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Huichang town, around the Huichang Museum; the nearest airport is about a two-hour drive away.

name: 江南宋城
summaryEn: A historic-quarter tourist area of about 50 ha in the northern part of Ganzhou's old city, whose landmarks are Yugutai, the hilltop pavilion on the highest point of the urban area, and Bajing Terrace at the meeting of the Zhang and Gong rivers. The main street is a pedestrian street of Song-style timber buildings, entered through the Junmen gate tower and a plaza with statues of four Song-era figures linked to the city, and an outer zone takes in the Fushou Ditch museum and the Wei family compound. The street and gate tower are modern reconstructions, while the Song-dynasty city wall passes below Yugutai.
description: 江南宋城位于江西赣州。游览特色包括楼阁建筑、特色街区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the north of Ganzhou's old city, where the Song-style street starts at the junction of Jianguo Road and Xijin Road and Yugutai stands on the hill nearby.

name: 九曲度假村
summaryEn: A holiday resort on the Jiuqu river at Tianjiu town, Dingnan county, set in bamboo woods with a waterfall, boat rides on its lake and a street presenting Hakka intangible heritage. It is a national 4A scenic area and was named one of Jiangxi's summer-retreat destinations in 2023.
description: 九曲度假村位于江西赣州。游览特色包括瀑布、湖泊。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: At Tianjiu town, on the Jiuqu river, about 16 km east-south-east of Dingnan town.

name: 罗汉岩
summaryEn: A red-sandstone (Danxia) scenic area around the Chenshi Reservoir in Rentian town, north-east of Ruijin, where cliffs and oddly shaped rock stacks rise beside a lake. It forms one of the two districts of the Ruijin National Scenic Area, the other being the Yeping–Shazhouba revolutionary sites. The provincial tourism department promotes the wildflowers of spring and summer, and Chenshi is another name for the rock.
description: 罗汉岩位于江西赣州。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Rentian town, about 20 km north-east of Ruijin.

name: 南康家居小镇
summaryEn: A purpose-built furniture-industry town in Jingba town, planned over 5 km² with a 2 km² core around a lake of more than 300 mu. It has a furniture-culture museum, a rosewood exhibition hall, Hakka walled-house-style buildings and folk performances, and lets visitors watch furniture production lines. It was named a national industrial-tourism demonstration base in 2023.
description: 南康家居小镇位于江西赣州。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jingba town, about 25 km south-west of central Ganzhou.

name: 屏山
summaryEn: Pingshan is a mountain in the far south of Yudu county whose summit, at 1,314 m the highest in the county, is covered by about 50,000 mu (roughly 3,300 hectares) of natural grassland. Its slopes have forest, a waterfall and rock formations such as the Immortals Playing Chess stone, and the county describes the area as a summer retreat with lodging and dining. An evening live-action show in the grounds tells of the Red Army's departure from Yudu in the 1930s and shows Hakka wedding customs.
description: 屏山位于江西赣州。游览特色包括瀑布、草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jingshi township, about 28 km south of Yudu town (Yudu's official tourism page gives about 55 km by road).

name: 虔心小镇
summaryEn: A hill resort town in Dongkeng village, Lintang township, developed as a wellness and holiday destination with tea growing and forest-based activities; about 100,000 mu (roughly 6,700 hectares) of forest land has been leased to it for that use. The provincial culture and tourism department counts it as a provincial 5A rural tourism site, and it is also a national 4A scenic area. It is a modern resort rather than a historic village, so it suits a few days' stay in the hills more than sightseeing.
description: 虔心小镇位于江西赣州。游览特色包括田园观光、茶文化、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dongkeng village, Lintang township, about 20 km south-south-east of Longnan town.

name: 青龙岩
summaryEn: Danxia sandstone cliffs in Nanqiao town, south of Xunwu county town, developed as a hot-spring tourist resort. Its landmark is the Lingshi Wall, a red rock face 200 m high and 800 m long, with the Lingshi hot springs at its foot; the water is a mineral spring rich in lithium, radon, metasilicic acid and fluorine. The Ministry of Culture and Tourism's rural-tourism routes feature the springs as a winter trip, best between November and February.
description: 青龙岩位于江西赣州。游览特色包括温泉、田园观光、砂岩地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Nanqiao town, about 19 km south-south-east of Changning, the county town of Xunwu.

name: 上堡梯田
summaryEn: Rice terraces of about 51,000 mu (some 3,400 ha) climbing the mountains of north-western Chongyi across Shangbao, Fengzhou and Sishun townships, with a history of more than 2,200 years. The slopes drop nearly 1,000 m and hold up to 62 tiers, watered by old gravity-fed channels. The terraces were inscribed as a World Heritage Irrigation Structure in October 2022.
description: 上堡梯田位于江西省赣州市崇义县西北部的山区，总面积约3400公顷，是世界上最大的客家梯田，其最高海拔有1260米，垂直落差近千米，是中华人民共和国三大梯田奇观之一。2022年10月6日，其入选世界灌溉工程遗产。
accessEn: In Shangbao township, about 28 km west-north-west of Hengshui, the county town of Chongyi.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 桃源乐境
summaryEn: Taoyuan Lejing is a landscaped hill park on the edge of Dingnan town, themed on the 'Peach Blossom Spring' story by the poet Tao Yuanming. It is laid out around lakes in wooded hills and suits families looking for an easy outing from town.
description: 桃源乐境位于江西赣州。游览特色包括林地风光、赏花。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the hills on the south-eastern edge of Dingnan town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 天龙山
summaryEn: A forested mountain scenic area in Jinlong town, Quannan county, with trails through pine woodland. The county counts it among its four core scenic areas, alongside the Dinglong Taojiang resort, the Climbing Town and Yaxi village, and parts of it have been built as settings from the martial-arts novels of Jin Yong, such as Mantuo Villa. Hotels and guesthouses have been added around the scenic area.
description: 天龙山位于江西赣州。游览特色包括山地游览、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jinlong town, about 8.5 km east-north-east of Quannan town.

name: 通天寨
summaryEn: A Danxia (red-sandstone) scenic area in Qinjiang town, south-east of Shicheng, rising to a summit of about 600 m. It lies within the Shicheng geopark and is a provincial-level forest park, and the sights the county lists include an old stone wall and the site of Yuyu Temple.
description: 通天寨位于江西赣州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、地质景观、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Dashe village in Qinjiang town, about 6 km south-south-east of Shicheng town (roughly 9 km by road).

name: 五龙客家风情园
summaryEn: A large leisure park of more than 2,000 mu (about 130 ha), with some 300 mu of water, on the south-eastern edge of Ganzhou's urban area. It is laid out around an ecology theme with Hakka and dragon-culture motifs, combining lakeside gardens and farm sightseeing with sports and outdoor-training grounds and conference and resort facilities. It suits families and groups wanting a half-day outing within the city.
description: 五龙客家风情园位于江西赣州。游览特色包括湖泊、园林景观、公园休闲。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Shahe area on the south-eastern edge of Ganzhou's built-up area. Check that it is open before going.

name: 苏区干部好作风纪念园
summaryEn: A memorial park of about 508 mu (34 hectares) on the south-western edge of Xingguo town, built around the Soviet-Area Cadres' Work Style exhibition hall, which shows 213 relics, 18 oil paintings and 12 large reconstructed scenes from the Soviet period, including a survey Mao Zedong made in Changgang township. The park, also called Generals' Park, has a generals' hall and a plaza with statues of Mao Zedong, Chen Yi and the 56 generals born in Xingguo, laid out along a Long March route.
description: 苏区干部好作风纪念园位于江西赣州。游览特色包括主题展览、历史纪念。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the south-western edge of Xingguo town, next to residential blocks. Closed on Mondays.

name: 阳明湖
summaryEn: A reservoir of about 31 sq km on the border of Shangyou and Chongyi counties, formed by damming the Shangyou River and formerly known as Doushui Lake. Forested hills surround its many bays and islands, 427 bays and 42 islands by the county's count. It is a national forest park and wetland park as well as a 4A scenic area, and Shangyou County took over its operation in September 2022.
description: 阳明湖位于江西赣州。游览特色包括湿地、森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the lake at Doushui town, about 16 km west-north-west of Shangyou county town (roughly 22 km by road).

name: 阳明心谷
summaryEn: A landscaped park of about 113 ha on the east bank of the Tao River north of Longnan town, built on reclaimed mining land around the Yushi Xianyan cliff and opened on trial in June 2023. Halfway up the cliff, the Yuxu Cave holds inscriptions, including five poems by the Ming official and philosopher Wang Yangming, written in 1518 after he put down the Sanli uprising, and the cave inscriptions are protected at provincial level. The park's walkways and halls are themed around Wang Yangming's time in Longnan.
description: 阳明心谷位于江西赣州。游览特色包括洞穴。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the east bank of the Tao River, about 3.5 km north of central Longnan and about 100 km south of Ganzhou.

name: 丫山
summaryEn: A mountain resort area of more than 30,000 mu in Huanglong town, inside Meiguan National Forest Park and named after its highest peak, Shuangxiu, whose Y-shaped summit gives the place its name (ya means a fork). A 13 km elevated forest boardwalk, a glass walkway and Wolong gorge cross the forest, while the foot of the mountain has the A Duo leisure village and water-play areas and lodging is spread up the slopes. It was designated a national tourism resort in 2023 and suits families wanting a stay in the hills.
description: 丫山位于江西赣州。游览特色包括峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Dalong village, Huanglong town, about 7 km north-north-east of Dayu town.

name: 雅溪古村
summaryEn: A Hakka village in Longyuanba town, north of Quannan, notable for two walled houses: Fuxing Wei, built of rammed earth, and Yafeng Wei, built of stone. Visitors walk through courtyards, lanes and ancestral halls, and on festival nights a long fire dragon made of thousands of incense sticks is paraded through the village.
description: 雅溪古村位于江西赣州。游览特色包括古村落、祠堂文化、节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yaxi village, Longyuanba town, about 19 km north-north-west of Quannan town.

name: 浴血瑞京
summaryEn: A red-tourism park in Jieyuan village, west of Ruijin, built around the live outdoor show Yuxue Ruijing, which the provincial tourism department presented in 2020 as the province's first real-scene performance project that visitors can take part in. 'Ruijing' was the name by which Ruijin was known as the capital of the Chinese Soviet Republic in the early 1930s. The park has been rated 4A since 2020.
description: 瑞金城西的红色旅游园以户外实景演出《浴血瑞京》为主要游览项目。
accessEn: In Jieyuan village, about 7 km west-north-west of central Ruijin.

name: 白云湖匠心谷
summaryEn: A lakeside wellness-resort area on the Baiyunshan Reservoir (Baiyun Lake) in Qingyuan District, under development since 2024 as a forest ecology-tourism and recuperation area. It combines accommodation, restaurants, exhibition space and water sports including a surfing facility, and has a tourist-boat landing on the shore, with others at Baiyun Bay and Shazhou Island. The first-phase visitor centre was completed in May 2026, so the area is new and still being built out.
description: 白云湖匠心谷位于江西吉安。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the shore of the Baiyunshan Reservoir, about 10 km east-south-east of Futian town and about 50 km south-east of Ji'an.

name: 草林红圩小镇
summaryEn: A restored market town in the centre of Caolin, built around an old market street, a lower street, a floating bridge and a shopping street, with a red-poetry hall and a former residence of Mao Zedong; the county describes it as combining market culture, revolutionary history, tea and folk customs. In January 1928 Mao Zedong's force occupied Suichuan and held a mass meeting in the market's Wanshou Temple to announce its policy towards traders, and the market then supplied the Jinggang Mountains base with goods such as salt, cotton and medicine. His 1928 report on the Jinggang Mountains records market days drawing about 20,000 people.
description: 草林红圩小镇位于江西吉安。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、民俗文化、名人故居。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Caolin town, about 14 km west-south-west of Quanjiang, Suichuan's county town.

name: 中国进士文化园
summaryEn: A classical-style garden park of about 30 hectares on Nanmen Zhou, a peninsula in the Gan River at the southern edge of Jishui town, built around the China Jinshi Museum on the holders of the highest imperial examination degree. Other parts of the park are a library tower, a pavilion for the top scorer, a Confucian temple, an opera stage, a street of scholars' mansions and replica examination cells, with more than 1,100 old books, portraits, calligraphy and paintings on display. Building began in October 2017.
description: 中国进士文化园位于江西吉安。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Nanmen Zhou at the southern edge of Wenfeng, Jishui's county town, beside the Wenfeng Bridge; Ji'an is about 17 km to the south-west.

name: 大丰田园
summaryEn: A countryside leisure park in Dunhou town, listed as a provincial 4A rural tourism point in 2021 and a national 4A scenic area in 2022. It is aimed at family day trips from Ji'an and runs events such as evening light shows.
description: 大丰田园位于江西吉安。游览特色包括田园观光、公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 7 km west-south-west of Dunhou, the seat of Ji'an county, and about 18 km south-west of Ji'an.

name: 钓源古村
summaryEn: A village in Xingqiao town founded at the end of the Tang as the home of descendants of the Song writer Ouyang Xiu, with more than 150 ancestral halls, academies and houses in the Gan regional style. It is on the national list of traditional villages and is a Historic and Cultural Village of China. In recent years restored houses have been given over to guesthouses, exhibition spaces and creative workshops, and a cherry-blossom avenue leads to the entrance.
description: 钓源古村位于江西吉安。游览特色包括古村落、祠堂文化、村落风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xingqiao town, Jizhou district, about 17 km west-north-west of Ji'an.

name: 恩江古城
summaryEn: The restored old quarter of Enjiang, Yongfeng's county town on the Enjiang River, which the county says holds the largest and best-preserved Ming county-town site in Jiangxi: stretches of Ming city wall, an east gate facing the river bridge, and the sites of a county assistant's office and a minister's mansion. More than 160 old buildings have been repaired and the grid of lanes kept, and people still live and shop in the quarter. It is themed on Ouyang Xiu, the Song writer whose family came from Yongfeng, with museums, a Song-style night street and evening light shows.
description: 恩江古城位于江西吉安。游览特色包括古城、历史宅院、历史街区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the old quarter of Enjiang, Yongfeng's county town, by the east gate and the Enjiang bridge; Ji'an is about 50 km to the west-south-west.

name: 海木源
summaryEn: A valley resort at Muyuan and Haiyuan villages in the hills of Tanqiu township, known for rafting through a bamboo forest in the warmer months. It also has a jungle-crossing course, suspension bridges, a children's play area, the old Xinxia path, a small folk village and a guesthouse complex rated a four-star homestay in 2025. Rhododendrons colour the slopes in spring, and Qipan Mountain, close to 1,000 m, is the high point.
description: 海木源位于江西吉安。游览特色包括山谷、林地风光、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills of Tanqiu township, about 29 km south-east of Jinchuan, Xingan's county town.

name: 金梅花
summaryEn: A tourism area in Jinping ethnic township, which the county calls the only multi-ethnic township in Jiangxi and where it lists nine groups: Jing, Zhuang, Dai, Yao, Miao, Dong, Yi, She and Han. It combines fruit orchards with a market of stalls in minority style, a pomegranate-orchard guesthouse and restaurant, a study base, and crafts such as wax-resist dyeing and traditional papermaking, and holds festivals such as the Third Day of the Third Month in spring. It suits families and groups for a half-day out.
description: 金梅花位于江西吉安。游览特色包括果园、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Xinmin village in Jinping ethnic township, about 10 km south-south-west of Shuibian, Xiajiang's county town.

name: 庐陵文化生态园
summaryEn: A large park on the northern side of Ji'an, laid out in recent years as one of the city's ecological parks and named for Luling, the old name of the Ji'an region. Its lotus ponds draw local visitors in summer, and it makes an easy outdoor stop in the city.
description: 庐陵文化生态园位于江西吉安。游览特色包括莲花观赏。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Baitang subdistrict, Jizhou district, in the north of Ji'an city.

name: 古后河人文谷
summaryEn: A district of shops, restaurants and cultural spaces in Ji'an's Luling New Area, laid out along the revived Gu Houhe river and its green corridor. Its centre is Luling Old Street, where a food night market opened in August 2026, and the Luling Renwengu commercial street, which the province listed among its first demonstration commercial streets (reported in January 2023) and which was named in the first batch of national night-time culture and tourism consumption clusters. It is a modern urban development rather than a historic quarter, and suits an evening visit.
description: 古后河人文谷位于江西吉安。游览特色包括商贸街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Ji'an's Luling New Area on the south-western side of the city, beside Jinggangshan Avenue and opposite the Gu Houhe green corridor.

name: 墨潭桃花岛
summaryEn: A flower and orchard island in the middle of the Gan River south of Jishui town, planted with peach and cherry trees, rape fields and mugwort, and forming the core of the Jihu National Wetland Park. It is laid out for family days out, with children's play areas, a glass footbridge across the river and a craft market. Spring blossom in March is the main draw.
description: 墨潭桃花岛位于江西吉安。游览特色包括湿地、岛屿、果园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On an island in the Gan River about 7 km south-south-west of Wenfeng, Jishui's county town.

name: 青原山
summaryEn: A wooded hill on the south-eastern edge of Ji'an with Jingju Temple, a national key Buddhist temple of the Han areas, founded in the Tang as Anyin Temple and renamed in the Song. It is the temple of the Chan master Xingsi, who taught here until his death in 740 and whose line led to the Caodong school, and the hill has the Qizu Pagoda, the Feilai Pagoda, a mountain pass gate, bridges, a pool and a spring.
description: 青原山位于江西吉安。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、古塔。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Qingyuan District, about 8 km south-east of central Ji'an.

name: 三湾改编
summaryEn: On 29 September 1927 the remnant of the Autumn Harvest Uprising force, fewer than 1,000 men, reached Sanwan, and its front committee under Mao Zedong decided at a meeting in the village to reorganise the 700 or so who stayed into a single regiment, with Party branches at company level and soldiers' committees. On 3 October the regiment assembled at the maple slope and set out for the Jinggang Mountains. The scenic area holds four national-level protected sites (Mao Zedong's former residence, the regimental headquarters, the soldiers' committee site and the maple slope), plus a memorial museum, the old village street and a red-maple lake.
description: 三湾是秋收起义部队在1927年抵达并进行改编的地点，游览以相关革命旧址为主。
accessEn: In Sanwan township, about 29 km west-south-west of Hechuan, Yongxin's county town; the memorial museum is closed on Mondays.

name: 蜀口生态岛
summaryEn: An island village in the Gan River at Mashi town, presented by the county as an ecological island. The old village of Shukou was founded in the Southern Song and still has ancestral halls, tombs, steles, plaques and old houses, and the county credits it with 21 jinshi. Paths round the island suit walking, cycling or a boat trip, and the village is known for its local tea and for carp-lantern performances.
description: 蜀口生态岛位于江西吉安。游览特色包括岛屿、乘船游览、祠堂文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Shukou village, Mashi town, beside National Highway 105, about 11 km west-south-west of Chengjiang, Taihe's county town.

name: 桃源梯田
summaryEn: Rice terraces climbing the mountainsides around Taoyuan village in Zuo'an town, in a scenic area of 10 km² made up of six zones: Jiaozi Ding, Wangtian Qiu, Panlong Hui, Yunding Xingsu, Taoyuan Huajie and Yunxiao Xianju. The county describes the terraces as small as saucers and as long as ribbons, changing shape with the seasons, and the area adds mountain walks, farm activities, Hakka customs and an evening light show on the terraces. It makes a day trip for photography and country walking.
description: 桃源梯田位于江西吉安。游览特色包括梯田。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Taoyuan village, about 8 km south-south-west of Zuo'an town and about 40 km south-west of Quanjiang, Suichuan's county town.

name: 田北农民画村
summaryEn: A village near Gaopi town built up as a showcase for Wan'an farmers' painting, the county's folk art, which the county promotes as a cultural-tourism product. The village has been rated a national 4A scenic area and a provincial 5A rural tourism point, and it hosts family activities such as catching loaches and butterflies in the fields. It suits a short stop for anyone curious about rural folk art.
description: 田北农民画村位于江西吉安。游览特色包括田园观光、民俗文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tianbei village near Gaopi town, about 23 km north-west of Furong, the seat of Wan'an county.

name: 燕坊古村
summaryEn: A village in Jintan town with a well-preserved Ming and Qing core of lineage halls, academies, memorial archways, houses, ponds and wells linked by lanes paved in stone, set among old camphor trees. The provincial tourism department's description records about 160 historic buildings, including 13 archways; the village was named a provincial historic and cultural village in 2003 and a national one in 2007. Spring Festival customs and markets are held here.
description: 燕坊古村位于江西吉安。游览特色包括古村落、历史建筑、节庆文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jintan town, about 6 km west-south-west of Wenfeng, the county town of Jishui.

name: 杨万里故里
summaryEn: Bantang village in Huangqiao town was the home of the Southern Song poet Yang Wanli (1127–1206), and the county presents it as the Yang Wanli Poetry and Painting Town. The village keeps his tomb, a provincial protected site, the Yang clan's ancestral hall and the Nanxi bridge among old blue-brick houses, and the site of his former residence has been restored to show how he lived. Scenes from his poems have been recreated, and the village has a study base for school groups.
description: 杨万里故里位于江西吉安。游览特色包括名人故居、祠堂文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Bantang village, Huangqiao town, about 14 km north-west of Wenfeng, Jishui's county town.

name: 羊狮慕
summaryEn: A scenic area of 37.5 km² on the Ji'an side of the Wugong Shan range, next to the Wugong Shan 5A area on the Pingxiang side, centred on a granite peak forest whose highest summit, Shisun Peak, is 1,764 m. The name comes from cloud formations that look like sheep and lions chasing each other, and the Song poet Yang Wanli wrote verse on the rock spires rising through the cloud. A high-level walkway gives views of the peaks and the sea of cloud, and walkers can climb to it from below through the Yeniu Waterfall Canyon.
description: 羊狮慕位于江西吉安。游览特色包括林地风光、登山观景。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: At Wenjia village in Yangshimu town, about 38 km west-north-west of Pingdu, Anfu's county town, on the Ji'an side of the Wugong Shan range.

name: 野牛瀑大峡谷
summaryEn: A gorge about 13 km long on the Wugong Shan range in Anfu, cut by the Gexian River, with waterfalls, pools, odd rock formations and old pines; it is the walking approach to the Yangshimu peaks. A walkway along the river in the lower gorge passes the Qinglong Falls, about 70 m high, and the Yeniu Falls, about 30 m, and reaches the wide Baiyun Falls. Beyond the end of the walkway the gorge continues as a hiking route.
description: 野牛瀑大峡谷位于江西吉安。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At the lower end of the gorge, about 3 km north-north-west of the Wugong Shan visitor centre at Wenjia village and about 39 km west-north-west of Pingdu, Anfu's county town.

name: 红豆杉养生谷
summaryEn: A countryside leisure area near Lutian town, named for its yew trees (more than 300,000, according to a 2023 provincial tourism department article), which the area promotes as a natural oxygen bar. Visitors can walk among the trees and try yew products such as yew wine and yew pillows, and there is a restaurant and guesthouses, with flower-viewing events in spring. It was rated a national 4A scenic area in 2024.
description: 芦田镇附近的乡村休闲区因红豆杉得名，以林木景观和山乡环境为特色。
accessEn: Near Lutian town, about 18 km west-north-west of Furong, the seat of Wan'an county.

name: 曲白院下
summaryEn: A tourist village in Qubai township laid out in Jiangxi-style old-village architecture, with grey brick and tile, horse-head gables and flagstone lanes. It has a food street and food court, a playground, a guesthouse hotel, a large stage in period style, riverside stilt houses, bars and cafes, so it is more a place for an evening meal and a stay than for historic sights. The province lists it as a 3A rural tourism demonstration site.
description: 曲白院下位于江西吉安。游览特色包括田园观光、滨水景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yuanxia village, Qubai township, about 16 km south-south-east of Hechuan, Yongxin's county town.

name: 云天麓谷
summaryEn: A rural leisure area in Tongping town, north of Ji'an, built around a large fishing centre, landscaped gardens and orchards of Jinggang mandarins and pomelos. Visitors can fish, pick fruit in season and walk the grounds, which suit families on a day trip from Ji'an. It was rated a national 4A scenic area in 2022.
description: 云天麓谷位于江西吉安。游览特色包括果园、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tongping town, about 17 km north-north-west of Ji'an.

name: 玉笥养生谷
summaryEn: A wellness park at the foot of Yuzhi Mountain, built around Xiajiang's traditional Chinese medicine industry and opened to visitors in early 2019. It was planned in three zones for wellness experiences, cultural displays and forest recuperation, with exhibits and hands-on spaces on Chinese medicine, set among ancient-style buildings, small bridges and lanterns. It was rated a national 4A scenic area in 2022 and suits a relaxed half-day outing from the county seat.
description: 玉笥养生谷位于江西吉安。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At the foot of Yuzhi Mountain, about 4 km south-west of Shuibian, the seat of Xiajiang county.

name: 怪石林
summaryEn: A scenic area of strangely shaped rock formations on the Wenshan hills where Leping meets Wannian county. It is made up of the stone forest itself, the Water Curtain Cave, a field of boulders and a peak viewpoint, with rocks that look like animals and figures as the main sight.
description: 怪石林位于江西景德镇。游览特色包括石林、林地风光、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Zhongbu town in the Wenshan hills, about 30 km south-south-east of Leping and close to the Wannian county line. Check that it is open before going.

name: 洪岩仙境
summaryEn: A limestone cave in the foothills of Mao Mountain in north-eastern Leping, about 1.6 km long, with stalactites, an underground waterfall and more than 120 named rock formations. Outside the cave is a stone-forest area of about 9 hectares (140 mu) with a pavilion, and the scenic area also keeps the site of a Song-dynasty study hall of the statesman Hong Hao. The cave stays cool in summer and is promoted as a retreat from the heat.
description: 洪岩仙境位于江西景德镇。游览特色包括瀑布、洞穴。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the hills near Hongyan town, about 32 km east-north-east of Leping, close to the Wuyuan and Dexing county borders.

name: 皇窑
summaryEn: A ceramics culture park of about 14 hectares (210 mu) in Xianghu town, laid out in grey-brick, dark-tiled buildings with workshop scenes of the Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing periods. Visitors can follow the 72 stages of hand-made porcelain from clay to kiln and try some of them, and the park receives school study groups. It is a national demonstration base for hand-made porcelain production and research, so it suits visitors who want a hands-on introduction.
description: 皇窑位于江西景德镇。游览特色包括陶瓷工艺。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Gaoling Avenue in Xianghu town, Fuliang, on the north-eastern outskirts of Jingdezhen, about 10 km east-north-east of the Imperial Kiln Museum.

name: 江西直升机科技馆
summaryEn: A science museum of about 10,000 square metres inside the grounds of a helicopter maker in Jingdezhen's high-tech zone; the city is one of China's helicopter-building centres and the Z-8 first flew here in 1985. It displays dozens of real helicopters, models and parts, some of which visitors can climb into, and offers virtual-reality flying and engine-assembly experiences and a view of the helicopter production line. It suits families and anyone interested in aviation.
description: 江西直升机科技馆位于江西景德镇。游览特色包括博物馆、科学科普。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Zhihang Road in the high-tech zone on the western side of Jingdezhen, about 10 km west-south-west of the Imperial Kiln Museum. Check that it is open before going.

name: 名坊园
summaryEn: A ceramics-craft park built in traditional style in the Changnan New District on the north-western edge of Jingdezhen, with a planned area of 1.3 square kilometres. It houses studios of porcelain makers recognised as intangible-heritage practitioners, creation bases of art colleges, the Guoci Pavilion showroom of the Jingdezhen Ceramics Group, and a leisure complex called Jingdezhen Memory with restaurants, bars and performance space. It is a modern development for meeting porcelain makers and shopping for ceramics, not a historic quarter.
description: 名坊园位于江西景德镇。游览特色包括楼阁建筑、陶瓷工艺。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Changnan New District on the north-western edge of Jingdezhen, about 8 km north-north-west of the Imperial Kiln Museum.

name: 陶溪川文创街区
summaryEn: A former state porcelain-factory district east of the old centre, redeveloped from the mid-2010s as a creative quarter. It has artists' studios and ceramic shops, the Central Academy of Fine Arts Taoxichuan Art Museum, a theatre, and markets for ceramics and street food. It shows present-day Jingdezhen, where young potters from across China and abroad work and sell.
description: 陶溪川文创街区位于江西景德镇。游览特色包括博物馆、书院文化、特色街区。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Xinchang West Road in Zhushan district, about 3 km east of the Imperial Kiln Museum.

name: 瑶里古镇
summaryEn: A mountain town in northern Fuliang that made porcelain before the Ming and later supplied porcelain clay and tea to Jingdezhen; its old name was written with the character for "kiln". Its Ming and Qing streets of Jiangxi-style houses stand along the river, with remains of kilns, workshops, wharves and old pack roads around them. In January 1938 Chen Yi presided here over the reorganisation of Red Army guerrilla units in south China before they moved to Anhui to form the New Fourth Army; the three buildings used, the Hongyi Temple, the Jingyi Hall that was his residence and the Cheng ancestral hall, are a national heritage unit.
description: 瑶里古镇位于江西景德镇。游览特色包括古镇、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Yaoli town, about 50 km north-east of Jingdezhen; the town is the main part of the Gaoling–Yaoli Scenic Area (the official 4A listing), and the Gaoling kaolin mine, its other part, is about 8 km to the south-south-west.

name: 长水景区
summaryEn: A mountain-village scenic area around Changshui village, in the foothills of the Jiuling range in south-eastern Wuning, with yew trees, forest cover and a countryside guesthouse. It was rated 4A in 2021 and is paired with Luxi Cave and the Meeting Wuning night show on a one-day cool-summer route listed by the provincial tourism department in 2025. It suits a quiet rural stop rather than a major sight.
description: 长水景区位于江西九江。游览特色包括林地风光、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Changshui village, Luoping town, about 17 km east-south-east of Wuning town and about 85 km south-west of Jiujiang.

name: 东浒寨
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in Zhengcun township, Xiushui county, where Jiangxi meets Hunan and Hubei, with red sandstone cliffs, a valley lake and a waterfall of over 30 m in a rock cave. It is named after two nearby hills shaped like a bell and a drum, which gave it the older name Bell-and-Drum Stockade. Its main draws are via ferrata climbing routes totalling about 3 km, a glass-floored bridge over Yinzi Stream and other adventure rides, so it suits active visitors.
description: 东浒寨位于江西九江。游览特色包括瀑布、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhengcun township, about 17 km south of Xiushui town.

name: 富华山
summaryEn: A 4.76 sq km tourist area on the Poyang Lake shore in Gongqingcheng, opened to visitors in November 2023, that gathers a park, a wetland and several museums in one place. It includes the Gongqingcheng Museum, the Jiangxi Ecological Civilisation Exhibition Hall, an aerospace museum named after Qian Xuesen and a Poyang Lake model test base, along with the cemetery of Hu Yaobang, the party leader who named the settlement Gongqing. A newly built commercial street, Shanghai Memory 1955, adds shops and restaurants in the style of old Shanghai, and the area suits families and school groups.
description: 富华山位于江西九江。游览特色包括博物馆、湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the Poyang Lake shore in the south-east of Gongqingcheng, about 4 km from the city centre and about 50 km south-south-west of Jiujiang. The Gongqingcheng Museum inside the area is closed on Mondays.

name: 共青垦荒文化体验园
summaryEn: A museum-style park on the site of the former Gongqing reclamation farm, where young volunteers from Shanghai began clearing land beside Poyang Lake in 1955; the farm later grew into Gongqingcheng. The old farm buildings have been repaired to look as they did in the 1950s and 1960s, and the park has reclamation tools on display, the site of the original Gongqing collective, a bonfire square, a VR hall and about 17 visiting sections. It suits school groups and anyone interested in how the city began.
description: 共青垦荒文化体验园位于江西九江。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Heping village, Jinhu township, about 7 km north-north-east of central Gongqingcheng.

name: 黄庭坚故里
summaryEn: The village of Shuangjing on the Xiu River, birthplace of the Northern Song poet and calligrapher Huang Tingjian, laid out as a scenic area since 2017 so that the whole village forms the attraction. It has a newly built commercial old street, the Shuangjing Jinshi Garden recalling the village's many successful examination candidates, and the Gaofeng Academy, and the village is also known for Shuangjing tea. It is popular with school study groups.
description: 黄庭坚故里位于江西九江。游览特色包括名人故居、园林景观、书院文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the Xiu River, about 6 km west-north-west of Xiushui town.

name: 凯瑞田园综合体
summaryEn: A farm-tourism complex of about 7,500 mu (500 hectares) in the Taibo Lake agricultural zone, where rice and crayfish are raised in the same fields. It has a farming museum, a hall on shrimp and crab farming, a village built around that theme, glasshouses, and walkways through orchards and bamboo. It suits families and anyone curious about modern Chinese agriculture, and has been rated 4A since 2022.
description: 凯瑞田园综合体位于江西九江。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Taibo Lake agricultural park, about 13 km north-east of Pengze town and about 76 km east-north-east of Jiujiang.

name: 龙宫洞
summaryEn: A karst cave group at the foot of Wulong Mountain in Tianhong town, south-west of Pengze town. The main cave, found in 1978, runs about 1.6 km underground at a steady 18°C all year, and the group also includes the Yuhu and Yuxian caves, a mountain temple and a forest park. A flower garden with a miniature train and other rides has been added on the surface.
description: 龙宫洞位于江西九江。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、洞穴、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills of Tianhong town, about 22 km south-south-west of Pengze town and about 50 km east of Jiujiang.

name: 龙源峡
summaryEn: A river gorge in the hills of the Yunshan area, deep inside the Yunju Mountain national scenic zone, with clear streams, cliffs and woods. A family-friendly rafting run through the gorge is its main activity in the warm months. It was rated 4A in February 2026.
description: 龙源峡位于江西九江。游览特色包括峡谷、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills about 10 km west of Zhenru Temple on Yunju Mountain, about 35 km west-north-west of Yongxiu town and about 79 km south-west of Jiujiang.

name: 鹿鸣谷
summaryEn: A family resort of about 2,000 mu (roughly 133 ha) on the edge of Xiushui town, built around a deer theme; its second phase, the former Xiushui hot-spring town, opened in January 2025. It combines hot-spring pools with a petting zoo where visitors can feed sika deer, plus evening shows and light displays. It suits families with children rather than anyone looking for heritage or scenery.
description: 鹿鸣谷位于江西九江。游览特色包括动物观赏、天然泉水。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the south-eastern edge of Xiushui town.

name: 庐山西海国际温泉度假村
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort at Yijiahe village on the south shore of the Xihai reservoir, listed by the province as Lushan Xihai Hot Spring Resort, with a large hotel, villas and a spa park of pools grouped by bathing style, among them Chinese, Japanese, Roman and Finnish sections and a herbal-bath cave. It also has a water-play area, and the hot water comes from a spring well. It makes a comfortable base for Lushan Xihai, the 5A lake scenic area, and for Yunju Mountain, and suits an overnight stay.
description: 庐山西海国际温泉度假村位于江西九江。游览特色包括温泉、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Yijiahe village on the south shore of the Xihai reservoir, about 36 km west-north-west of Yongxiu town and about 68 km south-west of Jiujiang. Check that it is open before going.

name: 鲁溪洞
summaryEn: A cave in the Mufu Mountains near Luxi town, at the source of the Luxi River, with stalactites throughout and an underground stream running through it. The cool interior makes it a summer stop, and the provincial tourism department's 2025 cool-summer route pairs it with Changshui and the Meeting Wuning night show. It was rated 4A in February 2024.
description: 鲁溪洞位于江西九江。游览特色包括洞穴、钟乳石。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 2 km east-north-east of Luxi town, about 27 km north-east of Wuning town and about 72 km west-south-west of Jiujiang.

name: 蔓谷田园综合体
summaryEn: A countryside leisure complex of about 7,900 mu (530 hectares) south-east of Pengze's national modern agriculture park, styled after the Wei and Jin dynasties. It has flower beds, rice-and-crayfish fields, a fruit-picking area, a fishing area, a children's play area, a small animal park, camping lawns, a hotel and guesthouses. It was rated 4A in February 2026.
description: 蔓谷田园综合体位于江西九江。游览特色包括动物观赏、田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the same farming district as Kairui, about 13 km east-north-east of Pengze town and about 77 km east-north-east of Jiujiang.

name: 鄱阳湖南山
summaryEn: A wooded hill on the southern side of Duchang town, laid out as a forest park, with views over the wide waters of Poyang Lake and old temples. Local tradition ties the Song poet Su Shi's verse on Duchang to a visit to Nanshan. It makes an easy stop for lake views and a short walk.
description: 鄱阳湖南山位于江西九江。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the southern side of Duchang town, beside Dongpo Road, about 51 km south-south-east of Jiujiang.

name: 南山公园
summaryEn: A wooded city park in Lianxi district, in the southern part of Jiujiang's built-up area, where residents relax and gather for events. It was the main venue of Jiangxi's 2022 intangible-heritage shopping festival, which brought together stalls for crafts, food and traditional medicine from across the province. It suits a short stop for green space in the city rather than a major sight.
description: 南山公园位于江西九江。游览特色包括林地风光、城市公园、节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Lianxi district, in the southern part of Jiujiang's built-up area, near the junction of Nanshan Road and Huaxi Road.

name: 浔阳江琵琶亭
summaryEn: A riverside park on the Yangtze bank in eastern Jiujiang, built around the rebuilt Pipa Pavilion, which takes its name from the Tang poet Bai Juyi's poem Song of the Pipa. Bai Juyi wrote it in 816 after hearing a pipa player on a boat on this stretch of river, then called the Xunyang River, while he was in exile in Jiujiang. The pavilion was rebuilt in 1988, and the park around it, with a pond, scenes from the poem and a digital show in which visitors talk with Bai Juyi, opened in April 2017.
description: 浔阳江琵琶亭位于江西九江。游览特色包括滨水景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the Yangtze bank beside Binjiang East Road in eastern Jiujiang, about 2 km east-north-east of Suojianglou Pagoda, with a riverside path between the two.

name: 赛城湖
summaryEn: A lakeside park and greenway on Saicheng Lake, in the Balihu New District on the western side of Jiujiang. Its shore path is used for walking, cycling and angling, and the park suits a short outdoor stop rather than a full outing.
description: 赛城湖位于江西九江。游览特色包括湖泊、绿道骑行。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jiujiang's Balihu New District, on the western side of the city.

name: 阳光照耀29度假村
summaryEn: A lakeside resort on more than a hundred islands and peninsulas of the Xihai reservoir in Yangzhou township, named for lying near latitude 29°N. Many of the islands are planted with a single flower, such as peach, magnolia, begonia or verbena, a flower festival is held each spring, and there is a sandy beach with water sports and wooden cabins. Boat routes link it with Wuning town and the main Lushan Xihai scenic area.
description: 阳光照耀29度假村位于江西九江。游览特色包括水库、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the Xihai reservoir in Yangzhou township, about 31 km east of Wuning town and about 47 km west-north-west of Yongxiu town, with cruise boats from Wuning town.

name: 台山公园
summaryEn: A town park in the centre of Hukou, on Taishan Avenue, rated 4A as part of the county's Taishan scenic area, which also takes in Shizhong Park, the Hukou County Museum and a planning exhibition hall. The museum and Shizhong Park stand close by, so it fits into a walk around the town centre before or after a visit to Shizhongshan on the Yangtze.
description: 台山公园位于江西九江。游览特色包括博物馆、主题展览。图集建议预留约1 小时游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Hukou town, on Taishan Avenue, about 30 km east-north-east of Jiujiang.

name: 汤太宗温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in Wenquan town, on the southern side of Mount Lushan, built in Han and Tang style with bathing pools set into the hillside and a hotel on site. Wenquan is known for its mineral springs, and this resort draws on water that rises from deep wells at about 70°C. It suits a relaxed half-day soak or an overnight stay rather than sightseeing.
description: 汤太宗温泉位于江西九江。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wenquan town, about 12 km west-south-west of Nankang, the main town of Lushan City, and about 27 km south of Jiujiang.

name: 庐山天沐温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in Wenquan town, at the foot of Mount Lushan, combining spa pools with a hotel, restaurants and meeting and entertainment facilities. Wenquan's mineral springs are used by several resorts, of which this is one, and it suits a relaxed half-day soak or overnight stay more than sightseeing.
description: 庐山天沐温泉位于江西九江。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wenquan town, about 12 km west-south-west of Nankang and about 28 km south of Jiujiang.

name: 铜源剪影文化园
summaryEn: A culture park at Xiafan town, on both banks of the Nanyang River beside the Tongling mine site, built around Ruichang paper-cutting, a craft on China's national intangible heritage list. It is planned in five sections, among them a paper-cutting town with a museum of the craft, a street of craft studios and an opera stage, together with farmland, a mine park and an artists' quarter. The museum has a hands-on area where visitors can try the stages of paper-cutting.
description: 铜源剪影文化园位于江西九江。游览特色包括博物馆、非遗文化、矿业遗产。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xiafan town, about 16 km north-west of Ruichang and about 41 km west-north-west of Jiujiang, about 2 km north-west of the Tongling Copper Mine Site. Check that it is open before going.

name: 中华贤母园
summaryEn: A themed park on the western side of Jiujiang devoted to the figure of the exemplary mother in Chinese tradition. It has display halls and sculptures, and it includes the Jiangxi Virtuous Mothers Culture Museum.
description: 中华贤母园位于江西九江。游览特色包括博物馆、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Yuanming Avenue on the western side of Jiujiang's built-up area, in Chaisang district. Closed on Mondays.

name: 万家岭大捷纪念园
summaryEn: A memorial park on the northern edge of De'an town commemorating the Battle of Wanjialing, fought in the hills of this county in autumn 1938 during the Second Sino-Japanese War between Chinese forces and the Japanese 106th Division. The exhibition hall shows relics and extracts from Japanese soldiers' diaries, and the park was added to China's national list of anti-war memorial facilities in 2015. The battlefield remains, including trenches and bunkers, lie in the hills at Moxi township and are a separate trip.
description: 万家岭大捷纪念园位于江西九江。游览特色包括主题展览、战役遗址、历史纪念。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the northern edge of De'an town, about 41 km south-south-west of Jiujiang.

name: 吴城候鸟小镇
summaryEn: A historic trading town on the western shore of Poyang Lake that has become a centre for watching wintering waterbirds, which gather on the lake's wetlands in large flocks. Bird-watching points with hides and towers are set around the nearby lakes, and Wanghu Pavilion in the town looks out over the water. In the high-water season from April to September, a 5 km section of the Yongwu Road at Dahuchi can be covered by shallow water and is promoted as a "water road".
description: 吴城候鸟小镇位于江西九江。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wucheng town on the western shore of Poyang Lake, about 26 km north-east of Yongxiu town and about 53 km south of Jiujiang, with the bird-watching points a few kilometres west-south-west along the Yongwu Road.

name: 西海湾
summaryEn: A lakeside park that makes up much of the centre of Wuning town, joining Chaoyang Lake, the Shatian River wetland park and several smaller parks with bridges, pavilions and waterside walks. Boats for cruises on the Xihai reservoir leave from the pier here, and in the evening a staged water show, Meeting Wuning, is performed with the shoreline lit up. It is an easy stop for a stroll or a boat trip.
description: 西海湾位于江西九江。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Wuning town on the shore of Chaoyang Lake, beside the pier for Xihai cruises; the town is about 95 km west-south-west of Jiujiang.

name: 安义古村群
summaryEn: Anyi Ancient Villages is a group of three villages, Luotian, Shuinan and Jingtai, arranged in a triangle in Shibi town, Anyi county, at the foot of the Meiling hills. The villages date from the Tang dynasty and are listed as Chinese traditional villages; Luotian grew into an old market town on the pilgrim route to Meiling and the Wanshou Palace at Xishan. The lanes have been developed for visitors with homestays, a regional snack street, teahouses and cafés.
description: 安义古村群位于江西南昌。游览特色包括古村落、村落风光、传统村落。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shibi town, about 12 km south-south-east of Anyi town and about 30 km west-north-west of central Nanchang.

name: 竹海明珠
summaryEn: Bamboo Sea Pearl, once known as the main peak of Meiling, is a bamboo-covered valley in the heart of the Meiling hills whose slopes climb to the Hualaoji peak, more than 800 m high. A series of coloured cascades drops over rocks at the entrance, and odd-shaped boulders, among them a tortoise-shaped one, stand among the bamboo.
description: 竹海明珠位于江西南昌。游览特色包括山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Xichang village area of Meiling town, about 21 km north-west of central Nanchang.

name: 方大特钢工业旅游区
summaryEn: An operating steel works in Qingshanhu district opened to visitors as an industrial tourism area, rated 4A in June 2022 as the first steelmaker in Jiangxi and the third in China to receive the rating. The plant, which makes spring flat steel and leaf springs for vehicles, has a visitor centre and a gift shop, and a tour can take in a rolling-mill line, a steelmaking plant, a control centre, a wetland landscape at the coking plant and a company exhibition hall. Leisure and study-tour programmes are also offered.
description: 方大特钢工业旅游区位于江西南昌。游览特色包括湿地、工业参观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Nangang subdistrict of Qingshanhu district, on the eastern side of Nanchang.

name: 凤凰沟
summaryEn: Fenghuanggou is a tea-growing and leisure estate of about 6 sq km in red-soil hills in Huangma township, Nanchang County, run as a modern agriculture demonstration park. Terraced tea gardens covering more than 2,100 mu (about 140 hectares) surround a cherry-blossom valley that flowers from late February to April, and the ginkgoes turn gold in December. Lakes, wetland, fruit and vegetable picking and a silk-and-mulberry theme add to a visit, which suits families and photographers in the flowering seasons.
description: 凤凰沟位于江西南昌。游览特色包括湿地、山谷、茶文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Huangma township of Nanchang County, about 35 km south-south-east of central Nanchang.

name: 怪石岭
summaryEn: Guaishiling Ecological Park is a hill-and-lake leisure area of about 4,200 mu (some 280 hectares) at Xixia town, north-west of Nanchang. Its crags include a natural climbing wall, and a 4.38 km agricultural viewing corridor is built in the form of a Great Wall, with trails, fishing and campsites in the grounds. It is a farm-and-leisure park rather than a wild landscape, and suits families and day trippers.
description: 怪石岭位于江西南昌。游览特色包括长城、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xixia town, Xinjian district, about 22 km north-north-west of central Nanchang.

name: 梅岭狮子峰
summaryEn: Lion Peak is a peak on the north-western side of the Meiling hills in Wanli district, named for its resemblance to a crouching lion, with a stream valley, bamboo woods, boulders, a suspension bridge and a summit viewpoint. The scenic area has also added adventure and water activities, and the district promotes it as a cool retreat for the city in summer.
description: 梅岭狮子峰位于江西南昌。游览特色包括山谷、登山观景、河溪风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Panxi village, Taiping town, on the north-western side of the Meiling hills, about 24 km north-west of central Nanchang.

name: 华侨城欢乐象湖
summaryEn: OCT Happy Xianghu is a leisure district developed by the OCT (Overseas Chinese Town) group on the west shore of Xianghu lake, rated 4A in 2022. It includes the Maya Beach water park, which the provincial tourism department lists on its summer city route.
description: 华侨城欢乐象湖位于江西南昌。游览特色包括湖泊、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the west shore of Xianghu lake in Xihu district, on the southern side of Nanchang.

name: 南昌融创乐园
summaryEn: Sunac Theme Park is an amusement park in the Jiulonghu area of Honggutan district, part of the Sunac cultural-tourism complex on the south-western side of Nanchang. It runs amusement rides and staged shows, and Sunac's separate ocean park, Sunac Sea World, stands in the same area.
description: 南昌融创乐园位于江西南昌。游览特色包括主题游乐、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Jiulonghu area of Honggutan district, on the south-western side of Nanchang.

name: 铜源峡
summaryEn: Tongyuan Gorge is a scenic area in the wooded hills of Xinjian district on the Meiling side of Nanchang, rated 4A in 2024. The city promotes it for spring flowers, with rapeseed fields of about 100 mu and a thousand peach trees, and the provincial tourism department lists it first on a one-day summer route of mountain and stream scenery that goes on to the Meiling hills and Guaishiling.
description: 铜源峡位于江西南昌。游览特色包括峡谷、油菜花田、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wangcheng town, Xinjian district, about 19 km west of central Nanchang.

name: 万寿宫历史文化街区
summaryEn: A quarter of lanes and shops rebuilt in old style around the Tiezhu Wanshou Palace, the Taoist temple of the Xu Xun cult, which stood in Nanchang's old city from the fourth century until it was burned down in the Cultural Revolution; the quarter opened in February 2021. Streets of grey brick and tile hold restaurants and shops selling local snacks and gifts, and an open-air stage is used for evening performances. It is lively after dark, and the city promotes a walking route linking it with the Pavilion of Prince Teng.
description: 万寿宫历史文化街区位于江西南昌。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、特色街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
