accessEn: On Zhongshan Road in Nanchang's Xihu district, beside the August 1 Uprising Memorial Hall.

name: 原城纪·南昌城市文化街区
summaryEn: Yuanchengji is a street quarter of about 250 mu (roughly 17 hectares) built in the Yinsanjiao area south-east of central Nanchang and opened in September 2020, designed to recall the city in the Republican era. Its two- to six-storey buildings are new, made in old-street style, and hold an arcade food street, a tea house staging Gan-region opera, craft and intangible-heritage workshops, shops and a boutique hotel. It is a place for a food-and-shopping stroll, not a historic district.
description: 原城纪·南昌城市文化街区位于江西南昌。游览特色包括特色街区。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Yinsanjiao area of Nanchang County, about 18 km south-south-east of central Nanchang and next to Yinsanjiao North station on Metro Line 3.

name: 佐家寨生态乐园
summaryEn: Zuojiazhai is a countryside leisure park of about 2,200 mu (150 hectares) on the Maogang farm in Qianfang town, Jinxian county, laid out around orchards, flower fields and the Yanming lake. Spring brings cherry blossom and flowering ground-cover phlox, with fruit picking, a long kiwi-fruit corridor, a tropical plant garden and family play areas, and the park stages a live-action show about the 1927 Nanchang Uprising. It was added to the national 4A list in February 2026.
description: 佐家寨生态乐园位于江西南昌。游览特色包括湖泊、果园、花卉观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Qianfang town, Jinxian county, about 10 km north of Minhe, the county town, and 40 km south-east of central Nanchang.

name: 武功山花涧里
summaryEn: Huajianli is a leisure and culture-tourism complex at the foot of Wugong Shan, built as a lowland attraction to go with the mountain. It stages shows, camp-site parties and food markets at holiday times, and hosted an outdoor electronic-music festival in 2022. It is a modern development in a village setting rather than a historic site, and has since been rated a national 4A scenic area.
description: 武功山花涧里位于江西萍乡。游览特色包括音乐文化、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At the foot of the range in Xinquan township, about 17 km south-south-east of Luxi town and a short distance north-west of the Wugong Shan visitor centre.

name: 麻山幸福村
summaryEn: A rural-tourism village on the edge of Mashan town in the south-west of Pingxiang's Xiangdong District, set among farmland and rated a national 4A scenic area. Mashan town has been named one of China's key rural-tourism towns and a provincial 'scenery unrivalled' tourism town. It is a countryside destination for day visits rather than a single sight.
description: 麻山幸福村位于江西萍乡。游览特色包括田园观光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the edge of Mashan town, about 10 km south-west of Pingxiang.

name: 仙凤三宝
summaryEn: A countryside leisure park at Zhuyuan village, Xuanfeng town, rated a national 4A scenic area as an agricultural leisure and sightseeing park. Pingxiang's tourism authorities promote it as a place for family outings and farmland leisure within reach of the city. It is a modern commercial park built on farmland, not a historic place.
description: 仙凤三宝位于江西萍乡。游览特色包括公园休闲、田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhuyuan village, Xuanfeng town, about 18 km east-north-east of Luxi town.

name: 月上广寒
summaryEn: A countryside scenic area in Guanghanzhai township, in the forested hills in the south of Pingxiang's Xiangdong District, rated a national 4A scenic area in 2025. People's Daily Jiangxi describes the township's Dashajiang river valley, its village tofu and bamboo-shoot workshops and its village guesthouses. It is a rural leisure area rather than a single sight.
description: 月上广寒位于江西萍乡。游览特色包括山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Guanghanzhai township, about 28 km south-south-west of Pingxiang.

name: 武功山云顶
summaryEn: Yunding is a separately rated part of the Luxi side of Wugong Shan, listed as a national 4A scenic area in its own right in 2022 rather than as part of the 5A core. Local tourism authorities join it with the Jinding area around the summit as a 'Yunding–Jinding' circuit. Its start point is the car park at Dongjiang village on the northern side of the range, from which paths climb towards the ridge.
description: 武功山云顶位于江西萍乡。游览特色包括登山观景。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: At Dongjiang village in Xinquan township, about 21 km south-east of Luxi town and about 34 km east-south-east of Pingxiang.

name: 大明花海
summaryEn: Daming Flower Sea is a flower-themed leisure park on the shore of Daming Lake, one of the lakes inside the Kangshan dyke on the south-east side of Poyang Lake. Work began in 2016, and the park has planted gardens of roses, crape myrtle and cherry trees, a landscaped waterfall and areas for wedding photography. It is a commercial attraction, and what is in bloom depends on the season.
description: 大明花海位于江西上饶。游览特色包括瀑布、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Datang township, about 17 km west-north-west of Yugan town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 叠山文化园
summaryEn: Dieshan Culture Park is centred on Dieshan Academy, a provincial protected site on the Xin River bank, first built in 1318 in memory of Xie Fangde (sobriquet Dieshan), a Southern Song loyalist who refused to serve the Yuan dynasty and died in 1289. The academy was rebuilt in the Ming dynasty and keeps its lecture hall, river-view tower, Wenchang pavilion and osmanthus garden; Fang Zhimin and Shao Shiping studied here between 1916 and 1919. The park became a national 4A scenic area in 2024 and is a stop on a Fang Zhimin heritage route launched in Yiyang in 2025.
description: 叠山文化园位于江西上饶。游览特色包括园林景观、楼阁建筑、书院文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Wangjiang Road on the north bank of the Xin River at Yiyang town, which is about 49 km west of Shangrao city.

name: 三清山神仙谷
summaryEn: Fairy Valley is a stream valley at the foot of Mount Sanqing, one of several smaller scenic areas around the mountain that are separate from the summit circuits. Streams and small waterfalls run through wooded hills, and the valley is set up for outdoor activities such as stream-tracing and forest crossing, with a caravan campsite among its experience bases.
description: 三清山神仙谷位于江西上饶。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At the south-western foot of Mount Sanqing, about 5 km west of the mountain's south-gate (Waishuangxi) service area and about 31 km north-west of Yushan town.

name: 广丰红木文化创意产业园
summaryEn: This is an industrial-tourism park for the redwood furniture and wood-carving trade in Yangkou town, run by a local redwood company and named a provincial industrial-tourism demonstration base in 2022. It is a modern commercial park rather than a historic site, aimed at visitors interested in redwood furniture and carving.
description: 园区依托上饶广丰洋口镇的红木产业，展示红木家具和当地木雕工艺。
accessEn: In Yangkou town, Guangfeng District, about 17 km east-south-east of Shangrao city. Check that it is open before going.

name: 灵山工匠小镇
summaryEn: A craft-themed tourist district on the road from Shangrao towards Lingshan, listed by local government among the cultural-industry projects of the former Shangrao County. Its second phase opened in 2020, and it was rated a national 4A scenic area in 2019. It is a modern development rather than a historic quarter, and suits a short stop on the way to Lingshan.
description: 小镇位于上饶通往灵山的道路旁，是以传统工艺与文创体验为主题的旅游街区。
accessEn: In Luoqiao subdistrict on the north-western edge of Shangrao's urban area, on the road towards Lingshan. Check that it is open before going.

name: 灵山
summaryEn: Lingshan is a granite mountain in the north of Guangxin District, with 72 peaks and 36 waterfalls, rock formations known as Sleeping Beauty, the Dragon's Spine and the Kissing Fish, and a main summit of 1,496 m. It is counted as the 33rd of Taoism's 72 blessed lands, with old temples such as Shiren Hall and Shicheng Temple nearby. It has been a national-level scenic area since 2009, and spring brings rhododendrons on the high slopes and terraced fields below.
description: 灵山位于江西上饶。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 15 km north-west of Shangrao city, in Guangxin District.

name: 三清山田园牧歌
summaryEn: Pastoral Idyll is a countryside-style holiday area beside the mountain road near the Jinsha entrance on the eastern side of Mount Sanqing. It is themed on Jiangnan (lower Yangtze) folk culture and is built around farmhouse-style guest rooms, restaurants, a hot spring and evening bonfire entertainment.
description: 三清山田园牧歌位于江西上饶。游览特色包括温泉、民俗文化、田园观光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the mountain road near the Jinsha entrance, about 3.7 km north-west of the Jinsha cable-car station and about 34 km north-north-west of Yushan town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 凤凰湖
summaryEn: Phoenix Lake is a reservoir in wooded hills on the southern side of Dexing city, laid out as a lakeside park with walking paths; the Dexing Museum stands in the scenic area. A stone-flagged old trail, the Phoenix Ancient Path, runs along the inner end of the lake and over Phoenix Ridge. It became a national 4A scenic area in 2024 and suits a short local outing rather than a long trip.
description: 凤凰湖位于江西上饶。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the southern side of Dexing city, which is about 63 km north-north-west of Shangrao city.

name: 琵琶湖
summaryEn: Pipa Lake is a lakeside wetland park on the south-western edge of Yugan town, laid out around a large urban lake with a peninsula plaza, walkways, a pavilion and a Ferris wheel. It was built as part of the county's three-lake tourism plan with Poyang Lake and Daming Lake, and a night-market arcade and a public reading room have since been set up there. It suits a short stroll by the water rather than a long visit.
description: 琵琶湖位于江西上饶。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the south-western side of Yugan town, beside the lake that gives the park its name.

name: 鄱阳湖国家湿地公园
summaryEn: Poyang Lake National Wetland Park covers channels, islands and shoreline at Wujincha, on the Poyang County side of China's largest freshwater lake. The lake is a winter refuge for migratory waterbirds, including a large share of the world's Siberian cranes, and the park is one of the bird-watching sites Jiangxi promotes to visitors. It suits a day of birdwatching in the winter months.
description: 鄱阳湖国家湿地公园位于江西上饶。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Wujincha on the lake shore in Tuanlin township, about 14 km north of Poyang town, which is about 55 km west-south-west of Jingdezhen.

name: 七里街
summaryEn: Qili Street is an old street in the south-west of Yushan town, beside the Bingxi river, and the scenic area includes a street of inkstone carvers. Their Luowen inkstones are the town's best-known craft, and Yushan holds the title of home of Luowen inkstones. It suits a short walk to look at the inkstones and the old quarter.
description: 七里街位于江西上饶。游览特色包括历史街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the south-west of Yushan town, beside the Bingxi river; Yushan is about 39 km north-east of Shangrao city.

name: 饶州古镇
summaryEn: Raozhou Ancient Town is a tourism and leisure quarter in the north of Poyang town, laid out in old-street style around a pond, with shops selling local snacks and sweets such as scallion biscuits (congsu bing) and filled sugar (guanxin tang). It was named one of China's first national tourism and leisure districts in 2022. The name recalls Raozhou, the prefecture whose seat was at Poyang for many centuries.
description: 饶州古镇位于江西上饶。游览特色包括古镇。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the north of Poyang town; Poyang is about 55 km west-south-west of Jingdezhen.

name: 神农源
summaryEn: Shennongyuan is a scenic area in the hills of Dayuan town, Wannian County, built around the Shennong Palace karst cave, whose stalactites and underground river are the main sight. The county promotes it, together with the nearby Xianrendong archaeological site, as a base for learning about rice culture and geology. It suits visitors interested in caves, or anyone combining a visit with the prehistoric site.
description: 神农源位于江西上饶。游览特色包括洞穴、喀斯特地貌、历史遗址。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Dayuan town, about 20 km east of Wannian town; the Xianrendong site is about 8 km to the west-north-west.

name: 水墨上河
summaryEn: Shuimo Shanghe is a tourism development around Shanghe village in Qiukou town, themed on Huizhou culture and built as a cultural-industry park that was complete by 2019. It combines the old village with newly built hotels, guesthouses and visitor facilities beside a lake, and Wuyuan's government counts it among the county's large resort-scale scenic areas.
description: 水墨上河位于江西上饶。游览特色包括湖泊、传统村落。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Qiukou town, about 10 km north-north-east of Wuyuan town.

name: 思溪延村
summaryEn: Sixi and Yancun are neighbouring villages in Sikou town, just over a kilometre apart, both listed as China Historic and Cultural Villages (Yancun in the fourth batch, Sixi in 2014). Yancun was founded in the Northern Song dynasty and keeps 53 well-preserved Ming and Qing houses, among them the Congting and Dujing halls, with a visitor centre, a village history museum, an old opera stage and a bridge. Sixi has its own merchants' houses, bridge and halls, protected at city or county level.
description: 思溪延村位于江西上饶。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Sikou town, about 12 km north-north-west of Wuyuan town; the pin is at Yancun.

name: 望仙谷
summaryEn: Wangxian Valley is a rock-walled gorge in Wangxian township, in the north of Guangxin District, developed as a tourist destination with a cliff-and-immortals fantasy theme and known for its night views. Yanpu Old Street, its shopping and dining street, has been recognised as a national tourism and leisure district. Shangrao's tourism bureau lists it among the city's busiest sights, with more than 3 million visitors in 2025.
description: 望仙谷位于江西上饶。游览特色包括峡谷、山谷、夜景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wangxian township, Guangxin District, about 28 km north-north-west of Shangrao city.

name: 文公山
summaryEn: Wengong Mountain is a wooded hill in the hills south-west of Wuyuan town, named after the Neo-Confucian philosopher Zhu Xi (posthumous title Wengong), whose family came from Wuyuan. It is where Zhu Xi came to honour his ancestors' tomb and planted 24 fir trees, which makes it one of Wuyuan's Zhu Xi sites alongside Xi Garden and Lingyan Cave. It suits visitors interested in Zhu Xi or a quiet walk in the forest.
description: 文公山位于江西上饶。游览特色包括园林景观、林地风光、洞穴。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the hills about 13 km south-west of Wuyuan town.

name: 大鄣山卧龙谷
summaryEn: Wolong Valley is a wooded mountain gorge in Dazhangshan township, in the high ground of northern Wuyuan, where a stream drops through pools and small waterfalls. Paths follow the valley, with a viewing platform and a covered bridge along the route. Shangrao's 2025-26 tourism plans list a resort town at the valley as a project under construction.
description: 大鄣山卧龙谷位于江西上饶。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Dazhangshan township, about 32 km north-north-west of Wuyuan town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 熹园
summaryEn: Xi Garden is a Huizhou-style garden complex on the edge of Wuyuan town, on the site of Zhujiazhuang, the village where Zhu Xi's second- and third-generation ancestors lived. It is laid out around Zhufei Pond, with old Huizhou houses on the east side, the Zunjing Pavilion, a ring of ponds in the middle, an exhibition of She inkstones on the west and the Ziyang Academy on the north, with a shrine to three sages in the grounds. It is used for ceremonies for Zhu Xi's descendants, such as a 2019 visit by descendants from Korea.
description: 熹园位于江西上饶。游览特色包括园林景观、楼阁建筑、书院文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north-western edge of Wuyuan town, at the foot of the hills beside the river.

name: 严田
summaryEn: Yantian is a village settled by Li-clan families in Fuchun town, in north-western Wuyuan, strung along the old Huizhou–Raozhou post road, with a Ming-dynasty patrol post among its hamlets. At the village's water-mouth stand ancient camphor trees, beside old stone bridges, a pavilion and a spring, and a camphor folk park built in 2002 with workshops for paper umbrellas, tofu, oil pressing and mushroom growing. Several of its bridges and old houses are protected at county level.
description: 严田位于江西上饶。游览特色包括楼阁建筑、桥梁建筑、历史建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Fuchun town, about 24 km west-north-west of Wuyuan town.

name: 隐居·石头部落
summaryEn: Yinju Stone Tribe is a hill hamlet in Dexing whose 18 surviving houses were built in the 1960s and 70s from river pebbles and flat stones, bonded with a clay-and-lime mortar mixed with glutinous rice. The local government restored fallen houses and added an old-style timber complex around them with folk-custom displays, shops, a covered bridge and an opera stage, so the site is part vernacular village and part new tourist development. It suits visitors interested in rural building traditions.
description: 德兴山间的小村保留着一批用河卵石和片石砌成的民居，房屋多建于上世纪六七十年代。
accessEn: In Shangyuantou hamlet, Chenfang village, Longtoushan township, about 35 km east of Dexing city.

name: 翼天文化旅游城
summaryEn: Yitian Cultural Tourism City is a purpose-built visitor complex on a river bend south of Wuyuan town, run by the Yitian cultural-tourism company, whose core project is Mengli Laojia ('Old Home in Dreams'), a large live outdoor show with a landscape backdrop. The show presents the struggles of Huizhou merchants, a love story, success in the imperial examinations and a life of retirement, and the complex is also marketed as the Mengli Laojia performing-arts tourist resort. It is a modern development, not a historic site.
description: 旅游城建在婺源县城以南的河湾位置，集文旅体验和休闲设施于一处。
accessEn: Near Majia village, about 6 km south-south-west of Wuyuan town.

name: 源头古村
summaryEn: Yuantou is a small village in a mountain valley in Fuchun town, a settlement of the Wu clan founded in the early Ming dynasty, with a stream, small bridges, a traditional water-mouth grove and old Huizhou-style houses. Old red-bean yew trees grow nearby and rapeseed fields colour the valley in spring. It is quieter and smaller than Wuyuan's best-known villages.
description: 源头古村位于江西上饶。游览特色包括古村落、油菜花田、山谷。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Fuchun town, about 30 km north-west of Wuyuan town.

name: 鸳鸯湖
summaryEn: Yuanyang Lake is a reservoir among wooded hills in Fuchun town, both a nature reserve and a tourist scenic area, promoted as a winter roosting ground for wild mandarin ducks, which arrive in autumn and leave in spring. It suits a quiet visit in the cooler months, when the birds are present.
description: 鸳鸯湖位于江西上饶。游览特色包括湖泊、水库、自然保护区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Fuchun town, about 33 km west-north-west of Wuyuan town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 三清山玉帘瀑布
summaryEn: A separate 4A scenic area in the Sanqingshan area, laid out as a walk up a forested valley below the mountain's north-eastern slopes, past a series of named waterfalls, nine in all. It offers streams, pools and woodland rather than the granite summit scenery of the main mountain, and suits a short visit alongside it.
description: 三清山玉帘瀑布位于江西上饶。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north-eastern side of the Sanqingshan area, close to the Jinsha service area and about 32 km north-north-west of Yushan town.

name: 云谷田园生态农业小镇
summaryEn: A farm-themed leisure park on the southern side of Shangrao, in Guangxin District, built around smart farming: a vertical vegetable factory and a fruit-and-vegetable base were shown to provincial officials in June 2024, and an aerospace science exhibition opened in 2023. Its first phase opened in 2020, and it is one of four national 4A scenic areas in Guangxin District. It suits families and anyone curious about modern farming rather than traditional villages.
description: 云谷田园生态农业小镇位于江西上饶。游览特色包括田园观光、农业体验、公园休闲。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 12 km south-east of Shangrao city, in Guangxin District.

name: 忠义文化园
summaryEn: The park is built around Zhongchen Temple, which stands beside Poyang Lake at Kangshan and honours 36 Ming generals, among them Han Cheng and Ding Pulang, killed in the 1363 Battle of Lake Poyang, where Zhu Yuanzhang defeated Chen Youliang. The temple has three halls in a row, the Dingjiang King hall, a Guanyin hall and the main hall of the loyal officers; the present buildings date from the Qing dynasty and have been restored since 1995. Around them the park has added old-style buildings, gardens, a performance hall and a shopping street, and it was rated a national 4A scenic area in 2018.
description: 忠义文化园位于江西上饶。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Kangshan township on the south-east shore of Poyang Lake, about 33 km north-west of Yugan town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 中国洞都
summaryEn: Dongcun township, in the north-east of Fenyi county, promotes itself as China's cave capital, and the 4A scenic area opens some of its karst caves to visitors. Xinyu's government lists it among the city's scenic sights alongside Fairy Lake.
description: 中国洞都位于江西新余。游览特色包括洞穴、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Dongcun township, about 28 km north-north-east of Fenyi town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 洪阳洞
summaryEn: A karst cave 983 m long with stalactites and stalagmites under coloured lighting, kept at a steady temperature of about 20°C that makes it a summer retreat. Outside the entrance there are a sunken stage, a non-powered play area, a small train and a slide. It was rated a national 4A scenic area in February 2026, and Xinyu's tourism bureau groups it with Fairy Lake and Jieqiao village.
description: 洪阳洞位于江西新余。游览特色包括洞穴、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Fenyi county, about 6.5 km south-west of Fenyi town and about 28 km west of Xinyu; the provincial list places it under Xinyu's Fairy Lake district.

name: 介桥古村
summaryEn: A village just south of Fenyi town with Ming and Qing family halls, promoted as the home village of the Ming grand secretary Yan Song (1480–1567). It has been developed for visitors, with evening shows such as role-play dramas, opera and molten-iron sparks, and a second phase was under construction in 2024. Xinyu's tourism bureau groups it with Hongyang Cave and Fairy Lake.
description: 介桥古村位于江西新余。游览特色包括湖泊、古村落。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 2 km south of Fenyi town.

name: 金石山
summaryEn: Jinshishan is a century-old mine in Ouli town, restored and turned into a leisure park covering about 1,278 mu (some 85 hectares), with more than 200 mu of new woodland and 360 mu of grass over the old workings. Its attractions include a central cascade, a mine-tunnel exploration hall, a high combined tower and a cliff-top viewing area, with a resort section in old-town style. Jiangxi Daily reported large crowds there in May 2026, and the provincial list names it the Xinyu Jinshishan resort.
description: 金石山位于江西新余。游览特色包括楼阁建筑、林地风光、公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Ouli town, about 13 km north-west of Xinyu.

name: 双林夏布
summaryEn: A culture-tourism area at Shuanglin town, in the heartland of Fenyi's ramie-cloth industry; Fenyi is known as the home of xiabu, 'summer cloth' woven by hand from ramie fibre. The grounds combine exhibition space on weaving and Xiabu embroidery, which is a national intangible heritage item, with an experience village for hands-on workshops. It was rated a national 4A scenic area in 2021, and the county was upgrading its experience village in 2024.
description: 双林夏布位于江西新余。游览特色包括非遗文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Shuanglin town, about 15 km north-north-east of Fenyi town.

name: 百峰岭
summaryEn: A horticulture-themed scenic area in the countryside of Gao'an. It was rated national 4A in 2020 and was among 20 scenic areas in Yichun reported as drawing the most visitors over the 2023 National Day holiday. It suits a short rural outing from Gao'an.
description: 百峰岭位于高安乡间，园艺栽培与田园景观构成游览的主要内容。
accessEn: In Yangxu township, about 27 km south-west of Gao'an. Check that it is open before going.

name: 禅都文化博览园
summaryEn: A cultural park on Chan (Zen) Buddhism on the eastern side of Yichun city, in a prefecture that promotes itself as a holy land of Chan. It was rated national 4A in 2015 and hosts seasonal events such as a moon-festival market, a Chinese-style garden fair, a food market and music nights. It suits an easy visit from the city centre.
description: 禅都文化博览园位于江西宜春。游览特色包括园林景观、节庆文化。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Jinxiu Avenue on the eastern side of Yichun city.

name: 中华传统文化园
summaryEn: An antique-style cultural park of more than 2,000 mu (about 133 ha) in Baofeng town, built as a traditional-culture study base, where a city-gate opening ceremony and a Confucius ceremony were held in 2018. It was rated national 4A in 2019.
description: 宝峰镇的仿古文化园以传统文化研习为宗旨，园区建筑与活动围绕这一主题设置。
accessEn: In Baofeng town, about 10 km north-north-east of Jing'an town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 五谷村丛林酒博园
summaryEn: A liquor-culture visitor park (the name means 'liquor expo park') at Wugu village on the northern edge of Shanggao town. It was rated national 4A in 2017. It suits a short stop for visitors interested in Chinese liquor culture.
description: 五谷村丛林酒博园位于江西宜春。游览特色包括酿造文化、休闲公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Shangtang Road on the northern edge of Shanggao town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 洞山
summaryEn: A mountain village in Tong'an township where the Tang monk Liangjie founded Puli Chan Temple, regarded as the ancestral temple of the Caodong school of Chan (Zen) Buddhism. Beside the temple, Fengqu Bridge, a stone arch bridge dated 1098, is the third Northern Song stone arch bridge with a dated inscription found in Jiangxi, after Guanyin Bridge on Lushan and Mingshui Bridge on Gezao Mountain. The village is a provincial rural tourism point promoted as 'Zen-realm Dongshan', and it hosted a rural Zen culture festival in 2018.
description: 洞山位于江西宜春。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Tong'an township, about 17 km north-north-east of Yifeng town.

name: 恒晖艺术农业
summaryEn: A farm-tourism park in the countryside near Sanxing town, run under the name 'art agriculture' (yishu nongye). It was the first scenic area in Wanzai county to be rated national 4A, in 2017. It suits a short rural outing from Wanzai town.
description: 恒晖艺术农业位于江西宜春。游览特色包括田园观光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Near Sanxing town, about 14 km north-north-east of Wanzai town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 爱情花卉小镇
summaryEn: A flower-themed park of about 4.7 km² at Tancheng village in Meilin town, built from 2018 on former barren hills around a flower and nursery-stock business. Its sights include a bird-and-flower garden, a lake called Love Sea, a rose garden, a southern plant garden, a flower-castle hotel and a water-screen film show, and a small railway runs through the flower beds. It is promoted as a romantic outing for couples.
description: 爱情花卉小镇位于江西宜春。游览特色包括湖泊、花卉观赏、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At the Meilin exit of the G60 expressway in Meilin town, about 18 km north-west of Fengcheng.

name: 宜春宋城明月千古情
summaryEn: A commercial theme park in Wentang town, developed with the Songcheng Performance Group and opened on 28 December 2018. Its main attraction is a staged song-and-dance show, Mingyue Qianguqing, drawing on Jiangxi history and folk customs, with scenes on porcelain, the moon goddess Chang'e and the legend of Empress Mingyue. It was rated national 4A in 2019 and is usually combined with Mingyue Mountain and Wentang's hot springs.
description: 宜春宋城明月千古情位于江西宜春。游览特色包括主题游乐、民俗文化、温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wentang town, about 20 km south-west of Yichun.

name: 七星岭
summaryEn: A mountain resort in Paibu town with a ski area whose slopes the county uses for mass-participation ski races. A new slope was added in 2023, and the resort is on the provincial tourism department's 2025 list of summer cool-weather routes, together with Tangli and Tianzhufeng. It was rated national 4A in 2024.
description: 排埠镇的山间度假区拥有滑雪场，也是当地大众滑雪活动举行的场地。
accessEn: In Paibu town, about 18 km west-south-west of Tonggu town.

name: 栖隐谷
summaryEn: A wooded valley on the eastern side of Mingyue Mountain, run as a separate scenic area from the main mountain gate near Wentang and rated national 4A in 2022. Qiyin Temple on Mount Yang, one of Jiangxi's old Chan monasteries, stands nearby.
description: 栖隐谷位于江西宜春。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Hongjiang town on the eastern side of Mingyue Mountain, about 23 km south-south-west of Yichun.

name: 天柱峰
summaryEn: A forested mountain scenic area on the shore of Jiulong Lake in Daduan town, in the county with the highest forest cover in Jiangxi. Boat trips on the lake, a glass bridge and night tours are among its newer attractions. It was rated national 4A in 2019 and is on the provincial tourism department's 2025 list of summer cool-weather routes.
description: 天柱峰位于江西宜春。游览特色包括湖泊、玻璃栈道、山地游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Daduan town, about 23 km north-east of Tonggu town.

name: 万载古城
summaryEn: A restored historic quarter in the centre of Wanzai (the Tianxia old-town district) with Ming and Qing buildings, including 26 ancestral halls, old houses and granaries, restored over about five years. It was rated national 4A in 2019 and listed in 2022 among China's selected projects combining intangible heritage with tourism, and local operas such as lantern opera and Nuo opera are staged here weekly. Wanzai is a fireworks town, and the old quarter holds firework displays at festivals.
description: 万载古城位于江西宜春。游览特色包括古城、祠堂文化、非遗文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Yanhe West Road in the centre of Wanzai town.

name: 白鹤湖嘻嘻哩
summaryEn: A family leisure park on the shore of Baihe Lake, a reservoir in north-western Guixi; its water park opened on 30 April 2023. It has water-play rides, boat trips on the lake, an artificial sand beach, a children's play area and off-road rides, with more than 30 hands-on attractions in all. It suits families with children in summer.
description: 白鹤湖嘻嘻哩位于江西鹰潭。游览特色包括湖泊、水库、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the shore of Baihe Lake in north-western Guixi, about 22 km north of Yingtan.

name: 中国血防红旗博览区
summaryEn: A memorial area in Yujiang about the campaign against schistosomiasis, a snail-borne parasitic disease. Yujiang county was declared to have eliminated the disease in 1958, the first in China, and the area presents that history in three parts: the China Schistosomiasis Control Memorial Hall, built in 1978 with halls on the disease and the campaign; Tongle Park opposite it, where a 1978 stele carries Mao Zedong's poem "Farewell to the God of Plague"; and the village of Lantian Songjia, with its campaign sites and a village history museum.
description: 中国血防红旗博览区位于江西鹰潭。游览特色包括纪念展览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The memorial hall is on Guoxi Avenue in Dengbu, the Yujiang district seat, about 21 km west of Yingtan; Lantian Songjia village is in Pingding township to the north-east. The memorial hall is closed on Mondays.

name: 灵溪湖
summaryEn: A lakeside leisure area around Lingxi Town in Yangxi township, Yujiang district, rated a 4A scenic area in early 2024. The town is used for school study trips and art-sketching groups and stages holiday events such as comic-themed exhibitions.
description: 灵溪湖位于江西鹰潭。游览特色包括湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Lingxi Town in Yangxi township, Yujiang district, about 31 km west of Yingtan.

name: 青茅境
summaryEn: A forest scenic area in the Shuangzhen forest farm in the mountains of southern Guixi, with bamboo groves, a sea of cloud seen from the main peak after rain, and the Sandie waterfall, which falls in three tiers for a total drop of more than 100 metres. It is promoted as a cool, clean-air retreat in summer.
description: 青茅境位于江西鹰潭。游览特色包括瀑布、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills of the Shuangzhen forest farm, about 44 km south-south-east of Guixi. Check that it is open before going.

name: 打渔张森林公园
summaryEn: Dayuzhang Forest Park is a provincial forest park of wetland, woodland and canals on the south bank of the Yellow River in Qiaozhuang town, Boxing County, centred on the headworks of the Dayuzhang Yellow River irrigation scheme. The county says it has over 100 plant species and some 40 bird species, and its sights include the diversion sluice and a hydraulic-engineering museum, the Huazhao flower garden, a crabapple orchard, wetland, a reservoir with a greenway and a camping base. It suits a quiet day of cycling, fishing and watching the river.
description: 打渔张森林公园位于山东滨州。游览特色包括博物馆、湿地、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Qiaozhuang town, about 21 km north-north-east of Boxing county town and 20 km east-south-east of Binzhou city centre; reached by road.

name: 麻大湖
summaryEn: Mada Lake is a freshwater lake and reed wetland south of Boxing county town, about 7 km from east to west and up to 3.5 km wide, which became a national wetland park in 2013. Reeds, cattails and lotus cover much of the shallow water, boats run through channels in the reeds, and the lake is known locally for lotus root, salted duck eggs and fish dishes. It suits a quiet half-day of wetland scenery and local food, with summer lotus the main draw.
description: 麻大湖位于山东滨州。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Xizha village, about 7 km south-south-west of Boxing county town, reached by road; Boxing lies about 28 km south-south-east of Binzhou city centre.

name: 蒲湖风景区
summaryEn: Puhu is a large lake park on the southern edge of Binzhou, between the Yellow River's main and secondary embankments, planned at about 543 hectares of which 180 had been developed by 2017. Its landmark is the Yellow River Tower, a modern tower on the lake's east shore that opened in 2021, and the park also has gardens, boats, a martyrs' cemetery and fishing areas. It is a local leisure park for walking and boating rather than a heritage site.
description: 蒲湖风景区位于山东滨州。游览特色包括湖泊、乘船游览、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the southern edge of Binzhou, about 6 km east-south-east of the city government; reached by road, with the G205 national road running through the park.

name: 孙武古城
summaryEn: Sun Wu Ancient City is the main tourist zone of Huimin County town, which claims the strategist Sun Wu, author of The Art of War, as a native son. It groups the Wuding Prefectural Yamen, which also holds the former Bohai revolutionary base-area offices, the Wusheng Garden park with weapons and folk museums, the Art of War City theme complex and a park along the moat, all set against a surviving stretch of Song-period city wall. Much of the zone is modern construction, so it suits visitors interested in Sun Tzu and Chinese military culture more than architecture.
description: 孙武古城位于山东滨州。游览特色包括博物馆、古城。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Huimin County town, about 42 km west-north-west of Binzhou city centre; the zone is reached by road.

name: 无棣古城
summaryEn: Wudi Ancient City is a walled old town of about 11.5 hectares in the centre of Wudi County, partly original and partly rebuilt in old style since 2010, with a moat and a lotus bay. The county says it keeps the Tang-period Dajue Temple and Haifeng Pagoda, a stretch of Song city wall, the Ming county-yamen hall and the Qing residence of the epigraphy scholar Wu Shifen, while its museum, intangible-heritage hall, shops and evening events are newer additions. It suits an easy half-day of strolling and boat rides on the moat.
description: 无棣古城位于山东滨州。游览特色包括博物馆、古城、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Wudi County town, about 51 km north-west of Binzhou city centre; reached by road.

name: 鑫诚田园生态旅游区
summaryEn: Xincheng Tianyuan is a large commercial farm-leisure park in Madian town, Huimin County, planned at about 15,000 mu and built round greenhouses and orchards. It has Dutch-style smart greenhouses, a flower house, an animal-feeding area, an EU-standard organic orchard, a 'Forest Tribe' zone opened in 2021 and the Sheng Ge Di Bay hot-spring water park, and it offers camping and bonfire evenings. It is a family destination rather than a heritage or nature sight.
description: 鑫诚田园生态旅游区位于山东滨州。游览特色包括水上游乐、果园、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Madian town, about 13 km east-south-east of Huimin County town and 29 km west-north-west of Binzhou city centre; reached by road.

name: 沾化冬枣生态旅游区
summaryEn: This is a jujube orchard park of about 500 mu in Xiawa town, the original home of the Zhanhua winter jujube, a crisp, apple-sized variety, about 20 km from Zhanhua town. It is laid out in three zones, including a lake area, with a covered bridge, a landscaped hill, a waterfall, a jujube-culture corridor, a research institute, a picking garden and reed wetland along the Qinkou River. The trees flower in early summer and carry fruit in autumn, which is the main season for a visit.
description: 沾化冬枣生态旅游区位于山东滨州。游览特色包括瀑布、湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xiawa town, about 17 km west of Zhanhua town and 34 km north of Binzhou city centre; reached by road.

name: 德百杂技蟋蟀谷
summaryEn: This is a leisure complex of about 1,000 mu (roughly 67 ha) south of Ningjin town, developed by the Debai group and themed on the county's acrobatics and cricket-keeping traditions. It includes the Dezhou Wild Animal Kingdom (a zoo with more than 1,500 animals and a circus theatre), a courtyard-style family-culture park, a jade museum, an acrobatics school with a theatre and museum, an artificial ski slope and a hot-spring garden hotel. It suits a family day out; the animal and acrobatics shows are staged performances.
description: 德百杂技蟋蟀谷位于山东德州。游览特色包括博物馆、动物观赏。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Ningjin County, about 5 km south of Ningjin town and about 42 km east-north-east of Dezhou.

name: 德百温泉度假村
summaryEn: Debai is a hot-spring hotel complex in Suliuzhuang town, Xiajin County, in the area of the Yellow River Old Course Forest Park. It has indoor and outdoor hot-spring pools, an indoor swimming pool and spa facilities, and Xiajin's government lists it among the county's main leisure attractions. It suits a relaxing half-day or overnight stay rather than sightseeing.
description: 德百温泉度假村位于山东德州。游览特色包括温泉、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Suliuzhuang town, about 14 km north-east of Xiajin county town.

name: 董子园
summaryEn: Dongzi Garden is a riverside memorial park in Dezhou commemorating the Han-dynasty Confucian scholar Dong Zhongshu. Its centrepiece is the 24.8 m Dongzi Reading Terrace, with a hall and shrine and a Confucian-culture exhibition hall beneath it, a 6 m bronze statue in front, and a lake with bridges, pavilions and a stone boat. Dezhou's tourism bureau dates the original terrace to the Sui dynasty and says it was destroyed in war in the Republican period, so what stands now is a modern rebuilding.
description: 董子园位于山东德州。游览特色包括湖泊、滨水景观、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the Shawang River in Dezhou's Tianqu New Area, about 8 km east of Dezhou railway station.

name: 海岛金山寺
summaryEn: Haidao Jinshan Temple is a large Buddhist temple complex on the northern edge of Qingyun, rebuilt from 2004 after an older temple that Dezhou's tourism bureau dates to the Sui dynasty was destroyed in the Ming. The scenic area has three zones, worship halls, a commercial area and landscaped grounds, and the bureau describes it as the largest group of antique-style buildings in the surrounding area. It suits a short stop for those interested in modern temple building in northern Shandong.
description: 海岛金山寺景区是山东省庆云县的一处国家AAAA级景区。位于庆云县北部，重建于2004年，2009年被评为4A景区。是德州市主要的乡村A级观光目的地之一。
accessEn: On the northern edge of Qingyun, about 4 km north of the county town and about 17 km east-north-east of Leling.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 泉城欧乐堡梦幻世界
summaryEn: Dream World is a theme park in Qihe County with zones styled on European and Western themes, such as a Dutch family town, a western town and a castle, dozens of rides including several roller coasters, a horse show, an international circus and fireworks. It is aimed at families and thrill-seekers. The same resort also has an ocean-and-polar aquarium, a water park and an animal park.
description: 泉城欧乐堡梦幻世界位于山东德州。游览特色包括主题游乐、水族展览、水上游乐。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Qihe County across the Yellow River from Jinan, about 19 km west-north-west of central Jinan.

name: 泉城欧乐堡海洋极地世界
summaryEn: This is a large indoor aquarium in Qihe County, completed in 2011, with more than ten halls including a tropical rainforest, an undersea tunnel, shark and turtle halls, a polar animal hall, a seal island and a 5D cinema. It has two show theatres, a mermaid underwater performance and a marine-animal show, both staged for audiences. It suits families, and it belongs to the same Ole Fortress resort as the Dream World theme park, less than 1 km to the north.
description: 泉城欧乐堡海洋极地世界位于山东德州。游览特色包括城堡、水族展览、岛屿。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Qihe County across the Yellow River from Jinan, about 19 km west-north-west of central Jinan.

name: 孤岛槐树林温泉
summaryEn: Gudao Locust Forest is a large locust-tree plantation on the Yellow River delta, in Gudao town, Hekou district, made into a 4A scenic area with an entrance gate, a visitor centre, boardwalks, a festival square and a waterside food street. The draws are woodland walks and seasonal events such as the locust-blossom festival, a windmill festival and photography exhibitions that the area has hosted. Official pages also list local geothermal water among its resources, which explains the 'hot spring' in its official name.
description: 孤岛槐树林温泉位于山东东营。游览特色包括温泉、林地风光、节庆文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the north-east of Gudao town, on both sides of provincial road S310, about 26 km east of Hekou town and about 54 km north-north-east of Dongying city centre, reached by road.

name: 红滩湿地
summaryEn: Hongtan Wetland is a coastal tourist area in Kenli district, on the Bohai shore behind a seawall at the edge of broad tidal mudflats. Its reed beds and seepweed flats, which turn red in autumn, are a stopover for migratory birds, and visitors can walk the seawall or go out onto the mudflats at low tide to gather shellfish. It suits families wanting an informal day at the coast.
description: 红滩湿地位于山东东营。游览特色包括湿地、观鸟。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the Bohai coast in Kenli district, about 26 km east-north-east of Dongying city centre, reached by road.

name: 揽翠湖旅游度假区
summaryEn: Lancuihu is a lakeside leisure area on the south-west edge of Dongying city, rated 4A in 2015, whose lawns and lakeshore are used for camping and a lawn music season. The city culture and tourism bureau describes plans for hot-spring hotels, a golf course, botanical gardens and water sports, and the area lies about a kilometre from the Yellow River Delta Zoo. It suits visitors wanting an outdoor day or a stay near the city rather than a sightseeing stop.
description: 揽翠湖旅游度假区位于山东东营。游览特色包括植物园、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On South 2nd Road in the south-west of Dongying city, about 8 km west-south-west of the city centre, reached by road.

name: 鸣翠湖湿地
summaryEn: Mingcuihu is a large lake and wetland park on the edge of Hekou's new town, designed around the themes of the Yellow River, oil, the sea and wetlands. The official page gives about 5,000 mu (roughly 330 hectares) of park with 3,500 mu of water and an 8 km shoreline, with themed zones for culture, leisure and wetland ecology. It was rated 4A in 2022 and suits an easy lakeside walk.
description: 鸣翠湖湿地位于山东东营。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside the new town of Hekou district, about 1 km west-south-west of the district centre and about 52 km north-north-west of Dongying city centre, reached by road.

name: 红色刘集
summaryEn: Liuji is a village in Dawang town, Guangrao, that was home to one of the earliest rural Communist Party branches in Shandong, which kept and used a first-edition Chinese translation of the Communist Manifesto, as local government pages tell it. The visit centres on a museum on the branch's former site and a Communist Manifesto memorial hall, with an underground tunnel exhibit, a Qi brush craft hall and a hall for local folk opera. It has also been used as a filming location for television dramas on the party's early history.
description: 红色刘集位于山东东营。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Liuji village, Dawang town, about 13 km south-east of Guangrao county town and about 53 km south-south-west of Dongying city centre, reached by road.

name: 孙子文化旅游区
summaryEn: The Sunzi Culture Tourism Area is a themed leisure district on Sunwu Lake in Guangrao's new eastern district, devoted to Sun Wu (Sun Tzu), author of The Art of War, whom Guangrao claims as a native son. Its core is the Sunzi Cultural Park, with a ceremonial entrance plaza of bronze chariot groups and drum-shaped walls, a large hall and exhibits on military thought. It is a modern development rather than a historic site, and Guangrao holds an annual Sunzi Culture Tourism Festival, the eighteenth opening on 11 September 2026.
description: 孙子文化旅游区位于山东东营。游览特色包括湖泊、历史纪念。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the new eastern district of Guangrao, about 3 km east of the county town centre and about 47 km south-south-west of Dongying city centre, reached by road.

name: 黄河三角洲动物园
summaryEn: The Yellow River Delta Zoo is an urban zoo on the south-west side of Dongying, opened in the early 2010s on about 1,000 mu (roughly 65 hectares) of land. In 2019 the city's culture and tourism bureau reported more than 100 species and over a thousand animals, including giraffes, white tigers and white rhinos, and a dinosaur-themed play area and a jellyfish exhibit have been added since. It suits families, and it was rated a 4A area in 2018.
description: 黄河三角洲动物园位于山东东营。游览特色包括动物观赏。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Tianmushan Road in the south-west of Dongying city, about 7 km west-south-west of the city centre.

name: 曹州牡丹园
summaryEn: Caozhou Peony Garden is a large peony park on the north side of Heze city, described by the city government as holding 1,237 peony varieties and more than 600 herbaceous peony varieties. It peaks in April during the city's peony festival, when the flower beds are joined by costume events and stage shows, and it also has a national-flower museum and a street of craft stalls.
description: 曹州牡丹园位于山东菏泽。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观、节庆文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north side of Heze city, about 5 km north-north-east of the city government, and reached by road from the centre.

name: 浮龙湖
summaryEn: Fulong Lake is a large reservoir-lake resort of about 21 sq km of water in the south-west of Shan County, on the course of the old Yellow River, with a lakeside plaza, a long jetty, islands, a rose garden and a Taoist temple, the Laojun Temple. Boats, electric carts and a small train link the sights, and a spring-summer culture festival is held there each year. It is a family and leisure destination for a day by the water rather than a historic site.
description: 浮龙湖位于山东菏泽。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Fugang town in the south-west of Shan County, about 20 km south-west of Shan County town; Shan lies about 76 km south-east of Heze city centre, and the lake is reached by road.

name: 幵山
summaryEn: Jianshan is a lakeside park in the development zone on the east side of Shan County town, laid out around a small hill and Jianshan Lake, with a walking path round the water, boats and a glass bridge. It also holds statues of local figures such as Empress Lü and the Four Gentlemen poets, a red-tourism education base, and, nearby, the Mingran Art Museum and the county cultural centre. It suits a short stroll in town rather than a full-day trip.
description: 幵山位于山东菏泽。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the east side of Shan County town, about 1.4 km east of the county government; the town lies about 76 km south-east of Heze city centre and is reached by road.

name: 金山
summaryEn: Jinshan is a low hill in Hetaoyuan town, about 1.5 km from north to south and rising to 133 m, with karst caves, springs and walking paths; part of it lies in a provincial geopark. On its south slope the local gazetteer places the Qin Wang Dong, a large man-cut cave that it identifies as an unfinished Western Han royal tomb, and the Jinshan Han tombs are a national heritage unit. The hill is the main sight of the Jinshan tourism zone, which also takes in nearby Qinglong and Baihu hills and a stone-built hill village.
description: 金山位于山东菏泽。游览特色包括洞穴、地质景观、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Hetaoyuan town, about 22 km south-east of Juye town; Juye lies about 59 km east-north-east of Heze city centre and the hill is reached by road.

name: 单县科技馆
summaryEn: The museum is a modern science centre of about 24,500 square metres in the north of Shan County town. Its permanent hall has 11 zones and over 300 exhibits arranged around the spirit, beauty and dream of science, and there are three cinemas (4D, VR and dome) and eight hands-on science labs. It is a family or school-group stop rather than a sight for heritage or scenery.
description: 单县科技馆位于山东菏泽。游览特色包括博物馆、科学科普。图集建议预留1.5–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the north of Shan County town, about 2.4 km north of the county government; Shan County lies about 76 km south-east of Heze city centre and is reached by road.

name: 孙膑旅游城·亿城寺
summaryEn: Sun Bin Tourist City is a large park of about 999 mu (roughly 67 hectares) in Jishan town, Juancheng County, built on the site of the old Yicheng Temple and opened in 2008. It combines a memorial zone for the Warring States strategist Sun Bin with a Buddhist temple area and gardens; sights named by the county include tombs attributed to Sun Bin and Jing Ke and a joint tomb of the legendary friends Yang and Zuo. It is a modern built attraction for people interested in Chinese military culture, with seasonal festivals and stage performances.
description: 孙膑旅游城·亿城寺位于山东菏泽。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、园林景观、佛教文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jishan town, about 20 km north-east of Juancheng county town; Juancheng lies about 34 km north of Heze city centre, and the park is reached by road.

name: 水浒好汉城
summaryEn: This is a theme park built in the style of a Song-dynasty town, in Yuncheng County, the home area of Song Jiang, Chao Gai and other characters in the novel Water Margin. Walled courtyards, streets, a reconstructed county yamen and regular costumed performances recreate scenes from the story, and the park is lit up for lantern events at the Spring Festival. It is a modern, commercial attraction for families and fans of the novel, not a historic old town.
description: 水浒好汉城位于山东菏泽。游览特色包括主题游乐、节庆文化、历史衙署。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north-west side of Yuncheng town, about 1 km north-west of the county government; Yuncheng lies about 56 km north-east of Heze city centre and is reached by road.

name: 曹县黄河故道湿地风景区
summaryEn: This wetland scenic area of about 512 hectares lies in Weiwan town on the bed the Yellow River left behind when it changed course in 1855, beside the Taihangdi reservoir. Its attractions include a lotus pond, reed beds, a peach-and-plum grove, a flower field and a flying camp, with rapeseed in spring and lotus in summer. It is a low-key rural outing for the flowers, boating and photography, not a heritage site.
description: 曹县黄河故道湿地风景区位于山东菏泽。游览特色包括湿地、水库。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Weiwan town, about 13 km west-south-west of Cao County town; Cao lies about 42 km south of Heze city centre and the area is reached by road.

name: 百脉泉酒文化旅游区
summaryEn: A visitor area built around the Baimaiquan distillery in Mingshui, Zhangqiu, with liquor-culture displays and a visitor centre, a shop and a restaurant. It was rated a 4A scenic area in December 2021, the first in Zhangqiu themed on industrial tourism, and suits visitors interested in how Chinese grain spirit is made.
description: 百脉泉酒文化旅游区位于山东济南。游览特色包括工业参观、酿造文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Longquan Road in Mingshui, about 3 km east of Baimai Springs and about 59 km by road east of central Jinan.

name: 房干生态旅游区
summaryEn: A hill and gorge scenic area at Fanggan village in Xueye subdistrict, Laiwu, which the Jinan tourism bureau describes as combining mountains, water, forest, springs, waterfalls and rock formations. It is promoted for hiking and clean mountain air, and the village has a small rural-memory museum. It suits a half-day outdoor trip in summer.
description: 房干生态旅游区位于山东济南。游览特色包括博物馆、瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Fanggan village in Xueye subdistrict, Laiwu District, about 46 km east-south-east of central Jinan and about 32 km north-west of central Laiwu.

name: 济南方特东方神画
summaryEn: A theme park in Huaiyin district belonging to the Fantawild group's Oriental Heritage line, which takes Chinese culture and folk stories as its themes. It has rides and show attractions, with parades, stage performances, seasonal festivals and evening openings. It suits families with children and is a full-day visit.
description: 济南方特东方神画位于山东济南。游览特色包括主题游乐、节庆文化。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Wujiabao subdistrict, Huaiyin district, about 14 km west-north-west of central Jinan; Jinan Metro Line 1 ends at Fangte station, about 3.6 km from the south gate, so allow for a shuttle or taxi for the last stretch.

name: 印象济南·泉世界
summaryEn: A shopping, dining and leisure block in Huaiyin district, newly built to resemble traditional Jinan architecture. Its water features include a large music fountain on the main square, small cascades along the lanes and a shallow stream where children paddle in summer. It has craft shops and a food street and is lit up at night, so it suits an evening stroll or a family outing.
description: 槐荫区的步行街区采用传统济南建筑风格，沿街分布餐饮、购物与休闲空间。
accessEn: At 2668 Qingdao Road, Huaiyin district, about 10 km west of central Jinan and about 2 km east-north-east of Jinan West railway station; the fountains are switched off from mid-November to mid-March.

name: 济南植物园
summaryEn: A botanical garden in the hills of Zhangqiu District, east of Jinan, laid out in themed areas that include a colour-plant garden and a rose garden. Spring brings flowering crabapple, cherry and peony, summer daylilies, roses and lotus, and autumn ginkgo and maple colour, while a climate-controlled subtropical hall holds more than 600 kinds of tropical plants. Its open lawns are used for picnics and camping, so it suits a spring or autumn day out.
description: 济南植物园位于山东济南。游览特色包括植物园、园林景观、莲花观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Bucun subdistrict, Zhangqiu District, about 40 km east of central Jinan and about 5 km south of the E'zhuang junction on Jingshi East Road, reached by road.

name: 济南国际园博园
summaryEn: A large lakeside park in Changqing District, built for the 7th China International Garden Expo, held from September 2009 to May 2010. It has show gardens, flower beds, a sandy shore and boat trips on Changqing Lake, with camping lawns, children's rides and seasonal events. It suits a relaxed day out, especially in the spring flower season.
description: 济南国际园博园位于山东济南。游览特色包括湖泊、乘船游览、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Changqing District, about 23 km south-west of central Jinan, with Jinan Metro Line 1 stopping at Yuanboyuan station next to the park.

name: 济南融创文旅城
summaryEn: A large leisure complex in Licheng district, east of central Jinan, opened in May 2021 and built new rather than historic. It combines an amusement park with rides and shows, a water park, an indoor sea-themed attraction, a shopping mall, hotels and a riverside bar street. In summer the amusement park opens for evening programmes, and the complex suits families.
description: 济南融创文旅城位于山东济南。游览特色包括主题游乐、水上游乐、滨水景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: On East Jingshi Road at the Fengming Road junction in Licheng district, about 16 km east of central Jinan.

name: 金象山乐园
summaryEn: A mountain amusement park in the wooded southern hills of Licheng district. The operator lists more than 200 attractions, including rides, a water-play area, a rainbow-coloured photo valley and jungle-crossing courses. It suits families and school or company groups.
description: 金象山乐园位于山东济南。游览特色包括主题游乐、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Shangjia village in Zhonggong subdistrict, about 38 km by road south-south-east of central Jinan.

name: 九顶塔中华民族欢乐园
summaryEn: A theme park in the hills of Liubu, south-east of Jinan, built around replica villages that stage the architecture, song, dance and food of China's ethnic groups. It reopened after a refit in March 2025, with staged live-action plays by day and a fire-themed show in the evening. It is an entertainment park rather than a historic site and suits families.
description: 九顶塔中华民族欢乐园位于山东济南。游览特色包括主题游乐、民族文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Liubu subdistrict in Jinan's southern hills, about 29 km south-south-east of central Jinan.

name: 九如山瀑布群
summaryEn: A wooded mountain valley in Jinan's southern hills where streams and waterfalls run through the woodland. It is run as a leisure resort, with a spring-fed swimming pool, timber cabins, a flower valley, craft workshops and summer-evening music events. It suits a day trip or an overnight stay in the warm months.
description: 九如山瀑布群位于山东济南。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xiying subdistrict in the hills south-east of Jinan, about 31 km south-east of central Jinan, reached by road.

name: 红叶谷
summaryEn: A hillside park in Jinan's southern hills where more than 4,000 mu (about 270 hectares) of wild smoke-tree scrub turns red each autumn. Stone steps and paths climb the slopes, the seven-storey Wanye Tower looks over the valley, and Xuanqiu Lake reflects the colours. The park also has themed gardens, including roses, plum and azaleas, and a small temple, Xingjiao Temple.
description: 红叶谷位于山东济南。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhonggong subdistrict in the hills south of Licheng district, about 32 km by road south-east of central Jinan, roughly half an hour by car.

name: 香山旅游区
summaryEn: A mountain resort area in Dawangzhuang town, in the north-west of Laiwu District, centred on Xiangshan (918.7 m) with two gorges, Jiutian and Shimen, and three highland villages. These are Wangshimen, described as Shandong's highest administrative village, Shiwuzi, kept in its original mountain style, and Zhujiayu; the area also has forest, springs, lakes and old Buddhist and Daoist sites. It is known for its red and yellow autumn leaves and suits a day of walking and sightseeing.
description: 香山旅游区位于山东济南。游览特色包括峡谷、林地风光、佛教文化。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: Around Dawangzhuang town in north-western Laiwu District, about 44 km south-east of central Jinan, reached by road from the town on provincial road S244; in November 2025 the area asked visitors to stay out of some road sections, including the way to the main peak, so check the current situation before going.

name: 朱家峪
summaryEn: A hill village in Guanzhuang, Zhangqiu, founded in the early Ming and kept largely intact, with more than 200 Ming and Qing buildings, bluestone lanes and 99 stone bridges, including a Kangxi-era double bridge that separated foot traffic from flood water. The Zhu clan ancestral hall, the Wenchang Pavilion and the old Shanyin school survive, and the village was a filming location for the television drama Chuang Guandong. It was named in the second batch of China Historic and Cultural Villages and among the first China Traditional Villages in 2012.
description: 朱家峪位于山东济南。游览特色包括祠堂文化、楼阁建筑、桥梁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Guanzhuang subdistrict, Zhangqiu District, about 7 km south-south-east of Mingshui, the district seat, and about 51 km east of central Jinan; Zhangqiu bus 17 runs to the gate.

name: 孔子六艺城
summaryEn: A modern cultural leisure complex just south of Qufu's old town, built around Confucius's Six Arts: rites, music, archery, charioteering, calligraphy and mathematics. It has a Six Arts experience zone and a folk-customs zone showing local life in Confucius's hometown, along with shops, restaurants and entertainment. It is a purpose-built attraction rather than a historic site, and suits visitors with spare time after the main Confucian sites.
description: 孔子六艺城位于山东济宁。游览特色包括书法文化、马术活动、历史街区。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Chunqiu West Road, about 1.8 km south-south-east of the Temple of Confucius; check that it is open before going.

name: 贾堌堆农家寨
summaryEn: A rural tourism village opened in 2016 in Jiagudui village, Dalukou town, built around farming culture and village folk customs. Its attractions include a pottery-making park, a folk-custom street, guesthouses, a folk performance hall, a campsite and flower fields. The activities are aimed mainly at families, and seasonal events include harvest festivals and costume garden parties.
description: 贾堌堆农家寨位于山东济宁。游览特色包括田园观光、民俗文化、花卉观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dalukou town, Liangshan County, about 16 km north-north-west of Liangshan county town and about 72 km north-west of Jining city centre.

name: 康王谷花世界
summaryEn: A flower-themed leisure and agri-tourism park in eastern Zoucheng, built in the late 2010s around flower fields and a lake. Indoor halls cover flowers, tropical plants and vegetable growing, and there are areas for picking fruit and vegetables. It is a modern family-oriented attraction rather than a historic site.
description: 康王谷花世界位于山东济宁。游览特色包括湖泊、田园观光、花卉观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 37 km east of Zoucheng city centre; check that it is open before going.

name: 莲花湖湿地
summaryEn: A provincial-level wetland park of about 290 hectares on the northern edge of Wenshang town, opened in 2011 and laid out around lakes and islands. It has zones for plant viewing, fruit picking, amusement attractions and folk-custom displays, and a folk museum, the Zhongdu Folk Museum, stands at its north-east corner. It suits a relaxed half-day outing.
description: 莲花湖湿地位于山东济宁。游览特色包括博物馆、湿地。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Just north of Wenshang town, about 40 km north of Jining city centre.

name: 南池
summaryEn: A garden park in the south of Jining, themed on the city's Grand Canal heritage, the poets Li Bai and Du Fu, and the Queen Mother of the West. The northern half has classical-style pavilions, archways, a gallery of inscribed steles and a shrine to Du Fu called the Shaoling Shrine, while the southern half is planted as an arboretum and flower gardens. It suits a relaxed stroll rather than a long visit.
description: 南池位于山东济宁。游览特色包括运河、花卉观赏、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the city of Jining, about 2.5 km south-south-west of the city centre.

name: 上九山村
summaryEn: Shangjiushan is a hill village of stone houses in Shiqiang town, Zoucheng. China Daily describes it as a rare stone village founded in the early Northern Song period and named after the nine hills around it, and media reports count more than 300 residences in Ming and Qing style. It was added to the seventh batch of China's Historic and Cultural Villages in 2019 and suits a slow walk through the old stone courtyards.
description: 邹城石墙镇的山村以石头砌筑的民居和村巷为特色。
accessEn: In the hills of Shiqiang town, about 23 km south-south-west of Zoucheng (about 31 km by road).

name: 石门山
summaryEn: A wooded hill once called Longmen Mountain and renamed for two facing peaks that look like a stone gate; the main peak, Shenghan, is 406 m high. The hill has twenty-four named scenic spots, some of them caves, and a Qing-dynasty temple complex; places on it are traditionally linked with Confucius studying the Book of Changes and with a gathering of the poets Li Bai and Du Fu. It suits a half-day hike for visitors based in Qufu.
description: 石门山位于山东济宁。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、林地风光、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 24 km north-north-east of Qufu city centre, in Shimenshan town.

name: 泗水滨
summaryEn: A landscaped riverside park of about 62 hectares on the Si River, laid out in a modern style as the core public space of the new eco-city district of Sishui County town. Its name, "the banks of the Si", echoes a line by the Song philosopher Zhu Xi. The Sishui County Museum stands beside the park's plaza and takes visitors at weekends and on public holidays only by prior booking.
description: 泗水滨位于山东济宁。游览特色包括博物馆、滨水景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north-west side of Sishui county town, about 25 km east-north-east of Qufu city centre and about 65 km east-north-east of Jining.

name: 太白湖
summaryEn: Taibai Lake is a lake and wetland scenic area of about 22 sq km on the southern side of Jining, laid out between the old canal on the east and the Grand Canal on the west as an eco-tourism area that combines sightseeing with wetland protection and water purification. Its lotus beds flower in midsummer. It suits a relaxed outing within the city rather than a full day trip.
description: 太白湖位于山东济宁。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊、运河。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the southern edge of Jining's urban area, about 11 km south of the city centre.

name: 万紫千红生态养生旅游度假区
summaryEn: Wanzi Qianhong is a modern leisure resort built around a lake in the hills of Sizhang town, Sishui County, marketed for countryside relaxation and 'eco-wellness'. It has accommodation and outdoor activities, and the setting is rural hill country rather than a historic site. It suits visitors who want a quiet stay or an outdoor day trip from Qufu.
description: 万紫千红生态养生旅游度假区位于山东济宁。游览特色包括湖泊、休闲度假。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Sizhang town, Sishui County, about 22 km south-east of Sishui town and about 40 km east-south-east of Qufu; check that it is open before going.

name: 仙河花海生态乐园
summaryEn: Xianhe Flower Sea is a leisure park of flower fields beside a large lake in the northern part of Qufu, in the area promoted as the Qufu International Slow City. It offers flower viewing, family activities and water recreation, and was rated a 4A scenic area in 2019. It is a modern, commercial park rather than a historic site, aimed mainly at families and groups.
description: 仙河花海生态乐园位于山东济宁。游览特色包括湖泊、花卉观赏、公园休闲。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 20 km north-north-east of Qufu (about 22 km by road); check that it is open before going.

name: 东阿阿胶文化旅游区
summaryEn: This is a themed tourist complex run by the Dong'e Ejiao company around ejiao, the donkey-hide gelatin used in Chinese medicine that Dong'e is known for. Its parts include Ejiao City, a replica old-street quarter built as a film set for late-Qing and early-Republican Jinan and Dong'e, the China Ejiao Museum, an experience factory, a hill with a temple to the medicine kings, and a donkey museum and breeding centre. It suits visitors interested in Chinese medicine, industrial tourism or period street scenes.
description: 东阿阿胶文化旅游区位于山东聊城。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the western edge of Dong'e, the county seat, about 27 km east-south-east of Liaocheng; the museum and experience factory are about 2 km further east.

name: 景阳冈酒文化旅游景区
summaryEn: This is a visitor attraction built since 2008 on the grounds of the Jingyanggang distillery in Yanggu, which makes baijiu, China's grain spirit, and it was rated a 4A area in December 2023. It includes a liquor museum, an exhibition on Yanggu's history, a gallery of local industrial heritage, a Ming-and-Qing-style brewing workshop, hands-on craft rooms and a long relief corridor of the Water Margin heroes. It suits visitors curious about baijiu or the Water Margin theme.
description: 景阳冈酒文化旅游景区位于山东聊城。游览特色包括博物馆、工业遗产、酿造文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the west of Yanggu county town on Qinghe West Road, about 500 m south-south-west of the Lion Tower and about 41 km south-south-west of Liaocheng.

name: 九州洼月季公园
summaryEn: Jiuzhouwa is a city park in Liaocheng's high-tech zone built around rose gardens, combined with wetland and play areas, and it was rated a 4A scenic area in December 2024. The city tourism bureau describes it as a theme park, city park, wetland park and cultural park in one, planned around rose-themed gardens and a rose display belt. It suits a family outing or an easy stroll close to the city.
description: 九州洼月季公园位于山东聊城。游览特色包括湿地、主题游乐。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At the south-west corner of Changjiang Road and Lushan Road in Liaocheng's high-tech zone, about 7 km east of central Liaocheng.

name: 孔繁森同志纪念馆
summaryEn: This memorial hall in Liaocheng commemorates Kong Fansen, a local-born official who worked in Tibet from 1979 and became party secretary of Ali Prefecture, and who died in a road accident in November 1994 on a trip to Xinjiang. Opened in 1995 on a site of about 19,000 square metres, it has a permanent exhibition of photographs, personal objects, reconstructed scenes and multimedia, plus temporary exhibition and lecture halls. It is one of Liaocheng's red-tourism sites and is also rated a national second-level museum.
description: 孔繁森同志纪念馆位于山东聊城。游览特色包括纪念展览、主题展览、历史纪念。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Fansen Road in the north-west of Liaocheng, beside Dongchang Lake and about 2 km north-west of the old-town centre; closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 宛园
summaryEn: Wanyuan is a modern Suzhou-style garden beside the Grand Canal in the north-west of Linqing, with pavilions, rockeries, ponds and brick, wood and clay carving made by craftsmen from Suzhou, according to the city's tourism pages. A second park carrying the Wanyuan name, the Canal Style Park (East Wanyuan), opened in September 2023 with replica Ming and Qing buildings, shows and food stalls. It suits a relaxed visit alongside Linqing's canal sights, and it is a recreated garden rather than a historic one.
description: 宛园位于山东聊城。游览特色包括运河、园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the north-west of Linqing city, close to the Grand Canal and about 2 km north-north-west of the city centre.

name: 苍马山·冠山
summaryEn: Cangma Mountain and Guan Mountain are two wooded hill areas north-east of Linshu town, listed together as one 4A scenic area. Cangma Mountain is a municipal-level nature reserve with forest trails on stone steps and a sightseeing bus, while Guan Mountain, about 3 km to the east, has a long-established Taoist temple and views over the surrounding fields and villages. It is a local hiking and leisure area rather than a major sight.
description: 苍马山·冠山位于山东临沂。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、自然保护区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Cangma Mountain is about 6 km north-east of Linshu town and Guan Mountain a further 3 km east, both reached by road.

name: 岱崮地貌
summaryEn: Daigu is the type locality of the 'gu' landform: flat-topped mesas capped by a 20–30 m layer of Cambrian limestone, with about 30 clustered around Daigu town in Mengyin County. The scenic area gives views of the mesas, a grassland and camping area, and a former Third Front military-industry site, and the surrounding hills are peach orchards that blossom in spring.
description: 岱崮地貌位于山东临沂。游览特色包括草原、果园、历史纪念。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 4 km west-south-west of Daigu town and roughly 31 km north-east of Mengyin county town, with Linyi city about 95 km to the south.

name: 东方瑞海国际温泉度假村
summaryEn: Dongfang Ruihai is a hot-spring resort and hotel complex in the south of Yishui town, on about 250 mu (roughly 17 hectares) that the county government says holds thermal baths, restaurants and conference rooms; the hotel was rated four-star in 2010. It is a modern leisure complex rather than a heritage site, and suits families or groups who want a soak.
description: 东方瑞海国际温泉度假村位于山东临沂。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the southern side of Yishui town, about 5 km south of the town centre and about 80 km north-north-east of central Linyi, reached by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 观唐温泉度假村
summaryEn: Guantang is a hot-spring resort of about 790 mu (roughly 50 hectares) in the Tangtou hot-spring zone in the north of Hedong district. It combines open-air thermal pools, a hotel and a conference centre with Wenshuixiang, a cluster of Ming and Qing buildings brought from Jiangxi, Anhui and elsewhere and set along a waterway. It is a leisure resort rather than a heritage site, and suits travellers who want to relax for an afternoon after sightseeing in the area.
description: 观唐温泉度假村位于山东临沂。游览特色包括温泉、休闲度假。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Tangtou hot-spring zone in the north of Hedong district, about 25 km north-north-east of central Linyi, reached by road.

name: 红石寨
summaryEn: Hongshizhai is a leisure resort on the shore of Xiangshan Lake in Tongjing town, developed by the operator of nearby Zhuquan village. Linyi's official tourism account lists a cliff-edge fast-car ride, a cliffside glass rafting course, coloured slides and a glass bridge among its attractions, and the county also describes a car-camping ground. It is a commercial adventure resort aimed at families and young visitors, and is often combined with Zhuquan village.
description: 红石寨位于山东临沂。游览特色包括湖泊、玻璃栈道、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tongjing town beside Xiangshan Lake, about 12 km north-north-west of Yinan town, reached by road.

name: 皇山东夷文化园
summaryEn: Huangshan Dongyi Culture Park is a park at the foot of Huang Hill in Linyi's Economic and Technological Development Zone, built around the Linyi Dongyi Culture Museum. The museum is a state-run museum on the Dongyi, the ancient peoples of eastern China, in a building designed to resemble a phoenix feather, with eight themed halls. It is a modest urban stop of an hour or two.
description: 皇山东夷文化园位于山东临沂。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At the foot of Huang Hill in the Economic and Technological Development Zone, about 6 km east-south-east of central Linyi, reached by road.

name: 兰陵国家农业公园
summaryEn: Lanling National Agricultural Park is a large farm-tourism park in Bianzhuang subdistrict, built to show modern vegetable and fruit growing, with greenhouses, soilless-cultivation displays and picking gardens. Its fields carry seasonal flowers such as rape blossom and sunflowers, and there are lotus ponds. It suits families and school groups, and ties in with Lanling's reputation as a vegetable-growing county.
description: 兰陵国家农业公园位于山东临沂。游览特色包括田园观光、园林景观、莲花观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Bianzhuang subdistrict, Lanling County, about 40 km south-west of central Linyi, reached by road.

name: 临沂市科技馆
summaryEn: Linyi Science and Technology Museum is the city's municipal science museum, a large modern building in the Beicheng New Area near the meeting of the Yi, Fang and Liuqing rivers. It has more than 300 hands-on exhibits covering physics, chemistry, biology and astronomy, and is rated a 4A scenic area. It suits families and school groups.
description: 临沂市科技馆位于山东临沂。游览特色包括博物馆、科学科普。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Beicheng New Area of Lanshan district, in the north of Linyi's urban area, reached by city road. Visits must be booked in advance, and the museum is closed on Mondays and Tuesdays.

name: 临沂龙园
summaryEn: Longyuan is a resort and rural-tourism complex next to the Tangtou hot-spring zone in Hedong district, built in Huizhou and Suzhou-garden style around a dragon-culture theme, so its buildings are modern rather than historic. The Hedong district government lists its main parts as a dragon-culture 'ancient town', a children's park, a dinosaur park and a 'Love Valley', and a group of nine museums is spread through it. It suits families and school groups looking for a day out.
description: 临沂龙园位于山东临沂。游览特色包括博物馆、古镇。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the north side of the Tangtou hot-spring zone in Hedong district, about 30 km north-north-east of central Linyi, reached by road.

name: 沂蒙马泉休闲园
summaryEn: Maquan Leisure Park is an orchard-and-farm park in the hills of Tongjing town, Yinan County, developed from 2012 as a 'pastoral complex' with agricultural demonstration and elder-care themes. Cherries are the main crop, among more than 150,000 fruit trees that also include sweet persimmon, grape, hawthorn and chestnut, and visitors can pick fruit and stay in forest cabins. It suits families on a countryside day out.
description: 沂蒙马泉休闲园位于山东临沂。游览特色包括果园、林地风光、农业体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills about 12 km north of Yinan town, a short distance from Zhuquan village and Hongshizhai, reached by road.

name: 郯城银杏生态旅游区
summaryEn: A 9.9 sq km belt of old ginkgo groves along both banks of the Yi River in south-west Tancheng, which the county government calls China's largest ancient-ginkgo area, with about 48,000 fruit-bearing trees over a century old. The main sites are the Ginkgo and Old Plum Garden in Xincun, with a ginkgo the county puts at over 3,000 years old and 41.9 m tall, a Suzhou-style garden and the ruins of the Guangfu Temple, and the Zhonghua Ginkgo Garden in Chongfang town, which grows 103 ginkgo cultivars.
description: 郯城银杏生态旅游区位于山东临沂。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、园林景观、历史遗址。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: The Ginkgo and Old Plum Garden (pinned) is in Xincun, about 2.5 km south of Chongfang town and 20 km west of Tancheng county town, roughly 55 km south-south-west of Linyi city.

name: 郯国古城
summaryEn: Tanguo Ancient City is a modern district built in Han–Tang style on Huangting Road in Tancheng, which opened in May 2021 and draws on local stories such as Confucius's visit to the Tan ruler. The completed part has the Tan King's Palace, with live-action performances, and an 'Imperial Street' of food and shopping that includes an academy, a commandery-office hall and an intangible-heritage exhibition hall. It is a recreated old-style street, not the historic Tan capital, and suits an evening visit.
description: 郯国古城位于山东临沂。游览特色包括古城、书院文化、主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the southern side of Tancheng county town, about 50 km south of Linyi city.

name: 天谷·天然地下画廊
summaryEn: Tiangu is a karst cave in Liuhuyu village, Yuandongtou town, whose stalactites are shaped like birds, animals and landscapes, hence the name 'natural underground gallery'. Above ground the site also runs rafting, grass-sliding and village-style activities.
description: 天谷·天然地下画廊位于山东临沂。游览特色包括洞穴、水上活动、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Liuhuyu village, Yuandongtou town, about 21 km west-south-west of Yishui town, reached by road.

name: 无极鬼谷
summaryEn: Wuji Guigu is a commercial scenic area in the hills and lake country of Zhulu town, themed on Guiguzi, the Warring States-period thinker. The Junan county government lists glass-slide rafting, boat trips on Jixin Lake and waterfalls among its attractions, and the area straddles the Linyi-Rizhao border. It suits families and groups looking for activities more than heritage.
description: 无极鬼谷位于山东临沂。游览特色包括瀑布、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhulu town in the Lingang development zone, about 30 km north-east of Junan town and about 75 km east-north-east of central Linyi, reached by road.

name: 雪山彩虹谷
summaryEn: Xueshan Rainbow Valley is a leisure park in a wooded valley on the eastern side of Yishui town, best known for an artificial rainbow made with sprayed water and light that the park says can be seen in every season. Its other zones include a 'Lovers' Valley', a 'Happy Valley' of rides and a war-games valley, and it is aimed at families and young visitors rather than sightseers.
description: 雪山彩虹谷位于山东临沂。游览特色包括山谷、林地风光、公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the eastern side of Yishui town, about 6 km east of the town-centre point, reached by road.

name: 压油沟
summaryEn: Yayougou is a rural tourism area in the hills of Lanling County, laid out around a Yimeng stone-house village with flagstone lanes, converted guesthouses and folk performances. It also has a small animal-contact area with alpacas, deer and peacocks. It suits families and weekend visitors from Linyi and Zaozhuang.
description: 压油沟位于山东临沂。游览特色包括田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills of Lanling County, about 35 km west-south-west of central Linyi, reached by road.

name: 沂蒙花开
summaryEn: Yimeng Huakai is a family-oriented park with an agricultural theme at Yinjiayu village in Quanzhuang town, Yishui County, which the county government lists as a 4A scenic area. Its children's area, Yaya Fantasy City, has VR games, handicraft workshops and a swing bridge.
description: 沂蒙花开位于山东临沂。游览特色包括手工艺。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Yinjiayu village in Quanzhuang town, about 27 km north-west of Yishui county town and about 95 km north of central Linyi. Check that it is open before going.

name: 沂蒙红色影视基地
summaryEn: The Yimeng Red Film and TV Base, also known as Hongsao Hometown Tourist Area, was set up in 2008 in Changshanzhuang village, an old stone village in Mamuchi township, as a location for filming wartime dramas; more than 400 films and series have been shot there. It now doubles as a red-tourism area with museum courtyards and live-action performances about the wartime Yimeng village women known as 'Hongsao', and villagers work there as extras.
