description: 沂蒙红色影视基地位于山东临沂。游览特色包括博物馆、影视拍摄、影视文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Mamuchi township, about 20 km north-west of Yinan town, reached by road.

name: 沂蒙云瀑洞天
summaryEn: A scenic area in Fei County laid out in four parts: the Finger-moving Stone (a balancing rock), Tianmeng Lake, the Yunpu Dongtian zone of rock formations and small waterfalls, and a water park. Paths wind through a maze of tall rock formations beside the lake, where visitors can take boats. The county describes it as a core scenic area of the Yimengshan geopark.
description: 沂蒙云瀑洞天位于山东临沂。游览特色包括瀑布、地质景观、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 5 km north-east of Dongmeng town and 18 km north-north-east of Fei county town, roughly 45 km north-west of Linyi city.

name: 智圣汤泉
summaryEn: Zhisheng is a large hot-spring resort at the north-eastern edge of Yinan town, themed on Zhuge Liang, the Three Kingdoms strategist whom Yinan counts among its natives, with Han-style buildings set in a Jiangnan-style garden. It combines thermal baths, a water park, a hotel and conference facilities, and Linyi's official tourism account describes pools among flower plantings in spring. It suits visitors who want a soak after sightseeing in the Yimeng hills.
description: 智圣汤泉位于山东临沂。游览特色包括水上游乐、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 2.5 km north-east of Yinan town and about 55 km north-north-east of Linyi city centre, reached by road.

name: 朱家林
summaryEn: Zhujialin is a rural area in the hills of Andi town that Yinan County has redeveloped since 2016 as a 'pastoral complex' of themed guesthouses, a 'field living room' and flats for creative start-ups. The county has also restored hillsides, reservoirs and old irrigation channels, building 32 ponds and a 5.4 km chain of landscape waterways, and the area was named to Shandong's 2023 list of ecological tourism areas. It suits visitors who want a quiet countryside stay.
description: 朱家林位于山东临沂。游览特色包括水库、灌溉工程。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Andi town in the hills of north-western Yinan County, about 28 km north-west of Yinan town, reached by road.

name: 竹泉村
summaryEn: Zhuquan ('Bamboo Spring') is an old village of stone houses built around springs and bamboo groves, renamed in the Qianlong era. From 2008 it was redeveloped as a tourist area, with the villagers rehoused in a new settlement, so it now works as a restored village resort that opened in 2009. Visitors walk the stone lanes, springs and bamboo, and can stay in village homestays.
description: 竹泉村位于山东临沂。游览特色包括传统村落。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 11 km north-north-west of Yinan county town and about 65 km north of Linyi city, reached by road.

name: 蓝树谷青少年世博园
summaryEn: A park of hands-on experience halls for children and teenagers in Yunshan town. The halls cover subjects such as science, electricity, weather and earthquakes, construction, traffic, fire safety and traditional crafts. It suits families with school-age children.
description: 蓝树谷青少年世博园位于山东青岛。游览特色包括地震纪念。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yunshan town, about 13 km east-north-east of Pingdu; check that it is open before going.

name: 藏马山国际旅游度假区
summaryEn: A leisure resort area on the south slope of Cangma Mountain in the West Coast New Area, laid out along Kaicheng Road. Its ski slope was upgraded in 2024 with night skiing and a snow-ring run, and hosted a provincial skiing challenge in January 2025; the district's autumn 2025 tourism programme also lists a Cangma Mountain sports carnival and a flight camp. It is mainly a family leisure destination for Qingdao residents.
description: 藏马山国际旅游度假区位于山东青岛。游览特色包括滑雪、休闲度假、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Kaicheng Road at the southern foot of Cangma Mountain in the West Coast New Area, about 58 km west-south-west of central Qingdao.

name: 华东百利酒庄
summaryEn: A winery estate in the Laoshan hills east of central Qingdao. The city's English tourism page lists a vineyard, a grape-culture gallery, a sculpture garden, a wine cellar and a cherry orchard among its sights. It suits visitors interested in Chinese wine who want a short trip out of the city.
description: 华东百利酒庄位于山东青岛。游览特色包括葡萄酒文化、果园、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the hills of Laoshan district, about 22 km east-north-east of central Qingdao; check that it is open before going.

name: 灵山湾城市阳台
summaryEn: A seafront park and bathing beach on Lingshan Bay in the West Coast New Area, laid out over about 72 hectares (1,075 mu) behind a long sandy beach. It was created in the clean-up of the bay's shoreline and is linked to a continuous coastal path for walking and cycling. Lingshan Island, the tallest island in northern China, lies about 10 km offshore.
description: 灵山湾城市阳台位于山东青岛。游览特色包括海滨、岛屿、海岸风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Lingshan Bay in the West Coast New Area, about 32 km south-west of central Qingdao across Jiaozhou Bay.

name: 毛公山
summaryEn: Maogong Mountain is a hill area of about 3.2 sq km in Chengyang district, known for a natural rock about 8.3 m high that locals say resembles a standing figure of Mao Zedong in a tunic suit; villagers came across it in 2008 while building a hiking path. Footpaths lead past other named rock formations, and a corridor and wall displays along the route present Chinese Communist Party history and quotations. It is mainly a walking and local sightseeing spot.
description: 毛公山位于山东青岛。游览特色包括山岩地貌。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xifu subdistrict of Chengyang district, about 28 km north-north-east of central Qingdao.

name: 明月海藻世界
summaryEn: Mingyue Seaweed World is an industrial-tourism site run by the Mingyue seaweed company in the West Coast New Area, opened to visitors in June 2021. Its visit route takes in a seaweed science museum, laboratory areas, a seaweed-themed zone called the Seaweed Tribe, a health workshop and an on-site hotel. It suits families and school groups curious about how a seaweed business works.
description: 明月海藻世界位于山东青岛。游览特色包括博物馆、科学科普。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yinzhu subdistrict of the West Coast New Area, across Jiaozhou Bay from the city, about 40 km south-west of central Qingdao.

name: 茶山风景区
summaryEn: A hill scenic area north of Pingdu, laid out in seven zones, including children's play, eco-tourism, villa stays and a pilgrimage area, under the theme of rocks, springs, flowers and temples. A walking route of about 2.5 km runs from the entrance to Banruo Temple, a Buddhist temple built in Qing timber style, passing a well called Zhuangyuan Well and a hillside Guanyin figure shaped from planted evergreens. It suits a half-day outing from Pingdu.
description: 茶山风景区位于山东青岛。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、佛教文化、朝圣文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dianzi town, about 20 km north of Pingdu; check that it is open before going.

name: 青岛方特梦幻王国
summaryEn: A theme park of nearly 700,000 m² in the Hongdao area on the north-west shore of Jiaozhou Bay, run by Fantawild. Its rides and shows retell themes from Chinese culture through film projection and interactive technology. It suits families and visitors who want a theme-park day rather than sightseeing.
description: 青岛方特梦幻王国位于山东青岛。游览特色包括主题游乐。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the Hongdao area of Chengyang district, across Jiaozhou Bay, about 17 km north-north-west of central Qingdao.

name: 青岛森林野生动物世界
summaryEn: A wildlife park in the Xiaozhushan hills of the West Coast New Area, which keeps animals such as elephants and runs nature-study programmes on animal care for school groups. It stands beside Zhushan National Forest Park, and in 2025 it hosted the Qingdao launch of the Earth Day and bird-protection-week publicity campaign. It suits families with children.
description: 青岛森林野生动物世界位于山东青岛。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Lingzhushan subdistrict of the West Coast New Area, about 26 km west-south-west of central Qingdao across Jiaozhou Bay.

name: 金沙滩
summaryEn: A crescent-shaped beach in Huangdao more than 3,500 m long and about 300 m wide, backed by resort buildings and restaurants. Visitors come for sea views, swimming and beach activities such as sand sculpture, kite flying, speedboat rides and ocean rowing. It suits family beach days in summer.
description: 金沙滩位于山东青岛。游览特色包括海滨、乘船游览、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the coast of Huangdao in the West Coast New Area, about 13 km south-south-west of central Qingdao across the bay.

name: 青岛世界园艺博览园
summaryEn: The former site of the 2014 World Horticultural Exposition, on hills around a reservoir in Licang district and covering about 190 hectares. It has themed gardens with more than 1,700 types of plants. It suits garden visitors and families for half a day.
description: 青岛世界园艺博览园位于山东青岛。游览特色包括水库、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Licang district, about 22 km north-east of central Qingdao; check that it is open before going.

name: 青岛奥林匹克雕塑文化园
summaryEn: A landscaped city park in Chengyang district, formerly Chengyang Century Park, turned into a sculpture park to mark the 2008 Olympic sailing events held at Qingdao. It has a World Olympic Boulevard, a China Olympic Champion Road and ten themed sculpture groups beside its main paths, with planted areas for plant study. It suits a short stop for a walk among the sculptures.
description: 青岛奥林匹克雕塑文化园位于山东青岛。游览特色包括雕塑艺术、城市公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Chengyang district, about 26 km north-north-east of central Qingdao.

name: 青岛极地海洋公园
summaryEn: An ocean park on the Fushan Bay shore in Laoshan district, built around an aquarium hall of polar and marine animals that includes penguins, polar bears, dolphins and belugas. It stages shows with dolphins and belugas, and a 360-degree dome cinema was added in 2023. It suits families with children.
description: 青岛极地海洋公园位于山东青岛。游览特色包括水族展览、海岸风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Donghai East Road in Laoshan district, about 11 km east of the old town.

name: 青岛银海国际游艇俱乐部
summaryEn: A yacht marina and club on the eastern stretch of Qingdao's seafront, with docks and berths, dry docks, a sailing training base, launch ramps and a clubhouse. The city's English tourism page names a site marking China's sea-level datum, a sightseeing tower and a sculpture group called Voyager among the nearby sights. It suits visitors interested in boats and the modern waterfront.
description: 青岛银海国际游艇俱乐部位于山东青岛。游览特色包括海岸风光、楼阁建筑、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On East Sea Middle Road at the eastern end of the seafront, about 9 km east of central Qingdao; the marina is a members' club, and it is not clear which parts visitors can enter.

name: 玫瑰小镇
summaryEn: A rose-growing park and visitor area on farmland in Lingshan subdistrict, which opened to visitors in 2015 after rose planting began there in 2012. State media report more than 3,000 mu (about 200 hectares) of roses in over 1,200 varieties, an underground culture corridor of nearly a kilometre, and rose-based foods and cosmetics. The flowers bloom and are harvested around May, when it is busiest.
description: 玫瑰小镇位于山东青岛。游览特色包括田园观光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Lingshan subdistrict in the north of Jimo district, about 21 km north of central Jimo and about 59 km north of central Qingdao.

name: 少海风景区
summaryEn: A lakeside wetland park on the edge of Jiaozhou. It is listed as a national wetland park and a national water-conservancy scenic area, and takes its name from Shaohai, an old name for Jiaozhou Bay. It suits an easy walk by the water.
description: 少海风景区位于山东青岛。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jiaozhou, about 29 km north-west of central Qingdao.

name: 天泰温泉度假区
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in Wenquan on the Jimo coast, with hotel accommodation. It is a spa and leisure destination rather than a sightseeing one. It suits visitors who want a soak and a stay outside Qingdao.
description: 天泰温泉度假区位于山东青岛。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wenquan, on the Jimo coast, about 19 km east-north-east of central Jimo and about 51 km north-east of central Qingdao; check that it is open before going.

name: 青岛滨海学院世界动物自然生态博物馆
summaryEn: A natural-history museum on the campus of Qingdao Binhai University, with more than 4,000 animal specimens from Africa, the Americas and elsewhere, including king cheetah, white rhinoceros, giant panda, golden eagle and crested ibis. Animals are displayed in reconstructed habitat scenes, and further sections cover marine life and the evolution of the universe. It is a national second-grade museum and a national science-education base, and suits families and school groups.
description: 青岛滨海学院世界动物自然生态博物馆位于山东青岛。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the university campus at 425 Jialingjiang West Road in the West Coast New Area, about 17 km west-south-west of central Qingdao across Jiaozhou Bay; Metro Line 6 stops at Pashan (Qingdao Binhai University) station. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 珠山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forested granite mountain park on Xiaozhu Mountain, whose main peak, Dading, reaches 724.9 m and which continues the Laoshan range. It became a national forest park in 2000 and, with Dazhu Mountain, forms the 'Shuangzhu Qianyun' view counted among the old eight sights of Jiaozhou. It suits walkers who want a mountain day without leaving the Qingdao area.
description: 小珠山是位于中华人民共和国山东省青岛市黄岛区的一座山峰，主峰大顶海拔724.9米。小珠山山脉是崂山山脉的延续，山体主要由花岗岩构成。小珠山与大珠山并称为古胶州八景之首的“双珠嵌云”。
accessEn: In Lingzhushan subdistrict of the West Coast New Area, about 24 km west-south-west of central Qingdao across Jiaozhou Bay.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 磴山
summaryEn: Dengshan is a forested hill about 3 km from the coast in Hushan town, Lanshan District, with springs, bamboo groves and the Hongyun Temple. Its 'Dengshan spring dawn' is ranked first among the old Eight Views of Haiqu, an old name for the Rizhao area, and magpies are common. A snow-play park and a Spring Festival temple fair were held here in early 2026.
description: 磴山位于山东日照。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、林地风光、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Hushan town, about 28 km south-west of central Rizhao, reached by road.

name: 浮来青旅游度假区
summaryEn: Fulaiqing is a tea-themed leisure resort in Xiazhuang town, Ju County, built around a large organic tea garden and a tea-culture hall, with a museum on the 'South Tea to the North' project that began in the 1950s. The Rizhao tourism bureau also lists a deer park, an artificial ski slope and summer rafting, as of 2021. It suits families and anyone curious about northern tea growing.
description: 浮来青旅游度假区位于山东日照。游览特色包括博物馆、茶文化、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xiazhuang town, about 26 km south-west of Ju County town, reached by road; check that it is open before going.

name: 黑虎山狩猎旅游区
summaryEn: Heihushan is a company-run hunting ground and holiday resort in the hills of Wulian County, on the west shore of Shimuzi Reservoir. The Rizhao tourism bureau describes it as a legally registered hunting ground with game such as pheasant, wild boar and hare, and says hunting is by members' reservation only. The grounds also have lodging, meeting rooms and an agricultural sightseeing area.
description: 黑虎山狩猎旅游区位于山东日照。游览特色包括水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wulian County, about 15 km south-south-west of Wulian town; hunting is for members only, so check access and that it is open before going.

name: 刘家湾赶海园
summaryEn: Liujiawan is a beach park on the coast of Taoluo town, with about 5.4 km of shoreline backed by a coastal forest belt. At low tide a broad tidal flat is exposed where visitors dig for clams, razor clams and crabs, a local pastime known as ganhai, and there are also sea bathing, sand sports and a golf practice range. It suits families wanting a half day at the seaside.
description: 刘家湾赶海园位于山东日照。游览特色包括海滨、海岸风光、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the coast about 18 km south-south-west of central Rizhao, reached by road; check tide times before going.

name: 龙门崮
summaryEn: Longmengu is a 16 km² mountain-and-lake resort in Sanzhuang town, centred on a flat-topped crag, or gu, 416 m high. Rong'an Group developed it from 2003 and it opened in May 2009, with a lake, gorges and caves, and fruit picking in autumn. It suits a relaxed day out in the hills.
description: 龙门崮位于山东日照。游览特色包括峡谷、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Sanzhuang town, about 39 km west-north-west of central Rizhao, reached by road; check that it is open before going.

name: 日照海洋公园
summaryEn: Rizhao Ocean Park is a modern marine park on Bihai Road in the Shanhaitian resort area, made up of an aquarium and a four-seasons flower-and-bird garden. It was added to the 4A list in late 2021. It suits families looking for an indoor stop on the city's seafront.
description: 日照海洋公园位于山东日照。游览特色包括水族展览、海岸风光、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Bihai Road about 4 km east-north-east of central Rizhao, reached by city bus or taxi.

name: 天台山
summaryEn: Tiantai Mountain is a wooded hill, 258 m high, in Taoluo town, built up as a sun-culture park around five low peaks. According to the Rizhao tourism bureau it has three themed areas, a place of worship, a sunrise platform and a Shangshu (Book of Documents) area, and it also runs tea tastings, craft workshops and festivals such as a New Year sunrise event. A hot-spring inn is attached.
description: 天台山位于山东日照。游览特色包括林地风光、手工艺、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Taoluo town, about 27 km south-west of central Rizhao, reached by road.

name: 嗡嗡乐园
summaryEn: Wengweng Paradise is a bee-themed leisure park in the hills of Longshan town, Ju County, which the Rizhao tourism bureau describes as Shandong's first bee-culture experience park. It has a bee-science museum, a bee-hive maze, lavender flower fields, an organic tea garden, a lake and a children's activity camp. It was added to the 4A list in late 2021 and suits families.
description: 嗡嗡乐园位于山东日照。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Longshan town, about 16 km east-south-east of Ju County town and about 50 km west-north-west of central Rizhao; check that it is open before going.

name: 五莲山
summaryEn: Wulian Mountain is a granite mountain area of about 73 km² in Wulian County, made up of Wulian Mountain itself, neighbouring Jiuxian Mountain and the Longtan gorge and lake. The main peak is 515.7 m high, and sights include rock peaks and viewpoints, the Ming-dynasty Guangming Temple, a provincial heritage site, and wild azaleas that flower in May. It suits a day of walking in hill scenery.
description: 五莲山位于山东日照。游览特色包括峡谷、寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Wulian County, about 32 km north-north-west of central Rizhao, reached by road.

name: 春秋古镇
summaryEn: A newly built town in classical northern Chinese style in Feicheng's Xincheng area, on more than 400 mu (roughly 27 hectares) with about 150,000 square metres of floor space. Its theme is the Spring and Autumn period, laid out as separate Qi and Lu zones, and it combines shops, restaurants, lodging, performances and an evening street scene rather than historic buildings. It holds an annual culture and tourism festival, the twelfth edition in autumn 2025, and suits an evening stroll or meal.
description: 春秋古镇位于山东泰安。游览特色包括古镇、历史建筑、节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xincheng subdistrict on the west side of Feicheng, about 4 km west of the city centre and about 36 km west of central Tai'an.

name: 徂徕山森林温泉康养度假谷
summaryEn: A hot-spring and wellness resort in the foothills of Culai Mountain, where a Tai'an government article of 2025 says the springs stand on the site of the Tang-dynasty 'Qianfeng bath'. A winter ski ground beside it has four pistes (beginner, intermediate, advanced and snowboard) and snow-tube runs. It is a modern resort rather than a sightseeing stop, and suits a winter weekend.
description: 徂徕山森林温泉康养度假谷位于山东泰安。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At the foot of Culai Mountain in Daiyue District, about 16 km south-south-east of central Tai'an.

name: 泰山方特欢乐世界
summaryEn: A theme park of the Fantawild chain on the north-eastern side of Tai'an, opened in 2010 and built around science-fiction and fantasy themes. Its rides and shows include Dinosaur Crisis, Future Police, the Mysterious Valley and Conch Bay, together with a water-play area. It is a modern amusement park aimed at families and teenagers.
description: 泰山方特欢乐世界位于山东泰安。游览特色包括主题游乐、山谷、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Shengzhuang town, Taishan District, about 7 km north-east of central Tai'an.

name: 昆仑山景区
summaryEn: A hill-and-lakeshore scenic area at Nantangzi village on the western shore of Dongping Lake, not to be confused with the Kunlun mountain range. The county government says it was developed from 2008 around film-set villages built for the new Water Margin television series (the Zhu and Song family manors), and lists a stone-carving gallery, a seven-star waterfall, the restored Yueyan Temple and later additions including a glass walkway, zip-line, rock climbing and a children's maze. The village beside it offers fishing-family stays, so it suits a relaxed rural and lake day out.
description: 昆仑山景区位于山东泰安。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Nantangzi village, Yinshan town, about 28 km west-north-west of Dongping town.

name: 太阳部落
summaryEn: A theme park in Manzhuang town built around prehistoric life and the Dawenkou culture of the Tai'an area. It has a Dawenkou culture exhibition hall, a replica ancient village, rides and cinema attractions with titles such as Nuwa Mends the Sky and Ancient Battle, a live-action show about a mountain flood, and an animal park. It suits families with children.
description: 太阳部落位于山东泰安。游览特色包括主题游乐、古村落。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Manzhuang town, Daiyue District, about 17 km south of central Tai'an.

name: 泰山宝泰隆旅游区
summaryEn: A tourist area in Qiujiadian town, east of Tai'an, built around the Tai'an Underground Dragon Palace, a show cave with stalactites, flowstone and stone columns. A Tai'an government article of 2025 says the cave stays at about 18 °C all year and that visitors can also raft about 3,000 m along an underground stream. The steady temperature makes it a comfortable stop in winter.
description: 泰山宝泰隆旅游区位于山东泰安。游览特色包括洞穴、钟乳石。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Qiujiadian town, about 11 km east-south-east of central Tai'an.

name: 天颐湖
summaryEn: A lakeside leisure area in Manzhuang town, south of Tai'an, that operates as the Taishan Flower Sea scenic area and has a Ferris wheel. Activities reported by the city government include nature-study sessions for school groups, seasonal themed events and an aerospace exhibition held over National Day 2024. It suits a family afternoon rather than a sightseeing visit.
description: 天颐湖位于山东泰安。游览特色包括湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Manzhuang town, Daiyue District, about 14 km south of central Tai'an.

name: 五埠岭伙大门
summaryEn: A hill village of dry-stone houses, with more than 200 courtyards of the Ming, Qing and Republican periods and the nickname 'first stone village of Shandong'. Its 'huodamen' are family compounds in which several households share one gate, with gates inside gates and lanes inside lanes, and a stone-slab lane marks the old boundary between Tai'an and Dongping prefectures. Since 2016 the village has been renovated with craft workshops, a food street and evening events, so it is now part heritage village and part tourist village.
description: 五埠岭伙大门位于山东泰安。游览特色包括手工艺。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Wubu village, Sunbo town, about 24 km south-south-west of central Feicheng.

name: 新甫山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area on Xinfu Mountain, also called Lotus Mountain from its nine peaks, which rises to 994 m north-west of Xintai. A Tai'an government account of 2017 says Emperor Wu of Han built a detached palace on the mountain and that the hill's shape earned it the name 'Little Mount Tai'; the area opened to visitors in 2005 and has Guanyin-themed temple buildings, among them the Guanyin Pavilion and Taiping Chan Temple. It suits a mountain-and-temple day trip from Xintai.
description: 新甫山位于山东泰安。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、山地游览、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills about 15 km north-north-west of central Xintai.

name: 白浪绿洲湿地公园
summaryEn: A long riverside wetland park on the upper Bailang River, running about 6.7 km from the Bailang River reservoir in the south to Baotong Street in the north on the western side of Weifang's urban area. It is laid out in three parts, a leisure area, a wetland science area and a cultural park, and is a national urban wetland park. It suits a walk or cycle beside the river.
description: 白浪绿洲湿地公园位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括湿地、水库。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the western side of Weifang's urban area, about 6 km south-west of the city centre; the park stretches roughly 6.7 km along the river.

name: 常山文化博物苑
summaryEn: This museum park lies on the northern slope of Changshan, the hill south of Zhucheng where the Song poet Su Shi came to pray for rain in 1075 while serving as the local magistrate. Opened around 2011 in Ming-and-Qing palace style, it has dozens of halls, a Buddhist temple and a 21.9 m seated bronze Guanyin, and it displays Buddhist statues, terracotta figures and other art from a local family's private collection. It suits visitors interested in Buddhist art who want a gentle hillside walk.
description: 常山文化博物苑位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the northern foot of Changshan, about 10 km south of Zhucheng town, reached by road.

name: 中国宝石城
summaryEn: A large gem and jewellery trading centre in Changle, the county known for its sapphires, laid out as a tourist area that includes the China Sapphire Museum. The museum has exhibits on gem types, the volcanic origin of the local sapphires, processing and gem identification, and the market halls sell sapphires, gold, jade and other jewellery. It suits visitors interested in gems or shopping, and it is a commercial centre rather than a historic site.
description: 中国宝石城位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the east of Changle county town, about 5 km north-north-east of the county town centre and about 27 km west of Weifang city centre.

name: 欢乐海沙滩
summaryEn: An artificial sand beach about 1,600 m long on the Bohai Bay coast in Weifang's Binhai district, opened in 2012 as the city's first sea-side beach. It is set up for paddling and swimming with lifeguards, beach games and camping, with fairground-style rides along the shore. It suits families on a summer day trip.
description: 欢乐海沙滩位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括海滨。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Binhai district on the Bohai Bay coast, about 57 km north of Weifang city centre.

name: 金宝乐园
summaryEn: A combined zoo, amusement park and botanical garden in the southern part of Weifang's urban area, opened in the 1990s on the site of a former swamp. The zoo is the main attraction, with tigers, lions, leopards, lemurs and red-crowned cranes, and there are also a children's petting area, rides and a poplar grove with hammocks. It suits families with children.
description: 金宝乐园位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括植物园、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the southern part of Weifang's urban area, about 7 km south-south-west of the city centre; check that it is open before going.

name: 景芝酒之城
summaryEn: A liquor-culture visitor area built around the Jingzhi distillery in Jingzhi town, south-east of Anqiu. The company was formed in 1948 by merging 72 village distilleries and is known for its sesame-aroma baijiu, and its traditional brewing technique is listed as national intangible cultural heritage. It is a company-run attraction for visitors interested in baijiu, not a historic site.
description: 景芝酒之城位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括非遗文化、酿造文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jingzhi town, about 25 km south-east of Anqiu town centre.

name: 九龙峪
summaryEn: A hill resort and amusement area on the southern edge of Qingzhou, with seasonal flower fields (cherry and rape blossom in spring, sunflowers and lavender in summer, chrysanthemums in autumn), rides such as a roller coaster and carousel, a small zoo, a high-level walkway and a winter snow-and-ice park. It is a commercial leisure area aimed mainly at families, with a guesthouse in a converted village inside it. Folk performances and craft sessions are also offered.
description: 九龙峪位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括动物观赏、花卉观赏、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Mihe town on the southern edge of Qingzhou, about 14 km south of Qingzhou city centre, close to the Jiulongyu interchange of the Ji-Wei expressway.

name: 揽翠湖天沐温泉度假村
summaryEn: A hot-spring and leisure resort on the eastern edge of Linqu, with a hotel, indoor and outdoor hot-spring pools, meeting rooms and restaurants. It is a commercial multi-pool resort rather than a natural hot-spring site. Weifang's tourism bureau pairs it with Mount Yi and the Shanwang fossil site on wellness routes in Linqu.
description: 揽翠湖天沐温泉度假村位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括温泉、化石遗迹、休闲度假。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the eastern side of Linqu county town, about 4 km east of the centre and about 56 km west-south-west of Weifang city centre; check that it is open before going.

name: 林海生态博览园
summaryEn: A large wetland park built on saline-alkali land near the Bohai coast in north Shouguang, with lotus ponds, a long wetland water channel and lakes. Visitors can take boat rides among the lotus, which flowers in summer when a lotus festival is held, and see displays on the area's salt-making and fishing traditions. It suits a slow half-day outing rather than a sightseeing circuit.
description: 林海生态博览园位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括湿地、乘船游览、莲花观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Shuangwangcheng area of north Shouguang, about 30 km north of the city centre; check that it is open before going.

name: 青山秀水
summaryEn: A leisure park made from an abandoned quarry in Changyi, developed by the Jinbao group and opened to the public in July 2015, described locally as Weifang's first scenic area built on a reclaimed mine. Its features include a bamboo grove, a swan lake, a bird garden, an animal park with African species, a lavender garden, and camping and RV grounds. It suits family days out rather than sightseeing.
description: 青山秀水位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括湖泊、园林景观、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the north side of the Shibu development zone, east of the Wei River, about 10 km south-south-east of Changyi town centre and about 27 km east-north-east of Weifang city centre; check that it is open before going.

name: 青云山民俗游乐园
summaryEn: A hillside theme park on Qingyun Mountain in south-east Anqiu, billed locally as the first folk-custom park of Shandong. It is divided into a Jiangnan-style garden area, an ethnic-customs area, an animal park and an adventure valley, with attractions such as a glass skywalk, a rainbow slide, horse riding and archery. It is aimed mainly at families.
description: 青云山民俗游乐园位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括主题游乐、山谷、民俗文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Qingyun Mountain Road on the south-eastern side of Anqiu, about 5 km south-south-east of the town centre.

name: 红高粱小镇
summaryEn: Red Sorghum Town is a tourism complex in the Dongbei Township area of Gaomi, the home district of the Nobel laureate Mo Yan, whose novel Red Sorghum Family was adapted as a Zhang Yimou film and as a TV series that began shooting in Gaomi in 2013. Its main attraction is a walled film-set town built in old style, with the Shan family compound and a bandit stronghold from the TV series, and Mo Yan's former residence stands about 500 m away. It suits fans of the book and films, and families looking for a rural day out.
description: 红高粱小镇位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括名人故居。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Dongbei Township area, about 18 km north-east of Gaomi town, reached by road.

name: 石门坊
summaryEn: A hill scenic area west of Linqu county town, known for its autumn colour: more than 3,000 mu (about 200 hectares) of natural woodland of smoke trees and maples turn red among pines and cypresses in October. The county government and local media promote it as Linqu's main red-leaf spot. The foliage is the main reason to go, so time a visit for October.
description: 石门坊位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the hills about 10 km west of Linqu county town, reached by road from the town.

name: 寿光极地海洋世界
summaryEn: A marine-themed aquarium and leisure complex in Shouguang, with displays of sea and polar animals and scenery, an underwater tunnel and a children's play area. A marine theatre stages shows, including a mermaid performance. It is aimed mainly at families with young children.
description: 寿光极地海洋世界位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括水族展览、戏剧演艺。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the built-up area of Shouguang, on Jinhai Road, and about 37 km west-north-west of Weifang city centre.

name: 寿光蔬菜高科技示范园
summaryEn: A national-level agricultural science and technology park on the east side of Shouguang, established in 2000 as the home of the Shouguang International Vegetable Sci-tech Fair, which is held every spring. Visitors walk through modern greenhouses, seedling-raising and plant-propagation demonstrations and variety displays, including a climate-controlled exhibition hall. It suits anyone curious about Shouguang's place in Chinese vegetable growing, and the fair period is the busiest.
description: 寿光蔬菜高科技示范园位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括主题展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Shengcheng East Street on the east side of Shouguang, and about 35 km west-north-west of Weifang city centre.

name: 泰和山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area of about 20 square kilometres in the south-western hills of Qingzhou, combining forest, valley scenery and religious sites. Its two main zones are the Tianyuan Valley, with temple buildings including the Taihe Temple, and the Huanghuaxi (Yellow Flower Stream) valley, with streams and waterfalls. It suits a day out in the hills.
description: 泰和山位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Miaozi town in the south-western hills of Qingzhou, about 27 km south-west of the city centre; check that it is open before going.

name: 世界风筝公园
summaryEn: A kite park in Anqiu, part of the Qilu Jiudi tourist area, which received the title 'World Kite Park' from the international kite federation in March 2024. It has a large kite-flying field, a three-storey kite culture centre with exhibition halls, flower fields and a food street, and it is the main venue of the Weifang International Kite Festival each April. Go in April for the competitions and mass kite-flying.
description: 世界风筝公园位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括花卉观赏、主题展览、节庆文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Anqiu, about 6 km north-north-west of the town centre and about 20 km south of Weifang city centre; the main festival is held there each April.

name: 杨家埠民间艺术大观园
summaryEn: A folk-art park in Hanting district, built on the site of the old Ming and Qing village of Yangjiabu, whose woodblock New Year prints and kites are both national intangible cultural heritage. It has four zones, heritage culture, old-village culture, a folk-art old street and live-scene performances, and next to the old shop street stands a surviving group of print-workshop houses. It suits visitors interested in how New Year prints and kites are made.
description: 杨家埠民间艺术大观园位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括非遗文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In West Yangjiabu village, Hanting district, about 1 km east-north-east of the district centre and about 8 km north-east of Weifang city centre.

name: 仰天山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forested mountain park in the hills of south-west Qingzhou, known as a summer retreat and for its spring locust-blossom season. It has karst caves and cliffs and the Buddhist remains of the Wenshu temple, and the park offers log cabins, RV pitches and camping grounds on site. It suits a day of cool air and walking in the hills.
description: 仰天山国家森林公园位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、洞穴、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills of south-west Qingzhou, about 32 km south-west of the city centre, reached by road.

name: 诸城恐龙文化旅游区
summaryEn: Dinosaur Gully is the fossil site south-west of Zhucheng where giant hadrosaur bones were recognised in 1964, and it is now protected under shelters; its fossil corridor is about 500 m long and 30 m deep, with nearly 10,000 bones exposed in the slope. Around it the city has built halls devoted to individual dinosaurs, including a Tyrannosaur Hall about 2.5 km to the north, and a national dinosaur fossil museum was under construction on the gully site in 2025. It suits families and fossil enthusiasts who want to see bones in the rock rather than only mounted skeletons.
description: 诸城恐龙文化旅游区位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括博物馆、化石遗迹。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Longdu subdistrict, about 11 km south-west of Zhucheng town, reached by road; a new museum was under construction at the gully in 2025, so check what is open before going.

name: 诸城恐龙博物馆
summaryEn: Zhucheng Dinosaur Museum stands in Dinosaur Park on the north-western side of the city, in a pyramid-like building beside a lake. Its best-known exhibit is the skeleton of Zhuchengosaurus, a hadrosaur about 16.6 m long and 9.1 m high, dug up at Dinosaur Gully in Zhucheng. Other halls cover Cretaceous life, fossil bones and a dome-screen cinema, which makes it a good first stop for families and anyone interested in palaeontology.
description: 诸城恐龙博物馆位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Dinosaur Park, about 2 km north-west of the centre of Zhucheng, reached by road.

name: 诸城动物园
summaryEn: Zhucheng Zoo is a municipal zoo on the south-eastern side of the city, with animals such as giraffes, zebras and ostriches and a petting area where visitors can feed alpacas. By summer 2026 a new intangible-heritage station offering crafts such as paper-cutting and sugar painting had opened beside the animals, and the grounds also have a Ferris wheel. It suits families with children.
description: 诸城动物园位于山东潍坊。游览特色包括动物观赏。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Mizhou subdistrict, about 8 km south-south-east of the centre of Zhucheng, reached by road.

name: 赤山
summaryEn: Chishan Fahua Temple is a Tang-style Buddhist temple at the foot of Red Mountain near Shidao, rebuilt in the late 1980s on the site of a temple founded in 823 by the Silla general Jang Bogo, where the Japanese monk Ennin stayed in 839. The scenic area also holds a memorial pagoda to Jang Bogo, put up in 1991, and a large statue of the Red Mountain god. The temple is promoted as a Buddhist site linking China, Korea and Japan.
description: 赤山位于山东威海。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、古塔。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the hillside about 3 km north-west of Shidao town and about 30 km south-south-west of Rongcheng city, reached by road.

name: 福如东海文化园
summaryEn: Furudonghai ('fortune like the Eastern Sea') is a modern cultural-tourism complex of 1,700 mu (about 1.1 km²) inside the Silver Beach resort, themed on fortune culture, the eastward voyages and Dongyi culture. It is laid out in four zones, for a calligraphy and painting institute, a resort hotel, a yacht club and shops, with gardens of more than 200 plant species, and was rated 4A in 2017. It suits a stroll alongside a beach visit.
description: 福如东海文化园位于山东威海。游览特色包括海滨、园林景观、书法文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Inside the Silver Beach resort, about 19 km east-south-east of Rushan town, reached by road.

name: 环翠楼公园
summaryEn: Huancuilou Park is a hill park in the middle of Weihai, named after the Huancui Tower, with wooded paths, viewpoints over the city and sports courts. It suits a short walk in the city centre.
description: 环翠楼公园位于山东威海。游览特色包括楼阁建筑、林地风光。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: In the middle of Weihai, about 1 km west-south-west of the city's central point.

name: 里口山
summaryEn: Likou Mountain is a range of hills with peaks above 400 m on the south-western edge of Weihai, made a provincial scenic area in 2004 and described by the city as an urban mountain park. Its orchards produce the well-known Likou peaches, and since 2024 it has added a camping base and a guesthouse street, with a visitor centre at Guangfu Temple. It was rated 4A in December 2021.
description: 里口山位于山东威海。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、果园、山地游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the south-western edge of Weihai about 5 km south-south-west of the city centre, reached by road.

name: 那香海
summaryEn: Nahaixiang is a coastal leisure area on Huanhai Road in Rongcheng, with a long sandy beach, a pine belt and resort buildings behind it. Attractions include a Ferris wheel, beach water sports and a boat route to Jiming Island, and the Weihai city government names it among the area's places for a seaside outing. It suits a family beach day.
description: 那香海位于山东威海。游览特色包括海滨、岛屿、海岸风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Huanhai Road on the Rongcheng coast, about 29 km east-south-east of central Weihai, reached by road.

name: 乳山银滩
summaryEn: Silver Beach is a seaside resort district on the south coast of the Shandong Peninsula, named for its pale sandy beaches, which the Rushan government puts at 21.7 km. Development began in 1992, it became a provincial tourist resort in 1994 and a 4A area in 2002, and hotels, apartment blocks and leisure venues now line the shore. It suits a beach holiday rather than sightseeing.
description: 乳山银滩位于山东威海。游览特色包括海滨、海岸风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the coast about 16 km south-east of Rushan town, reached by road.

name: 威海国际海水浴场
summaryEn: The International Bathing Beach is a sandy beach about 2.8 km long on Weihai's north coast, between Majia Mountain and Yandun Mountain and backed by a pine belt. The city marked out six swimming zones in 2021, and the beach has changing rooms, boat rides and amusements. It suits a half day of swimming in summer or a seafront walk at other times.
description: 威海国际海水浴场位于山东威海。游览特色包括海滨、海岸风光、乘船游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the coast about 7 km west-north-west of central Weihai, reached by road.

name: 海滨生态公园风景带·侨乡号游轮
summaryEn: This 4A listing combines a waterfront park belt on Weihai's seafront with the Qiaoxiang, a sightseeing ship that sails on Weihai Bay. The ship's pier is on Dengta Road, next to the Liugong Island ferry terminal. It suits a short harbour cruise combined with a visit to Liugong Island.
description: 海滨生态公园风景带·侨乡号游轮位于山东威海。游览特色包括海滨、岛屿、海岸风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: The pier is on Dengta Road, about 3 km south-east of central Weihai and beside the Liugong Island ferry terminal. Check that it is open before going.

name: 天沐温泉度假区
summaryEn: Tianmu is a hot-spring and conference resort in Zoujiachuang village, Zhangjiachan town, Wendeng District, set in wooded hills. The Wendeng tourism bureau describes a hotel with lake-view rooms, a conference centre and a spa area with 66 pools, including an indoor swimming hall and open-air hot springs. It suits an overnight hot-spring stay or a day trip.
description: 天沐温泉度假区位于山东威海。游览特色包括温泉、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhangjiachan town, about 13 km south of Wendeng's urban area and about 48 km south of central Weihai, reached by road.

name: 仙姑顶
summaryEn: Xianguding is a Daoist-themed hill park on Huanshan Road, south of central Weihai, with a temple complex, statues and small lakes among the hills. It suits a short outing from the city centre.
description: 仙姑顶位于山东威海。游览特色包括寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Huanshan Road about 6 km south of central Weihai, reached by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 艾山温泉度假村
summaryEn: Aishan Hot Spring Resort is a hot-spring complex beside the village of Aishantang, at the foot of Mount Ai north of Qixia town, with open-air pools and resort accommodation. It is set in a rural hill landscape and suits a quiet day out or an overnight stay.
description: 艾山温泉度假村位于山东烟台。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Songshan subdistrict, about 12 km north of Qixia town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 张裕国际葡萄酒城
summaryEn: Changyu International Wine City is the winery-tourism area of Changyu, which began making wine in Yantai in 1892, in the Yantai Economic-Technological Development Area. Its visitor core is the Changyu Castel Winery, a chateau in European style set among vineyards, with a tasting room; the wider wine city, begun in 2012, adds a large wine-production centre. It suits wine enthusiasts and anyone wanting a half-day out from Yantai.
description: 张裕国际葡萄酒城位于山东烟台。游览特色包括葡萄酒文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Beiyujia village in the Yantai Economic-Technological Development Area, about 23 km by road west of central Yantai.

name: 张裕酒文化博物馆
summaryEn: The museum stands on the original premises of Changyu, founded in Yantai in 1892 by the overseas Chinese businessman Zhang Bishi and regarded as the start of modern winemaking in China. Its centrepiece is the century-old underground wine cellar, a national heritage unit since 2013, where visitors can see the cellar and taste wine, while interactive displays and galleries cover the company's history, including a commemorative plate from the Panama exposition. It suits anyone interested in wine or in the history of Yantai as a treaty port.
description: 张裕酒文化博物馆位于山东烟台。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位、国家一级博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Dama Road in central Yantai, about 2 km east-south-east of Yantai railway station and within walking distance of Yantai Hill.

name: 磁山温泉小镇
summaryEn: Cishan Hot Spring Town is a hot-spring resort on the lower slopes of Cishan hill in the western part of the Yantai development zone, with hot-spring bathing, accommodation, restaurants and meeting rooms. It is one part of a larger wellness and retirement community developed by a local chemicals group. It suits a relaxing day out or a short stay from Yantai.
description: 磁山温泉小镇位于山东烟台。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Gu Xian subdistrict of the Yantai Economic-Technological Development Area, about 33 km by road west of central Yantai.

name: 大基山
summaryEn: Daji Mountain is a forested valley and peak (478 m) on the south-east edge of Laizhou that has long been a Taoist retreat associated with the Quanzhen master Qiu Chuji, and temple halls around Daji Lake, including the Taiqing Palace, were rebuilt from the early 2000s. Its cliffs carry 24 historic inscriptions, among them calligraphy cut in 512 by the Northern Wei official Zheng Daozhao, and the hills hold a Yueshi-culture site about 4,000 years old. Newer additions include a 1.6 km rafting course and, in summer, a water-jetpack show.
description: 大基山位于山东烟台。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the south-east edge of Laizhou, about 8 km east-south-east of the town centre and about 9 km by road.

name: 海昌渔人码头
summaryEn: Despite its name, Haichang Fisherman's Wharf is a modern waterfront leisure development on a small land-tied island in Laishan district, with the sea on three sides and buildings in Victorian and Georgian-inspired style. Its main attraction is the Haichang Whale Shark Marine Park, an aquarium, and there is also an amusement area, a food court, a beach play area at the Second Bathing Beach and a pier. It suits families and an easy afternoon by the sea.
description: 海昌渔人码头位于山东烟台。游览特色包括海滨、水族展览、岛屿。图集建议预留2–4 小时游览。
accessEn: On Binhai Middle Road in Laishan district, about 6 km by road east of central Yantai.

name: 海阳旅游度假区
summaryEn: Haiyang Tourist Resort stretches along the seafront south-east of Haiyang town, centred on a long sandy beach backed by pine woodland, hotels and villas. It also has a sand-sculpture park, a wetland park and the sports venues left from the third Asian Beach Games, held here in 2012. It suits a beach holiday or a stop on a coastal road trip.
description: 海阳旅游度假区位于山东烟台。游览特色包括湿地、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the seafront about 10 km south-south-east of the centre of Haiyang; the resort is about 110 km by road from central Yantai.

name: 金沙滩海滨公园
summaryEn: A long seaside park on Bajiao Bay (also called Taozi Bay) in Yantai's Development Zone, with a wide bathing beach of fine pale sand backed by a belt of coastal woodland. About 15 km of shoreline is divided into ten zones with plazas, boardwalks and a salt-marsh wetland park, and the bay hosts sailing regattas, a marathon and beach music festivals. It is mainly a summer swimming and promenade spot for people staying in Yantai.
description: 金沙滩海滨公园位于山东烟台。游览特色包括湿地、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yantai's Economic and Technological Development Zone, about 12 km west-north-west of central Yantai.

name: 君顶酒庄
summaryEn: Junding Winery is a winery estate that settled in Penglai in 2007 and is named by the Shandong tourism department among Yantai's leisure wineries for wine tourism. It lies in the Nanwang area south-east of the town and suits visitors who want to add a winery stop to Penglai's coastal sights.
description: 君顶酒庄位于山东蓬莱，是以葡萄种植和葡萄酒文化为主题的酒庄。
accessEn: In Nanwang subdistrict, about 10 km south-east of central Penglai and about 14 km by road.

name: 崑龙温泉
summaryEn: Kunlong Hot Spring is a hot-spring resort in Longquan town, on the northern foot of Mount Kunyu, with indoor and outdoor pools, a spa, a hotel and water-play areas. Longquan belongs to a district of long-established hot springs in the Kunyu foothills. It suits a relaxing day out or an overnight stay, particularly in cooler weather.
description: 崑龙温泉位于山东烟台。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Longquan town, about 52 km by road south-east of central Yantai.

name: 莱阳白垩纪国家地质公园
summaryEn: This national geopark south of Laiyang protects Cretaceous rocks about 140 to 65 million years old that have yielded dinosaurs, dinosaur eggs, pterosaurs and large numbers of insects, which is why Laiyang is known as the home of Chinese dinosaurs. The geological museum, completed in 2015, has galleries on the Laiyang fauna, the dinosaur family and dinosaur eggs, and its restored skeletons include Tsintaosaurus spinorhinus, a horned duck-billed dinosaur found here that is known in China as the first dinosaur of New China.
description: 莱阳白垩纪国家地质公园位于山东烟台。游览特色包括博物馆、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Jin'gangkou village in Lüegezhuang town, about 12 km south-south-west of central Laiyang and about 15 km by road.

name: 罗山黄金文化旅游区
summaryEn: The Luoshan Gold Culture Tourist Area is built around the Zhaoyuan Gold Museum, at the foot of Luoshan in a city whose gold-mining history local media put at about 2,000 years. The museum has 11 exhibition halls on the geology, mining and refining of gold, gold culture in China and abroad, and the Jiaodong gold-supply story of the war years; behind it, a former mine tunnel is set up for visitors to walk through wearing safety helmets. It suits families and anyone curious about mining.
description: 罗山黄金文化旅游区位于山东烟台。游览特色包括博物馆、主题展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Linglong town, about 15 km by road from Zhaoyuan town and about 2 km from the Linglong exit of the S19 expressway.

name: 蓬莱欧乐堡梦幻世界
summaryEn: A theme park on the Penglai coast that opened in the mid-2010s, built in a European style and laid out in seven themed zones with more than 40 rides and attractions. It is run by the same tourism group as Sanxian Mountain and Penglai Polar Ocean World, and a separate water park of the same brand, opened in 2017, stands nearby. It suits families and teenagers rather than visitors interested in heritage.
description: 蓬莱欧乐堡梦幻世界位于山东烟台。游览特色包括主题游乐、水上游乐。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: On the Penglai coast near Haishi West Road, about 3.5 km east-south-east of Penglai Pavilion.

name: 蓬莱海洋极地世界
summaryEn: A marine park close to Penglai Pavilion, run by the same tourism group as the Eight Immortals and Sanxian Mountain parks. It has aquarium halls and a marine theatre where dolphins perform in staged shows. It suits families with children and works as an indoor add-on to a visit to Penglai.
description: 蓬莱海洋极地世界位于山东烟台。游览特色包括水族展览、山地游览、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Penglai's seafront district, about 0.6 km west-south-west of Penglai Pavilion.

name: 太虚宫
summaryEn: Taixu Palace is a large Daoist temple complex on the shore of Changchun Lake, built on the former home of Qiu Chuji, the Daoist master born in Qixia who founded the Dragon Gate branch of Quanzhen Daoism. It has more than 30 halls, among them a Three Pure Ones hall that the local tourism bureau bills as the largest in China, and it hosts temple fairs around the Lunar New Year. It suits visitors interested in Daoism, and can be combined with nearby Mou's Manor.
description: 太虚宫位于山东烟台。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Yingbin Road beside Changchun Lake, about 4 km north of the centre of Qixia, which is about 65 km by road from central Yantai.

name: 月亮湾湿地公园
summaryEn: Moon Bay is a lakeside national wetland park in Chengtou town, Shanting District, where the town has added a water-screen film show and other evening attractions. It has run light-and-fountain shows and family events in holiday seasons, including a snow-play area in winter. It suits an easy half-day outing with children rather than a sightseeing trip.
description: 月亮湾湿地公园位于山东枣庄。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Chengtou town, Shanting District, about 14 km east-north-east of the centre of Tengzhou.

name: 铁道游击队景区
summaryEn: This is a memorial park and film-set complex on a hill in Xuecheng District, dedicated to the Railway Guerrillas, a local armed unit that fought Japanese forces on the railways around Zaozhuang. It has a 33 m memorial monument (1995) with an approach stair and a gallery of inscriptions, plus a street of Republic-era-style buildings put up as a TV-series set, where live-action battle shows are staged at holiday times. It suits visitors interested in the red-tourism theme or a family day out.
description: 薛城的山地园区以铁道游击队为主题，将纪念空间与影视场景相结合。
accessEn: On a hill at the east end of Linshan Road in Xuecheng District, about 1 km north-north-west of the district centre.

name: 微山湖红荷湿地
summaryEn: This wetland on the shore of Weishan Lake, in Tengzhou's Binhu town, is known for wild red lotus and reed beds; Tengzhou's government puts the reeds at about 30 km² and calls it a national wetland park. Visitors can take boat trips among the lotus and reeds, and the flowers bloom in summer. It suits a summer day trip, with lake-fish meals and seasonal events.
description: 微山湖红荷湿地位于山东枣庄。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Binhu town, about 28 km west of the centre of Tengzhou.

name: 仙坛山温泉小镇
summaryEn: Xiantanshan Hot Spring Town is a hot-spring resort in the wooded hills of Xiwangzhuang town, on the south-eastern edge of Zaozhuang. Besides the hot-spring baths, its valley park, Xiantan Mangu, has a lawn used for camping, children's activities and evening performances at holiday times. It suits a short leisure break or a relaxed local day out rather than sightseeing.
description: 仙坛山温泉小镇位于山东枣庄。游览特色包括温泉、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xiwangzhuang town, Shizhong District, about 11 km south-south-east of the district centre.

name: 熊耳山国家地质公园
summaryEn: This national geopark in Beizhuang town, Shanting District, centres on a limestone mesa 509 m high, one of the flat-topped crags typical of southern Shandong. Its main sight is the Shuanglong Great Rift, a deep fissure that local press says stays at about 18°C all year, together with karst caves and a geological museum opened in 2004. It suits walkers and families looking for cool shade in hot weather.
description: 熊耳山国家地质公园位于山东枣庄。游览特色包括博物馆、洞穴、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Beizhuang town, Shanting District, about 17 km north-north-east of Zaozhuang's Shizhong district centre.

name: 盈泰生态温泉度假村
summaryEn: Yingtai is a hot-spring resort in Hongxu town, south of Tengzhou city, which the Zaozhuang tourism authorities list among the city's winter hot-spring destinations. It is a leisure complex for bathing and short stays rather than a sightseeing site, and it runs seasonal hot-spring programmes around holidays. It suits a restful half-day or overnight break from Tengzhou.
description: 盈泰生态温泉度假村位于山东枣庄。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Hongxu town, about 5 km south of the centre of Tengzhou.

name: 翼云石头部落
summaryEn: Yiyun Stone Village is a hillside village of stone-slab houses in Shancheng subdistrict, Shanting District, restored in the old style after the original Xinglongzhuang village was relocated. The district government calls it the largest and best-preserved group of stone-slab houses in Shandong, and it now has a blacksmith's shop, an old opera stage, a stone-house memory museum and an intangible-heritage museum. It suits a half-day among traditional rural architecture.
description: 翼云石头部落位于山东枣庄。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shancheng subdistrict, about 4 km east-north-east of the centre of Shanting District.

name: 岜山中医药健康旅游景区
summaryEn: A traditional Chinese medicine themed visitor area in Bashan village, Yucheng town, on the northern edge of Boshan, named as one of the first demonstration bases for TCM health tourism in Shandong. Provincial tourism material published in 2023 lists a TCM culture hall (with wax figures of famous physicians, a medicinal-diet hall and an ointment-culture hall), a ceramics-and-glass base with a masters' gallery, the Moon Lake park and a cultural and sports centre.
description: 岜山中医药健康旅游景区位于山东淄博。游览特色包括湖泊、陶瓷工艺、蜡像展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Bashan village, Yucheng town, Boshan District, about 5 km north-north-west of Boshan town centre and about 36 km south-south-west of central Zibo. Check that it is open before going.

name: 博山陶瓷琉璃艺术中心
summaryEn: An arts complex on Yanshan Park North Road in central Boshan, the district long known for its pottery and glass. It brings together a glass art museum, a ceramics museum, exhibition halls and a hands-on workshop area where visitors can try making pieces, plus an art hotel and a ceramics garden. It suits those who want to see Boshan's craft traditions indoors rather than at working kilns.
description: 博山陶瓷琉璃艺术中心位于山东淄博。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观、陶瓷工艺。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Yanshan Park North Road in central Boshan, about 1 km south-west of the town centre and about 40 km south-south-west of central Zibo.

name: 国井酒文化博览园
summaryEn: A visitor park built around the Guojing liquor distillery on the north-eastern edge of Gaoqing town. It takes in the old Bandaojing well site, an underground store of aged baijiu, a winery museum and a traditional brewing workshop, and visitors can see parts of the modern production line. It is aimed at those curious about how Chinese grain spirit is made.
description: 国井酒文化博览园位于山东淄博。游览特色包括博物馆、葡萄酒文化、酿造文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north-eastern edge of Gaoqing town, about 4 km from the centre and about 44 km north-north-west of central Zibo.

name: 红叶柿岩
summaryEn: A canyon park close to Boshan, with about 95 percent forest cover, a stone-built Ming–Qing village, a red-leaf forest that colours in autumn and a pool called Wucai Tan. Visitor additions include a suspended walkway, a glass-bottomed water slide about 2 km long, a lit 'time tunnel' and a replica of part of the Qi Great Wall. It is a leisure destination with modern attractions and is best known for its autumn colour.
description: 红叶柿岩位于山东淄博。游览特色包括峡谷、长城。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Heshangfang village, Yucheng town, about 4 km west of Boshan town centre and about 42 km south-south-west of central Zibo.

name: 开元溶洞
summaryEn: A karst cave in the hills of Yuanquan town, south-east of Boshan, named after Tang-dynasty Kaiyuan-era inscriptions cut into its rock. The main passage is about 745 m long and up to 30 m wide and high, with stalactites, stalagmites, flowstone curtains and other formations. It is promoted as one of the finest caves in Shandong.
description: 开元溶洞位于山东淄博。游览特色包括洞穴、喀斯特地貌、钟乳石。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Near Donggao village, Yuanquan town, Boshan District, about 19 km east-south-east of Boshan town centre and about 45 km south of central Zibo.

name: 马踏湖国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A wetland park of reed beds, canals and lotus ponds on a low plain in Qifeng town, north-eastern Huantai, with about 10 sq km of core wetland. Visitors get around by small boat; the park also has a wetland museum with a 5D cinema and a shrine to five sages, and the lake is known for its lotus in summer. Local festivals include a water-wedding and lantern festival on the 15th day of the seventh lunar month.
description: 马踏湖国家湿地公园位于山东淄博。游览特色包括博物馆、湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Qifeng town, about 13 km north of Huantai town and about 29 km north of central Zibo.

name: 齐山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area of about 36 sq km south of Taihe town, billed as themed on Qi culture, with a 7.5 km walking route past a waterfall, a cliff-top spot called Tangsanzhai, an old plank road and a cave called Qimen Cave. Its own account mentions traces of the Qi Great Wall and army camps, and later ties to the Ming rebel Tang Sai'er and to the Anti-Japanese War. Rafting, a slide and a children's play area have been added, and the highest point is about 868 m.
description: 齐山位于山东淄博。游览特色包括瀑布、长城。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 5 km south of Taihe town government, Zichuan District, about 25 km south-east of Zichuan town and about 36 km south-south-east of central Zibo.

name: 天鹅湖国际慢城
summaryEn: A leisure area of lakes, reed wetland and farmland beside the Yellow River in northern Gaoqing, admitted to the international Cittaslow ('slow city') network in 2019. Facilities include lakeside walkways, bird-watching platforms, a hot-spring district and themed attractions drawing on local legend and history. It is built mainly for weekend leisure and countryside stays rather than heritage.
description: 天鹅湖国际慢城位于山东淄博。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊、观鸟。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside the S309 road in northern Gaoqing, about 9 km north-east of Gaoqing town and about 48 km north-north-west of central Zibo.

name: 潭溪山
summaryEn: A mountain resort on the Zibo–Qingzhou border, in the Ezhuang area of Taihe town, with about nine sq km open to visitors, more than a hundred natural sights and a highest peak of 867 m. Local accounts link the hill to a Ming prince who studied in a cave and to the rebel Tang Sai'er, with an old command platform, a temple and ancient steles. The resort, which marked its 16th anniversary in 2026, also has a glass bridge, a glass-bottomed rafting course and a cliff swing.
description: 潭溪山位于山东淄博。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、玻璃栈道、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Ezhuang, Taihe town, Zichuan District, about 27 km south-east of Zichuan town and about 38 km south-south-east of central Zibo.

name: 原山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A hilly forest park of about 1,700 hectares on the south-western edge of Boshan, approved as a national forest park in 1992. Walking routes pass the Song-dynasty Yuhuang Palace, Ming and Qing temple buildings in the woods, a field of karst boulders known as the 'stone sea' and a stretch of the Warring States Qi Great Wall. It suits an easy half-day walk from Boshan town.
description: 原山国家森林公园位于山东省淄博市博山区城区西南部，1992年国家林业部批准建立，总规划面积1702公顷。主要景点有原山玉皇宫，原山碧霞元君祠，喀斯特地貌形成的石海，齐长城等。它是中华人民共和国的国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: On the south-western edge of Boshan town, about 3 km from the town centre and about 42 km south-south-west of central Zibo.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 淄博陶瓷琉璃博物馆
summaryEn: A large city museum in Zibo's cultural centre devoted to the ceramics and coloured glass (liuli) for which the city is known. Its five floors trace pottery from the Houli culture some 10,000 years ago to the Qing and Republican periods, glassware from the Western Zhou onwards, and modern work by master ceramicists and glass artists from China and abroad, with hands-on workshops. It makes a useful introduction to Zibo's craft traditions before visiting Boshan.
description: 淄博陶瓷琉璃博物馆位于山东淄博。游览特色包括博物馆、国家一级博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Zibo Cultural Centre in western Zhangdian, Zibo's main urban district, about 6 km west-north-west of central Zibo; closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 中华古板栗园
summaryEn: A forest park at the eastern foot of the Linlü Mountains, west of Sangyuan village in Huanghua town, laid out around a grove of old Chinese chestnut trees. The city government counts more than 3,000 old chestnut trees here, some 1,300 of them over 600 years old, set among hills and village scenery.
description: 中华古板栗园位于河南安阳。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Huanghua town on the western side of Linzhou, roughly 20 minutes by car from the city centre.

name: 道口古镇
summaryEn: An old canal town on the Wei River, the Hua County stretch of the Grand Canal, which grew up in the Sui and Tang era of grain shipping. Along the canal the Shunhe streets and Yimian Street run for about 3 km, lined with more than 1,000 rooms of old shops and houses, mostly two-storey hard-gable buildings with grey tile roofs, a large group of Ming and Qing northern townhouses. The town is also the home of Daokou braised chicken (shaoji).
description: 道口古镇位于河南安阳。游览特色包括古镇、运河。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the western edge of the Hua County seat, about 1–1.5 hours by road south of Anyang.

name: 汤河国家湿地公园
summaryEn: Anyang's first national wetland park, along the Tang River west of Tangyin, with open water, wetlands and riverside paths. It lies on the central route of birds migrating through China and in winter draws flocks of waterfowl such as spot-billed ducks, teals and falcated ducks.
description: 汤河国家湿地公园位于河南安阳。游览特色包括湿地、滨水景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: West of Tangyin county town, about half an hour by road south of Anyang.

name: 汤阴梦幻谷
summaryEn: An amusement park in Tangyin's Antang new town, between Tangyin and Anyang, built around modern rides. According to the city government it has nearly 30 large and medium rides, including a Ferris wheel, and more than 50 family attractions such as rainbow slides and a glass-floored bridge, so it suits families with children.
description: 汤阴梦幻谷位于河南安阳。游览特色包括主题游乐、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Kunzhen Avenue in the Antang new town, about 20–30 minutes by car south of central Anyang.

name: 翔宇工业旅游景区
summaryEn: A factory tour at the Anyang Rehabilitation Science City, run by a maker of rehabilitation and physiotherapy equipment and rated 4A in December 2025. Visitors ride sightseeing carts through the production halls, where welding robots and laser cutters turn out some 600 kinds of rehabilitation products, and visit a rehabilitation medicine museum of nearly 6,000 m², a children's rehabilitation experience centre, a museum on mugwort and a traditional Chinese medicine wellness centre. It suits visitors interested in industry and health care rather than sightseeing.
description: 翔宇工业旅游景区位于河南安阳。游览特色包括博物馆、工业参观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the edge of Neihuang county town, about an hour by road east of Anyang.

name: 阿斗寨
summaryEn: A cypress-covered hill where, according to local legend, Liu Shan (A Dou), the last ruler of Shu Han and the man behind the saying 'too happy to think of Shu', was secretly held after his surrender to Wei. Remains of an old stockade wall, a grove of ancient cypresses, a tomb attributed to Liu Shan and the clear Jinxian River below make it a quiet walk, with flower gardens in the village at its foot.
description: 阿斗寨位于河南鹤壁。游览特色包括花卉观赏、园林景观、民间传说。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Hebiji town, on Wanbai Hill east of Shucun village, a little over 10 km north of the Heshan district seat, Hebi.

name: 朝阳山
summaryEn: A mountain area just west of Qi County town, best known for Chaoyang Temple, a 'hanging temple' built against the rock face, and an Eastern Wei cave carved with rows of small Buddha figures. Local tradition makes the mountain a winter retreat of the Shang king Di Xin and a place visited by Confucius, and a hill-climbing festival is held here every year.
description: 朝阳山位于河南鹤壁。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、洞穴、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 8 km north-west of Qi County town.

name: 大伾山
summaryEn: A small hill on the eastern edge of Xun County town whose Tianning Temple shelters the Great Stone Buddha, a colossal seated Maitreya carved from the cliff, begun by most accounts in the Northern Qi and finished in the early Tang, inside a pavilion rebuilt in 1445. The hill holds hundreds of carvings and inscriptions, among them Northern Wei stone beasts, a Tang inscription in praise of the hill, a poem by the Ming philosopher Wang Yangming and calligraphy by Wang Duo. The national listing also covers the Thousand Buddha Cave on Fuqiu Hill in the old town.
description: 大伾山位于河南鹤壁。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the eastern edge of Xun County town, about 1.5 km east of the Wenzhi Pavilion; Xun County is about 30 km south-east of Hebi's new district by road.

name: 古灵山
summaryEn: A Taihang mountain area north-west of Qi County promoted as a setting of the Investiture of the Gods legends and a centre of the cult of the goddess Nüwa, with a Nüwa Palace temple complex, rafting on Taigong Lake, a glass suspension bridge and a cable car towards a bronze-roofed summit shrine. A procession-style outdoor show on the Investiture of the Gods is staged daily with costumed characters around the grounds, and nearby Liangshuiquan village has been turned into guesthouses.
description: 古灵山位于河南鹤壁。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: About 10 km north-west of Qi County town by road.

name: 金山淇河文化旅游区
summaryEn: A riverside tourism area of about 14 km² on the Qi River in Jinshan subdistrict, Qibin district, combining the Qi River national wetland park, a Palaeogene volcanic-geology heritage park and the riverside village of Xugou, which has been developed for rural tourism with a riverbank camping ground and restaurants. It is a place for riverside walks rather than major sights, and stages costumed Book of Songs parades on holidays.
description: 金山淇河文化旅游区位于河南鹤壁。游览特色包括湿地、田园观光、滨水景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jinshan subdistrict on the Qi River, about 10 km north-west of central Qibin, Hebi's new urban district.

name: 石林会议旧址
summaryEn: The village where, in June 1947, Liu Bocheng and Deng Xiaoping held a military conference at Falong Temple while the headquarters of their Shanxi–Hebei–Shandong–Henan Field Army stayed here for 12 days during the Civil War. The temple, the courtyard used as army headquarters, the commanders' quarters and an ancient cypress have been restored with exhibitions, and in 2022 the site became Hebi's first red-tourism 4A scenic area.
description: 石林会议旧址位于河南鹤壁。游览特色包括石林、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shilin town, Shancheng district, about 25 km north of Hebi's new district by road.

name: 五岩山
summaryEn: A Taihang foothill in Jijiashan township, Heshan district, named for its five valleys and five rocky peaks, which tradition makes the retreat of Sun Simiao, the Tang physician revered as the King of Medicine. Paths link spots associated with him, among them his hermitage, an alchemy site, a library pavilion, a herb store, a stone mortar and an apricot grove, making it a destination for those interested in traditional Chinese medicine as much as for walkers.
description: 五岩山位于河南鹤壁。游览特色包括楼阁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jijiashan township in the hills of Heshan district, roughly 30 km north-west of Hebi's new district by road.

name: 朝歌文化园
summaryEn: A Shang-themed cultural park on the Qi River, inspired by the Lutai site that local tradition links with the Deer Terrace where Di Xin, the last Shang king, hoarded his treasure and burned himself to death. Its centrepiece is a modern five-storey Lutai Pavilion, 38 metres high, built in Shang high-terrace style, in a park of about 25 hectares with riverside paths, a small tourist train and boat rides. It is a park for strolling rather than an archaeological display.
description: 朝歌文化园位于河南鹤壁。游览特色包括滨水景观、乘船游览、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Juqiao town on the Qi River, about 8 km south of Hebi's new district by road.

name: 大沙河生态公园
summaryEn: A long riverside park along the Dasha River as it runs through urban Jiaozuo, with a wide water surface that draws egrets and other wild birds, waterside paths and lawns. On the south bank, the Taihang bonsai garden, opened in 2023, is laid out as a Chinese-style garden of rockeries, a lake, pavilions and covered walkways. It suits an easy stroll rather than a full day out.
description: 大沙河生态公园位于河南焦作。游览特色包括湖泊、滨水景观、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the urban area of Jiaozuo; reached by taxi or city bus.

name: 焦作市森林动物园
summaryEn: A zoo laid out in woodland in Jiefang district, Jiaozuo, with more than 100 species, including Siberian tigers, red pandas and meerkats. Children can feed some tame animals, and staged animal shows are held; it suits families with young children.
description: 焦作市森林动物园位于河南焦作。游览特色包括动物观赏、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jiefang district, Jiaozuo; reached by taxi or city bus.

name: 老家莫沟
summaryEn: Mogou, a village in Xiguo town ringed by gullies on three sides, which since 2015 has been renovated in place for rural tourism under the name 'Laojia Mogou' ('Old Home Mogou'). Restored cave dwellings, many now guesthouses, line the Wenshui stream, and attractions added since 2019 include a glass footbridge and a sightseeing train round the village. It suits a relaxed rural day out with local snacks.
description: 老家莫沟位于河南焦作。游览特色包括田园观光、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xiguo town on the western side of Mengzhou, about 1½ hours by road south-west of central Jiaozuo.

name: 蜜雪集团·大咖国际茶饮梦工厂
summaryEn: An industrial-tourism site at the central factory of Daka International, which supplies the Mixue Bingcheng chain of freshly made drinks, in Wen County. Visitors see exhibits on the history of milk tea and canned food, holographic and Hainan-themed halls and a fruit-cutting game, and can make their own drinks; it opened to visitors in early 2023 and is popular with school study tours. A 3 km 'sweet avenue' links it with Chenjiagou, the birthplace of taijiquan.
description: 园区围绕大咖国际的中央工厂设置，参观者可以了解连锁茶饮背后的生产与供应环节。
accessEn: About 3 km south of Chenjiagou in Wen County, roughly 45 minutes by road south of central Jiaozuo.

name: 南水北调天河公园
summaryEn: A park running for about 10 km along both banks of the South–North Water Diversion central-route canal where it crosses urban Jiaozuo. Along it are the South–North Water Diversion branch of the National Gazetteer Museum, opened in 2021, which displays project records and machinery such as a tunnel-boring machine, as well as Jiaozuo's Fire God Temple and the Enzhou Post Station street. It suits a walk or bike ride and a close look at one of China's largest water-transfer schemes.
description: 南水北调天河公园位于中华人民共和国河南省焦作市解放区，是一个公园。该公园位于南水北调中线工程总干渠焦作城区两岸，长约10公里。内有国家方志馆南水北调分馆、焦作市火神庙、西王褚村遗址，恩州驿、南水北调第一楼等建筑和设施。
accessEn: Along the canal through the centre of Jiaozuo; easily reached by taxi or city bus.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 西大井1919
summaryEn: A culture and leisure park on the site of the Wangfeng coal mine, known locally as Xidajing ('West Big Shaft'), which the British-owned Pekin Syndicate began building in 1919. The English-built pithead frame still stands beside a square on the site of the 1925 coal miners' strike, close to the former office of the Jiaozuo mining district people's committee, with a themed street and a mine archive hall nearby. It doubles as a red-education base, with exhibitions and short dramas on the history of the Jiaozuo coal miners.
description: 西大井1919位于河南焦作。游览特色包括公园休闲。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Wangfeng subdistrict, Zhongzhan district, about 20 minutes by road north-west of central Jiaozuo.

name: 圆融寺
summaryEn: An active Buddhist temple in the foothills of the Taihang Mountains at Dangyangyu village, Xiuwu County, just north of Jiaozuo. It is run as a scenic area rather than as a listed monument, and it lies about 1 km from the Dangyangyu kiln site, so the two can be visited together.
description: 圆融寺位于河南焦作。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、佛教文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Dangyangyu village at the foot of the Taihang hills, about 15 minutes by taxi north of central Jiaozuo; the Dangyangyu kiln site is about 1 km away.

name: 小沟背·银河峡
summaryEn: A forested valley at Shaoyuan in the far west of Jiyuan, known for volcanic-rock scenery: a streambed full of multicoloured boulders, a long ridge said to look like a giant turtle and a cliff of pale rock shapes nicknamed 'baby cliff'. Local legend makes it the place where the goddess Nüwa melted coloured stones to mend the sky, and walkways follow the stream past pools and falls; the scenic area runs a water-splashing festival in summer and an ice-fall festival in winter.
description: 小沟背·银河峡位于河南济源。游览特色包括山谷、林地风光、民间传说。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Near Shaoyuan, about 1.5 hours by road west of Jiyuan city.

name: 黄河三峡
summaryEn: A stretch of the Yellow River at Xiaye in south-western Jiyuan, where the reservoir upstream of the Xiaolangdi Dam fills three gorges, Gushan, Longfeng and Bali, between steep peaks. Boat trips run through the gorges, a cableway climbs to the Xuantian karst cave and Taohua Island gives views over the water, and a 6 km rafting run operates in summer.
description: 黄河三峡位于河南济源。游览特色包括峡谷、洞穴、水库。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Xiaye town, about 50 km (an hour or more by road) south-west of Jiyuan city.

name: 爱思嘉农业嘉年华
summaryEn: An agri-tourism park in the countryside south-west of Kaifeng, built around six themed exhibition halls on modern farming. Outdoors it has a children's farm, flower fields and play areas, including an adventure playground without powered rides. It suits families with young children.
description: 爱思嘉农业嘉年华位于河南开封。游览特色包括田园观光、花卉观赏、农业体验。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xijiangzhai township, Xiangfu District, about 20 km south-west of central Kaifeng and a few kilometres from Zhuxian; best reached by taxi or car. Check that it is open before going.

name: 启封故园
summaryEn: A modern scenic area in old-town style at Zhuxian, one of the four great trading towns of Qing China, with a lake, bridges, a gate tower, a teahouse and shops built in traditional style. It is a place for a stroll and for Zhuxian's woodblock New Year prints, a national intangible-heritage craft. The historic Yue Fei Temple and Zhuxian Mosque are nearby in the town.
description: 启封故园位于河南开封。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the northern edge of Zhuxian town, about 20 km south-west of central Kaifeng, around 40 minutes by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 天波杨府
summaryEn: A Song-style complex built in the 1990s beside the lakes of the Dragon Pavilion area, recreating the mansion of the Yang family generals, whose wars against the Liao are retold in the popular Generals of the Yang Family stories. It has a mock government office with a tower and halls of sculpted scenes from the stories, a family temple, a garden and a drill ground used for costumed shows. It suits visitors who know the Yang family tales from opera or television.
description: 天波杨府位于河南开封。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Just west of Dragon Pavilion Park in the north of Kaifeng's old city, a short walk from the Dragon Pavilion. Check that it is open before going.

name: 万岁山武侠城
summaryEn: A martial-arts-themed park on the northern edge of Kaifeng's old city, run as a scenic area since 2003 and renamed Wansui Mountain Wuxia City in December 2023. Costumed performers stage shows across its old-style streets and arenas throughout the day, and one street skit, a matchmaking scene starring the character Wang Po, went viral on Douyin in 2024 and made the park famous across China. It suits families and anyone after lively entertainment rather than history.
description: 万岁山武侠城位于中华人民共和国河南省开封市龙亭区东京大道中段，是一个主题公园。
accessEn: About 1.5 km north of the Dragon Pavilion on Dongjing Avenue, a short taxi ride from central Kaifeng.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 黄河湾风景区
summaryEn: A riverside scenic area at Dongbatou, where the Yellow River makes the last great bend of its course before turning north-east to the sea, and where in 1855 it burst its dyke and abandoned its old course to the south. Laid out along the levees and the Dongbatou river-training works, it has riverside walking paths, a tourist train on the old Lankao–Dongbatou railway line, an exhibition hall, a camper-van site and wetland where water birds gather. A memorial pavilion marks Mao Zedong's inspections of the river here in the 1950s, and the area is linked with Jiao Yulu's campaign against the county's drifting sand.
description: 黄河湾风景区位于河南开封。游览特色包括湿地、滨水景观、主题展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Dongbatou, about 12 km north of Lankao town, around 20 minutes by taxi.

name: 贾湖酒文化园
summaryEn: The baijiu distillery and visitor park of the Jiahu liquor company in Wuyang county town, named after the Neolithic Jiahu site in the same county, where residues of one of the earliest known fermented drinks were found.
