Among Huizhou-style buildings, visitors see traditional and mechanised distilling workshops, cellar pits and workshops listed as provincial industrial heritage in 2023, rows of old wooden storage vats, a temperature-controlled cellar and an old well called Wuquan.
description: 贾湖酒文化园位于河南漯河。游览特色包括工业遗产、酿造文化、休闲公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Renmin East Road in Wuyang county town, about 40 km south-west of central Luohe.

name: 神州鸟园
summaryEn: A bird-themed park in Yuanhui district on the south side of Luohe, developed from the former Kaiyuan Forest Park and once called the Golden Phoenix Bird Culture Park. It suits families looking for an easy outing in the city.
description: 神州鸟园位于河南漯河。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yuanhui district, a short taxi ride south of central Luohe. Check that it is open before going.

name: 抱犊寨
summaryEn: An old fortified mountain village (zhai) at Dahong in Sanchuan town, western Luanchuan, run as a scenic area around the stockade and its old village houses. In 2026 the county was repairing the old village and its infrastructure and building a Party clean-government education base there.
description: 抱犊寨位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括村寨、传统村落。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Sanchuan, western Luanchuan County, about an hour by road from Luanchuan county town.

name: 重渡沟
summaryEn: A mountain valley in north-eastern Luanchuan, in the core area of the Funiu Mountain Global Geopark, known for its springs and waterfalls and its extensive bamboo groves. The valley villages have turned to tourism: the wider Chongdugou zone has more than 500 boutique guesthouses and farm inns, evening markets and shows, and it was named a provincial night-economy cluster in 2026.
description: 重渡沟位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括瀑布、地质景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In north-eastern Luanchuan County, reached from the Chongdugou exit of the Luoyang–Luanchuan Expressway, about 2 hours by road from Luoyang.

name: 大河荟
summaryEn: A cultural leisure complex in Luolong District that opened in autumn 2023, built around immersive digital entertainment. Its centrepiece is the walk-through multimedia show Tracing the Ode to the Luo River Goddess, alongside a digital museum, shops, a Sui–Tang themed designer hotel and a cluster of role-play mystery game venues; it suits younger visitors and an evening out.
description: 大河荟位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Just west of Luoyang Longmen high-speed railway station in Luolong District, a short walk or taxi ride from the station.

name: 恐龙谷漂流
summaryEn: A commercial river-rafting attraction on a mountain stream at Chunshu village in Jincun township, in the hills of southern Ruyang County. Rafting on the stream is the main activity, and the scenic area was operating in 2026.
description: 恐龙谷漂流位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jincun, southern Ruyang County, south of Luoyang; best reached by car.

name: 伏牛山滑雪度假乐园
summaryEn: A mountain ski resort at Yangshuping village in the Funiu range west of Luanchuan, shortlisted in 2023 as a national-level ski tourism resort, the only one in Henan. Besides outdoor winter pistes served by lifts it has year-round indoor skiing, night skiing in season, camping and family activities.
description: 伏牛山滑雪度假乐园位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括滑雪。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Shimiao, about 15 km west of Luanchuan county town, which is roughly 2½ hours by expressway from Luoyang.

name: 豪泽国际郁金香花海欢乐城
summaryEn: A flower park in Yibin District, south-east of central Luoyang, planted with tulip fields that flower in spring, with fairground rides and children's play areas. It suits a family outing in tulip season.
description: 豪泽国际郁金香花海欢乐城位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括花卉观赏。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yibin District, about 25 km south-east of central Luoyang by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 龙凤山古镇
summaryEn: A large leisure town in Song-dynasty style built on former gullies and slopes north-west of Yichuan county town, with new walls open for walking, lanes, courtyards, food stalls, shops and guesthouses. It is busiest in the evening, when the buildings are lit up, and also runs a study camp on the Neo-Confucianism of the Cheng brothers, whose tombs are nearby.
description: 龙凤山古镇位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括古镇。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the north-western edge of Yichuan county town, about 30 km south of Luoyang by road.

name: 凤翔温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort on the southern edge of Luoyang, near the Longmen Grottoes, with thermal pools and an on-site hotel. It suits a relaxed half day after sightseeing at Longmen.
description: 凤翔温泉位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括石窟造像、温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the southern outskirts of Luoyang at the south end of Wangcheng Avenue, best reached by taxi.

name: 龙峪湾
summaryEn: A national forest park in the Funiu Mountains of Luanchuan County, which the city government describes as a core ecological scenic area of the range. Wooded valleys and streams lie below high ridges, among them Jijiaojian, at about 2,210 m the highest point in Luanchuan County.
description: 龙峪湾位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Miaozi town, Luanchuan County, about two and a half hours by expressway south-west of Luoyang; the park has been closed for rebuilding since the heavy rains of 30 June–1 July 2025, and the city has said it will reopen it by the end of 2026, so check before going.

name: 栾川蕙兰文化产业园
summaryEn: A park in Heyu town devoted to the huilan orchid (Cymbidium faberi), which opened in April 2023 with the first Luanchuan Huilan festival and which the city describes as the largest orchid park of its kind in northern China. It combines orchid nurseries and research with display halls, an orchid market, study programmes and leisure areas, and suits visitors interested in Chinese orchids.
description: 栾川蕙兰文化产业园位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Heyu town, eastern Luanchuan County, about two hours by road south of Luoyang.

name: 竹海野生动物园
summaryEn: A wildlife park in the Chongdugou valley area of north-eastern Luanchuan, best known for its Siberian tigers: more than 200 live here, and in 2026 an agriculture-ministry laboratory named it a Siberian tiger breeding base. A primeval-forest section with a hill-climbing trail opened in 2023, and a cableway serves the park.
description: 竹海野生动物园位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括动物观赏、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Next to the Chongdugou resort area in north-eastern Luanchuan, off the Luoyang–Luanchuan Expressway, about 2 hours by road from Luoyang.

name: 薰衣草庄园
summaryEn: A lavender-themed flower farm in Yibin District near the Longmen Grottoes, begun in 2013 as an agri-tourism project on the Yi River ecological corridor. It suits a short family visit when the lavender is in flower.
description: 薰衣草庄园位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括石窟造像、田园观光、庄园。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Xima in Yibin District, about 5 km east of Luoyang Longmen railway station. Check that it is open before going.

name: 洛邑古城
summaryEn: A tourist quarter in the east of Luoyang's old city, largely built in recent years in traditional style around surviving monuments: the Wenfeng Pagoda, a stretch of the Jin–Yuan city wall, the Xintan pond and the Henan Prefecture Confucian Temple. It is best known for Hanfu costume hire and photography, and has craft workshops, guesthouses, food stalls, evening lights and costumed street events at festivals.
description: 洛邑古城位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括古城、寺庙建筑、古塔。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Laocheng District, a short walk from Luoyigucheng station on Luoyang Metro Line 1.

name: 木札岭
summaryEn: A forested mountain area at Checun in south-eastern Song County, on the northern side of the Funiu range and within the Funiu Mountain nature reserve. One of its sights is Guanmao ('Official's Hat') Peak, and a small ski field lies just to the west of the scenic area.
description: 木札岭位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括自然保护区、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Near the Muzhaling exit of the Zhengzhou–Luanchuan Expressway in Checun, south-eastern Song County, about 3 hours by road from Luoyang.

name: 牡丹阁
summaryEn: A large pavilion-style building at the southern end of Luoyang's modern city axis, opened on trial during the 2022 peony festival, which houses the Luoyang Peony Museum, showing the history of peony growing, peony varieties, peony-themed relics and the modern peony industry with documents, objects, film and live plants. The outdoor garden around it is planted with named peony varieties, including several plants about a century old, and a roving costumed show is staged inside during the April peony festival.
description: 牡丹阁位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Near Luoyang Longmen high-speed railway station in Luolong District, a short taxi ride from the station.

name: 七彩童话动物王国
summaryEn: A zoo and amusement park in Lianzhuang town, Yiyang County, combining animal and plant collections with funfair rides, pick-your-own farm areas and school study programmes. It reopened in January 2025 after an upgrade that added a tiger free-roaming area, a hippo house and a large circus arena, with staged sea-lion and parrot shows; it suits families with children.
description: 七彩童话动物王国位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括动物观赏、主题游乐、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Lianzhuang town, Yiyang County, about 50 km south-west of central Luoyang by road.

name: 青要山
summaryEn: A mountain area in north-western Xin'an County, linked in legend with the Yellow Emperor. Its Lianzhu and Shuanglong gorges hold strings of pools and waterfalls, reached in places by boardwalks and suspension bridges; Shuanglong Gorge is cut into purple-red quartz sandstone, and a restored Ming-dynasty Shuanglong (Twin Dragon) Temple stands by the Black and White Dragon pools. The streams are a protected habitat for the Chinese giant salamander.
description: 青要山位于河南省洛阳市新安县西北，东距洛阳66公里。
accessEn: In Qingyaoshan town, north-western Xin'an County, about 70 km from Luoyang by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 隋唐城遗址植物园
summaryEn: A botanical garden and peony park laid out over part of the Sui–Tang city site south of the Luo River. In April, during the Peony Festival, its peony gardens are the setting for Tang-costume parades, lion dances and fire performances, and later-flowering varieties extend the season.
description: 隋唐城遗址植物园位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括植物园、园林景观、节庆文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Luolong District south of the Wangcheng Bridge, a short taxi ride from central Luoyang.

name: 天河大峡谷
summaryEn: A mountain canyon scenic area at Jiaohe in western Luanchuan, with a cableway up to Wusheng Peak. In March the cornelian cherries grown around Jiaohe for traditional medicine come into flower, and the scenic area has held a blossom festival at that time.
description: 天河大峡谷位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括峡谷、节庆文化、赏花。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jiaohe, western Luanchuan County, roughly 30 km west of the county town, which is about 2½ hours by expressway from Luoyang.

name: 王府竹海
summaryEn: A valley at Wangfugou in northern Luanchuan with large bamboo groves, rare this far north in China, along with waterfalls and springs. It was named in a 2024 national list of summer-retreat destinations compiled with weather services, and again in the National Climate Center's 2026 summer-climate map.
description: 王府竹海位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shizimiao, northern Luanchuan County, roughly 2 hours by road from Luoyang.

name: 魏坡·新序
summaryEn: A leisure and shopping quarter opened in 2024 in and around the old village of Weipo at Chaoyang, Mengjin, where grey-brick lanes and courtyards have been fitted out with cafés, shops, restaurants, a courtyard hotel and event spaces. It is a modern commercial district in an old-village setting rather than a historic site, suited to an afternoon or evening stroll.
description: 魏坡·新序位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括传统村落。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Chaoyang, Mengjin District, about 15 km north of central Luoyang by road.

name: 西泰山
summaryEn: A forested mountain scenic area at Fudian in southern Ruyang County, with Lovers' Valley and the Shengshui Lake. It is best known for its rhododendrons, celebrated each spring with a rhododendron festival that reached its 21st edition in 2023.
description: 西泰山位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括湖泊、山谷、山地游览。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Fudian, southern Ruyang County, about 2½ hours by road south of Luoyang.

name: 养子沟
summaryEn: A wooded valley on the slopes a few kilometres east of Mount Laojun, south-east of Luanchuan town. It is known for its damp, cool air and dense vegetation, and in 2026 the National Climate Center listed it among the country's forest summer retreats.
description: 养子沟位于河南洛阳。游览特色包括山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Luanchuan township, a short drive south-east of Luanchuan county town, which is roughly 2½ hours by expressway from Luoyang.

name: 白河滩公园
summaryEn: A riverside park stretching for nearly 10 km along the Bai River at Xinye, landscaped over some 8 km² with footpaths, waterside platforms and themed gardens of tulips, peach, cherry and roses. It holds seasonal flower shows and works Three Kingdoms themes into its landscaping, and was raised from 3A to 4A in 2025.
description: 白河滩公园位于河南南阳。游览特色包括滨水景观、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Along the Bai River beside Xinye town, about an hour by road south of Nanyang.

name: 宝天曼峡谷漂流
summaryEn: A whitewater rafting trip on the Tuan River through the gorges on the southern side of the Baotianman nature reserve in the Funiu Mountains. The run drops about 239 m and takes around three and a half hours past rapids, bends, pools and rocks standing in the riverbed; it suits active visitors rather than a quiet sightseeing day.
description: 宝天曼峡谷漂流位于河南南阳。游览特色包括峡谷、自然保护区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the mountains of northern Neixiang County, about 60 km (roughly 1.5 hours by road) from Neixiang town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 南召宝天曼
summaryEn: The Nanzhao County side of the Baotianman forests, near Qiaoduan in the Funiu Mountains, where the nature reserve's main peak reaches about 1,830 m. Sights include Baotian Cave, a limestone cave with stalactites, and Baotian Gorge, where a walkway of about 4.5 km follows a chain of pools and waterfalls through the forest.
description: 南召宝天曼位于河南南阳。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、洞穴。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Near Qiaoduan in western Nanzhao County, about two hours by road north-west of Nanyang. Check that it is open before going.

name: 德云山风情植物园
summaryEn: A commercial flower park laid out since 2015 on the hills at Erlangmiao, south-east of Fangcheng town, below a wind farm. Large plantings of tree peonies and cherry trees bloom in spring, and the site also has a hillside wildlife park and a children's amusement area.
description: 德云山风情植物园位于河南南阳。游览特色包括植物园、花卉观赏、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Erlangmiao, about 13 km from Fangcheng town and roughly 1.5 hours by road from Nanyang.

name: 中原二龙山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in the north of Neixiang County, inside the Funiu Mountain Global Geopark, named for a ridge of ten linked peaks said to look like two dragons playing with a pearl. The area rises to about 1,380 m and is promoted for its scenery and as a place of pilgrimage and meditation, with Han, Confucian, Buddhist and Taoist cultural themes.
description: 中原二龙山位于河南南阳。游览特色包括地质景观、山地游览、佛教文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Ranghe village in Banchang Township, roughly 1–1.5 hours by road north-west of Neixiang town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 鹳河漂流
summaryEn: A whitewater rafting run of about 12 km on the upper Laoguan (Guan) River in the mountains of Xixia County, through some eighteen rapids. It was among the first commercial rafting trips developed in central China and suits active visitors.
description: 鹳河漂流位于河南南阳。游览特色包括水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the upper Laoguan River about 42 km from Xixia town, roughly an hour by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 龙潭沟
summaryEn: A narrow gorge in the mountains north of Xixia town where a stream drops through a chain of about nineteen waterfalls and deep pools, the highest fall about 35 m. The walk up the valley passes cliffs and huge boulders in thick forest, making it a good half-day outing.
description: 龙潭沟位于河南南阳。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 40 km north of Xixia town off national road G311, roughly an hour by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 七峰山
summaryEn: The eastern end of the Funiu Mountains in northern Fangcheng County, a ridge of seven peaks topping out at 768 m with cliffs, caves, ravines and forest. Remains of the Chu Great Wall, the chain of defences the state of Chu built around the Nanyang Basin from the Spring and Autumn period, run along the ridge, which is why the area is promoted as home of the 'oldest Great Wall'. Walking trails, including one past stretches of the wall, make it a day out from Nanyang.
description: 七峰山位于河南南阳。游览特色包括长城、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 15 km north of Fangcheng town, roughly 1.5 hours by road north-east of Nanyang.

name: 七十二潭
summaryEn: A river valley in the hills north of Fangcheng where the stream runs over broad sheets of bare rock, forming a long chain of pools and small falls that visitors can wade through. The scenic area adds commercial attractions such as a glass bridge, a glass slide and other rides, so it suits families looking for water play rather than a quiet walk.
description: 七十二潭位于河南南阳。游览特色包括玻璃栈道、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: North of Fangcheng town beside provincial road S239, about 18 km from the Fangcheng exit of the Xuchang–Pingdingshan–Nanyang expressway.

name: 寺山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forested hill park across the Guan River from Xixia town, covering about 7.5 km² of woodland, pools and viewpoints. Paths lead to Matou Hill, the Heilong Pool, the ruins of an academy linked with the Jin-dynasty poet Yuan Haowen and the rebuilt Randeng Temple, a modern group of Buddhist halls with a large nine-dragon screen wall.
description: 寺山国家森林公园位于河南南阳。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Just west of Xixia town across the Guan River, about 2 km from Xixia railway station. Check that it is open before going.

name: 桐柏山淮源
summaryEn: The forested country around the source of the Huai River in the Tongbai Mountains on the Henan–Hubei border, beginning just outside Tongbai town. Its four sections take in the Huai source, Taibai Peak (about 1,140 m, the highest point in southern Henan), Taohua Cave and the Shuilian (Water Curtain) Cave, a Taoist grotto-heaven; the Yuntai Chan Temple, ancestral temple of the Baiyun branch of Chan Buddhism, is also in the area.
description: 桐柏山淮源位于河南南阳。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、林地风光、洞穴。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: The area begins about 3 km from Tongbai town, which is roughly 1.5 hours by expressway south-east of Nanyang.

name: 桐柏革命纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial hall in Tongbai founded in 1984 to commemorate those who died in and around the county during the Long March period, the War of Resistance against Japan and the civil war. The county saw heavy fighting, including the Red 25th Army's breakout from an encirclement at Xiemaling in November 1934 during the Long March.
description: 桐柏革命纪念馆位于河南南阳。游览特色包括纪念展览、历史纪念。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tongbai town, about 1.5 hours by expressway south-east of Nanyang.

name: 云露山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area of bamboo groves, forest and waterfalls at Mashankou in eastern Neixiang County, part of the Funiu Mountain Global Geopark. The developed sections follow the Yunlu River, with places to paddle, and climb to the Yaowang and Baota waterfalls; old stone walls on the ridges are attributed to the Chu Great Wall.
description: 云露山位于河南南阳。游览特色包括瀑布、长城、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Shimiao village near Mashankou, about an hour by road north-west of Nanyang. Check that it is open before going.

name: 镇平国际玉城
summaryEn: A large jade-trading complex of shops and workshops at Shifosi, the town at the heart of Zhenping County's jade-carving industry, built with private investment in the 2010s. Visitors can browse carved jade and see carving and processing at work, and the town's older jade markets, such as Yudiaowan, are close by.
description: 石佛寺镇是镇平玉雕产业中心，玉城集中展示玉石交易、作坊和玉雕作品。
accessEn: At Shifosi, just west of Zhenping town and about 45 minutes by road west of Nanyang.

name: 白龟湖湿地公园
summaryEn: A wetland park on the north shore of Baiguishan Reservoir, a lake built in 1958–66 on the south-western edge of Pingdingshan, designated a national urban wetland park in 2009. Boardwalks, lawns and squares run along the shore, making it a place for lakeside walks next to the city museum.
description: 白龟湖湿地公园位于河南平顶山。游览特色包括博物馆、湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the lakeshore in Pingdingshan's new district, beside Pingdingshan Museum and about 12 km west of the old city centre.

name: 灯台架
summaryEn: A hill area in southern Wugang named after its 808 m main peak, said to resemble an old lamp stand. Trails and a cliff-side walkway of about 2 km lead past pools and waterfalls such as the Tianchi plunge pool, and through gorges in layered sandstone, conglomerate and shale that preserve fossil mud cracks and other traces of ancient climates; a glass bridge and a water slide are extras.
description: 灯台架位于河南平顶山。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Changlingtou village, Yangzhuang township, in the south of Wugang, reached by local bus or car from Wugang city.

name: 墨子文化旅游区
summaryEn: A themed visitor area opened in 2016 at the foot of Mount Yao, built around the Warring States philosopher Mozi, whom Lushan claims as a native. Its core is a new street built in old-street style with food stalls, shops, craft workshops and an inn, served by a narrow-gauge sightseeing train, and paths continue up a side valley to waterfalls, a glass bridge and a dry slide. It suits families who combine it with Mount Yao.
description: 墨子文化旅游区位于河南平顶山。游览特色包括瀑布、玻璃栈道、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jiadian village, Yaoshan town, near the Mount Yao scenic area and about 60 km west of Lushan County town by road.

name: 祥龙谷
summaryEn: A canyon scenic area in the hills of southern Wugang with waterfalls, cliffs, forest and a small lake, rising to Longwangzhuang (866 m), which the city's tourism bureau gives as the highest point in Wugang. Local legends tie spots along the trail to the Han emperor Guangwu (Liu Xiu), the Yang family generals and other figures.
description: 祥龙谷位于河南平顶山。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Zangping village, Yangzhuang township, in the far south of Wugang, reached by road from Wugang city via Yinji. Check that it is open before going.

name: 尧山大峡谷漂流
summaryEn: A commercial rafting run on a mountain river in the Mount Yao area, where visitors paddle inflatable boats down a winding channel with drops, rapids and calmer stretches. It is a summer outing for families and groups rather than a sight in itself.
description: 尧山大峡谷漂流位于河南平顶山。游览特色包括峡谷、水上活动。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yaoshan town on national road G311, about 60 km west of Lushan County town and on the way to the Mount Yao gate.

name: 姚庄旅游区
summaryEn: A rural tourism area covering six villages of Yaozhuang Hui Township in southern Jia County, where just over half of the roughly 10,000 residents are Hui Muslims. It mixes orchards, a tea garden and eco-farms offering fruit picking with small culture venues such as a hall devoted to Xinyi Liuhe boxing and an old well, and suits a half-day country outing.
description: 姚庄旅游区位于河南平顶山。游览特色包括田园观光、果园、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yaozhuang Hui Township on the Jia County–Baofeng border, about half an hour by road north of Pingdingshan.

name: 东北庄杂技文化园区
summaryEn: A park in Dongbeizhuang, a village whose acrobatic tradition the national intangible-heritage list dates to the late Yuan or early Ming dynasty, more than 500 years ago, with troupes of the Liu, Qiao and Li families. At its centre is the Central Plains Acrobatics Museum, described by state media as China's first stand-alone museum on acrobatics, with a 360-degree cinema. Traditional acrobatics are performed for visitors, especially at festivals, and the village puts on its own show at Spring Festival.
description: 东北庄杂技文化园区位于河南濮阳。游览特色包括博物馆、历史建筑、节庆文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Dongbeizhuang village in Yuecun town, about 17 km east of central Puyang.

name: 南乐文庙
summaryEn: The Confucian temple of Nanle County town on South Street, a provincially protected monument whose surviving Qing buildings are the main Dacheng Hall and the Chongsheng Shrine to Confucius's ancestors. It became a 4A scenic area in 2025 and hosts cultural events and summer activities for families.
description: 南乐文庙位于河南濮阳。游览特色包括寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: On South Street in Nanle County town, about 45 km by road north of Puyang city.

name: 濮上园
summaryEn: A large park and leisure resort around a lake on the west side of Puyang city, used for strolls, seasonal lantern fairs and family outings. In February 2026 a family area called Longqi Island opened on an island in the lake, with a sandy beach, water play, children's rides, camping and evening shows.
description: 濮上园位于河南濮阳。游览特色包括湖泊、海滨。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On West Huanghe Road in the west of Puyang city.

name: 濮水小镇
summaryEn: A recently built leisure quarter in Puyang County town with pavilions and towers in traditional style, food stalls, shops and evening entertainment. It is busiest at night and on holidays, with events such as a summer water-splashing festival, costume parades and sparks of molten iron thrown in the traditional da tiehua performance.
description: 濮水小镇位于河南濮阳。游览特色包括楼阁建筑、节庆文化。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: At the junction of Dishun Avenue and Puqu Road in Puyang County town, about 10 km south of Puyang city.

name: 甘山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park in the mountains about 20 km south of Sanmenxia, rising to Ganlu Peak at about 1,885 m, with forest walks, autumn red-leaf areas, a water play area and a butterfly valley. It also has an outdoor activity base, mountain-bike facilities and a ski centre for winter.
description: 甘山国家森林公园位于河南三门峡。游览特色包括森林公园、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km south of Sanmenxia, in Shanzhou District.

name: 汉山
summaryEn: A high, thickly wooded mountain in Guxian town, Lingbao, next to the Xiaoqinling nature reserve, whose Jinding summit rises to about 2,200 m. Old Buddhist and Taoist sites survive on the mountain, among them the Sanhuang and Sanguan caves and the Yuhuang Pavilion, along with rock formations tied to local legends. A passenger ropeway climbs the mountain.
description: 汉山位于河南三门峡。游览特色包括自然保护区、楼阁建筑、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: At Hexi village, Guxian town, in the mountains of Lingbao; allow about two hours by road from Sanmenxia.

name: 娘娘山
summaryEn: A granite mountain and national geopark about 13 km west-south-west of Lingbao, known for its 'stone waterfalls', dark streaks running down bare granite slabs that look like ink paintings. Paths lead past the Baichi Waterfall, a string of pools and a Niangniang temple towards the summit at 1,563 m.
description: 娘娘山位于河南三门峡。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑、地质景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: At Nanshang village, Jiaocun town, about 13 km west-south-west of Lingbao city.

name: 陕州地坑院
summaryEn: A village of sunken courtyard houses at Beiying, south of Sanmenxia, opened as a scenic area: square pits are dug into the loess and cave rooms cut into their walls, hiding the village below ground level, a building craft listed as national intangible heritage in 2011. Some courtyards are open as folk-culture displays, guesthouses and snack stalls.
description: 陕州地坑院位于河南三门峡。游览特色包括非遗文化、传统民居、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Beiying village, Zhangbian township, about 10 km south-west of central Sanmenxia by road.

name: 瓮城瀑布
summaryEn: A small valley in Shiziping township, Lushi County, with five waterfalls in succession, the highest being the 61 m Wengcheng Waterfall, which freezes in winter. Boardwalks follow the stream, and the area also has guesthouses, farm restaurants and children's play areas.
description: 瓮城瀑布位于河南三门峡。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Liushuwan village, Shiziping township, in the mountains of Lushi County; allow 2–3 hours by road from Sanmenxia.

name: 仰韶仙门山
summaryEn: A mountain valley scenic area in Duancun township, about 30 km from Mianchi town, developed by the Yangshao liquor company as part of its tourism estate; it held its opening ceremony and 4A plaque unveiling in April 2023. Walks lead through wooded valleys and flower fields to a lake, the company stores liquor in caves in the hillside, and there is a long drift-rafting run.
description: 仰韶仙门山位于河南三门峡。游览特色包括湖泊、山谷、花卉观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Duancun township, about 30 km from Mianchi town and 80 km east of Sanmenxia by road.

name: 仰韶酒庄
summaryEn: The factory tourism area of the Yangshao liquor group in Mianchi, built around its distillery with brewing workshops, a cellar of liquor stored in caves, a museum of world liquor history, company exhibition halls and a pedestrian culture street. It suits visitors interested in Chinese baijiu and how it is made.
description: 仰韶酒庄位于河南三门峡。游览特色包括博物馆、洞穴、主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Mianchi County, about 70 km east of Sanmenxia by road.

name: 燕子山
summaryEn: A national forest park in the hills of Chuankou township, Lingbao, with stands of pagoda trees and dawn redwoods, several reservoirs and a cluster of waterfalls. It has restaurants, lodging and walking trails and is run as a forest-wellness destination.
description: 燕子山位于河南三门峡。游览特色包括瀑布、森林公园、水库。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: East of Shendi village, Chuankou township, in Lingbao, roughly 1.5 hours by road from Sanmenxia; the scenic area announced a temporary closure on 11 July 2026 because of road works on its access road, so check that it has reopened before going.

name: 黄河丹峡
summaryEn: A scenic area on the south bank of the Yellow River in Potou township, north of Mianchi, where red-rock cliffs and gorges run down to the river above the Xiaolangdi reservoir. It is made up of several gorges with rock formations, streams and pools, and offers rafting.
description: 黄河丹峡位于河南三门峡。游览特色包括峡谷、水库。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Potou township, north of Mianchi town on the Yellow River, about 1.5 hours by road from Sanmenxia. Check that it is open before going.

name: 黄河公园
summaryEn: A riverside park about 5 km long on the terraces above the Yellow River along the northern edge of Sanmenxia, running from the Maojin ferry west to the Yellow River bridge. It keeps the natural banks, gullies and vegetation, with gardens, paths and viewpoints over the river flats, and suits an easy walk from the city.
description: 黄河公园位于河南三门峡。游览特色包括滨水景观、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Along Beihuan Road on the northern edge of central Sanmenxia.

name: 豫西百草园
summaryEn: A rural tourism park next to the Yuxi Grand Canyon that combines fields of Chinese medicinal herbs and flowers with fruit picking, a recreated western Henan village and local food. It makes an easy stop on a trip to the canyon.
description: 豫西百草园位于河南三门峡。游览特色包括峡谷、田园观光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Xinping village, Guandaokou town, beside the Yuxi Grand Canyon, about 1.5 hours by road south of Sanmenxia. Check that it is open before going.

name: 凤栖湖
summaryEn: A lakeside park in Sui county town created from 2018 on the site of a disused brickworks. It is best known for evening cultural events, such as the molten-iron 'fire flower' performances, drone shows and folk shows staged at Spring Festival.
description: 凤栖湖位于河南商丘。游览特色包括湖泊、节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the northern edge of Sui county town, about an hour by road west of Shangqiu.

name: 淮海战役陈官庄纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial park of about 13 ha at Chenguanzhuang, where the Chenguanzhuang encirclement battle of the Huaihai Campaign, in the Chinese Civil War of 1948–49, was fought. Founded in 1963 and enlarged in 1974 and 2007–2012, it has a 24.6 m monument, a memorial hall of about 9,000 m², an exhibition on the fallen, a cemetery with a crypt of remains and a 200 m wall of names, and stone reliefs and bronze statues of the campaign's commanders.
description: 淮海战役陈官庄纪念馆位于河南商丘。游览特色包括纪念展览、战役遗址。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Chenguanzhuang in the north-east of Yongcheng, about 40 minutes by road from Yongcheng city.

name: 龙港湾
summaryEn: A farm-tourism and study-tour park at Yinzhuang village, Taiping town, Xiayi County, whose rated scenic area covers about 55 ha of a 340 ha agricultural base. It has strawberries grown on raised racks in greenhouses, an aquaponics hall, a computer-controlled seedling factory, wetland flower fields and a fruit theme park, and also runs farming study courses for school groups.
description: 龙港湾位于河南商丘。游览特色包括湿地、主题游乐。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Taiping town, about 7 km east of Xiayi county town, roughly an hour by road east of Shangqiu.

name: 睢县北湖
summaryEn: A lake of about 3.3 km² on the north side of Sui county town, formed when the old walled city of Suizhou was drowned after the Yellow River dykes were breached in 1642. Islands that were the higher parts of the old city now hold gardens such as the Xiang Garden, where the county museum is housed, and the lake is used for canoeing training and triathlon races.
description: 睢县北湖位于河南商丘。游览特色包括博物馆、古城、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the northern edge of Sui county town, about an hour by road west of Shangqiu.

name: 日月湖
summaryEn: An artificial lake of about 1 km² in the business district of Shangqiu's new town, dug as part of the new district's water system to store Yellow River water for irrigation and as a landscaped park. It is an urban park rather than a natural lake, suited to an evening stroll.
description: 日月湖位于河南商丘。游览特色包括湖泊、灌溉工程、城市公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Shangqiu urban–rural integration demonstration zone, about 15 minutes by taxi east of the old city.

name: 永城日月湖
summaryEn: A large park created from 2009 on land that had subsided over coal workings between Yongcheng's old and new towns, planned to cover 24 km², about a quarter of it water. Lakes, wetlands, islands and gardens with pavilions, towers and bridges make up its 'twenty-four views', and it was named a national water-conservancy scenic area in 2014.
description: 永城日月湖位于河南商丘。游览特色包括湿地、园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Between the old and new parts of Yongcheng city, a short taxi ride from the centre; Yongcheng is about 1½–2 hours by road south-east of Shangqiu.

name: 伯玉君子文化旅游区
summaryEn: A rural tourism area in Boyu village on the edge of Changyuan, the home of Qu Boyu, a statesman of the Spring and Autumn state of Wey whom Confucius praised as a true gentleman. The village, put on Henan's first provincial list of place-name cultural heritage in 2025, is the ancestral seat of the Qu clan and has been developed around the theme of 'gentleman culture'; a clan ancestral ceremony and culture festival took place here in March 2026.
description: 伯玉君子文化旅游区位于河南新乡。游览特色包括田园观光、节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Boyu village, Menggang subdistrict, on the edge of Changyuan, about 70 km east of central Xinxiang by road.

name: 凤湖
summaryEn: A large landscaped lake in the centre of the new Pingyuan district, across the Yellow River from Zhengzhou, built as a reservoir for Yellow River water and opened as a park that was rated 4A in 2019. Paths circle the lake past a history and folk-culture section, lawns and plazas, cherry-tree walks, a wetland area with lotus and a wooded central island.
description: 凤湖位于河南新乡。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Pingyuan Demonstration Zone, about 35 km south of central Xinxiang and 30 km north of Zhengzhou by road.

name: 关山
summaryEn: A national geopark in the Taihang Mountains north-west of Huixian, named after the ancient Zixia pass on a route through the range. Its scenery comes from cliff collapse and fissuring: forests of rock pillars, a narrow 'one-thread-of-sky' cleft, natural rock bridges and sheer walls, together with waterfalls and pools along the Pangu stream and a cave system known as Baibao Cave.
description: 关山位于河南新乡。游览特色包括瀑布、地质景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Shangbali town, about 25 km north-west of Huixian and 40 km from central Xinxiang by road.

name: 轿顶山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in the Taihang range north of Huixian, rated 4A in 2015, with red cliffs and forested slopes reached by a mountain road that visitors may drive up. It is also a provincial-level holiday area and forest-wellness base, and is a popular spot for snow scenery in winter.
description: 轿顶山位于河南新乡。游览特色包括山地游览、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shayao township, about 40 km north of Huixian by road.

name: 京华园
summaryEn: A landscaped leisure park in Xiaoji town, Xinxiang County, run by a local company. The city's culture bureau counts it among the scenic areas that combine sightseeing with a theme park, and it has also been listed as a national agricultural-tourism demonstration site. It is a modern built attraction rather than a historic garden, and suits a short family outing from Xinxiang.
description: 京华园位于河南新乡。游览特色包括主题游乐、园林景观、公园休闲。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xiaoji town, Xinxiang County, about 15 km south-west of central Xinxiang by road.

name: 九多肉多酱卤文化园
summaryEn: A factory-tour attraction at the plant of Jiuduo Rouduo, a maker of soy-braised meats and side dishes in the industrial zone of Yuanyang County. A viewing corridor runs past the production workshops, and exhibition halls and a small garden present the company and the tradition of jianglu braised meat. It suits visitors curious about how Chinese packaged food is made.
description: 九多肉多酱卤文化园位于河南新乡。游览特色包括园林景观、主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the industrial cluster of Yuanyang County, about 30 km south of central Xinxiang by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 龙卧岩
summaryEn: A provincial-level forest park in the Taihang foothills of northern Weihui, around Longwoyan village, which has turned to village tourism. It is a wooded hill area for walks, and in winter it runs ice-and-snow play areas.
description: 龙卧岩位于河南新乡。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光、村落风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Longwoyan village, about 30 km north-west of Weihui town by road.

name: 跑马岭
summaryEn: A provincial-level geopark and forest park in the Taihang foothills of northern Weihui, named after the ridge of the same name. It is an area of wooded hills for walking and scenery, and at the Spring Festival it has staged Ming-themed costume performances.
description: 跑马岭位于河南新乡。游览特色包括地质景观、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills of northern Weihui, about 30 km north-west of Weihui town by road.

name: 安山森林公园
summaryEn: A provincial forest park on Anshan, a wooded hill in Quanhepu township in the east of Gushi County. A Daoist temple, Anshan Nainai Temple, stands near the summit.
description: 安山森林公园位于河南信阳。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Quanhepu township, about 25 km east-north-east of Gushi county town by road.

name: 城阳城址
summaryEn: The site of Chengyang, an Eastern Zhou walled town that was a military stronghold of the state of Chu, surrounded by Chu tombs. Parts of the city wall and the outline of its moat survive, and a tomb excavated here in 1957 yielded a set of bronze bells. The site museum, opened in 2014 inside the archaeological park, is devoted to Chu culture, with bronzes, pottery, lacquered wood and jade, and halls built over two excavated tomb chambers.
description: 城阳城址位于河南信阳。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Pingqiao district about 25 km north of central Xinyang, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 大别山露营公园
summaryEn: A campground park at the eastern edge of Xin County town, opened in 2017, where self-drive groups can stay overnight, with campfires in the evening. It suits travellers who want to stay out in the Dabie hills while visiting the county's old villages and revolutionary sites.
description: 大别山露营公园位于河南信阳。游览特色包括历史纪念、传统村落。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xin County, about an hour and a half by road south-east of Xinyang.

name: 丁李湾
summaryEn: A hamlet in Balifan town, Xin County, whose old houses were built by families with roots in southern Anhui and northern Jiangxi, in a Hui style of high horse-head gables, grey brick on stone bases, carved brick and stone gatehouses and narrow stone-paved lanes. Five tall gatehouses line the north bank of the village pond, one of them belonging to the house of a Qing prefect, and in 2012 it was named one of the first Chinese Traditional Villages.
description: 丁李湾位于河南信阳。游览特色包括传统村落。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shenliuqiao village, Balifan town, about 15 km north-east of Xin County town by road.

name: 许世友将军故里
summaryEn: The birthplace of Xu Shiyou (1906–1985), one of the founding generals of the People's Liberation Army, who as a boy trained at Shaolin Temple, in the hamlet of Xujiawa in Hepu village. The site takes in his family home, a memorial hall on his life and his grave: he asked to be buried beside his mother, and in 1985 Deng Xiaoping approved this exception to the rule that senior leaders be cremated.
description: 许世友将军故里位于河南信阳。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tianpu township near the Hubei border, about 40 minutes by road south of Xin County town.

name: 龟山湖
summaryEn: A lake park north of Luoshan county town, beside the Youdian township seat, laid out in recent years around a lake with surrounding woodland and walkways. The paths have been themed as an 'intellectual property park', with signboards and illustrations about patents, trademarks and intangible-heritage crafts, and the park makes an easy walk for anyone staying in Luoshan.
description: 龟山湖位于河南信阳。游览特色包括湖泊、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside the Youdian township seat, about 5 km north of central Luoshan, a short taxi ride away.

name: 何家冲
summaryEn: A village in Tiepu town, Luoshan County, where about 2,900 soldiers of the Red Army's 25th Army assembled by an old ginkgo tree on 16 November 1934 before setting out on their own Long March, which reached northern Shaanxi in September 1935. The He family ancestral hall, a Ming-dynasty building that served as the army's headquarters, is now a memorial hall with period furniture, oil lamps and army shoes on display.
description: 何家冲位于河南信阳。游览特色包括纪念展览、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Hejiachong village, Tiepu town, about an hour by road south-east of Xinyang.

name: 何家寨露营基地
summaryEn: A hillside campsite and tent-hotel resort among the tea gardens of Haojiachong village, Shihegang town, opened in 2022, with white tent lodges scattered over the slopes and a shuttle up to the hilltop. When it opened it also had a mirror-glass photo platform and a glass water slide through the woods, plus tea-themed study programmes for school groups.
description: 何家寨露营基地位于河南信阳。游览特色包括园林景观、村寨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Haojiachong village, Shihegang town, in the tea hills roughly 25 km south-west of central Xinyang by road.

name: 黄柏山
summaryEn: A national forest park of forested ridges and valleys in the Dabie Mountains at the southern tip of Shangcheng County, where Henan meets Hubei and Anhui. Fayan Temple, a Buddhist monastery, stands within the park.
description: 黄柏山位于河南信阳。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 60 km south of Shangcheng town, around an hour and a half by road.

name: 金刚台猫耳峰
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area on Jingangtai, the highest peak of the Dabie Mountains in Henan, within the Jingangtai National Geopark south-east of Shangcheng town. It takes its name from Maoer ('cat's ear') Peak and suits a day of hill walking on the Henan–Anhui border.
description: 金刚台猫耳峰位于河南信阳。游览特色包括地质景观、山地游览、高山景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: The geopark plaza at the foot of the mountain is roughly 11 km south-east of Shangcheng town.

name: 金刚台西河景区
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in the Jingangtai National Geopark in the Dabie Mountains of Shangcheng County, made up of a tea-terraced gorge, the Huatuo Valley, a lake ringed by a waterside boardwalk and a river gorge used for rafting. Reports from 2023 and 2024 list canyon trails, a glass suspension bridge, a treetop adventure course and ziplines, and the valley is one of the main sources of Shangcheng's high-mountain green tea.
description: 金刚台西河景区位于河南信阳。游览特色包括峡谷、地质景观、湖泊。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the Dabie Mountains south-east of Shangcheng town, about 30 km by road from the nearest exit of the G40 Shanghai–Xi'an expressway.

name: 金兰山
summaryEn: A national forest park in the wooded Dabie hills on the north-western edge of Xin County town. In 1932 the Red Army fought a blocking action along the line from Fushanzhai to Jinlan Mountain during the Nationalist encirclement campaigns against the base area.
description: 金兰山位于河南信阳。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the north-western edge of Xin County town, a short taxi ride from the centre.

name: 灵龙湖
summaryEn: A reservoir lake about 5 km long in the tea and bamboo hills of Dongshuanghe township, created in 1965 as the Longwangsi Reservoir, whose waters covered the site of the old Longwang Temple. The scenic area around it combines forest, tea gardens and an old ginkgo tree with lakeside platforms, boating and fishing, and its first phase, finished in 2016, added a folk-culture village and a food street.
description: 灵龙湖位于河南信阳。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the hills about 20 km south-south-east of central Xinyang, reached by car. Check that it is open before going.

name: 灵山
summaryEn: A granite mountain in Lingshan town, south-west Luoshan County, with forested slopes, streams and waterfalls, forming part of the Dongzhai national bird reserve. Its best-known sight is Lingshan Temple, said to date back to the Northern Wei, where monks and nuns share one temple and a large temple fair is held on the first day of the third lunar month.
description: 灵山位于河南信阳。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Lingshan town, roughly an hour by road south-east of central Xinyang.

name: 息县龙湖公园
summaryEn: A long lake park through the middle of Xi County town, created from a former reservoir, with willow-lined embankments, an island and boats on the lake. It was rated 3A until the province raised it to 4A in December 2025, and it makes an easy stroll for anyone staying in town.
description: 息县龙湖公园位于河南信阳。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xi County town, a short walk or taxi ride from the centre.

name: 濮公山矿山公园
summaryEn: A mine park on Pugong Hill, across the Huai River from Xi County town, where a former quarry has been landscaped and replanted around a lake among the hills. A natural history museum stands on the site, and the park makes a short outing from Xi County, an ancient county seat on the Huai.
description: 濮公山矿山公园位于河南信阳。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Across the Huai River, a short drive south of Xi County town.

name: 桃花寨
summaryEn: A forested valley about 8 km west of the Jigong Mountain scenic area, named after a local legend of a peach-blossom fairy and known for its streams, pools and waterfalls. Xinyang's official tourism account listed boat trips on its lake, a glass suspension bridge, slides, bungee jumping and jungle rafting among its activities in 2021, so it is aimed at families and groups looking for outdoor fun rather than sightseeing.
description: 桃花寨位于河南信阳。游览特色包括瀑布、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills about 36 km south of central Xinyang by road, west of Jigong Mountain. Check that it is open before going.

name: 文新茶村
summaryEn: A tea-themed tourist village in Shihegang town, in the hills south-west of Xinyang where Xinyang Maojian, one of China's best-known green teas, is grown. Visitors can pick leaves in the tea gardens and watch the tea being fired by hand, a craft listed as national intangible heritage. Nanwan Lake is nearby.
description: 文新茶村位于河南信阳。游览特色包括湖泊、园林景观、非遗文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shihegang town, about 20 km south-west of central Xinyang by road, near Nanwan Lake.

name: 西九华山
summaryEn: A hill scenic area in Chenlinzi town in southern Gushi County, near the Anhui border, built around Miaogao Temple, a Buddhist temple whose monks' stupas are a provincial heritage site. Tea gardens and bamboo groves cover the slopes, and the area is also a provincial geopark.
description: 西九华山位于河南信阳。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Chenlinzi town, about an hour by road south-east of Gushi town; the Shanghai–Xi'an expressway has an exit named after it.

name: 武占岭
summaryEn: A leisure resort in the wooded valleys of Doushanhe township, Xin County, built around a river-rafting run and also known as Wuzhanling Rafting. It suits a summer day out rather than sightseeing.
description: 武占岭位于河南信阳。游览特色包括林地风光、水上活动、休闲度假。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Doushanhe township, roughly 20 km west of Xin County town by road.

name: 西河毛铺
summaryEn: Two old villages in Zhouhe township: Xihe, a settlement more than 700 years old that sits between green hills and the West River and keeps over 150 old houses of grey brick and dark tile, and Maopu, whose Loushang Louxia hamlet is a listed Chinese Traditional Village. Their Qing houses are listed as heritage buildings, and Xihe has become a busy rural-tourism village with guesthouses and restaurants.
description: 西河毛铺位于河南信阳。游览特色包括田园观光、传统村落。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhouhe township, about 30 minutes by road east of Xin County town.

name: 息州杉海
summaryEn: A forest park on the north-western edge of Xi County town, developed from the old state forest farm and named for its "sea" of dawn redwood, pond cypress and bald cypress. It also has large groves of Chinese wingnut and Masson pine, Ma Yuan Square and a cultural hall about Lady Xi, linked with the ancient state of Xi from which the county takes its name, and makes a shady walk close to town.
description: 息州杉海位于河南信阳。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north-western edge of Xi County town, about 3 km from the centre. Check that it is open before going.

name: 钟鼓楼亲子乐园
summaryEn: A children's nature park in Popihe town, Guangshan County, laid out on a former forest farm. It has terraced flower beds, playgrounds with slides, climbing nets and sandpits, and cabin lodging, and is aimed at families with young children.
description: 钟鼓楼亲子乐园位于河南信阳。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Popihe town, roughly 25 km south of Guangshan county town by road.

name: 中国钧瓷文化园
summaryEn: A themed park on the north side of Yuzhou devoted to Jun ware, one of the celebrated Song-dynasty ceramics, laid out as a palace-style garden around Tiancheng Pavilion, a building about 50 m tall. The pavilion's halls display the history of Jun porcelain and the work of local kilns, and workshops in the park let visitors try throwing a pot on the wheel. It has hosted several of the city's Jun porcelain festivals.
description: 中国钧瓷文化园位于河南许昌。游览特色包括园林景观、楼阁建筑、陶瓷工艺。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the eastern side of Yuzhou city, about 45 km west of Xuchang by road.

name: 大鸿寨
summaryEn: A national forest park of about 36 km² in the hills of north-western Yuzhou, named after Dahong, a minister of the legendary Yellow Emperor whom local tradition places here; its highest peak, Wofo Mountain, is 1,156 m. Paths lead past cliffs, caves, streams and pools, and the slopes turn red in the second half of October. Shuttle transport, a glass bridge with a slide and other rides have been added for day-trippers.
description: 大鸿寨位于河南许昌。游览特色包括森林公园、玻璃栈道、林地风光。图集建议预留一天游览。
accessEn: In Jiushan town in the north-west of Yuzhou, about 40 km north-west of Yuzhou city.

name: 花都温泉小镇
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in Chenhuadian town, set among Yanling's flower nurseries, with geothermal bathing pools, a hotel and guesthouses. Camping and seasonal events are held in the grounds, and it makes a base for touring the county's gardens.
description: 花都温泉小镇位于河南许昌。游览特色包括温泉、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Chenhuadian town, Yanling County, about 25 km east of central Xuchang by road.

name: 建业绿色基地
summaryEn: A plant-growing and garden base among the nurseries of Yanling, promoted on the city's 2026 spring flower routes for its anthuriums and crab-apple blossom. The county names it among its main gardens alongside the Flower Expo Garden and Tangyun; expect seasonal planting rather than historic sights.
description: 建业绿色基地位于河南许昌。游览特色包括园林景观、赏花。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yanling County, about 35 km east of central Xuchang by road.

name: 金雨香草庄园
summaryEn: A herb-themed hot-spring resort in Yanling whose bathing pools are infused with fragrant herbs. It is one of several spa resorts the county promotes together with its flower gardens, and suits a relaxing half-day rather than sightseeing.
description: 金雨香草庄园位于河南许昌。游览特色包括花卉观赏、园林景观、庄园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yanling County, about 30 km east of central Xuchang by road.

name: 首山
summaryEn: A hill just south of Xiangcheng town, linked in legend with the Yellow Emperor, who is said to have mined copper here, and ringed by rapeseed fields whose spring flowering has drawn an annual festival since 2018. A walking path circles the hill and leads to a viewing platform on the summit, and Qianming Temple lies at the hill's northern foot.
description: 首山位于河南许昌。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、油菜花田、登山观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Immediately south of Xiangcheng town, about 45 km south-west of Xuchang by road.

name: 唐韵生态旅游区
summaryEn: A garden park among Yanling's plant nurseries that combines a cherry-blossom garden with courtyards, pavilions and colonnades built in Tang-dynasty style among flowering trees. A new Tang-themed section with costume experiences opened in 2026, and the park is a regular stop on the county's spring flower routes.
description: 唐韵生态旅游区位于河南许昌。游览特色包括园林景观、楼阁建筑、赏花。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yanling County, about 30 km east of central Xuchang by road.

name: 五彩大地
summaryEn: A sightseeing park of flower fields in the core of Yanling County's nursery-growing district, planned in 2015 and laid out from 2016 as part of the county's flower-tourism drive. Expect seasonal flower displays rather than historic sights.
description: 五彩大地位于河南许昌。游览特色包括花卉观赏。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yanling County's flower-nursery district, about 30 km east of central Xuchang by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 香堤湾·奥帕拉拉水公园
summaryEn: An outdoor summer water park next to the Xiangdiwan hotel on Zhongyuan West Road in Yulong town, Xingyang, on the western edge of Zhengzhou, built around a large wave pool. It suits families wanting a day in the water close to the city.
description: 香堤湾·奥帕拉拉水公园位于河南郑州。游览特色包括水上游乐。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Zhongyuan West Road in Yulong town, Xingyang, under 1 km from Lishangyin Park station on Zhengzhou Metro Line 10, which opened in 2023.

name: 中原豫西抗日纪念园
summaryEn: A memorial park in Tianzhongwan village, deep in the Fuxi Mountain area of Xinmi, where General Pi Dingjun set up the Communist-led Western Henan anti-Japanese base area in 1944. It was developed by the local tourism company around Pi Dingjun's former office and keeps the wartime site as a memorial and patriotic-education base.
description: 中原豫西抗日纪念园位于河南郑州。游览特色包括历史纪念。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tianzhongwan village in the Fuxi Mountain tourist area of north-western Xinmi, about an hour by road south-west of central Zhengzhou.

name: 竹林长寿山
summaryEn: A hill park of about 8.7 km² at Zhulin town in eastern Gongyi, best known for its autumn red leaves and for rocks likened to a dragon and a turtle, which gave it its old name of Longgui Mountain. Trails lead past ponds, a temple hall and three ancient trees, and there are a glass bridge, swing bridges and other thrill rides, along with a food street built in old-town style.
description: 竹林长寿山位于河南郑州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、玻璃栈道、古树。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Zhulin town in eastern Gongyi, about an hour by road west of Zhengzhou.

name: 樱桃沟
summaryEn: A rural area of loess gullies, woods and cherry orchards about 15 km south-west of central Zhengzhou, crossed by walking trails and dotted with old villages, some of whose houses now hold artists' and makers' studios. Cherries have been grown here for centuries and are a local speciality. It makes an easy half-day walk out of the city.
description: 樱桃沟位于河南郑州。游览特色包括果园、传统村落。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Erqi district about 15 km south-west of central Zhengzhou, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 中国绿化博览园
summaryEn: A landscaped park of about 190 hectares in Zhongmu county east of Zhengzhou, opened in 2010 as the China Greening Expo Garden and laid out around a central lake with themed gardens. It also has a large musical fountain and an exhibition hall, and makes an easy, flat outing.
description: 中国绿化博览园位于河南郑州。游览特色包括湖泊、园林景观、主题展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Zhongmu county east of Zhengzhou, about 40 minutes by road from the centre; Lǜbóyuán station on the Zhengzhou–Kaifeng intercity railway is nearby.

name: 大熊山仙人谷
summaryEn: A mountain-valley scenic area of about 36 km² in Xuzhuang town, Dengfeng, with a lake, streams, waterfalls, caves and red-rock cliffs. Added attractions include a 266 m glass bridge, a dry toboggan run, river rafting and an exhibition hall on the revolutionary history of western Henan. It suits a day of walking and, in summer, water play.
description: 大熊山仙人谷位于河南郑州。游览特色包括瀑布、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xuzhuang town, Dengfeng, reached from the Gaocheng or Baiping exits of the Lintong Expressway, about two hours by road from Zhengzhou.

name: 杜甫故里
summaryEn: A memorial park below Bijia Hill in Nanyaowan village, Zhanjie town, Gongyi, at the place traditionally held to be where the Tang poet Du Fu (712–770) was born and spent his childhood. Spread over about 25 hectares, its halls, statues and gardens trace his life and the poetry that earned him the title 'Sage of Poetry'.
description: 杜甫故里位于河南郑州。游览特色包括园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Zhanjie town, Gongyi, about 1 km east of the Gongyi East exit of the Lianhuo Expressway and roughly 1.5 hours by road west of Zhengzhou; Gongyi city buses 1 and 12 stop nearby.

name: 范家门
summaryEn: A rural scenic area run by a village tourism company in the hills of Tangzhuang town, north-east of Dengfeng, rated 4A at the end of 2023. Visitors come for Lintai Mountain, a spring said never to run dry, the Lailong limestone cave of about 1.3 km formed along an old underground river, a glass suspension bridge and a small natural lake, with further attractions such as a glass slide and a zip line.
description: 范家门位于河南郑州。游览特色包括洞穴、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Fanjiamen village, Tangzhuang town, about 23 km from Dengfeng and 70 km from Zhengzhou, best reached by car.

name: 郑州方特欢乐世界
summaryEn: A technology-themed amusement park opened in 2012 in Zhongmu county east of Zhengzhou, with roller coasters, a flying-theatre ride and dark rides on science-fiction, myth and history themes. It is part of the Fantawild resort, which also has the Fantawild Dreamland park, a water park and a hotel.
description: 郑州方特欢乐世界位于河南郑州。游览特色包括主题游乐、水上游乐、戏剧演艺。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: On Wansan Road at Liuji in Zhongmu county, about 40 minutes by road east of central Zhengzhou.

name: 丰乐农庄·马拉湾海浪浴场
summaryEn: A leisure resort opened in 2003 beside the Yellow River levee in Huiji district, north of Zhengzhou, with a large hotel, hot-spring baths, gardens, an animal area, go-karts and a baseball park. Its Malawan water park, built around a large wave pool, opens only in the summer months.
description: 丰乐农庄·马拉湾海浪浴场位于河南郑州。游览特色包括水上游乐、园林景观、农业体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Jiangshan Road by the Yellow River levee in Huiji district, about 30 minutes by road north of central Zhengzhou.

name: 凤泉湖
summaryEn: The largest scenic area in the Fuxi Mountain tourist zone of north-western Xinmi, covering about 10 km² of red-rock hills, ravines and a lake; it is on the official list as Sanquan Lake. Paths climb to the Xiaoma plateau and run through the Qifeng ravine, and the area has the Phoenix Sky Bridge, a glass suspension bridge, as well as a glass slide and a 2 km mountain coaster. It suits a day of walking with some thrill rides.
description: 凤泉湖位于河南郑州。游览特色包括湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Fuxi Mountain tourist area of north-western Xinmi, about an hour by road south-west of central Zhengzhou.

name: 伏羲大峡谷
summaryEn: A red sandstone gorge about 5 km long in the Fuxi Mountain area of north-western Xinmi, with walkways under overhanging cliffs and a series of natural waterfalls. Local legends of Fuxi and Nüwa are attached to many of its features. It is one of several scenic areas in the Fuxi Mountain tourist zone and can be combined with the nearby Red Stone Forest.
description: 伏羲大峡谷位于河南郑州。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、石林。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhonggou village in the Fuxi Mountain tourist area of north-western Xinmi, about an hour by road south-west of central Zhengzhou.

name: 古柏渡飞黄
summaryEn: An outdoor recreation area on the south bank of the Yellow River at Wangcun, Xingyang, run together with the neighbouring Gubaidu cherry garden. Its main draws are long sand slides down the riverside slopes, a children's sand-slide area, camel rides on the sands and a sightseeing cable car.
description: 古柏渡飞黄位于河南郑州。游览特色包括滨水景观、园林景观、缆车观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Yinghua Avenue in Wangcun town, northern Xingyang, about 3 km north of the Shangjie exit of the Lianhuo Expressway and roughly an hour by road west of Zhengzhou.

name: 古柏渡丰乐樱花园
summaryEn: A large cherry-blossom park near the Yellow River in Wangcun town, northern Xingyang, planted with more than 80 varieties of cherry tree in four themed sections. It lies where the South–North Water Diversion canal passes under the Yellow River, and a museum of that river crossing, built in 2018, stands inside the park. It is at its best in the spring blossom season.
description: 古柏渡丰乐樱花园位于河南郑州。游览特色包括博物馆、运河。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wangcun town in northern Xingyang, about 10 km north of the Hulaoguan exit of the Lianhuo Expressway and roughly an hour by road west of Zhengzhou.

name: 建业·华谊兄弟电影小镇
summaryEn: A film-themed town in Zhongmu county east of Zhengzhou, built in old-street style as a set of film streets: Zhengzhou Street recreates the city's Dehua Street, Datong Road and Fushou Street as they looked about a century ago, and Taiji Street is themed on the film Tai Chi. It has street performances, film-themed shows and rides, craft workshops, restaurants and themed guesthouses, and suits families combining it with the nearby theme parks.
description: 建业·华谊兄弟电影小镇位于河南郑州。游览特色包括主题游乐、手工艺。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Zhengzhou International Cultural and Creative Industry Park in Zhongmu county, about 40 minutes by road east of central Zhengzhou.

name: 红石林
summaryEn: An area of red sandstone pinnacles and cliffs, about 8 km², around Jianshan and Niuxinshi villages in the Fuxi Mountain area of north-western Xinmi. An outdoor escalator climbs the hillside, a ring-shaped glass walkway runs along the cliffs, and a cliff-top hotel and restaurants serve the wider Fuxi Mountain resort. It can be combined with the Fuxi Grand Canyon nearby.
description: 红石林位于河南郑州。游览特色包括峡谷、石林。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Fuxi Mountain tourist area of north-western Xinmi, about an hour by road south-west of central Zhengzhou.

name: 黄帝千古情
summaryEn: A theme park built by Songcheng Performance with the Xinzheng government around a large stage show, 'Yellow Emperor Romance', a song-and-dance spectacle about the Yellow Emperor and the history of the Central Plains. Around it are a giant statue of the Yellow Emperor, a holographic theatre, an exhibition hall on Yellow Emperor culture, a haunted house, a market street with craft workshops and a large indoor children's play area.
description: 黄帝千古情位于河南郑州。游览特色包括主题游乐、手工艺、主题展览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Daxue South Road in Longhu, the northern part of Xinzheng city, about 40 minutes by road south of central Zhengzhou.

name: 黄河富景生态世界
summaryEn: An agri-tourism park of more than 600 hectares on the Yellow River floodplain at Huayuankou, north of Zhengzhou, set up to hold down wind-blown sand by farming it. Visitors can walk among organic crop fields, try farm activities and use its leisure facilities, and it suits families with children.
description: 黄河富景生态世界位于河南郑州。游览特色包括田园观光、农业体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Huayuankou town, Huiji district, near the Yellow River about 40 minutes by road north of central Zhengzhou. Check that it is open before going.

name: 银基国际旅游度假区
summaryEn: A large resort complex in Liuzhai town, Xinmi, south-west of Zhengzhou, combining an indoor ice-and-snow park, a water park, hot-spring baths, an animal park and an ocean-themed park with hotels and a lakeside shopping street. It is built for family stays of a day or two rather than for sightseeing.
description: 银基国际旅游度假区位于河南郑州。游览特色包括水上游乐、湖泊、动物观赏。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Liuzhai town, Xinmi, about 5 km south-west of the Xuanyuanqiu exit of the Zhengzhou–Luanchuan Expressway and roughly an hour by road from central Zhengzhou.

name: 摘星楼
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in the Daxiong Mountain provincial forest park in Xuzhuang town, south of Dengfeng, opened in the late 2010s beside Yanglin village. Alongside hiking trails it has built attractions such as a tree-top walk, water and dry slides and a zip line, plus a visitor centre, a memorial hall to the wartime Nanshan breakout battle, a hotel and guesthouses. It suits families on a day out from Zhengzhou or Dengfeng; the separate Xianrengu scenic area lies on the same mountain.
description: 摘星楼位于河南郑州。游览特色包括森林公园、纪念展览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Yanglin village, Xuzhuang town, about 22 km south of central Dengfeng, roughly 45 minutes by road.

name: 郑州园博园
summaryEn: The 119-hectare site of the 11th China (Zhengzhou) International Garden Expo, in the Airport Economy Zone south-east of Zhengzhou, laid out as 94 outdoor show gardens. Most were made by mainland Chinese cities in the imperial, Suzhou and Lingnan garden traditions, and 18 by cities in 15 other countries.
description: 郑州园博园位于河南郑州。游览特色包括园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Zhengzhou Airport Economy Zone south-east of the city, about an hour by road from the centre; buses link it with Xinzheng Airport station. Check that it is open before going.

name: 郑州海昌海洋公园
summaryEn: A marine theme park in Zhongmu county east of Zhengzhou, with aquarium halls for whale sharks, polar animals, penguins and jellyfish, an Ultraman-themed hall and some twenty rides including a Ferris wheel. Staged animal shows are held with dolphins, belugas and other marine mammals, and the resort has three themed hotels.
description: 郑州海昌海洋公园位于河南郑州。游览特色包括主题游乐、水族展览、海岸风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: At Zhengkai Avenue and Qingsha Street in Zhongmu county, about 40 minutes by road east of central Zhengzhou; Lǜbóyuán intercity station is a short bus ride away.

name: 郑州香山
summaryEn: A leisure area built around Xiang Mountain in Daye town on the eastern side of Mount Song, named after a shrine that, by local tradition, people raised to the Tang poet Bai Juyi after he toured the area as governor in 830. Its core is the Xiangxi Valley of streams, small lakes and waterfalls, with fairy-tale buildings such as 'hobbit houses' and a castle aimed at children. Around it are a Bai Juyi square, guesthouses, old mountain villages and a group of cave dwellings restored by villagers.
description: 郑州香山位于河南郑州。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhoushan village, Daye town, about 20 km east of Dengfeng and 40 km from Zhengzhou by road, best reached by car.

name: 建业运河古镇
summaryEn: A leisure area built from 2017 along Zhoukou's old canal, with a commercial street in old-town style, a large food hall of Central Plains dishes, homestays, camping, boat trips and a farm area. Its own troupe stages short shows on local themes such as Laozi and the canal trade, along with costume parades and wire-flying acts. It is a modern resort-style complex rather than a historic town and suits an evening out.
description: 建业运河古镇位于河南周口。游览特色包括古镇、运河。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the eastern stretch of Wenchang Avenue in Zhoukou's urban area, served by city buses 29 and K201.

name: 叶氏庄园
summaryEn: The family seat of the Ye merchants, who grew rich from river trade on the Sha River, built in stages over more than a century from the Kangxi to the Xianfeng reigns in the old town of Dengcheng. Three main compounds survive, the Tanglou, Five-Gate and High-Gate courtyards, with tall gatehouses, an open two-storey hall and carved brick, wood and stone throughout, and the city describes it as the largest and best-preserved Qing manor in eastern Henan. It is run as a museum.
description: 叶氏庄园位于河南周口。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、庄园、历史街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Dengcheng town, Shangshui County, on the south bank of the Sha River about 16 km west of central Zhoukou; reached by car or taxi.

name: 周口野生动物世界
summaryEn: A large safari park and entertainment complex opened around 2020 in Zhoukou Forest Park, with walk-through animal areas, a drive-through enclosure where visitors tour in their own cars or a park train, a bird garden and a ride zone with roller coasters. Its theatres stage acrobatic and circus shows, including staged animal acts, in keeping with Zhoukou's reputation as a home of Chinese acrobatics, and a themed hotel opened in 2026. It suits families with children.
description: 周口野生动物世界位于河南周口。游览特色包括森林公园、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Zhongzhou Road North in the north of Zhoukou city, reached by taxi or city bus; it reopened on 22 September 2026 after summer flood damage.

name: 蔡洪坊酒文化园
summaryEn: A working baijiu distillery and visitor park on the south bank of the Hong River in Xincai county town, built on the former state-run Xincai distillery and covering more than 600 mu. Visitors see the Cai liquor museum, a recreated hand-made qu (fermentation starter) workshop, the base-liquor warehouses and a tasting centre, plus the Central Plains Liquor Culture Hall on the history of Chinese and local liquor, an exhibition on local party history, a botanical garden and a children's playground.
description: 蔡洪坊酒文化园位于河南驻马店。游览特色包括博物馆、酿造文化、休闲公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Next to Beihu Park in Xincai county town, about an hour and a half by road south-east of Zhumadian.

name: 金顶山
summaryEn: A national forest park in Yifeng town where the Funiu and Tongbai ranges meet, on the climatic border between the subtropical and warm-temperate zones, with six peaks, dense mixed forest and rock formations. Besides hiking paths and an old mountain stockade, the scenic area has a water park and a zoo aimed at day-trippers from Zhumadian.
description: 金顶山位于河南驻马店。游览特色包括森林公园、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yifeng town, Yicheng district, about 25 km south-west of central Zhumadian, roughly 40 minutes by car.

name: 老乐山
summaryEn: A forested range of nine linked peaks at the eastern end of the Funiu and Tongbai mountains, the mountain scenery nearest to Zhumadian city, rising to 813 m at Yuhuang Peak. A national forest park with more than 95% forest cover, it is a Taoist mountain whose summit was historically ringed by temples and a worship terrace, and it is promoted as a place for the Double Ninth (Chongyang) festival climb.
description: 老乐山位于河南驻马店。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 9 km south-west of Zhumadian city and 8 km west of Queshan county town, around 20–30 minutes by car.

name: 南海禅寺
summaryEn: A large working Buddhist monastery on the south-eastern edge of Runan town, enclosed on three sides by the Ru River and rebuilt from 1992 to 2007 under the monk Mingcheng on the site of the old Xiaonanhai temple. Its halls cover some 50,000 m², among them a Mahavira Hall of more than 6,000 m² housing a huge seated Shakyamuni, approached through a 31 m-high gateway and a line of granite archways.
description: 南海禅寺位于河南驻马店。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、佛教文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Nanhai Avenue in Runan county town, about 30 km east of Zhumadian, roughly 40 minutes by car.

name: 皇家驿站
summaryEn: A modern culture-and-leisure town in Ming–Qing style in Zhumadian's Yicheng district, themed on the area's long history as a stop on the imperial courier-station network. Its 'seven streets and three lanes', among them an old street and a canal-side water street, are lined with restaurants, shops and inns around Feima Square, the Mawang Pavilion, an opera stage, Confucian and military temples and a post-station museum. It is busiest in the evening, with a night market, light shows and performances.
description: 皇家驿站位于河南驻马店。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑、运河。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Off Tianzhongshan Avenue in Yicheng district, about 15 minutes by taxi from central Zhumadian.

name: 铜山
summaryEn: A provincial scenic area in Biyang County made up of Tongshan mountain, the Tongshan Lake reservoir and Yunwu Peak, with forested hills, caves, waterfalls, temples and Taoist halls. The reservoir covers about 16 km² and is dotted with islands reached by boat, and the area is also a national forest park and a national water-conservancy scenic area.
description: 铜山位于河南驻马店。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km east of Biyang county seat and some 50 km south-west of Zhumadian, roughly an hour by car.

name: 巴人河
summaryEn: A karst river gorge in Chadianzi town, Badong County, also called the Three Gorges Women's Valley, where the scenic area climbs from about 350 to 1,650 metres above sea level. The route passes Qinglang Peak, a three-sided cliff reached along a narrow ridge path, the Longyin Palace limestone cave, a covered bridge and three iron-chain footbridges. The lower valley adds a rafting run, a slide and zip lines, and the shaded gorge is promoted locally as a place to escape the summer heat.
description: 巴人河位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括峡谷、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The scenic area lies in Chadianzi town on the G209 in Badong County, with its gate at an expressway exit.

name: 大清江
summaryEn: A boat-based scenic area on the Qing River in Enshi, spread across Sancha, Shadi and Xintang townships, where large passenger boats run along about 87 km of river between karst cliffs and villages. On the bank, the Honghua peak-forest area has riverside paths, a 1,056-metre cable car across the river and via ferrata climbing routes. Developed from 2012, it suits visitors who want to see the river's scenery from the water rather than on foot.
description: 大清江位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括滨水景观、林地风光、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Boats leave from the Hunshuihe pier at Sancha town, reached by road from Enshi city.

name: 地心谷
summaryEn: A deep limestone gorge in Gaoping town, Jianshi County, with cliff-hugging plank walkways, a glass bridge more than 200 metres above the valley floor and more than a thousand river-scoured potholes in the stream bed. The scenic area also contains the Jianshi Man site, where Homo erectus remains were found together with fossils of the giant ape Gigantopithecus, roughly two million years old, and a stretch of the old Ba salt road. It opened to visitors in 2014 and has since added rafting, a hillside lift and a hotel built into the cliff.
description: 地心谷位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括峡谷、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Gaoping town, Jianshi County, which has its own station on the Yichang–Wanzhou railway and lies on the G318 and the Shanghai–Chongqing Expressway.

name: 恩施土司城
summaryEn: A replica tusi (hereditary chieftain) manor complex on a hillside in the city of Enshi, opened in 2002, combining Tujia, Miao and Dong architecture, carving and painting. It includes a gate tower, the nine-courtyard Jiujin Hall, a hall to the legendary Ba leader Lin Jun, bell and drum towers and a flower garden, linked by loop paths past more than thirty sights. It is a modern re-creation rather than a surviving site, but it gives a quick introduction to the tusi system that governed Tujia areas from the Yuan dynasty until the 1730s.
description: 恩施土司城位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括花卉观赏、园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Tusi Road within Enshi city, about 1.5 km from the city centre.

name: 佛宝山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in the hills of Lichuan, with forest cover of more than 95 percent. Its canyon section has boardwalks, including a glass walkway and a cliff-side plank road, as well as a rafting route and waterfall viewing. It is a day out for visitors based in Lichuan who want to get into the hills.
description: 佛宝山位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Fobaoshan development zone in the hills of Lichuan, reached by road from Lichuan city.

name: 鹤峰满山红烈士陵园
summaryEn: A memorial cemetery on a wooded hillside on the south side of Hefeng town, begun in 1959 and expanded in 1978 as the cemetery of the Hunan-Hubei border soviet area. It holds the graves of Red Army commander Duan Dechang, He Long's sister He Ying and others associated with the revolutionary struggle in the border area. The grounds, about 10 hectares, include a main tomb, a monument, a martyrs' shrine, an exhibition hall of relics and a bronze statue of He Long, and the cemetery is a nationally protected martyrs' memorial and the core of the Manshanhong scenic area.
description: 鹤峰满山红烈士陵园位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括历史纪念、林地风光、主题展览。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: On Duan Dechang Road in Rongmei town, on the south side of Hefeng county town.

name: 龙船水乡
summaryEn: A riverside scenic area on the Qing River in Liangwu township, built as a tourism project by Hubei Communications Investment Group on the theme of the Longchuan Diao, a Lichuan folk song listed as national intangible heritage. Visitors travel by boat into the Shuilian water cave, where the air stays around 18 °C, and the grounds include a wetland park with an open-air stage used for folk shows and water-borne fire-spark displays. It suits a half-day stop for cool air and a staged folk-culture show.
description: 龙船水乡位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括湿地、水乡。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Liangwu township, about 8–10 km west of Lichuan city, reached by road.

name: 鹿院坪
summaryEn: A cliff-ringed hollow in Banqiao town, about 1,700 metres above sea level and more than 500 metres deep, with a farming hamlet, streams, waterfall groups and karst crevices on its floor. Until 2021 the only way in was a steep cliff path; now a 380-metre inclined lift takes about three minutes, a cliff-side slide runs beside the waterfalls and a 158-metre conveyor 'magic carpet' eases the climb back. It is a cool summer retreat.
description: 鹿院坪位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括瀑布、喀斯特地貌、农业体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Banqiao town, about 75 km from Enshi city by mountain road, roughly two hours' drive.

name: 卯洞
summaryEn: A river cave on the Youshui River at Baifusi in Laifeng County, close to where Hubei meets Hunan and Chongqing, where the river flows through an opening about 58 metres wide and 36 metres high and runs underground for some 215 metres. The visit is a boat trip through the cave and down the gorge beyond, between limestone peaks and cliffs, and takes a little over an hour; the boat route opened to visitors in 2021. Local legend says the craftsman-god Lu Ban chiselled the cave in a rabbit year, month and hour, hence the name.
description: 卯洞位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括峡谷、乘船游览、洞穴。图集建议预留1.5–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Baifusi town, about an hour's drive from Laifeng county town.

name: 坪坝营国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park of about 154 km² in the mountains of south-western Xianfeng County, close to the Chongqing border, with forest cover of over 90 percent. Its features include the Sidong Gorge, a cluster of sinkholes and through-caves in woodland, and extensive azalea woods. It suits a half-day of forest walking.
description: 坪坝营国家森林公园位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Pingbaying township in the south-west of Xianfeng County, about 33 km south-south-west of Xianfeng town as the crow flies, reached by road.

name: 狮子关
summaryEn: A river-gorge scenic area just east of Xuan'en town, about 9.6 km long, with steep rock walls and narrow passes such as the Lion's Mouth. The whole route can be toured by car, and the area also offers paddle-boarding and kayaking and a spot where wild macaques can be seen.
description: 狮子关位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括峡谷、水上活动、猕猴观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Just east of Xuan'en town, about 6 km from the centre, reached by road.

name: 唐崖河景区
summaryEn: A scenic area on the upper Tangya River at Huangjindong in the north of Xianfeng County, centred on Huangjin Cave, a large river cave that the Tangya River flows through.
