A trail runs upstream from the visitor centre to the cave portal, and the area has offered rafting down the river and through the cave. It suits a half-day outing in warm weather.
description: 唐崖河景区位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括水上活动、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Huangjindong township in the north of Xianfeng County, about 30 km north of Xianfeng town as the crow flies, reached by road.

name: 土家女儿城
summaryEn: A shopping and leisure district in Enshi, built in the style of a Tujia old town and opened as a street quarter in 2013, with stilt-house lanes, shops, restaurants, inns, a Tujia folk museum and a theatre. It is themed on the Nü'er Hui, a traditional Tujia folk gathering, which is staged here as a regular event. It is a modern, commercial place rather than a historic quarter, popular in the evening and for photo studios that hire out Tujia and Miao costumes.
description: 土家女儿城位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括博物馆、戏剧演艺、历史街区。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the south of Enshi city, off Ma'anshan Road.

name: 伍家台
summaryEn: A tea-growing village in Xuan'en County whose tea was presented to the Qianlong emperor in the 1780s, earning it the label 'tribute tea' and an imperial plaque. Boardwalks wind through the tea gardens, with chances to watch or try picking and hand processing, and the village has a tea museum; the tea gardens are a provincial-level protected site, and the tea is on the China-EU geographical indications list. It is a small, rural stop, busiest in spring when the tea is picked.
description: 伍家台位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括博物馆、茶文化、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Wujiatai village, Wanzhai township, 18 km (about 30 minutes) by road from Xuan'en county town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 巫峡口
summaryEn: A scenic area on Damian Mountain above the Yangtze at the eastern mouth of the Wu Gorge, the middle gorge of the Three Gorges, just upriver of Badong county town. A cable car and a tourist road climb the hillside to viewpoints over the sharp bend where the river leaves the gorge. The mouth of Shennong Stream lies only a few kilometres downriver.
description: 巫峡口位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括峡谷、缆车观景。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the Yangtze a few kilometres south-west of Badong county town, reached by road.

name: 浪漫宣恩旅游区
summaryEn: The county town of Xuan'en, run as a scenic area in its own right and built around the Gongshui River that flows through it. In summer the riverbanks host evening trips by bamboo raft and black-awning boat, with staged performances such as fire-spark (iron-flower) displays and dances. It suits an evening stopover for visitors already in the county.
description: 浪漫宣恩旅游区位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括滨水景观。图集建议预留一个晚上游览。
accessEn: In Xuan'en county town, about 35 km south of Enshi city as the crow flies, reached by road.

name: 杨梅古寨
summaryEn: A scenic area made up of two villages, Huangbaiyuan and Shiqiao, in Sanhu township, known for its groves of old Chinese bayberry (yangmei) trees, some of them more than 300 years old. The villages keep Tujia stilt houses, old courtyards, an old theatre stage, a water-powered mill and parts of an old salt road, linked by a tourist road. The fruit ripens around midsummer, the busiest time to visit.
description: 杨梅古寨位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括村寨、戏剧演艺。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Sanhu township, more than 20 km by road from Laifeng county town.

name: 矅天眼
summaryEn: A natural sinkhole (tiankeng) more than 290 m deep in Luoquanyan village, Jiaoyuan township, Xuan'en County, set among karst pinnacles and developed as a scenic area. After rain waterfalls pour into the pit, and in summer visitors go down to its cool depths, which Xinhua has reported as one of the county's popular cool-down destinations.
description: 矅天眼位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括瀑布、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Luoquanyan village, Jiaoyuan township, about 8 km west of Xuan'en town, reached by road.

name: 野三关森林花海
summaryEn: A flower-field attraction in the Tiechanghuang forest park on a plateau above Yesanguan town in Badong County, at more than 1,700 m. It is one of three main sights of the Lüchongpo resort area, with a ski field and a holiday village, where summer temperatures average about 22 °C. It suits a summer day trip to cooler hills.
description: 野三关森林花海位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括森林公园、花卉观赏、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills above Yesanguan town in the south-east of Badong County, reached by road from the town, which has an expressway junction and a railway station.

name: 野三峡
summaryEn: A mountain and river scenic region in Jianshi County, built around the Jingyang stretch of the Qing River and the neighbouring Yesan River. Its main parts are Butterfly Rock cave, the Huanghe peak forest of karst towers, Jingyang Gorge on the Qing River and the Xiaoxihu (Little West Lake) resort area, a cool hill retreat in summer. The old Jingyang pass and old street lie along the river.
description: 野三峡位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括峡谷、湖泊。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: Around Huaping and Jingyang towns in Jianshi County, about an hour and a half by road from Dixin Valley at Gaoping.

name: 玉龙洞
summaryEn: A show cave in Tuanbao township with passages on three levels, found in 1992 when villagers searching for water in a drought came across it. A trail runs along a gorge and over a bridge to the cave mouth, and about 1.6 km of passage is open, lit in colour, with folk dances in traditional costume staged on site. The rock formations are named for what they resemble, such as a swan on its nest and a group of elephants.
description: 玉龙洞位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括峡谷、洞穴、山岩地貌。图集建议预留约2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tuanbao township, about 30 km by road from Lichuan city.

name: 雨仙谷
summaryEn: A scenic area in the hills just outside Badong town, built around Wuyuan Cave, a large cave with a flowing spring and stalactites, and the gorge outside it, where the air stays around 20 °C. The grounds hold Three Gorges stone inscriptions, pavilions and a stele garden recalling the statesman Kou Zhun, as well as the Night Rain Pool, a constant-temperature outdoor pool on the Yangtze bank named after a poem by Li Shangyin. It suits a half-day combining a cave walk and the poetry sites.
description: 雨仙谷位于湖北恩施。游览特色包括峡谷、园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 10 km from Badong county town by road, in Xinling town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 凤栖绿洲生态文明博览园
summaryEn: A lakeside expo park in Liangzihu district, close to the Wuhan boundary, whose main building is the Liangzi Lake Ecological Civilisation Exhibition Hall, a two-storey hall of about 18,000 m² on lake protection and water-ecology restoration, described locally as the first of its kind in central China. Displays use interactive screens and 3D projection to cover the lake's history, its wetland ecosystem and local development. Outside are a lakeside camping ground, waterways, a boardwalk and a viewing platform; the park was rated 4A in December 2024.
description: 凤栖绿洲生态文明博览园位于湖北鄂州。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Wutong Lake area of Liangzihu district, on the Ezhou side of the boundary with Wuhan, reached by road from Ezhou or Wuhan.

name: 梁子岛
summaryEn: A 2.2 km² island in Liangzi Lake, reached by boat from the mainland, with a settlement of grey-tiled stone houses, farmland, small hills and lake views. The lake is the original home of the Wuchang bream, and the island is promoted as a quiet lakeside escape for walks and local fish dishes.
description: 梁子岛位于湖北鄂州。游览特色包括湖泊、岛屿、田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Boats to the island leave from Changling pier on the Liangzihu district shore; Ezhou is about 35 km to the east and Wuhan about 45 km to the north-west in a straight line.

name: 杏福园
summaryEn: A farm-tourism estate beside a lake in Duandian town, developed from 2014 by a Taiwanese-owned company on formerly fallow land. Current attractions listed by the district government include an orchid hall, a lakeside beach and water-play area, a pet park, farming study programmes and outdoor sports, with orchards and flower greenhouses around them. It is a modern leisure development rather than a heritage site, suited to families on a day out from Ezhou or Wuhan.
description: 杏福园位于湖北鄂州。游览特色包括湖泊、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Duandian town, Huarong district, about 20 km north-west of central Ezhou and roughly 45 km east of central Wuhan in a straight line, reached by road.

name: 西山风景区
summaryEn: A wooded hill park in the west of Ezhou, once called Fanshan, that preserves traces of the Wu state of the Three Kingdoms, whose ruler Sun Quan is said to have built a palace here. Paths lead past Lingquan Temple, the Songfeng Pavilion linked with the Song poet Huang Tingjian, a Wu king's summer palace, a sword-testing stone and an accession altar, and the poet Su Shi often came across the river from Huangzhou to wander here. It has been a 4A area since 2022.
description: 西山风景区位于湖北鄂州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、楼阁建筑、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the west of Ezhou's urban area, about 2 km from the old centre, which is about 60 km east of central Wuhan in a straight line.

name: 薄刀峰
summaryEn: Bodaofeng is a mountain scenic area in Shengli town in the north of Luotian county, in the Dabie Mountains of north-eastern Hubei, and is promoted as a cool summer retreat. It has ridges, pine-covered rock formations and a lake called Yuanmeng ('Dream-Fulfilling') Lake, and the Hubei Daily reported that Huanggang's 2025 summer tourism season was launched on its shore. It is a national forest park and suits visitors who want hill scenery and a cooler climate.
description: 薄刀峰位于湖北黄冈。游览特色包括森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Shengli town in the mountains north of Luotian county seat, reached by road from Luotian town.

name: 李先念故居
summaryEn: Li Xiannian (1909–1992) was born in Hong'an and served as President of the People's Republic of China from 1983 to 1988. His former residence in Gaoqiao town, a Qing-period house, was listed in 2006 as a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit and stands within a memorial park with a memorial hall about his life. The park is one of the red-tourism sites of Hong'an, a county known for the large number of senior army officers it produced.
description: 李先念故居位于湖北黄冈。游览特色包括纪念展览、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Changfeng village, Gaoqiao town, Hong'an county, reached by road from the county seat; Hong'an is about an hour's drive north of Wuhan.

name: 四季花海
summaryEn: Four Seasons Flower Sea is a modern leisure and study-tour resort about 1 km south of Yingshan county seat (Wenquan town), beside the upper Bailianhe reservoir and centred on planted flower fields. It also has a hot-spring area, a water-play zone, hotels and guesthouses, and study programmes with a revolutionary-history theme. It is a commercial development rather than a heritage or wilderness site and suits families and weekend visitors from Wuhan.
description: 四季花海位于湖北黄冈。游览特色包括水库、花卉观赏、历史纪念。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 1 km south of the centre of Yingshan county seat (Wenquan town), beside the upper Bailianhe reservoir.

name: 广济时光景区
summaryEn: Guangji Shiguang is a riverside park about 2 km long on the north bank of the Yangtze at Wuxue, built from 2013 and opened in January 2016. A central walkway runs between the river embankment and the waterfront, with a main square marked by a large helm sculpture, bronze sculptures on local trades and a terrace for looking out over the river. It was rated a national 4A scenic area in 2018 and suits a short riverside walk rather than a trip of its own.
description: 广济时光景区位于湖北黄冈。游览特色包括滨水景观、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the Yangtze waterfront in the urban area of Wuxue, a river port in south-eastern Hubei that has its own railway station.

name: 黄麻起义和鄂豫皖苏区纪念园
summaryEn: This memorial park in Hong'an town, the county seat, commemorates the Huangma Uprising of November 1927, when Communist-led peasant forces rose in Huang'an (now Hong'an) and Macheng, and the Hubei–Henan–Anhui revolutionary base area that followed. Set on a wooded hillside, it has a martyrs' monument, memorial halls for Dong Biwu and Li Xiannian, an exhibition hall on the history of the base area, and the graves of those who died. The county museum's curator told China Daily that Hong'an lost about 140,000 of its people in the wars of that era.
description: 黄麻起义和鄂豫皖苏区纪念园位于湖北黄冈。游览特色包括纪念展览、历史纪念、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Lingyuan Avenue in Hong'an town, the county seat, about an hour's drive north of Wuhan.

name: 锦绣铜锣景区
summaryEn: A privately run leisure park of about 4,200 mu (roughly 280 hectares) on the southern edge of Hong'an county seat, beside the Daoshui River. Its landmark is a giant bronze gong, and the park also has a children's play area, a petting-animal park, a military-themed park, a night market, a music fountain, a vintage green train, a riverside campsite and a water-screen light show on Hong'an's revolutionary history. It is aimed at families on a day out and is not a place of historic interest.
description: 锦绣铜锣景区位于湖北黄冈。游览特色包括滨水景观、历史纪念、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the southern edge of Hong'an county seat (Chengguan town), beside the Hong'an South exit of the Wuhong Expressway, roughly 80 km north of Wuhan.

name: 李时珍文化旅游区
summaryEn: A health-tourism area on the shore of Chilong Lake National Wetland Park in the south of Qichun county, built around the legacy of Li Shizhen (1518–1593), the Ming-dynasty physician who compiled the Bencao Gangmu (Compendium of Materia Medica). Its main parts are a culture plaza with a large statue of Li, the Bencao Gangmu Hall, an all-timber exhibition building using mortise-and-tenon joints, a herb garden planted with species from the book, and Qiai Town, a visitor town built in Ming–Qing style with craft workshops, herbal teas and performances. It complements the displays at the Li Shizhen Memorial Hall in Qizhou, and suits families and anyone curious about traditional Chinese medicine.
description: 李时珍文化旅游区位于湖北黄冈。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the Chilong Lake shore close to Qizhou town in the south of Qichun county, with the county seat Caohe roughly 25 km to the north.

name: 李山生态旅游区
summaryEn: A village-based tourism area of about 3 sq km in Lishan village, Datong town, in the north-east of Qichun county, developed around tea and the area's revolutionary history. The provincial tourism department lists an artificial lake with a lakeside pavilion, a tea-culture park, a tea street and a 600 mu (about 40 hectares) tea plantation, together with a Red Army cave, a red-culture plaza and gallery, a folk-culture wall and hands-on farming activities. It suits a half-day village outing for visitors already in the area rather than a reason to travel to the region.
description: 李山生态旅游区位于湖北黄冈。游览特色包括茶园、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Datong town, roughly 45 km north-east of Caohe, the Qichun county seat, in a straight line, reached by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 长征国家文化公园英山园区
summaryEn: A Long March-themed park in Taojiahe township on the southern slope of the Dabie Mountains, a key assembly area of the Red 25th Army before its Long March in 1934. The park marks the episode with statues of soldiers, exhibition halls and walking trails, including a 17.3 km history trail, and one trail reaches the surviving trenches of the Niubeiji (Ox-back Ridge) blocking action. It was rated a national 4A scenic area in December 2025.
description: 长征国家文化公园英山园区位于湖北黄冈。游览特色包括主题展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Taojiahe township, about 45 km north-east of Yingshan town, roughly an hour by road.

name: 麻城烈士陵园
summaryEn: A martyrs' cemetery and memorial park of about 11 hectares in Macheng, built to commemorate those who died in the Huangma Uprising and the Hubei–Henan–Anhui Soviet area. Its monument carries inscriptions by Ye Jianying and Li Xiannian, and the grounds hold the Macheng Revolutionary Memorial Hall and a memorial hall to General Wang Shusheng. It is on China's list of classic red-tourism areas and fits a red-tourism route through Macheng and neighbouring Hong'an.
description: 麻城烈士陵园位于湖北黄冈。游览特色包括纪念展览、历史纪念。图集建议预留约1 小时游览。
accessEn: In the urban area of Macheng, on Lingyuan Avenue (No. 75).

name: 大别山南武当
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in Wujiashan National Forest Park in the Dabie Mountains of northern Yingshan, promoted as 'Southern Wudang'. It combines forested mountain and river-gorge scenery with a Daoist temple complex, the Wusheng Palace, and has a ski area in winter. It suits a day in the hills for walking and views.
description: 大别山南武当位于湖北黄冈。游览特色包括峡谷、寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the mountains of northern Yingshan county, reached by road along the S309, roughly 40–50 km north of Yingshan town (an hour or more by road).

name: 普阳观
summaryEn: Puyang Guan is a Daoist temple on Fuhu Hill in Caohe, the county seat of Qichun, and the named core of the Li Shizhen Medical-Daoist Culture Tourism Area on the Hubei A-level list. The area's theme is the traditional medicine of Qichun, the home town of Li Shizhen.
description: 普阳观位于湖北黄冈。游览特色包括寺庙建筑。图集建议预留约1 小时游览。
accessEn: In Caohe, the county seat of Qichun, on Nanyang 4th Road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 桃花冲
summaryEn: Taohuachong is a mountain resort area in Caopandi town, in the east of Yingshan county in the Dabie Mountains. Its ski resort has seven runs, the longest about 1.2 km, and opens in winter; canyon rafting is a summer attraction. It suits visitors looking for winter sports or a cooler summer break within reach of Wuhan.
description: 桃花冲位于湖北黄冈。游览特色包括滑雪、峡谷。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Caopandi town in the east of Yingshan county, reached by road from the county seat, Wenquan town.

name: 天台山
summaryEn: Tiantai Mountain is a forested mountain area in the far north of Hong'an county, on the Hubei–Henan border, with a platform-shaped main peak, steep rock faces and named viewpoints along its stone steps. The scenic area also includes the Duitian River, where summer rafting runs down a bed of bluestone slabs. It is a national forest park and suits visitors who want a day of hiking or rafting in the hills north of Wuhan.
description: 天台山位于湖北黄冈。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光、水上活动。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the far north of Hong'an county on the Hubei–Henan border, reached by road from the county seat; Hong'an is about an hour's drive north of Wuhan.

name: 毕昇墓
summaryEn: Bi Sheng (died 1051), a Song-dynasty artisan, is credited with inventing the world's first movable type, made of fired clay. A tomb stele identified as his was found in 1990 at Wuguidun village, Caopandi town, Yingshan, which is why Yingshan is regarded as his hometown, and the tomb was listed in 2019 in the eighth batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units. Yingshan's Bi Sheng Memorial Park, opened in 2023, uses modern displays to show clay and wooden movable-type printing.
description: 毕昇墓位于湖北黄冈。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Caopandi town, east of Wenquan town, the seat of Yingshan county, reached by road from the county seat.

name: 通天河景区
summaryEn: Tongtian River is a themed tourist area in a hill valley in Yuchuan town, Wuxue, built around the story of Journey to the West. Its attractions follow that novel and include staged shows with scenes such as 'Havoc in Heaven' on weekends and holidays. It is an entertainment-style attraction that suits families and groups rather than a heritage or wilderness site.
description: 通天河景区位于湖北黄冈。游览特色包括山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yuchuan town in the hills of Wuxue, reached by road from the centre of Wuxue, a Yangtze river port in south-eastern Hubei. Check that it is open before going.

name: 雾云山
summaryEn: A mountain tea-and-terrace area in the hills of northern Qichun, at an average altitude of about 800 m. The main sights are the Wuyunshan tea gardens and the Leigongyan terraces, about 110 mu of paddy fields split into 310 small plots down a 120 m slope and described as about a thousand years old. The core scenic area covers about 2,000 mu (roughly 130 hectares).
description: 雾云山位于湖北黄冈。游览特色包括园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tanlin township in the northern mountains of Qichun, about 80 km from the county seat (Caohe) by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 孝感乡文化园
summaryEn: A modern city park in Macheng themed on 'Xiaogan Township', the place that many Sichuan and Chongqing families name as the origin of their ancestors in the Ming and Qing 'Huguang fills Sichuan' migrations. Historians debate how far that family memory matches real origins, and the park is best seen as a heritage-themed memorial space, not a historic site. It is a place for descendants of those migrants to visit when tracing their roots.
description: 孝感乡文化园位于湖北黄冈。游览特色包括城市公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the urban area of Macheng, on Huguang Avenue in the Nanhu subdistrict; Macheng is served by the Hefei–Wuhan high-speed line.

name: 滴水涯
summaryEn: A valley scenic area in Paishi town built around a waterfall group that the county government calls the 'three falls and nine pools', the main fall dropping about 68 m. Attractions added in recent years include stream rafting, a glass walkway, a dry slide, a hobbit-themed play area, camping, orchards and flower plantings. A small stalactite cave and a local tale that the Song poet Su Shi visited add colour, and the area was rated 4A in December 2025.
description: 滴水涯位于湖北黄石。游览特色包括瀑布、玻璃栈道、果园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Paishi town, Yangxin County, about 1 km from the Paishi exit of the G56 Hangrui expressway and roughly an hour's drive from Huangshi.

name: 东方山
summaryEn: A forested hill of about 475 m with three main peaks, described as the largest forest park in Huangshi's urban area and named for the Han writer Dongfang Shuo, who by local tradition studied and practised Daoism here. Its two main stops are Honghua Chan Temple, an old Buddhist temple described as a thousand years old, and Dongchang Pavilion, a modern nine-storey Tang-style tower run as an immersive entertainment attraction with costume experiences and staged shows. It suits a half-day of walking from the city.
description: 东方山位于湖北黄石。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xialu district on the western edge of Huangshi city, a short drive of about 15 km from the city centre.

name: 黄石国家矿山公园
summaryEn: A mine park on the site of the Daye iron mine, where records of mining go back to the third century and which was mechanised in the late Qing. Its centrepiece is a vast terraced open pit, more than 2 km long and over 400 m deep, which visitors look down into, set among reclaimed slopes planted with locust trees and tunnel displays. The park opened in 2007 and in 2018 joined China's first list of protected industrial heritage.
description: 黄石国家矿山公园位于湖北黄石。游览特色包括矿业遗产、工业遗产。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tieshan district, roughly 15–20 km west of central Huangshi by road.

name: 黄石华侨城恐龙奇域
summaryEn: A dinosaur-themed holiday resort on the shore of Daye Lake, opened in 2024. Its main park, the Dinosaur Dream Factory, has more than 30 large outdoor rides, indoor digital attractions and staged shows, with a 99 m illuminated Ferris wheel and go-karts in the neighbouring park and a shopping-and-dining street and hotels alongside. It is a modern theme park rather than a heritage site, and suits families with children.
description: 黄石华侨城恐龙奇域位于湖北黄石。游览特色包括湖泊、主题游乐。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: On the shore of Daye Lake in the Huangshi Economic Development Zone, roughly 15 km south-west of central Huangshi by road.

name: 雷山风景区
summaryEn: A hill scenic area in Chengui town, about 15 km west of Daye, covering some 55 km² in three zones: Xiaoleishan, with pines and oddly shaped rocks, Daquangou, a stream gorge with cascades and a reservoir, and Tiantaishan. A hot-spring resort stands inside the area, and an old nunnery, Lianhua An, lies in the Daquangou gorge. It suits a half-day outing from Daye.
description: 雷山风景区位于湖北黄石。游览特色包括峡谷、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Chengui town, about 15 km west of Daye city centre, reached by the Dajin provincial road.

name: 龙凤山
summaryEn: A rural-tourism park of nearly 14,000 mu around the twin peaks of Qinglong and Yufeng at Shuanggangkou in Liurenba town, run by one company as a farming-and-tourism enterprise. It has a fruit-and-vegetable picking park, a study and training base with a swimming pool, and a hill park with hiking paths, hydrangea, cherry and azalea plantings, timber cabins and a camping ground. The nearby Red Third Army sites are part of what the park promotes.
description: 龙凤山位于湖北黄石。游览特色包括田园观光、农业体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Liurenba town, about 28 km from Daye city and 40 km from central Huangshi by road.

name: 上冯古村
summaryEn: A hillside village in Jinhu subdistrict, Daye, nicknamed the village of the 'nine ancients' for its surviving old houses, paths, trees, wells and ancestral halls; local accounts date it to the late Yuan dynasty, some 600 years ago. About forty old houses with grey walls, dark tiles and stepped gables stand among stone paths and wells, a stone forest and a small mountain pond lie in the hills behind, and the village is on China's list of traditional villages. A walk-through scenic show called 'Shangfeng You Xi', a market street and other performances were added for visitors, and the area was rated 4A in December 2025.
description: 上冯古村位于湖北黄石。游览特色包括石林、古村落。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jinhu subdistrict, about 5 km south of the centre of Daye, which is about 20 km south-west of central Huangshi.

name: 仙岛湖
summaryEn: A reservoir lake in the northern foothills of the Mufu Mountains, once marketed as Qiandao ('Thousand Island') Lake, with about 1,002 wooded islands scattered across roughly 30 km² of water. The hills around it are well wooded, and local sights include relics linked to the Tang poet Luo Binwang, who is said to have retired here, and a Ming-dynasty bell. It is a provincial scenic area and tourist resort, and suits a day trip from Huangshi or Wuhan.
description: 仙岛湖位于湖北黄石。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wangying town, Yangxin County, about 140 km from Wuhan by road, close to national highways 106 and 107.

name: 沼山古村桃乡
summaryEn: A rural-tourism area built around Zhaoshan village in Bao'an town, known for its 'gouxue' (blood) peach, with nearly 3,500 mu (about 230 ha) of groves in the village itself that blossom in spring and fruit in summer. Visitors also come for a coffee shop, a plant-dye shop and an immersive water-borne evening show, 'In Peach Blossom Land', staged in the village, and for the rapeseed, plum and chrysanthemum fields of neighbouring villages. It was rated 4A in 2024 and suits a relaxed half day out of Daye or Huangshi.
description: 沼山古村桃乡位于湖北黄石。游览特色包括古村落、田园观光、村落风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Bao'an town in the west of Daye, roughly 25 km west of Daye city centre.

name: 极客公园
summaryEn: An aviation-themed park inside the iFlyer (Aifeike) Aviation Town in Jingmen's Zhanghe New Area, described as an aircraft museum. The collection of Chinese-built aircraft and models runs from the CJ-6 trainer to the J-20 fighter and includes real airframes such as a Shuihong-5 flying boat and a Y-5 transport. The town around it also offers wind-tunnel flying and light-aircraft flights, and the park is a regular stop for school study tours, so it suits families and aviation fans.
description: 极客公园位于湖北荆门。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the south-western edge of Jingmen in the Zhanghe New Area, roughly 20 minutes by road from the city centre.

name: 黄仙洞
summaryEn: A karst cave in Kedian town, on the Dahong Mountain side of Zhongxiang, about 2.6 km long and known for a large hall of rimstone pools and other stalactite formations. The rimstone pools cover about two hectares, and a small traditional village, Shuimeiping, stands on the hill above the cave. It suits visitors who like caves and a day in the hills.
description: 黄仙洞位于湖北荆门。游览特色包括洞穴、喀斯特地貌、传统村落。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Kedian town, about 45 km north-east of Zhongxiang town, roughly an hour by road.

name: 汇源农谷体验园
summaryEn: An agricultural experience park inside Dakou National Forest Park in Zhongxiang, certified as a 4A scenic area in July 2020. Its attractions are a space-agriculture exhibition hall, a creative fruit-and-vegetable farm, a science demonstration centre, small vegetable plots, a livestock and grain experience zone and a traditional games area. It is pitched at families and school groups as an outdoor classroom on nature and farming.
description: 汇源农谷体验园位于湖北荆门。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光、农业体验。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Inside Dakou National Forest Park in Zhongxiang, reached by road from Zhongxiang town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 荆门园博园
summaryEn: A landscaped park of about 140 hectares in south-west Jingmen, built on a former coal-mine subsidence area and construction-waste landfill and opened in April 2022 as the main venue of the third Hubei Garden Expo. It was laid out among hills and a lake with 32 show gardens from the expo's participating cities and other bodies, including Jingmen's own garden, a Wuhan garden and a Shennongjia garden, plus a flower valley planted above the mined-out ground. It suits a few hours of easy strolling and garden-viewing rather than a heritage visit.
description: 荆门园博园位于湖北荆门。游览特色包括湖泊、山谷、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the south-western side of Jingmen, about 3 to 4 km from the city centre, so a short taxi ride.

name: 彭墩乡村世界
summaryEn: A rural-tourism site in and around Pengdun village in Shipai town, built around modern farming and village life. It includes village scenery, farmers' housing, a farmers' park, six agricultural bases and an old-town-style quarter. It suits a relaxed countryside outing rather than sightseeing.
description: 彭墩乡村世界位于湖北荆门。游览特色包括田园观光、农业体验、历史街区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Pengdun village, Shipai town, a rural area of Zhongxiang, reached by road from Zhongxiang town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 圣境山
summaryEn: A hill and woodland eco-tourism area on the edge of Jingmen, best known for paragliding, with launch points, a large purpose-built landing ground and a training base that runs multi-day courses. It has hosted international paragliding competitions, and walking routes follow old paths through older woods across just over 5 square kilometres. It opened to visitors in 2019 and suits active day trips and anyone who wants to watch or try paragliding.
description: 圣境山位于湖北荆门。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dongbao District, about 10 km north-north-west of central Jingmen, roughly 10 minutes by road.

name: 太子山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park in the hills of south-western Jingshan, with wooded walking trails. It suits a half day of walking in woodland.
description: 太子山国家森林公园位于湖北荆门。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In south-western Jingshan, about 23 km west-south-west of Jingshan town and about 10 km north of the Qujialing site. Check that it is open before going.

name: 楚王车马阵
summaryEn: Xiongjiazhong is an Eastern Zhou burial ground of the Chu state, with a main earth mound 16 m high, a companion tomb about half its size and 40 chariot-and-horse pits. An exhibition hall about 133 m long covers Pit 1, 132.6 m long, where the 43 chariots and 164 horses excavated so far are laid facing west. The occupant is unconfirmed, with one proposal naming King Zhao or King Hui of Chu, and the site park is also called the Xiongjiazhong National Archaeological Site Park.
description: 楚王车马阵位于湖北荆州。游览特色包括主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Chuandian town, about 35 km north of Jingzhou old town, by car or taxi.

name: 洪湖湿地生态旅游区
summaryEn: This lakeside leisure area of more than 4,400 mu (about 290 ha) on the eastern shore of Hong Lake, at the edge of Honghu city, centres on a 1,500-mu wetland garden of flowers, aquatic plants and reed marsh. The Honghu tourist port, with 102 berths, runs boats onto the lake, and the area also has a lakeside hotel, a greenway, camping and fishing grounds and red-themed walking routes and a water-stage play on the Honghu story. Flowers bloom in spring, lotus in summer and wintering birds can be seen in the cold months.
description: 洪湖湿地生态旅游区位于湖北荆州。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Jinwan Avenue on the east shore of Hong Lake, a few kilometres from the centre of Honghu city.

name: 湘鄂西苏区革命烈士陵园
summaryEn: This memorial park on the Yangtze embankment in the south-west of Honghu city is built around the Hunan–West Hubei Soviet martyrs' cemetery and memorial hall, a nationally protected martyrs' memorial site of more than 350 mu (about 23 ha). It records the Communist-led revolutionary base that grew up around Hong Lake around 1930–32 under leaders including He Long, with a monument, a martyrs' shrine, an exhibition hall and a statue of He Long. A memorial park to the 1998 flood-fighting effort and a riverside park lie alongside, between the Yangtze and the lake.
description: 湘鄂西苏区革命烈士陵园位于湖北荆州。游览特色包括湖泊、纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the south-west of Honghu city on the north bank of the Yangtze, reached by road from Wuhan (more than 100 km north-east) or from Jingzhou.

name: 荆州园博园
summaryEn: This park was built for Hubei's second garden expo, held here from 28 September to 28 November 2019, and has stayed open as a public park since. It was laid out with 45 show gardens (17 from Hubei's cities and prefectures, 11 from counties and 17 by garden designers), a main exhibition hall and a water-town landscape of ponds and channels. It lies in the Jinan area close to the site of the ancient Chu capital, and suits an easy half day of garden-walking.
description: 荆州园博园位于湖北荆州。游览特色包括园林景观、主题展览、城市公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Jinan area north of Jingzhou old town, near the ancient Chu capital site, by taxi or car.

name: 荆州海洋世界
summaryEn: Jingzhou Ocean World is a marine-themed leisure park in Shashi District, open since 2016, with an aquarium (the Undersea Park) and a separate summer water park, both refurbished and reopened on 18 June 2026. The aquarium has polar, Yangtze river and shore-combing play zones, with staged shows including a dolphin meet-and-greet, a mermaid performance and a parade. It suits families with children rather than anyone looking for local heritage.
description: 荆州海洋世界位于湖北荆州。游览特色包括水族展览、水上游乐、公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Shashi urban area of Jingzhou, on Tiangu Avenue at its junction with National Road 318, by taxi from central Jingzhou.

name: 桃源小镇
summaryEn: Taoyuan Town is a purpose-built countryside leisure complex at the foot of Lujiao Peak in Taohuashan town, developed by a Hubei provincial culture-and-tourism group on about 325 hectares (4,873 mu). It is laid out as the peak area plus three themed zones, named for flower fields, a peach-blossom village and a rice-field village, with 24 sights in all, and takes its theme from the Chinese 'peach-blossom land' ideal. The surrounding Taohua Mountain range is known locally for its spring blossom, which is the best time to go.
description: 桃源小镇位于湖北荆州。游览特色包括花卉观赏、赏花。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Taohuashan town, about 30 km east of Shishou city.

name: 卸甲坪
summaryEn: Xiejiaping is the only Tujia ethnic township in Jingzhou, set in hills rising to 815 m on the Hunan border at the far south-west of Songzi, with a tourist area planned at about 5,300 mu (some 350 hectares). The sights mix scenery and Tujia culture: the Ming-Qing Huanglin bridge and a cluster of stilt houses, a canyon with waterfalls and karst scenery, a hot-spring area at Quchihe, and a Tujia folk museum and folk-custom street, with local Tujia folk songs and hand-waving dances. According to legend the name, roughly 'Armour-off Flat', comes from the Three Kingdoms general Guan Yu taking off his armour here.
description: 卸甲坪位于湖北荆州。游览特色包括博物馆、瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 50 km by road from Songzi's urban area and about 110 km from Jingzhou.

name: 悦兮半岛
summaryEn: Yuexi Peninsula is a hot-spring resort in Wulin town, Honghu, built around mineral water drawn from about 2,000 m underground at about 76 °C and a large column-free glass-and-steel indoor spring hall. Guests stay in the on-site hotel, some rooms opening straight onto outdoor pools, and the grounds also have a summer water park. It is a leisure resort rather than a sightseeing or heritage stop, suited to an overnight or half-day break from Wuhan.
description: 悦兮半岛位于湖北荆州。游览特色包括水上游乐、休闲度假。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wulin town, Honghu, about 85 km from central Wuhan by the Han-Hong expressway.

name: 红坪画廊
summaryEn: A mountain valley area around Hongping town in central Shennongjia, at about 1,600 m, known as Hongping Gallery after a series of paintings by the artist Zhang Bu and popular with painters and photographers. The Gallery Valley section has a 'pearl curtain' waterfall whose flow changes with the seasons and a narrow cleft, the 'line of sky', with 499 stone steps and about 200 m of height difference. Autumn colour and cloud are its main draws, and it combines easily with nearby Tianyan.
description: 红坪画廊位于湖北神农架。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Hongping town in central Shennongjia, a few kilometres from Tianyan and reached by road from Songbai or Muyu.

name: 神农天池
summaryEn: A commercially run valley park at Shennongjia's northern entrance, opened in 2014 as Batao Yuan and renamed Shennong Tianchi in 2023. Local legend calls it Emperor Yan's orchard, and the name Batao refers to the wild Ba walnut trees that still grow here; streams, pools and marshy meadows run through Qinling fir forest around a giant fir known as Jiulong Shensha, and the developed area of about 8 km² has an RV and camping ground, a forest adventure park and a winter snow park. It is more a leisure park than wilderness, and suits an easy half day on the way in or out of Shennongjia.
description: 神农天池位于湖北神农架。游览特色包括果园、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Honghuaduo village, Songbai town, at the northern gateway to Shennongjia, reached by road from Songbai town and Shennongjia railway station. The park announced a temporary closure on 12 August 2026 because of heavy rain, so check that it has reopened before going.

name: 天燕景区
summaryEn: A forest and mountain-pass scenic area in central Shennongjia, named for Yanzi Ya ('Swallow Pass') in the north and Tianmen Ya ('Heaven's Gate Pass') in the south, the latter the highest point of the G209 highway through the area. Highlights are primeval forest, sea-of-cloud and 'Buddha's light' effects at the passes, a high bridge over Yanzi Ya and a cave said to shelter tens of thousands of swiftlets, and the Shennongjia government counts more than 2,400 plant and 200 animal species here. The area is tied to local lore of the 'wild man' (Yeren) and to the Han epic 'Heian Zhuan' (Book of Darkness), and takes about two hours.
description: 天燕景区位于湖北神农架。游览特色包括林地风光、洞穴。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Hongping town in central Shennongjia, reached along the G209 highway from Songbai or Muyu.

name: 百龙潭
summaryEn: A wooded stream valley with a canyon walkway on the western edge of Shiyan, in Zhangwan District. Local tourism pages describe running streams, dense greenery and shaded paths, and it is promoted as a cool place to walk in summer. A short outing for people already in Shiyan rather than a reason to come to the region.
description: 百龙潭位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括峡谷、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Zhangwan District on the western side of Shiyan, a short drive from the city centre.

name: 沧浪海
summaryEn: A lakeside leisure area and boat landing on Danjiangkou Reservoir, in the new district at the edge of Danjiangkou city. Most visitors come for a boat trip on the reservoir; the memorial park for the South-to-North Water Diversion Project stands close by. A low-key stop for people already in Danjiangkou city, best combined with the dam and the memorial park.
description: 沧浪海位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括水库、湖泊、乘船游览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Wudang Avenue in the new town district on the shore of Danjiangkou Reservoir, within the built-up area of Danjiangkou city.

name: 东沟红色旅游景区
summaryEn: A red-tourism area in Donggou village, Maota township, in the hills south of Shiyan, centred on a restored Ming–Qing house that holds the Central Plains Breakout (Northwest Hubei) History Memorial Hall. Local sources say the Red Third Army under He Long was active in the area in 1931, and that in 1946 forces that had broken out of the Central Plains under Li Xiannian and Wang Shusheng set up a Communist-led county government here. As of 2020 the hall had about a dozen exhibition rooms and some 120 relics, and the grounds also have an old theatre stage, a village schoolhouse, a martyrs' cemetery, flower gardens and craft workshops.
description: 东沟红色旅游景区位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括纪念展览、红色文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Donggou village, Maota township, on the southern outskirts of Shiyan city, a short drive from the centre.

name: 汉江绿谷
summaryEn: A leisure area of about 6 km² in Anyang town, Yunyang, with a herb garden of about 330 hectares, a flower field on the water of over 60 hectares, more than 200 hectares of grassland and three themed 'manor' areas. Activities include fishing, barbecue and camping, go-karts, high-level swings and water play, with some twenty rides in all. It is also a national water-conservancy scenic area and a soil-conservation demonstration park.
description: 汉江绿谷位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括草原、花卉观赏、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Qinglong village, Anyang town, about 20 km east of Yunyang town and roughly 30 km north-east of central Shiyan as the crow flies.

name: 红甘苹橘海
summaryEn: A commercial 'smart orchard' beside Danjiangkou Reservoir in Junxian town, run by the Honggan Ping company and rated 4A as an agri-tourism site. Visitors walk a viewing corridor that shows the sensors and data used to manage the citrus groves, pick fruit and join study visits on automated crop protection and harvesting. It suits families and anyone curious about Danjiangkou's citrus industry.
description: 红甘苹橘海位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括水库、田园观光、果园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Junxian town on the north-western shore of Danjiangkou Reservoir, about 40 km west of the centre of Danjiangkou city.

name: 虎啸滩
summaryEn: A river-gorge scenic area on the Baiquan River in Baiquan village, Daliu township, named 'Tiger Roar Shoal' for the sound of the water pounding the rocks. About thirty natural and cultural sights are strung along the valley, including cliffs, stepped waterfalls, a chain of pools, caves such as the White Tiger Cave and the ruins of an old temple to the Wood Dragon. It is noticeably cooler than Shiyan city in summer, so it is mostly visited then.
description: 虎啸滩位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Baiquan village, about 20 minutes' drive from Daliu township, which lies roughly 20 km north of Yunyang town.

name: 静乐宫
summaryEn: A Taoist palace complex on the north shore of Jingle Lake, at the north-eastern edge of Danjiangkou city. It is a reconstruction, built between 2000 and 2006, of the Ming-dynasty Jingle Palace, founded in 1418 in old Junzhou and counted as the first of the Wudang Mountains' great palaces, which went under water when Danjiangkou Reservoir filled in 1967. Some 830 relics, including an archway and a tortoise-borne stele, were moved to higher ground beforehand, so the halls are new; the complex is a working Taoist site that held an ordination programme in 2023.
description: 静乐宫位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north-eastern edge of Danjiangkou city, a few kilometres from the centre by taxi.

name: 郧阳九龙瀑
summaryEn: A gorge scenic area in Nanhuatang town, Yunyang district, named 'Nine Dragons Falls' for the series of waterfalls along its stream; the district lists its core area as about 18 km². Walking paths follow the stream between cliffs, pools and woodland. In summer a 2.5 km rafting course runs through the gorge, and a cliff-side sightseeing car and bamboo-raft rides are also on offer.
description: 郧阳九龙瀑位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Nanhuatang town, about 34 km north of Yunyang town as the crow flies, reached by road.

name: 郧西龙潭河
summaryEn: A waterfall and gorge scenic area in Yangwei town, run as a provincial forest park and geopark, with more than sixty sights, over forty of them connected with waterfalls. The route takes in a flight of more than 80 cascades, including the Great Dragon Falls (Dalongpu). A traditional paper-making workshop is also on the route.
description: 郧西龙潭河位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yangwei town, about 30 km south-west of Yunxi county town as the crow flies.

name: 女娲山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in Baofeng town built around the legend of Nüwa, the goddess who in Chinese myth mended the sky and made the first people. Visitors climb to pray for blessings and hear the Nüwa stories, and the summit looks over a sea of cloud, and sometimes the sunrise, when the weather allows. An immersive intangible-heritage hall in the grounds shows more than 200 craft and folk-art items from over ten local categories.
description: 女娲山位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括山地游览、登山观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Baofeng town, about 23 km north-west of Zhushan town as the crow flies, reached by road from Zhushan or Shiyan.

name: 青龙山恐龙蛋化石群国家地质公园
summaryEn: A national geopark in Liupi town protecting a field of Cretaceous dinosaur eggs left where they were laid, with at least 300,000 eggs estimated, which state media describe as the largest known in-situ concentration. Visitors see the fossils and exhibition panels, and the park has added smart-glasses and hologram displays showing dinosaurs hatching. It is popular with family and school groups.
description: 青龙山恐龙蛋化石群国家地质公园位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括地质景观、化石遗迹。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Liupi town, about 9 km west of Yunyang town, reached by road from Yunyang or Shiyan.

name: 上津古城
summaryEn: A compact walled town on the east bank of the Jinqian River, close to the Shaanxi border, roughly 400 by 300 metres with walls about 7 m high, and known locally as the 'Emperor's Ferry' for its river crossing on the way towards Xi'an. The walls were begun in 1368, at the start of the Ming, and fully repaired in 1802, although the national listing dates the town to the Qing; visitors can walk on the wall, see the Shanxi–Shaanxi guildhall and an old street in Ming and Qing style, and take a boat trip on the river. Shangjin was named a national historic and cultural town in 2007.
description: 上津古城位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括古城、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Shangjin town on the Shaanxi border, about 40 km west-north-west of Yunxi county town as the crow flies.

name: 十堰市博物馆
summaryEn: The municipal museum of Shiyan, a national second-grade museum in the city centre close to Beijing North Road. Its displays cover dinosaurs, early humans (including replicas of the Yunxian Man skulls, Homo erectus fossils roughly a million years old found at Xuetangliangzi in Yunyang District), the Wudang Mountains, the Danjiangkou reservoir and Shiyan's car industry, plus finds from the South-to-North Water Diversion reservoir area. Worth an hour for anyone interested in the human and natural history of the Shiyan area.
description: 十堰市博物馆位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括博物馆、水库。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Shiyan (Maojian District), on Beijing North Road, reached by taxi or city bus. Closed on Mondays.

name: 桃花岛夯土小镇
summaryEn: A modern rural tourism town in Shuiping town, built in rammed-earth style from about 2018 and called Peach Blossom Island (Taohuadao); its Chinese name, Hangtu Xiaozhen, means 'rammed-earth town'. Its offer is built around health and wellness, including herbal-medicine meals and daoyin exercise sessions, and it has been named one of China's intangible-heritage tourism towns. Local itineraries often pair it with the Longwangya tea gardens.
description: 桃花岛夯土小镇位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括岛屿、田园观光、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xiangjiahui village, Shuiping town, about 10 km east of Zhuxi town by road.

name: 郧西天河
summaryEn: A riverside scenic area on the Tianhe at the southern edge of Yunxi county town, built around the county's Qixi (Double Seventh) culture, which is on China's national list of intangible cultural heritage. Features include Xuanguguan, a temple complex in traditional style laid out with a lake, caves, bridges, pavilions and halls, and Cherry Blossom Valley, planted with cherry trees around small bridges and pavilions. The county has also rebuilt an old street as the Qixi Sky Street, with immersive projection performances.
description: 郧西天河位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Chengguan town, on the southern edge of Yunxi county town, a short drive from the centre.

name: 天河口
summaryEn: The place where the Tianhe ('Heavenly River') flows into the Han, in Guanyin town, linked by local tradition to the Qixi (Double Seventh) legend of the cowherd and the weaver girl. The 4A area, about 1.7 km² and rated in December 2025, is a recent development with a wetland park, a riverside loop, a lion-head cliff viewpoint, a visitor centre, farmstays and an RV campsite. Yunxi's Qixi tradition is on China's national list of intangible cultural heritage.
description: 天河口位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括湿地、滨水景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Guanyin town, about 15 km from Yunxi county town, with local bus routes running to it and an exit of the Shiyan–Wushan expressway 7.6 km away.

name: 武当大明峰
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in Guanshan town, west of the Wudang Mountains' main peak, which Shiyan's tourism commission puts at about 1,316 m in height and roughly 39 sq km in area. It has a cliff-side plank walkway, a narrow 'strip of sky' gorge and the 'South Heavenly Gate' viewpoint, plus a glass skywalk, a cliff swing, zip lines and via ferrata climbing. A newer, activity-led area that gained its 4A rating in 2023, it suits active visitors with a car more than temple-hunters.
description: 武当大明峰位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括峡谷、山地游览、栈道。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Guanshan town in the west of Danjiangkou, reached only by road, so a car or taxi from Wudangshan town or Shiyan is the practical way.

name: 武当山快乐谷
summaryEn: A commercial adventure and amusement park in a wooded river valley in the Wudang Special Zone, about 5 km from the entrance of the Wudang Mountains scenic area and next to Taiji Lake. The special zone's tourism bureau lists a 75 m bungee jump, a rafting course of about 5.8 km, zip lines, a cliff swing and go-karts, plus a children's area with a dozen or so rides. It suits families and groups who want a lively half day alongside a trip to the Wudang temples; it is not a heritage visit.
description: 武当山快乐谷位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括湖泊、主题游乐、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Wudang Special Zone at the foot of the Wudang Mountains, close to Taiji Lake; Wudangshan town, which has its own high-speed rail station, is the usual base.

name: 武当山南神道
summaryEn: A walking-oriented scenic area on the south-western flank of the Wudang Mountains in Guanshan town, on the old pilgrim route by which worshippers from Sichuan, Shaanxi and western Hubei once came to Wudang. Danjiangkou's tourism bureau describes a route of about 20 km along the Jiudao River with plank walkways, streams and rocky peaks, strung with the Lüjiahe folk-song village, the former headquarters of the Red Third Army and rock features such as 'Two Dragons Playing with a Pearl' and 'Dragon-Slaying Cliff'. Known locally as Wudang's 'back garden', it suits visitors who want the countryside and hiking side of Wudang rather than the main temples.
description: 武当山南神道位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括栈道、宗教文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Guanshan town on the south-western side of the Wudang Mountains, reached by road, so a car or taxi from Wudangshan town or Danjiangkou is the practical way.

name: 野人洞·野人谷
summaryEn: A limestone cave and a wooded gorge about 25 km south of Fangxian county town, named after local 'wild man' (yeren) stories; the best known tells of a farmer's encounter at the cave mouth in 1974. The cave has two levels joined by an artificial stairway, with varied stalactite formations lit by coloured lights, and stays cool in summer; the valley beside it has a long gorge with cliff-side walkways and a lake with boats. The wild man is folklore rather than a confirmed species, and the area is promoted mainly as a summer retreat.
description: 野人洞·野人谷位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括峡谷、洞穴、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 25 km south of Fangxian county town on the G209 national road; Fangxian itself is about 65 km south of Shiyan as the crow flies.

name: 赛武当云龙谷
summaryEn: A large mountain-resort development in the Sai Wudang hills south of central Shiyan, in Maojian District, planned over about 24 km² in three phases with wellness, hot-spring, family-study, mountain-sports and folk-culture zones. Sai Wudang, also called Fulong Mountain, takes its name from a main peak that stands about 118 m higher than Wudang's Tianzhu Peak. The district lists the resort as partly open on a trial basis, and a folk-customs museum and a science museum there are stops on a Maojian tourist bus route.
description: 景区位于十堰茅箭区的赛武当山区，依托山谷地形发展山地休闲游览。
accessEn: In the hills of Maojian District, about 20 km south of central Shiyan as the crow flies. Part of the resort is still in trial operation, so check what is open before going.

name: 竹山绿松石文化旅游区
summaryEn: A themed cultural-tourism complex in Zhushan county town, between the Du and Huo rivers, built around turquoise, which is mined in several counties of north-west Hubei including Zhushan, and around local legends and history, from the Nüwa myth to the ancient Yong state and the Peach Blossom Spring story. The county describes it as one core, one street, one district and one waterside corridor, with staged performances, commercial space and river-front walks. It was rated a national 4A area only in December 2025.
description: 竹山绿松石文化旅游区位于湖北十堰。游览特色包括民间传说、赏花。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Chengguan, the county town of Zhushan, about 1.5 hours by road from Shiyan.

name: 抱朴谷
summaryEn: A wellness resort of about 12 km² in forested hills at the head of the Huai River, on the Hubei–Henan border. It is built around traditional Chinese medicine, with a clinic offering herbal baths, moxibustion and massage, plus forest cabins, guesthouses and walking routes. Local descriptions also mention Xinyi Zhai, a hill stockade dated to the Song dynasty, and a waterfall; it was rated 4A in December 2023.
description: 抱朴谷位于湖北随州。游览特色包括瀑布、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xierdaohe village, Huaihe town, in the Tongbai Mountains of northern Sui County, roughly 60 km north of Suizhou city in a straight line, so plan on driving.

name: 新四军第五师司令部旧址
summaryEn: In June 1940 the headquarters of the New Fourth Army's Hubei–Henan force moved into the Sun family compound at Jiukouyan, a Qing-dynasty courtyard house built in 1733 with 56 rooms in a three-hall, two-courtyard layout, and the Fifth Division was formally established there on 5 April 1941 under Li Xiannian. The compound is now a memorial museum showing the headquarters' offices and living quarters, and the village has further wartime sites, among them a branch of the Anti-Japanese Military and Political University, a newspaper office and an arsenal, plus a memorial garden opened in 2015. The village is also a listed traditional village.
description: 新四军第五师司令部旧址位于湖北随州。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Jiukouyan village, Luoyang town, about 40 km south of central Suizhou by road and a short drive from the Luoyang exit of the Hankou–Shiyan expressway.

name: 高贵三潭
summaryEn: A forest park and provincial scenic area on the Hubei–Henan border at the foot of the old Pingjing Pass, known for its waterfalls and pools (the 'three pools' of the name), the summit of Dagui Mountain and a grove of qingtan (wingceltis) trees of more than 2,000 mu that local officials bill as the largest in China. It also has the old pass road with a surviving beacon tower, Yang Gong Ridge (named for the Ming official Yang Lian, a native of the area) and Longpa Zhai, a hill fortress protected at provincial level. It became Guangshui's first 4A scenic area in 2023.
description: 高贵三潭位于湖北随州。游览特色包括瀑布、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Caihe town on the Hubei–Henan border, reached by road from Guangshui city and about 150 km from Wuhan. Check that it is open before going.

name: 西游记公园
summaryEn: A large leisure resort themed on the novel Journey to the West, covering about 260 hectares in the hills near Dahong Mountain. It combines hot-spring pools, a zoo, a glass bridge, a rose field and themed play areas with more than 800 hotel and cabin rooms on site. It suits families and groups on a leisure break rather than sightseers.
description: 西游记公园位于湖北随州。游览特色包括动物观赏、玻璃栈道、休闲度假。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Hongshan town on the north side of the Dahong Mountain area, about 50 km west of central Suizhou in a straight line, so allow an hour or more by road.

name: 西游记漂流
summaryEn: A rafting run of about 9 km down the Longtan stream in the Tongbai Mountains, with nine bends and more than 30 rapids over about two and a half to three hours, ending close to the expressway exit at Huaihe. Rafting is in four-person boats and runs only in summer, typically from late June to early September.
description: 西游记漂流位于湖北随州。游览特色包括水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Longquan village in Huaihe town, northern Sui County, roughly 70 km north of central Suizhou in a straight line, with the finish about 1.5 km from the Huaihe exit of the expressway.

name: 神农部落
summaryEn: A theme park in the Tongbai Mountains built around rock carvings that county officials present as prehistoric images of the legendary farmer-god Shennong, a sun god and a three-legged sun bird. Visitors walk through sacrificial gardens to the sun and the moon, a stone-carving area and a garden themed on a supposed Shennong script, in a development first rated AAA in 2021. It is best treated as a cultural theme park; the dating and interpretation of the carvings come from the local authorities.
description: 神农部落位于湖北随州。游览特色包括主题游乐、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Longquan village in Huaihe town, northern Sui County, roughly 65 km north of central Suizhou in a straight line and near the Huaihe exit of the expressway; it closed for an upgrade in September 2022 and was later rated 4A (December 2024), so check that it is open before going.

name: 随州文化公园
summaryEn: A large landscaped park in the eastern part of Suizhou, laid out around the city's cultural themes: the legendary farmer-god Shennong, the Zeng chime bells, the Spring and Autumn minister Ji Liang (whose statue stands partway up the hillside) and the Sui dynasty, which took its name from the city. It is a quiet city park rather than a major sight, and city itineraries pair it with the Suizhou Museum and the Marquis Yi tomb site.
description: 随州文化公园位于湖北随州。游览特色包括博物馆、城市公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the eastern side of Suizhou, about 3 km from the city centre, so a short taxi ride.

name: 千年银杏谷
summaryEn: A valley of ancient ginkgo trees strung along about 12 km of five villages in Luoyang town, with around 300 trees more than a thousand years old. The leaves turn gold from mid-October to late November, which is the main season. After a year-long closure for rebuilding, it reopened in December 2024 and the resort district held its formal opening in July 2025, with new visitor facilities and guesthouses.
description: 千年银杏谷位于湖北随州。游览特色包括山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Luoyang town, Zengdu district, about 40 km south of central Suizhou by road, along a line of villages that includes Jiukouyan.

name: 田王寨
summaryEn: A hill fortress of stone walls that follow nine hilltops on Gucheng Mountain in the Tongbai range, with gates and beacon towers; local accounts date it to the end of the Song or the Yuan period. It is a provincially protected relic, billed as the best-preserved stockade of its kind in central China, and part of the Hubei section of the Long March National Cultural Park, with displays on the Red 25th Army's Taibai meeting during the Long March. Cliff walls and a waterfall add a scenic side for those who like hill walking.
description: 田王寨位于湖北随州。游览特色包括城堡、村寨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Tongbai Mountains of northern Sui County, near the Taibaiding scenic area and roughly 65 km north of central Suizhou in a straight line, so plan on a long drive.

name: 炎帝神农故里
summaryEn: A memorial park at Lishan, which Suizhou promotes as the birthplace of Yandi (Shennong), the legendary farmer-god and herbalist. Its core area of about 3.4 km² has more than 60 sights, among them the Shennong Cave said to be his birthplace, a statue of Yandi, an ancestor-worship plaza, the Yandi hall and a herb garden. Ceremonies are held each year around his traditional birthday on the 26th day of the fourth lunar month, and the Suizhou rite is on China's national intangible heritage list.
description: 炎帝神农故里位于湖北随州。游览特色包括名人故居、园林景观、洞穴。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Lishan town, Sui County, about 18 km from central Suizhou by road.

name: 茶圣故里园
summaryEn: A memorial park in the old town of Tianmen, ancient Jingling, honouring Lu Yu, the Tang-dynasty author of the Classic of Tea, who is revered as the Sage of Tea and was born in the town. It gathers sites linked to his memory, among them a pavilion named for him, Wenxue (Literary) Spring and the ancient Wild Goose Bridge. It suits visitors interested in tea history and a gentle walk through the old town.
description: 茶圣故里园位于湖北天门。游览特色包括楼阁建筑、历史街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the old town of Tianmen, on and around Xisi Road near West Pagoda Temple.

name: 大余湾
summaryEn: A hillside village at the foot of Mulan Mountain, founded in the early Ming dynasty by the Yu family from Wuyuan in Jiangxi, with dozens of Ming and Qing houses in Jiangxi style, horse-head gables and stone-paved lanes; it is a China Historic and Cultural Village. It is run as a scenic area with folk shows such as shadow puppets, puppet plays and bronze-bell music, and each autumn crops are laid out on the roofs for a drying festival.
description: 大余湾位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括历史建筑、节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At the foot of Mulan Mountain in Mulan township, Huangpi district, about an hour by road from central Wuhan, usually reached by car or on a tour.

name: 凤娃古寨
summaryEn: A cultural-tourism complex in Fenghuang town, Xinzhou District, billed as a cluster of Ming and Qing-style buildings, with antique and folk-custom displays, leisure facilities and local food. In the evenings and at festivals it runs light shows, a fireworks theatre and folk performances, including a staged 'tossing the embroidered ball' wedding-choice show at one of its towers. It is a commercial attraction that suits families and day-trippers wanting a half-day out from Wuhan.
description: 凤娃古寨位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括节庆文化、村寨、戏剧演艺。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Fenghuang town in Wuhan's Xinzhou District, roughly 60 km north-east of central Wuhan by road, beside the G318 highway.

name: 武汉花博汇
summaryEn: A flower-themed leisure town in Caidian's Sino-French Eco-City, near Houguan Lake national wetland park, with a planned area of 5,300 mu (about 350 hectares). It combines flower fields with rural-experience activities, children's entertainment and holiday stays, and since 2024 has run an immersive evening walk with light projections, live performances and fire shows. It is a commercial, family-oriented attraction.
description: 武汉花博汇位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Sino-French Eco-City area of Daji subdistrict, Caidian district, in the south-west of Wuhan, reached by car or taxi.

name: 花乡茶谷
summaryEn: A tea-plantation leisure area on Honggang Mountain in Caijiazha subdistrict, Huangpi, which was rated 4A in 2022. The tea hills are planted with plum, cherry and other blossom, drawing most visitors from late winter to spring, and the park holds poetry-and-tea events through the year, including a poetry festival held since 2017. It is a commercial park suited to a relaxed half day.
description: 花乡茶谷位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括节庆文化、赏花。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Caijiazha subdistrict of Huangpi district, in the east of the district, about 50 km north of central Wuhan, usually reached by car.

name: 锦鲤土司城
summaryEn: A leisure park themed on Tujia and Miao culture in the hills of northern Huangpi, built in the style of a tusi (hereditary chieftain) fortress town with stilt houses rather than as a historic site. Its main attraction is a rafting course of several kilometres that combines an elevated glass section with a canyon section, and it also has waterfall viewpoints, a splash plaza and folk shows. It is a commercial park, mainly for families and groups.
description: 锦鲤土司城位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、城堡。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Caidian subdistrict of northern Huangpi district (not Caidian district), an hour or more by road from central Wuhan, usually reached by car.

name: 金龙水寨
summaryEn: A lakeside leisure park beside Jinlong Lake in Caidian, planted with camellias, lotus, osmanthus and plum so that something is in flower in each season, and known for its lotus ponds, which can be toured by boat in summer. The district lists a waterfall, a long embankment path, a tea garden, an artificial beach, a deer-themed forest play area, a lotus-root museum and an equestrian club among its features. It suits casual family outings.
description: 金龙水寨位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括博物馆、瀑布、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the shore of Jinlong Lake in Suohe subdistrict, Caidian district, about 11 km west of Caidian town, reached by car or taxi. Check that it is open before going.

name: 九真山
summaryEn: A wooded range of nine linked peaks in Caidian whose main summit, at 276 m, is billed as the highest point on the Jianghan Plain; forest covers more than 90% of the scenic area. Trails pass the site of the Jiuzhen Daoist temple, said to have been founded in the Wei-Jin period and long since vanished, and a valley named for the woodcutter Zhong Ziqi of the Boya and Zhong Ziqi 'high mountains, flowing water' friendship legend. It is mainly a local day-walk and spring-outing spot.
description: 九真山位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Lufang village in Yong'an subdistrict of Caidian district, on the western side of Wuhan, reached by car or taxi.

name: 梁湖漫乡
summaryEn: Lianghu Manxiang is a countryside leisure park in Wulijie, in the south-east of Wuhan's Jiangxia District, run as a large farm resort with guesthouses and meeting rooms, picking and fishing, farm-life activities and bonfire evenings. Provincial media report that it has added a play area with equipment that needs no power, a camping ground and seasonal fruit picking, including mulberries. It is aimed mainly at families and school groups on short stays from the city rather than at sightseers.
description: 梁湖漫乡位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wulijie subdistrict of Jiangxia District, on Liangzi Lake Avenue in the south-east of Wuhan, reached by car.

name: 木兰花乡
summaryEn: A former old hamlet in Huangpi, renovated from the mid-2010s and opened as a scenic area in 2017, now a flower and night-tour destination with seasonal flower beds, an animal park, a tropical-plant garden, rides and a children's water park. 'Mulan Night City', a street built in Northern Wei style that opened in 2023, stages shows and light displays in the evening. It is a commercial, family-oriented attraction.
description: 木兰花乡位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括水上游乐、园林景观、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yaojiaji subdistrict of Huangpi district, about an hour by road from central Wuhan, usually reached by car.

name: 木兰清凉寨
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area of about 10 sq km in the hills of northern Huangpi, known for autumn foliage (a red-maple festival has run since 2015) and as a summer refuge from the city heat. Activities include a glass-bottomed rafting run, a glass walkway and a zip line, and a hillside guesthouse now keeps many visitors overnight. It is a commercial leisure area rather than a wilderness.
description: 木兰清凉寨位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括玻璃栈道、山地游览、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Caidian subdistrict of northern Huangpi district (not Caidian district), an hour or more by road from central Wuhan, usually reached by car.

name: 木兰胜天
summaryEn: A hill-ringed leisure area in Wangjiahe, Huangpi, developed from a former forest farm, with about 90% forest cover, streams, a waterfall and rock formations. Its main draw is the Forest Water Kingdom, a large summer water park with slides, a big pool, a sand beach and a long shaded rafting channel. It is a commercial park aimed at families and young groups.
description: 木兰胜天位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括瀑布、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wangjiahe subdistrict of Huangpi district, about an hour by road from central Wuhan, usually reached by car.

name: 木兰水镇
summaryEn: A military-themed leisure park in Wangjiahe, Huangpi, laid out beside a lake and river junction with the look of a Jiangnan water town rather than any historic fabric. Activities listed on the district and city pages include amphibious vehicle rides, off-road buggy rides, live-action CS-style games, jungle courses and field camping. Evening events have included molten-iron sparks and a lit bamboo dragon raft on the lake, so it suits families and groups looking for an activity day.
description: 木兰水镇位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括湖泊、水乡。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wangjiahe subdistrict of Huangpi district, about 40 km north of central Wuhan, usually reached by car.

name: 武钢文化旅游区
summaryEn: A tourism zone of about 6.1 square kilometres inside the working Wuhan Iron and Steel (WISCO) plant in Qingshan, which opened in February 2023. Its core is Blast Furnace 1, first tapped in September 1958 and retired in October 2019, now an industrial-heritage park with a history exhibition on the ground floor, a recreated casting floor above and a viewing platform, with the plant's rail lines beside it still in use. The furnace was listed as national industrial heritage in 2021, and the zone was named a national industrial-tourism demonstration site in 2023.
description: 武钢文化旅游区位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括观景台。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Qingshan district, east of central Wuhan, inside the working steelworks near the Yejin Avenue main gate; visits have been booked in advance through online platforms since the zone opened in February 2023, so check the current arrangements first.

name: 武汉规划展示馆
summaryEn: Wuhan Planning Exhibition Hall occupies the east wing of the Citizens' Home civic complex in northern Jiang'an and explains the city's history, growth and development plans over three floors. It has scale models, maps and multimedia displays, with sections on the city's history, the two-river four-bank waterfront, transport and the master plan, and since March 2023 a geology gallery with a relief model of Wuhan. It is an easy, indoor stop for anyone curious about how modern Wuhan is laid out.
description: 武汉规划展示馆位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括主题展览。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Citizens' Home complex on Jinqiao Avenue in northern Jiang'an, close to Citizens' Home station on Metro Line 3.

name: 武汉极地海洋度假区
summaryEn: An ocean-themed resort in Dongxihu District with aquarium displays, a polar-themed Ice Kingdom that uses animal models, and staged shows such as costumed mermaid performances and a penguin parade. Since July 2025 it has also had a 91 m Ferris wheel and a circus theatre with an ocean-themed big-top show. The complex includes a hotel, restaurants and a spa, and suits families with children looking for a day out.
description: 武汉极地海洋度假区位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括水族展览、戏剧演艺。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Jinyintan Avenue in Dongxihu District, about 10 km north of central Hankou by road.

name: 武汉野生动物王国
summaryEn: An animal-themed park on Wumei Mountain in Caidian, on a hill that was quarried until around 2000 and has since been replanted; it opened in December 2020. Animals include giraffes, zebras, camels and tigers, with animal parades by day and, since July 2026, evening sessions with shows and guided night visits. It is a commercial park aimed mainly at families with children.
description: 武汉野生动物王国位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhangwan subdistrict of Caidian district, on the western side of Wuhan, reached by car or taxi.

name: 姚家山
summaryEn: A mountain village on the Huangpi-Dawu border that served as the base of the New Fourth Army's Fifth Division, whose political and military organs were stationed there from the early 1940s until 1946 under Li Xiannian. Several preserved buildings, including the assembly hall in a clan shrine and former residences, form what the district describes as the only well-preserved group of revolutionary-era buildings in Wuhan, and a museum on the division opened in 2015. The valley also has stream-tracing and camping in summer.
description: 姚家山位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括名人故居、历史纪念。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Caidian subdistrict of northern Huangpi district (not Caidian district), about 90 km from central Wuhan, usually reached by car.

name: 野村谷
summaryEn: A family leisure valley in Wangjiahe, Huangpi, with rafting runs, a shallow stream with a stepped weir, and a paddling water park with water-bamboo beds and slides. The grounds also have an earth-art play area, rose beds, go-karts and camping, and an avenue of ginkgo trees that colours in autumn. It is a commercial park aimed at families with young children.
description: 野村谷位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括水上游乐、山谷、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wangjiahe subdistrict of Huangpi district, about an hour by road from central Wuhan, usually reached by car.

name: 知音文化旅游区
summaryEn: The Zhiyin Cultural Area is Wuhan's name for a group of sights in Hanyang built around the legend of Yu Boya and Zhong Ziqi, in which a guqin player found a friend who truly understood his music (a 'zhiyin'). State media describe it as one hill, one lake, one garden and one pavilion: Turtle Hill, Moon Lake, the Guqin Terrace garden and Qingchuan Pavilion. The Guqin Terrace, on the south shore of Moon Lake, is the core: a small garden of halls and courtyards around a white-marble platform said to be where Boya played, first built in the Northern Song and rebuilt in the Jiaqing era of the Qing.
description: 知音文化旅游区位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括湖泊、园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Hanyang on the west side of Turtle Hill beside Moon Lake, a short walk from Qintai metro station on Line 6 and about 4 km west of Yellow Crane Tower across the river.

name: 武汉紫薇都市田园
summaryEn: A countryside leisure park on Ziwei Ridge in Cangbu, Xinzhou District, opened in 2014 on former scrub slopes and known for plant weaving: sculptures and lettering made from living plants. In March 2024 it opened a wetland cherry garden of islands, bridges and boat rides, and it holds seasonal flower and folk festivals. It is a modern leisure attraction rather than a historic site, and it suits a half-day family outing from Wuhan.
description: 武汉紫薇都市田园位于湖北武汉。游览特色包括湿地、乘船游览、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Cangbu subdistrict of Xinzhou District, in the north-east of Wuhan, about an hour by car from the city centre.

name: 白水寺
summaryEn: A hilltop temple complex at Wudian, south of Zaoyang, commemorating Liu Xiu (Emperor Guangwu), founder of the Eastern Han dynasty, whose ancestral home is placed in this district. The scenic area gathers some twenty sights around Lion Hill and the Gun River, including the temple buildings, a stele gallery, old wells and a memorial pavilion at the source of the Baishui stream. It suits visitors interested in Han-dynasty history who are already in Zaoyang.
description: 白水寺位于湖北襄阳。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、楼阁建筑、寻根文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 15 km south of Zaoyang city, in Wudian town, reached by road.

name: 中国汉城
summaryEn: A Han-dynasty-style capital built in modern times on the eastern side of Zaoyang to honour Liu Xiu (Emperor Guangwu) and present Han culture; it is a themed attraction and film location, not a historic site. Visitors walk among its palace buildings and food and market streets, watch staged shows such as the imperial guard's city-opening welcome, and try craft demonstrations including traditional papermaking, movable-type printing and paper-cutting. It suits families and anyone wanting an easy introduction to Han culture, and in summer it also runs an evening programme.
description: 枣阳东部的仿汉古城围绕汉光武帝刘秀与汉代文化展开展示。
accessEn: On the eastern side of Zaoyang city, which lies about 60 km east of central Xiangyang as the crow flies and is reached by road.

name: 大薤山
summaryEn: A forested mountain in south-western Gucheng, run as a national forest park and holiday area, whose main peak, Daughter Peak, reaches about 1,099 m. Forest cover is above 90 percent and summers average about 22 °C, so it is promoted as a summer retreat. Its best-known feature is a group of more than fifty villas built between 1903 and 1910 by missionaries from eight countries, among them the building where a county soviet government was set up under He Long's Red Army in 1931.
description: 大薤山位于湖北襄阳。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In the mountains of south-western Gucheng county, about 40 km from Gucheng town by road.

name: 横冲
summaryEn: A high-mountain forest area on the main ridge of the Jing Mountains in Houping town, at about 1,700 m on average and rising to just under 1,950 m, so it stays cool in summer. The county lists forest paths, a blueberry-picking garden, log-cabin lodgings and, in winter, a ski field. It lies in the same township as Wudaoxia Gorge, so the two fit into one trip.
description: 横冲位于湖北襄阳。游览特色包括峡谷、园林景观、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the mountains of Houping town, reached by road from the town centre, where Baokang County station on the Zhengzhou–Wanzhou high-speed line lies; Baokang town is roughly 85 km west of Xiangyang. Check that it is open before going.

name: 黄家湾
summaryEn: A leisure area of about 9.8 km² on the western outskirts of Xiangyang's Xiangcheng district, which local tradition names as the birthplace of Huang Yueying, the wife of Zhuge Liang. The district government lists fishing, picnic and barbecue spots and active attractions such as grass-sliding and zip-lines. It suits families wanting an outdoor day out in the same western tourism belt as Longzhong rather than a historic site.
description: 黄家湾位于湖北襄阳。游览特色包括名人故居。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the western outskirts of Xiangyang, about 9 km from the old walled city, reached by road.

name: 九路寨
summaryEn: A karst mountain area in Xiema town, in the south of Baokang County, at about 1,200 m on average. The county lists limestone peaks such as Chuwang Peak, Candle Peak and Elephant Trunk Peak, Huanglong Cave, a glass suspension bridge and a cableway across the gorge.
description: 九路寨位于湖北襄阳。游览特色包括峡谷、喀斯特地貌、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xiema town in the far south of Baokang County, reached by road from Baokang town, which is roughly 85 km west of Xiangyang. Check that it is open before going.

name: 六柱垭
summaryEn: A high-mountain leisure area at up to about 1,500 m, built on reclaimed phosphate-mining land in Huanglongguan village, Maqiao town, and rated 4A in 2024. About 90 hillside B&Bs include 72 timber cabins named after the disciples of Confucius and cliff-edge guesthouses, and there are camping, a stream-trekking route in the Suxi canyon and a ski slope in winter. It is mainly a summer retreat for a night or two away from the lowland heat.
description: 六柱垭位于湖北襄阳。游览特色包括峡谷。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Huanglongguan village in the mountains of Maqiao town, about 35 km west of Baokang town and reached by road.

name: 鹿门山
summaryEn: A wooded hill south-east of Xiangyang, once called Suling Mountain, whose present name comes from a shrine said to have been founded in the Eastern Han with a pair of stone deer beside its path. It is known as a retreat for scholars and poets: Pang Degong, who is credited with the nicknames 'Sleeping Dragon' for Zhuge Liang and 'Young Phoenix' for Pang Tong, the Tang poet Meng Haoran, and the late-Tang writer Pi Rixiu. Sights include the entrance archway, the Meng Garden memorial hall to Meng Haoran (opened 2003), a hall commemorating Zhuge Liang's study with Pang Degong, and a slope of weathered rocks.
description: 鹿门山位于湖北襄阳。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
