accessEn: In Xiangzhou district, about 15 km south-east of central Xiangyang, reached by road.

name: 襄阳华侨城奇幻度假区
summaryEn: A large leisure resort developed by OCT in Xiangyang's Dongjin New Area, opened in stages from 2020. It combines the Fantasy Valley space-exploration theme park, the Dream Beach water park, a children's park, a hot-spring bathing area, a leisure town and several themed hotels. It suits families and groups after an amusement-park day and is a modern entertainment development, not a historic site.
description: 襄阳华侨城奇幻度假区位于湖北襄阳。游览特色包括主题游乐、海滨。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the Dongjin New Area on the east side of Xiangyang, about 4 km from Xiangyang East high-speed railway station and some 10 km east of the old city, by taxi or ride-hailing.

name: 狮子岩
summaryEn: A lakeside scenic area in Jinniusi village, Cihe town, built around Shiziyan Reservoir (completed in 1976 on the Mo River, a tributary of the Han) and named for a hill said to resemble a lion. It covers about 6.5 km² and offers a lakeside greenway, a beach, a glass water slide, forest cabins and an off-road vehicle base. It also stages fantasy-themed (xianxia) character shows and night events, so it suits a half-day or overnight outing from Xiangyang.
description: 狮子岩位于湖北襄阳。游览特色包括水库、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Cihe town, Gucheng county, about 35 km west of central Xiangyang as the crow flies, reached by road.

name: 襄阳唐城
summaryEn: A Tang-dynasty-style film set and tourist complex at the foot of Xianshou Hill beside the Han River, built in the 2010s and now marketed as Shengshi Tangcheng ('Prosperous Tang City'); none of it is historic. Its gate towers, palace halls, mansions, temples and market streets follow a Chang'an layout, with canals said to echo the 'eight rivers around Chang'an', and more than a hundred film and television productions have shot here. A walk-through night show, 'Dream of the Great Tang', is the main evening draw, and the operator has been refurbishing the site since 2025.
description: 襄阳唐城位于湖北襄阳。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、运河。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the south-east of Xiangyang's Xiangcheng district, about 4 km from the old walled city, reached by road.

name: 五道峡
summaryEn: A forested stream gorge inside the Wudaoxia nature reserve, close to the main peak of the Jing Mountains, with a path of about 5 km beside the stream, waterfalls and old trees including a golden-thread nanmu. Its five gorge sections are named after the legend of Bian He, the Chu man said to have found a raw jade here and offered it to the king, and a lit karst cave retells the story. The area closed in 2023 and reopened on 1 October 2025 after a seven-month upgrade that added a new entrance with a lift, a lakeside walk and a family play area; rafting began in June 2026.
description: 五道峡位于湖北襄阳。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Houping town, about 15 km south of Baokang town and a few kilometres from Baokang County station on the Zhengzhou–Wanzhou high-speed line; Baokang is itself roughly 85 km west of Xiangyang.

name: 香水河
summaryEn: A forested river gorge at Putuo'an village in Xueping town, in the south-west of Nanzhang County, known for its chain of waterfalls, with more than fifty named sights including the Seven-Colour Falls and the Three-Tier Falls. A cable car and footpaths run through the gorge, and the cool upland air makes it a summer destination.
description: 香水河位于湖北襄阳。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Putuo'an village, Xueping town, in the south-west of Nanzhang County, about 38 km from Nanzhang town by road.

name: 堰河村
summaryEn: A tea-growing village in Wushan town, Gucheng, developed into a rural-tourism area; the county tourism bureau reports about 1,200 mu (80 ha) of tea gardens and more than fifty family-run farm restaurants and guesthouses in the village. Visitors come for the tea slopes, village lanes and countryside meals rather than any historic sight. It suits a relaxed stop in the Gucheng countryside.
description: 堰河村位于湖北襄阳。游览特色包括田园观光、茶文化、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 2.5 km west of Wushan town in western Gucheng county, some 30 km west of Gucheng town, reached by road.

name: 尧治河
summaryEn: A mountain village in Maqiao town, near the Fang County and Shennongjia borders, that has turned from phosphate mining to tourism. Visitors find waterfalls, a mining museum and an agricultural-culture museum, farmhouse B&Bs, and part of a belt of old mine tunnels about 20 km long that has been opened as the Sanjie Dongtian cave attraction. The village name is tied to a local legend that the ancient ruler Yao stayed here, and the cool upland air makes it a summer destination.
description: 尧治河位于湖北襄阳。游览特色包括博物馆、瀑布。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Yaozhihe village, Maqiao town, about 35 km west of Baokang town (itself roughly 90 km west of Xiangyang) and reached by road.

name: 楚天瑶池温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort on the bank of the Gan River in Xianning's urban area, at the site of the Feitan ('boiling pool') archway, which local sources call the marker of the 'first spring of central China'. More than 40 pools in ten types are set into the hillside, alongside a constant-temperature swimming pool, herbal baths, spa treatments and a children's pool. It is an easy add-on to a day in Xianning.
description: 楚天瑶池温泉位于湖北咸宁。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xianning's urban area on the Gan River, about 80 km (around an hour) south of Wuhan.

name: 温泉谷
summaryEn: A large hot-spring resort beside the main gate of Qianshan National Forest Park on the edge of Xianning. The bathing area is split into six zones, including indoor halls, a Chu-style area, Japanese-style and South-East Asian-style areas, and Thai-style bath houses, with a water-play area and more than 80 bathing and spa attractions in all. A resort hotel and a tea house on site make it suitable for an overnight stay as well as a day visit.
description: 温泉谷位于湖北咸宁。游览特色包括温泉、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At the main gate of Qianshan National Forest Park in Xianning's Wenquan district, about 80 km south of Wuhan.

name: 柃蜜小镇·白崖山
summaryEn: A rural resort built and run by a private tourism company at Fanshang village in Jintang town, Chongyang County, in the hills around Baiya Mountain. County media describe timber-cabin lodgings, more than 10,000 peach trees, a rose garden and fruit-growing, with peach blossom in March and April and pick-your-own fruit later in the year. It suits a countryside weekend rather than a particular sight.
description: 柃蜜小镇·白崖山位于湖北咸宁。游览特色包括园林景观、赏花。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jintang town, roughly 30 km south-east of Chongyang county town by road.

name: 龙隐山
summaryEn: A mountain leisure park built around 2020 beside Yinshui Cave in Dafan town, on a hill about 519 m above sea level overlooking Fushui Lake. It combines adventure attractions such as a glass bridge, cliff swing, jungle crossing and glass slide with viewpoints, including a stone-forest area, a high meadow and Jiulongding Plaza overlooking the islands of the lake. It suits families and thrill-seekers and pairs easily with the cave next door.
description: 龙隐山位于湖北咸宁。游览特色包括湖泊、玻璃栈道、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside Yinshui Cave in Dafan town, about 20 km east of Tongshan county town by road.

name: 龙佑赤壁温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort complex at the foot of Wuhong Mountain beside Lushui Lake, built in Han-Tang style around a hotel, a lakeside spring centre and villas. The city describes more than 40 pools scattered through the wooded hillside, and a 2023 refit added an infinity pool and a children's water park, with a hot-spring bath in every room. It is mainly for soaking and staying rather than sightseeing.
description: 龙佑赤壁温泉位于湖北咸宁。游览特色包括温泉、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 5 km from the centre of Chibi city, next to Lushui Lake and roughly 110 km south of Wuhan.

name: 陆水湖
summaryEn: A reservoir of about 57 sq km on the Lu River near Chibi, created in 1958 as a test dam for the Three Gorges and Gezhouba projects, with more than 800 islands among wooded hills and national scenic area status since 2002. Visitors tour the islands by boat, and the park has a dinosaur-themed island with a mine-train ride, an animal petting park, a water-play area and outdoor-activity grounds. It makes an easy half-day trip that combines with the Red Cliff site.
description: 陆水湖位于湖北咸宁。游览特色包括峡谷、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Lushui Lake subdistrict, a short drive south of central Chibi city, which is about 110 km south of Wuhan.

name: 三江森林温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort on the eastern foot of Qianshan National Forest Park, beside the Gan River on the edge of Xianning city. More than 70 open-air pools and bath houses are set into the wooded hillside among osmanthus trees and bamboo, and local sources describe the water as a weakly radioactive sulphate-radon spring. It is a place to soak for an afternoon rather than a sightseeing stop.
description: 三江森林温泉位于湖北咸宁。游览特色包括温泉、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Wenquan district of Xianning city, a short drive from the centre and about 80 km south of Wuhan.

name: 山湖温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort on the north shore of Bai Lake in the Sanhu–Lianjiang lake area of Jiayu County, opened in 2009 with a four-star hotel, a boat pier and a bathing centre. The county describes about 50 pools in seven themed zones, with water at 47–60°C of an alkaline sulphate-calcium type, plus a salt-flotation hall and spa treatments. It suits an overnight stay beside the lake.
description: 山湖温泉位于湖北咸宁。游览特色包括温泉、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Jiayu county town on the shore of Bai Lake, about 80 km south of Wuhan.

name: 太乙温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in Taiyi village, Fushan, on the southern edge of Xianning city, beside Taiyi Cave, a karst cave, and a lake of more than 200 mu. The original resort opened in 2009 and was rebuilt in 2025–26 as the family-oriented Taiyi Tianmu Hot Spring Resort, which began reopening in February 2026. It now has wooded-hillside pools, a summer water park and a hotel, and the cave stays at about 18°C.
description: 太乙温泉位于湖北咸宁。游览特色包括温泉、洞穴、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Taiyi village, about 7 km south of central Xianning and a short way from the ring road.

name: 田野乡村公园
summaryEn: A rural leisure park built around Group 8 of Guanqiao village in Jiayu County, with two lakes, a provincial forest park of about 1,800 mu and a 3.3 km lakeside greenway. Other features are a tea house on the highest point, glass greenhouses where visitors pick fruit, a farm museum recording the village's development since the 1978 reforms, and two squares with statues of Mao Zedong and Deng Xiaoping. It is a family day out that shows a modern model village rather than a historic one.
description: 田野乡村公园位于湖北咸宁。游览特色包括博物馆、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Guanqiao town, about 6 km south-east of Jiayu county town, which is roughly 80 km south of Wuhan.

name: 药姑山·古瑶村
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in Daping township, Tongcheng County, on Yaogu Mountain (also called Longjiao Mountain, summit about 1,260 m), known for nearly 10,000 mu of wild cherry blossom in March and April, waterfalls and a long reputation as a source of medicinal herbs. At the foot, Guyao village is presented as a base for Yao culture, with a small exhibition hall, a temple to a General Li, a Yao-style street and farm-stay guesthouses. A trail runs from the visitor centre past Yao heritage sites and the Old Dragon Pool to the Sanxian Temple.
description: 药姑山·古瑶村位于湖北咸宁。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Daping township, about 17 km north-west of Tongcheng county town in a straight line, reached by road.

name: 黄鹤楼森林美酒小镇
summaryEn: A visitor area inside the working Yellow Crane Tower baijiu distillery in Xianning's high-tech zone, set among wooded hills and a lake. Visitors can see a liquor museum, a field of large ceramic ageing jars and cellars dug into hillside caves. It is a factory tour for anyone curious about baijiu, and it also receives school study groups.
description: 黄鹤楼森林美酒小镇位于湖北咸宁。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Xianning high-tech development zone, about 4 km north-north-east of central Xianning, reached by road.

name: 隐水洞
summaryEn: A karst cave about 5 km long in Dafan town, Tongshan County, billed as Hubei's first geological park, with an underground stream, stalactite forests and chambers averaging about 30 m high. Visitors can tour it by boat on the underground river, by small train and on foot. The cave stays at about 18–20°C all year, which makes it a popular summer visit.
description: 隐水洞位于湖北咸宁。游览特色包括洞穴、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dafan town beside Fushui Lake, about 20 km east of Tongshan county town by road.

name: 梦里水乡
summaryEn: A countryside tourism area beside the Zhaoxiyuan forest farm in Xiantao, laid out as a Jianghan water-village scene with a lotus-pond village (Hetang), wetland paths, painted boats and farm scenes such as ox carts. People's Daily described it in 2023 as a well-known draw, and it appears on Hubei's 2023 spring flower route for Xiantao and Jingmen. It suits a relaxed half day in the countryside, best in the flower season.
description: 梦里水乡位于湖北仙桃。游览特色包括湿地、水乡。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 40 km west of Xiantao city centre, beside the Zhaoxiyuan forest farm. Check that it is open before going.

name: 沔阳小镇
summaryEn: A newly built old-style town on the shore of Pai Lake in Xiantao, with Jingchu-style houses laid out beside the water. Craft workshops let visitors watch or try straw-stalk painting, paper-cutting, shell carving and shadow puppetry. It is a modern recreation rather than a historic town, and suits an easy half-day outing.
description: 沔阳小镇位于湖北仙桃。游览特色包括湖泊、手工艺。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the shore of Pai Lake, about 18 km west-south-west of Xiantao city centre. Check that it is open before going.

name: 白兆山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in Yandian town, Anlu, linked to the Tang poet Li Bai, who local tradition says lived in the Baizhao Mountain area for about ten years and married a local woman. Sights include a Li Bai memorial hall and Peach Blossom Cave, where he is said to have lived as a recluse. Anlu promotes the area as the centre of its Li Bai heritage tourism.
description: 白兆山位于湖北孝感。游览特色包括纪念展览、山地游览、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yandian town, about 15 km west of Anlu city centre by road.

name: 北山红叶
summaryEn: An autumn-colour area around Beishan village in Sigu town, in the hills of south-eastern Dawu County, known for stands of Chinese tallow trees whose leaves turn red from late October into November. Dawu promotes the red-leaf season each autumn with a festival that brings markets and evening events to the village. The colour is seasonal, so time a visit for the second half of autumn.
description: 北山红叶位于湖北孝感。游览特色包括节庆文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Beishan village, Sigu town, about 30 km east-south-east of Dawu county town (straight line), reached by road.

name: 金卉庄园
summaryEn: A flower-viewing and picking estate in Pengxing township, just north of Xiaogan city, best known for its spring tulips. It is a seasonal family outing rather than a full-day destination.
description: 金卉庄园位于湖北孝感。游览特色包括庄园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Pengxing township, Xiaonan District, a short drive north of Xiaogan city. Check that it is open before going.

name: 新四军五师司令部旧址
summaryEn: The village of Baiguoshuwan was the headquarters of the New Fourth Army's Fifth Division from 1942 to 1945, when the Communist-led force operated behind Japanese lines in central China. The headquarters, political department and staff offices were spread across village houses of grey brick and black tile, which now stand beside a memorial hall with historic photographs, wartime objects and accounts of the division's commanders and base areas. Xinhua describes the village as the command centre for the war in the border area of Hubei, Henan, Anhui, Hunan and Jiangxi.
description: 新四军五师司令部旧址位于湖北孝感。游览特色包括纪念展览、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Baiguoshuwan village, Fangfan town, about 15 km south-south-east of Dawu county town and roughly 40 km south-west of the Zhongyuan site at Xuanhuadian, reached by road.

name: 钱冲古银杏
summaryEn: A village area in Wangyizhen town, Anlu, noted for its old ginkgo trees, whose leaves turn gold in autumn. Anlu promotes it as one of its three core 4A scenic areas, alongside Baizhao Mountain and the Shengshi Wenying cherry park, and features its golden ginkgo colour on its autumn route. It is a seasonal stop, so time a visit for the ginkgo colour.
description: 安陆王义贞镇的村落以古银杏树群闻名，秋季金黄色的树叶是当地的重要景观。
accessEn: In Qianchong village, Wangyizhen town, in the west of Anlu, reached by road from Anlu city; the town is about 30 km west-north-west of the city centre.

name: 盛世闻樱
summaryEn: A flower park in the countryside of Lidian town, Anlu, best known for its cherry blossom in spring. People's Daily named it among Hubei's cherry-blossom viewing spots in 2023, and Anlu lists it as one of its three core 4A scenic areas. It is a seasonal stop for photography and family outings, so check the bloom before travelling.
description: 盛世闻樱位于湖北孝感。游览特色包括花卉观赏、赏花。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Lidian town, about 8 km south-east of Anlu city centre by road.

name: 大悟十八潭
summaryEn: A mountain gorge in Sanli town, in the north of Dawu County, with a string of green pools and small waterfalls along a mountain stream. It is also visited in autumn for its red leaves, and a tourist road named after it, the Shibatan Tourist Road, runs up to the area from Dawu. It suits a half-day nature walk, especially in spring and autumn.
description: 大悟十八潭位于湖北孝感。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shipu village, Sanli town, about 25 km north-north-east of Dawu county town by road, along the Shibatan Tourist Road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 汤池温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort area in Tangchi town, in the west of Yingcheng, a town that takes its name from its springs. The water stays above 72°C all year, and Yingcheng holds the title of 'hometown of hot springs', with hotels and spa resorts built around the springs. It suits an overnight soak or a relaxed weekend stay.
description: 汤池温泉位于湖北孝感。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tangchi town, about 33 km by road west of Yingcheng city centre. Check that it is open before going.

name: 天屿湖
summaryEn: A lakeside leisure area on Tianyu Lake beside Makou town in Hanchuan. It has been developed as a leisure district with lakeside walks, bridges, small islands with pavilions, boat trips and a hotel. It suits a light family outing from Hanchuan.
description: 天屿湖位于湖北孝感。游览特色包括湖泊、乘船游览、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Makou town, about 15 km south of Hanchuan city centre by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 天紫湖
summaryEn: A lakeside leisure resort on Tianzi Lake in Xiaogang town, north of Xiaogan city, with a hotel, hot-spring pools and water-play areas. The resort promotes the local legend that the Seventh Fairy came down to earth here to meet Dong Yong, the folk tale behind Xiaogan's 'filial piety' name. It is aimed at short family and group stays and day visits from Xiaogan.
description: 天紫湖位于湖北孝感。游览特色包括湖泊、民间传说、休闲度假。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xiaogang town, Xiaonan District, about 20 km north of Xiaogan city centre by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 祥云湾
summaryEn: A recently built cultural-tourism complex in Yunmeng County in traditional Chinese architectural styles, arranged as Yunmeng Old Street (a dry street and a water street) plus a series of gardens. It is a newly built attraction rather than an original historic district, and suits a half-day outing from Xiaogan.
description: 祥云湾位于湖北孝感。游览特色包括园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yunmeng county town, about 25 km north-west of Xiaogan city by road.

name: 应城国家矿山公园
summaryEn: A former gypsum and rock-salt mining area in Yingcheng, a city known for gypsum, brine and hot springs, now landscaped as a national mine park. It holds the China Gypsum Museum and industrial-heritage displays on the area's geology and mining history, alongside leisure and hot-spring facilities, according to a 2026 state-media report. It suits visitors interested in industrial history who are already in the Yingcheng area.
description: 应城国家矿山公园位于湖北孝感。游览特色包括博物馆、温泉。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north-western edge of Yingcheng city, about 8 km from the city centre by road.

name: 百里荒高山草原
summaryEn: A highland meadow area of about 40 km² on the ridges of Fenxiang township in northern Yiling district, at an average altitude of about 1,200 m, with open pasture, pine woods, gorges and a row of wind turbines. It is cooler than Yichang city in summer, and activities include horse riding, glass water slides and paragliding. Local promotion presents it as a place for spring flowers, summer coolness, autumn colour and winter snow.
description: 百里荒高山草原位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括峡谷、草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the mountains of northern Yiling district, reached by road from Yichang via Huanghua town and the township of Fenxiang.

name: 朝天吼漂流
summaryEn: A rafting site on the Gaolan River in Xingshan county, where the main run is 6.5 km long with a 148 m drop through a wooded valley. A newer cave route runs through a lit tunnel and a waterfall cave, and night runs are also offered. The rafting season opens in late April.
description: 朝天吼漂流位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Gaolan, beside the Gaolan interchange of the G42 expressway in Xingshan county, about 100 km from Yichang.

name: 车溪民俗旅游区
summaryEn: A folk-culture park in Chexi, a Tujia village in Tucheng township, built around museums and demonstrations of traditional country life. Attractions include a water-wheel museum, a farm-life and Tujia museum, a cluster of old workshops where paper, oil, pottery and liquor are made, and a folk village, along a route of about 10 km. The local government also lists caves, a gorge and a large wild wintersweet grove among its ten sub-areas.
description: 车溪民俗旅游区位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括博物馆、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tucheng township, Dianjun district, about 18 km from central Yichang.

name: 九凤谷
summaryEn: A stream valley about 3 km long in the hills of Wuyanquan town at roughly 800 m altitude, where faulting has cut a narrow U-shaped gorge with cliffs, stalactites, deep pools and waterfalls up to about 20 m high. Visitors walk and wade up the stream, with a zip-line and other adventure activities, and the valley is planted with flowers such as crape myrtle, cherry and azalea. It is mainly a summer cool-off spot, developed as a leisure destination by a private company.
description: 九凤谷位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Chouxi village, Wuyanquan town, about 26 km from the city of Yidu.

name: 鸣凤山
summaryEn: A red-sandstone hill 408 metres high, circled by water on three sides, with a Taoist temple complex that local tradition dates to the Liang dynasty and links to the Wudang Mountains. The local government lists more than 50 sights, including caves such as Yanxia Cave, a lake, a gorge and the golden-roofed hall at the summit. It is a provincial-level scenic area, and pilgrims come to pray for children and good fortune.
description: 鸣凤山位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括峡谷、寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 3.5 km west of Yuan'an town centre, with Yuan'an itself about an hour and a half from Yichang. The county government describes Yuan'an as the only county in Hubei that is wholly closed to foreign visitors, so check current rules and permit requirements before planning.

name: 南津关大峡谷
summaryEn: An 8 km forested canyon on the Xiling Gorge side of Yiling district, with a height difference of about 400 m between its ends, developed for hiking, stream-tracing and canyoning (rope descents down the stream), alongside zip-line and cliff-climbing activities. A boardwalk path of about 6.8 km runs through the woods, and the Xialao stream area is popular with Yichang residents for paddling in hot weather. The canyon was rated 4A in December 2025.
description: 南津关大峡谷位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括峡谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: The south gate is about 25 km and the north gate about 55 km from central Yichang, with no expressway or main road running direct, so check the current access before going.

name: 清江方山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area of about 60 square kilometres in the core of the Qingjiang National Forest Park, with karst peaks, ravines, streams and waterfalls above Zhengjiabang village. Visitors follow forest paths and a cliff-side plank walkway of just over 6 kilometres, passing old trees and some of the 30 or so caves recorded in the area. Scenery is the main draw, so it suits hikers and photographers.
description: 清江方山位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括瀑布、森林公园。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Zhengjiabang village, Longzhouping township, about 25 km from Changyang county town, which is reached from Yichang by expressway.

name: 清江天龙湾
summaryEn: A lakeside leisure resort on the Qingjiang River reservoir in Yidu, with a hotel, a sand beach, water sports such as speedboats and pedal boats, and an outdoor team-building ground. Sightseeing boats run from here along the Qingjiang, and the resort is marketed as a short-trip destination from Yichang. It suits families and groups looking for a relaxed waterside break rather than sightseeing.
description: 清江天龙湾位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括水库、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yantuo village, Honghuatao town, Yidu, on the Qingjiang reservoir about 21 km south of central Yichang in a straight line.

name: 青林休闲旅游区
summaryEn: A leisure area of about 8.5 square kilometres on the Qing River below the Geheyan Dam, spread between Honghuatao and Gaobazhou towns and named after a former temple, Qinglin Temple. It is built around Qinglinsi village, which is known as China's riddle village, and also has a riddle-themed town, an 18-hole golf course, citrus orchards and the shore of the Gaobazhou reservoir. It suits families and anyone wanting an easy countryside day out from Yichang.
description: 青林休闲旅游区位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yidu, on the Qing River between Honghuatao and Gaobazhou towns, about 25 km south-south-east of central Yichang in a straight line.

name: 石牌要塞
summaryEn: The site of the Shipai fortress, a Yangtze position between the Three Gorges and Gezhouba dams that Chinese naval gunners fortified in 1938 and that was defended in May 1943 against a Japanese offensive aimed at Chongqing. The scenic area combines a war memorial museum built on the former military ground, a memorial monument and military-themed rafting on Yangjia stream. It overlaps with the Three Gorges Tribe scenic area, which lists the same museum and rafting among its sights.
description: 石牌要塞位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括博物馆、峡谷、城堡。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Shipai village in Sandouping town, Yiling district, between the Three Gorges and Gezhouba dams, about 20 km from central Yichang.

name: 三峡古兵寨
summaryEn: A heritage park in Huanghua town built around the hilltop stone stockades (bingzhai) of northern Yiling, more than 100 of which survive in the town according to local officials. The best preserved, Majia, Lijia and Baima, keep walls, beacon and watch towers, barracks and troop passages, and a small museum that opened in November 2024 explains how local historians date the stockades from the Spring and Autumn period to the Second World War. The Yangjiahe stockade group inside the park is a provincial-level protected site.
description: 三峡古兵寨位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括博物馆、村寨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Huanghua town, Yiling district, about an hour's drive north of central Yichang along the Yixing road.

name: 三峡橘醋
summaryEn: A company-run visitor estate of about 1.85 km² in Yidu's citrus-growing country, with orchards, lakes and wetland around a citrus-vinegar brewing estate that opened to visitors in March 2023. Visitors see the brewing and storage halls, a citrus culture centre with exhibits on the history and varieties of citrus, a vinegar-themed walkway and a gallery of dried tangerine peel, and can pick fruit in the harvest season. It is a modern food-and-farm attraction rather than a historic site, suited to families and food-minded travellers.
description: 三峡橘醋位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括湿地、果园。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Honghuatao town, Yidu, beside provincial road S254, about 30 km south-south-east of central Yichang in a straight line.

name: 三峡龙隐谷
summaryEn: A valley scenic area in Hualinsi town in the Taiping mountains, with waterfalls, a covered bridge, a small lake and riverside platforms in its valley section. The Yichang government also lists the Taiqing Cave, a limestone cave open to visitors, and a children's study-tour base with field classes, outdoor-skills activities and an outdoor combat-game field. It suits families and school groups for a day out.
description: 三峡龙隐谷位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括瀑布、洞穴、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Hualinsi town, Yuan'an county, reached by road from Yuan'an town, which is about an hour and a half from Yichang. The county government describes Yuan'an as the only county in Hubei that is wholly closed to foreign visitors, so check current rules, permit requirements and whether the valley is open before planning.

name: 三峡橙谷·环吒溪河景区
summaryEn: A rural scenic area in Shuitianba township, in the north-west of Zigui county, strung along the Zhaxi River through hillsides of navel-orange orchards; the township has about 4,700 hectares of them. Visitors can paraglide over the orchards, ride a sightseeing mini-train through the orange groves, or take dragon-boat rides on the river, and there is a riverside walkway. It was rated 4A by Hubei's tourism department at the end of 2024.
description: 三峡橙谷·环吒溪河景区位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括果园、滨水景观、乘船游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shuitianba township, in the north-west of Zigui county, about 40 km north-west of the county town at Maoping in a straight line.

name: 五叠水大峡谷
summaryEn: A forested stream valley on the south bank of the Yangtze at Sixi, Maoping, known for bamboo groves, caves and waterfalls, and also promoted as the Three Gorges Bamboo Sea. It has a core area of about 9 square kilometres with more than 300 kinds of bamboo, around ten caves and a tiered waterfall; a cave, a bamboo-raft pool and a waterfall are among the open sights. The canyon reopened on 16 July 2026 after upgrades that include a moving walkway up the slope, a waterfall-side platform, a zip-line and a staged folk-wedding show.
description: 五叠水大峡谷位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Sixi village in Maoping town, about 12 km from the Three Gorges Dam site and Zigui town.

name: 武陵峡口
summaryEn: A karst gorge and spa area of about 10 square kilometres in Yangping town, with a five-kilometre gorge path, some thirty viewpoints and four linked caves called Moon, Poplar, Soldiers-and-Horses and Sinkhole. Along the gorge are Qing-dynasty stone inscriptions, a stone tower, a stone stockade and temples, and the resort also has a hot-spring bathing area, rooms and a restaurant. It suits visitors who want a gorge walk and a soak in one day.
description: 武陵峡口位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括峡谷、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yangping town, in the north of Yuan'an county, reached by road from Yuan'an town, which is about an hour and a half from Yichang. The county government describes Yuan'an as the only county in Hubei that is wholly closed to foreign visitors, so check current rules and permit requirements before planning.

name: 仙女吉吉主题公园
summaryEn: A village-based leisure park in Xiangxiang village, Xiannü town, presented as a citrus-themed park and rated 4A in December 2023. Its orange-and-white buildings are styled on Greek island villages, and an orange-cat mascot called Jiji appears across the park. It is aimed at families, with orchard-picking, camping, an animal park opened in July 2026 where visitors feed alpacas, deer and other gentle animals, and a water-play area with citrus-themed slides and evening water games.
description: 仙女吉吉主题公园位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括主题游乐、岛屿、果园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xiangxiang village, Xiannü town, Zhijiang, about 45 km east-south-east of central Yichang in a straight line.

name: 西陵峡口风景区
summaryEn: A scenic area around the eastern mouth of Xiling Gorge, where the Yangtze leaves the Three Gorges on the north-west edge of Yichang. The Yichang government's tourism page lists eight sub-areas, among them Leizu Temple, Baima Cave, Peach Village, a leisure park and the Xialaoxi stream, which is used for rafting and swimming. It is a short trip from the city for gorge and river scenery.
description: 西陵峡口风景区位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括峡谷、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Nanjinguan on the north-west edge of Yichang, around the gorge mouth next to Three Travellers' Cave.

name: 杨守敬书院
summaryEn: A modern academy complex, built from 2005, in honour of Yang Shoujing (1839–1915), the Yidu-born historical geographer who completed the 80-volume Shuijing zhu shu, a commentary on the ancient waterways classic. Lecture halls, a library and a shrine stand beside the Gaobazhou reservoir near where the Yangtze, Qingjiang and Yuyang rivers meet, with a wetland education area and a water-sports zone. It is a recreated cultural park; Yang's actual former home and tomb are separate sites in Yidu town.
description: 杨守敬书院位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括湿地、水库。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the Gaobazhou reservoir in Yidu, about 35 km south of central Yichang in a straight line. Check that it is open before going.

name: 昭君村
summaryEn: The traditional birthplace of Wang Zhaojun, the Han-dynasty court lady sent to marry a Xiongnu ruler, set beside the Xiangxi River in Xingshan county. The grounds, about 2.7 km², hold a memorial hall with Han and Tang objects excavated locally, a study academy, and landmarks named for her legend such as the Dressing Platform, a zither-playing terrace and Niangniang Spring. The writer Guo Moruo inscribed the names of the hall and the village.
description: 昭君村位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括纪念展览、名人故居、书院文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Zhaojun town on the Xiangxi River, Xingshan county, about 80 km north-west of central Yichang in a straight line.

name: 卓尔木桥溪生态旅游度假区
summaryEn: A private resort planned over about 15 square kilometres in Muqiaoxi village, developed from 2017 by the Zhuoer group in a river valley of cliffs, waterfalls and forest. It combines scenery with outdoor activities, caravan and tent camping, a Tujia village zone and hotels. It was rated 4A in January 2022 and suits families and outdoor-activity groups.
description: 卓尔木桥溪生态旅游度假区位于湖北宜昌。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Gaojiayan town, Changyang county, about 25 km north-west of Changyang town, reached by road from Changyang and Yichang.

name: 常德市规划展示馆
summaryEn: The city's urban planning museum, run by the Changde natural resources and planning bureau and open since 2013, presents Changde's history, culture and planned growth in a series of themed sections. Alongside the displays it runs activities such as child volunteer guides, a photo hunt for 'city memories' and quizzes on local history. It gives a quick indoor overview of the city.
description: 常德市规划展示馆位于湖南常德。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Baimahu Park area of Wuling District, central Changde, a short taxi ride from the city centre.

name: 常德野生动物世界
summaryEn: A large zoo and safari-style park of about 2,500 mu (170 ha) in Hanshou County, opened in 2022, which now keeps more than 7,000 animals of over 200 species, among them Asian elephants, Siberian tigers, African lions and pumas. Besides the enclosures there are staged animal shows in a forest theatre and a circus theatre, a small sightseeing train, a petting area and a children's amusement park added in 2024. It is aimed at families on a day out from Changde or Changsha.
description: 常德野生动物世界位于湖南常德。游览特色包括动物观赏、主题游乐、林地风光。图集建议预留一天游览。
accessEn: Beside the Taizimiao expressway exit in Hanshou County, about 35 km south-east of central Changde; Changsha is about 1.5 hours away by road.

name: 枫林花海
summaryEn: A flower-field park of about 2,000 mu (130 ha) in Weihui New Village, in the Fengshu Uyghur and Hui Ethnic Township, with large seasonal flower fields and a vineyard. The township is home to the largest Uyghur community outside Xinjiang, and the area also takes in the former residence of the historian Jian Bozan, the tomb of the early-Ming general Hala Bashi and a mosque more than 600 years old.
description: 枫林花海位于湖南常德。游览特色包括葡萄酒文化、花卉观赏、名人故居。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Weihui New Village, Fengshu township, Taoyuan County, about 15 km west of Changde's urban area by road.

name: 林伯渠故居
summaryEn: The birthplace of Lin Boqu (1886–1960), a member of the Tongmenghui and of the Chinese Communist Party from 1921, who chaired the Shaan-Gan-Ning Border Region government, was secretary-general of the Central People's Government and later vice-chairman of the NPC Standing Committee, and is counted among the 'Five Elders' of Yan'an. The house, built in the Tongzhi reign of the late Qing and repaired in 1985, is a southern-style courtyard house of three successive courtyards on a hillside, with about 857 m² of floor space; it opened as a memorial in 1986 under a name board written by Deng Xiaoping. A life exhibition hall completed in 2019 shows documents, photographs and more than 1,200 objects, and the grounds also take in a bronze-statue square, the Lin family graves and a memorial archway; his ashes were brought back to Xiumei in 2013.
description: 林伯渠故居位于湖南常德。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、名人故居、传统民居。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Gaoqiao village, Xiumei town, Linli County, roughly an hour by road north of central Changde. Closed on Mondays.

name: 花岩溪
summaryEn: A national forest park designated in 1997 at the northern foot of the Jiulong Mountains, an offshoot of the Xuefeng range, where Dingcheng, Taoyuan and Anhua meet, covering about 75 km² of wooded hills and streams. Forest covers about 95 percent of the land, with Chinese yew, dawn redwood and other rare trees, and large numbers of egrets breed here.
description: 花岩溪位于湖南常德。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 60 km south of Changde by road, in Huayanxi town, Dingcheng District; Taohuayuan is the nearest major sight.

name: 常德卡乐星球
summaryEn: A theme park on Peach Blossom Island in Liuye Lake, opened in January 2020 and built by the culture-tourism technology arm of the OCT (Overseas Chinese Town) group together with Changde's city investment company. Its five themed zones hold more than 20 large indoor and outdoor rides and shows around a fairy-tale castle, and it stages seasonal events such as New Year fireworks and a summer festival. It suits families with children and teenagers.
description: 常德卡乐星球位于湖南常德。游览特色包括湖泊、主题游乐。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: On Peach Blossom Island in Liuye Lake, about 7 km north-east of central Changde, reached over the Liuye Lake bridge.

name: 灵犀茶油庄园
summaryEn: A camellia-oil estate on the shore of Maoli Lake in Jinshi, run by a local camellia-oil producer, that has been developed into a leisure and wellness area; provincial media describe it as Hunan's first eco-wellness estate built around camellia oil. Visitors can see the camellia plantations and the oil-pressing works as well as lakeside wetland scenery, art and leisure spaces and exhibits on ecology.
description: 灵犀茶油庄园位于湖南常德。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside Maoli Lake in the south-east of Jinshi; a car is needed.

name: 龙王洞
summaryEn: A limestone cave in Baiyun town, Shimen County, beside the waters of the Xianyang Lake national wetland park, opened to visitors in 1988 as the county's first tourist site. Its halls of stalactites, stalagmites and columns are lit with coloured sound-and-light effects, installed in a 2015–2016 upgrade and themed on local dragon legends, and a walkway leads through. It is a different cave from the better-known Longwang Cave at Jiangya in Cili County.
description: 龙王洞位于湖南常德。游览特色包括湿地、洞穴、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Baiyun town, about 30 km from Shimen county town by road; a car is needed.

name: 彭山
summaryEn: A forested hill area in Linan town, across the Li River from Li County town, rated 4A and listed as a national forest-wellness pilot base. It is laid out for nature and geology study trails, folk-custom activities, a revolutionary-history study section and a Chan meditation and wellness area, and in 2021 it was named a provincial study-tour base. It is set up mainly for school study trips and local day visitors.
description: 彭山位于湖南常德。游览特色包括历史纪念、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Linan town on the south side of the Li River, a short drive from Li County town.

name: 长沙园林生态园
summaryEn: A landscaped garden park beside the Laodao River at Luohanzhuang village in Kaifu District, on the northern outskirts of Changsha, with about 68 hectares open in its first phase out of a planned 200. It is known for its native Chinese cherry trees, more than ten early-flowering varieties of which the first bloom in February, and lies at the centre of the district's rural leisure area around Shaping and Baixia. It suits a walk or a family outing rather than a special trip.
description: 长沙园林生态园位于湖南长沙。游览特色包括园林、园林景观、赏花。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Laodaohe subdistrict, Kaifu District, about 12 km north-east of central Changsha; city buses terminate at the garden.

name: 关山古镇
summaryEn: A rural tourism village in Jinzhou town, Ningxiang, built around a Three Kingdoms theme from the local story that Guan Yu camped his troops here during his campaign against Changsha. White-walled houses in Hui style stand beside two lakes, with Three Kingdoms–themed halls and squares, a folk museum, shadow-puppet shows, farm restaurants and guesthouses, and a Three Kingdoms lantern festival has been held here.
description: 关山古镇位于湖南长沙。游览特色包括博物馆、古镇。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jinzhou town, Ningxiang, about 30 km west of central Changsha by road.

name: 华谊兄弟电影小镇
summaryEn: A film-themed leisure town carrying the Huayi Brothers name, opened in 2018 in the Dawangshan resort area of south-western Changsha and built around a replica Italian town modelled on Assisi and Venice, with 35 buildings, five squares, a waterfront and 22 bridges, Italian restaurants and craft shops, and film-set experiences. A second area recreates Republican-era Changsha as it looked before the 1938 fire, and the town suits a few hours of strolling and photography.
description: 长沙大王山片区的电影主题小镇将电影场景与休闲游览结合起来。
accessEn: In the Dawangshan resort area, Yuelu District, about 15 km south-west of central Changsha by road.

name: 三珍虎园
summaryEn: A captive tiger breeding centre in Jinjing town, northern Changsha County, holding Siberian and Bengal tigers that visitors watch from boardwalks through the woods and from railed viewing points. There is a nursery area with young cubs and visitors can take part in feeding; it suits families with children rather than anyone looking for wildlife in the wild.
description: 三珍虎园位于湖南长沙。游览特色包括动物观赏。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jinjing town, northern Changsha County, roughly an hour by road north-east of central Changsha.

name: 石燕湖
summaryEn: A reservoir lake ringed by wooded hills at Tiaoma in Yuhua District, where Changsha, Zhuzhou and Xiangtan meet, run as a 10 km² leisure scenic area. Its features include a glass skywalk across the lake and an island, a glass plank walk, a dragon-boat course and a large outdoor team-building base, and it suits families and groups on a day out from the city.
description: 石燕湖位于湖南长沙。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tiaoma town, Yuhua District, about 25 km south-east of central Changsha by road.

name: 田汉文化园
summaryEn: A culture park in Guoyuan town, Changsha County, built around the birthplace of Tian Han (1898–1968), the playwright and poet who wrote the lyrics of 'March of the Volunteers', now China's national anthem. His earth-brick family house, restored on its original site, stands at the back of the park, with the Tian Han Art Centre and its exhibition, an old-style timber opera stage, a drama arts street and National Anthem Square, and the park holds flag-raising ceremonies and performances about Tian Han and the anthem.
description: 田汉文化园位于湖南长沙。游览特色包括名人故居、艺术展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Guoyuan town, Changsha County, about 30 km north-east of central Changsha by road. The residence and its exhibition are closed on Mondays.

name: 西溪磐石大峡谷
summaryEn: A boulder-choked ravine on the south-eastern slopes of the Dawei Mountain range at Tianxi village, Zhangfang town, where a stream drops through pools and cascades between great rocks. Villagers developed it from 2015 with plank walks, trails, a glass bridge across the gorge and a grass slide, and the area now also has a children's play park, fruit picking and some 70 village guesthouses.
description: 西溪磐石大峡谷位于湖南长沙。游览特色包括峡谷、玻璃栈道、栈道。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhangfang town on the north-eastern edge of Liuyang, about 55 km north-east of Liuyang city.

name: 影珠山
summaryEn: A forested ridge of about 509 m in Fulin town, northern Changsha County, with more than 70 linked peaks and spurs, terraced fields, pools, bamboo groves and rock outcrops, and sunrise views over the clouds from the top. It was a battlefield of the Battles of Changsha in the war against Japan, and the Yingzhu Mountain War of Resistance Site Park has an exhibition hall, a former command post and trenches from a 1944 battle.
description: 影珠山位于湖南长沙。游览特色包括林地风光、主题展览、战役遗址。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Fulin town, Changsha County, about 50 km north-east of central Changsha by road.

name: 紫龙湾温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in Huitang, the spa town of south-western Ningxiang, set on a hillside below Mount Dongwu and looking over the man-made Zilong Lake. It has open-air thermal pools among trees, water-play facilities and a resort hotel, and suits a relaxing stay rather than sightseeing.
description: 紫龙湾温泉位于湖南长沙。游览特色包括温泉、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Huitang town, Ningxiang, about 70 km south-west of central Changsha, roughly an hour by expressway.

name: 宝山国家矿山公园
summaryEn: A mine park on Baoshan hill on the western edge of Guiyang county town, set up by the Baoshan non-ferrous metals company on a hill mined since ancient times. A small train takes visitors into the old underground workings, where scenes and tools show ancient mining methods, and there are also a modern open pit and processing works to see; the park became a 4A scenic area in 2014.
description: 宝山国家矿山公园位于湖南郴州。游览特色包括矿业遗产。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the south-western edge of Guiyang county town, about an hour by road west of Chenzhou.

name: 飞天山
summaryEn: A national geopark of red Danxia sandstone north-east of Chenzhou, where a river winds between cliffs and rock towers weathered into shapes likened to people and animals. Named sights include the Chuantan rock arch, the Heitan cave and the 'Niukou hanging coffins', old coffins placed in a cliff niche whose origin is unknown.
description: 飞天山位于湖南郴州。游览特色包括地质景观、砂岩地貌、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km north-east of central Chenzhou in Suxian District, roughly 40 minutes by road; Gaoyi Ridge is close by.

name: 福泉山庄
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort at Reshui ('hot water') town in eastern Rucheng, near the Jiangxi and Guangdong borders, built over a geothermal field whose springs reach 91–98 °C, among the hottest in southern China. The resort has dozens of outdoor pools, villas and a hotel set among bamboo-covered hills, and in the town people still boil eggs, peanuts and chestnuts directly in the spring water.
description: 福泉山庄位于湖南郴州。游览特色包括泉水。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Reshui town in eastern Rucheng County, about 3 hours by road east of Chenzhou.

name: 九龙江国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park on the former Daping state forest farm in south-eastern Rucheng County, on the Hunan–Guangdong border, covered mostly in natural broadleaf forest and rising to Fuyin Peak (1,381 m). The Jiulong River rises in the park and flows south into Guangdong, and a trail follows the Qinglong Gorge past a series of waterfalls; a glass walkway was added in 2017.
description: 九龙江国家森林公园位于湖南郴州。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Roughly an hour by road south-east of Rucheng county town, which is about 2–2.5 hours by expressway east of Chenzhou.

name: 龙女温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort area at Tongkenghu on the north-western edge of Chenzhou, near National Road 106, built around a carbonated spring at about 40 °C used for both bathing and drinking. The site is tied to the Tang tale of Liu Yi, the scholar who carried a letter for the Dragon King's daughter (the 'dragon maiden') herding sheep in exile, and has a Dragon Maiden shrine; its hotel has villas with private hot-spring pools.
description: 龙女温泉位于湖南郴州。游览特色包括温泉、天然泉水。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the north-western edge of Chenzhou in Beihu District, near National Road 106; 15–20 minutes by taxi from the centre.

name: 沙洲村
summaryEn: A Yao village in western Rucheng County known for the 'half a quilt' story: in November 1934, as the Central Red Army crossed the area on the Long March, three women soldiers who lodged with a villager, Xu Jiexiu, cut their only quilt in two and left her half. Xi Jinping retold the story in his 2016 speech marking the 80th anniversary of the Long March, and since 2017 Shazhou and four neighbouring villages have been developed into a red-tourism area of about 3.2 km², with the 'Warmth of Half a Quilt' exhibition hall, a sculpture and, in Xiushui village, a 1922 house used as the Red Army headquarters.
description: 汝城西部的瑶族村落与红军长征期间“半条被子”的故事有关。
accessEn: In Wenming Township, western Rucheng County, near the Wenming exit of the Xiamen–Chengdu Expressway; roughly 1.5 hours by road east of Chenzhou.

name: 苏仙岭
summaryEn: A wooded hill on the north-eastern edge of central Chenzhou, named after the legend of a local man who became an immortal ('Su the Immortal'); paths climb past the White Deer Cave, the 'Ascension Stone' and other spots tied to the story. Its cliff inscriptions, carved from the Tang to the Republic, are a national heritage site, the best known being the 'Three Excellences Stele': Qin Guan's poem on his stay at a Chenzhou lodge, with a colophon by Su Shi, in the calligraphy of Mi Fu. It makes an easy half-day walk from the city centre.
description: 苏仙岭位于湖南郴州。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、林地风光、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: The main gate is on Suxian South Road on the north-eastern side of central Chenzhou, a short taxi ride from the centre.

name: 天堂温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort at Tiantang village in Xujiadong, on the northern edge of Chenzhou, developed in the 2000s around a spring that comes up at about 52 °C. It has Japanese-style open-air pools in landscaped grounds, with a hotel and villas on site, and suits a relaxed half day or an overnight stay.
description: 天堂温泉位于湖南郴州。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xujiadong, about 6 km north of central Chenzhou; 15–20 minutes by taxi.

name: 王仙岭
summaryEn: A forested hill scenic area on the south-eastern edge of Chenzhou city, with walks among streams and small waterfalls under the trees. It lies close to the city centre and has long been paired with Suxian Ridge on a day out from Chenzhou.
description: 王仙岭位于湖南郴州。游览特色包括瀑布、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the south-eastern edge of Chenzhou, south of Chenzhou Avenue; 15–20 minutes by taxi from the centre. Check that it is open before going.

name: 万华岩
summaryEn: A limestone show cave in the south-western outskirts of Chenzhou, in Beihu District, where lit paths lead past stalactites, stalagmites and flowstone, and the walls carry inscriptions left by visitors from the Song dynasty onwards. An underground river runs through it, and from around the May Day holiday through the summer an 1,800 m rafting route of about 40 minutes follows the river inside the cave, which stays at about 18–20 °C all year. It is managed together with Suxian Ridge as one scenic area.
description: 万华岩位于湖南郴州。游览特色包括水上活动、洞穴、钟乳石。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 13 km south-west of central Chenzhou, roughly half an hour by taxi.

name: 万洋山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in Guidong County near the Jiangxi border, part of the Luoxiao range, whose high meadows above 1,500 m, natural tarn and lines of wind turbines are marketed as a 'southern grassland'; azaleas flower on the slopes in spring. Rated 4A in August 2026, it is promoted as a cool summer retreat, with average summer temperatures around 21 °C and forest cover of about 95%.
description: 万洋山位于湖南郴州。游览特色包括草原、山地游览、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the mountains north-east of Guidong county town, which is roughly 3 hours by road east of Chenzhou.

name: 西瑶绿谷
summaryEn: A national forest park, set up in 2010, in the Xishan Yao Township of south-western Linwu County, where forested mountains fall from 1,720 m to about 300 m into deep valleys with streams, waterfalls and caves. Paths follow the valley, a cherry valley planted in 2015 with some 2,000 trees flowers in early April, and the Yao hamlet of Taoyuanping lies deep in the hills.
description: 西瑶绿谷位于湖南郴州。游览特色包括瀑布、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Reached by road from Linwu county town, which is about 1.5 hours south-west of Chenzhou; local buses run from the town to the park.

name: 仰天湖大草原
summaryEn: A high grassland of rolling hilltops at around 1,300 m in the mountains south-west of Chenzhou, in Beihu District. Summer temperatures average about 20 °C, so it fills up in July and August with visitors from Chenzhou and the Guangdong cities to the south, who walk the meadows, ride horses and stay on for sunsets and starry skies. A 2022 season of the Hunan TV show 'Chinese Restaurant' was filmed here.
description: 仰天湖大草原位于湖南郴州。游览特色包括草原。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 1.5–2 hours by mountain road south-west of Chenzhou along the Chen–Yang road, which is sometimes closed after typhoon rains (as in September 2026).

name: 蔡伦竹海
summaryEn: A large area of bamboo forest in Huangshi Town in south-eastern Leiyang, the home district of the papermaking pioneer Cai Lun. Stone paths lead through the bamboo from a visitor centre with a statue of Cai Lun to old hand-papermaking workshops, where craftsmen show the traditional process of soaking, pounding and sheet-forming bamboo pulp. Since December 2024 the old Shangbao crystal mine inside the area, known for its fluorite specimens, has been open as a mine park.
description: 蔡伦竹海位于湖南衡阳。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Huangshi Town, about 30 km south-east of Leiyang city (itself about an hour south of Hengyang), roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 罗荣桓故居
summaryEn: The birthplace of Luo Ronghuan (1902–1963), a Communist commander who led political work in the Red Army and was made a marshal of the People's Liberation Army in 1955, in Nanwan Village, Ronghuan Town, Hengdong County. The family house was restored and opened to visitors in 1985, and a memorial hall nearby has a full-length bronze statue of him outside.
description: 罗荣桓故居位于湖南衡阳。游览特色包括纪念展览、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the east of Hengdong County, about 60 km north-east of Hengyang, roughly 1.5 hours by road.

name: 湘南学联旧址
summaryEn: The former premises of the Xiangnan (Southern Hunan) Student Union, a student federation active in Hengyang from the May Fourth period of 1919, on the east bank of the Xiang River. The site and its memorial hall hold exhibitions on the union and early revolutionary activity in southern Hunan, including a room associated with Mao Zedong. It hosted the opening of Hunan's Red Tourism Festival in 2022.
description: 湘南学联旧址位于湖南衡阳。游览特色包括纪念展览、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Zhuhui District on the east bank of the Xiang River, a short taxi ride from central Hengyang. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 岣嵝峰
summaryEn: Goulou Peak is one of the main summits of the Hengshan range, rising in the north-east of Hengyang County on the border with Hengshan County, inside a national forest park set up in 1995 that covers about 2,070 ha, takes in five of Mount Heng's 72 peaks and rises to 1,143 m. It gave its name to the Goulou Stele, an inscription in tadpole-like script traditionally attributed to Yu the Great, of which later copies are carved on Yuelu Mountain in Changsha and elsewhere. The forested mountain was rated a 4A scenic area in 2026.
description: 岣嵝峰位于湖南衡阳。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光、登山观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 35 km north of Hengyang city, roughly an hour by road.

name: 紫金山
summaryEn: A forested hill beside Kaiyun, the county town of Hengshan County, counted in the Mount Heng range as Jinzi Peak. The scenic area covers 4.35 km² with forest cover of about 87%, mixing woodland paths with a few cultural sites, and is promoted as a cool summer retreat.
description: 紫金山位于湖南衡阳。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the edge of Hengshan county town, about an hour by road north of Hengyang.

name: 穿岩山
summaryEn: A forested mountain area in Tongxihe town in the Xuefeng Mountains of Xupu County, rated 4A in 2019, with the hilltop Fengxiang Yao village of guesthouses as its main base. An 18 km walking route through it follows the line of march of the Red Second and Sixth Army Groups past an iron-chain bridge over the Shixi River, the old village of Yan'ejie, a stretch of old tea-horse road and Red Army pavilions and bridges.
description: 穿岩山位于湖南怀化。游览特色包括楼阁建筑、林地风光、传统村落。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Tongxihe town, about 30 km south of Xupu county town, roughly 45 minutes by road.

name: 飞山
summaryEn: A 720 m mountain north-west of Jingzhou town whose summit temple honours Yang Zaisi (860–954), a local leader of the Five Dynasties period who styled himself Lord of Feishan and is revered across the Hunan–Guizhou–Guangxi borderlands. The summit temple was first built in the Yuanfeng period (1078–1085) of the Song dynasty and rebuilt in 1903 after a fire, and the mountain also has a Qing temple of 1693, a Chan Buddhist temple rebuilt in 2005, the Taoist Fangguang Temple at its foot and old defensive trenches.
description: 飞山位于湖南怀化。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、登山观景、佛教文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 5 km north-west of central Jingzhou county town by road.

name: 皇都侗文化村
summaryEn: A Dong village in Pingtan township, Tongdao, run as a cultural scenic area, with timber stilt houses, drum towers and covered bridges. Visitors are met at the village gate with Dong welcome customs, and Dong songs and dances are staged for them at a performance ground; there are village guesthouses for overnight stays.
description: 通道平坦乡的侗族村落保存有木构吊脚楼、鼓楼与风雨桥，可沿村巷观察侗族建筑。
accessEn: About 10 km south-west of Tongdao county town by road, in the Pingtan valley.

name: 黄岩生态旅游区
summaryEn: A karst upland on the slopes of Liangshan south-east of Huaihua city, at an average altitude of about 850 m, that is a provincial tourist resort and forest park and is promoted as a summer retreat. It takes in the Huaihua Grand Canyon and Baima scenic spots and Daping village, where villagers have planted flower fields among the rocks and built cliff walkways and ziplines; grass sledding and rock climbing are also on offer.
description: 黄岩生态旅游区位于湖南怀化。游览特色包括峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 19 km south-east of central Huaihua, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 荆坪古村
summaryEn: A village of Ming and Qing brick-and-timber houses on the west bank of the Wu River in Zhongfang County, most of whose residents belong to the Pan clan. Its old buildings include the Pan ancestral hall, a Guandi temple and stone memorial archways; it is a China Historical and Cultural Village, was rated 4A in 2025, and keeps up a tradition of qin music linked to a Qing scholar of the clan.
description: 荆坪古村位于湖南怀化。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、古村落、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 15 km south-west of central Huaihua, roughly 30 minutes by road.

name: 九丰现代农博园
summaryEn: A modern agricultural park in Hecheng District, Huaihua, that opened in June 2018, built around large climate-controlled show glasshouses growing vegetables, fruit and some 360 unusual varieties. Its zones include farming-technology displays, vegetable and fruit growing areas, leisure areas and an ocean-themed science hall, and it mainly suits families from the city.
description: 九丰现代农博园位于湖南怀化。游览特色包括田园观光、农业体验。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Hecheng District on the outskirts of Huaihua city; take a taxi from the centre. Check that it is open before going.

name: 龙溪古镇
summaryEn: The old riverside quarter of Longxikou in Xinhuang county town, near the Guizhou border, shaped by Ming and Qing trade on the Wu River, with more than 200 old buildings including a group of historic merchant houses. The Longxi Academy here was revived in 2012 from the Wuyang Academy founded in 1821, and during the war against Japan the architects Liang Sicheng and Lin Huiyin stopped in the town for about ten days on their way south-west.
description: 龙溪古镇位于湖南怀化。游览特色包括古镇、滨水景观、书院文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xinhuang county town, roughly 1.5 hours by road west of Huaihua.

name: 思蒙碧水丹霞
summaryEn: A stretch of the Xu River at Simeng, west of Xupu county town, where red Danxia sandstone cliffs and peaks rise above the water, a landscape locally nicknamed little Guilin. Downstream the river enters the Quzi Gorge, named after the poet Qu Yuan, whose poem Crossing the River is tied by local tradition to this valley.
description: 思蒙碧水丹霞位于湖南怀化。游览特色包括峡谷、山谷、砂岩地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 12 km west of Xupu county town, around 20 minutes by road.

name: 粟裕故里
summaryEn: The home village of Su Yu (1907–1984), a leading Communist military commander who later served as Chief of the PLA General Staff and held the rank of Senior General; he was born into a Dong family in Fengmushujiao village, now part of Pingcun town. The scenic area joins his former home to the Su Yu Memorial Hall, devoted to his life and military career, with a memorial square, a bronze statue, a lake and an outdoor display of aircraft, tanks and other heavy weapons.
description: 粟裕故里位于湖南怀化。游览特色包括湖泊、纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Pingcun town, about 10 km north of Huitong county town (Lincheng) by road. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 滕代远纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial hall by the Jin River in Mayang county town to Teng Daiyuan (1904–1974), a Miao native of Mayang who was one of the leaders of the Pingjiang Uprising, a senior Red Army political commissar and later the first Minister of Railways of the People's Republic. Opened on 2 November 1986 with its name written by Hu Yaobang, it traces his life in ten sections with more than 300 photographs, more than 60 original documents and objects and two reconstructed scenes. His former home in Yanmen town, with some of his belongings, belongs to the same scenic area.
description: 滕代远纪念馆位于湖南怀化。游览特色包括纪念展览。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: In Mayang county town (Gaocun), about an hour by road north-west of Huaihua. Closed on Mondays.

name: 蔡和森纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial museum in Shuangfeng town to Cai Hesen (1895–1931), an early leader of the Chinese Communist Party and friend of Mao Zedong who argued for the Bolshevik approach from France and was executed in 1931, and to his family. It stands on Cai Hesen Square with a statue group of the family and the Cai Chang Library, named after his sister, the first chair of the All-China Women's Federation; the family home is about 22 km to the east.
description: 蔡和森纪念馆位于湖南娄底。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Shuangfeng county town, about 2 hours by road south-west of Changsha. Closed on Mondays.

name: 湄江
summaryEn: A karst national geopark of about 128 km² along the winding Mei River in north-western Lianyuan, opened to visitors from 1992: sheer limestone walls known as the Ten-li Painted Wall, the Three Rock Gates, natural bridges, two lakes, waterfalls and caves such as Xianren Cave, which stays at about 25°C and has a waterfall inside. Its six main areas are Guanyin Cliff, Cangjun Cave, Xianren Fu, Saihai Lake, Longquan Gorge and Dajiangkou, and visitors walk cliff paths or float down the river on rafts.
description: 湄江位于湖南娄底。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、地质景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Meijiang town in north-western Lianyuan, about 2.5 hours by road west of Changsha; leave the expressway at Longtang and follow National Road 207.

name: 梅山龙宫
summaryEn: A karst cave system by the Zi River in Youxi township, formed where the Taoxi stream sinks into the hills, with galleries stacked through some 80 m of height: flowstone and stalactites above, helictites and 'frost' crystals on old river sands, a great rubble pile called the Golden Mountain in the Water and stalagmite forests below. About 2,870 m have been explored, and the 1.9 km visitor route includes a 466 m stretch of underground river travelled by boat.
description: 梅山龙宫位于湖南娄底。游览特色包括洞穴、喀斯特地貌、钟乳石。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Youxi township on the Zi River, about 25 km north of Xinhua town by road.

name: 三联峒
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area of gorges and ridges in Sanliandong village, Weishan township, in Xinhua County. It is laid out around two walking routes, one up a stream gorge called Bingquan Xia (Ice Spring Gorge) with pools and waterfalls, the other along the rocky Longji Feng (Dragon's Spine) ridge.
description: 三联峒位于湖南娄底。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Weishan township, about 25 km by road from Xinhua county town; go by car or taxi.

name: 白水洞
summaryEn: A national scenic area in Yantang Town, Xinshao County, with two main sections: Bailong Cave, known for its towering 'Southern Sky Pillar', a curtain of flowstone and an 'undersea world' chamber, and a walk through the Baishuidong gorge. The caves and waters here have drawn visitors since the Ming dynasty, and Qing writers left travel accounts of them.
description: 白水洞位于湖南邵阳。游览特色包括峡谷、洞穴、历史建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yantang Town, Xinshao County, about 23 km north-east of Shaoyang city and close to Shaoyang North high-speed railway station.

name: 黄桑
summaryEn: A forested area in south-western Suining County around the Huangsang National Nature Reserve, where forest covers more than 90% of the land. Its sights include a relict forest of long-bracted hemlock (Tsuga longibracteata), waterfalls, a sea of cloud on the high slopes and Shangbao, a Dong village on China's tentative list for World Heritage since 2012.
description: 黄桑位于湖南邵阳。游览特色包括瀑布、自然保护区。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Around Huangsangping in south-western Suining County, roughly an hour by road from Suining county town.

name: 虎形山花瑶
summaryEn: A high mountain township in north-western Longhui, averaging about 1,350 m above sea level, that is home to the Huayao ('Flowery Yao'), a Yao group known for their cross-stitch embroidery and bright costumes. In villages such as Chongmudang, wooden houses stand among groves of ancient trees that the Huayao revere, the Datuo stone waterfall is nearby, and the cool summers draw visitors escaping the heat.
description: 虎形山花瑶位于湖南邵阳。游览特色包括瀑布、古树。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Huxingshan Yao Township in the mountains of north-western Longhui County, a long drive from Longhui county town.

name: 湘窖生态文化酿酒城
summaryEn: The distillery and visitor park of Hunan Xiangjiao Liquor, a baijiu maker that grew out of the Shaoyang wine factory founded in 1957. Tours show the traditional process, with grain fermented in old mud pits and the spirit aged in pottery jars, and visitors can blend their own liquor, taste several aroma styles and walk the landscaped grounds; it suits those curious about Chinese spirits.
description: 湘窖生态文化酿酒城位于湖南邵阳。游览特色包括陶瓷工艺、酿造文化、休闲公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shaoyang city; reach it by taxi from the centre.

name: 玉龙洞
summaryEn: A group of limestone show caves in Chengbu County made up of five connected caves (Yulong, Baiyun, Hongxi, Yangjiao and Biyun) and a natural shaft called Luosi Well, with varied stalactite formations. The caves stay at about 18–23 °C all year, and the area was rated 4A in August 2026.
description: 玉龙洞位于湖南邵阳。游览特色包括洞穴、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 4 km south of Chengbu county town (Rulin), a short taxi ride.

name: 云山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A mountain forest park just south of Wugang, an outlier of the Xuefeng range with seventy-one peaks rising to Zixiao Peak at 1,372.5 m, known for drifting cloud and cool summers. The Austrian botanist Heinrich von Handel-Mazzetti collected plants here in 1921, and eleven of the new species found are named after the mountain.
description: 云山国家森林公园位于湖南邵阳。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: A short drive south of Wugang city.

name: 盘龙大观园
summaryEn: A large privately developed flower park in Yuetang District, Xiangtan, in the green belt between Changsha, Zhuzhou and Xiangtan, best known for an azalea garden with about 800 varieties in some 150,000 pots that flowers in March and April. Seasonal displays follow through the year, with a rose garden in late spring, a lotus pond and grape picking in summer, and shows and night events added in 2026.
description: 盘龙大观园位于湖南湘潭。游览特色包括花卉观赏、园林景观、莲花观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yuetang District, Xiangtan, about half an hour by taxi from the city centre.

name: 银田银河
summaryEn: A riverside scenic area along the Shao River at Yintian town in eastern Shaoshan, rated 4A in 2026 after about ten years of water-environment works turned an irrigation channel and the old river into a green corridor. It mixes riverside paths, farmland views and water-conservancy works with red-history study visits and rural leisure, and suits a stop on the way between Xiangtan and the Mao sites at Shaoshan.
description: 银田银河位于湖南湘潭。游览特色包括滨水景观、灌溉工程、田园观光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yintian town, eastern Shaoshan, about 12 km east of Mao's former residence; roughly 40 minutes by road from Xiangtan.

name: 昭山城市海景水上乐园
summaryEn: A summer water park of about 18 ha in the Zhaoshan area between Changsha, Xiangtan and Zhuzhou, themed as a tropical beach, with an artificial sand beach and wave pool, large slides, children's water-play areas and an indoor sun-sheltered hall. It suits families on hot days and opens only in the summer season.
description: 昭山城市海景水上乐园位于湖南湘潭。游览特色包括海滨、水上游乐、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside Yangtianhu Park at the junction of Furong Avenue and Zhuyi Road in Yuetang District, about 2 km from Zhaoshan station on the Changsha–Zhuzhou–Xiangtan intercity railway.

name: 凤凰中华大熊猫苑
summaryEn: A giant panda park about 7 km west of Fenghuang old town, opened in July 2020 with eight pandas brought from the Dujiangyan Qingchengshan base of the China Conservation and Research Centre for the Giant Panda in Sichuan. The pandas are kept in glass-fronted indoor halls and outdoor enclosures, and the park is mainly visited by families staying in Fenghuang.
description: 凤凰中华大熊猫苑位于湖南湘西。游览特色包括历史街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Liaojiaqiao town, about 7 km west of Fenghuang old town, a short taxi ride.

name: 古苗河百瀑大峡谷
summaryEn: A 12.8 km gorge on the Gumiao River in Huayuan County, a river the local Miao regard as their mother river, with more than a hundred waterfalls large and small. About 4.8 km of the gorge, with some twenty waterfalls, is open to visitors along cliff walkways and riverside paths, a walk of about an hour and a half.
description: 古苗河百瀑大峡谷位于湖南湘西。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 3 km south-east of Huayuan county town, a short taxi ride.

name: 里耶古城
summaryEn: A town on the You River in southern Longshan County, where excavations in 2002 uncovered a walled town of the Warring States period and, in one of its wells, more than 36,000 inscribed Qin-dynasty slips. The Liye Qin Slips Museum, opened in 2010, displays the slips with bronzes and pottery, and the excavated city site lies close by in the old town.
description: 里耶古城位于湖南湘西。游览特色包括博物馆、古城、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Liye in the far south of Longshan County, roughly two hours by road from Longshan county town. The museum is closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 奇梁洞
summaryEn: A karst cave at the foot of a cliff in Qiliangqiao village, Tuojiang town, a few kilometres north of Fenghuang old town. Inside are an underground stream and halls of stalactites and other formations, and it is easily combined with a stay in Fenghuang.
description: 奇梁洞位于湖南湘西。游览特色包括洞穴、喀斯特地貌、钟乳石。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 4 km north of Fenghuang old town, roughly 15 minutes by taxi.

name: 惹巴拉
summaryEn: A cluster of Tujia villages along the Laoche River in Miao'ertan Town, Longshan County, with wooden houses, a large covered bridge and the tall Chongtian tower; Rebala and neighbouring Liuhe were among the first villages named Chinese traditional villages in 2012. The area holds Tujia brocade-weaving events and was rated 4A in 2026.
description: 惹巴拉位于湖南湘西。游览特色包括楼阁建筑、传统村落。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 75 km by road from Longshan county town; travel by car.

name: 乌龙山大峡谷
summaryEn: A karst canyon in Guitang Town, Longshan County, covering about 41 km² of the Wulongshan National Geopark and riddled with caves, of which surveys have counted 212. The main sights are Feihu (Flying Tiger) Cave, Remi Cave, Lianyu Cave, Shihua Cave and the Pidu River.
description: 乌龙山大峡谷位于湖南湘西。游览特色包括峡谷、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Guitang Town, about 35 km by road from Longshan county town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 湘西民族文化园
summaryEn: A cultural complex in the Xiangxi high-tech zone of Jishou, planned from 2015 as a showcase of the prefecture's Tujia and Miao heritage. Its centrepiece is the Xiangxi Prefecture Museum, in a new building opened in 2017, whose five permanent exhibitions cover the region's history, folk customs and revolutionary history and the intangible heritage of the Tujia and Miao, a useful introduction before travelling on to the old towns.
description: 湘西民族文化园位于湖南湘西。游览特色包括博物馆、民俗文化、非遗文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Xiangxi high-tech zone of Jishou, a taxi ride from the city centre. The museum is closed on Mondays.

name: 沅水画壁
summaryEn: A riverside scenic area at Baisha, the county town of Luxi, where cliffs known as the 'ten-li painted wall' line the Yuan River, a stretch of river associated with the writing of Shen Congwen. Visitors come for walks and water-based activities along the cliffs, and the area was rated 4A in July 2025.
description: 沅水画壁位于湖南湘西。游览特色包括滨水景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Baisha, the Luxi county town on the Yuan River, under an hour by road from Jishou.

name: 安化茶马古道
summaryEn: A gorge-and-forest scenic area in Jiangnan town, eastern Anhua, built around stretches of the old mountain trade road on which Anhua's dark tea was carried out by horse caravans; the county presents it as the starting point of the Hunan section of the Ten-Thousand-Li Tea Road. Visitors hike the old road and cliff-side and riverside paths through a deep valley past relics of the caravan trade and Meishan folk culture, a good day for walkers.
description: 安化茶马古道位于湖南益阳。游览特色包括峡谷、山谷、滨水景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Jiangnan town, about 20 km south-east of Anhua county town; drive or take a taxi from Anhua or Yiyang.

name: 百花寨
summaryEn: A tea-and-countryside scenic area around Baihuazhai hill above Taoxi town in Anhua, centred on an organic tea plantation and an eco-farm that also grows rice, fruit and vegetables. Since 2021 the area has been developed as a combined tea, culture and wellness project, and it suits a rural outing for those interested in Anhua's tea.
description: 百花寨位于湖南益阳。游览特色包括茶园、村寨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Taoxi town, Anhua County, east of Anhua county town; a car is needed. Check that it is open before going.

name: 茶乡花海
summaryEn: A flower park in Anhua County laid out beside the large Chaxiang Huahai resettlement community, built for villagers moved out of the mountains under the poverty-relief programme, and opened to visitors in April 2020. Seasonal flower beds and a viewing platform make it a local leisure spot, and it hosts events such as the county's spring dark-tea picking festival.
description: 茶乡花海位于湖南益阳。游览特色包括花卉观赏、节庆文化、观景台。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Anhua County near the Anhua interchange of the Pingjiang–Dongkou Expressway; go by taxi from Anhua county town.

name: 罗文村
summaryEn: A farming village in Wuzui township, Nan County, on a spit of land between the waterways of the Dongting Lake plain, whose houses are painted with large colourful graffiti murals and which is ringed by flower fields, best known for rapeseed blossom in early spring. Once an ordinary village, it has been named a Hunan model 'beautiful village' and a national key rural-tourism village, with a music square and farm restaurants for day visitors.
description: 罗文村位于湖南益阳。游览特色包括湖泊、壁画。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Wuzui township, about 5 km east of Nan County town by road; a car or taxi is needed.

name: 梅山文化园
summaryEn: A privately built culture park in Xianxi town, eastern Anhua, begun in 2007 to present the history, customs and folk art of the old Meishan region of central Hunan. Visitors walk past a village gate, the Wan family compound, an old opera stage, stilt houses and a covered bridge to a Meishan folk museum, and a small exhibition recalls the young Mao Zedong's two study tours through Anhua; tea gardens and orchards surround it.
description: 梅山文化园位于湖南益阳。游览特色包括博物馆、果园、民俗文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xianxi town in eastern Anhua County, reached by car from Anhua county town or from Yiyang; Meicheng and its Confucian temple are not far south.

name: 清溪村
summaryEn: The village in Xielingang town, Heshan District, on the southern outskirts of Yiyang where the writer Zhou Libo was born in 1908 and later lived while writing about country life, and which is presented as the real-life setting of his 1958 novel Great Changes in a Mountain Village (山乡巨变). His family house, a timber courtyard home of 28 rooms built in 1788, is the centrepiece, with an old-style street built nearby, a digital exhibition, writers' reading rooms and a hall of books signed by contemporary authors among the fields.
description: 益阳城南的清溪村是作家周立波的出生地，村落生活与他的乡土文学写作紧密相连。
accessEn: In Xielingang town, about 6 km south-west of central Yiyang; go by taxi or local bus. Zhou Libo's former residence is closed on Mondays.

name: 青云洞
summaryEn: A natural limestone cave in Maluxi village, Malu town, in western Anhua County, reopened in April 2023 after redevelopment by a private tourism company. Inside, projection mapping, glasses-free 3D screens and a holographic film tell a fantasy story based on Qu Yuan's poem cycle the Nine Songs among the cave's natural formations.
description: 青云洞位于湖南益阳。游览特色包括洞穴、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Maluxi village, Malu town, in the hills west of Anhua county town; go by car, and it can be combined with nearby Yuntai Mountain.

name: 桃花江竹海
summaryEn: A large bamboo forest on the edge of Taojiang county town, which the county presents as one of China's ten great 'bamboo seas', with more than 50,000 mu (about 33 km²) of continuous bamboo. Walking routes and shuttle buses lead through the groves past a bamboo culture museum, the Tianwen Academy and Jinpen Temple, making it an easy green half-day out from Yiyang.
description: 桃花江竹海位于湖南益阳。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the edge of Taojiang county town, about 20 km west of Yiyang city by road. The bamboo culture museum is closed on Mondays.

name: 天意木国
summaryEn: A wood-art park by Yuxing Lake in the Yuxingshan area of Yiyang's Eastern New District, opened in September 2018 by a Zhuhai company and presented as a 'world wood culture museum'. Its halls display large root and wood carvings, including scenes from classic novels such as Journey to the West and Dream of the Red Chamber, and one hall is given over to wood carvings of the Long March; it suits a couple of hours for anyone interested in carving.
description: 天意木国位于湖南益阳。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Yuxingshan area of the Eastern New District, roughly 25 km south-east of central Yiyang by road; go by taxi or car. Check that it is open before going.

name: 云台山
