summaryEn: A tea-growing mountain in Malu town, western Anhua, whose top is a basin of about 9 km² rising to 998 m and often wrapped in cloud, known locally as 'the plain on the mountain'. A sightseeing cable car climbs to tea-garden viewpoints, a glass walkway and glass suspension bridge, a rainbow slide, Longquan Cave, Shenxian Rock and a folk-culture village, and the summit is a favourite place to watch sunrise over a sea of cloud.
description: 云台山位于湖南益阳。游览特色包括玻璃栈道、茶文化、园林景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Malu town in the hills west of Anhua county town; a car is needed, and Qingyun Cave is nearby.

name: 箴言书院
summaryEn: An academy founded by Hu Linyi, a Qing official and leader of the Xiang Army, and completed in the 1860s, which became a school in 1905 and was rebuilt on its original site in Heshan District, opening to the public on 31 December 2023. The 1.4-hectare complex of rebuilt and new halls includes a Dacheng Hall, a lecture hall, a library, a memorial shrine, a pavilion and a garden, with exhibitions on the academy and the Zhenyan school that grew from it.
description: 箴言书院位于湖南益阳。游览特色包括园林景观、楼阁建筑、书院文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Heshan District, south of central Yiyang; go by taxi from the city centre.

name: 紫金湾欢乐王国
summaryEn: An amusement park on the east side of the Taohuajiang bamboo forest outside Taojiang county town, with fairground rides and play areas aimed at families with children. It is a local family day out rather than a sight in itself.
description: 紫金湾欢乐王国位于湖南益阳。游览特色包括主题游乐、林地风光、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Taojiang county town, about 20 km west of Yiyang city; go by taxi. Check that it is open before going.

name: 陈树湘红色文化园
summaryEn: A memorial park at Guitou village, Meihua town, Dao County, built to commemorate Chen Shuxiang, commander of the Red Army's 34th Division, and the soldiers of his division. The 34th formed the rearguard of the Central Red Army at the Battle of the Xiang River in late 1934; cut off on the east bank, the survivors fought back into southern Hunan, where Chen was wounded and captured in Dao County on 9 December and took his own life the next day. The memorial hall presents documents, objects and reconstructed scenes, and the grounds hold Chen's tomb, a tomb of 34th Division soldiers and a monument.
description: 道县梅花镇贵头村的纪念园为纪念红军第三十四师师长陈树湘而建。
accessEn: In Meihua town, about 10 km north of Dao County town, roughly 20 minutes by road.

name: 东山·零陵文武双庙
summaryEn: The wooded hill inside the old city of Lingling, opened as a park in 2018, which gathers several of Yongzhou's oldest buildings: the Confucian Temple, whose double-eaved great hall with yellow glazed tiles and dragon-carved marble columns dates from 1775, and the neighbouring Martial Temple, whose opera stage is used for performances. Also on the hill are Fahua Temple, founded in the Tang and long known as Gaoshan Temple, where Liu Zongyuan once lodged, and the Lütian Hermitage, marking where the monk-calligrapher Huaisu is said to have practised on banana leaves. The old East Gate, Huaisu's inkstone-washing pond and a stele of his 'Thousand Character Classic' were restored when the park was built.
description: 东山·零陵文武双庙位于湖南永州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the old town of Lingling on the east bank of the Xiao River, a short walk from the town centre and about 40 minutes by road from Yongzhou railway station in Lengshuitan.

name: 花千谷·月湖
summaryEn: A modern flower-valley and lakeside leisure area at Xiadeng village on the edge of Longbo, Shuangpai's county town, created as part of the county's 'Longbo International Slow City' rural-tourism scheme. It was rated 3A in 2019 and raised to 4A at the end of 2023; expect landscaped flower gardens and a lake for a stroll rather than a natural or historic sight.
description: 花千谷·月湖位于湖南永州。游览特色包括湖泊、田园观光、山谷。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Xiadeng village by Longbo, the county town of Shuangpai, which is roughly 40 minutes by road south of Lingling. Check that it is open before going.

name: 濂溪故里
summaryEn: Loutian village in Qingtang town, Dao County, birthplace of the Northern Song philosopher Zhou Dunyi (1017–1073), a founder of Neo-Confucianism whose sobriquet Lianxi is the name of the stream at his home. Its cluster of Ming and Qing buildings is protected, and the village has a memorial hall, the Lianxi Academy and a square, with lotus fields that recall his essay 'On the Love of the Lotus' and flower in summer. The Moon Cave (Yueyan), another sight linked with Zhou, lies about 13 km to the west.
description: 濂溪故里位于湖南永州。游览特色包括纪念展览、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 9 km west of Dao County town by road, around 20 minutes.

name: 龙家大院
summaryEn: A village of the Long clan at Jiantou town in Xintian County, set against hills on three sides, whose Ming-to-Republican houses follow a plan described as 'three halls, nine light wells, 24 lanes and 48 houses'. The grey-brick buildings, with stepped fire walls, carved woodwork and painted eaves, carry 128 couplets on doorways and walls, each in a different calligraphic hand, on themes of farming, study and a quiet life away from office. It was listed as a national heritage site in 2013 and the village is now a scenic area with flower fields round it.
description: 龙家大院位于湖南永州。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、农业体验、草原。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 30 minutes by road south-west of Xintian county town, which is roughly 2 hours by road east of Lingling.

name: 千家峒
summaryEn: A group of three mountain basins north of Jiangyong county town, covering about 200 km², which Yao communities in southern China, South-East Asia and beyond know from their manuscript histories as the homeland their twelve clans were forced to leave in 1305. Scholars meeting in Jiangyong in 2002 identified this valley as that homeland, and it now has a Pan Wang (ancestor king) temple and square, old Yao temples and tombs, and forest scenery including the Dabo waterfall.
description: 千家峒位于湖南永州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The entrance is about 5.5 km from Jiangyong county town, around 20 minutes by road to the basin.

name: 三公垒瀑布群
summaryEn: A chain of waterfalls on a forest stream in the core of Jindong National Forest Park, in the Jindong district that holds Hunan's largest state forest farm. A boardwalk of about 3.2 km follows the stream past more than 20 falls and pools, and a streamside café and paddling area opened in 2026; the district is also known for river rafting and forest homestays.
description: 三公垒瀑布群位于湖南永州。游览特色包括瀑布、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Jindong forest district south-east of Qiyang, roughly 1½ hours by road from Qiyang city.

name: 石洞源·龙溪李家大院
summaryEn: A scenic area in Panshi town, eastern Qiyang, centred on Shidongyuan, the village where the senior Communist Party leader Tao Zhu (1908–1969) was born, with his former residence, the Shidongyuan reservoir and the nearby Longxi Li Family Compound. The Li compound, a large group of Ming and Qing courtyard houses listed as a national heritage site in 2013, is admired for its carved and painted beams.
description: 石洞源·龙溪李家大院位于湖南永州。游览特色包括水库、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Panshi town, about 30 minutes by road east of Qiyang city.

name: 舜皇山
summaryEn: A forested range on Dong'an County's western border with Xinning County, protected as a national forest park, whose main peak rises to 1,882 m. Its name comes from the legend that the sage-king Shun hunted and lived on the mountain during his tour of the south. At Damiaokou on its eastern foot is Shunhuang Cave, found in 1984 by a villager gathering firewood: more than 700 m of passages and chambers hung with stalactites and lit with coloured lights.
description: 舜皇山位于湖南永州。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光、洞穴。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Damiaokou, the gateway town on the eastern (Dong'an) side, is roughly 1½ hours by road west of Lengshuitan. Check that it is open before going.

name: 下灌村
summaryEn: A large old farming village in Wanjing town, Ningyuan, which clan records say was founded in 499 and which now spans four administrative villages along streams below the Jiuyi Mountains. It is known as the home of Li He (808–873), remembered as the first top-ranked graduate of the imperial examinations from Hunan, and its stone-flagged lanes, small bridges and old houses are presented as a scenic area. Villagers link the place with 'yezi xi', an old leaf-card game, and card and mahjong tables are a common sight along its street.
description: 下灌村位于湖南永州。游览特色包括农业体验。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 16 km south of Ningyuan county town by road, around 25 minutes, on the way to the Jiuyi Mountains.

name: 瑶山水城
summaryEn: A tourism district in Shuikou, Jianghua, a new town built from 2016 for about 15,000 people moved from the Cengtianhe reservoir area and from poor mountain villages, which the county promotes as a Yao-themed 'China Love Town'. Its water street (Yaodu Shuijie), opened in 2019, mixes new Yao-style stilt houses with Huizhou-style courtyards, shops and food stalls and is lit up in the evenings, with the legend of the Yao ancestor Pan Wang and the third princess as its theme. The town also stages events such as group weddings in Yao dress and part of the county's Pan Wang Festival.
description: 瑶山水城位于湖南永州。游览特色包括水库。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Shuikou is about 30 km south of Jianghua county town (Tuojiang) by road, roughly 45 minutes.

name: 永州森林植物园
summaryEn: Yongzhou's forest botanical garden, laid out since 2013 on the grounds of the city's forestry research institute in Yitang town, on the eastern edge of Lengshuitan district, and covering about 520 ha (7,800 mu) of mostly wooded hills. More than 2,000 kinds of trees, bamboos, flowers and climbers grow in themed gardens such as the cherry, osmanthus, camellia and bamboo gardens, alongside a forestry park with a garden for each of Yongzhou's counties and a wetland park round a reservoir. It is a local weekend park for walks and plant-spotting rather than a major sight.
description: 永州森林植物园位于湖南永州。游览特色包括植物园、园林景观、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yitang town on the eastern edge of Lengshuitan, about 20 km by road south-east of Yongzhou railway station.

name: 云冰山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area at Nanfeng'ao on the Hunan–Guangdong border south of Lanshan, where a flight of 520 steps climbs to a 1,388 m pass and a viewing platform that straddles the two provinces. It is visited for sunrises and seas of cloud in summer and for rime and ice on the trees in winter, with mossy forest, bamboo valleys and azaleas on the way up.
description: 云冰山位于湖南永州。游览特色包括山地游览、林地风光、观景台。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Roughly an hour by road south of Lanshan county town; Lanshan is about 2½ hours by road from Lingling.

name: 周家大院
summaryEn: A village of Zhou-clan mansions at Ganyantou (also written Jianyantou) in Fujiaqiao town, Lingling, where six well-preserved Ming and Qing courtyard compounds stand together; the largest dates from the Tongzhi reign (1862–1874). Billed locally as the 'finest old mansion of Xiaoxiang', the village is a nationally listed historic village and heritage site.
description: 周家大院位于湖南永州。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、村落风光、历史宅院。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 25 km south-west of Lingling by road, roughly 45 minutes.

name: 6501景区
summaryEn: An unfinished man-made tunnel complex in the hills of Zhongfang, south-east of Linxiang, whose purpose has never been officially disclosed: three levels of passages, halls and shafts run for more than 10 km and cover over 80,000 m². Since an upgrade in 2019 the caverns hold an aerospace science exhibition with Long March rocket and satellite models, while outside there are military vehicle rides, archery, CS-style combat games and weapon models, aimed mainly at school study tours.
description: 6501景区位于湖南岳阳。游览特色包括历史纪念、洞穴、马术活动。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Qiuping village, Zhongfang town, about 23 km from Linxiang city and 5 km from the Zhongfang exit of the Hangzhou–Ruili Expressway; go by car or taxi.

name: 江豚湾
summaryEn: A reach of the Yangtze bank at Qigongling in Junshan District, about 107 ha, where the Hualong sand and gravel wharf was demolished in 2017 and the shore cleared and replanted. Yangtze finless porpoises are now often seen in the bend of the river here; on the bank are a monitoring post of the East Dongting Lake National Nature Reserve, an eco-trail and viewing platforms, and behind the embankment an exhibition hall on the protection of the Yangtze presents the area's finless porpoises, Père David's deer and migratory birds.
description: 江豚湾位于湖南岳阳。游览特色包括湖泊、自然保护区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the south bank of the Yangtze in Junshan District, across the mouth of Dongting Lake from central Yueyang; about 40 minutes by car or taxi.

name: 君山野生荷花世界
summaryEn: A lake of wild lotus at Tuanhu in Junshan District, where more than 10,000 mu (about 670 ha) of lotus grows in continuous beds and over 300 cultivated varieties have been added. Visitors go by boat through the lotus beds and walk shaded paths to a lotus-viewing tower, an old well, stepping-stone and lotus-viewing bridges and pavilions; it is at its best in summer, when the flowers open from about late June.
description: 君山野生荷花世界位于湖南岳阳。游览特色包括湖泊、楼阁建筑、莲花观赏。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Junshan District on the north-western side of Dongting Lake, roughly an hour by road from central Yueyang.

name: 石牛寨
summaryEn: A Danxia sandstone landscape of about 62 km² in north-eastern Pingjiang, a national geopark of long red cliff walls, rock 'waterfalls', natural bridges and narrow slot gorges, named after an old stone stronghold whose walls survive for some 2 km; the main source of the Miluo River rises here. It is also run as an adventure park, with a 300 m cliff-face stairway dropping 260 m, a glass viewing platform cantilevered 58.5 m out from a peak, a shop hung on the cliff and a cliffside inn.
description: 石牛寨位于湖南岳阳。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、地质景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Shiniuzhai town in north-eastern Pingjiang County, about 2 hours by road from Yueyang or Changsha.

name: 五尖山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A wooded hill of five peaks, the highest 588 m, rising just south-west of Linxiang city, a national forest park since 2008 that covers about 2,880 ha with forest cover of 98%. A mountain road and stone paths lead to old secondary forest, a large stele-forest museum of carved calligraphy, an open-air Guanyin statue, a Qu Yuan academy and farm restaurants, and it works largely as Linxiang's city park.
description: 五尖山国家森林公园位于湖南岳阳。游览特色包括博物馆、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the south-western edge of Linxiang city, a few minutes by taxi from the centre; Linxiang is about an hour by road north-east of Yueyang.

name: 贺龙故居
summaryEn: The birthplace of He Long (1896–1969), a founder of the Red Army and later a marshal of the People's Liberation Army, at Hongjiaguan in Sangzhi County. The family house has been restored to its original appearance, and the He Long Memorial Hall and a bronze statue of him stand beside it.
description: 贺龙故居位于湖南张家界。游览特色包括纪念展览、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Hongjiaguan, about 9 km north of Sangzhi county town, which is roughly 1.5 hours by road north-west of Zhangjiajie city. The memorial hall is closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 江垭温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in Jiangya Town, Cili County, where nine streams, all tributaries of the Lishui, meet. The spring was struck during construction of the Jiangya hydropower dam in the 1990s and rises from a depth of about 350 m at 52–54°C; its bicarbonate water now feeds the resort's pools.
description: 江垭温泉位于湖南张家界。游览特色包括温泉、水利景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jiangya Town, Cili County, about 1.5 hours by road north-east of Zhangjiajie city. Check that it is open before going.

name: 九天峰恋
summaryEn: A large karst cave in Shuidong Village, Lifuta Town, about 10 km from Sangzhi county town, named for the nine skylights that open from its roof to the surface. Discovered in 1987, it has three levels with underground rivers, pools and natural bridges, and more than 3,300 columns and pinnacles over 3 m tall. Its exit leads into the forested peaks of Fenglian Creek, the other half of the scenic area.
description: 九天峰恋位于湖南张家界。游览特色包括洞穴、山地游览、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 10 km from Sangzhi county town, which is roughly 1.5 hours by road north-west of Zhangjiajie city.

name: 红二方面军长征出发地
summaryEn: Liujiaping in Sangzhi County is where the Red Army's Second and Sixth Corps, led by He Long, Ren Bishi and others, set out on their Long March on 19 November 1935, after a military meeting here decided on a strategic withdrawal. The site has the memorial hall of the Second Front Army's Long March starting point, with group statues of its leaders, a monument and an equestrian statue of He Long.
description: 红二方面军长征出发地位于湖南张家界。游览特色包括纪念展览、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Liujiaping, about 10 km north-east of Sangzhi county town, roughly 1.5 hours by road north-west of Zhangjiajie city. The memorial hall is closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 龙王洞
summaryEn: A large limestone cave in Jiangya Town, Cili County, about 17 km east of the Wulingyuan scenic area, named after the legend of a dragon king living in the deep pool outside it. Found by local people in 1979 and run by the Huanglong Cave company since 2013, it has dozens of halls and corridors with underground rivers and lakes. It reopened on a trial basis in March 2026 after an upgrade.
description: 龙王洞位于湖南张家界。游览特色包括洞穴、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jiangya Town, Cili County, roughly an hour by road east of Wulingyuan town.

name: 张家界土家风情园
summaryEn: A commercial park of Tujia-style timber buildings on the western side of Zhangjiajie city, including a chieftain's compound known as Tusi City, with displays of Tujia architecture and customs and staged song-and-dance shows. It is an easy stop within the city for an introduction to the Tujia people, whose homeland takes in Zhangjiajie.
description: 张家界城区西部的文化园集中展示土家风格木建筑，包括土司文化主题的建筑群。
accessEn: In Yongding District on Dayong West Road, on the western side of Zhangjiajie city, a short taxi ride from the centre. Check that it is open before going.

name: 万福温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort on a hillside by the Cili East exit of the Changde–Zhangjiajie expressway, opened in 2016. Naturally flowing water at about 53°C feeds pools in nine zones, alongside a water park with slides, a hilltop hotel and a shopping street. It suits travellers wanting a soak between Zhangjiajie and Changde.
description: 万福温泉位于湖南张家界。游览特色包括温泉、水上游乐、特色街区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Next to the Cili East expressway exit, about 4 km from Cili railway station and roughly 1.5 hours by road east of Zhangjiajie city.

name: 溪布老街
summaryEn: A pedestrian street in Wulingyuan town, built in old-street style and lined with shops, snack stalls and restaurants, which the district counts among its cultural-tourism brands. It is listed as an intangible-heritage experience base, presenting crafts and folk culture of western Hunan.
description: 溪布老街位于湖南张家界。游览特色包括民俗文化、特色街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Wulingyuan town, about 40 km north of Zhangjiajie city by road.

name: 张家界地缝
summaryEn: A narrow karst slot gorge in Jinlong Village, Lingxi Town, in eastern Cili County, also called the Chaoyang Difeng ('earth crack'). The gorge averages nearly 200 m deep yet narrows to about 3 m across at the top, an unusual crack-like landform of the karst.
description: 张家界地缝位于湖南张家界。游览特色包括峡谷、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Lingxi Town, eastern Cili County, roughly 2 hours by road east of Zhangjiajie city.

name: 张家界冰雪世界
summaryEn: An indoor ski and ice centre in Yanghe Township, Cili County, opened in December 2019, with a snow-hall building of over 63,000 m² that takes up to 1,000 people at a time for skiing, skating and snow play. It offers families visiting Zhangjiajie a winter-sports option in any season.
description: 张家界冰雪世界位于湖南张家界。游览特色包括滑雪。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yanghe Township, Cili County, about 30 km east of Zhangjiajie city, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 株洲方特欢乐世界
summaryEn: A large theme park of the Chinese Fantawild chain in Shifeng District, northern Zhuzhou, opened in 2011, with themed indoor attractions, outdoor rides and shows. Its sister park Fantawild Dreamland, opened in 2016, stands next door, and both have staged holiday night events with drone shows; it suits families and ride fans.
description: 株洲方特欢乐世界位于湖南株洲。游览特色包括主题游乐。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Shifeng District, about 20 km north-east of central Zhuzhou; go by taxi or city bus.

name: 花湖谷
summaryEn: A privately developed rural resort in Yantang town east of Chaling, built by the Hunan Wanzhang Group round flower fields, a lake and a gorge; its crape-myrtle garden opened in 2018. Family activities include a high rafting chute down the gorge, coloured slides, horse riding, animal petting and camping, and the resort hosts a grassland music festival, held for the third time in October 2026.
description: 花湖谷位于湖南株洲。游览特色包括峡谷、草原、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yantang town, about 15 km east of Chaling county town by road; a car is needed.

name: 酒仙湖
summaryEn: A large reservoir in the hills of north-eastern You County, held back by a 50 m earth dam on the You River built in 1958–60 and renamed from Jiubujiang Reservoir in 2004, with about 11 km² of clear water among forested hills. It is now a lake resort and national wetland park with a 22 km lakeside trail, paddleboarding, camping and family events.
description: 酒仙湖位于湖南株洲。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 10 minutes by road from the Jiubujiang exit of the Wuhan–Shenzhen Expressway, north-east of You County town.

name: 红军标语博物馆
summaryEn: A museum in Yanling county town devoted to the slogans that Red Army units painted on village walls in this area in the late 1920s and early 1930s, opened in 2011 and described as the only museum of its kind in China. Wall panels removed from old buildings are shown in its halls, most written in lime or charcoal, one in purple dye from a local dye works and one on a wooden board; the county counts 339 surviving slogans at 115 sites, many still in place in the villages.
description: 红军标语博物馆位于湖南株洲。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yanling county town; Yanling is roughly 3 hours' drive south-east of Zhuzhou, and the Yan Emperor's Mausoleum is about 15 km away. Closed on Mondays.

name: 神农城
summaryEn: A large modern park in Tianyuan District, central Zhuzhou, themed on the Yan Emperor Shennong and laid out round Yandi Square with its statue of Shennong carrying a herb basket, Shennong Lake, the tall Shennong Tower and the Shennong Grand Theatre. It is a modern civic landmark rather than a historic site, good for an evening stroll, and holds a Shennong temple fair at the Spring Festival; the Yan Emperor's actual mausoleum is in Yanling County.
description: 神农城位于湖南株洲。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tianyuan District on the west bank of the Xiang River in central Zhuzhou, a short taxi or bus ride from the city centre.

name: 神农谷
summaryEn: A national forest park in the mountains of eastern Yanling County, covered in primary forest and threaded by streams and waterfalls such as the Zhulian (Pearl Curtain) Falls. Six areas with some 40 named sights, among them Jiashui, Taohuaxi and Jiuqushui, are reached by trails from the Nanmuba visitor centre, and its cool summers draw visitors escaping the heat.
description: 神农谷位于湖南株洲。游览特色包括瀑布、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In eastern Yanling County, roughly an hour or more by road east of Yanling county town; a car is needed.

name: 茶陵县工农兵政府旧址
summaryEn: The old prefectural and county yamen of Chaling, an official compound in use from the Southern Song to the Qing, where the Communists set up China's first county-level 'workers', peasants' and soldiers' government' during the Jinggangshan base period. The restored compound of about 1.8 ha, with grey-brick halls and tall stepped gable walls, keeps the layout of an imperial county office and houses exhibitions on that government.
description: 茶陵县工农兵政府旧址位于湖南株洲。游览特色包括草原、历史旧址、历史衙署。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the old walled quarter of Chaling county town, near the Southern Song city wall; Chaling is about 2–3 hours by road south-east of Zhuzhou. Closed on Mondays.

name: 云阳山
summaryEn: A forested mountain rising straight behind Chaling county town, protected as a national forest park of about 89 km², which local tradition links with the Yan Emperor Shennong and with tea, and which was briefly honoured as the Southern Peak in the early Tang. Paths lead to the Nanyue Palace and the Ziyun and Baiyun temples, caves, gorges and viewpoints, and pilgrims crowd the Nanyue Palace for its temple fair in the sixth and seventh lunar months.
description: 云阳山位于湖南株洲。游览特色包括峡谷、寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the western edge of Chaling county town, entered through the East Gate visitor centre; Chaling is about 2–3 hours by road south-east of Zhuzhou.

name: 淡浮院
summaryEn: A private collection museum and garden on the eastern side of Chaozhou, also known as Yanfeng Academy, built on the initiative of the Thai Chinese businessman Guo Fengyuan to promote Chinese culture and exchange between China and Thailand. Its halls and corridors show antiques, calligraphy and carved stone qilin and lions in landscaped grounds, and a memorial hall honours notable Chaoshan merchants.
description: 淡浮院位于广东潮州。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xiangqiao District, about 5 km east of Chaozhou's old town across the Han River, around 15 minutes by taxi.

name: 东山湖温泉度假村
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort by Dongshan Lake on the northern side of Sangpu Mountain in southern Chao'an District, near where Chaozhou, Shantou and Jieyang meet. Its pools are set at different levels across a landscaped hillside above the lake, with a hotel and other leisure facilities.
description: 东山湖温泉度假村位于广东潮州。游览特色包括温泉、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shaxi town, southern Chao'an District, about 20 km south-west of central Chaozhou, roughly 30–40 minutes by road.

name: 绿岛旅游山庄
summaryEn: An eco-tourism resort on the former Wanshanhong farm in Qiandong town, Raoping County, laid out around lakes, bamboo groves and orchards with a hotel, play areas and farming activities, and also used as a study-tour base for school groups. Its 'kiln chicken', baked in a stone oven, is a local speciality.
description: 绿岛旅游山庄位于广东潮州。游览特色包括果园、农业体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Qiandong town, Raoping County, about 23 km east of Chaozhou city, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 东莞展览馆
summaryEn: A city exhibition hall in Nancheng that tells the story of Dongguan's growth into a manufacturing city. The permanent display, renewed in 2023, shows products made by Dongguan firms and models of the city-centre plan and of the China Spallation Neutron Source, a large physics facility in the city, with films and multimedia screens throughout.
description: 东莞展览馆位于广东东莞。游览特色包括主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Hongfu Road in Nancheng, central Dongguan, about 800 m north of the Science and Technology Museum. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 东莞市科学技术博物馆
summaryEn: Dongguan's municipal science museum, opened in December 2005 in Nancheng district, with hands-on galleries built around two main themes: manufacturing technology and information technology. Exhibits are interactive, and the building also has a dome cinema. It suits families with children and anyone curious about the industries that turned Dongguan into a manufacturing city.
description: 东莞市科学技术博物馆位于广东东莞。游览特色包括博物馆、科学科普。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Nancheng district in central Dongguan, a short taxi or bus ride from most of the city.

name: 观音山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forested hill park in Zhangmutou town, south-east Dongguan, with a Buddhist temple and a large Guanyin square near the summit. A road of about 7 km climbs from the gate to the top, with sightseeing buses for part of the way, and footpaths lead through secondary forest to a lake and viewpoints.
description: 观音山国家森林公园位于广东东莞。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhangmutou town, south-east Dongguan, about 40 minutes by road from the city centre.

name: 华阳湖湿地公园
summaryEn: A national wetland park around Huayang Lake and the creeks of Mayong town, on the Pearl River delta in north-west Dongguan. The waterways were badly polluted until a clean-up begun in 2013 closed electroplating, dyeing and paper works, and the area was approved as a national wetland park in 2015. Paths, cycle tracks and boat trips now run through the restored wetland.
description: 华阳湖湿地公园位于广东东莞。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Mayong town, north-west Dongguan, about 40 minutes by road from the city centre.

name: 龙凤山庄影视度假村
summaryEn: A themed park in Fenggang town, opened in 2005 with Hong Kong investment and built around wedding photography, with mock European castles, a fairy-tale town and street sets that also serve as film backdrops. It has since added rides, family attractions and evening shows.
description: 龙凤山庄影视度假村位于广东东莞。游览特色包括影视拍摄、影视文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Fenggang town on Dongguan's border with Shenzhen, about an hour by road from central Dongguan.

name: 香市动物园
summaryEn: A privately run zoo in Liaobu town with more than 100 species, among them giant pandas, Asian elephants and Siberian tigers, many kept in open enclosures rather than cages. Staged shows, including a marine-animal show, are put on in its show halls, and it suits a family day out.
description: 香市动物园位于广东东莞。游览特色包括动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Liaobu town, about 20 minutes by road east of central Dongguan.

name: 银瓶山森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park across the hills of Xiegang, Qingxi and Zhangmutou towns in south-east Dongguan, the largest in the city, rising to Yinpingzui (898 m), Dongguan's highest peak. Waymarked trails with rest pavilions climb through hill forest towards the summit, and it is mainly a hiking destination.
description: 银瓶山森林公园位于广东东莞。游览特色包括森林公园、楼阁建筑、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The park office and main car parks are in Xiegang town, with a second entrance area in Qingxi, about 50 minutes by road from central Dongguan.

name: 隐贤山庄
summaryEn: A leisure resort on a wooded hillside in Changping town, with landscaped grounds, hotels and family attractions such as a small zoo, amusement rides, a water park and a glass bridge. It suits a family day out rather than sightseeing.
description: 隐贤山庄位于广东东莞。游览特色包括动物观赏、玻璃栈道、水上游乐。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Changping town, eastern Dongguan, about 40 minutes by road from the city centre.

name: 逸颐艺舍博物馆
summaryEn: A private museum in Hengli town built on a local family's collection of Chinese art, gathered since the 1970s. Galleries set around courtyards in white-walled, dark-tiled buildings show paintings and calligraphy, ceramics, bronzes, carvings and Ming and Qing furniture.
description: 逸颐艺舍博物馆位于广东东莞。游览特色包括博物馆、书法文化、陶瓷工艺。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Caixia Road in Hengli town, eastern Dongguan, about 40 minutes by road from the city centre.

name: 陈村花卉世界
summaryEn: The heart of the flower and ornamental-plant trade in Chencun, a Shunde town promoted as 'China's first flower town', where nurseries, plant markets and display gardens spread across the area. It became a 4A scenic area in 2012, and visitors come to wander among greenhouses and market halls of potted plants and flowers.
description: 陈村花卉世界位于广东佛山。游览特色包括园林景观、赏花。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Chencun town, northern Shunde, about 8 km south-east of central Foshan; a metro station named Huahui Shijie (Flower World) serves the area.

name: 乐从国际家居汇展中心
summaryEn: A furniture trade complex of two showroom towers at the head of the furniture strip on Lecong Avenue, in a Shunde town that its government describes as home to the world's largest furniture market. Listed as a 4A scenic area since 2014, it is essentially a furniture mall that suits visitors who want to browse showrooms rather than sightsee.
description: 顺德乐从的家具商贸展馆以两座展览楼为中心，呈现当地家具产业与产品。
accessEn: On Lecong Avenue in Lecong town, Shunde District, about 10 km south of central Foshan by road.

name: 罗浮宫国际家具艺术博览中心
summaryEn: A large furniture showroom complex in Lecong, Shunde, run by the Louvre (Luofugong) home-furnishings group, whose Chinese name is that of the Paris museum. Lecong's government describes the town as having the world's largest furniture market, and this centre, a 4A scenic area since 2012, is essentially a vast furniture mall that suits buyers and design-minded browsers rather than sightseers.
description: 罗浮宫国际家具艺术博览中心位于广东佛山。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Lecong's furniture strip in Shunde District, about 10 km south of central Foshan by road.

name: 梦里水乡
summaryEn: A scenic area of flower parks and waterside villages in Lishui town, northern Nanhai, rated a 4A scenic area in 2018. Its centrepiece is the Menglishuixiang Flower Garden, opened in 2017, with flower fields, waterways and a large glasshouse, plus small trains and duck boats for children. Nearby stops on the town's 'water-town garden' route include the cycle path around Xianlu Island and the old village of Chishan.
description: 梦里水乡位于广东佛山。游览特色包括水乡、岛屿、花卉观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Lishui town, Nanhai District, about 25 km north of central Foshan and close to the western edge of Guangzhou by road.

name: 南海湾森林生态园
summaryEn: A forested hill park on the western side of Xiqiao in Nanhai district, laid out along the Yinxi stream with an easy streamside trail and shallow spots where children paddle. A longer path follows the stream uphill to Qingyun Dong, a Taoist temple complex on the hillside for which the area was long known. It is a gentle family day out from Foshan or Guangzhou rather than a serious hike.
description: 南海湾森林生态园位于广东佛山。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、海岸风光、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At the end of Qingyun Avenue on the western side of Xiqiao town, Nanhai district, about an hour by road south-west of central Guangzhou; most visitors drive.

name: 平洲玉器街
summaryEn: A district of jade workshops, trading halls and shops in Pingzhou, Guicheng subdistrict of Nanhai, which grew into one of China's main markets for jadeite (feicui), much of it rough stone from Myanmar, and a centre of bangle making. Listed as a 4A scenic area since 2014, it suits visitors interested in jade carving and jewellery rather than sightseeing.
description: 佛山南海平洲的玉器街汇集玉器作坊、交易大厅和店铺，是当地玉石加工与贸易的集中地。
accessEn: In Pingzhou, Guicheng, Nanhai District, about 8 km east of central Foshan; the Yuqijie (Jade Street) stop on Nanhai Tram Line 1 is beside it.

name: 三水森林公园
summaryEn: A large forest park on the northern outskirts of Xinan in Sanshui District, covering more than 120,000 mu (about 80 km²) of wooded hills, reservoirs and lakes. Besides walks in the forest, its sights include a large gilded reclining Buddha, a hall of Han and Tibetan Buddhist art, the Kongsheng Garden Confucian temple, Wuqing Valley and Yuanyang Lake, and there are outdoor sports for groups.
description: 三水森林公园位于广东佛山。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 2 km north of the Xinan area of Sanshui, roughly 30 km north-west of central Foshan by road.

name: 三水荷花世界
summaryEn: A lotus park of nearly 1,000 mu (about 65 hectares) in Sanshui District, opened in 2000 and rated a 4A scenic area in 2005, with about 200 mu of lotus ponds among its gardens and an amusement-ride area. It is best visited in the summer flowering season.
description: 三水荷花世界坐落于中华人民共和国广东省佛山市三水区西南街道，是一座荷花生态专类园，4A级旅游景点，佛山新八景之一。占地近千亩，于2000年对外营业，2005年获评AAAA国家级旅游景区。
accessEn: In Yundonghai subdistrict, Sanshui District, roughly 30 km north-west of central Foshan by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 盈香生态园
summaryEn: A large rural tourism park in Hecheng, Gaoming, organised around the seasons: flower fields in spring, water play in summer, hill walks in autumn and farm food in winter. It mixes farm sightseeing with displays of growing methods such as heated greenhouses, hydroponics and the traditional mulberry-dyke fish ponds, and visitors can try making Gaoming lai fen rice noodles, a listed intangible-heritage craft; it suits families.
description: 盈香生态园位于广东佛山。游览特色包括田园观光、花卉观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the western edge of Hecheng, the Gaoming district centre, about 40 km south-west of central Foshan by road.

name: 皂幕山
summaryEn: The highest mountain in Foshan, in the south of Gaoming District, named 'black curtain' for the dense dark forest that covers its slopes. The first 4A scenic area in Gaoming keeps much of its natural forest, with 781 native plant species recorded, and walkers climb to the summit for wide views; 'Zaomu above the clouds' is one of the Ten Sights of Foshan.
description: 皂幕山位于广东佛山。游览特色包括林地风光、登山观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The visitor centre at the Kengmei entrance is about 40 minutes by road from Hecheng, the Gaoming district centre, which is roughly 40 km south-west of central Foshan.

name: 紫南村
summaryEn: A village in Nanzhuang town, Chancheng District, that has made its Lingnan water-village setting into a cultural tourism area and is listed as a national key village for rural tourism and a national study-tour base. Visitors can take the 'Zinan boat' trip along its waterways, watch a staged water, light and dance show titled 'This is Zinan', and visit an art garden and a hall on Cantonese family precepts.
description: 紫南村位于广东佛山。游览特色包括田园观光、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Nanzhuang town, Chancheng District, about 12 km west of central Foshan by road.

name: 广州融创文旅城
summaryEn: Opened in 2019 in northern Huadu, Sunac Land is a large leisure complex begun by Wanda and completed by Sunac, combining a theme park, an indoor snow park, an indoor water park, a sports centre and a shopping mall. The theme park has six zones themed on Lingnan history and legend, a flight-simulation ride over Guangdong's landmarks and a large show on Lingnan culture, while the snow park, now branded Hot Snow Miracle, has indoor ski slopes.
description: 广州融创文旅城是一个中国的室内型主题公园，位于广州市花都区北部，总面积约220万平方米。
accessEn: On Fenghuang North Road in Huadu District, about 30 km north of central Guangzhou, near Huachengjie station.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 神农草堂中医药博物馆
summaryEn: Opened in 2006 by the Baiyunshan Hutchison Whampoa traditional-medicine company beside its works in Baiyun District, this museum of traditional Chinese medicine is laid out as a garden, with exhibition halls set among beds of growing medicinal herbs. Its two themed areas cover Chinese and Lingnan (southern Chinese) medicine, with displays on health traditions, herbal tea and artemisinin, the antimalarial drug derived from sweet wormwood.
description: 神农草堂中医药博物馆位于广东广州。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观、主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Shatai North Road in Baiyun District, about 10 km north-east of the old city centre, reached by bus or taxi. Closed on Mondays, and visits must be booked in advance.

name: 石门国家森林公园
summaryEn: Shimen is a national forest park in the hills of north-eastern Conghua, based on the Daling Mountain forest farm and covered with some of the best-preserved subtropical evergreen broadleaf forest in the region. Its north-western corner takes in Tiantang Ding, the highest peak in Guangzhou, and other sights include the rock gateway (shimen) that gives the park its name, mountain pools, and stands of wild Mucuna vines and red-flowered Rhodoleia trees.
description: 石门国家森林公园位于广东广州。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光、高山景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In north-eastern Conghua District, about 25 km from Conghua town and 85 km from central Guangzhou, best reached by car.

name: 石头记矿物园
summaryEn: Opened in 2009 by the Shitouji jewellery company in Huadu's jewellery town, this mineral park has an outdoor garden of rocks and petrified tree trunks above an underground exhibition of crystals, meteorites, gemstones and ornamental stones. It also has a shop selling the company's jewellery and a restaurant, and suits visitors interested in rocks and gems.
description: 石头记矿物园位于广东广州。游览特色包括园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the jewellery town area of Huadu District, about 35 km north of central Guangzhou, reached by bus or taxi from central Huadu.

name: 天人山水
summaryEn: Tianren Shanshui is a landscaped resort of about 10 square kilometres in the hills of Taiping, Conghua, laid out from 2013 around the Shaxi Reservoir. Its gardens, such as Jingjie Garden and Xinyuan Ju, are themed on the poems of Tao Yuanming and modelled on a Song-dynasty painting of the poet's retreat by Li Gonglin, and the resort adds lodging, campsites, outdoor sports and nature-education activities. It suits a day out or a weekend stay in the countryside.
description: 天人山水位于广东广州。游览特色包括水库、园林景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Taiping town, Conghua District, about 50 km north-east of central Guangzhou and roughly an hour by road; Guangyu Ancestral Hall in Qiangang village is nearby.

name: 巴伐利亚庄园
summaryEn: A large resort estate on the southern edge of Heyuan city, laid out in German Bavarian style, with hotels, holiday housing, a hot-spring spa, a water park and the Black Forest amusement park. Heyuan's government lists it as the city's only national-level tourist resort, and it is aimed mainly at families on short breaks.
description: 巴伐利亚庄园位于广东河源。游览特色包括主题游乐、水上游乐、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Gaopugang subdistrict, near the Changchun–Shenzhen expressway, about 15 km south of central Heyuan.

name: 和平温泉之都
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort area in Reshui town, Heping County, in the hills of northern Heyuan, centred on the Relong Hot Spring resort and rated a 4A scenic area in 2010. Resort hotels with thermal pools lie in the valley, and the Reshui river-rafting run is close by.
description: 和平温泉之都位于广东河源。游览特色包括温泉、山谷、水上活动。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Reshui town, Heping County, roughly 1.5 hours by road north of Heyuan city.

name: 黄龙岩
summaryEn: A scenic area of wooded hills and landscaped grounds in Zhangxi She Ethnic Township, northern Dongyuan County, themed on the customs of the She people, an ethnic minority of the uplands of south-eastern China. It became a 4A scenic area in 2024, and its grounds include ponds and an open-air performance stage.
description: 黄龙岩位于广东河源。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xialan village, Zhangxi She Ethnic Township, northern Dongyuan County, roughly an hour by road north-east of Heyuan city.

name: 御临门温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort with villa accommodation near Reshui village in Zijin County, which Heyuan's tourism plan names as the county's leading attraction and one of the city's 4A scenic areas. Its thermal pools and villas suit an overnight stay.
description: 御临门温泉位于广东河源。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Near Reshui village in Jiuhe town, Zijin County, roughly 60 km south-east of Heyuan city.

name: 大亚湾红树林城市湿地公园
summaryEn: An urban wetland park at the mouth of the Dan'ao River on Daya Bay, protecting a dense stand of mangroves beside the district's new town, with boardwalks through the trees; egrets nest here in spring. It was rated a 4A scenic area in 2018 and suits an hour or two of walking by the water.
description: 大亚湾红树林城市湿地公园位于广东惠州。游览特色包括湿地。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Daya Bay Economic and Technological Development Zone, about 40 km south of central Huizhou by road.

name: 南昆山云顶
summaryEn: A hot-spring hotel resort near the foot of the Nankun Mountains in southern Longmen County, rated a 4A scenic area in 2018. Its thermal pools suit an overnight stay combined with a visit to the Nankunshan forest area, in a county known for its hot springs.
description: 南昆山云顶位于广东惠州。游览特色包括温泉、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Maxing village, Yonghan town, on the Zengcheng–Longmen road in southern Longmen County, roughly 1.5 hours by road north-east of Guangzhou.

name: 巽寮湾
summaryEn: A beach resort district on the west coast of the Renping Peninsula, facing Daya Bay in Huidong County, with about 27 km of coastline, eight small bays and dozens of islets. Its white-sand beaches shelve gently, staying under 2 m deep for about 100 m from shore, and the shore is lined with hotels and holiday flats.
description: 巽寮湾位于中华人民共和国广东省珠江三角洲东部惠州市惠东县的大亚湾，属亚热带湿润气候，它是一个旅游度假区，总面积105平方公里，平均气温21.7摄氏度。历史上当地人以农业和渔业为生。自20世纪90年代以来旅游产业开始发展，总长20多公里的海岸线内，有八个海湾，以石奇美、水奇清、沙奇白著称，是粤东数百公里海岸线中海水最洁净的海湾之一，被誉为“绿色翡翠”和“天赐白金堤”。
accessEn: In Huidong County, roughly 1.5 hours by road south-east of central Huizhou.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 古劳水乡
summaryEn: A landscape of villages, fish ponds and waterways inside the Gulao dyke on the Xijiang River, first built in 1394 against floods, developed since 2019 by the OCT Group into a tourism area. Visitors take boats through the channels and walk the waterfront market street and lotus ponds, and the site has added children's play areas and, in 2025, an indoor snow park.
description: 古劳水乡，又称围墩水乡、华侨城古劳水乡景区、古劳水乡国家AAAA级旅游景区，是一处位于中华人民共和国广东省江门市鹤山古劳镇的旅游景区，由华侨城集团运营。位于西江河畔，总投资50亿元，用地面积10平方公里，于2020年启动建设，建设期为五年。
accessEn: In Gulao town, Heshan, about 35 km by road north-west of central Jiangmen.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 锦江温泉
summaryEn: A large hot-spring resort in Datian town, Enping, built around an activity theme, with a hot-spring surf pool, a circular rafting channel and about 50 themed spring pools. It was among the Jiangmen resorts certified in 2018 as using genuine natural hot-spring water.
description: 锦江温泉位于广东江门。游览特色包括温泉、水上活动、泉水。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Datian town, about 25 km by road north of Enping city.

name: 康桥温泉
summaryEn: A large hot-spring resort in Southeast Asian style in Baisha town, Taishan, with more than a hundred spring pools in activity, leisure, wellness and couples' zones, a water park popular with families and a resort hotel. It was among the Jiangmen resorts certified in 2018 as using genuine natural hot-spring water.
description: 康桥温泉位于广东江门。游览特色包括温泉、水上游乐、泉水。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Baisha town, about 25 km by road south-west of Taishan city.

name: 泉林黄金小镇
summaryEn: A modern resort town in Dongcheng, east of central Enping, built around a hot-spring park with hotels and holiday housing. Its other attractions are an aviation-themed exhibition hall, a water park and the Dahema go-kart circuit. It suits a weekend of soaking and family activities rather than sightseeing.
description: 泉林黄金小镇位于广东江门。游览特色包括水上游乐、主题展览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dongcheng town about 8 km east of central Enping, which is roughly two hours by road south-west of Guangzhou.

name: 山泉湾温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring hotel resort in the hills of Datian town, Enping, with themed spring-fed pools, water slides, a children's splash area and a large swimming pool. Enping promotes itself as a hot-spring town, and this is one of several resorts clustered around Datian.
description: 山泉湾温泉位于广东江门。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Datian town, about 25 km by road north of Enping city.

name: 黄满寨瀑布
summaryEn: A forested gorge in the hills of northern Jiexi County with a chain of waterfalls, linked by footpaths and steps up the valley. It is one of Jiexi's main scenic areas and is often visited together with the Jingming hot-spring resort.
description: 黄满寨瀑布位于广东揭阳。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In northern Jiexi County, about an hour by road north-west of Jieyang city.

name: 阳美玉都
summaryEn: Yangmei village in Pandong, on the eastern edge of Jieyang city, is where the region's jadeite trade began and is still the core of a large carving and trading district, although no jade is mined locally. Its workshops, showrooms and markets deal in carved jadeite, and Yangmei jadeite carving has been a national intangible heritage item since 2008.
description: 阳美玉都位于广东揭阳。游览特色包括非遗文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Pandong, about 15 minutes by taxi south-east of central Jieyang.

name: 大唐荔乡
summaryEn: A lychee-culture park of about 500 mu at Baiqiao in Genzi town, now officially named Baiqiao Lychee Park, in an area where lychees have been grown for more than 2,000 years. Its heart is the Genzi Tribute Garden, an old orchard said to date from the Sui and Tang with 95 trees over a century old, nine of them more than a thousand years old; the park also takes in the China Lychee Museum, with seven halls on the fruit's history, and a national lychee germplasm nursery.
description: 大唐荔乡位于广东茂名。游览特色包括博物馆、果园、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Baiqiao in Genzi town, about 30 km south-east of Gaozhou city by road.

name: 窦州古城
summaryEn: The old walled seat of Xinyi county at Zhenlong, founded in 621 and the county town until 1952, which also served as the seat of Douzhou prefecture from 634 to 1071. The walls were pulled down in 1939, but the red Wenming Gate survives along with the old county school, which rebels of the short-lived Dahong kingdom used as a palace, and a dense quarter of Qing and Republican clan academies, ancestral halls and merchants' houses. It is one of the better-preserved old towns of western Guangdong, worth a slow walk.
description: 窦州古城，又称信宜古城、镇隆古城，位于广东省信宜市镇隆镇八坊村，始建于唐武德四年，历史上曾长期作为信宜县治所在地，唐贞观八年至宋熙宁四年还曾兼作窦州府治，故被称为“窦州古城”。窦州古城是粤西地区保存最为完整的古城及古村落之一，现存面积约1.5平方公里，是国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: In Bafang village, Zhenlong town, about 20 km south of Xinyi city by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 广垦国家热带农业公园
summaryEn: A large agricultural theme park of about 5,000 mu on the edge of Huazhou, built by the state-owned Guangdong agricultural reclamation group and approved by the Ministry of Agriculture. Eight themed gardens show tropical crops and fruit growing, with science and hands-on areas and a hotel, and it suits families and school groups.
description: 广垦国家热带农业公园位于广东茂名。游览特色包括主题游乐、田园观光、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shiwan subdistrict on the edge of Huazhou city, about 50 km west of central Maoming by road.

name: 莲花湖庄园
summaryEn: A lakeside resort of about 600 mu in Chidong town north of Xinyi, near the Guangdong–Guangxi border, built around Lotus Lake. It combines a lakeside greenway and culture corridors, a glass bridge, a Ferris wheel and a small amusement area with a food street themed on the ancient Baiyue peoples and a Wyndham hotel.
description: 莲花湖庄园位于广东茂名。游览特色包括湖泊、玻璃栈道、绿道骑行。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Chidong town, about 8 km north of Xinyi city by road.

name: 茂名森林公园
summaryEn: A provincial forest park of about 4,500 mu on the south-western edge of Maoming city, opened in 2002 on the site of an old state forestry farm. Besides wooded hills and walking paths it has botanical gardens, a zoo with an animal-show arena, a water park, an adventure course, a plant maze and a science museum, which make it a family outing.
description: 广东茂名森林公园，位于中国广东省茂名市茂南区西南部，始建于1999年11月，2002年12月对外开放，占地面积4500多亩，是一个集自然生态、旅游娱乐、科研科普于一体的具有亚热带风光特色的综合型近郊森林公园，是茂名市唯一的省级森林公园以及首个国家AAAA级旅游景区、广东省首批自然教育基地，每年接待游客超过80万人次。
accessEn: About 12 km south-west of central Maoming in Maonan District; city buses stop at the park.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 浪漫海岸
summaryEn: A seaside resort on 5.3 km of natural coastline in Maoming's Binhai New Area, built in South-East Asian style around a 'love and romance' theme. Coconut groves, lawns, rocky islets and a fishing harbour frame the beach, and the resort has hotels, restaurants, shops and conference facilities.
description: 浪漫海岸位于广东茂名。游览特色包括海滨、海岸风光、海岛。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Bohe town in Maoming's Binhai New Area, about half an hour's drive east of China's First Beach along the coast.

name: 高州仙人洞
summaryEn: A forested mountain area around Xianrendong village on the southern slopes of Datianding, the high range in north-east Gaozhou, known locally as an 'air-conditioned village' for its cool summers. Besides forest walks and a series of waterfalls, it has wild Mucuna vines whose bird-shaped flowers bloom in spring, a glass suspension bridge, a bamboo slide and guesthouses, and it is promoted as a summer retreat from the lowland heat.
description: 高州仙人洞位于广东茂名。游览特色包括瀑布、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Xianrendong village on the southern slopes of Datianding, about 70 km north-east of Gaozhou city by mountain road.

name: 御水古温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort of about 500 mu at the foot of Reshui (Hot Water) Mountain in Magang town, Dianbai, on what was once an old post road. Hot-spring pools and gardens spread through a valley of rocks and lychee orchards, old poem steles and cliff inscriptions survive in the grounds, and a large resort hotel stands on site.
description: 御水古温泉位于广东茂名。游览特色包括温泉、果园、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Magang town, Dianbai District, about 30 km north-east of Shuidong by road.

name: 百侯名镇
summaryEn: An old Hakka town in Dabu County whose villages of Hounan and Houbei keep more than 120 houses from the Ming and Qing dynasties, many built in the grand 'official-hall' style of scholar-official families. The town also has Zhaoqing Tang, a hall completed in 1917 and listed as a national heritage site in 2019. The old quarter is divided into five themed areas covering scholar-farmer family life, the old alleys and the former market, and Hounan is a listed Chinese Traditional Village.
description: 百侯名镇位于广东梅州。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、历史街区。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Baihou town, about 8 km east of Huliao, Dabu's county town, and roughly 1.5 hours by road from Meizhou.

name: 长潭
summaryEn: A reservoir on the Shiku River in the hills of Changtan town, northern Jiaoling County, set among wooded slopes in an area protected as a provincial nature reserve. Boat trips on the broad, calm lake have been its main draw, and the area is also promoted for the Hakka village life along its banks.
description: 长潭位于广东梅州。游览特色包括湖泊、水库、自然保护区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Changtan town, about 8 km north of Jiaoling's county town and roughly an hour by road from Meizhou. The visitor centre and boat pier have been closed since May 2026 while the Changtan reservoir is enlarged, so check whether the area has reopened before going.

name: 客天下
summaryEn: A large Hakka-themed tourism and residential development in Sanjiao town on the southern edge of Meizhou, built up since the mid-2000s and planned to cover some 637 hectares. Its visitor areas include a Hakka-style town, a main plaza, the hillside Shengren Zhai ('Sage's Village'), a wedding hall and large flower gardens, with sculptures, murals and folk performances on Hakka customs, while housing estates and hotels share the site. It is a modern creation rather than a historic village, and suits visitors wanting an easy introduction to Hakka culture close to the city.
description: 客天下位于广东梅州。游览特色包括壁画、花卉观赏、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Sanjiao town, about 5 km south-east of central Meizhou, around 15 minutes by taxi or city bus.

name: 韩山
summaryEn: A tea-growing upland on Hanshan in Fengliang town, northern Fengshun County, developed as a scenic area around the Hanshan tea plantation and rated 4A in 2023. Visitors walk among the tea terraces and the azalea slopes, try tea picking and see the Hanshan Tea Museum, and it makes a half-day outing from Fengshun or Meizhou.
description: 韩山位于广东梅州。游览特色包括博物馆、茶园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Fengliang town, about 16 km north of Tangkeng, Fengshun's county town, and roughly an hour by road from Meizhou.

name: 球王故里
summaryEn: A football-themed tourism area in Wuhua County honouring Lee Wai Tong (Li Huitang, 1905–1979), the Hong Kong-born footballer of Wuhua descent who captained China at the 1936 Berlin Olympics and later became a vice-president of FIFA. It links his family home, Lianqing Lou, a Hakka house in Laolou village, Hengpi town, with the Huitang Stadium, a statue and square in his honour and the Wuhua Football Science and Technology Museum in the county town of Shuizhai.
description: 球王故里位于广东梅州。游览特色包括科学科普、体育运动。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In and around Shuizhai, Wuhua's county town, about 75 km by road south-west of Meizhou; Lianqing Lou is a short drive away in Hengpi town.

name: 三河坝战役纪念园
summaryEn: A memorial park on Bizhiwei Hill at Sanhe, the town where the Ting, Mei and Meitan rivers join to form the Han River, marking the battle fought here in early October 1927 between part of the Nanchang Uprising army under Zhu De and the Nationalist 32nd Army. A granite monument with an inscription by Zhu De was raised on the battlefield in 1963 and a martyrs' cemetery added in 1974; a memorial museum on the site presents the battle.
description: 三河坝战役纪念园位于广东梅州。游览特色包括博物馆、战役遗址、历史纪念。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the edge of Sanhe town, about 13 km north-west of Huliao, Dabu's county town, and roughly 1 hour 15 minutes by road from Meizhou.

name: 五指石
summaryEn: A Danxia landscape of reddish sandstone cliffs in Chagan town, close to where Guangdong, Fujian and Jiangxi meet, named after five sheer peaks that stand side by side like the fingers of a hand. Trails pass narrow rock clefts, a spring, the rebuilt Shilin Temple (first founded in the Ming dynasty) and the ruins of a pagoda, and a cliffside walkway about 2.9 km long, with glass sections, runs high along the rock faces.
description: 五指石位于广东梅州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、古塔。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Chagan town at the northern tip of Pingyuan County, about 45 km by road north of Pingyuan's county town and roughly 2 hours from Meizhou.

name: 熙和湾
summaryEn: A modern theme park at Lanpai village, Yonghe town, on the edge of Xingning, built around Hakka culture, the area's lantern-making tradition and Chinese family names. Its landmark is a 36-metre tower in the shape of a lantern, recognised by Guinness World Records in 2017 as the largest lantern-shaped building, and the park also has a glass suspension bridge, an elevated rafting ride, a water park and sculpture galleries of Hakka folk life.
description: 熙和湾位于广东梅州。游览特色包括主题游乐、水上游乐、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yonghe town, about 10 km east of central Xingning and roughly an hour by road from Meizhou.

name: 雁山湖
summaryEn: A flower-themed holiday resort at Nanfu village in Yanyang town, combining seasonal flower gardens with a lake of about 800 mu (some 53 hectares) and the wooded hills of a national forest park. It has children's play areas, Hakka restaurants and pod-style 'Earth capsule' cabins among its lodgings, and suits families on a weekend break.
description: 雁山湖位于广东梅州。游览特色包括森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yanyang town, Meixian District, about 35 km by road east of central Meizhou, near Ye Jianying Memorial Park.

name: 洞天仙境
summaryEn: A karst scenic area in the Yingxi Peak Forest Corridor of western Yingde, billed as South China's first tiankeng: a large collapsed sinkhole among the limestone peaks. It was developed by the same company as the Jiulong farm resort nearby, and the official Yingxi rural tourism route links the two.
description: 洞天仙境位于广东清远。游览特色包括田园观光、林地风光、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jiulong town in western Yingde, about 2 km west of the town and 60 km south-west of Yingde city by road.

name: 广东瑶族博物馆
summaryEn: A museum in Liannan's county town devoted to the Yao people, covering the history and culture of the Yao branches across China and abroad. Displays include costume, Yao embroidery and the story of Yao migrations, and the province's Liannan ethnic-culture route pairs it with the Yao villages in the hills to the south.
description: 广东瑶族博物馆位于广东清远。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Bowuguan Road in Sanjiang, Liannan's county town, a short walk or taxi ride from the centre. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 古龙峡
summaryEn: A forested canyon in Qingxin District developed for adventure tourism, best known for white-water rafting on a 6.1 km course that drops 378 m through tight bends and chutes. Above the gorge are a glass sky-walk and viewing platform, aerial adventure rides and a chain of waterfalls with nine tiers. The rafting course was laid out to racing standards and has hosted international events and Guangdong's provincial rafting competition.
description: 古龙峡位于广东清远。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the hills of Qingxin District, about 70 km (roughly 1.5 hours) by road north-west of central Guangzhou.

name: 河中温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in Sankeng town, Qingxin District, with open-air pools beside a tree-lined river embankment; the name means 'hot spring in the river'. Until 2024 the scenic area was officially called the Qingxin Warm Mineral Spring resort, and it has its own hotel and guesthouse rooms for an overnight soak.
description: 河中温泉位于广东清远。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Sankeng town, Qingxin District, about 30 km west of central Qingyuan by road.

name: 湟川三峡·龙潭
summaryEn: A river scenic area south of Lianzhou where the Huangchuan, a headwater of the North River, winds through three steep gorges of cliffs and dripping limestone, praised by the 17th-century writer Qu Dajun. The Qingtian glass bridge spans the top of a group of waterfalls on the cliffs, and the Longtan area adds folk performances by local ethnic minorities. The river is also a national water-conservancy scenic area.
description: 湟川三峡·龙潭位于广东清远。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 10 km south-east of Lianzhou city by road.

name: 金子山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in the uplands of Lianshan Zhuang and Yao Autonomous County, promoted as a place to see snow in southern China, with rare rime ice on the trees in winter. Trails lead past the rock formation known as Yin-Yang Mountain and Queen Peak, with spring flowers, summer sunrises over a sea of cloud and, in autumn, views over three provinces.
description: 金子山位于广东清远。游览特色包括山地游览、山岩地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In northern Lianshan Zhuang and Yao Autonomous County, roughly an hour by mountain road from the county town.

name: 积庆里仙湖
summaryEn: A tea and hot-spring resort area north-west of Yingde, the city known as China's home of black tea, built around the hillside plantations of the Jiqingli Black Tea Valley. It combines tea gardens among karst hills and forest lakes with a hot-spring town and a resort community, and the tea valley has been named one of Guangdong's ten most beautiful tea gardens.
description: 积庆里仙湖位于广东清远。游览特色包括山谷、园林景观、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 25 km north-west of Yingde city by road.

name: 峰林晓镇
summaryEn: A large farm park and rural resort in Jiulong town, set among the limestone pinnacles of the Yingxi Peak Forest, Guangdong's densest belt of karst peaks. It mixes farmland, flower and lotus fields, village guesthouses and hotels, with a small sightseeing train through the lotus ponds and, in the evening, a water-screen light show and night market. A lotus festival is held each summer.
description: 峰林晓镇位于广东清远。游览特色包括林地风光、喀斯特地貌、农业体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jiulong town in western Yingde, about 60 km south-west of Yingde city by road.

name: 聚龙湾温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in Tangtang, the hot-spring town of Fogang County, with bathing pools and hotel accommodation, built by a Hong Kong-invested company. It was rated a national 4A scenic area in 2008, the first in Fogang County, and is one of several spa resorts around Tangtang.
description: 聚龙湾温泉位于广东清远。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tangtang town, Fogang County, about an hour by road north of Guangzhou.

name: 南岗千年瑶寨
summaryEn: A hillside village of the Pai Yao, a Yao group whose homeland is Liannan, with houses rising in tiers up a steep mountain slope above Sanpai town. It is listed as a China Historical and Cultural Village, and visitors climb its stepped lanes past the village gate, old defensive walls, the Yao king's house, a hilltop temple and the square used for song and dance gatherings. Provincial tourism routes suggest staying a night in the village.
description: 南岗千年瑶寨位于广东清远。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、村寨、草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 25 km by road south of Liannan's county town (Sanjiang), turning off the S114 at Sanpai town onto a winding mountain road.

name: 新银盏温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort at Yinzhan in southern Qingcheng District, built around large open-air thermal pools. Besides the pools it has a hotel, private hot-spring villas, sports grounds and a team-building centre, and it has been named one of Guangdong's ten best hot springs.
description: 新银盏温泉位于广东清远。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside Yinzhan station on the Guangzhou–Qingyuan intercity railway, about 15 km south of central Qingyuan; next door, Qingyuan Chimelong station is the start of the maglev line to the Chimelong Forest Kingdom park.

name: 森波拉度假森林
summaryEn: A theme resort in the forested hills of Yangjiao Mountain in Fogang County, opened in 2007 by a Hong Kong developer. It has three main parts: a 'volcano' hot-spring park with a staged eruption show, a glacier-themed water park, and Senbola Wonder World, a forest theme park built around an invented tribal culture. It suits families on a resort break from Guangzhou or Shenzhen.
description: 森波拉度假森林位于广东清远。游览特色包括主题游乐、火山地貌、冰川。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 4 km from the Fogang exit of the Beijing–Hong Kong–Macao Expressway, roughly an hour by road north of Guangzhou.

name: 万山朝王
summaryEn: A viewpoint and national stony-desertification park in the karst hills south of Liannan's county town, named 'ten thousand hills paying homage to the king' after the ranks of rocky peaks facing it across the valley. Its viewing platforms are popular with photographers, and the park also has a ginkgo grove of about 1,000 mu and Guangdong's first exhibition hall on rocky desertification and its control.
description: 万山朝王位于广东清远。游览特色包括沙漠、山谷、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside provincial road S261, about 8 km south of Liannan's county town (Sanjiang) on the way to the Yao villages.

name: 熹乐谷温泉
summaryEn: A large hot-spring resort complex in Tangtang, the hot-spring town of Fogang County, set in the hills around Huanghua Lake. Alongside the Phoenix hot-spring pools it has several hotels and guesthouses, a water park, a playground, a campsite, go-karts, a folk-culture village and staged cultural performances. It is aimed at families on short breaks from the Pearl River Delta, in summer for the water park and in winter for the springs.
description: 熹乐谷温泉位于广东清远。游览特色包括温泉、湖泊。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Tangtang town, Fogang County, about an hour by road north of Guangzhou.

name: 玄真漂流
summaryEn: A resort area on the northern edge of Taihe, Qingxin District's main town, centred on rafting down a mountain stream through a wooded gorge. Around the Xuanzhen Ancient Cave it also has hill scenery and rock formations, a hotel and restaurants.
description: 玄真漂流位于广东清远。游览特色包括峡谷、林地风光、水上活动。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the northern edge of Taihe, Qingxin District's main town, about 8 km north-west of central Qingyuan by road.

name: 方特欢乐世界·蓝水星
summaryEn: A science-fiction themed amusement park in Longhu district near the Shantou Bay Bridge, built with ride and show systems from the Fantawild group; official tourism lists now call it Blue Water Planet (Lanshuixing). It has themed indoor and outdoor rides and a children's area, and suits a family day out.
description: 方特欢乐世界·蓝水星位于广东汕头。游览特色包括主题游乐、游乐体验。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Longhu district, about 20 minutes by road east of central Shantou. Check that it is open before going.

name: 莲花峰
summaryEn: A granite headland in Haimen town, Chaoyang, named for boulders split like lotus petals and tied by legend to the Song loyalist Wen Tianxiang, who is said to have watched here in vain for the fleeing Song emperor's ships in 1278. Lianfeng Academy, built in 1594 in his memory, stands below the peak, and the area also has cliff inscriptions, odd rock formations and a beach.
description: 莲花峰位于广东汕头。游览特色包括海滨、书院文化、莲花观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Haimen town on the Chaoyang coast, about an hour by road south-west of central Shantou.

name: 莲华乡村旅游区
summaryEn: A rural tourism area in Lianhua town, north-east Chenghai, centred on Lianhua Mountain. Paths lead up the mountain, and orchid nurseries, leisure farms and a hot-spring resort lie around its foot; it suits a country day out rather than sightseeing.
description: 莲华乡村旅游区位于广东汕头。游览特色包括田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Lianhua town, about 40 minutes by road north of central Shantou; check that the hot-spring resort is open before going.

name: 中海龙虎滩
summaryEn: A sandy beach on Longhutan (Dragon and Tiger Beach) in Haojiang district, south of central Shantou; the scenic area, known until 2023 as the CITIC Golf Seaside Resort, now covers only the beachfront. The beach is used for swimming and water sports, including a national surfing contest in 2025, and a resort hotel and the Zhonghai water park are nearby.
description: 中海龙虎滩位于广东汕头。游览特色包括海滨、水上游乐、海岸风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the coast of Haojiang district, about 40 minutes by road south of central Shantou.

name: 螺洞世外梅园
summaryEn: A hillside plum orchard around Luodong village in Shuichun town, Luhe, a Hakka county known for its green plums, rated a 4A scenic area in 2023. Around the Minor and Major Cold solar terms in January, the blossom on more than 10,000 mu (about 670 hectares) of trees covers the slopes white, and boardwalks, a streamside park, old woodland and named rocks can be visited all year.
description: 螺洞世外梅园位于广东汕尾。游览特色包括果园、林地风光、赏花。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Luodong village, Shuichun town, Luhe County, about an hour by road north of Shanwei city.

name: 水底山
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort of about 85 hectares in forested hills at the heart of the Shenzhen-Shanwei Special Cooperation Zone, where a river valley forms a chain of pools and waterfalls. Its spring water emerges at about 73°C, and the resort has bathing pools, a long infinity pool and a hotel; a paragliding base operates on the slopes of Shuidi Mountain nearby.
description: 水底山位于广东汕尾。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Chishi subdistrict of the Shenzhen-Shanwei Special Cooperation Zone, a part of Shanwei administered by Shenzhen, roughly 2 hours by road east of central Shenzhen.

name: 曹溪温泉假日度假村
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in Mabao town, Qujiang district, about 2 km from Nanhua Temple, the monastery of the Chan patriarch Huineng, so the two are easily combined. It has outdoor hot-spring pools, a summer water-play pool with slides, sweat-bath and salt-bath rooms, and hotel accommodation. It is a place for an overnight soak rather than a sight in itself.
description: 曹溪温泉假日度假村位于广东韶关。游览特色包括温泉、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Mabao town, Qujiang district, about 2 km north-west of Nanhua Temple and about 20 km by road south of central Shaoguan.

name: 东华山
summaryEn: A hill scenic area on the eastern edge of Wengyuan town, centred on Donghua Temple, a Chan Buddhist monastery whose main hall houses a large gilded Buddha. Paths climb from the temple to a hilltop viewing platform over the surrounding hills, and cherry trees around the temple flower in early spring.
description: 东华山位于广东韶关。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、佛教文化、观景台。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 5 km east of central Wengyuan (Longxian town), roughly an hour and a half by road south-east of Shaoguan city.

name: 广东大峡谷
summaryEn: A deep, forested gorge in Dabu town in the far south-west of Ruyuan county, cut through quartz sandstone by the Dabu River, which drops from the rim to the valley floor in a large waterfall. A stone stairway of more than 1,300 steps descends into the canyon past rock pillars and falls such as Tenglong Falls and Huanglong Pool, and the scenic area stages high-wire acrobatic shows across the gorge.
description: 广东大峡谷位于广东韶关。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dabu town, Ruyuan county, about 100 km by road south-west of Shaoguan city; public transport is sparse, so most visitors drive.

name: 古佛洞天
summaryEn: A limestone show cave on the south-western outskirts of Lechang, also called Gufo Yan ('Ancient Buddha Rock') because Buddha images were once placed inside and a temple was built at its mouth. A lit walkway leads through stacked chambers of stalactites, stalagmites and flowstone, which stay cool all year at under 20 °C.
description: 古佛洞天位于广东韶关。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、洞穴、钟乳石。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 5 km south-west of central Lechang near the Leguang Expressway entrance, roughly an hour by road north-west of Shaoguan city.

name: 经律论文化旅游小镇
summaryEn: A Chan (Zen) Buddhist-themed hot-spring resort inside Xiaokeng National Forest Park in Qujiang district, opened in 2014, with a forest hot-spring area, a hotel, a suspension bridge across a wooded valley and a jade statue of Guanyin. It is a modern leisure resort, best for an overnight soak combined with a visit to Nanhua Temple.
description: 经律论文化旅游小镇位于广东韶关。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xiaokeng town, Qujiang district, about 40 km by road south-east of Shaoguan city.

name: 云天海原始森林度假村
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in forested hills beside the G105 road in Xinfeng county, with spring-fed outdoor pools, a mountain-water play park and hotel accommodation. It is a leisure resort for a weekend soak rather than a sightseeing destination.
description: 云天海原始森林度假村位于广东韶关。游览特色包括林地风光、休闲度假。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside the G105 about 12 km south-west of Xinfeng town, roughly two and a half hours by road north-east of Guangzhou.

name: 光明农场大观园
summaryEn: A family farm park on land of the old Guangming state farm, founded in the late 1950s and long known for its dairy, with fields, flower beds, animal enclosures and hands-on farming activities such as crop picking. Seasonal festivals add staged shows and evening lantern displays.
description: 光明农场大观园位于广东深圳。游览特色包括农业体验、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Guangming district in north-western Shenzhen; take Metro Line 6 to Guangming Street station, then a local bus.

name: 观澜山水田园
summaryEn: A farm-style leisure park of about 27 hectares in Guanlan, laid out in Lingnan and Hakka water-village style, with a resort hotel, village hot springs, a water park with a wave pool and a children's amusement area. Its country restaurant serves Hakka food, and the park is aimed at families from the city.
description: 观澜山水田园位于广东深圳。游览特色包括温泉、水上游乐、公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Guanlan, Longhua district, about 25 km north of central Shenzhen, near the Mission Hills golf area.

name: 欢乐港湾
summaryEn: A waterfront leisure and shopping district on Qianhai Bay in Bao'an's new city centre, developed by the OCT Group, with seaside promenades, shops and restaurants. Its centrepiece is Bay Glory, a 128 m cantilevered Ferris wheel opened in April 2021, whose cabins look out over Qianhai Bay and the Pearl River estuary.
description: 欢乐港湾位于广东深圳。游览特色包括海岸风光、购物街区。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xin'an subdistrict, Bao'an district, about 25 km north-west of central Shenzhen and a walk from Linhai metro station.

name: 春湾风景区
summaryEn: A karst area beside Chunwan town in northern Yangchun, ringed by craggy limestone peaks that have been used as a film location. Its sights include the Longgong Yan ('Dragon Palace') cave, a stone forest of limestone pinnacles, the Tongzhen and Ciyun caves, a tall rock pillar called the 'Sky Candle' and the old Nawu bridge.
description: 春湾风景区位于广东阳江。游览特色包括石林、林地风光、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside Chunwan town, about 35 km north of Yangchun city by road.

name: 大澳渔村
summaryEn: An old fishing village in the south-east of Dongping town on the Yangdong coast, once a port of call on the Maritime Silk Road, that keeps the look of a Ming and Qing fishing settlement beside its harbour. Its old street faces the moored boats, the village's folk-customs hall now serves as the Yangdong District Museum with displays on the Tanka boat people, and when the fishing season reopens in mid-August the harbour fills with visitors buying fresh seafood.
description: 大澳渔村位于广东阳江。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Dongping town, Yangdong District; from Yangdong station on the high-speed line it is roughly an hour by car or taxi. The museum in the village is closed on Mondays.

name: 金水台温泉小镇
summaryEn: A modern hot-spring resort town in Shuitai, Xinxing county, run by the Xiangshun group and known for having three different types of natural hot spring in one area, with outdoor bathing pools, hotels and conference facilities. Xinxing county is known for its hot springs, and Guo'en Temple at Liuzu town is about 25 km to the west.
description: 金水台温泉小镇位于广东云浮。游览特色包括温泉、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shuitai town, about 25 km by road south-east of Xinxing town.

name: 鼎龙湾
summaryEn: A large beach resort on the coast of Qinba town, Wuchuan, opened in 2017, with hotels and holiday flats along a long sandy beach and a water park. At holidays it stages lion dances, folk parades, light shows and fireworks, and it is built for beach holidays and family breaks.
description: 鼎龙湾位于广东湛江。游览特色包括海滨、水上游乐。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: On the coast of Wuchuan, about an hour by road east of central Zhanjiang.

name: 蓝月湾温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort at the Haibin Hotel in Xiashan district, central Zhanjiang, now listed as Blue Moon Bay; its earlier name, Haibin Volcanic Hot Spring, comes from the geothermal water drawn from volcanic rock. Its outdoor pools make a relaxing spa stop in town rather than a sight.
description: 蓝月湾温泉位于广东湛江。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Haibin Hotel on Haibin Avenue, Xiashan district, central Zhanjiang.

name: 金沙湾
summaryEn: An urban seafront in Chikan district, north of central Zhanjiang, with a sandy bathing beach, a seaside promenade park and open squares backed by the towers of the Jinsha Bay new town. It is a place for a stroll and a swim by the bay rather than a destination in itself.
description: 金沙湾位于广东湛江。游览特色包括海滨、海岸风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Chikan district, central Zhanjiang, a short taxi ride from downtown.

name: 茂德公鼓城
summaryEn: A resort and culture park in Leizhou opened in 2015, themed on drums and built in the style of the region's Ming and Qing architecture. Its food street, named a provincial Cantonese food street in 2022, and its squares host lion dances, Lei opera and other folk performances, with staged shows built around the Leizhou drum.
description: 鼓城以雷州鼓文化为主题，园区建筑参考当地明清建筑风貌。
accessEn: In Leizhou city, about an hour by road south-west of central Zhanjiang.

name: 遂溪孔子文化城
summaryEn: A Confucian-themed park on Bangtang Ridge in Suixi county town, opened in 2016; its new Confucius temple, completed in 2017, replaces the county's old one, demolished in 1978. The temple is modelled on the one at Qufu, with a seven-bay Dacheng Hall, and is joined by a Wenchang pavilion, a shopping street built in Spring and Autumn style, lotus lakes and natural basalt columns left by ancient eruptions.
description: 遂溪孔子文化城，又称孔圣山生态旅游区，前身为遂溪孔庙，是中国广东省湛江市遂溪县遂城街道的一处以儒家文化为主题的旅游景区，总面积1380亩。
accessEn: On the edge of Suixi county town, about 40 minutes by road north-west of central Zhanjiang.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 贺江碧道画廊
summaryEn: A riverside greenway along the He River in Fengkai County, running from Jiangkou, the county town, upstream to Dazhou town near the Guangxi border, on the old Xiaohe road between Guangdong and Guangxi. Cycle paths, a 121 km 'Hejiang 100 li' cycling route and riverside parks follow the bamboo-lined banks, and sightseeing boats run between Guangxin pier and Longhuang Island with its old-pier park. Villages, guesthouses and a forest wellness base along the way make it a slow, scenic day out.
description: 贺江碧道画廊位于广东肇庆。游览特色包括岛屿、滨水景观、绿道骑行。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Starts at Jiangkou, Fengkai's county town, roughly three hours by road west of Guangzhou; boats leave from Guangxin pier.

name: 封开龙山
summaryEn: A karst scenic area in Heerkou town, part of the Fengkai National Geopark, where limestone hills rise from the valley floor in a landscape locals compare to Guilin. Paths lead around the hills and into caves, one of which has been fitted out as a themed show cave.
description: 封开龙山位于广东肇庆。游览特色包括地质景观、山谷、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Heerkou town, about 50 km by road east of Fengkai's county town (Jiangkou). Zhaoqing's 2026 list marks the area as closed for upgrading, so check that it has reopened before going.

name: 猫爪谷
