summaryEn: A cat-themed leisure park of about 600 mu in Huilong town, Gaoyao District, built for family day trips. It mixes cat-themed art and interactive attractions with animal and plant displays, fruit and vegetable picking, flower fields, water play and 'starry-sky' tents for overnight stays.
description: 猫爪谷位于广东肇庆。游览特色包括花卉观赏、公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Huilong town, Gaoyao District, about 30 km south-east of central Zhaoqing by road.

name: 盘龙峡
summaryEn: A wooded mountain valley in northern Deqing County known for its chain of waterfalls. Visitors climb paths beside the stream past the falls, and the gorge has been used for rafting in the warm season.
description: 盘龙峡位于广东肇庆。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Guanxu town in the hills of northern Deqing County, about 30 km north of Deqing's county town by road. The area was being upgraded in 2026, so check that it is open before going.

name: 奇石河
summaryEn: A forested river valley in Weizheng town in the hills of northern Sihui, where Sihui meets Guangning and Qingyuan. As its name, 'strange-rock river', suggests, it is visited for a boulder-strewn mountain stream crossed by a broad curtain-like waterfall, with natural pools for swimming in summer.
description: 奇石河位于广东肇庆。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Weizheng town, about 50 km north of Sihui city by road.

name: 绥江竹海
summaryEn: An eco-tourism area of bamboo-covered hills along the Sui River on the edge of Guangning, a county known as the home of bamboo. Covering about 8 km², it links an old river pier, a Taoist shrine, a bamboo ecology art museum, plank walkways through the bamboo and a campsite, and is used for walks, camping and stays in bamboo-country guesthouses.
description: 绥江竹海位于广东肇庆。游览特色包括博物馆、栈道。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Benche village, Nanjie, about 6 km south-west of Guangning's county town and about 1 hour 20 minutes by road from Guangzhou.

name: 大涌红木文化博览城
summaryEn: A large complex of new buildings in mixed old styles in Dachong, a town whose hardwood ('redwood' or mahogany) furniture industry dates from the late 1970s, combining Lingnan, Jiangnan, Huizhou and imperial palace architecture. It was built as a culture, commerce and tourism complex for the furniture trade, and its old-style halls and streets are as much a shopping centre as a sight.
description: 中山大涌的展示园区依托当地硬木家具产业，以传统风格建筑呈现家具和工艺文化。
accessEn: On Qichong Road in Dachong town, about 10 km south-west of central Zhongshan (Shiqi) by road.

name: 华艺广场
summaryEn: A lighting-industry showcase run by the Huayi lighting group in Guzhen, a town built on the lighting industry. Visitors tour themed, hands-on displays on lighting design and manufacture, and it is mainly aimed at study tours and anyone curious about the town's trade.
description: 古镇镇的灯饰产业展览空间集中展示灯具与照明设计。
accessEn: On Zhongxing Avenue South in Guzhen town, about 25 km north-west of central Zhongshan by road.

name: 詹园
summaryEn: A private classical garden built from 1998 over five years by the Macau businessman Huang Yuanxin for his mother and named after her family name, Zhan. Laid out by craftsmen brought from Suzhou on a hillside with water through the middle, it blends Suzhou and Lingnan garden styles with some Western touches, and it opened to visitors after his mother moved out.
description: 詹园位于广东中山。游览特色包括园林、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside the G105 road at Beitai village in Nanqu, on the southern edge of central Zhongshan.

name: 汤臣倍健透明工厂
summaryEn: A working factory of the dietary-supplement maker By-Health in Sanzao, Jinwan District, opened to visitors in 2012 so that the public can follow its raw-material stores, production lines and testing laboratories. A nutrition exploration hall added in 2019 offers interactive health displays and simple health checks, and a highly automated fourth-phase plant has been running since 2021; by mid-2026 the site had received more than two million visitors.
description: 汤臣倍健透明工厂位于广东珠海。游览特色包括工业参观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Sanzao town, Jinwan District, about 45 km by road south-west of central Zhuhai and a few kilometres from Zhuhai Jinwan Airport.

name: 圆明新园
summaryEn: A theme park at the foot of Shijing Mountain in Xiangzhou, Zhuhai, opened in 1997 with full-size reconstructions of scenes from Beijing's Old Summer Palace (Yuanmingyuan), which was burnt in 1860. Chinese palace halls and Jiangnan-style garden buildings line a central axis and the shores of a lake modelled on the Fuhai, while the western part recreates the European-style palaces, including the Haiyan Tang and the great fountain.
description: 圆明新园位于广东珠海。游览特色包括湖泊、主题游乐。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Jiuzhou Avenue in Xiangzhou District, central Zhuhai, the terminus of several city bus routes and about 15 minutes by taxi from Gongbei.

name: 罗西尼工业旅游区
summaryEn: The factory park of the Zhuhai watchmaker Rossini at Tangjiawan, where a company-funded museum of clocks and watches opened in 2012. Its halls trace timekeeping from ancient instruments to modern wristwatches, with hands-on displays, and a viewing area looks onto the watch production lines.
description: 罗西尼工业旅游区位于广东珠海。游览特色包括博物馆、工业参观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tangjiawan town in northern Xiangzhou District, about 20 km by road north of central Zhuhai.

name: 百色欢乐小镇
summaryEn: A leisure complex south-east of Baise built around the Xinghe water park, with other family attractions and a street of restaurants and shops. It is a place for families after water rides and amusements rather than sightseeing.
description: 百色欢乐小镇位于广西百色。游览特色包括水上游乐、游乐体验。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Roughly 20 km south-east of central Baise by road, near an expressway exit. Check that it is open before going.

name: 大石围天坑群
summaryEn: The largest of about 30 collapse sinkholes around Leye: Dashiwei is about 613 m deep, 600 m long and 420 m wide, with an underground river and a primeval forest of about 9.6 hectares growing on its floor. The scenic area at Shuaba village also takes in neighbouring sinkholes such as Baidong and Shenmu, and lies within the Leye–Fengshan UNESCO Global Geopark, listed in 2010.
description: 大石围天坑群位于广西百色。游览特色包括地质景观、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Shuaba village about 23 km by road from Leye town.

name: 大王岭
summaryEn: A forest scenic area in the heart of the Dawangling nature reserve, known for its well-preserved old-growth forest, groves of tree ferns and river rafting. The rafting run is 5 km long with a drop of 126 m, on a boulder-strewn stream shaded by the forest canopy.
description: 大王岭位于广西百色。游览特色包括自然保护区、林地风光、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Daleng township about 42 km by road from central Baise.

name: 德保矮马王国
summaryEn: A family theme park built around the Debao pony, the county's small local horse breed, opened in 2020 at the exit of Jixingyan Cave. Visitors can ride and watch the ponies, and the park has a pony arena and a theatre for staged shows, a petting area, a play park and wooden-cabin and tent hotels. It suits families with young children.
description: 德保矮马王国位于广西百色。游览特色包括主题游乐、洞穴、戏剧演艺。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yandong township next to Jixingyan Cave, about 13 km south of Debao town.

name: 鹅泉
summaryEn: A large karst spring 6 km south of Jingxi city, welling up from an underground river into a clear pool among rice fields and limestone peaks; its waters flow on towards Detian Waterfall. A 15-arch Qing-dynasty stone bridge crosses the outflow, bamboo rafts pass beneath it, and a stele carved with a huge character for 'goose' recalls the legend behind the spring's name.
description: 鹅泉位于广西百色。游览特色包括瀑布、喀斯特地貌、桥梁建筑。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 6 km south of Jingxi city, a short taxi ride; carry your passport, as there are border checkpoints on the roads near the frontier.

name: 芳山文化园
summaryEn: A riverside park of about 17 hectares in the centre of Debao town, joining Fangshan hill and the former Jiuqu Bridge park along the Jian River. The Debao Ethnic Culture Centre, completed in 2016, has a 1,200-seat theatre and an exhibition of the county's intangible heritage, such as the Zhuang horse-bone fiddle and wheat-straw flower baskets, and the park hosts Zhuang song gatherings at festivals.
description: 芳山文化园位于广西百色。游览特色包括滨水景观、非遗文化、节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the eastern part of Debao town on Fangshan Road, within walking distance of the centre.

name: 敢壮山
summaryEn: A hill near Baiyu revered by the Zhuang as the home of Baeuqloxdoh (Buluotuo), the creator god and first ancestor in Zhuang mythology. Paths lead to a worship hall, an ancestral shrine, Zhuang totem sculptures, a spring and several caves. From the 7th to the 9th of the third lunar month, Zhuang people from across the region gather here for a large song fair, rites honouring Buluotuo and folk sports.
description: 敢壮山位于广西百色。游览特色包括祠堂文化、雕塑艺术、洞穴。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Baiyu town about 19 km by road from central Tianyang.

name: 古龙山大峡谷
summaryEn: A 7.8 km chain of four gorges joined by three underground-river caves in Huru town near the Vietnamese border, best known for a rafting run that passes through gorges and caves in turn. The forested gorges hold a dozen waterfalls, among them the 128 m Gulong Falls and a 68 m curtain fall.
description: 古龙山大峡谷位于广西百色。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km by road from Jingxi city, next to Tongling Grand Canyon; carry your passport, as there are border checkpoints on the roads near the frontier.

name: 浩坤湖
summaryEn: A clear green lake in the karst hills of southern Lingyun County, ringed by limestone peaks, with small islands and lone peaks rising from the water. Zhuang and Yao villages line the shore, and the area has been developed for lakeside leisure and village stays.
description: 浩坤湖位于广西百色。游览特色包括湖泊、喀斯特地貌、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 28 km by road from Lingyun town and about 50 km from Baise.

name: 锦绣古镇
summaryEn: A shopping and dining district on the east side of Jingxi city, built in old-town style around Zhuang and border-culture themes, with a commercial street, a night-market food street, themed inns and waterside restaurants. It is a modern development rather than a historic town, and is busiest in the evening when the streets are lit up.
description: 锦绣古镇位于广西百色。游览特色包括古镇、商贸街区、历史街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Xiuqiu Avenue on the east side of Jingxi city, a short taxi ride from the centre; carry your passport, as there are border checkpoints on the roads near the frontier.

name: 旧州
summaryEn: A Zhuang town south of Jingxi, once home to the local chieftain family, known for its hand-made embroidered balls (xiuqiu), which hang along the main street; visitors can learn to cut and stitch one in the workshops. Waterside houses, an old bridge and the Jiuzhou Zhuang Ecomuseum, opened in 2005, make it a pleasant stroll, and at Spring Festival the town stages dragon dances and a re-enacted chieftain's wedding parade.
description: 旧州位于广西百色。游览特色包括博物馆、节庆文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 8 km south of Jingxi city by road; carry your passport, as there are border checkpoints on the roads near the frontier.

name: 吉星岩
summaryEn: A four-level limestone cave 13 km south of Debao town, of which the second level is open on a route of about 2 km through five halls. Its highlight is a field of rimstone pools covering more than 6,000 m², stepped like rice terraces, with a dark stalagmite known as the 'bell' rising among the white flowstone. A large old Chinese horse chestnut and a mulberry tree stand at the entrance.
description: 吉星岩位于广西百色。游览特色包括梯田、洞穴。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yandong township about 13 km south of Debao town by road.

name: 龙云山故事小镇
summaryEn: A mountain resort built around a 3,000-mu (about 200-hectare) organic tea plantation in Gantian township, about 20 km from Leye town. A 5.6 km trail climbs through the tea fields past three tower pavilions and viewpoints, and the hotel complex has a tea-ceremony hall, a tea-culture exhibition and a workshop where visitors can pick and process their own tea. It suits a quiet stop with tea tasting on the way to or from Leye's sinkholes.
description: 龙云山故事小镇位于广西百色。游览特色包括茶园、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Gantian township about 20 km by road from Leye town.

name: 红叶森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park just north-east of Debao town, planned to cover about 1,000 hectares, whose sweetgum trees turn red, crimson and yellow in autumn around Hongfeng Lake, the Red Leaf Valley and two reservoirs. It is at its best in the autumn leaf season; the rest of the year it is a quiet place for walks among hills and water.
description: 红叶森林公园位于广西百色。游览特色包括森林公园、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 3.5 km north-east of Debao town, a short drive.

name: 田东湿地公园
summaryEn: A town park on the western side of Pingma, Tiandong's county seat, laid out around lakes beside the Baigu River. It makes an easy stroll for travellers stopping in Tiandong, for example after visiting the Youjiang government site nearby.
description: 田东湿地公园位于广西百色。游览特色包括湿地。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: On the western side of Pingma, about 1.5 km north-west of the Youjiang government site.

name: 田州古城
summaryEn: A Zhuang-themed town built in traditional style in Tianyang and opened in 2014, covering about 100 hectares with canals, a Buluotuo square, an ancestral pagoda, watchtowers, a Zhuang history museum and streets of shops, restaurants, inns and bars. It is a modern development rather than a historic town, and stages Zhuang song contests, lion-and-dragon parades and Buluotuo processions at festivals.
description: 田州古城位于广西百色。游览特色包括博物馆、古城、古塔。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Tianyang, about 35 km east of Baise by road.

name: 通天河
summaryEn: A show cave with an underground river in Liming township, formerly called Ganmo Cave: a 1.68 km walk through large chambers with more than twenty columns over 20 m tall is followed by a 1.6 km boat ride on the underground river, about 1.5 hours in all. It is also known as the Red Army Cave, because a Seventh Red Army unit under Wei Baqun held out here under siege for 36 days in 1931, a story told in a small exhibition hall at the site.
description: 通天河位于广西百色。游览特色包括乘船游览、洞穴、主题展览。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside provincial road S215 in Liming township in northern Pingguo, reached from the Liming or Bangxu exits of the G7522 expressway.

name: 北海园博园
summaryEn: A large landscaped park built as the venue of the fourth Guangxi Garden and Horticulture Expo, with themed display gardens laid out across the grounds. It makes a pleasant walk on the way between the city and Silver Beach.
description: 北海园博园位于广西北海。游览特色包括海滨、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At the junction of Nanzhu Avenue and Yintan Avenue in Yinhai district, about 7 km south-east of central Beihai by bus or taxi.

name: 北海海洋之窗
summaryEn: A modern marine-themed exhibition centre in the south of Beihai city, with aquarium tanks, themed halls on ocean life and interactive science displays. It is aimed mainly at families with children and suits a rainy day.
description: 北海海洋之窗位于广西北海。游览特色包括水族展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Sichuan South Road in Yinhai district, about 4 km south of central Beihai on the way to Silver Beach. Check that it is open before going.

name: 北海海底世界
summaryEn: An aquarium on Chating Road in central Beihai, with tanks of marine fish, sharks and other sea life. It is an easy indoor visit for families, especially on a rainy day.
description: 北海海底世界位于广西北海。游览特色包括水族展览。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Chating Road in central Beihai, a short taxi or bus ride from the Old Street. Check that it is open before going.

name: 高德古镇
summaryEn: The historic core of Gaode, an old market town on the north-eastern edge of Beihai city that belonged to Hepu county until 1951, whose three old streets are protected by Guangxi as the Gaode Three Streets historic block. The city promotes it as one of Beihai's sights alongside the better-known Old Street on Zhuhai Road.
description: 高德古镇位于广西北海。游览特色包括古镇、特色街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Gaode on the north-eastern edge of Beihai city, about 5 km from the centre near the junction of the Beitie highway and Haijing Avenue.

name: 月饼小镇
summaryEn: A mooncake-themed visitor complex at a baking factory in Lianzhou, built on Hepu's claim to the origin of filled cakes through a poem Su Dongpo wrote when he passed through the town. A culture hall traces the history of mooncakes and moon-worship customs with a large collection of cake moulds, visitors can watch the factory's production lines, and there is an area for trying baking.
description: 合浦廉州的月饼主题旅游园设在烘焙工厂，以当地月饼制作和点心文化为游览内容。
accessEn: On the southern side of Lianzhou, the Hepu county town, about 25 minutes by road north of Beihai city.

name: 金海湾红树林
summaryEn: A tract of coastal mangrove forest and tidal flats at Daguansha, east of Silver Beach, visited for its birds and the sea creatures of the mudflats. Sightseeing carts run through the area.
description: 金海湾红树林位于广西北海。游览特色包括海滨、海岸风光、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Daguansha on the south coast about 11 km south-east of central Beihai, a short drive east of Silver Beach. Check that it is open before going.

name: 海丝首港
summaryEn: A newly built Han-style harbour town at Yanlou village south-west of Lianzhou, themed on Hepu's role as a starting port of the Han-dynasty Maritime Silk Road. Its main draw is an open-air evening show in which more than 200 performers re-enact merchant ships arriving and departing, with shops and restaurants in Han-style buildings around it.
description: 廉州西南的仿汉港口小镇，以合浦在汉代海上交通与贸易中的作用为主题。
accessEn: On Jingang Avenue about 10 km south-west of Lianzhou, roughly 20 minutes by road from either the Hepu county town or Beihai city.

name: 中国（南宁）乐养城
summaryEn: A wellness and retirement-living resort town in Fusui County, planned from 2010 and opened in stages from 2022, laid out around a lake with landscaped grounds. Visitors can go boating, pick fruit, camp or use its therapy and sports facilities, and it runs a seniors' university and holds folk festivals. It is aimed mainly at older long-stay guests and at families.
description: 中国（南宁）乐养城位于广西崇左。游览特色包括湖泊、乘船游览、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 2 km from Fusui South station on the Nanning–Pingxiang high-speed railway, and roughly an hour by road from central Nanning.

name: 发现弄岗
summaryEn: An ecotourism area developed from 2018 at Siqing village, Xiangshui township, beside the Nonggang National Nature Reserve, whose karst hills carry seasonal rainforest and are home to rare langurs and birds. It offers walks through forested limestone country with views over green peaks, and a campsite for cars.
description: 发现弄岗位于广西崇左。游览特色包括自然保护区、林地风光、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 40 km (an hour) by road north-east of Longzhou county town. Carry your passport, as there are border checkpoints on the roads near the frontier.

name: 峒那屿湾
summaryEn: A stretch of karst river scenery on the Heishui River at Anping village, Leiping, formerly marketed as Anping Xianhe and also a national wetland park. Its named sights include Swallow Cave, river islands and shoals, and a cliffside path named after the Ming traveller Xu Xiake, who described the local Anping native chieftaincy in 1637. The site of the chieftain's seat and Anping's old street survive, and Zhuang customs such as eight-tone music and dragon dances are staged for visitors.
description: 峒那屿湾位于广西崇左。游览特色包括湿地、滨水景观、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Anping village near Leiping, Daxin County, about an hour by road downstream from the Detian falls and roughly 180 km (about 3 hours) from Nanning.

name: 丽川文化森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park on the edge of Tiandeng county town, registered as a regional-level forest park and upgraded to a 4A scenic area in 2019. A walking path follows the Lichuan River through its wooded, landscaped grounds, which residents use for exercise and leisure. It suits a short stroll for travellers passing through Tiandeng.
description: 丽川文化森林公园位于广西崇左。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the edge of Tiandeng county town, which is about 125 km (2 hours) from Nanning by road.

name: 立屯天梦
summaryEn: A memorial and study-tour site at Litun, a hamlet in the karst hills of Tuokan township whose villagers spent 24 years cutting a tunnel through the mountain to the outside world. A memorial hall tells the story, the tunnel itself is presented as a museum, and visitors can walk the old mountain path the villagers once used. Its first phase had opened by early 2021, aimed mainly at study tours and political-education visits.
description: 立屯天梦位于广西崇左。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tuokan township, about 20 minutes by road north-east of Tiandeng county town.

name: 龙宫仙境
summaryEn: A large natural limestone cave at Naling, near Daxin, with lofty chambers of stalactites, stalagmite columns and pools, lit with coloured lights along the visitor route. Part of the cave system has been fitted out as a refrigerated ice-and-snow attraction kept near freezing, and the scenic area also runs a long cliffside rail ride and rafting on the Na River. It suits families and anyone wanting a cool stop on the Detian circuit.
description: 龙宫仙境位于广西崇左。游览特色包括洞穴、水上活动、钟乳石。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Naling township, about 18 km (25 minutes) by road from Daxin county town and roughly 165 km from Nanning.

name: 龙谷湾恐龙公园
summaryEn: A dinosaur-themed amusement park near Fusui that opened in 2017, themed on the 'nest of three dinosaurs' fossil find in Fusui County, with recreated dinosaurs and other prehistoric animals, rides and play areas. It closed at the end of 2021 for a rebuild and has since reopened as part of the Longguwan resort, where a wildlife park was being added in 2025. It suits families with children.
description: 龙谷湾恐龙公园位于广西崇左。游览特色包括主题游乐、动物观赏、化石遗迹。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Fusui South station on the Nanning–Pingxiang high-speed railway in Fusui County, about an hour by road from central Nanning.

name: 龙州红军古道
summaryEn: An old horse-caravan path of about 2 km over the hills between Shuilong and Fucha hamlets, once the main route from Longzhou towards Jingxi and Baise, which, according to the local account, Deng Xiaoping travelled several times in 1929 while organising the Baise and Longzhou uprisings. It is presented as a red-tourism site with a history hall and visitor centre at Fucha. The adjoining Tianqin Zhuang Village is a modern leisure area with a large pool, restaurants, a water market and replica Zhuang wooden houses.
description: 龙州红军古道位于广西崇左。游览特色包括古道。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 12 km north of Longzhou county town, 7 km from the Shanglong exit of the Bama–Pingxiang expressway. Carry your passport, as there are border checkpoints on the roads near the frontier.

name: 龙州起义纪念园
summaryEn: The memorial park centres on the Longzhou Uprising Memorial Hall, opened in 2004 as the new exhibition building of the Eighth Red Army memorial museum, which covers the uprising of February 1930 in which Communist-led troops under Yu Zuoyu, Li Mingrui and Deng Xiaoping formed the Eighth Red Army and a short-lived soviet along the Zuo River. In the old town nearby, the former Eighth Red Army headquarters, where Deng worked and lived in 1929, keeps the two cypress trees he planted at its gate.
description: 龙州起义纪念园位于广西崇左。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Dushan Road opposite Longzhou bus station in the county town, which has a station on the Nanning–Pingxiang high-speed railway; carry your passport, as there are border checkpoints on the roads near the frontier. The memorial hall is closed on Mondays.

name: 明仕田园
summaryEn: The valley of the Mingshi River in Kanxu township, where the river winds between rice fields and steep karst peaks dotted with Zhuang villages. Often filmed for television, including the fantasy drama Hua Qian Gu, it is promoted as part of the 'China–Vietnam border landscape gallery', and Mingshi village was named a national key rural-tourism village in 2019. Several resort hotels have been built in the valley.
description: 明仕田园位于广西崇左。游览特色包括田园观光、山谷、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Kanxu township, about 37 km east of the Detian falls and roughly 200 km (3 hours) from Nanning by road. Carry your passport, as there are border checkpoints on the roads near the frontier.

name: 派阳山森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park of about 1,340 hectares on a state forest farm in Ningming County, covered in Tongmian pine and star-anise plantations with clear streams running through the valleys. Wildlife includes the Guangxi warty newt, pangolins and Burmese pythons, and tree ferns grow in the forest. Its dark skies have drawn a Guangxi stargazing gathering, and it is popular for summer walks and stream play.
description: 派阳山森林公园位于广西崇左。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 25 km (40 minutes) by road from Ningming county town. Carry your passport, as there are border checkpoints on the roads near the frontier.

name: 红木文博城
summaryEn: A large trade and exhibition complex in southern Pingxiang devoted to hongmu (rosewood) furniture, with showroom halls where hundreds of furniture firms display their work, a shopping street and buildings in traditional Chinese style. Its former expo centre was turned into a rosewood culture museum in 2020, showing Ming and Qing furniture, carvings, timber samples and woodworking tools. It suits visitors interested in Chinese furniture and craft, or in shopping.
description: 红木文博城位于广西崇左。游览特色包括博物馆、特色街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Nanshan rosewood district on the south side of Pingxiang city, about 10 minutes by taxi from the centre. Carry your passport, as there are border checkpoints on the roads near the frontier.

name: 石景林·园博园
summaryEn: Two adjoining parks in Chongzuo's southern new district: Shijinglin, a karst 'stone forest' of about 100 hectares opened in 1991, with weathered limestone pinnacles, small caves and pools named after the shapes they suggest, and the landscaped grounds built for the 7th Guangxi Garden and Horticulture Expo. Shijinglin is part of the Huashan national scenic area and hosts a Zhuang song fair each year on the 10th day of the fourth lunar month. Both make an easy outing from the city centre.
description: 石景林·园博园位于广西崇左。游览特色包括石林、园林景观、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the southern new district of Chongzuo, about 1 km from the city government centre and 15 minutes by taxi from central Chongzuo.

name: 太平古城
summaryEn: A leisure and shopping district in central Chongzuo built around the site of Taiping prefecture's city wall, first raised in 1372 under the Ming and now partly repaired, with a restored inner waterway. Streets of new buildings in old style hold food stalls, shops, guesthouses and stages for folk performances, and the area is busiest in the evening. Taiping has been an administrative seat since the Song, and the old wall is a regional heritage site.
description: 太平古城位于广西崇左。游览特色包括古城、购物街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In central Chongzuo (Jiangzhou district) on a bend of the Zuo River, a short taxi ride from anywhere in the city.

name: 白头叶猴生态旅游区
summaryEn: A visitor area on the edge of the Banli section of the Chongzuo White-headed Langur National Nature Reserve, which protects the critically endangered white-headed langur, a blackish monkey with a white crown, cheeks and neck found only in the karst hills of south-west Guangxi. It has a visitor centre, paths into the limestone hill forest, a white-headed langur museum and a study-tour base next to a long-running primate research station. The reserve also shelters François' langurs, cycads and golden camellias.
description: 白头叶猴生态旅游区位于广西崇左。游览特色包括博物馆、自然保护区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On provincial road S213 between Luobai and Banli townships, about 6 km from the Luobai exit of the Chongzuo–Qinzhou expressway and roughly an hour by road from central Chongzuo.

name: 雨花石景区
summaryEn: An area of about 3 km² on a bend of the Zuo River where countless coloured pebbles are cemented into rounded, many-hued conglomerate outcrops and cliffs, an unusual rock landscape for the region. A cave called Tianyan (Sky Eye) and several groups of ancient Zuojiang cliff paintings lie within the scenic area, and boat trips run on the river. It sits about 10 km downstream of the Zuojiang Leaning Tower, so the two are easily combined.
description: 雨花石景区位于广西崇左。游览特色包括乘船游览、楼阁建筑、洞穴。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Chongdeng hamlet, Taiping subdistrict, about 18 km (25 minutes) by road from central Chongzuo.

name: 白浪滩
summaryEn: A long sandy beach on the Jiangshan Peninsula south of Fangchenggang, whose name means 'white waves', developed since the 1990s from a fishing village's shore into a beach resort with clean sea and fine sand. The peninsula's 76 km coastline now holds more than 20 scenic areas, making it a good base for a seaside stay.
description: 白浪滩位于广西防城港。游览特色包括海滨、海岸风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the Jiangshan Peninsula about 13 km south-west of central Fangchenggang, roughly 30 minutes by road.

name: 东兴中越界河
summaryEn: The mouth of the Beilun River at Zhushan, where the border river between China and Vietnam meets the sea, marked by the Qing boundary stone No. 1 of 1890 and the zero-kilometre monument of the Guangxi border highway. Nearby are the old street of Zhushan, once a trading port, the Sansheng (Mazu) temple of 1876, a grove of ancient banyans and mangroves in the core of the Beilun Estuary national nature reserve.
description: 东兴中越界河位于广西防城港。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、自然保护区。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Zhushan village about 10 km east of central Dongxing by road. Carry your passport, as there are border checkpoints on the roads near the frontier.

name: 东兴国门
summaryEn: The riverside area around the Dongxing port, a first-class national land crossing to Mong Cai in Vietnam over the Beilun River, where the frontier inspection building at the end of the Beilun River Bridge is known locally as the 'national gate'. Around it are the Qing boundary stone No. 5, the China–Vietnam Friendship Park, temples to Guanyin and Guandi, a museum of qiaopi (overseas remittance letters) and the riverside Hedi Road, lined with shops selling Vietnamese goods.
description: 东兴国门位于广西防城港。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In central Dongxing near the junction of Xinhua Road and Hedi Road, about 40 minutes by road from Fangchenggang. Carry your passport, as there are border checkpoints on the roads near the frontier.

name: 百鸟乐园
summaryEn: A bird park inside the Shiwandashan National Forest Park on the Hongqi forest farm, with aviaries holding many species of birds in a setting of subtropical broadleaf forest. The surrounding forest park, the core of the Shiwandashan national nature reserve, has forest walks, an old stone-stepped trail towards the Fulong pass and Yao villages.
description: 百鸟乐园位于广西防城港。游览特色包括森林公园、自然保护区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Shiwandashan National Forest Park near Nadang in Jiao'an town, about 37 km by road south of Shangsi county town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 十万大山布透温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in a valley about 5 km from Shangsi town at the foot of the Shiwandashan, built around a low-temperature carbonate spring that the old county gazetteer records as used locally since the Ming. It has a large outdoor pool, a children's pool, an indoor swimming pool, smaller feature pools and a terraced cascade of warm pools, with villas for overnight stays.
description: 十万大山布透温泉位于广西防城港。游览特色包括温泉、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 5 km from Shangsi county town, roughly 75 minutes by road from Nanning.

name: 西湾
summaryEn: The waterfront of West Bay in the centre of Fangchenggang, where a walkway of almost 50 km links a tourist wharf, a city beach and about 15 parks around the bay. Its sandy bathing beach is popular with residents and visitors in summer, and the 1.57 km West Bay sea bridge, opened in 2003, crosses the water.
description: 西湾位于广西防城港。游览特色包括海滨。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Fangchenggang along Beibuwan Avenue in Gangkou district, easily reached by city bus or taxi.

name: 安澜公园
summaryEn: A riverside park running about 10 km along the south bank of the Yu River in central Guigang, from the Yujiang No. 2 Bridge downstream to the Anlan Pagoda. A greenway with cycle paths passes flower beds, lotus ponds, old wharf remains and a square of Qin-style replica buildings and terracotta-warrior statues, with views of the river bridges and old factory chimneys. It is a favourite place for locals' evening walks.
description: 安澜公园位于广西贵港。游览特色包括古塔、滨水景观、绿道骑行。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Along the south bank of the Yu River in Gangnan district, a short taxi ride from central Guigang.

name: 北帝山
summaryEn: A forested mountain area on the southern flank of the Dayao Mountains in Dapeng township, Pingnan, rising to Beidi peak at about 1,300 m and covering some 22 km² of woods, gorges and waterfalls. Developed from the late 2010s, it has canyon rafting, a glass walkway, cliff-hung boardwalks and hiking paths, and temples built around the cult of Beidi, the Taoist Northern Emperor. It suits a day of walking and rafting in summer.
description: 北帝山位于广西贵港。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Dapeng township, about 50 km (an hour) north of Pingnan county town and 5 km from the Dapeng exit of the Liuzhou–Wuzhou expressway.

name: 布山古郡
summaryEn: A culture and leisure quarter of about 0.67 km² opposite the Qintang district government, built in old style around springs at the foot of Longtou Hill. It takes its name from Bushan, the ancient county that served as a commandery seat from Qin to Sui times and is generally placed in today's Guigang. Evening markets and festivals are held in its streets.
description: 布山古郡位于广西贵港。游览特色包括节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Qintang district seat, about 20 minutes by road west of central Guigang.

name: 垌美生态乐园
summaryEn: A rural leisure park in the hills of Siwang township, set among rice fields, bamboo groves, streams and two old villages with temples and stone paths. It has barbecue areas in the bamboo, fruit-picking orchards, a windmill and children's activities, and was named a Guigang centre for traditional-medicine health tourism in 2024. It suits families on a country day out.
description: 垌美生态乐园位于广西贵港。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、果园、公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Huashi village in Siwang township, about 20 km (30 minutes) by road from Pingnan county town.

name: 佛子岭康养度假区
summaryEn: A hillside leisure and wellness resort in wooded country north-east of Pingnan, best known locally for its summer water park fed by mountain spring water, with large pools, slides and a children's splash area. It suits families looking for a summer day out.
description: 佛子岭康养度假区位于广西贵港。游览特色包括水上游乐、林地风光、泉水。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dezhai village, about 20 minutes by road north-east of Pingnan county town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 龚州公园
summaryEn: Pingnan's main town park, named after Gongzhou, the prefecture that had its seat here from the Tang to the Song. It takes in a martyrs' monument, two lakes, one of them planted with lotus, a Zhuangyuan (top-scholar) Pavilion and the Buddhist Zhengjue Temple, and a hillside of peach trees draws crowds when it blossoms around the Spring Festival. It is a pleasant stroll for anyone stopping in Pingnan.
description: 龚州公园位于广西贵港。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、楼阁建筑、佛教文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north side of Pingnan county town next to the government centre, walkable from the centre.

name: 贵港市园博园
summaryEn: A large landscaped garden-expo park in western Guigang, laid out around waterside wetlands and fields on the theme of Guigang as the 'lotus city'. Its zones include a Guigang garden, a lotus square, wetland walks and a set of display gardens from around Guangxi. It suits a relaxed walk, especially in the lotus season.
description: 贵港市园博园位于广西贵港。游览特色包括湿地、园林景观、莲花观赏。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the western district of Guigang, about 15 minutes by taxi from the city centre.

name: 桂平西山
summaryEn: A wooded Buddhist hill, also called Siling Shan, rising just west of Guiping at the meeting of the Qian and Yu rivers, protected as a national scenic area and national geopark of about 13 km². Paths climb past springs, rock outcrops and tea gardens to temples including the Xishi'an nunnery, founded in 1646 and now one of China's national key Buddhist temples, and the Longhua Temple behind it. Its tea and the Ruquan spring water are local specialities.
description: 桂平西山位于广西贵港。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the western edge of Guiping city, about 500 m from the centre and walkable or a short taxi ride away.

name: 荷美覃塘
summaryEn: A lotus-growing park north of Qintang built from 2014 around the district's lotus-root farming, which has a history of more than a thousand years. About 200 hectares of lotus ponds hold over 350 varieties, crossed by boardwalks and cycle paths, with a wind-and-rain bridge, a lotus science exhibition and farm-stay inns. Qintang holds a lotus festival here each summer, the best time to visit.
description: 荷美覃塘位于广西贵港。游览特色包括农业体验、莲花观赏、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the northern edge of Qintang, about 25 minutes by road from central Guigang.

name: 龙潭国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park in the hills north-west of Guiping, within the Dapingshan nature reserve and the Jintian state forest farm. It protects a well-preserved tract of subtropical monsoon evergreen broadleaf forest, rare in south-eastern Guangxi and rich in relict plants, with streams and the Longtan waterfall. It suits a day of forest walking.
description: 龙潭国家森林公园位于广西贵港。游览特色包括瀑布、森林公园、自然保护区。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 23 km (40 minutes) by road north-west of Guiping city.

name: 南山公园
summaryEn: A park on a craggy karst hill on the south side of Guigang, known for its caves and for Nanshan Temple, founded in 989 when a monk set up a shrine in a cave of Lion Head Hill. Song emperors sent it calligraphy and a name plaque, and its relics include an old stone Buddha, Song and Ming iron bells, a stele carved in 1329 from a Yuan emperor's inscription, and centuries of cliff inscriptions. The park also has Lotus Hill and Qilin Lake among some 30 named spots.
description: 南山公园位于广西贵港。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Gangnan district on the southern side of Guigang city, about 15 minutes by taxi from the centre.

name: 雄森动物大世界
summaryEn: A large private zoo and breeding centre of about 87 hectares on the edge of Pingnan, best known for its big numbers of tigers, African lions and black bears, with petting areas and other animals. Its programme has included staged circus and animal-act shows. It suits families with children.
description: 雄森动物大世界位于广西贵港。游览特色包括动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the industrial park about 5 km south of Pingnan county town, 10–15 minutes by taxi.

name: 平天山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park of about 1,676 hectares in the hills north-west of Guigang, with dense forest, canyons, waterfalls, tree ferns and hillside tea gardens. Its summit, Dapingtian (1,157.8 m), is the highest point in Guigang and is topped by a broad grassy meadow with views over the Yu River plain, popular for sunrise. Trails, a campsite and forest-stay facilities make it a weekend escape for the city.
description: 平天山国家森林公园位于广西贵港。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 10 km north-west of central Guigang, 20–30 minutes by car.

name: 山边村
summaryEn: A rural tourism village in Xintang township on the southern edge of Guigang, named one of China's 'beautiful leisure villages'. Old red-brick houses along its lanes have been turned into workshops for embroidery, oil painting, tea and pottery, and in spring the fields around it turn yellow with rapeseed flowers. A retired fighter jet and tank are also on display.
description: 山边村位于广西贵港。游览特色包括油菜花田、田园观光、陶瓷工艺。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xintang township next to Nanshan Park, about 15 minutes by taxi south of central Guigang.

name: 西山泉房车露营基地
summaryEn: A large car and RV campsite resort in the hills of Xishan town outside Guiping, rated a five-star campsite in Guangxi. Accommodation ranges from motorhomes and motel rooms to valley cabins and glamping tents, and there are rope courses, archery tag, mock combat games, a playground, a cycle track and climbing walls. It suits families and groups looking for outdoor activities.
description: 西山泉房车露营基地位于广西贵港。游览特色包括山谷、马术活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Bailan village, Xishan town, about 8 km (15–20 minutes) by road north-west of central Guiping.

name: 八角寨
summaryEn: A massif of Danxia red-sandstone peaks in Meixi town on the Guangxi–Hunan border, named after the eight upturned corners of its 818 m main peak; its Hunan side belongs to the Langshan scenic area. Trails and viewpoints look over clustered peaks, rock pillars and deep gorges, often wrapped in cloud.
description: 八角寨位于广西桂林。游览特色包括峡谷、砂岩地貌、村寨。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Meixi town in northern Ziyuan County, about 30 km north of Ziyuan town and roughly 3 hours by road from Guilin.

name: 蝴蝶泉
summaryEn: A park built around two steep karst hills beside National Road 321 south of Yangshuo town, on the stretch of countryside known as the Ten-Mile Gallery. A cave runs through one hill, named after a butterfly-shaped formation, and a suspension bridge crosses to the second hill, with butterfly-themed gardens below.
description: 蝴蝶泉位于广西桂林。游览特色包括园林景观、喀斯特地貌、洞穴。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 4 km south of Yangshuo town on the road to Gaotian, a short taxi or bike ride.

name: 大碧头国际旅游度假区
summaryEn: A countryside resort at Dabitou, a traditional village of the Bin clan in Miaotou town, north-eastern Quanzhou County, set among karst hills near the Xiang River. It has a hot spring with bathing pools and spa lodges, farmland landscapes, homestays in village houses and activities such as off-road buggy rides, aimed at weekend and wellness breaks.
description: 大碧头国际旅游度假区位于广西桂林。游览特色包括温泉、喀斯特地貌、传统村落。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dabitou village, Miaotou town, about 30 km north-east of Quanzhou town, which is roughly 2 hours by road from Guilin.

name: 大圩古镇
summaryEn: A historic market town on the Li River south-east of Guilin, with more than a thousand years of history, whose 2 km main street, paved with bluestone, is lined with old shop-houses. Along it are temples, guild halls and the Wanshou (Longevity) Bridge, and bamboo rafts leave from the waterfront.
description: 大圩古镇位于广西桂林。游览特色包括古镇、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 23 km south-east of central Guilin in Lingchuan County, roughly 40 minutes by road or local bus.

name: 东漓古村
summaryEn: A village resort on the Chaotian River near Daxu, set among houses in the traditional northern-Guangxi style, with craft and intangible-heritage workshops, farmland and guesthouses. It is pitched as a rural escape from Guilin and often combined with the Gudong Waterfall and Daxu old town.
description: 东漓古村位于广西桂林。游览特色包括瀑布、古村落。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yuanjia village, Daxu town, about 19 km east of central Guilin, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 古东瀑布
summaryEn: A spring-fed waterfall in a wooded valley near Daxu on the east side of the Li River. Visitors wade into the stream and climb up the falls through the water, which makes it a popular place to cool off in summer.
description: 古东瀑布位于广西桂林。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Gudong village in Daxu town, Lingchuan County, about 25 km south-east of central Guilin, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 桂海晴岚
summaryEn: A landscaped park on the eastern edge of Guilin laid out on a former golf course, with wide lawns, lakes and pine woods ringed by karst peaks. It is a relaxed place for walks, picnics and camping, with family activities such as pedal boats.
description: 桂海晴岚位于广西桂林。游览特色包括喀斯特地貌、高尔夫。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Hangtian Road in Qixing District, about 7 km east of central Guilin by taxi.

name: 红溪大峡谷
summaryEn: A forested canyon in the hills of northern Lingui, named after the reddish rocks of its stream bed, with a waterfall as its main sight. Walkways follow the stream through the forest, and the site also offers outdoor activities.
description: 红溪大峡谷位于广西桂林。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhongyong town, Lingui District, about 40 km north-west of central Guilin, roughly an hour by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 红岩村
summaryEn: A village in Lianhua town in southern Gongcheng County, rebuilt by its villagers to a single plan as a model new village and now run as a rural scenic area among persimmon orchards. Visitors walk the orchards, at their most colourful in autumn when the fruit ripens, and stay or eat in the villagers' guesthouses and restaurants.
description: 红岩村位于广西桂林。游览特色包括果园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Lianhua town, about 12 km south of Gongcheng town by road; there is no direct bus, so take a taxi.

name: 金钟山度假区
summaryEn: A resort area in the karst hills of Luojin town, eastern Yongfu County, built around Yongfu Cave, a show cave with golden-coloured formations, and a large karst sinkhole that can be entered on foot from the bottom, where it meets an underground river. A hot spring and river rafting make it a weekend retreat from Guilin.
description: 金钟山度假区位于广西桂林。游览特色包括温泉、水上活动、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Luojin town, about 45 km south-west of Guilin by road, roughly an hour's drive.

name: 老山界龙潭江
summaryEn: A forested river canyon in the Yuecheng range, known locally as Laoshanjie, in Huajiang Yao township, opened as a scenic area in 2021; it joins the Longtanjiang gorge with sites linked to the Red Army's crossing of Laoshanjie during the Long March in 1934. Visitors can walk a section of the Long March trail, and a Red Army culture park with a restored stretch of the old path and a memorial square is being added.
description: 老山界龙潭江位于广西桂林。游览特色包括峡谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Huajiang Yao township, Xing'an County, about 1.5–2 hours by road north of Guilin.

name: 荔江国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A national wetland park along the Lipu River and its tributaries, spread over several townships around Lipu town. Its ecology and science centre near the town introduces the river's wetlands.
description: 荔江国家湿地公园位于广西桂林。游览特色包括湿地。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Around Lipu town, about 45 km south of Yangshuo and 2 hours by road from Guilin.

name: 荔江湾
summaryEn: A scenic area on the Lipu River in Qingshan town, south-west of Lipu, where visitors take boat trips along the river among karst peaks and walk through Tiangong Cave, a show cave. It lies on the road from Yangshuo to Fengyu Cave and is easily combined with it.
description: 荔江湾位于广西桂林。游览特色包括乘船游览、喀斯特地貌、洞穴。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Qingshan town, Lipu, about 40 km south of Yangshuo, roughly an hour by road.

name: 融创漓江后海
summaryEn: The shopping and leisure quarter of the Guilin Sunac International Tourism Resort, a large resort in Yanshan District that opened in June 2021. Around it are the resort's theme park, Sea World ocean park and Water World, and a performing-arts centre, making it a full day out for families.
description: 融创漓江后海位于广西桂林。游览特色包括主题游乐、艺术展览。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Beside National Road 321 in Yanshan District, about 25 km south of central Guilin, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 刘三姐大观园
summaryEn: A theme park on the Taohua River at the foot of West Hill, named after Liu Sanjie, the singing heroine of Zhuang folk legend. Visitors can trade folk songs with costumed performers at its singing stage, watch scenes from the classic film about her in the performance hall and see staged ethnic song-and-dance shows among reconstructed buildings.
description: 刘三姐大观园位于广西桂林。游览特色包括主题游乐、民间传说、民歌。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At the west end of Taohuajiang Road in Xiufeng District, about 3 km west of Central Square, roughly 10 minutes by taxi. Check that it is open before going.

name: 桂花公社
summaryEn: An osmanthus-themed attraction among the fields of the Taohua River valley on the western edge of Guilin, a city whose name means 'forest of sweet osmanthus'. It has an osmanthus culture exhibition hall, a themed garden, a hotel and a study centre for school groups, with activities such as making osmanthus cakes.
description: 桂花公社位于广西桂林。游览特色包括山谷、园林景观、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Yangjiang Road in Xiufeng District, about 3 km west of Central Square, roughly 15 minutes by taxi. Check that it is open before going.

name: 千家洞文旅度假区
summaryEn: A resort opened in June 2023 in the traditional villages of Xiaolong and Sudong between Guanyang and Xinxu towns, built around the Yao tradition that Qianjiadong is the ancestral homeland of the Yao people, a place many Yao visit to trace their roots. Set in the landscape of the Qianjiadong National Nature Reserve, it combines Yao-style buildings, displays of Yao dress and history and a water show with farmland and mountain scenery.
description: 千家洞文旅度假区位于广西桂林。游览特色包括自然保护区、寻根文化、传统村落。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Guanyang town, about 150 km (roughly 2 hours) by road east of Guilin.

name: 三千漓
summaryEn: A modern resort and leisure district built on the north-eastern edge of Xingping, with a street of shops and restaurants, holiday housing and hotels set among fields and karst peaks along the Dayuan River. It runs evening boat trips and lantern events on the water and makes a base for the Xingping stretch of the Li River, a short ride from Xingping old town and the view printed on the 20-yuan note.
description: 三千漓位于广西桂林。游览特色包括乘船游览、喀斯特地貌、历史街区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the north-east side of Xingping town, about 25 km north-east of Yangshuo town, roughly 40 minutes by road; Yangshuo high-speed railway station, also in Xingping, is about 5 km away.

name: 红军长征湘江战役纪念园
summaryEn: A memorial park completed in September 2019 beside the Jiaoshanpu battlefield in Caiwan town, commemorating the Battle of the Xiang River of late 1934, when the Central Red Army fought its way across the river between Xing'an and Quanzhou during the Long March at heavy cost. It consists of the memorial park and a memorial hall with exhibitions on the campaign.
description: 红军长征湘江战役纪念园位于广西桂林。游览特色包括纪念展览、战役遗址、历史纪念。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside National Road 322 at Caiwan town, about 13 km west of Quanzhou town and roughly 1.5 hours by road from Guilin. The memorial hall is closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 红军长征突破湘江烈士纪念碑园
summaryEn: A memorial park in Xing'an town, built in 1995 in memory of the Red Army soldiers killed in the Battle of the Xiang River in late 1934, during the Long March. A memorial hall on the battle opened in the park in November 2014, and the park is now also called the Xiang River Battle Memorial Park.
description: 红军长征突破湘江烈士纪念碑园位于广西桂林。游览特色包括纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Shuangyong Road in Xing'an town, about 60 km north-east of Guilin, roughly an hour by road. The memorial hall is closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 逍遥湖
summaryEn: A lake park in Daxu town on the east side of the Li River, where paths follow the shore against a backdrop of karst hills. It is usually combined with the nearby Gudong Waterfall and Daxu old town on a day out from Guilin.
description: 逍遥湖位于广西桂林。游览特色包括瀑布、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Daxu town, Lingchuan County, about 25 km south-east of central Guilin, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 新圩阻击战酒海井红军纪念园
summaryEn: A memorial park completed in 2016 in Xinxu town, Guanyang County, where Red Army units fought a blocking action at Xinxu during the Battle of the Xiang River in late 1934, part of the Long March. It has a memorial and an exhibition hall on the Xinxu fighting, and close by in Hemu village are the Jiuhaijing memorial tower and the battle's field aid station in a Qing ancestral hall, both part of the national heritage site of the battle.
description: 新圩阻击战酒海井红军纪念园位于广西桂林。游览特色包括祠堂文化、楼阁建筑、主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xinxu town, Guanyang County, about 2 hours by road east of Guilin.

name: 愚自乐园
summaryEn: A landscape sculpture park among karst hills south of Guilin, founded in the late 1990s by the Taiwanese entrepreneur Cao Rizhang. More than 200 artists from around the world have left large contemporary works across its lawns, lakeshores and pine woods, many of them made at the international sculpture symposiums held here, and a Club Med resort opened at the park in 2013.
description: 愚自乐园位于广西桂林。游览特色包括喀斯特地貌、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dabu township, Yanshan District, about 30 km south of central Guilin, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 状元哪嗬嗨
summaryEn: A redeveloped street district in the centre of Yongfu town, on the former site of the home of Wang Shize, the first person from Guangxi to take first place (zhuangyuan) in the imperial examinations. It combines dining, shopping and entertainment, with zhuangyuan-themed souvenirs and photo spots in scholar's robes, and hosts festival events such as those at the Dragon Boat Festival.
description: 状元哪嗬嗨位于广西桂林。游览特色包括节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Yongfu town, about 55 km south-west of Guilin, roughly an hour by road.

name: 资江·天门山
summaryEn: A scenic area on the upper Zi River north of Ziyuan town, where boat and raft trips run past red-sandstone (Danxia) cliffs to a landing below Tianmen Mountain. Paths on the mountain lead through narrow rock clefts to a glass viewing platform.
description: 资江·天门山位于广西桂林。游览特色包括砂岩地貌、观景台。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 10 km north of Ziyuan town, which is roughly 2.5 hours by road north of Guilin.

name: 巴腊猴山
summaryEn: A forested karst valley at Bala hamlet in Qiaoyin township, where villagers have protected a troop of more than 600 macaques since reforestation began in the 1990s, and the monkeys come to feeding areas and let visitors approach closely. The site also has a children's playground, a petting area with deer, horses and peacocks, and farm restaurants, and is aimed mainly at families; it was rated 4A in 2024.
description: 巴腊猴山位于广西河池。游览特色包括山谷、林地风光、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Bala hamlet, Jiulong village, Qiaoyin township, about 27 km from Fengshan county town by road.

name: 水晶宫
summaryEn: A show cave on a hillside at Daluo village, Nashe township, known for dense clusters of snow-white helictites, needle-like crystals and flower-shaped formations. The corridor-shaped cave is over 600 m long and 8–40 m wide with a fairly level path, and it was one of Bama's first 4A sites, in 2009.
description: 水晶宫位于广西河池。游览特色包括洞穴。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Daluo village, Nashe township, about 44 km north-west of Bama county town by road.

name: 长寿岛
summaryEn: An island of about 3 hectares in the Pogui section of Cifu Lake, the reservoir on the Panyang River 8 km from Bama town, ringed by karst hills. By day it is a culture park on Bama's longevity customs; in the evening there are bonfire parties, long-table dinners and the outdoor show 'Dream of Bama', which stages a Yao wedding and bronze-drum dances.
description: 长寿岛位于广西河池。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Cifu Lake about 8 km from Bama county town by road.

name: 巴平湿地森林康养
summaryEn: A wetland and forest area at Baping in Mangchang town, developed since 2020 within the Laxi National Wetland Park, a highland wetland of about 560 hectares where 168 bird species have been recorded. Boardwalks lead past lakes and lotus ponds, and the nearby Baping terraces and flower fields offer farm stays, home cooking and fruit picking.
description: 巴平湿地森林康养位于广西河池。游览特色包括湿地、花卉观赏、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Baping in Mangchang town, about 25 km north of Nandan county town by road, close to the Guizhou border.

name: 澄江国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A national wetland park on the clear blue-green Chengjiang River, which rises at the Jiudun skylights in Daxing town and flows 42 km south through farmland to the Hongshui River. The 4A area of about 3.1 km² at Yili, north of Du'an town, is part of the Chengjiang national water-conservancy scenic area, and snorkelling in the river has become popular in summer.
description: 澄江国家湿地公园位于广西河池。游览特色包括湿地、田园观光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Yili, about 8 km north of Du'an county town by road.

name: 成龙湖
summaryEn: A lake park ringed by hills on the edge of Luocheng town, named after Yu Chenglong, the Qing official famed as an incorruptible magistrate, who served in Luocheng and is said to have written poems beside it. It was rated 3A in 2015 and has since been raised to 4A.
description: 成龙湖位于广西河池。游览特色包括湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On provincial road S204 about 3 km west of central Luocheng.

name: 多彩毛南
summaryEn: A cultural area in Sien, the county town of Huanjiang, the only autonomous county of the Maonan people, built around the Maonan Museum. Opened in 2012, the museum holds more than 1,200 objects and has galleries on the feitao thanksgiving ritual, the Fenlong festival, flower-bamboo hat weaving and bronze-drum casting, plus a revolutionary history gallery added in 2019. Beside it stand the seven-storey Sien Pagoda, climbed for views over the town, and squares themed on Nuo masks and bronze drums.
description: 多彩毛南位于广西河池。游览特色包括博物馆、古塔。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: By the river on the western side of Sien, the Huanjiang county town; Huanjiang station on the Guiyang–Nanning high-speed railway serves the county.

name: 棉花天坑
summaryEn: A resort around a karst tiankeng (giant sinkhole) at Shendong hamlet in Mianhua village, which also takes in Changsheng Cave, a show cave of stalactites, and the Mulao village of Shendong. Cliff-edge attractions include a hotel, a bookshop lit up at night, a pool, glass and cliff walkways, a via ferrata, a zip line and a small cliff train, alongside a Mulao intangible-heritage hall.
description: 棉花天坑位于广西河池。游览特色包括喀斯特地貌、洞穴、钟乳石。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Shendong hamlet, Mianhua village, Siba town, about 15 km from Luocheng county town by road.

name: 丹炉山
summaryEn: A wooded hill scenic area at Danlu hamlet in Wuai town, built around the remains of a Ming-dynasty alchemy site that the county describes as one of the most complete found in China, with karst caves and local Taoist, lantern-dance and tusi (chieftain) traditions. Since opening in 2018 it has added a glass walkway, a glass slide and a glass suspension bridge, a staged show and long-table banquets.
description: 丹炉山位于广西河池。游览特色包括洞穴、玻璃栈道、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Danlu hamlet, about 18 km from Wuai town, roughly an hour by road south-west of Nandan county town.

name: 丹泉洞天酒海
summaryEn: A visitor site at the Danquan distillery in Nandan town, founded in 1956 and now Guangxi's largest liquor producer, where visitors can follow baijiu production from grain to blending. Its highlight is Dongtian Jiuhai, a natural karst cave with a constant temperature of about 15 °C and room for some 50,000 tonnes of base liquor, certified by Guinness World Records as the largest liquor-storage cave.
description: 丹泉洞天酒海位于广西河池。游览特色包括洞穴、喀斯特地貌、酿造文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Inside the Danquan distillery on Minxing North Road in Nandan county town.

name: 东兰红色旅游区
summaryEn: A group of revolutionary sites linked to Wei Baqun, a Zhuang leader of the 1920s peasant movement, rated 4A together in 2011. In the county town, the Donglan Martyrs' Cemetery, founded in 1956, holds Wei Baqun's tomb, a memorial tower and a hall of about 600 documents, photographs and relics, next to the Wei Baqun Memorial Hall. Some 30 km south-west near Wuzhuan are Lenin Cave, the vast natural cave where Wei ran Guangxi's first peasant movement institute in 1925, the 1906 Kuixing Tower used by the Seventh Red Army's front committee under Deng Xiaoping in 1930, and Wei's rebuilt mountainside home.
description: 东兰红色旅游区位于广西河池。游览特色包括纪念展览、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1 天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: The cemetery and memorial hall are on the western edge of Donglan county town; Lenin Cave and Kuixing Tower are near Wuzhuan town, about 30 km south-west by road.

name: 都安地下河国家地质公园
summaryEn: A national geopark of about 210 km² along the Disu underground river system, which with its 12 tributaries runs for some 241 km beneath the karst before joining the Hongshui River. More than 300 skylights, collapse windows down to the river, pock the landscape, and the Tunbang and Jiuling skylights in Dongmiao township are the main visitor spots; peach-blossom freshwater jellyfish appear in some pools between April and October.
description: 都安地下河国家地质公园位于广西河池。游览特色包括地质景观、喀斯特地貌、赏花。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Around Dongmiao township, about 25 km north-west of Du'an county town by road.

name: 红水河第一湾
summaryEn: A viewpoint above a sweeping U-shaped bend where the Hongshui River loops through a gorge at Banwen village in Sanshi town. A glass viewing platform shaped like a bronze drum, a nod to Donglan's bronze-drum tradition, looks down over the meander.
description: 红水河第一湾位于广西河池。游览特色包括峡谷、观景台。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Near Banwen village, Sanshi town, roughly an hour by road south-east of Donglan county town.

name: 歌娅思谷
summaryEn: A Baiku Yao (White Trousers Yao) culture resort of about 9.6 km² at Ganhe hamlet in Lihu Yao township, where a river winds past fields into a cave among karst hills. Alongside courtyard hotel buildings and a mud-and-timber hotel in Baiku Yao style, it has restaurants, a cave theatre, farm-experience fields and a workshop showing how Baiku Yao clothing is made, with staged song-and-dance evenings and long-table feasts.
description: 歌娅思谷位于广西河池。游览特色包括喀斯特地貌、洞穴、戏剧演艺。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Ganhe hamlet in Lihu Yao township, about 10 km east of Nandan county town by road.

name: 红水河百里风情画廊
summaryEn: A 27.7 km² stretch of the Hongshui River running upstream from Dahua town towards Guhe township, within the Hongshui River–Qibainong scenic area, where tour boats cruise between karst hills and riverside villages. Rated 4A in 2019, it forms the backbone of Dahua's river tourism, linking the county town with the reservoir and peak-cluster scenery upstream.
description: 红水河百里风情画廊位于广西河池。游览特色包括水库、滨水景观、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Starts at Poliao village on the edge of Dahua county town and follows the river upstream.

name: 刘三姐故里
summaryEn: A river scenic area where the Xiajian River meets the Longjiang east of Yizhou, presented as the home of Liu Sanjie (Third Sister Liu), the legendary folk singer whose song tradition, nominated by Yizhou, is on the national intangible heritage list. Boats run up the clear Xiajian past karst peaks, bamboo groves and a 'water stone forest' of rocks in the river, with stops at a house shown as Liu Sanjie's home, folk-song performances and farm restaurants.
description: 刘三姐故里位于广西河池。游览特色包括石林、非遗文化、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 7 km east of central Yizhou by road.

name: 笼箱盖枫杏
summaryEn: A former mining area at Lamo village near Chehe town, between about 700 and 1,200 m, that has been regraded and replanted with 18 introduced maple varieties, ginkgo, peach, azalea and peony, and was rated 4A in 2023. It is best known for autumn colour, when the maples, ginkgo and pink muhly grass turn, and has forest trails, viewing platforms, a rainbow slide, a campsite, guesthouses and displays on the area's mining past.
description: 笼箱盖枫杏位于广西河池。游览特色包括林地风光、观景台。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the east side of the old Longxianggai mine near Chehe town, about 20 km south-east of Nandan county town by road.

name: 密洛陀文化公园
summaryEn: A riverside park of about 30 hectares in Du'an's Hedong district, opened in 2015 for the county's 60th anniversary and themed on the Bunu Yao, whose creation epic of the goddess Miluotuo became national intangible heritage in 2011. It has wind-and-rain bridges, waterfalls and lakes, a riverside promenade, a culture street, a hotel and the museum of the Du'an Underground River Geopark.
description: 密洛陀文化公园位于广西河池。游览特色包括博物馆、瀑布、地质景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Yanjiang Road in the Hedong district of Du'an county town.

name: 木论喀斯特
summaryEn: A tourism area on the south-eastern edge of the Mulun National Nature Reserve, part of the Huanjiang Karst component of the South China Karst World Heritage Site since 2014, which protects karst forest continuous with Maolan in Guizhou. Visitors come for the Gubin River, with a walk through its butterfly gorge, rafting and riverside camping, and there is a hotel and visitor centre at Xiazhai hamlet.
description: 木论喀斯特位于广西河池。游览特色包括峡谷、自然保护区。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: At Xiazhai hamlet, Chuanshan town, about 52 km north-west of Huanjiang county town and 70 km from Libo in Guizhou.

name: 南丹矿物温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort at Tanghan village in Chehe town, fed by water that reaches the surface at about 62 °C. It has a dozen public pools, nine private courtyard pools, a hot-spring swimming pool, a children's water park, a hotel and villas, set among wooded hills.
description: 南丹矿物温泉位于广西河池。游览特色包括温泉、水上游乐、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Tanghan village in Chehe town, about 12 km south of Nandan county town by road.

name: 牛角寨瀑布群
summaryEn: A forested karst gorge of about 10 km² at Bamian village, Minglun town, where a 3 km trail passes more than ten tiers of falls in quick succession, nine of them large. The best known, Seven Fairies Falls, is about 60 m wide and over 50 m high and drops in seven strands; the area borders the core of the Mulun karst World Heritage area.
description: 牛角寨瀑布群位于广西河池。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Bamian village, Minglun town, roughly an hour by road north-east of Huanjiang county town.

name: 七百弄国家地质公园
summaryEn: A national geopark of about 323 km² in northern Dahua, declared in 2009, covering what is regarded as one of the world's densest clusters of karst peaks and enclosed hollows: some 9,000 peaks with summits above 800 m crowd around more than 2,500 depressions. Roads wind through the Bunu Yao villages of Qibainong township past high lakes, the Banlan canyon and viewpoints, and a geopark museum stands at the entrance.
description: 七百弄国家地质公园位于广西河池。游览特色包括博物馆、峡谷、地质景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: The geopark museum is about 1.5 hours by road north-west of Dahua county town; the core peak-cluster area lies around Qibainong township.

name: 奇美水城
summaryEn: A riverside cultural quarter in Dahua's Gujiang community on the Hongshui River, developed by the county around its ornamental-stone culture, local food and Zhuang and Yao customs, with a stone museum, a food hall, an ethnic museum and Mituo Temple. It was rated 4A in 2019 and hosts folk events such as rice-cake pounding at festivals.
description: 奇美水城位于广西河池。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Jiangbin North Road along the river in Dahua county town.

name: 三岛湾
summaryEn: A resort area of about 830 hectares on the Hongshui River near Xingli village in Disu town, set among karst hills, Bunu Yao villages and farmland. It offers riverside stays and aerial views over the valley, and runs a model-aircraft science camp and study programmes for school groups.
description: 三岛湾位于广西河池。游览特色包括山谷、滨水景观、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside the Hongshui River about 17 km from Du'an county town and close to Dahua.

name: 天龙大峡谷
summaryEn: A forested karst gorge about 15 km long and 800–1,000 m deep just outside Tian'e town, formerly promoted as Longtan Grand Canyon National Forest Park and rated 4A in 2014. With forest cover of about 96 percent it shelters rare plants such as slipper orchids and golden camellia, and trails lead to a viewpoint over the town, primeval forest, an orchid garden and Lion Cave.
description: 天龙大峡谷位于广西河池。游览特色包括峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 6 km west of Tian'e county town by road.

name: 天上河谷
summaryEn: Tian'e's riverside town scenic area on the Hongshui River, joining Tianfu Hill park with the town's embankment walks, a food street, a fountain square and an elevated skywalk. Visitors climb Tianfu Hill to the Fuwang Pavilion and the Dong Xi Literary Museum, devoted to the Tian'e-born novelist Dong Xi, winner of the Mao Dun and Lu Xun literary prizes, or take a boat on the river within sight of the Longtan dam; paddleboarding has become popular in summer.
description: 天上河谷位于广西河池。游览特色包括博物馆、滨水景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In and around Tian'e county town on the Hongshui River.

name: 瑶望天下
summaryEn: A Baiku Yao cultural tourism complex at Wangshang hamlet in Lihu Yao township, rated 4A in 2023, laid out in areas for intangible-heritage displays on Baiku Yao food, weddings, funerals, bronze drums and top-spinning, with shops, restaurants, hotels and guesthouses and a family park. At major festivals Baiku Yao people gather at its Yaowang village square to play bronze drums, blow ox horns, sing and dance. The complex also takes in Dongtian Shengjing, an underground canyon with waterfalls inside a cave.
description: 瑶望天下位于广西河池。游览特色包括节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Wangshang hamlet in Lihu Yao township, about 13 km east of Nandan county town by road.

name: 鸳鸯洞
summaryEn: A two-level karst cave at over 700 m on Phoenix Hill just east of Fengshan town, about 480 m long, up to 320 m wide and 52 m high at its tallest hall. Dense clusters of stalagmites, one of them 36.4 m tall, form what looks like a stone forest underground, and the visitor route through the first level winds for about 1.2 km. Below it, at the foot of the hill, the twin pools of Yuanyang Spring have long been counted the first of Fengshan's eight views.
description: 鸳鸯洞位于广西河池。游览特色包括石林、洞穴。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Phoenix Hill about 3 km east of Fengshan county town, a short taxi ride.

name: 云观天
summaryEn: An upland pasture and camping area in Mangchang town at around 1,000 m, rated 4A in 2022, with mountain meadows, woodland, karst peaks and farmland. Facilities include a viewing platform above the clouds, a campsite, a coffee house and walking trails, and it draws visitors on the rare winter days when snow falls.
description: 云观天位于广西河池。游览特色包括林地风光、喀斯特地貌、观景台。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Mangchang town, about 25 km north of Nandan county town by road.

name: 壮乡将军纪念园
summaryEn: A red-tourism memorial park in Nongying, the home village of General Wei Guoqing (1913–1989), created for his centenary with a restored version of his former home. Its memorial hall, opened in September 2013, has seven galleries: the ground floor covers Wei Guoqing's life, and the upper floor 19 generals who rose through the Seventh and Eighth Red Armies, among them Zhang Yunyi, Li Tianyou and Wei Jie.
description: 壮乡将军纪念园位于广西河池。游览特色包括纪念展览、历史纪念。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Nongying village, Sanshi town, roughly 20 km south of Donglan county town by road; closed on Mondays except public holidays, and visitors show ID at the entrance (foreign visitors their passport).

name: 大桂山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park in the Dagui Mountains at Butou town, south of Hezhou city, one of the first national forest parks approved in China, with forest covering about 93% of its area. Its 4A scenic area of about 3.5 km² is mainly a place for forest walks.
description: 大桂山国家森林公园位于广西贺州。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At the Daguishan forest farm in Butou town, about 35 km south of central Hezhou by road.

name: 富川生态高值农业科技示范园
summaryEn: An agricultural demonstration park of about 58 ha near Fuli town, centred on a 9,600 m² greenhouse that shows soilless and hydroponic vegetable growing and giant vegetable-shaped displays. Around it are fruit orchards for seasonal picking, a farming-culture exhibit, a bamboo grove, flower fields, family allotments and a wetland area planted with lotus and other water crops. It suits families and school groups more than general sightseers.
description: 富川生态高值农业科技示范园位于广西贺州。游览特色包括湿地、田园观光、果园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Fuli town, about 8 km north-east of Fuchuan county town by road.

name: 富川古明城
summaryEn: The old walled county town of Fuchuan, begun in 1396 under the Ming, through which the Xiaohe Ancient Road, the old road linking the Xiao River in Hunan with the He River, entered by the north gate and left by the south. Much of the wall and part of the moat survive, enclosing a Confucian temple, a martial temple, pebble-paved lanes, old opera stages, a lantern tower, wells and old houses; the county town also keeps the Republican-era arcade street of Xinyong Jie.
description: 富川古明城位于广西贺州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、楼阁建筑、古道。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Fuyang, the Fuchuan county town (Wenjiao Road), about 55 km north-west of Hezhou city by road.

name: 昭平桂江
summaryEn: A 25 km stretch of the Gui River, the lower course of the Li River, centred on Zhaoping town, from Songlin Gorge upstream to Matan Gorge downstream. Boat trips run between green hills and bamboo-lined banks, combining Li River-style scenery with narrow gorges.
description: 昭平桂江位于广西贺州。游览特色包括峡谷、乘船游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The scenic stretch runs through Zhaoping town, about 60 km (an hour's drive) west of Huangyao.

name: 玉石林
summaryEn: A rare stone forest of white marble, the stone known in Chinese as 'Han white jade', in Huangtian town north of Hezhou. The site, about 25 ha, was long an open-cast quarry; after the stone ran out it was restored and opened as a scenic area, with paths winding among white pinnacles and spires.
description: 玉石林位于广西贺州。游览特色包括石林、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Qingmian village, Huangtian town, about 18 km north of central Hezhou by road.

name: 南山茶海
summaryEn: Tea gardens covering the hills just south of Zhaoping town, ringed by mountains and often wrapped in mist, known for the county's early spring tea. Spring, from March to June, is the best time to visit, while the new leaves are being picked.
description: 南山茶海位于广西贺州。游览特色包括园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the hills about 5 km south-east of Zhaoping town, about 6 km (15 minutes' drive) from the Gui River scenic area.

name: 十八水
summaryEn: A forested valley on the northern outskirts of Hezhou, below Gupo Mountain, where a stream drops through a long chain of waterfalls and pools, a type of stepped cascade uncommon in southern China. Paths climb beside the falls through the woods.
description: 十八水位于广西贺州。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Luhua village, Huangtian town, about 20 km north of central Hezhou by road, on the way to Gupo Mountain.

name: 西溪森林温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in forested hills at Nanxiang town in eastern Hezhou, where the spring water comes out at up to 86.5°C. More than a hundred outdoor pools are spread through the woods, from plain spring-water pools to a children's water park and a hilltop infinity pool, with hotel rooms, villas and inns on site. Most guests come from neighbouring Guangdong, and it suits an overnight soak rather than sightseeing.
description: 西溪森林温泉位于广西贺州。游览特色包括温泉、水上游乐、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Nanxiang town, roughly an hour by road east of central Hezhou.

name: 英家·中共广西省工委纪念园
summaryEn: Yingjia, in Qingtang town in south-western Zhongshan County, is an old market village near the Xiaohe Ancient Road that prospered from the late Ming onward. From 1942 to 1945 it was a base of the Communist Party's Guangxi provincial working committee, and in June 1947 it was the scene of the Yingjia uprising; a museum on the committee's history opened in 2016. The village also keeps the Yuedong Guild Hall, built in 1777 by merchants from Guangdong, a brick, timber and stone hall known for its carving.
description: 英家·中共广西省工委纪念园位于广西贺州。游览特色包括博物馆、古道、历史纪念。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yingjia village, Qingtang town, about 30 minutes by road from Huangyao Ancient Town and about 2 hours from Yangshuo.

name: 紫云洞
summaryEn: A limestone cave in a karst hill at Limu village, Etang town, on the south-western edge of Hezhou city, lit with coloured lights. In 2023 its operator, the Guangxi Tourism Development Group, added a 17-scene show in the cave that combines projections, sound and mixed-reality headsets with the formations and with Yao legends.
description: 紫云洞位于广西贺州。游览特色包括洞穴、喀斯特地貌、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Limu village, Etang town, about 6 km south-west of central Hezhou; a taxi is the easiest way there.

name: 百崖大峡谷
summaryEn: A 10 km red-rock (Danxia-type) canyon in the hills of north-eastern Wuxuan, 5–40 m wide, with 37 bends, ten waterfalls and hundreds of steep side gorges that give it the name 'hundred cliffs'. Paths lead through forest with tree ferns and other protected plants past pools and cascades, among them the Tiannü Sanhua fall with a single drop of 86 m; the site reopened in 2022 after new walkways and a visitor centre were built.
description: 百崖大峡谷位于广西来宾。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dongxiang town about 38 km by road north-east of Wuxuan county town, 9 km beyond Xialiantang village.

name: 八仙天池
summaryEn: A lake about 150 m long and 100 m wide lying more than 100 m up a hillside south of Wuxuan, ringed by eight small peaks that gave it the name 'Eight Immortals'. The county gazetteer notes that its level hardly changes in flood or drought; it was listed as a Guangxi scenic area in 1988 and opened to visitors in 2018.
description: 八仙天池位于广西来宾。游览特色包括湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Guanlu village about 6 km south of Wuxuan county town by road.

name: 大瑶山盘王界
summaryEn: Formerly the Lianhua (Lotus) Mountain scenic area, a 23 km² area of quartz-sandstone peaks north-west of Jinxiu whose main summit rises to 1,350 m and whose cluster of pinnacles resembles a lotus bud. Trails climb through old forest past stone pinnacles, cliffs and deep ravines to viewpoints over seas of cloud, and there is a temple to Panhu, the legendary ancestor of the Yao.
description: 大瑶山盘王界位于广西来宾。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、山地游览、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside county road X644 opposite Meng village, about 16 km by road north-west of Jinxiu county town.

name: 古沙沟
summaryEn: A mountain area in north-eastern Jinxiu, largely inside the Dayao Mountains national nature reserve, combining rafting on the Changliu River gorge, the Lingzu canyon with its clear stream and coloured pebbles, the old village of Lingzu, red maple woods on Niulingding and the high Yao village of Bale. A glass walkway along the cliffs at Bale's Shimen pass looks out over the ridges, and the uplands are used for paragliding and hiking.
description: 古沙沟位于广西来宾。游览特色包括峡谷、自然保护区。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Zhongliang township, about 48 km by road north-east of Jinxiu county town.

name: 古象温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort at Reshui ('hot water') village east of Xiangzhou town, built around the Xiangzhou hot springs, with bathing pools set among green hills, fields and village houses. It makes a relaxing stop on the way between Laibin or Liuzhou and the Dayao Mountains.
description: 古象温泉位于广西来宾。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Reshui village in Sicun town, about 7 km east of Xiangzhou county town and roughly an hour by road from Laibin.

name: 合山国家矿山公园
summaryEn: An industrial heritage park on about 27 hectares of the former east mine of the Heshan Mining Bureau, Guangxi's first coal-mining enterprise, beside national road 322. It has a mine-park museum, an underground coal-mining experience, a steam locomotive, a train restaurant, the ruins of the coal-preparation building and a hall of mining machinery, plus karting and other rides.
description: 合山国家矿山公园位于广西来宾。游览特色包括博物馆、历史遗址、矿业遗产。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On national road 322 north-east of central Heshan, about 9 km from the city and roughly an hour by road west of Laibin.

name: 山水瑶城
summaryEn: Jinxiu county town, at about 775 m in the Jinxiu River valley in the heart of the Dayao Mountains, is described by the county as the highest county town in Guangxi; it has been rebuilt in Yao style and made a 4A scenic area as a whole. Its sights include the Yao Museum, the Gongde and Santing bridges, the Panwang Valley, Yaodu Square and streets of Yao crafts and food. It is the base for exploring the Dayao Mountains, home to five distinct Yao groups.
description: 山水瑶城位于广西来宾。游览特色包括博物馆、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Jinxiu town is roughly 2 hours by road from Liuzhou.

name: 圣堂湖
summaryEn: A reservoir and river gorge at the foot of Shengtang Mountain in south-eastern Jinxiu, where the river winds between peaks and cliffs of red sandstone. Visitors come for boat trips on the reservoir, rafting on the river and swimming in spring-fed pools, and the scenic area also presents Yao village customs.
description: 圣堂湖位于广西来宾。游览特色包括峡谷、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
