accessEn: In Changdong township about 28 km by road south-east of Jinxiu county town.

name: 圣堂山
summaryEn: The main peak of the Dayao Mountains and, at 1,979 m, the highest summit in central Guangxi, revered by the Yao as a holy mountain. Its often cloud-wrapped ridges of purple-red sandstone carry pines, rhododendrons that flower in May, stone rivers left by ancient glaciation and a Ming-dynasty stone wall.
description: 圣堂山位于广西来宾。游览特色包括砂岩地貌、登山观景、历史建筑。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: At Pingmeng village in Changdong township, south of Jinxiu county town, reached by mountain road; driving or a tour is easiest.

name: 蓬莱洲时光岛
summaryEn: A resort on Penglaizhou, an island of about 27 hectares in the Hongshui River east of Laibin, with steep karst banks, rocky outcrops and thick vegetation. Guests stay at the island hotel, take boat trips around the island, barbecue and join local food activities such as making oil tea and glutinous rice cakes. The island also holds the site of the Song-dynasty seat of Xiangzhou, a protected archaeological site.
description: 蓬莱洲时光岛位于广西来宾。游览特色包括岛屿、乘船游览、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Chengxiang town about 16 km by road from Laibin city, around 30 minutes from Laibin North high-speed railway station.

name: 下莲塘
summaryEn: A village of the Liu family in eastern Wuxuan, set among ponds and old longan groves, with two notable buildings: the General's Mansion, a walled Qing courtyard compound begun in 1801 with 175 rooms where about a hundred people still live, and the Liu Bingyu Manor of 1908. The manor, built by an army general of the Republican era, combines a traditional courtyard plan with Western-style architecture and became a national heritage site in 2019.
description: 下莲塘位于广西来宾。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、历史宅院。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Dongxiang town, about 29 km by road from Wuxuan county town and 9 km from the Baiya Grand Canyon.

name: 忻城薰衣草庄园
summaryEn: A flower farm on the southern edge of Xincheng town, billed as the largest lavender estate in Guangxi, with fields of lavender, verbena and other flowering plants laid out for strolling and photography. Visit in the flowering season, as by late autumn few plants are in bloom.
description: 忻城薰衣草庄园位于广西来宾。游览特色包括庄园、赏花。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Tongliang in Fantuan village, about 5 km south-west of Xincheng county town; driving or a taxi is easiest. Check that it is open before going.

name: 银杉森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park in the Dayao Mountains national nature reserve north-east of Jinxiu town, named after the Cathaya (yinshan), a rare conifer found only in China, which grows here with southern yew and Bretschneidera. It is the part of the reserve richest in rare species, including macaques and the golden Kaiser-i-Hind butterfly, and also has the site of a 'sent-down youth' camp and the Dayaoshan ecology museum.
description: 银杉森林公园位于广西来宾。游览特色包括博物馆、森林公园、自然保护区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 15 km by road north-east of Jinxiu county town.

name: 岜公塘湿地公园
summaryEn: A wetland park of about 107 hectares in the new town of Liujiang District, created from a large pond and opened in October 2019. Paths and bridges circle the lake, with a bird island where egrets gather, flower meadows and the Bagong pagoda set against a karst hill, and the park is lit up at night.
description: 岜公塘湿地公园位于广西柳州。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊、古塔。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Liujiang District new town about 13 km south-west of central Liuzhou, roughly 25 minutes by road.

name: 百朋荷苑
summaryEn: A lotus-growing area at Baipeng, the centre of Liujiang's double-crop lotus-root farming, with about 45 hectares of lotus fields in a scenic area of about 79 hectares. Boardwalks cross the ponds, a small sightseeing train runs between them, farm restaurants serve lotus-root dishes, and a lotus festival is held each summer.
description: 百朋荷苑位于广西柳州。游览特色包括农业体验、莲花观赏、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Baipeng town in Liujiang District, about 20 km south-west of central Liuzhou, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 布央仙人山
summaryEn: Tea gardens covering the hillsides of Buyang, a Dong village in Bajiang township, at about 600 to 1,000 m, where tea is the main crop and the early-spring harvest is the local speciality. Paths lead from the entrance through a maple grove and terraced tea gardens to a Dong hamlet, an old tea garden and a stretch of old trading path, and there are campsites and wooden cabins on the hill.
description: 布央仙人山位于广西柳州。游览特色包括园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 17 km by road north-west of Sanjiang county town, roughly 30 minutes by car.

name: 侗天宫
summaryEn: A complex of new Dong-style timber buildings, including drum towers and covered corridors, around a cultural square in Guyi, Sanjiang's county town, opened in 2021 among 15 old sweetgum trees aged 100 to 200 years. Dong music shows with lusheng reed pipes, leaf-blown songs and pipa ballads are staged for visitors, and evening opening began in 2024 with a music festival.
description: 侗天宫位于广西柳州。游览特色包括音乐文化、节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Jiangfeng Road in Guyi, Sanjiang's county town, about 1 km from the Sanjiang Drum Tower.

name: 凤凰河生态旅游度假区
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort on the upper Liu River at Luoman, west of Liuzhou, developed as part of the Liu River tourism belt and rated 4A in 2015. It draws geothermal water from a deep well for public and private hot-spring pools, alongside a resort hotel, villas and outdoor activity areas.
description: 凤凰河生态旅游度假区位于广西柳州。游览特色包括天然泉水、温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Luoman town about 15 km north-west of central Liuzhou, roughly 30 minutes by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 广西生态科普苑
summaryEn: A science-education scenic area on the campus of the Guangxi Eco-Engineering Vocational and Technical College in Shatang, north of Liuzhou, rated 4A in 2023. Visitors walk through its east and west gardens, groves of old and notable trees, the historic buildings of the former forestry school and the woodland around Junwu Lake, and it is used mainly for study tours.
description: 广西生态科普苑位于广西柳州。游览特色包括湖泊、园林景观、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shatang town about 17 km north of central Liuzhou, roughly 30 minutes by road. It is on a working college campus, so check visiting arrangements before going.

name: 古岭龙
summaryEn: An industrial-tourism site at the Guangxi Gulinglong group's garden-style factory in Chuanshan town, which makes infused liquors, spirits steeped with herbs and, in some cases, snakes and other animals. Visitors see the brewing and bottling halls, a museum of infused liquor with jars of snakes and other creatures, a tasting hall, a collection of about 600 kinds of Chinese and foreign liquors, and a rooftop rice field.
description: 古岭龙位于广西柳州。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观、酿造文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Chuanshan town, Liujiang District, about 32 km south of central Liuzhou, roughly 45 minutes by road.

name: 克里湾欢乐世界
summaryEn: An amusement park in the Liudong New Area, opened in 2017 as Kale Planet and rated 4A in 2018, now operating under the Keliwan Happy World name beside the Liuzhou Garden Expo Park. It has outdoor rides and play areas aimed at families with children and teenagers.
description: 克里湾欢乐世界位于广西柳州。游览特色包括主题游乐、园林景观、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Cuiling Road in the Liudong New Area, next to the Liuzhou Garden Expo Park, about 16 km east of central Liuzhou.

name: 克里湾水乐园
summaryEn: An outdoor water park in the Liudong New Area with water rides and pools, mainly a summer outing for families and young people. It shares the Keliwan name with the neighbouring amusement park.
description: 克里湾水乐园位于广西柳州。游览特色包括主题游乐、水上游乐、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Jiuziling Avenue in the Liudong New Area, next to Keliwan Happy World, about 16 km east of central Liuzhou. Check that it is open before going.

name: 百里柳江
summaryEn: The scenic stretch of the Liu River as it loops through central Liuzhou, lined with landscaped promenades on both banks. Sightseeing boats leave from the East Embankment pier, and after dark the banks are floodlit and a large musical fountain plays on the river by the north bank.
description: 柳江在柳州市中心蜿蜒而过，两岸的滨水步道可从不同角度观赏城市与江流。
accessEn: Boats leave from the East Embankment (Dongdi) tourist pier in central Liuzhou, about 10 minutes by taxi from People's Square.

name: 柳工
summaryEn: The main works of LiuGong, the construction-machinery maker founded in Liuzhou in 1958 that built mainland China's first wheel loader in 1966, rated a 4A industrial-tourism site in 2018. The works receive study groups and visiting delegations and suit travellers interested in heavy industry.
description: 广西柳工机械股份有限公司始建于1958年，前身为从上海华东钢铁建筑厂部分搬迁到柳州而创建的“柳州工程机械厂”。公司总部位于广西壮族自治区柳州市。于1993年在深交所上市，是中国大陆工程机械类第一家上市公司，中国制造业500强企业。
accessEn: At 1 Liutai Road in Liunan District, western Liuzhou, about 20 minutes by taxi from People's Square. It is a working factory, so arrange a visit in advance.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 柳州文庙
summaryEn: A modern reconstruction of Liuzhou's Confucian temple, first founded in the early Tang dynasty, standing on the east bank of the Liu River below Dengtai Hill. The complex, mainly in Song style with southern Chinese details, comprises the Dacheng Gate, Dacheng Hall, Chongsheng Shrine and Minglun Hall, and hosts traditional-culture events on festivals.
description: 柳州文庙位于广西柳州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Fuzi Road on the east bank of the Liu River, about 10 minutes by taxi from People's Square.

name: 柳州园博园
summaryEn: A large landscaped park in the Liudong New Area, built for the first Guangxi Garden and Horticulture Expo and opened in October 2011. Its themed show gardens, lakeside promenades, fountain and flower squares and a greenhouse spread over about 42 hectares of planting and 12 hectares of water, with more than 380 plant species.
description: 柳州园博园位于广西柳州。游览特色包括湖泊、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Boyuan Avenue in the Liudong New Area, about 16 km east of central Liuzhou, roughly 35 minutes by road.

name: 柳州城市规划展览馆
summaryEn: A two-floor exhibition on the east bank of the Liu River about the city's history and planning. The ground floor centres on a 1:750 model of the whole city and a virtual tour along the river, and the upper floor covers bridges and other engineering works, ethnic culture and tourism in Liuzhou and its counties.
description: 柳州城市规划展览馆位于广西柳州。游览特色包括主题展览、民族文化。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: On Wenchang Road on the east bank of the Liu River in central Liuzhou, a short taxi ride from People's Square. Check that it is open before going.

name: 柳州市动物园
summaryEn: The city zoo on the southern edge of Liuzhou, which moved here from Liuhou Park in 2005 and keeps more than a hundred species. It has a big-cat area, an aviary, a small-animal area where children can feed animals and a herbivore enclosure crossed by boardwalks among sika deer and ostriches, and an ice-and-snow play area opened in 2024.
description: 柳州市动物园位于广西柳州。游览特色包括动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Hangyin Road in Liunan District, southern Liuzhou, near the Liuzhou Military Museum Park, about 25 minutes by taxi from People's Square.

name: 龙女沟
summaryEn: A valley in Sirong township on the south-western slopes of Yuanbao Mountain, with clear pools, waterfalls and forest beside Miao and Dong villages of wooden houses and drum towers. Sights include the Longnü Pool and waterfall, terraced fields and the Red Army Bridge, first built by the Red Seventh Army when it passed through in 1930 and later rebuilt as a Dong wind-and-rain bridge.
description: 龙女沟位于广西柳州。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Sirong township about 50 km by road north-west of Rongshui county town, roughly 1.5 hours by car.

name: 螺蛳粉小镇
summaryEn: A themed town at Taiyangcun, west of Liuzhou, developed since 2018 around luosifen, the city's river-snail rice-noodle soup, and recognised as a national modern agricultural industrial park. It brings together raw-material farms, noodle factories and study-tour facilities, and its hilltop launch site is a paragliding base that hosted the Guangxi championships in 2024.
description: 柳州以西太阳村镇的旅游小镇围绕螺蛳粉这一地方饮食展开体验与展示。
accessEn: In Taiyangcun town about 14 km west of central Liuzhou, roughly 30 minutes by road.

name: 洛维螺蛳粉产业园
summaryEn: An industrial park in the Luowei area of southern Liuzhou where packaged luosifen, the city's river-snail rice-noodle soup, is made, rated a 4A industrial-tourism site in 2018. Visitors watch the automated packing lines from viewing corridors and tour a luosifen culture exhibition hall, and it suits food-minded travellers and school groups.
description: 洛维螺蛳粉产业园位于广西柳州。游览特色包括主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Putaoshan Road about 10 km south of central Liuzhou, roughly 25 minutes by road.

name: 马鹿山奇石博览园
summaryEn: A hillside park in eastern Liuzhou built around ornamental stones, a long-standing local passion. Its centrepiece is the Liuzhou Stone Museum, a stone-shaped building whose three floors show stones from the Hongshui River, from elsewhere in China and abroad, and minerals and fossils, and a large stone market lies across the road.
description: 马鹿山奇石博览园位于广西柳州。游览特色包括博物馆、化石遗迹。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Donghuan Avenue in Chengzhong District, eastern Liuzhou, about 15 minutes by taxi from People's Square.

name: 梦呜苗寨
summaryEn: A Miao culture park inside the Shuanglong Gully resort, set up around 2018 by dismantling stilt houses in remote mountain villages and rebuilding them here, with some of their Miao owners resettled to work in the park. It has reconstructed stilt houses and covered bridges, staged Miao song-and-dance shows, and craft halls where visitors watch lusheng-making, Miao embroidery and silversmithing.
description: 梦呜苗寨位于广西柳州。游览特色包括村寨。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Inside the Shuanglong Gully resort about 5 km north-west of Rongshui county town.

name: 东方梦工场·柳空文创园
summaryEn: A creative park in the former Liuzhou Air Compressor Works, a state factory founded in 1958 and listed as national industrial heritage in 2021. Its red-brick workshops now hold a cinema, an industrial experience hall, an art gallery, a theatre and studios, and the park was rated 4A in 2020.
description: 东方梦工场·柳空文创园位于广西柳州。游览特色包括戏剧演艺、工业遗产、艺术展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Beique Road in Liubei District, northern Liuzhou, about 20 minutes by taxi from People's Square.

name: 上汽通用五菱宝骏基地
summaryEn: The Baojun car plant of SAIC-GM-Wuling in the Liudong New Area, rated 4A in 2018 and opened for industrial tours in June 2019. Guided routes lead past production lines, a new-energy vehicle laboratory, a company history hall and an exhibition on electric, connected and self-driving cars, and there is a test-drive area.
description: 上汽通用五菱宝骏基地位于广西柳州。游览特色包括工业参观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At 8 Baojun Avenue in the Liudong New Area, about 18 km east of central Liuzhou, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 三江大侗寨
summaryEn: The scenic area covering the modern Dong-style landmarks of Guyi, Sanjiang's county town, rated 4A in 2012. Its centrepiece is the Sanjiang Drum Tower, 42.6 m tall with 27 tiers of eaves, built in 2002 under the master carpenter Yang Siyu, with viewing decks inside, and the area also takes in the Sanjiang wind-and-rain bridge, the 'Dong Bird's Nest' bullfighting arena, a stele corridor on Dong history and Moon Street, a street of shops in Dong style.
description: 三江大侗寨位于广西柳州。游览特色包括楼阁建筑、村寨。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Guyi, Sanjiang's county town; Sanjiang South high-speed station is about 10 km away.

name: 三江口生态旅游区
summaryEn: A riverside area at Laobao, where the Duliu (Rongjiang) and Xun rivers meet and become the Rong River, rated a 4A scenic area in 2023. It combines boat trips along the rivers, an old banyan grove at Chankou village, visits to Dong villages, and farming, camping and leisure activities on Yongxing islet.
description: 三江口生态旅游区位于广西柳州。游览特色包括滨水景观、乘船游览、农业体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Laobao township about 20 km south-west of Sanjiang county town, roughly 30 minutes by road.

name: 石门仙湖
summaryEn: A karst scenic area of about 470 hectares around the Shimen reservoir in Daliang town, named after a huge natural stone gateway near its entrance. A glass walkway runs along the cliff, boardwalks lead through upper, middle and lower caves linked by an underground river, and boats continue from the lower cave onto the lake. Old cliff inscriptions and the ruins of an academy add some history.
description: 石门仙湖位于广西柳州。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside National Road 209 in Daliang town, about 70 km north of Liuzhou and 50 km south of Rong'an county town, roughly 1.5 hours by road from Liuzhou.

name: 双龙沟
summaryEn: A forested valley north-west of Rongshui town with about 420 hectares of old-growth public-welfare forest, two streams, waterfalls and a small reservoir. Trails lead through the forest, and the resort adds a glass suspension bridge, zip lines and other adventure activities; the Mengwu Miao culture park lies within it.
description: 双龙沟位于广西柳州。游览特色包括瀑布、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 5 km north-west of Rongshui county town, roughly 15 minutes by road; Rongshui is about 1.5 hours by road from Liuzhou.

name: 仙草堂生态灵芝透明工厂
summaryEn: A see-through factory of the Guangxi Xiancaotang pharmaceutical company in Rong'an's county town, where visitors follow the growing and processing of lingzhi (reishi) mushrooms. It has smart greenhouses that imitate mountain-forest conditions, production halls open to view, a lingzhi science hall and a restaurant serving lingzhi dishes.
description: 仙草堂生态灵芝透明工厂位于广西柳州。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Dongsheng Street in Chang'an, Rong'an's county town, about 1.5 hours by road north of Liuzhou.

name: 祥荷乡韵
summaryEn: A farming and leisure area around Shixiang hamlet near Zhongdu, centred on about 67 hectares of lotus ponds among karst peaks, rated 4A in 2018. The lotus flowers in summer, when boardwalks lead across the ponds past waterwheels, and a cycling route links the fields with Zhongdu Old Town, the Xiangshui waterfall and the Xiangqiao karst geopark.
description: 祥荷乡韵位于广西柳州。游览特色包括瀑布、地质景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 2 km north-west of Zhongdu Old Town in Luzhai county, roughly an hour by road from Liuzhou.

name: 香桥岩
summaryEn: A national geopark of karst scenery in Zhongdu town, with caves, underground rivers, a natural stone bridge and sinkholes among wooded limestone hills. The Jiulong (Nine Dragons) Cave lies at the end of a cycling route from Zhongdu Old Town past the Xiangshui waterfall and a stone forest.
description: 香桥岩位于广西柳州。游览特色包括瀑布、石林、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 9 km north-west of Zhongdu Old Town, roughly 15 minutes by road; Zhongdu is about an hour from Liuzhou.

name: 月也侗寨
summaryEn: A purpose-built Dong-style leisure quarter of about 4.8 hectares in the centre of Sanjiang's county town, built and run by the state-owned Guangxi Tourism Development Group and rated 4A in 2020. Its main draw is Zuomei Sanjiang, an evening staged song-and-dance show about Dong courtship customs, alongside a night market, long-table banquets and buffalo fights held on holidays.
description: 月也侗寨位于广西柳州。游览特色包括村寨。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Dongxiang Avenue in the centre of Guyi, Sanjiang's county town; Sanjiang South high-speed station is about 10 km away.

name: 立鱼峰
summaryEn: Two limestone hills rising from the city on the south bank of the Liu River: Yufeng Hill, about 156 m above sea level, and the taller Ma'an Hill. Yufeng Park is themed on the folk singer Liu Sanjie, who in legend sang here and rode a carp into the sky from the pool below, and a cave halfway up holds painted figures telling her story. From Ma'an Hill's summit there are views over the loop of the river and the whole city.
description: 立鱼峰位于广西柳州。游览特色包括洞穴、登山观景、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Yufeng Road on the south bank of the Liu River, about 10 minutes by taxi from People's Square.

name: 知青城
summaryEn: A theme village at Luoya on the Rong River, where more than 400 urban 'educated youth' were sent to live and farm during the Down to the Countryside Movement. The lane from the jetty to the village square is lined with houses painted with period slogans and murals and hung with old photographs, and the village has a museum on the movement.
description: 知青城位于广西柳州。游览特色包括博物馆、壁画。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Dapu town about 5 km from Liucheng county town and 55 km north-west of Liuzhou, roughly an hour by road.

name: 中渡古镇
summaryEn: A market town in north-western Luzhai county with nearly 2,000 years of history, listed as a national historic and cultural town. Its old quarter keeps Ming- and Qing-era houses, the Yuedong (Cantonese) guild hall, a Guandi temple whose restoration was completed in 2023, and a banyan-shaded river wharf. A cycling route leads on past lotus fields, the Xiangshui waterfall and a stone forest to the Xiangqiao karst geopark.
description: 中渡古镇位于广西柳州。游览特色包括瀑布、古镇、石林。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhongdu town about 50 km north-east of Liuzhou, roughly an hour by road.

name: 八桂田园
summaryEn: A modern agriculture showcase set up in 1999 by the Guangxi Department of Agriculture on the training farm of the provincial agricultural school and now run under Guangxi Agricultural Vocational University. Greenhouses and demonstration plots show fruit, vegetables and flowers grown with modern methods, and it suits families and school groups interested in farming.
description: 八桂田园位于广西南宁。游览特色包括农业体验、田园观光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At 19 Xiangsihu East Road in Xixiangtang District, north-western Nanning, about 2 km from Guangxi University for Nationalities metro station. Check that it is open before going.

name: 百益·上河城
summaryEn: A creative and leisure district in the red-brick workshops of the former Nanning silk-spinning mill, built in 1966, south of the Yong River in Jiangnan District, converted and opened in 2018. The old factory buildings now hold an industrial-history gallery, exhibition and performance spaces, craft shops of intangible-heritage makers, cafés, bars and restaurants, and the district is liveliest in the evening.
description: 百益·上河城位于广西南宁。游览特色包括工业遗产。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At 45 Tinghong Road in Jiangnan District, about 1 km from Tinghong Lu station on metro Line 2.

name: 中华茉莉园
summaryEn: A jasmine park of variety gardens, a wetland lake and wide flower fields around Shijing village in Xiaoyi town, at the centre of Hengzhou's jasmine industry, which produces more than 80 percent of China's jasmine flowers and jasmine tea. In the summer picking season visitors can walk the fields, watch growers picking the buds and try picking themselves, and the Shijing jasmine market nearby trades the day's flowers.
description: 中华茉莉园位于广西南宁。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xiaoyi town, about 15 km north of central Hengzhou and roughly 1.5 hours by road east of Nanning.

name: 大龙湖
summaryEn: A reservoir lake in the karst hills of Xiyan town in northern Shanglin County, formed in 1958 by damming underground water, which now covers about 560 hectares with 14 small islands and 16 caves. Boat trips on the lake pass limestone peaks nicknamed Lotus, Penguin and Peacock hills, and visitors can also go into Dalong Cave on the shore.
description: 大龙湖位于广西南宁。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dalongdong village, Xiyan town, about 28 km from Shanglin county town and roughly 2 hours by road north of Nanning.

name: 大庙江
summaryEn: An outdoor recreation area of about 630 hectares at the foot of the Daming Mountains nature reserve in Shanglin County, built around a forest rafting run on the Damiao River. Besides the rafting it has stream walks to waterfalls, a wetland park, a wisteria walk lined with windmills and a children's play area, and it suits families looking for a summer day in the hills.
description: 大庙江位于广西南宁。游览特色包括瀑布、湿地、自然保护区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Liulian village, Xiangxian town, roughly 1.5 hours by road north-east of Nanning; the rafting runs only in the warmer months, so check before going.

name: 顶蛳山遗址
summaryEn: A freshwater shell-midden site on a terrace where the Bachi River meets a stream, lived on from about 10,000 to 6,000 years ago and excavated between 1997 and 2000, when 331 burials, many of them tightly flexed, were found; it gave its name to the Dingsishan culture, the first Neolithic culture defined in Guangxi. A site park and a shell-shaped museum with about 1,300 m² of galleries and more than 200 artefacts opened with the neighbouring Garden Expo Park in 2018, inside a 4A countryside area of farmland, fruit picking and campsites.
description: 顶蛳山遗址位于广西南宁。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 2 km on foot west of the south gate of the Nanning Garden Expo Park in Yongning District, some 20 km south-east of central Nanning. The museum is closed on Mondays.

name: 梦想城
summaryEn: A modern resort area built in imitation of the Austrian lakeside village of Hallstatt, set by a lake among karst peaks near Yiling Cave in Shuangqiao town. Its European-style streets and lakeside buildings serve mainly as a large wedding and wedding-photography base, so it suits photographers and couples rather than visitors looking for history.
description: 梦想城位于广西南宁。游览特色包括湖泊、喀斯特地貌、洞穴。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Bali hamlet, Yiling village, Shuangqiao town, about 26 km north of central Nanning and close to Yiling Cave. Check that it is open before going.

name: 凤岭儿童公园
summaryEn: A children's park of about 56 hectares laid out over hilly ground in the Fengling district of eastern Nanning, opened on 1 June 2012. It has an amusement park of themed zones with rides, including roller coasters and a Ferris wheel, a summer water park and grassy slopes for play, and suits families with children.
description: 凤岭儿童公园位于广西南宁。游览特色包括主题游乐、水上游乐、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At 25 Yunjing Road in Qingxiu District, about 900 m from ASEAN Business District metro station.

name: 花花大世界
summaryEn: A flower-themed leisure park of about 113 hectares in Shuangqiao town, Wuming, with seasonal flower fields, bougainvillea gardens, a large lawn, lotus ponds crossed by a Zhuang-style covered bridge and a hilltop walkway with a glass section. A European-style chapel on a patch of artificial white sand is used for weddings and photo shoots, and festival events such as Spring Festival fireworks and lion dances are staged for families.
description: 花花大世界位于广西南宁。游览特色包括花卉观赏、园林景观、莲花观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shuangqiao town, Wuming District, about 25 km north of central Nanning on the road to Wuming.

name: 金花茶公园
summaryEn: A city park on the west side of Nanhu Lake devoted to golden camellias, rare yellow-flowered camellias under national protection, with a gene bank that collects and studies many kinds of them alongside other camellias and tea plants. The bushes flower from November to April, at their best in January and February, and a small science hall explains the plants.
description: 金花茶公园位于广西南宁。游览特色包括湖泊、城市公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At 3-5 Gecun Road in Qingxiu District, about 1 km from Nanhu metro station.

name: 广西药用植物园
summaryEn: A research botanical garden founded in 1959 on 202 hectares of low hills on the north-eastern edge of Nanning, which conserves more than 10,000 species of medicinal plants and was certified by Guinness World Records in 2011 as the largest medicinal botanical garden. Themed areas cover Guangxi's own medicinal plants, trees, climbers, shade plants, the ginger family, tropical plants and medicinal animals, and it serves as a teaching base for traditional Chinese medicine.
description: 广西药用植物园位于广西南宁。游览特色包括植物园、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At 189 Changgang Road in Xingning District, about 7 km north-east of central Nanning, a short taxi ride.

name: 广西高峰森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park run by the state-owned Gaofeng Forest Farm in the hills on Nanning's northern edge, with a core area of about 1,200 hectares and around 90 percent forest cover. Its attractions include a glass bridge, forest go-karts, a viewing platform over the city, a water slide and children's play areas, as well as a China–Vietnam Friendship Forest grown from Manglietia seeds that Ho Chi Minh gave to Zhou Enlai in the 1960s.
description: 广西高峰森林公园位于广西南宁。游览特色包括森林公园、玻璃栈道、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The south entrance is about 15 km north of central Nanning and 4 km from the Gaofeng toll gate on the Nanning outer ring expressway.

name: 广西规划馆
summaryEn: A large exhibition hall in the Wuxiang New Area, opened on 8 November 2011, presenting Guangxi's development and its urban and regional planning in about 46,000 m² of floor space. Its three floors of galleries include a digital display centre, halls on Guangxi's landscapes and on cooperation with ASEAN, and a gallery of gifts of friendship, and it suits visitors curious about modern Guangxi.
description: 广西规划馆位于广西南宁。游览特色包括主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At 8 Songxiang Road in Liangqing District, about 450 m from Guangxi Planning Exhibition Hall station on metro Line 3.

name: 广西科技馆
summaryEn: Guangxi's main science museum, founded in 1983 and moved into a new building near Minzu Square in December 2008, with about 9,000 m² of permanent exhibitions on engineering, information technology and bioengineering. There are also temporary exhibitions, a youth science studio and special-format cinemas, and the building's design draws on Elephant Trunk Hill, Yangshuo's Moon Hill, oyster shells and bronze drums.
description: 广西科技馆位于广西南宁。游览特色包括博物馆、科学科普、主题展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At 20 Minzu Avenue near Minzu Square, about 350 m from Xinmin Lu metro station.

name: 古辣稻花香里
summaryEn: A rural scenic area of about 72 hectares in Cai village near Gula town, built around the Cai family's old residential compound of more than 180 rooms, whose halls, courtyards and corner watchtowers date from rebuilding after 1859 in the late Qing dynasty. The village is surrounded by water on three sides and by rice fields, and since it opened as a scenic area in October 2019 it has combined the old houses with farmland views and farm-stay restaurants.
description: 古辣稻花香里位于广西南宁。游览特色包括历史建筑、田园观光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Cai village near Gula town in north-eastern Binyang County, about 1.5 hours by road north-east of Nanning. Check that it is open before going.

name: 鼓鸣寨
summaryEn: Guminzhuang, a Zhuang village developed as the Gumingzhai scenic area, lies beside a lake with small islands in a valley ringed by hills and has 158 rammed-earth houses, most of them built in the Qing and Republican periods. The houses have rough-stone bases, yellow-earth walls and grey-tiled roofs, many arranged as a central ancestral hall between two wings around a small courtyard, and the county describes the village as the largest and best-preserved of its kind in Guangxi. It suits a quiet walk among old houses with the lake and hills around them.
description: 鼓鸣寨位于广西南宁。游览特色包括湖泊、山谷、祠堂文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Changlian village, Xiangxian town, about 25 km from Shanglin county town and 65 km north-east of central Nanning, roughly 1.5 hours by road.

name: 江南公园
summaryEn: A large city park south of the Yong River in Jiangnan District, opened in June 2018 and laid out around linked lakes with Wenfeng Hill as a backdrop. Lawns, flowering trees, covered walkways and pavilions in old Chinese style surround the water, and a square at the west gate has a sculpture decorated with Zhuang motifs such as bronze drums and brocade.
description: 江南公园位于广西南宁。游览特色包括楼阁建筑、雕塑艺术、城市公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At 17 Zhuangjin Avenue in Jiangnan District, next to Jiangnan Park station on metro Line 5.

name: 九曲湾温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in Santang town on the north-eastern edge of Nanning, open since November 2005, with indoor and outdoor thermal pools and décor drawing on Zhuang and other ethnic cultures. It also has a water park with nearly 6,000 m² of pools under a large shade roof, plus a hotel and restaurants, and suits a relaxing half-day out of the city.
description: 九曲湾温泉位于广西南宁。游览特色包括温泉、水上游乐、民族文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Wenquan Road off Kunlun Avenue in Santang town, Xingning District, about 15 km north-east of central Nanning by road.

name: 良凤江国家森林公园
summaryEn: One of the earliest national forest parks approved by China's former Ministry of Forestry, on the south-western outskirts of Nanning along the Liangfeng River. It has a large plant garden with a wide collection of trees, a cultural garden containing Tianning Temple of the Guangxi Buddhist Association, and a small amusement area.
description: 良凤江国家森林公园位于广西南宁。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At 78 Youyi Road in Jiangnan District, about 12 km south-west of central Nanning and 15 km from Nanning Wuxu International Airport.

name: 龙虎山
summaryEn: A nature reserve of forested limestone hills in Pingshan township, Long'an County, known as one of China's 'four great monkey mountains' for its more than 3,000 wild rhesus macaques. Besides watching the monkeys, visitors can walk in forest that shelters more than 1,200 plant species and over 200 kinds of wild animals, and take part in water activities.
description: 龙虎山位于广西南宁。游览特色包括自然保护区、林地风光、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Pingshan township, Long'an County, about 80 km west of Nanning; National Road G358 runs through the scenic area.

name: 龙门水都
summaryEn: A leisure resort in forested hills around Longmen Reservoir on the north-western edge of Nanning, about 15 km from the city centre. It combines hot-spring and herbal-bath pools, a summer water park and a long glass suspension bridge with walking paths and themed gardens, and suits families on a day out from the city.
description: 龙门水都位于广西南宁。游览特色包括水库、水上游乐、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Xinji Road in Xixiangtang District, about 15 km north-west of central Nanning; the nearest metro station, Keyuan Dadao, is about 3 km away.

name: 名山
summaryEn: A hill area in Chenping town in southern Binyang County, made up of three peaks whose highest, Mingshan Top, rises to 876 m, the second-highest point in the county, above plum orchards and villages. Promoted as a 'Lingnan plum village', it has a visitor centre and viewing platforms, and visitors come to climb the peak and walk among the plum trees, especially in the blossom season.
description: 名山位于广西南宁。游览特色包括果园、观景台、赏花。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 5 km from Chenping town and 17 km from Kunlun Pass, roughly an hour by road north-east of Nanning.

name: 南国乡村
summaryEn: A rural tourism area in Nagong hamlet, Sugong village, Shuangqiao town, built around a museum of rural house building that presents the village architecture of different ethnic groups alongside new building methods. Around it are an expo garden of model new farmhouses, a farm and homestays, and it suits a countryside half-day with children or a group.
description: 南国乡村位于广西南宁。游览特色包括博物馆、田园观光、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shuangqiao town, Wuming District, about 18 km north of the Nanning ring road and the same distance from Wuming town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 南宁文化旅游艺术园
summaryEn: A 4A area created in 2023 by grouping four sites run by the Guangxi Tourism Group in the Wuxiang area south of the Yong River: the 'Guanglü Nanning Night' evening leisure district, the Guangxi Art Museum, Central Park and the 'Yunduoduo' young artists' camp. Together they combine night-time strolling and entertainment with art exhibitions and park space, and suit an evening out more than a sightseeing visit.
description: 南宁文化旅游艺术园位于广西南宁。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Its listed address is the Guangxi Culture and Art Centre on Longdi Road, Liangqing District, on the south bank of the Yong River, about 700 m from Nanning Museum metro station.

name: 南宁园博园
summaryEn: The 263-hectare site of the 12th China International Garden Expo, opened in December 2018 beside the Bachi River in Yongning District on the south-eastern edge of Nanning. Gardens built by Chinese cities and ASEAN countries spread around its lakes, among them the China–ASEAN Friendship Pavilion linking ten national pavilions and an ASEAN Garden with Cambodian, Lao and Philippine sections, and seasonal flower and grass fields draw crowds in autumn.
description: 南宁园博园位于广西南宁。游览特色包括园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At 20 Puxing Avenue in Yongning District, about 20 km south-east of central Nanning; BRT buses stop at Yuanboyuan near the gates.

name: 南宁国际会展中心
summaryEn: The hillside convention centre on Minzu Avenue that is the permanent venue of the annual China–ASEAN Expo and one of Nanning's landmark buildings, whose 41-hectare grounds were rated a 4A scenic area in 2021. Displays and landscaping themed on the expo's history and on the cultures of China and the ten ASEAN countries make it a sightseeing stop between trade fairs, and it looks across to Minge Lake.
description: 南宁国际会展中心位于广西南宁。游览特色包括湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At 106 Minzu Avenue in Qingxiu District, about 650 m from Convention & Exhibition Center metro station.

name: 南宁极地海洋世界
summaryEn: A large indoor aquarium in the Rongsheng Tianhe Haiyue City shopping complex in Jiangnan District, laid out in themed halls on ocean legends, the polar regions and marine life, with an animal-petting area for children. Its animals include sea lions, seals, penguins and many kinds of fish, and staged shows such as a sea-lion show and an underwater show are part of the programme, so it is mainly a family outing.
description: 南宁极地海洋世界位于广西南宁。游览特色包括水族展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Rongsheng Tianhe Haiyue City complex at 39 Shajing Avenue, Jiangnan District, in south-western Nanning. Check that it is open before going.

name: 南宁万达茂
summaryEn: A large indoor shopping and entertainment complex opened in June 2017 in the Wuxiang New Area south of the Yong River, rated 4A in 2018 for its indoor attractions. Its former indoor theme park has been converted into an indoor ski centre, opened in July 2026, which is kept at −5 °C all year and has three ski runs, a snow-play area and a training centre, alongside the mall's shops and restaurants.
description: 南宁万达茂位于广西南宁。游览特色包括主题游乐。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At 6 Liangdi Road in Yongning District, about 15 km south-east of central Nanning by road.

name: 南宁动物园
summaryEn: Nanning's city zoo, opened in April 1975 among about 37 hectares of subtropical gardens on University East Road in the north-west of the city. Around 30 exhibit areas house animals such as Asian elephants, gibbons, golden snub-nosed monkeys, tigers and lions, and staged animal shows, including a sea-lion show, are part of the programme, alongside two funfair areas with rides.
description: 南宁动物园位于广西南宁。游览特色包括动物观赏、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At 73 University East Road in Xixiangtang District, about 300 m from Nanning Zoo station on metro Line 1.

name: 弄拉
summaryEn: A hamlet in the karst peak-cluster hills of Guling town, Mashan County, whose villagers replanted the limestone hills around it after they were stripped of trees in the 1950s, and which is often cited as a model for reversing rocky desertification. The surrounding Nongla nature reserve protects limestone forest, and the scenic area has an exhibition hall on desertification control, a Buddhist temple and paths past oddly shaped peaks and rocks.
description: 弄拉位于广西南宁。游览特色包括沙漠、石林、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 100 km north of Nanning and 20–25 km from Mashan county town; there is no direct public transport, so come by car.

name: 蒲津公园
summaryEn: An open park laid out over three limestone hills, Jinzhen, Yinzhen and Gong'e, in the middle of Pumiao, the seat of Yongning District. It serves mainly as a place for residents' walks and exercise, and suits a short stroll for visitors passing through Pumiao.
description: 蒲津公园位于广西南宁。游览特色包括石灰岩景观。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: At 65 Pujin Road in Pumiao town, Yongning District, about 20 km south-east of central Nanning by road.

name: 秀美邕江·邕州古韵
summaryEn: A riverside scenic area of about 1.5 km² along the Yong River in central Nanning, from Yangguan Wharf to Lingtie Bridge, rated 4A in 2020, with sculptures on the city's history and legends, the Changyou Pavilion, arcades and remains of old city walls along the bank. Its core is the 'Ancient Yongzhou' evening cruise from Minsheng Wharf past the floodlit bridges and banks, with stories of Nanning's history told on board.
description: 秀美邕江·邕州古韵位于广西南宁。游览特色包括滨水景观、楼阁建筑、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Boats leave from Minsheng Wharf at the river end of Minsheng Road in central Nanning, about 1 km from Chaoyang Square metro station; since February 2026 a public water bus also runs from the same wharf.

name: 首创儿童乐园
summaryEn: A children's play park attached to the Shouchuang (Capital) Outlets mall on Kunlun Avenue in north-eastern Nanning, rated 4A in November 2023. Its main draw is a large playground of non-motorised play equipment, with other play, sports and learning activities for children, so it suits families with young children rather than adult travellers.
description: 南宁昆仑大道的儿童游乐空间邻近购物中心，主要面向家庭出游。
accessEn: At the Shouchuang Outlets on Kunlun Avenue in Xingning District, about 13 km north-east of central Nanning by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 水锦·顺庄
summaryEn: A canyon resort area in Leping village, Guling town, ringed by the Daming Mountains, where the Shuijin stream runs through a natural gorge about 10 km long with waterfalls, spring pools and cascades. Walkways lead through the gorge to attractions such as a glass bridge and slides, and the area also has a farming display zone and a themed resort hotel.
description: 水锦·顺庄位于广西南宁。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shuijin hamlet, Leping village, Guling town, about 28 km from Mashan county town and roughly 2 hours by road north of Nanning.

name: 五象湖公园
summaryEn: A 122-hectare park around five linked lakes in the Wuxiang New Area south of the Yong River, opened in August 2013 as the site of the third Guangxi Garden and Horticulture Expo. Paths lead past themed gardens on Guangxi's regions and Zhuang culture, and the park borders the Guangxi Planning Exhibition Hall and the Guangxi Art Museum.
description: 五象湖公园位于广西南宁。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观、主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Pingle Avenue in Liangqing District, about 900 m from Wuxiang Lake station on metro Line 3.

name: 香榭里南国温泉谷
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in the Jiahe City development on Kunlun Avenue in north-eastern Nanning, next to a golf course, also known as the Jiahe City Hot Spring Valley. Its main draw is a large complex of outdoor thermal pools, several themed on bathing traditions of different countries, together with a water park and on-site accommodation, and during the annual China–ASEAN Expo it has served as a reception venue for visiting delegations.
description: 香榭里南国温泉谷位于广西南宁。游览特色包括温泉、水上游乐、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At 995 Kunlun Avenue in Xingning District, about 13 km north-east of the Nanning International Convention and Exhibition Centre by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 小都百
summaryEn: A rural tourism village in Qiaolao village, Guling town, beside the Mashan–Shanglin road, rebuilt with white-walled, grey-tiled houses in local Zhuang style and known as the 'home of waterwheels' for the wheels along its streams. Visitors come for farm-stay meals and lodging, seasonal fruit and vegetable picking, flower fields, cycling and the waterwheel landscape, and it makes a stop on the way to Nongla.
description: 小都百位于广西南宁。游览特色包括田园观光、花卉观赏。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 10 km east of Mashan county town and 8 km from Guling town, beside the Mashan–Shanglin road.

name: 伊岭岩
summaryEn: A karst cave in Yiling village, Shuangqiao town, about 25 km north of central Nanning, whose Zhuang name means 'a cave as beautiful as a palace', with a 1,100 m route through 24,000 m² of chambers full of stalactites, stalagmites, columns and flowstone. Outside, a Zhuang culture garden displays old farm tools, stone implements and handwoven Zhuang clothing, alongside poem tablets by visitors such as Guo Moruo and a children's play area.
description: 伊岭岩位于广西南宁。游览特色包括洞穴、园林景观、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside the Nanning–Wuming city road about 25 km north of central Nanning, close to the Yilingyan exit of the Nanning–Hechi expressway.

name: 邕州古城
summaryEn: The old commercial heart of Nanning near the Yong River, centred on the Sanjie Liangxiang historic district of three old streets (Xingning, Minsheng and Jiefang roads) and two Ming–Qing lanes (Jinshi and Yinshi), whose history goes back to the Song dynasty. Restored and reopened as a pedestrian district in 2018, it has more than 20 protected buildings and sites, including the City God Temple, the Deng Yingchao Memorial Hall, the Xinhui and Lianghu guild halls and Republican-era arcaded shophouses, now filled with cafés, bookshops and snack stalls. Since 2025 it has been promoted together with the neighbouring Zhongshan Road food street and Shuijie as Yongzhou Old Town, and it is busiest in the evening.
description: 邕州古城位于广西南宁。游览特色包括古城、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xingning District in central Nanning, about 300 m from Chaoyang Square metro station.

name: 八寨沟
summaryEn: A forested valley on the northern flank of the Shiwan Mountains in Guitai town, where a spring-fed gorge of about 16 km runs through subtropical forest with streams, pools and waterfalls. Hiking and wading along the streams are the main draw.
description: 八寨沟位于广西钦州。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Guitai town, Qinbei district, about 53 km north-west of central Qinzhou, roughly 50 minutes by road.

name: 北部湾花卉公园
summaryEn: A flower park in Shabu town east of Qinzhou, with fields of cockscomb in autumn and spring plantings such as snapdragons, cosmos and strawflowers. It also hosts nature-study visits and floral-art activities.
description: 北部湾花卉公园位于广西钦州。游览特色包括花卉观赏、赏花。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shabu town, Qinnan district, about 12 km east of central Qinzhou by road.

name: 刘永福、冯子材旧居
summaryEn: The mansions of two Qing generals from the old Qinzhou region who fought the French in the Sino-French War, protected nationally since 2001 and rated 4A together in 2006. Liu Yongfu's Sanxuan Tang of 1891, in the old town, has 119 rooms behind 4 m walls, halls with gilded murals and woodcarving, and exhibitions on the war and his Black Flag Army. Feng Zicai's Gongbao Di of 1875, about 4 km north at Baishuitang, is a three-row, nine-building compound from which he set out for the 1885 victory at Zhennan Pass.
description: 刘永福、冯子材旧居位于广西钦州。游览特色包括壁画、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Liu Yongfu's residence is on Bangui Street in central Qinzhou; Feng Zicai's is about 4 km north in Baishuitang, Qinbei district, a short taxi ride.

name: 林湖森林公园
summaryEn: A provincial-level forest park on the southern edge of Qinbei district, about 3 km from central Qinzhou, laid out for walking among wooded hills and lakes. It is a popular suburban green space with nature-education and outdoor-activity areas, and was rated 4A in 2017.
description: 林湖森林公园位于广西钦州。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 3 km north of central Qinzhou, with National Road 325 along its eastern side; a short taxi or bus ride.

name: 六峰山
summaryEn: A wooded hill rising 182 m above the Mingke River in the centre of Lingshan town, named after its six peaks and admired as a beauty spot since the Song dynasty; it was rated 4A in 2017 and was a filming location for the TV series The Bad Kids. Paths climb past temples and Taoist halls such as the Beidi Temple, Guanyin Pavilion and Sanqing Palace, and Sanhai Cave on the west side holds more than 150 inscriptions carved over the centuries.
description: 六峰山位于广西钦州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、楼阁建筑、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Lingshan county town, about 98 km north-east of Qinzhou by road; the climb takes about 40 minutes.

name: 那雾山森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park of about 230 hectares on Nawu Mountain in Nali town, rated 4A in 2019, within a regional geopark. From the glass walkway and glass bridge near the summit visitors look out over seas of cloud, wind turbines and, on clear days, the Beibu Gulf.
description: 那雾山森林公园位于广西钦州。游览特色包括地质景观、森林公园。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Near Nawutang village, Nali town, about 40 km east of central Qinzhou by road.

name: 钦州园博园
summaryEn: A park of about 80 hectares in Qinzhou's eastern new town, built for the 9th Guangxi Garden Expo, which opened here on 2 December 2016 on the theme of coastal scenery and Nixing pottery. Fourteen gardens named after Guangxi's cities are spread among hills and water, with the Qinzhou garden at the centre, an ASEAN garden and a Nixing pottery museum, next to the Nixing pottery creative-industry park.
description: 钦州园博园位于广西钦州。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观、陶瓷工艺。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Jinhaiwan East Street in Qinnan district, about 7 km east of central Qinzhou by road.

name: 钦州老街
summaryEn: Qinzhou's historic district of qilou arcade buildings along Zhongshan Road and the neighbouring streets of the old town, a short walk from Liu Yongfu's former residence. Visitors come for snack stalls serving local dishes such as pig's-trotter rice noodles, the Qinzhou Bookstore and street performances of caicha opera, and in September 2026 the three-storey 33 Canal Bookstore opened in an arcade building on Renmin South Road.
description: 钦州老街位于广西钦州。游览特色包括运河、名人故居、历史街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the old town of central Qinzhou, Qinnan district, within walking distance of Liu Yongfu's former residence.

name: 神蜉酒庄园
summaryEn: An industrial-tourism site of about 11 hectares at the Shenfu liquor works on the northern edge of Pubei town, home of Shenfu jiu, a liquor made with ants that was already well known in the 1980s and whose making is listed as Qinzhou city-level intangible heritage. Opened in 2020 and rated 4A in 2021, it combines a liquor museum and old brick workshops with a water park, a Ferris wheel, an 'Ant Kingdom' play area and a greenway.
description: 神蜉酒庄园位于广西钦州。游览特色包括博物馆、水上游乐、绿道骑行。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Chengbei Road on the northern edge of Pubei county town, about 2 km from the county government.

name: 五皇山
summaryEn: A granite upland of about 40 km² around Longmen town, with nine main peaks averaging some 700 m and topped by Qingshanding at 778.8 m, known for fields of egg-shaped boulders, high meadows, tea gardens, terraces, streams and waterfalls. It is divided into the Rentoushi, Meizhuizhai and Shizhuling areas, and visitors come for sunrise, seas of cloud and the wind turbines on the ridges.
description: 五皇山位于广西钦州。游览特色包括瀑布、园林景观。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: Around Longmen town, about 32 km from Pubei county town and 135 km from Qinzhou by road.

name: 苍海湖·梧州园博园
summaryEn: A large landscaped lake in the new Canghai district on the south bank of the Xi River, built to hold back floodwater and now the centre of Canghai National Wetland Park, with gardens, paths and footbridges around the shore over about 215 ha. Within it the Wuzhou Garden Expo Park shows gardens in the styles of cities across Guangxi. It is a pleasant place for a walk, especially early in the morning or at sunset.
description: 苍海湖·梧州园博园位于广西梧州。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Longxu District on the south bank of the Xi River, about 10 km south-west of Wuzhou's old town by taxi or city bus.

name: 长坪水韵瑶寨
summaryEn: Changping village in the Changping Yao Ethnic Township, in forested mountains in the north-east of Mengshan County, where a spring-fed stream runs through a Yao village surrounded by woodland. It has been developed for rural tourism, with a wind-and-rain bridge, a heart-shaped peach-blossom island, wooden cabins and farm restaurants serving Yao dishes, and was named one of Guangxi's key rural-tourism villages in 2022. It suits a quiet countryside stay rather than a heritage visit.
description: 长坪水韵瑶寨位于广西梧州。游览特色包括岛屿、田园观光、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Changping Yao Ethnic Township, about 27 km north-east of Mengshan town by mountain road.

name: 东山文化公园
summaryEn: A hillside park on the edge of Cenxi city, laid out over a whole hill for exercise and recreation, with stone stairways, pavilions, a rock garden, a Confucius temple, a tea house and Dongshan Pavilion at the top. It is divided into themed sections on old customs, honest government, filial piety and Confucian learning. It is mainly a local park, worth a stroll if you are passing through Cenxi.
description: 东山文化公园位于广西梧州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、园林景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north side of Cenxi city off Beihuan Avenue; Cenxi is about 70 km south-west of Wuzhou by expressway.

name: 梁羽生公园
summaryEn: A hilltop park in the south-east of Mengshan town, formerly Aoshan Park, turned in 2005 into a park named after Liang Yusheng (Chen Wentong, 1924–2009), born in Mengshan County and, with Jin Yong and Gu Long, one of the best-known wuxia (martial-arts) novelists of the 20th century; Jin Yong wrote the name over the gate. Its landmark is the five-storey hexagonal Aoshan Pagoda, first built in 1762 and rebuilt in 1985, whose door couplet Liang wrote on a visit home in 1987. The small Yong'an Temple stands at the foot of the hill, and the view at sunset from the pagoda is one of Mengshan's traditional eight scenes.
description: 梁羽生公园位于广西梧州。游览特色包括古塔。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: On Tongwen Street in Mengshan town, a short walk from the Yong'an Royal City sites.

name: 岭南文化园
summaryEn: A large complex of new Ming-style buildings beside the Dragon Mother Temple, covering about 6 ha and rated 4A in 2024, themed on the office of the Viceroy of Liangguang, which the Ming court set up in Wuzhou in 1469 to govern Guangdong and Guangxi; the philosopher Wang Yangming later served here as viceroy. Inside are exhibition spaces on the culture of the Lingnan region, with bronze drums among the artefacts on show, and stages for folk performances. It is a modern reconstruction rather than a surviving building, and it is easily combined with a walk through the arcade quarter.
description: 岭南文化园位于广西梧州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Baihua Road in Wanxiu District, next to the Dragon Mother Temple at the north end of Wuzhou's old town; walkable from the arcade streets.

name: 玫瑰湖公园
summaryEn: A lakeside park in Longxin village on the western side of Wuzhou, facing Changzhou Island across the river, built around a lake that was created in 1976 when a levee turned low-lying fields into a fish farm. From 1992 the lake and Changzhou Island were developed together as a countryside recreation area, and it is now a city park crossed by Sanlong Avenue. It is mainly of interest to local walkers and families.
description: 玫瑰湖公园位于广西梧州。游览特色包括湖泊、岛屿、城市公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Changzhou District on Hongling Road, about 7 km west of the old town; city buses stop at the park.

name: 石表山
summaryEn: A red-sandstone (danxia) landscape in Xiangqi town in the south of Teng County, about 16 km² of red cliffs and peaks above a river with sandbanks, bamboo groves and the old village of Daojia. The scenic area includes rafting on the Siluo River, the Shibiao mountain stockade, the Shilong Canyon, Daojia village and a beach park.
description: 石表山位于广西梧州。游览特色包括峡谷、海滨。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Daojia village, Xiangqi town, about 40 km from Teng county town and about 90 km south-west of Wuzhou city by road.

name: 天龙顶山地公园
summaryEn: A mountain park in Nandu town in the south of Cenxi, around Tianlongding, at 1,211 m the highest peak in Wuzhou prefecture, known for its grassy summit meadows and for seas of cloud that form at a relatively low altitude. Trails lead past a mountain lake, streams and waterfalls, and the park caters for hiking, camping and mountain biking, with farm restaurants nearby.
description: 天龙顶山地公园位于广西梧州。游览特色包括瀑布、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Nandu town, about 30 km south-west of Cenxi city by road; a car or taxi from Cenxi is the practical way to get there.

name: 天书侠谷
summaryEn: A wooded gorge about 5 km east of Mengshan town, also called Yumengchong, winding for more than 10 km past clear pools and oddly shaped rocks. It takes its name from a huge character for 'heaven' at the mouth of the valley and a rock in a pool said to look like a book of heavenly scripts. Spots along the trail are themed on Liang Yusheng's martial-arts novels, such as Fairy Pool, Sword-Washing Pool and a 'Golden Sabre' stockade.
description: 天书侠谷位于广西梧州。游览特色包括峡谷、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 5 km east of Mengshan town by road, near Gantang village; taxi from Mengshan.

name: 都峤山
summaryEn: A red-sandstone (Danxia) mountain south-east of Rong County town, a Taoist retreat since the Han dynasty and counted as the 20th Taoist grotto-heaven. A cableway climbs to the North Grotto-Heaven and Suopo Rock, where calligraphy by Su Dongpo survives and a statue of him stands, and trails link temples, cliff caves and viewpoints; the Ming traveller Xu Xiake spent several days here and wrote a long account of it.
description: 都峤山位于广西玉林。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、砂岩地貌、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shizhai town about 10 km south-east of Rong County town by road.

name: 勾漏洞
summaryEn: Four linked limestone caves, Baogui, Yuque, Baisha and Taoyuan, about 1 km long in all, at the foot of Goulou Hill 3 km north-east of Beiliu; old Taoist texts list the site as the 22nd of the 36 grotto-heavens. The lit caves hold stalactites, columns and flowstone, the rock walls inside and out carry more than 120 inscriptions from the Tang dynasty on, and tradition says the Jin-dynasty alchemist Ge Hong sought the post of Goulou magistrate to practise here.
description: 勾漏洞位于广西玉林。游览特色包括洞穴、钟乳石、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 3 km north-east of central Beiliu, a short taxi ride.

name: 龟岭谷
summaryEn: A hillside eco-park in Shapo town whose main sight is a wall climbing the crest of Bazi Ridge, promoted as the 'little Great Wall of the south'. A 500 m elevated steel walkway with a bell platform links to the wall and looks over the Xiexian range, and there are zip lines, go-karts and a children's play area.
description: 龟岭谷位于广西玉林。游览特色包括长城。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Gaoqing village in Shapo town, about 10 km east of Luchuan county town.

name: 克拉湾水上乐园
summaryEn: An outdoor water park on the riverside Jiangbin East Road in Yulin, with a large wave pool, a water fortress and a lazy river. It is aimed at local families on hot summer days.
description: 克拉湾水上乐园位于广西玉林。游览特色包括城堡、水上游乐、滨水景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Jiangbin East Road in eastern Yulin city, a short taxi ride from the centre. Check that it is open before going.

name: 三环陶瓷小镇
summaryEn: An industrial and visitor complex built by Guangxi Sanhuan, one of China's leading makers of everyday porcelain, in Beiliu, a pottery centre since the Song dynasty. Its ceramics museum traces Chinese and local ceramics from early dynasties to the present, and the company's showroom displays the tableware it exports to more than 80 countries. It suits travellers with an interest in ceramics.
description: 三环陶瓷小镇位于广西玉林。游览特色包括博物馆、陶瓷工艺。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Min'an industrial park about 5 km east of central Beiliu.

name: 桂东南抗日武装起义旧址
summaryEn: A group of village sites in Chenghuang town linked to the armed uprising against Japanese forces launched here in March 1945. The centrepiece is the Zhensheng Building, a brick-and-timber house in mixed Chinese and Western style built in 1912–14, which served as headquarters of the county's anti-Japanese self-defence army; on nearby Gongyan Ridge some 2,000 fighters and villagers held a rally on 3 March 1945 to launch the uprising.
description: 桂东南抗日武装起义旧址位于广西玉林。游览特色包括历史旧址。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Chenghuang town in the south-west of Xingye County, about 40 km west of Yulin city.

name: 铜石岭
summaryEn: A hill resort on Tongshiling, east of Beiliu, where karst limestone and red Danxia sandstone cliffs occur side by side and where copper was smelted and bronze drums cast in the Han dynasty. A statue group of Zhao Tuo, the ancient king of Nanyue, stands before the gate tower, and a 10 km route of walkways, a glass skywalk and summit rides such as slides, grass and dry-snow sledging and go-karts climbs the hill. It suits families and active travellers more than heritage seekers.
description: 铜石岭位于广西玉林。游览特色包括楼阁建筑、喀斯特地貌、砂岩地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Min'an town about 10 km east of central Beiliu, with visitor centres at the south and north gates.

name: 五彩田园
summaryEn: A modern farming demonstration zone on the eastern edge of Yulin, laid out as a rural park with seasonal flower fields, lotus ponds and a cherry garden. Rapeseed blooms in early spring and lotus from mid-May into August draw local visitors for walks, photos and cycling.
description: 五彩田园位于广西玉林。游览特色包括花卉观赏、园林景观、农业体验。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Maolin town about 14 km east of central Yulin.

name: 云天文化城
summaryEn: A large palace-style building complex on Jiangbin Road in Yulin, opened as a cultural attraction with halls of sculpture, a folk-culture museum and displays of collected treasures. Many visitors come mainly for the imposing exterior, and the forecourt hosts lion dances and martial-arts shows at festivals such as New Year.
description: 云天文化城位于广西玉林。游览特色包括博物馆、雕塑艺术、节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Jiangbin Road in the west of Yulin city, a short taxi ride from the centre. Check that it is open before going.

name: 神玉岛文化旅游区
summaryEn: A lakeside leisure area on the Maozhen Reservoir in the hills of Xiangshui town, built around a jade-culture theme and named after an island in the lake. Visitors can take a boat on the lake and see a jade art gallery and a rainforest-ecology exhibition hall, and the lakeside hotel runs forest-wellness sessions for its guests. It suits a short leisure visit.
description: 神玉岛文化旅游区位于海南保亭。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the Maozhen Reservoir in Xiangshui town, about 13 km west of Baocheng, the Baoting county seat.

name: 福山咖啡文化风情镇
summaryEn: A tourist town built around the coffee of Fushan, where coffee has been grown since the 1930s and whose beans hold national geographical-indication status. Its first phase has a large coffee square and some 19 local and international coffee brands, among them houses presenting the coffees of Vietnam, Turkey and Ethiopia, along with the town's own coffee academy, a lawn market and a snack street. It holds coffee festivals and stage performances through the year and became a 4A scenic area in 2025.
description: 福山咖啡文化风情镇位于海南澄迈。游览特色包括书院文化、节庆文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Fushan town, about 17 km north-north-west of Jinjiang, the Chengmai county seat.

name: 石花水洞地质公园
summaryEn: A karst geopark at Yaxing in western Danzhou, built around a limestone cave that visitors tour partly on foot and partly by small boat, with a stone forest above ground. The cave holds stalactites and other limestone formations, and the park also runs study programmes for school groups.
description: 石花水洞地质公园位于海南儋州。游览特色包括石林、洞穴、地质景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At the Bayi farm area near Yaxing, about 31 km west-south-west of Nada, the Danzhou city seat.

name: 母瑞山革命根据地
summaryEn: A mountain base area of the Communist-led Qiongya forces, which held out on Murui Mountain in 1928 and again in 1932. The memorial park, completed on 1 August 1996 and named a national patriotic education base in 2001, displays historical material and objects from the Hainan revolutionary struggle. About ten sites of the period have been rebuilt, including a Red Army cooperative, a sewing group and a transport office.
description: 母瑞山革命根据地位于海南定安。游览特色包括历史纪念。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Zhongrui farm in Hanlin town, in the far south of Ding'an county, about 49 km south of Dingcheng, the county seat.

name: 文笔峰
summaryEn: A Taoist and Pangu-legend complex of about 1,200 mu at the foot of Wenbi Peak near Nanli Lake, built in Southern Song style around the Yuchan Palace, a group of Taoist halls and shrines. In local legend the peak is Pangu's nose, and paths lead past lotus ponds and a bell and drum tower to a rock known as the dragon head and tortoise back and to a Pangu cave. The park also serves vegetarian meals and has a wellness-retreat centre.
description: 文笔峰位于海南定安。游览特色包括湖泊、楼阁建筑、洞穴。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Longhu town, near Nanli Lake and about 14 km south of Dingcheng, the Ding'an county seat; the eastern expressway exit at Juding is the nearest.

name: 娥仙岭
summaryEn: A forested limestone massif in Donghe town on the shore of the Daguangba reservoir, whose main peak, E'niang Jiufeng, rises above 1,200 metres and is covered in rainforest on karst. Boats run on the reservoir among karst hills, and a climb of about an hour leads to E'niang Cave, where roughly 800 metres of route among stalactites and stalagmites are open. The area also includes a Li and Miao village, and it was rated 4A in 2024.
description: 娥仙岭位于海南东方。游览特色包括水库、林地风光、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Donghe town, about 39 km east-south-east of Basuo, the Dongfang city seat, on the Daguangba reservoir.

name: 花梨谷
summaryEn: A leisure park themed on Hainan's huanghuali rosewood, with a plantation of more than a million trees, flower fields, a picking garden, a visitor centre, a rosewood museum, caravan and star-gazing cabins, and a hot-spring resort. It combines forestry and tourism and focuses on forest wellbeing and hot-spring holidays. It became Dongfang's first 4A scenic area in November 2022.
description: 花梨谷位于海南东方。游览特色包括博物馆、花卉观赏、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Banqiao area, about 41 km south-south-east of Basuo, the Dongfang city seat, off the G98 expressway and about 10 km from Jinyuewan railway station.

name: 海南热带野生动植物园
summaryEn: A zoo set in about 1,500 mu of planted tropical forest in the hills south of Haikou, opened in 1996, with a drive-through area and a walking area. Animals on show have included giant pandas, an Asian elephant, brown bears and takin. It was badly damaged by Typhoon Yagi in September 2024 and reopened within a month.
description: 海南热带野生动植物园位于海南海口。游览特色包括植物园、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dongshan town, Xiuying district, about 31 km south of Haikou.

name: 海南海洋欢乐世界
summaryEn: A marine-life theme park resort at Li'an, opened in December 2021 as R&F Ocean Paradise, covering about 2,000 mu (roughly 130 hectares) in five themed zones. It combines dozens of rides with animal halls and aquariums of South China Sea species, sea-lion and mermaid-themed shows, a polar animal hall with polar bears, belugas and penguins (opened in July 2024) and a separate water park (opened in April 2025). It suits families with children.
description: 海南海洋欢乐世界位于海南陵水。游览特色包括主题游乐、水族展览、水上游乐。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: At Li'an, about 7 km south-south-east of Yelin, the Lingshui county seat.

name: 清水湾
summaryEn: A beach-resort district on Lingshui's coast with about 12 km of shoreline, fine sand and clear water. Its sights include the Freedom Lighthouse, a red-and-white landmark tower used as a film location, a sea-viewing platform and a stretch of beach known for its 'singing sand', and it has several resort hotels. It was named a provincial tourist resort in 2021.
description: 清水湾位于海南陵水。游览特色包括海滨、海岸风光、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the coast near Yingzhou town, close to the Yingzhou exit of the eastern round-island expressway and about 21 km south-west of Yelin, the Lingshui county seat.

name: 白石岭
summaryEn: A hilly area beside the Wanquan River covering 16.24 square kilometres, made up of four linked ridges with peaks, valleys, lakes and forest of about 90 percent cover, the highest point reaching 328 metres. An aerial cableway opened in 1995, and glass walkways, a via ferrata and a camping area have been added since.
description: 白石岭位于海南琼海。游览特色包括玻璃栈道、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 13 km south-west of Jiaji, the Qionghai city seat, on the Wanquan River.

name: 博鳌亚洲论坛永久会址
summaryEn: The permanent conference site of the Boao Forum for Asia, on Dongyu Island where the Wanquan River meets the sea. The grounds hold the forum's conference halls and hotels beside the water, with a globe sculpture in front of the main venue and a waterfront promenade. The forum's annual meeting takes place here each spring.
description: 博鳌亚洲论坛永久会址位于海南琼海。游览特色包括岛屿、雕塑艺术、历史旧址。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Dongyu Island in Boao town, about 17 km south-east of Jiaji, the Qionghai city seat; Boao has its own railway station.

name: 世界热带水果之窗
summaryEn: A tropical-fruit park in Dalu town that grows and displays some 680 fruit varieties introduced from Latin America, Australia and South-East Asia, with science-education displays alongside the orchards. Visitors can also see seasonal shows and themed photo sets, and the park was rated 4A in 2024. It suits families with children.
description: 世界热带水果之窗位于海南琼海。游览特色包括果园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Huzai village, Dalu town, about 10 km north-north-west of Jiaji, the Qionghai city seat.

name: 百花岭
summaryEn: A forested hill area in Hainan's central highlands, opened to visitors in 2019, with a tree-top boardwalk, tree houses, a swinging bridge over water, a glass slide and a 2 km rainforest slide, along with Baihua Waterfall, which drops more than 300 m in all. It lies next to the northern gate of the Hainan Tropical Rainforest National Park, and Li and Miao folk song and dance are among the activities it offers.
description: 百花岭位于海南琼中。游览特色包括瀑布、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 4 km south-west of Yinggen, the Qiongzhong county seat, close to the G224 road.

name: 三亚红色娘子军演艺公园
summaryEn: A show-centred theme park in Tianya district, laid out in three zones named Red Memory, Red Sanya and Sea of Stars. Its main production is the open-air show Red Detachment of Women, which uses dance, martial arts and Li and Miao elements to retell the 1930s story of the women's company of the Communist-led Red Army on Hainan. The park also has a musical-fountain plaza, a Silk Road crafts centre and a children's playground.
description: 三亚红色娘子军演艺公园位于海南三亚。游览特色包括主题游乐。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Sanya Bay subdistrict, Tianya district, about 10 km north-north-west of central Sanya.

name: 西岛
summaryEn: A small island off Sanya's western coast, the offshore island nearest to the city, with a working fishing village of old coral-stone houses whose history goes back more than 400 years. Visitors can walk the lanes, where nets are hung out to dry, and stay overnight in homestays once the day-trippers have left.
description: 西岛位于海南三亚。游览特色包括岛屿。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The island lies about 15 km west of central Sanya; boats leave from Xiaoqi Port in Tianya district and the crossing takes 15–20 minutes.

name: 亚龙湾热带天堂森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park on the hills behind Yalong Bay, set in dense tropical forest. Its best-known feature is the Guojianglong suspension bridge, 168 m long and hung nearly 40 m above the valley, which appeared in the film If You Are the One 2 and in later television dramas. It suits visitors who want a forest walk close to the Yalong Bay beach resorts.
description: 亚龙湾热带天堂森林公园位于海南三亚。游览特色包括森林公园、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills behind Yalong Bay, about 14 km east of central Sanya and about 5 km north-north-west of the beach.

name: 梦幻香山
summaryEn: A fragrance-themed garden park of more than 600 mu (about 40 hectares) in the hills beside the central expressway, with over a hundred kinds of scented flowers and herbs, about 400 mu of lemon orchard and some 10,000 agarwood trees, more than half of them nearly 30 years old. It also has a fragrance museum and a hotel, and runs seasonal flower displays and sachet-making and fruit-picking activities. It suits families and photographers.
description: 梦幻香山位于海南屯昌。游览特色包括博物馆、果园、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside the central expressway, about 6.5 km west-south-west of Tuncheng, the Tunchang county seat.

name: 兴隆热带植物园
summaryEn: A botanical garden founded in 1957 and open to visitors since 1997, run by the Spice and Beverage Research Institute of the Chinese Academy of Tropical Agricultural Sciences. It holds more than 3,200 tropical and subtropical plant species, with collections of coffee, pepper, vanilla and cocoa, and rainforest features such as buttress roots and flowers borne directly on trunks. It sits in Xinglong, an overseas-Chinese settlement known for its coffee.
description: 兴隆热带植物园位于海南万宁。游览特色包括植物园、园林景观、书院文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xinglong, about 22 km west-south-west of Wancheng, the Wanning city seat.

name: 椰子大观园
summaryEn: A coconut-themed park of 443 mu (about 30 hectares) that grew out of a palm germplasm collection of the Coconut Research Institute and has been open to visitors since 1980. It grows 217 palm species and 130 rare tree species among coconut groves, and has a coconut science museum, a coconut-grove maze, a petting area and an adventure camp. It suits families with children and school groups.
description: 椰子大观园位于海南文昌。游览特色包括博物馆、科学科普。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Wenqing Avenue in Wenchang, close to the city government.

name: 铜鼓岭
summaryEn: A coastal ridge at the north-eastern tip of Hainan, surrounded by sea on three sides, with 18 linked peaks and a main summit of 338 metres. Its slopes carry a coastal tropical evergreen monsoon forest with 1,019 recorded plant species, 12 of them rare or endangered, as well as boulders, beaches, a river and a lake within the area. A path climbs to the summit, which is a popular place to watch the sunrise.
description: 铜鼓岭位于海南文昌。游览特色包括湖泊、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Longlou town, about 27 km east-north-east of Wenchang.

name: 五指山红峡谷
summaryEn: A rainforest gorge in Nansheng town developed for visitors from 2015, with a 3.8 km rafting run through the canyon and a 3.8 km boardwalk along its banks. Other attractions include a double suspension bridge (one deck glass, one timber) about 40 m above the water, a glass slide and a Li and Miao restaurant.
description: 五指山红峡谷位于海南五指山。游览特色包括峡谷、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Nansheng town, about 14 km east of Tongshi, the Wuzhishan city seat.

name: 五指山革命根据地纪念园
summaryEn: A memorial park built from 2001 on the site of the Qiongya Column's headquarters in Maogui village, the last base of the Communist-led armed struggle on Hainan before 1950. A 23 m monument stands above the plaza, with a martyrs' cemetery nearby, and a history hall of 2,558 square metres covers 1939–50 in seven sections: the Baisha uprising, the creation of the Wuzhishan central base, the three offensives of 1948–49 and the changes in the Li and Miao autonomous areas after 1950.
description: 五指山革命根据地纪念园位于海南五指山。游览特色包括历史纪念。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Maoyang town, about 18 km north-north-west of Tongshi, the Wuzhishan city seat; closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 安居古城
summaryEn: Anju sits where the Qiong River joins the Fu River, 17 km north of Tongliang, and was once an important distribution centre for goods on the upper Yangtze. Its hillside old town of stone-flagged lanes is run as a scenic area with a recently rebuilt Confucian temple and county yamen, and in 2022 it was named a national intangible-cultural-heritage tourism area; dragon-boat races are held on the river.
description: 安居古城位于重庆。游览特色包括古城、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Anju town, 17 km north of Tongliang and about 60 km from central Chongqing, roughly 1.5 hours by road.

name: 安陶小镇
summaryEn: A pottery-themed tourist area in Anfu Subdistrict built around Rongchang pottery, a craft listed as national intangible cultural heritage, linking the Rongchang Pottery Museum, the old Taobao post road and craft-experience sites. Holiday events have included markets, street performances and hands-on crafts such as sugar-figure making and opera-mask painting.
description: 安陶小镇位于重庆。游览特色包括博物馆、非遗文化、陶瓷工艺。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Anfu Subdistrict, Rongchang District, about 12 km west of the district centre.

name: 白公祠
summaryEn: A memorial temple to the Tang poet Bai Juyi, who served as prefect of Zhongzhou, first built in 1630 and rebuilt in 1986, now a museum park in the Zhong County town. Since 2003 its grounds have held two Eastern Han stone pillar-gates (que), the Dingfang Que and the Uninscribed Que, moved from sites flooded by the Three Gorges reservoir; the taller tower of the Dingfang pair stands 6.26 m high. Holograms and multimedia displays present the county's relics in the halls.
description: 白公祠位于重庆。游览特色包括博物馆、峡谷、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Baigong Road in Baigong Subdistrict of the Zhong County town, Zhong County.

name: 百里竹海观音洞
summaryEn: Part of the Baili Bamboo Sea, about 230 km² of continuous bamboo forest in the valleys between a dozen peaks over 1,000 m on Mingyue Mountain, on Liangping's border with Sichuan. The rated area is the Guanyin Cave section at Zhengzhi village in Zhushan town, and nearby villages such as Lieshen have turned former gypsum-mining land into guesthouses for summer stays.
description: 百里竹海观音洞位于重庆。游览特色包括林地风光、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhushan town on Mingyue Mountain, west of the Liangping district town, roughly an hour by road.

name: 贝迪颐园温泉度假区
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort with bathing pools in landscaped grounds at Baishiyi, in Chongqing's western suburbs. It is a place for a relaxing soak rather than sightseeing.
description: 贝迪颐园温泉度假区位于重庆。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Nongke Avenue in Baishiyi town, Jiulongpo District (Chongqing High-tech Zone), about 30 km west of central Chongqing by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 茶山竹海
summaryEn: A national forest park on the hills just north of Yongchuan town, where tea plantations give way to large stands of bamboo crossed by walking trails. Baodaoling ridge, the highest point in western Chongqing, is the place for sunrise and seas of cloud, Baoji Temple stands in the forest, and an activity area offers a summer toboggan and slides, with a campsite added in 2024.
description: 茶山竹海位于重庆。游览特色包括茶园、寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the hills immediately north of central Yongchuan, in Yongchuan District, about an hour by road from central Chongqing.

name: 陈抟故里
summaryEn: Farmland around Chongkan town, one of the places claimed as the birthplace of the 10th-century Daoist sage Chen Tuan, where the rapeseed fields along the Qiong River turn yellow every March and a taiji (yin-yang) pattern about 236 m across has been planted in the core area. Visitors tour the flowers on foot, by boat, by small sightseeing train and by sightseeing cable car, and a Taiji town built in traditional style has a statue of Chen Tuan, an exhibition hall and temple buildings.
description: 陈抟故里位于重庆。游览特色包括油菜花田、名人故居、缆车观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Chongkan town in western Tongnan District, about 30 km by road from central Tongnan, roughly 2 hours by road from central Chongqing.

name: 蚩尤九黎城
summaryEn: A large hillside complex of Miao-style buildings on the edge of Pengshui town, rated 4A in 2016, with stilt houses, the Jiuli Palace and a ceremonial square, built around the Miao legends of Chiyou and the ancient Jiuli people. By day visitors climb through the complex for the views, and in the evenings it opens for night visits with light shows on Miao themes.
description: 彭水城边山坡上的苗族风格建筑群包含吊脚楼、九黎宫等游览空间。
accessEn: In Dianshui Subdistrict on the edge of Pengshui town, Pengshui County; tourist buses run from Pengshui West station on the Chongqing–Xiamen high-speed railway, and the drive from central Chongqing takes about 3 hours.

name: 重庆保税体验旅游景区
summaryEn: A shopping and exhibition zone inside the Lianglu–Cuntan bonded port area of Liangjiang New Area, run by the port's operating company, where imported goods are displayed and sold at a bonded commodity trading centre. It is of interest mainly to shoppers looking for imported products.
description: 景区位于两路寸滩保税港区，是依托港区形成的购物与贸易展示空间。
accessEn: On Haier Road in the Cuntan bonded port area, Jiangbei District (Liangjiang New Area), about 30 minutes by taxi from Jiefangbei. Check that it is open before going.

name: 重庆工业文化博览园
summaryEn: An industrial heritage park on the old Chongqing Iron and Steel works at Dadukou, opened in 2019 after the steelworks moved out to Changshou.
