Its museum tells the story of Chongqing industry from the opening of the port in 1891 to the present, centred on a British-built 8,000-horsepower twin-cylinder steam engine of 1905, with locally made machinery, vehicles and motorcycles. Old chimneys and other relics of the plant are kept in the grounds as landscape features.
description: 重庆工业文化博览园位于重庆。游览特色包括博物馆、工业参观、工业遗产。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At 999 Yidu Road in Dadukou District, about 15 km south-west of Jiefangbei by road. Closed on Mondays.

name: 重庆际华园
summaryEn: A large sports and leisure complex in Longxing, announced in 2016 as an extreme-sports centre, whose facilities include an indoor ski slope. It runs family activities on public holidays and lies next to the Liangjiang film set, so the two are easily combined.
description: 重庆际华园位于重庆。游览特色包括运动休闲、影视拍摄。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Longxing town, Yubei District (Liangjiang New Area), about an hour by road east of central Chongqing.

name: 大风堡
summaryEn: The core forest area of Huangshui National Forest Park, which reaches 1,934 m, with dense old woodland and more than 20 marked sights along its trails. Summer temperatures far below those of Chongqing make it a popular hiking and summer-escape spot, often combined with Sun Lake next door.
description: 大风堡位于重庆。游览特色包括森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Huangshui town, Shizhu Tujia Autonomous County, about 1.5 hours by road from Shizhu county town.

name: 大木花谷
summaryEn: A flower park on the slopes above Damu, a mountain town at about 1,000 m in south-eastern Fuling that fills with visitors escaping the summer heat. Seasonal flowers are planted on terraces, around a lake and along forest paths, and in summer 2026 the park held its first lantern festival with large light displays among the flower beds.
description: 大木花谷位于重庆。游览特色包括湖泊、花卉观赏、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 1 km above Damu town on Huagu Avenue, in Fuling District, roughly 1.5 hours by road from central Fuling.

name: 弹子石老街
summaryEn: Danzishi grew from the early 19th century around one of the ferry landings on the Yangtze's south bank, opposite the Chaotianmen confluence, and keeps older buildings such as the French Naval Barracks of 1902 and the Wang family compound. The hillside has since been redeveloped as a stepped quarter of shops, bars and restaurants in old-street style that looks across the river to the Yuzhong peninsula. The restored barracks belong to a national heritage group of former Allied diplomatic and military premises from Chongqing's years as wartime capital.
description: 弹子石老街位于重庆。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、草原。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On the Nanbin Road riverfront in Nan'an District, a short walk from Danzishi station on the Metro Loop Line.

name: 叠石花谷
summaryEn: A landscaped valley south of Youyang county town beside the G65 expressway, where the scenic area doubles as an open motorway service area. It is built around outcrops of stromatolite, layered rock dating from the Cambrian period about half a billion years ago, with named rock features themed on local Nuo masked-ritual culture, such as a circle of pillars for the twelve month-gods. Seasonal flower fields, including pink muhly grass in autumn, and a zip line complete the visit.
description: 叠石花谷位于重庆。游览特色包括山谷、花卉观赏。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: A short drive south of Youyang county town on the G65 Chongqing–Hunan expressway.

name: 秀山凤凰山
summaryEn: A hill park at about 600 m on the eastern edge of the Xiushan county town, developed as a showcase for the Xiushan flower-lantern song and dance, a national intangible-heritage tradition. It joins the Fenghuang Mountain forest park and its old temples, a Lingguan hall built in the early Yuan and Chuandeng Temple of 1575, with a lantern gallery, a lantern food street and evening light shows.
description: 秀山凤凰山位于重庆。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the eastern edge of the Xiushan county town in the far south-east of Chongqing, near the borders with Guizhou and Hunan.

name: 丰盛古镇
summaryEn: Fengsheng, in the hills of eastern Ba'nan, grew as an overland trading post, is nicknamed the 'first dry port on the Yangtze' and is listed among China's historic and cultural towns. Its old quarter keeps fortified watchtowers in the local Sichuan–Chongqing style, streets laid out in a nested-square plan and Ziyun 'ringing stones' that chime when struck, and the town is being developed as a showcase of old commercial culture.
description: 丰盛古镇位于重庆。游览特色包括古镇、历史街区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Fengsheng town, eastern Ba'nan District, roughly an hour by road east of central Chongqing.

name: 观音桥商圈
summaryEn: One of central Chongqing's main shopping districts, centred on a pedestrian street and plaza in Jiangbei north of the Jialing River. Department stores, malls and restaurants surround it, making it one of the city's busiest places for shopping and eating out.
description: 观音桥商圈位于重庆。游览特色包括特色街区、购物街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside Guanyinqiao metro interchange station in Jiangbei District, about 15–20 minutes by metro from Jiefangbei.

name: 观音塘湿地公园
summaryEn: An urban wetland park in central Bishan, built in the 2010s as one of the district's main city parks during a programme of river clean-up and new green spaces. Its waterside paths make it a quiet place for a stroll.
description: 观音塘湿地公园位于重庆。游览特色包括湿地、城市公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Biquan subdistrict, central Bishan District, about 40 minutes by road from central Chongqing.

name: 归原小镇
summaryEn: A rural tourism project in Jingzhu village on the Fairy Mountain plateau, where old farmhouses have been restored and joined by new buildings of rammed earth, glass and steel, among them a village library with a café and a cluster of boutique guesthouses. The village, at 800–1,300 m among karst hills, was named one of UN Tourism's Best Tourism Villages in 2022 and also has fruit-picking farms.
description: 归原小镇位于重庆。游览特色包括田园观光、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jingzhu village, Xiannüshan Subdistrict, Wulong District, under an hour by road from Wulong town; Wulong South station, on the Chongqing–Xiamen high-speed railway since 2025, serves Wulong town.

name: 古剑山
summaryEn: A forested mountain near Qijiang town, counted among the 'New Twelve Views of Bayu', where visitors climb for sunrise and seas of cloud from the summit. Jingyin Temple, a working Buddhist temple, stands near the top, and campsites and holiday lodgings at the foot make it a weekend retreat.
description: 古剑山位于重庆。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、林地风光、登山观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 10 km from Qijiang town, roughly 1.5 hours by road south of central Chongqing.

name: 加勒比海水世界
summaryEn: An outdoor water park on Nanshan, the ridge above the south bank of the Yangtze, run by the Haichang group, with water slides, a children's splash area and a wave pool. It opens only in the summer season, usually from mid-May, and suits families looking for a break from Chongqing's summer heat.
description: 加勒比海水世界位于重庆。游览特色包括水上游乐。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Nanshan in Nan'an District, about 30 minutes by taxi from Jiefangbei. Check that it is open before going.

name: 海兰云天温泉度假区
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort around Hailan Lake in Chongqing's western suburbs, combining outdoor and indoor spring pools with a lakeside hotel, boating and hillside walks over roughly 100 hectares. It is a family weekend retreat rather than a sightseeing destination.
description: 海兰云天温泉度假区位于重庆。游览特色包括温泉、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: By Hailan Lake in Jinfeng town, Jiulongpo District (Chongqing High-tech Zone), about 30 km west of central Chongqing through the Zhongliang Mountain tunnels. Check that it is open before going.

name: 汉海海洋公园
summaryEn: A large aquarium and marine park at Longzhouwan in Ba'nan, with a 360-degree coral-reef tank, a shark hall, an underwater tunnel, a penguin house and the Aegean Theatre for staged shows. It suits families, and a Hanhai-branded whale-and-dolphin water park lies nearby.
description: 汉海海洋公园位于重庆。游览特色包括水族展览、水上游乐、海岸风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Jialong Road at Longzhouwan, Ba'nan District, about 1 km from Xuetangwan station on Line 3, or roughly 40 minutes by taxi from central Chongqing.

name: 重庆欢乐谷
summaryEn: A large theme park opened in July 2017 as the seventh in the Happy Valley chain of the Overseas Chinese Town group, with roller coasters including a wooden coaster and a wing coaster, family rides and stage shows. In summer its Maya Beach water park adds a wave pool and water slides, and it suits families and thrill-ride fans looking for a full day out.
description: 重庆欢乐谷位于重庆。游览特色包括主题游乐、海滨。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Lijia, Yubei District (Liangjiang New Area), about 15 km north of central Chongqing, beside Huanlegu station on the metro's Guobo line.

name: 洪安边城
summaryEn: An old river town where Chongqing, Guizhou and Hunan meet, about 47 km south-east of the Xiushan county town, said to be the model for the setting of Shen Congwen's novella Border Town (Biancheng). Its sights include a pavilion where 'a cock's crow is heard in three provinces' and a monument to the Second Field Army's 1949 advance into the south-west, and a long-running immersive show, Meeting Biancheng, stages Tujia wedding customs around the town; a newer resort quarter nearby adds evening shows.
description: 洪安边城位于重庆。游览特色包括楼阁建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Hong'an town, about 47 km south-east of the Xiushan county town by road; central Chongqing is about four hours away by road.

name: 皇华城
summaryEn: An island in the Yangtze that held a walled city of the late Southern Song, the seat of Xianchun Prefecture, and one of the best-preserved Song and Yuan town sites in the reservoir area. Excavations since 2016 have traced its gates, walls, government offices, an academy and workshops, now shown on site and in a display centre opened in May 2026, while the rest of the island is a national wetland park.
description: 皇华城位于重庆。游览特色包括古城、湿地、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On an island in the Yangtze about 6 km downstream of the Zhong County town, Zhong County; it opened to visitors in October 2023.

name: 滑石古寨
summaryEn: A fortified hamlet on top of a steep, isolated peak in Huashi village, near Shuanggui Temple, used as a military stronghold in the Ming and Qing periods, which keeps old watchtowers, gateways and a stone hall. It is now run as a scenic area with viewing terraces and a gallery of local crafts, alongside added attractions such as a long two-stage dry slide and a glass bridge.
description: 滑石古寨位于重庆。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、玻璃栈道、历史纪念。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Huashi village in Jindai Subdistrict, about 12 km south-west of the Liangping district town and a few kilometres from Shuanggui Temple.

name: 花田梯田
summaryEn: Rice terraces step down the hillsides around Hejiayan village in Huatian township, at an average altitude of about 800 m, and have been farmed for more than 400 years. Restored from 2012, the roughly 8,000 mu (about 530 ha) of terraces now grow organic 'Huatian tribute rice' and turn gold before the autumn harvest.
description: 花田梯田位于重庆。游览特色包括梯田、花卉观赏。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Huatian township north-west of Youyang county town, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 会龙庄
summaryEn: A large fortified manor at Shuangfeng village on the northern edge of the Simian Mountain area, regarded as one of the finest historic estates in south-west China. Its stone-and-timber courtyard buildings cover more than 2 ha and stand on 328 stone pillars beside a 38 m watchtower; who built it and when has not been established. It is usually combined with a visit to Simian Mountain or Zhongshan Ancient Town.
description: 会龙庄位于重庆。游览特色包括古镇。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Shuangfeng village in Simianshan town, southern Jiangjin District, about half an hour by road from the Simian Mountain scenic area.

name: 金鳌田园
summaryEn: A rural leisure area on Jin'ao Mountain in Tiaodeng town, at the southern tip of Dadukou facing the Yangtze, among the nearest countryside to central Chongqing. Coloured terraced fields, farm restaurants and guesthouses spread over the hill, which rises to 495 m, and the area was rated 4A in 2024.
description: 金鳌田园位于重庆。游览特色包括田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Around Shipan village in Tiaodeng town, Dadukou District, about 30 minutes by road from central Chongqing.

name: 金刀峡
summaryEn: A limestone gorge about 10 km long on the south-western slopes of the Huaying Mountains in north-eastern Beibei, where a stream has cut along a fault into a deep, narrow canyon of potholes and clear pools. Sights along the route include waterfalls, caves and a slot section called the 'thread of sky', and the steep fall of the stream has made the gorge a place for canyoning.
description: 金刀峡位于重庆。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Jindaoxia town in north-eastern Beibei District, about 60 km by road from central Beibei and 90 km from central Chongqing.

name: 九重天
summaryEn: A clifftop attraction at over 1,000 m in Lianhuadong village in the hills of Shuanglu, built from 2015 and opened in 2017. Its main features are a glass-floored bridge about 280 m long over a sheer drop, a glass cliff walkway of about 3.5 km and thrill rides such as cliff swings, and it draws summer visitors to the cool mountain air.
description: 九重天位于重庆。游览特色包括栈道。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Lianhuadong village, Shuanglu, in the mountains of Fengdu County, a drive of under an hour from the Fengdu county town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 恺之峰
summaryEn: A hillside peony park at Mudan village in Taiping town, on the Mingyue Mountains, the centre of Dianjiang's long tradition of peony growing, where many varieties bloom in April and May. It is named after the 4th-century painter Gu Kaizhi, who according to local legend saw Dianjiang's peonies, and has a petal-shaped glass viewing platform.
description: 恺之峰位于重庆。游览特色包括民间传说、观景台。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Mudan village in Taiping town, about 10 km south-west of Dianjiang town in Dianjiang County, roughly 2 hours by road from central Chongqing.

name: 兰英大峡谷
summaryEn: A deep canyon near Lanying township in eastern Wuxi, promoted locally as one of the deepest gorges in Asia. Its best-known sight is the Lanying 'sky road', a narrow road cut into the cliffs high above the gorge, which has become a popular drive and photo stop.
description: 兰英大峡谷位于重庆。游览特色包括峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Lanying township in eastern Wuxi County, roughly an hour by road from Wuxi county town, which is about an hour by road from Fengjie station on the Zhengzhou–Chongqing high-speed railway.

name: 乐和乐都
summaryEn: An animal-themed park on the edge of Yongchuan with a large zoo where giant and red pandas, chimpanzees, elephants, giraffes, lions and tigers can be seen. It adds a children's play area, evening events and staged animal shows, is aimed at families and gets very busy on public holidays.
description: 乐和乐都位于重庆。游览特色包括动物观赏。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: On Fenglong Road on the southern edge of Yongchuan town, Yongchuan District, about an hour by road west of central Chongqing.

name: 鎏嘉码头
summaryEn: A riverside leisure complex on the Beibin Road waterfront in Jiangbei, with restaurants, bars and riverside entertainment by the Jialing River. Jiangbei District promoted it in 2021 as its second municipal-level night-market street after the Jiujie bar district, and it is mainly a place for dinner and drinks by the river.
description: 鎏嘉码头位于重庆。游览特色包括滨水景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Beibin 1st Road along the north bank of the Jialing River in Jiangbei District, a short walk from Liujiatai station on Metro Line 9. Check that it is open before going.

name: 龙桥河
summaryEn: A karst river valley in Longqiao Tujia Township where a stream fed by an underground river system about 50 km long flows for some 3.7 km at the surface, passing beneath a large natural rock bridge that spans the canyon. The valley lies at about 1,500 m among densely forested mountains.
description: 龙桥河位于重庆。游览特色包括峡谷、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Longqiao Tujia Township in southern Fengjie County, about 80 km by road from the county town and 20 km beyond Xinglong Town.

name: 龙水峡地缝
summaryEn: A deep, narrow slot canyon cut into the limestone south of the Three Natural Bridges, inside the same Wulong Karst World Heritage area. A lift takes visitors down into the fissure.
description: 龙水峡地缝位于重庆。游览特色包括峡谷、喀斯特地貌、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xiannüshan Subdistrict, Wulong District, about 4 km south of the Three Natural Bridges, reached by shuttle bus from the Fairy Mountain tourist centre or the Three Natural Bridges exit.

name: 龙潭古镇
summaryEn: Longtan, the main town of eastern Youyang, is a listed Chinese Historical and Cultural Town whose old streets are run as a scenic area. Its best-known building is the childhood home of Zhao Shiyan (1901–1927), an early Chinese Communist leader who co-founded the Chinese Youth Communist Party in France with Zhou Enlai and was executed in Shanghai in 1927; the house is a national heritage site kept as a memorial.
description: 龙潭古镇位于重庆。游览特色包括古镇、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Longtan town in eastern Youyang County, roughly 30–40 minutes by road from Youyang county town.

name: 龙头嘴森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park in the hills of Zishui township in northern Kaizhou, promoted by the district as a forest sports park, with woodland walks and open lawns. It is mainly a cool summer retreat for people from the Kaizhou area.
description: 龙头嘴森林公园位于重庆。游览特色包括森林公园、运动休闲、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xiongying village, Zishui township, in the hills north of the Kaizhou district town, roughly 1.5 hours by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 美心红酒小镇
summaryEn: A leisure town beside the Yangtze at Linshi, with Chinese- and European-style buildings, an amusement park, a ferris wheel, riverside guesthouses and the 'Foreigners' Street' that moved here from central Chongqing. Since 2022 a network of cable-car lines has linked it to vineyards, a winery and a second, larger ferris wheel on the hills above, and it is mainly a weekend outing for families.
description: 美心红酒小镇位于重庆。游览特色包括葡萄酒文化、主题游乐、滨水景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Linshi on the Yangtze, in the west of Fuling District, about an hour by road from central Chongqing.

name: 摩围山
summaryEn: A forested mountain near Pengshui town, at around 1,400 m above sea level, with forest cover of about 91 percent, listed as one of China's 'forest oxygen bars'. In 2021 it became one of the first national youth nature-education camps, and the county is developing it as a mountain holiday resort.
description: 摩围山位于重庆。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Pengshui County, about 30 km by road from Pengshui town; tourist buses run from Pengshui West station on the Chongqing–Xiamen high-speed railway, and the drive from central Chongqing takes about 3 hours.

name: 楠木湾
summaryEn: Nanmuwan, in Jinsinan ('golden-thread nanmu') village of Liangzeng township in western Youyang, is known for a large grove of golden-thread nanmu (Phoebe zhennan), a prized hardwood, including several trees more than 1,000 years old. Stone-flagged paths run between the trees and the village's traditional houses.
description: 酉阳两罾乡金丝楠木村内，以成片楠木林和古树景观为主要看点。
accessEn: In Liangzeng township in western Youyang County, close to Gongtan Ancient Town, roughly 1.5–2 hours by road from Youyang county town.

name: 南天湖
summaryEn: A mountain resort area at 1,400–2,000 m about 45 km south of the Fengdu county town, built around a lake in forest that covers nearly nine-tenths of the land. It is a summer retreat from the Chongqing heat and in winter runs a ski area, with lakeside walks, camping and hotels, and it was named a national tourist resort in 2020.
description: 南天湖位于重庆。游览特色包括湖泊、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Nantianhu town, about 45 km south of the Fengdu county town by road and about 160 km from central Chongqing.

name: 黔江城市大峡谷
summaryEn: A gorge about 10 km long and some 200 m deep that runs through the middle of Qianjiang city, separating the old town from the new district, developed as a scenic area under the Tujia name Balahu, meaning 'gorge'. Its cliffs, woods and caves hold temples, pavilions and rock carvings, including a 123 m figure of Guanyin carved into the cliff face. It is the easiest of Qianjiang's sights to reach from the city centre.
description: 黔江城市大峡谷位于重庆。游览特色包括峡谷、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Zhoubai subdistrict in the middle of Qianjiang city, Qianjiang District; Qianjiang station is on the Chongqing–Xiamen high-speed railway, with tourist buses to the canyon.

name: 千野草场
summaryEn: An upland grassland in Yuchi town in northern Shizhu, high enough to stay cool in summer, with open pasture, woods and rocks grazed by cattle and sheep. Visitors come to camp and watch the stars in summer and to see the red firethorn berries that cover the slopes in autumn, and a zip line and cliff swing have been added.
description: 千野草场位于重庆。游览特色包括草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Yankou in Yuchi town, Shizhu Tujia Autonomous County, about 40 minutes by road from the Dafengbao area of Huangshui.

name: 黄桷门奇彩梦园
summaryEn: A rural leisure park in Huangjuemen village on the south side of Tongliang, next to Xuantian Lake, with flower fields planted for each season, fruit and vegetable picking, a woodland area and a small Bayu-style village street with shops and guesthouses. Families come for the water play area, children's rides, mini-train and grass sledding, and Tongliang's fire-dragon dance is staged here at festivals.
description: 黄桷门奇彩梦园位于重庆。游览特色包括湖泊、花卉观赏、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Huangjuemen village on the south side of Tongliang, next to Xuantian Lake, about 1.5 hours by road west of central Chongqing.

name: 夏布小镇
summaryEn: A shopping and leisure quarter of 24 courtyard buildings in Ming and Qing style, completed in 2015 and named after xiabu, the ramie cloth whose weaving is one of Rongchang's national intangible heritage crafts. Besides xiabu shops it has restaurants, bars and night markets, and it hosts many of the district's festivals and evening events.
description: 夏布小镇位于重庆。游览特色包括非遗文化、节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Rongbin South Road in the Rongchang district centre, Rongchang District.

name: 融汇温泉小镇
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort complex at Lishuwan in urban Shapingba, with outdoor and indoor spa pools, a water-play area and hotels. Its small restaurant-and-shop street, Quanli Xiaozhen, has hosted summer evening markets, and the resort suits a relaxing half-day rather than sightseeing.
description: 融汇温泉小镇位于重庆。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Lishuwan in Shapingba District near Sanxia Square, about 13 km west of Jiefangbei. Check that it is open before going.

name: 三合湖湿地公园
summaryEn: An urban wetland park of about 140 hectares around the Sanhe Lake reservoir in the eastern new district of Dianjiang town, opened in July 2022 with a ring path linking eight zones, wetland planting and an island. Billed as Dianjiang's first 'smart park', it has digital guides and a running track whose roadside screens show runners their distance and laps; it is mainly a local recreation space, best combined with Dianjiang's spring peony season.
description: 三合湖湿地公园位于重庆。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the eastern new district of Dianjiang town, Dianjiang County, about 2 hours by road north-east of central Chongqing.

name: 三峡原乡
summaryEn: A rural scenic area in the karst uplands of Xinglong Town, opened around 2020, built around a pair of cliffs that locals call Dry Kuimen for their likeness to the gate of Qutang Gorge, and a cave known as Shenxian Cave. Flower fields, winding flower terraces and a children's farm fill the valley, part of the Xinglong resort area that Fengjie promotes as a cool summer retreat.
description: 三峡原乡位于重庆。游览特色包括峡谷、山谷、花卉观赏。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xinglong Town in the southern uplands of Fengjie County, roughly an hour by road from the county town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 神龙峡
summaryEn: A forested gorge near Nanping on the western side of the Jinfo Mountain range, with a walking trail past waterfalls and pools and a rafting run down its stream in summer. It was rated 5A jointly with Mount Jinfo in 2013, lost that status in 2016 and has been a 4A in its own right since 2022.
description: 神龙峡位于重庆。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Nanping town in Nanchuan District, about 20 km south of Nanchuan town; buses run from Nanchuan North railway station. Check that it is open before going.

name: 石笋山
summaryEn: A pair of forested hills on the border of Jiangjin and Yongchuan, known locally as the 'male' and 'female' Shisun peaks, with a small lake, several Buddhist and Taoist shrines and the old walls of the Yunwuping hill fort. It is a place for hill walks, cloud views and temple visits rather than major sights.
description: 石笋山位于重庆。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the Jiangjin–Yongchuan border about 35 km west of Jiangjin's urban area, roughly an hour by road from Jiangjin.

name: 双桂湖国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A lake of about 120 hectares on the south-western side of the Liangping district town, a reservoir of 1951 that was cleaned up from around 2010 and turned into a wetland park of reed beds, channels and small wetlands crossed by boardwalks. More than 200 bird species have been recorded there, and it is the best-known wetland of Liangping, which has been named an International Wetland City.
description: 双桂湖国家湿地公园位于重庆。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shuanggui subdistrict a few kilometres south-west of the old centre of the Liangping district town, a short taxi ride away.

name: 三峡梯城
summaryEn: A hillside park in the centre of Yunyang's new county town, which was built here from 1999 after the Three Gorges reservoir flooded the old town. It takes in the Three Gorges Cultural Relics Park and Panshi Fortress, a hilltop stronghold used from the Tang to the Qing dynasties, where stretches of stone wall and two gateways survive.
description: 三峡梯城位于重庆。游览特色包括峡谷、城堡、水库。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shuangjiang Subdistrict in the centre of the Yunyang county town, Yunyang County.

name: 三峡之光
summaryEn: An evening show cruise launched at Wushan in 2021, on which visitors watch light projections across 152 buildings on both banks, the Goddess Temple and its hills and the Wushan Yangtze bridge, followed by a staged night show in Longmen Gorge. The show draws on local themes such as the Goddess of Wushan, the red autumn leaves and the resettlement of the reservoir towns.
description: 三峡之光位于重庆。游览特色包括峡谷、寺庙建筑、水库。图集建议预留1.5 小时游览。
accessEn: Boarding is at the Wushan visitor centre on Ningjiang Road in the Wushan county town, Wushan County; the cruise runs in the evening.

name: 三峡之巅
summaryEn: A mountain-top scenic area opened in 2020 along more than 10 km of the ridge of Chijia Mountain above Kuimen, whose highest point, at 1,388 m, looks down on the Yangtze entering Qutang Gorge. Terraces and monuments along the ridge celebrate Kui, the legendary music master of ancient China, and a glass walkway runs along the cliff edge; a ridge-top hiking trail of about 10 km, the Taibai Bird Path, links the area with White Emperor City along the cliffs on the north side of the gorge.
description: 三峡之巅位于重庆。游览特色包括峡谷、玻璃栈道、山地游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Fengjie County on the ridge north of Qutang Gorge, about 40 km by road from the Fengjie county town and about 10 minutes' drive from Wushan Airport, or on foot from White Emperor City along the 10 km ridge trail.

name: 天心寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple among old trees in the hills of Tianxingsi town in eastern Ba'nan, at the centre of a Buddhist culture area that the district promotes for tea drinking and meditation classes. Guesthouses, one of them in a restored old courtyard house, lie in the surrounding villages.
description: 天心寺位于重庆。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、传统民居、佛教文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tianxingsi town, eastern Ba'nan District, roughly an hour by road from central Chongqing. Check that it is open before going.

name: 铁山坪森林公园
summaryEn: A forested upland on the Tongluo Mountain ridge in the east of Liangjiang New Area, facing Nanshan across the Yangtze. Walking trails link its 'ten views', among them the old Sengguan Temple, the remains of an old battlefield and of works that once guarded the river, flower fields and lookouts over the Yangtze.
description: 铁山坪位于中华人民共和国重庆市两江新区铁山坪街道，属森林公园，被列为中华人民共和国国家AAAA级风景区。
accessEn: In Tieshanping subdistrict, Jiangbei District (Liangjiang New Area), about 40 minutes by road from Jiefangbei.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 统景温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring and gorge scenic area where the Wentang River leaves its gorge at Tongjing, in the far east of Beibei District (until 2025 part of Yubei). Springs here rise at up to 61°C and feed bathing pools, and the scenic area also takes in river gorges, caves and waterfalls.
description: 统景温泉位于重庆。游览特色包括温泉、瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tongjing town, which moved from Yubei to Beibei District in 2025, about an hour by road north-east of central Chongqing.

name: 土城红军老街
summaryEn: An old street of flagstones, timber eaves and remains of the town wall in the Chengkou county town, laid out in the Jiaqing era of the Qing dynasty about 200 years ago. It carries the Red Army name because Chengkou was part of the Sichuan–Shaanxi revolutionary base area, which the Fourth Front Army of the Red Army entered in October 1933, and the county's Soviet government and Red Army memorial parks are also in town.
description: 土城红军老街位于重庆。游览特色包括历史纪念、历史建筑。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: In Gecheng Subdistrict in the Chengkou county town, Chengkou County, in the Daba Mountains in the far north of Chongqing.

name: 土家十三寨
summaryEn: A group of 13 Tujia hamlets of wooden stilt houses spread along the Banjia stream in the north of Xiaonanhai town, where around 200 households still live. Flagstone paths and covered bridges link the hamlets, and visitors can hear Tujia folk songs and see the baishou hand-waving dance, while embroidery, weaving and batik are still practised; Hejiazhai is the largest and best preserved of the villages.
description: 土家十三寨位于重庆。游览特色包括村寨、民歌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xinjian village, Xiaonanhai town, about 30 km north-west of central Qianjiang by road in Qianjiang District, and easily combined with Xiaonanhai lake.

name: 万灵古镇
summaryEn: A historic riverside market town in north-eastern Rongchang, called Lukong until 2013 and listed among China's historic and cultural towns. Its old quarter takes in the Darong Bridge and the Niushiba wharf, a Huguang guild hall, the Zhao clan shrine and a memorial hall to the Ming official Yu Maojian, and opera and folk performances are staged there on holidays.
description: 万灵古镇位于重庆。游览特色包括古镇、纪念展览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wanling Town, Rongchang District, about 15 km north-east of the district centre by road.

name: 万盛老街
summaryEn: This old street in central Wansheng recreates Wanshengchang, the market from which the town grew: first called Wanshouchang, it was renamed in the Tongzhi reign of the Qing, when sales of local coal and coke drew merchants and guild halls from Jiangxi, Zhejiang and Huguang. The stone Sanyuan Bridge over the river, paid for by a merchant in the Xianfeng reign, still stands, and the street is now a shopping and dining district.
description: 位于万盛城区的老街重现当地场镇贸易空间，可沿街观察山城商业聚落的风貌。
accessEn: In central Wansheng (Wansheng Economic Development Zone, Qijiang District), about 2 hours by road from central Chongqing.

name: 文峰
summaryEn: A mountain-top Taoist temple on the north bank at the western mouth of Wu Gorge, first built in the Ming dynasty as Lingyun Temple and rebuilt in 1786 for the Quanzhen Longmen school. The site looks over the river on one side and wooded ridges on the other, and the hillsides are one of Wushan's main red-leaf areas in late autumn.
description: 文峰位于重庆。游览特色包括峡谷、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the hills just east of the Wushan county town in Wushan County, a short drive or local bus ride away.

name: 西部菌谷
summaryEn: A mushroom-themed family park in Lüshui village, Conglin town, north-east of Wansheng, combining fairy-tale play areas for children with a picking area where visitors can gather enoki, shiitake, straw mushrooms and lingzhi. It is one of Wansheng's farm-tourism projects and suits families with young children.
description: 万盛丛林镇绿水村的家庭游园以食用菌为主题，结合童话场景与儿童游乐。
accessEn: In Conglin town, about 15 minutes by road north-east of central Wansheng, which is about 2 hours by road from central Chongqing.

name: 乌江画廊
summaryEn: The steep-walled gorge of the Wu River south of Pengshui, part of the roughly 100 km stretch from Pengshui past Gongtan to Yanhe in Guizhou that is known as the 'hundred-li gallery' for its cliffs and dark green water. The 4A scenic area is based at Wanzu town, and sightseeing boats run through the gorge.
description: 乌江画廊位于重庆。游览特色包括峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Boats start from Wanzu in Pengshui County, about 15 km by road south of Pengshui town; tourist buses run from Pengshui West station on the Chongqing–Xiamen high-speed railway, and the drive from central Chongqing takes about 3 hours.

name: 武陵山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park on the Wuling Mountains in south-eastern Fuling, centred on the old Damu state forest farm, with dense forest and upland grassland. Forest cover is about 95 percent and July and August average under 20°C, so it is used mainly as a summer retreat for walking and forest stays.
description: 武陵山国家森林公园位于重庆。游览特色包括森林公园、草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At the Damu state forest farm near Damu town, in south-eastern Fuling District, roughly 1.5 hours by road from central Fuling.

name: 香国公园
summaryEn: Dazu's largest city park, covering about 87 ha around two lakes, Miaoshan and Xiangquan, laid out on the theme of Dazu's old name, the 'land of begonia fragrance'. Covered bridges, pavilions, cascades, a public stage, children's play areas and an evening light-and-water show are spread through it, and the Song-style Changzhou Ancient Town street lies alongside. It makes an easy evening stroll after a day at the carvings.
description: 香国公园位于重庆。游览特色包括古镇、楼阁建筑、城市公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tangxiang subdistrict in central Dazu, Dazu District, roughly 1.5 hours by road from central Chongqing.

name: 下庄村
summaryEn: A village at the bottom of a deep, cliff-ringed basin in Zhuxian Township that was cut off from the outside until its residents, led by the village Party secretary Mao Xianglin, spent seven years carving an 8 km road along the cliffs. The road, the citrus orchards planted since and a small exhibition room on the village's story now draw visitors, and state media present Xiazhuang as a model of the national poverty-alleviation campaign.
description: 下庄村位于重庆。游览特色包括果园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhuxian Township in north-eastern Wushan County, about 2 hours by mountain road from the county town.

name: 融汇西流沱
summaryEn: A modern riverside leisure quarter on the Yangtze at Lijiatuo in Ba'nan, developed by the Ronghui property group around Xiliutuo Town, a newly built pedestrian district whose streets, courtyards and terraces are laid out on different levels with a Ba-culture theme. People come mainly for the local food and for walks or rides along the Babin riverside road.
description: 融汇西流沱位于重庆。游览特色包括滨水景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Lijiatuo on the south bank of the Yangtze in Ba'nan District, about 30 minutes by taxi from central Chongqing.

name: 璧山秀湖公园
summaryEn: A large lake park in Bishan, created in the 2010s as one of more than 30 public parks the district built while cleaning up its rivers. Lakeside paths, lawns and gardens make it a pleasant place for a walk, and a car-camping park lies alongside.
description: 璧山秀湖公园位于重庆。游览特色包括湖泊、园林景观、城市公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In central Bishan District, a short walk from Xiuhu Park station on the Bishan SkyShuttle line, and about 40 minutes by road from central Chongqing.

name: 秀山西街
summaryEn: The old western quarter of the Xiushan county town on both banks of the Meijiang River, the heart of the town since it was founded in 1736, restored as a folk-culture area of about 1 km². Old streets and lanes lead to the Tianhou Temple, the Bagua Well, a stretch of the old town wall, courtyard houses, an old opera stage and covered bridges, and the streets are hung with flower lanterns at festivals.
description: 秀山西街位于重庆。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、传统民居、特色街区。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the west of the Xiushan county town (Zhonghe subdistrict), in the far south-east of Chongqing.

name: 玄天湖
summaryEn: A lake of about 1,500 mu (100 ha) at the foot of Bayue Mountain on the southern edge of Tongliang, landscaped with lakeside running paths and designated, with the mountain, a municipal-level tourist resort in 2022. On its Dragon Dance Plaza an outdoor show, 'Chasing the Dream: Tongliang Dragon', staged on selected dates since 2022, presents the town's dragon and fire-dragon dances with lighting and stage effects.
description: 玄天湖位于重庆。游览特色包括湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the southern edge of Tongliang town at the foot of Bayue Mountain, about 1.5 hours by road west of central Chongqing.

name: 酉水河湾
summaryEn: Hewan is a Tujia village on the Youshui River in Youshuihe town, eastern Youyang, in the valley the county treats as the heartland of its Tujia culture. Its old hillside hamlet, Hewan Shanzhai, is rated one of the county's leading tourism resources, and village households run guesthouses under the county's 'Taoyuan Renjia' homestay scheme.
description: 酉水河湾位于重庆。游览特色包括山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Youshuihe town on the eastern edge of Youyang County, roughly 1–1.5 hours by road from Youyang county town.

name: 云阳环湖绿道
summaryEn: A greenway of riverside parks around the reservoir lake at Yunyang's county town, which was rebuilt here after the Three Gorges reservoir flooded the old town. Its eight themed parks, among them the Moonlight Lawn, were all open by 2022.
description: 云阳环湖绿道位于重庆。游览特色包括峡谷、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Along the Yangtze waterfront of the Yunyang county town in Yunyang County, walkable from the town centre.

name: 周君记火锅食品工业旅游体验园
summaryEn: The hotpot-seasoning factory of the Zhoujunji company in Zhongliangshan, which has run factory tours since 2006. Visitors see the chillies, ginger and other raw materials, watch the production lines and the traditional frying of hotpot base, can fry a batch themselves and finish with a hotpot meal. A museum of Sichuan and Chongqing seasonings and hotpot culture opened beside the factory in 2025.
description: 周君记火锅食品工业旅游体验园位于重庆。游览特色包括博物馆、工业参观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Hualong Avenue in Zhongliangshan subdistrict, Jiulongpo District, about 20 km south-west of central Chongqing by road.

name: 竹溪生态乐园
summaryEn: A rural leisure park in Zhuxi town, opened in 2021 with Kaizhou's Zhuxi rural-revitalisation zone and themed on the bamboo (zhu) and streams (xi) of its name. It offers countryside walks and farm landscapes and is mainly a weekend outing for families from the Kaizhou area.
description: 竹溪生态乐园位于重庆。游览特色包括公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhuxi town, about 10 km west of the Kaizhou district town by road.

name: 中国古羌城·坪头羌寨
summaryEn: A large complex on the edge of Mao County town, built after the 2008 earthquake to present the culture of the Qiang people. It houses the China Qiang Museum, a reconstructed Qiang king's residence and halls for crafts and performances. Pingtou, a Qiang village on the slope just above, has become a summer retreat with many family guesthouses.
description: 中国古羌城·坪头羌寨位于四川阿坝。游览特色包括博物馆、地震纪念、村寨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the edge of Mao County town, a short taxi ride from the centre.

name: 俄木塘花海
summaryEn: Natural grassland in southern Hongyuan County where more than 30,000 mu (about 20 km²) of meadow turns into a sheet of wildflowers from early June to early August. Yellow, purple, white and blue flowers spread towards snow peaks, and in the hills above lie the sacred lake Cuoqiong and about 20 other mountain lakes reached on horseback or on foot. It is a summer stop on the G248 south of Hongyuan town.
description: 俄木塘花海位于四川阿坝。游览特色包括草原、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside the G248 in southern Hongyuan County, about 73 km (2 hours) by road from Hongyuan town and 25 km from Hongyuan Airport, carrying your passport for checkpoints.

name: 甲勿海·熊猫园
summaryEn: A mountain lake near Wujiao in Jiuzhaigou County, set among forest and snow peaks in an area of Baima Tibetan villages. A giant panda park beside the lake opened in November 2019 with pandas on loan from the China Conservation and Research Center for the Giant Panda, among them Xiao Liwu, who was born at San Diego Zoo in 2012.
description: 甲勿海·熊猫园位于四川阿坝。游览特色包括湖泊、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 35 km by road from Jiuzhaigou county town (Yongle), towards Wujiao.

name: 莲宝叶则
summaryEn: A granite massif on the border between Aba County and Qinghai, a southern spur of the Bayan Har range whose highest peak reaches 5,369 metres. Jagged grey peaks rise above more than a hundred lakes, and the range forms the divide between the Yellow River and Yangtze systems. Valleys such as Longke, Zhumu and Zhagar are explored from the visitor centre.
description: 莲宝叶则又称莲宝叶则山系、莲宝叶则·石头山景区、莲宝叶则-石头山景区、莲宝叶则石头山风景区，是中华人民共和国四川省阿坝藏族羌族自治州阿坝县与青海省果洛藏族自治州久治县交界处的山脉，是巴颜喀拉山南段支脉。
accessEn: About 1.5 hours by road north-west of Aba county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 两河口会议会址
summaryEn: At Lianghekou in Xiaojin County the Communist Party Politburo met on 26 June 1935, after the Red Army's First and Fourth Front Armies had joined forces at Dawei earlier that month. The meeting adopted the strategy of moving north to set up a base in the Sichuan–Shaanxi–Gansu region. The meeting site is protected as part of a national heritage listing of Long March sites in Aba.
description: 两河口会议会址位于四川省小金县两河口镇，原建筑为建于清代的关帝庙，现仅存正殿后的三间瓦房小庙。两河口会议是1935年6月26日在四川懋功两河口召开的一次中国共产党中央政治局扩大会议。1980年7月7日列为四川省重新确定公布的第一批省级文物保护单位。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About an hour and a half by road north of Xiaojin county town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 红军长征纪念总碑
summaryEn: A memorial park on Yuanbao Hill above Chuanzhusi, completed in 1990 to commemorate the Red Army's Long March across the Songpan grasslands in 1935. The main monument, topped by a bronze statue of a Red Army soldier, is 41.3 metres high, and the park also has a granite sculpture group and a Long March museum.
description: 红军长征纪念总碑位于四川阿坝。游览特色包括博物馆、草原、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Beside Chuanzhusi town, about 20 minutes by road north of Songpan and close to Jiuzhai–Huanglong Airport.

name: 日干乔
summaryEn: A large highland marsh near Waqie on the Hongyuan grasslands, part of the wider Zoige wetlands, where streams and pools spread across the peatland of the upper Yellow River basin. It is greenest in summer, and the stupas and prayer flags of Waqie are close by.
description: 日干乔位于四川阿坝。游览特色包括湿地、草原。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Near Waqie on the G213, about 40 minutes by road north of Hongyuan town.

name: 三奥雪山
summaryEn: Three snow peaks, Aotaiji, Aotaimei and Aotaina, rising above Luhua, the county town of Heishui. Their valleys, lakes and meadows attract trekkers, and the peaks have become popular with novice mountaineers; the nearby village of Deshiwo has trained more than 200 licensed mountain guides.
description: 三奥雪山位于四川阿坝。游览特色包括高山景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: The base camp lies roughly 20 km south-west of Heishui county town (Luhua) and is reached by mountain road.

name: 神座
summaryEn: A Tibetan village in Chali township in eastern Aba County, with high pastures behind it and old forest facing it across the river. Its stone houses, small prayer halls and the surrounding grassland and woods make it a quiet stop on the grassland routes.
description: 神座位于四川阿坝。游览特色包括草原、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Chali township, east of Aba county town; allow an hour or more by road.

name: 世外梨园
summaryEn: A 14.4 km² stretch of the Dajin River valley in Jinchuan County where Gyalrong Tibetan villages sit among snow-pear orchards; the county grows more than 40,000 mu (about 2,700 hectares) of the pears, and over a million trees line the valley. The orchards blossom white in March and April against snow peaks and turn red in autumn, and the scenic area spans Qingning, Ka'er and Sha'er townships. Come for the spring blossom or the autumn colour.
description: 世外梨园位于四川阿坝。游览特色包括果园、山谷、高山景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Along the Dajin River near Jinchuan county town, a long day's drive from Chengdu, carrying your passport for checkpoints.

name: 汶川大禹文化旅游区
summaryEn: Mianchi, on the Min River south of Wenchuan county town, is traditionally held to be the birthplace of Yu the Great, the legendary tamer of China's floods. The cultural area links an altar to Yu with other places in the area tied to the legend, and local celebrations of Yu's birthday are traditionally held on the sixth day of the sixth lunar month.
description: 汶川大禹文化旅游区位于四川阿坝。游览特色包括名人故居。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About half an hour by road south of Wenchuan county town (Weizhou).

name: 鹧鸪山自然公园
summaryEn: A nature park on Zhegu Mountain, the high pass on the G317 between Miyaluo and Barkam, with conifer forest, alpine meadows and wide mountain views. In winter part of the park runs as a ski area.
description: 鹧鸪山自然公园位于四川阿坝。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the G317 about an hour by road east of Barkam.

name: 白衣古镇
summaryEn: Baiyi is an old trading town on the Ba River in southern Pingchang county that grew along the Micang trade road between Sichuan and Shaanxi. Its historic quarter, a provincial heritage site, keeps temples, memorial arches, pavilions and old merchant mansions.
description: 白衣古镇位于四川巴中。游览特色包括古镇、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 20 km south of Pingchang county town, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 恩阳古镇
summaryEn: Enyang is an old market and river town on the Enyang River, about 15 km south-west of central Bazhong. Its stone-paved lanes keep timber-fronted shops, courtyard houses and temples, and the riverside makes a pleasant stroll.
description: 恩阳古镇位于四川巴中。游览特色包括古镇、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 15 km south-west of central Bazhong, 20–30 minutes by bus or taxi; Bazhong Enyang Airport is nearby.

name: 山水化湖
summaryEn: A lake area around Huacheng Reservoir in Huacheng town, about 20 km north-east of central Bazhong, listed as a National Water Conservancy Scenic Area. The town around it is being developed as a lakeside eco-town with farm-based sightseeing and leisure. It is a quiet lakeside outing for those staying in Bazhong.
description: 山水化湖位于四川巴中。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Huacheng town, about 20 km north-east of central Bazhong by road.

name: 皇家山
summaryEn: A tea-growing hill area of about 12.6 km² spanning Xixing and Tuya towns, where more than 400 hectares of tea bushes follow the slopes and low clouds often settle in the valleys. It is a home of the local folk dance Fanshan Jiaozi, listed as national intangible cultural heritage in 2008. It suits a rural outing in spring.
description: 皇家山位于四川巴中。游览特色包括茶文化、非遗文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xixing town in southern Pingchang County, under an hour by road from Pingchang county town.

name: 九寨山
summaryEn: A landscaped hill park on the eastern side of Bazhong, in the city's economic development zone near Bazhong East railway station. It is used mainly by local residents for walks and family outings rather than as a destination for visitors from afar.
description: 九寨山位于四川巴中。游览特色包括村寨。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Diagonally across from Bazhong East railway station on the eastern edge of the city, a short taxi ride from the centre.

name: 空山天盆
summaryEn: Kongshan is a high upland basin of meadows, farmland and forest ringed by mountains in northern Tongjiang county; 'Tianpen' means 'sky basin'. A memorial park recalls the Battle of Kongshanba, fought here by the Red Fourth Front Army in the 1930s, and the battlefield is a provincial heritage site.
description: 空山天盆位于四川巴中。游览特色包括林地风光、战役遗址、田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 2 hours by mountain road north of Tongjiang county town.

name: 南天门
summaryEn: A forested hill area of about 18.5 km² in Wumu town, once a stage on the Micang ancient road and a military strongpoint of the Sichuan–Shaanxi revolutionary base area. It has been developed for outdoor sport, with a forest sports park, a mountain-bike trail, a self-drive campsite and the Shuanghe eco-garden. It suits hikers, cyclists and campers more than sightseers.
description: 南天门位于四川巴中。游览特色包括运动休闲、园林景观、历史纪念。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wumu town, about 30 km from Pingchang county town and 25 km from the Sima interchange on the Bazhong–Dazhou expressway.

name: 诺水河
summaryEn: The Nuoshui (Xiaotong) River cuts through the limestone of the Micang range in northern Tongjiang county, and its scenic area is known for karst caves, gorges and forested valleys. Together with Guangwushan it makes up the Guangwushan–Nuoshuihe UNESCO Global Geopark.
description: 诺水河位于四川巴中。游览特色包括峡谷、洞穴、地质景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 1.5 hours by road north of Tongjiang county town.

name: 驷马水乡
summaryEn: A leisure area around Sima town, on the border of Pingchang County and Bazhou District, built around an artificial lake and wetlands. It includes the Sima National Wetland Park, a filial-piety culture garden, a water park and a modern agricultural demonstration park. It suits families and weekend visitors from Bazhong rather than travellers looking for historic sights.
description: 驷马水乡位于四川巴中。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊、水乡。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Sima town, south-east of Bazhong, near the Sima interchange on the Bazhong–Dazhou expressway.

name: 白鹤滩国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A wetland park on the Min River at Xinjin, where river deposits have built up sandbars, gravel shoals and grassy meadows. It was approved as a national wetland park in 2013, and more than 180 bird species had been recorded there by 2022. Riverside paths make it a quiet spot for walking and birdwatching on the southern edge of Chengdu.
description: 白鹤滩国家湿地公园位于四川成都。游览特色包括湿地、滨水景观、观鸟。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xinjin District, about an hour by road or metro south of central Chengdu.

name: 彭州宝山
summaryEn: A tourist area around Baoshan village in the Longmen Mountains of Pengzhou, combining two forested valleys, Taiyangwan and Huilonggou, with a hot-spring resort and village tourism. Taiyangwan lies within a nature reserve and geopark and has walking routes rising from low to high mountain zones. Baoshan itself has a national reputation as a model mountain village.
description: 彭州宝山位于四川成都。游览特色包括地质景观、自然保护区。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 36 km from Pengzhou city, roughly two hours by road from Chengdu.

name: 成都国际非遗博览园
summaryEn: A large event park of about 1,780 mu (119 hectares) in western Chengdu, built as the permanent home of the Chengdu International Intangible Cultural Heritage Festival, whose ninth edition opened here in May 2025. Between festivals it hosts music festivals, markets, sports events, film shoots and a few exhibition and immersive-experience venues, so what is on varies widely. It is worth a visit mainly when the festival or another event is running.
description: 成都国际非遗博览园位于四川成都。游览特色包括非遗文化、音乐文化、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Guanghua Avenue in Qingyang district, west Chengdu, next to Feiyi Bolanyuan metro station.

name: 成都极地海洋公园
summaryEn: A marine park of about 7 hectares in Huayang, Tianfu New Area, on the southern side of Chengdu, opened in 2010 as Haichang Polar Ocean World and since renamed. It keeps polar bears, beluga whales, walruses and sea lions among other marine animals, and stages dolphin and sea-lion shows. It is a family attraction, and most visitors spend around four hours.
description: 成都极地海洋公园位于四川成都。游览特色包括海岸风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Huayang, about 18 km south of central Chengdu, roughly 40 minutes by taxi.

name: 成佳茶乡
summaryEn: Rolling tea country around Chengjia town in Pujiang county, south-west of Chengdu, with some 22,000 mu (about 1,500 hectares) of tea gardens, more than half of them organic. Visitors walk among the plantations, try picking and processing tea and stay in tea-garden guesthouses. It is at its best in spring, when the Chengdu tea-picking festival is held in Pujiang.
description: 成佳茶乡位于四川成都。游览特色包括园林景观、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 80 km south-west of central Chengdu near the Chengdu–Ya'an expressway, roughly 1.5 hours by road.

name: 丹景山
summaryEn: A wooded mountain in Pengzhou known for tree peonies since at least the Song dynasty, when the poet Lu You wrote that Tianpeng (Pengzhou) peonies were the finest in Sichuan. A peony festival, held since 1985, fills its hillside gardens each spring, usually from late March. Paths also lead to a shrine to Lu You, Jinhua Temple and old cliff carvings.
description: 丹景山位于四川成都。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、石刻。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Pengzhou, about 1–1.5 hours by road north of Chengdu.

name: 丹景台
summaryEn: A hilltop viewing park on the ridge of the Longquan Mountains, opened on New Year's Day 2020 as the first showcase project of the Longquan Mountain Urban Forest Park. From 702 metres above sea level it looks over the island-studded Sancha Lake and the new Eastern New Area, and on clear days to distant snow peaks; the main building has an exhibition on the forest park and an ecology display. It suits a half-day drive for the views.
description: 丹景台位于四川成都。游览特色包括森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the Longquan Mountain ridge about 50 km south-east of central Chengdu, best reached by car or taxi.

name: 道明竹艺村
summaryEn: A rural hamlet in Daoming, Chongzhou, known for Daoming bamboo weaving, a local craft added to China's national intangible cultural heritage list in 2014. Its landmark is Zhuli, a contemporary building whose roofline forms an infinity sign when seen from above and whose name comes from a poem by Lu You. Workshops and shops around the village show woven bamboo work being made and sold.
description: 道明竹艺村位于四川成都。游览特色包括非遗文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About an hour and a half by road west of central Chengdu, via Chongzhou.

name: 凤凰湖
summaryEn: A wetland park around a lake in Qingbaijiang district, north-east of Chengdu, rated a 4A scenic area in 2022. It is best known for its cherry blossom, with more than 16,000 trees of dozens of varieties that flower in March and April, when a cherry-blossom festival is held, and has footpaths and boardwalks around the water. Visit in spring for the blossom.
description: 凤凰湖位于四川成都。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 35 km north-east of central Chengdu, roughly 50 minutes by road.

name: 国色天乡乐园
summaryEn: A large theme-park and resort development in Wanchun, Wenjiang, on Chengdu's western edge, built in a foreign-themed style beside a big housing estate. It has three parks: the Fairy-Tale World; a land park with roller coasters, drop towers and other rides; and a water park open in the warmer months. It is aimed at families with children.
description: 国色天乡乐园位于四川成都。游览特色包括主题游乐、水上游乐。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wanchun town, Wenjiang district, about 25 km west of central Chengdu by road or taxi.

name: 海滨城
summaryEn: A large indoor shopping and entertainment complex in the Jiaolonggang area of Shuangliu, south-west Chengdu, listed as a scenic area for its leisure attractions. Alongside shops and food halls it contains an aquarium with fish displays and mermaid shows, an ice rink and flight-simulator experiences. It is a rainy-day option for families rather than a sightseeing destination.
description: 海滨城位于四川成都。游览特色包括海滨、水族展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shuangliu district, about 16 km south-west of central Chengdu, roughly 40 minutes by taxi.

name: 花水湾温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort town in the mountains of Dayi county, on the road up to Xiling Snow Mountain, with a river running through it between the hills. Its hotels and bathhouses use a spring marketed as 'ancient seawater', and since 2024 the town and Xiling Snow Mountain have together formed a national-level tourist resort. It suits a soak and an overnight stop before or after the mountain.
description: 花水湾温泉位于四川成都。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 1.5–2 hours by road west of Chengdu via Dayi county town.

name: 花舞人间
summaryEn: A flower park of more than 3,000 mu (about 200 hectares) in Xinjin district, on the southern fringe of Chengdu. It runs a sequence of flower festivals through the year, among them tulips, rhododendrons, lupins, sunflowers and lilies, with water-based amusements alongside. It is best in spring for a half-day stroll.
description: 花舞人间位于四川成都。游览特色包括花卉观赏、节庆文化、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km south of central Chengdu, roughly an hour by road.

name: 锦门
summaryEn: A recently developed cultural and commercial quarter in Sanhe, Xindu district, north of Chengdu, themed on Shu brocade and promoted as the starting point of the Southern Silk Road. It houses the Sichuan Silk Museum, which traces silk-making from sericulture to drawloom weaving, and has brought in more than 100 intangible-heritage crafts such as Shu brocade, Shu embroidery and lacquerware, alongside shops and restaurants. It suits visitors interested in textiles and traditional crafts.
description: 锦门位于四川成都。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Sanhe subdistrict, Xindu, about 15 km north of central Chengdu, roughly 30–40 minutes by taxi.

name: 麓湖水城
summaryEn: A planned lakeside district in Tianfu New Area, south of central Chengdu, built from 2010 around an artificial lake of about 2,100 mu (140 hectares) fed with water from the Dujiangyan irrigation system. Its 1.92 km² visitor area mixes waterfront paths, islands and parks with housing, cafés and shops. It suits an afternoon walk and an interest in new urban development.
description: 麓湖水城位于四川成都。游览特色包括湖泊、灌溉工程。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside Luhu (Luxelake) station on Chengdu Metro Line 1, about 22 km south of the city centre.

name: 农科村
summaryEn: A flower- and bonsai-growing village in Youai town, Pidu, north-west of Chengdu, promoted as the birthplace of nongjiale, the farmhouse restaurants and guesthouses now found across rural China. Visitors walk among some 300 mu (20 hectares) of nursery gardens and potted landscapes and eat in farmhouse courtyards. The village also presents itself as the home area of the Han-dynasty scholar Yang Xiong.
description: 农科村位于四川成都。游览特色包括名人故居、园林景观、田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 45 minutes by road north-west of central Chengdu.

name: 桃花故里
summaryEn: A hillside orchard area at Shanquan in the Longquan Mountains, on Chengdu's eastern edge, centred on the peach groves for which Longquanyi is known. It has more than 30 viewpoints linked by themed footpaths, including a long stepped trail, and a small museum of peach culture. Come in March for the blossom, when the district's peach-blossom festival (held since 1987) takes place, or in summer for the fruit.
description: 桃花故里位于四川成都。游览特色包括博物馆、果园、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shanquan town, about an hour by road east of central Chengdu via Longquanyi.

name: 青杠树村
summaryEn: A model village in Sandaoyan town, Pidu, on the north-western edge of Chengdu, where streams and irrigation channels run among western-Sichuan farmhouses and tree-shaded linpan homesteads. It is popular for spring rapeseed blossom, cycling and farmhouse meals, and has hosted outdoor music festivals. It combines easily with Sandaoyan's rebuilt riverside quarter a few kilometres away.
description: 青杠树村位于四川成都。游览特色包括滨水景观、音乐文化、灌溉工程。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 40 minutes by road north-west of central Chengdu, a few kilometres south-east of Sandaoyan town.

name: 三圣花乡
summaryEn: A belt of flower-growing villages in Sansheng subdistrict on Chengdu's south-eastern edge, developed as five themed areas known as the 'Five Golden Flowers': Flower Village Farmhouses, Happy Plum Grove, Jiang Family Vegetable Plots, East Hedge Chrysanthemum Garden and Lotus Pond Moonlight. Among the gardens stands the Xu Liaoyuan Museum of Modern Design Art, which holds art and design exhibitions. It is an easy half-day escape from the city centre.
description: 三圣花乡位于四川成都。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观、莲花观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 10 km south-east of central Chengdu; Sansheng Huaxiang station on Metro Line 13 is nearby.

name: 天府芙蓉园
summaryEn: A themed park in the Jiang'an River green belt of Wuhou district, south-west Chengdu, opened in 2018 and developed with Joy City Holdings around the hibiscus, Chengdu's city flower. It mixes flower meadows, a eucalyptus grove and seasonal flower islands with a bookshop, restaurants and art spaces, and runs festivals, lantern shows and camping events. It suits a relaxed half-day rather than a sightseeing stop.
description: 天府芙蓉园位于四川成都。游览特色包括节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jinhuaqiao subdistrict, Wuhou district, about 11 km south-west of central Chengdu by taxi.

name: 天府国际慢城
summaryEn: A rural leisure area around Baitou town, west of Chongzhou on the Chengdu Plain, made up of the Qimu River wetland park, the Wuxing village folk-culture area and open rice and rapeseed fields. Visitors cycle or walk along the river past white-walled western-Sichuan houses, linpan homesteads and farm restaurants, and the rapeseed fields flower yellow from late February into March. It suits a slow day of cycling in spring.
description: 天府国际慢城位于四川成都。游览特色包括湿地、油菜花田。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Baitou town, Chongzhou, about an hour by road west of central Chengdu.

name: 天艺浓园
summaryEn: An art park in Wuhou district, south-west Chengdu, founded in 2005 and now grouped into three sections that combine artists' studios, galleries and teaching spaces. Old-style courtyards and modern outdoor sculpture surround galleries such as the Yue Art Museum, and the park hosts exhibitions and craft markets. It suits visitors interested in contemporary Chinese art.
description: 天艺浓园位于四川成都。游览特色包括博物馆、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Wuhou Avenue (Sanhe section), about 10 km south-west of central Chengdu by taxi.

name: 蔚然花海
summaryEn: A large commercial flower park in Tong'an, Longquanyi, on the eastern edge of Chengdu, planted mainly with seasonal flowers such as tulips, poppies, zinnias and coneflowers, including some grown from space-bred seed. Beyond the flower beds it runs a sightseeing train, children's rides, camping and evening shows, and it has hosted the Cactus music festival. It is a family day out, best in spring.
description: 蔚然花海位于四川成都。游览特色包括花卉观赏、音乐文化、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tong'an subdistrict, Longquanyi, about 45 minutes by road east of central Chengdu.

name: 五凤溪古镇
summaryEn: A riverside town on the Tuo River in the Longquan Mountains of Jintang County, which prospered as a busy river port in the Qing dynasty. Its old lanes of timber houses lead to halls built by migrant merchant communities, notably the Guansheng Palace and the Nanhua Palace, the Guangdong guild hall.
description: 五凤溪古镇位于四川成都。游览特色包括古镇、滨水景观、历史建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jintang County, about 1.5 hours by road east of central Chengdu.

name: 幸福田园
summaryEn: A showcase rural area of about 1,400 mu (93 hectares) at Xingfu village in Wanchun, Wenjiang, on the western edge of Chengdu, presenting farm life on the Chengdu Plain. A greenway through the fields links western-Sichuan courtyard houses, flower nurseries, a wetland park, a crape-myrtle garden and a small farming-culture museum. It suits an easy half-day out of the city and can be combined with the Guose Tianxiang amusement park, also in Wanchun.
description: 幸福田园位于四川成都。游览特色包括博物馆、湿地。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wanchun town, Wenjiang district, about 25 km west of central Chengdu by road.

name: 战旗村
summaryEn: A model village in Tangchang, Pidu, noted for its collective land reforms and visited by Xi Jinping in February 2018; an exhibition hall presents the village's development and that visit. The Eighteen Village Workshops, opened in 2018, show crafts such as Tangchang cloth-shoe making, soy-sauce brewing and grain-liquor distilling, and there is also a farming-culture museum and an old-style street. It suits visitors curious about rural development in China and traditional crafts.
description: 战旗村位于四川成都。游览特色包括博物馆、农业体验、主题展览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 45 km north-west of central Chengdu, roughly an hour by road.

name: 巴山大峡谷
summaryEn: The Bashan Grand Canyon scenic area covers river gorges, cliffs and forested mountains in the Daba range of north-eastern Xuanhan county, around the Tujia ethnic township of Dukou. Viewpoints and routes along the gorges are the main draw, and Tujia villages set it apart culturally from the rest of Dazhou.
description: 巴山大峡谷位于四川达州。游览特色包括峡谷、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 2 hours by road north-east of Xuanhan county town.

name: 八台山
summaryEn: Batai Mountain, south-east of Wanyuan city in the Daba range, is a national geopark of isolated peaks and sheer cliffs, known for sunrise views, seas of cloud and 'Buddha's light' halos. Glass walkways and a glass bridge, camping and winter snow sports are part of a visit, and the slopes turn red in autumn.
description: 八台山位于四川达州。游览特色包括地质景观、玻璃栈道。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km south-east of Wanyuan city, under an hour by road; the Shitang exit of the G65 expressway is 9 km away.

name: 賨人谷
summaryEn: Congren Valley is a 41 km² karst landscape of gorges, caves, springs, waterfalls and forest in the hills east of Qu County town, protected as a national forest park and provincial geopark. It is named after the Cong, a branch of the ancient Ba people, and a cave-dwelling site and small exhibition hall on their history sit alongside natural sights such as the Longqiu Waterfall.
description: 賨人谷位于四川达州。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 13 km east of Qu County town, around 20 minutes by road; the nearest expressway exit is 2.5 km away.

name: 金山
summaryEn: Jinshan is a wooded hill in Pu'an town, a few kilometres west of Kaijiang county town, centred on Jinshan Temple, a Buddhist monastery. It is a local destination for temple visits and walks in the surrounding woods.
description: 金山位于四川达州。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、林地风光、佛教文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: A few kilometres west of Kaijiang county town, a short taxi ride.

name: 神剑园
summaryEn: Shenjianyuan, in Luojiang town north-east of Dazhou city, is built around the childhood home of Zhang Aiping (1910–2003), a Red Army veteran who later directed China's early nuclear tests and served as defence minister. Exhibition halls on Zhang, on other Dazhou-born commanders and on the Red Army in the region hold about 1,200 items.
description: 神剑园位于四川达州。游览特色包括主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 15 km north-east of central Dazhou, around 30 minutes by road.

name: 万源红军公园
summaryEn: On Tuoshan hill above Wanyuan city, this memorial park commemorates the 1934 Defence of Wanyuan, when the Red Fourth Front Army held the area against Sichuan warlord forces. At its centre, the Defence of Wanyuan war-history exhibition hall presents the campaign.
description: 万源红军公园位于四川达州。游览特色包括主题展览、历史纪念。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Wanyuan city, about 2 hours by train or road north-east of Dazhou.

name: 乌梅山
summaryEn: A 17.75 km² rural area around Baijie, south of Dazhou, centred on orchards of mume trees grown for wumei, the smoked dried fruit, which blossom in January–February and ripen in May–June. Besides orchards and flower fields it takes in Baijie old street, founded in 1614, with a fig tree over 200 years old, the character 'Kui' carved into a cliff in 1835, the Wumei Lake reservoir and the walls of the hilltop Pingding fort. Most visitors come for the winter blossom and local plum products.
description: 乌梅山位于四川达州。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Baijie town, a little over 20 km (about 40 minutes by car) from central Dazhou.

name: 洋烈水乡
summaryEn: An open rural leisure area of about 6.8 km² along the Zhou River near Xuanhan, developed since 2013. It strings together the Yanglie village centre with displays of Ba culture, a riverside promenade, the Yuzixi wetland park, a cycle path, flower fields used as a wedding-photo base and a play area called Ba People's Happy Valley. It is a suburban outing spot, best in spring and autumn.
description: 洋烈水乡位于四川达州。游览特色包括湿地、水乡。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 8 km from Xuanhan county town and 12 km from central Dazhou, around 20–30 minutes by car.

name: 金色清平
summaryEn: A mountain leisure area around Qingping, a small town in the Longmen Mountains north-west of Mianzhu, where a former mining district has been turned into a tourist area. Old mine tracks now carry a vintage-style steam sightseeing train, and the town promotes forest walks, a pleasant mountain climate and a mix of Qiang and Han folk culture. It suits a day or an overnight stay in the mountains rather than sightseeing.
description: 金色清平位于四川德阳。游览特色包括民俗文化、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About an hour by road north-west of Mianzhu city.

name: 九龙山—麓棠山
summaryEn: A rural tourism belt along the foot of the Longmen Mountains west of Mianzhu, spread over several townships. It combines the Jiulong village tourism area with farm restaurants and hill walks, the China Rose Valley, a large Damask rose plantation, and the Lutang hot-spring resort, fed by a natural thermal spring. It suits a relaxed day of countryside, flowers and bathing rather than sightseeing.
description: 九龙山—麓棠山位于四川德阳。游览特色包括田园观光、山谷、村落风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20–30 minutes by road west of Mianzhu city.

name: 易家河坝
summaryEn: A village-run leisure area at Youyi village in Sanshui town, where the Yazi, Shiting and Mianyuan rivers meet east of Guanghan, built up around fish ponds, orchards and farmland. Weekend visitors come for angling, fruit picking, farm meals and a water park, and the village is a national leisure-fishery demonstration base. It is a local family outing rather than a sight in its own right.
description: 易家河坝位于四川德阳。游览特色包括水上游乐、果园、田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 minutes by road east of central Guanghan.

name: 十八军窑洞群遗址
summaryEn: In 1951, soldiers of the People's Liberation Army's 18th Army dug cave dwellings into a hillside about 4 km from Ganzi town while building Ganzi airfield, in support of the army's march into Tibet. More than a thousand caves survive across the slope, and a small cave museum at the site explains how they were built.
description: 十八军窑洞群遗址位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括博物馆、洞穴。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 4 km from Ganzi town beside the G317 highway; carry your passport, as it is checked at police checkpoints on the roads into western Ganzi.

name: 巴格嘛呢墙
summaryEn: The Bage Mani Wall is a long wall built entirely of stones carved with Buddhist mantras and images, running across the grassland of Shiqu County. Together with the Songge (Gsumge) Mani Stone Castle it is protected as a national heritage site dating from the Ming and Qing dynasties, and local Tibetans still add carved stones and walk around it as an act of devotion.
description: 巴格嘛呢墙位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括草原、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Changshagongma township, roughly an hour or more by road north of Shiqu county town, which is about two days' drive from Kangding and closer to Yushu in Qinghai; carry your passport, as it is checked at police checkpoints on the roads into western Ganzi.

name: 查呈沟天浴温泉
summaryEn: A valley at Kemai village in Ranwu township, Xiangcheng County, where the county counts 108 hot springs between 17°C and 85°C within half a square kilometre. Bathing outdoors in the springs is an old local custom, which gives them the name Tianyu ('sky bath'), and the 4A area, rated in 2022, also takes in canyon pastures, alpine lakes and traces of the old tea-horse road. It lies on the Greater Shangri-La loop road between Daocheng and Shangri-La.
description: 查呈沟天浴温泉位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括温泉、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Ranwu township, roughly an hour by road south-east of Xiangcheng town, carrying your passport for checkpoints.

name: 邓玛湿地公园
summaryEn: Dengma Wetland Park takes in riverside wetland around Zhengke and Luoxu in the Jinsha River valley of southern Shiqu County, on the border with Tibet. At about 3,300 metres the Luoxu area lies well below the rest of Shiqu, a county whose plateau averages more than 4,000 metres and which is among the most remote parts of Sichuan.
description: 邓玛湿地公园位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括湿地、山谷、滨水景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Very remote: several hours by road south-west of Shiqu county town, itself about two days' drive from Kangding; carry your passport, as it is checked at police checkpoints on the roads into western Ganzi.

name: 多饶嘎目
summaryEn: A cultural park below Mount Zhara (Yala) near Tagong, rated 4A in February 2025 and built around the Minyak Tibetan culture of the area. It has a Minyak culture and arts centre, a tea-horse road trading hall and areas for Tibetan medicine, folk customs, nomad life, handicrafts and farming, while hot-spring and guesthouse facilities are being developed. It works as an introduction to local culture on the road between Kangding and Tagong.
description: 多饶嘎目位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括民俗文化、农业体验、手工艺。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tagong town, on the road between Kangding Airport and Tagong, about an hour and a half by road west of Kangding town; carry your passport for checkpoints.

name: 福地色达
summaryEn: A 4A cultural area listed at Luoruo, the township in the Larung valley of Serthar County, which until recently went by the name Waxu Tribe Cultural Tourism Area. Xinhua describes it as a living showcase of Tibetan culture, where local communities are still organised along traditional clan lines and customs from the Gesar epic era survive. Luoruo is also home to the Larung Gar Buddhist Academy, founded in 1980 and one of the largest Tibetan Buddhist academies, whose students' small red-painted dwellings cover the valley slopes.
description: 福地色达位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括山谷、书院文化、佛教文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km by road from Serthar county town, carrying your passport for checkpoints. Foreign visitors have not been admitted in recent years, so check the current rules before planning.

name: 格萨尔王城
summaryEn: A newly built cultural complex on the south-eastern edge of Garzê county town, begun in 2017, opened in 2019 and themed on King Gesar, hero of the Tibetan epic, with zones for Gesar culture, the epic, grassland and wetland. It forms one scenic area with the Yalong Bay wetland park along the Yalong River, which also offers farming and herding experiences. It suits travellers on the G317 interested in the Gesar epic tradition.
description: 格萨尔王城位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括湿地、草原。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside the G317 at the south-eastern edge of Garzê county town, about 385 km by road from Kangding; carry your passport for checkpoints.

name: 松格嘛呢石经城
summaryEn: The Gsumge (Songge) Mani Stone Castle is a rectangular mass of stacked mani stones, carved with mantras and Buddhist images, about 73 by 47 metres and 9 metres high, rising to 15 metres, on the Zachuka grassland of Shiqu County. Built without any frame or mortar, it hides a maze of narrow corridors around a central shrine to King Gesar and his generals. Local tradition links it to the Gesar epic, and carved stones from the 11th–12th centuries have been found within it.
description: 松格嘛呢石经城位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括草原、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Arizha township, roughly 1.5–2 hours by road north-east of Shiqu county town, which is about two days' drive from Kangding and closer to Yushu in Qinghai; carry your passport, as it is checked at police checkpoints on the roads into western Ganzi.

name: 康巴汉子村
summaryEn: A Tibetan village on the G318 at Xi'eluo, formerly called Jiezhu, which registered the name 'Kangba Hanzi' (men of Kham) as a trademark in 2005 and turned to tourism; it became a 4A area in 2022. Solid timber Tibetan houses line the valley, many now run as family guesthouses, alongside a Kham-style shopping street, with old ruins on Guogang summit and small lakes in the surrounding hills. It suits travellers on the Sichuan–Tibet road looking for a village overnight stop.
description: 康巴汉子村位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括山谷、特色街区、登山观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 60 km west of Yajiang county town along the G318, roughly an hour by road, carrying your passport for checkpoints.

name: 康巴文都
summaryEn: Kangba Wendu is a large, newly built culture park beside Dêgê town presenting the crafts and traditions for which Dêgê is known across Kham. Its many exhibition halls cover Kham culture, the Gesar epic, the southern school of Tibetan medicine and the region's traditional crafts.
description: 康巴文都位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括主题展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Bayiqiao, a few kilometres south-west of Dêgê town and a short drive from the Parkhang; carry your passport, as it is checked at police checkpoints on the roads into western Ganzi.

name: 卡萨湖
summaryEn: Kasa Lake is a freshwater plateau lake at roughly 3,510 metres, set among grassland and hills just off the G317, the northern Sichuan–Tibet highway, in western Luhuo County. It is the centre of the Liangquhe Scenic Area and a haunt of waterbirds, and makes an easy stop on the drive between Luhuo and Ganzi towns. Chonggu, the township around the lake, also has a site of the ancient stone-cist tombs for which Luhuo is known.
description: 卡萨湖位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括草原、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 30 km east of Ganzi town or 60 km north-west of Luhuo town on the G317, roughly 40 minutes or an hour by road respectively; carry your passport, as it is checked at police checkpoints on roads in western Ganzi.

name: 拉龙措
summaryEn: Lalong Tso is a national wetland park high on the plateau of eastern Baiyu County, where moraine-dammed lakes lie among glacier-polished rocks and boulders left by ancient glaciers. Its marshes and lakes are said to be a breeding ground for black-necked cranes.
description: 拉龙措位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括湿地、冰川。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Remote: reached via Nata township in eastern Baiyu County, several hours by road from Baiyu or Ganzi towns; carry your passport, as it is checked at police checkpoints on the roads into western Ganzi.

name: 勒通古镇
summaryEn: Litang's old quarter, on the north side of this high-plateau town at about 4,000 metres, covers roughly 1.5 square kilometres: some 4,000 Tibetan houses in 13 old villages, many still lived in by local families. At its heart is Renkang Street, where a traditional house is honoured as the birthplace of the 7th Dalai Lama, Kelsang Gyatso, and Litang Monastery stands on the hillside just above.
description: 勒通古镇位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括古镇、名人故居、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Litang town on the G318 highway, about 5–6 hours by road west of Kangding; carry your passport, as it is checked at police checkpoints on the roads into western Ganzi.

name: 木雅圣地
summaryEn: A tourist area west of Zheduo Pass in Kangding, presented as the first themed area devoted to the culture of the Minyak (Muya) Tibetans, in an area that was once a checkpoint on the tea-horse road. It takes in grassland and flower meadows, traditional herding pastures, viewpoints such as the 'Princess's Dressing Table' lake, and Ranti Monastery, a Tibetan Buddhist monastery said to be more than 600 years old. It is an easy stop on the Sichuan–Tibet road between Kangding and Xinduqiao.
description: 木雅圣地位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括草原、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside the G318 west of Zheduo Pass, about an hour by road from Kangding towards Xinduqiao; carry your passport for checkpoints.

name: 墨石公园
summaryEn: Moshi ('ink stone') Park is a forest of dark grey rock pinnacles near Bamei in Daofu County, standing out against the surrounding grassland. The stones are described as mylonite, rock crushed and sheared along the Xianshui River fault, which runs past Bamei, and then weathered into spires.
description: 墨石公园位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括草原、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 6 km from Bamei town on the road between Tagong and Daofu, under an hour's drive north of Tagong.

name: 青德藏乡田园
