summaryEn: Around Qingde, just south of Xiangcheng town, villages of whitewashed rammed-earth Tibetan houses stand among terraced barley fields in the valley. These white houses are a signature of the Xiangcheng area, on the road between Shangri-La and Daocheng.
description: 青德藏乡田园位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括山谷、田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 15 minutes by road south of Xiangcheng town, which is roughly 3 hours by road from Daocheng.

name: 桑堆红草湿地
summaryEn: In the river valley at Sangdui, north of Daocheng, shallow pools are filled with an aquatic grass that turns deep red in autumn. It is a popular photo stop beside the highway between Litang and Daocheng.
description: 桑堆红草湿地位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括湿地、山谷。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside the G227 highway at Sangdui, about 30 minutes' drive north of Daocheng town.

name: 措普沟
summaryEn: Tsopu is a high valley in northern Batang County whose sacred lake, Tsopu Lake, lies backed by snow peaks and forest. Smaller lakes and the small Tsopu Monastery lie nearby.
description: 措普沟位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括湖泊、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Turn off the G318 at Cuola, between Litang and Batang, and drive up the valley; allow about 3 hours from Batang town and carry your passport, as it is checked at police checkpoints on the roads into western Ganzi.

name: 伍须海
summaryEn: Wuxu Lake is a clear green barrier lake set among mountains about 25 km from Jiulong town, within the Mount Gongga national scenic area. It lies higher than the county town, itself at about 2,900 metres, so the air is thin and nights are cold even in summer.
description: 伍须海位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 minutes by road from Jiulong county town.

name: 新龙红山
summaryEn: The Red Mountains lie in Yinduo township in the north-west of Xinlong County. They are a high-altitude Danxia landscape of red rock ridges and cliffs strung out along a valley.
description: 新龙红山位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括山谷。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Remote: in Yinduo township in the north-west of Xinlong County, nearer to Ganzi town than to Xinlong town; allow a long day by road and carry your passport, as it is checked at police checkpoints on the roads into western Ganzi.

name: 亚拉雪山
summaryEn: Yala (Zhara Lhatse), the 5,820-metre sacred peak that dominates the Tagong grassland, also rises above Daofu County to the north, and this scenic area covers that northern side. It takes in forest, meadows and alpine lakes beneath the snowfields.
description: 亚拉雪山位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括草原、林地风光、高山景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About half an hour's drive east of Bamei, which is under an hour north of Tagong.

name: 藏巴拉花海
summaryEn: A flower-field and farm area at Hange village in Zhuosang township, south of Litang, beside the G227 road and next to the Haizishan nature reserve. Summer flower fields, starry night skies and farm sightseeing are the draw, with camping, horse riding, archery and fruit and vegetable picking, and guesthouses and restaurants are being added. It suits a stop on the drive south from Litang rather than a special trip.
description: 藏巴拉花海位于四川甘孜。游览特色包括自然保护区、花卉观赏、马术活动。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About an hour by road south of Litang town on the G227, carrying your passport for checkpoints.

name: 神龙山巴人石头城
summaryEn: A hill park on the southern edge of Guang'an's new town, rising about 81 metres above the city as its highest point. Its centrepiece is a fortress-like complex built from tens of thousands of massive dressed stone blocks, presented as a stronghold of the ancient Ba people on the old route between the Ba, Shu and Qin lands. The summit gives wide views over the city.
description: 神龙山巴人石头城位于四川广安。游览特色包括城堡、登山观景。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the southern edge of Guang'an, a short taxi ride from the city centre.

name: 柏林古镇
summaryEn: A small town in the south of Zhaohua District that grew up around the Bailin post station on the southern branch of the old Shu Road. A stretch of flagstone street survives, lined with timber-framed houses in the northern Sichuan vernacular style; local accounts also mention a Kuixing Pavilion, Guangshan Temple and Bailin Lake beside the town.
description: 柏林古镇位于四川广元。游览特色包括古镇、寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About an hour by road south of Guangyuan city.

name: 龙门阁
summaryEn: Longmen Pavilion is one of the best-known cliff-side plank-road sections of the ancient Jinniu Road near Chaotian, where the route between Qin and Shu was carried along the cliffs. The scenic area also takes in the Longmen stone forest and a group of caves.
description: 龙门阁位于四川广元。游览特色包括石林、楼阁建筑、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Near Chaotian town, about 40 minutes by road north of Guangyuan; easily combined with Mingyue Gorge.

name: 米仓山大峡谷
summaryEn: A canyon landscape in the Micang Mountains of northern Wangcang County, on the Sichuan–Shaanxi border, part of the natural divide between northern and southern China and rich in plant and animal life. Its forests are known for their autumn colour, with ridge trails, viewing platforms and lookout towers.
description: 米仓山大峡谷位于四川广元。游览特色包括峡谷、观景台。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 60 km north of Wangcang county town, roughly 2 hours by road.

name: 木门会议会址
summaryEn: Mumen Temple, built in the Kangxi reign of the Qing on a hillside above Mumen town in south-eastern Wangcang County, hosted a six-day conference of the Red Fourth Front Army's leaders in late June 1933, after which the army expanded rapidly in the Sichuan–Shaanxi base area. The temple now displays relics from the Red Army period.
description: 木门会议会址位于四川广元。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 38 km south-east of Wangcang county town, under an hour by road.

name: 平乐旅游区
summaryEn: A rural scenic area at Yuanba, south-east of Guangyuan city, built around Pingle Temple and said to take in the wooded Qifeng Gorge and Ziyun Lake. It is mainly a local weekend escape for walks in the gorge, with the temple adding some interest.
description: 平乐旅游区位于四川广元。游览特色包括峡谷、寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 minutes by road south-east of central Guangyuan.

name: 青溪古城
summaryEn: A small walled town on the upper Qingzhu River at the foot of Motian Ridge, close to where Guangyuan, Mianyang and Gansu meet, with surviving stretches of Ming city wall and lanes of timber houses in the northern Sichuan style. It is the base for the Tangjiahe reserve and for walks on the Yinping Road, the mountain route by which the Wei general Deng Ai's army entered Shu in 263.
description: 青溪古城位于四川广元。游览特色包括古城。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 3 hours by road west of Guangyuan via Qingchuan county town.

name: 红军城
summaryEn: The old streets of Donghe, the Wangcang county town, which from November 1934 housed the Red Fourth Front Army's headquarters and more than 40 party, government and military bodies, making it the centre of the Sichuan–Shaanxi base in its final phase and the army's assembly point for the Long March. Three main streets and two lanes of Qing-era timber houses survive, and small memorial halls occupy former headquarters buildings.
description: 红军城位于四川广元。游览特色包括纪念展览、历史纪念、特色街区。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Wangcang county town, about 1.5 hours by road east of Guangyuan.

name: 曾家山
summaryEn: A karst upland in Chaotian District, mostly 1,300–1,400 m above sea level, where stone forests, sinkholes, gorges and caves are scattered among farmland and forest. Its cool summers have made it one of northern Sichuan's main summer retreats, with a great many guesthouses and farm stays, and it often sees snow in winter.
description: 曾家山位于四川广元。游览特色包括峡谷、石林。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About an hour by road north-east of Guangyuan city.

name: 大渡河金口大峡谷
summaryEn: A deep gorge of the Dadu River in mountainous Jinkouhe District, listed both as a 4A scenic area and as a National Water Conservancy Scenic Area. The Chengdu–Kunming railway threads along the canyon through tunnels, and Guancunba station, built in 1966 in the canyon, sits partly inside a tunnel. Jinkouhe District is almost entirely mountain, with nearly 2,800 m between its lowest and highest points.
description: 大渡河金口大峡谷位于四川乐山。游览特色包括峡谷。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Roughly 2–3 hours by road west of Leshan, or by the slow train from Emei towards Puxiong, which stops at Guancunba station in the canyon. Jinkouhe is one of the few districts in China still closed to foreign nationals, so foreign visitors have not been admitted in recent years; check the current rules before planning.

name: 乌木文化博览苑
summaryEn: A large museum in Suji town devoted to wumu, the dark timber formed when ancient trees were buried in old riverbeds by earthquakes, floods or landslides. Its halls show raw buried trunks alongside wumu carvings, and one hall lets you watch carvers at work. Suji lies on the road between Leshan and Mount Emei, so the museum is an easy stop between the two.
description: 乌木文化博览苑位于四川乐山。游览特色包括博物馆、地震纪念、古树。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Suji town, about 15 km west of central Leshan, roughly 30 minutes by taxi or bus.

name: 沐川竹海
summaryEn: Muchuan county in the hills of southern Leshan is thickly covered in bamboo, and this scenic area beside National Road 213 near Yongfu town showcases it. Roads and paths lead through bamboo-covered ridges, valleys and streams.
description: 沐川地处乐山南部丘陵，景区以成片竹林与竹乡环境为特色。
accessEn: Near Yongfu town on National Road 213, about 2 hours by road south of Leshan.

name: 农夫山泉峨眉山工业旅游区
summaryEn: A working bottled-water plant of the Nongfu Spring company in Gaoqiao town, at the foot of Mount Emei, opened to visitors as an industrial tourism site. Tours show the production line for natural drinking water and spring-water testing, along with displays on the company and its water source, and the site is used for school study trips. It suits families and anyone curious about modern manufacturing more than scenery seekers.
description: 农夫山泉峨眉山工业旅游区位于四川乐山。游览特色包括工业参观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Gaoqiao town west of Emeishan city, about half an hour by taxi from the city centre.

name: 四川旅博天地
summaryEn: A modern complex of about 87 hectares in the eastern new district of Emeishan city that combines exhibition, culture and tourism venues with city shopping. It is of most use to travellers already staying in Emeishan, rather than a destination in its own right.
description: 峨眉山市东部新区的综合场馆集旅游会展、文化展示与休闲功能于一体。
accessEn: In the eastern new district of Emeishan city, a short taxi ride from the centre.

name: 世界茉莉博览园
summaryEn: A jasmine-themed agricultural park in Qingxi town that opened in 2020, with a core area of about 87 hectares planted with more than 120 jasmine varieties. Qianwei is a major jasmine-growing county, with about 5,700 hectares of jasmine supplying the scented-tea trade. It is a rural flower park rather than a historic site, best for those interested in tea and gardens.
description: 世界茉莉博览园位于四川乐山。游览特色包括田园观光、花卉观赏、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Qingxi town, Qianwei County, about an hour by road south-east of Leshan.

name: 会理古城
summaryEn: Huili, in the far south of Liangshan near the Yunnan border, has been a county seat since the Western Han dynasty and was named a national historic and cultural city in 2011. Its old quarter keeps lanes of traditional shopfronts and courtyard houses, entered through the north gate tower, Gongji Lou.
description: 会理古城位于四川凉山。游览特色包括古城、楼阁建筑、传统民居。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Huili is roughly 2–2.5 hours by expressway south of Xichang; the old town is in the city centre.

name: 会理会议纪念地
summaryEn: In May 1935, after crossing the Jinsha River on the Long March, the Red Army spent about two weeks around Huili, and the Communist Party's Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Tiechang on the outskirts of the town. The meeting site is now a memorial area presenting this stage of the Long March.
description: 会理会议纪念地位于四川凉山。游览特色包括历史旧址。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Tiechang, about 5 km north-east of Huili's old town, a short drive away.

name: 建昌古城
summaryEn: Jianchang is the old name of Xichang, and its old town on the north side of the modern city keeps stretches of the former city wall and the Datong Gate, with lanes of older houses, teahouses and snack stalls inside. It makes an easy evening stroll after a day at Qionghai Lake.
description: 建昌古城位于四川凉山。游览特色包括古城、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Xichang, a short taxi ride from the railway stations and Qionghai Lake.

name: 凯地里拉温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in Pisha town, Ningnan County, in southern Liangshan. The Liangshan government describes a naturally flowing spring of about 70°C rich in fluoride and other minerals, feeding dozens of linked outdoor pools, and the resort also has private spring courtyards and a self-drive camp. It draws visitors from Yunnan and Panzhihua and suits a rest stop on a road trip through the region.
description: 凯地里拉温泉位于四川凉山。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Pisha town, about 3 km from the centre of Ningnan county town.

name: 马湖
summaryEn: Mahu is a deep mountain lake in Leibo County, in the far east of Liangshan, formed where glaciers dammed an old river valley and measured in 1982 at 134 metres at its deepest point. Forest covers the surrounding hills, and the Menghuo Hall by the lake is a provincial heritage site. It is a quiet stop well away from the main tourist routes.
description: 马湖彝名哈琅署火，是中国的一个高原淡水湖，位于中华人民共和国四川省雷波县东北面47公里处，是四川省级风景名胜区、省级地质公园，湖区的孟获殿还是是四川省文物保护单位。1982年6月，中国科学院南京地理所用超声波测得马湖最大水深为134米。
accessEn: About an hour by road north-east of Leibo town.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0
imageCredit: 雷馬峨屏調查記，常隆慶, 施懷仁, 俞德浚著，中國西部科學院，1935

name: 彝海
summaryEn: Yihai is a small mountain lake in northern Mianning County where, on 22 May 1935, during the Long March, the Red Army commander Liu Bocheng and Xiaoyedan, a leader of the local Yi Guoji clan, swore brotherhood in a blood oath, allowing the army to pass through Yi territory. The meeting place on the grassy slope above the lake is a protected heritage site, and the episode is known in China as the Yihai Alliance.
description: 彝海位于四川凉山。游览特色包括湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About an hour by road north of Mianning town.

name: 董允坝·伞乡
summaryEn: A rural scenic area at Fenshuiling town, Jiangyang district, combining the Dongyunba national modern-agriculture demonstration park with Sanli ('umbrella village'), a new rural-community street of about 1.1 km built in old-street style and hung with oil-paper umbrellas. Fenshui oil-paper umbrella making, a craft with some 400 years of history, is on China's national intangible heritage list, and the street has an umbrella museum, umbrella-making experiences and hanfu costume shops. It suits craft enthusiasts and photographers.
description: 董允坝·伞乡位于四川泸州。游览特色包括非遗文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Fenshuiling town, east of central Luzhou, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 凤凰湖
summaryEn: A winding reservoir lake with more than ten islands in Naxi district, south-west of Luzhou, set within some 30 km² of forested hills. The surrounding area takes in gorges, rock formations, waterfalls and caves among forest and bamboo, along with waterside villages and a liquor-making estate. It suits a quiet day in the countryside from Luzhou.
description: 凤凰湖位于四川泸州。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 40 minutes by road south-west of central Luzhou; the expressway has a Fenghuang Lake exit.

name: 黄荆老林
summaryEn: A large forested upland in northern Gulin county, protected as a national forest park and a provincial nature reserve, with extensive subtropical evergreen broadleaf forest. Its best-known sight is Bajiedong, a chain of eight waterfalls and rapids along a gorge, and trails lead past streams, deep pools and old trees.
description: 黄荆老林位于四川泸州。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About an hour by road north of Gulin county town, or roughly 3 hours from central Luzhou.

name: 天仙硐
summaryEn: A densely forested danxia landscape of red sandstone cliffs, valleys, streams and stepped waterfalls in Naxi district, south of Luzhou. Local legend says the goddess Jiutian Xuannü once lived here, giving the area its name, and the scenic area also takes in the small old town of Ledao on the Yongning River, with streets of Ming and Qing houses.
description: 天仙硐位于四川泸州。游览特色包括瀑布、林地风光、砂岩地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About an hour by road south of central Luzhou, via Naxi.

name: 中国泡菜城
summaryEn: An industrial zone in Chongli, Dongpo District, where about a hundred companies in the Sichuan pickle (paocai) industry are clustered, run as a 4A industrial-tourism area. Visitors can see the China Paocai Museum, opened in 2012, upgraded in 2018 and described as the country's only museum devoted to pickles, walk a pickle-themed shopping street and view some factory production lines. It suits food-minded travellers already visiting Meishan.
description: 中国泡菜城位于四川眉山。游览特色包括博物馆、特色街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Chongli town on the outskirts of Meishan, a short taxi ride from the city centre; Meishan is about half an hour from Chengdu by high-speed train.

name: 柳江古镇
summaryEn: An old market town in the hills of western Hongya County, with timber stilt houses along its river and lanes of older shops and homes. Its best-known building is Zengjiayuan, a family mansion completed in 1937 and now a national heritage site. The town lies on the way to Mount Wawu and is often combined with it.
description: 柳江古镇位于四川眉山。游览特色包括古镇、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About an hour by road west of Hongya county town, or roughly 2.5–3 hours from Chengdu.

name: 彭祖山
summaryEn: A wooded hill in Pengshan District linked to Pengzu, a figure of Chinese legend said to have lived for about 800 years and revered as a symbol of long life. The scenic area includes a tomb and shrine attributed to him, a grove and the neighbouring Xiannü (Fairy) Mountain.
description: 彭祖山位于四川眉山。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jiangkou, Pengshan District, about an hour by road south of Chengdu.

name: 仁寿城市湿地公园
summaryEn: A public wetland park in Renshou county town, one link in a chain of waterways and parks the county has laid out through the town. It has open water and wetland planting with shaded footpaths, and a musical fountain plays on weekend and holiday evenings. It is a local leisure park, worth a stroll if you are staying in Renshou.
description: 仁寿城市湿地公园位于四川眉山。游览特色包括湿地、公园休闲。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Renshou county town, about an hour and a half by road south of central Chengdu.

name: 佛爷洞
summaryEn: A karst cave in Dakang town, north-west of Jiangyou, with chambers of stalactites, stalagmites and rimstone pools and an underground river toured by boat. Its name refers to a Buddha-like stalagmite said to have been found in the underground river in the Republican era, and it is promoted as a filming location for the 1986 television series Journey to the West.
description: 佛爷洞位于四川绵阳。游览特色包括洞穴、喀斯特地貌、钟乳石。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 20–30 minutes by road north-west of Jiangyou city; a taxi or own transport is easiest.

name: 李白故居
summaryEn: Qinglian is traditionally held to be the boyhood home of Li Bai, whose family is said to have settled here around 705, when he was about five. The site groups the Longxi Yuan, where he is said to have studied as a child, with the Taibai Shrine, the Fenzhu Lou and other places tied to his family. The Longxi Yuan was founded in the Northern Song, rebuilt under the Qing and badly damaged in the 2008 earthquake.
description: 李白故居位于四川绵阳。游览特色包括名人故居、地震纪念。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Qinglian town, about 20 minutes by road south of Jiangyou city.

name: 九皇山
summaryEn: A limestone mountain area in eastern Beichuan County known for the Ape King Cave and other karst caves. A cable car serves the slopes, and the scenic area adds walkways and Qiang-style buildings.
description: 九皇山位于四川绵阳。游览特色包括洞穴、喀斯特地貌、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 70 km, or roughly 1.5 hours by road, north-west of Mianyang via Guixi town.

name: 罗浮山
summaryEn: An isolated, steep and wooded hill in western Anzhou District, raised from an ancient seabed by tectonic movement, which in mist seems to float in the clouds. Close by are the Luofushan hot-spring resort and the Feiming Chan Monastery, a Buddhist site founded in the Tang dynasty. It is mainly a hot-spring and walking weekend destination for people from Mianyang.
description: 罗浮山位于四川绵阳。游览特色包括林地风光、寺庙建筑、佛教文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In western Anzhou District, about an hour by road west of Mianyang.

name: 寻龙山
summaryEn: A small scenic area of eroded conglomerate rock beside the new Beichuan county town, with rock forests, a waterfall and a cave explored by boat. It also has Longyin Town, a film-set street built in the style of a Republican-era Sichuan town.
description: 寻龙山位于四川绵阳。游览特色包括瀑布、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Close to the new Beichuan county town (Yongchang), about 40 minutes by road west of Mianyang.

name: 两弹城
summaryEn: From 1969 to 1992 this compound at the foot of Changqing Mountain was the headquarters of the Ninth Academy, now the China Academy of Engineering Physics, the institute that developed China's nuclear weapons. Its preserved buildings include the auditorium, the headquarters offices, the archive and the house where the physicist Deng Jiaxian lived, and the Sichuan Two Bombs City Museum, opened to the public in 2024, presents the history of the nuclear weapons programme.
description: 两弹城位于四川绵阳。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 15 minutes by road from Zitong town, which is roughly an hour's drive north-east of Mianyang.

name: 维斯特农业观光园
summaryEn: A modern-farming showcase on the edge of Yongchang, the new Beichuan county town built after the 2008 earthquake. Smart greenhouses form a miniature eco-farm displaying mountain crops and farming technology, and hot-spring and hotel facilities are attached. It suits families and school groups more than general sightseers.
description: 维斯特农业观光园位于四川绵阳。游览特色包括田园观光、地震纪念、农业体验。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the edge of Yongchang, the new Beichuan county town, about 40 minutes by road from Mianyang.

name: 升钟湖
summaryEn: A large reservoir among the hills of Nanbu County, created by a dam begun in the 1970s, with a long, branching shoreline of wooded peninsulas and islands. It is best known in China for angling and hosts an annual international fishing competition. Boat trips on the lake suit those who do not fish.
description: 升钟湖位于四川南充。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Shengshui town, Nanbu County, roughly 2 hours by road north-west of Nanchong.

name: 天宫院
summaryEn: A temple in the countryside south-west of Langzhong dedicated to Yuan Tiangang and Li Chunfeng, two Tang-dynasty astrologers revered as masters of feng shui, who according to local legend chose their burial places here. The present buildings date from a Ming rebuilding of 1459, and Li Chunfeng's tomb lies on Wulongtai hill to the south. The scenic area adds a feng shui compass plaza and an old street.
description: 天宫院位于四川南充。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、民间传说。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the countryside south-west of Langzhong, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 西山风景区
summaryEn: A chain of wooded hills on the western edge of Nanchong's Shunqing district, laid out as a large park with paths, temples and views over the city. Its best-known building is the Wanjuan Lou, a library tower honouring Chen Shou, the Nanchong-born historian who wrote the Records of the Three Kingdoms; other sights include Qile Temple, a cluster of Eastern Han cliff tombs and the former headquarters of the Shunlu Uprising of the 1920s.
description: 西山风景区位于四川南充。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、楼阁建筑、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the western edge of central Nanchong, a short taxi ride from the city centre.

name: 周子古镇
summaryEn: A riverside town on the Jialing in Peng'an County, named in honour of the Song Neo-Confucian thinker Zhou Dunyi, who is said to have taught here; a shrine to him, a former Jiangxi guild hall and an old wharf survive among its lanes. The wider scenic area covers the river's wetland islands, where in the warmer months hundreds of water buffalo swim out to graze each morning, a sight promoted as the 'hundred oxen crossing the river'.
description: 周子古镇位于四川南充。游览特色包括古镇、湿地。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Peng'an county town, about an hour by road east of Nanchong.

name: 古宇湖
summaryEn: A large reservoir west of Longchang, officially Guyumiao Reservoir, listed as a National Water Conservancy Scenic Area. Its open water draws migratory birds in autumn and winter, including the rare Baer's pochard and black-headed gulls, and visitors can cycle around the lake. It makes an easy add-on to Longchang's stone memorial archways.
description: 古宇湖位于四川内江。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: A short taxi ride west of Longchang town.

name: 乐贤半岛
summaryEn: A peninsula in a loop of the Tuo River on the edge of Neijiang city, laid out as a riverside leisure area. Its Tashan Park has greenway paths with the river on two sides, and the Sanyuan Pagoda on its hill was first built in the Tang dynasty and rebuilt in the Jiaqing reign of the Qing. It suits an easy walk for anyone staying in Neijiang.
description: 乐贤半岛位于四川内江。游览特色包括古塔、滨水景观、绿道骑行。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the south-eastern edge of central Neijiang, a short taxi ride from the city centre.

name: 石板河
summaryEn: A shallow river that runs for around 7 km over a bed of solid rock, in the hills of the Weiyuan dome north-west of Weiyuan county. The water is mostly well below knee height, so the open stretch, with rapids and small waterfalls, is popular for wading and stream walks in summer; adventure activities have also been added.
description: 石板河位于四川内江。游览特色包括瀑布。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Close to the Lianjie exit of the Chengdu–Zigong–Luzhou expressway, roughly 40 minutes by road north-west of Weiyuan county town.

name: 世界无花果博览园
summaryEn: An agricultural park in Sifang village, Xiangyi town, built around fig growing, one of Weiyuan County's farm industries. It is described as China's first expo park themed on the fig industry, with dozens of fig varieties planted and a visitor centre, and the village has a small exhibition room on local history and fig growing. It suits families and those interested in farming rather than travellers looking for scenery.
description: 世界无花果博览园位于四川内江。游览特色包括田园观光、农业体验。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xiangyi town, Weiyuan County, about half an hour by road north of Zigong or an hour west of Neijiang.

name: 大千园
summaryEn: A hilltop park in Neijiang, the home town of the painter Zhang Daqian (Chang Dai-chien, 1899–1983), one of the best-known Chinese artists of the 20th century. It brings together a memorial hall to his life and the Zhang Daqian Museum, designed by the Barcelona architects EMBT and opened in 2019, beside the old Xilin Temple on the same hill.
description: 大千园位于四川内江。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑、纪念展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Neijiang's Dongxing district, a short taxi ride from Neijiang North station on the Chengdu–Chongqing high-speed line.

name: 阿署达四季花海
summaryEn: A flower park opened in January 2025 on the capped Majiatian tailings reservoir, where the Panzhihua steelworks piled ore waste for about 50 years until it was closed in 2022. More than 400 mu (about 27 hectares) of flower beds ring a central pool, laid out so that from above they form a kapok flower, the tree the city is named after, and there are also a small animal area, a garden restaurant, an open-air music plaza and a shopping street. It suits families and anyone curious to see how an old industrial site has been reused.
description: 阿署达四季花海位于四川攀枝花。游览特色包括水库、花卉观赏、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the eastern edge of Panzhihua's East district near the airport road, a short taxi ride from the city centre.

name: 二滩国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park of steep wooded hills around the reservoir of the Ertan hydropower station on the lower Yalong River. Its 240-metre double-curvature arch dam belongs to what was the largest power station China completed in the 20th century, and the lake shore, forests and viewpoints around it make an easy outing from Panzhihua.
description: 二滩国家森林公园位于四川攀枝花。游览特色包括森林公园、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About an hour by road north of central Panzhihua; the dam lies roughly 46 km from the city.

name: 格萨拉
summaryEn: A high plateau of meadows, forest and limestone country in north-western Yanbian County, on the border with Yunnan, where karst sinkholes, a stone forest and caves are the main sights. It lies around Gesala Yi Ethnic Township, and the culture of the Yi communities who live here is part of the draw.
description: 格萨拉位于四川攀枝花。游览特色包括石林、林地风光、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 120 km by mountain road from Panzhihua city (and a similar distance from Lugu Lake); allow most of a day for the round trip.

name: 傈僳梯田
summaryEn: Terraced fields climbing the hillsides around Xinshan, a Lisu ethnic township in the hills of Miyi County, worked by the Lisu for generations. They are most photogenic in late spring and early summer, when the flooded terraces reflect the sky, and the township also promotes stargazing and Lisu customs.
description: 傈僳梯田位于四川攀枝花。游览特色包括梯田。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the hills above Miyi county town, roughly an hour by winding road.

name: 中国死海
summaryEn: A salt-water resort in Daying County built over an ancient underground salt lake around 3,000 m below the surface, whose brine is pumped up to fill its pools. The water is over 22% salt, so bathers float easily as in the Dead Sea, and it comes out of the ground hot enough to be used for thermal pools. It is a family water park; the Zhuotong salt wells nearby show how brine here was once drilled by hand.
description: 中国死海位于四川遂宁。游览特色包括湖泊、水上游乐、盐湖风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the edge of Daying county town, about 45 minutes by road from Suining or 2 hours from Chengdu.

name: 观音湖·世界荷花博览园
summaryEn: Guanyin Lake is the stretch of the Fu River held back by the Guojundu dam in Suining, now a national wetland park of about 600 ha with three islands. On Shenglian Island, the park's core, the World Lotus Expo Garden grows more than 800 varieties of lotus and water lily from 23 countries and regions, which flower in summer. Visitors walk the island's boardwalks and the lakeshore, mostly in June–August for the lotus.
description: 观音湖·世界荷花博览园位于四川遂宁。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the Fu River in central Suining, a short taxi ride from the city centre; Suining is about an hour from Chengdu by high-speed train.

name: 七彩明珠
summaryEn: A large rural leisure area of about 9,400 mu (some 630 ha) in Yufeng town, Anju District, strung along the G318 road. It is divided into seven clusters, among them flower fields, peach and fruit orchards, farm villages, an egret island and a 'Huang E ancient town' themed on the Ming poet couple Huang E and Yang Shen, and it has a large outdoor training camp. It is a weekend spot for Suining families, with fruit picking in season.
description: 七彩明珠位于四川遂宁。游览特色包括古镇、岛屿、果园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yufeng town on the G318, about 40 minutes by road south-west of central Suining.

name: 舍得酒文化旅游区
summaryEn: The distillery of Shede Spirits at Tuopai town in Shehong, maker of the Tuopai and Shede brands of baijiu, opened to visitors as a 4A liquor-culture area. The company traces its roots to the Tai'an workshop of the late Qing dynasty and a distillery founded in 1940, and visitor routes take in brewing and starter-making workshops and the jar cellars where the liquor is aged. It suits travellers curious about how Chinese liquor is made.
description: 舍得酒文化旅游区位于四川遂宁。游览特色包括历史建筑、酿造文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tuopai town, Shehong, about 45 minutes by road north-west of Suining.

name: 射洪硅化木国家地质公园
summaryEn: A national geopark in the hills south of Shehong where fossilised tree trunks from the Jurassic period are exposed and protected where they lie. Footpaths lead past the fossil beds, and an on-site museum explains the geology; the scenic area is promoted under a Jurassic theme.
description: 射洪硅化木国家地质公园位于四川遂宁。游览特色包括博物馆、地质景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 30 minutes by road south of Shehong city, which is roughly an hour by road north of Suining.

name: 宋井桃源
summaryEn: A 4A area (2025) in Zhuotong Well town that pairs the Zhuotong salt-well site, where narrow-bore percussion drilling was developed in the Northern Song (1041–48), with a new Song-dynasty-themed village among peach orchards. The village has inns, craft and food stalls, campsites and well derricks set up in the fields to show the old technique, hosts a peach-blossom food festival and Song-style art events, and a small tourist train links the parts. It suits a half-day combined with the well site itself.
description: 宋井桃源位于四川遂宁。游览特色包括果园、节庆文化、赏花。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhuotong Well town, about 13 km (20 minutes by car) from Daying county town.

name: 飞仙关
summaryEn: A riverside pass in the mountains west of Ya'an that was a gateway on the Tea Horse Road, the old trade route that carried tea from Sichuan to Tibet. The pass and its Nanjie archway are protected as part of the national Tea Horse Road heritage listing, and the old Feixianguan bridge over the river is a provincial heritage site.
description: 飞仙关位于四川雅安。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、滨水景观、古道。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 20 minutes by road west of Ya'an, on the road to Lushan and Tianquan.

name: 花海果乡
summaryEn: An orchard district around Jiuxiang in Hanyuan County, where pear, peach, cherry and apricot trees flower each spring. It takes in the pear-blossom slopes around Jiuxiang, the peach orchards of Shuangxi and Shengou and the Confucian temple at Qingxi. It is mainly a spring blossom destination and can be combined with the Jiuxiang stone archway.
description: 花海果乡位于四川雅安。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、果园、花卉观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Around Jiuxiang town in Hanyuan County beside the Ya'an–Xichang expressway, about 2 hours by road south of Ya'an.

name: 灵关石城
summaryEn: A tourism district around Lingguan town in Baoxing County built on the local white-marble industry. It combines a stone-carving park where visitors can watch marble being worked, a stone-products street at a village rebuilt after the 2013 Lushan earthquake, a re-created Qingyi street and museum on the ancient Qingyi Qiang state, a wetland park laid out in the shape of a panda's head and the Lingjiu gorge with a natural Buddha-head rock and a seven-storey pagoda. It is a stop on the road to Baoxing and the panda country beyond.
description: 灵关石城位于四川雅安。游览特色包括博物馆、峡谷、湿地。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Lingguan town in southern Baoxing County, about 62 km (roughly 1.5 hours by road) north-west of Ya'an.

name: 龙苍沟
summaryEn: A national forest park in Yingjing county, about 196 km from Chengdu, valued for the diversity of its forest plants and its streams and waterfalls. The Diecuixi trail follows a creek through dense, often misty forest past cascades and viewing platforms, and the park is a popular summer escape from the heat.
description: 龙苍沟位于四川雅安。游览特色包括瀑布、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 45 minutes by road south of Yingjing county town, which is under an hour from Ya'an by expressway.

name: 月亮湖
summaryEn: A small lake and tea-garden leisure area at Jiefang village, Baizhang town, on Mingshan's tea-garden greenway. It has a wetland, fishing platforms, viewing decks, a crescent-moon landmark, walking paths, a square themed on the 'educated youth' sent to the countryside and a wedding-photo base. It is a local leisure stop, pleasant if you are travelling the tea greenway.
description: 月亮湖位于四川雅安。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Baizhang town, Mingshan District, about half an hour by road from Mingshan town.

name: 熊猫古城
summaryEn: A quarter of Muping, Baoxing's county town, developed from 2012 in traditional western Sichuan style and themed on the giant panda, which was first described to Western science from Baoxing in 1869. It contains a memorial hall to the Red Army's crossing of Jiajin Mountain on the Long March and a riverside walk with displays on panda evolution. It makes a convenient base for Dengchigou and the road north over Jiajin Mountain.
description: 熊猫古城位于四川雅安。游览特色包括古城、纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Baoxing county town, about 200 km by road from Chengdu via Ya'an or Lushan.

name: 硗碛藏寨
summaryEn: Qiaoqi, Baoxing county's only ethnic township, lies in a high valley above 2,000 metres at the head of the eastern branch of the Qingyi River, and most of its people are Tibetan. The scenic area pairs the village and its reservoir with Shenmulei, an area of ancient trees and forest trails higher up. The road continues north over Jiajin Mountain, crossed by the Red Army on the Long March in 1935.
description: 硗碛藏寨位于四川雅安。游览特色包括水库、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Roughly 1–1.5 hours by road north of Baoxing county town.

name: 王岗坪
summaryEn: A mountain area east of the Dadu River in Shimian county, climbed by a cable car about 3.5 km long. Its upper viewpoints face Gongga Shan, about 30 km away in a straight line, and are visited for sunrise on the snow peaks, seas of cloud and old rhododendron forest; there is also a small ski area.
description: 王岗坪位于四川雅安。游览特色包括林地风光、缆车观景、高山景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Roughly 4 hours by road from Chengdu via the Ya'an–Xichang expressway, leaving it near Shimian.

name: 云峰山
summaryEn: A forested mountainside about 4 km from Yingjing county town, spanning roughly 1,000 to 2,600 metres and centred on Yunfeng Temple, also known as Taihu Temple. Founded in the Tang dynasty, burned in the early Yuan and rebuilt from the mid-Ming onwards, the temple has mostly Qing-style halls. Its grounds are known for ancient Phoebe zhennan (nanmu) trees, including one promoted as about 1,700 years old.
description: 云峰山位于四川雅安。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 4 km from Yingjing county town, 10–15 minutes by taxi; Yingjing is under an hour from Ya'an by expressway.

name: 僰王山
summaryEn: A forested mountain area in Xingwen County named after the ancient Bo people, whose stone gateway and wall remains survive on the mountain; it is a provincial scenic area and part of the Xingwen UNESCO Global Geopark. Paths lead through large groves of moso bamboo, gorges and waterfalls to Feiwu Cave, two deep shafts linked by an underground stream, with a waterfall inside.
description: 僰王山位于四川宜宾。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、地质景观。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Bowangshan town, about 20 km west of Xingwen county town and roughly two hours by road from Yibin.

name: 佛来山
summaryEn: A pear-growing hill area near Changning town, centred on Foli village, part of a belt of some 12,000 mu of pear orchards. The trees flower white in March, and pears can be picked in summer, roughly from July to September. It makes a half-day outing from Changning or the nearby Shunan Bamboo Sea.
description: 佛来山位于四川宜宾。游览特色包括果园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 minutes by road from Changning county town, south-east of Yibin.

name: 七洞沟
summaryEn: A wooded gorge of the Mianxi River in Changning County, hemmed in by red sandstone cliffs with waterfalls and springs, and popular in summer for its 3 km rafting run. Within the scenic area are the Qigedong ('Seven Caves') Eastern Han cliff tombs, a national heritage site, and a glass footbridge.
description: 七洞沟位于四川宜宾。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Guhe town, about 15 km north-east of Changning town and roughly an hour by road from Yibin.

name: 尖山
summaryEn: A rural hill area of 2.86 km² in Rongbian town outside Zigong, more than 70% wooded, best known for its peach orchards and the peach-blossom fair that opens each March. A 2020 revamp added lakes, flower beds for every season, a fishing ground, a poetry gallery, a suspended boardwalk, zip lines and other outdoor activities, alongside farmhouse restaurants. It is a local day-out spot that suits families more than sightseers.
description: 尖山位于四川自贡。游览特色包括果园、林地风光、田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Rongbian town, Ziliujing district, south-west of central Zigong, around 30 minutes by car.

name: 宝森柠檬小镇
summaryEn: A lemon-themed farm park in Yanqiao village, Wenhua town, in Anyue, the county named China's home of lemons, rated 4A in 2023. Across about 3.2 km² it combines lemon orchards and a lemon exhibition hall with leisure facilities and accommodation, and it is promoted for spring outings and family breaks. It can be paired with the Anyue rock carvings, the main reason most visitors come to the county.
description: 宝森柠檬小镇位于四川资阳。游览特色包括果园、农业体验、主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Wenhua town near the Anyue exit of the Chengdu–Anyue–Chongqing expressway, about 11 km from Anyue county town and roughly 130 km from Chengdu.

name: 多彩万象
summaryEn: A modern resort-style leisure complex on Xihang Avenue in Anshun's economic development zone, combining entertainment, holiday accommodation, business conferencing and wellness-themed attractions. It is a purpose-built leisure development rather than a historic or natural site.
description: 多彩万象位于贵州安顺。游览特色包括休闲度假。
accessEn: On the western side of Anshun, in the Xihang area of the economic development zone, about 9 km south-west of the city centre. Check that it is open before going.

name: 高荡布依古寨
summaryEn: A Buyei village near the Huangguoshu waterfalls where more than 120 houses are built of stone, with flagstone lanes and stone-slab roofs; experts date the settlement to the Ming dynasty. It has a Buyei folk museum with over 3,000 everyday objects, a central square used for festivals such as the sixth day of the sixth lunar month, and some restored houses run as homestays. Its historic buildings are protected at provincial level.
description: 高荡布依古寨位于贵州安顺。游览特色包括博物馆、瀑布。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Ningxi subdistrict, Zhenning county, about 7 km west of the county town (10 km by road) and not far from Huangguoshu.

name: 格凸河
summaryEn: A karst river-and-cave scenic area in Ziyun county, with limestone hills, large cave arches and a river running through. It is divided into the Dachuandong (Big Through-cave), Xiaochuandong (Small Through-cave), Dahe (river) and Yaoyan sections plus several separate sights, with Miao villages along the river. It is also a well-known rock-climbing area.
description: 格凸河位于贵州安顺。游览特色包括喀斯特地貌、洞穴、石灰岩景观。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Ziyun Miao and Buyei autonomous county, about 70 km south-east of Anshun in a straight line, reached by road.

name: 关岭古生物化石群
summaryEn: A fossil park in Guanling county that protects the Guanling biota, a Late Triassic marine fauna more than 200 million years old, with ichthyosaurs, placodonts, turtles, sea lilies and ammonites among its fossils. Its main visitor area is under 1 sq km, within a much larger planned park area. The park is used for school study trips.
description: 关岭古生物化石群位于贵州安顺。游览特色包括化石遗迹。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xinpu town, Guanling county, in the south-west of Anshun prefecture, reached by road.

name: 关岭九仙
summaryEn: A cave-themed leisure area in Yongning town, Guanling county, with a show-cave route and a separate water-recreation zone. It is a modern leisure attraction rather than a heritage site.
description: 关岭九仙位于贵州安顺。游览特色包括洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yongning town, Guanling county, in the south-west of Anshun prefecture, reached by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 旧州古镇
summaryEn: A historic town in Xixiu district that was once the seat of the old Anshun prefecture and is a China Historic and Cultural Town, home to tunbao people descended from Ming-era soldiers. Its four main streets keep many Ming and Qing courtyard houses of stone walls, timber frames and stone-slab roofs, restored in recent years in the original style, and local women wear Fengyang-style Han costume. Festivals such as the tunbao New Year, dixi processions and the City God procession are held through the year, and the old streets now hold more than 400 shops and other businesses.
description: 旧州古镇位于贵州安顺。游览特色包括古镇、传统民居、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jiuzhou town, Xixiu district, about 28 km east of central Anshun by road.

name: 黔山秀水
summaryEn: A countryside leisure park near Puding county town, built around a lake, with a camping base at the 'Twenty-four Pools', go-karts, a coloured slide and river drifting. Holiday events have included 'tieshui chonglong', a molten-iron dragon display listed as provincial intangible heritage. It is a suburban leisure base for family outings.
description: 黔山秀水位于贵州安顺。游览特色包括湖泊、非遗文化、公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 8 km from Puding county town, in the west of Anshun prefecture, reached by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 塘约村
summaryEn: Tangyue is a village in Leping town, Pingba district, promoted since about 2017 as a model of rural reform and poverty reduction. After a flood it registered land, forest, housing and water-works rights and pooled its farmland in a village cooperative, an approach known as the "Tangyue road". A visitor area opened in October 2017, and the village was named in the first list of national key villages for rural tourism in 2019.
description: 塘约村位于贵州安顺。游览特色包括田园观光、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Leping town, Pingba district, roughly 30 km north-east of central Anshun in a straight line, reached by road.

name: 天龙屯堡
summaryEn: A stone-built town in Pingba district, on the old route west to Yunnan, settled by Ming-era garrison soldiers from the lower Yangtze region; their descendants are known as Tunbao people. Its stone lanes and shops are open to visitors, local women wear the traditional Fengyang-style Han dress, and a performance ground stages dixi, a masked 'ground opera' of martial episodes from the Three Kingdoms and other heroic romances. Tiantaishan Wulong Temple stands on the hill about 2 km to the east.
description: 平坝通往云南的旧驿路旁，明代驻军聚落发展成今天以石构建筑闻名的屯堡。
accessEn: In Tianlong town, Pingba district, about 30 km north-east of central Anshun by road.

name: 小河湾
summaryEn: A waterside village in Xiayun town, Pingba district, billed by the provincial culture and tourism department as one of the prettiest villages in central Guizhou, with rapeseed and pear blossom in spring. It is run as a countryside leisure area with farmhouse restaurants, homestays and room for visitors to park RVs.
description: 小河湾位于贵州安顺。游览特色包括田园观光、赏花。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xiayun town, Pingba district, beside the Shanghai–Kunming expressway, about 55 km from Guiyang and 48 km from Anshun, both by road.

name: 夜郎洞
summaryEn: A karst scenic area in Biandanshan town, Zhenning county, upstream of the Huangguoshu waterfalls. It combines caves, a sinkhole, a canyon, a waterfall and primary forest with Buyei village culture, and festivals are held here each year on the third day of the third lunar month and the sixth day of the sixth.
description: 夜郎洞位于贵州安顺。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Biandanshan town, Zhenning county, roughly 40 km south-west of central Anshun in a straight line, reached by road.

name: 阿西里西大草原
summaryEn: Axilixi Grassland, also called Ertaipo, is a plateau of pasture in southern Hezhang at an average height of about 2,300 m, where cattle and horses graze beneath wide views and, in fair weather, seas of cloud. It opened to visitors in September 2019 and is best known for the 'Wave Road', a road that undulates over the hills and has made the area a self-drive destination; a small sightseeing train and campsites are among the other features. It is promoted together with Jiucaiping, about 15 km away, and the two are usually visited together.
description: 阿西里西大草原位于贵州毕节。游览特色包括草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In southern Hezhang County, about 40 km from Hezhang town by road, and some 15 km from Jiucaiping.

name: 大韭菜坪
summaryEn: Dajiucaiping ('big chive plateau') is a high plateau in south-western Hezhang between about 2,300 and 2,777 m, covered in wild chive plants whose purple flowers open from July and peak in August and September. Wind turbines, seas of cloud and karst rock walls add to the views, and the cool summers have made it a popular escape from the heat; the scenic area covers about 80 sq km. A second, higher summit, Xiaojiucaiping (2,900.6 m, the highest point in Guizhou), lies nearby on the Liupanshui side and has its own entrance.
description: 大韭菜坪位于贵州毕节。游览特色包括喀斯特地貌、登山观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In south-western Hezhang County, about 35 km by road from Hezhang town.

name: 方家坪
summaryEn: Fangjiaping is a mountain park in the Baili Dujuan district built around outdoor activities rather than flowers. The district's 2024 announcement lists more than 20 activities, including night-time programmes, RV camping, a rail-guided slide car and a cliff swing. It suits families and active visitors more than those looking for rhododendron blooms.
description: 方家坪位于贵州毕节。游览特色包括山地游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Baili Dujuan district, about 30 km east-north-east of Dafang town in a straight line; reached by road.

name: 拱拢坪国家森林公园
summaryEn: Gonglongping is a forest park of more than 1,700 hectares in the hills near Bijie, with forest cover that Bijie's government puts at 95 percent. Its main sights are Tuntianjing, a deep karst sinkhole, and a round stone 'echo platform' about 10 metres across. There is also a forest campsite among the trees, and the cool summer air is part of the draw.
description: 拱拢坪国家森林公园位于贵州毕节。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills of Qixingguan District, about an hour's drive from central Bijie.

name: 金海湖
summaryEn: Jinhai Lake is a lakeside and wetland park on the edge of the Jinhaihu New Area, between Bijie's Qixingguan District and Dafang, with more than 1,200 mu (about 80 hectares) of water. It has lakeshore paths, boats and camping lawns, and a gorge section with an old plank road and caves. It is a city-edge place for a short break rather than a long excursion.
description: 金海湖位于贵州毕节。游览特色包括峡谷、湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 25 km from central Bijie by road.

name: 奢香古镇
summaryEn: Shexiang Ancient Town is a newly built district in the north of Dafang, developed mainly as a poverty-relocation project for about 12,000 residents. Its tourist streets are built in Ming and Qing style with elements of local Yi manor houses, and include three themed shopping quarters, eight squares, ten art towers and a terraced flower garden. It is a place for an evening stroll, shops, food and performances rather than a historic old town.
description: 奢香古镇位于贵州毕节。游览特色包括古镇、花卉观赏、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the north of Dafang town, a county seat about 35 km east of central Bijie in a straight line; reached by road.

name: 彝山花谷
summaryEn: Yishan Flower Valley is a planted flower garden beside Pengcheng, the main town of the Baili Dujuan district, made to give visitors something to see after the rhododendron season ends. Bijie's 2026 visitor itineraries list a boardwalk through the flower beds, a small sightseeing train, a pet park and a bookshop among its attractions. It is a compact, family-oriented stop that works best combined with the main Baili Dujuan rhododendron areas.
description: 彝山花谷位于贵州毕节。游览特色包括山谷、花卉观赏、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Pengcheng area of the Baili Dujuan district, roughly 30 km east of Dafang town by road.

name: 油杉河
summaryEn: Youshanhe is a karst gorge and forest scenic area of about 67 sq km in north-eastern Dafang, one mountain range away from Baili Dujuan. Its best-known sight is Xianyu Peak, a rock tower rising from the river valley with water on three sides and an old temple on top; a glass walkway runs along the gorge, and the high meadow of Cuisuba, at about 1,700 metres, has a campsite and grassland walks. It is described as part of a national forest park and is promoted for cool summers and hiking.
description: 油杉河位于贵州毕节。游览特色包括峡谷、寺庙建筑、草原。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Yuchong township in north-eastern Dafang, roughly an hour and a half by road from Dafang town.

name: 中果河
summaryEn: Zhongguohe is a rafting resort on the Zhongguohe river in Zhongjian township, Qianxi, whose rafting course and themed viewpoints follow the 1990s film A Chinese Odyssey (Dahua Xiyou), with spots named after scenes in it such as the Moonlight Box and Dinosaur Valley. It was developed by a private company and, after being upgraded from 3A, became Qianxi's first 4A scenic area in 2021. Rafting is the main summer activity, and the township has guesthouses and hotels for an overnight stay.
description: 中果河位于贵州毕节。游览特色包括山谷、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhongjian township, about 50 km from Qianxi town by road and close to an expressway exit. Check that it is open before going.

name: 白马峪温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring and wellness resort in a mountain valley at about 1,340 m in Kaiyang county, where the climate is cool and often misty. Its courtyard-style buildings hold about 70 guest rooms, and the spring water runs at around 40 °C; the Guiyang government says it adds traditional Miao, Dong and Yao healing methods and Chinese-medicine health checks. It suits a quiet overnight stay away from the city.
description: 白马峪温泉位于贵州贵阳。游览特色包括温泉、山谷、泉水。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Baima village, Shuangliu town, Kaiyang county, about 55 km north of central Guiyang by road.

name: 多彩贵州城
summaryEn: A modern shopping, dining and entertainment district near Longdongbao airport, begun in 2011 and opened in 2014. It brings together a multi-ethnic culture display centre, a city air terminal, a creative park, an aquarium and many food and souvenir outlets, and the Guiyang government pitches it as the first or last stop on a trip to Guizhou. It suits a short visit before or after a flight.
description: 多彩贵州城位于贵州贵阳。游览特色包括水族展览、民族文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 2 km from Longdongbao airport and 10 km south-east of central Guiyang, served by Metro line 2.

name: 多彩贵州风景眼文创园
summaryEn: A cultural park beside Guiyang's Longdongbao airport that showcases Guizhou's intangible cultural heritage, open since July 2015. It combines exhibition spaces, shops, restaurants, a theatre and study programmes, and sits next to the Shuanglong ecological wetland park; the Guiyang government nicknames it the airport's park and a playground for intangible heritage. It suits a short stop before or after a flight.
description: 多彩贵州风景眼文创园位于贵州贵阳。游览特色包括湿地、非遗文化、戏剧演艺。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Xingye Street in the Shuanglong Airport Economic Zone, close to Longdongbao airport and south-east of central Guiyang.

name: 贵阳森林野生动物园
summaryEn: A forest wildlife park of about 5,000 mu (some 330 hectares) at the Zhazuo forest farm in Xiuwen county, home to more than 200 species and some 2,000 animals according to the Guiyang government. It is built around viewing and breeding wild animals, with a conventional funfair and a glass-sided water slide as extras. It suits family outings.
description: 贵阳森林野生动物园位于贵州贵阳。游览特色包括动物观赏、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the Guibi road in Jingyang subdistrict (formerly Zhazuo town), Xiuwen county, about 35 km north of central Guiyang by road.

name: 贵御温泉
summaryEn: A garden-style hot-spring resort in Wudang district that the Guiyang government presents as Guizhou's first open-air garden hot spring. Its pools include a children's area, herbal pools, a whirlpool, fish-therapy pools and a standard-size swimming pool, with water drawn from about 1,900 m underground at around 53 °C. It suits an easy soak close to Guiyang.
description: 贵御温泉位于贵州贵阳。游览特色包括温泉、园林景观。图集建议预留2–4 小时游览。
accessEn: On Wenquan Road in Xintianzhai, Wudang district, about 8 km from Longdongbao airport and 10 km from Guiyang railway station.

name: 孔学堂
summaryEn: A Confucian academy and cultural complex in Han–Tang style, opened to the public in 2013 in the middle of the Huaxi National Urban Wetland Park. A ritual axis runs from a statue of Confucius up to the Dacheng Hall and the Apricot Altar, and halls include an underground Confucius exhibition and a hall on Wang Yangming's years in Guizhou. The 4A area also takes in the Huaxi National Urban Wetland Park, a karst river-valley park of about 941 hectares.
description: 孔学堂位于贵州贵阳。游览特色包括湿地、山谷、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Huaxi Avenue in Huaxi district, about 18 km south of central Guiyang by road, with a metro station and a bus stop named after it.

name: 乐湾国际温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in the Lewan International development in eastern Wudang district. The Guiyang government describes its water as a silicic-acid spring drawn from nearly 3,000 m underground, with indoor pools that include herbal, rose, milk and sulphur baths, and a Chinese-medicine wellness hall. It is aimed at family outings and short wellness breaks.
description: 乐湾国际温泉位于贵州贵阳。游览特色包括温泉。图集建议预留2–4 小时游览。
accessEn: On Yudongxia Road in Dongfeng town, eastern Wudang district, on the north-east side of Guiyang. Check that it is open before going.

name: 南江大峡谷
summaryEn: A river canyon in Kaiyang county noted for karst cliffs, cascades and tufa formations, with some 40 waterfalls along its length. Provincial tourism authorities have counted more than 80 natural sights, and the canyon has long been promoted as a rafting destination with cliff-side walkways. It sits beside the Ten-Mile Gallery countryside, so it can be combined with Matouzhai village.
description: 南江大峡谷位于贵州贵阳。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Nanjiang township, Kaiyang county, about 55 km north-east of central Guiyang by road.

name: 南山天沐温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in traditional Chinese architectural style on a wooded hillside beside the Nanshan state forest farm in Yongjing town, Xifeng county, with pools laid out in cascading terraces. The Guiyang government counts 79 indoor and outdoor pools, 245 guest rooms and an indoor children's play area; the spring water, at about 48 °C, comes from around 2,500 m underground. In 2025 it was one of three Guiyang hot springs rated 'golden grade' under the provincial standard.
description: 南山天沐温泉位于贵州贵阳。游览特色包括温泉、林地风光、泉水。图集建议预留2–4 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xinluo village, Yongjing town, Xifeng county, about 60 km north of central Guiyang by road.

name: 蓬莱仙界
summaryEn: An agri-tourism site in Niuchang township, Baiyun district, built around the district's edible-mushroom industry. The mushroom-themed 'Moli Town' project adds recreation, restaurants, shopping, folk-culture experiences and accommodation, and the site is designated a city-level study base for school pupils. It suits family and school outings.
description: 蓬莱仙界位于贵州贵阳。游览特色包括田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Penglai village, Niuchang township, Baiyun district, about 20 km north of central Guiyang by road.

name: 保利国际温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort on the wooded edge of Wudang district, beside a five-star hotel and a small lake where visitors can feed black swans. The Guiyang government lists more than 40 indoor and outdoor pools, among them herbal, red-wine and vinegar pools, a starlit hydrotherapy hall, fish-therapy pools and water slides for children, fed by water at about 67 °C. It suits a family soak or half-day break near the city.
description: 保利国际温泉位于贵州贵阳。游览特色包括温泉、湖泊。图集建议预留2–4 小时游览。
accessEn: On Shunhai Middle Road in the Poly Hot Spring New Town area of Wudang district, about 8 km north-east of central Guiyang by road.

name: 黔贵六广温泉
summaryEn: A riverside hot-spring resort at Yangming Wharf on the Liuguang River canyon in Xiuwen county, built in terraces up the slope above the water. It combines hot-spring bathing with a hotel, restaurants, canyon boat trips and outdoor activities, and opened on a trial basis in January 2015. The Guiyang government says the spring water comes from about 1,800 m underground at 56–60 °C.
description: 黔贵六广温泉位于贵州贵阳。游览特色包括温泉、峡谷。图集建议预留2–4 小时游览。
accessEn: At Yangming Wharf in Liuguang town, in the north-west of Xiuwen county, about 80 km from central Guiyang by road.

name: 泉湖公园
summaryEn: A lake park of about 1,080 mu (72 hectares) in the south of Baiyun district, with some 205 mu of water and about 750 mu of planting. Its named sights include the Quanhu Secret Realm, the Jade Water Long Bridge and Cloud Tower, and the park serves as a green corridor between Baiyun and Guanshanhu districts. It suits an easy walk in the city.
description: 泉湖公园位于贵州贵阳。游览特色包括湖泊、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Baiyun district in the north-west of Guiyang, with a metro station named after the park.

name: 时光贵州
summaryEn: A modern themed town of about 140,000 square metres in Qingzhen, between Red Maple Lake and Baihua Lake, built in the style of 1940s Shanghai and old Guiyang architecture, with shops, restaurants and entertainment. The Guiyang government says four lanes (military, merchants, officials and townspeople) tell Guizhou's story, from the Triassic fossils shown on the town walls to the Ming-era Tunpu garrison-settler culture. It is a purpose-built attraction rather than a historic town.
description: 时光贵州位于贵州贵阳。游览特色包括湖泊、历史纪念、化石遗迹。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Qingzhen, about 30 km west of central Guiyang by road, near the junction of Guanqing Road and Baihua Road.

name: 四季贵州
summaryEn: A holiday resort complex in Qingzhen built around a water park and hot springs under a four-seasons theme. The Guiyang government describes a summer water park and winter bathing in natural hot springs, aimed at leisure and wellness stays.
description: 四季贵州位于贵州贵阳。游览特色包括温泉、水上游乐。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Qingzhen, about 30 km west of central Guiyang by road, at the junction of Baima Avenue and Qingzhou Avenue.

name: 天河潭
summaryEn: A karst scenic area in Shiban town, Huaxi district, named for a natural stone bridge that spans a pool where a river runs through its caves. Features include a dry cave and a water cave, the Beauty Pool waterfall and the Shibang cascade. It is a nature outing south-west of the city.
description: 天河潭，全称天河潭风景区，是中华人民共和国贵州省贵阳市花溪区石板镇境内的景区，距贵阳市中心24公里，距花溪13公里，总面积为15平方公里，是中国国家4A级旅游景区。
accessEn: In Shiban town, Huaxi district, about 30 km south-west of central Guiyang by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 万象温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort and hotel in Wudang district, north-east of central Guiyang. Indoor baths and a garden of nearly 50 outdoor pools are fed by spring water drawn from about 2,200 m underground at around 57 °C, according to the Guiyang government. It also has a spa centre, a children's water-play area and a hotel, so it works as a soak close to the city.
description: 万象温泉位于贵州贵阳。游览特色包括温泉、园林景观、泉水。图集建议预留2–4 小时游览。
accessEn: On Xintian Avenue in Wudang district, about 11 km from the centre of Guiyang by road, close to Wudang's commercial centre.

name: 乡愁贵州
summaryEn: A themed park on the Xiangchou campus of Qingzhen's vocational education city, in Zhanjie town, built around rural life and traditional farming culture. The Guiyang government says it draws on three strands: agrarian civilisation, the philosophy of Wang Yangming and the local reading-and-farming tradition. It is a purpose-built culture park rather than a historic village.
description: 乡愁贵州位于贵州贵阳。游览特色包括农业体验、村落风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Xiangchou Avenue in Zhanjie town, Qingzhen, about 30 km west of central Guiyang (roughly 45 km by road).

name: 羊昌·花画小镇
summaryEn: A flower-themed leisure park of about 789 mu (some 53 hectares) in Yangchang town, Wudang district. Its 20-odd attractions include a flower-art walking street, a flower hill, a lawn, an RV camp, a culture square about the Shuidong region and a garden recalling the 'educated youth' era. It also serves as a city-level labour-education base for school pupils, and suits family and school visits.
description: 羊昌·花画小镇位于贵州贵阳。游览特色包括园林景观、公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yangchang village, Yangchang town, Wudang district, about 40 km north-east of central Guiyang by road.

name: 阳明洞
summaryEn: The cave on Qixia Hill where the Ming philosopher Wang Yangming lived for about three years from 1508, after being exiled to the Longchang post station, and where tradition places the 'Longchang enlightenment' that shaped his later teaching, including 'unity of knowing and acting'. The cave carries inscriptions from the Ming, Qing and Republican periods, and the cultural park around it adds a memorial hall, a plaza and the Longgang Academy where he taught. The national listing also covers the Yangming Shrine in Guiyang city, a separate site.
description: 阳明洞，是一个小岩洞，位于中国贵州省贵阳市修文县城东栖霞山上，为王学圣地之一，现为全国重点文物保护单位。时任兵部主事的明朝大儒王守仁因触怒宦官权臣刘瑾，被廷杖四十后谪为龙场驿丞，时龙场地处偏远，少有人烟。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Qixia Hill beside Xiuwen county town, about 40 km north of central Guiyang by road.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 云漫湖
summaryEn: A family-oriented leisure park built around an artificial lake in the Gui'an New Area, formed by linking two reservoirs and opened in 2016. The main section, an eco-resort park of about 2,200 mu (some 150 hectares), is laid out in Swiss-style buildings with themed zones such as Wonder Island, Rainbow Garden, Adventure Forest, Valley of Wind and Roaming Hills, and by 2024 had added an artificial pink-sand beach and summer-evening events. It suits families wanting a lakeside day out from Guiyang.
description: 云漫湖位于贵州安顺。游览特色包括湖泊、水库、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Gui'an New Area, in Pingba district of Anshun, about 50 km by road south-west of central Guiyang.

name: 百车河
summaryEn: Baichehe is a river-valley resort area in Panlong town, Shuicheng, built around hot springs and promoted as a summer retreat. It has hot-spring baths, more than 90 homestays with about 1,500 rooms, a wetland park, riverside paths and family attractions such as slides and children's boats. It suits long stays and families rather than sightseeing.
description: 百车河位于贵州六盘水。游览特色包括温泉、湿地。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Panlong town, Shuicheng District, roughly 30 km south-east of central Liupanshui in a straight line; reached by road.

name: 哒啦仙谷
summaryEn: Dala Xiangu is a leisure-farming and rural-tourism area in Panzhou with a wetland park, a lake, about 300 mu (20 hectares) of coloured flower fields laid out in circular patterns, a cartoon-themed play area and a lakeside hotel. The name 'Dala' is given as a Buyei word meaning mutual help, and the agronomist Yuan Longping, known as the father of hybrid rice, visited and inscribed the name. It is a family leisure stop rather than a wild landscape.
description: 哒啦仙谷位于贵州六盘水。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Lianghe subdistrict, about 20 km north-east of Panzhou town in a straight line; reached by road.

name: 贵州三线建设博物馆
summaryEn: This museum in Liupanshui's Shuicheng old town is about the 'Third Front', the programme from the mid-1960s to relocate defence and heavy industry to the interior, in which Liupanshui became a coal and steel centre. The main building has seven exhibition halls, a separate hall uses sound and light to recreate factory floors, a workers' canteen and a supply cooperative, and large objects such as a steam locomotive stand outdoors. It opened in 2013 and holds more than 20,000 items.
description: 贵州三线建设博物馆位于贵州六盘水。游览特色包括博物馆、主题展览、历史街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Shuicheng old-town quarter of Zhongshan District, within the urban area of Liupanshui.

name: 回龙溪康养休闲度假旅游景区
summaryEn: Huilongxi is a spa and leisure resort beside Yanjiao old town, with hot-spring baths, a rafting course, a hotel and conference facilities, and ethnic-culture and entertainment attractions. The spring water is piped from the Mugong springs, a village known locally for longevity, and the area has a provincially protected group of late-Qing and Republican-era trading buildings.
description: 回龙溪康养休闲度假旅游景区位于贵州六盘水。游览特色包括水上活动、休闲度假、泉水。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Yanjiao old town, about 20 km north-west of Liuzhi town.

name: 落别龙井温泉度假区
summaryEn: Luobie Longjing is a hot-spring resort in the Luobie Buyei-Yi ethnic township, south-east of Liuzhi, with more than 60 soaking pools of different kinds, an indoor and outdoor water park, restaurants, rooms and meeting facilities. It is built for relaxing stays and family outings rather than sightseeing.
description: 落别龙井温泉度假区位于贵州六盘水。游览特色包括温泉、水上游乐。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Luobie township, roughly 15 km south-east of Liuzhi town in a straight line; reached by road.

name: 胜境温泉
summaryEn: Shengjing Hot Spring is a hot-spring resort of about 6.3 sq km in Liuguan subdistrict, Panzhou, combining indoor and outdoor pools with a waterfall, a wave pool, a cave-style soaking pool and a children's water park. The grounds also hold a lakeside park, a forest park, a sports park, a wetland park and a hotel with conference rooms. It suits families and groups wanting a spa stop.
description: 胜境温泉位于贵州六盘水。游览特色包括温泉、瀑布、湿地。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Liuguan subdistrict, about 15 km from Panzhou high-speed railway station by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 妥乐古银杏
summaryEn: Tuole is a village of about 1,400 old ginkgo trees in Shiqiao town, Panzhou, where wooden walkways, viewing platforms and a path through the old village have been built among the trees. The leaves turn gold in autumn, which is the busiest season, and stalls sell roasted ginkgo nuts and dried chestnut-rose fruit. It is a short, scenic stop that is easy to combine with Wumeng Grassland.
description: 妥乐古银杏位于贵州六盘水。游览特色包括草原、观景台、传统村落。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shiqiao town, about 13 km south-east of Panzhou town in a straight line; reached by road.

name: 小韭菜坪
summaryEn: Xiaojiucaiping ('small chive plateau') is the Liupanshui-side approach to the Jiucaiping range and its summit, at 2,900.6 m the highest point in Guizhou, on the border with Hezhang County. Wild chives cover the ridges, and the area has karst stone-forest rocks, caves and sinkholes, rhododendrons in spring and a well-known camping ground; the city also describes it as a provincial-level tourist resort. Hezhang's Dajiucaiping, with its own entrance, covers the neighbouring plateau.
description: 小韭菜坪位于贵州六盘水。游览特色包括林地风光、喀斯特地貌、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dawan town, about 52 km by road from Liupanshui railway station (roughly an hour's drive from the city centre, according to the city tourism page).

name: 玉舍森林公园
summaryEn: Yushe National Forest Park, in the hills of Shuicheng District south of central Liupanshui, is best known for Yushe Snow Mountain, which the city describes as Guizhou's first alpine ski resort. It has beginner, intermediate and advanced slopes, a snow-play area, snowmobile and cable-car rides, and has hosted youth alpine ski races; frost on the trees and frozen lakes are noted in winter. Outside the snow season the forest park is a cool place for walks.
description: 玉舍森林公园位于贵州六盘水。游览特色包括滑雪、森林公园。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: About 35 km from Liupanshui railway station, roughly an hour by road; the city tourism page lists a direct coach from the station.

name: 牂牁江
summaryEn: Zangke River is a broad stretch of river water in southern Liuzhi, about 51 sq km of water surface at around 724 m above sea level, with an outdoor-sports base at Laowang Mountain. The scenic area has a hotel and a Yelang culture exhibition centre, and has hosted international paragliding and kayaking events since 2012. The city also lists it as a provincial-level tourist resort.
description: 牂牁江位于贵州六盘水。游览特色包括水上活动。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: In Zangke town in the south of Liuzhi Special District, about 67 km from Liuzhi urban area by road.

name: 岜沙苗寨
summaryEn: Basha is a Miao village a few kilometres from Congjiang county town, home to nearly 2,800 people, whose residents have kept customs such as haircuts with sickles, tree worship and carrying muskets with special permission from the police. The scenic area has a visitor service centre, and visitors can watch staged performances including musket firing, sickle haircutting, dances and wedding customs. It was rated 4A in 2018.
description: 岜沙苗寨位于贵州黔东南。游览特色包括村寨。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 8 km from Congjiang county town, a short drive; Congjiang is served by high-speed rail.

name: 丹寨万达小镇
summaryEn: Danzhai Wanda Village is a purpose-built tourism town beside Donghu lake in the middle of Danzhai county, built by the Wanda Group under a 2014 poverty-alleviation agreement with the county and opened in July 2017. It is a modern development in Miao architectural style, with themed streets and squares, craft shops (a large share devoted to heritage crafts such as batik and traditional papermaking), lake boating, a glass bridge and hot-spring hotels. It suits visitors who want an easy introduction to local crafts rather than a historic village.
description: 丹寨万达小镇位于贵州黔东南。游览特色包括湖泊、玻璃栈道、乘船游览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Longquan town, in the middle of Danzhai county, about 55 km by road from Kaili, a little under an hour.

name: 高过河
summaryEn: Gaoguo River is a forested gorge river in Yangchang town, north-west of Zhenyuan, best known for summer rafting: a course of about 5 km that drops some 200 m past rapids, pools and waterfalls and takes three to four hours. The rafting ends near Sanzhai village, a cluster of Dong, Miao and Tujia hamlets with a Dong drum tower, a wind-and-rain bridge and stilt houses, where evening cultural shows are staged. The river area has been a provincial scenic area since 2000.
description: 高过河位于贵州黔东南。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yangchang town, about 35–40 km north-west of Zhenyuan old town by road; rafting is a summer activity (the 2026 season began in May).

name: 贵洞
summaryEn: Guidong is a rural scenic area in Jieping village, Bagong town, centred on a karst cave that local sources describe as about 4 km long, with stalactites, grooves and an underground stream. Only a first phase of the cave has been opened to visitors, lit in colour; around it are bamboo forest, a workshop showing traditional bamboo-pulp papermaking, farmland, a glass maze and an evening light show. The area was rated 3A in 2017 and upgraded to 4A in 2023.
description: 贵洞位于贵州黔东南。游览特色包括洞穴、林地风光、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jieping village, Bagong town, about 7.5 km by road from Sansui high-speed railway station, with the G320 road and the Shanghai–Kunming rail line passing the area.

name: 加榜梯田
summaryEn: The Jiabang terraces climb the steep slopes of Jiabang township in southern Congjiang, covering more than 10,000 mu (about 667 ha) along some 25 km, with Miao villages scattered among the fields. Plots are small, many holding only a row or two of rice, so the paddies follow the contours closely; rice is planted in spring and the terraces turn gold in early autumn. Each spring a Kaiyang festival, held on 19 April in 2026, marks the start of planting with a ritual led by village elders, farming demonstrations and a field-climbing race.
description: 加榜梯田位于贵州黔东南。游览特色包括梯田、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jiabang township, about 75 km from Congjiang county town, one to one and a half hours by road.

name: 剑河温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort in Wenquan village, Cengsong town, north-east of Jianhe county town, fed by six springs; the water comes out at about 38–53 °C and is a radon-and-sulphur type. It has more than 80 indoor and outdoor pools, a seasonal water park, a theatre with Miao-themed water shows, hotels and a shopping street in Miao and Dong style. It is a developed leisure resort aimed at holiday-makers rather than a sightseeing stop.
description: 剑河温泉位于贵州黔东南。游览特色包括温泉、水上游乐、特色街区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wenquan village, Cengsong town, about 5–7 km north-east of Jianhe county town, which is roughly an hour from Kaili by road.

name: 旧州古城
summaryEn: Jiuzhou is an old market town on the upper Wuyang River in Huangping county, long a trading and grain centre of eastern Guizhou. Its Ming and Qing buildings, a national heritage unit, include old houses on West Upper Street, the Renshou Palace, a Jiangxi guildhall built in 1786 with an opera stage, a Tianhou (Mazu) temple and a Catholic church. The Fuzhong Bridge, first built under the Ming, is a stone arch bridge of about 68 m and the largest ancient stone arch bridge in the county.
description: 旧州古城位于贵州黔东南。游览特色包括古城、寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Jiuzhou town, about 23 km from Huangping county town and 75 km (roughly an hour) from Kaili by road.

name: 蓝梦谷
summaryEn: Lanmenggu is a blueberry-growing park in Longshan town, Majiang, one of two blueberry parks (with the nearby Wukaping park) in the county's blueberry tourism area. Majiang began planting blueberries in 1999 and is now one of China's largest blueberry-growing counties. Visitors walk among the plantations and, in the picking season from about June to August, can pick berries; the park also offers jam-making and wine-making.
description: 麻江龙山镇的蓝莓种植园展示当地特色果业，游览以蓝莓园和农业景观为主。
accessEn: In Gonghe village, Longshan town, about 35 km by road south-west of Kaili, 30–40 minutes.

name: 龙鳌河
summaryEn: Long'ao River is a river valley in the north-west of Cengong county whose tourist stretch runs about 16.5 km, with gorges, waterfalls, caves and farmland. Boat trips run along the gorge from Aimenguan, a Ming-dynasty stone mountain gateway. Nearby are Majiazhai, a village of courtyard houses with carved stone flag-bases and old lanes, where people still live and farm, and the former command post of a Red Army corps.
description: 龙鳌河位于贵州黔东南。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shuiwei town, about 40–50 km (roughly an hour) by road from Cengong town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 隆里古城
summaryEn: Longli is a walled garrison town founded under the Ming in the late 14th century, when soldiers and their families from Jiangnan and Jiangxi were settled here. It keeps its city gates, sections of wall, cobbled lanes and dozens of old houses and clan halls, and many residents are descended from the garrison and still perform customs such as the painted-face dragon dance and Han opera at the New Year. Its Ming and Qing buildings are a national protected group, and the village is a National Famous Historic and Cultural Village.
description: 隆里古城位于贵州黔东南。游览特色包括古城、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 45 km from Jinping county town, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 下舞阳河
summaryEn: The lower Wuyang River runs from Gaobei Lake near Shibing down to Zhenyuan, within the Wuyang River national scenic area. This section is known for its gorges, notably Zhuge Gorge and Longwang Gorge and the Peacock Screen rock.
description: 下舞阳河位于贵州黔东南。游览特色包括峡谷、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Boats link Zhenyuan and Shibing along the river; two-way sailings began on 25 April 2026.

name: 翘街
summaryEn: Qiaojie, literally 'upturned street', is an old street about 1 km long in the centre of Liping, named because its middle dips and both ends rise like a carrying pole. It is lined with Ming and Qing brick houses with fire-break walls and old guildhalls, and today holds craft and snack shops. The Liping Conference site, a Qing-dynasty merchant's courtyard house where the Politburo of the Chinese Communist Party met in December 1934 during the Long March, stands in the street area beside a memorial hall; on 18 December the meeting decided to change the planned route towards the interior of Guizhou.
description: 翘街位于贵州黔东南。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、传统民居、历史建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In central Liping, which has an airport with flights from Guiyang and is about two and a half hours by road from Kaili.

name: 三门塘
summaryEn: Sanmentang is a Dong village on the Qingshui River, close to the Hunan border, that was long a timber-trading port. Its protected buildings, listed as Qing to Republican in date, include two ancestral halls, the Wang clan's Taiyuan Hall (rebuilt in 1908) and the Liu clan hall, with courtyard houses, wells, stone bridges, stone tablets and old trees around them. The group has been a national protected site since 2013.
description: 三门塘位于贵州黔东南。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、祠堂文化、传统民居。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Fenchu town on the Qingshui River, about 45 km by road from Tianzhu county town, roughly an hour.

name: 杉木河
summaryEn: Shanmu River is a clear mountain river in the Shibing karst World Heritage area, inside the Wuyang River national scenic area, and one of the three main scenic areas of Shibing Karst.
