It is best known for rafting: a course of about 9 km through a forested gorge with a mix of rapids and calm stretches, plus a section of about 2 km lit for evening drifts in summer. The water is described as meeting mineral-water standards.
description: 杉木河位于贵州黔东南。游览特色包括峡谷、林地风光、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 10 km north-west of Shibing county town, which has a high-speed railway station; rafting runs in summer (the 2026 season opened on 23 May).

name: 施洞
summaryEn: Shidong is a Miao market town on the middle Qingshui River, long a meeting place for the villages around it and a main venue for two festivals on China's national intangible-heritage list. The Sisters' Festival, on the 15th day of the third lunar month, centres on young women in silver headdresses and embroidered costume; the dragon-canoe festival, on the 24th to 27th of the fifth lunar month, features races between canoes made of three joined fir trunks with paddlers standing. The dates follow the lunar calendar, so check them before going.
description: 施洞位于贵州黔东南。游览特色包括节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the Qingshui River, about 20 km north of Taijiang town in a straight line and roughly an hour by road from Kaili.

name: 草塘千年古邑（猴场会议旧址）
summaryEn: Houchang, also called Caotang, is an old town in Weng'an developed as a tourism area; the prefecture lists some thirty sights there, including an opera tower, the former Qishan Academy and a jinshi (scholar) tower. It is best known for the Houchang Conference, a Communist Party Politburo meeting held here on 31 December 1934 and 1 January 1935 during the Long March. The courtyard where it met is preserved, with a memorial hall beside it, and the site has been a national protected site since 2019.
description: 草塘千年古邑（猴场会议旧址）位于贵州黔南。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、楼阁建筑、书院文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Houchang town, about 15 km north-east of Weng'an county town.

name: 都匀茶文化影视小镇
summaryEn: A tea-themed and film-set area in Duyun's eastern development zone which the city's tourism list describes as made up of the Qin-Han Film City, the China Tea Culture Expo Park and a Republic-era themed town. The Expo Park's gate hall, pagodas and pavilions are modelled on the Chinese pavilion at the 1915 Panama-Pacific International Exposition and house tea trading, a tea culture centre and a display of objects. The film sets are modern constructions, not historic buildings, and have hosted many television productions.
description: 都匀茶文化影视小镇位于贵州黔南。游览特色包括古塔、茶文化、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yundong town in the Duyun Economic Development Zone, about 10 km east of central Duyun.

name: 罗甸红水河景区
summaryEn: A purpose-built riverside leisure area on a reservoir of the Hongshui River at Hongshuihe town, on Guizhou's southern border with Guangxi, with a floating walkway of about 5 km as its centrepiece. Around it are a floating swimming pool and water park, tropical and palm plant gardens, a night-lit flower park on a peninsula and a seven-storey viewing tower; the prefecture's page puts a full visit at about two hours. It is aimed at families and water-sports visitors and promoted as a place for a warm-winter break.
description: 罗甸红水河景区位于贵州黔南。游览特色包括水库、水上游乐、滨水景观。图集建议预留约2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Hongshuihe town, roughly 60 km by road from Luodian county town.

name: 金海雪山
summaryEn: A rural tourism area of about 19 sq km in Panjiang town, made up of 14 villages where about 95% of residents are Buyei. Its name, 'golden sea, snow mountain', describes the spring sight of white plum blossom on the hillsides against yellow rapeseed fields beside the Wengcheng river. Attractions include a flower valley and, according to the county's 2026 reports, an early-cherry garden and a family area with a rice-field mini train and a Ferris wheel.
description: 金海雪山位于贵州黔南。游览特色包括油菜花田、田园观光、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Panjiang town, about 15 km south-west of Guiding county town in a straight line, and within about an hour's drive of Guiyang and Duyun.

name: 龙里油画大草原
summaryEn: A leisure park on a high mountain plateau in Longli, with grassland of around a thousand mu (about 67 hectares) and, in season, flower fields that include white azaleas. A cable car links the foot of the hill with the plateau, where attractions include a glass bridge, a zip line, grass-skiing, a camping area and a run of nearly 4 km on non-powered scooters back down; the lower area has a commercial street in Miao and Buyei architectural styles. It suits families on a day out from Guiyang.
description: 龙里油画大草原位于贵州黔南。游览特色包括草原、滑雪。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Yuxia village in Longshan town, Longli county, about 30 km south-east of central Guiyang.

name: 杉木湖
summaryEn: The central park at Shanmu Lake, a municipal park of about 80 hectares in Duyun's eastern new town, in the core of the Duyun Economic Development Zone. The prefecture describes it as a general public park combining green space, culture, recreation and fitness facilities. It is a local recreation space, so it suits a short walk rather than a full visit.
description: 杉木湖位于贵州黔南。游览特色包括湖泊、城市公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yundong town, in the Duyun Economic Development Zone on the east side of Duyun.

name: 神泉谷
summaryEn: Shenquan Valley is a riverside leisure area of about 8.8 km along the Wuma river in Changshun, running from the Weiyuan tidal spring to the Qinglong pool. Its signature sight is the 'tidal well' (chaojing), a spring whose water surges out and falls back irregularly, from two or three to seven or eight times a day according to the prefecture, each surge lasting five to ten minutes. The county reports that a hotel, campsites, off-road go-karts and children's attractions have been added in recent years.
description: 神泉谷位于贵州黔南。游览特色包括山谷、滨水景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Changzhai subdistrict, Changshun county town, in the west of Qiannan prefecture.

name: 独山天洞
summaryEn: A themed leisure park in Jichang town, Dushan, built around Tiandong, a limestone cave where coloured lights pick out the stalactites, and Duxiu peak, which visitors can climb for views over the surrounding area. The grounds also hold gardens, lakes and a Buyei-style village under a 'heavenly court' theme, and the park has hosted music festivals. It suits a short family stop rather than a long visit.
description: 独山天洞位于贵州黔南。游览特色包括洞穴、园林景观、音乐文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jichang town, about 15 km by road from Dushan town; buses from Dushan bus station towards Jichang stop at the park.

name: 双龙镇巫山峡谷
summaryEn: A gorge leisure area at Shuanglong in Longli, between two reservoirs, with rock paintings on its cliffs and a newly built courtyard-style town beside it. Attractions listed by the county include a cliff-side glass walkway, a suspension bridge, a via ferrata route and a water park. It is aimed at families and active day-trippers from Guiyang.
description: 双龙镇巫山峡谷位于贵州黔南。游览特色包括峡谷、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Gujiao town, Longli county, at the Shuanglong themed town, about 7 km south-east of Guiyang's Longdongbao airport.

name: 瑶山古寨
summaryEn: A village area of about 3.6 sq km in Yaoshan Yao township, described by the prefecture as a main settlement of the Baiku ('white-trousers') Yao, a name from the knee-length white trousers men traditionally wear. Many houses are mud-walled with thatched roofs, a cluster of granaries stands among them, and visitors can see a village-history museum and craft workshops and watch staged performances in the evenings. The Libo Yao monkey-drum dance, a funeral and ancestral-rite dance of the Baiku Yao, has been on China's national intangible-heritage list since 2008 and is also performed for visitors.
description: 瑶山古寨位于贵州黔南。游览特色包括博物馆、手工艺、村寨。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yaoshan Yao township, about 30 km from Libo town by road and a few kilometres from Xiaoqikong.

name: 阿妹戚托小镇
summaryEn: A hillside town built to rehouse the whole of Sanbao Yi township on the edge of Qinglong county town, named after Amei Qituo, a Yi bridal dance on China's national intangible cultural heritage list that is often called the Eastern tap dance. It has a dance culture hall, a craft street with embroidery and batik shops, Miao and Yi culture squares, a pagoda and guesthouses in Yi-style buildings, and in the evening visitors are invited to join the dancing on Jinmen Square. It is a modern resettlement town rather than a historic village, and Yi and Miao culture is presented there for visitors.
description: 阿妹戚托小镇位于贵州黔西南。游览特色包括古塔、非遗文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 3 km from the centre of Qinglong county town and a few kilometres from the 24-zig road.

name: 北盘江大峡谷
summaryEn: A U-shaped canyon of the Beipan River in Zhenfeng, about 94 km long within the county, with karst peaks, caves and waterfalls along a reservoir created by the Dongqing dam; the area is part of the Beipan River National Wetland Park. The main way to see it is a boat trip upstream from the dam area, about two hours there and back to the Xiaohuajiang iron-chain bridge, and the county also points to rock paintings, cliff inscriptions and old Tea-Horse Road paths along the gorge. It is billed locally as Guizhou's little Three Gorges.
description: 北盘江大峡谷位于贵州黔西南。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、湿地。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhexiang town, roughly 35 km from Zhenfeng county town by road, with boats leaving from the Dongqing dam area.

name: 放马坪
summaryEn: A highland grassland of about 21,000 mu at an average height of 1,630 m on the northern edge of Xingren, nicknamed Gaoyuan Saiwai, the plateau frontier. Besides the open pasture there are karst sinkholes, cliffs and a plateau lake, with flower fields in season and activities such as grass-sliding, kite flying, camping and horse riding. It suits families and outdoor-minded visitors, and hosts camping and kite-flying events.
description: 放马坪位于贵州黔西南。游览特色包括草原、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 24 km north of Xingren city centre by road, on the boundary of Panjiazhuang and Xiashan towns.

name: 贵州醇景区
summaryEn: A leisure park of about 2,400 mu in the urban area of Xingyi, named after the Guizhou Chun baijiu brand and described in provincial tourism promotion as one of 14 liquor-and-tourism scenic areas in Guizhou. It has cherry and plum woods, flower fields, a covered wind-and-rain bridge beside a waterfall, a children's amusement area, an adventure playground, ziplines, boating, a mushroom-themed lodge hotel and an open-air beer garden. It is aimed at families and short visits, and a riverside path of about 21 km, with electric shuttles, now links it to Wanfenglin.
description: 贵州醇景区位于贵州黔西南。游览特色包括瀑布、花卉观赏、乘船游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Within the urban area of Xingyi; a riverside path of about 21 km, also served by electric shuttles, links it with Wanfenglin.

name: 鲁屯牌坊群
summaryEn: Lutun is a Ming-era military settlement in the Yilong New Area east of Xingyi, where three Qing stone memorial archways dated 1839 to 1846 still stand in the old streets, two honouring people who reached 100 and one a woman praised for chastity and filial devotion; the group is a national-level protected monument. The old town lies inside the Yilong Mountain Tourism, Sport and Leisure Expo Park, the 4A scenic area of about 1,000 mu that also has a convention centre and a baseball and softball park. It is a short stop, mainly for those curious about the fortified-settlement towns of Guizhou.
description: 鲁屯牌坊群位于贵州黔西南。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、历史纪念、特色街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Lutun town in Xingyi's Yilong New Area, about 30 km by road from central Xingyi.

name: 普安茶文化生态旅游景区
summaryEn: A tea-tourism area at Chayuan, east of Pu'an town, built around local claims that the region is an origin of tea: the county dates a fossilised tea seed found nearby in 1980 to more than two million years ago, and says more than 20,000 ancient wild tea trees survive in Pu'an. The Buyei Tea Source Town at its centre has a tea-culture park, a Shennong shrine, a pavilion for Funiang, whom local tradition names as the Buyei tea ancestor, and a tea-bowl-shaped exhibition hall, while the surrounding hills have tea plantations, a mountain-bike course and guesthouses. It suits visitors who want to see tea country and try picking or brewing.
description: 普安茶文化生态旅游景区位于贵州黔西南。游览特色包括茶文化、楼阁建筑、化石遗迹。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 15 km east of Pu'an county town, with Pu'an County station on the Shanghai–Kunming high-speed line about 20 minutes away by road.

name: 双玉峰
summaryEn: Two rounded karst peaks rising about 260 m above their surroundings, which the local Buyei call the Holy Mother Peaks, on the road from Zhenfeng towards Guiyang; many local pages still use the older name Shuangrufeng. The scenic area adds a small stone forest, a lake, a Buyei village and a heritage showcase for local costume, blacksmithing and traditional pottery. It is a short visit for the views and the crafts, close to Sanchahe Lake.
description: 双玉峰位于贵州黔西南。游览特色包括石林、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 8 km from Zhenfeng county town, on the road towards Guiyang.

name: 万峰湖
summaryEn: A large reservoir on the Nanpan River where Guizhou, Yunnan and Guangxi meet, formed by the Tianshengqiao-I dam and named for the many karst peaks around it. The prefecture describes a surface of about 176 square kilometres with dozens of islands, peninsulas and bays, and visitors come for boat trips, lakeside fishing and views. The 4A scenic area covers nine lakeside spots on the Xingyi shore, with a visitor centre, a fishing service centre and boat services.
description: 万峰湖位于贵州黔西南。游览特色包括水库、湖泊、乘船游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the Xingyi shore of the lake, roughly 30 km south-east of central Xingyi by road, with boat trips from the lakeside piers.

name: 兴义国家地质公园博物馆
summaryEn: A geopark museum in Wusha, west of Xingyi, devoted to the Middle Triassic marine reptiles and fishes of the Xingyi fauna, above all the small reptile Keichousaurus, known as the Guizhou dragon. It has two buildings, the museum itself with six exhibition halls and a hall that preserves fossil beds in place, and offers hands-on activities such as fossil preparation, aimed at school-age visitors. UNESCO dates the fauna to roughly 242 to 237 million years ago, and it is one of the features of the Xingyi UNESCO Global Geopark, designated in 2024.
description: 兴义国家地质公园博物馆位于贵州黔西南。游览特色包括博物馆、地质景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Wusha town beside the G324 road, about 15 km from central Xingyi.

name: 招堤
summaryEn: A lotus-filled wetland on the north-eastern edge of the old town of Anlong, built around a stone embankment, a provincial-level protected monument, that a local garrison officer raised in 1694 to hold back floodwater. More than 5,000 mu of lotus are grown here, and in midsummer the flowers, a curving viewing bridge and pavilions draw visitors to what the prefecture describes as the largest lotus-viewing spot on the Guizhou plateau. Egrets, herons and moorhens are among the waterbirds recorded in the wetland.
description: 招堤位于贵州黔西南。游览特色包括湿地、楼阁建筑、莲花观赏。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north-east side of Anlong old town, about an hour by road east of Xingyi.

name: 贞丰古城
summaryEn: A restored old quarter at the foot of Feng Hill on the east side of Zhenfeng, once the Buyei market settlement of Mingu, with Ming and Qing streets, courtyard houses, the Wenchang Palace and the former guild halls of merchants from Hunan, Hubei, Guangdong and Guangxi. The county says repair and opening to visitors began in 2015, while the scenic area as a whole was built from 2017 and opened in 2018, so part of what visitors see is new construction in old style. It is best for an evening stroll when the streets are lit.
description: 贞丰古城位于贵州黔西南。游览特色包括古城、传统民居、历史街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the east of Zhenfeng county town, about 114 km from Xingyi and 231 km from Guiyang by road.

name: 大明边城
summaryEn: A riverside attraction on the Jinjiang river in Tongren, built in the style of a Ming-dynasty frontier town and themed on the Ming court bringing the local Sizhou and Sinan chiefdoms under its rule. It is a modern, artificial landscape rather than a historic site, and a scenic-area upgrade project was listed among Tongren investment projects in 2023.
description: 大明边城位于贵州铜仁。游览特色包括滨水景观、历史建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the Jinjiang river in eastern Tongren, about 2 km east of the Zhongnanmen old town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 九丰农业博览园
summaryEn: A farm-tourism park in Wanshan district that opened in 2015, built around large greenhouses where more than a hundred kinds of unusual fruit and vegetables are grown and visitors can pick seasonal produce. It also has flower and marine-science exhibition halls, holiday villas and a hotel, and it takes school study groups. It suits families and anyone curious about modern farming.
description: 九丰农业博览园位于贵州铜仁。游览特色包括田园观光、农业体验、主题展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Gaolouping township, Wanshan district, about 40 minutes by road from central Tongren.

name: 黎芝峡
summaryEn: Lizhi Gorge is part of the Wujiang Gorge scenic area in Yanhe Tujia Autonomous County, where the Wujiang river runs between steep cliffs. Visitors see it from a boat, passing cliff formations that have been given names such as Beauty Peak, Tianmen Stone and Straw Hat Rock.
description: 黎芝峡位于贵州铜仁。游览特色包括峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Boat trips go from the Hedong tourist pier at Yanhe county town, which is reached by road from Tongren city.

name: 思南石林
summaryEn: A field of karst limestone pinnacles beside the Silin reservoir on the Wujiang river in Changba town, covering roughly 5 square kilometres. The rock forms range from needles and swords to towers, pillars and castle-like masses, and some are named after animals, such as the twelve zodiac stones. It has been a national geopark since 2009, with a geology museum and walking trails, and the 4A listing also covers a hot-spring site in Sinan town.
description: 思南石林位于贵州铜仁。游览特色包括博物馆、石林、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Changba town, about 70 km by road from Sinan county town.

name: 五彩洋山河
summaryEn: A karst gorge about 2.5 km long and 100–400 m deep in Dejiang county, opened to visitors in 2020, with a sinkhole, natural bridge, caves, stone forest and underground river. Its centrepiece is Nuoxian Cave, where the underground stream shows several colours and a fried-egg-shaped mineral formation is the best-known curiosity. A glass suspension bridge, a viewing platform and an inclined cable car take visitors across and down into the gorge.
description: 五彩洋山河位于贵州铜仁。游览特色包括峡谷、石林。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Gaoshan town, about 32 km (roughly 40 minutes) by road from Dejiang county town.

name: 亚木沟
summaryEn: A forested stream valley fed from Fanjingshan in Zhaibao village, Taiping town, with small waterfalls and clear rock pools. Xinhua reports forest cover above 97 percent and an average temperature of about 17°C. It is a low-key add-on for visitors staying near the Jiangkou entrance to Fanjingshan.
description: 亚木沟位于贵州铜仁。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Zhaibao village, Taiping town, about 20 km by road north-west of Jiangkou county town, on the Fanjingshan side of the county. Check that it is open before going.

name: 夜郎古泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort at the edge of Shiqian county town, in a county known as a hot-spring homeland: about twenty spring sites with 36 outlets have been surveyed there. The springs have been used for more than 400 years, and the resort has more than 130 bathing pools of different kinds as well as a water park with a wave pool. A cable car links it with the cliff-top Xianren Street attractions, so a visit can combine a mountain outing with a soak.
description: 夜郎古泉位于贵州铜仁。游览特色包括水上游乐、缆车观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tangshan sub-district, on the southern edge of Shiqian county town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 云舍村
summaryEn: A Tujia village at the foot of Fanjingshan on the Taiping River, with stone-paved lanes and old timber houses, most of them dating from the Ming and Qing periods. Visitors can see hand-papermaking and Tujia weaving demonstrations, a small museum on Tujia wedding customs and the clear Shenlong Pool. It makes an easy stop before or after climbing Fanjingshan.
description: 云舍村位于贵州铜仁。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 5 km from Jiangkou county town by bus or car, and about 50 km from Tongren city.

name: 玉屏侗乡风情园
summaryEn: A purpose-built tourist complex in Tianping town that presents Dong culture in newly built timber architecture, including a drum tower and some thirty Dong-style houses. Inside are small museums of Dong embroidery and bamboo flutes, a mock 1960s-70s village market street, a lotus-pond wetland park, and an outlet shopping street across the road. It was built from the late 2010s, so the buildings are modern, but it gives an easy introduction to Dong music, crafts and food.
description: 玉屏侗乡风情园位于贵州铜仁。游览特色包括博物馆、湿地。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tianping town, about 10 km by road from Zhushaguzhen railway station and about 30 km from Tongren South high-speed station. Check that it is open before going.

name: 中南门古城
summaryEn: Tongren's old quarter lies on a peninsula with the Jinjiang river on three sides, and its restored courtyard houses, lanes and wharf from the Ming to Republican periods now host evening events such as street concerts and open-air films. Several monuments in and around the old city make up the national heritage unit known as the Dongshan ancient buildings, including Dongshan Temple on its hill (first built in 1516), Chuanzhu Palace (founded in 1375, with an opera stage) and the courtyard home of Zhou Yiqun, an early Communist Party figure. The lanes are most lively in the evening.
description: 中南门古城位于贵州铜仁。游览特色包括古城、寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the centre of Tongren city on the Jinjiang river, reached by local bus or taxi.

name: 朱砂古镇
summaryEn: Wanshan was China's largest cinnabar and mercury producer, mined for more than 2,000 years until the mines closed in 2001, and the remains are a national heritage unit and a national mine park. Zhusha Ancient Town is the converted mining settlement, with restored workers' streets, shops and canteen from the mining days, old tunnels where cinnabar can still be seen in the rock, and a glass walkway along a gorge. It suits anyone interested in industrial heritage and how it is reused.
description: 朱砂古镇位于贵州铜仁。游览特色包括峡谷、古镇、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Wanshan district, east of Tongren; Zhushaguzhen station on the Tongren-Yuping railway is the nearest rail stop, roughly 8 km west of the town.

name: 丙安古镇
summaryEn: Bing'an is an old river-trading town on the Chishui River, once a staging post for the boats that carried Sichuan salt into Guizhou, with timber stilt houses built along the steep riverbank, a stone town gate, a Qing-era towpath and an old bridge. In January 1935 units of the Red Army's First Army Corps camped here during the Long March, ahead of the first crossing of the Chishui, and the town has a First Army Corps exhibition hall and a memorial hall for General Geng Biao. It was named a Chinese Traditional Village in 2012 and suits visitors who enjoy historic riverside architecture.
description: 丙安古镇位于贵州遵义。游览特色包括古镇、滨水景观、主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Bing'an town, about 20 minutes' drive up the Chishui River from Chishui city.

name: 中国丹霞谷
summaryEn: A forested river valley with red Danxia sandstone walls in Sancha River town, Xishui County. Its best-known sight is the Wangxiantai grotto, a rock-cut complex carved into the cliff for the Qing-dynasty businessman Yuan Jindao and described in local media as Guizhou's finest grotto. Streams and forest against the red rock make up the rest of the scenery.
description: 中国丹霞谷位于贵州遵义。游览特色包括山谷、林地风光、砂岩地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Sancha River town in the north-east of Xishui County, about 45 km by road from Xishui county town.

name: 中国酒文化城
summaryEn: The visitor complex of the Moutai distillery in Maotai town, the home of Moutai baijiu on the Chishui River. It includes a museum of famous Chinese liquors and displays introducing Moutai's history and culture.
description: 中国酒文化城位于贵州遵义。游览特色包括博物馆、酿造文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Maotai town, on the Chishui River, roughly 10-15 km by road from the centre of Renhuai city. Check that it is open before going.

name: 飞龙寨
summaryEn: A scenic area on the shore of Feilong Lake, a reservoir on the Wujiang River in Yuqing County, presented as a Miao village with local folk culture. Its best-known feature is the Feilong Corridor, a 999 m promenade whose dragon motifs give the place its name. Nearby Langshuiwan, another part of the Feilong Lake area, offers boat trips and water sports.
description: 飞龙寨位于贵州遵义。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the shore of Feilong Lake in Yuqing County, in the south-east of Zunyi prefecture; the county town is the nearest base.

name: 苟坝会议旧址
summaryEn: Gouba is a village in Fengxiang town where the Red Army's headquarters stopped in March 1935 during the Long March. At a farm compound called Xinfangzi, Politburo meetings on 10-12 March debated whether to attack the town of Daguxinchang, and a three-man military command group of Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai and Wang Jiaxiang was set up. The meeting site is preserved, with an exhibition hall on the conference, and it suits visitors tracing the Long March around Zunyi.
description: 苟坝会议旧址位于贵州遵义。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、历史纪念、主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Gouba village, Fengxiang town, Bozhou district, about 50 km west of central Zunyi by road.

name: 茶海之心
summaryEn: A large tea-growing landscape in Tianba village, Yong'an town, Fenggang County, at about 1,000 m, where tea bushes grow in bands among pine and other trees. A cableway of about 780 m and a glass walkway give views over the plantations, which are the core of Fenggang's zinc- and selenium-rich tea. Spring tea-picking, farmstays and camping among the tea gardens are the other draws.
description: 茶海之心位于贵州遵义。游览特色包括玻璃栈道、茶文化、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yong'an town, about 40 km north-west of Fenggang county town by road, in the east of Zunyi prefecture. Check that it is open before going.

name: 小西湖
summaryEn: A reservoir lake beside Tongzi town, formed in the 1940s together with the Tianmenhe hydropower station, with wooded hills around it. General Zhang Xueliang, held under house arrest after the 1936 Xi'an Incident, was confined at Tianmen Cave by the lake from December 1944 until his transfer to Chongqing in 1946. It was rated a national 4A scenic area in December 2024.
description: 小西湖位于贵州遵义。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the edge of Tongzi county town (Loushanguan subdistrict), roughly 60 km north of Zunyi by road.

name: 天下第一壶茶文化博览园
summaryEn: A tea-culture park in Meitan whose centrepiece is a teapot-shaped building 73.8 m high, certified in 2006 by a Shanghai record-keeping body as the world's largest teapot-shaped structure. Inside, the China Tea Ceremony Hall has galleries on tea in the Tang, Song, Ming and Qing dynasties, on minority tea customs, and on Japanese, Korean and Taiwanese tea traditions. It suits visitors interested in tea culture, and lies close to Meitan's wartime Zhejiang University site.
description: 天下第一壶茶文化博览园位于贵州遵义。游览特色包括茶文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Meitan town, about 70 km east of Zunyi by road, roughly an hour and a half.

name: 湄潭茶海生态园
summaryEn: A rural tea-tourism area around Hetaoba village, about 10 km from Meitan county town, where tea plantations surround a village of Qianbei-style houses whose carved window lattices bear small teapot motifs, echoing the Giant Teapot in the county town. The county government describes a leisure area combining village houses, tea-culture experiences, local restaurants and water recreation. It is a different place from the large 'China Tea Sea' viewing area at Yongxing town, further north-east.
description: 湄潭茶海生态园位于贵州遵义。游览特色包括茶园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Hetaoba village, about 10 km east of Meitan county town, which is about 70 km by road east of Zunyi.

name: 清溪峡
summaryEn: Qingxi Gorge is a river gorge in Suiyang county, nicknamed a "jade belt" for the green of its water, and is sold as part of the Shierbeihou ("Twelve Behind") tourism area alongside Shuanghedong cave. Boats run on the water, where a 120-seat vessel was built in 2023, and a camping base has been added. It suits travellers who want a day on the water, combined with the cave in the same county.
description: 清溪峡位于贵州遵义。游览特色包括峡谷、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Qinggangtang town, Suiyang county, about 1.5 hours by road from Zunyi.

name: 杉坪
summaryEn: A rural tourism area in Shanping village, Loushanguan subdistrict, south of Tongzi county town, developed as a farming-and-tourism demonstration project during China's poverty-alleviation campaign. Its flower fields were reported in 2016 as a sea of purple blooms, and the county lists Shanping among its main tourism sites.
description: 杉坪位于贵州遵义。游览特色包括田园观光、花卉观赏、农业体验。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shanping village, about 6 km south of Tongzi county town, and roughly 60 km north of Zunyi by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 双门峡
summaryEn: Shuangmen Gorge is a river-gorge scenic area in Fenghua town, Suiyang county, promoted as "China's Poetry Valley" and officially recognised as a national water-conservancy scenic area. Its theme is poetry culture, tied to Suiyang's long-standing image as a "poetry town". It suits travellers who want to combine it with other Suiyang sights such as Shuanghedong cave.
description: 双门峡位于贵州遵义。游览特色包括峡谷、山谷、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Fenghua town, Suiyang county, about 50 km north-north-east of central Zunyi by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 水银河大峡谷
summaryEn: A river canyon in Mugua town in northern Tongzi County, where the Shuiyin River runs through a gorge with more than ten large waterfalls and dozens of smaller ones. Rafting down about 4 km of the river is the main activity and runs in the warmer months.
description: 水银河大峡谷位于贵州遵义。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Mugua town in the far north of Tongzi County, about 80 km by road from Tongzi county town. Rafting is seasonal and can close in bad weather.

name: 四洞沟
summaryEn: Sidonggou is a valley of stepped waterfalls in the red-sandstone hills near Chishui, with four main falls strung along a route of about 5 km. The falls are known as Water Curtain Cave, Moon Pool, Flying Frog Cliff and White Dragon Pool, each with a different shape. It suits walkers who want a waterfall day trip from Chishui city.
description: 四洞沟位于贵州遵义。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、砂岩地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Datong town, about 20 km by road from Chishui city. Check that it is open before going.

name: 洪关太阳坪
summaryEn: A hilltop scenic area at about 1,500 m in Hongguan Miao ethnic township, in the west of Bozhou district, known for slopes of wild azaleas that bloom in spring; the township holds an azalea festival in May. A glass viewing platform looks out over Bozhou, Jinsha and Renhuai, and the area also has bungee and aerial-swing rides and guesthouses.
description: 洪关太阳坪位于贵州遵义。游览特色包括节庆文化、观景台。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Hongguan Miao ethnic township, about 75 km by road west of central Zunyi.

name: 夜郎酒谷
summaryEn: Yelang Liquor Valley is a baijiu-themed tourist area in Renhuai's famous-liquor industrial park, in the Maotai area of Zunyi. The Renhuai government describes hills and water around the site, village houses several hundred years old, and a blend of Yelang-culture themes with visitor experiences of traditional sauce-aroma baijiu making. It was rated a national 4A scenic area in December 2024.
description: 夜郎酒谷位于贵州遵义。游览特色包括山谷、酿造文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Renhuai's famous-liquor industrial park in the Maotai area, reached by road from Renhuai city. Check the entrance and that it is open before going.

name: 云门囤
summaryEn: A riverside scenic area at Sandu town in Zunyi's Xinpu New Area, covering about 8 sq km at the meeting point of three rivers. Its best-known sight is the Water Gate to Heaven, a natural karst gateway over the river described as about 80 m wide and 100 m high; visitors also tour the river gallery by boat and can see a rock fissure about 200 m long, the Great Rift.
description: 云门囤位于贵州遵义。游览特色包括滨水景观、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Sandu town, about 50 km by road east of central Zunyi.

name: 正安吉他文化产业园
summaryEn: A guitar-making and visitor park in Zheng'an County, where local figures cited in People's Daily say about one in seven of the world's guitars is made. In the south area, a guitar plaza hosts band performances and there is a guitar-themed street and a guitar museum; in the north, visitors can watch guitars being made in the factories. The county also runs a summer music season and guitar festivals.
description: 正安吉他文化产业园位于贵州遵义。游览特色包括博物馆、节庆文化、休闲公园。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Zheng'an county town, roughly 130 km by road north-north-east of Zunyi.

name: 北海湿地
summaryEn: Beihai is a protected wetland in a volcanic basin north of Tengchong. Much of its water is covered by floating mats of matted grass and roots, said to be up to about 2 m thick, which grew on volcanic ash and organic matter. Boardwalks lead across the marsh, and visitors can step out onto the springy grass rafts.
description: 北海湿地位于云南保山。游览特色包括湿地。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 12 km north of central Tengchong, 20–30 minutes by taxi; carry your passport for checkpoints in this border area.

name: 东山草原
summaryEn: Dongshan is an upland meadow on the hills east of Tengchong, a state pasture from 1983 that was badly overgrazed and has been restored since 2012. Its open grassy slopes give wide views west over the Tengchong basin.
description: 东山草原位于云南保山。游览特色包括草原。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the hills about 8 km east of central Tengchong, 20–30 minutes by car; carry your passport for checkpoints in this border area.

name: 高黎贡国际精品咖啡文化园
summaryEn: A coffee-themed park in the Lujiang valley, Baoshan's main coffee-growing area below the eastern flank of the Gaoligong range, rated 4A in 2022. It combines coffee plantings with a coffee-culture exhibition centre, a visitor processing workshop where you can follow coffee from bean to cup, a café, guesthouses, tents and an RV campsite.
description: 高黎贡国际精品咖啡文化园位于云南保山。游览特色包括山谷。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Nahu village, Lujiang town, in the Lujiang valley (Longyang district), about an hour by road west of Baoshan city.

name: 高黎贡山茶博园
summaryEn: A tea-themed park in Qingshui township next to Tengchong airport, operating since 2013, with tea gardens holding a collection of more than 500 Chinese tea varieties and a tea-culture museum by the entrance. Visitors can pick, process and taste tea, and there is a tea-themed restaurant, a hotel and an RV camp.
description: 高黎贡山茶博园位于云南保山。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the airport road about 8 km south of central Tengchong, roughly 20 minutes by taxi.

name: 江东银杏村
summaryEn: Jiangdong, in Gudong town north of Tengchong, is a cluster of four farming hamlets set among tens of thousands of ginkgo trees growing on fertile volcanic soil, more than a thousand of them over a century old. From mid-November to early December the leaves turn gold. The village was listed as a Chinese traditional village in 2013.
description: 江东银杏村位于云南保山。游览特色包括农业体验、传统村落。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 37 km north of Tengchong, roughly an hour by road and close to the volcano park; carry your passport for checkpoints in this border area.

name: 原乡栖花岭
summaryEn: A flower and family leisure park at the foot of the Gaoligong range in Qushi township, developed by a property company as part of a holiday-housing project and rated 4A in 2020. Flower fields and a rose garden set around a chain of small lakes are mixed with rides such as a long slide, a zip line and swing bridges, a water play area and a small farm.
description: 原乡栖花岭位于云南保山。游览特色包括花卉观赏、园林景观、公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Qushi township about 25 km north of Tengchong, roughly 40 minutes by road; travel listings showed it as temporarily closed in 2026, so check before going.

name: 杜鹃王古木博览园
summaryEn: An exhibition park of about 5 ha in Tengchong's economic development zone that displays more than 300 pieces of ancient timber and tree roots, including yew, left uncarved and unpainted to show their natural colour, grain and shape. A second hall shows wooden furniture, tea tables and smaller crafts, with a workshop where visitors can try woodworking, and there is a wood-themed restaurant.
description: 腾冲经济开发区的专题园馆展示古木藏品，可观察不同木材的形态与纹理。
accessEn: In the economic development zone on the western edge of Tengchong, about 15 minutes by taxi from the centre.

name: 善洲林场
summaryEn: This forest farm on Daliangshan in Shidian county was planted from 1988 by Yang Shanzhou, a former Communist Party secretary of Baoshan prefecture, who after retiring led local people in reforesting the mountain. By the time he handed the farm to the state free of charge in 2009 it covered about 3,700 hectares. Visitors see the original shed headquarters, an exhibition room on his life, a stele garden and a memorial cemetery, set among the plantations he started.
description: 善洲林场位于云南保山。游览特色包括园林景观、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Daliangshan in southern Shidian county, roughly an hour by mountain road from Shidian town, which is about 1.5 hours by road south of Baoshan.

name: 司莫拉佤族村
summaryEn: Simola is the middle hamlet of Sanjia village in Qingshui township, a Wa settlement with a history of more than 500 years. Visitors walk through the village to its folk-culture square and a small museum of Wa culture, and in recent years villagers have opened farmhouse restaurants.
description: 司莫拉佤族村位于云南保山。游览特色包括博物馆、田园观光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 13 km south-west of central Tengchong, around half an hour by taxi; carry your passport for checkpoints in this border area.

name: 楚雄彝族自治州博物馆
summaryEn: Opened in July 1995, the prefecture museum in Chuxiong covers the archaeology, history and Yi culture of central Yunnan in eight main galleries, with fossils, bronzes and Yi costume among its strongest collections. Its best-known exhibits are the bronze drums excavated in 1975 from the Wanjiaba tombs on the edge of the city, some still blackened with soot from use as cooking vessels.
description: 楚雄彝族自治州博物馆位于云南楚雄。游览特色包括博物馆、化石遗迹。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the south of Chuxiong city, a short taxi ride from the centre; Chuxiong is roughly an hour from Kunming by high-speed train.

name: 武定狮子山
summaryEn: Lion Mountain, just west of Wuding town, has long been called the 'first mountain of the south-west'. Its Zhengxu Temple, founded in the Yuan dynasty, is linked by legend to the Ming Jianwen Emperor, who is said to have hidden here as a monk after losing his throne. A large peony garden, with over 120 varieties, has been planted in the scenic area.
description: 武定狮子山位于云南楚雄。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: A few kilometres west of Wuding county town, which is about 1.5 hours by road north-west of Kunming.

name: 禄丰世界恐龙谷
summaryEn: Lufeng has been known for Jurassic dinosaur fossils since 1938, when the first skeletons, including Lufengosaurus, were dug up in the area. In the Chuanjie basin south of the city, World Dinosaur Valley has a large fossil site hall displaying finds from the surrounding beds, among them the skull of Lishulong, an early Jurassic sauropodomorph described in 2024. The rest of the valley is given over to a dinosaur theme park and a hot-spring hotel.
description: 禄丰世界恐龙谷位于云南楚雄。游览特色包括主题游乐、山谷、化石遗迹。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Chuanjie basin about 20 km south of Lufeng city, roughly 1.5 hours by road west of Kunming.

name: 彝人古镇
summaryEn: A Yi-style 'ancient town' newly built in Chuxiong city as a commercial, hotel and residential district, with an opera stage, squares, shops and restaurants. In the evenings locals and visitors join bonfire dancing in the squares; there is no old fabric, but it is a lively place to eat and see Yi music and dance.
description: 彝人古镇位于云南楚雄。游览特色包括古镇。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Off Weichu Avenue in Chuxiong city, about 10 minutes by taxi from the centre.

name: 十月太阳历文化园
summaryEn: A modern cultural park in Chuxiong's high-tech zone that presents the Yi people's traditional ten-month solar calendar. Its centrepiece is a three-tiered circular platform, used as an altar and observation terrace, topped by ten totem pillars and faced with about 40 relief panels of Yi myths and folk tales, and an exhibition hall explains the calendar.
description: 十月太阳历文化园位于云南楚雄。游览特色包括主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Chuxiong's high-tech zone, close to the Yi People's Ancient Town and a short taxi ride from the city centre.

name: 元谋人世界公园
summaryEn: A leisure park on Fenghuang hill in Yuanma town, themed on the 'Yuanmou Man' hominin fossils found in the county, combining cultural displays with water-park rides and a hot-spring pool complex. It is a commercial leisure site; the fossil site and the Yuanmou Man Museum are separate.
description: 元谋人世界公园位于云南楚雄。游览特色包括博物馆、化石遗迹、公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Fenghuang hill on the western side of Yuanmou county town, a short taxi ride from the centre.

name: 大理地热国
summaryEn: A hot-spring resort beside Cibi Lake on the edge of Eryuan town, where mainly sulphurous springs at about 70–90 °C feed more than 30 open-air pools of different styles. Guest rooms are set in Bai-style courtyards, and it is a convenient stop on the road between Dali and Shaxi or Jianchuan.
description: 大理地热国位于云南大理。游览特色包括湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Eryuan, about 50 km (an hour) north of Dali Old Town via the Dali–Lijiang expressway.

name: 大理海洋世界
summaryEn: An aquarium and marine theme park in the new hillside district of Haidong on the east side of Erhai Lake, with twelve themed halls including an underwater tunnel, a jellyfish hall, a polar section and displays of fish native to south-west China. A dolphin show, a 5D cinema and an indoor snow play area are aimed at families with children.
description: 大理海洋世界位于云南大理。游览特色包括湖泊、主题游乐。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Haidong on the east side of Erhai, about 20 minutes by taxi from Xiaguan.

name: 剑川木雕艺术小镇
summaryEn: A woodcarving-themed town at Shihe village beside Jianhu Lake, built from 2017 and devoted to Jianchuan woodcarving, a Bai craft on China's national intangible cultural heritage list. It has a woodcarving square, master carvers' workshops and showrooms where you can watch artisans at work, alongside the older Bai houses of Shihe village. Most of the complex is new, so pair it with Jianchuan Old Town for historic architecture.
description: 剑川木雕艺术小镇位于云南大理。游览特色包括湖泊、非遗文化、历史街区。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shihe village, Diannan town, south of Jianchuan county town, close to the Diannan exit of the Dali–Lijiang expressway; local buses run there from the county town.

name: 千狮山
summaryEn: A wooded hill at Manxianlin on the western edge of Jianchuan, where local stonemasons have carved more than 3,000 lion figures into the rocks and boulders along its trails since the late 1990s. Seeing them means walking narrow paths through the forest.
description: 千狮山位于云南大理。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 3 km west of Jianchuan Old Town by road.

name: 苍山石门关
summaryEn: A gorge on the western flank of the Cangshan range, where a stream from the Cangshan peaks drops through a chain of pools and waterfalls between sheer cliffs, with walkways following the water. A cliffside skywalk with a glass-floored section has also been built along the gorge wall.
description: 苍山石门关位于云南大理。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yangbi County on the far side of the Cangshan range from Dali, roughly an hour by road from Xiaguan via the expressway.

name: 弥渡天生桥
summaryEn: A karst scenic area a few kilometres east of Midu town, centred on Tianshengqiao, a natural rock bridge, with walking trails through a wooded valley. It is marketed under the name of 'Xiaohe Tangshui' ('The Flowing Stream'), a love song adapted in the 1940s from a folk tune of Midu County.
description: 弥渡天生桥位于云南大理。游览特色包括山谷、林地风光、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: A few kilometres east of Midu town, which is about an hour by road south-east of Dali's Xiaguan.

name: 无量山樱花谷
summaryEn: A tea plantation on the slopes of Wuliang Mountain in Nanjian county where winter-flowering cherry trees were planted among the tea terraces. For a few weeks around December the pink blossom against the green tea rows draws crowds of photographers, with paths and viewpoints across the hillside. Outside the flowering season it is simply a working tea plantation.
description: 无量山樱花谷位于云南大理。游览特色包括茶园、花卉观赏、赏花。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wuliangshan town, Nanjian county, about 2.5 hours by road south-east of Dali (Xiaguan); there is an expressway exit named after the valley.

name: 勐焕银塔
summaryEn: A white Theravada Buddhist pagoda on Leiyarang hill above Peacock Lake in Mangshi, built as a counterpart to the Menghuan Golden Pagoda a few hundred metres away. The golden pagoda, completed in 2007 to replace one destroyed during the Second World War, is more than 70 metres tall and is described as the tallest Theravada pagoda in China.
description: 勐焕银塔位于云南德宏。游览特色包括湖泊、古塔。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On a hill about 2 km south of central Mangshi, a few minutes by taxi; Mangshi has an airport.

name: 莫里热带雨林
summaryEn: A forested valley north-east of Ruili whose Dai name is said to mean 'beautiful waterfall'. The scenic area covers about 7 square kilometres of dense forest with streams and a waterfall of about 60 metres. Local legend holds that the Buddha preached here and left a footprint in the rock, and a gilded stupa has been built beside it.
description: 莫里热带雨林位于云南德宏。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km north-east of Ruili city, roughly 30 minutes by taxi; carry your passport, as there are police checkpoints on roads in this border area.

name: 孔雀谷
summaryEn: A forest park in the hills north-east of Mangshi where peacocks are bred and roam the grounds in large numbers, and flocks are released from the hillside in staged flights down into the valley. A glass viewing tower, flower fields, tea gardens, ethnic song-and-dance shows and rides such as a dragon-shaped slide fill out a family day out.
description: 孔雀谷位于云南德宏。游览特色包括森林公园、山谷、花卉观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 12 km north-east of central Mangshi off the G320, roughly 20 minutes by taxi.

name: 巴拉格宗
summaryEn: A deep canyon area in the north-west of Shangri-La, near the borders with Sichuan and Tibet, within the Hongshan section of the Three Parallel Rivers World Heritage Site. The land drops from Gezong Snow Mountain, at 5,545 metres the highest peak in Shangri-La, to about 2,000 metres in the valley; plank walkways and viewpoints line the canyon, and the Tibetan village of Bala sits on a mountainside at about 2,900 metres.
description: 巴拉格宗位于云南迪庆。游览特色包括峡谷、山谷、高山景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 50 km north of Shangri-La town, roughly an hour by road; inside the scenic area you travel by sightseeing bus or, since 2026, by your own car; carry your passport for checkpoints.

name: 滴水苗城
summaryEn: A newly built Miao-style district and tourist hub on the Muyang River at the north-western edge of Pingbian county town, with stilt-style houses, covered bridges and a waterfall on the river. A Miao culture centre and the Yunnan Miao Medicine Museum present local history and Miao herbal medicine.
description: 滴水苗城位于云南红河。游览特色包括博物馆、瀑布。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north-western edge of Pingbian county town, next to the Pingbian exit of the Mengzi–Pingbian expressway and a few minutes by taxi from Pingbian railway station; Mengzi is about an hour away by road.

name: 东风韵
summaryEn: An art and leisure town begun in 2014 on the former Dongfeng state farm south of Mile, a grape-growing area since the farm was founded in 1958. Its landmark is a cluster of domed, flame-like buildings in local red brick designed by the artist Luo Xu, with halls for exhibitions and events. Vineyards, hot-spring resorts and hotels surround the core.
description: 东风韵位于云南红河。游览特色包括葡萄酒文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the southern edge of Mile, about 15 minutes by road from Mile railway station, which is under an hour by high-speed train from Kunming.

name: 凤凰生态公园
summaryEn: A large city park in Kaiyuan's southern new district, opened in 2017, made up of Phoenix Hill, Phoenix Lake with a small beach and lakeside walks, and a wetland along the Nandong River. The clock-tower-style Phoenix Tower on the hill houses an exhibition on Kaiyuan's history, and 1909 Square beside the Yunnan–Vietnam railway displays old locomotives and track of three gauges. It is a local leisure park, convenient if you are breaking a journey through Kaiyuan.
description: 凤凰生态公园位于云南红河。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊、海滨。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the southern new district of Kaiyuan city, a short taxi ride from the centre; Kaiyuan lies on the road between Mile and Mengzi.

name: 湖泉生态园
summaryEn: A large lakeside park on the western side of Mile city, set around a broad lake with a sand beach, islands, lakeside paths and birds such as egrets and black swans. A hotel, restaurants and hot-spring pools stand within the grounds, and the park doubles as a public park for local residents.
description: 湖泉生态园位于云南红河。游览特色包括湖泊、海滨。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Wenquan Road in Mile, served by city buses and about 10 minutes by taxi from Mile railway station.

name: 锦屏山
summaryEn: A hillside temple park north of Mile whose centrepiece is a seated, laughing Maitreya Buddha 19.99 m tall, installed in 1999 at the top of a flight of 1,999 steps. Below it, Mile Temple, said to have been founded in the Song and rebuilt in the Ming, was restored in the Qianlong era and enlarged in 1999. The city shares its Chinese name with Maitreya (Mílè), which makes the statue a local emblem.
description: 锦屏山位于云南红河。游览特色包括寺庙建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 10 km north of central Mile by road; the statue is reached by a long flight of steps.

name: 可邑小镇
summaryEn: A village of the Axi, a branch of the Yi people, north of Mile, regarded as one of the birthplaces of the Axi tiaoyue, a moonlight dance to the three-stringed guitar listed as national intangible heritage in 2008. Now run as a tourist 'ethnic town' with a Yi museum, it is still home to some 700 villagers, whose earth-yellow house walls are painted with figures of the dance. Visitors come for the village itself and its song and dance performances.
description: 可邑小镇位于云南红河。游览特色包括博物馆、非遗文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 15 km north of central Mile by road; Mile is under an hour by high-speed train from Kunming.

name: 马帮古城
summaryEn: Yisa, the county town of Honghe County, is built along a narrow ridge south of the Red River; it grew rich on mule-caravan trade and is known as a home town of overseas Chinese. Its East Gate tower and 18 houses on East Gate Street, built from the late Qing to the Republican era, blend Chinese courtyard plans with Western-style features. Among them are the mansions of the Yao and Qian families.
description: 马帮古城位于云南红河。游览特色包括古城、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the centre of Yisa, the county town of Honghe County, reached by bus or car from Jianshui, Mengzi or Yuanyang.

name: 开远南洞
summaryEn: A scenic area on the southern outskirts of Kaiyuan where underground streams emerge from the limestone hills to form the Nandong River; long counted first among the area's traditional eight views, it opened to visitors in 1988. It takes in eight karst caves, among them Taoyuan Cave with a dry section and a water section, and the century-old metre-gauge Yunnan–Vietnam railway runs through it. The Phoenix Valley section adds a glass skywalk and a glass slide.
description: 开远南洞位于云南红河。游览特色包括洞穴、山谷、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the southern outskirts of Kaiyuan, about 12 km from the city centre by road.

name: 撒玛坝梯田
summaryEn: Samaba is a sweep of Hani rice terraces on a single mountainside in Baohua town, Honghe County, which the prefecture's publicity department puts at more than 14,000 mu (over 9 sq km) in over 4,300 levels. A viewing platform looks across the whole terraced slope at once, and a walkway leads down among the paddies. It lies in a different county from the World Heritage terraces of Yuanyang, about 45 km to the south-east.
description: 撒玛坝梯田位于云南红河。游览特色包括梯田、观景台。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Baohua town, about 38 km by mountain road from Yisa, the Honghe County seat; a hired car is the practical way to get there.

name: 建水燕子洞
summaryEn: A large karst cave in the hills east of Jianshui, divided into a dry cave and a water cave through which an underground river flows. It is named after the swifts that nest under its roof in great numbers, arriving in spring and leaving in summer. Together with Jianshui's old town it forms part of the Jianshui national scenic area.
description: 建水燕子洞位于云南红河。游览特色包括洞穴、喀斯特地貌、历史街区。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 30 km east of Jianshui along National Road 323, roughly 30–45 minutes by road.

name: 太平湖森林小镇
summaryEn: A forest and lake resort on the outskirts of Mile city, built on once-barren karst hills that have been replanted, with forest cabins to stay in, flower fields and a lakeside wetland. It is set up for family days out and short breaks, with resort hotels in the wider development.
description: 太平湖森林小镇位于云南红河。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the eastern outskirts of Mile city; take a taxi from the city centre or Mile railway station.

name: 凤龙湾
summaryEn: A resort built around the Fenglongwan Reservoir, dammed on the Malong River in 1956, at Tangzi in Xundian county. Its centrepiece is a newly built fairy-tale town on an Aladdin theme beside the water, with a sightseeing train and boat trips around the lake; it is aimed at families and photographers.
description: 凤龙湾位于云南昆明。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Tangzi in Xundian county, about 85 km (roughly 1.5 hours) by road north-east of Kunming; public transport is sparse, so drive or hire a car.

name: 昆明融创海世界
summaryEn: An indoor aquarium in the Sunac cultural-tourism complex by the Caohai part of Dian Lake in Xishan district, which also holds an indoor ski and snow park. Themed zones of tanks show marine life from many seas, with jellyfish displays and mermaid performances, and it is aimed squarely at families with children.
description: 昆明融创海世界位于云南昆明。游览特色包括湖泊、水族展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Biji Road in Xishan district, about 30 minutes by taxi from central Kunming; connector bus J32 runs from Metro Line 3.

name: 捞鱼河湿地公园
summaryEn: An urban wetland park on the eastern shore of Dian Lake in Chenggong district, laid out where the Laoyu River enters the lake. Paths run through planted wetland and lakeside woodland, and it is mainly a local spot for walking and cycling rather than a destination in itself.
description: 捞鱼河湿地公园位于云南昆明。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the eastern shore of Dian Lake in Chenggong, about 40 minutes by taxi from central Kunming; city buses stop at Laoyuhe Park.

name: 青龙峡
summaryEn: A forested gorge of about 19 square kilometres in Qinglong subdistrict, north-west of central Anning, with streams, waterfalls and old climbing vines along its trails. It is run as a family day out, and the walks are combined with add-on activities such as rafting.
description: 青龙峡位于云南昆明。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Roughly 30 km by road north-west of central Anning, or about 1.5 hours' drive from Kunming.

name: 杏林大观园
summaryEn: A park themed on traditional Chinese medicine in the Taiwan farmers' enterprise park of Shilin county, combining medicinal-plant gardens and displays on Chinese medicine with wellness activities and a hot-spring spa. It is a commercial wellness and agri-tourism development rather than a heritage site, and is sometimes added to a Stone Forest trip.
description: 杏林大观园位于云南昆明。游览特色包括石林、田园观光、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Heilongtan Road in Shilin county, a short drive from the Stone Forest scenic area.

name: 玉龙湾
summaryEn: A leisure park near Taiping in Anning, set among lakes and forested hills about 24 km from central Kunming and listed as a 4A site in 2022. It has an 'old Kunming' street area, lakeside and forest walks and family activities, alongside a golf course, a riding club and lakeside hotels.
description: 玉龙湾位于云南昆明。游览特色包括湖泊、林地风光、高尔夫。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 minutes by road south-west of central Kunming via the Taiping exit of the Hangrui expressway; a taxi or car is easiest.

name: 老君山黎明
summaryEn: Liming, a Lisu township in western Yulong county, has about 240 square kilometres of red Danxia sandstone landforms within the Laojun Mountain area, part of the Three Parallel Rivers World Heritage Site. Its best-known sight is Qiangui ('Thousand Turtles') Mountain, a red sandstone dome whose cracked, weathered surface looks like rows of crawling turtles.
description: 老君山黎明位于云南丽江。游览特色包括砂岩地貌。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Roughly 3–4 hours by road west of Lijiang; most visitors stay overnight in Liming village.

name: 玉水寨
summaryEn: Yushuizhai, at the southern foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain on the northern edge of Baisha, is a Naxi Dongba cultural site built around a sacred spring that drops down the hillside in a three-tier cascade. It has a temple to Dongba Shiluo, regarded as the founder of the Dongba religion, and a gallery of murals in the Dongba painting style.
description: 玉水寨位于云南丽江。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、壁画。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 15 km north of Lijiang Old Town, 25 minutes by taxi on the road to Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.

name: 班洪葫芦王地
summaryEn: A scenic area around Banhong, a Wa village on the Myanmar border in Cangyuan county, where local Wa people clashed with British forces in 1934 as a silver-mining company moved in from Burma. The Banhong Incident led to renewed Sino-British boundary talks, and the village now has a memorial stele at the incident site and a memorial hall, with tea gardens on the surrounding hills.
description: 班洪葫芦王地位于云南临沧。游览特色包括纪念展览、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Roughly an hour by road north-west of Cangyuan county town; carry your passport, as there are police checkpoints on roads in this border area.

name: 荣康达乌龙茶庄园
summaryEn: A company-run oolong tea estate and eco-cultural park in Shahe township just outside Shuangjiang county town, with tea gardens spread over the surrounding hills. Paths lead through the plantation to viewpoints over the valley, and the estate hotel offers tea-related activities.
description: 荣康达乌龙茶庄园位于云南临沧。游览特色包括山谷、园林景观、庄园。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Chenjiazhai, Shahe township, about 6 km from Shuangjiang bus station, 15 minutes by taxi.

name: 博尚碗窑
summaryEn: A pottery village in Boshang town south of Lincang city, founded according to the county gazetteer in 1738 by three potters from Hunan who built dragon kilns to use the local clay. Its earthenware making is on Yunnan's provincial intangible heritage list, and around 60 households still work as potters, alongside pottery cafés, guesthouses and study programmes added in recent years.
description: 博尚碗窑位于云南临沧。游览特色包括非遗文化、陶瓷工艺。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 20 km south-west of central Lincang by road, roughly 30 minutes.

name: 中华普洱茶博览苑
summaryEn: A tea-themed park on Yingpan Mountain south-east of Pu'er city, set in the middle of some 1,500 hectares of tea gardens. Its core area holds a Pu'er tea museum covering the tea's origins, cultivation, processing and trade, along with tea-making workshops, a hall to the tea ancestor and tasting houses. Visitors can try picking and processing tea and look out over the tea hills from the higher viewpoints.
description: 中华普洱茶博览苑位于云南普洱。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yixiang town on Yingpan Mountain, about 20 km south-east of central Pu'er, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 老达保
summaryEn: A Lahu village in Jiujing township, Lancang county, known as the home of the song 'Happy Lahu' and for villagers who sing Lahu folk songs to the guitar. In 2013 the villagers set up a performance company in which they hold shares, and it stages song-and-dance shows for visitors. The village is a base for two nationally listed intangible heritage traditions, the Lahu creation epic Mupa Mipa and the lusheng dance.
description: 老达保位于云南普洱。游览特色包括非遗文化、民歌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jiujing township, about an hour by road south of Lancang county town.

name: 勐梭龙潭
summaryEn: A natural freshwater lake at about 1,150 m beside Ximeng, a Wa autonomous county in western Pu'er, ringed by forest and regarded by the Wa as a sacred lake. In the woods behind it lies Longmoye, a Wa sacred site where buffalo skulls from sacrifices are kept among the trees and rites are held during the Wa wooden-drum festival each April.
description: 勐梭龙潭位于云南普洱。游览特色包括湖泊、林地风光、节庆文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the southern side of Ximeng county town, roughly 1–1.5 hours by road north of Menglian; carry your passport for checkpoints in this border area.

name: 普洱茶马古道
summaryEn: A heritage park on the edge of Pu'er city built around a section of the Tea Horse Road, the caravan route along which tea from southern Yunnan was carried north; Pu'er was a gathering point for tribute tea bound for the imperial capital. A walking route of about 5 km follows the old road through the hills on the Banjiupo section, which is protected as part of the national Tea Horse Road listing, and a museum covers the history of the mule caravans. The park lies behind the Chama Ancient Town leisure quarter and stages a caravan-themed water show.
description: 普洱茶马古道位于云南普洱。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 2 km from central Pu'er (Simao), a short taxi ride.

name: 太阳河森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park of about 216 km² in the hills south-east of Pu'er city, protecting a large, little-disturbed tract of southern subtropical monsoon evergreen broadleaf forest. Raised wooden walkways wind among the trees, and electric carts serve the core area, which is closed to private vehicles. More than 2,100 species of higher plants have been recorded here, and the park runs a rescue and breeding centre for rare animals such as white-cheeked gibbons and binturongs.
description: 太阳河森林公园位于云南普洱。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km south-east of central Pu'er (Simao), roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 彩色沙林
summaryEn: At the foot of Wufeng Mountain south of Luliang town, the Coloured Sand Forest is about 6 square kilometres of weathered sandstone eroded into ridges, pinnacles and gullies in shades of red, yellow, white and grey. Sand sculptures have been carved among the natural formations, though rain erosion has worn many of them down and some of the named features have collapsed.
description: 彩色沙林位于云南曲靖。游览特色包括林地风光、砂岩地貌、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 15–20 km south of Luliang town, which is roughly an hour by road south of Qujing; the Cuan Longyan Stele is nearby.

name: 尼珠河大峡谷
summaryEn: The Nizhu River, the lower course of the Kedu River and a tributary of the Beipan, has cut a deep gorge along the Yunnan–Guizhou border in Puli township, Xuanwei. The G56 expressway crosses it on the Duge (Beipanjiang) Bridge, whose deck sits about 565 m above the floor of the gorge and which was the world's highest bridge from its opening in 2016 until 2025.
description: 尼珠河大峡谷位于云南曲靖。游览特色包括峡谷、河溪风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Puli township, roughly 1.5 hours by road east of Xuanwei city, which is about 2 hours by road north-east of Qujing.

name: 雨碌大地缝
summaryEn: The Yulu 'Earth Crack' is a narrow karst slot gorge in Yulu township, south-east of Huize. Visitors explore it on a walking trail that follows the gorge.
description: 雨碌大地缝位于云南曲靖。游览特色包括峡谷、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yulu township, roughly 1–1.5 hours by road south-east of Huize town.

name: 英雄老山圣地
summaryEn: Laoshan is a small range of peaks on the China–Vietnam border south of Malipo, where Chinese and Vietnamese forces fought a major battle in 1984 during the border conflict that followed their 1979 war. The scenic area covers the former battlefield, with the main peak, gun positions, memorials and an exhibition hall on local support for the front. The Laoshan Battle Memorial Museum and a martyrs' cemetery are near Malipo town.
description: 英雄老山圣地位于云南文山。游览特色包括博物馆、主题展览、朝圣文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The main peak is about 55 km by road south of Malipo town, close to the Vietnamese border; carry your passport, as there are checkpoints in the border area.

name: 西洋江大峡谷
summaryEn: This scenic area, also promoted as Nongren Valley, follows a deep, steep-sided stretch of the Xiyang River gorge at Mulu village in Dongbao township, Guangnan county. A riverside boardwalk of about 2 km runs through the gorge, with a glass walkway and glass slide added more recently, and the township holds Zhuang folk festivals and performances here.
description: 西洋江大峡谷位于云南文山。游览特色包括峡谷、玻璃栈道、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dongbao township, roughly an hour by road south of Guangnan county town.

name: 大益庄园
summaryEn: A tea estate of about 100 hectares at Menghai, formerly the Tea Horse Road scenic area, renamed in 2016 when the Dayi tea company, a provincial tourism group and the Yunnan Academy of Agricultural Sciences' Tea Research Institute joined forces to run it. Visitors walk through the tea gardens and a reconstructed Tea Horse Road street with a caravan inn displaying artefacts from the old route, and can try pressing pu'er tea cakes by hand.
description: 大益庄园位于云南西双版纳。游览特色包括园林景观、书院文化、庄园。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Menghai town, about 49 km (an hour) by road west of Jinghong on the G214.

name: 勐景来
summaryEn: A Dai village of stilt houses in Daluo town, Menghai county, run as a scenic area by the villagers together with a tourism company; it was listed as a Chinese Traditional Village in 2013. The Daluo River loops past the village and forms the border with Myanmar, with boundary marker 229 on its bank. Visitors see a grove of carved stupas and demonstrations of more than ten traditional crafts, among them brocade weaving, papermaking, slow-wheel pottery, sugar-making and brewing, alongside peacock and elephant-foot-drum dances.
description: 勐景来位于云南西双版纳。游览特色包括传统村落。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 3 km east of Daluo town and roughly 2 hours by road south-west of Jinghong via Menghai; carry your passport for checkpoints in this border area.

name: 勐远仙境
summaryEn: A limestone area of seasonal tropical rainforest at Mengyuan village in Mengla county, with karst peaks, stalactite caves and an underground river. The main show cave, Baojiaoniu Cave, stays at about 21°C, and a cave route of about 1.6 km is divided into themed sections. The area also takes in Dai and Yao villages and forest trails.
description: 勐远仙境位于云南西双版纳。游览特色包括林地风光、喀斯特地貌、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km north-west of Mengla town and 100 km south-east of Jinghong, roughly 1.5–2 hours by road from Jinghong; carry your passport for checkpoints in this border area.

name: 独树成林
summaryEn: A huge old banyan in Daluo town whose aerial roots have grown down from the branches and taken root as separate trunks, so that one tree looks like a small grove. Yunnan's forestry authority counts 36 such roots and estimates the tree at more than 1,000 years old, and locally it is called 'Meilongka', Dai for 'one tree makes a forest'. It stands in a small scenic area less than 1 km from the Daluo border crossing and is easily combined with Mengjinglai, about 5 km to the east.
description: 独树成林位于云南西双版纳。游览特色包括林地风光、边境口岸。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: In Daluo town, roughly 2 hours by road south-west of Jinghong via Menghai; carry your passport for checkpoints in this border area.

name: 西双版纳融创乐园
summaryEn: An amusement park in the Sunac resort district on the western side of Jinghong, part of a large complex of hotels and holiday housing. It has rides and family attractions and suits travellers with children.
description: 西双版纳融创乐园位于云南西双版纳。游览特色包括主题游乐、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Sunac resort area on the west side of Jinghong, about 20 minutes by taxi from Gaozhuang.

name: 龙泉公园
summaryEn: A forest park on the western edge of Yimen county town, built around Dalongkou, a karst spring where an underground river emerges from the hillside. Lakes, waterside paths and old trees surround the springs, and Longquan Temple and the smaller Longyin Temple stand in the woods.
description: 龙泉公园位于云南玉溪。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the western edge of Yimen county town, roughly 1–1.5 hours by road south-west of Kunming.

name: 映月潭
summaryEn: A hot-spring leisure complex at Dayingjie on the western side of Yuxi's Hongta district, with many pools of different temperatures and themes set in gardens around a large pond. The Yuquan Temple stands within the same grounds.
description: 映月潭位于云南玉溪。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Gongyuan Road in Dayingjie, Hongta district, about 20 minutes by taxi from Yuxi railway station.

name: 大古里欢乐城
summaryEn: An amusement park and leisure complex on the edge of Zhenxiong county town in north-eastern Yunnan. It has a roller coaster, a large Ferris wheel with views over the town, a water park and a hot-spring hotel, and mainly serves local families.
description: 大古里欢乐城位于云南昭通。游览特色包括主题游乐、水上游乐、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the Zhenxiong Avenue extension at the edge of Zhenxiong county town, about 2.5 hours by road east of Zhaotong city.

name: 绥江金沙水上乐园
summaryEn: A water park on the Jinsha River reservoir at Suijiang county town, laid out on floating platforms on the river, with swimming areas and inflatable play courses. Jet skis and flyboarding are on offer, and the park hosts events such as dragon-boat and music festivals.
description: 绥江金沙水上乐园位于云南昭通。游览特色包括水库、水上游乐、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Longhu Road in Suijiang county town on the Jinsha River, roughly 2 hours by road west of Yibin.

name: 邵女坪
summaryEn: A lakeside resort town on the Xiangjiaba reservoir of the Jinsha River, redeveloped for tourism from 2023 on the site where 318 households displaced by the reservoir were resettled. It has a sand beach, a hot-spring centre with dozens of pools and an infinity pool, sightseeing boats and water sports, barbecue and camping spots and a lakeside walkway. Many of its guesthouses are run by or for the resettled families.
description: 邵女坪位于云南昭通。游览特色包括水库、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the Shuifu–Suijiang road along the reservoir, about 20 minutes by car west of central Shuifu.

name: 西部大峡谷温泉
summaryEn: A hot-spring and water-park resort on Wenquan Avenue on the western side of Shuifu, above the Jinsha River just upstream of the Xiangjiaba dam at Yunnan's northern border with Sichuan. It has themed outdoor hot-spring pools, water slides and an on-site hotel. The original resort on the canyon floor was lost to the dam's reservoir, and this hillside site, which draws the hot water up from the valley, replaced it.
description: 西部大峡谷温泉位于云南昭通。游览特色包括温泉、峡谷、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the western edge of Shuifu city, about 4 km from the centre and roughly 40 minutes by road from Yibin in Sichuan.

name: 小草坝
summaryEn: A forested upland around Xiaocaoba town, north-east of Yiliang county town, in the Chaotianma section of the Wumengshan National Nature Reserve, which protects large tracts of subtropical evergreen broadleaf forest. Xiaocaoba is promoted as the original home of tianma (Gastrodia elata), the wild orchid tuber used in Chinese medicine and cooking, and the forest also shelters dove trees (Davidia) and other rare plants.
description: 小草坝位于云南昭通。游览特色包括自然保护区、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km north-east of Yiliang county town, roughly an hour by mountain road.

name: 扎西会议纪念地
summaryEn: Memorial sites in Zhaxi, the county town of Weixin, where the Chinese Communist Party Politburo held a series of meetings in early February 1935 during the Long March, completing the leadership changes begun at the Zunyi Conference. The Jiangxi Guild Hall on Zhaxi's old street, one of the meeting venues, survives, and a memorial hall displays several thousand artefacts and photographs from the Red Army's passage, including weapons, a radio set and an X-ray machine.
description: 扎西会议纪念地位于云南昭通。游览特色包括纪念展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Weixin county town (Zhaxi), roughly 3–4 hours by road east of Zhaotong city.

name: 岗托村
summaryEn: Gangtuo, on the west bank of the Jinsha River where National Road 317 crosses from Sichuan into Tibet, is where units of the People's Liberation Army's 18th Army crossed the river in October 1950 and raised the first PRC national flag in Tibet, which gave the village the title 'First Village of Tibet's Liberation'. The village keeps the river-crossing site, the ruins of a blockhouse, an old army supply-station granary and the former 18th Army barracks, now a small museum, alongside Tibetan-style houses, some of which take guests.
description: 岗托村位于西藏昌都。游览特色包括历史遗址。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On National Road 317 at the Jinsha River, about 70 km by road east of Jomda county town; carry your passport for road checkpoints.

name: 三色湖
summaryEn: Three small lakes lie close together in Puyu village, Banbar town, each a different colour, and are known as the black, white and yellow lakes. Listed among Tibet's first regional-level scenic areas in 2011, they have a viewing platform, and Puyu also leads to the Xianggela glacier and an ice cave, where villagers run off-road motorbike trips.
description: 三色湖位于西藏昌都。游览特色包括冰川、洞穴、观景台。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 50 km by road from Banbar county town; carry your passport for road checkpoints.

name: 南山公园
summaryEn: A hillside park on the mountains south of the Lhasa River, directly across the river from the Potala Palace, created by planting trees on bare slopes since 2012. It covers about 2.3 km² and climbs to about 4,000 m, with walking trails and viewpoints looking back over the river to the Potala and the city. It has become one of Lhasa's most popular green spaces, though the climb is hard work at this altitude.
description: 拉萨河南侧的山地公园与布达拉宫隔河相望，登高可从南面观察拉萨河谷。
accessEn: On the south side of the Lhasa River facing the Potala Palace, a short taxi ride from the city centre.

name: 文成公主藏文化风情园
summaryEn: A culture park in the Cijueling cultural and creative zone on the south bank of the Lhasa River, built around the open-air theatre of 'Princess Wencheng', a large stage show about the 7th-century marriage of the Tang princess to the Tibetan king Songtsen Gampo. Staged against a hillside facing the Potala Palace across the river by a company of several hundred, the show has run in seasons since 2013 and passed 2,000 performances. The park also stages a second production, 'Princess Jincheng'.
description: 文成公主藏文化风情园位于西藏拉萨。游览特色包括戏剧演艺。图集建议预留一个晚上游览。
accessEn: In the Cijueling area on the south bank of the Lhasa River, a short taxi ride from the city centre; the show runs in seasons from spring, so check the dates before going.

name: 藏域星球天文体验馆
summaryEn: An indoor astronomy science centre in the Lhasa Economic and Technological Development Zone, opened in December 2019 as the first astronomy-themed science museum in Tibet. Its galleries start with traditional Tibetan astronomy and the Tibetan calendar, including their links with Tibetan medicine, and move on to the Earth, the solar system and the wider universe through more than 50 interactive exhibits using projections, motion capture and VR, plus a 3D theatre. It suits families, or a gentle indoor visit while acclimatising in Lhasa.
description: 藏域星球天文体验馆位于西藏拉萨。游览特色包括博物馆、科学科普。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the astronomy tourism park beside the Lhasa River in the Economic and Technological Development Zone, roughly 10 km west of central Lhasa by taxi. Closed on Mondays and Tuesdays.

name: 西藏野生动物保护园
summaryEn: A zoo and wildlife rescue centre beside the G318 at Chabalang village in Qüxü town, south-west of Lhasa, laid out in the late 2010s on woodland planted by local villagers and known locally as Qushui Zoo. In 2024 it kept about 377 animals of 46 species, among them elephants, lions, tigers, lynx, camels, alpacas and sika deer, in areas for plateau plants, rare species, big cats and wild animals, with a children's play area and picnic (linka) grounds. It also takes in injured wild animals such as brown bears and blue sheep, and releases those that recover.
description: 西藏野生动物保护园位于西藏拉萨。游览特色包括动物观赏、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Beside the G318 about 4 km east of Qüxü county town, roughly 60 km south-west of central Lhasa by road; carry your passport for road checkpoints.

name: 象雄美朵
summaryEn: A modern cultural tourism park in the Tolung (Duilong) river valley in Doilungdêqên District, west of Lhasa, named after Zhangzhung (Xiangxiong), the ancient culture of western Tibet, and open since 2020. Its grounds take in an equestrian arena used for horse shows and races, large flower fields, linka (picnic) parkland and an amusement area, and it has hosted evening light shows in summer and on holidays. It suits a relaxed outing from the city rather than a heritage visit.
description: 象雄美朵位于西藏拉萨。游览特色包括山谷、花卉观赏、游乐体验。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Tolung river valley in Doilungdêqên District, about 25 km west of central Lhasa along the G109.

name: 秀色才纳
summaryEn: A flower and farm park beside the airport expressway at Caina in Qüxü County, part of the township's plateau agriculture projects. Its flower valley, opened in 2024, has nearly 1,000 mu (about 65 ha) of flower fields planted with tulips, roses, sunflowers and many other varieties, with walking paths, a petting area with alpacas and ponies, a children's playground, food stalls and linka (picnic) tents. It makes a short stop on the road between Lhasa and Gonggar airport when the flowers are out.
description: 秀色才纳位于西藏拉萨。游览特色包括山谷、花卉观赏、农业体验。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At the Caina exit of the Lhasa–Gonggar airport expressway in Qüxü County, about 40 minutes by road from Lhasa; carry your passport for road checkpoints.

name: 萨普
summaryEn: Sapu lies below the peak of Sepu Kangri, on the boundary between Biru and Banbar counties, in an area of snow mountains, large maritime glaciers and glacial lakes; in Tibetan 'sa' means snow leopard and 'pu' the head of a valley. A paved road now reaches a glacial lake, and nearby villages offer guesthouses and tents for visitors.
description: 萨普位于西藏那曲。游览特色包括湖泊、冰川。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 110 km by road south of Biru county town, in Yangxiu township; carry your passport for road checkpoints.

name: 班公湖
summaryEn: A lakeside scenic area on the Rutog shore of Pangong Lake (Bangong Co), a long, narrow lake at about 4,240 m on the plateau of far western Tibet. Viewpoints and a lakeside resort look over the clear water and the bare mountains around it, and the lake is frozen for about six months of the year. The area was rated 4A in 2025.
description: 班公湖位于西藏阿里。游览特色包括湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 12 km north-west of Rutog town by road; carry your passport for road checkpoints. It lies in a border area, which also needs a border permit.

name: 措木及日
summaryEn: Cuomujiri, whose Tibetan name is usually translated as 'fairy's tears', is an old moraine-dammed lake in a forested valley just north of Bayi, with snow peaks behind it. The valley is best known for its autumn colours, when the forest along the winding road up to the lake turns red and gold.
description: 措木及日位于西藏林芝。游览特色包括湖泊、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The visitor centre is on the northern edge of Bayi (Nyingchi city), from where a mountain road climbs to the lake; carry your passport for road checkpoints. Check that it is open before going.

name: 世界柏树王园林
summaryEn: This park protects a grove of giant Tibetan cypresses (Cupressus gigantea) at Baji village beside the G318, just south-east of Bayi. Close to a thousand trees grow here, and the largest, the 'King of Cypresses', is estimated to be more than 3,200 years old.
description: 世界柏树王园林位于西藏林芝。游览特色包括园林。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
