accessEn: Beside the G318 about 10 minutes by road south-east of Bayi (Nyingchi city); carry your passport for road checkpoints.

name: 嘎朗湖
summaryEn: Galang Lake, about 2 km² in area, lies in the Galang National Wetland Park beside Galang village, at the mouth of the Bodui peach-blossom valley in Bomê County. Snow peaks and forest surround the lake, and across the road are hillside ruins associated with the old Galang kingdom; in spring the village orchards turn pink with peach blossom.
description: 嘎朗湖位于西藏林芝。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Off the G318 about 17 km north-west of Bomê town (Zhamo); carry your passport for road checkpoints.

name: 果果塘
summaryEn: At Guoguotang, about 12 km from Medog town, the Yarlung Tsangpo swings through a tight horseshoe bend around a forested spur, seen from viewing platforms above the river. Tea gardens cover the slopes nearby, and the low altitude and humid climate make the scene unusually green for Tibet.
description: 果果塘位于西藏林芝。游览特色包括园林景观、林地风光、观景台。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 12 km from Medog town; visitors normally leave cars at the visitor centre and ride the scenic area's shuttle bus, as private cars are not allowed into the core area; carry your passport for road checkpoints. It lies in a border area, which also needs a border permit.

name: 卡定沟
summaryEn: Kading Valley is a steep, forested side gorge off the Nyang River valley north-west of Bayi, known for the Tianfo ('Heavenly Buddha') waterfall that drops down its cliffs. It makes a short stop on the G318 between Lhasa and Nyingchi.
description: 卡定沟位于西藏林芝。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside the G318 about 30 km north-west of Bayi (Nyingchi city), on the road towards Lhasa; carry your passport for road checkpoints.

name: 林则
summaryEn: Linze village in Gongbo'gyamda County is home to several thousand wild Tibetan macaques that live in the surrounding forest and come down to meet visitors, who may feed them under staff guidance. The scenic area also includes the grey-stone manor of the aristocratic Ngapoi family, whose best-known member was the politician Ngapoi Ngawang Jigme, and a hill sacred to a local wealth deity, with murals.
description: 林则位于西藏林芝。游览特色包括壁画、林地风光、猕猴观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 26 km by road east of Gongbo'gyamda county town and 20 km from Bahe on the G318; carry your passport for road checkpoints.

name: 鲁朗
summaryEn: Lulang is a high valley of meadows, streams and spruce forest at about 3,300 m on the G318 east of the Sejila pass, often wrapped in cloud. The scenic area takes in the forest viewpoints along the road, the Lulang International Tourism Town of hotels and guesthouses, built with aid from Guangdong province, and villages such as Tashigang where families run homestays.
description: 鲁朗位于西藏林芝。游览特色包括山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: On the G318 about 70–80 km east of Bayi (Nyingchi city), over the Sejila pass; carry your passport for road checkpoints.

name: 玉麦
summaryEn: Yumai is a small township in a deep valley of Lhünzê County, among fir forest and snow peaks, where rain and snow fall for much of the year. For decades it was known as the 'three-person township', when the herder Sangjie Quba and his daughters Zhuoga and Yangzong were its only residents; a paved road opened in 2019, and it now has two villages, Yumai and Niulintang, with about 250 people. Visitors see the family's old house, walk a forest trail with rhododendrons and waterfalls, and stay in village guesthouses.
description: 玉麦位于西藏山南。游览特色包括山谷、林地风光、高山景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: A long mountain drive from Lhünzê county town over the high Rila pass and down into the valley; carry your passport for road checkpoints. It lies in a border area, which also needs a border permit.

name: 崇巴雍错
summaryEn: Chongba Yumtso is a glacial lake at about 4,570 m on the north side of the Himalaya in southern Kangmar County, and the source of the Nyang River that flows down past Gyantse to Shigatse. Snow peaks ring the water, and in mid to late June rhododendrons flower pink and white along the shore; the scenic area also has dome-shaped 'bubble' rooms for stargazing.
description: 崇巴雍错位于西藏日喀则。游览特色包括湖泊、冰川湖泊、高山景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside the road from Kangmar towards Yadong, about 50 km by road south of Kangmar county town; carry your passport for road checkpoints. It lies in a border area, which also needs a border permit.

name: 吉隆沟
summaryEn: The Gyirong Valley cuts deep into the central Himalaya, falling to about 2,800 m around Gyirong town, where dense forest and farming villages lie beneath snow peaks. For centuries it was one of the main routes between Tibet and Nepal. Besides walks in the valley, visitors see the town's Phagpa Temple and nearby villages such as Nai.
description: 吉隆沟位于西藏日喀则。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
accessEn: Based at Gyirong town, roughly 70 km by road south of the county seat at Zongga and a long day's drive from Shigatse; carry your passport for road checkpoints. It lies in a border area, which also needs a border permit.

name: 朗东庄园
summaryEn: Langba, a listed traditional village on the upper Nyang River in Kangmar County, was renovated and opened as a scenic area in 2023 around Langdong Manor, an aristocratic estate house more than 500 years old. Visitors can tour the manor, stay in village homestays and watch villagers perform the local folk song-and-dance.
description: 朗东庄园位于西藏日喀则。游览特色包括庄园、传统村落。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shaogang township beside the G562, about 25 km by road north of Kangmar county town and a similar distance south of Gyantse; carry your passport for road checkpoints. It lies in a border area, which also needs a border permit.

name: 奇林峡
summaryEn: Qilin Gorge, also known as the Mu Village earth forest, is a valley in Qiongzi township on the north side of the Himalaya where meltwater has eroded the soft sediments into crowded ranks of earth pillars and fins. Viewpoints look over the formations towards snow peaks on the horizon, and villagers of Mu run the site through a tourism cooperative.
description: 奇林峡位于西藏日喀则。游览特色包括峡谷、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Qiongzi township in the south of Dinggye County, reached by road from Dinggye or Gamba, a long drive from Shigatse; carry your passport for road checkpoints. It lies in a border area, which also needs a border permit.

name: 飞渡峡·黄安坝
summaryEn: A scenic area on the northern slopes of the Daba Mountains in Shuping town, at the southern tip of Ankang where Shaanxi borders Chongqing, combining the Feidu River gorge with the Huang'anba upland pastures. The gorge is known for its unusual trees, oddly shaped rocks, waterfalls and deep pools, with red leaves in autumn, while Huang'anba is open grassland and meadow.
description: 飞渡峡·黄安坝位于陕西安康。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、草原。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Shuping town, about 40 km from Zhenping town by road; Zhenping is roughly 3 hours by road south-east of Ankang.

name: 凤堰古梯田
summaryEn: Hillside rice terraces in Xuanwo town, Hanyin County, made up of the Fengjiang and Yanping terrace systems and described as the largest and best-preserved Qing-dynasty terraces found in the Qinling–Daba region. They were begun in the Qianlong era by the Wu clan, migrants from Changsha prefecture in Hunan, built up on a large scale in the mid-19th century and are still farmed; Ming–Qing farmhouses such as the Wu family's 'flowered house' stand among some 12,000 mu (about 800 ha) of fields, golden with rice in autumn. The terraces became a national heritage site in 2019.
description: 凤堰古梯田位于陕西安康。游览特色包括梯田、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Xuanwo town, roughly 40 minutes by road south-west of Hanyin town; Hanyin is about an hour by road west of Ankang.

name: 鬼谷岭
summaryEn: The highest mountain in Shiquan County, also called Yunwu Mountain and protected as a national forest park, where the Warring States strategist Guiguzi is said to have taught his disciples. Its main peak is ringed by five ridges, and visitors come for old-growth forest, oddly shaped peaks, rocks and trees, caves, and seas of cloud in autumn; it is also regarded as a Daoist mountain.
description: 鬼谷岭位于陕西安康。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yunwushan town north-east of Shiquan town, roughly an hour by road.

name: 南宫山
summaryEn: A national forest park of 7,648 ha in eastern Langao County, described by the provincial government as the first in Shaanxi, whose three-peaked summit, Jinding, reaches 2,267 m. It is known for stone forests left by ancient volcanic eruptions, well-preserved Quaternary glacial landforms on its southern slope, dove trees and other rare plants, and temples that began as a Daoist temple in 1126 and later became Buddhist; a glass skywalk looks out over the sea of clouds.
description: 南宫山位于陕西安康。游览特色包括石林、寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 90 km south of central Ankang by road via Langao town, roughly 2 hours.

name: 千层河
summaryEn: A forested river valley in Hengxi town in the far south of Langao County, in the Daba Mountains. A path follows the clear stream upstream past a string of green pools through dense woodland, and the valley is often combined with Nangong Mountain and the Bashan grassland on trips through southern Ankang.
description: 千层河位于陕西安康。游览特色包括草原、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Hengxi town, roughly 2.5 hours by road south-west of Ankang via Langao town.

name: 秦巴文化生态旅游区
summaryEn: A belt of public parks of about 67 ha in the core of Ankang's High-tech Zone, west of the city centre, made up of a sports park, Beichen Park and a culture park. It has a large musical fountain, cycle tracks and outdoor courts, a landscaped water channel modelled on the Yue River with gold-panning motifs, and features that recreate landmarks from Ankang's counties such as Nangong Mountain and Houliu old town.
description: 秦巴文化生态旅游区位于陕西安康。游览特色包括运动休闲、城市公园、历史街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Ankang's High-tech Zone along Ankang Avenue, a short taxi or city-bus ride west of the centre.

name: 陕甘茶马古道
summaryEn: A scenic area at Wafangdian in Xiangyang town, where the Zhu and Ren rivers meet west of Ziyang town, built around the Qing guild halls of the merchants of the old tea trade, together with a tea-hill trail and a small tea garden. Its centrepiece, the Beiwusheng Guild Hall ('Hall of the Five Northern Provinces'), was begun at the end of the Qianlong era and finished in the Tongzhi era; its two halls, once dedicated to Guan Yu, carry about 100 m² of murals of the Twenty-four Exemplars of Filial Piety and the Three Kingdoms. The murals, hidden behind panelling when the hall became a granary in 1952 and rediscovered in 2006, were conserved in a Sino-German project, and performances are now staged in the guild halls.
description: 陕甘茶马古道位于陕西安康。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、园林景观、古道。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Wafangdian, Xiangyang town, roughly 20–30 minutes by road west of Ziyang town; Ziyang is about 1.5 hours by road from Ankang.

name: 石泉古城
summaryEn: The historic core of Shiquan town on the Han River, with the Yuwang Palace, a temple to Yu the Great first built in the Tang, and a cluster of Ming and Qing buildings including the old county yamen, the Jiangxi guild hall and the east and west gates. In the evening its old streets turn into a night market of food stalls serving local dishes.
description: 石泉古城位于陕西安康。游览特色包括古城、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Shiquan town, about 1.5 hours by road west of Ankang along the Han River.

name: 双河口古镇
summaryEn: A small market town in the hills of northern Hanyin County, founded in the early Ming about 600 years ago where the Loufang and Lishu rivers meet, and long the trading and transport centre of the area. Its old street keeps old shopfronts and a guild hall, and it is often visited together with the Fengyan terraces and the memorial hall of Hanyin's scholarly Shen brothers.
description: 双河口古镇位于陕西安康。游览特色包括古镇、纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shuanghekou town, roughly 30–40 minutes by road north of Hanyin town.

name: 双龙景区
summaryEn: A dragon-themed scenic area in Shuanglong town, southern Hanbin District, where a 5.6 km loop links Longtan Gorge, Xianglong Valley, the Youlong waterfall, the Qinglong stockade and the Yulong Palace. Built around the theme of the origins of the Chinese dragon, it combines gorge walking, limestone caves and a hilltop stockade with dragon legends and staged performances.
description: 双龙景区位于陕西安康。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shuanglong town, about 30 km south of central Ankang, roughly half an hour by the Ankang–Langao expressway (Shuanglong exit, then 3 km).

name: 蜀河古镇
summaryEn: An old Han River port 53 km east of Xunyang town, where the Shu River joins the Han, nicknamed 'Little Hankou' for its river trade. It keeps stone-paved lanes, Ming and Qing guild halls and old wooden houses with plank fronts, lattice windows and fine carving, and is listed as a national historic and cultural town.
description: 蜀河古镇位于陕西安康。游览特色包括古镇、商贸街区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 53 km east of Xunyang town along the Han River, roughly an hour by road.

name: 桃花溪
summaryEn: A wooded creek valley in Tielu village, Guangfo town, about 15 km from Pingli town. The stream drops through a series of clear pools and stepped cascades, which the local tourism bureau likens to a small Jiuzhaigou.
description: 桃花溪位于陕西安康。游览特色包括山谷、林地风光、草原。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 15 km from Pingli town by road, around half an hour.

name: 天宝梯彩农园
summaryEn: An agri-tourism park in Tianbao village, Cangshang town, in western Baihe County, built around hillsides of stone-walled terraced fields presented as 'land art'. It combines working farm and livestock areas with sightseeing, melons and fruit grow on the terraces in season, and it lies about 12 km south of Shuhe Ancient Town, with which it is often paired.
description: 天宝梯彩农园位于陕西安康。游览特色包括古镇、田园观光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Cangshang town, western Baihe County, roughly 1.5 hours by road east of Ankang.

name: 天书峡
summaryEn: A gorge in Baxian town at the southern end of Pingli County, on the Chongqing border and within the Qianjiaping national forest park, with old forest, waterfalls and mid-mountain meadows. Its name, 'Heavenly Books Gorge', comes from the layered, vertically jointed slabs of slate strewn along the stream, which local legend says are books left behind by the Eight Immortals.
description: 天书峡位于陕西安康。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Baxian town in the far south of Pingli County, roughly 1–1.5 hours by road south of Pingli town via the Ankang–Laifeng expressway.

name: 筒车湾
summaryEn: A 12 km² river-and-forest leisure area on the Wenshui River in Tongchewan town, on the southern slopes of the Qinling in Ningshan County, with streams, falls, springs and pools under more than 90% forest cover. It bundles five attractions: a 5.6 km rafting run on the Wenshui that passes through a 200 m tunnel, a riverside water park, the Canglong Gorge forest park with plank walkways past its pools, the Huangliang Gully wellness garden, and an unusually designed City God temple.
description: 筒车湾位于陕西安康。游览特色包括峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tongchewan town, roughly an hour by road north of Shiquan town.

name: 雁山瀑布
summaryEn: A wooded valley in Xihe town, southern Shiquan County, where a stream drops more than 300 m in 13 steps, forming 47 waterfalls and 36 pools. Footpaths climb beside the falls, cliffs and flower plantings, and the valley stays mild in winter and cool in summer.
description: 雁山瀑布位于陕西安康。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 40 minutes by road south of Shiquan town, on the road towards Xihe.

name: 燕翔洞
summaryEn: A natural limestone cave system in Yundou town on the Han River in southern Shiquan County, of which about 1.6 km has been opened to visitors. Inside are stalactites, flowstone 'waterfalls', stone curtains, rimstone dams, stalagmites and many other formations, and the cave keeps a mild, even temperature all year.
description: 燕翔洞位于陕西安康。游览特色包括瀑布、洞穴。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yundou town, roughly an hour by road south of Shiquan town.

name: 中坝大峡谷
summaryEn: A 21 km² canyon scenic area in Houliu town, Shiquan County, of cliffs, stacked boulders, mountain springs and thick bamboo and woodland. Plank walkways fixed to the cliffs pass high waterfalls and clear pools, and the trip is often combined with the riverside old town of Houliu and the Zhongba craft village nearby.
description: 中坝大峡谷位于陕西安康。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Houliu town, roughly an hour by road south-west of Shiquan town.

name: 长乐塬抗战工业遗址
summaryEn: Remains of the Shenxin cotton mill that the Rong family's textile firm moved from Hankou to Baoji in 1938, during the war against Japan. Workers dug 24 linked cave workshops into the Changle loess terrace, about 1.75 km long in all, which went into production in April 1941, and the site also keeps the mill's office building and a thin-shell concrete workshop.
description: 长乐塬抗战工业遗址位于陕西宝鸡。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、工业参观、洞穴。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Shilipu, Jintai District, about 6 km east of Baoji railway station by taxi.

name: 凤县革命纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial hall in Fengzhou opened in 2016 on the county's twentieth-century political history. Its exhibitions cover the Communist organising in the local garrison that led to the Liangdang Mutiny of April 1932, which Xi Zhongxun helped to organise, the Red Army's passage through the county, the wartime Industrial Cooperatives (Gung Ho) movement and the end of Nationalist rule in the county.
description: 凤县革命纪念馆位于陕西宝鸡。游览特色包括纪念展览、历史纪念。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Fengzhou village, about 10 km east of the Feng County seat at Shuangshipu by road and under 1 km from Xiaozai Temple.

name: 扶眉战役纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial hall and martyrs' cemetery at Changxing in Mei County for the Fumei Campaign of 10–14 July 1949, in which the People's Liberation Army defeated Hu Zongnan's Nationalist forces in the Wei valley between Fufeng and Mei County. Begun in the 1950s, when the remains of fallen soldiers were gathered here, and opened to the public in 1972, it has a 19.49 m monument and exhibitions on the campaign with relics and a sand-table model.
description: 扶眉战役纪念馆是一个位于中华人民共和国陕西省宝鸡市眉县常兴镇的一个纪念扶眉战役的纪念馆，纪念馆面积1560平方米，烈士纪念碑19.49米。于1953年开始筹建，1954年开始收敛阵亡士兵遗骨，1955年收集阵亡士兵遗物。
accessEn: In Changxing town, Mei County, about 1 hour by road east of Baoji.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 关山草原
summaryEn: An upland of alpine meadow and forest in the Guanshan mountains on the Shaanxi–Gansu border, at Guanshan village in Tiancheng town, south-west Long County. The grassland, a provincial scenic area and tourist resort, is at its best in summer, when it is a popular cool-weather retreat.
description: 关山草原位于陕西宝鸡。游览特色包括草原、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: On provincial road S305 about 30 km south-west of Long County town, a long day trip by road from Baoji.

name: 九龙山
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in western Chencang District whose nine converging peaks are said to resemble nine dragons, with red-sandstone Danxia cliffs rising to 1,910 m and forest. A hot-spring hotel named after the mountain has been built for visitors.
description: 九龙山位于陕西宝鸡。游览特色包括山地游览、林地风光、砂岩地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In western Chencang District, roughly 1 hour by road west of central Baoji.

name: 龙门洞
summaryEn: A Taoist mountain sanctuary in Xinjichuan town north-west of Long County, where the Quanzhen master Qiu Chuji spent seven years in retreat in the late 12th century; the Longmen (Dragon Gate) school of Taoism, which honours him as its patriarch, takes its name from the place. Temple halls are built against cliffs and in caves above a gorge, within a forest park.
description: 龙门洞位于陕西宝鸡。游览特色包括峡谷、寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xinjichuan town about 40 km north-west of Long County town, best reached by car.

name: 青峰峡
summaryEn: A national forest park in a Qinling gorge near Taochuan in Taibai County, with dense forest, streams and the Qingfeng Waterfall. The area keeps traces of Quaternary glaciation.
description: 青峰峡位于陕西宝鸡。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 12 km east of the Taibai County seat, which is roughly 1.5 hours by road south of Baoji.

name: 红河谷森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park in Yingtou town, Mei County, on the north slopes of the Qinling below the main peak of Mount Taibai. Paths lead up a wooded valley past streams, small temples and waterfalls, among them the Doumu Falls.
description: 红河谷森林公园位于陕西宝鸡。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Near Yingtou, about 20 km south of the Mei County seat, roughly 1.5 hours by road east of Baoji.

name: 水城·三国小镇
summaryEn: A modern tourist town at Caijiapo in southern Qishan County, built in old style around canals and ponds on a Three Kingdoms theme. Its period-style streets hold shops and food stalls, so it suits a relaxed stroll rather than heritage sightseeing.
description: 水城·三国小镇位于陕西宝鸡。游览特色包括运河。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Caijiapo, about 5 km north-east of Qishan high-speed railway station by taxi.

name: 周公庙
summaryEn: A temple to the Duke of Zhou, the royal regent who helped consolidate the early Zhou kingdom, at the foot of Fenghuang Hill north-west of Qishan town; its present halls date from the Ming and Qing dynasties. The hill's southern slope is the Zhougong Temple archaeological site, where excavations in the 2000s found large Western Zhou tombs thought to belong to the Duke of Zhou's family and more than 11,000 fragments of oracle bones. The temple is now part of the Zhou Culture Scenic Area, marketed as China·Zhouyuan, which adds a modern Zhou-themed town where staged shows recreate Zhou rites and scenes from the Investiture of the Gods legend.
description: 周公庙位于陕西宝鸡。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 6 km north-west of Qishan town, a short taxi ride from the town centre.

name: 通天河国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park of wooded mountains and streams in the Qinling range of northern Feng County, in Tangzang town. It is promoted for a high-mountain 'stone forest' of rock pillars.
description: 通天河国家森林公园位于陕西宝鸡。游览特色包括石林、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Tangzang town in northern Feng County, roughly 2 hours by road south-west of Baoji.

name: 消灾寺
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple complex on Douji Hill at Fengzhou, facing the old town of Fengzhou across the river. Its name, 'temple of dispelling disaster', comes from a local tradition that Emperor Xuanzong of Tang prayed here while fleeing the An Lushan rebellion.
description: 消灾寺位于陕西宝鸡。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、佛教文化、历史街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Douji Hill at Fengzhou, about 10 km east of the Feng County seat at Shuangshipu by road.

name: 长青华阳
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area around Huayang, an old post town on the Tangluo road across the Qinling that keeps Ming- and Qing-era buildings, beside the Changqing National Nature Reserve at an average altitude of about 1,700 m. The crested ibis, giant panda, golden snub-nosed monkey and takin all live wild in these mountains, and the Qinling Four Treasures Park and its exhibition hall introduce them. The town also has the former headquarters of the Red Army's 25th Army.
description: 长青华阳位于陕西汉中。游览特色包括自然保护区、山地游览、主题展览。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Huayang town, about 49 km north of Yang County town by mountain road.

name: 朱鹮梨园
summaryEn: A scenic area on the edge of Yang County town that combines pear orchards with the Crested Ibis Ecological Park, a rescue and breeding centre for the endangered crested ibis. Visitors can watch the birds in a rewilding aviary of nearly 10,000 m²; it was in this county that the last seven known wild crested ibises were found in 1981.
description: 朱鹮梨园位于陕西汉中。游览特色包括果园。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the edge of Yang County town, about 50 km east of Hanzhong; Yang County has high-speed trains to Xi'an in about an hour.

name: 佛坪熊猫谷
summaryEn: A wildlife park in a forested valley north of Foping town, on a corridor used by the Qinling giant panda population and close to the Foping National Nature Reserve. It contains a training base where more than ten giant pandas, among them the brown panda Qizai, have been prepared for life in the wild, a canyon where troops of golden snub-nosed monkeys roam, and an enclosure of golden pheasants and other pheasants.
description: 佛坪熊猫谷位于陕西汉中。游览特色包括峡谷、自然保护区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km north of Foping town along the G108; Foping station on the Xi'an–Chengdu high-speed railway, beside the town, is the easiest approach, with a taxi ride on to the valley.

name: 汉江源
summaryEn: A forested valley in Ningqiang County where the Yudai River, regarded as the source of the Han River, rises among wooded hills and streams, with mist and ice in winter. Ningqiang keeps a strong Qiang cultural tradition, and Qiang song-and-dance and nuo troupes regularly perform here, including ritual feats such as climbing a ladder of blades.
description: 汉江源位于陕西汉中。游览特色包括山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 10 km south-west of Ningqiang town, which high-speed trains reach from Hanzhong in about 30 minutes.

name: 黎坪国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park in the Daba and Micang mountains near the Sichuan border south of Hanzhong, with primeval forest, gorges and waterfalls along the Yudai and Xiliu rivers and extensive stands of Bashan pine. Its best-known sight is Longlin ('Dragon Scale') Mountain, a reddish ridge whose rock is packed with fossil nautiloids (Sinoceras) more than 400 million years old.
description: 黎坪国家森林公园位于陕西汉中。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Roughly 2–3 hours by road south-west of Hanzhong via Nanzheng; the visitor centre is near Liping town.

name: 骆家坝古镇
summaryEn: A small market town at the head of the Muma River, at the northern foot of the Micang Mountains, whose old riverside street has been rebuilt in traditional style. The scenic area also takes in the Huilong Gorge and the restored venue of the Zhongjiagou meeting, a site from the revolutionary period, and the town stages folk performances and food fairs on holidays.
description: 骆家坝古镇位于陕西汉中。游览特色包括峡谷、古镇。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the far south-west of Xixiang County, roughly 50 km by mountain road from Xixiang town.

name: 石门栈道
summaryEn: A scenic area at the mouth of the Bao valley, where the Baoxie road, the oldest of the plank roads across the Qinling to Sichuan, came out onto the Hanzhong plain and where the Eastern Han cut the Shimen ('Stone Gate') tunnel through the cliff. The original tunnel was flooded by the Shimen reservoir in the early 1970s and its famous inscriptions moved to the Hanzhong Museum, so visitors see a reconstructed cliff-side plank road, a replica tunnel, the dam and the reservoir, which can be toured by boat.
description: 石门栈道位于陕西汉中。游览特色包括博物馆、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Baogukou near Hedongdian, about 18 km north of central Hanzhong; city bus 21 runs to Hedongdian bus station, about 500 m from the scenic area.

name: 五龙洞国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park of forested mountains and valleys in Wulongdong town, northern Lueyang County, made up of the Wulong Valley, the Qinglong and Bailong gullies, the Sanfo Temple area and a Di-Qiang folk village. The village has houses built in the style of the Di and Qiang peoples who once lived here, and Qiang dances, bonfire evenings, embroidery and paper-cutting are offered to visitors in the town.
description: 五龙洞国家森林公园位于陕西汉中。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wulongdong town, about 48 km north of Lueyang town by mountain road, roughly 1–1.5 hours.

name: 午子山
summaryEn: A wooded hill a little over 10 km south-east of Xixiang town, covered by some 200 hectares of lacebark pine, a rare tree with mottled pale bark. Cliff inscriptions and carved images are scattered over the mountain, among them the characters 'Feifeng Shan' that local legend attributes to the Three Kingdoms general Zhang Fei, and the summit looks out over Xixiang and its valley.
description: 午子山位于陕西汉中。游览特色包括山谷、林地风光、登山观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: A little over 10 km south-east of Xixiang town, about 20 minutes by road; the Shiyan–Tianshui expressway has a Wuzishan exit.

name: 兴汉胜境
summaryEn: A modern culture park built in Han-dynasty style around Hanyuan Lake in Hanzhong's Xinghan New Area, with a large Han Culture Museum, the Han Yuefu hall of Han-style music and banquets, a city planning exhibition hall and two streets of shops and restaurants. In the evening a water show, Tian Han Chuanqi, is staged on the lake, and holiday events include Hanfu costume parades.
description: 兴汉胜境位于陕西汉中。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Xinghan New Area about 5 km north of central Hanzhong, a short taxi ride.

name: 栈道水世界
summaryEn: A hillside water park at Daoshuiwan in Wuguanyi town, in the Qinling valleys of Liuba County, with a wave pool, large water slides, a lazy river and children's water play areas, themed on the ancient plank roads of the area. A river-rafting run starts from the same site, and it is a summer outing for families rather than a historic site.
description: 栈道水世界位于陕西汉中。游览特色包括水上游乐、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wuguanyi town, Liuba County, roughly 70 km north of Hanzhong by road; the water park opens only in summer, so check before going.

name: 张良庙·紫柏山
summaryEn: A large Ming and Qing temple complex at the south-eastern foot of Zibai Mountain in the Qinling, dedicated to Zhang Liang, the strategist who helped Liu Bang found the Han dynasty and who, by tradition, retired here as a recluse. Its twelve parts climb from a memorial archway and bridge through gate halls, a Hall of the Three Pure Ones and garden courtyards to a pavilion reached by a steep stairway, and it is one of the largest and best-preserved temples to Zhang Liang in China. The scenic area also takes in Zibai Mountain behind it, a national forest park whose karst summit, reached by cableway, has grassy sinkhole meadows at up to about 2,600 m.
description: 张良庙·紫柏山位于陕西汉中。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: At Miaotaizi in Liuhou town, Liuba County, about 88 km north of Hanzhong, roughly 1.5 hours by road.

name: 丹江漂流
summaryEn: A commercial rafting trip on the Dan River (Danjiang) at Danfeng, in which visitors drift in rafts down a stretch of the river valley between the Qinling hills. It is a warm-season activity that suits families and groups wanting a few hours on the water, and it can be combined with Dihua Ancient Town upstream.
description: 丹江漂流位于陕西商洛。游览特色包括古镇、山谷、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Starts at Danfeng town, roughly 2 hours by expressway south-east of Xi'an.

name: 棣花古镇
summaryEn: A scenic area opened in 2014 at Dihua, an old post station on the Shangyu road about 15 km west of Danfeng and the home village of the novelist Jia Pingwa. Its two streets are Song–Jin Street, whose paving marks the 12th-century border between the Song and Jin, and Qingfeng Street, the old village street restyled after his novel The Shaanxi Opera; the restored Erlang Temple is described as Shaanxi's only surviving Jin-dynasty building. There is also a museum of Jia's work near his old family home, and wide lotus ponds that are lit up for night visits.
description: 棣花古镇位于陕西商洛。游览特色包括古镇、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 15 km west of Danfeng town, next to the Dihua exit of the Shanghai–Shaanxi expressway; roughly 2 hours by road from Xi'an.

name: 漫川古镇
summaryEn: An old trading town at the south-eastern tip of Shaanxi on the border with Hubei, which grew from the Eastern Jin onwards as a river-and-road transfer point between the Qin lands to the north and Chu to the south. Its core is a row of three Qing guild halls begun in 1881 – the Mule Caravan Guild Hall, the Northern Guild Hall and the Wuchang Guild Hall – covering more than 12,000 m², and the mule guild's paired opera stages are finely built and carved; the Mule Caravan Guild Hall is a national heritage site.
description: 漫川古镇位于陕西商洛。游览特色包括古镇、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 40 km south-east of Shanyang town by expressway; Manchuanguan station on the Xi'an–Shiyan high-speed railway, opened in June 2026, is about 3 km north of the old town.

name: 月亮洞
summaryEn: A limestone show cave halfway up a hillside above the Jinqian River in Yangdi town, south-western Shanyang County, at the heart of a scenic area that also takes in the Jiashi Gorge. Local legend gives the cave nine levels, of which four, with more than 1.5 km of passages, have been opened, winding like a maze past stalactites and other formations; the Tianpeng Shanzhai scenic area lies about 15 km to the west.
description: 月亮洞位于陕西商洛。游览特色包括峡谷、洞穴、钟乳石。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yangdi town, about 50 km west of Shanyang town by road, roughly an hour.

name: 木王国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park of 3,616 ha in the far west of Zhen'an County, designated in 2003, with old-growth forest, high-mountain wetland, rhododendron groves, peaks and rock formations. It has four areas – Sihaiping with gorges, waterfalls and alpine meadow, Shuangtouma with a long bare-rock 'stone waterfall' and rhododendrons, Cigou with its rhododendron belt, and Yingzuifeng (Eagle-Beak Peak) – and is home to protected animals such as takin, golden eagle, black bear and giant salamander; the rhododendrons flower in spring.
description: 木王国家森林公园位于陕西商洛。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、湿地。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 76–78 km west of Zhen'an town by road, roughly 156 km from Xi'an.

name: 牛背梁国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park on the main ridge of the Qinling in Zhashui County, named after its ox-back-shaped summit and rising from about 1,000 m to 2,802 m. Its zones run from Lingniu (Takin) Valley, with streams, pools and waterfalls, up through Qinling fir and rhododendron belts to alpine meadow and Quaternary glacial landforms; the rhododendrons flower in May and the woods turn red in autumn. The park lies within the Niubeiliang UNESCO biosphere reserve and was rated 4A in 2013.
description: 牛背梁国家森林公园位于陕西商洛。游览特色包括瀑布、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Zhujiawan village, Yingpan town, about 42 km south of Xi'an through the Qinling Zhongnanshan Tunnel; Niubeiliang station on the Xi'an–Ankang high-speed railway, opened in September 2026, is in the same town.

name: 秦岭江山
summaryEn: A forest scenic area of about 2,400 ha in Yaoshi town in the north of Shangzhou District, near the source of the Dan River, with more than 90% forest cover. Its sights include a glass suspension bridge, the Doucao waterfall, a patch of karst 'stone teeth' rare in the Qinling, and the reputed retreat of the Four Hoary Recluses of Mount Shang from the early Han.
description: 秦岭江山位于陕西商洛。游览特色包括瀑布、林地风光、喀斯特地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 9 km north of the Yaoshi exit of the Shanghai–Shaanxi expressway, roughly 33 km from Shangluo city and 90 km from Xi'an.

name: 桃花谷
summaryEn: A valley at Zhulinguan near where Shaanxi, Henan and Hubei meet, developed around soil-and-water-conservation works and described by the city government as Shangluo's largest peach-blossom viewing area. It is a national soil-and-water-conservation demonstration park and national water park, and was rated 4A in early 2026; spring, when the peach trees flower, is the time to go.
description: 桃花谷位于陕西商洛。游览特色包括水上游乐、山谷、花卉观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Zhulinguan town, roughly an hour by road south-east of Danfeng town.

name: 塔云山
summaryEn: A pagoda-shaped peak in Chaiping town, south-west of Zhen'an town, crowned by a group of Daoist temple buildings more than 500 years old. The Guanyin hall on the Golden Summit stands on a rock pinnacle with sheer drops on three sides; a cableway, a glass bridge and swings have been added, and the peak is a noted spot for seas of cloud.
description: 塔云山位于陕西商洛。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、古塔。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km south-west of Zhen'an town by road; Zhen'an West station on the Xi'an–Ankang high-speed line opened in September 2026.

name: 天蓬山寨
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in south-western Shanyang County, named after a 6 km gorge between the Yintai and Dingjia ridges and a stone stronghold (shanzhai) about 300 m long, from the Ming–Qing period, on the Yintai ridge above it. Paths follow the gorge past pools, waterfalls and features such as a water-curtain cave and a narrow 'one-line sky' cleft, and climb to the old stronghold walls; the area has been developed for tourism since the early 2010s.
description: 天蓬山寨位于陕西商洛。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the far south-west of Shanyang County, where Yangdi and Hujiayuan towns meet, about 80 km from Shanyang town by mountain road.

name: 阳城驿
summaryEn: A themed scenic area in Fushui town, just east of Shangnan town, built around Yangcheng post station on the old Shangyu road and the late-Ming rebel leader Li Zicheng, who is said to have camped in the nearby hills. It has three parts: a post-station complex rebuilt on the old site; the Chuangwang Zhai hilltop stronghold themed on Li Zicheng, where a staged horseback battle show is performed; and a large tea-garden park where visitors can try picking tea.
description: 阳城驿位于陕西商洛。游览特色包括园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Fushui town, about 8 km east of Shangnan town by road.

name: 云盖寺古镇
summaryEn: An old market town on the river 18 km west of Zhen'an town, named after Yungai Temple, a once-large monastery rebuilt in the Ming and Qing dynasties. Its front, back and 'half' streets run for more than 1.2 km between some 40 courtyard houses in a mix of Huizhou and Sichuan styles, mostly from the Ming–Qing period or later and restored since 2013. The temple, the old streets and a set of carved cliff inscriptions on the hill nearby are provincial protected sites.
description: 云盖寺古镇位于陕西商洛。游览特色包括古镇、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 18 km west of Zhen'an town by road.

name: 柞水溶洞
summaryEn: A cluster of more than a hundred limestone caves in Xialiang town, Zhashui County, set among gorges and waterfalls. The main show caves are Foye Cave, whose Zhuanjinglou section is crowded with stalactites, stalagmites and formations likened to figures and animals, and the corridor-shaped Tiandong (Heaven Cave) next to it, where the formations are within arm's reach.
description: 柞水溶洞位于陕西商洛。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、洞穴。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 15 km south of Zhashui town by road; Zhashui is roughly 1–1.5 hours from Xi'an by expressway, or a short ride on the Xi'an–Ankang high-speed line to Zhashui West, opened in September 2026.

name: 动漫花溪谷
summaryEn: A flower-garden park on the edge of Yijun town, planted with herbaceous peonies, a medicinal-herb valley and bamboo, with windmills, a play castle and other attractions for children, a 100 m slide and a toboggan run of about 1 km. It holds peony-season and beer and food festivals, and suits families.
description: 动漫花溪谷位于陕西铜川。游览特色包括山谷、园林景观、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the edge of Yijun town, roughly an hour by road north of central Tongchuan; Yijun has a station on the Xi'an–Yan'an high-speed railway, opened in December 2025.

name: 金锁关石林
summaryEn: A sandstone landscape in the hills of Jinsuoguan, north of central Tongchuan, where rockfalls and weathering have left a maze of pillars, cliffs and boulders, unusual on the plateau north of the Wei River. Paths wind through the rocks, and a cableway, a glass suspension bridge, a cliff swing and a zip line add thrill rides.
description: 金锁关石林位于陕西铜川。游览特色包括石林、砂岩地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jinsuoguan town about 20 km north of central Tongchuan by road.

name: 溪山胜境
summaryEn: A wooded valley of red Danxia sandstone cliffs at Zhaojin, said to be the landscape behind Travellers among Mountains and Streams, the famous painting by the Northern Song artist Fan Kuan. A former coal-mining area that has been replanted, it has mountain paths, a cableway to a viewing platform named after the painter, a campsite and a hotel, and is known for red autumn leaves and frozen waterfalls in winter.
description: 溪山胜境位于陕西铜川。游览特色包括瀑布、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xiufanggou, Zhaojin town, about 1.5 hours by road from Xi'an.

name: 耀州窑博物馆
summaryEn: The site museum of the Yaozhou kilns at Huangbao, which from the Tang to the Yuan made what is generally regarded as the finest northern celadon, prized in the Northern Song for its olive-green glaze over carved and later moulded decoration. Besides galleries of excavated ceramics, two halls shelter excavated kiln and workshop remains, including a Tang site where sancai three-colour wares were made, and there are demonstrations of traditional pottery-making.
description: 耀州窑博物馆位于陕西铜川。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Huangbao town beside the Huangbao exit of the Xi'an–Tongchuan expressway, about 10 km south of central Tongchuan.

name: 照金·香山
summaryEn: Zhaojin, in the red Danxia sandstone hills west of Tongchuan, was the centre of the Shaanxi–Gansu Border revolutionary base set up in the early 1930s by Communist leaders including Liu Zhidan and Xie Zichang; its sites include the cliff caves of Xuejiazhai, used as Red Army strongholds, a memorial hall on the base's history first opened in 2004 and rebuilt in 2013, and an immersive light show on the Xuejiazhai battle. The scenic area also takes in Daxiangshan, a Buddhist mountain about 12 km to the north-east with a temple said to date from the 4th century and linked by legend to Princess Miaoshan, who became the bodhisattva Guanyin.
description: 照金·香山位于陕西铜川。游览特色包括纪念展览、全国重点文物保护单位、国家一级博物馆。图集建议预留1 天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Zhaojin town is roughly an hour by road west of Tongchuan, with tourist buses from Tongchuan's high-speed railway station.

name: 丰图义仓
summaryEn: A walled charity granary at Chaoyi, begun in 1882 at the urging of the Qing minister Yan Jingming, a native of the town, after the Guanzhong famine of 1877, and still used to store state grain. Built as a fort within a fort, it has an outer rammed-earth wall and an inner rectangle of about 133 by 83 m whose 58 vaulted storage chambers form the inner wall; Empress Dowager Cixi is said to have called it the 'first granary under heaven'. Twelve small exhibition halls cover grain storage and local history.
description: 丰图义仓位于陕西渭南。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Near Chaoyi town, about 16 km east of Dali county town, roughly 25 minutes by road.

name: 富平陶艺村
summaryEn: A ceramics-themed village on the northern edge of Fuping town, built around the FuLe International Ceramic Art Museums (FLICAM). Each pavilion is devoted to ceramic artists from one country or region and shows work they made during residencies here: the French and Scandinavian pavilions opened first in 2005, followed by Australasia, North America and, in 2016, Ukraine.
description: 富平陶艺村位于陕西渭南。游览特色包括博物馆、楼阁建筑、陶瓷工艺。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Qiaoshan Road at the northern edge of Fuping county town, about 3 km from Fuping station and 8 km from Fuping South station on the Xi'an–Yan'an high-speed railway, about 20 minutes from Xi'an North. Reports in 2025 suggest the village may have closed, so check that it is open before going.

name: 梁带村芮国遗址博物馆
summaryEn: The site museum of the cemetery of Rui, a small Zhou-dynasty state on the Yellow River conquered by Qin in the 7th century BC, where excavations from 2004 found more than 1,300 tombs and 64 chariot-and-horse pits. Opened in 2018, its four galleries show about 800 bronzes, gold ornaments and jades from the 26,000 objects recovered, arranged to follow the order of excavation.
description: 梁带村芮国遗址博物馆位于陕西渭南。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: Beside Liangdai village, about 6 km north-east of Hancheng station and 2 km from Dangjia Village, so the two combine easily.

name: 林皋湖
summaryEn: A reservoir lake of about 2,200 mu (150 ha) in the loess uplands of northern Weinan, designated a national wetland park and promoted by Baishui county as the 'Lingao Lake International Slow City'. A road and lakeside paths ring the water, with viewing platforms and a sandy beach, and the scenic area extends to the planted forests of Fangshan.
description: 林皋湖位于陕西渭南。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 22 km north-west of Baishui county town, roughly 30 minutes by road.

name: 龙门钢铁景区
summaryEn: The working plant of Shaanxi Longmen Iron and Steel at Longmen, opened to visitors as an industrial tourism site on the theme of how steel is made. Guided visits in hard hats take in the company exhibition hall, the ore yard, the ironworks, the converter steel plant, the rolling mill where red-hot billets are drawn out into strip, and the production control centre, and they suit older children and anyone curious about heavy industry.
description: 龙门钢铁景区位于陕西渭南。游览特色包括工业参观、主题展览。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Longmen town about 20 km north-east of Hancheng station, roughly 30 minutes by road; visits are booked in advance through the site.

name: 少华山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park on the northern slopes of the Qinling Mountains south-east of Huazhou, named Shaohua ('Lesser Hua') as the smaller neighbour of Mount Hua further east. Paths climb wooded gorges such as Shimen Gorge to the hillside Qianlong Temple, near which a glass-floored walkway runs along a cliff.
description: 少华山国家森林公园位于陕西渭南。游览特色包括峡谷、寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The main gate is about 10 km south-east of Huazhou town, roughly 20 minutes by taxi.

name: 渭南葡萄产业园
summaryEn: A large table-grape estate at Xiagui in northern Linwei district, run as a farm park with a 10,000 m vine-covered arcade, rain-shelter vineyards, big greenhouses, a winery and a European-style garden. It is busiest in summer, when the arcade is in leaf and visitors come to pick grapes, and it holds a grape music season each July.
description: 渭南葡萄产业园位于陕西渭南。游览特色包括葡萄酒文化、园林景观、农业体验。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 1 km east of Xiagui town, some 25 km north of central Weinan, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 渭南市博物馆
summaryEn: The city museum of Weinan, rated a national second-grade museum, on Letian Street in the west of the city. Its permanent exhibition, 'Yu Hua Xiang Yi: the Story of Weinan', follows the eastern Guanzhong region from prehistory to modern times through finds from across the prefecture.
description: 渭南市博物馆位于陕西渭南。游览特色包括博物馆、主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 3 km south-west of Weinan North high-speed station, a short taxi ride.

name: 渭南桃花源
summaryEn: A folk-culture park built in the Linghe river valley south of Weinan, laid out in Ming–Qing Guanzhong style with timber courtyard houses, a gate tower, pavilions, a pagoda and a group of temples. It has a food street, traditional craft workshops and guesthouses, and suits a half-day outing from the city.
description: 渭南桃花源位于陕西渭南。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、古塔。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Sanzhang town about 8 km south of central Weinan, roughly 20 minutes by taxi.

name: 尧头窑
summaryEn: An old pottery village in Yaotou town whose folk kilns, traced by the Ming county gazetteer to the Tang dynasty and at their height under the Ming and Qing, made everyday black-glazed stoneware such as bowls, jars and basins, a craft potters still practise here. The site of about 4 km² keeps 129 kilns from the Ming, Qing and Republican periods, 78 workshops and 75 old houses, and the local firing technique has been national intangible cultural heritage since 2006.
description: 尧头窑位于陕西渭南。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、陶瓷工艺。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 11 km south-west of Chengcheng county town by road, roughly 15–20 minutes by taxi.

name: 中华郡
summaryEn: A culture-themed leisure park on the Jingshan plateau on the Fuping–Yanliang border, built around the legend that the Yellow Emperor cast his bronze tripods at Jingshan. It has a food street, a 'guochao' quarter of cafés and craft-experience shops, a hanfu shop, an inn, night markets and a recreated village of an ancient tribe, with iron-flower fire displays, Han–Tang dance shows and themed holiday programmes, and it suits families and evening visits.
description: 中华郡位于陕西渭南。游览特色包括公园休闲。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the Yanliang–Fuping Friendship Road about 1.5 km west of Fuping South station on the Xi'an–Yan'an high-speed railway, about 20 minutes from Xi'an North, and a short taxi ride from Fuping town or from Yanliang in Xi'an.

name: 白鹿仓
summaryEn: A themed leisure town on the White Deer Plain (Bailuyuan) south-east of Xi'an, opened in April 2017 and built around the life and folk customs of the plain in the early Republican era of the 1910s. It is a modern development rather than a historic village, with Republican-style streets, a waterside lane and some 300 snack and food stalls, and suits an easy half-day close to the city.
description: 白鹿仓位于陕西西安。游览特色包括民俗文化、村落风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the White Deer Plain in Baqiao District about 15 km south-east of the Bell Tower, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 浐灞国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A national wetland park on the floodplain of the Wei River at the northern edge of Xi'an, close to Weiyang Lake. It offers an easy walk among lakes and wetland planting rather than a sight in its own right.
description: 浐灞国家湿地公园位于陕西西安。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 18 km north of the Bell Tower in Weiyang District, about 1 km from Weiyanghu station on Metro Line 10.

name: 翠华山
summaryEn: A national geopark in the Zhongnan range of the Qinling Mountains, south of Xi'an, known for the huge rock blocks and boulder fields left by ancient landslides. Its centrepiece is Tianchi, a lake about 600 m long formed where fallen rock dammed the Taiyi valley, and paths climb from the lake through the landslide debris towards the higher peaks.
description: 翠华山位于陕西西安。游览特色包括地质景观、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km south of the Bell Tower in Chang'an District, roughly an hour by road.

name: 汉城湖
summaryEn: A long lakeside park in north-western Xi'an, created from 2006 out of the Tuanjie Reservoir, which had been dug in the 1950s along the old moat of the Han-dynasty capital. Paths run past Han-themed sculpture, a 21.5 m statue of Emperor Wu and the 64 m Dafeng Pavilion, which has small exhibitions inside and views over the lake from the top, and the remains of the Han city's south-east corner are marked in the park.
description: 汉城湖位于陕西西安。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 5 km north-west of the Bell Tower, beside Dafengge station on Metro Line 8 (opened in 2024).

name: 金龙峡
summaryEn: A gorge scenic area on the northern edge of the Qinling Mountains in Huyi District, west of General Mountain (Jiangjun Shan). A walking route follows the wooded valley upstream past a chain of waterfalls and pools.
description: 金龙峡位于陕西西安。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Qinling foothills of Huyi District about 40 km south-west of central Xi'an, roughly an hour or more by road.

name: 秦岭国家植物园
summaryEn: A botanical garden opened in 2017 on the northern slopes of the Qinling Mountains in Zhouzhi County, with a planning area of 639 km² that rises more than 2,000 m from the plain into the mountains. The visitor area holds themed gardens for peonies, ginkgos, orchids and water plants, a large greenhouse and a palaeobotany hall, while the mountain zones protect native forest.
description: 秦岭国家植物园位于陕西西安。游览特色包括植物园、园林景观、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 60 km south-west of central Xi'an near Jixian in Zhouzhi County, roughly 1.5 hours by road.

name: 秦岭野生动物园
summaryEn: A large zoo at the foot of the Qinling Mountains in Chang'an District, with more than 300 animal species. Visitors walk round one section to see animals such as golden monkeys, flamingos, hippos and Asian elephants, and ride through drive-through enclosures of African and Asian herbivores and of big cats; giant pandas are also kept. It suits families and makes an easy day out from the city.
description: 秦岭野生动物园位于陕西西安。游览特色包括动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 28 km south of central Xi'an at Luanzhen in Chang'an District, roughly 45 minutes to an hour by road.

name: 诗经里
summaryEn: A new themed town on the Feng River in Fengdong New City, opened in September 2017 and themed on the Book of Songs (Shijing), the ancient poetry anthology, close to where the Western Zhou capitals of Feng and Hao once stood. It combines a landscaped riverside with shops, restaurants and creative businesses, and suits an easy stroll and a meal.
description: 诗经里位于陕西西安。游览特色包括滨水景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At the southern end of Metro Line 16 (Shijingli station) in Fengdong New City, about 20 km south-west of the Bell Tower.

name: 南五台
summaryEn: A peak of the Zhongnan range south of Xi'an, named for its five summit terraces and long a centre of Buddhist retreat. A forested path of about 12 km climbs from a bamboo valley past a small waterfall and oddly shaped rocks to a string of small temples near the 1,688 m summit, and Shengshou Temple, founded under the Sui dynasty, keeps an old brick pagoda in the valley below.
description: 南五台位于陕西西安。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑、古塔。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Near Wutai in Chang'an District about 30 km south of the Bell Tower, roughly an hour by road, with the full climb taking several hours.

name: 太平国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park in the Taiping valley of the Qinling Mountains in Huyi District, named after a Sui-dynasty palace and rising from about 880 m to 3,000 m between steep cliffs, rapids and pools. Its best-known sight is a cluster of waterfalls, among them the Rainbow Waterfall, with larch and birch woods higher up and wild redbud flowering on the slopes in April.
description: 太平国家森林公园位于陕西西安。游览特色包括瀑布、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 50 km south-west of central Xi'an in the Qinling foothills of Huyi District, roughly 1.5 hours by road.

name: 王顺山
summaryEn: A national forest park in Lantian County, part of the Zhongnan range of the Qinling, covering about 36 km² and topped by Jade Emperor Peak at 2,239 m, with sheer rock faces that have earned it the nickname of Shaanxi's little Huangshan. It is named after Wang Shun, a son of local legend who carried earth up the mountain to bury his mother, and a temple to him, oddly shaped rocks, a narrow gorge and an old azalea tree line the climb.
description: 王顺山位于陕西西安。游览特色包括峡谷、寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Near Lanqiao about 55 km south-east of Xi'an off National Road 312, roughly an hour by road; the climb to the top takes about four hours.

name: 白鹿原影视城
summaryEn: A film and television theme park built by the Shaanxi Tourism Group on the White Deer Plain, the loess tableland that gave its name to Chen Zhongshi's novel, and opened in July 2016. It mixes filming sets of old Guanzhong streets and villages with a long outdoor hillside stairway, parades of costumed film characters, daytime shows and an evening light show in the valley, and suits families on a half-day trip.
description: 白鹿原影视城位于陕西西安。游览特色包括主题游乐、山谷、影视拍摄。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the White Deer Plain in Lantian County about 40 km south-east of central Xi'an, roughly an hour by road.

name: 西安世博园
summaryEn: The grounds of the 2011 Xi'an International Horticultural Expo, laid out on the delta between the Chan and Ba rivers in north-eastern Xi'an and covering 418 hectares, of which 188 hectares are water. Kept as a public park after the expo, it has lakes, themed gardens and the Chang'an Tower, built as the expo's landmark.
description: 西安世博园位于陕西西安。游览特色包括园林景观、楼阁建筑、城市公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Chanba district about 13 km north-east of the Bell Tower, roughly 30–40 minutes by taxi.

name: 周至水街
summaryEn: A riverside leisure quarter laid out from 2012 along the Sha River, an old river that skirts Zhouzhi county town, with the Qinling Mountains as a backdrop. Its centre is Yanhuo Xiangzi, a lane district built in Han and Tang style and opened in 2022, where outdoor shows, small indoor theatres, open-air stages for folk performances and costumed characters accompany food stalls and inns. It is busiest in the evening and suits a night out from Xi'an or a stop on the way to Louguantai or the Qinling parks.
description: 周至水街位于陕西西安。游览特色包括滨水景观、戏剧演艺。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the south side of Zhouzhi county town about 70 km west of Xi'an, roughly 1–1.5 hours by road.

name: 张裕瑞那城堡酒庄
summaryEn: A winery of the Changyu wine group, opened in October 2013 in Qinhan New City between Xi'an and Xianyang and run with Italy's Reina winemaking family. Its castle-style building stands beside vineyards and a wine-themed garden, and visits take in the underground cellar of about 15,800 m², built to hold 15,000 oak barrels.
description: 张裕瑞那城堡酒庄位于陕西咸阳。游览特色包括城堡、葡萄酒文化、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Qinhan New City about 10 minutes by road from Xi'an Xianyang International Airport, or roughly 40 minutes from central Xi'an.

name: 茯茶镇
summaryEn: A tea-themed tourist town in Jinghe New City north of Xi'an, opened in August 2015 on the site of the old village of Shuangzhao and devoted to fu tea, a fermented brick tea. It has a tea street of shops and tea brands, a folk-food street of Guanzhong snacks and the China Fu Tea Culture Museum, and is mainly a place for tea tasting, snacks and an evening stroll.
description: 茯茶镇位于陕西咸阳。游览特色包括博物馆、茶文化、传统村落。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jinghe New City about 30 km north of central Xi'an, roughly 45 minutes by road.

name: 乐华欢乐世界
summaryEn: An amusement park in Jinghe New City north of Xi'an, opened as Lewa Hengye Happy World around a cluster of roller coasters and some 30 rides. After an upgrade it reopened on 1 May 2026 as Jinghuayuan · Darenguo, themed on the classic novel Flowers in the Mirror, adding lantern walks and costumed characters to the rides, with lantern displays and shows in the evening. It suits families and teenagers.
description: 乐华欢乐世界位于陕西咸阳。游览特色包括主题游乐、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jinghe New City about 25 km north of the Bell Tower, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 马栏革命旧址
summaryEn: Malan, in the hills of northern Xunyi County, was the seat of the Communist Party's Guanzhong sub-region of the Shaanxi–Gansu–Ningxia Border Region in the 1940s, on an important route from Xi'an to Yan'an. The site keeps a hillside of 375 cave dwellings dug by soldiers and local people after the sub-region's offices moved here at the end of 1941, a memorial monument and the Malan Revolutionary Memorial Hall, which shows photographs and office objects of the period and has a digital exhibition. It was named one of China's 100 classic red-tourism sites in 2005.
description: 马栏革命旧址位于陕西咸阳。游览特色包括纪念展览、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Malan town in the hills north-east of Xunyi town, roughly 3 hours by road from Xi'an.

name: 马嵬驿
summaryEn: A folk-culture park built from 2012 in a gully left empty when Lijiapo village was moved, named after the Mawei post station where Yang Guifei, consort of Emperor Xuanzong, was put to death during a mutiny of his guards in 756. Behind rammed-earth walls and a gate tower are new buildings in traditional style, restored loess cave dwellings with a collection of more than 23,000 old farm tools and household objects, and a snack street of Guanzhong dishes, with workshops pressing oil, making tofu and grinding chilli in stone mills. Yang Guifei's tomb is close by.
description: 马嵬驿位于陕西咸阳。游览特色包括楼阁建筑、洞穴。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Lijiapo in Mawei subdistrict about 11 km west of Xingping town, roughly 1–1.5 hours by road from Xi'an.

name: 西北农林科技大学博览园
summaryEn: A group of six museums on the campus of Northwest A&F University in Yangling, opened to the public in 2005 and described by the university as China's largest group of agriculture-themed museums. They cover insects, animals, soils, plants, the history of Chinese agriculture and water conservancy, drawing on collections that include more than 1.5 million insect specimens, and are set among a butterfly garden, an arboretum and herb and grain gardens. It suits families and anyone curious about natural history and farming.
description: 西北农林科技大学博览园位于陕西咸阳。游览特色包括博物馆、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Taicheng Road in Yangling about 80 km west of Xi'an, a short taxi ride from Yangling South high-speed station; from December to February it is closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 侍郎湖
summaryEn: A lake among the loess hills south-west of Binzhou, developed as an eco-tourism area. A walkway runs around the shore past fishing platforms and a glass suspension bridge, with campsites, guesthouses and restaurants by the lake.
description: 侍郎湖位于陕西咸阳。游览特色包括湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km south-west of central Binzhou, roughly 40 minutes by road; Binzhou is about 2 hours by road from Xi'an. It may be temporarily closed, so check before going.

name: 丝路欢乐世界
summaryEn: A Silk Road-themed park in Fengxi New City on the western edge of Xi'an, opened in April 2023 by the Shaanxi Tourism Group, laid out as seven themed streets that recreate places along the old trade routes, such as Rome, Persia and India, as stage-set architecture. Street performances, costumed characters, shops and restaurants fill the streets, and it is aimed at families and evening visitors.
description: 丝路欢乐世界位于陕西咸阳。游览特色包括古道。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Fengxi New City about 23 km west of the Bell Tower, near Fengxi Wenhua Gongyuan and Diaotai stations on Metro Line 5.

name: 咸阳湖
summaryEn: An artificial lake by the Wei River in central Xianyang, lined with riverside parks and promenades. Weibin Park runs along its north bank and the Gudu Langqiao, a covered footbridge, crosses the water; it makes an easy evening walk after the Xianyang Museum in the Confucian Temple, a few hundred metres to the north.
description: 咸阳湖位于陕西咸阳。游览特色包括博物馆、寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In central Xianyang, under 1 km south of the Xianyang Museum and roughly 40 minutes by road from central Xi'an.

name: 杨凌现代农业创新园
summaryEn: A showcase of modern farming of about 87 hectares in the Yangling agricultural high-tech zone, and Shaanxi's first 4A-rated agricultural tourism site. Eight exhibition halls cover factory seedling production, soilless cultivation, flowers, bonsai, a 'super vegetable garden', southern fruit trees and crops of western China, set among seed nurseries and an artificial lake planted with aquatic plants. It suits families and visitors interested in how farming technology works.
description: 杨凌现代农业创新园位于陕西咸阳。游览特色包括湖泊、田园观光、园林景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On Beihuan Road on the northern side of Yangling, about 80 km west of Xi'an, roughly 1.5 hours by road.

name: 袁家村
summaryEn: A Guanzhong farming village near Liquan that turned to rural tourism in 2007 and is now lined with brick-and-timber houses in Ming–Qing style. Its snack streets serve Guanzhong dishes made on the spot from the village's cooperative oil, vinegar, tofu and chilli workshops, and an old street holds craft shops for weaving, shadow puppets and woodblock New Year prints, along with cafés, bars and guesthouses. It drew about 9.5 million visitors in 2024, so weekends and holidays are very crowded.
description: 袁家村位于陕西咸阳。游览特色包括田园观光、农业体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Yanxia town in Liquan County, about 65 km north-west of Xi'an or roughly 1.5 hours by road, with the Zhaoling Museum about 2 km to the south.

name: 云集生态园
summaryEn: An eco-park and rural resort among locust-tree woodland in the hills of Yongshou County, with guesthouse courtyards, woodland walks and farm-style restaurants. Yongshou is known for its locust-tree forests and locust-blossom honey, and the trees flower in late spring.
description: 云集生态园位于陕西咸阳。游览特色包括林地风光、赏花。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills of Ganjing town, Yongshou County, about 100 km north-west of Xi'an, roughly 1.5–2 hours by road.

name: 黄陵国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park of about 44 km² in the Qiaoshan forest on the upper Ju River, south-west of Huangling town, opened to visitors in 2015. Its northern Xuanyuan Valley, which local legend makes the birthplace of the Yellow Emperor, has lakes, meadows and forest trails, and a ridge road leads south to Zi'e Temple with its cliffside shrines and walkways; it makes a green half-day outing for people visiting the Huangdi Mausoleum.
description: 黄陵国家森林公园位于陕西延安。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 40 km south-west of Huangling town by road, roughly an hour; Huangling has a station on the Xi'an–Yan'an high-speed railway, opened in December 2025.

name: 黄龙山
summaryEn: A 13 km² forest scenic area in the wooded Huanglong Mountains on the south-western edge of Huanglong town, with its visitor centre at Dianzihe village. It takes in Wuliang Shan, whose hilltop Lianyun Temple grew from an earlier Taoist shrine and keeps steles going back to the Ming dynasty and centuries-old pines and cypresses, a 6.2 km forest trail to Muke Zhai hill, a stone-carving gallery on local culture and a lake with water activities.
description: 黄龙山位于陕西延安。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Dianzihe on the edge of Huanglong town, about 220 km south-east of Yan'an by road; Hancheng is the nearer large town.

name: 劳山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park in the Lao Shan hills of south-western Ganquan County, south of Yan'an, where secondary forest covers the loess hills; the provincial forestry bureau puts its forest cover at 92%. It is a place for forest walks and picnics on a day trip from Yan'an.
description: 劳山国家森林公园位于陕西延安。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Near Dazhuang village in Dao town, roughly 30 km south-west of Ganquan town by road; Ganquan is about an hour south of Yan'an.

name: 中央红军长征胜利纪念园
summaryEn: A memorial park on Shengli ('Victory') Hill above Wuqi town, approved in 2005, marking the end of the Central Red Army's Long March, which reached Wuqi on 19 October 1935. Steps lead up past bronze sculptures, including a bugler, to the Long March Victory Monument and the hilltop command post of the 21 October 'cut the tail' battle, in which the Red Army ambushed the cavalry pursuing it.
description: 中央红军长征胜利纪念园位于陕西延安。游览特色包括雕塑艺术、历史纪念。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Shengli Hill on the edge of Wuqi town, about 3 hours by road north-west of Yan'an; the Wuqi Revolutionary Site is about 500 m away.

name: 秋林抗战纪念地
summaryEn: Qiulin, a small town in Yichuan County, was the headquarters of the Nationalist army's Second War Zone under Yan Xishan after the Japanese advance drove it out of Shanxi in 1938. The memorial site presents the former headquarters and other wartime sites in and around the town, with an exhibition hall on the period.
description: 秋林抗战纪念地位于陕西延安。游览特色包括主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Qiulin town, about 10 km east of Yichuan town on National Road 309, the road to the Hukou Waterfalls.

name: 碧麟湾
summaryEn: A modern four-season resort south of Shenmu city, with a water park and amusement rides for the summer season. In winter it runs a ski area with eight runs, three of them built to FIS standard, which was chosen to host alpine skiing and snowboard events of Shaanxi's first Winter Games in February 2026.
description: 碧麟湾位于陕西榆林。游览特色包括滑雪、水上游乐、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 15 km south of central Shenmu along the Hanjie road, around 25 minutes by taxi.

name: 波罗古堡
summaryEn: A walled hilltop garrison town on Huangyun Hill above the south bank of the Wuding River, one of the forts of the Ming-dynasty Great Wall frontier in the Yulin region, with stone walls and four gates around an old main street; it is protected as a provincial heritage site. In October 1946 the Nationalist garrison stationed here under Hu Jingduo went over to the Communist side, an event known as the Hengshan Uprising.
description: 波罗古堡位于陕西榆林。游览特色包括长城、城堡。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 50 km south-west of central Yulin by road at Boluo town in Hengshan district, around an hour's drive.

name: 补浪河女子民兵治沙连
summaryEn: In 1974, 54 young women with an average age of 18 formed a militia company at Bulanghe to plant trees and fix the dunes of the Mu Us sands near the Inner Mongolia border, and the unit became known across China. The site has an exhibition hall on nearly fifty years of local sand control, the company's barracks and military-themed activities including a live-firing range and clay-pigeon shooting.
description: 补浪河女子民兵治沙连位于陕西榆林。游览特色包括历史纪念、主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 60 km west of central Yulin in Bulanghe township, roughly an hour by road.

name: 赤牛坬村
summaryEn: A hill village of old stone cave dwellings among jujube groves near the Yellow River, which its residents have turned into a folk-culture tourist village. Villagers perform their own open-air show, 'An Ox on the High Hill', recreating northern Shaanxi farm life, and the village has a northern Shaanxi folk-custom museum of old everyday objects in 68 exhibition rooms as well as cave dwellings converted into guest rooms. It suits visitors curious about rural life on the loess plateau.
description: 赤牛坬村位于陕西榆林。游览特色包括博物馆、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Kengzhen township about 20 km south of Jia County town, roughly 40 minutes by road.

name: 尔林兔大草原
summaryEn: A grassland scenic area in Erlintu township on the sandy steppe at the edge of the Mu Us Desert, run as a farm-and-grassland leisure park with open pasture, flower fields and a children's play park. Visitors come in summer for camping, farm activities, a folk-food street and bonfire evenings, and it lies close to Hongjiannao Lake, so the two are easily combined.
description: 尔林兔大草原位于陕西榆林。游览特色包括沙漠、草原、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 70 km north-west of Shenmu city near Erlintu town, around 1 hour 15 minutes by road.

name: 郝家桥
summaryEn: A loess-hill village south-west of Suide that the Shaanxi–Gansu–Ningxia Border Region government named a 'model village' in 1944, when the labour hero Liu Yuhou led its farmers' labour-exchange teams in the wartime production drive. It now presents that history as one of Suide's red-history education sites, and has turned 26 empty cave dwellings into guesthouses alongside a northern Shaanxi-themed shopping street and a village cinema.
description: 郝家桥位于陕西榆林。游览特色包括特色街区、洞穴。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 10 km south-west of Suide town in Zhangjiabian township, around 20 minutes by road.

name: 麻黄梁黄土地质公园
summaryEn: A 37 km² geopark on the loess plateau east of Yulin, where deep gullies have cut the thick loess into a 'peak forest' of pillars and ridges and exposed sections of Quaternary sediment, with desert landforms and fossil finds nearby. A two-storey visitor building holds a loess geology museum and an art gallery of paintings and photographs made here, and the area is a favourite of painters and photographers, especially after snow.
description: 麻黄梁黄土地质公园位于陕西榆林。游览特色包括博物馆、沙漠、地质景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 35 km east of central Yulin in Mahuangliang township, around 40 minutes by road.

name: 名州古城
summaryEn: The historic core of Suide town, run as a cultural tourism district that links the Mingzhou historic street with the Suide Revolutionary Memorial Hall, a museum of Han-dynasty carved stone reliefs and the Fusu Culture Garden around the tomb on Shushu Hill traditionally attributed to Fusu, eldest son of the First Emperor of Qin. On the hill stands the Xundi Tower, first built in the early Ming and recently rebuilt in Ming style on its old site.
description: 名州古城位于陕西榆林。游览特色包括博物馆、古城、纪念展览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Suide town, about 120 km south-east of Yulin by road (around 1½ hours).

name: 北国风光
summaryEn: A red-tourism scenic area on the Gaojiawa plateau above the Yellow River, named after the opening words of Mao Zedong's poem 'Snow' (Qinyuanchun · Xue). In February 1936, as the Red Army prepared to cross the river east into Shanxi, Mao came up to this plateau from his quarters in nearby Yuanjiagou village to survey the crossing in deep snow, and wrote the poem back in Yuanjiagou that night. The modern scenic area has the Cangxue Tower, a museum of Mao's poetry and a visitor centre.
description: 北国风光位于陕西榆林。游览特色包括楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In eastern Qingjian County near the Yellow River, about 45 km east of Qingjian town by road (around an hour); Mao's former quarters in Yuanjiagou village are nearby.

name: 陕北民歌博物馆
summaryEn: A museum devoted to the folk songs of northern Shaanxi, with about 5,700 m² of displays on traditional songs, the revolutionary songs of the Yan'an years such as 'The East Is Red', newer compositions and the region's folk music. The complex also has a 500-seat theatre, part of a youth activity centre, that doubles as a stage for folk-song performances.
description: 陕北民歌博物馆位于陕西榆林。游览特色包括博物馆、历史纪念、民歌。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At the north-east corner of the Jinsha Road and Hongshan East Road junction in northern Yulin city, about 4 km north of the old town by taxi; closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 圣都乐园
summaryEn: An open-plan amusement park inside the Yuxi riverside park in central Yulin, opened in October 2014. It opened with more than 20 large outdoor rides and over ten indoor ones, among them an 89 m Ferris wheel, a six-loop roller coaster and a water flume ride, and it suits families and thrill-ride fans.
description: 圣都乐园位于陕西榆林。游览特色包括主题游乐、滨水景观、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Binhe Road beside the Yuxi River in central Yulin, a short taxi ride from the old town.

name: 波浪谷
summaryEn: A Danxia landscape of eroded red sandstone in the gullies at Longzhou, south-east of Jingbian town, named for the wave-like layering of its rock. On holidays the scenic area stages local folk performances such as yangge and waist-drum dancing, the 'running donkey' dance and northern Shaanxi folk songs, and it drew 88,000 visitors over the 2026 National Day week.
description: 波浪谷位于陕西榆林。游览特色包括砂岩地貌、民歌。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 20 km south-east of Jingbian town in Longzhou township, around 30 minutes by road.

name: 杨家沟革命旧址
summaryEn: From November 1947 the CPC Central Committee's front committee under Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai and Ren Bishi, together with the PLA headquarters, spent 120 days in this loess-valley village during the civil war, and held an enlarged Central Committee meeting here on 25–28 December 1947, known as the December Meeting. The memorial site preserves the leaders' cave-dwelling residences and the meeting hall within the hillside manor of the local Ma family, with displays in a memorial hall.
description: 杨家沟革命旧址位于陕西榆林。游览特色包括全国重点文物保护单位、山谷、历史纪念。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 20 km east of Mizhi town in Yangjiagou township, around 30 minutes by road.

name: 黄河东渡
summaryEn: A Yellow River scenic area north of Wubu town that links three sites: the Erqi rapids, opposite Qikou in Shanxi, where the narrowed river pours over rock ledges; the old Guaishang ferry, with rafting on the river; and the memorial park at the Chuankou ferry, where Mao Zedong crossed into Shanxi on 23 March 1948, leaving northern Shaanxi after 13 years. The park has a monument, a memorial hall, sculptures and a landing stage.
description: 黄河东渡位于陕西榆林。游览特色包括纪念展览、水上活动、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 20 km north of Wubu town on the riverside road through Chashang township, around 30 minutes by road.

name: 大坪凤园花海
summaryEn: A flower park in the Daping agricultural park at Shuichuan, south-east of Baiyin city, opened in 2018, where beds of verbena, Iceland poppies, petunias and other flowers are laid out in the shape of a phoenix. A coloured slide, high swings and a small tourist train run beside the flowers, and there are a fruit-picking garden and tents for overnight stays, so it is mainly a family outing from early summer to autumn.
description: 大坪凤园花海位于甘肃白银。游览特色包括田园观光、花卉观赏、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shuichuan, about 20 km south-east of Baiyin city, 30–40 minutes by road.

name: 水岸三合
summaryEn: A riverside leisure park of about 47 ha on the Yellow River at Sanhe village, Dongwan, that combines farm and flower displays with a summer water-play area where water obstacle-course contests are held. It suits families looking for a summer day out from Jingyuan or Baiyin.
description: 水岸三合位于甘肃白银。游览特色包括滨水景观、公园休闲。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Sanhe village in Dongwan town, about 8 km from Jingyuan town, roughly 15 minutes by road.

name: 水川湿地公园
summaryEn: A wetland park of about 3,000 mu (roughly 200 ha) on the Yellow River at Shuichuan, south of Baiyin city, with lotus ponds that flower in summer, reedbeds, an artificial lake, zigzag bridges and a small tourist train. Waterbirds such as black swans and great crested grebes live here, and the park is often visited together with the nearby Daping flower park.
description: 水川湿地公园位于甘肃白银。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Shuichuan, about 20 km south of Baiyin city, 30 minutes by road.

name: 常家河山楂小镇
summaryEn: A farm-tourism area in Changjiahe town built around hawthorn orchards planted by a local cooperative from 2018, with blossom in spring and fruit in autumn. Around the orchards are a Daoist-style temple complex used as a study base, an old fortified village, the Longzhu viewing terrace, a small pet and bird park and traditional villages used as bases for sketching and photography, so it suits a countryside day out from Tongwei.
description: 常家河山楂小镇位于甘肃定西。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、果园、传统村落。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Changjiahe town, about 50 km by road south-west of Tongwei county town.

name: 狼渡滩
summaryEn: Langdutan is a broad upland of wetland meadows and grassland at an average height of about 2,600 m around Lüjing town in eastern Min County, threaded by winding streams and grazed by yaks, cattle and sheep. The G316 runs through it, which makes it an easy summer stop for wildflowers and cool weather, and a summer horse-racing festival has been held on the grassland.
description: 狼渡滩位于甘肃定西。游览特色包括湿地、草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Around Lüjing town, about 70 km east of Min County town on the G316.

name: 李家龙宫
summaryEn: The Lijia Longgong is the ancestral temple of the Li clan in Longxi, the clan's ancestral seat, said to have been founded in the early Tang and named from an inscription by Emperor Taizong. The surviving buildings come from rebuildings of 1577, 1648 and later, with new buildings in the old style added in recent years, and people surnamed Li visit it to trace their roots. It is usually visited together with the Longxi Museum beside it, whose collection includes Neolithic pottery and Song–Yuan tomb brick carvings.
description: 李家龙宫位于甘肃定西。游览特色包括寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Beiguan quarter of Longxi county town, about 1.3 km north-east of the Weiyuan Tower; Longxi is about an hour by road south of Dingxi city. The Longxi Museum beside it is closed on Mondays.

name: 岷州会议旧址
summaryEn: A memorial at Sanshilipu outside Min County town to the Minzhou Conference of 16–18 September 1936, at which the Communist Party's Northwest Bureau, meeting while the Red Army's Second and Fourth Front Armies were in Min County, rejected Zhang Guotao's plan to take the Fourth Front Army west and decided that the forces should go north to join the First Front Army. The Red Army passed through Min County in 1935 and stayed in 1936, when a Gansu provincial Soviet government was set up here, and the memorial hall presents that history.
description: 岷州会议旧址位于甘肃定西。游览特色包括历史旧址。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Sanshilipu village in Shili town, about 13 km west of Min County town. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 渭河源
summaryEn: The Wei River is traditionally said to rise here in the Niaoshu ('Bird and Rat') Mountains south-west of Weiyuan, where the Book of Documents records Yu the Great guiding its waters, and the springs that feed it emerge in the wooded headwater valley. The scenic area has a hall to Yu the Great, a temple to the Wei River Dragon King and an exhibition hall on the river's history, and it is the core of Weiyuan's tourism.
description: 渭河源位于甘肃定西。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wuzhu town, roughly 20 km by road south-west of Weiyuan county town.

name: 元古堆
summaryEn: Yuangudui is a hill village in Tianjiahe township, Weiyuan County, at about 2,440 m, which Xi Jinping visited in February 2013 and which has since developed rural tourism.
