Visitors see the rebuilt village with its farm stays, among them a deer-themed one, and fields of lilies and of medicinal herbs such as codonopsis and astragalus grown for sale.
description: 元古堆位于甘肃定西。游览特色包括田园观光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tianjiahe township, about 40 km by road south-west of Weiyuan county town.

name: 岳麓山
summaryEn: Yuelu Mountain is the wooded hill on the eastern edge of Lintao town, long a Daoist site and a meeting place for scholars. Paths lead up past temple halls to the Chaoran Terrace and the Jiaoshan Academy, linked with the Ming official Yang Jisheng, who set up a school while exiled to Lintao, then called Didao; at the foot is the Yuquan spring by Longquan Temple, one of the old Eight Views of Taoyang, and in late spring the hill has displays of purple-spotted peonies.
description: 岳麓山位于甘肃定西。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、林地风光、书院文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the eastern edge of Lintao county town, about 1.5 hours by road south of Lanzhou.

name: 悦心国际书画村
summaryEn: A cultural tourism complex in Tongwei county town, in a county known for its calligraphy and painting culture, made up of a long calligraphy and painting gallery with more than 100 commercial galleries, the Yuexin Art Museum, a hot-spring pool complex, a hotel and an organic fruit-picking farm outside the town. It suits visitors interested in Chinese brush art, and the spa pools use spring water piped from the Tangchi valley south-west of the town.
description: 悦心国际书画村位于甘肃定西。游览特色包括博物馆、山谷、书法文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Wenquan Road in Tongwei county town.

name: 遮阳山、贵清山
summaryEn: Two forested mountain areas in the south of Zhang County that together make up a national forest park. Zheyang Mountain, south-west of the county town, is a deep gorge of streams, pools and waterfalls between cliffs that serve as a training base for China's national rock-climbing team, with Song and Ming inscriptions along the path; Guiqing Mountain, further south, has steep peaks, old-growth woods, a bridge across a chasm and a temple first built in the Ming Longqing era.
description: 遮阳山、贵清山位于甘肃定西。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留1–2 天游览。
accessEn: Zheyang Mountain is about 35 km by road south-west of Zhang county town, near the Zheyangshan exit of the G75, and Guiqing Mountain lies to the south of the town. Check that Guiqing Mountain is open before going.

name: 阿万仓湿地
summaryEn: A broad wetland grassland around Awancang town in Maqu county, inside the great loop of the upper Yellow River known as its First Bend, where the river's side channels meander through pasture, pools and marsh. It is grazing land for the Tibetan herders' yaks, sheep and Hequ horses, a breed famous across China, and the wide open views are the attraction.
description: 阿万仓湿地位于甘肃甘南。游览特色包括湿地、草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 55 km south-west of Maqu county town by road, which is about 3 hours south-west of Hezuo; carry your passport for checkpoints.

name: 茨日那毛泽东旧居
summaryEn: A Tibetan village on the Bailong River in Wangzang town, Têwo county, where the Central Red Army stayed in September 1935 on the first stage of its Long March through Gansu; Mao Zedong lodged in a two-storey Tibetan house of rammed-earth walls and log beams. The house, looked after by the third generation of the family who hosted the soldiers, is kept as Mao Zedong's former residence, and the village is a stop on the Long March sites route through Têwo with the Ejie meeting site and Lazikou.
description: 茨日那毛泽东旧居位于甘肃甘南。游览特色包括名人故居。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: In Wangzang town about 40 km east of Têwo county town along the Bailong valley; carry your passport for checkpoints.

name: 当周草原
summaryEn: A grassland scenic area on the edge of Hezuo, the capital of Gannan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, made up of the Dangzhou grassland park and the forested South Mountain, with natural pasture and summer wildflowers. It is the main venue of the prefecture's Shambhala tourism and arts festival and a gathering place for Tibetan and other local community festivals and celebrations.
description: 当周草原位于甘肃甘南。游览特色包括草原、林地风光、节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the southern edge of Hezuo, about 5 km from the town centre; Hezuo is about 3 hours by road south-west of Lanzhou.

name: 大峪沟
summaryEn: A valley system in the Dieshan range south of Jonê county town, inside the Tao River National Nature Reserve, where a tributary of the Tao River runs for about 70 km through forest, alpine meadow and wetland below Zhayikega, the 4,920 m main peak of the Dieshan. Its developed side valleys, such as Qibu and Ajiao, have rock features including One-Line Sky, Triangle Stone, Yangzhuo Lake and Moon Gate, and the valley also holds Tibetan villages and Qibu Monastery.
description: 大峪沟位于甘肃甘南。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊、自然保护区。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km south of Jonê county town by road, which is roughly 1.5 hours south-east of Hezuo; carry your passport for checkpoints.

name: 拉尕山
summaryEn: A mountain area 33 km west of Zhouqu county town, between Jiuzhaigou and Lazikou, whose Tibetan name means 'a place the immortals love'. It combines Tibetan hill villages, grassy slopes, streams and forest, and it was named among the '100 wonders of north-west China' at a regional tourism fair in 2018.
description: 拉尕山位于甘肃甘南。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 33 km west of Zhouqu county town by road, roughly an hour; carry your passport for checkpoints.

name: 则岔石林
summaryEn: A gorge in Larenguan township, Luqu county, where sheer rock walls and pinnacles rise above grassland and dense forest, shaped over a long time by wind, rain and running water; fossils of ancient sea creatures are found on the peaks and in the caves. It lies inside the Gahai–Zecha National Nature Reserve, set up with State Council approval in 1998.
description: 则岔石林位于甘肃甘南。游览特色包括峡谷、石林、草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About an hour by road south-east of Luqu county town; carry your passport for checkpoints.

name: 东湖
summaryEn: A large park in Jiayuguan's southern district, built from 2002 to 2006 as the centrepiece of the new part of the city, covering 165 ha with a 56 ha artificial lake, a 640 m ribbon stream, a central square, waterfall walks, pavilions, bridges and about 90 ha of planted woodland and lawns. Its landmark is the Western Pearl weather tower, and the lake hosts the Jiayuguan International Triathlon, whose 17th edition was held here in July 2026.
description: 东湖位于甘肃嘉峪关。游览特色包括瀑布、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Hecheng East Road in the southern district of Jiayuguan city, a short taxi ride from the centre.

name: 嘉峪关方特欢乐世界
summaryEn: A theme park of the Chinese Fantawild chain, opened in 2015 on Fangte Avenue in Jiayuguan's southern district, with twenty-odd rides, dark rides and shows built around Chinese stories and 4D and interactive effects, among them a flying-theatre ride, a snow-mountain adventure, a magic-castle show, a log flume and Boonie Bears attractions. The same company's second park in the city, Fantawild Silk Road Myth, has rides and shows on Silk Road, legend and folk-culture themes; both suit families and groups of young people.
description: 嘉峪关方特欢乐世界位于甘肃嘉峪关。游览特色包括主题游乐、戏剧演艺。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: On Fangte Avenue in the southern district of Jiayuguan, about 15 minutes by road from the city centre.

name: 紫轩葡萄酒庄园
summaryEn: The winery estate of Gansu Zixuan Wine, part of the JISCO (Jiuquan Iron and Steel) group, on the airport road north-east of Jiayuguan, covering about 65 ha. Visitors tour the winery and its 13,700 m² underground barrel cellar, which the city presents as the largest single wine cellar in Asia, taste the wines and pick grapes in season; wine and grape-seed products are sold on site.
description: 紫轩葡萄酒庄园位于甘肃嘉峪关。游览特色包括葡萄酒文化、庄园、酿造文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the airport road between Jiayuguan city and Jiayuguan Jiuquan Airport, roughly 10 minutes by road from the centre.

name: 金水湖
summaryEn: A man-made lake park east of central Jinchang, built between 2005 and 2008 as a water-storage and landscape project in this water-short city: five lakes linked by ribbon wetlands, with islands, bridges and jetties, cover about 236 hectares, 60 of them water. It is an open suburban green space with themed scenic corners, exercise and older people's activity areas and an outdoor nature-education zone.
description: 金水湖位于甘肃金昌。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 5 km east of central Jinchang, south of Xinhua Road and east of Changzhou Road, a short taxi ride.

name: 火星1号基地
summaryEn: A Mars-themed experience park on the red-rock Gobi south of Jinchang, built from 2022 because the terrain resembles the Martian surface, with simulated survival bases and science-fiction sets that have also served as film and television locations. Visitors can try more than 30 activities such as a weightlessness experience, live role-play games and 'Mars sleeping pods'; it is aimed at families and school study trips.
description: 金昌以南的红色戈壁地貌与火星地表相似，园区围绕火星探索布置体验空间。
accessEn: In Ningyuanbao town, about 14 km south of central Jinchang, reached by taxi or car.

name: 紫金花城
summaryEn: A flower park of about 38 hectares on the northern outskirts of Jinchang, planted with some 40 kinds of herbs and flowers, among them lavender, verbena and cosmos, that colour the fields purple in the flowering season. It is the core of a wider planned green belt on the city's northern side and is visited for walks and photographs among the flowers.
description: 紫金花城位于甘肃金昌。游览特色包括花卉观赏、赏花。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the northern edge of Jinchang city, a short taxi ride from the centre. Check that it is open before going.

name: 博罗转井影视基地
summaryEn: The abandoned former seat of Aksay Kazakh Autonomous County, on the northern slopes of the Altyn-Tagh, left empty when the county town moved down to the plain in 1998 and since used as a film set. Most of its buildings date from around 1980, and films shot among its empty streets since 2002 include Hero, Wind Blast and Dragon Blade.
description: 博罗转井影视基地位于甘肃酒泉。游览特色包括影视拍摄、影视文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 25 km south of Aksay's present county town, Hongliuwan, and roughly 2 hours by road from Dunhuang.

name: 瓜州戈壁雕塑艺术长廊
summaryEn: A group of large outdoor artworks in the Gobi on the road from Guazhou towards the Yulin Caves. The best known is Son of the Earth, a sleeping baby 15 m long carved in red sandstone by Tsinghua University sculptor Dong Shubing, and close by stands his Boundless, a 60 m-long, 21 m-high white steel frame of palace pavilions drawn from Dunhuang murals; other works include Han Wu Xiong Feng and Gobi Ark.
description: 瓜州戈壁雕塑艺术长廊位于甘肃酒泉。游览特色包括壁画、楼阁建筑、砂岩地貌。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: About 16 km south of Guazhou county town on the road to the Yulin Caves, around 20 minutes by car.

name: 金塔沙漠胡杨林
summaryEn: A planted forest of Euphrates poplars on the desert edge north-west of Jinta town, grown through volunteer tree-planting campaigns since the 1960s to stop the sand at what had been the county's worst wind gap; the poplar scenic area covers nearly 10,000 mu (about 6.7 km²). Local media call it the largest planted forest in the Hexi Corridor, and it is at its best in late September and October, when the leaves turn gold.
description: 金塔沙漠胡杨林位于甘肃酒泉。游览特色包括沙漠、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Just north-west of Jinta county town, which is under an hour by road north-east of Jiuquan.

name: 西汉酒泉胜迹
summaryEn: A lake park on the east side of central Jiuquan around the spring that gave the city its name: legend says the Han general Huo Qubing poured wine from the emperor into it to share with his troops. Soldiers and residents organised by the Qing general Zuo Zongtang are said to have dug out the lake and planted the trees, the Nationalist government named it Quanhu Park in 1942, and today, as the Western Han Jiuquan Scenic Spot, it has the old spring, pools, pavilions and willows more than 130 years old from Zuo's time.
description: 西汉酒泉胜迹位于甘肃酒泉。游览特色包括湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Gongyuan Road in central Jiuquan, about 2 km east of the Drum Tower.

name: 酒泉天宝
summaryEn: An indoor exhibition of ornamental stones in a shopping complex in Jiuquan's Suzhou district, presented by its operators as China's largest stone-appreciation attraction. Its halls show the 'four famous stones' of ancient China and modern collectors' stones, with large holdings of yardang stones, 'cartoon' stones and the locally named Jiuquan black eagle stone, and it runs study courses for school groups.
description: 酒泉肃州区的室内展馆以观赏石为主题，集中展示不同形态的石材藏品。
accessEn: On Fukang Road in Jiuquan's Suzhou district, within the city.

name: 祁连苇海
summaryEn: A reed, cattail and marsh wetland in Yinda town on the northern edge of the Jiuquan oasis, at the edge of the Badain Jaran desert, with the Ming Great Wall along its south side. Reed beds turn golden under white plumes in autumn and water birds live among them; it suits a short outing from the city rather than a special trip.
description: 祁连苇海位于甘肃酒泉。游览特色包括长城、湿地、沙漠。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yinda town, about 17 km north of central Jiuquan by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 雪域紫亭
summaryEn: An open park in Dangchengwan, the county town of Subei Mongol Autonomous County, made up of a flower field of about 1,000 mu, Ziting Lake and a fruit and vegetable picking garden. In late summer and early autumn the beds of cosmos, calendula, cleome and other annuals are in full flower, with boardwalks, pavilions and windmills among them; it is mainly a leisure spot for residents and passing travellers.
description: 雪域紫亭位于甘肃酒泉。游览特色包括湖泊、花卉观赏、园林景观。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: In Dangchengwan, the Subei county seat, about 120 km south of Dunhuang by road, roughly 1.5 hours.

name: 玉门油田老一井
summaryEn: The old oil town of Yumen, regarded as the cradle of China's oil industry, is where in 1939 geologist Sun Jianchu's team drilled the first well beside the small Laojunmiao temple; until the Daqing field was found, the Yumen field was the country's largest. The red-tourism area keeps the Old No. 1 Well with a pumping unit, the Qing-dynasty temple, a monument to Sun Jianchu, a statue and memorial hall for the oil worker Wang Jinxi and an oil-city park.
description: 玉门油田老一井位于甘肃酒泉。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、纪念展览、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the old town of Yumen (Laojunmiao), about 100 km west of Jiuquan by road, roughly 1.5 hours.

name: 草圣故里文化产业园
summaryEn: A calligraphy-themed culture park in Guazhou county town honouring Zhang Zhi, the Eastern Han calligrapher from this region who is revered in China as the 'sage of cursive script'. Its 681 mu of grounds hold water features, pavilions, halls, sculpture and steles, including a memorial square with his statue and a memorial hall, and it suits visitors with a strong interest in Chinese calligraphy.
description: 草圣故里文化产业园位于甘肃酒泉。游览特色包括纪念展览、楼阁建筑、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: In Guazhou county town, about 120 km east of Dunhuang by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 河口古镇
summaryEn: A former Yellow River ferry and trading town on the western edge of Lanzhou, where the Zhuanglang River joins the Yellow River, restored since 2014 as a historic district around Hekou village. Its 'four streets and seventeen lanes' radiate from a two-storey bell and drum tower, lined with 37 Ming and Qing courtyard houses, the site of Gansu's first customs house and shops selling local snacks. Local traditions such as the military Nuo dance and Hekou gauze lanterns are kept up here.
description: 河口古镇位于甘肃兰州。游览特色包括古镇、楼阁建筑、历史纪念。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Xigu District, about 50 km west of central Lanzhou by road.

name: 金城关
summaryEn: A riverside cultural park on the north bank of the Yellow River at the foot of Baita Mountain, centred on a reconstruction of Jincheng Pass, the fortified gate that guarded the old river crossing. It houses small museums on Yellow River bridges, Qinqiang opera and painted pottery. The 4A scenic area, rated in December 2023, also takes in Zhongshan Bridge and Baita Mountain Park, which rises directly behind the pass.
description: 金城关位于甘肃兰州。游览特色包括博物馆、滨水景观、山地游览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north bank in Chengguan District, a short walk west of the northern end of Zhongshan Bridge.

name: 兰州水车博览园
summaryEn: A riverside culture park on the south bank of the Yellow River, opened in 2005 to recall the giant wooden waterwheels that once lined the river at Lanzhou, lifting water to irrigate the fields along its banks. Replica Yellow River waterwheels turn alongside other types of waterwheel from around the world, in a waterwheel garden, a waterwheel square and a culture square on the riverside promenade.
description: 兰州水车博览园位于甘肃兰州。游览特色包括滨水景观、园林景观。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: On South Binhe East Road in Chengguan District, about 2.5 km east of Zhongshan Bridge along the river.

name: 青城古镇
summaryEn: An old river town on the Yellow River at the northern tip of Yuzhong County, listed as a national historic and cultural town, whose Ming-to-Republican courtyard houses are protected as a national heritage site. Its sights include the Gao family ancestral hall, the Luo family courtyard, the Qingcheng Academy and a City God temple.
description: 青城古镇位于甘肃兰州。游览特色包括古镇、寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 1.5 hours by road north-east of central Lanzhou.

name: 栖云田园小镇
summaryEn: A rural leisure complex built around Lijiazhuang village on the edge of Yuzhong county town, with flower fields, farm restaurants, guesthouses, play attractions for children and craft workshops. It was rated a national 4A scenic area in 2024.
description: 栖云田园小镇位于甘肃兰州。游览特色包括花卉观赏、手工艺、田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the edge of Yuzhong county town, roughly 45 minutes by road south-east of central Lanzhou. Check that it is open before going.

name: 仁寿山
summaryEn: A hill park on the north side of Anning District in western Lanzhou, set among peach orchards. It is the main venue of Lanzhou's annual Peach Blossom Festival, held when the trees flower in mid-April, with photography exhibitions, food markets and performances.
description: 仁寿山位于甘肃兰州。游览特色包括果园、节庆文化、赏花。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Anning District, about 20 km north-west of central Lanzhou by road.

name: 什川古梨园
summaryEn: An orchard of centuries-old pear trees on the Yellow River flats around Shichuan town in Gaolan County, where the Ming set up a garrison fort in 1495. The trees flower in mid-April, when the town holds blossom-season events, and in summer their broad canopies shade picnics and walks between the villages.
description: 什川古梨园位于甘肃兰州。游览特色包括果园、赏花。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 minutes by road north-east of central Lanzhou.

name: 石佛沟
summaryEn: A national forest park in the wooded hills of Agan town on the southern edge of Lanzhou, the closest of the city's forest parks. Gentle trails and boardwalks follow the valleys, where summer temperatures stay several degrees below the city's, and farmhouse restaurants along the way serve local dishes such as jiangshui noodles.
description: 石佛沟位于甘肃兰州。游览特色包括森林公园、林地风光、田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About half an hour by road south of central Lanzhou; city bus 44 runs there.

name: 吐鲁沟
summaryEn: A national forest park in Liancheng town in the north-west of Yongdeng County, where gorges, streams, waterfalls and dense forest make it one of Lanzhou's main summer retreats. It can be combined with the Lu Tusi Yamen and Miaoyin Temple in Liancheng.
description: 吐鲁沟位于甘肃兰州。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 2.5 hours by road north-west of central Lanzhou; most visitors stay a night.

name: 西部恐龙水乐园
summaryEn: A large water park in Lanzhou New Area, about 7 km south of Zhongchuan Airport, built in 2017 as part of a resort district developed with the company behind Changzhou's China Dinosaurs Park. An indoor water hall under a glass dome shaped like a dinosaur egg is paired with outdoor slides, pools and a lazy river, aimed at families.
description: 西部恐龙水乐园位于甘肃兰州。游览特色包括水上游乐。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Lanzhou New Area, about 7 km south of Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport and roughly an hour by road north of central Lanzhou. Check that it is open before going.

name: 大墩峡
summaryEn: A system of four gorges about 13 km long, forming a Y shape below Heida Mountain (3,300 m), 6 km west of Dahejia town in Jishishan, the autonomous county of the Bonan (Bao'an), Dongxiang and Salar peoples. Cliffs, five streams, more than twenty waterfalls and many springs fill the gorges, and the plant life is rich, with rhododendrons and lilac in flower in early summer and frozen waterfalls in winter; parking areas, restaurants and visitor facilities are at the entrance.
description: 大墩峡位于甘肃临夏。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 5 km south-west of Dahejia town in northern Jishishan County, near the Qinghai border; Dahejia is about an hour by road north-west of Linxia city.

name: 法台山
summaryEn: A year-round resort in Songming town next to the Songmingyan scenic area, with the Songmingyan International Ski Resort for winter sport and, in summer, a glass walkway, mountain rafting, grass-sliding and children's play areas such as go-karts. It also hosts events such as hua'er folk-song contests and bonfire evenings, so it suits families and groups looking for an active day out rather than sightseeing.
description: 法台山位于甘肃临夏。游览特色包括滑雪、玻璃栈道、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Songming town about 20 km south of Hezheng county town, next to Songmingyan.

name: 和政古动物化石博物馆
summaryEn: A museum of fossil animals in Hezheng county town, founded in 2003 and now a national first-grade museum, holding more than 40,000 fossils from the late Cenozoic beds of the Linxia Basin. Its collections include giant rhinoceroses, shovel-tusked elephants, the three-toed horse Hipparion, the giant horse Equus eisenmannae, the giant hyena and the Hezheng sheep, which the museum describes as unique to Hezheng, and it is a core site of the Linxia UNESCO Global Geopark.
description: 和政古动物化石博物馆位于甘肃临夏。游览特色包括博物馆、国家一级博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Yingbin Road in Hezheng county town, about 40 minutes by road south-east of Linxia city.

name: 桦林万兽谷
summaryEn: A fossil site in a farming valley at Hualin, south-east of Hezheng county town, whose in-situ fossil hall (opened 2013) shows about 3,200 m² of Hipparion-fauna bones, some 11 to 5 million years old, as they lay when buried. The valley's rocks record four successive mammal faunas of the Linxia Basin, from giant rhinoceroses of about 27 million years ago to Equus horses of about 2 million years ago, and the site also has a geological section and the geopark's main monument square.
description: 桦林万兽谷位于甘肃临夏。游览特色包括山谷、化石遗迹、地质景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Hualin village, Songming town, about 16 km south-east of Hezheng county town by road.

name: 白桦林
summaryEn: A scenic area of natural forest at Liewa village in Basong township, on the Taizi Mountains tourist highway in southern Kangle County, where some 3,000 mu (200 ha) of birch woods cover the hillsides and forest cover reaches about 95 percent. It has a visitor centre, nature trails and a woodland play area, and draws visitors for summer shade, golden autumn leaves and winter ice-and-snow events.
description: 白桦林位于甘肃临夏。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Liewa village, Basong township, beside the G310 road about 25 km south-west of Kangle county town; Kangle is about an hour by road south-east of Linxia city.

name: 刘家峡恐龙国家地质公园
summaryEn: A geopark in Yanguoxia town protecting Early Cretaceous dinosaur trackways found in 1999 in the rocks above the Yellow River, with footprints of sauropods, theropods, ornithopods and pterosaurs as well as resting traces, tail drags, ripple marks and plant fossils. Its core is the hall over the first trackway site, covering about 1,400 m² of rock with 276 prints in 23 trackways on five levels, including a sauropod hind print 1.5 m long billed as the largest known; at the entrance a wall of full-size casts shows the main kinds.
description: 刘家峡恐龙国家地质公园位于甘肃临夏。游览特色包括地质景观、化石遗迹。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yanguoxia town on the Yellow River, roughly an hour by road west of Lanzhou. The park's dinosaur museum is closed on Mondays.

name: 刘家峡国际滑翔营地
summaryEn: A paragliding base on the north shore of the Liujiaxia Reservoir (Bingling Lake) in Yangta township, with its launch on Huangjia Mountain at about 2,300 m and a height difference of some 580 m to the landing ground. It hosts rounds of the national paragliding league and pilots' meets with powered and smoke-trail flying displays, and the county is promoting it for low-altitude tourism.
description: 刘家峡国际滑翔营地位于甘肃临夏。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yangta township on the north shore of the reservoir, about 30 km by road south-west of Liujiaxia (Yongjing county town), which is about 1.5 hours by road west of Lanzhou.

name: 松鸣岩
summaryEn: A national forest park and provincial scenic area in the foothills of the Taizi Mountains in Songming town, named for the roar of the wind in its pines echoing off the cliffs. Temples first built in the Ming, among them the Yuhuang Pavilion, the Bodhisattva Hall, the Shengmu Palace and the Dugang Temple, cling to the cliffs among the forest, and from the 26th to the 29th day of the fourth lunar month it holds a large hua'er folk-song fair.
description: 松鸣岩位于甘肃临夏。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Songming town about 23 km south of Hezheng county town, roughly an hour by road from Linxia city.

name: 胭脂湖
summaryEn: A town park in Kangle county town at the meeting of the Yanzhi, Zhongdi and Suji rivers, laid out around Yanzhi Lake with three stone arch bridges and a three-storey pavilion standing in the middle of the lake. It also has a children's park, a fun park and a sports park, flower beds from spring to autumn and light displays at night.
description: 胭脂湖位于甘肃临夏。游览特色包括湖泊、运动休闲、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Kangle county town; Kangle is about an hour by road south-east of Linxia city.

name: 竹子沟
summaryEn: A valley inside the Taizishan nature reserve at Bazigou village, Minglu township, in southern Kangle County, with alpine meadows, forest and streams, which joined the 4A list in January 2026. Summer visitors come for the meadows and for folk-song and music events, and in winter the valley offers horse-drawn sleighs, a ski slope, a rime-coated "ice cave" and hotpot in heated tents; a small amusement park with a rainbow slide and fairground rides opened beside it in April 2026.
description: 竹子沟位于甘肃临夏。游览特色包括自然保护区、主题游乐、山谷。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: At Bazigou village, Minglu township, about 25 km south-west of Kangle county town; Kangle is about an hour by road south-east of Linxia city.

name: 陈院生态园
summaryEn: An 8.7 km² rural leisure park in Chenyuan town, just west of Chengxian, laid out with orchards, woods and flower-lined roads. It combines countryside sightseeing with farming-culture activities, children's cartoon-themed amusements and stalls selling local produce, and suits families on a day out.
description: 陈院生态园位于甘肃陇南。游览特色包括果园、农业体验、公园休闲。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Chenyuan town, a few kilometres west of Chengxian county town by road.

name: 杜公祠
summaryEn: The Du Gong Shrine at the mouth of Feilong Gorge, south-east of Chengxian, commemorates the poet Du Fu, who stayed briefly at Tonggu, as the town was then called, in 759 before moving on to Chengdu; it is promoted as the earliest of China's many Du Fu 'thatched cottages'. Its courtyard of old cypresses holds more than ten steles from the Song to the Republican era, and paths lead on into the gorge to the Phoenix Terrace, Wanzhang Pool and an old plank road.
description: 杜公祠位于甘肃陇南。游览特色包括峡谷、历史纪念。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 3 km south-east of Chengxian county town, at the mouth of Feilong Gorge.

name: 甘肃秦文化博物馆
summaryEn: The Gansu Qin Culture Museum on Qinren Square in Li County town has a collection of several thousand objects, many recovered from the early Qin cemetery at Dabuzishan and the Xichui area. Highlights include a small four-wheeled cart, ding and gui vessels of the Qin lords and a set of Qin bells, which together show the archaeology of the Qin homeland before the state moved east.
description: 甘肃秦文化博物馆位于甘肃陇南。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Qinren Square in Li County town, roughly two hours by road south-west of Tianshui. Closed on Mondays.

name: 花桥村
summaryEn: Huaqiao is a village in Changba town, in the hills of western Kang County, that has been developed as a rural tourism area with countryside walks, holiday and retirement stays, folk-culture experiences including traditional liquor-making, and a centre where local farm produce is processed and sold. It has been named a model rural-tourism village and serves as a rural tourism training base for Gansu, so it suits visitors curious about village life in the hills of southern Gansu.
description: 花桥村位于甘肃陇南。游览特色包括田园观光、酿造文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Changba town, roughly 25 km by road north-west of Kang county town.

name: 嘉陵江峡谷群
summaryEn: A large scenic area of 217.6 km² along the gorges of the upper Jialing River in south-eastern Hui County, with cliffs, forest, caves and waterfalls, among them the Meiya Falls, which drop more than 400 m. Visitors can hike Moon Gorge, see the formations of Swallow Cave, walk through the Ming–Qing houses of Daoping old village, raft a 13 km stretch of the river in summer and, in autumn, see the 153 ancient ginkgo trees of Tianhe village; remains of old plank roads on the Shu roads survive along the cliffs.
description: 嘉陵江峡谷群位于甘肃陇南。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Jialing town in the south-east of Hui County, roughly an hour by road from the county town; a direct scenic-area bus has run since February 2026.

name: 金徽酒业
summaryEn: The landscaped brewery park of Jinhui, a strong-aroma baijiu maker whose roots go back to a state distillery formed from local workshops in 1951, in Fujia town north-west of Hui County town. Visitors see the liquor-culture exhibition hall, the brewing workshops, the pottery-jar and stainless-steel storage halls and the bottling line, with gardens, a cherry-tree avenue and a spring-fed lake around them; it suits those curious about how Chinese liquor is made.
description: 金徽酒业位于甘肃陇南。游览特色包括湖泊、园林景观、陶瓷工艺。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Fujia town, about 20 km by road north-west of Hui County town.

name: 金徽矿业
summaryEn: An industrial tourism site at Jinhui Mining's lead–zinc mine north of Hui County town, on the Xicheng lead–zinc belt. The company presents it as a green, digitised mine with its works underground and landscaped gardens on the surface, and it offers sightseeing and popular-science visits for those interested in modern mining.
description: 金徽矿业位于甘肃陇南。游览特色包括工业参观、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At the mine in Liulin town, roughly 35 km by road north of Hui County town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 两当兵变纪念馆
summaryEn: This memorial hall in Liangdang county town commemorates the Liangdang Mutiny of 2 April 1932, when Xi Zhongxun and other Communist organisers led about 200 soldiers of a Nationalist battalion stationed in the area into revolt and reformed them as a Red Army guerrilla detachment, which was later broken up. The red-tourism scenic area links the hall with the battalion's former command post, the site of the mutiny, the camp at Yangdian and Taiyang Temple, where the detachment was reorganised, and it is used for patriotic and Party education.
description: 两当兵变纪念馆位于甘肃陇南。游览特色包括纪念展览、历史纪念。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Liangdang county town, about 40 minutes by road north-east of Hui County town; renovation works were under way in October 2026, so check that it is open before going. Normally closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 祁山堡
summaryEn: The Qishan scenic area east of Li County town is built around Qishan Fort and its Wuhou Shrine to Zhuge Liang, one of the earliest shrines to him, rebuilt in the Ming and Qing dynasties, on the ground where Shu Han armies campaigned against Wei in the Three Kingdoms period. Around it are some ten sites linked by tradition to those campaigns, such as the terrace where Zhuge Liang is said to have reviewed his troops, a hollow where troops were hidden and an old cypress named after him.
description: 礼县城东的祁山堡与纪念诸葛亮的武侯祠构成景区的主要历史看点。
accessEn: About 20 km east of Li County town on the G316.

name: 山湾梦谷
summaryEn: A valley resort of about 240 ha in Lianghekou town, Tanchang, built around the Qiang and Tibetan culture of the area, with flower fields and farmland on the valley floor and forest above. About 6.5 km up from the gate, a homestay village mixes surviving village houses with new buildings in Qiang–Tibetan style, and visitors come for local food, Qiang folk-culture activities and walks; it suits families and visitors wanting a quiet countryside stay.
description: 山湾梦谷位于甘肃陇南。游览特色包括山谷、花卉观赏、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the G212 in Lianghekou town, roughly 40 km by road south of Tanchang county town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 王坝
summaryEn: A rural scenic area of villages and wooded valleys around Wangba town, 10 km from Kang county town, centred on Dashuigou village, with a village-life exhibition hall, log-cabin lodgings and the cliffs of Qinglin Gully. The township's folk arts, among them the bangbang whip performance, ballad singing and sheepskin-drum music, were listed as Longnan intangible heritage in 2006, and the area suits visitors looking for a short countryside stay.
description: 王坝位于甘肃陇南。游览特色包括民俗文化、非遗文化、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 10 km by road from Kang county town.

name: 晚霞湖
summaryEn: Wanxia Lake is a reservoir lake of about 120 ha just west of Xihe county town, with reed beds, water birds and boat trips on the water. Its Qiqiao culture garden has a statue of the Weaving Maid by the sculptor He E and a museum of Xihe's Qiqiao (Double Seventh) festival, which draws crowds to the lake at festival time.
description: 晚霞湖位于甘肃陇南。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 9 km by road west of Xihe county town.

name: 万象洞
summaryEn: A large karst cave on the south side of the Bailong River east of Wudu, filled with stalactites and other formations along the visitor route, whose walls carry inscriptions and poems left by visitors since the Northern Zhou. Its name was written by Zhao Puchu, and a second, sister cave was found nearby in 2007. It is a provincial heritage unit, scenic area and geopark.
description: 万象洞位于甘肃陇南。游览特色包括洞穴、地质景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 15 km by road south-east of central Wudu (Longnan city), in Hanwang town.

name: 文县天池
summaryEn: Wenxian Tianchi, also called Yangtang Tianchi, is a long, winding mountain lake formed where faulting dammed the Yangtang River in the mountains north of Wen County, its shoreline broken by headlands and ringed by forested peaks. Together with the smaller Penjing Pool, where trees grow out of the shallow water, the Yinma Pool and Huanglin Gully, it forms one scenic area that is at its best in autumn colour.
description: 文县天池位于甘肃陇南。游览特色包括湖泊、海岸风光、山地游览。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 64 km north of Wen county town by mountain road, above Tianchi town.

name: 阳坝
summaryEn: Yangba, in the far south of Kang County, is a humid, forested valley area of bamboo groves, streams, tea gardens and palms, promoted as the 'Xishuangbanna of Gansu' for its almost subtropical feel. Its best-known parts are Meiyuan Gully, Hongdou Valley and the old-growth forest along the Qing River, where paths follow clear streams and pools.
description: 阳坝位于甘肃陇南。游览特色包括山谷、园林景观、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 84 km by road south of Kang county town, roughly two hours' drive.

name: 云华山
summaryEn: Yunhua Mountain, north-east of Xihe, is a steep danxia-type peak shaped like a jade tablet, which gave it the old name Guishan, with more than ten small Daoist temple halls, including one to the Xuanwu emperor, packed onto its narrow summit. It is known locally as a long-standing Daoist mountain and as the birthplace of Xihe's Qiqiao (Double Seventh) festival, and in autumn the summit often looks out over a sea of cloud.
description: 云华山位于甘肃陇南。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、名人故居、登山观景。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 10 km north-east of Xihe county town, in Shaoyu town.

name: 云屏三峡
summaryEn: The Yunping Three Gorges, Tudi, Guanyin and Xigou, cut through forested mountains south-east of Liangdang and form a provincial scenic area of cliffs, overhanging pines, waterfalls and caves with more than 60 named sights, among them a temple and two rock 'gates'. Lacebark pines and red leaves make autumn a good time for the walks, and the area lies over the ridge from the Santan scenic area in Hui County.
description: 云屏三峡位于甘肃陇南。游览特色包括瀑布、峡谷、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 45 km by mountain road south-east of Liangdang county town, around Yunping town.

name: 张果老养生文化景区
summaryEn: A rural scenic area of about 320 ha in the hills of Yangdian town, north-east of Liangdang, built around the Guolao Dengzhen Cave, which legend links with the Daoist immortal Zhang Guolao. Around it are a farm park, the traditional village of Chengou, an eco-sightseeing garden and pine woods with a large natural stand of lacebark pines, and three of Liangdang's traditional Eight Views lie within it. It suits walkers and visitors after a quiet countryside stay.
description: 张果老养生文化景区位于甘肃陇南。游览特色包括园林景观、洞穴、农业体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Lingguandian village, Yangdian town, about 12 km by road north-east of Liangdang county town, close to the G316 and the Liangdang–Huixian expressway.

name: 朱家沟古村
summaryEn: Zhujiagou is an old village on the Yanzi River near Anmenkou town, listed as a Chinese traditional village in 2016, whose main sights are the Qing-style Zhu family compound, a covered 'wind-and-rain' bridge and an ancient Chinese wingnut tree said to be a thousand years old. The wider Anmenkou scenic area adds a valley of old ginkgo trees and an eco-farm, and the town has some fifteen homestays and twenty farm stays, so it is easy to stay overnight.
description: 朱家沟古村位于甘肃陇南。游览特色包括古村落、山谷、村落风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 10 km by road south of Kang county town, along the Yanzi River.

name: 古灵台荆山森林公园
summaryEn: A wooded hill park on Zhongtai Hill in the middle of Lingtai town, around the 'Ancient Lingtai', the terrace that legend says King Wen of Zhou raised for offerings to Heaven after his campaign against the state of Mixu. Modern Han-style gateways, pavilions and a hall to three local worthies, among them the physician Huangfu Mi, line the paths to a hilltop viewpoint, and the park also holds the Lingtai County Museum, strong in Western Zhou bronzes, and a memorial hall on the county's revolutionary history.
description: 古灵台荆山森林公园位于甘肃平凉。游览特色包括博物馆、森林公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Lingtai town, entered from Jingshan Road. The county museum and the memorial hall inside the park are closed on Mondays.

name: 关山莲花台
summaryEn: A forested mountain area in the Guanshan, the old Long Mountains on Huating's western border, rising to 2,748 m at Wutai Shan, with birch and pine forest over more than 90 percent of the land, meadows, rock pinnacles, waterfalls and old Buddhist and Taoist temples. It is visited mainly for cool summer walking and autumn colour along its two main trails, Xuanfeng Shan and Lianhuatai.
description: 关山莲花台位于甘肃平凉。游览特色包括瀑布、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: The entrance plaza is about 15 km west of Huating city, and the core of the scenic area is some 35–42 km from the city by road, best reached by car; the inner scenic area usually closes for forest-fire prevention from late autumn until May, leaving only the entrance area open, so check before going in that season.

name: 海寨沟
summaryEn: A rural valley at Dazhai, south-east of Pingliang, developed as an activity resort. In the warmer months it offers glass-slide rafting, a long glass-floored walkway across the valley, zip lines, high-ropes courses and a water park, and in winter there is a ski slope; it suits families looking for activities rather than scenery or history.
description: 海寨沟位于甘肃平凉。游览特色包括水上游乐、山谷、水上活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km south-east of central Pingliang by road, near the G85 expressway.

name: 界石铺红军长征毛泽东旧居纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial in Jieshipu town marking the Red Army's passage on the Long March: in October 1935 Mao Zedong and other leaders camped here with the Shaanxi–Gansu column, and in October 1936 Red Army units again passed through while the three main forces gathered in the Huining–Jingning area. The house where Mao stayed is preserved with its furnishings, and exhibition halls display some 235 items from the period.
description: 界石铺红军长征毛泽东旧居纪念馆位于甘肃平凉。游览特色包括纪念展览、主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jieshipu town beside the G312, about 23 km north-west of Jingning town.

name: 米家沟
summaryEn: A wooded valley and provincial forest park on the edge of Huating, run as a family leisure area with streams, peach and flower fields, a climbing wall, adventure courses, a children's playground and live-action combat games, plus cave-dwelling restaurants and yurts. Summer temperatures under the trees stay around 20 °C, and local families come for blossom in spring, shade in summer and colour in autumn.
description: 米家沟位于甘肃平凉。游览特色包括森林公园、山谷、花卉观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 5 km east of central Huating, a short drive or taxi ride.

name: 田家沟
summaryEn: A loess gully system just north of Jingchuan that decades of soil-conservation work have turned green, now a national water-conservancy scenic area and soil-conservation demonstration park. Paths lead past the 'thousand-year earth arrows', ranks of sheer loess pillars left by erosion, to a water play area, fishing ponds, pavilions and cave-dwelling style lodgings; it suits a half-day family outing.
description: 田家沟位于甘肃平凉。游览特色包括楼阁建筑、洞穴。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 3 km north of Jingchuan town on the road to Dangyuan (S202), and about 5 km from Wangmu Palace. Check that it is open before going.

name: 云崖寺
summaryEn: A forested gorge in the Guanshan mountains of Zhuanglang where red sandstone cliffs hold Buddhist caves begun in the late Northern Wei and restored up to the Qing: on the main cliff, about 300 m long and 80 m high, 19 caves in three tiers keep stone and clay statues and fragments of murals, with well-preserved Ming clay figures in Caves 6 and 7. The scenic area is also a national forest park, and the Chenjiadong caves in a nearby valley, part of the same heritage listing, add weathered rock-cut Buddhas and a small seven-storey Tang stone pagoda.
description: 云崖寺位于甘肃平凉。游览特色包括峡谷、森林公园、壁画。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the Guanshan mountains about 40 km from Zhuanglang town, best reached by car.

name: 龙栖谷
summaryEn: A narrow rocky gorge more than 1 km long at Maosi village in the Pu River valley south of Xifeng, whose winding course is said to look from above like a coiled dragon; it is also called Heilaoguo, the "black pot", because the stream sinks underground and has scoured the dark rock into a pot shape. In winter ice pillars, icicles and frozen falls hang from the gorge walls, and in spring the valley floor is yellow with rapeseed; the scenic area also takes in the old village of Maosi and a camping ground at Yueliangwan.
description: 龙栖谷位于甘肃庆阳。游览特色包括峡谷、山谷。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Maosi village, Xiansheng township, about 40 km by road south of central Xifeng (Qingyang city). Check that it is open before going.

name: 南梁革命旧址
summaryEn: In 1934 Communist organisers led by Liu Zhidan, Xie Zichang and Xi Zhongxun made Nanliang, in the Ziwuling hills of eastern Huachi County, the base of a Soviet government for the Shaanxi–Gansu border area; it took the name Shaanxi–Gansu Border Region Soviet Government in November 1934 and moved to Xiasiwan in Shaanxi in April 1935. The red-tourism area around Liyuanbao has the Nanliang Revolutionary Memorial Hall, with a general exhibition and halls on Liu, Xie and Xi, the Lenin Primary School, now a nine-year school, and the former offices of the border region military committee and Soviet government at Zhaiziwan.
description: 南梁革命旧址位于甘肃庆阳。游览特色包括纪念展览、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Nanliang town, about 140 km by road north-east of Xifeng (Qingyang city) and 55 km east of Huachi county town. The memorial hall is closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 药王洞养生小镇
summaryEn: A modern tourist town in old-street style on the east bank of the Rouyuan River at Qingcheng, about 3.2 km long and below the Zhouzu Mausoleum; it takes its name from a cave associated with the legendary physician Qibo. It has restaurants and snack streets, folk performances, traditional Chinese medicine and wellness services, courtyard guesthouses and leisure rides such as a glass bridge, slides and go-karts, and is lit up in the evenings. A hot-spring resort between the town and the mausoleum area opened at the end of 2025.
description: 药王洞养生小镇位于甘肃庆阳。游览特色包括玻璃栈道、洞穴。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the east bank of the Rouyuan River at Qingcheng county town, below the Zhouzu Mausoleum, about 55 km by road north-east of Xifeng (Qingyang city).

name: 周祖陵
summaryEn: A forest park on the East Hill above Qingcheng, named after the tomb traditionally held to be that of Buzhu, the Xia-period ancestor of the Zhou royal house, who is said to have brought his people here and taught them farming. Since the 1980s the county has rebuilt temples, halls, pavilions and steles on the hill: 822 stone steps lead up to the Zhaozhou Shengzu archway and the Zhouzu Hall with statues of Buzhu and his son and grandson, and another area honours Qibo, the legendary physician of the Yellow Emperor's Inner Classic, with a large forest of inscribed steles. The Bagua Pavilion on the summit looks over the old town and the Rouyuan River.
description: 周祖陵位于甘肃庆阳。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the East Hill of Qingcheng county town, about 60 km by road north-east of Xifeng (Qingyang city).

name: 子午花溪谷
summaryEn: A flower-valley leisure area at Lianjiabian in Taibai town, on the edge of the Ziwuling forest in eastern Heshui County, laid out around a visitor centre and car park. Its named areas include the Ziyunhai flower fields, a streamside path with a small waterfall and a stalactite cave, a garden of mixed flowers, a children's play area and a rose garden, and it also has a zip line, a glass bridge and wooden cabins among the flowers.
description: 子午花溪谷位于甘肃庆阳。游览特色包括瀑布、玻璃栈道、山谷。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside the Lianjiabian exit of the Qingdao–Lanzhou expressway (G22) in Taibai town, roughly an hour by road north-east of Heshui county town.

name: 凤山
summaryEn: A hill on the eastern edge of Qin'an town covered by the Taishan Temple complex, 41 Ming and Qing halls, pavilions and cave shrines built on nine terraces, with Confucian, Buddhist and Taoist figures side by side. Its landmark is the Penglai Pavilion of 1749, and the slopes around the temples are planted as a forest park among old cypresses.
description: 凤山位于甘肃天水。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、森林公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the eastern edge of Qin'an town, a short walk or taxi ride from the centre; Qin'an is roughly an hour by road north of Tianshui.

name: 古坡草原
summaryEn: Upland meadows, forest and rocky peaks around the headwaters of the Ji River in southern Gangu County, between about 1,760 and 2,700 m above sea level. Visitors come in summer for horse riding and walks across the grassland, and sights within the area include Shigu Mountain, mentioned in the 6th-century Commentary on the Water Classic, and Heitan Temple, first built in the Yuan dynasty.
description: 古坡草原位于甘肃天水。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、草原。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: On the grassland plateau beyond Gupo town, about 50 km by road south-south-west of Gangu county town; Gangu is roughly 45 minutes by road west of Tianshui.

name: 平安草原
summaryEn: An expanse of high mountain meadows, valleys and streams in the Guan Mountains of Zhangjiachuan Hui Autonomous County, where the early Qin state is said to have pastured its horses. Boardwalks link viewpoints across the grassland, and in summer visitors come for horse riding, camping, star-view cabins and evening bonfires.
description: 平安草原位于甘肃天水。游览特色包括草原、马术活动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Ping'an township in the east of Zhangjiachuan County, on a paved road; Zhangjiachuan town is roughly 1.5–2 hours by road north-east of Tianshui.

name: 青鹃山
summaryEn: A countryside resort around Sunji village in Pingnan town, south of Tianshui, laid out around a lake lined with themed wooden cabins where visitors can fish, go boating and cook their catch in the cabins' kitchens. Outdoor activities include a rock-climbing wall and a treetop adventure course, and there are restaurants serving local dishes.
description: 青鹃山位于甘肃天水。游览特色包括湖泊、乘船游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Pingnan town, about 40 minutes by road south of central Tianshui.

name: 苏湾民俗庄园
summaryEn: A rural folk-culture park in Sujiawan village, Pingnan town, in the hills south of Tianshui, which became a 4A scenic area in 2025. Visitors can explore displays of local folk customs and pick seasonal produce, and on public holidays there are performances such as molten-iron 'fireworks' and face-changing. It lies near the Qingjuanshan resort, and the two are promoted together.
description: 苏湾民俗庄园位于甘肃天水。游览特色包括民俗文化、庄园。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Pingnan town, roughly 45 minutes by road south of central Tianshui.

name: 冰沟河
summaryEn: A mountain valley at the eastern end of the Qilian range in the Tianzhu Tibetan Autonomous County, named after its glacier-fed river, with alpine meadows grazed by white yaks, conifer forest and wild iris grassland. Sightseeing buses run up the valley, and a long trail and boardwalk climb to Chaierlonghai, a clear tarn below snow peaks; going there and back is a strenuous high-altitude day walk of around 20 km.
description: 冰沟河位于甘肃武威。游览特色包括草原、冰川。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About two hours by car north-west of Tianzhu county town; weather turns fast at altitude, so bring warm and waterproof layers, and carry your passport for checkpoints.

name: 古浪战役纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial park in the south-west of Gulang town on the battlefield of November 1936, when the Western Route Army of the Chinese Red Army fought the forces of the Ma clique around Gulang during its advance west along the Hexi Corridor. A three-storey exhibition hall follows the Western Route Army's campaign with 926 artefacts, documents and battle dioramas, and the grounds include a memorial square and a martyrs' cemetery.
description: 古浪战役纪念馆位于甘肃武威。游览特色包括纪念展览、主题展览、战役遗址。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the south-west corner of Gulang town, about an hour by road south-east of Wuwei. Closed on Monday mornings.

name: 沙井文化民俗旅游区
summaryEn: A village folk-culture centre in a former school at Xintao, Sanlei, built around a museum set up by local villagers, said to be the largest privately run folk museum in Gansu, with thousands of objects of rural life and several hundred pottery, stone and bone finds of the Shajing culture, the early first-millennium BC culture named after a site in Minqin. It also offers farming-life activities and evening village shows, including a staged play of the Su Wu sheep-herding story.
description: 沙井文化民俗旅游区位于甘肃武威。游览特色包括博物馆、民俗文化、农业体验。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Sanlei town south-west of Minqin town, easily combined with Ruian Fort. The museum is closed on Mondays.

name: 神州荒漠野生动物园
summaryEn: A wildlife park on the desert edge east of Wuwei that specialises in desert animals of north-west China, notably Przewalski's horses, Tibetan wild asses and wild Bactrian camels, alongside zoo species such as golden snub-nosed monkeys, African lions, brown bears and Amur tigers. There is a hall of desert wildlife specimens and a petting area with marmots and alpacas, and it is mainly a family and school-trip destination.
description: 神州荒漠野生动物园位于甘肃武威。游览特色包括沙漠、动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 24 km east of central Wuwei on the Liangzhou-Gulang road; a taxi or car is easiest.

name: 苏武沙漠
summaryEn: A desert leisure area on the southern edge of the Tengger Desert near Minqin, named after Su Wu, the Han envoy of the famous sheep-herding exile story, whom local tradition links with Minqin. It groups the International Desert Sculpture Creation Base, with more than a hundred works by artists from around the world set among the dunes, a 'Star-Picking Town' with an astronomy hall and stargazing cabins, a Su Wu culture town, and dune buggies and off-road rides, with evening shows in the autumn season.
description: 苏武沙漠位于甘肃武威。游览特色包括沙漠、雕塑艺术。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 35 km by road south-east of Minqin town; a car is needed.

name: 武威沙漠公园
summaryEn: A desert-themed park on the desert edge east of Wuwei, billed as the first in China built around desert scenery, that mixes sand dunes with planted woodland, grassland and landscaped gardens across more than 530 hectares. It holds a spring pear-blossom and kite festival and an autumn fun run.
description: 武威沙漠公园位于甘肃武威。游览特色包括沙漠、草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km east of central Wuwei, best reached by taxi or car.

name: 冰沟丹霞
summaryEn: The second major scenic area of the Zhangye Danxia geopark, opened in 2014 on the north bank of the Liyuan River in Sunan: in contrast to the striped hills of Qicai Danxia, it is a landscape of red sandstone cliffs, walls, pillars and spires. Its sandstone 'window-lattice' formations, weathered into rows of upright ribs like the windows of a palace, are the type locality for that landform.
description: 冰沟丹霞位于甘肃张掖。游览特色包括地质景观、砂岩地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 45 km west of Zhangye and some 15 km west of the Qicai Danxia north entrance by road.

name: 滨河九粮液
summaryEn: The Binhe distillery in the Minle eco-industrial park, maker of Jiuliangye baijiu, is open to visitors as a liquor-culture scenic area covering its starter-making, distilling and bottling halls, blending cellars and a large storage cellar. Outside, the grounds on the edge of the Gobi have a lake, rose and marigold fields, organic sorghum and maize plots, viewing platforms and barbecue and self-drive campsites.
description: 滨河九粮液位于甘肃张掖。游览特色包括湖泊、观景台、酿造文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Minle eco-industrial park beside Liuba town, about 28 km north of Minle town and under an hour by road south-east of Zhangye. Check that it is open before going.

name: 大湖湾
summaryEn: A lake and wetland leisure area in the Heihe valley near Gaotai, centred on the Chongwen Tower, a 41.7 m five-storey timber tower in southern Ming–Qing style built in 2011–12, with a lakeside plaza, boardwalks and bridges. It hosts local festivals, concerts and dragon-boat races on the lake, and its visitor centre, car parks and paths were renovated in 2024.
description: 大湖湾位于甘肃张掖。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Near Xuanhua, a short drive north-west of Gaotai town.

name: 丹霞口文旅小镇
summaryEn: A modern tourist town built in old style near the north entrance of the Qicai Danxia scenic area, mixing grey-tiled Huizhou-style houses with the walls and gate towers of the north-west. Its lanes hold restaurants, guesthouses, craft workshops and small exhibition rooms, and staged entertainment includes a gate-opening welcome, a camel-caravan parade, costumed street actors and the stage show Huidao Zhangye.
description: 丹霞口文旅小镇位于甘肃张掖。游览特色包括手工艺。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 5 km by road from the north entrance of the Qicai Danxia scenic area and about 35 km west of Zhangye; a tourist bus line from Zhangye West high-speed station opened in May 2026.

name: 甘泉红色历史文化旅游区
summaryEn: A 50 ha district in central Zhangye that joins red-history sites, including the Gao Jincheng Martyr Memorial Hall and an exhibition on the Western Route Army's 1936–37 campaign in the Hexi Corridor, with the Ganquan spring, rebuilt traditional gardens, the Sanyuan Museum and two lakes. There is also a children's playground, a water-screen film show and performances of local intangible heritage.
description: 甘泉红色历史文化旅游区位于甘肃张掖。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In central Zhangye, about 700 m north-west of the Drum Tower.

name: 流沙河景区
summaryEn: A riverside park of about 230 ha on the south side of Linze town, with lakes including Swan Lake, a Danxia-style hill and square, a Journey to the West garden and a 'hundred stones' garden carved with poems. It serves as the town's main park, with walking and fitness trails, a visitor centre and an ice playground in winter, and black storks have been recorded along the river.
description: 流沙河景区位于甘肃张掖。游览特色包括湖泊、滨水景观、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Along the Liusha River on the south side of Linze town, about 40 km north-west of Zhangye by road.

name: 芦水湾
summaryEn: A chain of man-made lakes with lakeside parkland on the north-western edge of Zhangye, with bridges, promenades and the Shuitian Yise square, and sightseeing carts running between them. It suits an evening walk or bike ride, and its paved promenades host events such as roller-skating races.
description: 芦水湾位于甘肃张掖。游览特色包括湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north-western edge of Zhangye city, about 4 km from the Drum Tower, 10–15 minutes by taxi.

name: 民乐现代丝路田园综合体
summaryEn: An agri-tourism park in northern Minle built around fruit-picking orchards, flower fields, a folk-culture village and street and a farming-culture study area. Other features include cherry and pear orchards, peony and orchid gardens, food workshops, a children's playground and a hot-spring resort, and it suits families on a day out from Zhangye.
description: 民乐现代丝路田园综合体位于甘肃张掖。游览特色包括田园观光、果园、花卉观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 40 km south-east of Zhangye and 25 km north of Minle town, beside National Road 227. Check that it is open before going.

name: 平山湖大峡谷
summaryEn: A canyon of red sandstone and conglomerate cut into the desert hills north-east of Zhangye, opened to visitors in 2014, where trails and viewpoints lead along the ridges and down into narrow gorges of a 95 km² scenic area. It lies in Pingshanhu Mongolian Township, and the scenic area adds Mongolian food, music and yurts to hiking and geology.
description: 平山湖大峡谷位于甘肃张掖。游览特色包括峡谷、沙漠。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 56 km north-east of Zhangye by road across the Gobi, roughly an hour's drive.

name: 祁连山鹿文化生态旅游区
summaryEn: An alpine valley on the Jinchang River at 2,700–3,500 m in Sunan where more than 600 farmed Qilian red deer (white-rumped deer) graze on high grassland below snow peaks, and visitors can see them at close quarters. Hot-air balloon rides and grass-sledging are offered, and it makes a stop on National Road 213 between the Danxia areas and Sunan town.
description: 祁连山鹿文化生态旅游区位于甘肃张掖。游览特色包括草原、山谷、高山景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 20 km from Sunan's county town on National Road 213, roughly 96 km west of Zhangye by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 中国工农红军西路军纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial to the Western Route Army, the Red Army force of about 21,800 that crossed the Yellow River in October 1936 and was defeated by Ma clique forces in the Hexi Corridor over the following months; its Fifth Army was destroyed at Gaotai in January 1937. Built on the 1957 martyrs' cemetery, where Fifth Army commander Dong Zhentang and more than 3,000 soldiers are buried, it has a monument, sculpture groups and a museum building modelled on a beacon tower, with eight galleries on the campaign.
description: 中国工农红军西路军纪念馆位于甘肃张掖。游览特色包括纪念展览、国家一级博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the east side of Gaotai town, about 85 km north-west of Zhangye by road. Closed on Mondays except public holidays.

name: 屋兰古镇
summaryEn: A modern tourist town built in old style at Gucheng village in Jiantan, east of Zhangye, whose centrepiece is the Jiuqu Huanghe lantern maze: a 2.4 km labyrinth laid out on the nine palaces and eight trigrams, with 365 lanterns, nine halls and more than 700 walls decorated with themes from traditional cosmology and Hexi history. A branch of the Zhangye gazetteer museum opened in the town in 2023.
description: 屋兰古镇位于甘肃张掖。游览特色包括博物馆、古镇。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Jiantan, about 20 km east of Zhangye city near National Road 312, roughly 25 minutes by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 裕固风情走廊
summaryEn: A 27 km scenic road through the Qilian foothills around Kangle in Sunan Yugur Autonomous County, home of the Yugur, a people of about 15,000 who speak Turkic and Mongolic languages and mostly follow Tibetan Buddhism. Along the Yu–Kang road it links a yurt camp, the Wanfo gorge, a Western Route Army monument, Yugur heritage and song-and-dance venues and the Saihan Tala alpine grassland, combining Danxia scenery, meadows and Yugur culture.
description: 裕固风情走廊位于甘肃张掖。游览特色包括峡谷、草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: The road begins about 50 km west of Zhangye and runs 27 km towards Kangle; a car or tour is needed.

name: 裕固族民俗度假区
summaryEn: Sunan's county town, Hongwansi, and its surroundings form this scenic area, which includes the Yugur Fengqing Yuan cultural park, ethnic villages, a red-history theme park, the Xiliugou folk-culture street and the Solangge racecourse. Traditional horse races, song-and-dance shows and festivals present Yugur, Tibetan and Mongolian culture, and there are campsites and RV pitches for self-drive travellers.
description: 裕固族民俗度假区位于甘肃张掖。游览特色包括主题游乐、民俗文化、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: Hongwansi is about 85 km west of Zhangye by road, around 1.5 hours.

name: 张掖国家沙漠体育公园
summaryEn: An 18 km² park in the desert dunes 13 km south of Zhangye, laid out for outdoor sport, sightseeing and children's play, with a motorsport circuit that has staged a round of the China Rally Championship nine years running. In winter part of it becomes a snow playground, and it suits families and anyone wanting desert scenery close to the city.
description: 张掖国家沙漠体育公园位于甘肃张掖。游览特色包括沙漠、体育运动。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 13 km south of Zhangye city, 20–30 minutes by taxi.

name: 张掖国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A wetland park on the northern edge of Zhangye, where boardwalks wind through reedbeds, ponds and stands of tamarisk and oleaster, and lotus ponds bloom in midsummer. Protected birds such as the lesser kestrel and the Eurasian hobby have been recorded here, and it is popular with residents for summer lotus-viewing and autumn colour.
description: 张掖国家湿地公园位于甘肃张掖。游览特色包括湿地、莲花观赏。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north side of Zhangye city, about 3 km north of the Drum Tower and 10 minutes by taxi.

name: 班玛红军沟
summaryEn: A forested valley in Yartang township, Banma County, where Red Army units spent about three weeks in July 1936 on the Long March, and which local people renamed Red Army Valley. The national heritage unit is a slogan the soldiers wrote on a rock face at the valley mouth, now sheltered by a pavilion, and the scenic area adds a memorial hall opened in 2017 with Long March relics, plus a bridge, spring and stockade named for the Red Army.
description: 班玛红军沟位于青海果洛。游览特色包括纪念展览、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Yartang township, about 40 km south of Banma's county town along the Maqu river valley, in the far south-east of Golog; carry your passport for checkpoints.

name: 达玉民俗村
summaryEn: Dayu Folk Village is a privately run Tibetan folk-culture park at Jinyintan near Xihai town, named after the Dayu tribe of the Qinghai Lake area. Its grounds hold a folk museum, an experience area and a performance centre, and the village also serves as a campsite for recreational vehicles on the lake circuit.
description: 达玉民俗村位于青海海北。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Near Xihai town in Haiyan County, about 100 km north-west of Xining, on the Qinghai Lake circuit.

name: 高原海滨藏城
summaryEn: Gangcha is the county town north of Qinghai Lake, rebuilt in Tibetan style and promoted as the 'Plateau Seaside Tibetan City'. The county government's description lists Tibetan-style building groups, an ethnic history museum called Tancheng (the mandala), a song-and-dance performance centre and the Shaliu River, up which the lake's naked carp (huangyu) migrate in summer. The county also lists an old site for offerings to the lake, Matou Lazetan.
description: 高原海滨藏城位于青海海北。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊、海滨。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Gangcha county town (Shaliuhe town) lies about 15 km north of Qinghai Lake and about 200 km from Xining by road.

name: 门源百里油菜花海
summaryEn: The valley floor at Menyuan is farmed with rapeseed, which turns it yellow against the surrounding mountains in July. The scenic area is built around the Yuanshan flower-viewing platform at Qingshizui, about 3,000 m above sea level and the county's first commercial tourist site (built in 2006), with a boardwalk, viewing decks and a second flower area, Fenfangyu, nearby. Peak bloom is usually from mid-July, so a visit is strongly seasonal.
description: 门源百里油菜花海位于青海海北。游览特色包括油菜花田、山谷、花卉观赏。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 19 km west of Menyuan county town and roughly 130 km from Xining by road; Menyuan also has a high-speed railway station.

name: 祁连山生态牧场
summaryEn: The Qilian Mountain Eco-Ranch is a commercial grassland park in the Menyuan valley, developed from 2016 by a private tourism company, with its first phase opened in June 2017. Its zones cover pasture sightseeing, livestock-product displays, folk-custom experiences, song and dance shows, walking areas and grassland lodging, and it lies next to the Menyuan rapeseed flower area.
description: 祁连山生态牧场位于青海海北。游览特色包括草原、油菜花田、山谷。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At Sujiwan village in Sujitan township, about 10 km from Menyuan county town and 8 km from Menyuan railway station; Xining is roughly 140 km away by road.

name: 文迦牧场
summaryEn: Wenjia Ranch is a privately run grassland resort near the east shore of Qinghai Lake in Haiyan County, begun in 2017 by a team of university graduates with a few rented tents and set up as a company in 2019. It has a Tibetan-style 'starry sky' hotel and guesthouses, a restaurant, a craft centre, a bookshop, an incense-making workshop, a nomad-life experience area, a viewing platform and an evening bonfire with group dancing. It suits visitors who want a night near the lake with organised Tibetan-style activities rather than a historic or protected site.
description: 文迦牧场位于青海海北。游览特色包括草原、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the Ring-Lake East Road on the east side of Qinghai Lake in Haiyan County, about 15 km by road from Xihai town.

name: 互助北山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A large forest park in the mountains north-east of Huzhu, rising from about 2,100 m to over 4,300 m and also a national geopark. Its central zone, Langshidang, is the best developed, with red and white birch woods, waterfalls, two high-altitude lakes and a Tibetan stupa. It is a day trip for walking and mountain scenery rather than a single sight.
description: 互助北山国家森林公园位于青海海东。游览特色包括瀑布、地质景观、森林公园。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: About 110 km from Xining and 78 km from Huzhu's county town by road, in the mountains on the Qinghai–Gansu border.

name: 河湟文化博物馆
summaryEn: A regional museum in Ledu District that opened in July 2023 and is described in Chinese state media as the only comprehensive museum devoted to Hehuang culture, the cultures of the Huangshui valley in eastern Qinghai. It shows about 1,180 objects in 17 categories, from stone, jade and bone objects to pottery, porcelain, gold and textiles. The walls of its entrance hall display 374 painted pots from the Liuwan cemetery.
description: 河湟文化博物馆位于青海海东。游览特色包括博物馆、山谷、陶瓷工艺。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Ledu District, about 60 km east of Xining and under an hour by road. Closed on Mondays.

name: 平安驿
summaryEn: A newly built cultural quarter in Ping'an District, laid out in the style of an old post-station village and themed on Hehuang, the Huangshui valley of eastern Qinghai, whose food, architecture and crafts reflect its many ethnic groups. Its lanes hold regional restaurants, a courtyard inn with hot-spring baths, cafés and craft shops, with staged folk performances. It is a place to eat, stay and browse in newly built old-street style, not a historic town.
description: 平安驿位于青海海东。游览特色包括山谷。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 35 km east of Xining, roughly half an hour by road.

name: 七里花海
summaryEn: A rural-tourism park at the foot of Mount Kangeda in Shanzhuang village, Gushan town, Minhe County, developed from 2017 on stony wasteland. It covers about 60 hectares, of which roughly 20 hectares are flower beds that bloom from spring to autumn, with boardwalks and viewing pavilions. Besides the flowers it has slides, a glass water slide, a children's play area, village guesthouses and, in winter, a small ski and snow-tube slope, so it suits families and day trips more than hikers.
description: 七里花海位于青海海东。游览特色包括田园观光、花卉观赏、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 40 km from Minhe's county town (some 40 minutes by road) and about 145 km from Xining, roughly two hours by car.

name: 撒拉尔故里民俗文化园
summaryEn: A folk-culture park in Majia village, Jiezi town, set up to present the life of the Salar, a Muslim people whose ancestors, by tradition, migrated here from Central Asia and who live mainly in Xunhua. It has a visitor centre, a marriage-customs hall, a folk museum, a display of traditional Salar timber-and-wattle houses and an exhibition on Qinghai hand-pulled noodles, with Salar-style meals and guesthouses. It makes a good introduction to Salar culture alongside the nearby Camel Spring.
description: 撒拉尔故里民俗文化园位于青海海东。游览特色包括博物馆、民俗文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Majia village, Jiezi town, a short drive west of Xunhua's county town and about 160 km from Xining by road.

name: 贵德国家地质公园
summaryEn: The geopark is a Danxia landscape of red sandstone and conglomerate cliffs near Ashigong village in Garang township, where earth-pillar formations sit on the upper layers and seven differently coloured gorges cut through the lower ones. It was approved as a national geopark in 2009 and is laid out with viewing platforms and thirteen 'earth culture' plazas; the colour of the rock changes with the weather.
description: 贵德国家地质公园位于青海海南。游览特色包括峡谷、地质景观。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Garang township on the road between Xining and Guide, about 20 km east of Guide county town and roughly 70 km from Xining.

name: 龙羊峡
summaryEn: Longyangxia is a Yellow River gorge scenic area built around the reservoir behind the Longyangxia hydropower dam (completed in 1992). Visitors take boats on the reservoir and walk gorge-edge walkways where blue sheep and golden eagles can sometimes be seen, and the old dam-builders' town of Longyangxia keeps many 1970s and 1980s buildings. A Danxia 'earth forest' park with a wooden boardwalk of about 2 km lies nearby.
description: 龙羊峡位于青海海南。游览特色包括峡谷、水库。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: Longyangxia town in Gonghe County, about 150 km from Xining by road.

name: 清清黄河
summaryEn: Along its stretch at Guide the Yellow River runs unusually clear, which gave rise to the local saying that 'the Yellow River is clear at Guide'. The riverside scenic area on the south bank at Heyin town has a waterwheel plaza, walkways and boat trips on the river past red Danxia cliffs.
description: 清清黄河位于青海海南。游览特色包括滨水景观、乘船游览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the riverside in Guide county town, about 90 km from Xining by road.

name: 茶卡壹号·盐湖
summaryEn: Chaka Yihao, formerly Tiankong Yihao ('Sky Number One') until its renaming in July 2022, is the second tourist area of Chaka Salt Lake, on the eastern part of the lake; it opened in July 2019 after nearly a year of trial operation. It was planned at about 14 km² with five zones, including salt culture, wetland sightseeing and creative-culture areas, and it runs separately from the main Chaka Salt Lake scenic area, which has its own entrance.
description: 茶卡壹号·盐湖位于青海海西。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Near Chaka town in Ulan County, about 13 km by road east of the main Chaka Salt Lake entrance and roughly 290 km west of Xining by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 翡翠湖
summaryEn: Emerald Lake is a group of former mining pools in the Da Qaidam salt lake, an industrial legacy of the area's mineral extraction, where brine of differing mineral content shows colours from pale blue to deep green. The local government gives the area as about 15 km², and the water is still tied to industrial salt extraction, so it is a working landscape as much as a scenic one. The scenic area has a visitor centre, viewing platforms and a car park.
description: 翡翠湖位于青海海西。游览特色包括湖泊、观景台、盐湖风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 12 km west of Da Qaidam town by road, mostly along the G215, with Golmud about 200 km and Delingha about 220 km away.

name: 将军楼
summaryEn: The General's Building is a two-storey brick building from 1956 that served as the office and home of Mu Shengzhong, who commanded construction of the Qinghai–Tibet Highway (completed to Lhasa in December 1954); it was the first two-storey building in Golmud. It is now the centre of a 9.8-hectare memorial park, opened in 2009, with a Qinghai–Tibet Highway museum and the Heaven Road memorial tower, whose 39.16 m height echoes the roughly 3,916 km combined length of the highway and the railway. The displays cover how the highway was built and how Golmud grew around it.
description: 将军楼位于青海海西。游览特色包括博物馆、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: On Jinfeng Road in the middle of Golmud city; Golmud is about 770 km from Xining by road and has an airport and a railway station.

name: 格尔木昆仑旅游区
summaryEn: The Kunlun tourist area is Golmud's name for a string of Kunlun Mountains sights south of the city along the Qinghai–Tibet road rather than a single gated park; Golmud's promotion lists Kunlun Spring and Wuji Longfeng Palace among them. Kunlun Spring does not freeze at about 3,540 m, and the Kunlun Mountains National Geopark (opened in 2008) along the same road takes in the glaciers around Yuzhu Peak (6,178 m) and the surface rupture left by the magnitude 8.1 earthquake of 2001 near Kunlun Pass. It is a high-altitude drive.
description: 格尔木昆仑旅游区位于青海海西。游览特色包括地质景观、冰川。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: The Kunlun Spring is about 94 km south-west of Golmud on the Qinghai–Tibet highway, and the road climbs to Kunlun Pass about 160 km from the city, so allow for the altitude and carry your passport for checkpoints.

name: 和日寺石经墙
summaryEn: A Nyingma temple in Heri town, Zêkog (Zeku) County, known for its stone-sutra wall of more than 100,000 engraved slabs, which the county government gives as over 200 m long. The slabs carry mainly the Kangyur and Tengyur, with images of Buddhas, Padmasambhava and stupas; by local tradition the carving began in the early 19th century and was completed in the 1950s, and Heri stone carving is listed as national intangible heritage. The county's Heri scenic area, about 2.5 sq km, centres on the temple and the wall.
description: 和日寺石经墙位于青海黄南。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Heri town, about 75 km by road west of the Zeku county seat, which is over 250 km from Xining; carry your passport for checkpoints.

name: 边麻沟花海
summaryEn: A flower garden of about 800 mu (roughly 53 hectares) in Bianmagou village, Shuobei Tibetan township, Datong County, at an average height of about 2,800 m. The village began planting it around 2015 with plateau flowers such as lupins, gaillardias and irises and with spruce and crab-apple trees, and has since added a glass water slide, farmhouse restaurants and guesthouses. Xinhua found the flowers in bloom in late July, and it suits a half-day trip from Xining.
description: 边麻沟花海位于青海西宁。游览特色包括花卉观赏、园林景观、田园观光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shuobei Tibetan township, Datong County, about 50 km north of central Xining and roughly an hour by road.

name: 昆仑玉文化博物馆
summaryEn: A museum in the Biological Science and Technology Park in Xining's Chengbei district, in the same museum cluster as the Tibetan Medicine Culture Museum and the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau Natural Museum. Its three floors are arranged in ten sections on the history of jade culture in China and on the culture of Qinghai's Kunlun jade. It was upgraded in 2017 and opened to visitors in March 2019.
description: 昆仑玉文化博物馆位于青海西宁。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Biological Science and Technology Park in Xining's Chengbei district, about 10 km north-west of the city centre. Check that it is open before going.

name: 老爷山
summaryEn: A 2,928 m mountain above Qiaotou town, the seat of Datong Hui and Tu Autonomous County north of Xining, taking its name by tradition from a Guandi temple on its slopes, with other small temples along the ascent. It is the home of the Laoyeshan huaer gathering, a folk-song festival held each summer, traditionally around the sixth day of the sixth lunar month; huaer folk song is on China's list of intangible cultural heritage.
description: 老爷山位于青海西宁。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、非遗文化、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Qiaotou town, Datong County, about 40 km north of central Xining and under an hour by road.

name: 力盟步行街
summaryEn: A modern shopping and dining quarter in central Xining, built in an old-street style of Qin-brick and Han-tile design and laid out as 'two streets, four gates and eight lanes'. It mixes local snack restaurants with national chains, cafes, bars and a cinema, and a 2019 state-media guide describes it as a gathering place for young locals. It is a modern commercial development, not historic Xining, and stands a few minutes' walk from the Qinghai Provincial Museum.
description: 西宁市中心的购物餐饮街区采用仿古街巷设计，适合步行游览。
accessEn: In the city centre of Xining beside West Gate Street, a few minutes' walk from the Qinghai Provincial Museum.

name: 青海藏文化馆
summaryEn: A privately run museum of Tibetan history and culture in Lusar, Huangzhong District, opened in 2010 and housed in two exhibition halls. The first covers the history of the Tibetan people, Buddhist figures and deities, masks, thangka, script and epics, costume, song and dance, the 'three arts' of Kumbum and Tibetan opera, and the second presents Tibetan Buddhist views of the cosmos and of life and death. It makes a useful companion to a visit to Kumbum Monastery nearby.
description: 青海藏文化馆位于青海西宁。游览特色包括博物馆、主题展览、佛教文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Lusar town, Huangzhong District, about 2 km east of Kumbum Monastery and 25 km south-west of Xining.

name: 青海藏医药文化博物馆
summaryEn: A national first-grade museum devoted to Tibetan medicine and plateau civilisation, in Xining's Biological Science and Technology Park, with nearly 60,000 objects including fossils, stone tools, pottery, gold and silver, silks, old manuscripts, medical instruments and thangka. It is best known for a thangka scroll 618 m long, 'Grand View of Tibetan Cultural Art', painted by artists from five provinces and regions; a second 410 m volume was installed in April 2025. Other highlights include a Tubo-period gold headdress inlaid with turquoise and a manuscript of the Four Medical Tantras (Subsequent Tantra).
description: 青海藏医药文化博物馆位于青海西宁。游览特色包括博物馆、国家一级博物馆。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Biological Science and Technology Park in Xining's Chengbei district, about 10 km north-west of the city centre.

name: 青藏高原自然博物馆
summaryEn: A natural-history museum in Xining's Biological Science and Technology Park, opened in 2011 and a few minutes' walk from the Tibetan Medicine Culture Museum. Its displays introduce the landscapes of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau and its animal and plant life.
description: 青藏高原自然博物馆位于青海西宁。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Biological Science and Technology Park in Xining's Chengbei district, about 10 km north-west of the city centre. Check that it is open before going.

name: 青藏高原野生动物园
summaryEn: A zoo and wildlife rescue centre at the foot of Fenghuang Mountain on the western edge of Xining, opened in 2009 and best known for its snow leopards, most of them rescued from the wild; Xinhua reported in 2025 that it kept 12 of the roughly 20 snow leopards on public display in China. According to Xinhua, its small-cat house is the only place in China where visitors can see the Chinese mountain cat, also called the desert cat.
