description: 青藏高原野生动物园位于青海西宁。游览特色包括动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the western edge of Xining, about 6 km west of the city centre, reached by city bus or taxi.

name: 中国工农红军西路军纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial museum in Xining on the Red Army's Western Route Army, the force that crossed the Yellow River westwards in October 1936 and was defeated by Ma family armies in Gansu's Hexi Corridor by March 1937, when more than 9,000 of its soldiers were captured. Its permanent exhibition, 'The Power of Faith: Soldiers of the Western Route Army in Qinghai', has six units and seven reconstructed scenes and shows more than 130 relics, among them a worn pair of knitted trousers found with a soldier's remains in 1956. A multimedia online exhibition hall accompanies the galleries.
description: 中国工农红军西路军纪念馆位于青海西宁。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Nanchuan East Road in the south of Xining, a short drive from the city centre. Closed on Mondays.

name: 乡趣卡阳
summaryEn: An outdoor resort in the high forest and pasture hills of Lanlongkou town, Huangzhong District; an official 2020 case study calls it the nearest primeval forest to Xining, with 81.1% tree cover, and gives its Tibetan name Kayang as 'pure place'. Facilities listed there include an 18 km boardwalk trail, an 800 m water slide, mountain-bike and motorbike tracks, a caravan camp, a winter ski area and a climbing area. It suits families and groups who want a day of outdoor activity near Xining rather than sightseeing.
description: 乡趣卡阳位于青海西宁。游览特色包括林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills west-south-west of Lanlongkou town, Huangzhong District, roughly 45 km north-west of Xining by road.

name: 新华联童梦乐园
summaryEn: A children's theme park and resort complex at Duoba in Huangzhong District, built around a Silk Road theme and open since 2019 on a site of about 24 hectares. It combines a land amusement park with rides, an indoor water park, an aquarium, a 'Silk Road Town', an ethnic food street, an ocean-themed hotel and a large Ferris wheel. It suits families with young children.
description: 新华联童梦乐园位于青海西宁。游览特色包括主题游乐、水族展览、水上游乐。图集建议预留一天游览。
accessEn: At Duoba in Huangzhong District, about 20 km west of central Xining, roughly half an hour by road.

name: 西宁市体育公园
summaryEn: A municipal sports-themed park on Haihu Avenue in Xining's Chengbei district, opened in 2016 as one of the main areas of the city's ring-road ecological park. Local reports describe walking paths, a lake, open woodland and grass, a tai chi plaza, a dance plaza, fitness equipment, ball courts, a children's play area and a self-drive and RV campsite. It is mainly a place for local exercise and leisure, and suits a short stop rather than a sightseeing visit.
description: 西宁市体育公园位于青海西宁。游览特色包括湖泊、林地风光、体育运动。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: On Haihu Avenue in Xining's Chengbei district, about 9 km north-west of the city centre by road.

name: 宗家沟
summaryEn: A gorge scenic area in Riyue Tibetan township, Huangyuan County, with rock formations, natural caves and a hall to the Queen Mother of the West, a figure of Kunlun mythology. In winter a display of ice falls and icicles lit with coloured lights covering 40,000 square metres drew visitors in 2021, according to China News Service. It is a short outing on the road between Xining and Qinghai Lake rather than a major sight.
description: 宗家沟位于青海西宁。游览特色包括峡谷、湖泊。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: In a gorge near Dashitou village in Riyue Tibetan township, Huangyuan County, roughly 70 km west of Xining on the way to Qinghai Lake. Check that it is open before going.

name: 六盘山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park in the Liupan Mountains of southern Ningxia, whose main peak, Migang Shan, reaches 2,942 m; the damp slopes carry birch, poplar, oak and bamboo thickets that stand out from the dry Loess Plateau around them. Its main visitor areas are Xiaonanchuan, a wooded stream valley at one of the sources of the Jing River, and the 8 km Liangdian Gorge, along with an ecology museum and a botanical garden. It is separate from the Long March memorial on the Liupan pass further north.
description: 六盘山国家森林公园位于宁夏固原。游览特色包括博物馆、峡谷、森林公园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: The main areas lie 10–20 km south and south-west of Jingyuan county town, which is about an hour by road south of Guyuan.

name: 华夏奇石山
summaryEn: A landscaped park of about 1.1 km² beside Xinghai Lake in Dawukou, created by grading, covering and planting a former power-station ash dump that stood 13 m above the surrounding land. It displays ornamental stones and stone carvings in themed areas, with a spring garden, a children's science play area and a winter snow park, and suits a short walk.
description: 华夏奇石山位于宁夏石嘴山。游览特色包括湖泊、园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside Xinghai Lake in Dawukou, central Shizuishan, about an hour by road north of Yinchuan.

name: 牛家坊
summaryEn: A village on the southern edge of Wuzhong developed as a rural tourism area of about 130 ha, with grey-brick houses, rammed-earth courtyard walls and a village museum of Yellow River farming and folk life. It also has homestays, a food street, craft workshops, a children's play area and fruit picking, and suits a half-day visit for local food and village life.
description: 牛家坊位于宁夏吴忠。游览特色包括博物馆、田园观光、农业体验。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shangqiao town on the southern edge of Wuzhong (Litong district), about 4 km from Wuzhong high-speed railway station.

name: 盐州古城
summaryEn: A cultural tourism district on the north side of Yanchi county town, laid out along the Ming Great Wall that runs past the town and forming the core of Yanchi's part of the Great Wall National Cultural Park. It groups a Great Wall gateway (Changcheng Guan), the Ningxia Great Wall Museum, the Jiuqu folk-culture park, the old walled town of Huamachi and Yinma Lake, and is also an evening leisure and food area.
description: 盐州古城位于宁夏吴忠。游览特色包括博物馆、古城、长城。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north side of Yanchi county town, about 2 hours by road south-east of Yinchuan.

name: 百瑞源枸杞博物馆
summaryEn: A company museum run by the goji (wolfberry) producer Bairuiyuan, tracing what it presents as 4,000 years of goji culture and the modern Ningxia goji industry. Visits can include a see-through processing plant and the company shop, and suit travellers curious about Ningxia's best-known crop.
description: 百瑞源枸杞博物馆位于宁夏银川。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the Helan industrial park in Helan County, on the northern edge of Yinchuan about 7 km north of the Drum Tower, around 20 minutes by road.

name: 中粮长城天赋酒庄
summaryEn: A winery of COFCO's Great Wall Wine brand, completed in 2012 on reclaimed desert land at the foot of the Helan Mountains, just across the road from the Western Xia tombs. It has a 7,000 m² underground cellar and extensive vineyards, and offers winery tours, tastings and family activities.
description: 中粮长城天赋酒庄位于宁夏银川。游览特色包括长城、沙漠。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 35 km west of central Yinchuan beside the Western Xia tombs, around 45 minutes by road.

name: 贺兰山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park in the Suyukou valley of the Helan Mountains, inside the Helan Mountains national nature reserve north-west of Yinchuan. Shuttle buses run up the valley from the Songtao Shanzhuang stop, and plank walkways and trails climb through wooded slopes to viewpoints over the range.
description: 贺兰山国家森林公园位于宁夏银川。游览特色包括森林公园、自然保护区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 50 km north-west of central Yinchuan in Helan County, roughly an hour by road.

name: 黄河横城
summaryEn: A Yellow River-themed resort on the east bank opposite Yinchuan, built around Hengcheng, a Ming-dynasty fort on the riverbank where the Great Wall east of the river began, beside an old ferry crossing used by the Kangxi Emperor in 1697. Besides the fort, it has newly built halls, an old-style street, a ferry pier, riverside restaurants and a self-drive campsite.
description: 黄河横城位于宁夏银川。游览特色包括长城、滨水景观、历史建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 18 km south-east of central Yinchuan on the east bank of the Yellow River, beside the Yellow River bridge on the road to Hedong Airport, around 30 minutes by road. In November 2025 the regional tourism department ordered it to fix problems by November 2026, so check it is operating normally before going.

name: 黄沙古渡
summaryEn: A Yellow River leisure area on the east bank north-east of Yinchuan, named after an old ferry crossing and combining sand dunes, reed wetland and riverside farmland. The usual activities are camel rides on the dunes and boat or raft trips on the river, and it suits families and anyone wanting desert scenery close to the city.
description: 黄沙古渡位于宁夏银川。游览特色包括湿地、沙漠。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 50 km by road from central Yinchuan, on the east bank of the Yellow River in Yueyahu township north-east of the city, around an hour's drive.

name: 华夏河图银川艺术小镇
summaryEn: An arts district on the west bank of the Yellow River south-east of Yinchuan, developed around the Museum of Contemporary Art Yinchuan (MOCA Yinchuan). Besides the museum it has an artists' village, a sculpture park and wetland and canal-side parks, and suits visitors interested in contemporary art.
description: 华夏河图银川艺术小镇位于宁夏银川。游览特色包括博物馆、湿地、运河。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the west bank of the Yellow River south-east of Yinchuan, about 13 km from the Drum Tower, around 25 minutes by road. In November 2025 the regional tourism department ordered it to fix problems within six months, so check it is operating normally before going.

name: 看见贺兰演艺小镇
summaryEn: A modern leisure town opened in 2016 across National Road 110 from the Zhenbeibu film studio, first built around a Helan Mountains wine theme and later relaunched as the 'Seeing Helan' immersive performance town. Staged plays and street shows recreate a Tang-dynasty frontier town, with costumed actors mixing with visitors, and the town also has a hot-spring complex, a wine exhibition hall and food streets. It was named a national tourism and leisure district in 2025.
description: 看见贺兰演艺小镇位于宁夏银川。游览特色包括主题展览、影视拍摄。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 25 km north-west of central Yinchuan, across National Road 110 from the Zhenbeibu film studio, around 40 minutes by road.

name: 宁夏农旅产业园
summaryEn: A 2,170-mu (about 145 ha) agricultural park started in 2009 by the state-owned Ningxia Nongken group just outside Helan county town. It combines modern horticulture with fruit picking, children's play areas, sports grounds and study programmes, and is aimed mainly at families.
description: 宁夏农旅产业园位于宁夏银川。游览特色包括田园观光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 1 km from Helan county town and 15 km north of central Yinchuan, around 25 minutes by road.

name: 天山海世界·黄河明珠
summaryEn: An indoor water park in Binhe New Area on the east bank of the Yellow River, with heated pools and water slides kept warm all year. It is a family leisure venue rather than a sightseeing stop.
description: 天山海世界·黄河明珠位于宁夏银川。游览特色包括水上游乐。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Binhe New Area near the Binhe Yellow River Bridge, about 25 km east of central Yinchuan, around 40 minutes by road. Recent news of its opening is scarce, so check it is open before going.

name: 西夏风情园
summaryEn: A Western Xia (Tangut) themed park at the foot of the Helan Mountains on Yinchuan's western edge, with new buildings in imitation Western Xia palace style set among lakes and gardens. Live-action shows on Western Xia themes are its main feature, alongside wine tasting and restaurants, and it pairs easily with a visit to the nearby Western Xia tombs.
description: 西夏风情园位于宁夏银川。游览特色包括园林景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On Beijing West Road in Xixia District, about 22 km west of central Yinchuan, around 35 minutes by road.

name: 沃福百瑞宁夏枸杞馆
summaryEn: A goji (wolfberry) exhibition hall opened in 2022 by the Ningxia producer Wofu Bairui in Yinchuan's Xixia District. It combines displays on goji growing and health-food culture with a see-through factory corridor, a product tasting centre and a restaurant serving goji dishes.
description: 沃福百瑞宁夏枸杞馆位于宁夏银川。游览特色包括主题展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xixia District, about 12 km west of central Yinchuan, around 25 minutes by road.

name: 黄河军事文化博览园
summaryEn: A defence-themed park in Binhe New Area on the east bank of the Yellow River, opened in 2013 around the decommissioned destroyer Yinchuan, one of China's first-generation guided-missile destroyers, which served from 1976 to 2012. The ship is the centrepiece of a park with a lake, a peace plaza and areas for defence-education activities aimed at school groups and families.
description: 黄河军事文化博览园位于宁夏银川。游览特色包括湖泊、历史纪念。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Binhe New Area on the east bank of the Yellow River, beside the Binhe Yellow River Bridge, about 25 km east of central Yinchuan, roughly 40 minutes by road. Recent news of its opening is scarce, so check it is open before going.

name: 阅海湾
summaryEn: A large lake and park area in Jinfeng District covering 1,739 ha, 922 ha of it water, made up of Yuehai National Wetland Park, a water park, Lanshan Park and the Flower Expo Garden. The wetland was made a national wetland park in 2006, and the big open-air amphitheatre in Lanshan Park is a popular place to watch the sun set behind the Helan Mountains.
description: 阅海湾位于宁夏银川。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Jinfeng District, about 7 km north-west of the old centre of Yinchuan, around 20 minutes by taxi.

name: 玉泉国际酒庄
summaryEn: A winery of the state-owned Ningxia Nongken group in the Yuquan wine village of Yongning County, set among vineyards, with buildings in Song-dynasty style decorated with classical wine poetry; it bills itself as China's first poetry-themed winery. It is a second-growth estate in the Helan Mountains East classification, and visits take in the winery, a wine-poetry exhibition and tastings.
description: 玉泉国际酒庄位于宁夏银川。游览特色包括葡萄酒文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yongning County, about 35 km south-west of central Yinchuan, around 45 minutes by road.

name: 志辉源石酒庄
summaryEn: A winery in the Helan Mountains foothills built on an abandoned gravel quarry, restored with vineyards, shelter woods and underground cellars dug into the old pits. Visitors follow the route from vineyard and fermentation hall to barrel cellar and tasting hall, and the estate received more than half a million visitors in 2025.
description: 志辉源石酒庄位于宁夏银川。游览特色包括葡萄酒文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Zhenbeibu town, about 25 km north-west of central Yinchuan, around 40 minutes by road.

name: 寺口子
summaryEn: A gorge scenic area of about 18 km² in the hills south of Xuanhe town, known in ancient times as Beihai. Its eastern part is a narrow karst gorge with odd rock formations, while the western part has red sandstone (danxia) cliffs, a natural cave and spots tied to local legends such as that of the Han envoy Su Wu herding sheep.
description: 寺口子位于宁夏中卫。游览特色包括峡谷、喀斯特地貌、砂岩地貌。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km south of Xuanhe town and roughly 45 minutes by road south-east of Zhongwei city.

name: 腾格里沙漠湿地·金沙岛
summaryEn: A wetland leisure area on the south-eastern edge of the Tengger Desert, where a chain of lakes and reed beds meets the dunes, with an island in the main lake. Visitors walk round the lakes, climb a dune of about 30 m and see seasonal flower fields and a 4 km stretch of earthen Ming Great Wall that runs through the area, and water birds gather on the lakes.
description: 腾格里沙漠湿地·金沙岛位于宁夏中卫。游览特色包括长城、湿地、沙漠。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 8 km west of central Zhongwei, around 15 minutes by road, and about 12 km north-east of the Shapotou scenic area.

name: 阿克苏国家湿地公园
summaryEn: A wetland park beside Aksu city covering about 5,000 mu (330 ha), of which some 1,800 mu is water, laid out as 23 linked lakes with paths and five viewing platforms. It draws waterbirds such as ducks, coots and grebes, and protected species recorded here include the black stork and golden eagle.
description: 阿克苏国家湿地公园位于新疆阿克苏。游览特色包括湿地、观景台。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside Aksu city; take a taxi from the centre.

name: 刀郎部落
summaryEn: A folk-culture scenic area in Awat County themed on Dolan (刀郎) culture, the tradition behind Dolan muqam music, set among old desert-poplar woodland by a river. It stages Dolan song and dance and folk sports such as horse racing at festivals, and about 100 residents live and run shops inside the scenic area.
description: 刀郎部落位于新疆阿克苏。游览特色包括沙漠、林地风光、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Awat County, about an hour by road south of Aksu city.

name: 沙漠花海
summaryEn: A desert leisure park of about 3,000 mu (some 200 ha) opened at the end of 2016 on a patch of dunes surrounded by oasis farmland in Qiaolepaibage village, Xinhe County. Flowerbeds are planted among the dunes, and the park offers desert off-road rides and water-based amusements.
description: 沙漠花海位于新疆阿克苏。游览特色包括沙漠、花卉观赏、公园休闲。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tashi'airike town, about 5 km north of Xinhe county town.

name: 多浪河
summaryEn: The landscaped banks of the Duolang River through Aksu city, a 4A scenic area since 2018, with promenades, pavilions such as the Gumo Pavilion and a small amusement area. Waterbirds gather on the river and locals come for evening walks, so it is an easy stroll rather than a destination in itself.
description: 多浪河位于新疆阿克苏。游览特色包括楼阁建筑、游乐体验。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Aksu city, along the Duolang River. Check that it is open before going.

name: 加依村
summaryEn: Jiayi is a village in Xinhe County known for making traditional Uyghur musical instruments, a craft it has practised for more than 300 years; nearly half of its roughly 290 households build instruments such as the dutar, ajek and rawap. Visitors can watch instruments being made in family workshops and at the village's instrument-making centre, and one master craftsman is a national-level intangible heritage bearer.
description: 加依村位于新疆阿克苏。游览特色包括非遗文化。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Yiqi'airike town, Xinhe County, about 35 km by road south-west of Kuqa.

name: 康其湿地
summaryEn: A wetland in Arele village, Kangqi township, where the Karasu and Muzat rivers meet east of Baicheng county town, developed for rural tourism since 2018. Rapeseed and sunflower fields line a stretch called the 'ten-li gallery', visitors can go kayaking, and village families run restaurants along a food street.
description: 康其湿地位于新疆阿克苏。游览特色包括湿地、田园观光、花卉观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Arele village, Kangqi township, about 16 km by road from Baicheng county town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 柯柯牙纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial hall at the core of the Kekeya greening project, which since the 1980s has planted forest across the gravel desert that once sent dust storms into Aksu. Photographs, objects, reconstructions and VR displays tell the story of the tree planters, and the roof, modelled on Tomur Peak, has a viewing platform over the planted shelter belts.
description: 阿克苏地区柯柯牙纪念馆，简称柯柯牙纪念馆，原为柯柯牙绿化工程纪念馆，是纪念阿克苏地区最大规模的人工造林工程——柯柯牙绿化工程的纪念馆，是新疆首家生态文明建设纪念馆，位于中国新疆维吾尔自治区阿克苏地区温宿县。
accessEn: On the Kekeya plateau in Wensu County, about 15 km north of central Aksu.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 库车王府
summaryEn: Kuqa Palace is a reconstruction, completed in 2004, of the residence of the Kuqa princes, a hereditary title first granted under the Qianlong Emperor in the 18th century and held by twelve generations. The compound mixes Chinese and Islamic architectural styles and houses exhibitions on the princely family, Kucha history and local folk life, next to a surviving stretch of Qing-dynasty city wall.
description: 库车王府位于新疆阿克苏。游览特色包括历史建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Kuqa's old town, a few minutes' walk from the Kuqa Grand Mosque.

name: 齐兰古城
summaryEn: Qilan Ancient City is a Qing-dynasty ruin site in the desert about 7 km east of Qilan village in Kalpin County, listed nationally as the Konaqilan ruins. It was rated a 4A scenic area in 2023, and the county promotes it as one of its main heritage sights.
description: 齐兰古城位于新疆阿克苏。游览特色包括古城、沙漠、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In the desert about 55 km by road east of Kalpin county town; a car is needed.

name: 沙棘林
summaryEn: A wetland park in Wushi County built around a large stand of wild sea-buckthorn, with a boardwalk of about 5 km winding through the thickets beside streams and springs. Local people come here to walk and camp, and Aksu tourism routes usually pair it with Yanquanshan Park in the county town.
description: 沙棘林位于新疆阿克苏。游览特色包括湿地。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Wushi County, about 27 km west-south-west of Wushi county town, itself roughly 100 km by road west of Aksu city; go by car. Check that it is open before going.

name: 唐安西都护府文化园
summaryEn: A modern culture park in Xinhe county town named after the Tang dynasty's Anxi Protectorate, rated 4A in 2023. It serves as an evening market and events venue, and was listed in 2022 among the region's first night-time culture and consumption districts.
description: 新和县城的现代文化园以唐代安西都护府为名，围绕西域历史展开游览。
accessEn: In Xinhe county town, about 40 km by road south-west of Kuqa.

name: 塔里木河湿地
summaryEn: A scenic area of wetland and natural desert-poplar (Populus euphratica) forest beside the Tarim River south of Shaya county town. Regional tourism routes promote it for the meeting of desert and river, and the poplars are at their best in autumn.
description: 塔里木河湿地位于新疆阿克苏。游览特色包括湿地、沙漠。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 40 km by road south of Shaya county town.

name: 天山神秘大峡谷
summaryEn: A narrow canyon about 5.5 km long cut into red-brown sedimentary rock on the southern flank of the Tian Shan, part of a national geopark; locals call it Kizilya, 'red cliffs'. Visitors walk along the canyon floor between towering walls, and inside the canyon is the Ah-ai Grotto, a small 8th-century Buddhist cave with Tang-style murals found by a herdsman in 1999.
description: 天山神秘大峡谷位于新疆阿克苏。游览特色包括峡谷、地质景观、壁画。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 70 km north of Kuqa on the G217 Duku Highway.

name: 天山神木园
summaryEn: A grove of ancient trees in a spring-fed oasis at about 1,700 m in the Tian Shan foothills of Wensu County, covering some 600 mu (40 ha). Its 289 old poplars, averaging about 145 years, grow in contorted shapes where groundwater rises along fault lines, earning it the nickname 'museum of old trees'. Fences protect the trunks and props hold up some of the heavier branches.
description: 天山神木园位于新疆阿克苏。游览特色包括博物馆、古树。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 60 km by road north-west of Wensu county town.

name: 渭干河生态文化旅游景区
summaryEn: A park area on the Weigan River in Shaya, rated 4A in 2023, centred on Yanming Lake People's Park and its lakeside wetland. It has an evening market and outdoor stage, sports grounds used for the village basketball league, and a ski slope in winter, so it is a place to see local life rather than a sight in itself.
description: 渭干河生态文化旅游景区位于新疆阿克苏。游览特色包括湿地、湖泊。图集建议预留2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shaya, about 70 km by road south of Kuqa.

name: 雁栖·田园综合体
summaryEn: An agri-tourism complex built around a modern agricultural science park in Gulebage town, Shaya County, rated 4A in 2024. It offers themed farm sightseeing and leisure, and surrounding villages have opened homestays and pick-your-own orchards along newly upgraded rural roads.
description: 雁栖·田园综合体位于新疆阿克苏。游览特色包括田园观光、果园。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 4 km by road north-east of Shaya county town.

name: 燕泉山
summaryEn: Yanquanshan is a landscaped scenic park at the western end of Wushi county town, used mainly by local residents for walks. Aksu tourism routes pair it with the Sea-Buckthorn Forest Wetland Park, and it was named a regional model scenic area for visitor conduct in 2024.
description: 燕泉山位于新疆阿克苏。游览特色包括湿地、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the western edge of Wushi county town, roughly 100 km by road west of Aksu city.

name: 阿贡盖提草原石人
summaryEn: A Kazakh culture park on the Agonggaiti grassland beside the road from Burqin to Kanas, built around a group of ancient steppe stone figures and rock carvings left by early nomads. Visitors can walk among the carved standing stones and watch horsemanship shows, Dawaz tightrope walking and the 'girl chase' riding game, and try Kazakh customs and food. Surrounded by hills, pine woods and streams, it is often the first stop on the way into Kanas.
description: 阿贡盖提草原石人位于新疆阿勒泰。游览特色包括草原。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the Agonggaiti grassland beside the Burqin–Kanas road, about 12 km from Kanas Airport and 35 km before the Jiadengyu gate of Kanas.

name: 桦林公园
summaryEn: A park of wooded river islands at the north-western corner of Altay city, where the Kelan River splits into six islands under birch and poplar. A boardwalk of about 5 km loops through the woods, with a woodland cafe, a small animal park and a sightseeing train. The birches turn gold from late September, and in winter hoar frost coats the trees.
description: 桦林公园位于新疆阿勒泰。游览特色包括滨水景观、林地风光、动物观赏。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the north-west of Altay city on the Kelan River, about 4 km north of the centre.

name: 富蕴滨河
summaryEn: A landscaped riverside promenade along the Irtysh in Fuyun county town, rated 3A in 2016 and 4A in 2019. It links the south-bank embankment walks, a pedestrian suspension bridge, a musical fountain square on Karatunk island, a weir and Nanshan Park, and residents use it daily for walks, dancing and games. It makes an easy stop on the way to Koktokay, and was listed as a regional tourism and leisure street in 2023.
description: 富蕴滨河位于新疆阿勒泰。游览特色包括岛屿、滨水景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Along the Irtysh River in Fuyun county town, within walking distance of the centre.

name: 哈巴河白桦林
summaryEn: A belt of natural birch forest along the Habahe River valley just west of Habahe town, rated a national forest park in 2010 and linked to the town by the Akqi national wetland. Paths and wooden bridges lead through the white-trunked birches, and the park has a visitor centre built to look like a birch stump, a Kazakh folk-culture area with yurts and a Ferris wheel above the forest. The leaves turn gold in autumn.
description: 哈巴河白桦林位于新疆阿勒泰。游览特色包括湿地、森林公园。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 5 km west of Habahe county town, a short taxi ride.

name: 克兰河滨河
summaryEn: An 11.6 km riverside scenic belt of about 720 hectares along the Kelan River through Altay city, from the Birch Park bridge in the north to the Red Stone area in the south. Walking and exercise areas, photo spots and cultural venues follow the river between the mountains that ring the city, and on summer evenings the banks fill with residents and visitors out for a stroll. In winter the long, heavy snow season turns it into a place for snow play close to the centre.
description: 克兰河滨河位于新疆阿勒泰。游览特色包括滨水景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Along the Kelan River through Altay city, walkable from the centre.

name: 可可托海国家矿山公园
summaryEn: A former rare-metal mine in Koktokay town, built around the huge open pit of the Number 3 Vein, a deposit found in 1935 that is known as a natural geological museum for its 84 minerals, including lithium, beryllium, tantalum, niobium and caesium. Around it are the Ayiguozi mine tunnel, Soviet-style wooden bridges and buildings, an exhibition hall of ore specimens and company history, and the old ore-dressing plant and machine works. The park is run as a patriotic-education base on the mine's role in the 'Two Bombs, One Satellite' programme and received its plaque as a national industrial-tourism demonstration base in 2023.
description: 可可托海国家矿山公园位于新疆阿勒泰。游览特色包括博物馆、地质景观、主题展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Koktokay town, about an hour by road north-east of Fuyun county town.

name: 中俄老码头风情街
summaryEn: A riverside leisure quarter of about 20 hectares on the Irtysh in Burqin town, built around the old wharf of the Sino-Soviet river shipping that once ran on the Irtysh. It brings together a night market on the river embankment, the Sino-Soviet Shipping Memorial Hall, the sites of the old wharf and pontoon bridge, a Russian-style shopping street and a theatre.
description: 中俄老码头风情街位于新疆阿勒泰。游览特色包括纪念展览、滨水景观、特色街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Hebin Road by the Irtysh in Burqin town, within walking distance of the centre.

name: 五彩滩
summaryEn: A stretch of the north bank of the Irtysh 24 km from Burqin, where water and wind have carved the ground into multicoloured ridges, gullies and pinnacles, facing the green riverine woods on the far bank. Boardwalks lead over the eroded formations to viewpoints, a suspension bridge crosses the river and a lighthouse-style tower gives views along it, and the colours are richest at sunset, the favourite time for photographers. It is a usual stop on the road between Burqin and Kanas.
description: 五彩滩位于新疆阿勒泰。游览特色包括楼阁建筑。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north bank of the Irtysh about 24 km from Burqin town, roughly half an hour by road.

name: 睡胡杨谷
summaryEn: A stand of dead desert poplars on the north-western edge of the Taklamakan in the 14th Regiment's land, where trunks covering more than 3,000 mu (about 2 km²) still stand upright or lie in twisted shapes; local sources link the die-off to the Keriya River ceasing to reach the area in the late Ming or early Qing period. The scenic area has a visitor centre, a sightseeing train, camel rides and buggies, and the bird-rich Swan Lake wetland, with boardwalks and a bird-watching tower, lies close by. October and November, when the living poplars turn gold, are the best months.
description: 睡胡杨谷位于新疆阿拉尔。游览特色包括沙漠、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 60 km by road east of Aral city, or about 40 km by road from the Desert Gate area south of the Tarim River; a car or taxi is the practical option.

name: 塔河源
summaryEn: The scenic area at Xiaojiake, west of Aral, where the Aksu, Hotan and Yarkand rivers meet to form the Tarim, China's longest inland river. Paths lead through riverside desert-poplar forest towards the confluence, and the site, open since 2023, has a visitor centre, the 'Eye of the Tarim' observation tower overlooking the meeting of the rivers, small halls on the river and on the desert poplar, a campground and a children's play area.
description: 塔河源位于新疆阿拉尔。游览特色包括沙漠、滨水景观、楼阁建筑。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In the 16th Regiment area, roughly 30 km west of Aral city, best reached by car or taxi.

name: 巴州博物馆
summaryEn: The prefecture museum of Bayingolin in Korla, founded in 1990 and opened in 2008, and rated a national second-grade museum in 2018. Its collection covers more than ten kinds of objects, among them bronzes, pottery and porcelain, textiles, gold and silver, jade, murals and mummies.
description: 巴州博物馆位于新疆巴音郭楞。游览特色包括博物馆、壁画。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Shihua Avenue at Yingbin Road in Korla, a short taxi ride from the city centre. Closed on Mondays.

name: 北山森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park on formerly bare gobi hills at the north-western edge of Hejing town, where gravel quarries were moved out from 2013 and more than 50 kinds of trees and shrubs, among them desert poplar, oleaster, sea buckthorn and walnut, were planted on drip irrigation fed from the Huangshui gully. A path of about 3 km climbs from the entrance past flower gardens to a patriotic and national-defence education base on the hilltop, and the park also has a fruit-picking orchard, a small zoo and Butterfly Spring, where swans gather. Local families come here to walk, camp, fish and barbecue.
description: 北山森林公园位于新疆巴音郭楞。游览特色包括沙漠、森林公园。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north-western edge of Hejing town, about 7 km from the centre by taxi; Hejing is about 30 km north-west of Yanqi.

name: 金沙滩
summaryEn: A sand-beach resort on the north-eastern shore of Bosten Lake in Hoxud County, upgraded in 2024–25 with a visitor centre, lakeside promenade, jetty, hotels and guesthouses. In summer visitors swim and paddle, go sailing or boating, and join evening events such as bonfire parties.
description: 金沙滩位于新疆巴音郭楞。游览特色包括湖泊、海滨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: On the north-east shore of Bosten Lake, about 35 km south-east of Hoxud county town and roughly two hours by road from Korla.

name: 巩乃斯森林公园
summaryEn: A forest park in the Gongnaisi (Künes) valleys of the Tian Shan in north-western Hejing County, at an average altitude of about 2,000 m, where the main valley runs for some 40 km. Pure stands of Tian Shan spruce cover the upper valley terraces, giving way to mixed spruce, birch, aspen and willow lower down, with mountain and forest meadows between them.
description: 巩乃斯森林公园位于新疆巴音郭楞。游览特色包括森林公园、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the upper Gongnaisi valley, about 90 km by road north-east of Bayanbulak town.

name: 霍拉山丝路古村
summaryEn: A farming village on the southern slope of the Horashan range west of Yanqi, developed as a rural tourism area and rated 4A in 2018, with a horse-culture hall, a market street built in the style of ancient Yanqi, farm restaurants, guesthouses and a visitor centre. The surrounding valleys hold yardang rock formations, rock art, a rafting run and the ruins of a Tang-dynasty Buddhist temple, which is a national heritage site.
description: 霍拉山丝路古村位于新疆巴音郭楞。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、古村落、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: About 50 km west of Yanqi town at the edge of the Horashan mountains, roughly an hour by road.

name: 开都河景区
summaryEn: Riverside parkland along the Kaidu River at Bohu town, rated 4A in 2022, with walks, Tianhuwan Square and the 182 m Qinbo Bridge, whose glass-floored deck is lit with coloured lights and music in the evening. The Bohu County Ecological Museum, opened inside the scenic area in May 2025, covers the nature, history, intangible heritage and herding life of the Bosten Lake area over four floors. It is mainly a place for an evening stroll on the way to or from Bosten Lake.
description: 开都河景区位于新疆巴音郭楞。游览特色包括博物馆、湖泊。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the western side of Bohu town, about 10 km south-east of Yanqi and roughly an hour by road from Korla.

name: 罗布人村寨
summaryEn: A tourist village on the banks of the Tarim River in Yuli County that presents the culture of the Lop people (Lopliks) of the lower Tarim, relaunched in 2025 after a major upgrade. Its old-village area shows traditional Loplik houses, palaz weaving, fishing and hunting, and music and dance, a Silk Road bazaar recreates the trade of the ancient Lop Nur region, and camel rides and other desert activities are offered on East Sand Hill.
description: 罗布人村寨位于新疆巴音郭楞。游览特色包括沙漠、村寨。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Dunkuotan township about 80 km south of Korla, roughly 1.5 hours by road via Yuli county town.

name: 阿拉山口边境旅游区
summaryEn: The border tourism area at Alashankou, the rail and road port on the Kazakhstan border in the Dzungarian Gate, a pass with gales of force 8 or more on more than 180 days a year. Visitors see the national gate facing Kazakhstan's Dostyk, where guides explain the history of the broad- and standard-gauge railways and the China–Europe freight trains, and an import-goods shopping centre stands beside the visitor centre. The border-defence post known as the 'first post in the wind gap' is open by appointment only.
description: 阿拉山口边境旅游区位于新疆博尔塔拉。游览特色包括边境口岸。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At the port on the edge of Alashankou city, about 80 km by road north-east of Bole; visits to the national gate must be booked in advance, and the border inspection station checks visitors' details.

name: 博尔塔拉河旅游区
summaryEn: The scenic area strings together three landscaped river belts in the middle of Bole, the Bohe, Kaiping and Qinghe belts, about 4.8 km long in all and linking the old town in the north with the new town in the south. The Bohe belt, centred on Jinshui Bridge, has lakeside parkland including a Swan Lake zone, the Kaiping belt has a lake park with an evening water show, and the Qinghe belt has an ice rink and the Beijing Road night market.
description: 博尔塔拉河旅游区位于新疆博尔塔拉。游览特色包括湖泊、历史街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Bole city along the Bortala River; walk or take a taxi from the centre.

name: 鄂托克赛尔天泉
summaryEn: Etuokesai'er Tianquan ('heavenly spring'), also known as Xiao Wenquan, is a hot spring high in the Etuokesai'er River valley at about 2,650 m, and one of Wenquan County's three noted hot springs. The scenic area also takes in the river valley, the Narensala waterfall about 12 km west of the spring and the Daban glacier, with meadows where herds of horses graze. A resort complex has been under development at the spring since the early 2020s.
description: 鄂托克赛尔天泉位于新疆博尔塔拉。游览特色包括温泉、瀑布、冰川。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Etuokesai'er valley in the mountains south-west of Wenquan county town, reached by road. It lies in a border area, so a border-area permit (边境通行证) is needed as well as a passport; check the current rules before travelling.

name: 木特塔尔沙漠
summaryEn: A desert scenic area of sand dunes in Tuotuo town, Jinghe County, which held its first desert culture festival in 2018. Activities include off-road vehicles and sand motorbikes, a big-tyre dune vehicle and a dune-climbing challenge.
description: 木特塔尔沙漠位于新疆博尔塔拉。游览特色包括沙漠、节庆文化。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Tuotuo town, Jinghe County, reached by road from Jinghe county town.

name: 圣泉
summaryEn: Shengquan ('holy spring') is Wenquan County's best-known hot spring, used for about a century and the site of a sanatorium from 1954, now a spa complex in the county town with public pools, an outdoor bath, saunas and a hotel. The water is about 48–50 °C in summer and 41–42 °C in winter, and the Wenquan wetland and birch woods lie opposite.
description: 圣泉位于新疆博尔塔拉。游览特色包括温泉、湿地。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Wenquan county town, a little over an hour (about 80 km) by road west of Bole.

name: 温泉河谷林
summaryEn: A riverside forest scenic area built in 2019 on the Bortala River just north of Wenquan county town, laid out around a 36 km greenway through marsh, sea-buckthorn scrub and woods of poplar and willow. It has a visitor centre, a tree-house and photo spots, and the greenway has hosted half-marathons. A neighbouring village runs farm restaurants and guesthouses.
description: 温泉河谷林位于新疆博尔塔拉。游览特色包括温泉、滨水景观、绿道骑行。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Just north of Wenquan county town, about 90 km by road west of Bole.

name: 世纪园
summaryEn: A large landscaped public park in Hutubi county town, used by local people for walks and for festivals such as the Lantern Festival light displays. It suits a short stop on the way to the Kangjiashimenzi rock carvings in the county's southern hills.
description: 世纪园位于新疆昌吉。游览特色包括城市公园、节庆文化。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: In Hutubi town, roughly an hour by road west of Ürümqi.

name: 杜氏旅游
summaryEn: A leisure resort north-east of Changji city that grew from a farm guesthouse opened in 1997 into a large complex of orchards, amusement rides, a water park and restaurants. It is aimed at families and day-trippers from Ürümqi and Changji, with fruit picking in season.
description: 杜氏旅游位于新疆昌吉。游览特色包括水上游乐、果园、休闲度假。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Liugong town, north-east of Changji city, about 45 minutes by road from Ürümqi.

name: 华兴悠游谷
summaryEn: A leisure park in the Changji National Agricultural Science and Technology Park north of Changji city, combining a winery, a small animal park, flower nurseries and an outdoor activity camp. It holds seasonal events such as Dragon Boat Festival activities and suits families looking for a short outing from Ürümqi or Changji.
description: 华兴悠游谷位于新疆昌吉。游览特色包括葡萄酒文化、动物观赏、节庆文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 24 km north of central Changji, roughly an hour by road from central Ürümqi.

name: 吉木萨尔千佛洞
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple and cave shrine near Jimsar town, rebuilt in the Qing dynasty and restored since 1993, now set in a temple park with halls to Kshitigarbha and Guanyin and a main Buddha hall. It holds temple fairs on Buddhist festival days, with prayer ceremonies, local opera and food stalls.
description: 吉木萨尔千佛洞位于新疆昌吉。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、洞穴、佛教文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: A few kilometres from the centre of Jimsar town, about 2 hours by road east of Ürümqi.

name: 庭州生态绿谷
summaryEn: A riverside park about 13 km long on the Toutun River at the boundary between Changji and Ürümqi, created by a five-year clean-up, completed in 2021, of a valley once scarred by gravel pits and workshops. On the west bank Changji's green valley links five themed parks, from nature-restoration ponds and sports grounds to an industrial-heritage park, while the east bank holds the Bingtuan 12th Division's Toutun valley forest park. Footpaths run along the water, where ruddy shelducks and other water birds can be seen.
description: 庭州生态绿谷位于新疆昌吉。游览特色包括山谷、滨水景观、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the eastern edge of Changji city, about 30 minutes by road from central Ürümqi.

name: 新疆农业博览园
summaryEn: A large agricultural showground and garden at the core of the Changji National Agricultural Science and Technology Park, with exhibition areas, glasshouses of tropical plants and fruit, and fields for picking fruit and vegetables. It holds flower shows and seasonal festivals and suits families and anyone curious about farming in Xinjiang.
description: 新疆农业博览园位于新疆昌吉。游览特色包括田园观光、园林景观、农业体验。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north-eastern outskirts of Changji city, about 40 minutes by road from central Ürümqi.

name: 中华碧玉园
summaryEn: A large commercial complex in Manas town built in the 2010s around the trade in Manas green jade (biyu), with a jade and stone market, shops, restaurants and a sports centre. It hosts the county's jade culture festival and mainly suits visitors interested in looking at or buying nephrite.
description: 中华碧玉园位于新疆昌吉。游览特色包括节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Manas town, roughly 2 hours by road west of Ürümqi.

name: 哈密东天山
summaryEn: This mountain scenic area north of Hami links four spots in the eastern Tian Shan: Mingsha Shan, a singing sand dune; the alpine meadows of Baishitou, named after a lone white boulder; Songshutang, cool in summer and snowy in winter; and Tianshan Temple, a viewpoint whose temple is said to date back to the Tang. A scenic road climbs through belts of Tian Shan spruce and Siberian larch, so a single drive passes from desert to snowy peaks.
description: 哈密东天山位于新疆哈密。游览特色包括沙漠、寺庙建筑。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: On the Tianshan scenic road about 90 km by road north of Hami city towards Barkol, roughly an hour and a half's drive; a car is needed. Check that it is open before going.

name: 高家湖湿地
summaryEn: Gaojiahu is a spring-fed wetland of ponds, marsh and winding streams on the Barkol grassland, listed among China's important wetlands and home to water birds, with the snowy Tian Shan as a backdrop. Boardwalks cross the meadows and visitors can boat and fish, and the area has a visitor centre, a waterside restaurant, a glass water slide, star-gazing cabins and about thirty farm stays.
description: 高家湖湿地位于新疆哈密。游览特色包括湿地、草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Shirenzi township about 17 km east of Barkol county town; go by car. Check that it is open before going.

name: 哈密雅丹大海道
summaryEn: South-west of Hami, wind has carved the Gobi into a vast field of yardangs, ridges and mesas of clay and sandstone in shapes given names such as the Starship and the Horse's Head, along the line of the Dahaidao, an ancient short cut between Turpan and Dunhuang. The area is also where the fossil pterosaur Hamipterus was found, and in September 2026 it was inaugurated as the Hami Pterosaur–Yardang National Geopark, with the new Hami Pterosaur Museum inside. The museum's six oval halls display pterosaur skeletons and fossil eggs and embryos.
description: 哈密雅丹大海道位于新疆哈密。游览特色包括地质景观、化石遗迹、砂岩地貌。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the Gobi west and south-west of Hami city; the north gate is about 80 km from the city by road, and a full day with a hired car and driver is advisable.

name: 哈密市博物馆
summaryEn: The Hami Museum, a national first-grade museum, holds the main collection of the Hami region, with stone tools, bronzes, painted pottery, woodwork, woollen textiles and naturally preserved mummies from prehistory to the Ming and Qing. The permanent display on ancient Hami highlights finds from the Yanbulaq cemetery and the Dongheigou site, the mummies from the Wubao cemetery are among its highlights, and a second gallery covers the region's geology. The same complex, the Hami Cultural Heritage Institute, also has an exhibition on the region's music, dance, crafts, food and festivals.
description: 哈密市博物馆位于新疆哈密。游览特色包括博物馆、国家一级博物馆。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Huancheng Road in Hami city, opposite the Hami Kings' Mausoleum; closed on Mondays except national holidays.

name: 伊吾胡杨林
summaryEn: A large forest of desert poplar (Populus euphratica) on the edge of the Naomaohu basin in Yiwu County, run as a national desert park and scenic area since 2004. A route of about 23 km leads past gnarled old trees, an area of ancient root forms and viewpoints such as Bow Mountain. It is also promoted as a base for star-gazing and drone photography.
description: 伊吾胡杨林位于新疆哈密。游览特色包括沙漠、林地风光、古树。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 10 to 15 km from Naomaohu town in Yiwu County, far to the north-east of Hami city; a car and driver are needed. It lies in a border area, so a border-area permit (边境通行证) is needed as well as a passport; check the current rules before travelling.

name: 和田博物馆
summaryEn: The prefecture's main museum, which opened in its present form in May 2020. Its seven halls trace the history of Hotan, an oasis on the southern Silk Road and the seat of the Buddhist kingdom of Khotan, using models, holograms and animation alongside excavated objects, and include a hall devoted to the Niya site. Finds from desert sites that are hard to visit can be seen here.
description: 和田博物馆位于新疆和田。游览特色包括博物馆、沙漠。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On Kunlun South Road in the south of Hotan city.

name: 库尔班·吐鲁木纪念馆
summaryEn: A memorial hall in the home village of Kurban Tulum, the Uyghur farmer known as 'Uncle Kurban', built in 2003 and enlarged several times since. After receiving land in the early 1950s he set out to thank Mao Zedong in person, and in 1958 he met Mao in Beijing with a Xinjiang farmers' delegation, a story later retold in songs and a film. The hall is on the national list of classic red-tourism sites and tells his life through displays and sculpted scenes.
description: 库尔班·吐鲁木纪念馆位于新疆和田。游览特色包括纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tuogerigazi township, about 20 minutes by road west of Yutian town.

name: 拉里昆国家湿地公园
summaryEn: Lakes and reed beds about 20 km north-west of Moyu town, where the oasis farmland meets the desert, designated a national wetland park in 2012. Visitors take boat trips through the waterways and watch the water birds.
description: 拉里昆国家湿地公园位于新疆和田。游览特色包括湿地、沙漠。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 20 km north-west of Moyu town, roughly 1–1.5 hours by road from Hotan.

name: 龙湖
summaryEn: A reed-fringed lake on the edge of the Taklamakan near Xiwule township, reached through a belt of desert poplar woodland west of Yutian town. Developed as a scenic area since 2016, it has a pier, viewing platforms, a small science museum and the former home of Kurban Tulum. Fish were released into the lake in 2024 and 2025 to keep the water clear, and more water birds now winter here.
description: 龙湖位于新疆和田。游览特色包括博物馆、沙漠、湖泊。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 30 km by road west of Yutian town, turning off at Xiwule township.

name: 墨玉老城
summaryEn: The old quarter of Moyu (Karakax) county town, rated a 4A scenic area in 2020. Its square and streets host festivals and craft displays, including a regional intangible-heritage exhibition in 2025, and an experience hall introduces traditional herbal medicine beside a large riverside mural of a healer.
description: 墨玉老城位于新疆和田。游览特色包括滨水景观、节庆文化、历史街区。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Moyu town, about half an hour by road north-west of Hotan.

name: 和田团城
summaryEn: A renovated old quarter of Hotan city around Gezi Xiang (Pigeon Lane), where traditional Uyghur courtyard houses with aiwan halls have been kept and the lanes turned into a garden-like district of homes, workshops, cafés and restaurants. It was named a national tourism and leisure block in 2023 and is liveliest in the evening, when music restaurants, book cafés and street performers open up around its public square.
description: 和田团城位于新疆和田。游览特色包括园林景观、传统民居、历史街区。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In central Hotan city, off Beijing East Road.

name: 乌鲁瓦提
summaryEn: A large mountain reservoir at the point where the Karakax River leaves the Kunlun Mountains, formed by the Wuluwati dam, which was built between 1993 and 2001 for irrigation, flood control and hydropower. The scenic area around the lake is visited mainly for boat trips on the water and for the Kunlun setting.
description: 乌鲁瓦提位于新疆和田。游览特色包括湖泊、水库。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Langru township in the Kunlun foothills south-west of Hotan, roughly 1–1.5 hours by road from Hotan city.

name: 新疆昆仑山景区
summaryEn: A large mountain scenic area in the central Kunlun above Ulughsay township, south of Qira, covering more than 596 km² of high grassland, valleys and snow peaks; it grew out of the Banlange summer pasture and was rated 4A in 2021 as 'Kunlun Shengjing'. Herds graze the meadows below the snow line, shuttle buses run up to viewpoints such as Diru Peak, and Kunlun-culture displays add to the scenery. It was named a national adventure-tourism scenic area in 2023 and passed the landscape assessment for 5A status in 2024.
description: 新疆昆仑山景区位于新疆和田。游览特色包括草原、山地游览、高山景观。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In Ulughsay township in the Kunlun foothills, about 115 km by road south of Qira (Cele) town, roughly 2.5–3 hours.

name: 玉龙湾沙漠乐园
summaryEn: A desert recreation area in Duolu township on the edge of the Taklamakan, where visitors slide down the dunes and try other sand activities, and school groups learn about the shelter belts planted to hold back the sand. It was rated 4A in 2024 and has been a stop on the Taklimakan Rally.
description: 玉龙湾沙漠乐园位于新疆和田。游览特色包括沙漠。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Duolu township, Lop County, roughly 40 minutes by road east of Hotan.

name: 阿克塔斯姑娘峰
summaryEn: Upland grassland on the Aktas pastures north-west of Tekes, a 'sky grassland' of flower meadows in early summer, with primulas and globeflowers, and forest edges below snow peaks. The scenic area has boardwalks, wooden cabins and viewing decks, riding and cycling routes, and in winter snowmobiles, horse-drawn sledges and traditional horseback games.
description: 阿克塔斯姑娘峰位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括草原、林地风光、高山景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the hills north-west of Tekes town, under an hour by road.

name: 中华福寿山
summaryEn: Hills of wild fruit forest in Daxigou township, Huocheng County, where some 60 kinds of wild fruit tree grow, mainly wild apple, wild cherry plum, apricot and hawthorn; the wild cherry plum here is its only natural population in China. The slopes are white and pink with blossom in April, when a mountain-flower festival is held, and turn red and gold in autumn.
description: 中华福寿山位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括林地风光、节庆文化、赏花。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Daxigou township, about 40 km north of Huocheng town by road.

name: 灯塔知青馆
summaryEn: A museum opened in 2014 at the former Dengta pasture near Zhaosu, where more than 80 educated youths from Beijing and Shanghai were sent to live and work in the 1970s under the 'up to the mountains and down to the countryside' movement. Photographs, documents and everyday objects in and around the old camp buildings show their work and daily life. The camp is a regional protected heritage site and the museum was the first in Xinjiang on this theme.
description: 灯塔知青馆位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留1 小时游览。
accessEn: In Tugeleqin village about 7 km from Zhaosu town.

name: 野核桃沟
summaryEn: A valley in the hills near Gongliu town that shelters a rare natural stand of wild walnut trees, a relict species from the Tertiary period, within a scenic area of about 12 km². More than 350 rare plant and animal species have been recorded, and an exhibition hall on the wild walnut forest serves school and family groups.
description: 野核桃沟位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括山谷、林地风光、主题展览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 15 km south of Gongliu town by road.

name: 果子沟
summaryEn: A winding gorge about 32 km long through the northern Tianshan, named for the wild fruit forests on its slopes and long the main route from Sayram Lake down into the Ili valley, once a branch of the northern Silk Road. The G30 expressway crosses it on the Guozigou Bridge, now a sight in its own right, and the snow peaks, spruce woods and roadside viewpoints make it a regular stop on the drive between Ürümqi and Yining.
description: 果子沟，位于中华人民共和国新疆维吾尔自治区伊犁哈萨克自治州霍城县境内的一条河流，伊犁河右岸支流，因沟内广布大片野果林而得名。发源于博罗科努山东段南麓，蜿蜒自东北向西南流，于果子沟牧场出山口。出山口处建有果子沟引水枢纽。
accessEn: On the G30 expressway and G312 between Sayram Lake and Huocheng, about 1.5 hours by road north of Yining.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 惠远古城
summaryEn: Huiyuan was founded in 1763 as the seat of the Qing General of Ili, the highest military and civil official in Xinjiang, and remained the region's chief city until Xinjiang became a province; after the old city was ruined in the 1860s and 1870s, a new town was built in 1882–93 about 7.5 km to the north. The new town keeps its bell and drum tower, a three-storey timber pavilion on a brick platform at the central crossroads, and the restored office compound of the Ili General, with exhibition halls on the generals' rule, a Confucian temple and other Qing yamen buildings. Two stretches of the old city's rammed-earth wall, each over 800 m long, survive in fields near the Ili River.
description: 惠远古城位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括古城、全国重点文物保护单位。图集建议预留半天游览。
highlights: 全国重点文物保护单位
accessEn: In Huiyuan town, Huocheng County, about 40 km west of Yining; the old city walls lie about 7.5 km to the south.

name: 伊犁老城
summaryEn: The old quarter of Yining, about 3.5 km² of lanes with more than 300 traditional buildings and many courtyard houses in blue and white, where about 120,000 people still live. Visitors tour by horse-drawn cart or electric buggy, with home visits, craft workshops, song-and-dance shows and flocks of pigeons over the rooftops, and the Shaanxi Great Mosque stands inside the area. Long known as the Kazanqi Folk Tourism Area, it was renamed the Ili Old Town Cultural Tourism Area in 2024–25 as part of a bid for 5A status.
description: 伊犁老城位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括传统民居、手工艺、宗教建筑。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the south-east of central Yining, within walking distance of the centre.

name: 伊犁河风景区
summaryEn: A riverside park along the Ili River on the southern edge of Yining, popular with locals on summer evenings and for watching the sunset over the water. It has riverside paths and viewpoints, a campsite and space for open-air weddings, and has hosted a dragon-boat race at the Dragon Boat Festival.
description: 伊犁河风景区位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括滨水景观、节庆文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the Ili River at the southern edge of Yining, around 15 minutes by taxi from the city centre.

name: 锦绣园
summaryEn: A landscaped park in the city of Kuytun, developed around the North Xinjiang Botanical Garden and used by local people for walks and open-air performances. The prefecture's 2022 plan lists old-style, Buddhist-culture and amusement areas among its projects there.
description: 锦绣园位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括植物园、园林景观、佛教文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In the city of Kuytun, a short taxi ride from the centre.

name: 霍尔果斯中哈国际文化旅游区
summaryEn: A tourist zone at the Khorgos land port made up of the Chinese part of the China–Kazakhstan Horgos International Border Cooperation Centre, a cross-border trade zone set up under a 2005 agreement, and the National Gate area with an exhibition hall on the history of the crossing. Inside the cooperation centre visitors can walk through the passage linking the Chinese and Kazakh sectors, shop in duty-free malls on both sides and visit the China Culture Hall, while beside the gate are a Central Asian-style street and a 108 m sightseeing tower.
description: 霍尔果斯中哈国际文化旅游区位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括主题展览、边境口岸、购物街区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Khorgos city, about 90 km west of Yining; entry to the cooperation centre needs a pass issued at its pass office, so carry your passport.

name: 六星街
summaryEn: A residential quarter of Yining laid out from 1935 on a six-pointed street plan, with lanes radiating from a central square through six wedge-shaped blocks of blue, green, orange and purple-painted houses and courtyards. Renovated from 2009 and named a historic and cultural district by the regional government in 2010, it is now full of guesthouses, cafés, craft shops and small museums, including an accordion hall, while residents of several ethnic groups still live there. Locals often dance to live music in the square on summer evenings.
description: 六星街位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括博物馆。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In north-western central Yining, a short taxi ride or a walk from the city centre.

name: 那拉提国家湿地公园
summaryEn: Reed beds, rivers, marshes and lakes in Xiaoerbulake town, Xinyuan County, a national wetland park since 2019 on a migration route for birds. Boardwalks, viewing platforms and boat trips lead through the reeds, and a scientific survey reported in 2024 found here the largest breeding colony of glossy ibis known in China.
description: 那拉提国家湿地公园位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括湿地、乘船游览、观景台。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xiaoerbulake town about 45 km west of Xinyuan town, near the G218 and G578 roads.

name: 湿地古杨
summaryEn: Riverside woodland of old poplars and Tianshan birch along the Kash River just west of Nilka town, part of a belt of poplar forest that follows the river for about 110 km and a national wetland park since 2014. Boardwalks lead through the trees, where squirrels, foxes and pheasants may be seen, and a rafting stretch of about 2 km runs in summer.
description: 湿地古杨位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括湿地、滨水景观、林地风光。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 2 km west of Nilka town.

name: 解忧公主薰衣草园
summaryEn: A lavender park in Qingshuihe town, Huocheng County, set up to show the whole lavender industry, from nurseries and fields to oil distilling and product displays. Huocheng is one of China's main lavender-growing areas, and the fields are in flower in June, the garden's busiest time. It takes its name from Princess Jieyou, a Han-dynasty princess sent to marry into the Wusun, whose lands lay in this region.
description: 解忧公主薰衣草园位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括园林景观。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Qingshuihe town on the G218, about 60 km by road north-west of Yining.

name: 唐布拉草原
summaryEn: A chain of grassland, spruce forest and hot springs strung along the upper Kash River valley for more than 50 km in eastern Nilka County, often called the 'hundred-li gallery'. Some 113 side valleys open off the main valley, and the area is a national forest park popular with photographers and summer visitors. The name is explained locally as meaning 'seal' or 'imprint'.
description: 唐布拉草原位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括温泉、森林公园、草原。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: Along the S315 road in eastern Nilka County, about 1.5–2 hours by road east of Nilka town towards Qiaoerma and the Duku Highway.

name: 特克斯八卦城
summaryEn: The county town of Tekes, laid out on a radial plan modelled on the eight trigrams (bagua) of the Book of Changes: from the Taiji altar at the centre, streets run outwards across four ring roads, 64 streets in all over about 8 km². The town was listed as a national historical and cultural city in 2007, and its centre is a 4A scenic area with a visitor centre and a night-time leisure district.
description: 特克斯县城采用放射状街道布局，从中心向外延伸的街巷取意《易经》八卦。
accessEn: Tekes town, about two hours by road south-east of Yining.

name: 天山花海
summaryEn: An agri-tourism park developed since 2017 on former gravel desert in Kashi town, Yining County, covering about 46 km² of lavender, flower fields and orchards. Apricot blossom in spring, lavender in summer (now extended into autumn by late-flowering techniques) and fruit picking in autumn are the main draws, with campervan pitches, cabins and a lavender-oil distillery on site. It suits photographers and families rather than travellers looking for wild landscape.
description: 天山花海位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括沙漠、田园观光、果园。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Kashi town, Yining County, about an hour by road east of Yining city.

name: 图开沙漠
summaryEn: An area of mostly fixed and semi-fixed sand dunes beside the Ili River south-west of Huocheng town, described locally as the only desert inside an oasis in Xinjiang. Since 2021 it has been run as an amusement complex, Tukai Desert Happy World, with a desert water park, camel rides, dune buggies, ATVs and go-karts, and a staged song-and-dance show on the Han princess Jieyou.
description: 图开沙漠位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括沙漠、水上游乐、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 7 km south-west of Huocheng town.

name: 托乎拉苏草原
summaryEn: Rolling hill grassland on the southern side of the Keguqin range of the western Tianshan, north of Yining County town, with spruce, streams and summer herds below snow peaks. The Kazakh name is explained locally as 'keep going and you arrive over the mountain', after an old herders' route between Jinghe and Yining that crosses the grassland. Sights include an apricot-blossom valley and Wuxifu Gou, a long forested canyon.
description: 托乎拉苏草原位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括峡谷、草原。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the Keguqin hills about 40 km north-east of Yining city in a straight line, reached by road through Yining County.

name: 肖尔布拉克酒文化小镇
summaryEn: A distillery town in Xinyuan County built around a large baijiu works, where visitors can see the Western Regions Liquor Culture Museum, a liquor street, a sauce-aroma baijiu workshop and a yard of decorated earthenware storage jars. It is a factory-tour stop on the main road between Yining and Nalati and a regional industrial-tourism site.
description: 肖尔布拉克酒文化小镇位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括博物馆、酿造文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Xiaoerbulake town about 30 km west of Xinyuan town, just off the G218.

name: 夏塔
summaryEn: The mouth of the Xiata valley on the north side of the Tianshan, with spruce forest, meadows and river valleys below the Muzart glacier and snow peaks. It is the northern end of the Xiata ancient road, a 120 km route across the mountains to Wensu County in the Aksu region that has long drawn experienced trekkers. Roads, parking and a shopping street were upgraded in 2024.
description: 夏塔位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括冰川、山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 70 km south-west of Zhaosu town, roughly an hour by road, with scenic-area buses inside; trekkers should check current rules before attempting the ancient road.

name: 天马旅游文化园
summaryEn: An equestrian park at the Zhaosu horse farm, in the heartland of Ili horse breeding, with a national-standard racecourse, grandstands, an indoor equestrian hall and stables. It hosts horse races through the season and the Celestial Horse (Tianma) Festival, held in early summer, with horse shows and performances.
description: 天马旅游文化园位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括节庆文化。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: At the Zhaosu horse farm, about 15 km south-west of Zhaosu town.

name: 昭苏玉湖
summaryEn: A glacier-fed lake dammed high in the Aheyazi valley of the Tianshan, whose milky blue-green colour, given by fine rock flour from the glaciers, shifts with the light. A one-way road up the valley leads to the Yujing Tianfeng viewpoint above the lake, and the woods around it turn gold from mid-September to early October.
description: 昭苏玉湖位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括湖泊、冰川。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 50 km south of Zhaosu town and an hour's drive from the Xiata scenic area; there is no public bus, so drive or hire a car.

name: 昭苏湿地公园
summaryEn: Wetland and meadow along the upper Tekes River and its tributaries south of Zhaosu town, where some 90 bird species have been recorded, including demoiselle and common cranes, whooper swans and great bustards. On summer evenings herds of horses are driven through the river for a staged show, 'Celestial Horses Bathing in the River', watched from a viewing platform.
description: 昭苏湿地公园位于新疆伊犁。游览特色包括湿地、观景台。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside the S313 road about 25 km south-west of Zhaosu town.

name: 独山子大峡谷
summaryEn: The Dushanzi Grand Canyon is a section of the gorge, about 200 m deep, that the meltwater-fed Kuytun River has cut through the gravel foothills of the Tian Shan south of Dushanzi. Walkways along the rim look down on walls scored with grey-black gullies and, from July to September, on meltwater channels braiding across the flat floor; the canyon has also been used as a film location. It lies near the start of the Duku Highway, the mountain road across the Tian Shan to Kuqa.
description: 独山子大峡谷位于新疆克拉玛依。游览特色包括峡谷。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 25 km south of Dushanzi along the Duku Highway; go by car. Check that it is open before going.

name: 黑油山
summaryEn: Heiyoushan, 'Black Oil Mountain', is a low mound of natural asphalt just outside the city centre, formed over ages as crude oil seeped to the surface and set with the sand; Karamay, Uyghur for 'black oil', is named after it. Some 36 oil springs still bubble on the hill, twelve of them ringed with stone into little pools, and at one, the 'jumping spring', bubbles rise faster when visitors jump beside it.
description: 克拉玛依城边的黑油山由原油长期渗出、凝聚形成，是观察天然沥青地貌的地点。
accessEn: About 2 km north-east of central Karamay, a short taxi ride.

name: 克拉玛依河
summaryEn: The Karamay River is a canal-fed waterway, opened in 2000, that brings water from the Irtysh diversion scheme right across the oil city to a reservoir on its south-western edge. Riverside parks and promenades run its whole length from Jiulongtan, a pool framed by traditional-style buildings at its head, under a string of footbridges and road bridges, making it the city's main leisure area.
description: 克拉玛依河长8.5公里，位于新疆维吾尔自治区克拉玛依市克拉玛依区，是引额济克工程西干渠进入克拉玛依市区的名字。河流总体呈从东北至西南流向，从东北部的仿古建筑九龙潭起始，经过两座大型公园以及多座桥梁，穿越整个城区，流到西南方的阿依库勒水库，沿河也成为市区最重要的休闲娱乐公园。
accessEn: Jiulongtan, at the river's head, is in the north-east of central Karamay, and the river can be followed on foot through the city.
descriptionCredit: 中文维基百科贡献者 · CC BY-SA 4.0

name: 巴楚红海
summaryEn: A large leisure area 12 km from Bachu county town that links a folk-culture village, a stretch of the old Silk Road route along the Kashgar River, Golden Poplar Island in the desert-poplar woods, the Red Sea Bay water park and wetlands. Developed since 2009, it has a core area of about 80 km² joined up by a 38 km touring loop.
description: 巴楚红海位于新疆喀什。游览特色包括湿地、沙漠。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Anakule (Honghai) township about 12 km from Bachu county town, which is roughly 3 hours by road east of Kashgar.

name: 达瓦昆沙漠
summaryEn: A desert scenic area on the western edge of the Taklamakan beside the Yarkand River in Yopurga County, where a lake lies among the sand dunes beneath the distant Kunlun range. Open since 2002, it offers camel rides, dune rides in off-road vehicles, sand sliding and water activities, with staged song-and-dance shows and an avenue of desert poplars at the entrance. It has been named a national water-conservancy scenic area and a national desert park, and lies about 100 km from Kashgar.
description: 达瓦昆沙漠位于新疆喀什。游览特色包括沙漠、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Yopurga County, roughly 1.5–2 hours by road south-east of Kashgar.

name: 刀郎画乡
summaryEn: A village of Dolan farmer painters in Kumkusar township just south of Markit, twice named a national folk-art village by the Ministry of Culture, whose painters have exhibited their work in China and abroad. The scenic area has galleries of farmer paintings, a gourd-painting hall, a hall of traditional musical instruments, a memorial hall on Taklamakan exploration and a square for Dolan song and dance, and visitors can often watch painters at work and buy their pictures. Dolan farmer painting was added to the county's intangible heritage list in 2021.
description: 刀郎画乡位于新疆喀什。游览特色包括纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Kumkusar township about 7 km south of Markit county town, which is roughly 2–2.5 hours by road from Kashgar.

name: 城中胡杨生态园
summaryEn: An ecological park on the north-western side of Jiashi county town, opened in 2019 and planned over about 1,050 mu around a stand of desert poplars linked by waterways. Paths lead through the poplar woodland, flower beds and waterside areas, and there are fairground rides such as a pirate ship and a rainbow slide, speedboats, a poplar night market and a camping area. It works mainly as a town park, with local people making up about half its visitors, and makes a short stop on the road between Kashgar and Aksu.
description: 城中胡杨生态园位于新疆喀什。游览特色包括沙漠、林地风光。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the north-western side of Jiashi county town, about an hour by road east of Kashgar.

name: 塔克拉玛干N39°沙漠
summaryEn: A desert activity area among the Taklamakan dunes in Markit County, used for a stage of the Taklimakan Rally; its name refers to the 39th parallel north. Modified four-wheel-drive vehicles take visitors along beginner, intermediate and advanced dune routes, and there are camel treks along the sand ridges, sand sliding, study tours on desert plants, stargazing and desert camping. A 2.5 km desert road, a large car park and two viewing platforms have been added in recent years.
description: 塔克拉玛干N39°沙漠位于新疆喀什。游览特色包括沙漠、观景台。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the desert about 30 km east of Markit county town, which is roughly 2–2.5 hours by road from Kashgar.

name: 花儿为什么这样红景区
summaryEn: A long, narrow river valley south-east of Tashkurgan promoted as the home of 'Why Are the Flowers So Red', the song from the 1963 film Visitors on the Icy Mountain that the composer Lei Zhenbang adapted from the Tajik folk song 'Guli Bita'. The 985 km² scenic area takes in the valley's villages and about 5,000 mu of natural woodland, and is known locally as a village of song and dance.
description: 花儿为什么这样红景区位于新疆喀什。游览特色包括山谷、林地风光。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In Bandier township south-east of Tashkurgan, about 55 km from the county town by road.

name: 莎车老城
summaryEn: The historic quarter of Yarkand (Shache), once the capital of the Yarkand Khanate, rated as a 4A scenic area in 2022. Its lanes include the Kazanchi old street, where coppersmiths and ironworkers make pots and other wares in open workshops among food stalls and shops selling farm produce, and visitors can try crafts such as Atlas silk tie-dyeing. Festival evenings and performances are staged in the old town, and the royal tombs and the Jame Mosque are close by.
description: 莎车老城位于新疆喀什。游览特色包括节庆文化、历史街区。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the centre of Yarkand (Shache), which is about 2.5 hours by road south-east of Kashgar.

name: 英吉沙南湖
summaryEn: A lakeside resort along the dam of a reservoir 5.5 km south of Yengisar town, inside a national wetland park. Along the shore are the Yengisar Knife Museum, devoted to the town's handmade knives, a bird science hall, a boat pier, a shopping street and a hotel, and it has been a regional study-tour base for school groups since 2021. It suits a stop for families or anyone interested in Yengisar knives on the road between Kashgar and Yarkand.
description: 英吉沙南湖位于新疆喀什。游览特色包括博物馆、湿地、水库。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: About 5.5 km south of Yengisar county town, which is about 1–1.5 hours by road south of Kashgar. Check that it is open before going.

name: 张骞丝路文化园
summaryEn: A park in Shule county town dedicated to Zhang Qian, the Han dynasty envoy to the Western Regions, centred on the Han-style Zhang Qian Memorial Hall and Shule Museum opened in 2010. Its galleries cover Zhang Qian's mission, finds from the ancient kingdom of Shule and local folk customs, using sculpture, reliefs, touch screens and projections. Two new venues opened at the end of 2025: the Kunlun Station Natural Science Museum, with about 1,400 animal specimens and models, and a nature-photography centre run under the Chinese National Geography brand.
description: 张骞丝路文化园位于新疆喀什。游览特色包括博物馆、纪念展览。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: In Shule county town, about 20 minutes by road south-east of central Kashgar.

name: 宗郎灵泉
summaryEn: A spring oasis at the foot of the Kunlun Mountains, where water trickles from cracks in a cliff above the east bank of the Ulukustang River into a round pool about 10 m across, shaded by four ancient willows. The 18 km² scenic area adds wetland meadows and riverside walks, and an upgrade in 2026 brought an evening water show, kart track, water games, open-air dining tents and short helicopter flights over the oasis. The name is a transliteration said to mean 'water with fish', with lingquan ('miraculous spring') added for the spring's reputation.
description: 宗郎灵泉位于新疆喀什。游览特色包括湿地、滨水景观。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 6 km from Zonglang township and 42 km from Yecheng county town, which is roughly 3–3.5 hours by road south-east of Kashgar.

name: 阿孜汗无花果风情小镇
summaryEn: A traditional Uyghur village in Songtak town just outside Artux, protected as a traditional village and opened to visitors around its fig orchards and Artux-style houses. A folk-culture street, four themed lanes and a shaved-ice shop run by the same family for three generations are among the sights, and figs can be picked in season.
description: 阿孜汗无花果风情小镇位于新疆克孜勒苏。游览特色包括果园、传统村落。图集建议预留2–3 小时游览。
accessEn: About 10 minutes by road from Artux city, or roughly 45 km from Kashgar on the G3012 expressway.

name: 克州冰川公园
summaryEn: A mountain valley west of Oytak town in Akto County, where glaciers come down from snow peaks to forest, meadows and waterfalls. Viewpoints take in the glacier, avalanche slopes, waterfalls and small lakes such as Feitian Lake, and the park is visited as a cool summer retreat.
description: 克州冰川公园位于新疆克孜勒苏。游览特色包括瀑布、湖泊、冰川。图集建议预留半天至一天游览。
accessEn: Off the China–Pakistan (Karakoram) Highway at Oytak, roughly 120 km and 2–2.5 hours by road south-west of Kashgar.

name: 可克达拉薰衣草文化产业园
summaryEn: A lavender park on the edge of Kokdala, the Bingtuan city of the 4th Division in the Ili valley, with lavender fields, a lavender science museum, a showroom for the park's lavender and fragrance products and a souvenir shop. The fields flower in summer, when the park is a popular photo stop and the lavender campground beside it, with water and charging points, fills with tents and camper vans; it suits a short stop on an Ili valley road trip.
description: 可克达拉薰衣草文化产业园位于新疆可克达拉。游览特色包括博物馆、科学科普、山谷。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the edge of Kokdala, about 30 km west of Yining and about 6 km south-east of Huiyuan Ancient City, best reached by car or taxi.

name: 沙海老兵红色旅游区
summaryEn: A red-tourism area in the 47th Regiment's town, Laobing ('veterans') Town, on the southern edge of the Taklamakan, built around the Memorial Hall of the PLA's March into Hotan. In December 1949 about 1,800 soldiers of a PLA regiment crossed the desert on foot, some 790 km in 18 days, to reach Hotan, and many then stayed to farm here; the hall tells the story with photographs, objects and multimedia, and a monument on the square in front is dated 22 December 1949. Smaller sites nearby include a veterans' household museum and a memorial garden, and the town has guesthouses and a canteen themed on the early settlers.
description: 沙海老兵红色旅游区位于新疆昆玉。游览特色包括沙漠、纪念展览。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Laobing Town, roughly 30 km north of Karakax (Moyu) county town and about an hour by road from Hotan.

name: 野果林
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area in the Wuerkaxiaer Mountains about 30 km south-east of Emin, where rock outcrops, woodland and waterfalls fill the valleys and the slopes flower in spring and summer. The lower ground is used for Kazakh folk events under Emin's 'home of Kazakh folk customs' banner, with farm-stay restaurants, sports grounds and water play, while the upper valleys are kept for scenery and walking. Its snow draws visitors in winter as well.
description: 野果林位于新疆塔城。游览特色包括瀑布、民俗文化、山地游览。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km south-east of Emin county town via provincial road S201 and county road X810.

name: 鹿角湾
summaryEn: A mountain scenic area of more than 19,000 ha on the north slope of the Tianshan south-west of Shawan, made up of Big and Little Lujiaowan between the Bayingou River on the west and the Danangou valley on the east. Its name, 'antler bay', comes from the antlers that the Tianshan red deer shed each year and leave in the gullies and beside the streams.
description: 鹿角湾位于新疆塔城。游览特色包括山谷、山地游览。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 69 km south-west of Shawan city on the north slope of the Tianshan, beside the Tianshan road.

name: 松海湾
summaryEn: A forested valley on the south slope of the Saier Mountains, also called the Haergatu White Pine Forest Park and known locally as Songshugou ('pine valley'), through which highway G219 climbs at around 1,800 m. Siberian larch and tall poplars cover the slopes, and at the top lie the Yukuqiaolong summit pastures and the small 'Love Lake', reached by a 1,314-step trail and circled by a 900 m boardwalk. The area also takes in Niushitou grassland and ancient remains including stone-mound tombs and so-called 'beard tombs'.
description: 松海湾位于新疆塔城。游览特色包括森林公园、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 30 km north-east of Hoboksar county town on highway G219.

name: 佛山国家森林公园
summaryEn: A national forest park of 39,000 ha in the Tianshan south of Wusu, made up of the Daifuseng, Bayingou and Wulansadeke areas of mountain forest, grassy slopes and river valleys. Its emblem is the 3,946 m Snow Buddha peak, likened to a giant natural Buddha, and it also has a sub-alpine botanical garden. Formerly Wusu's Nanshan park, it became a national forest park in 2008 and is a favourite summer outing for people from Wusu and nearby cities.
description: 佛山国家森林公园位于新疆塔城。游览特色包括森林公园、植物园。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: In the Tianshan about 60 km by road south of Wusu city, roughly an hour and a quarter's drive; Daifuseng is the most developed area.

name: 永安湖
summaryEn: A lake-and-desert recreation area on Yong'an Lake, part of the wetlands of the lower Yarkand River south of Tumxuk, where open water, reed beds, desert poplars, sand dunes and a bare mountain ridge lie side by side. The wetland reserve around the lake is a stopover for migrating birds, and visitors come for boat trips, autumn colours and desert sunsets. A desert activity area offers sand-motorbike rides and in winter becomes a snow park with a 300 m ski run.
description: 永安湖位于新疆图木舒克。游览特色包括湿地、沙漠、湖泊。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 25 km by road south of Tumxuk city, best reached by car or taxi.

name: 火山红酒庄
summaryEn: A modern winery and leisure resort in Turpan's Gaochang District, where visitors ride sightseeing carts round the estate. Its 3 km underground cellar has been turned into a gallery on the history of wine with tasting areas, the production hall is open as a factory tour, and the estate has a hotel built in the shape of oak wine barrels.
description: 火山红酒庄位于新疆吐鲁番。游览特色包括火山地貌、葡萄酒文化、休闲度假。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: In Gaochang District, about 8 km north-north-west of central Turpan; reach it by taxi or hired car. Check that it is open before going.

name: 坎儿井民俗园
summaryEn: A company-run park opened in 2000 on the West Gate karez, an old underground irrigation channel on the western edge of Turpan's old town. Visitors walk down to a stretch of the karez and its outlet, see a small karez museum, and can eat, shop and stay in the park's Uyghur-style hotel and guest rooms among the vines. The park also stages an outdoor song-and-dance show about the karez.
description: 坎儿井民俗园位于新疆吐鲁番。游览特色包括博物馆、民俗文化、灌溉工程。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the western edge of central Turpan, a short taxi ride from the city centre.

name: 楼兰酒庄
summaryEn: A working winery of the Turpan Loulan Winery company at Shuangshuimo in Shanshan County, rated as a 4A scenic area in 2023. Visitors can tour the estate and its wine museum, which presents the grape-growing and winemaking of the Turpan basin.
description: 楼兰酒庄位于新疆吐鲁番。游览特色包括博物馆、葡萄酒文化。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: At Shuangshuimo in Shanshan County, about 7 km east-north-east of Shanshan town; reach it by taxi or hired car from the town. Check that it is open before going.

name: 阿唛龙幻想乐园
summaryEn: An amusement park in the Ürümqi Economic and Technological Development Zone, on the western side of the city. It is a modern theme park for families with children rather than a sightseeing destination.
description: 阿唛龙幻想乐园位于新疆乌鲁木齐。游览特色包括主题游乐、游乐体验。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: In the development zone (Toutunhe District) about 16 km west of central Ürümqi, roughly 30 minutes by road. Check that it is open before going.

name: 白水涧古镇
summaryEn: A tourist town built in old style beside the Baiyang River gorge at Dabancheng, reopened in 2014 after older buildings on the site were refitted, with a mock-Tang city gate where a staged welcome dance is performed, a folk-custom street, craft workshops, inns and a wetland park. It has an art museum for the composer Wang Luobin, whose 1938 song 'The Girl from Dabancheng' is named after the town, and next to it stands the small Xiakou fort on a rocky knoll, presented as the ruins of a Tang post although excavation in 2016 dated it to the Qing dynasty. It makes an easy stop on the road between Ürümqi and Turpan.
description: 白水涧古镇位于新疆乌鲁木齐。游览特色包括博物馆、峡谷、古镇。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: Beside the Ürümqi–Turpan expressway at Dabancheng, about an hour by car from Ürümqi.

name: 红光山
summaryEn: A hill on the northern edge of central Ürümqi, between the Xinjiang International Convention and Exhibition Centre and the Olympic Sports Centre, crowned by the Hongguangshan Grand Buddha Temple, a Chinese Buddhist temple complex that opened to the public in 2021. A stairway lined with statues of the Buddha's ten disciples climbs to a large Buddha figure on a lotus platform.
description: 红光山位于新疆乌鲁木齐。游览特色包括寺庙建筑、佛教文化、莲花观赏。图集建议预留1–2 小时游览。
accessEn: On the northern edge of the city near the International Convention and Exhibition Centre, about 20 minutes by taxi from the centre.

name: 丝绸之路山地度假区
summaryEn: A ski and mountain resort on the northern slopes of the Tian Shan in Shuixigou town, Ürümqi County, also known as the Silk Road International Ski Resort. The ski season usually starts in mid-November and runs into March, and Pingxiliang village below the slopes has a cluster of guesthouses serving skiers.
description: 丝绸之路山地度假区位于新疆乌鲁木齐。游览特色包括滑雪。图集建议预留1 天游览。
accessEn: About 40 km south of central Ürümqi, roughly an hour by road.

name: 新疆天山野生动物园
summaryEn: A large wildlife park in Dabancheng District, south-east of Ürümqi, where a range of animals are kept in large enclosures. It is a common family day out from the city.
description: 新疆天山野生动物园位于新疆乌鲁木齐。游览特色包括动物观赏。图集建议预留半天游览。
accessEn: About 20 km south-east of central Ürümqi, roughly 40 minutes by road. Check that it is open before going.
